articles.title_zh: 中国建筑副总经理陈勇任上被查
articles.title_en: Chen Yong, Vice President of China State Construction, Put under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日，中国建筑集团有限公司党组成员、副总经理陈勇因涉嫌严重违纪违法，接受中央纪委国家监委纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 5, Chen Yong, Party member and vice president of CSCEC, is under investigation for suspected serious disciplinary and legal violations.

articles.title_zh: 中建集团党组：坚决拥护党中央决定
articles.title_en: China State Construction Group Party Group Firmly Supports CPC Central Committee Decision
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日，中建集团党组召开会议，通报中央纪委国家监委对党组成员、副总经理陈勇进行纪律审查和监察调查的决定，一致表示坚决拥护。
articles.summary_en: On September 5, the Party Group of China State Construction Group held a meeting to announce the decision by the CCDI and National Supervisory Commission to investigate Chen Yong, a member of the Party Group and deputy general manager, for suspected serious violations of discipline and law, and unanimously expressed firm support.

articles.title_zh: 能源大省山西求解煤与煤层气共采的“绿色方程式”
articles.title_en: Shanxi Tackles Green Equation of Coal and Coalbed Methane Co-mining
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，煤与煤层气共采创新发展论坛在山西举行，聚焦将煤矿瓦斯转化为清洁能源，实现安全与绿色双赢。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 4, the Coal and Coalbed Methane Co-mining Innovation Forum was held in Shanxi, focusing on converting coal mine gas into clean energy for dual wins in safety and green transition.

articles.title_zh: 中加举行第五次国防部工作会晤
articles.title_en: China, Canada Hold 5th Defense Ministry Working Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，中加第五次国防部工作会晤在加拿大举行，双方就国际和地区问题坦诚交换意见，表达加强两军务实合作意愿。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 4, the fifth China-Canada defense ministry working meeting was held in Canada. Both sides exchanged views on shared issues and expressed willingness to enhance military cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 应急管理部调度江西遂川泥石流灾害救援 派出工作组赶赴现场
articles.title_en: Ministry of Emergency Management Mobilizes Mudslide Rescue in Jiangxi's Suichuan, Sends Work Team to Scene
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日，江西遂川发生泥石流和山体滑坡。应急管理部立即调度部署抢险救援，启动四级应急响应并派工作组赴现场指导。
articles.summary_en: On September 5, a mudslide and landslide hit Suichuan, Jiangxi. The Ministry of Emergency Management activated a Level IV response and dispatched a work team to guide rescue operations.

articles.title_zh: 两部门针对福建提升国家自然灾害救助应急响应级别至三级
articles.title_en: Two Departments Upgrade National Disaster Relief Emergency Response to Level III in Fujian
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日，国家防减救灾委、应急管理部针对台风及强降雨对福建造成的严重影响，将国家自然灾害救助应急响应级别提升至三级，并派工作组赴灾区指导救助。
articles.summary_en: On September 5, two national departments upgraded the natural disaster relief emergency response to Level III in Fujian due to typhoon and extreme rainfall, sending a work team to guide local relief.

tags.name_en: National Commission for Disaster Prevention, Reduction and Relief

tags_en: National Commission for Disaster Prevention, Reduction and Relief

articles.title_zh: 近镜头｜两大文明跨越时空的双向奔赴
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan Tour Grand Egyptian Museum with Egyptian President Sisi
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月2日下午，国家主席习近平和夫人彭丽媛在埃及总统塞西夫妇陪同下参观大埃及博物馆，展现中埃文明互鉴。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 2 local time, President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan visited the Grand Egyptian Museum with Egyptian President Sisi and his wife, demonstrating mutual learning between the two civilizations.

articles.title_zh: 中国民政部：西藏吉隆泥石流灾害慈善捐赠超6.6亿元人民币
articles.title_en: Chinese Ministry of Civil Affairs: Charitable Donations for Tibet Gyirong Mudslide Disaster Exceed 660 Million Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日，民政部披露西藏吉隆泥石流灾害慈善捐赠已超6.6亿元，其中互联网捐款超5000万元；‘十四五’以来慈善捐款超200亿元。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 5, the Ministry of Civil Affairs said charitable donations for the Tibet Gyirong mudslide exceeded 660 million yuan, with over 50 million from online platforms; donations since the 14th Five-Year Plan exceed 20 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 不断发展壮大的“上合大家庭”众行致远
articles.title_en: Growing SCO Family Achieves More Together
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月1日，国家主席习近平在比什凯克出席上海合作组织成员国元首理事会第二十六次会议并发表题为《推动上海合作组织实现更高质量发展》的重要讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, 2026, President Xi Jinping attended the 26th SCO Heads of State Council meeting in Bishkek and delivered an important speech titled 'Promoting Higher-Quality Development of the SCO'.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”时期生育险、长护险、医保报销将有这些变化
articles.title_en: "15th Five-Year Plan" Period Will Bring Changes to Maternity Insurance, Long-term Care Insurance, and Medical Insurance Reimbursement
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，国务院新闻办举行发布会，国家医保局表示，“十五五”时期将完善生育保险、全面推行长期护理保险、推动医保报销目录全国统一等。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on Sept 4, the National Healthcare Security Administration outlined planned improvements to maternity insurance, long-term care insurance, and unified medical reimbursement during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致信祝贺《小喇叭》节目开播70周年
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter to 'Little Horn' Program on 70th Anniversary
articles.summary_zh: 在中央广播电视总台《小喇叭》节目开播70周年之际，习近平致信祝贺，强调落实立德树人根本任务，创作更多传播真善美的优秀作品。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter on the 70th anniversary of China Media Group's 'Little Horn' program, emphasizing moral education and creation of works spreading truth, goodness and beauty.

articles.title_zh: 我国将实施教师发展国家行动
articles.title_en: China to Launch National Action for Teacher Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，教育部召开新闻发布会，宣布将实施教师发展国家行动，重点在精神引领、培养质量、公平发展和关心关爱教师等方面发力。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 4, the Ministry of Education announced a national action plan for teacher development, focusing on spiritual guidance, training quality, equity, and teacher care.

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥会见俄罗斯总统普京并与俄方共同主持中俄双边机制性会议
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Meets Russian President Putin and Co-Chairs Bilateral Mechanism Meetings with Russian Side
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日至4日，国务院副总理丁薛祥在符拉迪沃斯托克会见俄罗斯总统普京，并同俄方共同主持中俄投资、能源合作委员会会议。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 2 to 4, Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang met with Russian President Putin in Vladivostok and co-chaired the China-Russia investment and energy cooperation committee meetings with the Russian side.

articles.title_zh: 促进数字化绿色化协同转型发展
articles.title_en: Seven Ministries Issue Plan for Digital-Green Coordinated Transformation
articles.summary_zh: 中央网信办等七部门联合印发《促进数字化绿色化协同转型发展实施方案（2026—2030年）》，明确“十五五”时期双化协同的目标和重点任务。
articles.summary_en: Seven government departments, led by the Cyberspace Administration of China, issued a plan to promote coordinated digital-green transformation (2026-2030), outlining goals and tasks for the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 李希在贵州调研时强调 深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想 抓深抓实全面从严治党和反腐败工作
articles.title_en: Li Xi Stresses Deeper Implementation of Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building and Intensified Anti-Corruption in Guizhou Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日至3日，中共中央政治局常委、中央纪委书记李希在贵州调研，强调纪检监察机关要深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想，抓深抓实全面从严治党和反腐败工作。
articles.summary_en: Li Xi, head of the CCDI, visited Guizhou from Sept 1 to 3, calling for deeper study of Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building and stronger anti-corruption efforts.

articles.title_zh: 公布修订后的《电力安全事故应急处置和调查处理条例》
articles.title_en: State Council Publishes Revised Regulations on Emergency Response and Investigation of Electric Power Safety Accidents
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强签署国务院令，公布修订后的《电力安全事故应急处置和调查处理条例》，自2027年1月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council order to promulgate the revised Regulations on Emergency Response and Investigation of Electric Power Safety Accidents, effective January 1, 2027.

articles.title_zh: 今年全总将支持建设600个全国劳模工匠创新工作室
articles.title_en: ACFTU to Support 600 National Model Worker Innovation Studios This Year
articles.summary_zh: 全国总工会近日印发通知，确定2026年支持建设600个全国劳模工匠创新工作室，每个给予10万元补助，以激发职工创新创造活力。
articles.summary_en: The All-China Federation of Trade Unions recently issued a notice to support the construction of 600 national model worker innovation studios in 2026, granting 100,000 yuan to each to boost workers' innovation vitality.

articles.title_zh: 岭南万物竞蓬勃——广东涵养经济生态助推高质量发展
articles.title_en: All Things Thrive in Lingnan: Guangdong Fosters Economic Ecosystem for High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 广东系统构建产业、科创、营商、内需、开放、就业、区域、人文八大经济生态，助推高质量发展；上半年GDP增长4.5%，进出口增长20.8%，区域创新能力连续九年全国第一。
articles.summary_en: Guangdong is fostering an eight-part economic ecosystem (industry, innovation, business climate, etc.) for high-quality development. H1 GDP grew 4.5%, foreign trade jumped 20.8%, and innovation capacity led China for nine years.

articles.title_zh: 赵俊民在迪庆州调研统战工作 强调扎实推进中华民族共同体建设
articles.title_en: Zhao Junmin Inspects United Front Work in Diqing, Emphasizing Ethnic Unity
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日至4日，云南省委常委赵俊民赴迪庆州调研统战工作，走访村寨、社区、企业等，强调铸牢中华民族共同体意识，推进民族团结进步和宗教和谐。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 2 to 4, Zhao Junmin, member of the Standing Committee of the Yunnan Provincial Party Committee, inspected united front work in Diqing, visiting villages, communities and enterprises, stressing consolidation of the Chinese national community consciousness.

articles.title_zh: 长春市召开开发区改革发展暨中国光电城项目建设推进大会
articles.title_en: Changchun Holds Conference on Development Zone Reform and Optoelectronic City Project
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，长春市召开开发区改革发展暨中国光电城项目建设推进大会，市委书记张恩惠出席并讲话，部署深化开发区改革、推进光电城建设，汇聚高质量发展合力。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Changchun held a conference on development zone reform and the China Optoelectronic City project. Party Secretary Zhang Enhui attended and delivered a speech, urging deeper reforms and high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 省人大常委会督办发展农村集体经济重点处理代表建议
articles.title_en: Provincial People's Congress Supervises Handling of Key Proposals on Rural Collective Economy
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，省人大常委会在南京召开发展农村集体经济重点处理代表建议督办会，副主任魏国强、副省长史志军出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, the Standing Committee of the Provincial People's Congress held a supervision meeting in Nanjing on key proposals for developing rural collective economy. Vice Chairman Wei Guoqiang and Vice Governor Shi Zhijun attended and delivered speeches.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林在阜新市调研防沙治沙工作时强调 高质量打好科尔沁沙地歼灭战 久久为功筑牢生态安全屏障
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Inspects Desertification Control in Fuxin, Stresses High-Quality Battle Against Horqin Sandy Land
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日至4日，辽宁省委书记许昆林在阜新市调研防沙治沙工作，强调高质量打好科尔沁沙地歼灭战，筑牢生态安全屏障，并查看彰武治沙成效和沙产业情况。
articles.summary_en: From September 3 to 4, Xu Kunlin, Secretary of the Liaoning Provincial Party Committee, visited Fuxin to inspect desertification control and emphasized winning the battle against the Horqin Sandy Land with high quality to consolidate the ecological security barrier.

articles.title_zh: 吉尔吉斯斯坦各界人士高度评价习近平主席国事访问
articles.title_en: Kyrgyz Officials and Scholars Hail President Xi Jinping's State Visit
articles.summary_zh: 近日，习近平主席对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问，两国元首签署永久睦邻友好合作条约，吉尔吉斯各界高度评价此访。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping paid a state visit to Kyrgyzstan, during which the two heads of state signed a treaty on everlasting good-neighborly friendship and cooperation. Kyrgyz officials and scholars highly praised the visit.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省第十六届运动会、第十二届残疾人运动会在定西开幕
articles.title_en: 16th Gansu Provincial Games and 12th Para Games Open in Dingxi
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日晚，甘肃省第十六届运动会、第十二届残疾人运动会在定西开幕，省委书记胡昌升宣布开幕，代省长孔绍逊致辞。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of September 4, the 16th Gansu Provincial Games and the 12th Para Games opened in Dingxi, with Provincial Party Secretary Hu Changsheng declaring the games open and Acting Governor Kong Shaoxun delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研推进食品安全工作
articles.title_en: City Leaders Promote Food Safety Through Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，淮安市市长顾坤赴淮安区、淮阴区、涟水县调研食品安全工作，实地察看学校食堂、食品企业、蔬菜园及网络餐饮街区，强调严格落实“四个最严”，筑牢食品安全防线。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Huai'an Mayor Gu Kun visited Huai'an, Huaiyin, and Lianshui to inspect food safety, emphasizing strict regulation to protect public health.

articles.title_zh: 市政府党组会议召开
articles.title_en: Taizhou Municipal Government Party Group Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，泰州市政府党组会议召开，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话指示精神和中央、省委部署，研究防汛和正确政绩观学习教育工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, the Taizhou Municipal Government Party Group met to convey and study Xi Jinping's recent speeches and instructions, and deploy flood prevention and correct view of political achievements education.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会会议暨市委理论学习中心组学习会召开
articles.title_en: Taizhou Municipal Party Standing Committee Meeting and Theoretical Study Session Held
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，泰州市委常委会暨理论学习中心组学习会召开，市委书记姜冬冬主持并讲话，学习习近平关于基层工作方法论述，研究部署当前重点工作及开发园区体制机制优化。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, the Taizhou Municipal Party Standing Committee held a meeting and theoretical study session chaired by Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong, studying Xi Jinping's remarks on grassroots work methods and discussing key tasks and development zone reform.

articles.title_zh: 第十期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”举行
articles.title_en: The 10th 'Frontier Lecture' for Leading Officials Held in Taizhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，泰州市举办第十期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”，邀请商汤科技董事长徐立作人工智能专题授课，市领导参加学习。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Taizhou held its 10th 'Frontier Lecture' for leading officials, inviting SenseTime CEO Xu Li to speak on AI, with municipal leaders attending.

articles.title_zh: 市委党的建设工作领导小组召开会议
articles.title_en: Municipal Party Committee Party Building Work Leading Group Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，市委书记姜冬冬主持召开市委党的建设工作领导小组会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记关于树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育的重要指示精神，研究部署巩固拓展学习教育成果工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Municipal Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong chaired a meeting of the Party Building Work Leading Group to study Xi Jinping's instructions on learning education for correct political achievements and deploy consolidation of achievements.

articles.title_zh: 总部迁入、利润再投，外资为何频频“重仓”江阴？
articles.title_en: Foreign Capital Keeps Betting Big on Jiangyin via HQ Relocations and Reinvested Profits
articles.summary_zh: 江阴市持续优化营商环境吸引外资，安姆科等外企将总部迁入或利润再投，今年以来实际使用外资达10.14亿美元。
articles.summary_en: Jiangyin has continued to optimize its business environment to attract foreign investment, with companies like Amcor relocating headquarters and reinvesting profits, bringing actual foreign investment to $1.014 billion so far this year.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开企业上市工作推进会
articles.title_en: Municipal Government Holds Work Conference on Corporate Listings
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，无锡市政府召开全市企业上市工作推进会，市长蒋锋出席并讲话，部署推动企业上市和上市企业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Wuxi Municipal Government held a city-wide work conference on corporate listings. Mayor Jiang Feng attended and delivered a speech, deploying efforts to promote high-quality development of listings and listed companies.

articles.title_zh: 李勇毅赴奋勇高新区、赤坎区调研督导并走访重点企业
articles.title_en: Li Yongyi Tours High-tech Zone and Chikan District for Research and Enterprise Visits
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，湛江市委副书记、市长李勇毅赴奋勇高新区、赤坎区调研督导，并走访东岛新能源等企业，强调优化营商环境、支持企业增资扩产。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 4, Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi visited the High-tech Zone and Chikan District to inspect work and tour key enterprises, calling for a better business environment and support for enterprise expansion.

articles.title_zh: 李勇毅赴雷州督导爱国卫生运动
articles.title_en: Li Yongyi Inspects Patriotic Health Campaign in Leizhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，湛江市长李勇毅深入雷州市镇村实地督导爱国卫生运动和蚊媒防控工作，强调严查卫生死角、清理蚊虫孳生地，压实基层防控责任。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi inspected towns and villages in Leizhou to supervise the Patriotic Health Campaign and mosquito vector control, urging thorough cleanup and grassroots responsibility.

articles.title_zh: 黄玉国主持召开六届市委常委会第一次会议
articles.title_en: Huang Yuguo Chairs First Meeting of 6th CPC Zhoukou Municipal Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，周口市委书记黄玉国主持召开六届市委常委会第一次会议，传达学习习近平总书记关于管党治党政治责任的重要文章，研究市委常委分工，部署新一届市委工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 4, Zhoukou Party Secretary Huang Yuguo chaired the first meeting of the 6th Standing Committee, studying Xi Jinping's article on political responsibility in Party governance and allocating Standing Committee members' duties.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会机关召开会议
articles.title_en: Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日上午，周口市人大常委会机关召开会议传达学习市第六次党代会精神，主任郭力铭出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 4, the Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held a meeting to convey the spirit of the 6th Municipal Party Congress, with Director Guo Liming giving a speech.

tags_en: Study of Municipal Party Congress Spirit

articles.title_zh: 市政协召开党组会议暨十届七十四次主席会议 巩固拓展学习教育成果 以正确政绩观推动政协工作高质量发展
articles.title_en: Zhuhai CPPCC Holds Party Group Meeting and Chairman's Meeting to Consolidate Education Achievements and Promote High-Quality Work with Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，珠海市政协召开党组会议暨主席会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，研究巩固拓展学习教育成果，强调以正确政绩观推动政协工作高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, the Zhuhai CPPCC held a Party group meeting and chairman's meeting to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches, and to consolidate education achievements with a correct view of political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 陈勇到珠海高新区调研新质生产力发展情况
articles.title_en: Chen Yong Visits Zhuhai High-tech Zone to Research New Quality Productive Forces
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日上午，珠海市委书记陈勇到珠海高新区调研新质生产力发展情况，走访多家企业并强调要塑造高质量发展新动能新优势。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sep 4, Chen Yong, Party chief of Zhuhai, visited the Zhuhai High-tech Zone to inspect new quality productive forces, emphasizing high-quality development in enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 2026年年中省直老干部情况通报会召开
articles.title_en: Mid-2026 Briefing Meeting for Provincial Retired Officials Held
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，2026年年中省直老干部情况通报会在济南召开。省委常委张海波、单义代表省委、省政府向老干部通报上半年全省经济社会发展情况。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 4, a briefing meeting for retired provincial officials was held in Jinan, with Zhang Haibo and Shan Yi representing the provincial Party committee and government to report on H1 economic and social progress.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔在淄博调研时强调 加力强产业扩消费增动能 推动经济持续稳健向好进中提质
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Inspects Zibo, Stresses Industrial Strength, Consumption Expansion and New Momentum
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，山东省委副书记、省长周乃翔在淄博调研，走访生物制药、新材料企业和文旅项目，强调强产业、扩消费、增动能，推动经济稳健向好。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 4, Zhou Naixiang, Governor of Shandong, inspected Zibo, visiting enterprises and tourism projects and stressing stronger industries, expanded consumption and new growth drivers.

articles.title_zh: 陈亭妃登记参选台南市长：嘴里喊着“抗中保台”，身上夹着大疆麦克风……
articles.title_en: Chen Ting-fei Registers for Tainan Mayor Bid, Wearing DJI Mic While Advocating 'Resist China'
articles.summary_zh: 民进党籍“立委”陈亭妃9月2日在黄伟哲等人陪同下登记参选台南市长，被网友发现佩戴大陆品牌大疆麦克风，引发对其“抗中保台”言论的讽刺。
articles.summary_en: Chen Ting-fei, a DPP legislator, registered to run for Tainan mayor on Sept 2, accompanied by current mayor Huang Wei-che. Netizens mocked her for wearing a DJI microphone while advocating 'resistance to China'.

articles.title_zh: 中国建筑集团副总经理陈勇被查
articles.title_en: China State Construction Vice President Chen Yong Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 中央纪委国家监委网站9月5日消息，中国建筑集团有限公司党组成员、副总经理陈勇涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: Chen Yong, Party member and vice president of China State Construction Group, is suspected of serious disciplinary and legal violations and is under review and investigation by the CCDI and the National Supervisory Commission.

articles.title_zh: 吴贤德赴永泰县检查督导防汛救灾工作
articles.title_en: Wu Xiande Inspects Flood Relief Work in Yongtai County
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，福州市长吴贤德赴永泰县检查督导防汛救灾，强调落实各项措施，确保群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Fuzhou Mayor Wu Xiande inspected flood relief efforts in Yongtai County, urging implementation of all measures to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 美国多家人工智能公司旗下服务同日发生故障
articles.title_en: Multiple US AI Companies Experience Service Outages on Same Day
articles.summary_zh: 美国多家人工智能公司旗下服务9月3日相继发生故障，包括Anthropic、xAI和OpenAI等，部分用户无法使用聊天和API服务，目前均已恢复。
articles.summary_en: Several AI companies in the U.S., including Anthropic, xAI, and OpenAI, suffered service outages on September 3, affecting chat and API services. Major services have been restored.

articles.title_zh: 刘强到市人民群众来访联合接待中心接访时强调：解决急难愁盼问题 维护群众合法权益
articles.title_en: Liu Qiang Visits Public Complaint Reception Center, Stresses Resolving People's Urgent Concerns
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，济南市委书记刘强到市人民群众来访联合接待中心接访，强调要用心用情用力解决群众急难愁盼问题，维护群众合法权益。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Liu Qiang, Secretary of the Jinan Municipal Party Committee, visited the municipal joint reception center for public complaints, emphasizing efforts to resolve pressing concerns and safeguard people's legitimate rights.

articles.title_zh: 济南召开全市服务业大会 部署服务业高质量发展工作
articles.title_en: Jinan Holds Citywide Services Industry Conference to Boost High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，济南召开全市服务业大会，部署服务业高质量发展工作。此前，省委书记林武赴济南调研，强调推动服务业扩能提质，支持培育‘AI+新型服务业’。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 2, Jinan held a citywide services industry conference to promote high-quality development. Earlier, Shandong Party Secretary Lin Wu visited Jinan, stressing expansion and upgrading of services and supporting "AI-plus new services".

tags.name_en: Integration of Agriculture, Culture and Tourism

tags_en: Integration of Agriculture, Culture and Tourism

articles.title_zh: 市政府党组召开扩大会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Jinan Municipal Government Party Group Holds Enlarged Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speech and Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，济南市政府党组召开扩大会议，传达学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话和重要指示精神，总结树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，部署巩固拓展成果工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, the Party Group of Jinan Municipal Government held an enlarged meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions, summarizing the education on establishing a correct view of achievements and deploying efforts to consolidate outcomes.

articles.title_zh: 市委理论学习中心组进行集体学习 刘强主持并讲话 于海田韩金峰杨峰参加
articles.title_en: Liu Qiang Chairs Jinan Party Committee Study on Xi Jinping Thought on Rule of Law
articles.summary_zh: 济南市委理论学习中心组集体学习习近平法治思想，市委书记刘强主持并讲话，于海田、韩金峰、杨峰等市领导参加。
articles.summary_en: Jinan Municipal Party Committee's theoretical learning group held a collective study on Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law. Liu Qiang presided and addressed the meeting, with Yu Haitian, Han Jinfeng, Yang Feng and other municipal leaders in attendance.

articles.title_zh: 数智赋能筑牢国门安全屏障 连云港边检站创新推出口岸管控信息系统
articles.title_en: Lianyungang Border Inspection Station Unveils Smart Port Control System
articles.summary_zh: 连云港边检站推出“安澜”智慧监管平台和“泊安码”，通过扫码实时掌握船舶状态，实现口岸人员动态管控，提升通关便利和国门安全。
articles.summary_en: The Lianyungang Border Inspection Station launched the 'Anlan' smart platform and 'Bo'an Code' to provide real-time vessel status via QR scanning, enhancing port personnel management and border security.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛会见强生公司高管
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Meets with Johnson & Johnson Executives
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，江苏省省长刘小涛在南京会见强生公司执行副总裁史明德，双方表示将深化产学研用合作，共建创新平台，推动生物医药产业发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao met in Nanjing with Johnson & Johnson's executive vice president, agreeing to deepen industry-university-research cooperation and promote biomedical innovation.

articles.title_zh: 长三角G60九地发布低空安全联合行动倡议
articles.title_en: Nine Cities along G60 Corridor Issue Joint Initiative on Low-Altitude Safety
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日至5日，2026低空经济发展大会在安徽芜湖举办，长三角G60科创走廊九城市政府首次联合发布低空安全联合行动倡议，标志着区域低空经济从产业协同迈向制度协同。
articles.summary_en: At the 2026 Low-Altitude Economy Development Conference in Wuhu, Anhui, nine cities along the G60 Innovation Corridor jointly issued an initiative on low-altitude safety, marking the first regional institutional coordination in the sector.

articles.title_zh: 中国工程院院士、中国海洋大学原校长管华诗逝世
articles.title_en: Guan Huashi, Academician of Chinese Academy of Engineering and Former President of Ocean University of China, Dies at 87
articles.summary_zh: 中国工程院院士、中国海洋大学原校长管华诗因病医治无效，于9月4日在青岛逝世，享年87岁。
articles.summary_en: Guan Huashi, academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering and former president of Ocean University of China, died in Qingdao on September 4 at the age of 87.

articles.title_zh: 摘除“食品”标签，国家药监局多家直属单位更名
articles.title_en: Drug Regulator Drops 'Food' from Names of Several Affiliated Units
articles.summary_zh: 国家药监局多家直属单位近期更名，摘除“食品”标签，职责相应调整，更专注药品监管。
articles.summary_en: China's drug regulator recently renamed several affiliated units to remove 'Food' from their titles, reflecting a stronger focus on drug regulation.

articles.title_zh: 国家动物博物馆标本受损后，博物馆动物标本防护指南立项：建议一级标本禁止裸展
articles.title_en: Guidelines for Animal Specimen Protection Initiated After Damage at National Zoological Museum, Suggesting No Bare Display of First-Class Specimens
articles.summary_zh: 国家动物博物馆标本受损后，国家自然博物馆联合多家机构申报《博物馆动物标本防护指南》立项，建议一级标本禁止裸展，以平衡科普与保护。
articles.summary_en: After specimen damage at the National Zoological Museum, a guideline project for animal specimen protection was initiated, recommending first-class specimens not be displayed without enclosures.

articles.title_zh: 通车倒计时！宁旌高速通过交工验收
articles.title_en: Ningguo-Jingde Expressway Passes Acceptance Inspection, Ready to Open
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，S44安吉至旌德高速公路宁国至旌德段通过交工验收，具备通车条件。项目全长约32公里，建成后宁国到旌德车程仅需25分钟。
articles.summary_en: The 32-km Ningguo-Jingde Expressway passed completion acceptance on Sept 4, becoming ready for traffic. It will cut Ningguo-Jingde travel to 25 minutes.

articles.title_zh: 安徽省成立虚拟电厂运营管理中心
articles.title_en: Anhui Establishes Virtual Power Plant Operation Management Center
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，安徽省虚拟电厂政策宣贯暨工作交流会议在合肥召开，省能源局授牌国网安徽电力设立省虚拟电厂运营管理中心，标志其管理体系从政策引导迈向实体化运营。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Anhui held a virtual power plant policy conference in Hefei. The provincial energy authority authorized State Grid Anhui Electric Power to set up the Anhui Virtual Power Plant Operation Management Center, marking a shift from policy guidance to practical operation.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会举行会议 研究部署提升成渝地区双城经济圈发展能级等工作
articles.title_en: Chongqing Party Committee Holds Meeting on Chengdu-Chongqing Economic Circle Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，重庆市委常委会举行会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话和指示精神，研究部署提升成渝地区双城经济圈发展能级等工作，市委书记袁家军主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 4, the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee held a meeting to study Xi Jinping's speeches and discuss boosting the Chengdu-Chongqing economic circle. Secretary Yuan Jiajun presided.

articles.title_zh: 福建省政协专题议政性常委会会议举行 周祖翼讲话 滕佳材主持
articles.title_en: Fujian Provincial CPPCC Holds Special Meeting on Education, S&T and Talent Reform; Zhou Zuyi Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，福建省政协召开专题议政性常委会会议，围绕教育科技人才体制机制一体改革协商议政。省委书记周祖翼出席并讲话，省政协主席滕佳材主持。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 4, the Fujian Provincial CPPCC held a special standing committee meeting on integrated reform of education, science and technology and talent systems. Provincial Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi attended and addressed the meeting.

tags_en: Education, Science and Technology and Talents

articles.title_zh: 福建省委理论学习中心组召开学习会 周祖翼赵龙出席
articles.title_en: Fujian Provincial Party Committee Holds Theoretical Study Session, Zhou Zuyi and Zhao Long Attend
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，福建省委理论学习中心组召开学习会，学习贯彻习近平总书记关于教育科技人才一体发展的重要论述，省委书记周祖翼、省长赵龙出席，滕锦光院士作专题报告。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, the Fujian Provincial Party Committee's Theoretical Learning Center Group held a study session to implement Xi Jinping's important expositions on the integrated development of education, science, technology, and talent. Provincial Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi and Governor Zhao Long attended, and academician Teng Jinguang delivered a special report.

articles.title_zh: 2026年全国科普月甘肃（天水）主场活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 National Science Popularization Month Gansu (Tianshui) Main Event Launches
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日上午，2026年全国科普月甘肃（天水）主场活动启动仪式在天水市伏羲广场举行，由省科协等33家单位主办，设置科创展区并直播推介农特产品。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 4, the 2026 National Science Popularization Month Gansu (Tianshui) main event launched at Fuxi Square, co-hosted by 33 units including the provincial science association.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能+，“+”出了什么？
articles.title_en: What Does "AI+" Add to Industries?
articles.summary_zh: 广西各地推动人工智能赋能千行百业，在农业、气象、金融、工业等领域落地一批应用场景，并探索面向东盟的产业出海路径。
articles.summary_en: Guangxi is integrating AI across industries, with applications in agriculture, meteorology, finance, and manufacturing, and exploring a differentiated path to export AI solutions to ASEAN.

articles.title_zh: 贵州省医疗器械临床成果转化“春雨行动”在贵阳启动
articles.title_en: Guizhou Launches 'Spring Rain Action' for Clinical Transformation of Medical Devices in Guiyang
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，贵州省医疗器械临床创新成果转化“春雨行动”在贵阳市乌当区启动，为期三年，旨在打通临床创意到转化落地全链条。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Guizhou launched the 'Spring Rain Action' for clinical innovation and transformation of medical devices in Wudang District, Guiyang, to be implemented over three years to smooth the entire chain from clinical ideas to commercialization.

articles.title_zh: 2026年全国“质量月”活动全面启动
articles.title_en: 2026 National Quality Month Activities Fully Launched
articles.summary_zh: 9月，市场监管总局、中央宣传部等25个部门共同部署开展2026年全国“质量月”活动，主题为“增强质量技术基础能力 提升质量安全保障水平”，旨在落实《质量强国建设纲要》。
articles.summary_en: In September, the State Administration for Market Regulation and 25 other departments jointly launched the 2026 National Quality Month campaign, themed on strengthening quality technical foundations and improving quality safety, to implement the Outline for Building a Quality Powerhouse.

articles.title_zh: 河北省委常委会召开扩大会议 学习贯彻中央政治局会议精神
articles.title_en: Hebei Provincial Party Committee Holds Enlarged Meeting to Study and Implement CPC Central Political Bureau Meeting Spirit
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，河北省委常委会召开扩大会议，传达学习中共中央政治局会议精神，研究防灾减灾救灾和安全稳定等工作，省委书记罗文主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, the Standing Committee of the CPC Hebei Provincial Committee held an enlarged meeting to convey and study the spirit of the CPC Central Political Bureau meeting, focusing on disaster prevention, mitigation, and social stability. Secretary Luo Wen presided.

articles.title_zh: 海南在全国率先出台专项规定 促进城镇开发边界精细化管理
articles.title_en: Hainan Takes Lead in Issuing Special Rules for Refined Urban Development Boundary Management
articles.summary_zh: 近日，海南在全国率先出台《海南省城镇开发边界管理实施细则（试行）》，通过细化管控标准、优化调整规则，健全城镇开发边界精细化管理体系。
articles.summary_en: Hainan has recently taken the lead nationwide in issuing the Implementation Rules for the Management of Urban Development Boundaries (Trial), refining control standards and optimizing adjustment rules to improve refined management of urban development boundaries.

articles.title_zh: 数据采集在宿迁催生10万+灵活岗
articles.title_en: Data Collection Creates Over 100,000 Flexible Jobs in Suqian
articles.summary_zh: 2026年“活力中国调研行”走进宿迁京东机器人数据采集中心，京东计划在宿迁动员10万居民参与数据采集，催生灵活就业新岗位。
articles.summary_en: In 2026, a "Vibrant China" research tour visited JD.com's embodied-intelligence robot data collection center in Suqian, Jiangsu. JD plans to recruit 100,000 local residents for data collection, boosting flexible employment.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Party Standing Committee of Autonomous Region Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，自治区党委常委会召开会议，传达学习中央政治局会议精神，部署防汛救灾、财政科学管理和反腐败等工作。自治区党委书记王伟中主持。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, the Standing Committee of the Party Committee of the Autonomous Region held a meeting to convey and study the spirit of the Politburo meeting, and made arrangements for flood control, fiscal management and anti-corruption. The meeting was chaired by Wang Weizhong, Secretary of the Regional Party Committee.

tags.name_en: Party Committee of the Autonomous Region

tags_en: Party Committee of the Autonomous Region

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古出台科技服务人才专项扶持政策
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Issues Special Support Policy for Sci-Tech Service Talent
articles.summary_zh: 近日，内蒙古自治区科技厅联合多部门印发《若干措施》，首次将科技服务人才作为独立人才类别出台专项扶持政策，提出到2028年培养高级技术经理人500名以上等目标。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Inner Mongolia Science and Technology Department and other departments jointly issued a special support policy for sci-tech service talent, covering technology managers and other professionals, with goals such as cultivating over 500 senior technology managers by 2028.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古印发“十五五”审计工作实施意见
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Issues Implementation Opinions on Audit Work for the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 近日，内蒙古自治区党委审计委员会办公室与审计厅印发《“十五五”内蒙古审计工作实施意见》，部署未来五年审计工作重点任务。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Office of the Audit Committee of the CPC Inner Mongolia Autonomous Regional Committee and the Regional Audit Department issued the Implementation Opinions on Audit Work for the 15th Five-Year Plan, outlining key tasks.

tags.name_en: Audit Department of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region

tags_en: Audit Department of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region

articles.title_zh: 第五届西部电商文旅促消费系列活动在盐池启幕
articles.title_en: 5th Western E-commerce, Culture and Tourism Consumption Promotion Series Opens in Yanchi
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，第五届西部电商文旅促消费系列活动暨盐池县闽宁协作交流活动在宁夏盐池县开幕，将开展项目签约、产业对接、文化展销等活动。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, the 5th Western E-commerce, Culture and Tourism Consumption Promotion Series and Yanchi-Min-Ning Cooperation Exchange opened in Yanchi County, Ningxia, featuring project signings and industry matchmaking.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席出席上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Attends SCO Summit and Pays State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 习近平主席8月30日至9月2日出席上海合作组织比什凯克峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦和埃及进行国事访问，推动共建一带一路合作与中埃命运共同体建设。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping attended the SCO summit in Bishkek and paid state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt from Aug 30 to Sep 2, promoting Belt and Road cooperation and the China-Egypt community with a shared future.

articles.title_zh: 坚持智能化绿色化融合化方向 不断夯实高质量发展的产业根基
articles.title_en: Adhere to Intelligent, Green and Integrated Development to Consolidate Industrial Foundation for High-quality Growth
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日至4日，四川省委书记王晓晖赴宜宾、内江、眉山调研，强调坚持智能化、绿色化、融合化方向，建设现代化产业体系，并检查地震受灾群众安置工作。
articles.summary_en: Sichuan Party Secretary Wang Xiaohui visited Yibin, Neijiang and Meishan from Sept 2-4, stressing smart, green and integrated industrial development and inspecting post-quake relocation.

articles.title_zh: “卡脖子”正变成“杀手锏”：一场会客厅里的山东新能源突围
articles.title_en: Shandong's New Energy Sector: From 'Bottlenecks' to 'Trump Cards' at Industry Forum
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，“齐鲁制造会客厅”新能源装备与新能源电池专场在济南举办，展示山东新能源产业从“跟跑”到“领跑”的突破与链式升级。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 4, the 'Qilu Manufacturing Parlor' new energy equipment and battery session was held in Jinan, showcasing Shandong's breakthroughs from 'follower' to 'leader' and its chain upgrades.

articles.title_en: Xi'an, Shenyang and Harbin Sign Agreement on Aviation Industry Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，西安、沈阳、哈尔滨三地航空集群促进机构签署航空产业协作共建协议，推动三地航空产业协同发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, aviation cluster promotion agencies from Xi'an, Shenyang and Harbin signed a cooperation agreement to jointly develop the aviation industry, promoting coordinated regional growth.

articles.title_zh: 新版《云南团队旅游产品参考成本》发布
articles.title_en: New Edition of Yunnan Group Tour Product Reference Cost Released
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，云南省旅行社协会发布新版《云南团队旅游产品参考成本》，明确25人以上团队游分项参考成本及5条热门线路最低价格标准。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, the Yunnan Provincial Travel Agency Association released a new reference cost for group tour products, specifying itemized costs for tours of 25+ people and minimum prices for 5 popular routes.

articles.title_zh: 苏辉率全国政协台联侨联界别委员视察团赴云南视察
articles.title_en: Su Hui Leads CPPCC Delegation to Yunnan for Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日至9月4日，全国政协副主席苏辉率台联、侨联界别委员视察团赴云南，围绕加快西部陆海新通道建设及高质量共建“一带一路”开展视察。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 31 to Sep 4, CPPCC Vice Chair Su Hui led a delegation to Yunnan to inspect the Western New Land-Sea Corridor and Belt and Road construction.

articles.title_zh: 北京市直机关各单位深入学习宣传贯彻习近平党建思想 深悟思想伟力 汇聚奋进合力
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal Directly Affiliated Organs Deeply Study and Implement Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 近日，北京市直机关各单位通过党组会议、专题党课、大讲堂等形式，深入学习宣传贯彻习近平党建思想，兴起学习热潮，并将学习成效转化为服务首都高质量发展的务实举措。
articles.summary_en: Recently, various directly affiliated organs of Beijing have studied and implemented Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building through party group meetings, themed lectures, and special forums, translating learning outcomes into practical measures for the capital's high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 尹力在市委党校调研时强调发挥党校干部教育培训主阵地作用
articles.title_en: Yin Li Inspects Beijing Party School, Stresses Core Role in Cadre Training
articles.summary_zh: 昨天（9月4日）下午，北京市委书记尹力在市委党校调研，强调要发挥党校干部教育培训主阵地作用，提升党员干部统筹高质量发展和高水平安全能力。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 4 afternoon, Beijing Party chief Yin Li visited the municipal party school, stressing its main role in cadre training to improve officials' ability to balance high-quality development and high security.

articles.title_zh: 学习进行时丨科学的未来在青年
articles.title_en: Learning in Progress: The Future of Science Belongs to Youth
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记强调科学的未来在青年，要把青年科技人才队伍建设作为战略工程，并回顾了与青年人才交流交往、关心青年创新创造的故事。2026年全国科普月活动于9月1日启动。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping stressed that the future of science lies with youth and that building a young sci-tech talent team should be a strategic project, while recalling his interactions with young innovators. The 2026 National Science Popularization Month was launched on Sept 1.

articles.title_zh: 风雨同舟启新程——习近平主席的开罗时间
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Cairo Visit: A New Journey of China-Egypt Friendship
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，习近平主席结束出席上合组织峰会及对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及的国事访问回京。访埃期间同塞西总统会谈，共商中埃全面战略伙伴关系发展蓝图。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 3, President Xi Jinping returned to Beijing after attending the SCO summit and state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt. During his Cairo visit, he held talks with President Sisi and charted the course for the comprehensive strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议 梁言顺主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Committee Meeting Held, Liang Yanshun Chairs and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日上午，安徽省委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记在中央政治局会议上的重要讲话精神，研究部署防灾减灾救灾工作，省委书记梁言顺主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 4 morning, Anhui Provincial Party Committee met to convey General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the Aug 28 Politburo meeting and plan disaster prevention and relief. Liang Yanshun, provincial party chief, chaired.

articles.title_zh: 韦韬主持召开自治区政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Wei Tao Chairs Guangxi Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，自治区主席韦韬主持召开自治区政府常务会议，传达学习国务院常务会议精神，研究南丹关键金属高质量发展综合试验区建设，审议水安全保障等规划文件。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 4, Wei Tao chaired Guangxi government meeting to convey State Council instructions, discuss Nandan key metals pilot zone, and review water security plans.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚在桂林开展漓江生态环境保护蹲点调研
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Conducts Field Research on Lijiang River Ecological Protection in Guilin
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日至4日，广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚深入桂林市开展漓江生态环境保护蹲点调研并主持座谈会，强调打赢打好漓江生态环境提档升级总体战。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 2 to 4, Chen Gang, Secretary of the CPC Guangxi Committee, conducted field research on Lijiang River ecological protection in Guilin and chaired a symposium, stressing a comprehensive campaign to upgrade the river's environment.

articles.title_zh: 孔昌生调研指导政协协商品牌建设工作
articles.title_en: Kong Changsheng Inspects Work on CPPCC Consultation Brand Building
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，省政协主席孔昌生调研指导“豫事好商量·河南省政协委员之家”建设工作，强调以品牌打造深化政协自身建设，更好服务高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Henan Provincial CPPCC Chairman Kong Changsheng inspected the construction of the 'Yushi Hao Shangliang' brand and Members' Home, stressing the use of brand building to enhance CPPCC self-development and serve high-quality growth.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议 刘宁主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Standing Committee Meets, Liu Ning Chairs and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，河南省委书记刘宁主持召开省委常委会会议，部署防灾减灾救灾、财政科学管理和金融支持融入全国统一大市场等工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Liu Ning, Secretary of Henan Provincial Party Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to address disaster prevention and reduction, fiscal management, and financial support for the national unified market.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明赴石门县调研指导暴雨洪涝灾害受灾群众转移安置工作
articles.title_en: Shen Xiaoming Visits Shimen County to Guide Resettlement of Flood Victims
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，湖南省委书记沈晓明赴常德市石门县调研灾后重建和受灾群众安置工作，强调有力有序推进相关工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Shen Xiaoming, Secretary of the Hunan Provincial Party Committee, visited Shimen County to inspect post-disaster reconstruction and resettlement of flood victims, stressing orderly work.

articles.title_zh: 毛万春在省住房和城乡建设厅调研
articles.title_en: Mao Wanchun Conducts Research at Provincial Housing and Urban-Rural Development Department
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，湖南省政协主席毛万春率队在省住建厅调研，强调以住建事业新成效更好服务高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Mao Wanchun, chairman of the Hunan Provincial CPPCC, led a research team to the Provincial Department of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, emphasizing achieving new results in housing and urban-rural development to better serve high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明在张家界调研
articles.title_en: Mao Weiming Investigates in Zhangjiajie
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日至4日，湖南省委副书记、省长毛伟明赴张家界市调研，强调放大生态优势、做强特色产业，持续打造世界级旅游目的地。
articles.summary_en: From September 3 to 4, Mao Weiming, Deputy Secretary of CPC Hunan Provincial Committee and Governor, visited Zhangjiajie to stress leveraging ecological advantages and strengthening specialty industries to build a world-class tourist destination.

articles.title_zh: 亚太媒体高端论坛在深圳举办 李书磊出席开幕式并发表主旨演讲
articles.title_en: Asia-Pacific Media High-Level Forum Held in Shenzhen; Li Shulei Attends and Delivers Keynote Speech
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日，亚太媒体高端论坛在广东深圳开幕，中共中央政治局委员、中宣部部长李书磊出席并发表主旨演讲，中共中央政治局委员、广东省委书记黄坤明出席并致辞。论坛聚焦亚太开放合作与媒体作用。
articles.summary_en: The Asia-Pacific Media High-Level Forum opened in Shenzhen, Guangdong on Sept 5. Li Shulei, CPC Political Bureau member and publicity chief, delivered a keynote speech; Huang Kunming, also Political Bureau member and Guangdong Party chief, attended and addressed.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席中亚、中东之旅难忘瞬间
articles.title_en: Unforgettable Moments from President Xi Jinping's Tour of Central Asia and the Middle East
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日至9月3日，习近平主席赴吉尔吉斯斯坦出席上合组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问，密集出席20余场活动，访问圆满成功。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 30 to Sep 3, President Xi Jinping attended the SCO summit in Kyrgyzstan and paid state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt, holding 20-plus events with fruitful results.

articles.title_zh: 让“美丽产业”成为“幸福产业”
articles.title_en: Making 'Beautiful Industry' a 'Happiness Industry'
articles.summary_zh: 文章介绍云南响应习近平总书记2025年3月考察指示，从种业、种植、市场三端发力发展花卉产业，2025年鲜切花产量达221.5亿枝，全产业链产值突破1400亿元，带动乡村振兴和农民增收。
articles.summary_en: Yunnan follows Xi Jinping's 2025 inspection guidance to advance the flower industry across breeding, cultivation and market, achieving 22.15 billion cut flowers and 140 billion yuan in output in 2025, boosting rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 习近平强党兴党的故事丨“党性教育是共产党人修身养性的必修课”
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Story of Strengthening the Party: 'Party Spirit Education Is a Compulsory Course for Communists' Self-Cultivation'
articles.summary_zh: 2010年9月，时任中央党校校长习近平在福建省委党校观摩中青班教学时强调，党性教育是共产党人修身养性的必修课；十八大以来，他提出一系列关于党性的新思想。
articles.summary_en: In September 2010, Xi Jinping, then head of the CPC Central Party School, stressed while visiting a training session at the Fujian Provincial Party School that party spirit education is an essential course for communists to cultivate themselves. Since the 18th CPC National Congress, he has put forward a series of new insights on party spirit.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 王浩：奋力推动山区海岛县高质量发展积厚成势加速取得新突破
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Urges New Breakthroughs in High-Quality Development of Mountain and Island Counties
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，山区海岛县高质量发展现场推进会在衢州召开，浙江省委书记王浩出席并讲话，强调要把握关键、扭住重点，奋力推动山区海岛县高质量发展取得新突破。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, an on-site meeting on high-quality development of mountainous and island counties was held in Quzhou. Wang Hao, Secretary of CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee, stressed efforts to seize key points and achieve new breakthroughs.

articles.title_zh: 殷勇在首都医科大学调研，要求深化校院融合、释放创新潜能，促进更多医学成果转化落地
articles.title_en: Yin Yong Inspects Capital Medical University, Urges Deepening Integration and Innovation to Promote Medical Achievement Translation
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日下午，北京市市长殷勇在首都医科大学调研，强调深化校院融合、释放创新潜能，促进更多医学成果转化落地，推进‘双一流’建设。
articles.summary_en: On September 3 afternoon, Beijing Mayor Yin Yong visited Capital Medical University, stressing deeper university-hospital integration and innovation to facilitate medical achievement translation and advance Double First-Class construction.

articles.title_zh: 尹力围绕国际科技组织发展工作在朝阳区调研，要求促进国际科技组织集群化、规模化、高质量发展
articles.title_en: Yin Li Inspects International S&T Organizations in Chaoyang, Calls for Clustered, Large-scale, High-quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日下午，北京市委书记尹力在朝阳区调研国际科技组织发展工作，强调促进其集群化、规模化、高质量发展，打造全球创新网络关键枢纽。
articles.summary_en: On Sep 3, Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li toured Chaoyang District to learn about international S&T organizations, urging clustered and high-quality growth to make Beijing a global innovation hub.

articles.title_zh: 西沙群岛属于中国，于史于法于实皆有据可依
articles.title_en: Xisha Islands Belong to China with Full Historical, Legal and Practical Grounds
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆针对越南言论表示，西沙群岛是中国固有领土，不存在任何争议，中方在自己领土上的建设主权范围内，越方无权说三道四。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 3, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun said the Xisha Islands are China's inherent territory with no dispute, rejecting Vietnam's remarks on Chinese activities there.

articles.title_zh: 首次！北斗基准站服务数据向社会共享开放
articles.title_en: First-Ever Public Sharing of BeiDou Ground Station Service Data
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，自然资源部会同国家数据局在北京召开推进会，宣布全国北斗基准站一张网服务数据首次向社会共享开放。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 4, the Ministry of Natural Resources and the National Data Administration held a promotion meeting in Beijing, announcing first-ever public sharing of BeiDou ground station network service data.

articles.title_zh: 台湾半导体业界析两岸合作：“绕开大陆产业链不切实际”
articles.title_en: Taiwan Semiconductor Industry on Cross-Strait Cooperation: Bypassing Mainland Supply Chain Unrealistic
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日至4日，SEMICON Taiwan半导体展在台北举行，多家台湾半导体企业受访表示两岸产业合作空间增大，绕开大陆产业链不切实际。
articles.summary_en: At SEMICON Taiwan held in Taipei from Sept 2-4, multiple Taiwanese semiconductor firms said cross-strait cooperation is expanding and bypassing the mainland's industrial chain is unrealistic.

articles.title_zh: “绝不能让他们流汗又流泪”，多地密集部署
articles.title_en: Multiple Regions Deploy Crackdown on Corruption Around the People
articles.summary_zh: 近一个月来，浙江、吉林、内蒙古、河南、甘肃、云南等多地密集召开推进会，部署整治群众身边不正之风和腐败问题，重点治理拖欠农民工工资、医保基金等民生领域问题。
articles.summary_en: Over the past month, regions including Zhejiang, Jilin, Inner Mongolia, Henan, Gansu, and Yunnan held meetings to intensify rectification of corruption and misconduct affecting the public, focusing on wage arrears for migrant workers and livelihood issues.

articles.title_zh: 习近平回到北京
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Returns to Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日上午，国家主席习近平圆满结束出席2026年上海合作组织峰会和对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及的国事访问后回到北京。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 3, President Xi Jinping returned to Beijing after concluding his attendance at the 2026 SCO Summit and state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记致信祝贺《小喇叭》开播70周年
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter on 70th Anniversary of Children's Program 'Little Horn'
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，在中央广播电视总台《小喇叭》节目开播70周年之际，习近平总书记致贺信，勉励少儿文艺工作者用心用情创作传播真善美的优秀作品，培养社会主义建设者和接班人。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter on the 70th anniversary of the launch of China Media Group's children's program 'Little Horn', encouraging children's literary and art workers to create more excellent works that spread truth, goodness and beauty and cultivate socialist builders and successors.

articles.title_zh: 市委召开常委会会议 认真学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神 研究部署党校“三秋”和数据等工作
articles.title_en: Municipal Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speech and Deploy Party School, Agriculture, and Data Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，安康市委召开常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署党校、三秋及数据等工作，市委书记柯昌万主持。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, the Ankang Municipal Party Committee held a standing committee meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's important speech and deploy work on party school, agriculture, and data, chaired by Secretary Ke Changwan.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠顾刚专题研究重点项目规划设计工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui and Gu Gang Study Planning and Design of Key Projects
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，长春市委书记张恩惠主持召开调度会，与市长顾刚专题研究国家中医代谢病医学中心筹建及中国光电城重点项目规划设计工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Changchun Municipal Party Secretary Zhang Enhui chaired a coordination meeting with Mayor Gu Gang to study the planning and design of the National TCM Metabolic Disease Medical Center and key projects in China Optoelectronics City.

articles.title_zh: 第八届中俄能源商务论坛开幕 丁薛祥宣读习近平主席贺信并致辞
articles.title_en: 8th China-Russia Energy Business Forum Opens; Ding Xuexiang Reads Xi Jinping's Letter and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月4日，国务院副总理丁薛祥在俄罗斯符拉迪沃斯托克出席第八届中俄能源商务论坛开幕式，宣读习近平主席贺信并致辞，强调深化中俄能源合作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 4, Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang attended the opening of the 8th China-Russia Energy Business Forum in Vladivostok, read President Xi Jinping's congratulatory letter and delivered a speech, emphasizing deeper energy cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 医保高质量发展助力中国式现代化建设
articles.title_en: High-Quality Development of Medical Insurance Supports Chinese Modernization
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日上午，国务院新闻办公室举行发布会，介绍推进医保高质量发展情况。国家医保局表示将稳步提升参保质量，每年调整药品目录，扩大创新药纳入报销范围。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 4, the State Council Information Office held a press conference on advancing high-quality medical insurance development. The National Healthcare Security Administration pledged to steadily improve coverage quality, adjust the drug list annually, and include more innovative drugs for reimbursement.

articles.title_zh: 李强签署国务院令公布修订后的电力安全事故应急处置和调查处理条例
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Order on Revised Power Safety Accident Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强签署国务院令，公布修订后的《电力安全事故应急处置和调查处理条例》，自2027年1月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council order promulgating the revised regulations on emergency response and investigation of electric power safety accidents, effective January 1, 2027.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席出席上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问取得圆满成功
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Attends SCO Summit and Pays State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt with Full Success
articles.summary_zh: 习近平主席出席上海合作组织比什凯克峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问；同两国签署多项合作文件并发表联合声明，推动构建命运共同体，访问取得圆满成功。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping attended the SCO Bishkek Summit and paid state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt, signing multiple cooperation documents and issuing joint statements to promote a community with a shared future, achieving complete success.

articles.title_zh: 张国清出席第三十二次亚太经合组织中小企业部长会议开幕式并致辞
articles.title_en: Zhang Guoqing Attends and Addresses Opening Ceremony of 32nd APEC SME Ministerial Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，第32次APEC中小企业部长会议在广州举行，国务院副总理张国清出席开幕式并致辞，强调深化合作，推动中小企业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, the 32nd APEC SME Ministerial Meeting was held in Guangzhou. Vice Premier Zhang Guoqing attended and addressed the opening ceremony, emphasizing deeper cooperation for high-quality development of SMEs.

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥同俄罗斯副总理诺瓦克共同主持中俄能源合作委员会第二十三次会议
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang and Russian Deputy PM Novak Co-Chair 23rd China-Russia Energy Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥9月4日在符拉迪沃斯托克同俄罗斯副总理诺瓦克主持中俄能源合作委员会第二十三次会议，并签署会议纪要。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 4, Ding Xuexiang, member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau Standing Committee and Vice Premier, co-chaired the 23rd China-Russia Energy Cooperation Committee meeting with Russian Deputy PM Novak in Vladivostok and signed the minutes.

articles.title_zh: 中国超大市场红利惠及全球
articles.title_en: China's Super-Large Market Dividend Benefits the World
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来，我国持续扩大进口，超大规模市场释放的需求正成为全球共享发展新机遇，进口水果和机电产品均快速增长。
articles.summary_en: Since this year, China has kept expanding imports, with its super-large market creating new opportunities for global development, as fruit and machinery imports have grown rapidly.

articles.title_zh: 中埃元首续写文明交流互鉴佳话
articles.title_en: Chinese, Egyptian Presidents Write New Chapter of Civilization Exchanges
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月2日下午，国家主席习近平和夫人彭丽媛在埃及总统塞西陪同下参观大埃及博物馆，强调中埃文明交流互鉴。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 2 local time, Chinese President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan, accompanied by Egyptian President Sisi, visited the Grand Egyptian Museum, stressing mutual learning between the two ancient civilizations.

articles.title_zh: 张丹赴重点纺织服装企业调研智改数转赋能产业升级情况
articles.title_en: Mayor Zhang Dan of Dandong Visits Key Textile and Apparel Enterprises to Promote Smart Transformation and Industrial Upgrading
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，丹东市市长张丹深入重点纺织服装企业，实地调研智改数转实施和产业提质升级，强调以智改数转推动传统制造业迭代升级，培育壮大新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Zhang Dan, Mayor of Dandong, visited key textile and apparel enterprises to inspect smart transformation and digital upgrading, stressing the need to upgrade traditional manufacturing and cultivate new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 第七届中国（甘肃）中医药产业博览会开幕 何维宣布开幕 胡昌升致辞 孔绍逊主持
articles.title_en: 7th China (Gansu) TCM Industry Expo Opens with He Wei, Hu Changsheng, Kong Shaoxun
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日上午，第七届中国（甘肃）中医药产业博览会在定西市陇西县开幕。全国人大常委会副委员长何维宣布开幕，甘肃省委书记胡昌升等致辞。
articles.summary_en: The 7th China (Gansu) TCM Expo opened Sept 4 in Longxi County, Dingxi. He Wei announced opening; Hu Changsheng delivered remarks.

articles.title_zh: 市委理论学习中心组召开专题学习会议
articles.title_en: Fushun Municipal Party Committee Holds Thematic Study Session on Party Theories
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，抚顺市委理论学习中心组召开专题学习会议，深入学习贯彻习近平法治思想和习近平生态文明思想，市委书记高键主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, the Theoretical Study Center Group of the Fushun Municipal Party Committee held a special session to study Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law and Ecological Civilization, chaired by Secretary Gao Jian.

articles.title_zh: 淮北市委书记蒋曦调研红色资源保护传承利用工作
articles.title_en: Huaibei Party Secretary Jiang Xi Inspects Revolutionary Heritage Preservation
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日下午，淮北市委书记蒋曦赴相山区、杜集区调研红色资源保护传承利用工作，强调传承红色基因，凝聚转型发展力量。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 4, Jiang Xi, Secretary of Huaibei Municipal Party Committee, visited Xiangshan and Duji districts to inspect revolutionary heritage preservation and stressed carrying forward the red gene to boost transformation.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦会见中科大新创基金会理事长石兵
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi Meets Shi Bing, Chairman of USTC New Innovation Foundation
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日下午，淮北市委书记蒋曦会见中科大新创基金会理事长、合肥应物科技董事长石兵一行，就深化合作、推动科技创新成果在淮转化等进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 4, Jiang Xi, Secretary of the Huaibei Municipal Party Committee, met with Shi Bing, Chairman of the USTC New Innovation Foundation and Chairman of Hefei Yingwu Technology, to discuss deepening cooperation and promoting the commercialization of sci-tech achievements in Huaibei.

articles.title_zh: 韦朝晖主持召开2026年世界划联龙舟世界杯（沅陵）专题调度会
articles.title_en: Wei Zhaohui Chairs Coordination Meeting for 2026 Dragon Boat World Cup (Yuanling)
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日上午，市委书记韦朝晖主持召开2026年世界划联龙舟世界杯（沅陵）专题调度会，强调精心精细高质高效做好筹备，确保赛事安全有序精彩圆满。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Wei Zhaohui, Secretary of the Huaihua Municipal Party Committee, chaired a coordination meeting for the 2026 Dragon Boat World Cup (Yuanling), emphasizing meticulous and high-quality preparation to ensure a safe, orderly and splendid event.

articles.title_zh: 韦朝晖主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Wei Zhaohui Chairs CPC Huaihua Municipal Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，怀化市委书记韦朝晖主持市委常委会会议，传达学习中央政治局会议和总书记重要指示精神，部署地质灾害防治与县域经济工作，并通报牛顺生被开除党籍公职。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 3, Wei Zhaohui chaired a CPC Huaihua Municipal Standing Committee meeting, conveying central and Xi Jinping's directives, arranging disaster prevention and county economy, and announcing Niu Shunsheng's expulsion from the Party.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保主持召开市委议军会议
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao Chairs Municipal Party Committee Military Affairs Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，揭阳市委书记曾风保主持召开市委议军会议，分析武装工作形势，部署下一步党管武装和国防动员重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Jieyang Municipal Party Committee Secretary Zeng Fengbao chaired a military affairs meeting to analyze the armed forces work situation and deploy key tasks on party-managed armed forces and national defense mobilization.

articles.title_zh: 企业家代表团来揭考察并参加揭阳市招商引资推介会
articles.title_en: Entrepreneur Delegation Visits Jieyang and Attends Investment Promotion Conference
articles.summary_zh: 3日下午，揭阳市举办招商引资推介会，市长曲晓杰出席并讲话，邀请厦门大学管理学院EMBA企业家代表团来揭考察交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of the 3rd, Jieyang City held an investment promotion conference. Mayor Qu Xiaojie attended and spoke, inviting an EMBA entrepreneur delegation from Xiamen University to visit Jieyang.

articles.title_zh: 王君正主持西藏自治区党委常委会会议部署政绩观学习教育常态化长效化
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Chairs Tibet CPC Committee Meeting to Institutionalize Political Achievement View Education
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正在拉萨主持召开自治区党委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，总结树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成效，研究部署常态化长效化工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Wang Junzheng, Party chief of Tibet Autonomous Region, chaired a standing committee meeting in Lhasa to convey Xi Jinping's recent important speeches, review the education campaign on correct political achievement views, and plan its institutionalization.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登在吉隆泥石流灾害应急救援指挥部调度抢险救援工作
articles.title_en: Gama Zedeng Directs Rescue Work at Jilong Mudslide Disaster Emergency Command
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日晚，西藏自治区主席嘎玛泽登在吉隆泥石流灾害应急救援指挥部调度抢险救援工作，强调全力以赴保障人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of September 2, Gama Zedeng, chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region, directed rescue operations at the Jilong mudslide disaster emergency command, emphasizing all-out efforts to safeguard lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 学习进行时丨巩固拓展学习教育成果，总书记提出明确要求
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Gives Instructions on Consolidating and Expanding Achievements of Education on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记近日作出重要指示，强调要经常性开展政绩观教育，巩固拓展学习教育成果。中央党的建设工作领导小组8月24日召开会议研究部署相关工作。
articles.summary_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping recently made important instructions on consolidating and expanding the achievements of the education on the correct view of political achievements, emphasizing regular education. The Central Leading Group for Party Building held a meeting on August 24 to arrange follow-up work.

articles.title_zh: 汕头市政府召开党组（扩大）会议、常务会议
articles.title_en: Shantou Municipal Government Holds Party Group (Expanded) Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日上午，市长陈涛主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议、常务会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示，部署网络餐饮食品安全和制售假劣肉制品治理工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 3, Mayor Chen Tao chaired the municipal government's Party group (expanded) meeting and executive meeting, studying the spirit of an important instruction from General Secretary Xi Jinping and deploying work on food safety in online catering and crackdown on fake and substandard meat products.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群到汕头市政协机关调研并召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Visits Shantou CPPCC Office for Research and Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日上午，市委书记庄悦群到市政协机关调研并召开座谈会，强调发挥专门协商机构作用，为汕头在新时代经济特区建设中迎头赶上作出政协贡献。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 3, Zhuang Yuequn, Secretary of the Shantou Municipal Party Committee, visited the CPPCC office for research and held a symposium, stressing the role of the CPPCC as a specialized consultative body in contributing to Shantou's development.

articles.title_zh: 汕尾市政府党组会议研究部署灾害防范应对、经济运行和招商引资等工作
articles.title_en: Shanwei Municipal Government Party Group Meeting Arranges Work on Disaster Prevention, Economic Operation, and Investment Attraction
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，广东省汕尾市政府召开党组会议、常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，研究部署灾害防范应对、经济运行、招商引资等工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, the Shanwei municipal government held a party group meeting and executive meeting to convey General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech and instructions, and to arrange work on disaster prevention, economic operation, and investment attraction.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰主持召开工作专题会议研究推进中秋晚会暨文旅周活动筹备工作
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Chairs Special Work Meeting on Preparations for Mid-Autumn Gala and Culture-Tourism Week
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，汕尾市委书记逯峰主持召开专题会议，研究推进广东卫视2026年粤港澳大湾区中秋晚会暨汕尾中秋文旅周筹备工作，强调高标准高质量做好各项筹备，确保活动圆满成功。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Lu Feng, secretary of the Shanwei Municipal Party Committee, chaired a special meeting on preparations for the 2026 Guangdong TV Mid-Autumn Gala and Shanwei Culture-Tourism Week, calling for high-standard, quality work to ensure the event's success.

articles.title_zh: 市政府党组理论学习中心组学习会召开
articles.title_en: Municipal Government Party Group Holds Theoretical Learning Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，市政府党组理论学习中心组召开学习会，深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于基层工作方法的重要论述，市长李晖主持。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, the Municipal Government Party Group held a theoretical learning session to study Xi Jinping's important statements on grassroots work methods, chaired by Mayor Li Hui.

articles.title_zh: 上海市浙江商会走进威海恳谈会举行
articles.title_en: Shanghai Zhejiang Chamber of Commerce Symposium Held in Weihai
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，上海市浙江商会走进威海恳谈会举行。威海市委书记张海波出席并讲话，表示希望深化合作，推动项目落地。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, a symposium of the Shanghai Zhejiang Chamber of Commerce was held in Weihai. Weihai Party Secretary Zhang Haibo attended and spoke, expressing hopes for deeper cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 宣布芜湖军分区党委第一书记任职大会召开
articles.title_en: Meeting Held to Announce Appointment of First Secretary of Wuhu Military Subdistrict Party Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，芜湖军分区党委第一书记任职大会召开，省军区政委王金良宣读决定，市委书记徐志任军分区党委第一书记。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, a meeting in Wuhu announced the appointment of Xu Zhi as First Secretary of the Wuhu Military Subdistrict Party Committee; Provincial Military Region Political Commissar Wang Jinliang read the decision.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党新乡市第十三次代表大会关于中共新乡市第十二届委员会工作报告的决议
articles.title_en: The 13th CPC Xinxiang Municipal Congress Approves Resolution on the 12th Municipal Committee's Work Report
articles.summary_zh: 中国共产党新乡市第十三次代表大会批准魏建平代表十二届市委所作的报告，总结过去五年成就，部署今后五年主要任务和全面从严治党等重点工作。
articles.summary_en: The 13th CPC Xinxiang Municipal Congress approved a work report delivered by Wei Jianping on behalf of the 12th Municipal Committee, summarizing achievements and outlining key tasks for the next five years.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平率队赴中国一汽考察洽谈
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Leads Delegation to Visit China FAW for Cooperation Talks
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，市委书记严汉平率队赴吉林长春，拜访中国一汽集团，与董事长邱现东座谈，共商深化合作。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Yan Hanping, Secretary of the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee, led a delegation to Changchun, Jilin, to visit China FAW Group and held talks with Chairman Qiu Xiandong on deepening cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 烟台市委常委会会议暨市委党的建设工作领导小组会议召开 研究部署巩固拓展正确政绩观学习教育成果
articles.title_en: Yantai Municipal Party Committee Meeting Deploys Consolidation of Education on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，烟台市委常委会会议暨市委党的建设工作领导小组会议召开，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，总结全市树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，部署巩固拓展工作。市委书记江成主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Yantai Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey Xi Jinping's important instructions, summarize the city's education on correct view of political achievements, and deploy consolidation efforts. Party Secretary Jiang Cheng presided.

articles.title_zh: 烟台市委常委会传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Yantai Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting to Convey Xi's Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，烟台市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记在中央政治局会议上的重要讲话精神，研究贯彻落实意见，部署防汛抗旱等防灾减灾工作。市委书记江成主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, the Standing Committee of the Yantai Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the August 28 Political Bureau meeting, deploying flood and drought disaster prevention work. Jiang Cheng, Deputy Director of the Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee and Party Secretary of Yantai, presided over and addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 阳江市委常委会会议召开
articles.title_en: Yangjiang Municipal Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，阳江市委常委会会议召开，市委书记卢一先主持，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神和中央、省委部署，研究防灾减灾、生态文明建设及“百千万工程”等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 3, the CPC Yangjiang Municipal Committee held a Standing Committee meeting chaired by Secretary Lu Yixian to convey Xi Jinping's important speeches and decisions on disaster prevention, ecological civilization, and rural development.

tags_en: High-quality development program of counties, towns and villages

articles.title_zh: 中共银川市委十五届十六次全会举行
articles.title_en: CPC Yinchuan Municipal Committee Holds 16th Plenary Session of 15th Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，中共银川市委十五届十六次全会在银川举行，审议通过工业转型升级实施意见和召开市第十六次党代会决议，赵旭辉讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, 2026, the 16th Plenary Session of the 15th CPC Yinchuan Municipal Committee was held in Yinchuan, approving opinions on industrial transformation and the resolution to convene the 16th Municipal Party Congress, with Zhao Xuhui speaking.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞在西吉县调研并主持召开座谈会 强调统筹推进‘两化一振兴’促进城乡融合发展
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Investigates Xiji County, Chairs Symposium on Urban-Rural Integration and People's Livelihoods
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日至3日，宁夏回族自治区党委书记李邑飞在西吉县调研常态化帮扶、特色产业发展、防汛防灾等工作，并主持召开座谈会，强调统筹推进‘两化一振兴’、促进城乡融合发展。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 2 to 3, Li Yifei, Party Chief of Ningxia, visited Xiji County to inspect regular assistance, featured industries, and flood control, and chaired a symposium urging integrated urban-rural development and improved livelihoods.

articles.summary_en: On September 3, Yang Zhengkun, Party Secretary of Yuxi City, Yunnan, visited Yuxi Homeland Construction Investment Co., Ltd. to survey SOE operations, urging reform and innovation to deepen state-owned enterprise reform.

articles.title_zh: 唐浩然调研县域经济高质量发展工作

articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping visited Egypt on Sept 1-2, citing an ancient saying in a signed article, met President el-Sisi, and visited the Grand Egyptian Museum. Both sides issued a joint statement and signed documents.

Municipal Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong presided and delivered a speech.
