articles.title_zh: 山东省政府第八次全体会议召开
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial Government Holds Eighth Plenary Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，山东省政府第八次全体会议召开，省委副书记、省长周乃翔主持并讲话，部署下半年经济社会发展工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, the Shandong Provincial Government held its eighth plenary meeting. Governor Zhou Naixiang presided and addressed the meeting, outlining work for economic and social development in the second half of the year.

articles.title_zh: 陕西印发2026年成人高校招生工作实施办法
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Issues Implementation Measures for 2026 Adult College Enrollment
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，陕西省教育考试院印发《2026年陕西省成人高校招生工作实施办法》，明确成人高考报名时间为9月14日至18日，全国统考于10月17、18日进行。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, the Shaanxi Provincial Education Examination Authority issued the Implementation Measures for 2026 Adult College Enrollment, specifying registration from September 14 to 18 and national exam on October 17-18.

articles.title_zh: 今年已发布新兴产业国家标准1400余项
articles.title_en: Over 1,400 National Standards for Emerging Industries Issued This Year
articles.summary_zh: 市场监管总局（国家标准委）9月3日透露，今年以来已发布国家标准2800余项，其中新兴产业国家标准1400余项，约占半数，涵盖信息技术、新材料、高端装备等领域，有力支撑新质生产力发展。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation said on September 3 that over 1,400 of the 2,800-plus national standards issued this year target emerging industries, covering IT, new materials and high-end equipment, boosting new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 天津居民期望寿命达82.80岁 保持国内先进水平
articles.title_en: Tianjin Residents' Average Life Expectancy Reaches 82.80 Years, Maintaining Advanced Domestic Level
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，天津市卫生健康委发布2025年度居民健康状况报告，户籍居民期望寿命达82.80岁，保持国内先进水平。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Tianjin Municipal Health Commission released the 2025 Tianjin Resident Health Report, showing that the average life expectancy of registered residents reached 82.80 years, maintaining a leading level in China.

articles.title_zh: 上半年云南省规模以上服务业平稳增长
articles.title_en: Yunnan's Above-Scale Service Industry Sees Steady Growth in H1
articles.summary_zh: 云南省统计局数据显示，今年上半年全省规模以上服务业企业营业收入1837.99亿元，同比增长1.3%，数字经济、现代物流等重点行业增长较快。
articles.summary_en: According to Yunnan Provincial Bureau of Statistics, revenue of above-scale service enterprises in Yunnan reached 183.799 billion yuan in H1, up 1.3% year-on-year, with rapid growth in digital economy and modern logistics sectors.

articles.title_zh: 2026浙江省“质量月”活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Zhejiang 'Quality Month' Activities Kick Off
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，2026浙江省“质量月”活动启动仪式暨第九届长三角G60科创走廊质量标准大会在杭州举行，发布系列报告与倡议，聚焦质量技术基础与质量安全。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, the launch ceremony of Zhejiang's 2026 'Quality Month' and the 9th Yangtze River Delta G60 Science and Innovation Corridor Quality Standards Conference were held in Hangzhou, releasing reports and initiatives on quality infrastructure and safety.

articles.title_zh: 习近平抵达开罗对埃及进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives in Cairo for State Visit to Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月1日，国家主席习近平抵达埃及开罗，对埃及进行国事访问。此访正值中埃建交70周年，两国元首在尼罗河畔擘画合作新蓝图。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, President Xi Jinping arrived in Cairo, Egypt, for a state visit at the invitation of President Sisi. The visit marks the 70th anniversary of China-Egypt diplomatic ties.

articles.title_zh: 管党治党怎样从宽松软走向严紧硬
articles.title_en: How to Tighten Party Governance from Loose to Strict
articles.summary_zh: 本文阐述落实管党治党政治责任是全面从严治党的关键，强调健全责任体系、完善党内法规，推动管党治党从宽松软走向严紧硬。
articles.summary_en: This article explains that implementing political responsibility for party governance is key to strict governance, emphasizing the improvement of accountability systems and party regulations.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开第90次常务会议 陈新武主持
articles.title_en: Chen Xinwu Chairs 90th Executive Meeting of Chongqing Municipal Government
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，重庆市市长陈新武主持召开市政府第90次常务会议，研究民生保障、深化国资国企改革，审议重庆都市圈建设“十五五”实施方案等。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Chongqing Mayor Chen Xinwu chaired the 90th executive meeting, focusing on livelihood security, SOE reform, and reviewing the Chongqing metropolitan area's 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 王凯到省市场监管局调研
articles.title_en: Wang Kai Visits Provincial Market Regulation Administration for Research
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，河南省省长王凯到省市场监管局调研，强调强化质量意识、安全监管和服务理念，优化营商环境，助力高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Governor Wang Kai of Henan visited the Provincial Market Regulation Administration, calling for stronger quality awareness, safety regulation, and service concepts to optimize the business environment and drive high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 全省低碳减排专题工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Provincial Special Work Conference on Low-Carbon Emission Reduction Held
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日下午，全省低碳减排专题工作会议在济南召开。省委书记林武出席并讲话，省长周乃翔主持，部署打赢低碳减排硬仗，推动绿色低碳高质量发展先行区建设。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 3, the province's low-carbon reduction work meeting was held in Jinan; Secretary Lin Wu spoke, stressing efforts to promote green low-carbon transition.

articles.title_zh: 携手推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合 为新疆经济社会高质量发展提供有力支撑
articles.title_en: Deepening Sci-Tech and Industrial Innovation Integration to Support Xinjiang's High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，新疆维吾尔自治区与中国工程院在乌鲁木齐举行院士新疆行恳谈会，自治区党委书记陈小江、中国工程院院长张玉卓出席并讲话，强调深化科技创新与产业创新融合，助推新疆高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 3, Xinjiang and Chinese Academy of Engineering held an academician symposium in Urumqi. Chen Xiaojiang and Zhang Yuzhuo called for deeper sci-tech and industrial innovation for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江主持召开自治区党委常委会会议 研究应急管理和防灾减灾等工作
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Regional Party Committee Meeting Focuses on Emergency Management and Disaster Reduction
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，新疆自治区党委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻中央政治局会议精神，研究应急管理、防灾减灾、碳达峰碳中和及自然资源资产管理部署。自治区党委书记陈小江主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, the Standing Committee of the CPC Xinjiang Regional Committee met to study the Political Bureau's spirit, focusing on emergency management, disaster prevention, carbon goals, and natural resources asset management. Chen Xiaojiang presided.

articles.title_zh: 2026年全国科普月云南省主场活动启动
articles.title_en: Yunnan Launches Main Event of 2026 National Science Popularization Month
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，以“科技改变生活 创新赢得未来”为主题的2026年全国科普月云南省主场活动启动仪式在昭通市镇雄县举行。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, the 2026 National Science Popularization Month Yunnan main event kicked off in Zhenxiong County, Zhaotong, under the theme 'Technology Changes Life, Innovation Wins the Future'.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷在杭州调研人工智能产业发展工作
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Inspects AI Industry Development in Hangzhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，浙江省委副书记、省长刘捷在杭州专题调研人工智能产业发展工作，强调加快促进创新链和产业链深度融合，推动人工智能相关产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Liu Jie, Deputy Secretary of CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee and Governor, visited Hangzhou to inspect AI industry development, urging faster integration of innovation and industrial chains for high-quality development of AI-related industries.

tags.name_en: Integration of Innovation and Industrial Chains

tags_en: Integration of Innovation and Industrial Chains

articles.title_zh: 王浩：稳扎稳打 久久为功 持续推动山区海岛县高质量发展
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Stresses Steady Progress in High-Quality Development of Mountain and Island Counties
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，浙江省委书记王浩在衢州调研，强调要稳扎稳打、久久为功，持续推动山区海岛县高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Wang Hao, Secretary of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee, inspected Quzhou, emphasizing steady and sustained high-quality development of mountainous and island counties.

articles.title_zh: 墨西哥外长贝拉斯科将访华 外交部介绍中方期待
articles.title_en: Mexican Foreign Minister Velasco to Visit China; MFA Outlines Expectations
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆宣布，应王毅外长邀请，墨西哥外长贝拉斯科将于9月6日至7日访华，中方期待深化中墨关系。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 3, MFA spokesperson Guo Jiakun announced that Mexican Foreign Minister Velasco will visit China from Sept 6-7 at the invitation of Foreign Minister Wang Yi, expecting to deepen bilateral ties.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：中国在委内瑞拉的合法权益必须得到保护
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China's Legitimate Rights in Venezuela Must Be Protected
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上表示，中委合作受国际法和两国法律保护，中国在委内瑞拉的合法权益必须得到保护。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said at a regular press conference that China-Venezuela cooperation is protected by international law and that China's legitimate rights in Venezuela must be protected.

articles.title_zh: 抢险救援第八天，深层次搜救如何进行？
articles.title_en: Rescue Day 8: How to Conduct Deep-Level Search and Rescue?
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，通往西藏吉隆口岸的G216国道救援通道打通，救援进入深层次搜救阶段；应急管理部与自然资源部专家分析搜救难点及地质灾害监测措施。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, the rescue passage to Gyirong Port in Tibet was cleared, entering deep-level search and rescue. Experts from emergency management and natural resources departments discussed challenges and monitoring strategies.

articles.title_zh: 消防救援队伍在吉隆泥石流受灾区域纵深推进全域精细化搜寻
articles.title_en: Fire Rescue Teams Conduct Detailed Searches in Jilong Mudslide Area
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，国家综合性消防救援队伍在西藏吉隆泥石流受灾区域持续救援，打通G216国道核心受灾段通道，并分批次深入核心区开展精细化搜寻。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, national fire and rescue teams continued rescue operations in the mudslide-hit Jilong area, clearing the key section of G216 and conducting detailed searches in the core zone.

articles.title_zh: 学习新语｜人类和平与发展的崇高事业必将胜利
articles.title_en: The Noble Cause of Human Peace and Development Will Surely Triumph
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日抗战胜利纪念日之际，回顾习近平总书记关于伟大抗战精神的重要论述，号召在民族复兴新征程上砥砺奋进。
articles.summary_en: On the 81st anniversary of China's victory in the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression, President Xi Jinping's remarks on the great spirit of resistance are revisited, calling for renewed dedication to national rejuvenation and world peace.

articles.title_zh: 航行警告！黄海部分海域将进行军事演练 禁止驶入
articles.title_en: Navigation Warning: Military Exercise to Be Held in Parts of Yellow Sea, Entry Prohibited
articles.summary_zh: 日照海事局9月3日发布航行警告：9月5日8时至8日8时，黄海部分海域将进行军事演练，禁止驶入。
articles.summary_en: Rizhao Maritime Safety Administration issued a navigation warning on Sept. 3: A military exercise will be held in parts of the Yellow Sea from 8:00 Sept. 5 to 8:00 Sept. 8, 2026. Entry is prohibited.

articles.title_zh: 青海省国有资产投资管理有限公司原总经理姚洪仲被开除党籍
articles.title_en: Yao Hongzhong, Former General Manager of Qinghai State-owned Assets Investment Management Co., Ltd., Expelled from CPC
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，经青海省委批准，青海省纪委监委通报，对原总经理姚洪仲严重违纪违法问题立案审查，决定给予其开除党籍处分，并移送检察机关审查起诉。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 3, the Qinghai Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection announced that Yao Hongzhong, former general manager, was expelled from the CPC for serious disciplinary violations and transferred to prosecutors for review and prosecution.

tags.name_en: Qinghai Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervisory Commission

tags_en: Qinghai Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervisory Commission

articles.title_zh: 民政部：到年底前实现养老机构从业人员消防技能培训全覆盖
articles.title_en: Ministry of Civil Affairs: Full Coverage of Fire Safety Training for Elderly Care Staff by Year End
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，民政部养老服务司副司长张军在北京表示，民政部会同国家消防救援局推进养老机构消防培训，年底前实现从业人员全覆盖。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 3, Zhang Jun, deputy director of the Ministry of Civil Affairs' elderly care department, said in Beijing that the ministry, with the National Fire and Rescue Administration, will provide full fire-safety training for elderly care staff by year-end.

tags.name_en: Fire Safety in Elderly Care Facilities

tags_en: Fire Safety in Elderly Care Facilities

articles.title_zh: 国际月球村中心（中国）及4个深空探测联合实验室在合肥揭牌
articles.title_en: International Lunar Village Center (China) and Four Joint Deep-Space Exploration Laboratories Inaugurated in Hefei
articles.summary_zh: 2026年深空探测（天都）国际会议9月3日在合肥开幕，国际月球村中心（中国）及4个深空探测联合实验室在会上揭牌，将推动深空探测国际合作。
articles.summary_en: At the 2026 Deep Space Exploration (Tiandu) International Conference held in Hefei on Sept. 3, the International Lunar Village Center (China) and four joint deep-space exploration laboratories were inaugurated to boost international cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：中国对尼泊尔第三批紧急援助物资今天上午已经启运
articles.title_en: China's Third Batch of Emergency Aid to Nepal Delivered, Foreign Ministry Says
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上表示，中国对尼泊尔第三批紧急援助物资当天上午已启运，包括帐篷、毛毯等。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said at a regular press conference that China's third batch of emergency aid to Nepal had been shipped that morning, including tents and blankets.

articles.title_zh: 中国化工装备有限公司原党委书记蔡挺接受审查调查
articles.title_en: Cai Ting, Former Party Secretary of China Chemical Equipment Co., Ltd., Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 中央纪委国家监委驻中国中化控股纪检监察组与湖南省纪委监委通报，中国化工装备原党委书记、董事长、总经理蔡挺涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: Cai Ting, former Party Secretary, Chairman and General Manager of China Chemical Equipment Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of Sinochem Holdings, is under disciplinary and supervisory investigation for alleged serious violations of discipline and law.

tags.name_en: Hunan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision

tags_en: Hunan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision

articles.title_zh: 西藏吉隆：全力打通灾害核心区道路电力通信“生命线”
articles.title_en: Gyirong, Xizang: Efforts to Restore Lifelines of Roads, Power and Communications in Disaster-Hit Core Area
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，西藏吉隆口岸核心区域救援通道基本打通，应急管理部等部门正全力恢复电力通信，保障救援深入。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 2, rescue routes to the core area of Gyirong port in Xizang were basically opened, with authorities racing to restore power and communications after a mudslide.

articles.title_en: Zhongnanhai Monthly: August 2026
articles.summary_zh: 央视网月刊回顾习近平2026年8月重要活动：出席纪念江泽民诞辰100周年大会、主持召开政治局会议部署救灾、出访吉尔吉斯斯坦并出席上合峰会等。
articles.summary_en: CCTV's monthly review covers Xi Jinping's key activities in August 2026, including attending the centenary of Jiang Zemin, chairing a Politburo meeting on disaster relief, and visiting Kyrgyzstan for the SCO summit.

articles.title_zh: 中埃两国元首夫妇共同参观的大埃及博物馆，是一座什么馆？
articles.title_en: What Kind of Museum Is the Grand Egyptian Museum, Jointly Visited by the Two Countries' Heads of State and Their Spouses?
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月2日下午，国家主席习近平和夫人彭丽媛在埃及总统塞西和夫人陪同下参观大埃及博物馆。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 2 local time, President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan, accompanied by Egyptian President Sisi and his wife, visited the Grand Egyptian Museum.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：坚决遏制日本“新型军国主义”祸乱地区危害世界
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: Resolutely Curb Japan's 'New-Style Militarism' Harming the Region and the World
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上回应日本防卫白皮书及创纪录防卫预算，表示坚决遏制日本“新型军国主义”祸乱地区、危害世界。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Foreign Ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun responded to Japan's defense white paper and record-high military budget at a regular press conference, vowing to curb Japan's 'new-style militarism' from destabilizing the region and the world.

articles.title_zh: 上海发布加快国际贸易中心建设“十五五”规划 提出22项重点任务
articles.title_en: Shanghai Releases 15th Five-Year Plan for Accelerating International Trade Center Construction, Outlining 22 Key Tasks
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，上海市政府新闻办举行发布会，发布《上海市加快国际贸易中心建设“十五五”规划》，提出22项重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Shanghai municipal government held a press conference to release the 15th Five-Year Plan for accelerating international trade center construction, outlining 22 key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 2026年暑运两岸“小三通”运送旅客近44万人次
articles.title_en: Nearly 440,000 Passengers Traveled via Cross-Strait Mini-Three-Links During 2026 Summer
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月1日至8月31日暑运期间，福建口岸查验闽台往来旅客约57万人次，其中约43.8万人次经两岸“小三通”客运航线往来，同比增长超两成。
articles.summary_en: During 2026 summer travel (Jul 1-Aug 31), Fujian ports recorded about 570,000 cross-strait passengers; some 438,000 used mini-three-links routes, up over 20% YoY.

articles.title_zh: 王毅谈习近平出席上合组织峰会并访问吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Briefs on Xi Jinping's SCO Summit Attendance and Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅向媒体介绍习近平主席出席上合组织比什凯克峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问相关情况，强调弘扬‘上海精神’，推动全球治理改革。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 3, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, briefed on Xi Jinping's attendance at the SCO Bishkek Summit and state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt, calling for upholding the Shanghai Spirit and improving global governance.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同埃及总统塞西会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Egyptian President Sisi
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月2日，国家主席习近平在开罗同埃及总统塞西举行会谈，就中埃关系及中东局势等交换意见，并见证多项合作文件签署。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Xi Jinping held talks with Egypt's President Sisi in Cairo on bilateral ties and the Middle East, witnessing cooperation deals.

articles.title_zh: 国家发改委、交通运输部联合印发《物流网建设实施方案》
articles.title_en: NDRC and MOT Jointly Issue Implementation Plan for Logistics Network Construction
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委、交通运输部近日联合印发《物流网建设实施方案》，提出到2030年物流网建设取得明显成效，推动社会物流总费用与GDP比率降至13.1%，促进物流基础设施成链成网。
articles.summary_en: NDRC and MOT jointly issued the Implementation Plan for Logistics Network Construction, aiming to upgrade logistics infrastructure into integrated networks and cut social logistics costs to 13.1% of GDP by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致电祝贺挪威国王哈康八世即位
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Congratulates Norway's King Haakon VIII on His Accession to Throne
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，国家主席习近平致电挪威新任国王哈康八世，对其即位表示祝贺，表示愿同其一道努力，书写中挪友好交往新篇章。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory message to Norway's new King Haakon VIII on his accession, expressing readiness to write a new chapter of China-Norway friendship.

articles.title_zh: 山西省人大常委会原党组成员、副主任岳普煜严重违纪违法被开除党籍
articles.title_en: Yue Puyu, Former Deputy Director of Shanxi Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee, Expelled from CPC for Serious Disciplinary Violations
articles.summary_zh: 经中共中央批准，中央纪委国家监委对山西省人大常委会原副主任岳普煜严重违纪违法问题立案审查调查，决定给予其开除党籍处分，涉嫌犯罪问题移送检察机关依法审查起诉。
articles.summary_en: Upon CPC Central Committee approval, the CCDI and National Commission of Supervision investigated Yue Puyu, former deputy director of Shanxi Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee, for serious disciplinary violations and corruption. He was expelled from the CPC and his case transferred to procuratorates for prosecution.

tags.name_en: CCDI and National Commission of Supervision

tags_en: CCDI and National Commission of Supervision

articles.title_zh: 三部门发布《汽车行业境外竞争行为与合规建设指引》
articles.title_en: Three Ministries Issue Guidelines on Overseas Competition and Compliance for Auto Industry
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，商务部、工业和信息化部、市场监管总局联合发布《汽车行业境外竞争行为与合规建设指引》，旨在规范汽车企业境外竞争行为，加强合规建设，促进产业链国际合作。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, 2026, the Ministry of Commerce, MIIT, and SAMR jointly issued the Guidelines on Overseas Competition and Compliance for the Auto Industry to regulate overseas competition and enhance compliance.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 中央网信办深入整治AI应用乱象
articles.title_en: Central Cyberspace Administration Intensifies Crackdown on AI Application Chaos
articles.summary_zh: 中央网信办近期组织开展“清朗·整治AI应用乱象”专项行动第二阶段工作，截至9月2日累计清理违法违规信息561万余条，查处账号4.9万余个。
articles.summary_en: The Central Cyberspace Administration launched the second phase of its campaign against AI application malpractices, clearing over 5.61 million pieces of illegal information and handling 49,000 accounts as of September 2.

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥会见俄罗斯总统普京
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Meets with Russian President Putin
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月2日晚，中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥在符拉迪沃斯托克会见俄罗斯总统普京，双方就深化中俄关系与务实合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of September 2 local time, Ding Xuexiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, met with Russian President Putin in Vladivostok to exchange views on deepening bilateral ties and practical cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 全国人大常委会修订通过国防动员法 习近平签署主席令公布
articles.title_en: NPC Standing Committee Revises National Defense Mobilization Law; Xi Jinping Signs Presidential Order
articles.summary_zh: 第十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议于2026年8月28日修订通过《中华人民共和国国防动员法》，国家主席习近平签署主席令予以公布，自2026年10月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: The 24th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee passed the revised National Defense Mobilization Law on August 28, 2026. President Xi Jinping signed a presidential order to promulgate it, effective October 1, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 习近平和彭丽媛同埃及总统塞西夫妇共同参观大埃及博物馆
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan Visit Grand Egyptian Museum with Egyptian President and First Lady
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月2日下午，国家主席习近平和夫人彭丽媛在埃及总统塞西和夫人陪同下参观大埃及博物馆，强调文明交流互鉴。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 2, local time, President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan, accompanied by Egyptian President El-Sisi and his wife, visited the Grand Egyptian Museum, underscoring exchanges and mutual learning among civilizations.

articles.title_zh: 2026年《开学第一课》播出：赓续伟大精神 走好我们的长征路
articles.title_en: 2026 'First Lesson at School' Aired: Carry Forward the Great Spirit and Walk Our Long March
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，由中央宣传部、教育部、中央广播电视总台联合主办的2026年《开学第一课》播出，以“我们的长征路”为主题，讲述红军长征故事，引导青少年树立正确历史观。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, the 2026 'First Lesson at School' program, co-hosted by the Central Propaganda Department, the Ministry of Education, and China Media Group, aired under the theme 'Our Long March', telling stories of the Red Army to guide youth in forming a correct view of history.

articles.title_zh: 王宁在昭通市调研时强调 加快发展壮大资源经济园区经济 毫不放松抓好群众持续增收
articles.title_en: Wang Ning Emphasizes Resource Economy, Industrial Parks, and Income Growth During Zhaotong Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日至3日，云南省委书记王宁在昭通市调研，走访光伏企业、苹果庄园和花椒基地，强调加快发展资源经济和园区经济，持续促进群众增收。
articles.summary_en: Yunnan Party Secretary Wang Ning inspected Zhaotong on Sept 2-3, calling for a stronger resource- and industrial-park economy and sustained rural income growth.

articles.title_zh: 王予波在文山州调研时强调 全力以赴稳增长稳产业稳企业稳投资
articles.title_en: Wang Yubo Inspects Wenshan Prefecture, Stresses Efforts to Stabilize Growth, Industry, Enterprises and Investment
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日至3日，云南省委副书记、省长王予波在文山州调研，强调全力稳增长、稳产业、稳企业、稳投资，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 2 to 3, Wang Yubo, Deputy Secretary of Yunnan Provincial Party Committee and Governor, inspected Wenshan Prefecture, stressing efforts to stabilize growth, industry, enterprises and investment for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 省领导到辽宁考察对接对口合作工作
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Leaders Visit Liaoning for Counterpart Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日至9月2日，江苏省委常委、常务副省长马欣率队赴辽宁考察，与辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟会见，深化对接对口合作。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 31 to Sep 2, Ma Xin, Executive Vice Governor of Jiangsu, led a delegation to Liaoning and met with Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei to deepen inter-provincial cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见江苏省代表团一行
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet Jiangsu Provincial Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见江苏省委常委、常务副省长马欣率领的江苏省代表团一行，就深化辽苏对口合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Xu Kunlin, Secretary of CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee, and Governor Wang Xinwei met in Shenyang with a Jiangsu delegation led by Ma Xin, Executive Vice Governor of Jiangsu, to discuss deepening Liaoning-Jiangsu counterpart cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁省推进招商引资工作视频会议召开 王新伟出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Liaoning Holds Provincial Video Conference on Investment Promotion; Governor Wang Xinwei Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，辽宁省推进招商引资工作视频会议在沈阳召开，省委副书记、省长王新伟出席并讲话，强调着力提高招商引资实效性，以高质量项目支撑高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Liaoning held a provincial video conference on investment promotion in Shenyang. Governor Wang Xinwei attended and spoke, emphasizing the need to improve the effectiveness of investment attraction and support high-quality development with high-quality projects.

articles.title_zh: 霍步刚在皇姑区调研重大项目建设时强调 着力谋项目招项目推项目 为高质量发展注入新动力
articles.title_en: Huo Bugang Visits Huanggu District to Inspect Major Projects, Stressing Vigorous Planning, Attraction and Promotion of Projects to Boost High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，沈阳市委书记霍步刚在皇姑区调研重大项目建设，强调要贯彻习近平总书记对辽宁、沈阳的指示精神，着力谋划、招引、推动项目，为高质量发展注入新动力。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Huo Bugang, Party Secretary of Shenyang, inspected major project construction in Huanggu District, stressing the need to plan, attract and promote projects to inject new momentum into high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 市政府党组召开2026年第10次（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Chifeng Municipal Government Party Group Holds 10th (Enlarged) Meeting in 2026
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，赤峰市市长栾天猛主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记对西藏泥石流灾害的重要指示和李强总理批示精神，部署防灾减灾及基层减负工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, Chifeng Mayor Luan Tianmeng chaired the municipal government party group meeting, conveying Xi Jinping's instructions on Tibet mudslide and Li Qiang's directives, and deploying disaster prevention and bureaucracy reduction.

articles.title_zh: 唐毅主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议暨市委党建工作领导小组会议
articles.title_en: Tang Yi Chairs Municipal Party Committee Meetings on Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，赤峰市委书记唐毅主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议暨市委党建工作领导小组会议，传达习近平总书记重要指示精神，总结树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育情况，部署贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, Tang Yi, Chifeng's party secretary, chaired an enlarged municipal party committee meeting and party building group meeting to convey Xi's directives and review political-achievement education.

articles.title_zh: 促进中小企业发展“十五五”规划发布
articles.title_en: 15th Five-Year Plan for Promoting SME Development Released
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部等10部门印发《促进中小企业发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年中小企业研发投入年均增长8%以上、专精特新“小巨人”企业达2.2万家等目标。
articles.summary_en: MIIT and nine other departments issued a plan to boost SME development in the 15th Five-Year Plan period, targeting over 8% annual R&D growth and 22,000 'little giant' firms by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席总结中埃关系70年鲜明特征
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Summarizes Distinctive Features of 70 Years of China-Egypt Relations
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，国家主席习近平在开罗同埃及总统塞西会谈，总结中埃关系70年鲜明特征，双方发表联合声明并签署20余份合作文件。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, President Xi Jinping held talks with Egyptian President Sisi in Cairo, summarizing the distinctive features of 70 years of China-Egypt relations, issuing a joint statement and signing over 20 cooperation documents.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席的“比什凯克时间”：主动引领历史航向的大国担当
articles.title_en: President Xi's 'Bishkek Time': A Major Power's Responsibility to Steer History
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日至9月1日，习近平主席出席上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问，分别与吉、乌总统会谈，签署多项合作文件，强调共同发展。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 30 to Sep 1, President Xi Jinping attended the SCO summit and paid a state visit to Kyrgyzstan, holding talks with leaders and signing cooperation documents.

articles.title_zh: 59项强制性国家标准9月起实施
articles.title_en: 59 Mandatory National Standards Take Effect from September
articles.summary_zh: 市场监管总局披露，9月1日起59项强制性国家标准和375项推荐性国家标准实施，涉及家电健康节能、劳动护肤剂、城轨适老化等。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation announced that from Sept 1, 59 mandatory and 375 recommended national standards took effect, covering home appliance health, energy conservation, skin protectants, and aging-friendly urban rail.

articles.title_zh: 锚定体育强国建设 推动体育高质量发展
articles.title_en: Anchoring Sports Powerhouse Construction and Promoting High-Quality Sports Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，国务院新闻办举行发布会，国家体育总局介绍“十五五”时期体育强国建设情况，将完善全民健身公共服务体系、改革竞技体育管理体制、推动体育产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: At a press conference on Sept. 3, the General Administration of Sport outlined plans for the 15th Five-Year Plan period to build a sporting powerhouse, including improving public fitness services, reforming competitive sports management, and boosting the sports industry.

articles.title_zh: 国家能源局部署新型电网建设重大任务
articles.title_en: National Energy Administration Deploys Major Tasks for New-Type Power Grid Construction
articles.summary_zh: 近日，国家能源局召开新型电网建设工作部署会，部署“十五五”时期新型电网建设任务，强调夯实基础设施、创新引领、多元支撑和安全运行。
articles.summary_en: The National Energy Administration held a meeting to deploy major tasks for new-type power grid construction during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, focusing on infrastructure, innovation, support, and safety.

articles.title_zh: 刘国中在内蒙古调研时强调 切实抓好农业防灾减灾 全力夺取秋粮丰产丰收
articles.title_en: Liu Guozhong Stresses Agricultural Disaster Prevention and Autumn Grain Harvest During Inner Mongolia Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理刘国中9月1日至3日在内蒙古调研，要求切实抓好农业防灾减灾，全力夺取秋粮丰产丰收。
articles.summary_en: Vice Premier Liu Guozhong inspected Inner Mongolia from Sept 1 to 3, urging effective disaster prevention and reduction in agriculture to ensure a bumper autumn grain harvest.

articles.title_zh: 习近平结束出席2026年上海合作组织峰会和对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及的国事访问回到北京
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Returns to Beijing After Attending 2026 SCO Summit and State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日上午，国家主席习近平圆满结束出席2026年上海合作组织峰会和对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及的国事访问，回到北京。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 3, President Xi Jinping returned to Beijing after successfully attending the 2026 SCO Summit and state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt.

articles.title_zh: 张丹到市数据和政务服务局调研
articles.title_en: Zhang Dan Inspects Municipal Data and Government Services Bureau
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，丹东市委副书记、市长张丹到市数据和政务服务局调研，强调用好12345热线平台，提升政务服务质效，优化营商环境。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Zhang Dan, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Dandong Municipal Committee and Mayor of Dandong, visited the Municipal Data and Government Services Bureau, stressing the use of the 12345 hotline to improve government service quality and optimize the business environment.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和重要指示批示精神
articles.title_en: Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting to Convey and Study Xi Jinping's Important Speech and Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，丹东市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和重要指示批示精神，研究贯彻落实意见。市委书记蒋冰主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, the Standing Committee of the CPC Dandong Municipal Committee held a meeting to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions, and to discuss implementation plans. Municipal Party Secretary Jiang Bing presided and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 全省推进招商引资工作视频会议召开 王新伟出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Liaoning Holds Provincial Video Conference on Investment Promotion, Governor Wang Xinwei Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，全省推进招商引资工作视频会议在沈阳召开。省委副书记、省长王新伟出席并讲话，强调提高招商引资实效性，以高质量项目支撑高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Liaoning Province held a video conference on investment promotion in Shenyang. Governor Wang Xinwei attended and delivered a speech, stressing the need to improve investment promotion effectiveness and support high-quality development with high-quality projects.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱主持召开市委党的建设工作领导小组会议
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Chairs Meeting of Municipal Party Committee Leadership Group on Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱主持召开市委党的建设工作领导小组会议，强调贯彻习近平党建思想，巩固拓展学习教育成果，推动高质量转型发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Wang Xingzhu, Secretary of the Hegang Municipal Party Committee, chaired a meeting of the Municipal Party Committee's Party Building Work Leading Group, emphasizing implementation of Xi Jinping's thoughts on party building and consolidating achievements of the learning education.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱会见新华社黑龙江分社社长顾钱江一行
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Meets with Xinhua Heilongjiang Branch Head Gu Qianjiang
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱会见新华社黑龙江分社社长顾钱江一行，双方就加强新闻宣传、支持鹤岗高质量发展进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Hegang Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu met with Gu Qianjiang, head of Xinhua Heilongjiang Branch, to discuss strengthening media cooperation and supporting Hegang's high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研推进全域“双高协同”工作
articles.title_en: Municipal Leaders Promote Citywide 'Double High Collaboration' Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，淮安市市长顾坤赴淮安高新区、经开区调研，强调全域推广“双高协同”改革经验，促进园区与高校院所协同创新。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Huai'an Mayor Gu Kun visited the High-tech Zone and Economic Development Zone to promote the citywide 'Double High Collaboration' initiative, stressing synergy between parks and universities.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研推进全域“双高协同”工作
articles.title_en: Mayor Gu Kun Surveys City-wide 'Double-High Collaboration' Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，淮安市市长顾坤到淮安高新区、经开区调研推进全域“双高协同”工作，强调促进开发园区与高校院所双向赋能，推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, Huai'an Mayor Gu Kun surveyed high-tech and economic zones on the 'Double-High Collaboration' drive, urging synergy between parks and universities to integrate tech and industrial innovation.

articles.title_zh: 市政府2026年第17次党组会暨理论学习中心组学习会议召开 黄韡主持会议并讲话
articles.title_en: Municipal Government Holds 17th Party Group Meeting, Huang Wei Presides and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日下午，淮北市政府召开2026年第17次党组会暨理论学习中心组学习会议，代市长黄韡主持并讲话，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示和中央、省委、市委党建领导小组会议精神。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 3 afternoon, Huaibei Municipal Government held its 17th Party Group meeting. Acting Mayor Huang Wei presided, conveying Xi Jinping's instructions and party-building meeting spirits.

articles.title_zh: 于海田调研中试平台建设工作时强调 建强用好中试平台 加速科技成果转化
articles.title_en: Yu Haitian Inspects Pilot Platform Construction in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，济南市委副书记、市长于海田调研中试平台建设，强调要建强用好中试平台，加速科技成果转化，为省会高质量发展提供强劲动能。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Yu Haitian, Deputy Secretary and Mayor of Jinan, inspected pilot platform construction and stressed strengthening and utilizing these platforms to accelerate commercialization of scientific achievements.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保调研国道G206线揭阳新亨至地都段改建工程项目
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao Inspects Reconstruction Project of National Highway G206 in Jieyang
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日下午，揭阳市委书记曾风保调研国道G206线改建工程，强调攻坚征拆难点，推动项目提速增效。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, Zeng Fengbao, Secretary of Jieyang Municipal Committee, inspected the G206 reconstruction project, urging efforts to overcome land acquisition obstacles and speed up construction.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰带队到普宁市调研“百千万工程”建设情况
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Leads Team to Puning to Inspect Construction of the "Hundreds, Thousands, and Tens of Thousands" Project
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，揭阳市市长曲晓杰带队到普宁市调研“百千万工程”建设情况，走访多家重点企业，强调要抢抓转型机遇，聚焦科技创新与产业升级，为高质量发展注入动力。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Qu Xiaojie, Mayor of Jieyang, led a team to Puning to inspect the "Hundreds, Thousands, and Tens of Thousands" project and visited key enterprises, emphasizing seizing transformation opportunities and integrating sci-tech innovation with industrial upgrading for high-quality development.

tags.name_en: Hundreds, Thousands, and Tens of Thousands Project

tags_en: Hundreds, Thousands, and Tens of Thousands Project

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰带队到普宁市调研“百千万工程”建设情况
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Leads Delegation to Puning to Inspect 'Baiqianwan' Development Project
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，揭阳市委副书记、市长曲晓杰带队到普宁市调研“百千万工程”建设情况，走访多家重点企业，强调聚力产业升级。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, Qu Xiaojie, deputy secretary of Jieyang Municipal Party Committee and mayor, led a delegation to Puning to inspect the 'Baiqianwan' project and visit key enterprises, stressing industrial upgrading and quality development.

articles.title_zh: 拉萨市人民代表大会常务委员会批准任免名单
articles.title_en: Lhasa Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Approves Appointment and Removal List
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月1日，拉萨市第十二届人民代表大会常务委员会第三十八次会议通过批准任免名单。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, 2026, the 38th session of the Standing Committee of the 12th Lhasa Municipal People's Congress approved the appointment and removal list.

tags.name_en: Standing Committee of Lhasa Municipal People's Congress

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁主持召开市委议军会议暨人武部党委第一书记述职会议
articles.title_en: Dawa Tsering Chairs Lhasa Municipal Party Committee Military Work Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 拉萨市委书记达娃次仁主持召开市委议军会议暨人武部党委第一书记述职会议，强调深入学习贯彻习近平强军思想，为如期实现建军一百年奋斗目标贡献力量。
articles.summary_en: Dawa Tsering, Lhasa Party chief, chaired a municipal military affairs meeting, urging in-depth study of Xi Jinping Thought on Strengthening the Military and contributions to the PLA's centenary goal.

articles.title_zh: 西藏吉隆县泥石流灾害新闻发布会召开
articles.title_en: Press Conference Held on Debris Flow Disaster in Gyirong County, Xizang
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，西藏吉隆县泥石流灾害新闻发布会在吉隆镇召开，自治区主席嘎玛泽登出席介绍救援进展，常务副主席任维回答记者提问。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, the press conference on the debris flow disaster in Gyirong County, Xizang was held in Gyirong Town. Chairman Garma Cedain of Xizang introduced rescue progress; Vice Chairman Ren Wei answered questions.

articles.title_zh: 全区金融系统党的建设工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Party Building Work Conference for the Financial System Held
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，全区金融系统党的建设工作会议在拉萨召开，传达学习习近平党建思想，总结部署金融系统党建工作，自治区副主席韦秀长出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, the regional financial system party building work conference was held in Lhasa to convey Xi Jinping's thought on party building and arrange next steps. Wei Xiuchang, vice chairman of the region, attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 王君正在自治区党委党校2026年秋季学期开学典礼上强调树立和践行正确政绩观
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Stresses Correct View of Political Achievements at Autumn Party School Opening
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正在自治区党委党校秋季学期开学典礼上讲话，强调树立和践行正确政绩观，推动长治久安和高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 1, Tibet Party Secretary Wang Junzheng urged establishing a correct view of political achievements to promote lasting stability and high-quality development at the regional Party School's autumn opening ceremony.

articles.title_zh: 龙岩市领导赴上杭县和永定区调研乡村振兴工作
articles.title_en: Longyan Leaders Visit Shanghang and Yongding to Survey Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日至2日，龙岩市委书记胡盛深入上杭县和永定区乡村调研，强调党建引领乡村振兴，发展特色产业。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 1-2, Longyan Party Secretary Hu Sheng visited rural areas in Shanghang and Yongding, urging Party building-led rural revitalization and development of distinctive industries.

articles.title_zh: 全区金融系统党的建设工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Party Building Work Conference for Regional Financial System Held in Lhasa
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，全区金融系统党的建设工作会议在拉萨召开，自治区副主席韦秀长出席并讲话，强调贯彻习近平党建思想，部署重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, a Party building conference for the regional financial system was held in Lhasa. Wei Xiuchang, vice-chairman, spoke on Xi Jinping's Party building thought.

articles.title_zh: 王君正：坚定坚决贯彻落实习近平总书记重要指示精神牢固树立和践行正确政绩观努力推动长治久安和高质量发展
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Stresses Implementing Xi Jinping's Instructions and Correct View of Political Achievements at Party School Opening Ceremony
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正在自治区党委党校秋季学期开学典礼上讲话，强调贯彻落实习近平总书记关于西藏工作的重要指示，树牢正确政绩观，推动长治久安和高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the CPC Tibet Autonomous Regional Committee, spoke at the regional Party school's autumn semester opening ceremony, stressing implementation of Xi Jinping's important instructions on Tibet work and promoting long-term stability and high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群到汕头海关开展调研
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Visits Shantou Customs for Research and Exchange
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日上午，汕头市委书记庄悦群到汕头海关调研，就深化关地协同合作、扩大高水平对外开放与海关领导班子座谈交流。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 2, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn visited Shantou Customs to discuss deepening local-customs cooperation and expanding high-level opening-up.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群调研养老服务工作
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Inspects Elderly Care Services in Shantou
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日下午，汕头市委书记庄悦群到金平区、龙湖区调研养老服务工作，强调优化服务供给、提升服务品质，推动养老事业和养老产业协同发展。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 2, Zhuang Yuequn, Secretary of the Shantou Municipal Party Committee, inspected elderly care services in Jinping and Longhu districts, emphasizing improved service supply and coordinated development of elderly care programs and industry.

tags.name_en: Integration of Medical and Elderly Care

tags_en: Integration of Medical and Elderly Care

articles.title_zh: 周小壮带队调研汕尾沉香产业 推动沉香产业发展走深走实
articles.title_en: Zhou Xiaozhuang Leads Research on Shanwei Agarwood Industry
articles.summary_zh: 近日，汕尾市副市长周小壮到海丰县莲花山专题调研沉香产业，要求打造具有区域竞争力的特色产业集群，推动沉香产业走深走实。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Shanwei Vice Mayor Zhou Xiaozhuang visited Lianhua Mountain in Haifeng County to investigate the agarwood industry, urging the creation of a regionally competitive industrial cluster to promote its development.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰会见信利集团董事会主席兼行政总裁林伟华一行
articles.title_en: Lufeng Meets Truly Group Chairman and CEO Lin Weihua
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，汕尾市委书记逯峰会见了信利集团董事长兼行政总裁林伟华一行，双方就深化合作、做大做强电子信息产业进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Shanwei Municipal Party Secretary Lufeng met with Truly Group Chairman and CEO Lin Weihua to discuss deepening cooperation and strengthening the electronic information industry.

articles.title_zh: 银川市金凤区举行第六届人民代表大会代表换届选举 李邑飞参加所在选区投票选举
articles.title_en: Yinchuan's Jinfeng District Holds Reelection of People's Congress Deputies; Li Yifei Votes in His Constituency
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，银川市金凤区举行第六届人民代表大会代表换届选举，自治区党委书记李邑飞在所在选区参加投票。县乡人大代表选举工作将于9月15日基本完成。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Yinchuan's Jinfeng District held the reelection of its sixth People's Congress deputies. Li Yifei, secretary of the regional Party committee, voted in his constituency. County and township elections are expected to be basically completed by September 15.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏回族自治区政府召开常务会议
articles.title_en: Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region Government Holds Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，自治区主席张雨浦主持召开自治区政府常务会议，研究防范化解重大灾害风险、推进“十五五”碳达峰行动、建设荒漠化防治合作中心等工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Chairman Zhang Yupu chaired the regional government's executive meeting to discuss major disaster risk prevention, the 15th Five-Year Plan carbon peak action, and desertification control cooperation center construction.

articles.title_zh: 深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想理论研讨会在泰安召开 陈扬勇温暖杨洪涛出席并致辞
articles.title_en: Seminar on Xi Jinping's Party Building Thought Held in Tai'an; Chen Yangyong, Wen Nuan, Yang Hongtao Attend
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想理论研讨会在山东泰安召开，求是杂志社社长陈扬勇、山东省副省长温暖、泰安市委书记杨洪涛出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, a seminar on Xi Jinping's party building thought was held in Tai'an, Shandong. Chen Yangyong, Wen Nuan, and Yang Hongtao attended and delivered speeches.

tags.name_en: Publicity Department of Shandong Provincial Party Committee
Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building

tags_en: Publicity Department of Shandong Provincial Party Committee

articles.title_zh: 泰州召开项目攻坚观摩推进会
articles.title_en: Taizhou Holds City-wide Project Promotion Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，泰州市召开项目攻坚观摩推进会，市委书记姜冬冬强调要实字当头、效字为要，推动项目攻坚取得实效，市长李晖主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, Taizhou held a city-wide project promotion meeting. Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong stressed practical results; Mayor Li Hui chaired. They had earlier visited key projects in Jiangyan and Taixing.

articles.title_zh: 孔凡萍主持召开威海市政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Kong Fanping Chairs Weihai Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，威海市长孔凡萍主持召开市政府第74次常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，审议农业防灾减灾和消防管理相关文件。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, Mayor Kong Fanping chaired the 74th executive meeting of Weihai Municipal Government to study Xi Jinping's recent speeches and review documents on agricultural disaster relief and fire safety management.

articles.title_zh: 张海波到高区调研新一代信息技术产业链发展情况
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Inspects New-Generation IT Industry Chain in High-tech Zone
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，威海市委书记张海波到高区调研新一代信息技术产业链，强调实施工业经济“头号工程”，强化科技创新和数字赋能。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Zhang Haibo, Secretary of the Weihai Municipal Party Committee, visited the high-tech zone to inspect the new-generation information technology industry chain, emphasizing science and technology innovation and digital empowerment.
keywords: 新一代信息技术产业链

tags_zh: 新一代信息技术产业链

articles.title_zh: 张海波会见新西兰客人
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Meets New Zealand Guests
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，威海市委书记张海波会见新西兰驻华大使乔文博一行，双方就深化经贸、教育、人文等领域合作交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, Zhang Haibo, Party Secretary of Weihai, met with New Zealand Ambassador to China and his delegation to discuss deepening cooperation in trade, education and cultural exchanges.

articles.title_zh: 全市安全稳定专题会议召开
articles.title_en: Municipal Meeting on Safety and Stability Held in Weihai
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，威海市召开全市安全稳定专题会议，市委书记张海波出席并讲话，市长孔凡萍主持，部署下步重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Weihai held a municipal meeting on safety and stability. Party Secretary Zhang Haibo attended and spoke, while Mayor Kong Fanping presided over the meeting to arrange key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 陈东赴高新区（弋江区）开展调研
articles.title_en: Chen Dong Conducts Investigation in High-tech Zone (Yijiang District)
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，芜湖市委副书记、代市长陈东赴高新区（弋江区）调研产业园区和重点企业，了解半导体、新能源汽车等产业发展情况。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Chen Dong, deputy secretary of the Wuhu Municipal Party Committee and acting mayor, visited the High-tech Zone to inspect industrial parks and key enterprises, focusing on semiconductors and NEVs.

articles.title_zh: 陈东赴鸠江区开展调研
articles.title_en: Chen Dong Conducts Research in Jiujiang District
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，芜湖市委副书记、代市长陈东赴鸠江区调研科创平台建设和重点企业发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Chen Dong, Deputy Secretary of the Wuhu Municipal Party Committee and Acting Mayor, visited Jiujiang District to inspect sci-tech innovation platforms and key enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作
articles.title_en: Wuxi Party Secretary Inspects Rectification of Misconduct and Corruption Around the People
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，无锡市委书记杜小刚调研群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作，强调强化食品安全和农产品质量安全监管，维护群众“舌尖上的安全”。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, Wuxi Party Secretary Du Xiaogang inspected the rectification of misconduct and corruption affecting the people, stressing stronger food safety and agricultural product quality supervision.
keywords: 群众身边腐败问题整治

articles.title_zh: AI+全域康养产业融合发展试验区启动
articles.title_en: AI + Integrated Health and Wellness Industry Pilot Zone Launches
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，AI+全域康养产业融合发展试验区启动仪式在无锡举行。该项目由无锡市医疗健康集团与新吴区江溪街道联合打造，规划床位180张，将构建机构、社区、居家三位一体的医养服务体系。
articles.summary_en: The launch ceremony of the AI + integrated health and wellness industry pilot zone was held in Wuxi on Sept 1. Jointly built by Wuxi Medical Health Group and Jiangxi Subdistrict, it plans 180 beds.

tags.name_en: Integration of Medical Care and Eldercare

tags_en: Integration of Medical Care and Eldercare

articles.title_zh: 西安市委常委会会议暨市委党的建设工作领导小组会议召开 强调巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果
articles.title_en: Xi'an Municipal Standing Committee Meeting Emphasizes Consolidating Education on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，西安市委常委会会议暨市委党的建设工作领导小组会议召开，总结树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成效，部署巩固拓展工作。省委常委、市委书记蒿慧杰主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, the Standing Committee Meeting of the Xi'an Municipal CPC Committee and the Meeting of the Municipal Party Building Leading Group were held to summarize the education campaign on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements and to plan further consolidation. Hao Huijie, member of the Provincial Standing Committee and Secretary of the Municipal CPC Committee, presided over and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议认真学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神研究安排防汛减灾和联动巡视整改等工作
articles.title_en: Xi'an Municipal Party Standing Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Instructions and Arrange Flood Control and Inspection Rectification
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，西安市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记对西藏吉隆县泥石流灾害的重要指示精神和中央政治局会议精神，听取“保回迁”问题整改进展汇报，市委书记蒿慧杰主持。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, the CPC Xi'an Municipal Standing Committee met to convey and study Xi Jinping's instructions on the Tibet mudslide and the Political Bureau meeting spirit, and heard rectification progress on 'Baohuiqian' resettlement. Hao Huijie, municipal party secretary, presided.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰会见中兴通讯董事长方榕一行
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Meets ZTE Chairman Fang Rong and Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，陕西省委常委、西安市委书记蒿慧杰会见中兴通讯董事长方榕一行，双方就加强战略合作、促进数字经济和人工智能融合发展等进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Hao Huijie, member of the Standing Committee of the Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Xi'an Municipal Party Committee, met with Fang Rong, Chairman of ZTE, and her delegation to discuss enhancing strategic cooperation and promoting integrated development of digital economy and AI.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平督办市政协重点提案
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Supervises Key Proposals of Municipal CPPCC
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，盐城市委书记严汉平督办市政协重点提案，强调加快人工智能发展，市政协主席羊维达主持。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, Yan Hanping, Yancheng Municipal Party Secretary, supervised key proposals of the Municipal CPPCC, stressing faster AI development; CPPCC Chairman Yang Weida hosted the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 全市市县乡三级人大换届选举工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Yancheng Holds Work Meeting on Three-Level People's Congress Election
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，盐城市召开市县乡三级人大换届选举工作会议。市委书记严汉平出席并讲话，市人大常委会主任王荣部署整体工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Yancheng held a meeting to arrange elections for municipal, county and township people's congresses. Party Secretary Yan Hanping spoke, and Wang Rong, director of the Standing Committee, explained the plan.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会开展文旅融合发展情况专题调研
articles.title_en: Yangjiang Municipal People's Congress Conducts Special Research on Cultural and Tourism Integration
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日至2日，阳江市人大常委会调研组赴阳春、阳西等地，通过实地察看了解文旅融合发展情况，强调挖掘本土文化资源，赋能乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 1 to 2, a research group of the Yangjiang Municipal People's Congress visited Yangchun and Yangxi to inspect cultural and tourism integration, stressing local cultural resources to boost rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 市委党校（市行政学院）举行2026年秋季学期开学典礼
articles.title_en: Party School of Yangjiang Municipal Committee Holds Autumn Semester Opening Ceremony
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，阳江市委党校举行秋季学期开学典礼，市委书记卢一先出席并作专题辅导，强调年轻干部树立正确政绩观。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, the Party School of Yangjiang Municipal Committee held its autumn semester opening ceremony; Party Secretary Lu Yixian attended and delivered a special lecture on the correct view of political achievements for young cadres.

articles.title_zh: 余金富到阳西县调研
articles.title_en: Yu Jinfu Visits Yangxi County for Research

Zhao Xuhui, member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Autonomous Region Committee and Secretary of the Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee, and other municipal leaders voted.

articles.title_zh: 湛江市十五届人大常委会召开第五十次会议

articles.title_en: Pinglu Canal Holds Comprehensive Ship Navigation Drill
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，平陆运河举行船舶通航全要素综合演练，集结14家单位20余艘船舶，为正式通航做准备。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, the Pinglu Canal held a comprehensive ship navigation drill with 14 units and over 20 vessels to prepare for official opening.

articles.title_zh: 重庆打出森林防灭火“组合拳”
articles.title_en: Chongqing Rolls Out Multi-Pronged Measures for Forest Fire Prevention
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，重庆在两江新区等地开展森林防火演练，通过无人机空中巡护、前置指挥部和“十户联防”等组合措施，构建地面巡护与空中巡检立体防控格局。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Chongqing conducted forest fire drills in Liangjiang New Area and other places, using drones, forward command posts and the "ten-household joint defense" mechanism to build a three-dimensional prevention and control pattern.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省多措并举推动中药工业提质升级
articles.title_en: Gansu Takes Multiple Measures to Upgrade Traditional Chinese Medicine Industry
articles.summary_zh: “十五五”时期，甘肃将从壮大市场主体、夯实制造根基等五方面推动中药工业提质升级，提升陇药产业竞争力。
articles.summary_en: During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, Gansu will promote the quality upgrading of the traditional Chinese medicine industry through five aspects, including strengthening market entities and manufacturing foundation, to enhance the competitiveness of Longyao.

articles.title_zh: 兰州新区首届“新事心办”政务技能大赛启动
articles.title_en: Lanzhou New Area Launches First 'Xinshi Xinban' Government Services Skills Competition
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，兰州新区首届“新事心办”政务技能大赛启动并开始报名，面向全区政务服务人员，以赛代训提升服务水准。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 1, Lanzhou New Area launched its first 'Xinshi Xinban' government services skills competition for all local government service employees, using contests to enhance service quality.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃发布“人工智能+教育”行动计划
articles.title_en: Gansu Issues Action Plan for 'AI + Education'
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省教育厅等五部门印发《甘肃省“人工智能+教育”行动计划（2026-2030年）》，提出到2030年建成示范区，并从2027年秋季学期起在中小学校普及人工智能通识教育。
articles.summary_en: The Gansu Provincial Department of Education and four other departments issued an action plan for AI-plus-education, aiming to build a demonstration zone by 2030 and to popularize general AI education in primary and secondary schools from the fall semester of 2027.

articles.title_zh: 包兰铁路第二阶段集中修启动
articles.title_en: Baotou-Lanzhou Railway Launches Second Phase of Intensive Maintenance
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，兰州铁路局启动包兰铁路第二阶段集中修，计划进行换轨、清筛、捣固等作业，提升线路设备质量。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Lanzhou Railway Bureau launched the second phase of intensive maintenance on the Baotou-Lanzhou Railway, including rail replacement, ballast cleaning, and tamping to improve track quality.

articles.title_zh: 广西启动2026年“质量月”系列活动
articles.title_en: Guangxi Launches 2026 Quality Month Activities
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，广西启动2026年“质量月”系列活动，21个部门推出60项特色活动，聚焦质量服务与产业升级，助力高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Guangxi launched its 2026 Quality Month campaign, with 21 departments organizing 60 activities focused on quality services, industrial upgrading, and public welfare to support high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 贵州推动非常规天然气增储上产
articles.title_en: Guizhou Promotes Increase in Unconventional Natural Gas Reserves and Production
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，贵州省人民政府办公厅印发《贵州省非常规天然气增储上产三年攻坚行动方案（2026—2028年）》，聚焦页岩气、煤层气，系统推进勘探、开发、储运、利用全链条建设。
articles.summary_en: On Sep 2, Guizhou issued a three-year plan (2026-2028) to boost unconventional gas reserves and production, focusing on shale gas and coalbed methane across the full industry chain.

articles.title_zh: 孩子写作业先问AI，家长怎么办（教育优质均衡发展·四问“人工智能+教育”①）
articles.title_en: Children Turn to AI for Homework: What Should Parents Do? (Balanced Quality Education Development · Four Questions on 'AI + Education' 1)
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报“教育优质均衡发展·四问‘人工智能+教育’”系列报道聚焦学生用AI写作业现象，采访专家、教师，探讨家长应对之策，提出培养AI素养与建立分级机制。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily series on balanced quality education discusses students using AI for homework. Experts and teachers advise parents to guide children to use AI properly, avoid replacing thinking, and call for age-appropriate AI regulation.

articles.title_zh: 河南高速首批百余座闪充站投运
articles.title_en: First Batch of 100+ Flash Charging Stations Put into Operation on Henan Expressways
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，河南高速公路首批百余座闪充站在京港澳高速新郑等119个服务区正式投运，最快9分钟充满电，由河南交投与比亚迪合作建设。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, the first batch of over 100 flash charging stations was put into operation at 119 service areas on Henan expressways, cutting charging time to as little as 9 minutes through cooperation between Henan Jiantou and BYD.

articles.title_zh: 大力推进数字湖北 赋能经济发展添彩生活
articles.title_en: Hubei Governor Emphasizes Digital Hubei Construction to Empower Economy and Livelihood
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，湖北省省长李殿勋在武汉调研数字湖北建设并召开领导小组会议，强调推进数字技术与各领域融合，为经济发展、社会治理和人民生活在添彩。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Hubei Governor Li Dianxun visited Wuhan to inspect Digital Hubei construction and chaired a leading group meeting, urging deeper integration of digital technology to empower economic development, social governance, and people's livelihood.

articles.title_zh: 扣紧责任链条 采取有力有效措施抓好安全生产
articles.title_en: Hebei Party Secretary Urges Tightening Responsibility Chain for Work Safety
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，河北省委书记罗文在石家庄专题检查安全生产工作，强调扣紧责任链条，采取有力有效措施坚决守住安全生产底线。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Luo Wen, Secretary of Hebei Provincial Party Committee, inspected work safety in Shijiazhuang, stressing tight responsibility chain and effective measures to ensure safety.

articles.title_zh: 罗文在雄安新区调研强调深化高水平保护打造生态城市
articles.title_en: Luo Wen Visits Xiong'an New Area, Urges Building Ecological City Through High-Level Protection
articles.summary_zh: 近日，河北省委书记罗文在雄安新区调研，强调要加快建设美丽雄安，通过深化高水平保护打造生态城市，推动新区生态环境保护全面绿色发展。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Luo Wen, Secretary of Hebei Provincial Party Committee, visited Xiong'an New Area and stressed building an ecological city through high-level environmental protection and green development.

articles.title_zh: 加快推动产业结构转型升级 走出具有陵水特色的高质量发展之路
articles.title_en: Feng Fei Stresses Accelerating Industrial Restructuring for Lingshui's High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，海南省委书记冯飞赴陵水调研，察看园区、高校等，强调加快产业结构转型升级，打造热带海岛滨海精致城市。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Hainan Provincial Party Secretary Feng Fei visited Lingshui to inspect industrial parks and universities, stressing faster industrial transformation to build a refined coastal tropical city.

articles.title_zh: 刘小明在琼中调研经济社会发展情况
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaoming Inspects Economic and Social Development in Qiongzhong
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，海南省省长刘小明赴琼中黎族苗族自治县调研，考察园区、乡村振兴和项目建设，强调发展特色产业，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Hainan Governor Liu Xiaoming visited Qiongzhong Li and Miao Autonomous County to inspect economic and social development, emphasizing distinctive industries and high-quality growth.

articles.title_zh: 江苏首票半导体晶圆清洗设备保税维修业务在南通综保区落地
articles.title_en: Jiangsu's First Bonded Repair Business for Semiconductor Wafer Cleaning Equipment Starts in Nantong
articles.summary_zh: 近日，江苏省首票半导体晶圆清洗设备保税维修业务在南通综保区落地。9月2日，首批6台设备进入赛芈科技厂区维修，实现南通保税维修业态零的突破。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu's first bonded repair business for semiconductor wafer cleaning equipment has landed in Nantong. Six units entered maintenance on Sept 2, a first for the local sector.

articles.title_zh: 连云港出台促进宠物经济高质量发展三年行动方案
articles.title_en: Lianyungang Unveils Three-Year Action Plan for Pet Economy Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，连云港市发布促进宠物经济高质量发展三年行动方案，提出到2028年宠物经济产业规模突破70亿元。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Lianyungang released a three-year action plan to boost high-quality development of the pet economy, targeting over 7 billion yuan in industry scale by 2028.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行︱龙虾超级工厂来了
articles.title_en: Vibrant China Research Tour: Lobster Super Factory Arrives
articles.summary_zh: 今年夏天，江苏淮安盱眙龙虾超级工厂一期试生产，旺季过后接茬加工罗氏沼虾；该县龙虾全产业链总产值去年突破400亿元。
articles.summary_en: This summer, the first phase of the Xuyi Lobster Super Factory in Huai'an, Jiangsu began trial production, processing giant freshwater prawns after the lobster season. The county's lobster industry chain output value exceeded 40 billion yuan last year.

articles.title_zh: 自治区人民政府和上海交通大学签署全面合作协议
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Government and Shanghai Jiao Tong University Sign Comprehensive Cooperation Agreement
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，自治区人民政府和上海交通大学签署全面合作协议，包钢、丁奎岭见证签约。双方将聚焦科技创新、医疗协作、人才引育等领域开展务实合作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 1, the Inner Mongolia regional government and Shanghai Jiao Tong University signed a comprehensive cooperation agreement, witnessed by Ba Gang and Ding Kuiling, focusing on sci-tech innovation, medical collaboration, and talent cultivation.

articles.title_zh: 自治区政协召开专题协商会
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia CPPCC Holds Thematic Consultation on Cultural Tourism
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，自治区政协召开专题协商会，聚焦推动文旅融合发展、打造国内外知名全域旅游目的地。自治区政协主席张延昆出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, the CPPCC committee of Inner Mongolia held a thematic consultation on promoting integrated cultural tourism and building a world-renowned all-region tourism destination. Chairman Zhang Yankun attended and addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏宁东基地2026年“质量月”系列活动正式启动
articles.title_en: Ningdong Base Launches 2026 Quality Month Activities in Ningxia
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，宁东基地2026年“质量月”启动仪式在宁夏中汇化工有限公司举行，宁东市场监管局宣读实施方案，动员企业参与质量提升行动。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, the 2026 Quality Month kickoff was held at Ningxia Zhonghui Chemical Co., Ltd. The Ningdong Market Supervision Administration announced an action plan to encourage enterprises to join quality improvement efforts.

articles.title_zh: 纪念中国人民抗日战争暨世界反法西斯战争胜利81周年座谈会在京举行
articles.title_en: Symposium Held in Beijing to Mark 81st Anniversary of Victory in Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and World Anti-Fascist War
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，纪念中国人民抗日战争暨世界反法西斯战争胜利81周年座谈会在北京举行，中共中央政治局委员、中宣部部长李书磊出席。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, a symposium commemorating the 81st anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and World Anti-Fascist War was held in Beijing, attended by Li Shulei, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and head of the Publicity Department.

articles.summary_en: Two books on Xinjiang's regional and religious history were released in Beijing on September 2, showcasing the region's development under unified state governance and the Party's successful governance policies.

articles.summary_en: At the invitation of the Zambian government, Xi Jinping's special envoy and CPPCC Vice Chairperson Xian Hui attended President Hakainde Hichilema's inauguration in Lusaka on September 1. Hichilema met with Xian Hui on September 2.

articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，青海省委副书记、省长罗东川赴海东市平安区、互助县调研，强调坚持生态优先、绿色发展，推动高质量发展，并察看高标准农田、绿色算力项目等。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 2, Luo Dongchuan, deputy secretary of the Qinghai Provincial Party Committee and governor, visited Haidong City, calling for ecological priority, green development, and high-quality growth.

articles.title_zh: 中国商飞3C示范应用暨赋能四川重点产业链智改数转推进活动在蓉举行
articles.title_en: COMAC 3C Demonstration and Intelligent Transformation Event for Sichuan Industrial Chains Held in Chengdu

articles.summary_en: On September 1, the COMAC 3C demonstration and the event to empower Sichuan's key industrial chains with intelligent transformation were held in Chengdu. Governor Shi Xiaolin met with COMAC Chairman He Dongfeng and both attended, exchanging views on deepening cooperation.

articles.title_en: Asia-Pacific Civil Society Conference Opens in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，由中国民间组织国际交流促进会和山东省政府共同主办的亚太民间社会会议在济南开幕，全国人大常委会副委员长肖捷出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: The Asia-Pacific Civil Society Conference opened in Jinan on Sept 2, co-hosted by China NGO Network for International Exchanges and Shandong government. NPC Vice Chairperson Xiao Jie attended and delivered remarks.

articles.title_zh: 光伏最高可配50%、风电30%，山东为新能源场站配建储能立新规
articles.title_en: Shandong Sets New Rules for Energy Storage at Renewable Stations: PV Up to 50%, Wind 30%
articles.summary_zh: 近日，山东省发展改革委等四部门联合印发通知，为新能源场站配建储能制定新规，明确光伏最高配建50%、风电30%的上限，并提出13项措施促进新能源消纳和源储协同发展。
articles.summary_en: Shandong's four agencies issued a notice on energy storage for renewable stations, capping PV at 50% and wind at 30%, with 13 measures to boost consumption and coordination.

articles.summary_en: Chen Jining met with the Chairman, President of the Export-Import Bank of China and international enterprise representatives in Shanghai, saying the city will continue to enhance its global allocation capacity of shipping resources.

articles.title_en: Making Chips with Plug-and-Play Access

articles.summary_en: The Photonics Leading Institute in Xi'an Hi-tech Zone has built a pilot platform for photonic chips, enabling startups to "move in with just their tech". It has served over 120 sci-tech enterprises, boosting the province's photonics industry.

articles.title_en: Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Issues Work Plan to Boost Brain-Computer Interface Quality
articles.summary_zh: 京津冀三地市场监管部门印发《京津冀脑机接口跨区域质量强链工作方案》，推进脑机接口产业质量强链。

articles.title_en: Tianjin Issues Action Plan to Upgrade Business Environment with 23 Tasks
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，天津市政府新闻办举行政策吹风会，发布《2026年天津市推进营商环境提质升级行动计划》，提出五项行动、23项任务，以优化全市营商环境。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, Tianjin's Information Office held a briefing on the 2026 Action Plan to upgrade business environment, which proposes five actions and 23 tasks.

articles.title_en: China-SCO Port Economic Cooperation Center Settles in Tianjin
