articles.summary_en: At the 2026 SCO Summit in Bishkek, President Xi Jinping announced the establishment of the China-SCO Port Economic Cooperation Center in Tianjin to deepen opening-up and cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 戈壁滩上盖花园
articles.title_en: Building a Garden on the Gobi Desert
articles.summary_zh: 新疆石河子传承弘扬兵团精神，推动农业现代化和新兴产业发展，把戈壁滩建成了花园。
articles.summary_en: Xinjiang's Shihezi carries forward the Corps spirit to develop modern agriculture and emerging industries, turning the Gobi Desert into a garden.

articles.title_zh: 吉林省党政代表团来疆考察对接对口支援与合作发展工作
articles.title_en: Jilin Delegation Visits Xinjiang for Counterpart Support and Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日至9月2日，吉林省党政代表团来新疆考察对口支援与合作。双方在乌鲁木齐召开座谈会，吉林省委书记黄强与新疆党委书记陈小江等出席，共商深化对口援疆和区域合作。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 31 to Sep 2, the Jilin provincial delegation visited Xinjiang to discuss counterpart support. A symposium was held in Urumqi, with Secretaries Huang Qiang and Chen Xiaojiang attending to deepen cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 新疆政协十三届常委会第十六次会议闭幕
articles.title_en: Xinjiang CPPCC Concludes 16th Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 新疆维吾尔自治区政协十三届常委会第十六次会议9月2日闭幕，围绕科技创新与产业创新融合、'人工智能+'行动等议题协商议政。自治区政协主席努尔兰·阿不都满金主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: The 16th Standing Committee meeting of Xinjiang CPPCC concluded on Sept 2, discussing integrated technological and industrial innovation and the AI+ initiative. Chairman Nurlan Abudumanjin presided and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 西藏吉隆县泥石流灾害新闻发布会召开
articles.title_en: Press Conference Held on Debris Flow Disaster in Gyirong County, Xizang
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，西藏吉隆县泥石流灾害新闻发布会在吉隆镇召开，自治区主席嘎玛泽登出席介绍救援情况，常务副主席任维等回答记者提问。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, a press conference on the debris flow disaster in Gyirong County, Xizang was held in Gyirong Town. Regional chairman Gama Zedeng attended and briefed the situation, while executive vice chairman Ren Wei answered reporters' questions.

articles.title_zh: 王宁王予波与清华大学校长李路明会谈
articles.title_en: Wang Ning, Wang Yubo Meet with Tsinghua University President Li Luming
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，云南省委书记王宁、省长王予波在昆明与清华大学校长李路明会谈，感谢清华支持，深化省校合作。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 31, Yunnan Party Secretary Wang Ning and Gov. Wang Yubo met with Tsinghua University President Li Luming in Kunming to deepen provincial-university cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 浙江发起“君子兰”行动推动构建文明旅游新风
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Launches 'Junzilan' Action to Promote Civilized Tourism
articles.summary_zh: 2026年4月，浙江省发起“君子兰”行动，通过数字平台正向激励游客文明行为，目前已有超4.4万用户、200余家单位参与。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang launched a 'Junzilan' campaign in April 2026 to encourage civilized tourism, using digital rewards for visitors; over 44,000 users and 200 institutions have joined.

tags.name_zh: 浙江省文化广电和旅游厅
tags.name_en: Zhejiang Provincial Department of Culture, Radio and Tourism

tags_zh: 浙江省文化广电和旅游厅
tags_en: Zhejiang Provincial Department of Culture, Radio and Tourism

articles.title_zh: 立足实业根基 激活创新动能
articles.title_en: Rooted in Real Economy, Activating Innovation Momentum
articles.summary_zh: 浙江宁波坚持发展实体经济，推动科技创新与产业融合，因地制宜培育新质生产力。上半年GDP达9460亿元，制造业投资增长12.3%。
articles.summary_en: Ningbo, Zhejiang, has focused on the real economy, integrated technological innovation with industry, and cultivated new quality productive forces. In H1 2026, GDP reached 946.0 billion yuan, with manufacturing investment up 12.3%.

articles.title_zh: 尹力会见美中贸易全国委员会董事会代表团
articles.title_en: Yin Li Meets US-China Business Council Board Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 北京市委书记尹力会见美中贸易全国委员会董事会代表团，双方就中美经贸合作、科技创新等议题进行交流。
articles.summary_en: Yin Li, Secretary of CPC Beijing Municipal Committee, met with the board delegation of the US-China Business Council to discuss bilateral trade and cooperation, technological innovation, and other topics.

articles.title_zh: 商务部：今年前7个月中埃贸易额同比增长23.2%
articles.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: China-Egypt Trade Volume Up 23.2% in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 商务部介绍，今年前7个月中埃贸易额同比增长23.2%，中国连续十四年成为埃及最大贸易伙伴国，双边经贸合作步入快车道。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Commerce said trade volume between China and Egypt rose 23.2% year-on-year in the first seven months, with China remaining Egypt's largest trading partner for 14 consecutive years.

articles.title_zh: 第六次中国城乡老年人生活状况抽样调查启动
articles.title_en: Sixth National Sample Survey on Living Conditions of Urban and Rural Elderly Launched
articles.summary_zh: 民政部等五部门近日联合印发通知，启动第六次中国城乡老年人生活状况抽样调查，调查对象为60周岁及以上老年人及社区，样本量33万人。
articles.summary_en: Five ministries including the Ministry of Civil Affairs jointly issued a notice to launch the sixth national sample survey on living conditions of urban and rural elderly, covering seniors aged 60+ and their communities, with a sample size of 330,000.

articles.title_zh: 习近平和彭丽媛同埃及总统塞西夫妇共同参观大埃及博物馆
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan Visit Grand Egyptian Museum with Egyptian President Sisi and Wife
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月2日，国家主席习近平和夫人彭丽媛在埃及总统塞西夫妇陪同下参观大埃及博物馆，强调文明交流互鉴。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2 local time, President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan, accompanied by Egyptian President Sisi and his wife, visited the Grand Egyptian Museum, calling for mutual learning among civilizations.

tags.name_en: Exchanges and Mutual Learning Among Civilizations

tags_en: Exchanges and Mutual Learning Among Civilizations

articles.title_zh: 为推进平等有序的世界多极化贡献上合力量
articles.title_en: Contribute SCO Strength to Promoting an Equal and Orderly Multipolar World
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，国家主席习近平在比什凯克出席“上海合作组织+”会议并发表重要讲话，倡导平等有序的世界多极化，呼吁上合组织为此贡献力量。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, President Xi Jinping attended the SCO Plus meeting in Bishkek and delivered an important speech advocating an equal and orderly multipolar world, calling on the SCO to contribute its strength.

articles.title_zh: 习近平结束出席2026年上海合作组织峰会和对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及的国事访问回到北京
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Returns to Beijing After Attending 2026 SCO Summit and State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日上午，国家主席习近平圆满结束出席2026年上海合作组织峰会和对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及的国事访问后回到北京。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 3, President Xi Jinping returned to Beijing after successfully concluding his attendance at the 2026 SCO Summit and state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt.

articles.title_zh: 十一届省委全面深化改革委员会第十五次会议召开
articles.title_en: Anhui Provincial Committee on Comprehensively Deepening Reform Holds 15th Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日上午，十一届省委全面深化改革委员会第十五次会议召开，省委书记梁言顺主持并讲话，听取改革进展汇报，研究讨论《安徽省建立长期护理保险制度实施方案》。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 2, the 15th meeting of the 11th Anhui Provincial Committee for Comprehensively Deepening Reform was held, chaired by provincial party secretary Liang Yanshun, who heard reports on reform progress and discussed a plan for establishing long-term care insurance in Anhui.

articles.title_zh: 程丽华在两江新区渝中区调研时强调 察实情献良策 助力高质量推进城市更新
articles.title_en: Cheng Lihua Emphasizes Fact-Finding and Sound Advice in Urban Renewal Survey in Chongqing
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，重庆市政协主席程丽华带队赴两江新区、渝中区调研城市更新工作，强调深入一线察实情、问需求、献良策，助力高质量推进城市更新。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Cheng Lihua, Chairwoman of the Chongqing Municipal CPPCC, led a team to survey urban renewal projects in Liangjiang New Area and Yuzhong District, urging fact-finding, demand collection and sound advice for high-quality renewal.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军陈新武赴中国长安汽车集团调研并召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun and Chen Xinwu Visit Changan Automobile Group and Hold Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日下午，重庆市委书记袁家军和市长陈新武赴中国长安汽车集团调研并召开座谈会，强调加快打造世界一流汽车企业集团，共同推动重庆智能网联新能源汽车之都建设。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 2, Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun and Mayor Chen Xinwu visited China Changan Automobile Group and held a symposium, emphasizing building a world-class automobile group and jointly developing Chongqing as a hub for intelligent connected new energy vehicles.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚在南宁调研文化和文物保护工作
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Tours Cultural Heritage and Artifact Protection in Nanning
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚在南宁调研文化和文物保护工作，强调加强文物保护、传承中华优秀传统文化，推动文旅融合。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Chen Gang, Secretary of the CPC Guangxi Committee, toured cultural heritage and artifact protection sites in Nanning, stressing artifact conservation, promotion of Chinese traditional culture, and cultural-tourism integration.

articles.title_zh: 自治区旅游业发展工作专班2026年第一次全体会议召开
articles.title_en: Guangxi Tourism Development Task Force Holds First Plenary Meeting in 2026
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，自治区旅游业发展工作专班2026年第一次全体会议在南宁召开，自治区主席韦韬主持并讲话，强调推动全区旅游业高质量发展，加快建设旅游强区。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, the first plenary meeting of Guangxi's tourism development task force in 2026 was held in Nanning. Chairman Wei Tao presided and stressed the need to promote high-quality tourism development and build a strong tourism region.

articles.title_zh: 李炳军调研“六张网”和重点领域项目谋划推进情况
articles.title_en: Li Bingjun Inspects 'Six Networks' and Key Project Planning
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，贵州省委副书记、省长李炳军在贵阳贵安调研“六张网”和重点领域项目建设推进情况，并召开省政府专题会议，强调抢抓机遇谋划推进重大项目，全力扩大有效投资。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Li Bingjun, Deputy Secretary of the Guizhou Provincial Party Committee and Governor, inspected the progress of the 'Six Networks' and key projects in Guiyang and Gui'an, and chaired a provincial government meeting to plan major projects and expand effective investment.

articles.title_zh: 王凯到省文化和旅游厅调研
articles.title_en: Wang Kai Inspects Provincial Culture and Tourism Department
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，河南省省长王凯到省文化和旅游厅调研文旅产业发展与文化遗产保护，强调加快智慧文旅建设，推动文旅深层次融合。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Henan Governor Wang Kai visited the Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism to research industry development and heritage protection, stressing smart tourism and deeper integration.

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明在省交通运输厅调研
articles.title_en: Mao Weiming Inspects Provincial Transport Department
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，湖南省委副书记、省长毛伟明到省交通运输厅调研，强调构建现代化综合交通运输体系。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Mao Weiming, Deputy Secretary of the Hunan Provincial Party Committee and Governor, inspected the Provincial Transport Department and stressed building a modern comprehensive transportation system.

articles.title_zh: 近镜头｜时光见证中埃情谊历久弥新
articles.title_en: Xi and Sisi Meet on 70th Anniversary of China-Egypt Relations
articles.summary_zh: 中埃建交70周年之际，习近平主席同埃及总统塞西会晤，畅叙友谊、共商合作，擘画深化全面战略伙伴关系新蓝图。这是习近平时隔10年再次访问埃及。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping met with President Sisi on the 70th anniversary of China-Egypt ties to bolster friendship and cooperation. It was Xi's first visit to Egypt in 10 years.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席的“比什凯克时间”：主动引领历史航向的大国担当
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping's 'Bishkek Time': A Major Power's Initiative in Steering the Course of History
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日至9月1日，习近平主席出席2026年上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问，展现大国担当，推动中吉关系发展。
articles.summary_en: From August 30 to September 1, President Xi Jinping attended the 2026 SCO Summit in Bishkek and paid a state visit to Kyrgyzstan, demonstrating China's initiative and responsibility as a major power.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 进一步畅通实体经济的“筋络”——“十五五”开局之年推进物流网建设观察
articles.title_en: Advancing Logistics Network to Unclog the 'Meridians' of the Real Economy: Observations in the First Year of 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 新华社北京9月2日电 文章指出，“十五五”时期中国将系统推进物流网建设，到2030年社会物流总费用与GDP比率降至13.1%，以降低物流成本，畅通实体经济循环。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua's Sept. 2 Beijing analysis says China will build a comprehensive logistics network during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, aiming to cut total logistics cost to 13.1% of GDP by 2030, boosting the real economy.

articles.title_zh: 铭记历史警示，3000多件侵华日军罪证背后的故事
articles.title_en: Remember Historical Lessons: Stories Behind Over 3,000 Pieces of Evidence of Japanese Aggression
articles.summary_zh: 山东济南平阴县博物馆馆长韩光友40多年搜集了3000多件侵华日军罪证，近日在山东乡忆民俗文化博物馆展出，用于对青少年进行爱国主义教育。
articles.summary_en: In Pingyin, Jinan, Shandong, museum curator Han Guangyou has collected over 3,000 pieces of evidence of Japanese invasion over 40 years, now displayed at Shandong Xiangyi Folk Culture Museum for patriotic education.

articles.title_zh: 应急管理部调派央企工程应急救援力量全力抢险救援
articles.title_en: Emergency Management Ministry Deploys Central SOE Rescue Forces for Disaster Relief
articles.summary_zh: 西藏吉隆县发生泥石流灾害后，应急管理部调派央企救援力量796人及522台套装备，开展搜救和道路抢通，G216国道已恢复通行。
articles.summary_en: After a mudslide hit Gyirong County, Shigatse, Tibet, the Ministry of Emergency Management deployed 796 rescue personnel and 522 sets of equipment from central SOEs to assist relief operations, restoring traffic on National Highway G216.

articles.title_zh: 赵刚主持省政府领导班子集体学法 强调贯彻《农村公路条例》
articles.title_en: Zhao Gang Chairs Provincial Government Collective Law Study Meeting on Rural Road Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，陕西省省长赵刚主持省政府领导班子集体学法会议，学习《农村公路条例》，强调推动“四好农村路”高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Zhao Gang, Governor of Shaanxi, chaired a collective law-study meeting of the provincial government to study the Rural Road Regulations, emphasizing high-quality development of 'Four Good Rural Roads'.

articles.title_zh: 赵一德调研西安社区党建工作时强调把基层党组织建设得更加坚强有力
articles.title_en: Zhao Yide Inspects Community Party Building in Xi'an, Stressing Stronger Primary-Level Party Organizations
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，陕西省委书记赵一德在西安市调研社区党建工作，强调把基层党组织建设得更加坚强有力，推动党建引领基层治理取得更大成效。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Zhao Yide, Secretary of the Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee, inspected community Party building in Xi'an, emphasizing stronger primary-level Party organizations and better Party-led community governance.

articles.title_zh: 天津市委常委会召开会议 陈敏尔主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Tianjin Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting, Chen Min'er Presides and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，天津市委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署中国—上海合作组织合作平台中心建设和财政科学管理等工作。市委书记陈敏尔主持。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, the Standing Committee of Tianjin Municipal Party Committee convened to study and implement Xi Jinping's important speech, discussing the construction of China-SCO cooperation platforms and fiscal management. Chen Min'er presided.

articles.title_zh: 科普大篷车鸡鸣三省红色行在云南昭通威信启动
articles.title_en: Red Science-Truck Tour Across Three Provinces Launches in Weixin, Yunnan
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，全国科普月云南主场活动之一“科普大篷车鸡鸣三省红色行”在昭通威信启动，滇川黔三省科协联合举办，将赴革命老区开展科普服务。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 3, Yunnan, Sichuan and Guizhou science associations jointly launched a cross-province science-truck red tour in Weixin, Zhaotong, as part of National Science Month, aiming to bring science to revolutionary base areas.

articles.title_zh: 王浩：坚决打赢集中整治攻坚战 为高质量发展建设共同富裕示范区提供坚强保障
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Stresses Winning Campaign Against Corruption Around People at Zhejiang Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，浙江省召开集中整治群众身边不正之风和腐败问题攻坚推进大会，省委书记王浩强调坚决打赢集中整治攻坚战，为高质量发展建设共同富裕示范区提供坚强保障。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Zhejiang Province held a conference on intensifying the campaign against improper practices and corruption around the people. Provincial Party Secretary Wang Hao stressed winning the tough battle to support high-quality development of a demonstration zone for common prosperity.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷主持召开数字政府2.0建设第八次工作例会强调 紧扣年度目标任务 抓具体抓深入抓出成效
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Chairs 8th Working Meeting on Digital Government 2.0, Stressing Annual Targets
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日上午，浙江省委副书记、省长刘捷主持召开数字政府2.0建设第八次工作例会，强调要落实习近平总书记关于数字中国建设的重要论述，紧扣年度目标推进数字政府建设。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 2, Liu Jie, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee and Governor of Zhejiang, chaired the 8th working meeting on Digital Government 2.0, stressing implementation of Xi Jinping's important remarks on digital China and progress toward annual goals.

articles.title_zh: 山西省人大常委会原副主任岳普煜严重违纪违法被开除党籍
articles.title_en: Former Vice Chairman of Shanxi Provincial People's Congress Yue Puyu Expelled from CPC for Serious Disciplinary Violations
articles.summary_zh: 经中共中央批准，中央纪委国家监委对山西省人大常委会原副主任岳普煜严重违纪违法问题立案审查，决定给予开除党籍处分并移送检察机关。
articles.summary_en: With approval of the CPC Central Committee, the CCDI and National Supervisory Commission investigated Yue Puyu, former vice chairman of Shanxi Provincial People's Congress, for serious disciplinary violations, and decided to expel him from the Party and refer him to prosecutors.

articles.title_zh: 发展中埃关系，习近平主席强调“不忘初心、继往开来”
articles.title_en: Developing China-Egypt Relations, President Xi Jinping Emphasizes 'Staying True to Original Aspiration and Forging Ahead'
articles.summary_zh: 习近平主席在赴埃及进行国事访问前，在埃及媒体发表署名文章，回顾中埃友好历史，强调“不忘初心、继往开来”，为两国关系发展指明方向。
articles.summary_en: On the eve of a state visit to Egypt, President Xi Jinping published a signed article in Egyptian media, reviewing Sino-Egyptian friendship and calling for staying true to the original aspiration to advance bilateral ties.

articles.title_zh: 习近平抵达开罗对埃及进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives in Cairo for State Visit to Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月1日晚，国家主席习近平乘专机抵达开罗，应埃及总统塞西邀请对埃及进行国事访问，塞西总统夫妇到场迎接。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of September 1 local time, President Xi Jinping arrived in Cairo by special plane for a state visit to Egypt at the invitation of Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi, who welcomed him at the airport with his wife.

articles.title_zh: 习近平出席“上海合作组织+”会议并发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends SCO+ Meeting and Delivers Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月1日下午，习近平在比什凯克出席“上海合作组织+”会议并发表讲话，强调共同倡导平等有序的世界多极化、推动实现更加公正合理的全球治理。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 1, Xi Jinping attended the SCO+ meeting in Bishkek and delivered a speech, calling for jointly advocating an equal and orderly multipolar world and advancing more just and reasonable global governance.

articles.title_zh: 习近平出席上海合作组织成员国元首理事会第二十六次会议并发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends 26th Meeting of SCO Council of Heads of State and Delivers Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月1日，国家主席习近平在比什凯克出席上海合作组织成员国元首理事会第二十六次会议并发表题为《推动上海合作组织实现更高质量发展》的重要讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 1, President Xi Jinping attended the 26th Meeting of the Council of Heads of State of the SCO in Bishkek and delivered an important speech titled "Promoting Higher-Quality Development of the SCO."

articles.title_zh: 推动上海合作组织实现更高质量发展
articles.title_en: Promoting Higher-Quality Development of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平在上海合作组织成员国元首理事会第二十六次会议上发表讲话，强调坚持发展优先、安全为要，推动上合组织更高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping delivered a speech at the 26th SCO Council of Heads of State meeting, stressing development and security for higher-quality cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 共同倡导平等有序的世界多极化 实现更加公正合理的全球治理
articles.title_en: Jointly Advocate an Equal and Orderly Multipolar World and Achieve More Just and Equitable Global Governance
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月1日，中国国家主席习近平在比什凯克举行的“上海合作组织+”会议上发表讲话，倡导平等有序的世界多极化，推动全球治理体系更加公正合理。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, 2026, Chinese President Xi Jinping delivered a speech at the SCO Plus meeting in Bishkek, advocating an equal and orderly multipolar world and more just and equitable global governance.

articles.title_zh: 习近平出席上海合作组织成员国元首理事会第二十六次会议并发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends 26th SCO Council of Heads of State Meeting and Delivers Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月1日上午，国家主席习近平在比什凯克出席上海合作组织成员国元首理事会第二十六次会议并发表重要讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 1, local time, President Xi Jinping attended the 26th Meeting of the Council of Heads of State of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization in Bishkek and delivered an important speech.

articles.title_zh: 王宁王予波与清华大学校长李路明会谈
articles.title_en: Wang Ning and Wang Yubo Hold Talks with Tsinghua University President Li Luming
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，云南省委书记王宁、省长王予波在昆明与清华大学校长李路明会谈，就深化省校合作、人才培养、科技创新等事宜进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Wang Ning, Party Secretary of Yunnan, and Governor Wang Yubo met with Li Luming, President of Tsinghua University, in Kunming to discuss deepening provincial-university cooperation in talent cultivation and scientific innovation.

articles.title_zh: 顾刚调研汽车零部件企业发展情况
articles.title_en: Gu Gang Investigates Development of Auto Parts Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，长春市委副书记、市长顾刚带队调研多家汽车零部件企业，现场研究解决问题，强调政企合力、智改数转，推动汽车产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Gu Gang, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Changchun Municipal Committee and Mayor, led a research team to several auto parts enterprises to address issues and promote high-quality development of the automobile industry.

articles.title_zh: 中国农工民主党赤峰市第八次代表大会召开
articles.title_en: 8th Congress of CPWDP Chifeng Committee Convened
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，中国农工民主党赤峰市第八次代表大会召开，选举产生第八届委员会，白凤强当选主任委员。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, the 8th Congress of the Chinese Peasants' and Workers' Democratic Party (CPWDP) Chifeng Committee was held, electing its 8th committee; Bai Fengqiang was elected chairman.

articles.title_zh: 《平“语”近人——习近平喜欢的典故》(阿拉伯语版)在埃及主流媒体播出
articles.title_en: Arabic Version of Program on Xi Jinping's Favorite Allusions Launched in Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，《平“语”近人——习近平喜欢的典故》阿拉伯语版启播活动在埃及开罗举行，埃及总统塞西发贺信祝贺。节目即日起在埃及及非洲主流媒体播出。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, the Arabic version launch of "Ping Yu Jin Ren: Xi Jinping's Favorite Allusions" was held in Cairo, Egypt. Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi sent a congratulatory letter. The program airs on mainstream Egyptian and African media.

articles.title_zh: 彭丽媛同埃及总统塞西夫人依缇萨尔茶叙并参观小型手工艺品展
articles.title_en: Peng Liyuan and Egyptian First Lady Intisar Enjoy Tea and Visit Handicraft Exhibition
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月2日上午，国家主席习近平夫人彭丽媛在开罗同埃及总统塞西夫人依缇萨尔茶叙并参观小型手工艺品展，就中埃友好与人文交往亲切交流。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 2, Peng Liyuan, wife of Chinese President, had tea with Egypt's first lady Intisar in Cairo and toured a handicraft exhibition, exchanging views on bilateral friendship and cultural ties.

articles.title_zh: 勇担历史责任 主动引领历史航向——习近平主席重要讲话为上合组织实现更高质量发展擘画蓝图
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Delivers Keynote Speech at SCO Bishkek Summit, Charting Blueprint for Higher-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，习近平主席在比什凯克出席上海合作组织成员国元首理事会第二十六次会议并发表讲话，提出坚持发展优先、安全为要等4点主张，为上合组织高质量发展擘画蓝图。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, 2026, President Xi Jinping attended the 26th SCO Council of Heads of State meeting in Bishkek and delivered an important speech, proposing four priorities for the organization's higher-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 推进世界多极化 改革完善全球治理——习近平主席重要讲话引领上合组织贡献更大力量
articles.title_en: Xi's Speech Guides SCO to Promote World Multipolarity and Reform Global Governance
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平9月1日在吉尔吉斯斯坦比什凯克出席“上海合作组织+”会议，发表讲话倡导平等有序的世界多极化，改革完善全球治理。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping delivered an important speech at the SCO Plus meeting in Bishkek on Sept 1, advocating an equal and orderly multipolar world and reformed global governance.

articles.title_zh: 从天津到比什凯克 中国持续推动全球治理改革完善
articles.title_en: From Tianjin to Bishkek: China Presses Ahead with Global Governance Reform
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，国家主席习近平在比什凯克出席2026年上海合作组织峰会并发表重要讲话，倡导平等有序的世界多极化，推动全球治理改革完善。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, President Xi Jinping attended and addressed the 2026 SCO Summit in Bishkek, advocating an equal and orderly multipolar world and advancing global governance reform.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席署名文章引发埃及各界人士强烈共鸣
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Signed Article Resonates Strongly with Egyptian People from All Walks of Life
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，国家主席习近平在赴埃及进行国事访问之际，在埃及三大报纸发表署名文章，引发埃及各界人士强烈共鸣。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, during his state visit to Egypt, President Xi Jinping published a signed article in three major Egyptian newspapers, resonating strongly with Egyptian people from all walks of life.

articles.title_zh: 习近平出席埃及总统举行的欢迎仪式
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends Welcoming Ceremony Hosted by Egyptian President
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月2日上午，埃及总统塞西在开罗举行隆重仪式，欢迎习近平时隔十年再次对埃及进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 2 local time, Egyptian President Sisi held a grand ceremony in Cairo to welcome Xi Jinping on his state visit to Egypt after ten years.

articles.title_zh: 中华人民共和国和阿拉伯埃及共和国关于进一步深化全面战略伙伴关系的联合声明
articles.title_en: Joint Statement on Further Deepening Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between China and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 应埃及总统塞西邀请，国家主席习近平于2026年9月1日至2日对埃及进行国事访问，双方发表联合声明，宣布深化全面战略伙伴关系。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi, Chinese President Xi Jinping paid a state visit to Egypt from September 1 to 2, 2026, and the two sides issued a joint statement on deepening their comprehensive strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 张丹赴东港市调研渔业安全生产及渔船管控工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Dan Investigates Fishing Safety and Vessel Control in Donggang
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，丹东市委副书记、市长张丹赴东港市调研开海后渔业安全生产及渔船管控工作，检查海上联合巡航执法，并出席开海仪式。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Zhang Dan, Deputy Secretary and Mayor of Dandong, visited Donggang to inspect fishing safety and vessel control after the fishing season reopened, and attended the opening ceremony.

articles.title_zh: 汪尚学主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Wang Shangxue Chairs Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日下午，定西市委书记汪尚学主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神和中央、省委有关会议精神，部署贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Dingxi Municipal Party Committee Secretary Wang Shangxue chaired a standing committee meeting to convey and study important speeches and instructions by General Secretary Xi Jinping and arrangements by the central and provincial authorities.

articles.title_zh: 王新伟主持召开省政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Wang Xinwei Chairs Provincial Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，辽宁省省长王新伟主持召开省政府常务会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署服务和融入全国统一大市场建设，审议辽宁实验室布局及公共数据授权运营方案。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Governor Wang Xinwei of Liaoning chaired a provincial executive meeting to study and implement Xi Jinping's important speech, discuss integrating into the national unified market, and review plans for Liaoning Laboratories and public data authorization.

articles.title_zh: 福建省党政代表团赴宁夏学习考察并召开闽宁协作第30次联席会议
articles.title_en: Fujian Party and Government Delegation Visits Ningxia for 30th Joint Meeting on Fujian-Ningxia Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日至9月1日，福建省委书记周祖翼率福建省党政代表团赴宁夏学习考察，召开闽宁协作第30次联席会议并签署会议纪要，携手续写“山海情”。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 31 to Sep 1, Fujian Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi led a party and government delegation to Ningxia for study and the 30th Fujian-Ningxia cooperation meeting, signing minutes to renew ties.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱调研检查养老机构运行情况
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Inspects Operation of Elderly Care Institutions
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱赴兴安区、向阳区多家养老机构调研检查，强调提升养老服务质量、守牢安全底线。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, Wang Xingzhu, Hegang Party secretary, visited elderly care institutions in Xing'an and Xiangyang districts, stressing improving service quality and safety management.

articles.title_zh: 邓维元采取“四不两直”方式深入市工业和信息化局调研
articles.title_en: Deng Weiyuan Conducts Unannounced Visit to Municipal Bureau of Industry and Information Technology
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，市委副书记、市长邓维元采取“四不两直”方式深入市工业和信息化局调研，强调稳住工业基本盘、培育壮大接续产业，奋力推动鹤岗高质量转型发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 2, Mayor Deng Weiyuan made an unannounced visit to the Municipal Bureau of Industry and Information Technology, stressing stabilizing the industrial base, fostering successor industries, and pushing Hegang's high-quality transformation.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调度推进城市更新工作
articles.title_en: Huaian Mayor Chairs Meeting on Urban Renewal Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，淮安市市长顾坤主持召开专题会议，调度推进城市更新工作，强调科学谋划、系统推进，提升城市功能品质和民生福祉。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Huaian Mayor Gu Kun chaired a special meeting on urban renewal work, emphasizing scientific planning and systematic implementation to improve urban functions, quality, and people's livelihood.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡参加企业家接待日——商协会“面对面”活动 听取意见建议 协调解决问题
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Attends Entrepreneurs Reception Day to Hear Business Association Opinions
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日下午，淮北市委副书记、代市长黄韡参加企业家接待日——商协会“面对面”活动，与6家商协会代表交流，听取意见建议并现场协调解决企业诉求。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 2, Huang Wei, acting mayor of Huaibei, attended the Entrepreneurs Reception Day, engaging with six business associations to listen to their suggestions and address enterprise issues.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会扩大会议暨市委党的建设工作领导小组会议召开 强调巩固拓展学习教育成果
articles.title_en: Huaibei Municipal Party Committee Meeting Stresses Consolidating Learning Education Outcomes
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日下午，淮北市委常委会扩大会议暨市委党的建设工作领导小组会议召开，总结树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，部署巩固拓展学习教育成果等工作。市委书记蒋曦、省委第一督导组组长汤春和讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 2, the enlarged meeting of the Standing Committee of CPC Huaibei Municipal Committee and the Municipal Party Building Leading Group meeting was held to summarize the education on establishing and practicing a correct view on political achievements and deploy work to consolidate its outcomes. Party Secretary Jiang Xi and Tang Chunhe, head of the First Provincial Supervision Group, spoke.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡在市安委会2026年第三次全体会议上强调从严从实抓好安全生产各项工作
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Stresses Strict Implementation of Work Safety Measures at Municipal Safety Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日上午，淮北市安委会召开2026年第三次全体会议，市委副书记、代市长黄韡强调要从严从实抓好安全生产各项工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 2, the third plenary meeting of Huaibei Municipal Safety Committee was held; Acting Mayor Huang Wei stressed strict implementation of safety production measures.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保：更好统筹发展和安全 不断增进民生福祉
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao Calls for Better Balancing Development and Safety to Improve People's Well-being
articles.summary_zh: 1日上午，市委书记、市人大常委会主任曾风保到揭西县调研“百千万工程”和地质灾害减灾防灾工作，强调统筹发展与安全，增进民生福祉。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 1, Zeng Fengbao, Secretary of the Jieyang Municipal Party Committee, visited Jiexi County to inspect the 'Baiqianwan Project' and geological disaster prevention work, emphasizing the need to coordinate development and safety to enhance people's well-being.

articles.title_zh: 揭阳高新区举行跨境电商与数智赋能专题培训会
articles.title_en: Jieyang High-tech Zone Holds Cross-border E-commerce and Digital Empowerment Training Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，揭阳高新区举办跨境电商与数智赋能专题培训会，助力企业数字化出海。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Jieyang High-tech Zone held a cross-border e-commerce and digital empowerment training session to help local enterprises go global digitally.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰带队到榕城区调研“百千万工程”建设情况
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Leads Team to Inspect 'Baiqianwan Project' in Rongcheng District
articles.summary_zh: 1日，揭阳市市长曲晓杰带队到榕城区调研“百千万工程”建设情况，走访多家重点企业，现场协调解决问题，强调强化科技引领、赋能产业焕新升级。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 1, Qu Xiaojie, mayor of Jieyang, led a team to Rongcheng District to inspect the 'Baiqianwan Project' and visited key enterprises, addressing their concerns and emphasizing sci-tech innovation to drive industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 王君正调度吉隆县泥石流灾害抢险救援工作
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Directs Rescue Work after Gyirong Mudslide
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正在拉萨调度吉隆县泥石流灾害抢险救援，强调贯彻习近平总书记重要指示，全力搜救失联人员并做好善后。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 1, Wang Junzheng, secretary of Tibet AR Party Committee, directed rescue operations for the Gyirong County mudslide in Lhasa, urging full search and relief efforts.

articles.title_zh: 自治区人大常委会党组理论学习中心组（扩大）学习会召开
articles.title_en: Standing Committee of Regional People's Congress Party Group Holds Theoretical Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日下午，西藏自治区人大常委会党组副书记、副主任肖友才主持党组理论学习中心组学习会，深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于总体国家安全观的重要论述。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 1 afternoon, Xiao Youcai, deputy director of the Standing Committee of the Regional People's Congress, chaired a Party group theoretical study session to implement Xi Jinping's important remarks on the holistic national security concept.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登等自治区省军级领导向遇难人员默哀
articles.title_en: Gama Zedeng and Other Leaders Observe Moment of Silence for Victims
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，深切哀悼吉隆泥石流灾害遇难人员活动在西藏吉隆县吉隆镇举行，自治区主席嘎玛泽登等省军级领导参加默哀。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, a memorial activity for the victims of the Gyirong mudslide disaster was held in Gyirong Town, Gyirong County, Tibet, with leaders including Gama Zedeng observing a moment of silence.

articles.title_zh: 全市对口支援对口合作挂职干部座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Longyan Holds Symposium for Seconded Cadres in Pairing Support and Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，龙岩市召开对口支援对口合作挂职干部座谈会，市委书记胡盛出席并讲话，勉励挂职干部实干担当、再立新功。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Longyan held a symposium for seconded cadres in pairing assistance and cooperation. Municipal Party Secretary Hu Sheng attended and encouraged them to work with dedication and achieve new results.

articles.title_zh: 龙岩市委书记胡盛会见福建省税务局局长白渊一行
articles.title_en: Longyan Party Secretary Hu Sheng Meets Fujian Tax Bureau Head Bai Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，龙岩市委书记胡盛在古田山庄会见福建省税务局党委书记、局长白渊一行，双方就税源培育、惠企服务等交流，胡盛希望省税务局继续支持老区发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 1, Longyan Party Secretary Hu Sheng met Bai Yuan, Director-General of Fujian Provincial Tax Bureau, at Gutian Villa. They discussed tax support and corporate services.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登：深切哀悼吉隆泥石流灾害遇难人员活动举行
articles.title_en: Mourning for Gyirong Mudslide Victims Held, Attended by Tibet Chairman Gama Zedeng
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，深切哀悼吉隆泥石流灾害遇难人员活动在吉隆县吉隆镇举行，西藏自治区主席嘎玛泽登等省军级领导及救援人员参加，向遇难者默哀3分钟。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, a mourning ceremony for victims of the Gyirong mudslide was held in Gyirong Town. Gama Zedeng, chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region, along with other officials and rescue workers, observed three minutes of silence.

articles.title_zh: 王君正调度吉隆县泥石流灾害抢险救援工作
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Directs Rescue Work for Gyirong County Mudslide
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正在拉萨自治区应急指挥部调度吉隆县泥石流灾害抢险救援工作，强调落实习近平总书记重要指示，全力搜救失联人员并做好善后。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 1, Wang Junzheng, Tibet's party chief, directed rescue work for the Gyirong County mudslide at an emergency center in Lhasa, urging full search for the missing.

articles.title_zh: 肖友才主持自治区人大常委会党组理论学习中心组（扩大）学习会
articles.title_en: Xiao Youcai Chairs Study Session of Party Leadership Group of Regional People's Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日下午，西藏自治区人大常委会党组副书记、副主任肖友才主持党组理论学习中心组（扩大）学习会，深入学习贯彻总体国家安全观。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 1, Xiao Youcai, deputy secretary of the Party Leadership Group and deputy director of the Standing Committee of the People's Congress of Tibet Autonomous Region, chaired an expanded study session on holistic national security.

articles.title_zh: 汕头召开会议专题研究部署固定资产投资工作
articles.title_en: Shantou Holds Special Meeting on Fixed-Asset Investment Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日下午，汕头市委书记庄悦群主持召开专题会议，听取有关部门汇报，研究部署固定资产投资工作，强调促投资稳投资，推动经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 1, Shantou Municipal Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn chaired a special meeting to hear reports and study fixed-asset investment, stressing efforts to promote stable investment for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰会见全国政协常委、香港广东社团总会主席龚俊龙
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Meets CPPCC Standing Committee Member Gong Junlong on Development Exchange
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，广东汕尾市委书记逯峰会晤全国政协常委、香港广东社团总会主席龚俊龙，双方就发挥港澳乡亲作用、推动汕尾高质量发展进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 1, Lu Feng, Shanwei's Party chief, met Gong Junlong, a CPPCC Standing Committee member and chairman of the HK Guangdong Community General Association, to discuss how Hong Kong compatriots can help Shanwei's high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰会见全国政协常委、香港广东社团总会主席龚俊龙
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Meets with Gong Junlong, Standing Committee Member of CPPCC and Chairman of HK Guangdong Community Association
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，汕尾市委书记逯峰会见全国政协常委、香港广东社团总会主席龚俊龙，就发挥乡亲优势推动汕尾高质量发展进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Lu Feng, Secretary of Shanwei Municipal Party Committee, met with Gong Junlong, Standing Committee Member of CPPCC and Chairman of Hong Kong Guangdong Community Association, to discuss leveraging overseas fellow townsmen's advantages to promote Shanwei's high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 闽宁协作第三十次联席会议在银川召开 周祖翼李邑飞讲话
articles.title_en: 30th Fujian-Ningxia Collaboration Joint Meeting Held in Yinchuan; Zhou Zuyi and Li Yifei Address
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，闽宁协作第三十次联席会议在银川召开，福建省委书记周祖翼、宁夏自治区党委书记李邑飞出席并讲话，两省区签署会议纪要。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, the 30th Fujian-Ningxia Collaboration Joint Meeting was held in Yinchuan. Zhou Zuyi, Secretary of Fujian Provincial Party Committee, and Li Yifei, Secretary of Ningxia Regional Party Committee, attended, delivered speeches, and signed the meeting minutes.

articles.title_zh: 泰州市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Taizhou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，泰州市委常委会召开会议，市委书记姜冬冬主持，学习中央政治局会议精神，交流专题调研成果，部署当前重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, the Standing Committee of Taizhou Municipal Party Committee met, chaired by Secretary Jiang Dongdong, to study the spirit of the Political Bureau meeting, exchange research findings, and arrange key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 黄强率吉林省党政代表团到新疆学习考察
articles.title_en: Huang Qiang Leads Jilin Party-Government Delegation on Study Tour in Xinjiang
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日至9月2日，吉林省委书记黄强率吉林省党政代表团到新疆学习考察，出席对口支援工作座谈会，与新疆党委书记陈小江会谈，推动吉新交流合作。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 31 to Sep 2, Jilin Party Secretary Huang Qiang led a provincial delegation to Xinjiang for study and inspection, attending a counterpart support symposium and meeting with Xinjiang Party Secretary Chen Xiaojiang, to boost cooperation.

tags.name_en: Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Regional Party Committee

tags_zh: 新疆维吾尔自治区党委
tags_en: Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Regional Party Committee

articles.title_zh: 张海波到综合保税区调研
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Visits Comprehensive Bonded Zone for Research
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，威海市委书记张海波到综合保税区调研，强调释放政策叠加优势，壮大实体产业，提升外贸质量，推动高水平开放。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Zhang Haibo, Secretary of the Weihai Municipal Party Committee, visited the comprehensive bonded zone, emphasizing the need to leverage policy advantages, expand the real economy, and improve foreign trade quality.

articles.title_zh: 孔凡萍到乳山调研矿山和渔业安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Kong Fanping Investigates Mining and Fishery Safety in Rushan
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，市委副书记、市长孔凡萍到乳山调研矿山和渔业安全生产工作，强调抓实抓细安全管控，守牢安全发展底线。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Kong Fanping, deputy secretary of the Weihai Municipal Party Committee and mayor, visited Rushan to inspect mining and fishery safety production, stressing strict implementation of safety measures.

articles.title_zh: 徐志与华强集团董事长李曙成举行工作会谈
articles.title_en: Xu Zhi Holds Working Talks with Huaqiang Group Chairman Li Shucheng
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，芜湖市委书记徐志与华强集团董事长李曙成举行工作会谈，双方就深化产业合作、推动项目落地进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 1, Wuhu Party Secretary Xu Zhi held talks with Huaqiang Group Chairman Li Shucheng to deepen industrial cooperation and advance projects.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰主持西渭融合高质量发展座谈会
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Chairs Xi'an-Weinan High-Quality Development Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，西渭融合高质量发展座谈会在西安召开，蒿慧杰主持并讲话，王浩讲话，两市部署深化协同发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 1, Xi'an hosted the Xi'an-Weinan High-Quality Development Symposium. Hao Huijie chaired and addressed it; Wang Hao also spoke, with both cities pledging deeper integration.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市人大常委会围绕国有资产管理情况开展专题询问
articles.title_en: Yancheng Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Conducts Special Inquiry on State-Owned Assets Management
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日下午，盐城市九届人大常委会第四十次会议举行联组会议，就国有资产管理情况开展专题询问和满意度测评，市人大常委会主任王荣出席。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the 40th session of the Yancheng Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held a joint meeting to conduct a special inquiry and satisfaction assessment on state-owned assets management, with Chairman Wang Rong attending.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 研究部署防灾减灾、生态环保等工作
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee Meeting Focuses on Disaster Prevention and Ecological Protection
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，银川市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神和《党政领导干部生态环境损害责任追究办法》，研究部署防灾减灾、生态环保等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 1, Yinchuan's municipal Party committee held a meeting to implement Xi Jinping's instructions and study disaster prevention and ecological environment protection. Zhao Xuhui chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 李强会见美中贸易全国委员会董事会代表团
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets Board Delegation of US-China Business Council
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日下午，国务院总理李强在北京人民大会堂会见美中贸易全国委员会董事会主席麦凯恩率领的访华团，就推动中美经贸合作等交流意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 1, Premier Li Qiang met with a delegation led by McCain, chairman of the Board of Directors of the US-China Business Council, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing.

articles.title_zh: 市九届人大常委会举行第87次主任会议
articles.title_en: Yueyang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 87th Directors' Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，岳阳市九届人大常委会举行第87次主任会议，副主任喻文主持，听取城市二次供水管理条例草案等事项。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, the 87th directors' meeting of the Standing Committee of the 9th Yueyang Municipal People's Congress was held, chaired by Vice Chairman Yu Wen. The meeting heard a draft regulation on urban secondary water supply.

articles.title_zh: 汪涛主持召开市政协党的建设工作领导小组会议
articles.title_en: Wang Tao Chairs Meeting of CPPCC Party Building Leading Group
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，市政协党组书记、主席汪涛主持召开市政协党的建设工作领导小组会议，传达学习习近平总书记关于树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育重要指示精神，总结部署学习教育工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Wang Tao, chairman of the Yueyang Municipal CPPCC, presided over a meeting of the Party building leading group to convey Xi Jinping's important instructions and arrange follow-up measures.

articles.title_zh: 李庆新主持召开市政府全体会议 全力抓好全年经济工作 奋力实现“十五五”良好开局
articles.title_en: Li Qingxin Chairs Municipal Government Plenary Meeting to Boost Economic Work for a Good Start of the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，云浮市市长李庆新主持召开市政府第十次全体会议，部署下半年经济工作，强调完成全年目标任务，谋划“十五五”规划。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Yunfu Mayor Li Qingxin chaired the 10th plenary meeting of the municipal government to deploy economic work for the second half of the year, urging completion of annual targets and planning for the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 黄玉国与市直代表一团代表一起审议党代会报告、市纪委工作报告
articles.title_en: Huang Yuguo Reviews Party Congress Report with Municipal Delegates
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，周口市领导黄玉国到市直代表一团审议党代会报告和市纪委工作报告，听取代表意见并强调落实党代会精神。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 1, Huang Yuguo joined delegates of the municipal delegation to review the Party Congress report and the discipline inspection work report in Zhoukou, calling for implementing the congress spirit.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神 研究财政金融协同促内需等事项
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting, Conveys Xi's Instructions and Studies Fiscal-Financial Measures to Boost Domestic Demand
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日上午，省委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记对西藏泥石流灾害的重要指示和中央政治局会议精神，审议通过《关于财政金融协同促内需的若干措施》，省委书记林武主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 1, the Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee met to convey Xi Jinping's important instructions on the Tibet mudslide disaster and review fiscal-financial measures to boost domestic demand. Lin Wu chaired.

tags.name_en: Fiscal-Financial Coordination to Boost Domestic Demand

tags_en: Fiscal-Financial Coordination to Boost Domestic Demand

articles.title_zh: 省领导出席第30届鲁台经贸洽谈会相关活动
articles.title_en: Provincial Leaders Attend Events of the 30th Shandong-Taiwan Economic and Trade Fair
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日至9月1日，山东省委常委、统战部部长邓云锋和副省长孙喜民在潍坊出席第30届鲁台经贸洽谈会相关活动，包括两岸智能制造产业合作对接会和两岸绿色化工产业合作推进会。
articles.summary_en: From August 31 to September 1, Deng Yunfeng, member of the Standing Committee of the Shandong Provincial Party Committee and head of the United Front Work Department, and Vice Governor Sun Ximin attended events of the 30th Shandong-Taiwan Economic and Trade Fair in Weifang, including cross-strait smart manufacturing and green chemical industry cooperation meetings.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会会议暨省委党的建设工作领导小组会议召开
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial Party Committee Holds Meeting on Party Building Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，山东省委常委会暨省委党的建设工作领导小组会议召开，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，总结政绩观学习教育成果，部署巩固拓展工作。省委书记林武主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 1, Shandong Provincial Party Committee held a party building meeting to convey Xi Jinping's instructions, summarize education on correct view of political achievements, and plan consolidation. Party Secretary Lin Wu chaired.

articles.title_zh: 通往吉隆口岸的216国道预计今日抢通，大规模搜救工作即将全面展开
articles.title_en: National Highway 216 to Gyirong Port Expected to Reopen Today, Large-Scale Search and Rescue to Commence
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，通往西藏吉隆口岸的216国道最后一段预计抢通，大规模搜救即将展开。该泥石流灾害已致中方16人遇难、546人失联。
articles.summary_en: The last section of National Highway 216 leading to Gyirong Port in Tibet is expected to reopen on September 2, enabling large-scale search and rescue. The disaster has left 16 dead and 546 missing on the Chinese side.

articles.title_zh: 被控“串谋勾结外国或者境外势力危害国家安全”，黄之锋当庭认罪
articles.title_en: Joshua Wong Pleads Guilty to Conspiracy with Foreign Forces to Endanger National Security
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，香港高等法院开庭审理黄之锋被控“串谋勾结外国或者境外势力危害国家安全”一案，黄之锋当庭认罪，案件押后判刑。
articles.summary_en: Joshua Wong pleaded guilty on Sept 2 to conspiring with foreign forces to endanger national security. Sentencing was deferred.

articles.title_zh: 通往吉隆口岸216国道全线抢通，深层次搜救全面展开
articles.title_en: Highway 216 to Gyirong Port Fully Restored, In-Depth Rescue Operations Underway
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日上午，西藏吉隆镇通往吉隆口岸的216国道全线抢通，大型机械进入受灾核心区，深层次搜救全面展开。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 2, the 216 National Highway from Gyirong Town to Gyirong Port was fully reopened, allowing heavy machinery to enter the disaster-hit core area for in-depth rescue operations.

articles.title_zh: 中消协发布提示：别让AI服务误导消费决策
articles.title_en: China Consumers Association Issues Alert: Prevent AI Services from Misleading Consumer Decisions
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中国消费者协会发布人工智能服务消费提示，提醒消费者谨慎依据AI生成内容作出决定，并敦促经营者规范AI客服、落实责任。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the China Consumers Association issued an AI service consumption alert, urging consumers to verify important information rather than rely solely on AI-generated content, and requiring businesses to manage AI chatbots responsibly.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席的中亚之行，这些细节令人难忘
articles.title_en: President Xi's Central Asia Visit: Unforgettable Details
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日至9月1日，习近平主席出访吉尔吉斯斯坦，出席上合组织峰会，签署合作文件，会见多国领导人，推动周边合作。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 30 to Sep 1, President Xi Jinping visited Kyrgyzstan, attended the SCO Summit, signed cooperation documents, and met with leaders of Uzbekistan, Mongolia and Russia, promoting regional cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会党组扩大会议暨党组理论学习中心组集体学习举行
articles.title_en: Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Party Group Holds Enlarged Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日下午，青岛市人大常委会党组扩大会议暨党组理论学习中心组集体学习举行，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，梅建华主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 2, the Party Group of the Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held an enlarged meeting and collective study session to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches. Mei Jianhua presided over the meeting and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 信长星在凤凰出版传媒集团和省文投集团调研
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing Visits Phoenix Publishing & Media Group and Jiangsu Cultural Investment Group
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，江苏省委书记信长星赴凤凰出版传媒集团和省文投集团调研，强调贯彻习近平文化思想，以文化赋能经济社会发展，推进文化强省建设。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, Xin Changxing, Secretary of CPC Jiangsu Committee, visited Phoenix Publishing & Media Group and Jiangsu Cultural Investment Group, stressing cultural confidence and innovation to empower economic development and build a culturally strong province.

articles.title_zh: 著名地质学家、中国科学院院士李廷栋逝世
articles.title_en: Famous Geologist, CAS Academician Li Tingdong Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 中国科学院院士、著名地质学家李廷栋因病医治无效，于2026年9月1日在北京逝世，享年96岁。
articles.summary_en: Renowned geologist and CAS academician Li Tingdong passed away in Beijing on September 1, 2026, at age 96.

articles.title_zh: 中山古镇：一个小镇如何照亮“半”个世界？
articles.title_en: Guzhen, Zhongshan: How a Small Town Lights Up Half the World
articles.summary_zh: 本文报道广东中山古镇灯饰产业占全国七成、全球超五成市场份额，讲述企业主通过转型、智能化与完整供应链推动产业升级，照亮世界市场。
articles.summary_en: This article reports how Guzhen, a small town in Zhongshan, produces over 50% of global lighting fixtures, driven by entrepreneurship, intelligent upgrades, and a complete supply chain.

articles.title_zh: 孔绍逊任甘肃省代省长
articles.title_en: Kong Shaoxun Appointed Acting Governor of Gansu
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，甘肃省十四届人大常委会第二十五次会议在兰州闭幕，决定任命孔绍逊为甘肃省副省长、代理省长，接受任振鹤辞去省长职务。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, the 25th session of the 14th Gansu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee closed in Lanzhou, appointing Kong Shaoxun as vice governor and acting governor, accepting Ren Zhenhe's resignation.

articles.title_zh: 福建省（厦门）人工智能产业园孵化器路演会举行
articles.title_en: Roadshow Held at Fujian (Xiamen) AI Industrial Park Incubator
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，福建省（厦门）人工智能产业园孵化器路演会举行，8个AI项目集中路演，吸引十多家投资机构参与，旨在促进项目与资本对接。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, the Fujian (Xiamen) AI Industrial Park Incubator roadshow was held, with 8 AI projects presented to over ten investment institutions to promote project-capital matchmaking.

tags_zh: 厦门市软件园管理委员会

articles.title_zh: 福州长乐前塘至福清庄前高速公路竣工验收
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Expressway from Changle Qiantang to Fuqing Zhuangqian Passes Final Acceptance
articles.summary_zh: 近日，福州长乐前塘至福清庄前高速公路通过竣工验收，将进入规范化运营，并为长乐、福清两地互联互通和区域发展提供交通动力。
articles.summary_en: The Changle Qiantang-Fuqing Zhuangqian Expressway in Fuzhou passed its final acceptance inspection, marking its official entry into standardized operation and boosting regional connectivity and development.

articles.title_zh: 梅宏：开发“具身智能操作系统” 推动具身智能走向可复用、可规模化的产业生态
articles.title_en: Mei Hong: Develop "Embodied Intelligence Operating System" to Drive Embodied Intelligence Toward a Reusable, Scalable Industrial Ecosystem
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日晚，北京大学教授梅宏在2026数博会DATA之夜活动上作主旨演讲，提出构建具身智能操作系统，推动具身智能实现可复用、可规模化的产业发展。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of August 28, Peking University professor Mei Hong delivered a keynote speech at the 2026 Big Data Expo DATA Night, proposing to build an embodied intelligence operating system to drive the industry toward reuse and scale.

articles.title_zh: 2026年河北省“质量月”活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Hebei Province Quality Month Activities Kick Off

articles.summary_en: On August 31, the 2026 Integrated Circuit Innovation and Development Conference opened in Wuxi, where Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao attended the opening ceremony and unveiled the Jiangsu Integrated Circuit Industry Alliance.

articles.summary_en: On August 30, the 8th Congress of the China Democratic League Chifeng Committee was held, electing a new committee and Lü Dongming as chairman.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 31 local time, President Xi Jinping met with Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the SCO Summit in Bishkek, exchanging views on deepening bilateral ties and cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 今年以来消费品以旧换新带动销售额超1.54万亿元

Provincial Party Secretary Xu Kunlin chaired the meeting, and Che Jun, head of the Central Second Steering Group, attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 市领导检查秋季开学和校园安全工作
articles.title_en: Municipal Leaders Inspect Fall School Opening and Campus Safety Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，淮安市市长顾坤深入中小学、幼儿园及在淮高校，检查秋季开学和校园安全工作，强调全面细致做好开学各项工作，保障师生安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Huaian Mayor Gu Kun visited primary and secondary schools, kindergartens, and colleges to inspect fall school opening and campus safety, emphasizing thorough preparations and safety for teachers and students.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市长顾坤检查秋季开学和校园安全工作
articles.title_en: Huaian Mayor Gu Kun Inspects School Opening and Campus Safety
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，淮安市市长顾坤走进中小学、幼儿园及在淮高校，检查秋季开学和校园安全工作，强调为师生营造安全稳定、和谐有序的环境。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Mayor Gu Kun of Huai'an inspected schools and universities on autumn opening and campus safety, emphasizing a safe and orderly learning environment.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开常务会议
articles.title_en: Municipal Government Holds Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日下午，代市长高靖生主持召开市政府常务会议，传达学习中央政治局会议和省委全会精神，部署经济、扫黑除恶、信访等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 31, Acting Mayor Gao Jingsheng chaired the municipal government executive meeting to convey the spirit of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau meeting and provincial party committee plenary session, and deploy work on economy, anti-crime, and petition handling.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰：锚定全年目标 全力推动经济向上向好
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie: Anchor Annual Goals to Boost Economic Growth
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日上午，揭阳市市长曲晓杰主持召开市政府会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，分析经济形势，部署防汛防台风和传统产业焕新等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 31, Qu Xiaojie, mayor of Jieyang, chaired a municipal government meeting to convey Xi Jinping's important speech, analyze economic trends, and arrange flood prevention and traditional industry upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保：全力推动城市现代化建设和产业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao: Promoting Urban Modernization and High-Quality Industrial Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，揭阳市委书记曾风保到揭东区调研“百千万工程”并走访企业，强调全力推动城市现代化建设和产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Zeng Fengbao, Secretary of the CPC Jieyang Municipal Committee, visited Jiedong District to inspect the "Baiqianwan Project" and enterprises, stressing efforts to promote urban modernization and high-quality industrial development.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰带队到惠来县调研重点企业
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Leads Delegation to Inspect Key Enterprises in Huilai
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日下午，揭阳市市长曲晓杰带队赴惠来县调研重点企业，强调以“店小二”式服务护航企业高质量发展，推动海洋经济产业集群升级。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Qu Xiaojie, Mayor of Jieyang, led a delegation to inspect key enterprises in Huilai County, emphasizing 'shop assistant' services to boost high-quality growth and marine economy clusters.

articles.title_zh: 王炳森到兴隆台区调研项目建设情况并主持召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Wang Bingsen Visits Xinglongtai District to Inspect Project Construction and Chairs Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，盘锦市委书记王炳森到兴隆台区调研项目建设情况并主持召开座谈会，强调加快项目建设进度，优化营商环境，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Wang Bingsen, Secretary of the Panjin Municipal CPC Committee, visited Xinglongtai District to inspect project construction and chaired a symposium, emphasizing the need to accelerate project progress, improve the business environment, and promote high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登：坚持人民至上生命至上尽最大努力全力推进搜救工作
articles.title_en: Gama Zedeng Urges All-Out Rescue Efforts, Putting People and Lives First
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，西藏自治区主席嘎玛泽登在吉隆泥石流灾害应急救援指挥部调度抢险救援工作，强调坚持人民至上、生命至上，全力推进搜救。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 30, Gama Zedeng, Chairman of Tibet Autonomous Region, coordinated rescue work at the Gyirong mudslide emergency command center, stressing the need to put people and lives first and make every effort in search and rescue.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群到市人大常委会机关开展调研并召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Inspects Standing Committee of Municipal People's Congress and Holds Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日上午，汕头市委书记庄悦群到市人大常委会机关调研并召开座谈会，强调坚持党的领导、人民当家作主、依法治国有机统一，发挥人大制度作用。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 31, Zhuang Yuequn, Secretary of the Shantou Municipal Party Committee, visited the Standing Committee of the Municipal People's Congress and held a symposium, stressing the integration of Party leadership, people's democracy, and rule of law.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会会议暨市“百千万工程”指挥部会议召开 逯峰主持会议
articles.title_en: Shanwei Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting on High-quality Development Project, Lu Feng Chairs
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，汕尾市委常委会会议暨市“百千万工程”指挥部会议召开，听取市城区和捷胜镇工作汇报，研究推进县域经济高质量发展，市委书记逯峰主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the Standing Committee of the Shanwei Municipal Party Committee and the command headquarters for the 'Bai Qian Wan' project held a meeting to promote high-quality county-level development. Party Secretary Lu Feng chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 认真学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神 研究部署防灾减灾救灾、侨务、审计、经济运行等工作 逯峰主持会议
articles.title_en: Standing Committee of CPC Shanwei Municipal Committee Meets to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speech and Instructions, Deploying Disaster Prevention, Overseas Chinese Affairs, Audit, and Economic Work; Lu Feng Chairs Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，汕尾市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和重要指示精神，研究部署防灾减灾救灾、侨务、审计、经济运行等工作，市委书记逯峰主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the Standing Committee of the CPC Shanwei Municipal Committee held a meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's recent important speech and instructions, and to deploy work on disaster prevention and relief, overseas Chinese affairs, audit, and economic operation. Lu Feng, secretary of the municipal party committee, chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 习近平会见乌兹别克斯坦总统米尔济约耶夫
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Meets with Uzbek President Mirziyoyev
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月31日下午，国家主席习近平在比什凯克出席上合组织峰会期间会见乌兹别克斯坦总统米尔济约耶夫，双方同意深化互利合作，共创中乌关系新的“黄金10年”。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 31, President Xi Jinping met with Uzbek President Mirziyoyev on the sidelines of the SCO summit in Bishkek, agreeing to deepen mutually beneficial cooperation and create a new "golden decade" for bilateral ties.

articles.title_zh: 习近平会见蒙古国总统呼日勒苏赫
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Meets Mongolian President Khurelsukh
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月31日，国家主席习近平在比什凯克出席上海合作组织峰会期间会见蒙古国总统呼日勒苏赫，双方就巩固战略互信、深化互利合作等达成共识。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Chinese President Xi Jinping met Mongolian President Khurelsukh on the sidelines of the SCO summit in Bishkek, agreeing to consolidate strategic mutual trust and deepen cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 认真学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神 研究部署防灾减灾救灾、侨务、审计、经济运行等工作 逯峰主持会议
articles.title_en: Shanwei Municipal Party Committee Meeting Studies Xi Jinping's Important Speeches and Instructions, Deploys Disaster Prevention, Overseas Chinese Affairs, Audit and Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，汕尾市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和重要指示精神，研究部署防灾减灾救灾、侨务、审计、经济运行等工作，市委书记逯峰主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the Standing Committee of the Shanwei Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions, and deployed work on disaster prevention, overseas Chinese affairs, audit, and economic operation. Lu Feng, secretary of the municipal party committee, chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 习近平出席“上海合作组织+”会议并发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends "SCO+" Meeting and Delivers Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月1日下午，国家主席习近平在比什凯克出席“上海合作组织+”会议并发表题为《共同倡导平等有序的世界多极化 实现更加公正合理的全球治理》的重要讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 1 local time, President Xi Jinping attended the "SCO+" meeting in Bishkek and delivered an important speech titled "Jointly Advocating an Equal and Orderly Multipolar World and Achieving More Just and Equitable Global Governance."

articles.title_zh: 石嘴山市委常委会召开会议 统筹发展和安全两件大事 以正确政绩观引领各项工作落实落细
articles.title_en: Shizuishan Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting Emphasizes Development and Security, Correct Performance View
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，石嘴山市委书记杨青龙主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署防灾减灾、新能源体系和政绩观教育等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Yang Qinglong, Party Secretary of Shizuishan, chaired a Standing Committee meeting to convey Xi Jinping's important speech and studied disaster prevention, new energy system, and performance view education.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央宣传部等印发《关于组织开展2026年“全民国防教育月”活动的通知》
articles.title_en: CPC Publicity Department and 11 Departments Issue Notice on 2026 National Defense Education Month
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中共中央宣传部等12部门联合印发通知，部署在9月集中开展“全民国防教育月”活动，要求各地加强国防教育和爱国主义教育。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Publicity Department and 11 other departments jointly issued a notice to organize nationwide defense education activities in September, promoting patriotism and defense awareness.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在埃及媒体发表署名文章
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Publishes Signed Article in Egyptian Media Ahead of State Visit
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，国家主席习近平在赴埃及进行国事访问之际，在埃及《金字塔报》等媒体发表题为《风雨同舟七十载，踔厉奋发新征程》的署名文章，阐述中埃友谊与合作。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, ahead of his state visit to Egypt, President Xi Jinping published a signed article titled "Sailing Together for Seventy Years, Embarking on a New Journey" in Egyptian media including Al-Ahram, expounding on China-Egypt friendship and cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 泰安市工商联第十二次代表大会召开
articles.title_en: Tai'an City Federation of Industry and Commerce Holds Its 12th Congress
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，泰安市工商联第十二次代表大会召开，市委书记杨洪涛、省工商联副主席陆怡出席并讲话，选举产生新一届领导班子。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the 12th Congress of the Tai'an City Federation of Industry and Commerce was held. Party Secretary Yang Hongtao and Provincial Federation Vice Chair Lu Yi attended and spoke, and a new leadership was elected.

articles.title_zh: 市十七届人大常委会举行第三十八次会议
articles.title_en: 17th Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 38th Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，市十七届人大常委会举行第三十八次会议，决定接受徐志辞去市长职务，任命陈东为副市长、代理市长。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 31, the 17th Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held its 38th session, accepting Xu Zhi's resignation as mayor and appointing Chen Dong as acting mayor.

articles.title_zh: 芜湖市人民代表大会常务委员会关于接受徐志辞职请求的决定
articles.title_en: Wuhu Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Accepts Xu Zhi's Resignation
articles.summary_zh: 因工作变动，徐志辞去芜湖市市长职务，芜湖市第十七届人大常委会第三十八次会议决定接受其辞职请求。
articles.summary_en: Due to work changes, Xu Zhi resigned as Mayor of Wuhu. The Standing Committee of the 17th Wuhu Municipal People's Congress accepted his resignation at its 38th meeting.

articles.title_zh: 无锡市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Wuxi Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，无锡市委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要指示精神，研究部署巩固政绩观教育成果和防汛防台等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the Wuxi Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee held a meeting to study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important instructions, and to deploy work on consolidating political achievement education and flood/typhoon prevention.

articles.title_zh: 赵一德赵刚徐新荣会见港区省级政协委员联谊会经贸文化交流团
articles.title_en: Zhao Yide, Zhao Gang and Xu Xinrong Meet Delegation of Hong Kong Provincial CPPCC Members' Association
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，陕西省委书记赵一德、省长赵刚、省政协主席徐新荣在西安会见港区省级政协委员联谊会经贸文化交流团，双方就深化陕港合作交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Shaanxi Party Secretary Zhao Yide, Governor Zhao Gang, and CPPCC Chairman Xu Xinrong met the delegation of Hong Kong Provincial CPPCC Members' Association in Xi'an to discuss deepening Shaanxi-Hong Kong cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 习近平出席上海合作组织成员国元首理事会第二十六次会议
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends 26th Meeting of SCO Council of Heads of State
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月1日上午，国家主席习近平在比什凯克幸福宫出席上海合作组织成员国元首理事会第二十六次会议。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 1 local time, President Xi Jinping attended the 26th Meeting of the SCO Council of Heads of State at the Happiness Palace in Bishkek.

articles.title_zh: 赵一德会见陕西省第十批“三秦楷模”
articles.title_en: Zhao Yide Meets Shaanxi's 10th 'Sanqin Role Models'
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，陕西省委书记赵一德在西安会见陕西省第十批“三秦楷模”代表，表示祝贺和敬意，强调发挥榜样引领作用。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Zhao Yide, Secretary of the CPC Shaanxi Provincial Committee, met with representatives of the 10th 'Sanqin Role Models' in Xi'an, expressing congratulations and emphasizing the role of exemplary figures.

articles.title_zh: 市九届人大常委会第四十次会议召开
articles.title_en: Yancheng Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 40th Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，盐城市九届人大常委会第四十次会议召开，王荣主持并讲话。会议表决通过人事任免事项和《盐城市中小学幼儿园周边交通安全管理规定》等。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the 40th session of the Yancheng Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee was held, chaired by Wang Rong. The meeting approved personnel appointments and removals and passed several local regulations.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平主持召开书记专题会议
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Chairs Special Meeting on Inspection Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，盐城市委书记严汉平主持召开书记专题会议，听取第八届市委第九轮巡察情况汇报，研究部署下一阶段巡察工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Yan Hanping, Secretary of the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee, chaired a special meeting to review the ninth round of inspections and plan next-step work.

tags.name_en: Full and Strict Governance over the Party

tags_en: Full and Strict Governance over the Party

articles.title_zh: “示范性诉讼+批量化调解”试点工作扎实推进
articles.title_en: Pilot Work on 'Model Litigation + Batch Mediation' Steadily Advanced
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，营口市政府新闻办召开新闻发布会，市中级人民法院介绍“示范性诉讼+批量化调解”试点工作，全市法院累计批量化解案件2900余件，类型化纠纷收案量下降。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the Yingkou Municipal Government Information Office held a press conference where the Intermediate People's Court presented its pilot work on 'model litigation + batch mediation.' Courts across the city have batch-resolved over 2,900 cases, with a decline in new cases of typed disputes.

articles.title_zh: 李军主持召开市政府全体（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Li Jun Chairs Municipal Government Enlarged Plenary Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，营口市长李军主持召开市政府全体（扩大）会议，传达贯彻中央和省委有关精神，部署下半年重点经济工作，确保完成全年目标任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Yingkou Mayor Li Jun chaired the municipal government enlarged plenary meeting to convey central and provincial directives and arrange key economic work for the second half, aiming to achieve annual targets.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会召开党组会暨主任会
articles.title_en: Yuxi Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Party Group Meeting and Director Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，玉溪市人大常委会党组会暨主任会议召开，党组书记、主任聂涛主持，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究人事任免等事项。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the Party Group meeting and director meeting of Yuxi Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee was held, chaired by Nie Tao, Party Secretary and Director. The meeting conveyed Xi Jinping's important speech and discussed personnel appointments.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记在中央政治局会议研究部署西藏日喀则市吉隆县泥石流灾害抢险救援工作时的重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting, Studying Xi Jinping's Important Speech on Tibet Mudslide Relief Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，国务院总理李强主持召开国务院常务会议，学习贯彻习近平关于西藏日喀则市吉隆县泥石流抢险救援的重要讲话精神，研究地下管网、招商引资、税收征管等事项。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 31, Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting to study Xi's important speech on Tibet mudslide rescue. It also covered urban pipelines, investment promotion, and tax and audit drafts.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江主持召开八届市委审计委员会第九次会议
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Chairs Ninth Meeting of Yueyang Municipal Party Committee Audit Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江主持召开八届市委审计委员会第九次会议，研究部署审计工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Xie Weijiang, Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Yueyang Municipal Party Committee, chaired the ninth meeting of the Eighth Yueyang Municipal Party Committee Audit Committee to plan audit work.

articles.title_zh: 市委工作会议召开，研究部署爱国卫生运动相关工作
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Party Committee Meeting Deploys Patriotic Health Campaign
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日下午，湛江市委工作会议召开，市委书记余钢主持并讲话，部署深入开展爱国卫生运动，强调防蚊灭蚊和人居环境整治。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 31, Zhanjiang Municipal Party Committee held a work meeting chaired by Secretary Yu Gang to deploy the Patriotic Health Campaign, emphasizing mosquito control and environmental improvement.

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐调研教育并检查开学准备工作
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Inspects Education and School Preparation
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，珠海市长吴泽桐赴高新区调研教育并检查开学准备工作，强调以高水平教育支撑高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Zhuhai Mayor Wu Zetong visited the high-tech zone to inspect education and school preparation, emphasizing high-quality education for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 陈勇调研跨境电商高质量发展工作
articles.title_en: Chen Yong Investigates High-Quality Development of Cross-Border E-Commerce
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日下午，珠海市委书记陈勇到香洲区调研跨境电商高质量发展，强调探索新业态新模式，推动区位优势转化为发展胜势。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Aug 31, Chen Yong, Party Secretary of Zhuhai, visited Xiangzhou District to inspect cross-border e-commerce development, urging new models and faster transformation of locational advantages.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔会见西班牙众议院第三副议长
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Meets Third Vice President of Spanish Congress of Deputies
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，山东省省长周乃翔在济南会见西班牙众议院第三副议长埃丝特·希尔德雷博莱尼奥一行，双方表示将深化多领域合作。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Zhou Naixiang, Governor of Shandong, met in Jinan with Esther Hildreboleño, Third Deputy Speaker of the Spanish Congress of Deputies, to discuss deepening cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 赵庆文调研生态环境保护工作
articles.title_en: Zhao Qingwen Inspects Ecological Environment Protection Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日下午，市委副书记、市长赵庆文到临淄区、淄博高新区调研生态环境保护工作，强调精准治理支撑高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 31 afternoon, Zhao Qingwen, Deputy Secretary and Mayor of Zibo, visited Linzi District and Zibo High-tech Zone to inspect ecological environment protection, emphasizing precise governance for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 长实、长和及李嘉诚基金会捐款1500万元支援西藏赈灾
articles.title_en: Cheung Kong, CK Hutchison and Li Ka Shing Foundation Donate 15 Million Yuan for Tibet Disaster Relief
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，长江实业、长江和记及李嘉诚基金会通过中联办赈灾账户向西藏吉隆泥石流灾区捐款1500万元人民币。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Cheung Kong Group, CK Hutchison and Li Ka Shing Foundation donated 15 million yuan to disaster relief for the Gyirong mudslide in Tibet via the Liaison Office account.

articles.title_zh: 防癌保险赔付50万变1万？北京法院提醒：警惕互联网保险“隐藏条款”
articles.title_en: Beijing Court Warns of Hidden Clauses in Online Insurance After Cancer Payout Dispute
articles.summary_zh: 北京金融法院审结一起互联网防癌险理赔纠纷，认定保险公司减轻赔付责任的条款未充分提示，判决按50万元保额赔付，并提醒消费者警惕互联网保险隐藏条款。
articles.summary_en: Beijing Financial Court ruled that an online cancer insurance clause reducing payout was not properly disclosed, ordering the insurer to pay 500,000 yuan, and warned consumers about hidden clauses in online insurance.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能应用服务商培育专项行动启动
articles.title_en: Special Action Launched to Cultivate AI Application Service Providers
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部日前印发通知，启动人工智能应用服务商培育专项行动，提出到2026年底服务商资源池内服务商数量突破2000家。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology has launched a special action to cultivate AI application service providers, aiming to have over 2,000 providers in the national resource pool by the end of 2026.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 中吉元首出席签字仪式，现场响起长时间热烈掌声
articles.title_en: Chinese and Kyrgyz Presidents Attend Signing Ceremony, Drawing Warm Applause
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月31日，习近平主席同吉尔吉斯斯坦总统扎帕罗夫出席签字仪式，两国元首交换文本时现场响起长时间热烈掌声。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, President Xi Jinping and Kyrgyz President Japarov attended a signing ceremony, where the two leaders exchanged documents amid prolonged warm applause.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席在比什凯克先后会见三国总统
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Meets Presidents of Three Countries in Bishkek
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月31日下午，国家主席习近平在比什凯克分别会见乌兹别克斯坦总统米尔济约耶夫、蒙古国总统呼日勒苏赫和俄罗斯总统普京。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 31 local time, President Xi Jinping met with the presidents of Uzbekistan, Mongolia, and Russia in Bishkek.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将对埃及进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Pay State Visit to Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 应埃及总统塞西邀请，国家主席习近平将对埃及进行国事访问。2026年是中埃建交70周年，两国关系持续健康发展。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi, Chinese President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to Egypt. 2026 marks the 70th anniversary of China-Egypt diplomatic relations, with bilateral ties developing steadily.

articles.title_zh: 于海田督导检查非煤矿山安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Yu Haitian Inspects Safety at Non-coal Mines
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，济南市委副书记、市长于海田到莱芜区督导检查非煤矿山安全生产工作，实地察看鲁中矿业和山东莱矿马庄铁矿，并召开座谈会强调压实安全责任。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Yu Haitian, Deputy Secretary of the Jinan Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, inspected safety production at non-coal mines in Laiwu District, visiting Luzhong Mining and Shandong Laiku Majuang Iron Mine, and chaired a symposium to stress safety responsibilities.

articles.title_zh: 刘强调研企业时强调：持续提升服务企业质效 推动经济运行稳中向好
articles.title_en: Liu Qiang Emphasizes Improving Enterprise Services and Steady Economic Growth During Enterprise Research
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，济南市委书记刘强调研多家企业，强调持续提升服务企业质效，推动经济运行稳中向好。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Jinan Party Secretary Liu Qiang visited multiple enterprises, stressing better enterprise services and steady economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 学习进行时丨从习近平主席署名文章读懂中吉关系高质量发展之道
articles.title_en: Xi's Signed Article Highlights High-Quality Development of China-Kyrgyzstan Ties
articles.summary_zh: 在访问吉尔吉斯斯坦前夕，习近平主席在吉媒体发表署名文章，回顾中吉友好历程，展望关系高质量发展，强调构建中吉命运共同体。
articles.summary_en: On the eve of his visit to Kyrgyzstan, President Xi Jinping published a signed article in Kyrgyz media, reviewing bilateral friendship and envisioning high-quality development of ties, emphasizing building a China-Kyrgyzstan community with a shared future.

articles.title_zh: 老朋友们的相见！“上合伙伴”提前见
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Meets Presidents of Uzbekistan, Mongolia and Russia at SCO Summit
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月31日下午，国家主席习近平在比什凯克出席上海合作组织峰会期间，会见乌兹别克斯坦、蒙古、俄罗斯三国总统，共商合作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 31, President Xi Jinping met with the presidents of Uzbekistan, Mongolia and Russia on the sidelines of the SCO Summit in Bishkek, promoting friendship and cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同吉尔吉斯斯坦总统会谈 强调高质量建好中吉乌铁路
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Kyrgyz President, Stresses High-Quality Construction of China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan Railway
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月31日，习近平主席在比什凯克同吉尔吉斯斯坦总统扎帕罗夫会谈，强调高质量建好中吉乌铁路这条承载地区发展希望的“交通大动脉”。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, President Xi Jinping held talks with Kyrgyz President Japarov in Bishkek, emphasizing high-quality construction of the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway, a "transport artery" carrying regional development hopes.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会调研组到崂山区调研金融审判工作
articles.title_en: Municipal People's Congress Research Team Inspects Financial Trial Work in Laoshan District
articles.summary_zh: 近日，市人大常委会调研组到崂山区专题调研金融审判工作，实地走访海尔消费金融公司和崂山法院，听取汇报并提出要求。
articles.summary_en: Recently, a research group of the Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee visited Laoshan District to inspect financial trial work, touring Haier Consumer Finance Co. and Laoshan Court, and listening to reports.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席鼓励我们做中埃友好使者
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Encourages Us to Be Messengers of China-Egypt Friendship
articles.summary_zh: 在中埃建交70周年之际，习近平主席即将对埃及进行国事访问。文章回顾两国人文交流成果，展现人民相知相亲的动人故事。
articles.summary_en: On the 70th anniversary of China-Egypt diplomatic ties, President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to Egypt. The article reviews the achievements of people-to-people exchanges, showcasing touching stories of mutual understanding and friendship.

articles.title_zh: 玛纳斯：中吉人民共同拥有的文化瑰宝
articles.title_en: Manas: A Cultural Treasure Shared by Chinese and Kyrgyz People
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，习近平主席在吉尔吉斯斯坦媒体发表署名文章，提及中吉携手保护传承《玛纳斯》等非物质文化遗产。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, President Xi Jinping published a signed article in Kyrgyz media, mentioning the joint protection of intangible cultural heritage such as Manas.

articles.title_zh: 省政府第77次常务会议召开 施小琳主持
articles.title_en: Shi Xiaolin Chairs 77th Executive Meeting of Sichuan Provincial Government
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，四川省省长施小琳主持召开省政府第77次常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示，审议通过多项“十五五”规划。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Governor Shi Xiaolin of Sichuan chaired the 77th executive meeting of the provincial government to convey key directives from Xi Jinping and approve several 15th Five-Year Plan documents.

articles.title_zh: 长江中下游“最大个”！我国发布铜、金重大找矿成果
articles.title_en: China Releases Major Copper and Gold Prospecting Achievements in Middle-Lower Yangtze Region
articles.summary_zh: 自然资源部9月1日宣布，安徽宣城茶亭斑岩铜多金属矿床勘探取得重大进展，铜、金潜在资源量巨大，有望打造华东超大型铜金生产基地。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Natural Resources announced on September 1 that exploration of the Chating porphyry copper-gold deposit in Xuancheng, Anhui, has made major progress, with huge potential copper and gold resources, expected to build an ultra-large copper-gold production base in East China.

articles.title_zh: 时政微纪录丨习主席的亚非时间 第一集 中吉关系迈上新台阶
articles.title_en: Xi's Asia-Africa Time: China-Kyrgyzstan Relations Reach New Heights
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月30日下午，国家主席习近平抵达比什凯克，对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问并出席上合组织峰会，两国签署联合宣言和友好合作条约。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 30 local time, President Xi Jinping arrived in Bishkek for a state visit to Kyrgyzstan and attended the SCO summit, with the two countries signing a joint declaration and a treaty on permanent good-neighborliness and friendly cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 极寒之地的“绿色脉动”
articles.title_en: Green Pulse in the Extreme Cold
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报调研组近日走访国家管网集团东北公司，报道其在极寒地区守护油气管道、推进氢能甲醇管道等绿色转型的实践。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily research team recently visited PipeChina Northeast Company, reporting on its efforts to safeguard oil and gas pipelines in extreme cold and advance green transition with hydrogen and methanol pipelines.

articles.title_zh: 中埃建交70周年，习主席时隔10年再访埃及
articles.title_en: China-Egypt 70th Anniversary: President Xi to Visit Egypt Again After 10 Years
articles.summary_zh: 应塞西总统邀请，习近平主席即将对埃及进行国事访问，此系时隔10年再访，将为深化中埃全面战略伙伴关系擘画新蓝图。
articles.summary_en: At President Sisi's invitation, President Xi Jinping will soon visit Egypt, a decade after his last visit, on the 70th anniversary of ties, to deepen the comprehensive strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 埃及各界期待习近平主席对埃进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Egyptian Figures Expect President Xi Jinping's State Visit to Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 应埃及总统塞西邀请，国家主席习近平将对埃及进行国事访问。埃及各界期待此访深化中埃关系，成为两国关系新里程碑。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of Egyptian President Sisi, President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to Egypt. Egyptian figures expect the visit to deepen bilateral ties and mark a new milestone.

articles.title_zh: 北京首个外卖包装新规今日起正式实施
articles.title_en: Beijing's First Takeout Packaging Regulation Takes Effect Today
articles.summary_zh: 北京市市场监督管理局发布的《餐饮外卖商户绿色包装使用指南》于9月1日起正式实施，这是全国首个专门针对餐饮外卖商户绿色包装的地方标准，旨在推动外卖包装减量化和循环再利用。
articles.summary_en: The Guidelines for Green Packaging Use by Food Delivery Merchants, issued by Beijing Municipal Market Supervision Administration, officially took effect on September 1, becoming the first local standard for green packaging in the takeout industry to promote waste reduction and recycling.
