articles.title_zh: 中央统战部原副部长张声作逝世，享年93岁
articles.title_en: Zhang Shengzuo, Former Deputy Head of CPC United Front Work Department, Passes Away at 93
articles.summary_zh: 中央统战部原副部长、国务院宗教事务局原局长张声作因病于2026年8月1日在上海逝世，享年93岁。
articles.summary_en: Zhang Shengzuo, former deputy head of the CPC United Front Work Department and former head of the State Administration for Religious Affairs, died in Shanghai on Aug. 1, 2026 at age 93.

articles.title_zh: 欧洲科学院院士、中国政府友谊奖获得者亨利·哈曼·阿达姆松逝世
articles.title_en: Henry Harman Adamson, European Academy of Sciences Fellow and Recipient of the Chinese Government Friendship Award, Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 欧洲科学院院士、中国政府友谊奖获得者亨利·哈曼·阿达姆松逝世，曾任广东省大湾区集成电路与系统应用研究院首席科学家。
articles.summary_en: Henry Harman Adamson, Fellow of the European Academy of Sciences and winner of the Chinese Government Friendship Award, has passed away. He served as chief scientist at the Guangdong Greater Bay Area Institute of Integrated Circuit and System Applications.

articles.title_zh: 《我的阿勒泰》作者李娟获公示入围享受政府特殊津贴推荐人选
articles.title_en: Li Juan, Author of 'My Altay', Named in Publicity for State Council Special Allowance Recommendation
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中国文明网公布2026年享受政府特殊津贴推荐人选公示，新疆作家李娟入围。
articles.summary_en: China Civilization Network recently published the 2026 State Council Special Allowance recommendation list, including Xinjiang writer Li Juan.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古：下决心开展致敏性蒿草系统治理
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia: Determined to Launch Systematic Treatment of Allergenic Mugwort
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月31日，内蒙古自治区政府主席包钢主持政府常务会议，听取致敏性蒿草治理汇报，强调要科学精准开展长效系统治理，回应群众关切。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, 2026, Bao Gang, Chairman of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, chaired a government executive meeting to deploy systematic treatment of allergenic mugwort, emphasizing science-based governance.

articles.title_zh: 中国作协原党组副书记、书记处常务书记玛拉沁夫逝世，享年97岁
articles.title_en: Ma Laqinfu, Former Deputy Secretary of China Writers Association Party Group, Dies at 97
articles.summary_zh: 中国作协原党组副书记、书记处常务书记，著名作家玛拉沁夫因病医治无效，于2026年9月1日在北京逝世，享年97岁。
articles.summary_en: Ma Laqinfu, former deputy secretary of the leading party group and executive secretary of the secretariat of the China Writers Association, a renowned writer, died of illness in Beijing on September 1, 2026, at the age of 97.

articles.title_zh: 中央网信办：当前人工智能领域主要面临5方面安全风险挑战
articles.title_en: Central Cyberspace Administration: AI Sector Faces Five Major Security Risks
articles.summary_zh: 中央网信办指出当前人工智能领域主要面临技术脆弱性、模型失控、应用风险、误用滥用及技术霸权五方面安全风险挑战。
articles.summary_en: The Central Cyberspace Administration identified five major security risks in AI, including technical vulnerabilities, model runaway, application risks, misuse, and technological hegemony.

articles.title_zh: 湖南石门县发改局：有不法分子伪造我单位文件，已向公安机关报案
articles.title_en: Hunan Shimen Development and Reform Bureau: Criminals Fabricated Official Documents, Police Report Filed
articles.summary_zh: 石门县发展和改革局发布声明称，不法分子伪造其备案文件，已向公安机关报案，提醒公众谨防上当。
articles.summary_en: The Shimen County Development and Reform Bureau stated that criminals forged its filing documents, reported the case to police, and warned the public to stay vigilant.

articles.title_zh: 单项冠军县，何以扛打丨便宜又好穿，曹县汉服斩获全国市场过半份额
articles.title_en: How Does a Champion County Thrive? Caoxian Hanfu Captures Over Half of National Market with Affordable Quality
articles.summary_zh: 2026年上半年，山东曹县汉服网络销售额达47.75亿元，占全国市场过半份额。凭借极致性价比和完整产业链，曹县汉服产业快速发展。
articles.summary_en: In the first half of 2026, Caoxian County in Shandong achieved online Hanfu sales of 4.775 billion yuan, capturing over half of the national market through its cost-effective production and integrated supply chain.

articles.title_zh: 2026年网安周将于9月14日至20日在全国举行
articles.title_en: 2026 Cybersecurity Week to Be Held Nationwide from September 14 to 20
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，2026年国家网络安全宣传周新闻发布会在北京举行，宣布网安周将于9月14日至20日在全国举行，开幕式在济南。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, the press conference for the 2026 China Cybersecurity Week was held in Beijing, announcing the event will take place nationwide from September 14 to 20, with the opening ceremony in Jinan.

articles.title_zh: 西部集成电路与工业软件创新港竣工投用
articles.title_en: Western Integrated Circuit and Industrial Software Innovation Port Completed and Put into Use
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，重庆永川区西部集成电路与工业软件创新港暨重庆智能工程职业学院产教融合示范基地全面竣工启用，总投资10亿元，占地213亩。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the Western Integrated Circuit and Industrial Software Innovation Port and the Chongqing Intelligent Engineering Vocational College Industry-Education Integration Demonstration Base in Yongchuan District were fully completed and put into operation, with a total investment of 1 billion yuan and covering 213 mu.

articles.title_zh: 构建安全韧性现代水网 《宁德市水网建设规划》出台
articles.title_en: Building a Safe and Resilient Modern Water Network: Ningde's Water Network Construction Plan Released
articles.summary_zh: 近日，《宁德市水网建设规划》经宁德市政府常务会议审议通过并印发实施，规划总投资969.5亿元，提出构建“一屏一带五廊，三干九支四枢”的市级水网布局。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Ningde Municipal Water Network Construction Plan was reviewed and approved by the Ningde Municipal Government's executive meeting and officially issued. The plan, with a total investment of 96.95 billion yuan, outlines a municipal water network layout.

articles.title_zh: 2026年第二批“中国好人榜”发布
articles.title_en: Second Batch of 2026 'China Good Person List' Released
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，2026年第二批“中国好人榜”发布仪式在甘肃省平凉市静宁县举办，共有150名身边好人上榜。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 31, the ceremony for the second batch of the 2026 'China Good Person List' was held in Jingning County, Pingliang, Gansu, with 150 local好人 honored.

articles.title_zh: 2026年第二批“中国好人榜”在甘肃平凉发布
articles.title_en: Second Batch of 2026 'China Good Person List' Released in Pingliang, Gansu
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，2026年第二批“中国好人榜”发布仪式在甘肃省平凉市静宁县举行，150名先进典型上榜，活动由中央精神文明建设办公室主办。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the release ceremony for the second batch of the 2026 'China Good Person List' was held in Jingning County, Pingliang, Gansu, with 150 exemplary individuals honored, hosted by the Central Office for Cultural and Ethical Progress.

articles.title_zh: 好片带动观影热 “电影+”拉长消费链（文化市场新观察）
articles.title_en: Quality Films Drive Summer Box Office, 'Film+' Extends Consumption Chain
articles.summary_zh: 2026年暑期档总票房突破124亿元，观影人次达3.39亿，放映场次创历史新高。好片带动“电影+”消费链延伸，文旅、文创等业态增长。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 summer box office surpassed 12.4 billion yuan with 339 million admissions by Aug 31, hitting a record high in screenings. Quality films drove 'Film+' to extend consumption chains in tourism and cultural products.

articles.title_zh: 商务部等7部门印发意见 推动商品消费扩容升级
articles.title_en: Ministry of Commerce and Six Other Departments Issue Opinions on Expanding and Upgrading Consumer Goods
articles.summary_zh: 商务部会同国家发改委等7部门印发《关于推动商品消费扩容升级的实施意见》，提出到2030年社会消费品零售总额达60万亿元左右。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce and six other departments issued the Implementation Opinions on Expanding and Upgrading Consumption of Goods, aiming for total retail sales of consumer goods to reach about 60 trillion yuan by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 世界首座四主缆悬索桥燕矶长江大桥启动荷载试验
articles.title_en: World's First Four-Main-Cable Suspension Bridge Yanji Yangtze River Bridge Starts Load Test
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日晚，由湖北交投集团投资建设的燕矶长江大桥启动荷载试验，180台重型载重车同步加载，全面评估桥梁承载力与安全性。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of August 30, the Yanji Yangtze River Bridge, invested by Hubei Communications Investment Group, started load tests with 180 heavy trucks loading simultaneously to assess its bearing capacity and safety.

articles.title_zh: 京津冀推出26处生物多样性体验地
articles.title_en: Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Unveils 26 Biodiversity Experience Sites
articles.summary_zh: 京津冀三地生态环境部门推出26处生物多样性体验地，涵盖湿地、森林、海洋等类型，集生态保护与科普研学于一体。
articles.summary_en: The Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region has launched 26 biodiversity experience sites, integrating ecological protection with science education.

articles.title_zh: 罗文在石家庄专题检查安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Luo Wen Inspects Work Safety in Shijiazhuang
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，河北省委书记罗文在石家庄市专题检查安全生产工作，强调创新制度机制、扣紧责任链条，王正谱参加。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Luo Wen, secretary of Hebei Provincial Party Committee, inspected work safety in Shijiazhuang and stressed innovative mechanisms and responsibility chains. Wang Zhengpu attended.

articles.title_zh: 海南首单新能源汽车动力电池保税维修业务落地
articles.title_en: Hainan Launches First Bonded Repair Business for NEV Power Batteries
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，经海口海关所属马村港海关办结通关手续，海南首单新能源汽车动力电池保税维修业务在海口综合保税区正式启动。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, the first bonded repair business for new energy vehicle power batteries in Hainan was officially launched at Haikou Comprehensive Bonded Zone after customs clearance by Macun Port Customs.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江自贸试验区黑河片区推动沿边高水平开放高质量发展
articles.title_en: Heihe Area of Heilongjiang Pilot Free Trade Zone Promotes High-Quality Opening-Up
articles.summary_zh: 2019年挂牌的中国（黑龙江）自贸试验区黑河片区以制度创新为核心推动沿边开放，2026年上半年进出口总值214.54亿元，累计形成280项制度创新案例。
articles.summary_en: Since its establishment in 2019, the Heihe Area of the Heilongjiang Pilot Free Trade Zone has promoted border opening-up through institutional innovation, with total imports and exports reaching 21.454 billion yuan in H1 2026 and 280 institutional innovation cases formed.

articles.title_zh: 徐州等多地推动小农机产品闯入海外大市场
articles.title_en: Xuzhou and Other Regions Boost Small Agricultural Machinery Exports to Global Markets
articles.summary_zh: 近年来，中国工程机械出口增长迅速，徐州、永康、济宁等地通过技术创新、供应链协同和市场服务，推动电动三轮车、小型拖拉机、微型挖掘机等小农机产品海外热销，成为制造业出海的生动缩影。
articles.summary_en: With rapid growth in China's engineering machinery exports, Xuzhou, Yongkang, Jining and other regions are boosting overseas sales of small agricultural machinery such as electric tricycles, mini tractors and micro excavators through innovation, supply chain coordination and market services.

articles.title_zh: 江苏印发通知进一步加强重点用能单位节能降碳管理
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues Notice to Strengthen Energy-Saving and Carbon-Reduction Management for Key Energy-Consuming Units
articles.summary_zh: 近日，江苏省工信厅、省发展改革委联合印发通知，加强重点用能单位节能降碳管理，明确企业主体责任和部门监管体系，8月31日工信厅对通知进行解读。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu's industry and development reform departments jointly issued a notice to strengthen energy-saving and carbon-reduction management for key energy-consuming units, specifying corporate responsibilities and supervision. On Aug 31, the department explained key points.

articles.title_zh: 为算力服务器建“空调房”
articles.title_en: Building 'Air-Conditioned Rooms' for Computing Servers
articles.summary_zh: 江苏句容的镇江鸿鑫公司为算力服务器研发液冷IT方舱，订单爆满，正扩建二期三期，助力绿色数据中心建设。
articles.summary_en: Zhenjiang Hongxin in Jurong, Jiangsu, develops liquid-cooled IT cabins for computing servers. With surging orders, the company is expanding its Phase 2 and 3 plants to support green data centers.

articles.title_zh: 第五批公共数据“跑起来”示范场景清单发布 江苏一项目入选
articles.title_en: Fifth Batch of Public Data Demonstration Scenarios Released, Jiangsu Project Selected
articles.summary_zh: 近日，国家数据局发布第五批公共数据“跑起来”示范场景建设清单，江苏昆山一项目入选。
articles.summary_en: The National Data Administration recently released its fifth batch of public data demonstration scenarios, with a Kunshan project in Jiangsu selected.

articles.title_zh: 江苏出台新规加快推进城市基础设施数智化转型
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues New Regulations to Accelerate Digital and Intelligent Transformation of Urban Infrastructure
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省政府办公厅近日发布《江苏省城市基础设施生命线安全工程建设运行管理办法》，明确智慧监测思路，加快推进城市基础设施数智化转型，新规将于2026年9月21日起施行。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of Jiangsu Provincial Government has issued the Measures for the Construction, Operation and Management of the Safety Project for Urban Infrastructure Lifelines, promoting digital and intelligent transformation, effective from September 21, 2026.

tags.name_en: General Office of Jiangsu Provincial Government

tags_en: General Office of Jiangsu Provincial Government

articles.title_zh: 2026年第二批“中国好人榜”发布 江西7人上榜
articles.title_en: Second Batch of 2026 'Good Samaritans of China' List Published, 7 Jiangxi Residents Honored
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，中央精神文明建设办公室发布2026年第二批“中国好人榜”，全国共150人上榜，其中江西7人。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the Central Office for Cultural and Ethical Progress issued the second batch of the 2026 'Good Samaritans of China' list, with 150 people nationwide, including 7 from Jiangxi.

articles.title_zh: 宜春扎实推动“高效办成一件事”改革
articles.title_en: Yichun Advances Reform of 'Efficiently Handling One Thing'
articles.summary_zh: 宜春市推行“高效办成一件事”改革，上线74项重点事项，压减办理环节、材料、时限70%以上，并推出智慧服务等举措。
articles.summary_en: Yichun promotes the 'efficient handling of one thing' reform, launching 74 key items, reducing processing steps, materials, and time by over 70%, and introducing smart services.

articles.title_zh: 奋力决战120天 推动集中整治夺取更大胜利
articles.title_en: Strive for 120 Days to Win Greater Victory in Centralized Rectification
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，内蒙古自治区召开集中整治工作调度会，自治区党委书记王伟中主持并讲话，强调以超常规举措决战120天，推进群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Inner Mongolia held a video conference on centralized rectification. Party Secretary Wang Weizhong presided and urged extraordinary measures in a 120-day campaign against misconduct and corruption around the people.

articles.title_zh: 包钢主持召开自治区人民政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Bao Gang Chairs Executive Meeting of Inner Mongolia Regional Government
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，内蒙古自治区主席包钢主持召开政府常务会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神，听取稳投资、质量强区、知识产权保护及蒿草治理汇报，审议“十五五”专项规划。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Bao Gang, chairman of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, presided over the regional government executive meeting to follow Xi Jinping's instructions, discuss investment stabilization, quality enhancement, IP protection and Artemisia control, and review 15th Five-Year plans.

articles.title_zh: 厦门航空宁夏分公司揭牌成立
articles.title_en: Xiamen Airlines Inaugurates Ningxia Branch
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，厦门航空宁夏分公司在银川揭牌成立，系闽宁协作30年标志性成果，将填补宁夏属地航企空白。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Xiamen Airlines' Ningxia Branch was inaugurated in Yinchuan, marking a milestone in 30 years of Fujian-Ningxia cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 绿能奔涌 “四地”潮生
articles.title_en: Green Energy Surges, 'Four Bases' Thrive
articles.summary_zh: 今年是习近平总书记考察青海提出“让清洁能源更好造福人民”嘱托10周年。10年来，青海建成国家清洁能源产业高地，清洁能源装机占比达93.3%，以绿电赋能产业“四地”协同发展。
articles.summary_en: This year marks the 10th anniversary of General Secretary Xi Jinping's inspection of Qinghai and his call to 'let clean energy better benefit the people.' Over the past decade, Qinghai has built a national highland for clean energy, with clean energy accounting for 93.3% of installed capacity, and green power empowering the coordinated development of its 'four industrial bases.'

articles.title_zh: 双江口水电站一期机组全部投运
articles.title_en: Shuangjiangkou Hydropower Station's First Phase Units Fully Operational
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，世界第一高坝水电站双江口水电站一期三台机组全部投运，年发电量约77亿千瓦时，提升大渡河流域水资源利用效率。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 31, the first phase of the Shuangjiangkou Hydropower Station, the world's tallest dam, fully operated with three units, providing about 7.7 billion kWh annually.

articles.title_zh: 成都东部新区发布三年行动方案 天府国际机场二期力争2028年开工
articles.title_en: Chengdu Eastern New Area Unveils Three-Year Action Plan; Tianfu International Airport Phase II Aims for 2028 Start
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，成都东部新区举行门户枢纽发展大会，发布三年行动方案，提出天府国际机场二期工程力争2028年开工，并明确航线、吞吐量等目标。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Chengdu Eastern New Area issued a three-year action plan, aiming to start Phase II of Tianfu International Airport by 2028 and setting targets for routes and passenger throughput.

articles.title_zh: 王晓晖主持召开四川省委理论学习中心组专题学习（扩大）会强调 认真总结攀枝花共同富裕试验区建设经验 推动全省共同富裕迈出坚实步伐
articles.title_en: Wang Xiaohui Chairs Sichuan Provincial Party Committee Theoretical Study Group Meeting, Stressing Summarizing Panzhihua Common Prosperity Pilot Zone Experience
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，四川省委书记王晓晖主持召开省委理论学习中心组专题学习会，强调总结攀枝花共同富裕试验区建设经验，推动全省共同富裕迈出坚实步伐。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Wang Xiaohui, Secretary of the Sichuan Provincial Party Committee, chaired a special study meeting of the Party Committee Theoretical Study Group, emphasizing the need to summarize the experience of the Panzhihua Common Prosperity Pilot Zone and make solid progress toward common prosperity across the province.

articles.title_zh: 第三十届鲁台经贸洽谈会在潍坊开幕
articles.title_en: 30th Shandong-Taiwan Economic and Trade Fair Opens in Weifang
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，由山东省政府和国务院台办共同主办的第三十届鲁台经贸洽谈会在山东潍坊开幕，约800位两岸各界人士参加。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the 30th Shandong-Taiwan Economic and Trade Fair, co-hosted by Shandong Provincial Government and the State Council Taiwan Affairs Office, opened in Weifang, with about 800 participants from both sides.

tags.name_en: Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council

tags_en: Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔主持召开省政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Chairs Provincial Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，山东省委副书记、省长周乃翔主持召开省政府常务会议，研究安全稳定、科技创新、财政金融协同促内需等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Zhou Naixiang, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee and Governor of Shandong Province, chaired a provincial government executive meeting to discuss safety, stability, scientific innovation, and fiscal-financial coordination to boost domestic demand.

tags.name_en: Fiscal-Financial Coordination to Boost Domestic Demand
Ecological Protection of the Yellow River Basin

articles.title_zh: 山东省政协工作经验交流会召开
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial CPPCC Work Experience Exchange Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，山东省政协工作经验交流会召开，省政协主席葛慧君出席并讲话，强调坚持党的领导、服务大局，为现代化强省建设贡献智慧力量。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the Shandong Provincial CPPCC held a work experience exchange meeting. Chairperson Ge Huijun attended and delivered a speech, emphasizing Party leadership and serving the overall situation to contribute to the province's modernization.

tags.name_en: Shandong Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

tags_en: Shandong Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

articles.title_zh: 山东将做好五篇文章，推动电商扩能提质
articles.title_en: Shandong to Boost E-commerce with Five-pronged Strategy
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，山东省政府新闻办举行发布会解读《关于推动电子商务扩能提质的若干措施》，提出强主体、抢赛道、优供给、聚人才、强保障五方面16条举措。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the Shandong Provincial Government Information Office held a press conference to interpret the Measures on Promoting E-commerce Expansion and Quality Improvement, proposing 16 measures in five aspects.

articles.title_zh: 2026年中国农民丰收节金秋消费季将于本周五在上海启动
articles.title_en: 2026 China Farmers' Harvest Festival Autumn Consumption Season to Launch in Shanghai This Friday
articles.summary_zh: 2026年中国农民丰收节金秋消费季启动活动将于9月4日至6日在上海举行，由农业农村部等多部委共同发起，通过“1+5+N”架构开展系列活动。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 China Farmers' Harvest Festival Autumn Consumption Season launching event will be held in Shanghai from Sept. 4 to 6, jointly initiated by multiple ministries including the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, featuring a '1+5+N' structure of activities.

articles.title_zh: 山西出台加快中医药产业高质量发展三年行动方案
articles.title_en: Shanxi Issues Three-Year Action Plan to Boost High-Quality Development of TCM Industry
articles.summary_zh: 近日，山西省卫生健康委联合多部门印发《加快中医药产业高质量发展三年行动方案（2026—2028年）》，部署六大专项行动，旨在推动中医药全产业链高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Shanxi Provincial Health Commission and multiple departments issued the Three-Year Action Plan to Boost High-Quality Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine Industry (2026-2028), deploying six major actions to promote high-quality development of the entire TCM industry chain.

articles.title_zh: 追风逐光 山西省新能源装机快速增长
articles.title_en: Shanxi's New Energy Installed Capacity Grows Rapidly
articles.summary_zh: 山西省新能源装机快速增长。截至2026年上半年，风光新能源装机达8061万千瓦；临汾太子湖水上光伏项目累计发电约1.2亿千瓦时。
articles.summary_en: Shanxi's new energy capacity is growing rapidly. By the first half of 2026, wind and solar installed capacity exceeded 80.61 GW, with the Taizi Lake floating PV project in Linfen generating about 120 GWh.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江、艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在自治区市场监管局调研座谈
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang and Erkin Tuniyaz Visit and Hold Talks at Regional Market Supervision Administration
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，自治区党委书记陈小江、主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在自治区市场监督管理局调研座谈，强调提升市场监管能力、保障民生权益和优化营商环境。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Chen Xiaojiang, Party Secretary of the autonomous region, and Erkin Tuniyaz, Chairman of the autonomous region, visited and held talks at the regional market supervision bureau, emphasizing improving regulation, protecting people's rights, and optimizing the business environment.

articles.title_zh: 坚持人民至上生命至上 尽最大努力全力推进搜救工作
articles.title_en: Adhering to People First and Life First, Making All-Out Efforts to Advance Search and Rescue
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，西藏自治区主席嘎玛泽登在吉隆泥石流灾害应急救援指挥部调度抢险救援工作，强调人民至上生命至上，要求全力推进搜救。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, Gama Zedeng, chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region, directed rescue operations at the Jilong landslide emergency command headquarters, stressing people-first and life-first principles and urging full efforts in search and rescue.

articles.title_zh: 王予波主持召开云南省政府党组会议常务会议
articles.title_en: Wang Yubo Chairs Yunnan Provincial Government Party Group Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，云南省省长王予波主持召开省政府党组会议和常务会议，传达学习中央精神，部署防汛减灾、党建、民族团结等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Yunnan Governor Wang Yubo chaired the provincial government party group meeting and executive meeting to convey central policies and arrange flood control, party building, and ethnic unity work.

articles.title_zh: 2026首都民营经济创新发展大会举办
articles.title_en: 2026 Beijing Private Economy Innovation and Development Conference Held
articles.summary_zh: 日前，北京市工商联举办2026首都民营经济创新发展大会，全国工商联副主席李冰、市委常委马骏致辞，市政协副主席燕瑛出席。
articles.summary_en: The Beijing Federation of Industry and Commerce recently held the 2026 Beijing Private Economy Innovation and Development Conference, with Vice Chairman Li Bing of the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce and Beijing Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Member Ma Jun delivering speeches.

articles.title_zh: 北京市人大常委会关于向社会公开征集2027年立法计划项目建议的公告
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Announces Public Solicitation of Legislative Proposals for 2027
articles.summary_zh: 北京市人大常委会发布公告，公开征集2027年立法计划项目建议，截止时间为2026年10月8日。
articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of the Beijing Municipal People's Congress issued a notice to publicly solicit legislative proposals for the 2027 legislative plan, with a deadline of October 8, 2026.

tags.name_en: Beijing Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee

tags_en: Beijing Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee

articles.title_zh: 推动上海合作组织实现更高质量发展——在上海合作组织成员国元首理事会第二十六次会议上的讲话
articles.title_en: Promote Higher-Quality Development of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization - Speech at the 26th Meeting of the Council of Heads of State of the SCO
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，习近平在比什凯克出席上海合作组织成员国元首理事会第二十六次会议并发表讲话，提出坚持发展优先、安全为要、以人为本、对话协商等主张。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Xi Jinping attended the 26th Meeting of the SCO Council of Heads of State in Bishkek and delivered a speech, advocating priorities on development, security, people-centered approach, and dialogue.

articles.title_zh: 我国光伏发电装机历史性超过煤电
articles.title_en: China's Solar PV Installed Capacity Surpasses Coal Power for First Time
articles.summary_zh: 国家能源局9月1日宣布，我国光伏发电装机历史性超过煤电，成为装机规模最大的电源品类。截至7月底光伏装机12.86亿千瓦，煤电12.85亿千瓦。
articles.summary_en: China's National Energy Administration announced on Sept 1 that installed solar PV capacity has historically surpassed coal power, becoming the largest power source in the country. By end of July, PV capacity reached 1.286 billion kW, coal power 1.285 billion kW.

articles.title_zh: 教育部提醒：新生入学季，这四类诈骗要警惕
articles.title_en: Ministry of Education Warns of Four Types of Fraud During Freshman Enrollment Season
articles.summary_zh: 教育部针对新生入学季发布防范提醒，揭露谎称“内部指标”、“补录名额”等四种诈骗手法，提醒考生和家长通过官方渠道核实信息。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Education issued fraud prevention tips for the freshman enrollment season, exposing four scams including false 'internal quotas' and 'supplementary admission slots', urging students and parents to verify info via official channels.

articles.title_zh: 中国电气装备集团西南有限公司揭牌
articles.title_en: China Electrical Equipment Group Southwest Co., Ltd. Inaugurated
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日下午，中国电气装备集团西南有限公司在重庆揭牌，市委书记袁家军、市长陈新武会见集团董事长李洪凤一行并共同揭牌。
articles.summary_en: On August 31 afternoon, China Electrical Equipment Group Southwest Co., Ltd. was inaugurated in Chongqing. Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun and Mayor Chen Xinwu met with Chairman Li Hongfeng and jointly unveiled the plaque.

articles.title_zh: 徐麟出席遵义市领导干部会议并讲话
articles.title_en: Xu Lin Attends Zunyi Cadres Meeting and Delivers Speech
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，遵义市召开领导干部会议，宣布省委关于郭强同志任遵义市委书记的决定，省委书记徐麟出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Zunyi held a cadres meeting to announce the provincial party committee's decision appointing Guo Qiang as Zunyi's party secretary, with Provincial Party Secretary Xu Lin attending and delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 徐麟会见农民日报社党委书记、社长宁启文一行
articles.title_en: Xu Lin Meets Party Secretary and President of Farmers' Daily Ning Qiwen
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，贵州省委书记徐麟在贵阳会见农民日报社社长宁启文，双方就宣传贵州“三农”事业和乡村振兴进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Xu Lin, Secretary of the Guizhou Provincial Party Committee, met with Ning Qiwen, President of Farmers' Daily, in Guiyang to discuss promoting Guizhou's agricultural and rural development.

articles.title_zh: 李炳军：不断巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果
articles.title_en: Li Bingjun: Continuously Consolidate and Expand Achievements of Education on Correct View of Political Performance
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，贵州省省长李炳军主持召开省政府党组理论学习中心组集中研讨会，强调深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于基层工作方法的重要论述，不断巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Guizhou Governor Li Bingjun chaired a study meeting of the provincial government party group, stressing in-depth study of Xi Jinping's important statements on grassroots work methods and consolidating education on a correct view of political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 王凯主持召开省政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Wang Kai Chairs Henan Provincial Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，河南省省长王凯主持召开省政府常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究生态环境保护、财政科学管理等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Governor Wang Kai of Henan chaired a standing committee meeting of the provincial government to convey and study important instructions of General Secretary Xi Jinping and discuss ecological environment protection and fiscal management.

articles.title_zh: 王凯主持召开省政府党组扩大会议
articles.title_en: Wang Kai Chairs Enlarged Meeting of Provincial Government Party Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，河南省省长王凯主持召开省政府党组扩大会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神，总结树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果，研究建立长效机制。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Governor Wang Kai chaired an enlarged meeting of the Provincial Government Party Group to study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions, summarize the learning education achievements on correct performance views, and research establishing a long-term mechanism.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁在调研经济运行工作时强调锚定目标任务 强化运行调度 坚决打好打赢经济发展夏秋季战役
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Stresses Winning Summer-Autumn Economic Campaign during Research Visit
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，河南省委书记刘宁到省交通运输厅、国网河南省电力公司、省政府国资委调研经济运行工作，强调打好打赢经济发展夏秋季战役。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 31, Liu Ning, secretary of the Henan Provincial Party Committee, visited provincial transport department, State Grid Henan Electric Power Company and SASAC to review economic operations, urging efforts to win the summer-autumn economic campaign.

articles.title_zh: 9月1日起 一批国家标准开始实施
articles.title_en: National Standards Take Effect Starting September 1
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日起，59项强制性国家标准和375项推荐性国家标准开始实施，覆盖家电、机器人智能控制、智能终端等领域，为产业高质量发展提供标准支撑。
articles.summary_en: Starting September 1, 59 mandatory and 375 recommended national standards take effect, covering home appliances, robot intelligent control, smart terminals, and more, providing standard support for high-quality industrial development.

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明主持召开省政府第98次常务会议
articles.title_en: Mao Weiming Chairs 98th Executive Meeting of Hunan Provincial Government
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日下午，省长毛伟明主持召开湖南省政府第98次常务会议，研究部署防灾减灾、经济重点工作、水利现代化建设等。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Governor Mao Weiming chaired the 98th executive meeting of the Hunan Provincial Government, deliberating on disaster prevention, economic priorities, and water conservancy modernization.

articles.title_zh: 2026集成电路（无锡）创新发展大会开幕 刘小涛出席
articles.title_en: 2026 Integrated Circuit (Wuxi) Innovation and Development Conference Opens; Liu Xiaotao Attends
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，以“芯生万象 链动无界”为主题的2026集成电路（无锡）创新发展大会开幕，省长刘小涛出席并为江苏省集成电路产业联盟揭牌。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the 2026 Integrated Circuit (Wuxi) Innovation and Development Conference opened under the theme "Chip Born Vientiane, Chain Moves Boundless." Governor Liu Xiaotao attended and inaugurated the Jiangsu Integrated Circuit Industry Alliance.

articles.title_zh: 时政镜距离丨描绘中埃相知新画卷
articles.title_en: A New Picture of China-Egypt Mutual Understanding
articles.summary_zh: 本文讲述埃及艺术家纳瓦尔通过画作展现中国发展变迁，习近平主席回信鼓舞其创作，体现中埃人文交流深化。
articles.summary_en: This article tells how Egyptian artist Ahmed Nawar captures China through paintings. President Xi Jinping's reply encouraged him, reflecting deepening people-to-people exchanges between China and Egypt.

articles.title_zh: 永久的友好近邻 真诚的合作伙伴
articles.title_en: A Permanent Good Neighbor and Sincere Partner
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月31日，习近平主席在比什凯克同吉尔吉斯斯坦总统扎帕罗夫会谈，双方签署联合宣言与永久睦邻友好合作条约。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, President Xi Jinping held talks with Kyrgyz President Japarov in Bishkek, signing a joint declaration and a treaty on permanent good-neighborly friendship and cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 30年京九铁路启新程
articles.title_en: Beijing-Kowloon Railway Embarks on New Journey at 30th Anniversary
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月1日，京九铁路迎来全线开通运营30周年。30年来，该铁路累计发送旅客17.7亿人次、货物10.53亿吨。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, 2026, the Beijing-Kowloon Railway marked its 30th anniversary of full operation. Over three decades, it has carried 1.77 billion passenger trips and 1.053 billion tons of freight.

articles.title_zh: 一树扎根沙地 “赛考斯”的惜别与守望
articles.title_en: A Tree Takes Root in Sand: Farewell and Vigil of 'Saskas'
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，美国教师“赛考斯”（罗纳德·萨科尔斯基）结束访华，在北京与治沙劳模殷玉珍道别。他此行重访内蒙古等地，续写26年因治沙结下的跨国友谊。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 1, U.S. teacher Ronald Sakolsky ("Saskas") parted tearfully with Yin Yuzhen in Beijing after visiting Inner Mongolia and Henan, rekindling a 26-year friendship built on desert greening.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央宣传部等印发《关于组织开展2026年“全民国防教育月”活动的通知》
articles.title_en: CPC Central Publicity Department and Others Issue Notice on 2026 National Defense Education Month Activities
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中共中央宣传部等12部门联合印发通知，部署在9月集中开展“全民国防教育月”活动，围绕“弘扬伟大长征精神 同心共筑强大国防”主题开展群众性国防教育。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the CPC Central Publicity Department and 11 other departments issued a notice to hold National Defense Education Month in September, promoting patriotic education and national defense awareness.

tags_en: Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 三项婴童用品国家标准实施 助力儿童健康成长
articles.title_en: Three National Standards for Infant and Child Products Take Effect
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日起，三项婴童用品国家标准正式实施，覆盖如厕器具、感统训练产品、游泳配套用品，旨在规范市场、守护儿童安全。
articles.summary_en: As of Sept 1, three national standards for infant and toddler products took effect, covering toilet aids, sensory training products and swimming accessories to regulate market and protect children's safety.

articles.title_zh: 电影暑期档收官 票房超124亿元
articles.title_en: Summer Film Season Ends with Box Office Exceeding 12.4 Billion Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 国家电影局9月1日发布数据，2026年暑期档电影票房达124.98亿元，观影人次3.4亿，同比分别增长4.45%和5.86%。
articles.summary_en: China Film Administration data released Sept. 1 shows summer box office revenue reached 12.498 billion yuan with 340 million admissions, up 4.45% and 5.86% year-on-year.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在自治区市场监管局调研座谈
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang and Erkin Tuniyaz Hold Talks at Regional Market Regulation Bureau
articles.summary_zh: 自治区党委书记陈小江、自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜8月31日在自治区市场监管局调研座谈，强调全面提升市场综合监管能力水平。
articles.summary_en: Party Secretary Chen Xiaojiang and Regional Chairman Erkin Tuniyaz visited and held talks at the regional Market Regulation Bureau on Aug 31, emphasizing comprehensive market supervision.

articles.title_zh: 2026年亚太经合组织第三次高官会结束，外交部介绍有关情况
articles.title_en: 2026 APEC Third Senior Officials' Meeting Concludes, Foreign Ministry Briefs on Outcomes
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆介绍，2026年APEC第三次高官会于8月17日至28日在大连举行，近130场会议活动，聚焦开放、创新、合作。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Guo Jiakun said the 2026 APEC Third Senior Officials' Meeting was held in Dalian from August 17 to 28, with nearly 130 events focused on openness, innovation, and cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 有外媒对泥石流灾害成因发表不当言论，外交部：在大灾大难面前，坚决反对没有事实依据的恶意揣测
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Rejects Baseless Speculation on Landslide Cause
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆主持例行记者会，回应外媒对中尼边境泥石流灾害成因的不当言论，坚决反对没有事实依据的恶意揣测，并通报中方救援进展。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Guo Jiakun held a regular press conference, responding to inappropriate remarks by foreign media on the cause of the Sino-Nepal border landslide, firmly opposing baseless speculation, and updating on China's rescue efforts.

articles.title_zh: 商务部等7部门：到2030年，社会消费品零售总额达60万亿元左右
articles.title_en: MOFCOM and Six Other Departments: Total Retail Sales of Consumer Goods to Reach About 60 Trillion Yuan by 2030
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，商务部等7部门发布推动商品消费扩容升级实施意见，提出到2030年社会消费品零售总额达60万亿元左右。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the Ministry of Commerce and six other departments issued implementation opinions to expand and upgrade commodity consumption, aiming for total retail sales of consumer goods to reach about 60 trillion yuan by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：中美应维护好当前经贸领域来之不易的良好势头
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China and US Should Maintain Hard-Won Good Momentum in Trade
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上回应美国财长言论，表示中美经贸关系互利共赢，反对单边关税，应维护当前良好势头。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said at a regular press conference that China-US trade ties are mutually beneficial, opposes unilateral tariffs, and both sides should maintain the hard-won good momentum.

articles.title_zh: 商务部解读《关于推动商品消费扩容升级的实施意见》
articles.title_en: Ministry of Commerce Explains Implementation Opinions on Promoting Expansion and Upgrading of Commodity Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 近日，商务部会同多部门印发《关于推动商品消费扩容升级的实施意见》，明确到2030年社零总额达60万亿元等目标，并部署促进商品消费的重点任务。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Ministry of Commerce, together with several departments, issued implementation opinions on expanding and upgrading commodity consumption, setting a target of 60 trillion yuan in total retail sales by 2030 and outlining key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 受贿1864万余元，四川达州市政协原副主席王洪波一审获刑11年
articles.title_en: Former Dazhou CPPCC Vice Chairman Wang Hongbo Sentenced to 11 Years for Bribery
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月31日，四川乐山中院一审公开宣判达州市政协原副主席王洪波受贿案，判处有期徒刑十一年，并处罚金180万元，追缴全部受贿所得。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, 2026, the Leshan Intermediate People's Court in Sichuan sentenced Wang Hongbo, former vice chairman of Dazhou CPPCC, to 11 years in prison for bribery and a fine of 1.8 million yuan, with all illicit gains confiscated.

articles.title_zh: 合声致远 共启新程！2026上海合作组织国家人文交流活动在比什凯克举行
articles.title_en: 2026 SCO People-to-People Cultural Exchange Event Held in Bishkek
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月30日，2026上海合作组织国家人文交流活动在比什凯克举行，由中央广播电视总台与吉尔吉斯斯坦国家电视广播公司联合主办，发布系列媒体合作成果。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, the 2026 SCO People-to-People Cultural Exchange Event was held in Bishkek, co-hosted by China Media Group and Kyrgyzstan's state broadcaster, releasing a series of media cooperation outcomes.

articles.title_zh: 赛考斯：取自毛乌素沙地的沙子无法带回美国，现在有了新的计划
articles.title_en: Saikaosi: Sand from Mu Us Desert Cannot Be Taken to US, Now Has New Plan
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，美国友人赛考斯在中国外交部蓝厅观摩记者会后表示，因海关规定无法将毛乌素沙地的沙子带回美国，呼吁人们亲手种树善待地球。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, American friend Saikaosi said after observing a press conference at China's Foreign Ministry that customs rules prevented him from taking sand from the Mu Us Desert to the US, and he called on people to plant trees and cherish the Earth.

articles.title_zh: 外交部驳斥外媒关于吉隆泥石流灾害成因的不当言论
articles.title_en: Chinese FM Refutes Foreign Media's Inappropriate Remarks on Gyirong Mudslide Cause
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上驳斥外媒关于中尼边境吉隆-热索瓦口岸泥石流成因的不当言论，称灾害由尼泊尔境内高位冰川崩塌引发。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 31, FM spokesperson Guo Jiakun refuted foreign media's groundless speculation about the cause of the mudslide at the Gyirong-Rasuwa border port, attributing it to glacier collapse in Nepal.

articles.title_zh: 民进中央原副主席、陕西省政协原副主席刘宽忍一审被判15年
articles.title_en: Liu Kuanren, Former Vice Chairman of CPPCC Central Committee and Shaanxi Provincial CPPCC, Sentenced to 15 Years in First Instance
articles.summary_zh: 刘宽忍利用职务便利受贿4146万余元，贪污739万余元，数罪并罚一审获刑15年。
articles.summary_en: Liu Kuanren was sentenced to 15 years in prison for bribery and embezzlement totaling over 48.85 million yuan, as ruled by Urumqi Intermediate People's Court.

tags_zh: 乌鲁木齐市中级人民法院

articles.title_zh: 海南非遗主题展亮相台湾高雄
articles.title_en: Hainan Intangible Cultural Heritage Exhibition Opens in Kaohsiung
articles.summary_zh: 8月29日，“守望精神家园——第十二届两岸非物质文化遗产月”系列活动在高雄佛光山佛陀纪念馆开幕，以海南为主题，展示黎族传统纺染织绣技艺等艺术创作。
articles.summary_en: The 12th Cross-Strait Intangible Cultural Heritage Month opened on Aug 29 at Fo Guang Shan Buddha Memorial Center in Kaohsiung, featuring Hainan's Li ethnic textile dyeing, weaving and embroidery techniques and other artworks.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将出席上合峰会并访问吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Attend SCO Summit and Visit Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平将于8月30日至9月3日出席在比什凯克举行的上海合作组织峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦和埃及进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping will attend the SCO Summit in Bishkek and pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt from August 30 to September 3.

articles.title_zh: 颠覆性创新攻克国际难题 同步加速器发明成果获中国专利金奖
articles.title_en: Disruptive Innovation Wins China Patent Gold Award for Synchrotron Accelerator
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，中国科学院近代物理研究所的发明专利“连续波慢引出同步加速器”荣获中国专利金奖，该技术攻克国际难题，应用于国家大科学工程及航天、医疗等领域。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the Institute of Modern Physics of the Chinese Academy of Sciences won the China Patent Gold Award for its invention 'Continuous Wave Slow Extraction Synchrotron', which overcomes international challenges and is applied in major scientific projects, aerospace, and medical fields.

articles.title_zh: 航行警告！南海部分海域进行实弹射击训练 禁止驶入
articles.title_en: Navigation Warning: Live-Fire Drill in Parts of South China Sea, Entry Prohibited
articles.summary_zh: 茂名海事局发布航行警告，8月31日至9月5日每日13时至18时，南海部分海域进行实弹射击训练，禁止驶入。
articles.summary_en: Maoming Maritime Safety Administration issued a navigation warning that live-fire exercises will be held in parts of the South China Sea from Aug 31 to Sep 5, 13:00-18:00 daily, and entry is prohibited.

articles.title_zh: APEC“中国年”最后一次高官会将于11月APEC领导人会议前夕在深圳举行
articles.title_en: APEC 'China Year' Final SOM to Be Held in Shenzhen Ahead of Leaders' Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 外交部发言人郭嘉昆8月31日表示，2026年APEC第三次高官会8月17日至28日在大连举行，最后一次高官会将于11月在深圳召开。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Guo Jiakun said at a press conference that the third APEC Senior Officials' Meeting was held in Dalian from August 17 to 28, and the final SOM will take place in Shenzhen in November.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：中方正全力搜救西藏吉隆泥石流灾害国内外失联人员
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China Making All-Out Efforts to Search for Missing in Gyirong Landslide Disaster
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆表示，中方正全力搜救西藏吉隆泥石流灾害国内外失联人员，并第一时间向尼方提供援助。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 31, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said China is making all-out efforts to search for missing people in the Gyirong landslide disaster, and has provided timely assistance to Nepal.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在比什凯克出席吉尔吉斯斯坦总统举行的欢迎仪式
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends Welcome Ceremony Hosted by Kyrgyz President in Bishkek
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月31日上午，国家主席习近平在比什凯克和谐宫出席吉尔吉斯斯坦总统扎帕罗夫举行的欢迎仪式。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 31 local time, President Xi Jinping attended a welcome ceremony hosted by Kyrgyz President Japarov at the Harmony Palace in Bishkek.

articles.title_zh: 东部战区海军连续19年开展“东海强军文化先锋艇”综合服务活动
articles.title_en: Eastern Theater Command Navy Holds 19th 'East China Sea Cultural Pioneer Boat' Service Activity
articles.summary_zh: 东部战区海军近日开展第19届“东海强军文化先锋艇”综合服务活动，为一线官兵送去理论宣讲、文艺演出、医疗和法律服务。
articles.summary_en: The Eastern Theater Command Navy recently held its 19th 'East China Sea Pioneer Boat' comprehensive service activity, delivering theoretical lectures, performances, medical care, and legal advice to frontline troops.

articles.title_zh: 上海推动建立长三角地区海外服务站和人才资源共享共建机制
articles.title_en: Shanghai Promotes Overseas Service Stations and Talents Resource Sharing Mechanism in Yangtze River Delta
articles.summary_zh: 上海市知识产权局31日披露，今年以来推动建立长三角地区海外服务站和人才资源共享共建机制，并公布相关名单。下半年将制定知识产权国际竞争力提升三年计划。
articles.summary_en: Shanghai Intellectual Property Administration disclosed on Aug 31 that it has promoted the establishment of overseas service stations and a talents resource sharing mechanism in the Yangtze River Delta, and released relevant lists. It will formulate a three-year plan to boost IP international competitiveness.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席引领推动构建更加公正合理的全球治理体系
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Leads Efforts to Build a More Just and Equitable Global Governance System
articles.summary_zh: 习近平主席提出全球治理倡议一周年，国际社会广泛支持。中国发布白皮书并推动成立世界人工智能合作组织等，以实际行动完善全球治理。
articles.summary_en: One year after President Xi Jinping proposed the Global Governance Initiative, it has gained broad international support. China has issued a white paper and promoted the establishment of the World AI Cooperation Organization to improve global governance.

tags.name_en: Community with a Shared Future for Mankind

tags_en: Community with a Shared Future for Mankind

articles.title_zh: 长三角持续深化协同创新
articles.title_en: Yangtze River Delta Continues to Deepen Collaborative Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 长三角地区通过“一盘棋”统筹、“一股绳”发力、“一条链”贯通、“一张网”联动，持续深化跨区域协同创新，高新技术企业数量占全国超30%，2025年技术交易额增长14.7%。
articles.summary_en: The Yangtze River Delta deepens cross-regional collaborative innovation through coordinated planning, integrated efforts, industrial chains, and innovation networks, with high-tech enterprises accounting for over 30% of the national total and tech transaction value up 14.7% in 2025.

articles.title_zh: 坚持落实管党治党政治责任
articles.title_en: Uphold Political Responsibility for Party Governance
articles.summary_zh: 本文节录习近平总书记2013年至2026年关于坚持落实管党治党政治责任的重要论述，强调全面从严治党主体责任和监督责任。
articles.summary_en: This article excerpts Xi Jinping's important remarks from 2013 to 2026 on upholding political responsibility for party governance, emphasizing the main and oversight responsibilities in full and strict party governance.

articles.title_zh: 为推动构建上海合作组织命运共同体注入新动力
articles.title_en: Injecting New Momentum into Building an SCO Community with a Shared Future
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平即将出席在吉尔吉斯斯坦比什凯克举行的2026年上海合作组织峰会，就深化合作和全球治理等议题与各国领导人交换意见。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping will attend the 2026 SCO Summit in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, to exchange views on deepening cooperation and global governance.

articles.title_zh: 为中埃关系深入发展擘画新蓝图——埃及各界期待习近平主席对埃进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Egyptian Sectors Expect Xi Jinping's State Visit to Chart New Blueprint for China-Egypt Relations
articles.summary_zh: 应埃及总统塞西邀请，习近平主席将对埃及进行国事访问。埃及各界期待此访深化两国全面战略伙伴关系，推动构建面向新时代的命运共同体。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi, President Xi Jinping will make a state visit to Egypt. Egyptians from all sectors expect the visit to deepen the comprehensive strategic partnership and promote a community with a shared future in the new era.

articles.title_zh: 《平“语”近人——习近平喜欢的典故》（多语种版）在上合组织国家媒体播出
articles.title_en: Multilingual Version of "Xi Jinping's Favorite Quotations" Airs on SCO Media
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，《平“语”近人》多语种版启播活动在吉尔吉斯斯坦首都比什凯克举行，节目即日起在上合组织国家媒体播出。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, the launch of the multilingual version of "Ping Yu Jin Ren" was held in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, with broadcasts starting on SCO national media.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席署名文章深深打动吉尔吉斯斯坦民众
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Signed Article Deeply Moves Kyrgyzstan People
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，习近平主席在赴吉国事访问前夕于吉尔吉斯斯坦媒体发表署名文章，阐述中吉友好关系。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, ahead of a state visit to Kyrgyzstan, President Xi Jinping published a signed article in Kyrgyz media elaborating on China-Kyrgyzstan friendly ties.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席赴比什凯克出席2026年上海合作组织峰会
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Attends 2026 SCO Summit in Bishkek
articles.summary_zh: 习近平主席赴比什凯克出席2026年上海合作组织峰会，传承上海精神，推动构建上合组织命运共同体。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping attends the 2026 SCO Summit in Bishkek, promoting the Shanghai Spirit and building an SCO community with a shared future.

articles.title_zh: 广大党员、干部深学细悟《习近平党建文选》第一卷、第二卷
articles.title_en: Party Members and Officials Deeply Study Xi Jinping's Selected Works on Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央党史和文献研究院编辑的《习近平党建文选》第一卷、第二卷出版发行，全国党员、干部深学细悟，将学习成效转化为奋进新征程的实际行动。
articles.summary_en: The first and second volumes of Xi Jinping's Selected Works on Party Building, edited by the CPC Central Committee's Institute of Party History and Literature, were published. Party members and officials across the country are studying them intensively to translate learning into action on the new journey.

articles.title_zh: '十五五'，如何培养更多大国工匠（解码'十五五'专项规划）
articles.title_en: How to Cultivate More Master Craftsmen in the 15th Five-Year Plan (Decoding the 15th Five-Year Plan)
articles.summary_zh: 国务院印发'十五五'就业规划，提出到2030年技能人才占就业人员比例达35%，各地开展职业技能培训、推行'新八级工'制度，着力培养大国工匠。
articles.summary_en: The State Council issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for employment, aiming to increase the share of skilled workers to 35% by 2030, with local governments promoting vocational training and the new eight-grade skilled worker system.

articles.title_zh: 《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《坚持落实管党治党政治责任》
articles.title_en: Qiushi Journal to Publish Xi Jinping's Important Article on Party Governance Responsibility
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日出版的第17期《求是》杂志将发表习近平总书记重要文章《坚持落实管党治党政治责任》，强调落实管党治党政治责任、全面从严治党。
articles.summary_en: The 17th issue of Qiushi Journal, published on September 1, will carry Xi Jinping's important article on upholding political responsibility for party governance and strict party discipline.

articles.title_zh: 习近平抵达比什凯克
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives in Bishkek for SCO Summit and State Visit
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月30日下午，国家主席习近平乘专机抵达比什凯克，出席2026年上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 30 local time, President Xi Jinping arrived in Bishkek by special plane to attend the 2026 SCO Summit and pay a state visit to Kyrgyzstan.

articles.title_zh: 重庆自贸试验区推动“物理联通”迈向“规则衔接”
articles.title_en: Chongqing Pilot Free Trade Zone Advances from Physical Connectivity to Rule Alignment
articles.summary_zh: 重庆自贸试验区创新多式联运“一单制”，实现陆海联运无缝衔接，数字提单上链超2.1万单，并推动陆运单证金融化，显著提升贸易便利化。
articles.summary_en: Chongqing Pilot Free Trade Zone innovates multimodal transport 'one-document' system, enabling seamless sea-rail联运, with over 21,000 digital bills on blockchain and logistics financing, boosting trade facilitation.

articles.title_zh: 特写：“您是我们的家人”
articles.title_en: Feature: You Are Our Family
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日下午，国家主席习近平乘专机抵达吉尔吉斯斯坦首都比什凯克，出席2026年上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问，吉尔吉斯斯坦总统扎帕罗夫夫妇在机场迎候。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 30, Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, to attend the 2026 SCO Summit and pay a state visit. Kyrgyz President Japarov and his wife welcomed him at the airport.

articles.title_zh: 规上工业企业利润同比增长17.6%
articles.title_en: Profits of Industrial Enterprises Above Designated Size Rise 17.6%
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局数据显示，今年前7月规模以上工业企业利润同比增长17.6%，其中高技术制造业利润增长50.1%，电子行业利润增长1.1倍。
articles.summary_en: According to the National Bureau of Statistics, profits of industrial enterprises above designated size grew 17.6% year on year in the first seven months, with high-tech manufacturing up 50.1% and electronics up 110%.

articles.title_zh: 全国社会物流总额同比增长5.0%
articles.title_en: China's Total Social Logistics Volume Grows 5.0% Year on Year
articles.summary_zh: 中国物流与采购联合会发布数据显示，今年前7月全国社会物流总额214.5万亿元，同比增长5.0%，需求结构有所优化。
articles.summary_en: Data from the China Federation of Logistics & Purchasing shows the total social logistics volume reached 214.5 trillion yuan in the first seven months, up 5.0% year on year, with improved demand structure.

articles.title_zh: 2026年国家社科基金年度项目评审工作会议在京召开
articles.title_en: 2026 National Social Science Fund Annual Project Review Work Conference Held in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，2026年国家社科基金年度项目评审工作会议在北京召开，中共中央政治局委员、中宣部部长李书磊出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, the 2026 National Social Science Fund annual project review work conference was held in Beijing. Li Shulei, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and head of the Publicity Department, attended and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同吉尔吉斯斯坦总统扎帕罗夫会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Kyrgyz President Japarov
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月31日，国家主席习近平在比什凯克同吉尔吉斯斯坦总统扎帕罗夫举行会谈，双方签署联合宣言和永久睦邻友好合作条约。
articles.summary_en: On August 31 local time, President Xi Jinping held talks with Kyrgyz President Japarov in Bishkek, signing a joint declaration and a treaty on permanent good-neighborliness and friendly cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 一村一策，酸化耕地治理有良方
articles.title_en: Village-Specific Strategies Prove Effective in Treating Acidified Farmland
articles.summary_zh: 广西钦南区通过土壤调理剂和科学分类治理，酸化耕地亩产从两三百斤提升至超800斤，2025年粮食产能同比提高3.52%。
articles.summary_en: By applying soil conditioners and tailored treatments, Qinnan District in Qinzhou, Guangxi raised rice yields on acidified farmland from 200-300 jin to over 800 jin per mu, boosting grain production capacity by 3.52% in 2025.

articles.title_zh: 习近平抵达比什凯克出席2026年上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives in Bishkek for 2026 SCO Summit and State Visit to Kyrgyzstan
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月30日下午，国家主席习近平乘专机抵达比什凯克，出席2026年上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 30 local time, President Xi Jinping arrived in Bishkek to attend the 2026 SCO Summit and pay a state visit to Kyrgyzstan.

articles.title_zh: 坚持睦邻友好 携手共享繁荣
articles.title_en: Uphold Good-Neighborly Friendship and Share Prosperity Together
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平应吉尔吉斯斯坦总统扎帕罗夫邀请，即将对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问，这将是习近平第三次访吉。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping, at the invitation of Kyrgyz President Japarov, will soon pay a state visit to Kyrgyzstan, his third visit to the country.

articles.title_zh: 《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《坚持落实管党治党政治责任》
articles.title_en: Qiushi Journal to Publish Important Article by Xi Jinping on Upholding Political Responsibility for Party Governance
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，新华社报道《求是》杂志将于9月1日发表习近平总书记重要文章，强调党要管党、从严治党，落实管党治党政治责任。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Xinhua reported that Qiushi Journal will publish an important article by Xi Jinping on September 1, stressing the need to govern the Party with strict discipline and fulfill political responsibility for Party governance.

articles.title_zh: 胡玉亭专题研究氢能试点城市群建设方案
articles.title_en: Hu Yuting Chairs Special Meeting on Hydrogen Energy Pilot City Cluster
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，吉林省委副书记、省长胡玉亭主持召开氢能试点城市群建设专题会议，研究建设方案并部署下一步工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Hu Yuting, Deputy Secretary of the Jilin Provincial Party Committee and Governor, chaired a special meeting on the hydrogen energy pilot city cluster, studying the construction plan and arranging next steps.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠在市委党的建设工作领导小组（扩大）会议上强调 巩固拓展政绩观学习教育成果
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui Chairs Meeting of Changchun Party Building Leadership Group, Emphasizes Consolidating Educational Achievements on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 8月29日，长春市委书记张恩惠主持召开市委党的建设工作领导小组（扩大）会议，强调巩固拓展学习教育成果，让改革发展成果惠及于民。
articles.summary_en: On August 29, Zhang Enhui, secretary of the Changchun Municipal Party Committee, chaired a meeting of the Party Building Leadership Group, emphasizing consolidation of learning achievements and benefiting the people through reform and development.

articles.title_zh: 九三学社赤峰市第八次代表大会召开
articles.title_en: 8th Congress of Jiusan Society Chifeng Municipal Committee Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月29日，九三学社赤峰市第八次代表大会召开，选举产生第八届委员会，孙德欣当选主任委员。
articles.summary_en: On August 29, the 8th Congress of the Jiusan Society Chifeng Municipal Committee was held, electing a new committee with Sun Dexin as chairman.

articles.title_zh: 中国民主促进会赤峰市第五次代表大会召开
articles.title_en: The 5th Congress of China Association for Promoting Democracy Chifeng Committee Convened
articles.summary_zh: 8月29日，中国民主促进会赤峰市第五次代表大会召开，选举产生第五届委员会，黄双燕当选主任委员。
articles.summary_en: On August 29, the 5th Congress of China Association for Promoting Democracy Chifeng Committee was held, electing the 5th committee with Huang Shuangyan as chairman.

articles.title_zh: 彭丽媛同吉尔吉斯斯坦总统夫人扎帕罗娃参观吉尔吉斯共和国国家历史博物馆
articles.title_en: Peng Liyuan Visits Kyrgyz National History Museum with Kyrgyzstan's First Lady
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月31日上午，国家主席习近平夫人彭丽媛在比什凯克同吉尔吉斯斯坦总统扎帕罗夫夫人扎帕罗娃参观吉尔吉斯共和国国家历史博物馆，并共同参观文化展。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 31 local time, Peng Liyuan, wife of Chinese President Xi Jinping, visited the Kyrgyz National Historical Museum in Bishkek with Aigul Japarova, wife of Kyrgyz President Japarov, and toured cultural exhibitions together.

articles.title_zh: 前7月全国社会物流总额同比增长5.0%
articles.title_en: China's Total Social Logistics Volume Up 5.0% in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 中国物流与采购联合会数据显示，今年前7月全国社会物流总额214.5万亿元，同比增长5.0%，工业品物流和进口物流保持稳定增长。
articles.summary_en: According to the China Federation of Logistics & Purchasing, China's total social logistics volume reached 214.5 trillion yuan in the first seven months, up 5.0% year on year, with steady growth in industrial and import logistics.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将对埃及进行国事访问 埃及各界期待深化中埃关系
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Pay State Visit to Egypt, Egyptian Circles Expect Deeper China-Egypt Ties
articles.summary_zh: 应埃及总统塞西邀请，国家主席习近平将对埃及进行国事访问。埃及各界人士表示期待此访续写两国友谊，深化全面战略伙伴关系。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of Egyptian President Sisi, President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to Egypt. Egyptian elites expect the visit to renew friendship and deepen the comprehensive strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同吉尔吉斯斯坦总统小范围晤谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Small-Scale Talks with Kyrgyz President
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月30日晚，习近平夫妇与吉总统夫妇共进晚餐；31日，彭丽媛与吉总统夫人参观国家历史博物馆。
articles.summary_en: On the night of Aug 30 local time, Xi Jinping and his wife had dinner with the Kyrgyz president and his wife; on Aug 31, Peng Liyuan visited the National Historical Museum with the first lady.

articles.title_zh: 8月份我国制造业PMI上升0.6个百分点
articles.title_en: China's Manufacturing PMI Rises 0.6 Percentage Points in August
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局8月31日发布数据显示，8月份我国制造业PMI为49.8%，比上月上升0.6个百分点，景气水平回升。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the National Bureau of Statistics reported China's manufacturing PMI at 49.8% in August, up 0.6 percentage points from the previous month, indicating a recovery in business sentiment.

articles.title_zh: 《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《坚持落实管党治党政治责任》
articles.title_en: Qiushi Journal to Publish Important Article by General Secretary Xi Jinping on Upholding Political Responsibility for Party Governance
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日出版的第17期《求是》杂志将发表习近平总书记重要文章《坚持落实管党治党政治责任》，文章强调落实管党治党责任、健全责任体系。
articles.summary_en: The 17th issue of Qiushi Journal, to be published on September 1, will carry an important article by General Secretary Xi Jinping on upholding political responsibility for strict Party governance, emphasizing the need to consolidate the responsibility system.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强8月31日主持召开国务院常务会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话，研究城市地下管网建设、招商引资等工作，并通过两项法规修订草案。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting on Aug 31 to study Xi Jinping's remarks, discuss urban pipeline networks and investment promotion, and approve two revised draft laws.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央政治局研究部署西藏吉隆县泥石流灾害抢险救援工作
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee Political Bureau Studies and Deploys Rescue Work for Mudslide Disaster in Gyirong County, Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，中共中央政治局召开会议部署西藏吉隆县泥石流灾害抢险救援。8月30日，消防救援力量持续开展拉网式搜寻，多部门调派专业力量支援。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 28, the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau met to deploy rescue for the mudslide in Gyirong, Tibet. On Aug 30, fire rescue forces continued search operations with multi-agency support.

articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Leads Efforts for a Fairer Global Governance System

articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping is leading efforts to build a more just and equitable global governance system, with the Global Governance Initiative gaining support from nearly 160 countries and international organizations a year after its launch.

articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends Welcome Ceremony Hosted by Kyrgyz President
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月31日，国家主席习近平在比什凯克出席吉尔吉斯斯坦总统扎帕罗夫举行的欢迎仪式，两国元首检阅仪仗队。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, President Xi Jinping attended a welcome ceremony hosted by Kyrgyz President Japarov in Bishkek, where the two leaders reviewed the honor guard.

articles.title_en: Seven Departments Issue Plan to Expand Commodity Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，商务部等7部门发布实施意见，推动商品消费扩容升级，提出到2030年社会消费品零售总额达60万亿元左右，并明确4方面重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, seven departments including the Ministry of Commerce issued an implementation plan to expand and upgrade commodity consumption, targeting around 60 trillion yuan in total retail sales of consumer goods by 2030.

articles.summary_en: On August 28, the Standing Committee of the Dandong Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey the spirit of Xi Jinping's important speeches and articles, and to study implementation measures. Party Secretary Jiang Bing presided and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 吴贤德赴晋安区接待群众来访
articles.title_en: Mayor Wu Xiande Receives Public Visitors in Jin'an District
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，福州市市长吴贤德赴晋安区岳峰镇接待群众来访，强调用心用情解决群众合理合法诉求。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Wu Xiande, Mayor of Fuzhou, received public visitors in Yuefeng Town, Jin'an District, emphasizing sincere efforts to resolve legitimate demands.

articles.title_zh: 邓维元主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议暨常务会议
articles.title_en: Deng Weiyuan Chairs Municipal Government Party Group Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，鹤岗市委副书记、市长邓维元主持召开市政府党组扩大会议暨常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神和李强总理调研讲话精神，研究部署相关工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Deng Weiyuan, deputy secretary of the Hegang Municipal Party Committee and mayor, chaired an enlarged Party group meeting and executive meeting to convey Xi Jinping's important instructions and Premier Li Qiang's inspection speech, and to arrange related work.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡在调研督导文明创建工作时强调 细化任务 压实责任 全力推进文明创建提质增效
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Emphasizes Refining Tasks and Consolidating Responsibilities in Civilized City Creation Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日下午，淮北市委副书记、代市长黄韡以“四不两直”方式到烈山区、相山区调研督导文明创建工作，强调细化任务、压实责任，全力推进文明创建提质增效。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 31, Huang Wei, Deputy Secretary of the Huaibei Municipal Party Committee and Acting Mayor, inspected civilized city creation in Lieshan and Xiangshan districts, stressing refined tasks and responsibilities to improve quality and efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 努力建好江淮粮仓
articles.title_en: Striving to Build the Jianghuai Granary
articles.summary_zh: 安徽省深化农村改革，推进土地延包、高标准农田建设、科技创新和社会化服务，粮食产量连创新高，努力建设江淮粮仓，保障国家粮食安全。
articles.summary_en: Anhui deepens rural reform, promoting land contract extension, high-standard farmland, agricultural technology, and social services. Grain output hits records as it builds the Jianghuai Granary for national food security.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话 重要指示精神 安排部署贯彻落实工作
articles.title_en: Dawa Tsering Chairs Lhasa Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee (Enlarged) Meeting to Convey and Study General Secretary Xi Jinping's Recent Important Speeches and Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 拉萨市委书记达娃次仁主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话指示精神，部署贯彻落实工作，并向吉隆县泥石流遇难人员默哀。
articles.summary_en: Dawa Tsering, Secretary of Lhasa Municipal Party Committee, chaired an enlarged Standing Committee meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions, and to arrange implementation. The meeting observed a moment of silence for victims of the Gyirong County mudslide.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁主持召开市委理论学习中心组集体学习会深入学习贯彻习近平总书记视察西藏时的重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Dawa Tsering Chairs Lhasa CPC Theoretical Study Session on Xi's Important Speech on Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，拉萨市委书记达娃次仁主持召开市委理论学习中心组集体学习会，深入学习习近平总书记视察西藏时的重要讲话精神，强调加快建设社会主义现代化新拉萨。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Lhasa party secretary Dawa Tsering chaired a theoretical study session to thoroughly study Xi Jinping's important speech on Tibet, stressing accelerated building of a modern socialist new Lhasa.

articles.title_zh: 京拉携手“送智上门” 共绘区域文创品牌建设新图景
articles.title_en: Beijing and Lhasa Cooperate to Boost Regional Cultural Creative Brand Building
articles.summary_zh: 北京与拉萨携手开展“送智上门”活动，共同推进区域文创品牌建设，助力两地文化产业发展。
articles.summary_en: Beijing and Lhasa have launched a joint 'send wisdom' initiative to boost regional cultural and creative brand development, supporting cultural industry growth in both cities.

articles.title_zh: 自治区十二届人大常委会第七十二次主任会议召开
articles.title_en: Yan Jinhai Chairs 72nd Meeting of Regional People's Congress Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日上午，西藏自治区党委副书记、人大常委会主任严金海在拉萨主持召开自治区十二届人大常委会第七十二次主任会议，听取多项工作报告并研究相关议程。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 25, Yan Jinhai, Deputy Secretary of the Regional Party Committee and Director of the Regional People's Congress Standing Committee, chaired the 72nd Director Meeting in Lhasa, hearing reports on ecological protection, rule-of-law government, and debt management, and deliberating agendas.

articles.title_zh: 西藏吉隆县泥石流灾害新闻发布会召开 嘎玛泽登介绍抢险救灾总体情况
articles.title_en: Press Conference on Mudslide Disaster in Gyirong County, Tibet Held; Karma Tseden Details Rescue Efforts
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，西藏吉隆县泥石流灾害新闻发布会在吉隆镇召开，自治区主席嘎玛泽登介绍抢险救灾总体情况，截至29日18时已致16人遇难、546人失联。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, a press conference on the mudslide disaster in Gyirong County, Tibet was held in Gyirong Town. Chairman Karma Tseden detailed rescue efforts; as of 6 p.m. on August 29, 16 had died and 546 were missing.

articles.title_zh: 林芝市召开二届市委常委会议
articles.title_en: Linzhi Municipal Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，林芝市委书记巴塔主持召开市委常委会会议，学习习近平总书记重要指示，部署防汛减灾等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Linzhi Municipal Party Committee Secretary Ba Ta chaired a meeting of the Standing Committee to study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions and deploy flood prevention and disaster reduction work.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记重要指示精神激励西藏干部群众落实抢险救援部署
articles.title_en: Xi's Instructions Inspire Tibetans in Rescue Efforts
articles.summary_zh: 近日，西藏吉隆县发生泥石流灾害，吉隆县公安局和边检站救援人员坚守一线，落实习近平总书记重要指示，全力搜救受灾群众。
articles.summary_en: Recently, a mudslide hit Gyirong County, Tibet. Police and border inspection officers are on the front line, implementing Xi Jinping's instructions to rescue victims.

articles.title_zh: 王君正主持召开自治区党委常委会会议部署抢险救援
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Chairs Party Committee Meeting to Coordinate Disaster Rescue
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正主持召开自治区党委常委会（扩大）会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神，部署吉隆县泥石流灾害抢险救援工作，全力以赴减少人员伤亡。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the CPC Tibet Autonomous Regional Committee, chaired an expanded meeting of the regional Party committee to study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's instructions and coordinate rescue efforts after a mudslide in Gyirong County, aiming to minimize casualties.

articles.title_zh: 龙岩市人大常委会党组召开会议
articles.title_en: Longyan Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Party Group Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，龙岩市人大常委会党组召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神和省委、市委全会精神，研究部署卫生健康、安全生产等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the Party Group of the Standing Committee of Longyan Municipal People's Congress held a meeting to study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and the plenary sessions of the provincial and municipal party committees, deploying work on health, safety production, etc.

articles.title_zh: 西藏吉隆县泥石流灾害新闻发布会召开 嘎玛泽登介绍抢险救灾总体情况
articles.title_en: Press Conference on Gyirong County Mudslide Disaster Held, Gama Zedeng Briefs on Rescue Efforts
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，西藏吉隆县泥石流灾害新闻发布会在吉隆镇召开，自治区主席嘎玛泽登介绍抢险救灾情况。截至29日18时，灾害已造成16人遇难、546人失联。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, a press conference on the mudslide disaster in Gyirong County, Tibet was held in Gyirong Town. Regional chairman Gama Zedeng briefed on rescue efforts. As of 18:00 on August 29, 16 people were confirmed dead and 546 missing.

articles.title_zh: 王君正主持召开自治区党委常委会（扩大）会议 部署抢险救援工作
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Chairs Regional Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting on Rescue Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正在日喀则主持召开自治区党委常委会（扩大）会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示，部署吉隆县泥石流灾害抢险救援工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Region Party Committee, chaired an enlarged standing committee meeting in Shigatse to study and deploy rescue work after the debris flow disaster in Gyirong County.

articles.title_zh: 习近平强调坚持极限思维、底线思维 做好防灾减灾救灾工作
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Stresses Extreme and Bottom-Line Thinking in Disaster Prevention and Relief
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，习近平主持中共中央政治局会议，研究部署西藏日喀则市吉隆县泥石流灾害抢险救援工作，强调坚持极限思维、底线思维，切实保障人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Xi Jinping chaired a meeting of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau to deploy rescue work for the mudslide disaster in Gyirong County, Shigatse, Tibet, stressing extreme and bottom-line thinking to ensure people's safety.

articles.title_zh: 潮南区持续深化全域环境卫生整治
articles.title_en: Chaonan District Intensifies Comprehensive Environmental Sanitation Efforts
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，潮南区结合汕头、潮州、揭阳三市交界区域爱国卫生统一行动，组织党员干部和志愿者开展全域环境卫生整治，区委书记张晓铿等领导参加。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Chaonan District joined the patriotic health campaign at the border area of Shantou, Chaozhou, and Jieyang, organizing party members, volunteers, and residents to improve the environment, with Party Secretary Zhang Xiaokeng in attendance.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞调度全区防汛防灾工作 强调抓实抓细自然灾害防御
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Coordinates Flood and Disaster Prevention in Ningxia, Stressing Thorough Defense
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，自治区党委书记李邑飞到自治区自然资源厅调度全区防汛防灾工作，强调抓实抓细自然灾害防御，保障人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 28, Li Yifei, Party Secretary of Ningxia, went to the Department of Natural Resources to coordinate flood and disaster prevention, stressing thorough disaster defense to safeguard people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬检查防汛防台风工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Inspects Flood and Typhoon Prevention Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬到医药高新区（高港区）检查防汛防台风工作，实地察看积水点位和排水设施，强调压紧压实责任、确保安全度汛。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 30, Jiang Dongdong, Secretary of the Taizhou Municipal Party Committee, inspected flood and typhoon prevention in the Medicine High-tech Zone (Gaogang District), stressing responsibilities and safe flood season.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬检查防汛防台风工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Inspects Flood Prevention and Typhoon Response Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，市委书记姜冬冬到医药高新区（高港区）检查防汛防台风工作，实地查看积水点、河闸站等，要求压实责任、保障人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong inspected flood and typhoon prevention work in the Medical High-tech Zone (Gaogang District), urging solid measures to safeguard people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛检查秋季开学准备工作
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Inspects Fall Semester Opening Preparations
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，江苏省省长刘小涛在徐州市检查秋季开学准备工作，强调确保安全平稳有序开学。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao inspected fall semester opening preparations in Xuzhou, emphasizing safety and orderly school resumption.

articles.title_zh: 张海波调研海上安全和海洋科技创新工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Inspects Maritime Safety and Marine Technology Innovation Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，威海市委书记张海波赴远遥中心渔港和威海海洋科技馆调研海上安全和海洋科技创新工作，强调守牢海上安全底线，加快打造创新型国际化海洋城市。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Zhang Haibo, Secretary of Weihai Municipal Committee, visited Yuanyao Central Fishing Port and Weihai Marine Science and Technology Museum to inspect maritime safety and marine technology innovation, stressing safety and innovation.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会召开第六十八次主任会议
articles.title_en: Municipal People's Congress Holds 68th Directors Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，芜湖市人大常委会召开第六十八次主任会议，听取人事任免报告，决定8月31日举行常委会第三十八次会议。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, the Wuhu Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held its 68th directors meeting to hear personnel appointment reports and decide to convene its 38th session on August 31.

articles.title_zh: 应时代之变 行天下大道——习近平主席引领推动构建更加公正合理的全球治理体系
articles.title_en: Adapting to the Times, Walking the Path of the World: President Xi Jinping Leads Efforts to Build a More Just and Equitable Global Governance System
articles.summary_zh: 新华社8月30日刊发特稿，回顾习近平主席提出全球治理倡议一周年，阐述中国推动构建更加公正合理的全球治理体系的理念与实践，获国际社会广泛支持。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua published a feature on August 30 reviewing the first anniversary of President Xi Jinping's Global Governance Initiative, elaborating China's efforts to build a more just and equitable global governance system with broad international support.
