articles.title_zh: 新乡市委十二届十一次全会召开 决定召开市第十三次党代会
articles.title_en: Xinxiang Municipal CPC Committee Holds 12th Plenary Session, Decides to Convene 13th Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月30日，新乡市委十二届十一次全会召开，市委书记魏建平作讲话。全会审议通过相关报告，决定9月1日召开市第十三次党代会。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 30, 2026, the 12th Plenary Session of the Xinxiang Municipal CPC Committee was held, with Secretary Wei Jianping speaking. The session reviewed reports and decided to convene the 13th Municipal Party Congress on Sept 1.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Municipal Party Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月29日，新乡市委书记魏建平主持召开市委常委会会议，听取市委十二届十一次全会和市第十三次党代会筹备情况汇报，研究有关事项。
articles.summary_en: On August 29, Wei Jianping, Secretary of the Xinxiang Municipal Party Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to hear reports on preparations for the 11th Plenary Session and the 13th Municipal Party Congress.

articles.title_zh: 市委十二届十一次全会召开
articles.title_en: The 11th Plenary Session of the 12th Xinxiang Municipal Party Committee Convened
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，中国共产党新乡市第十二届委员会第十一次全体会议召开，审议通过市第十三次党代会有关事项，决定党代会于9月1日召开。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, the 11th Plenary Session of the 12th CPC Xinxiang Municipal Committee was held, reviewing matters for the 13th Municipal Party Congress and deciding to convene it on September 1.

articles.title_zh: 许昌高新区召开安全生产“大排查、大起底、大整治”专项行动动员部署会
articles.title_en: Xuchang High-tech Zone Holds Mobilization Meeting for Safety Production Special Action
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，许昌高新区召开安全生产“大排查、大起底、大整治”专项行动动员部署会，党工委书记孙毅主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Xuchang High-tech Zone held a mobilization meeting for a special safety production inspection and rectification campaign, chaired by Party Secretary Sun Yi.

articles.title_zh: 许昌市生态环境局召开年轻干部座谈会
articles.title_en: Xuchang Ecological Environment Bureau Holds Young Cadre Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，许昌市生态环境局召开年轻干部座谈会，围绕加强干部队伍建设进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the Xuchang Ecological Environment Bureau held a symposium for young cadres to exchange views on strengthening cadre team building.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平主持召开强降雨应对视频调度会
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Chairs Video Conference on Heavy Rainfall Response
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日上午，盐城市委书记严汉平主持召开强降雨应对视频调度会，部署防范措施，代市长吴炜出席。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 30, Yan Hanping, secretary of the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee, chaired a video conference on heavy rainfall response, deploying preventive measures. Acting mayor Wu Wei attended.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛在连云港盐城南通调研沿海经济带建设
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Surveys Coastal Economic Belt Development in Lianyungang, Yancheng and Nantong
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日至27日，江苏省省长刘小涛在连云港、盐城、南通调研港口建设和沿海经济带发展，强调构建现代化海洋产业体系。
articles.summary_en: From August 26 to 27, Governor Liu Xiaotao of Jiangsu Province surveyed port construction and coastal economic belt development in Lianyungang, Yancheng and Nantong, stressing efforts to build a modern marine industry system.

articles.title_zh: 杨文龙到新洲镇调研“百千万工程”和信访工作
articles.title_en: Yang Wenlong Visits Xinzhou Town to Inspect 'Baiqianwan Project' and Petition Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，市政协主席杨文龙到阳东区新洲镇调研“百千万工程”和信访工作，强调统筹谋划项目、做实信访工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Yang Wenlong, chairman of the Municipal CPPCC, visited Xinzhou Town, Yangdong District, to inspect the 'Baiqianwan' Project and petition work, emphasizing coordinated planning and proper handling of petitions.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委党的建设领导小组（扩大）会议召开 李邑飞主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Party Building Leadership Group of Ningxia Regional Party Committee Holds (Expanded) Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，自治区党委党的建设领导小组召开（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示，部署建立正确政绩观长效机制，李邑飞主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 31, the Party Building Leadership Group of the Autonomous Region Party Committee held an (expanded) meeting to convey Xi Jinping's important instructions and arrange long-term mechanisms for correct views on political achievements. Li Yifei presided and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉调研紫色大道及驿站建设运营情况 强调以路串景一站一景
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Inspects Purple Avenue and Service Station Operations
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，银川市委书记赵旭辉调研紫色大道及驿站建设运营情况，强调以路串景、路景一体，打造文旅产业大道。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Zhao Xuhui, secretary of Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee, inspected the Purple Avenue and its service stations, emphasizing integrated landscape and tourism development to boost the local wine industry.

articles.title_zh: 玉溪市委召开专题会议听取对党代会报告的意见建议
articles.title_en: Yuxi Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting to Solicit Opinions on Party Congress Report
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，玉溪市委召开专题会议，研究市第七次党代会报告，听取县（市、区）和市直部门意见建议，市委书记杨政昆主持并介绍起草情况。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 28, the Yuxi Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to discuss the 7th Party Congress report, soliciting suggestions from counties and municipal departments, chaired by Secretary Yang Zhengkun.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议传达学习习近平总书记近期重要文章重要讲话重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Yuxi Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Convey Xi Jinping's Important Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，玉溪市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要文章、重要讲话和重要指示精神，听取上半年经济运行汇报，市委书记杨政昆主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, the Standing Committee of the Yuxi Municipal Party Committee met to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important articles, speeches, and instructions, and heard reports on the city's economic performance in the first half of the year. The meeting was chaired by Yang Zhengkun, Secretary of the Municipal Party Committee.

articles.title_zh: 李强在西藏吉隆指导抢险救援和应急处置工作
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Guides Rescue and Emergency Response in Gyirong, Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，李强受习近平总书记委托赴西藏日喀则市吉隆县指导泥石流灾害抢险救援，实地察看灾情、看望受灾群众，要求全力搜救失联人员并防范次生灾害。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, entrusted by General Secretary Xi Jinping, Li Qiang went to Gyirong County, Shigatse, Tibet to guide rescue and emergency response after a mudslide, inspecting the disaster site and visiting affected residents, urging all-out search and rescue efforts and prevention of secondary disasters.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江主持召开市委党的建设工作领导小组会议
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Chairs Meeting of Yueyang Municipal Party Committee Leading Group for Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，岳阳市委书记谢卫江主持市委党的建设工作领导小组会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，总结学习教育工作并部署巩固拓展成果。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 28, Yueyang Party Secretary Xie Weijiang chaired a meeting of the municipal Party building leading group, conveying Xi Jinping's important instructions and deploying consolidation of learning achievements.

articles.title_zh: 上海交通大学与岳阳市交流座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Yueyang Hold Exchange Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月29日，上海交通大学与岳阳市交流座谈会召开，双方共同揭牌两个创新中心，并围绕深化合作、推动高质量发展进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 29, Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Yueyang City held an exchange symposium, jointly unveiling two innovation centers and discussing deeper cooperation for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 李勇毅走访慰问市驻京联络处干部职工
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi Visits City's Beijing Liaison Office Staff
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，湛江市市长李勇毅走访慰问市驻京联络处干部职工，调研驻京阵地运行情况并部署下一阶段重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 26, Li Yongyi, mayor of Zhanjiang, visited and condoled staff of the city's Beijing liaison office, inspecting its operation and outlining key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 政协第十一届遂溪县委员会常务委员会召开第二十八次会议
articles.title_en: Suixi County CPPCC Standing Committee Convened for 28th Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日下午，政协第十一届遂溪县委员会常务委员会召开第28次会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和生态环境法典，听取上半年经济运行汇报并围绕典型村培育开展专题议政。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 28, the Standing Committee of the 11th Suixi County CPPCC Committee held its 28th meeting to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech and the Ecological Environment Code, hear a report on the first-half economic performance, and conduct special consultation on typical village cultivation.

articles.title_zh: 吴松江主持召开市委十四届第195次常委会（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Wu Songjiang Chairs Expanded Standing Committee Meeting of Leizhou Municipal Party Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，雷州市委书记吴松江主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议，深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想，研究部署贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Wu Songjiang, Party Secretary of Leizhou, chaired an expanded Standing Committee meeting to study Xi Jinping's party building thought and arrange implementation measures.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会聚焦“粮食安全”开展专题询问
articles.title_en: Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Special Inquiry on Food Security
articles.summary_zh: 8月29日上午，周口市人大常委会围绕粮食安全开展专题询问，主任郭力铭出席并讲话，副市长王家才作表态发言。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 29, the Standing Committee of Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress held a special inquiry on food security. Director Guo Liming attended and spoke, and Vice Mayor Wang Jiacai made a statement.

articles.title_zh: 习近平会见俄罗斯总统普京
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Meets with Russian President Vladimir Putin
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月31日下午，国家主席习近平在比什凯克出席上海合作组织峰会期间会见俄罗斯总统普京，双方就中俄关系及共同关心的国际地区问题交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 31 local time, President Xi Jinping met with Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit in Bishkek, exchanging views on bilateral ties and international and regional issues.

articles.title_zh: 累计推进533米！国道216线抢通作业进入难度最大路段
articles.title_en: Cumulative 533 Meters! Rescue Work on National Highway 216 Reaches Most Difficult Section
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日尼泊尔一侧泥石流致西藏吉隆口岸人员伤亡，截至8月31日，国道216线抢通累计推进533米，进入最困难路段。
articles.summary_en: A debris flow on the Nepalese side on Aug 26 caused casualties at Gyirong Port, Tibet. As of Aug 31, rescue work on National Highway 216 has advanced 533 meters and reached the most difficult section.

articles.title_zh: 8月我国制造业PMI为49.8%，景气水平回升
articles.title_en: China's Manufacturing PMI Rises to 49.8% in August, Signaling Recovery
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局8月31日发布2026年8月中国采购经理指数运行情况，制造业PMI为49.8%，比上月上升0.6个百分点，景气水平回升。
articles.summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics released August 2026 PMI data on Aug 31, showing manufacturing PMI at 49.8%, up 0.6 percentage points from the previous month, indicating a recovery in business sentiment.

articles.title_zh: 民进中央原副主席、陕西省政协原副主席刘宽忍，被判15年
articles.title_en: Liu Kuanren, Former Vice Chairman of Minshu Central and Shaanxi CPPCC, Sentenced to 15 Years
articles.summary_zh: 民进中央原副主席、陕西省政协原副主席刘宽忍因职务犯罪被判处有期徒刑15年。
articles.summary_en: Liu Kuanren, former vice chairman of the Central Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy and former vice chairman of Shaanxi Provincial CPPCC, was sentenced to 15 years in prison for duty-related crimes.

articles.title_zh: 打虎！江苏省委常委、组织部部长刘建洋被查
articles.title_en: Liu Jianyang, Senior Jiangsu Official, Investigated for Serious Disciplinary Violations
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日晚，中央纪委国家监委通报江苏省委常委、组织部部长刘建洋涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of August 31, the CCDI announced that Liu Jianyang, Standing Committee member and Organization Department head of Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee, is under investigation for suspected serious disciplinary violations.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：尼泊尔一侧受灾地区失联中国公民近百人，正全力搜救
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: Nearly 100 Chinese Citizens Missing in Nepal Disaster Area, Rescue Underway
articles.summary_zh: 外交部表示，尼泊尔一侧受灾地区失联中国公民近百人，目前正全力搜救。
articles.summary_en: The Chinese Foreign Ministry said nearly 100 Chinese citizens are missing in the disaster-hit area on Nepal's side, and rescue efforts are in full swing.

articles.title_zh: 张雪现身香港交付新车，82岁车主称这是世界上最好的车
articles.title_en: Zhang Xue Delivers New Motorcycles in Hong Kong; 82-Year-Old Owner Calls It 'World's Best'
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，张雪机车创始人张雪赴香港向首批三位车主交付跑车820RR，其中包括立法会议员何君尧；张雪还承诺向香港特区政府捐赠5台机车。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, Zhang Xue, founder of Zhang Xue Motorcycles, flew to Hong Kong to deliver the first batch of 820RR sports motorcycles to three owners, including Legislative Council member Junius Ho. He also promised to donate 5 motorcycles to the Hong Kong SAR government.

articles.title_zh: 从年中答卷看河北怎样写金融“五篇大文章”
articles.title_en: Hebei’s Mid-Year Financial Report: Advancing the ‘Five Major Financial Initiatives’
articles.summary_zh: 河北围绕科技、绿色、普惠、养老、数字金融“五篇大文章”协同发力，截至6月末相关领域贷款余额增速显著高于平均水平，并推出多项创新金融产品与服务。
articles.summary_en: Hebei promotes finance serving technology, green, inclusive, pension, and digital sectors; loans in these areas grew faster than overall average by mid-year, with innovative products supporting industries and elderly care.

articles.title_zh: “细胞工厂”里的万千世界
articles.title_en: Inside the 'Cell Factory': The New Engine of Future Industries
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报报道我国生物制造产业加速发展，从技术突破迈向应用落地，强调菌种自主可控和全链条产业化，以新模式助力绿色低碳与实体经济转型。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily reports China's biomanufacturing industry accelerating from breakthroughs to applications, stressing self-reliant strains and full-chain industrialization as new momentum for green, low-carbon transformation.

articles.title_zh: 争分夺秒挺进吉隆灾区 全力以赴开展抢险救援
articles.title_en: All-Out Rescue Operations Underway in Gyirong, Tibet After Deadly Debris Flow
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，西藏吉隆县因尼泊尔一侧冰岩崩引发巨型泥石流，造成重大伤亡。截至29日已有16人遇难、546人失联，各方救援力量正全力搜救。
articles.summary_en: A massive debris flow triggered by an ice-rock avalanche on the Nepalese side struck Gyirong County, Tibet on August 26, causing heavy casualties. As of August 29, 16 were confirmed dead and 546 missing, with rescue teams working around the clock.

articles.title_zh: 第30届鲁台经贸洽谈会开幕式暨两岸产业融合高质量发展大会举行
articles.title_en: 30th Shandong-Taiwan Trade Fair Opens with Cross-Strait Industrial Integration Forum
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，第30届鲁台经贸洽谈会开幕式暨两岸产业融合高质量发展大会在潍坊举行，宋涛、林武、萧旭岑出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the opening ceremony of the 30th Shandong-Taiwan Economic and Trade Fair and the Cross-Strait Industrial Integration High-Quality Development Conference was held in Weifang. Song Tao, Lin Wu, and Hsiao Hsu-tsen attended and delivered speeches.

tags_en: Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 吴贤德赴晋安区接待群众来访
articles.title_en: Wu Xiande Receives Public Visitors in Jin'an District
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，福州市长吴贤德赴晋安区岳峰镇接待群众来访，强调用心用情解决群众合理合法诉求，提升群众获得感、幸福感、安全感。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Fuzhou Mayor Wu Xiande received public visitors in Yuefeng Town, Jin'an District, emphasizing the need to resolve people's legitimate demands with care and law to enhance their sense of gain, happiness, and security.

articles.title_zh: 习近平开启亚非之行，出席上合峰会并访问吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Kicks off Asia-Africa Tour, Attending SCO Summit and Visiting Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月30日下午，国家主席习近平抵达比什凯克，出席2026年上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问，随后还将前往埃及进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 30, President Xi Jinping arrived in Bishkek to attend the 2026 SCO Summit and pay a state visit to Kyrgyzstan, followed by a state visit to Egypt.

articles.title_zh: 青岛市工商业联合会第十五次代表大会开幕
articles.title_en: Qingdao Federation of Industry and Commerce Holds 15th Congress
articles.summary_zh: 青岛市工商业联合会第十五次代表大会8月31日开幕，省委常委、市委书记曾赞荣和省人大常委会副主任王随莲出席并讲话，强调支持民营经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The 15th Congress of Qingdao Federation of Industry and Commerce opened on August 31. Zeng Zanrong and Wang Suilian attended and spoke, emphasizing support for high-quality development of private economy.

tags.name_en: Federation of Industry and Commerce Work

tags_en: Federation of Industry and Commerce Work

articles.title_zh: 任刚调研经济运行、产业项目、人工智能等工作
articles.title_en: Ren Gang Investigates Economic Operations, Industrial Projects and AI Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日上午，青岛市市长任刚到城阳区调研经济运行、产业项目、人工智能等工作，强调深化产教融合。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 30, Ren Gang, Mayor of Qingdao, led relevant departments to Chengyang District to inspect economic operations, industrial projects, and AI work, emphasizing industry-education integration.

articles.title_zh: 吉尔吉斯斯坦高规格欢迎习近平主席抵达
articles.title_en: Kyrgyzstan Welcomes President Xi Jinping with High Honors
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月30日下午，国家主席习近平乘专机抵达吉尔吉斯斯坦首都比什凯克，吉总统扎帕罗夫夫妇热情迎接。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 30 local time, President Xi Jinping arrived in Bishkek, the capital of Kyrgyzstan, and was warmly greeted by Kyrgyz President Japarov and his wife.

articles.title_zh: 微视频丨弘扬“上海精神” 凝聚“上合力量”
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Attend SCO Summit and Visit Kyrgyzstan, Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日至9月3日，国家主席习近平将出席在比什凯克举行的2026年上海合作组织峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: From August 30 to September 3, President Xi Jinping will attend the 2026 SCO Summit in Bishkek and pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt.

articles.title_zh: 做强中国芯 拥抱芯世界 记者探馆第十四届半导体设备材料与核心部件展
articles.title_en: 14th Semiconductor Equipment, Materials and Core Components Expo Opens in Wuxi
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，第十四届半导体设备与核心部件及材料展在江苏无锡开幕，国内外企业展示最新技术成果，推动半导体材料国产化替代。
articles.summary_en: The 14th Semiconductor Equipment, Materials and Core Components Expo opened in Wuxi, Jiangsu on August 31, with domestic and foreign companies showcasing latest technologies to advance import substitution in semiconductor materials.

articles.title_zh: 中国羽毛球协会副主席夏煊泽被查
articles.title_en: Xia Xuanze, Vice Chairman of Chinese Badminton Association, Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 据中央纪委国家监委驻国家体育总局纪检监察组、江苏省纪委监委消息，中国羽毛球协会副主席夏煊泽涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: According to the discipline inspection and supervision group stationed at the General Administration of Sport and Jiangsu Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection, Xia Xuanze, vice chairman of the Chinese Badminton Association, is under investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 大圣被AI客服“逼疯”？有治了，这项国家标准9月1日起实施
articles.title_en: Monkey King Driven Crazy by AI Customer Service? National Standard Takes Effect Sept. 1
articles.summary_zh: 国家标准《顾客联络服务 人工与智能客户服务协同要求》于9月1日起实施，旨在解决AI客服“转人工”难、服务体验碎片化等问题，明确涉及人身财产安全时应优先转人工。
articles.summary_en: The national standard 'Requirements for Collaboration between Human and Intelligent Customer Service' takes effect on September 1, addressing pain points like hard-to-reach human agents and fragmented service experience, requiring priority transfer to human agents in safety-related scenarios.

articles.title_zh: 宝利化携手南京中医药大学启动依舒佳林®药理机制深度研究
articles.title_en: Baolihua and Nanjing University of Chinese Medicine Launch Deep Research on Yishujialin's Pharmacological Mechanism
articles.summary_zh: 近日，宝利化制药与南京中医药大学张启春团队举行科研合作签约仪式，将联合开展依舒佳林®（甲磺酸二氢麦角碱缓释片）药理机制专项基础研究。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Baolihua Pharma and the team of Professor Zhang Qichun from Nanjing University of Chinese Medicine held a signing ceremony for scientific cooperation to jointly conduct basic research on the pharmacological mechanism of Yishujialin.

articles.title_zh: 浙江省委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Study and Implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's Important Speech and Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日上午，浙江省委常委会召开会议，省委书记王浩主持，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神，研究部署贯彻落实意见，并强调做好防汛防台和政绩观学习教育等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 31, the Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee held a meeting chaired by Wang Hao to study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions, and to deploy flood and typhoon prevention and correct view of political achievements education.

articles.title_zh: 2026年第二批“中国好人榜”发布，贺娇龙等在列
articles.title_en: 2026 Second Batch of 'China Good Person List' Released, He Jiaolong Among Honorees
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，中央精神文明建设办公室在甘肃静宁县举办2026年第二批“中国好人榜”发布仪式，150名身边好人上榜。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the Central Office for Spiritual Civilization Development held the unveiling ceremony in Jingning County, Gansu, for the second batch of 2026 'China Good Person List', with 150 individuals honored.

articles.title_zh: 石泰峰出席学习《习近平党建文选》座谈会暨习近平党建思想研究中心成立会并讲话
articles.title_en: Shi Taifeng Attends Symposium on Xi Jinping's Selected Works on Party Building and Inauguration of Research Center
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，学习《习近平党建文选》座谈会暨习近平党建思想研究中心成立会在京召开，中共中央政治局委员、中央组织部部长石泰峰出席并讲话，强调学好用好《习近平党建文选》。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, a symposium on studying Xi Jinping's Selected Works on Party Building and the inauguration of the Research Center on Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building were held in Beijing. Shi Taifeng, member of the Political Bureau and head of the CCP Central Organization Department, attended and stressed the importance of studying and applying the works.

tags.name_en: Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building

tags_en: Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building

articles.title_zh: 9月起这些新规将施行，涉及住房公积金、微短剧等
articles.title_en: New Regulations Take Effect from September, Covering Housing Provident Fund and Micro-dramas
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日起，一批全国性新规施行，包括住房公积金提取条件放宽、人民币买卖例外规定、微短剧分类备案等。
articles.summary_en: Starting September 1, a batch of national regulations take effect, including relaxed housing provident fund withdrawal rules, exceptions for RMB trading, and classified filing for micro-dramas.

articles.title_zh: 著名马克思主义理论家、中央编译局原副局长顾锦屏逝世
articles.title_en: Famous Marxist Theorist and Former Deputy Director of Central Compilation Bureau Gu Jinping Dies
articles.summary_zh: 著名马克思主义理论家、翻译家、中央编译局原副局长顾锦屏同志因病于2026年8月21日在北京逝世，享年93岁。他曾长期从事马克思主义经典著作编译工作。
articles.summary_en: Gu Jinping, a renowned Marxist theorist, translator, and former deputy director of the Central Compilation and Translation Bureau, passed away from illness in Beijing on August 21, 2026, at the age of 93.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持国务院常务会议 学习贯彻习近平关于西藏吉隆县泥石流抢险救援重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Speech on Gyirong Mudslide Rescue in Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 李强8月31日主持国务院常务会议，学习贯彻习近平关于西藏吉隆县泥石流救援重要讲话精神，部署应急处置，并研究地下管网、招商引资、税收征管法等事项。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 31, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council meeting to study Xi's speech on Tibet mudslide rescue, and discussed urban pipelines, investment promotion, and tax law amendments.

articles.title_zh: 上海警备区原政委张立志逝世，享年83岁
articles.title_en: Former Shanghai Garrison Political Commissar Zhang Lizhi Dies at 83
articles.summary_zh: 正军职退休干部、上海警备区原政委张立志因病医治无效，于2026年8月19日在上海逝世，享年83岁。
articles.summary_en: Zhang Lizhi, former political commissar of the Shanghai Garrison, died of illness in Shanghai on August 19, 2026, at the age of 83.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省委：坚决拥护党中央对刘建洋审查调查的决定
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Committee Firmly Supports CPC Central Committee's Decision to Investigate Liu Jianyang
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，江苏省委书记信长星主持省委常委会会议，通报刘建洋涉嫌严重违纪违法接受审查调查，与会同志一致拥护党中央决定。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, Jiangsu Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing chaired a standing committee meeting, reporting that Liu Jianyang is under disciplinary review for suspected serious violations, and attendees unanimously expressed firm support for the CPC Central Committee's decision.

articles.title_zh: “科创中国”科技服务团到芜湖调研
articles.title_en: "Innovation China" Sci-Tech Service Team Conducts Research in Wuhu
articles.summary_zh: 近日，“科创中国”汽车供应链协同创新科技服务团赴安徽芜湖调研，考察奇瑞汽车等企业，探讨智能网联新能源汽车供应链发展。
articles.summary_en: The "Innovation China" auto supply chain service team recently visited Wuhu, Anhui, to research and discuss development of the intelligent connected new energy vehicle supply chain.

articles.title_zh: 长三角持续深化协同创新
articles.title_en: Yangtze River Delta Continues to Deepen Collaborative Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 长三角地区持续深化协同创新，2025年技术合同交易4.68万项，技术交易额2461.3亿元，同比增长14.7%，高新技术企业占全国比重超30%。
articles.summary_en: The Yangtze River Delta continues deepening collaborative innovation. In 2025, it recorded 46,800 technology contracts with a transaction value of 246.13 billion yuan, up 14.7%, while high-tech enterprises account for over 30% of the national total.

articles.title_zh: 重庆发布进一步推动经济稳中向好政策
articles.title_en: Chongqing Issues Policies to Further Stabilize Economic Growth
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，重庆市印发《重庆市进一步推动经济稳中向好若干政策举措》，从六大方面提出37条举措，稳就业、稳企业、稳市场、稳预期。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, Chongqing issued a set of policy measures to promote stable economic growth, featuring 37 concrete steps across six areas to stabilize employment, enterprises, markets, and expectations.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃出台稳岗扩容提质行动实施方案
articles.title_en: Gansu Introduces Action Plan for Stabilizing Employment and Expanding Capacity
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省政府近日印发《甘肃省稳岗扩容提质行动实施方案》，聚焦稳岗、扩容、提质三大任务，推动产业就业协同发展，拓宽就业渠道。
articles.summary_en: Gansu Provincial Government issued an action plan to stabilize employment, expand job channels, and improve quality, focusing on industry-employment coordination and protecting workers' rights.

articles.title_zh: 国资国企数智产业创新实验室正式启动
articles.title_en: State-owned Assets and Enterprises Digital Intelligence Industry Innovation Laboratory Officially Launched
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日晚，2026数博会DATA之夜在贵阳举行，国资国企数智产业创新实验室正式启动。该实验室由国务院国资委研究中心等单位联合发起，聚焦数智前沿领域。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of August 28, the 2026 Big Data Expo DATA Night was held in Guiyang, where the State-owned Assets and Enterprises Digital Intelligence Industry Innovation Laboratory was officially launched. Jointly initiated by the Research Center of SASAC and other units, it focuses on frontier digital intelligence fields.

articles.title_zh: 数据要素筑基，人工智能加速落地应用（经济聚焦）
articles.title_en: Data Elements Lay Foundation, AI Applications Accelerate
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日至30日，2026中国国际大数据产业博览会在贵阳举办，展示AI应用、数据供给、词元调用等，推动人工智能加速落地。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 China International Big Data Industry Expo was held in Guiyang from Aug 28 to 30, showcasing AI applications, data supply, and token services to accelerate AI adoption in industries.

articles.title_zh: 河南省委财经委员会会议召开
articles.title_en: Henan Provincial Party Committee Holds Financial and Economic Affairs Commission Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，河南省委书记刘宁主持召开省委财经委员会会议，强调坚定信心、主动作为，打好经济发展夏秋季战役，确保完成全年目标任务。省长王凯出席。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, Liu Ning, Secretary of the Henan Provincial Party Committee, presided over a meeting of the Provincial Financial and Economic Affairs Commission, emphasizing confidence and proactive action to win the summer-autumn economic campaign and ensure annual targets. Governor Wang Kai attended.

tags.name_en: Henan Provincial Party Committee Financial and Economic Affairs Commission

tags_en: Henan Provincial Party Committee Financial and Economic Affairs Commission

articles.title_zh: 郏县：巡察首日就解“积水忧” 干群同心疏通“民心沟”
articles.title_en: Jiaxian County Inspection Team Resolves Waterlogging Issue on First Day
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，郏县县委第一巡察组进驻王寨村，现场指导解决村民排水沟堵塞问题，当天下午即完成疏通。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the First Inspection Team of Jiaxian County Party Committee stationed in Wangzhai Village to guide solving the drainage blockage issue, completing the dredging that afternoon.

articles.title_zh: 海南省启动“物业服务质量再提升”专项行动
articles.title_en: Hainan Launches Special Campaign to Further Improve Property Service Quality
articles.summary_zh: 近日，海南省在陵水黎族自治县召开“物业服务质量再提升”专项行动启动会议，从制度建设、服务进家庭和迎接越冬业主三个板块提升物业服务。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Hainan Province held a launching meeting in Lingshui Li Autonomous County for a special campaign to improve property services, covering institutional building, in-home services, and welcoming wintering residents.

articles.title_zh: 长三角持续深化协同创新
articles.title_en: Yangtze River Delta Continues to Deepen Collaborative Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，《人民日报》报道长三角持续深化协同创新，三省一市通过资源共享与政策协同提升科创活力。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, People's Daily reported that the Yangtze River Delta continues to deepen collaborative innovation, with three provinces and one municipality enhancing sci-tech vitality through resource sharing and policy coordination.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省委常委、组织部部长刘建洋接受审查调查
articles.title_en: Liu Jianyang, Standing Committee Member and Organization Department Head of Jiangsu Provincial Committee, Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 中央纪委国家监委8月31日消息，江苏省委常委、组织部部长刘建洋涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: The Central Commission for Discipline Inspection announced on August 31 that Liu Jianyang, Standing Committee member and head of the Organization Department of the Jiangsu Provincial Committee, is under disciplinary and supervisory investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 江苏推出新政 购买十大智能品类家电可享15%优惠
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Launches New Policy: 15% Subsidy for Ten Smart Appliance Categories
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，江苏省发展改革委、财政厅、商务厅联合发布通告，自8月29日起对智能家电等十大品类提供15%以旧换新补贴，每件最高补贴1500元。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Jiangsu's development, finance, and commerce authorities jointly announced a 15% trade-in subsidy for ten smart appliance categories, effective from August 29, capped at 1,500 yuan per item.

tags.name_en: Jiangsu Provincial Development and Reform Commission

tags_en: Jiangsu Provincial Development and Reform Commission

articles.title_zh: 挖掘资源 创新载体 庐山推动廉洁文化浸润人心
articles.title_en: Lushan Promotes Clean Culture Through Resources and Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 近日，庐山市纪委监委通过挖掘历史廉洁资源、创新教育载体，推动廉洁文化浸润人心，并召开警示教育大会强化以案促改。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Lushan City Commission for Discipline Inspection promoted clean culture by tapping historical resources and innovating education methods, holding a warning education meeting to strengthen case-based reforms.

articles.title_zh: “闽商塞上行”助力宁夏高质量发展活动启动
articles.title_en: Fujian Merchants' Ningxia Tour Launched to Boost High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，“闽商塞上行”助力宁夏高质量发展活动在银川启动，闽宁两地约100名代表参加。福建省工商联与宁夏自治区工商联签署合作协议，深化产业协作。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, the "Fujian Merchants' Ningxia Tour" activity kicked off in Yinchuan to boost Ningxia's high-quality development, with about 100 representatives from Fujian and Ningxia. The Fujian and Ningxia Federations of Industry and Commerce signed a cooperation agreement.

articles.title_zh: 为加快建设农业强国推进农业农村现代化夯实法治根基
articles.title_en: Consolidating the Legal Foundation for Accelerating Agricultural Strength and Rural Modernization
articles.summary_zh: 全国人大农业与农村委员会主任委员在人民日报撰文，解读新修订的农业法，强调其对建设农业强国、推进农业农村现代化的重大意义，并阐述修改重点。
articles.summary_en: The chairman of the NPC Agriculture and Rural Affairs Committee writes in People's Daily to interpret the newly revised Agriculture Law, emphasizing its significance for building an agricultural powerhouse and advancing rural modernization, and elaborating on key amendments.

articles.title_zh: "我家门前那座桥"工程已开工263座
articles.title_en: 263 Bridges Started in 'Bridge in Front of My Home' Project
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，青海省交通运输厅在"四好农村路"现场会上透露，"我家门前那座桥"工程已开工263座，同时推进农村公路新改建等民生项目。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, the Qinghai Provincial Transport Department reported that 263 of 550 planned bridges have begun construction under the 'Bridge in Front of My Home' project, along with rural road upgrades and safety works.

articles.title_zh: 山东实施创业模式引领行动
articles.title_en: Shandong Launches Entrepreneurship Model Leadership Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 山东省人力资源社会保障厅等9部门出台意见，提出推进四种创业模式引领，并推出17条具体措施。
articles.summary_en: Shandong's Department of Human Resources and Social Security and 8 other departments issued guidelines to promote four entrepreneurship models with 17 specific measures.

tags.name_en: Shandong Provincial Department of Human Resources and Social Security

articles.title_zh: 上海出台“一江一河”规划
articles.title_en: Shanghai Issues Plan for 'One River, One Creek' Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，《上海市“一江一河”发展“十五五”规划》发布，推动黄浦江、苏州河沿岸从线性贯通走向功能融合，建设具有全球影响力的世界级滨水区。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, Shanghai released its 15th Five-Year Plan for the 'One River, One Creek' development, promoting functional integration along the Huangpu River and Suzhou Creek to build a world-class waterfront.

articles.title_zh: 厚植为民情怀 砥砺实干担当——陕西扎实开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育
articles.title_en: Cultivating People-centered Sentiments and Forging Practical Responsibility: Shaanxi Carries Out Education on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 2026年以来，陕西省委扎实开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，一体推进学查改，办好民生实事，以实干实绩推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Since 2026, Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee has conducted education on correct view of political achievements, integrating learning, inspection and rectification, delivering practical benefits, and boosting high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 多部门联合部署做好稳投资工作
articles.title_en: Multiple Departments Jointly Deploy to Stabilize Investment
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，国家发展改革委联合有关部门召开全国投资工作推进会议，部署稳投资重点任务，强调以有效投资支撑经济社会高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, the National Development and Reform Commission and relevant departments held a national investment promotion meeting to deploy key tasks for stabilizing investment, emphasizing effective investment to support high-quality economic and social development.

articles.title_zh: 2026“一带一路”年度汉字发布
articles.title_en: 2026 'Belt and Road' Annual Chinese Character Released
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，2026“一带一路”年度汉字发布活动在新疆乌鲁木齐举行，“齐”字当选年度汉字。活动由中国公共关系协会、乌鲁木齐市人民政府主办。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the 2026 Belt and Road Annual Character release event was held in Urumqi, Xinjiang, with 'Qi' selected as the annual character. The event was hosted by CPRCA and Urumqi Municipal Government.

articles.title_zh: 澳门特区政府捐助3000万元支持西藏吉隆灾害救援
articles.title_en: Macao SAR Government Donates 30 Million Yuan to Support Disaster Relief in Gyirong, Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 澳门特区政府29日决定通过澳门基金会向西藏自治区捐助3000万元，支持日喀则市吉隆县泥石流灾害救援及善后工作。
articles.summary_en: On Aug. 29, the Macao SAR Government decided to donate 30 million yuan through the Macao Foundation to support disaster relief and recovery in Gyirong County, Tibet.

articles.title_zh: 西藏自治区新闻办通报吉隆县泥石流灾害：已致16人遇难、546人失联
articles.title_en: Tibet Briefing on Gyirong County Mudslide: 16 Dead, 546 Missing
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，西藏自治区人民政府新闻办公室举行发布会，通报吉隆县泥石流灾害救援情况，截至8月29日18时已致16人遇难、546人失联。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 30, the Information Office of the Tibet Autonomous Region government held a briefing on the mudslide disaster in Gyirong County, reporting 16 dead and 546 missing as of 6 p.m. Aug 29.

articles.title_zh: 全国避暑休闲旅游优秀案例发布 云南两个案例上榜
articles.title_en: Yunnan's Two Cases Listed Among National Summer Retreat Tourism Excellent Cases
articles.summary_zh: 2026全国避暑休闲旅游消费交流促进活动在湖北利川举办，发布45个优秀案例，云南两个案例上榜，展示避暑旅游发展成果。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 National Summer Retreat Tourism Consumption Exchange and Promotion Activity was held in Lichuan, Hubei, releasing 45 excellent cases, with two from Yunnan on the list.

articles.title_zh: 金华火腿启动“三标”统一管理质量验收
articles.title_en: Jinhua Ham Launches Unified Quality Inspection for 'Three Marks' Program
articles.summary_zh: 近日，金华市对火腿“三标”统一管理启动2026年度质量验收，涉及54家企业105万条火腿，合格品将佩戴防伪溯源码。
articles.summary_en: Jinhua recently launched the 2026 quality inspection under its unified 'Three Labels' management for Jinhua ham, covering 1.05 million hams from 54 enterprises, with qualified products tagged with anti-counterfeit codes.

articles.title_zh: 近66亿条信用信息带来什么——‘信用浙江’建设观察
articles.title_en: What Do Nearly 6.6 Billion Credit Records Bring? Observations on 'Credit Zhejiang' Construction
articles.summary_zh: 浙江深化‘信用浙江’建设，归集近66亿条信用信息，构建现代信用体系，以数字化改革支撑高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang deepens its 'Credit Zhejiang' initiative, collecting nearly 6.6 billion credit records to build a modern credit system, using digital reform to support high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 分秒不息 鏖战吉隆
articles.title_en: Fighting Nonstop at Gyirong: Rescue after Mudslide
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日西藏吉隆县发生泥石流灾害，截至29日已致16人遇难、546人失联。各方救援力量正全力搜救，并已查明灾害原因为尼泊尔侧冰岩崩引发巨型泥石流。
articles.summary_en: A massive mudslide hit Gyirong County, Tibet on Aug 26, killing 16 and leaving 546 missing as of Aug 29. Rescue teams are searching, with cause identified as an ice-rock avalanche from Nepal.

articles.title_zh: 习近平抵达比什凯克出席上合组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives in Bishkek for SCO Summit and State Visit to Kyrgyzstan
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月30日下午，国家主席习近平乘专机抵达比什凯克，出席2026年上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问，强调两国合作迎来快速发展“黄金期”。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 30 local time, President Xi Jinping arrived in Bishkek by special plane to attend the 2026 SCO Summit and pay a state visit to Kyrgyzstan, stressing the 'golden period' of bilateral cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席署名文章谈中吉关系高质量发展
articles.title_en: Xi's Signed Article on High-Quality Development of China-Kyrgyzstan Relations
articles.summary_zh: 习近平在访问吉尔吉斯斯坦前夕发表署名文章，回顾中吉关系发展，展望新时代全面战略伙伴关系。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping published a signed article ahead of his visit to Kyrgyzstan, reviewing bilateral ties and envisioning a new era of comprehensive strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 在激发社会活力中增强高质量发展动力
articles.title_en: Enhancing High-Quality Development Momentum by Stimulating Social Vitality
articles.summary_zh: 本文围绕7月30日中央政治局会议部署，阐述激发社会活力与增强高质量发展动力的内在联系，并提出全面深化改革的具体举措。
articles.summary_en: This article elaborates on the relationship between stimulating social vitality and enhancing high-quality development momentum, based on the Political Bureau meeting of July 30, and proposes specific measures for deepening reforms.

articles.title_zh: 坚持落实管党治党政治责任
articles.title_en: Uphold Political Responsibility for Strict Party Governance
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月31日，《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《坚持落实管党治党政治责任》，汇总其2013年至2026年关于管党治党责任的论述。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, 2026, Qiushi Journal published an important article by Xi Jinping on upholding political responsibility for strict Party governance, compiling his remarks from 2013 to 2026.

articles.title_zh: 习近平会见乌兹别克斯坦总统米尔济约耶夫
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Meets with Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月31日下午，国家主席习近平在比什凯克出席上海合作组织峰会期间会见乌兹别克斯坦总统米尔济约耶夫，就深化中乌全面战略伙伴关系达成共识。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 31 local time, President Xi Jinping met with Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev on the sidelines of the SCO summit in Bishkek, agreeing to deepen the comprehensive strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 习近平会见蒙古国总统呼日勒苏赫
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Meets Mongolian President Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月31日下午，国家主席习近平在比什凯克出席上海合作组织峰会期间会见蒙古国总统呼日勒苏赫，双方就深化中蒙全面战略伙伴关系等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 31 local time, President Xi Jinping met with Mongolian President Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh on the sidelines of the SCO Summit in Bishkek, discussing deepening the comprehensive strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 把正确政绩观熔铸于魂、力践于行
articles.title_en: Forge the Correct View of Political Achievements into the Soul and Practice It
articles.summary_zh: 本文评论巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果，强调把正确政绩观熔铸于魂、力践于行，建立长效机制。
articles.summary_en: This commentary reviews the achievements of the education campaign on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements, emphasizing the need to forge it into the soul and put it into practice, and to build a long-term mechanism.

articles.title_zh: 习近平会见俄罗斯总统普京
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Meets with Russian President Vladimir Putin
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月31日下午，国家主席习近平在比什凯克出席上海合作组织峰会期间会见俄罗斯总统普京。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 31, local time, President Xi Jinping met with Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the SCO Summit in Bishkek.

articles.title_zh: 真抓实干向未来——8月全国各地经济社会发展观察
articles.title_en: Real Efforts for the Future: Observations on Economic and Social Development Across China in August
articles.summary_zh: 8月，全国县域消费潜能释放，首发经济、赛事经济和人形机器人应用展现活力，经济在稳的基础上积蓄进动能。
articles.summary_en: In August, county-level consumption potential was unleashed, with debut economy, sports economy, and humanoid robot applications showing vitality, as the economy accumulated momentum for progress on a stable basis.

articles.title_zh: 尼泊尔泥石流灾害中已取得联系的中方人员已安全转移
articles.title_en: Chinese Personnel in Contact During Nepal Landslide Disaster Safely Relocated
articles.summary_zh: 据中国驻尼泊尔大使馆消息，截至8月30日中午，在尼泊尔泥石流灾害中已取得联系的中方人员已全部转移至安全地区。
articles.summary_en: According to the Chinese Embassy in Nepal, as of noon on August 30, all Chinese personnel in contact during the Nepal landslide disaster had been relocated to safe areas.

articles.title_zh: 切实把管党治党政治责任落实到位
articles.title_en: Effectively Implementing the Political Responsibility for Party Governance
articles.summary_zh: 《求是》杂志编辑部发表文章，强调落实管党治党政治责任是全面从严治党的关键，要求全党知责担责履责。
articles.summary_en: Qiushi journal's editorial emphasizes that fulfilling political responsibility for Party governance is key to full and rigorous Party self-governance, urging all Party members to assume responsibility.

articles.title_zh: 用好规划这台“导航仪”
articles.title_en: Use Planning as the "Navigation Device"
articles.summary_zh: 本文指出近期一系列国家级专项规划密集出台，强调五年规划是治国理政的重要经验，需以全局思维推动政策协同，将规划优势转化为发展效能。
articles.summary_en: This commentary highlights the recent rollout of national special plans, emphasizing five-year planning as a key governance experience and calling for policy coordination to turn planning advantages into development effectiveness.

articles.title_zh: 省委财经委员会会议召开 刘宁主持并讲话 王凯出席
articles.title_en: Provincial Financial and Economic Committee Meeting Held, Liu Ning Chairs and Wang Kai Attends
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，河南省委书记刘宁主持召开省委财经委员会会议，强调要坚定信心、主动作为，打好打赢经济发展夏秋季战役，确保完成全年目标任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, Henan Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning chaired the Provincial Financial and Economic Committee meeting, stressing firm confidence and proactive action to win the summer-autumn economic campaign and achieve annual goals.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛检查秋季开学准备工作
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Inspects Preparations for Autumn School Opening
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，江苏省省长刘小涛在徐州市检查秋季开学准备工作，强调确保安全平稳有序开学。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, Governor Liu Xiaotao of Jiangsu inspected autumn school opening preparations in Xuzhou, emphasizing safe and orderly start.

articles.title_zh: 高规格欢迎 吉尔吉斯斯坦马队护送习近平主席专车
articles.title_en: High-Spec Welcome: Kyrgyz Mounted Guard Escorts President Xi's Car
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月31日上午，国家主席习近平在吉尔吉斯斯坦出席总统扎帕罗夫举行的欢迎仪式，马队护送专车进入总统府。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Aug 31 local time, President Xi Jinping attended a welcoming ceremony hosted by Kyrgyz President Japarov; a mounted guard escorted his car to the presidential palace.

articles.title_zh: 中埃是携手发展共同繁荣的好伙伴
articles.title_en: China and Egypt Are Good Partners for Shared Development and Common Prosperity
articles.summary_zh: 应埃及总统塞西邀请，国家主席习近平将对埃及进行国事访问。此访时隔10年再次对埃及进行国事访问，对两国关系发展具有重要意义。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi, Chinese President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to Egypt. This visit, the first in 10 years, is of special significance to bilateral relations.

articles.title_zh: 深刻理解民为邦本、为政以德的治理思想
articles.title_en: Understanding the Governance Thought of 'People as the Foundation and Virtue in Governance'
articles.summary_zh: 本文阐述民为邦本、为政以德治理思想的历史渊源与时代价值，强调其与以人民为中心的发展思想相融通，为新时代国家治理提供文化滋养。
articles.summary_en: The article elaborates on the historical origins and contemporary value of the governance thought that regards the people as the foundation and virtue as the principle, integrating with the people-centered development philosophy.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同吉尔吉斯斯坦总统扎帕罗夫会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月31日上午，习近平在比什凯克同吉尔吉斯斯坦总统扎帕罗夫会谈，签署联合宣言及永久睦邻友好合作条约。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 31 (local time), Xi Jinping held talks with Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov in Bishkek, signing a joint declaration and a treaty on permanent good-neighborliness and friendly cooperation.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥将赴俄罗斯出席第十一届东方经济论坛并举行中俄投资合作委员会第十三次会议、能源合作委员会第二十三次会议和第八届中俄能源商务论坛
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang to Attend 11th Eastern Economic Forum and Co-chair Meetings in Russia
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，外交部宣布，应俄罗斯联邦政府邀请，丁薛祥将于9月2日至4日赴俄罗斯出席第十一届东方经济论坛，并举行多个双边合作会议。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 31, the Foreign Ministry announced that Ding Xuexiang will visit Russia from Sept 2 to 4 to attend the 11th Eastern Economic Forum and co-chair several China-Russia cooperation meetings.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 2030年我国将基本建成现代农产品产地市场体系
articles.title_en: China to Basically Build Modern Agricultural Producing Area Market System by 2030
articles.summary_zh: 农业农村部印发《全国农产品产地市场体系发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年基本建成现代农产品产地市场体系。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs issued the plan for developing the national agricultural producing area market system during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, aiming to basically complete a modern market system by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 两部门印发《物流网建设实施方案》——推动物流基础设施“成链成网”
articles.title_en: Two Ministries Issue Implementation Plan for Logistics Network Construction
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委、交通运输部近日联合印发《物流网建设实施方案》，提出到2030年物流网建设取得明显成效，推动物流基础设施成链成网。
articles.summary_en: China's NDRC and Ministry of Transport jointly issued a plan to build an integrated logistics network by 2030, promoting infrastructure connectivity and efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 有关部门依法查处两起涉中医药网络违规营销宣传问题
articles.title_en: Authorities Investigate Two Cases of Illegal Online Marketing of Traditional Chinese Medicine Products
articles.summary_zh: 国家中医药管理局会同有关部门依法查处两起涉中医药网络违规营销宣传问题，包括网店虚假宣传和医生违规推荐处方药。
articles.summary_en: The National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine and relevant departments investigated two cases of illegal online marketing of TCM products, involving false advertising and doctors illegally recommending prescription drugs.

tags.name_en: National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine

tags_en: National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine

articles.title_zh: 国务院常务会议部署城市地下管网建设工作
articles.title_en: State Council Executive Meeting Deploys Urban Underground Pipeline Construction
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，国务院常务会议部署城市地下管网建设工作，强调以系统思维加快推进建设，从源头消除安全隐患，提高城市功能品质。
articles.summary_en: On August 31, the State Council executive meeting deployed urban underground pipeline construction, emphasizing systematic planning to eliminate safety hazards and improve urban functions.

articles.title_zh: 2026年《开学第一课》聚焦“我们的长征路”主题
articles.title_en: 2026 'First Lesson of School' Focuses on 'Our Long March Road' Theme
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日，中央宣传部、教育部、中央广播电视总台联合主办的2026年《开学第一课》将于9月1日在央视综合频道播出，主题为“我们的长征路”，纪念长征胜利90周年。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 public welfare program 'First Lesson of School', co-hosted by the Central Publicity Department, Ministry of Education, and China Media Group, will air on CCTV-1 on September 1, themed 'Our Long March Road', marking the 90th anniversary of the Long March victory.

articles.title_zh: 一份童书榜单引发关注——警惕“成功学”带偏孩子的阅读
articles.title_en: Beware of 'Success' Books Misleading Children's Reading
articles.summary_zh: 新华社调查发现，‘成功学’童书在电商平台热销，贩卖育儿焦虑，挤占优秀儿童文学市场。专家呼吁治理渠道生态、优化算法推荐，让更多优秀童书被看见。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua investigation finds 'success' books for children selling well on e-commerce platforms, exploiting parental anxiety and crowding out quality children's literature. Experts urge channel governance and algorithmic optimization to promote good books.

articles.title_zh: 水利部专家解读吉隆泥石流灾害堰塞湖处置
articles.title_en: Water Resources Ministry Expert Explains Handling of Landslide-Dammed Lake in Gyirong
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日尼泊尔一侧泥石流造成西藏吉隆口岸重大伤亡并形成堰塞湖。8月30日水利部确认堰塞湖已基本排空，专家回应网友关切。
articles.summary_en: A debris flow from Nepal on Aug. 26 caused heavy casualties in Gyirong Port, Tibet, forming a barrier lake. On Aug. 30, the water ministry said the lake had mostly drained and experts addressed public concerns.

articles.title_zh: 报告显示：2019年以来我国乡村信息基础设施实现跨越发展
articles.title_en: Report Shows China's Rural Information Infrastructure Achieved Leaping Development Since 2019
articles.summary_zh: 国家互联网信息办公室、农业农村部发布《中国数字乡村发展报告（2019—2025年）》，显示乡村信息基础设施实现跨越发展，2025年农村网络零售额首破3万亿元。
articles.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of China and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs released a report showing leaping development in rural information infrastructure, with rural online retail sales exceeding 3 trillion yuan in 2025.

articles.title_zh: 武契奇：感谢中方
articles.title_en: Vucic: Thanks to China
articles.summary_zh: 塞尔维亚与中企智元、敏实集团合作建设的人形机器人工厂29日在沙巴茨启动量产，总统武契奇出席启动仪式并致辞，感谢中方支持。
articles.summary_en: Serbia's humanoid robot factory in Sabac, co-built with Chinese firms Zhiyuan and Minth, started mass production on Aug 29. President Vucic attended and thanked China.

articles.title_zh: 习近平抵达吉尔吉斯斯坦比什凯克玛纳斯国际机场发表书面讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives at Manas International Airport in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, Delivers Written Remarks
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月30日，国家主席习近平抵达比什凯克，对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问并出席上合组织峰会，发表书面讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, 2026, President Xi Jinping arrived in Bishkek for a state visit to Kyrgyzstan and to attend the SCO summit, delivering written remarks.

articles.title_zh: 习近平抵达比什凯克出席2026年上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives in Bishkek for SCO Summit and State Visit to Kyrgyzstan
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月30日下午，国家主席习近平乘专机抵达比什凯克，出席2026年上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 30 local time, President Xi Jinping arrived in Bishkek by special plane to attend the 2026 SCO Summit and pay a state visit to Kyrgyzstan.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开月度工作推进会
articles.title_en: Municipal Government Holds Monthly Work Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，长春市委副书记、市长顾刚主持召开月度工作推进会，部署经济稳增长、产业培育和投资等重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Changchun Mayor Gu Gang chaired a monthly work meeting to deploy key tasks on economic growth, industry cultivation, and investment.

articles.title_zh: 前7月机械工业生产实现较快增长
articles.title_en: Mechanical Industry Output Sees Rapid Growth in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 据中国机械工业联合会数据，前7月机械工业主要大类行业增加值同比保持增长，工业机器人产量同比增长28.5%。
articles.summary_en: According to the China Machinery Industry Federation, value-added output of major machinery sectors grew year-on-year in the first seven months, with industrial robot output rising 28.5%.

articles.title_zh: 共享机遇 共谋发展——习近平主席引领推动全球发展倡议在上合组织国家落地生根造福地区各国人民
articles.title_en: Sharing Opportunities, Seeking Common Development: Xi Jinping Leads Global Development Initiative to Take Root in SCO Countries
articles.summary_zh: 新华社北京8月29日电，文章阐述习近平主席推动全球发展倡议在上海合作组织国家落地生根，促进共同发展、造福地区人民。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua, Beijing, Aug 29. The article expounds on President Xi Jinping's promotion of the Global Development Initiative taking root in SCO countries, fostering common development and benefiting regional people.

articles.title_zh: 我国推出新举措加快数据产业发展
articles.title_en: China Unveils New Measures to Accelerate Data Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 国家数据局宣布新举措，包括在32个城市开展数据标注先行先试、14家央国企开放超60亿条高价值数据等，以加快数据产业发展。
articles.summary_en: The National Data Administration announced new measures to accelerate data industry development, including pilot data labeling in 32 cities and opening over 60 billion high-value data records from 14 central state-owned enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 《平“语”近人——习近平喜欢的典故》（多语种版）在上海合作组织国家主流媒体播出
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Favorite Allusions (Multilingual) Premieres on SCO Media
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月30日，中央广播电视总台制作的《平“语”近人——习近平喜欢的典故》（多语种版）启播活动在比什凯克举行，吉尔吉斯斯坦总统扎帕罗夫致贺信，节目将在上合组织国家主流媒体播出。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, the launch ceremony of the multilingual version of 'Ping Yu Jin Ren – Xi Jinping's Favorite Allusions' was held in Bishkek by China Media Group. Kyrgyz President Japarov sent a congratulatory letter. The program will air on mainstream media of SCO countries.

articles.title_zh: 《平“语”近人——习近平喜欢的典故》（多语种版）在上合组织国家媒体播出
articles.title_en: Multilingual Edition of 'Xi Jinping's Favorite Literary Quotes' Launches on SCO Media
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，《平“语”近人——习近平喜欢的典故》（多语种版）启播活动在比什凯克举行，即日起在上合组织国家媒体落地播出。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, the launch event for the multilingual edition of 'Xi Jinping's Favorite Literary Quotes' was held in Bishkek, and it began airing on SCO member state media.

articles.title_zh: 习近平离京出席2026年上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Leaves Beijing for SCO Summit and State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日上午，国家主席习近平乘专机离开北京，赴比什凯克出席上海合作组织峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 30, President Xi Jinping departed Beijing by special plane for Bishkek to attend the SCO Summit and pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt.

articles.title_zh: 王毅同尼泊尔外长希西尔通电话
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Holds Phone Call with Nepalese Foreign Minister Sishir
articles.summary_zh: 8月29日，王毅同尼泊尔外长希西尔通电话，就尼泊尔边境冰川崩塌引发泥石流灾害致两国人员伤亡表示慰问，并通报中方提供紧急援助、开展国际合作。
articles.summary_en: On August 29, Wang Yi held a phone call with Nepalese Foreign Minister Sishir, expressing condolences over the transboundary glacier collapse and mudslide causing casualties in both countries, and noting China's emergency aid and international cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 上半年全国新设外商投资企业3.5万户
articles.title_en: China Sees 35,000 New Foreign-Funded Enterprises in H1
articles.summary_zh: 市场监管总局数据显示，上半年全国新设外商投资企业3.5万户，同比增长7%，消费市场成为吸引外资新方向。
articles.summary_en: According to SAMR data, 35,000 new foreign-funded enterprises were established in China in H1, up 7% year-on-year, with the consumer market becoming a new driver for foreign investment.

articles.title_zh: 科技助力田管 推动粮食稳产增收
articles.title_en: Technology Drives Field Management for Stable Grain Harvest
articles.summary_zh: 8月下旬，秋粮进入产量形成关键期，河南、安徽、山西、云南、四川等地运用无人机、智慧监测平台等科技手段加强田间管理，推动粮食稳产增收。
articles.summary_en: In late August, as autumn grain enters its critical yield-formation period, regions including Henan, Anhui, Shanxi, Yunnan, and Sichuan use drones and smart monitoring platforms for field management to ensure stable and increased grain harvests.

articles.title_zh: 集结力量 全力以赴 扎实做好西藏吉隆泥石流灾害抢险救援各项工作
articles.title_en: Mobilize All Forces to Rescue After Debris Flow in Gyirong, Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，中共中央政治局召开会议部署西藏吉隆泥石流灾害抢险救援工作，各方力量全力投入救援。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 28, the CPC Central Committee Politburo met to deploy rescue efforts after a debris flow in Gyirong, Tibet; multiple forces are racing to help.

articles.title_zh: 广大党员、干部深学细悟《习近平党建文选》第一卷、第二卷
articles.title_en: Party Members and Cadres Study Xi Jinping's Selected Works on Party Building in Depth
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央党史和文献研究院编辑的《习近平党建文选》第一、二卷出版后，全国广大党员、干部深学细悟，结合实践推动学习贯彻走深走实。
articles.summary_en: After the publication of Xi Jinping's Selected Works on Party Building, Volumes I and II, edited by the CPC Central Party History and Literature Research Institute, Party members and cadres nationwide studied them deeply and applied them in practice.

tags.name_en: CPC Central Party History and Literature Research Institute

tags_zh: 中共中央党史和文献研究院

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议 许昆林主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Committee Holds Meeting Chaired by Xu Kunlin
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，辽宁省委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和重要指示精神，研究贯彻落实意见，省委书记许昆林主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the Liaoning Provincial Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions, and to study implementation opinions. Xu Kunlin, Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee, chaired the meeting and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市政府常务会议召开
articles.title_en: Huai'an Municipal Government Holds Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，市长顾坤主持召开市政府九届第59次常务会议，研究法治政府建设、工业项目服务、消防安全、耕地保护及群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 28, Mayor Gu Kun chaired the 59th municipal government executive meeting, covering legal governance, industrial projects, fire safety, farmland protection, and anti-corruption efforts.

articles.title_zh: 全市市县（区）镇三级人大换届选举工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Huai'an Holds Work Conference on Three-Level People's Congress Election
articles.summary_zh: 8月29日，淮安市召开市县（区）镇三级人大换届选举工作会议，市委书记史志军强调要高质量完成换届选举工作。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 29, Huai'an held a work conference on the election of people's congress deputies at city, county (district), and town levels. Party Secretary Shi Zhijun stressed high-quality completion of the election.

articles.title_zh: 高靖生赴部分县市区调研经济社会发展情况
articles.title_en: Gao Jingsheng Investigates Economic and Social Development in Huaihua
articles.summary_zh: 近日，怀化市委副书记、代市长高靖生赴多个县市区调研，强调精准施策抓实体、突出特色强产业。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Gao Jingsheng, deputy mayor and acting mayor of Huaihua, visited several counties and districts to inspect economic and social development, emphasizing targeted measures for the real economy and distinctive industries.

articles.title_zh: 习近平抵达比什凯克出席2026年上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives in Bishkek for 2026 SCO Summit and State Visit to Kyrgyzstan
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月30日下午，国家主席习近平乘专机抵达比什凯克，出席2026年上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问。吉尔吉斯斯坦总统扎帕罗夫夫妇到机场迎接。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 30 local time, President Xi Jinping arrived in Bishkek by special plane to attend the 2026 SCO Summit and pay a state visit to Kyrgyzstan at the invitation of President Japarov, who welcomed him at the airport.

articles.title_zh: 第九期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”举行
articles.title_en: The 9th "Frontier Lecture Hall" for Leading Cadres Held in Taizhou
articles.summary_zh: 8月29日，泰州市举办第九期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”，南京大学商学院教授沈坤荣围绕智能经济作专题授课，市委书记姜冬冬、市长李晖等参加学习。
articles.summary_en: On August 29, Taizhou held the 9th "Frontier Lecture Hall" for leading cadres. Professor Shen Kunrong from Nanjing University gave a lecture on the intelligent economy, attended by Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong, Mayor Li Hui, etc.

articles.title_zh: 蒋锋检查调研秋季开学准备和校园安全工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Feng Inspects Fall Semester Preparations and Campus Safety
articles.summary_zh: 8月29日，无锡市长蒋锋到部分初高中学校检查调研2026年秋季学期开学准备和校园安全工作，强调确保平稳有序开学，营造安全育人环境。
articles.summary_en: On August 29, Wuxi Mayor Jiang Feng inspected several middle and high schools regarding fall semester opening preparations and campus safety, emphasizing orderly school reopening and a safe educational environment.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平听取跨国公司江苏行—盐城零碳产业园国际合作交流会情况汇报
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Chairs Meeting on International Cooperation Exchange for Yancheng Zero-Carbon Industrial Park
articles.summary_zh: 8月29日，盐城市委书记严汉平主持召开会议，听取跨国公司江苏行—盐城零碳产业园国际合作交流会情况汇报，研究部署相关工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 29, Yan Hanping, Secretary of the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee, chaired a meeting to hear reports on the International Cooperation Exchange of Multinational Companies in Jiangsu - Yancheng Zero-Carbon Industrial Park and deploy related work.

articles.title_zh: 李庆新到郁南县调研督导农村集体“三资”管理工作
articles.title_en: Li Qingxin Inspects Rural Collective Asset Management in Yunan County
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，市长李庆新到郁南县调研督导农村集体“三资”管理工作，强调从严管理、用好用活，促进保值增值。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Mayor Li Qingxin inspected rural collective asset management in Yunan County, stressing strict management and effective use to preserve and increase value.

articles.title_zh: 李勇毅主持召开湛江市政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Li Yongyi Chairs Zhanjiang Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日下午，湛江市长李勇毅主持召开市政府第134次常务会议，传达学习习近平法治思想及相关法规，研究部署登革热、基孔肯雅热疫情防控工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 28, Mayor Li Yongyi of Zhanjiang chaired the 134th executive meeting of the municipal government, conveying Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law and relevant regulations, and deploying prevention and control work for dengue fever and chikungunya fever.

articles.title_zh: 国家自然科学基金委员会通报31起科研不端行为，多笔已拨资金被追回
articles.title_en: NSFC Reports 31 Cases of Research Misconduct, Recovers Disbursed Funds
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，国家自然科学基金委员会通报31起科研不端行为，涉及委托代写、买卖数据、抄袭剽窃等问题，多笔已拨资金被追回。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the National Natural Science Foundation of China reported 31 cases of research misconduct, including ghostwriting, data trading, and plagiarism, with multiple disbursed funds recovered.

articles.title_zh: 习近平离京出席2026年上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Leaves Beijing for SCO Summit and State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日上午，国家主席习近平乘专机离开北京，赴比什凯克出席2026年上海合作组织峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 30, President Xi Jinping left Beijing by special plane for Bishkek to attend the 2026 SCO Summit and pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席引领推动全球发展倡议在上合国家落地生根
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Leads Global Development Initiative to Take Root in SCO Countries
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾习近平主席提出并推动全球发展倡议，在上合组织框架内促进区域合作与可持续发展，2026年上合峰会即将启幕。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews President Xi Jinping's Global Development Initiative and its implementation within the SCO, promoting regional cooperation and sustainable development ahead of the 2026 SCO summit.

articles.title_zh: 被他人冒名注册平台账号，中国教育电视协会要求侵权行为人立即删除账号
articles.title_en: China Education Television Association Demands Removal of Impersonating Accounts
articles.summary_zh: 中国教育电视协会声明从未注册抖音账号，要求冒名者立即删除账号；此前四川省记协也发布类似打假声明。
articles.summary_en: China Education Television Association stated it never registered a Douyin account and demanded immediate deletion of impersonating accounts; earlier, Sichuan Journalists Association issued a similar statement.

articles.title_zh: 筑牢安全防线 武汉全城静待学子迎接新学期
articles.title_en: Wuhan Bolsters Security as Students Await New Semester
articles.summary_zh: 武汉市中小学、幼儿园即将迎来新学期，武汉公安提前进入护学模式，开展校园安全检查、安保实训及周边环境整治，确保学生平安返校。
articles.summary_en: Wuhan public security has launched pre-semester safety inspections, security training, and surrounding-area crackdowns to ensure a safe return for students.

articles.title_zh: 北影携手石炭井“青年工业影像创作计划”正式启动
articles.title_en: Beijing Film Academy and Shitanjing Launch Youth Industrial Film Creation Program
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，北京电影学院与石炭井联合启动“青年工业影像创作计划”，优选4支青年创作团队聚焦工业记忆、城市转型等主题开展创作，助力石嘴山文旅升级。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 30, Beijing Film Academy and Shitanjing launched the Youth Industrial Film Creation Program, selecting 4 youth teams to create films on industrial memory and urban transformation, boosting local cultural tourism.

articles.title_zh: 模速空间：创新点亮年轻事业
articles.title_en: Model Space: Innovation Lights Up Young Careers
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月，上海模速空间大模型创新生态社区发展迅速，入驻企业增至300余家，青年创业者汇聚，人工智能技术取得新突破。
articles.summary_en: In August 2026, Shanghai's Model Space, an AI innovation community, has expanded from 100 to over 300 enterprises, attracting young entrepreneurs and achieving breakthroughs in AI technology.

articles.title_zh: 通道畅 枢纽强 结构优——前7月新疆外贸企稳回升态势强劲的背后
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Foreign Trade Rebounds Steadily in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 乌鲁木齐海关数据显示，2026年1至7月新疆外贸进出口总值达3352.2亿元，同比增长4.4%；其中7月增长70.4%，向西开放通道扩容、贸易结构优化，外贸企稳回升态势强劲。
articles.summary_en: Data from Urumqi Customs show Xinjiang's foreign trade from Jan to July 2026 reached 335.22 billion yuan, up 4.4% year-on-year, with July surging 70.4%. Expanding westbound channels and optimized structure drive steady recovery.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚主持召开东博会、峰会广西领导小组2026年第3次会议强调 加强对接演练检查宣传安保 务实节俭办好第23届东博会、峰会
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Chairs 2026 Guangxi Leading Group Meeting on China-ASEAN Expo and Summit
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，自治区党委书记陈刚主持召开东博会、峰会广西领导小组2026年第3次会议，研究部署第23届东博会、峰会筹备工作，强调加强对接演练检查宣传安保，务实节俭办好。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Chen Gang, Secretary of the CPC Guangxi Committee, chaired the 3rd meeting of the Guangxi Leading Group for the China-ASEAN Expo and Summit in 2026 to prepare for the 23rd expo and summit, emphasizing coordination, drills, inspection, publicity, security, and frugality.

articles.title_zh: 李炳军会见京东集团首席执行官许冉一行
articles.title_en: Li Bingjun Meets JD.com CEO, Guizhou Signs Strategic Cooperation Agreement
articles.summary_zh: 8月29日，贵州省委副书记、省长李炳军在贵阳会见京东集团CEO许冉，随后省政府与京东集团签署战略合作框架协议，将在智能物流、数字经济等领域深化合作。
articles.summary_en: On August 29, Li Bingjun, Deputy Secretary of the Guizhou Provincial Party Committee and Governor, met with JD.com CEO Xu Ran in Guiyang. The provincial government later signed a strategic cooperation framework agreement with JD.com to deepen cooperation in smart logistics and the digital economy.

articles.title_zh: 省政协召开十三届七十四次主席会议 张义珍主持
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial CPPCC Holds 74th Chairman Meeting, Chaired by Zhang Yizhen
articles.summary_zh: 近日，江苏省政协召开十三届七十四次主席会议，认真学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究贯彻落实举措。省政协主席张义珍主持。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Jiangsu Provincial CPPCC held its 74th chairman meeting to study President Xi Jinping's important instructions and discuss implementation. It was chaired by CPPCC Chairman Zhang Yizhen.

articles.title_zh: 汲取思想伟力 开启奋进新程——广大党员、干部深学细悟《习近平党建文选》第一卷、第二卷
articles.title_en: Party Members and Cadres Study Xi Jinping's Selected Works on Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 在建党105周年之际，《习近平党建文选》第一卷、第二卷出版发行，广大党员干部深学细悟，推动理论学习转化为实践。
articles.summary_en: The Selected Works on Party Building by Xi Jinping were published on the 105th anniversary of the CPC, and Party members nationwide are studying them to turn theory into practice.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席鼓励我们做中埃友好使者
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Encourages Us to Be Messengers of China-Egypt Friendship
articles.summary_zh: 在中埃建交70周年之际，习近平主席即将对埃及进行国事访问，回顾中埃人文交流成果，强调文明互鉴与民心相通。
articles.summary_en: On the 70th anniversary of China-Egypt diplomatic ties, President Xi Jinping is about to pay a state visit to Egypt, reviewing cultural exchanges and emphasizing mutual learning between civilizations.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 还剩1.25公里 专业救援力量争分夺秒打通口岸关键通道
articles.title_en: 1.25 km Left: Rescue Forces Race to Clear Key Route to Gyirong Port
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，中国安能出动110名救援人员及28台（套）装备，在G216损毁路段抢通通往吉隆口岸的关键通道，已推进285米，正全力打通剩余约1.25公里。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, China Aneng dispatched 110 rescuers and 28 sets of equipment to clear the damaged G216 section leading to Gyirong Port, advancing 285 meters and striving to open the remaining 1.25 km of the rescue route.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁大连：两艘超大型矿砂船正式亮相
articles.title_en: Two Ultra-Large Ore Carriers Unveiled in Dalian, Liaoning
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日，由恒力重工集团建造的两艘超大型矿砂船在大连正式亮相，专为铁矿石、铝土矿等远洋运输打造。
articles.summary_en: On August 30, two very large ore carriers built by Hengli Heavy Industry were officially unveiled in Dalian, designed for ocean transport of iron ore and bauxite.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷：推动人工智能创新发展高地 建设不断取得新突破
articles.title_en: Liu Jie: Advancing AI Innovation Highland for Further Breakthroughs
articles.summary_zh: 28日下午，浙江省省长刘捷主持召开专题会议，研究人工智能创新发展工作，强调深化“人工智能+”，加快推动相关产业链发展。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Aug 28, Liu Jie, governor of Zhejiang, chaired a meeting on AI innovation, stressing deepening "AI+" and accelerating industrial chain development.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷：深化“两创”深度融合 加快推动先进制造业提质升级
articles.title_en: Liu Jie: Deepen Integration of Sci-Tech and Industrial Innovation to Upgrade Advanced Manufacturing
articles.summary_zh: 日前，浙江省委副书记、省长刘捷在杭州调研先进制造业，强调深化科技创新和产业创新融合，推动先进制造业提质升级。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Liu Jie, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee and Governor of Zhejiang, visited Hangzhou to inspect advanced manufacturing, stressing deeper integration of sci-tech and industrial innovation to upgrade the sector.

articles.title_zh: 美专家沃尔特·格林里夫对中国科技创新生态充满信心 呼吁加强跨国合作
articles.title_en: US Expert Confident in China's Tech Innovation Ecosystem, Calls for Cross-border Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 美国斯坦福大学专家沃尔特·格林里夫在北京HICOOL峰会期间接受采访，称赞中国科技创新生态，呼吁加强美中在智慧医疗健康领域的跨国合作。
articles.summary_en: US expert Walter Greenleaf from Stanford University, during the HICOOL summit in Beijing, expressed confidence in China's tech innovation and called for stronger US-China cooperation in smart healthcare.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将访埃及，中埃续写“老友记”
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Visit Egypt, China-Egypt 'Old Friends' Story Continues
articles.summary_zh: 应埃及总统塞西邀请，中国国家主席习近平将对埃及进行国事访问，时值中埃建交70周年。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi, Chinese President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to Egypt, marking the 70th anniversary of diplomatic ties.

articles.title_zh: 聚焦“六大战略定位” 山西晋城绘就“十五五”高质量发展路线图
articles.title_en: Jincheng, Shanxi Outlines High-Quality Development Roadmap for 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，山西省晋城市委副书记、市长刘振华表示，“十五五”时期晋城将聚焦六大战略定位，推动资源型经济转型，力争GDP年均增长5.5%左右。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Liu Zhenhua, deputy secretary of the Jincheng Municipal Party Committee and mayor, said that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, Jincheng will focus on six strategic positions, promote resource-based economic transformation, and strive for an average annual GDP growth of about 5.5%.

articles.title_zh: HICOOL汇聚全球创新种子在北京“破土”
articles.title_en: HICOOL Global Startup Summit Kicks Off in Beijing, Fostering Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日至29日，HICOOL 2026全球创业者峰会在北京举办，以“从创新源头到产业潮头”为主题，吸引600余家企业参展，促进国际创新合作。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 26 to 29, the HICOOL 2026 Global Startup Summit was held in Beijing, themed 'From Source of Innovation to Industry Frontier,' attracting over 600 exhibitors and boosting global innovation collaboration.

articles.title_zh: 心相近｜中吉共续文化丝路情缘
articles.title_en: Shared Affinity: China and Kyrgyzstan Continue Cultural Silk Road Bonds
articles.summary_zh: 新华社报道中吉两国通过碎叶古城遗址保护、敦煌研究院与吉方联合实验室等合作，共同传承丝路文化，深化文化遗产保护与人才交流。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reports that China and Kyrgyzstan deepen cultural heritage protection and talent exchange through cooperation on the Suyab ancient city site and a joint lab with the Dunhuang Academy, continuing the Silk Road cultural bond.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江林业职业技术学院原党委书记江怀亮被查
articles.title_en: Former Party Secretary of Heilongjiang Forestry Vocational and Technical College Jiang Huailiang Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江林业职业技术学院原党委书记江怀亮涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受黑龙江省纪委监委纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: Jiang Huailiang, former Party secretary of Heilongjiang Forestry Vocational and Technical College, is under disciplinary review and supervision investigation by the Heilongjiang Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

tags.name_en: Heilongjiang Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision

tags_en: Heilongjiang Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision

articles.title_zh: HICOOL 2026全球创业者峰会：一棵树看见AI“热带雨林”生态
articles.title_en: HICOOL 2026 Global Entrepreneur Summit: A Tree Reveals AI 'Tropical Rainforest' Ecosystem
articles.summary_zh: 8月29日，HICOOL 2026全球创业者峰会在北京举行，海淀区14家AI企业集中展示从基础模型到终端产品的完整链条，呈现AI生态。
articles.summary_en: On August 29, the HICOOL 2026 Global Entrepreneur Summit was held in Beijing, where 14 AI companies from Haidian District showcased a full chain from foundational models to end products, revealing the AI ecosystem.

articles.title_zh: 广州市台资企业协会举行成立36周年庆典

articles.summary_en: On the morning of Aug 29, Huang Wei, deputy secretary of the Huaibei Municipal Party Committee and acting mayor, visited key industrial enterprises in Suixi County, stressing innovation, strengthening foundations, and improving services to boost industrial economy.

articles.title_zh: 于海田主持召开市政府常务会议研究群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治等事项

articles.summary_en: On August 28, Yu Haitian, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Jinan Municipal Committee and Mayor, chaired a municipal government executive meeting to study the concentrated rectification of misconduct and corruption around the people and other matters.

articles.title_zh: 各民主党派市委会新一届领导班子座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Conference of New Leadership of Municipal Democratic Parties Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，济南市召开各民主党派市委会新一届领导班子座谈会，市委书记刘强讲话，强调加强思想政治建设、履职尽责。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 28, Jinan held a conference for the new leadership of municipal democratic parties. Party Secretary Liu Qiang stressed political unity and performance of duties.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰带队调研重点项目建设
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Leads Inspection of Key Project Construction

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of the 28th, Qu Xiaojie, mayor of Jieyang, led a team to inspect key construction projects, emphasizing efforts to advance projects and expand effective investment.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开全体会议暨全市经济分析会
articles.title_en: Shantou Mayor Chairs City Government Meeting on Economic Analysis
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日下午，汕头市长陈涛主持召开市政府全体会议暨全市经济分析会，研究部署经济工作，强调完成全年目标任务。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 28, Shantou Mayor Chen Tao chaired a plenary meeting and economic analysis meeting to study economic work and emphasize achieving annual targets.

articles.title_zh: 汕头市委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Shantou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speech and Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日上午，汕头市委常委会召开会议，市委书记庄悦群主持，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，研究防灾减灾救灾等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 28, the Standing Committee of the CPC Shantou Municipal Committee held a meeting chaired by Secretary Zhuang Yuequn to study and implement the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech and instructions, and to discuss disaster prevention, mitigation, and relief work.

articles.title_zh: 市六届人大常委会第三十二次会议闭幕
articles.title_en: 32nd Session of Taizhou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Concludes
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，泰州市六届人大常委会第三十二次会议闭幕，通过多项地方性法规修改决定，并任命刘子强为市监察委员会副主任、代理主任。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the 32nd session of the Taizhou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee concluded, passing decisions on local regulations and appointing Liu Ziqiang as deputy director and acting director of the Municipal Supervision Commission.

articles.title_zh: 吉林省委党的建设工作领导小组（扩大）会议召开 蒋卓庆黄强讲话
articles.title_en: Jilin Party Committee Holds Enlarged Meeting on Party Building, Jiang Zhuoqing and Huang Qiang Speak
articles.summary_zh: 8月29日，吉林省委党的建设工作领导小组（扩大）会议召开，传达学习中央精神，总结全省学习教育工作，中央指导组组长蒋卓庆和省委书记黄强讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 29, the Jilin Provincial Party Committee held an enlarged meeting of its Party Building Leading Group to convey central directives and sum up learning education, with Jiang Zhuoqing and Huang Qiang delivering speeches.

articles.title_zh: 芜湖市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Wuhu Municipal Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，芜湖市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神，听取经济运行和食品安全工作汇报，研究部署重点工作。市委书记徐志主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the Standing Committee of the Wuhu Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study important speeches and instructions of General Secretary Xi Jinping, hear reports on economic operations and food safety, and arrange key tasks. Party Secretary Xu Zhi presided.

articles.title_zh: 市委理论学习中心组学习会议召开
articles.title_en: Wuhu Municipal Party Committee Holds Theoretical Study Center Group Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，芜湖市委理论学习中心组召开学习会议，重温习近平总书记考察安徽重要讲话精神，市委书记徐志主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the Wuhu Municipal Party Committee's Theoretical Study Center Group held a meeting to review General Secretary Xi Jinping's inspection speeches in Anhui, with Party Secretary Xu Zhi presiding and delivering remarks.

articles.summary_en: On August 28, Wuxi Party Secretary Du Xiaogang chaired the city's bi-monthly meeting on major industrial projects, with Mayor Jiang Feng assigning tasks, emphasizing faster project construction and effective investment.

articles.title_zh: 市政协重点提案督办暨专题协商会议召开
articles.title_en: Wuxi CPPCC Holds Key Proposal Supervision and Consultation Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，无锡市政协召开重点提案督办暨专题协商会议，围绕支持本土企业增资扩产听取意见建议，市长蒋锋出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Wuxi CPPCC held a meeting on key proposal supervision and consultation, focusing on supporting local enterprises to expand production. Mayor Jiang Feng attended and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰会见国家金融监督管理总局陕西监管局党委书记、局长田代臣一行
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Meets Delegation Led by Tian Daichen, Party Secretary of Shaanxi Regulatory Bureau of NFRA
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，省委常委、市委书记蒿慧杰在西安会见国家金融监督管理总局陕西监管局党委书记、局长田代臣一行，双方就金融服务、风险防范等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Hao Huijie, member of the Standing Committee of the Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Xi'an Municipal Party Committee, met with Tian Daichen, Party Secretary and Director of the Shaanxi Regulatory Bureau of the National Financial Regulatory Administration, to exchange views on financial services and risk prevention.
