articles.title_en: Yancheng Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，盐城市委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，研究部署安全生产、防灾减灾等工作。市委书记严汉平主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 28, the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee held a meeting to study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and arrange work on safety production and disaster prevention. Yan Hanping, municipal party secretary, presided.

articles.title_zh: 市政府党组会议暨理论学习中心组学习会召开
articles.title_en: Yancheng Municipal Government Party Group Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，盐城市政府党组会议暨理论学习中心组学习会召开，代市长吴炜主持，学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和重要文章精神。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 28, the Yancheng Municipal Government Party Group meeting was held, chaired by acting mayor Wu Wei, to study Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and articles.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞调度全区防汛防灾工作时强调抓实抓细自然灾害防御工作
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Directs Flood and Disaster Prevention Work in Ningxia
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，宁夏回族自治区党委书记李邑飞到自治区自然资源厅调度全区防汛防灾工作，强调抓实抓细自然灾害防御，全力保障人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Li Yifei, Party secretary of Ningxia, visited the Department of Natural Resources to coordinate flood and disaster prevention, emphasizing meticulous disaster preparedness to safeguard lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 市领导到霞山区督导“两热”防控工作
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi Inspects Dengue and Chikungunya Prevention Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日上午，湛江市委副书记、市长李勇毅赴霞山区督导基孔肯雅热和登革热防控工作，强调落实消杀措施，筑牢公共卫生安全防线。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 28, Li Yongyi, deputy secretary of the Zhanjiang Municipal CPC Committee and mayor, inspected dengue and chikungunya fever prevention in Xiashan District, emphasizing disinfection measures to safeguard public health.

articles.title_zh: 市五届人大常委会召开第三十一次会议
articles.title_en: Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 31st Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，周口市五届人大常委会召开第三十一次会议，审议多项条例草案和报告，表决人事任免等事项。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the Standing Committee of the 5th Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress held its 31st session, reviewing draft regulations and reports, and voting on personnel appointments and dismissals.

articles.title_zh: 詹鹏到沈丘县调研重点项目建设和企业发展情况
articles.title_en: Zhan Peng Investigates Key Project Construction and Enterprise Development in Shenqiu County
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，周口市市长詹鹏到沈丘县调研重点项目建设和企业发展，强调高质量发展，并协调解决项目推进中的堵点难点问题。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Mayor Zhan Peng of Zhoukou visited Shenqiu County to inspect key project construction and enterprise development, emphasizing high-quality development and coordinating solutions to bottlenecks.

articles.title_zh: 詹鹏到沈丘县调研重点项目建设和企业发展情况
articles.title_en: Zhan Peng Visits Shenqiu County to Inspect Key Projects and Enterprise Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，周口市市长詹鹏到沈丘县调研重点项目建设和企业发展，强调推动项目提质增效、企业做大做强。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 28, Zhoukou Mayor Zhan Peng visited Shenqiu County to inspect key projects and enterprise development, urging higher efficiency and stronger growth.

articles.title_zh: 珠海市党政代表团赴韶关考察调研 携手推进“百千万工程”
articles.title_en: Zhuhai Delegation Visits Shaoguan to Promote 'Baiqianwan Project'
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日至28日，珠海市委书记陈勇率党政代表团赴韶关考察调研，学习当地“百千万工程”经验做法，并与韶关市委书记陈少荣交流合作，携手推进“百千万工程”实现五年显著变化。
articles.summary_en: Chen Yong led a Zhuhai delegation to Shaoguan on Aug 27-28 to learn from its 'Baiqianwan Project' experience and discuss cooperation with Shaoguan Secretary Chen Shaorong.

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐走访调研珠海外资企业
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Visits Foreign-Invested Enterprises in Zhuhai
articles.summary_zh: 近日，珠海市市长吴泽桐赴香洲区、经开区走访调研外资企业，强调以更优服务支持外资企业发展，塑造开放型经济新优势。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Zhuhai Mayor Wu Zetong visited foreign-invested enterprises in Xiangzhou and Economic Development Zone, emphasizing better services to support them and build new advantages in open economy.

articles.title_zh: 林武在临沂枣庄调研时强调 集中精力抓项目谋创新激活力 为高质量发展持续注入强劲动能
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Stresses Project Development and Innovation During Inspection in Linyi and Zaozhuang
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日至28日，山东省委书记林武在临沂市、枣庄市调研，强调要集中精力抓项目、谋创新、激活力，为高质量发展注入强劲动能。
articles.summary_en: From August 27 to 28, Lin Wu, Secretary of CPC Shandong Provincial Committee, inspected Linyi and Zaozhuang, calling for focused efforts on projects, innovation, and vitality to drive high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔在菏泽调研时强调 着力做强特色产业 推动高质量发展迈出新步伐
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Stresses Strengthening Specialty Industries During Heze Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，山东省省长周乃翔在菏泽市调研，强调要做强特色产业，推动高质量发展，并考察多个产业项目和乡村建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Shandong Governor Zhou Naixiang inspected Heze, emphasizing the need to strengthen specialty industries and promote high-quality development, visiting industrial projects and rural areas.

articles.title_zh: 中国救援队抵达西藏吉隆口岸开展搜救
articles.title_en: Chinese Rescue Team Arrives at Gyirong Port in Tibet for Search and Rescue
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日尼泊尔一侧泥石流致西藏吉隆口岸重大伤亡失联。中国救援队第一梯队28日抵达核心区展开搜救，目前尚未发现被困人员。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 26, a debris flow on the Nepalese side caused heavy casualties and missing at Gyirong Port, Tibet. The first echelon of Chinese rescue team arrived at the core area on Aug 28 for search and rescue, no trapped persons found yet.

articles.title_zh: “松哥打虎”，涉黑被抓
articles.title_en: 'Song Ge Da Hu' Arrested for Mafia-Linked Crimes
articles.summary_zh: 网红‘松哥打虎’因涉嫌组织、领导黑社会性质组织罪被公安机关抓获，案件正在侦办中。
articles.summary_en: Internet celebrity 'Song Ge Da Hu' has been arrested on suspicion of organizing and leading a mafia-like criminal organization; the case is under investigation.

articles.title_zh: 福州长乐机场T2航站楼通过对外开放省级验收
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Changle Airport T2 Terminal Passes Provincial Acceptance for International Opening
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，福州长乐国际机场T2航站楼对外开放通过省级验收，由福建省口岸办牵头的联合验收组同意通过。这是二期扩建工程的又一关键节点。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Fuzhou Changle International Airport's T2 terminal passed provincial acceptance for international opening, approved by a joint inspection team led by Fujian Provincial Port Office. This marks a key step in the airport's second-phase expansion.

articles.title_zh: 福州市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁主持召开市委常委会会议，学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话指示精神，研究贯彻落实措施，并听取海丝相关活动筹备汇报、审议产业规划。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Guo Ningning, Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Municipal Party Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to study Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and directives, discuss implementation measures, review preparations for maritime silk road events, and deliberate on an industrial plan.

articles.title_zh: 市政府党组召开扩大会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Municipal Government Party Group Holds Expanded Meeting to Study Xi's Important Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，市政府党组召开扩大会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究贯彻落实意见，市长于海田主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the Party Leadership Group of the Municipal Government held an expanded meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions and discuss implementation measures. Mayor Yu Haitian presided over and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 于海田主持召开市政府常务会议 研究群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治等事项
articles.title_en: Yu Haitian Chairs Municipal Government Executive Meeting on Rectifying Misconduct and Corruption Around the People
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，济南市市长于海田主持召开市政府常务会议，研究群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治等事项，强调严惩蝇贪蚁腐。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Jinan Mayor Yu Haitian presided over a municipal government executive meeting to address the campaign against misconduct and corruption around the people, emphasizing severe punishment for low-level corruption.

articles.title_zh: 济南召开各民主党派市委会新一届领导班子座谈会
articles.title_en: Jinan Holds Symposium for New Leadership of Municipal Democratic Parties
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，济南市召开各民主党派市委会新一届领导班子座谈会，市委书记刘强讲话，市长于海田主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Jinan held a symposium with the new leadership of municipal democratic parties. CPC Secretary Liu Qiang spoke and Mayor Yu Haitian presided.

articles.title_zh: 全国人大常委会表决通过新修订的国防动员法
articles.title_en: NPC Standing Committee Votes to Pass Revised National Defense Mobilization Law
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议表决通过新修订的国防动员法，自2026年10月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the 24th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee voted to pass the revised National Defense Mobilization Law, effective October 1, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将出席上合组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Attend SCO Summit and Pay State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 习近平主席将于8月30日至9月3日出席2026年上海合作组织峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping will attend the 2026 SCO Summit and pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt from August 30 to September 3.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席以尼罗河比喻中埃友谊
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Uses Nile Metaphor for China-Egypt Friendship
articles.summary_zh: 应埃及总统塞西邀请，国家主席习近平即将对埃及进行国事访问，并以尼罗河比喻中埃友谊。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of Egyptian President Sisi, President Xi Jinping will soon pay a state visit to Egypt, using the Nile metaphor to describe the China-Egypt friendship.

articles.title_zh: 演艺产业联盟在宁成立，40家机构携手打造江苏演艺产业高质量发展新平台
articles.title_en: Performing Arts Industry Alliance Established in Nanjing, 40 Institutions Team Up for Jiangsu's High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 演艺产业联盟在南京成立，首批40家机构加入。联盟将整合全省演艺资源，推动演艺与科技、金融、旅游等跨界融合，助力江苏演艺产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The Performing Arts Industry Alliance was established in Nanjing with 40 founding members. It will integrate provincial resources and promote cross-sector integration to boost Jiangsu's performing arts industry.

articles.title_zh: 新华社发布3分钟动画，直观解析吉隆泥石流灾害全过程
articles.title_en: Xinhua Releases 3-Minute Animation to Explain Gyirong Debris Flow Disaster Process
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，吉隆口岸遭泥石流冲击。新华社发布动画，自然资源部专家称灾害由尼泊尔冰川崩塌引发，形成冰崩—碎屑流—泥石流灾害链。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 26, a debris flow hit Gyirong Port. Xinhua released an animation; MNR experts said it was triggered by a Nepali glacier collapse, forming an ice avalanche-debris flow chain.

articles.title_zh: 跃居全球第一！中国新能源汽车正在实力“圈粉”
articles.title_en: China's NEV Exports Rank First Globally, Winning Global Fans
articles.summary_zh: 中国新能源汽车出口量跃居全球第一，增长超六倍，展现全球化布局与产业升级，正实力圈粉全球市场。
articles.summary_en: China's new energy vehicle exports have surged to world's largest, showing global expansion and industrial upgrade, winning favor in global markets.

articles.title_zh: “闽式生活”把千年文脉揉进消费场景
articles.title_en: 'Fujian-style Living' Weaves Millennium Heritage into Consumption Scenes
articles.summary_zh: 近日，“活力中国调研行”采访团走访福建泉州、漳州、厦门，体验“闽式生活”将世遗、古厝、非遗等文化资源转化为文旅消费新场景，带动福建文旅消费增长。
articles.summary_en: A research tour in Fujian explored how 'Fujian-style Living' turns cultural heritage (World Heritage sites, ancient houses, intangible culture) into new consumption scenes, boosting provincial tourism revenue.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将出席上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Attend SCO Summit and Pay State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平将于8月30日至9月3日出席在比什凯克举行的上海合作组织峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦和埃及进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping will attend the SCO summit in Bishkek from Aug 30 to Sep 3 and pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt.

articles.title_zh: 江苏“30条”新政：增动力激活力，关键在“提”字
articles.title_en: Jiangsu's 30 New Policies: Boosting Momentum and Vitality, Key is 'Improvement'
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日下午，江苏省政府召开新闻发布会，解读《关于紧抓当前提质增效推动经济持续向新向优向好发展的若干政策措施》，提出以“提”字为核心的30条新政，扩内需、强产业、优环境。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 28, the Jiangsu provincial government held a press conference to explain its 30 new policies aimed at improving quality and efficiency, boosting domestic demand, upgrading industries, and optimizing the business environment.

articles.title_zh: 政企协商会上，省长与企业家面对面谋良策、话发展、增共识
articles.title_en: Governor Meets Entrepreneurs at Consultation Forum to Discuss Development and Build Consensus
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，江苏省政协召开政企协商座谈会，省长刘小涛等与16位企业家面对面交流，共议完善现代企业制度、优化营商环境、培育世界一流企业。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 28, Jiangsu CPPCC held a gov-enterprise forum. Governor Liu Xiaotao met 16 entrepreneurs to discuss improving modern enterprise systems and building world-class enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 安徽省人大常委会督办汽车产业代表建议
articles.title_en: Anhui Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Supervises Deputy Suggestions on Auto Industry
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，安徽省人大常委会副主任韩军在合肥开展汽车产业高质量发展代表建议督办活动，走访多家企业及创新中心，强调推动产业链创新链深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Han Jun, deputy director of the Anhui Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee, led a supervision activity in Hefei on deputy suggestions for high-quality auto industry development, visiting enterprises and innovation centers and stressing deep integration of industrial and innovation chains.

articles.title_zh: 安徽未来产业拔节生长
articles.title_en: Anhui's Future Industries Flourish
articles.summary_zh: 8月29日报道，安徽布局深空探测、量子科技、机器人、氢能等未来产业，产业链规模超930亿元，形成集聚发展态势。
articles.summary_en: On August 29, Anhui's future industries including deep-space exploration, quantum technology, robotics, and hydrogen energy have formed clusters, with industrial chain scale exceeding 93 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 人民建议丨城市外宣如何更出彩？重庆市委宣传部这样回复网友
articles.title_en: Chongqing Publicity Department Responds to Netizen Suggestions on City Publicity
articles.summary_zh: 近日，重庆网友通过人民网领导留言板向市长陈新武留言，建议提升城市外宣质效。市委宣传部认真研究并公开回复。
articles.summary_en: A netizen recently left a message for Mayor Chen Xinwu via the People's Daily Online message board, suggesting improvements to city publicity. The Municipal Publicity Department studied and publicly replied.

articles.title_zh: 重庆市机构编制系统启动“强服务提质效”行动
articles.title_en: Chongqing's Institutional Staffing System Launches Action to Improve Service Quality and Efficiency
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，重庆市委编办召开动员部署会，启动“强服务提质效”行动，推动机构编制干部转作风、优服务、提效能，为现代化新重庆建设提供体制机制保障。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, the Chongqing Municipal Committee for Institutional Staffing held a mobilization meeting to launch an action to improve service quality and efficiency, promoting a shift from management-oriented to service-oriented work.

articles.title_zh: 厦门市思明区“自媒体”行业团工委成立
articles.title_en: Xiamen Siming District Establishes Youth League Working Committee for Self-Media Industry
articles.summary_zh: 近日，厦门市思明区“自媒体”行业团工委正式成立，并为两家企业党支部授牌“党团共建联系点”，旨在加强新兴领域青年组织建设。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Youth League Working Committee for the self-media industry was established in Siming District, Xiamen, with two enterprise party branches designated as co-building sites, to strengthen youth organization in emerging fields.

articles.summary_en: Luo Wen, Secretary of Hebei Provincial Party Committee, visited Xiong'an New Area and stressed building a highland for headquarters economy and one-person companies (OPC) to promote self-sustaining development.

articles.summary_en: On August 28, the Standing Committee of the Hainan Provincial Party Committee held a meeting to convey important instructions from General Secretary Xi Jinping and central meetings, deploying work on major natural disaster prevention, education on political achievements, and cultural relics protection. Feng Fei, secretary of the provincial party committee, presided over the meeting.

articles.summary_en: On August 28, Hainan Provincial Government and China State Shipbuilding Corporation signed a deepening strategic cooperation agreement in Haikou, with Provincial Party Secretary Feng Fei and Governor Liu Xiaoming meeting with CSSC Chairman Xu Peng and witnessing the signing.

articles.summary_zh: 今年上半年，七台河市经济运行稳中有进，地区生产总值增长4.6%，规上工业增加值增长12%，消费市场活力增强。
articles.summary_en: In H1, Qitaihe's economy showed steady progress, with GDP up 4.6% and above-scale industrial added value up 12%, while consumer market vitality increased.

articles.title_zh: 许勤到北大荒集团调研
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Inspects Beidahuang Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，黑龙江省委书记许勤到北大荒集团调研深化农垦改革工作，强调全面深化改革，争当现代化大农业排头兵。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, visited Beidahuang Group to investigate deepening farm reclamation reform, emphasizing comprehensive reform and striving to be a pioneer in modern large-scale agriculture.

articles.title_zh: “高标准建设海南自贸港”新闻发布会走进长春
articles.title_en: Press Conference on High-Standard Construction of Hainan Free Trade Port Held in Changchun
articles.summary_zh: 8月29日上午，海南省新闻办公室在长春举办海南自贸港专场新闻发布会，介绍封关运作成效并推介政策优势，推动琼吉合作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 29, the Hainan Provincial Information Office held a special press conference in Changchun to present the achievements of the Hainan Free Trade Port's island-wide customs closure and promote policy advantages, boosting Hainan-Jilin cooperation.

articles.summary_en: On August 29, at the 6th China New E-commerce Conference held in Jilin City, People's Daily Online launched the 'People's Benefit Travel Program' to build a nationwide cultural tourism benefit service system.

articles.summary_en: On August 28, the Department of Natural Resources of Jiangsu Province and the Provincial Data Bureau released the 2026 edition of Jiangsu standard maps, totaling 72 maps.

articles.summary_en: On August 28, the Jiangsu provincial government issued a policy document with 30 measures to boost domestic demand, upgrade industries, and support enterprises, aiming to sustain economic growth.

articles.summary_en: On August 28, the 24th meeting of the Standing Committee of Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress appointed Shi Zhijun as Vice Governor of Jiangsu Province.

articles.summary_en: Jiangsu Provincial Department of Education issued a notice on Aug 28, releasing reference standards for identifying and rectifying fire safety hazards in off-campus training venues to strengthen risk prevention.

articles.title_zh: 修水县第一人民医院挂牌九江学院第三附属医院
articles.title_en: Xiushui County First People's Hospital Unveiled as Third Affiliated Hospital of Jiujiang University

articles.summary_en: On August 28, the First People's Hospital of Xiushui County was unveiled as the Third Affiliated Hospital of Jiujiang University, marking deepened cooperation in medical education and county-level healthcare.

articles.title_zh: 长征红色故事宣讲活动启动仪式在于都举行

articles.summary_en: On August 25, the launch ceremony of the Long March red stories publicity campaign was held in Yudu, Jiangxi, with series of lectures planned from August to October.

articles.summary_en: On August 28, the Inner Mongolia Rural Construction University Alliance was established in Hohhot, initiated by the Agriculture and Education Departments with over 30 universities to support rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 学习贯彻习近平总书记对西藏日喀则市吉隆县遭受泥石流灾害作出的重要指示精神

articles.title_zh: 《平“语”近人——习近平喜欢的典故》（多语种版）将在上合组织国家主流媒体落地播出
articles.title_en: Xi's Classical Quotes (Multilingual Version) to Air on SCO Countries' Mainstream Media
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，吉尔吉斯斯坦政府机关报《吉尔吉斯斯坦言论报》头版报道，《平“语”近人——习近平喜欢的典故》（多语种版）将在上合组织国家主流媒体落地播出，多国媒体已播发相关报道。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 28, Kyrgyzstan's government newspaper front-paged that Xi Jinping's classical quotes show (multilingual version) will air on mainstream media in SCO countries, with multiple media already reporting it.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央政治局召开会议研究部署西藏日喀则市吉隆县泥石流灾害抢险救援工作
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Chairs CPC Central Political Bureau Meeting on Tibet Landslide Rescue
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局8月28日召开会议，研究部署西藏日喀则市吉隆县泥石流灾害抢险救援工作，习近平主持会议并提议默哀。会议要求全面排查风险隐患，加强动态监测预警。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the CPC Central Political Bureau held a meeting to deploy rescue efforts after a landslide in Gyirong County, Xigaze, Tibet. Xi Jinping chaired the meeting and called for risk screening and strengthened monitoring.

articles.title_zh: 西宁时代学校举行首届开学典礼
articles.title_en: Xining Times School Holds First Opening Ceremony
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，西宁时代学校举行首届开学典礼，青海省委副书记、省委教育工委书记刘奇凡出席并调研学校建设情况。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the first opening ceremony of Xining Times School was held, with Liu Qifan, Deputy Secretary of Qinghai Provincial Committee and Secretary of the Provincial Education Working Committee, attending and inspecting the school's construction.

articles.title_zh: “遇·鉴——澜湄合作源头对话”活动在西宁开幕
articles.title_en: Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Source Dialogue Opens in Xining
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日晚，“遇·鉴——澜湄合作源头对话”活动在西宁开幕，青海省委书记吴晓军致辞，省长罗东川主持，并与湄公河流域五国代表共同启动活动。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Source Dialogue opened in Xining. Qinghai Party Secretary Wu Xiaojun spoke; Governor Luo Dongchuan co-launched it with representatives from five Mekong countries.

articles.title_zh: 青海推动经济林和林下经济产业发展
articles.title_en: Qinghai Promotes Development of Economic Forests and Under-forest Economy
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，青海省林业和草原局与中国林业科学研究院签署科技合作协议，共同推进经济林、林下经济产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the Forestry and Grassland Bureau of Qinghai Province and the Chinese Academy of Forestry signed a cooperation agreement to promote the high-quality development of economic forest and under-forest economy industries.

articles.title_zh: “Hi Qinghai”・江源体验活动在西宁启动
articles.title_en: 'Hi Qinghai' Jiangyuan Experience Event Launches in Xining
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，“Hi Qinghai”・江源体验活动在青海省西宁市启动，澜湄合作源头对话嘉宾团实地调研当地产业与文化，促进区域合作。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, the 'Hi Qinghai' Jiangyuan Experience event launched in Xining, Qinghai. A delegation from the Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Source Dialogue visited local enterprises and cultural sites to promote regional cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 青海启动2026年从优秀村（社区）党组织书记中考聘乡镇（街道）事业编制人员工作
articles.title_en: Qinghai Launches 2026 Recruitment of Township (Street) Public Institution Staff from Outstanding Village (Community) Party Organization Secretaries
articles.summary_zh: 近日，青海省委组织部等部门印发通知，启动2026年从优秀村（社区）党组织书记中考聘乡镇（街道）事业编制人员工作，计划考聘80名，突出实干实绩导向。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Organization Department of the CPC Qinghai Provincial Committee and other departments issued a notice to launch the 2026 recruitment of 80 public institution staff in townships (streets) from outstanding village (community) Party organization secretaries, emphasizing a practical performance orientation.

articles.title_zh: “四川造”首款新能源捷达驶下生产线 成都基地整车产量突破700万辆
articles.title_en: First New Energy Jetta Rolls Off Production Line in Sichuan, Chengdu Base Output Exceeds 7 Million Vehicles
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，一汽大众捷达M6首台量产车在成都下线，成都基地整车产量突破700万辆，这是捷达落地四川后首款新能源车型。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the first mass-produced Jetta M6 rolled off the line in Chengdu, pushing the plant's total output over 7 million units. It is the first new energy model since Jetta's arrival in Sichuan.

articles.title_zh: 四川省人大常委会党组召开（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Sichuan Provincial People's Congress Party Group Holds Enlarged Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，四川省人大常委会党组召开（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和中央有关会议精神，研究贯彻落实措施，强调以实绩实效服务四川现代化建设。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 28, the Party Group of Sichuan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee held an enlarged meeting to convey Xi Jinping's recent speeches and central conference spirits, seeking implementation measures to serve Sichuan's modernization.

articles.title_zh: 林武在临沂枣庄市调研时强调 集中精力抓项目谋创新激活力 为高质量发展持续注入强劲动能
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Emphasizes Projects, Innovation, and Vitality During Investigation in Linyi and Zaozhuang
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日至28日，山东省委书记林武在临沂、枣庄调研，强调集中精力抓项目、谋创新、激活力，为高质量发展持续注入强劲动能。
articles.summary_en: From August 27 to 28, Lin Wu, Secretary of the Shandong Provincial Party Committee, inspected Linyi and Zaozhuang, emphasizing focused efforts on projects, innovation, and vitality to inject strong momentum into high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔在菏泽调研时强调做强特色产业推动高质量发展
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Emphasizes Strengthening Specialty Industries for High-Quality Development During Heze Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，山东省委副书记、省长周乃翔在菏泽市调研，强调做强特色产业，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Zhou Naixiang, Deputy Secretary of the Shandong Provincial Party Committee and Governor, inspected Heze and stressed strengthening specialty industries to promote high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 上海启动“上海定制”扩消费职工劳动和技能竞赛
articles.title_en: Shanghai Launches 'Shanghai Custom' Consumption Promotion Workers' Labor and Skills Competition
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，上海启动“上海定制”扩消费职工劳动和技能竞赛，以赛促训、促促销，推动“上海定制”品牌建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Shanghai launched the 'Shanghai Custom' consumption promotion workers' labor and skills competition to boost training and sales, advancing the 'Shanghai Custom' brand.

articles.title_zh: 上海首份街镇级“ESG发展白皮书”在南外滩发布
articles.title_en: Shanghai's First Street-Level "ESG Development White Paper" Released in South Bund
articles.summary_zh: 8月29日，上海市黄浦区小东门街道发布上海首份街镇级ESG发展白皮书，将ESG理念融入超大城市基层治理。
articles.summary_en: On August 29, Xiaodongmen Subdistrict of Huangpu District, Shanghai released the city's first street-level ESG development white paper, integrating ESG principles into grassroots governance of a megacity.

articles.title_zh: 陕西省智能终端产业链推介招商签约互采对接会召开
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Holds Smart Terminal Industry Promotion and Signing Event
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，陕西省智能终端产业链推介招商签约互采对接会在西安召开，省委常委、省委宣传部部长孙大光出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Shaanxi held its smart terminal industry promotion, investment, and procurement matching meeting in Xi'an. Sun Daguang, member of the Standing Committee of the Shaanxi Provincial Committee and head of the Publicity Department, attended and addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 陕西省防汛救灾和安全生产工作调度会召开
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Holds Work Coordination Meeting on Flood Prevention, Disaster Relief and Work Safety
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，陕西省召开防汛救灾和安全生产工作调度会，省委书记赵一德、省长赵刚作出批示，常务副省长王晓主持并讲话，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示，部署近期安全生产。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Shaanxi Province held a coordination meeting on flood prevention, disaster relief and work safety. Party Secretary Zhao Yide and Governor Zhao Gang made instructions, and Executive Vice Governor Wang Xiao chaired and addressed the meeting, studying and implementing Xi Jinping's important instructions and deploying recent work safety.

articles.title_zh: 金融监管总局发布房地产相关融资管理办法
articles.title_en: Financial Regulator Issues Measures on Real Estate Financing
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，国家金融监督管理总局发布商品住房开发贷款、个人住房贷款等房地产相关融资管理办法，以落实房地产发展新模式要求。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the National Financial Regulatory Administration issued measures on real estate financing, including housing development loans and personal housing loans, to implement the new model for real estate development.

articles.title_zh: 证监会发布意见支持构建房地产发展新模式
articles.title_en: CSRC Issues Opinions to Support New Model for Real Estate Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，中国证监会发布《关于资本市场支持构建房地产发展新模式的意见》，提出改革房地产开发融资方式，支持合理融资需求，防范化解房地产相关风险，促进房地产高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the China Securities Regulatory Commission issued opinions on supporting a new model for real estate development, reforming financing methods and managing risks to promote high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 新疆维吾尔自治区政府召开常务会议 安排做好防灾减灾救灾和安全生产等工作
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Regional Government Holds Executive Meeting on Disaster Prevention and Work Safety
articles.summary_zh: 28日下午，自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜主持召开自治区政府常务会议，研究部署防灾减灾救灾和安全生产工作，审议通过推动县域经济高质量发展等方案。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Aug 28, Chairman Erkin Tuniyaz chaired a regional government executive meeting to arrange disaster prevention, relief and work safety, and approved documents on county economy development.

articles.title_zh: 兵团党委常委会召开会议 研究部署防灾减灾救灾和安全生产等工作
articles.title_en: XPCC Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Deploy Disaster Prevention, Reduction, Relief and Work Safety
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，兵团党委常委会召开会议，研究部署防灾减灾救灾、安全生产及深化扫黑除恶专项斗争等工作，何忠友主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the XPCC Party Committee Standing Committee held a meeting to deploy disaster prevention, reduction, relief, work safety and the special campaign against gang crimes, chaired by He Zhongyou.

articles.title_zh: 中国首版全国几何基准影像成果发布
articles.title_en: China Issues First National Geometric Reference Image Results
articles.summary_zh: 自然资源部发布中国首版全国几何基准影像成果，统筹整合7500余座卫星导航定位基准站，实现全国统一精度遥感影像底图产品，服务数字中国建设。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Natural Resources released China's first national geometric reference image results, integrating over 7,500 satellite navigation positioning stations to create a unified-precision remote sensing image base map serving Digital China.

articles.title_zh: 重庆市政府召开第89次常务会议 陈新武主持
articles.title_en: Chongqing Municipal Government Holds 89th Executive Meeting Chaired by Chen Xinwu
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，重庆市市长陈新武主持召开市政府第89次常务会议，审议经济稳中向好政策举措、现代水网工程建设等，听取群众身边不正之风和腐败问题整治汇报。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Chongqing Mayor Chen Xinwu chaired the 89th executive meeting of the municipal government, reviewing economic stability policies, modern water network projects, and hearing reports on curbing corruption among the people.

articles.title_zh: 重庆市政协召开党组会议暨主席会议 程丽华主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Chongqing CPPCC Holds Party Group Meeting and Chairperson's Meeting, Cheng Lihua Presides
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，重庆市政协召开党组（扩大）会议暨六届八十四次主席会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和重要指示精神，研究落实工作举措。市政协党组书记、主席程丽华主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the Chongqing Municipal CPPCC held an expanded Party group meeting and the 84th Chairperson's meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions, and to discuss implementation measures. Cheng Lihua, Party secretary and chairperson of the Municipal CPPCC, presided and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 孔昌生主持召开省政协党的建设工作领导小组会议
articles.title_en: Kong Changsheng Chairs Meeting of Provincial CPPCC Party Building Leading Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，省政协主席孔昌生主持召开省政协党的建设工作领导小组会议，部署巩固拓展学习教育成果，建立树立和践行正确政绩观长效机制。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Kong Changsheng, Chairman of the Provincial CPPCC, chaired a meeting of the Party Building Leading Group to consolidate education achievements and establish a long-term mechanism for a correct view of political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委扩大会议暨省委党的建设工作领导小组会议召开
articles.title_en: Hennan Provincial Committee Holds Enlarged Standing Committee Meeting and Party Building Leadership Group Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，河南省委常委扩大会议暨省委党的建设工作领导小组会议召开，省委书记刘宁主持并讲话，强调巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the Henan Provincial Party Committee held an enlarged standing committee meeting and party building leadership group meeting. Secretary Liu Ning presided and stressed consolidating education achievements on correct political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议 刘宁主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting; Liu Ning Presides and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，省委书记刘宁主持召开省委常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记对西藏泥石流灾害的重要指示精神，部署防汛救灾工作，并传达学习中央纪委全会精神，研究社会工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning chaired a Standing Committee meeting to convey Xi Jinping's instructions on landslide disaster response, deploy flood prevention, and discuss discipline inspection and social work.

articles.title_zh: 省政协党组扩大会议和主席会议召开
articles.title_en: Provincial CPPCC Party Group and Chairman Meetings Convened
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，省政协主席孔昌生主持召开省政协党组扩大会议和主席会议，学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究贯彻落实措施和筹备省政协常委会会议等事宜。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Kong Changsheng, chairman and Party secretary of the provincial CPPCC, presided over enlarged Party group and chairman meetings to study Xi Jinping's important instructions and deliberate on implementation measures.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁会见第八次发展中国家议员研讨班一行
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Meets Delegation of 8th Developing Countries' Parliamentarians Seminar
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，河南省委书记刘宁在郑州会见第八次发展中国家议员研讨班一行，与各国议会联盟秘书长安达·菲利普及11个发展中国家的议会代表会谈，表示愿深化立法互鉴与多领域合作。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 28, Henan Party Secretary Liu Ning met in Zhengzhou with the 8th seminar delegation of parliamentarians from developing countries, including IPU Secretary General Anda Filip, expressing willingness to deepen legislative exchanges and broad cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 河北大力推动产业关键核心技术攻关
articles.title_en: Hebei Promotes Key Core Technology Breakthroughs in Industries
articles.summary_zh: 近年来，河北省探索构建“产业出题、科技答题、市场阅卷”的科技攻关机制，聚焦生物医药、高端装备制造、新材料等产业，滚动支持项目，推动关键核心技术突破。
articles.summary_en: In recent years, Hebei Province has established a collaborative mechanism for sci-tech tackling, focusing on biomedicine, high-end equipment manufacturing, advanced materials, and rolling out projects to break through key core technologies.

articles.title_zh: 弘扬“上海精神” 凝聚“上合力量”
articles.title_en: Carry Forward the Shanghai Spirit and Pool SCO Strength
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日至9月3日，国家主席习近平将出席在比什凯克举行的2026年上海合作组织峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: From August 30 to September 3, President Xi Jinping will attend the 2026 SCO Summit in Bishkek and pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt.

articles.title_en: Striving to Build the Jianghuai Granary

articles.summary_en: Anhui deepens rural reform, advances high-standard farmland and full grain industry chain, achieving growth in grain output and farmers' income in 2025.

articles.title_zh: 元首引领 中埃合作结硕果
articles.title_en: Heads of State Guide Fruitful China-Egypt Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 中埃建交70周年之际，两国元首引领推进'一带一路'与'2030愿景'对接，双方在基建、经贸、航天、文博等领域合作成果丰硕。
articles.summary_en: On the 70th anniversary of China-Egypt diplomatic ties, the two heads of state have steered the alignment of the Belt and Road Initiative with Egypt's Vision 2030, yielding fruitful cooperation in infrastructure, trade, aerospace, culture and more.

articles.title_zh: 王浩：集中精力打好陆上防御战 科学精准谋划好后续工作 坚决夺取防汛防台全面胜利
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Party Chief Wang Hao Stresses Land Defense in Typhoon Response
articles.summary_zh: 28日上午，第18号台风“沙德尔”先后在台州玉环、温州龙湾登陆，省委书记王浩在省防指主持召开防御会商调度会，强调打好陆上防御战、科学谋划后续工作。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 28, Typhoon Saudel made landfall in Zhejiang. Party Secretary Wang Hao chaired a defense coordination meeting, stressing land defense and follow-up planning.

articles.title_zh: 陈武同志生平
articles.title_en: Comrade Chen Wu's Life and Career
articles.summary_zh: 政协第十四届全国委员会副主席陈武因病于2026年8月24日在北京逝世，享年72岁。
articles.summary_en: Chen Wu, Vice Chairman of the 14th National Committee of the CPPCC, passed away in Beijing on August 24, 2026, at the age of 72.

articles.title_zh: 蒋超良一审被判死缓 曾任湖北省委书记等职
articles.title_en: Jiang Chaoliang Sentenced to Death with Reprieve in Bribery Case
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，南京市中级人民法院一审公开宣判，蒋超良因受贿7.46亿余元被判处死刑缓期二年执行，终身监禁，不得减刑、假释。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Nanjing Intermediate People's Court sentenced Jiang Chaoliang to death with a two-year reprieve for bribery of over 746 million yuan, with commutation to life imprisonment without parole.

articles.title_zh: 许利平：大国博弈下的国际变局与中国—东盟合作机遇
articles.title_en: Xu Liping: International Changes amid Great-Power Rivalry and China-ASEAN Cooperation Opportunities
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月28日，中国社科院研究员许利平在柬埔寨金边接受专访，解读大国博弈下的国际变局与中国—东盟合作机遇。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, 2026, Xu Liping, a researcher at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, gave an interview in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, sharing insights on international changes amid great-power rivalry and opportunities for China-ASEAN cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 云南省委召开换届后县（市、区）党政正职正确政绩观视频培训会
articles.title_en: Yunnan Provincial Party Committee Holds Video Training on Correct View of Political Achievements for New County Leaders
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，云南省委在昆明召开换届后县（市、区）党政正职正确政绩观视频培训会，省委书记王宁作辅导报告并讲授专题党课。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the Yunnan Provincial Party Committee held a video training session in Kunming for newly appointed county party and government heads on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements. Provincial Party Secretary Wang Ning delivered a report and a party lecture.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠在市委理论学习中心组集体学习会上强调以法治思维推进新时代民族工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui Stresses Rule of Law in Ethnic Work at Municipal Party Committee Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，长春市委书记张恩惠主持召开市委理论学习中心组集体学习会，强调以法治思维推进新时代民族工作，推动长春全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Zhang Enhui, Secretary of Changchun Municipal Party Committee, chaired a collective study session of the municipal party committee's theoretical learning center group, emphasizing rule-of-law thinking in ethnic work to promote Changchun's comprehensive revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央政治局召开会议 研究部署西藏日喀则市吉隆县泥石流灾害抢险救援工作 中共中央总书记习近平主持会议
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee Politburo Holds Meeting on Landslide Relief in Tibet's Gyirong; Xi Chairs
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，中共中央政治局召开会议，研究部署西藏日喀则市吉隆县泥石流灾害抢险救援工作，习近平主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On Aug. 28, the CPC Central Committee Politburo met to coordinate rescue efforts after a landslide in Gyirong County, Tibet. Xi Jinping chaired the meeting, which observed a moment of silence for victims.

articles.title_zh: 李强在西藏吉隆指导抢险救援和应急处置工作
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Guides Rescue and Emergency Response in Gyirong, Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，国务院总理李强受习近平总书记委托，赴西藏日喀则吉隆县指导泥石流灾害抢险救援和应急处置工作，看望受灾群众并部署救援。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Premier Li Qiang, entrusted by General Secretary Xi Jinping, visited Gyirong County in Shigatse, Tibet to guide rescue and emergency response after a mudslide, visiting affected residents and deploying relief efforts.

articles.title_zh: 多方力量向西藏吉隆县救灾一线集结 最大限度争取救援主动
articles.title_en: Multiple Forces Gather in Gyirong County, Tibet for Disaster Relief, Striving to Maximize Rescue Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日西藏日喀则市吉隆县发生泥石流灾害，各方救援力量迅速集结，全力抢险救灾，守护人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, a mudslide struck Gyirong County, Shigatse, Tibet. Multiple rescue forces gathered swiftly to conduct disaster relief and protect people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 推动构建更加公正合理的全球治理体系——习近平主席引领推动全球治理倡议走深走实
articles.title_en: Promoting a More Just and Equitable Global Governance System – President Xi Jinping Leads Global Governance Initiative Forward
articles.summary_zh: 文章综述习近平主席提出全球治理倡议一年来，从理念转化为国际实践，推动构建更加公正合理的全球治理体系，并列举中法联合声明、多边会议等具体行动。
articles.summary_en: An overview of President Xi Jinping's Global Governance Initiative over the past year, from concept to international practice, promoting a fairer global governance system, with joint statements and multilateral actions.

articles.title_zh: 多部门联合部署做好稳投资工作
articles.title_en: Multiple Departments Jointly Deploy Efforts to Stabilize Investment
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，国家发展改革委联合有关部门召开全国投资工作推进会议，研究布置重点任务，加力做好稳投资各项工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the National Development and Reform Commission, together with relevant departments, held a national investment work promotion meeting to arrange key tasks and intensify efforts to stabilize investment.

articles.title_zh: 十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议在京闭幕
articles.title_en: 14th NPC Standing Committee Concludes 24th Session in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议8月28日在北京闭幕，表决通过医疗保障法、新修订的农业法等，任命李常官为民政部部长，习近平签署主席令，赵乐际主持。
articles.summary_en: The 14th NPC Standing Committee closed its 24th session in Beijing on Aug 28, passing the Medical Security Law and revised Agriculture Law, and appointing Li Changguan as Minister of Civil Affairs. President Xi Jinping signed decrees; Zhao Leji presided.

articles.title_zh: 我国数据产业规模持续稳健增长
articles.title_en: China's Data Industry Scale Continues Steady Growth
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，国家数据发展研究院院长胡坚波在2026中国国际大数据产业博览会开幕式上介绍，截至2025年底全国数据企业达48.2万家，同比增长17.9%，数据产业规模达6.78万亿元。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Hu Jianbo, head of the National Data Development Institute, said at the opening of the 2026 China International Big Data Industry Expo that by end-2025, China had 482,000 data firms, up 17.9% YoY, with the industry scale reaching 6.78 trillion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 2026年服贸会开幕在即，这些亮点值得期待
articles.title_en: 2026 CIFTIS Opens Soon: Highlights to Look Forward To
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，国新办举行新闻发布会介绍2026年服贸会筹备情况。服贸会将于9月9日在北京首钢园开幕，约90个国家和国际组织设展，1800余家企业参展。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 28, the State Council Information Office briefed on preparations for the 2026 CIFTIS, which will open Sept 9 at Shougang Park in Beijing, with about 90 countries/international organizations and 1,800+ enterprises participating.

articles.title_zh: 习近平签署国家主席令
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Signs Presidential Orders
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平8月28日签署六项主席令，公布医疗保障法、耕地保护和质量提升法、农业法等，并任免民政部部长。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, President Xi Jinping signed six presidential orders to promulgate laws on healthcare security, farmland protection, agriculture, and national defense mobilization, and to appoint a new minister of civil affairs.

articles.title_zh: 王毅会见美国驻华大使庞德伟
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets US Ambassador to China Pang Dewei
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅26日在北京会见美国驻华大使庞德伟，双方就落实两国元首共识、筹备高层互动等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, met with US Ambassador to China Pang Dewei in Beijing on August 26. They exchanged views on implementing the consensus of the two heads of state and preparing for high-level interactions.

articles.title_zh: 蒋冰主持召开市委专题会议
articles.title_en: Jiang Bing Chairs Dandong Municipal Party Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，丹东市委书记蒋冰主持召开市委专题会议，研究推进重大项目及重点工程建设工作。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 27, Dandong Party Secretary Jiang Bing chaired a special meeting to advance major projects and key construction.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林在大连市长海县调研
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Visits Changhai County in Dalian for Research
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日至27日，辽宁省委书记许昆林到大连市长海县调研，强调发展海洋产业、保护生态、建设和美海岛，并考察渔港、医院等。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 25 to 27, Xu Kunlin, Secretary of CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee, visited Changhai County, Dalian, stressing marine industry development, ecological protection, and building beautiful islands. He inspected fishing ports, hospitals, and local enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 市十七届人大常委会召开第三十五次会议
articles.title_en: Seventeenth Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 35th Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，鹤岗市十七届人大常委会召开第三十五次会议，听取审议预算执行和调整报告，接受两名副市长辞呈并通过人事任免。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the Standing Committee of the 17th Hegang Municipal People's Congress held its 35th meeting to review budget execution and adjustment reports, accept resignations of two vice mayors, and approve personnel appointments.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱主持召开市委常委会会议并讲话
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Chairs Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话、重要指示和重要文章精神，研究贯彻落实意见，部署相关工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Wang Xingzhu, secretary of the Hegang Municipal Party Committee, chaired a Standing Committee meeting to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions, and to arrange related work.

articles.title_zh: 市长顾坤开展巡河并现场推进水生态环境治理工作
articles.title_en: Mayor Gu Kun Inspects Rivers and Promotes Water Ecological Governance
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，淮安市市长顾坤到涟水县、清江浦区开展巡河并推进水生态环境治理，强调贯彻习近平生态文明思想，提升河湖治理保护水平。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, Mayor Gu Kun of Huai'an inspected rivers in Lianshui County and Qingjiangpu District to advance water ecological governance, emphasizing the implementation of Xi Jinping's thought on ecological civilization and improving river-lake protection.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会党组理论学习中心组开展“践行嘱托要求，助力共同富裕”第二次现场研学活动
articles.title_en: Huaian People's Congress Standing Committee Party Group Conducts Study Activity on Common Prosperity
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日至27日，淮安市人大常委会党组理论学习中心组开展现场研学活动，学习大运河保护重要指示精神，并召开研学交流会部署地方人大工作。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 26 to 27, the Party Group of Huaian Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee conducted an on-site study activity on Grand Canal protection and held a meeting to discuss local people's congress work.

articles.title_zh: 市领导开展巡河并现场推进水生态环境治理工作
articles.title_en: City Leaders Conduct River Inspections and Promote Water Ecological Environment Improvement
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，淮安市市长顾坤到涟水县、清江浦区巡河，现场推进水生态环境治理，强调系统施策、落实河湖长制，确保断面水质达标。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, Mayor Gu Kun of Huai'an inspected rivers in Lianshui and Qingjiangpu districts, promoting water ecological environment improvement and emphasizing systematic governance and implementation of the river chief system.

articles.title_zh: 市十七届人大常委会召开第四十一次主任会议
articles.title_en: The 17th Huainan Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Its 41st Directors' Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日下午，淮南市人大常委会主任陈儒江主持召开第四十一次主任会议，决定9月上中旬召开市十七届人大常委会第三十七次会议，并听取多项工作报告。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 27, Chen Rujiang, director of Huainan Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, chaired the 41st directors' meeting, deciding to hold the 37th session in early-mid September and reviewing various reports.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保到榕城区调研古城保育活化工作
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao Inspects Ancient City Preservation in Rongcheng District
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日上午，揭阳市委书记曾风保到榕城区调研古城保育活化工作，强调以“绣花”功夫守护千年古城文脉。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 27, Zeng Fengbao, Secretary of Jieyang Municipal Party Committee, visited Rongcheng District to inspect preservation work, emphasizing meticulous efforts to protect the ancient city's heritage.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保到榕城区调研古城保育活化工作
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao Investigates Ancient City Preservation in Rongcheng District
articles.summary_zh: 27日上午，揭阳市委书记曾风保到榕城区调研古城保育活化工作，强调坚持修旧如旧、以'绣花'功夫守护千年古城文脉。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Aug 27, Zeng Fengbao, Secretary of the Jieyang Municipal Party Committee, inspected the preservation and revitalization of the ancient city in Rongcheng District, emphasizing meticulous restoration to protect its cultural heritage.

articles.title_zh: 广东海事局与揭阳市人民政府签订战略合作框架协议
articles.title_en: Guangdong Maritime Safety Administration and Jieyang Municipal Government Sign Strategic Cooperation Framework Agreement
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，广东海事局与揭阳市人民政府签订战略合作框架协议，开启海事与地方协同发展新篇章。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Guangdong Maritime Safety Administration and Jieyang Municipal People's Government signed a strategic cooperation framework agreement, opening a new chapter of coordination between maritime and local development.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席出席上合组织峰会并访问吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及前瞻
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Attends SCO Summit and Pays State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平将于8月30日至9月3日出席在比什凯克举行的上海合作组织峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问，共商合作大计。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping will attend the SCO Summit in Bishkek and pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt from Aug 30 to Sep 3, promoting cooperation and development.

articles.title_zh: 严金海在山南市洛扎县、措美县调研乡村振兴和基层党组织建设
articles.title_en: Yan Jinhai Visits Lhozhag and Comai Counties to Research Rural Revitalization and Grassroots Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日至27日，西藏自治区党委副书记、自治区人大常委会主任严金海在山南市洛扎县、措美县调研乡村振兴、产业发展、基层党组织建设等，强调要打造藏南边陲种养富民、善治安边的示范样板。
articles.summary_en: From August 26 to 27, Yan Jinhai, Deputy Secretary of the Tibet Regional Party Committee and Director of the Regional People's Congress Standing Committee, visited Lhozhag and Comai counties in Shannan to research rural revitalization, industrial development and grassroots party building, urging to build a model of border prosperity and good governance.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将出席上合组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Attend SCO Summit and Visit Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平将于8月30日至9月3日出席在比什凯克举行的上海合作组织峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping will attend the SCO Summit in Bishkek and pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt from August 30 to September 3.

articles.title_zh: 向空图强 育新提质 全力打造环渤海低空经济发展标杆
articles.title_en: Soaring to the Sky, Cultivating New Quality: Building Panjin into a Bohai Rim Low-Altitude Economy Benchmark
articles.summary_zh: 盘锦市交通运输局发布低空经济调研报告，梳理基础设施建设、场景应用及产业集聚成效，提出搭建智能调度平台、贯通产业链等路径，全力打造环渤海低空经济标杆城市。
articles.summary_en: The Panjin Municipal Transportation Bureau issued a research report on the low-altitude economy, reviewing infrastructure, applications and industrial clustering, and proposing measures such as building an intelligent dispatching platform and completing the industrial chain, aiming to make Panjin a Bohai Rim low-altitude economy benchmark.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Panjin Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，盘锦市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和指示精神，研究贯彻落实工作，部署经济、民生、防灾等任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the Panjin Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee held a meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions, and deploy work on economic development, livelihood, and disaster prevention.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将出席2026年上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Attend 2026 SCO Summit and Pay State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 外交部发言人宣布，国家主席习近平将于8月30日至9月3日出席在比什凯克举行的上海合作组织峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: The Foreign Ministry spokesperson announced that President Xi Jinping will attend the SCO summit in Bishkek and pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt from Aug 30 to Sep 3.

articles.title_zh: 严金海在山南洛扎、措美调研时强调：以党建为引领、以产业为支撑，打造藏南边陲示范样板
articles.title_en: Yan Jinhai Inspects Shannan, Stresses Building Demonstration Model in Southern Tibet Border Area
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日至27日，自治区党委副书记、人大常委会主任严金海在山南市洛扎县、措美县调研，强调以党建为引领、以产业为支撑，打造藏南边陲种养富民、善治安边的示范样板。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 26 to 27, Yan Jinhai, deputy secretary of the regional Party committee and chairman of the regional people's congress standing committee, visited Lhozhag and Comai counties in Shannan, stressing party building-led industry support to create a demonstration model.

articles.title_zh: 生命至上闻令而动，最大限度减少伤亡
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Orders All-Out Rescue After Tibet Mudslide Casualties
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，西藏吉隆县发生泥石流灾害，造成重大人员伤亡和失联。习近平总书记作出重要指示，各方全力开展抢险救援。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, a mudslide in Gyirong County, Tibet caused heavy casualties and missing people. Following President Xi Jinping's instructions, rescue efforts are underway to minimize losses.

articles.title_zh: 受习近平总书记委托，李强抵达西藏吉隆指导抢险救灾工作
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Arrives in Jilong, Tibet to Guide Disaster Relief Work on Behalf of General Secretary Xi Jinping
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日下午，李强总理受习近平总书记委托，抵达西藏吉隆县泥石流受灾区域，指导抢险救灾工作，看望抢险救援人员和受灾安置群众。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 27, Premier Li Qiang, on behalf of General Secretary Xi Jinping, arrived at the mudslide disaster area in Jilong County, Tibet, to guide relief work and visit rescue workers and affected residents.

articles.title_zh: 2026年汕头市党外人士暑期座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Shantou Holds 2026 Summer Symposium for Non-Party Personages
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日下午，汕头市召开2026年党外人士暑期座谈会，市委书记庄悦群主持并讲话，听取各民主党派意见建议。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 27, Shantou held the 2026 summer symposium for non-party personages. Municipal Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn presided and delivered a speech, listening to suggestions from democratic parties.

articles.title_zh: 陈良贤带队莅汕调研
articles.title_en: Chen Liangxian Leads Delegation to Shantou for Research
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，广东省政府党组成员陈良贤到汕头调研爱国卫生运动、医疗卫生项目建设和特色农业产业，强调改善人居环境、提升中医药服务、做优特色农业。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Chen Liangxian, member of the Party Leadership Group of Guangdong Provincial Government, visited Shantou to investigate patriotic health campaigns, medical construction, and specialty agriculture.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群到市税务局调研
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Visits Municipal Tax Bureau for Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日上午，汕头市委书记庄悦群到市税务局调研，强调强化税收征管、提升服务效能，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 27, Zhuang Yuequn, Secretary of the Shantou Municipal Party Committee, visited the Municipal Tax Bureau to emphasize strengthening tax collection and improving service efficiency to promote high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰率队拜访省交通运输厅、省交通集团 加快革命老区综合交通体系高质量发展
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Leads Delegation to Visit Provincial Transport Department and Transport Group to Accelerate High-Quality Development of Comprehensive Transport System in Old Revolutionary Base Area
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，汕尾市委书记逯峰率队赴广州拜访省交通运输厅、省交通集团，就推进“十五五”汕尾交通基础设施建设等进行座谈交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Lu Feng, Secretary of Shanwei Municipal Party Committee, led a delegation to Guangzhou to visit the Provincial Department of Transport and the Provincial Transport Group, discussing the promotion of Shanwei's transportation infrastructure during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰率队拜访省交通运输厅、省交通集团 加快革命老区综合交通体系高质量发展
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Leads Delegation to Visit Provincial Transport Department and Guangdong Transportation Group to Accelerate High-Quality Development of Comprehensive Transport System in Old Revolutionary Base Areas
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，汕尾市委书记逯峰率队赴广州拜访省交通运输厅、省交通集团，就“十五五”交通基础设施建设等座谈交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Lu Feng, Secretary of Shanwei Municipal Party Committee, led a delegation to Guangzhou to visit the Provincial Department of Transportation and Guangdong Transportation Group for talks on transport infrastructure development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 汕尾市八届人大常委会第四十七次会议召开
articles.title_en: Shanwei Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Convenes 47th Session
articles.summary_zh: 会议审议通过国民经济与预算调整方案，修改九项地方性法规，并作出人事任免事项。
articles.summary_en: The 47th meeting of Shanwei Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee approved adjustments to economic plans and fiscal budget, amended nine local regulations, and made personnel decisions.

articles.title_zh: 自治区政府召开常务会议
articles.title_en: Autonomous Region Government Holds Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，自治区主席张雨浦主持召开自治区政府常务会议，研究国防动员建设、中央巡视反馈意见整改、自然灾害调查评估及部分“十五五”专项规划编制等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Chairman Zhang Yupu presided over the regional government executive meeting to discuss national defense mobilization, rectification of inspection feedback, natural disaster assessment, and the compilation of some 15th Five-Year Plan special programs.

articles.title_zh: 杨洪涛会见民主党派市委会离任老主委
articles.title_en: Yang Hongtao Meets Retired Chairpersons of Democratic Party Municipal Committees
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，中共泰安市委书记杨洪涛会见民主党派市委会离任老主委，向他们致以敬意和感谢。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Yang Hongtao, Secretary of the CPC Tai'an Municipal Committee, met with retired chairpersons of the democratic party municipal committees, expressing respect and gratitude.

articles.title_zh: 李国强主持召开市人民政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Li Guoqiang Chairs Municipal People's Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日上午，泰安市长李国强主持召开市政府常务会议，审议通过《泰安市参加重大竞技体育比赛奖励办法》，研究文旅安全生产等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 27, Tai'an Mayor Li Guoqiang chaired a municipal government executive meeting, approving the reward measures for major competitive sports competitions and discussing cultural tourism safety.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神 研究高标准农田建设突出问题整治等工作事项
articles.title_en: Taian City Party Committee Meeting Convenes to Convey Xi Jinping's Instructions and Study Farmland Rectification
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究高标准农田建设突出问题整治等工作，市委书记杨洪涛主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, the Taian Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met to convey Xi Jinping's important instructions and discuss rectification of high-standard farmland issues. Yang Hongtao, municipal party secretary, presided and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬调研教育工作并检查开学准备情况
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Investigates Education Work and Checks School Opening Preparations
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬调研教育工作，实地检查多所学校开学准备情况，强调办好人民满意的教育。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Jiang Dongdong, Secretary of the Taizhou Municipal Party Committee, inspected education work and school opening preparations, stressing quality education for the people.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬调研教育工作并检查开学准备情况
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Inspects Education Work and School Opening Preparations
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬调研教育工作并检查秋季开学准备，强调办好人民满意的教育。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Jiang Dongdong, Secretary of the Taizhou Municipal Party Committee, inspected education work and the preparations for the fall semester, stressing the importance of satisfying education for the people.

articles.title_zh: 全市服务业大会召开
articles.title_en: Weihai Holds Citywide Service Industry Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，威海市服务业大会召开，市委书记张海波出席并讲话，市长孔凡萍主持，会议部署服务业高质量发展重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Weihai held its citywide service industry conference. Party Secretary Zhang Haibo delivered a speech and Mayor Kong Fanping presided over the meeting, deploying key tasks for the high-quality development of the service industry.

articles.title_zh: 孔凡萍会见韩国锦湖石油化学集团客人
articles.title_en: Kong Fanping Meets with Guests from Kumho Petrochemical
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，威海市市长孔凡萍会见韩国锦湖石油化学集团会长朴赞求一行，双方就合成橡胶、新能源电池材料等领域合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Weihai Mayor Kong Fanping met with Kumho Petrochemical Chairman Park Chan-koo and his delegation, discussing cooperation in synthetic rubber and new energy battery materials.

tags.name_en: Economic and Trade Cooperation with South Korea

tags_en: Economic and Trade Cooperation with South Korea

articles.title_zh: 孔凡萍会见韩国锦湖石油化学集团会长朴赞求
articles.title_en: Kong Fanping Meets Chairman of South Korea's Kumho Petrochemical Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，威海市市长孔凡萍会见韩国锦湖石化集团会长朴赞求，双方就深化经贸合作、拓展新材料新能源领域合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Kong Fanping, Mayor of Weihai, met with Park Chan-gu, Chairman of South Korea's Kumho Petrochemical Group, to discuss deepening economic and trade cooperation in new materials and new energy.

articles.title_zh: 全市服务业大会召开
articles.title_en: Weihai Holds Municipal Service Industry Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，威海市服务业大会召开，市委书记张海波出席并讲话，强调构建优质高效服务业新体系，推动服务业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Weihai held its municipal service industry conference; Party Secretary Zhang Haibo stressed building a high-quality service industry system and promoting high-quality development of the service sector.

articles.title_zh: 市政协十四届五十九次主席会议暨市政协党组理论学习中心组学习（扩大）会议召开
articles.title_en: Wuhu CPPCC Holds 59th Chairman Meeting and Party Group Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，芜湖市政协十四届五十九次主席会议暨党组理论学习中心组学习（扩大）会议召开，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 27, the 59th Chairman Meeting of Wuhu Municipal CPPCC and Party Group Study (Expanded) Session was held to convey Xi Jinping's important speeches and arrange key work.

articles.title_zh: 中共西安市委十四届十一次全会举行
articles.title_en: 11th Plenary Session of 14th Xi'an Municipal Party Committee Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，中国共产党西安市第十四届委员会第十一次全体会议举行，审议通过区域发展战略实施意见，部署重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, the 11th Plenary Session of the 14th Xi'an Municipal Party Committee was held, reviewing and approving implementation opinions on regional development strategy and deploying key tasks.

tags.name_en: Xi'an Municipal Committee of the CPC

tags_en: Xi'an Municipal Committee of the CPC

articles.title_zh: 中共西安市委十四届十一次全会举行
articles.title_en: Xi'an Municipal Party Committee Holds 11th Plenary Session of 14th Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，中共西安市委十四届十一次全会举行，审议通过区域发展战略实施意见，部署重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, the 11th Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Xi'an Municipal Committee was held, reviewing and approving an implementation plan for regional development strategy and deploying key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 魏建平调研文物保护利用及文旅融合发展工作
articles.title_en: Wei Jianping Inspects Cultural Relic Protection and Cultural-Tourism Integration
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，新乡市委书记魏建平到平原示范区、原阳县调研文物保护利用及文旅融合发展工作，强调推动文物活态化传承，建设文旅强市。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Wei Jianping, Secretary of Xinxiang Municipal Party Committee, inspected cultural relic protection and cultural-tourism integration in Pingyuan Demonstration Zone and Yuanyang County, emphasizing dynamic heritage preservation and building a strong cultural-tourism city.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平会见丹麦驻上海总领事严慕白
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Meets Danish Consul General in Shanghai
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，市委书记严汉平在盐城会见丹麦驻上海总领事严慕白一行，双方就现代农业、绿色能源等领域合作展开交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Yan Hanping, Party Secretary of Yancheng, met with Danish Consul General in Shanghai Yan Mubai and his delegation to discuss cooperation in modern agriculture and green energy.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市与国家统计局江苏调查总队签署合作协议
articles.title_en: Yancheng Signs Cooperation Agreement with Jiangsu Survey Team of NBS
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，盐城市与国家统计局江苏调查总队签署合作框架协议，市委书记严汉平、总队长安平年出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Yancheng signed a cooperation framework agreement with the Jiangsu Survey Team of the National Bureau of Statistics; Party Secretary Yan Hanping and Team Leader An Pingnian attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 我市举行学习贯彻习近平党建思想主题宣讲活动
articles.title_en: Yangjiang Holds Publicity Activity on Xi Jinping's Party Building Thought
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，阳江市在广东广青金属科技有限公司举行“漠阳儿女心向党”学习贯彻习近平党建思想主题宣讲活动，120余名党员干部和企业职工参加。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Yangjiang held a publicity event on Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building at Guangdong Guangqing Metal Technology Co., Ltd., with over 120 party members and enterprise employees attending.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会开展《广东省优化营商环境条例》执法检查
articles.title_en: Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Inspects Implementation of Guangdong Business Environment Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日至27日，市人大常委会常务副主任李宗瑞率执法检查组对全市贯彻实施《广东省优化营商环境条例》情况开展执法检查，要求优化政务服务环境。
articles.summary_en: From August 26 to 27, Li Zongrui, executive deputy director of the Standing Committee of the Municipal People's Congress, led an inspection team to check the implementation of the regulations, demanding better government services.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉调研葡萄酒产业发展及闽宁镇高质量发展
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Surveys Wine Industry Development and Minning Town High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉调研葡萄酒产业发展及闽宁镇高质量发展，强调发展特色优势产业，打造新时代闽宁协作“升级版”。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Zhao Xuhui, member of the Standing Committee of the Regional Party Committee and Secretary of the Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee, surveyed the wine industry and Minning Town's high-quality development, stressing the growth of specialty industries and an upgraded version of East-West cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 市十七届人大常委会召开第九十三次主任会议
articles.title_en: Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 93rd Director Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，营口市十七届人大常委会召开第九十三次主任会议，史卫东主持，研究确定第四十二次会议安排。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, the 93rd director meeting of the 17th Yingkou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee was held, chaired by Shi Weidong, discussing arrangements for the 42nd session.

articles.title_zh: 习近平对西藏日喀则市吉隆县遭受泥石流灾害作出重要指示
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Gives Important Instructions on Debris Flow Disaster in Shigatse, Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，西藏日喀则市吉隆县因尼泊尔一侧泥石流灾害造成重大人员伤亡失联，习近平作出重要指示要求千方百计搜救，李强作出批示。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, a debris flow from Nepal caused heavy casualties at Gyirong Port in Tibet. Xi Jinping gave important instructions to spare no effort in search and rescue, and Li Qiang made instructions.

articles.title_zh: 中国人民银行营口市分行发布江泽民诞辰100周年普通纪念币分配公告
articles.title_en: Yingkou Branch of People's Bank of China Issues Distribution Announcement for 100th Anniversary Commemorative Coin of Jiang Zemin
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月28日，中国人民银行营口市分行公告江泽民诞辰100周年普通纪念币预约兑换事项，预约期为8月31日至9月1日。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, 2026, the Yingkou Branch of the People's Bank of China announced the reservation and exchange of the ordinary commemorative coin for the 100th anniversary of Jiang Zemin's birth, with reservation from Aug 31 to Sep 1.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会党组召开（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Municipal People's Congress Party Group Holds Enlarged Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，市人大常委会党组书记、主任史卫东主持召开党组（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记对巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果、基础教育和侨务工作的重要指示精神，研究贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Shi Weidong, Secretary of the Party Leadership Group and Director of the Standing Committee of the Municipal People's Congress, chaired an enlarged meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on consolidating the achievements of education on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements, basic education, and overseas Chinese affairs, and to plan implementation.

articles.title_zh: 市十七届人大常委会第四十二次会议将于9月下旬召开
articles.title_en: Yingkou's 17th People's Congress Standing Committee to Hold 42nd Meeting in Late September
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，营口市十七届人大常委会召开第九十三次主任会议，决定第四十二次会议于9月下旬召开，建议审议政府债务、交通管理、文旅融合等多项报告。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 27, the 93rd director meeting of Yingkou's 17th People's Congress Standing Committee decided that its 42nd session will be held in late September, with agendas including reports on government debt, traffic management, and cultural-tourism integration.

articles.title_zh: 市政协召开党组会议暨九届第五十五次主席（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Yueyang CPPCC Holds Party Group Meeting and 55th Chairperson (Enlarged) Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，岳阳市政协主席汪涛主持召开市政协党组会议暨九届第五十五次主席（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，审议多项调研报告和协商议题。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Wang Tao, chairman of the Yueyang Municipal CPPCC, chaired a party group meeting and the 55th chairperson (enlarged) meeting to convey Xi Jinping's important speeches and review research reports and consultative topics.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Chairs Meeting of Yueyang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，湖南省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究贯彻意见，审议改革试点方案。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Xie Weijiang, Deputy Secretary of the Hunan Provincial Committee and Secretary of the Yueyang Municipal Committee, chaired a meeting of the standing committee to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech and study implementation measures.

articles.title_zh: 陈飞率队来岳调研
articles.title_en: Chen Fei Leads Delegation to Yueyang for Field Research
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，省人大常委会副主任陈飞率队赴岳阳县调研灌溉沟渠畅通问题，强调高标准农田建设，保障粮食安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Chen Fei, Deputy Director of the Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee, led a team to Yueyang County to inspect irrigation canal problems and emphasized high-standard farmland construction to ensure food security.

articles.title_zh: 2026年湛江市党外人士暑期座谈会召开
articles.title_en: 2026 Zhanjiang Summer Forum for Non-Party Personages Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日上午，湛江市党外人士暑期座谈会召开，市委书记余钢主持并讲话，市长李勇毅通报经济形势，各民主党派和工商联代表建言献策。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Aug 27, the 2026 Zhanjiang Summer Forum for Non-Party Personages was held. Party Secretary Yu Gang chaired and spoke, Mayor Li Yongyi briefed the economic situation, and representatives from democratic parties and federations offered suggestions.

articles.title_zh: 湛江市促进两大国家战略联动发展动员部署会召开
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Holds Mobilization Meeting on Coordinated Development of Two National Strategies
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日下午，湛江市召开促进两大国家战略联动发展动员部署会，市委书记余钢等出席并讲话，部署对接粤港澳大湾区和海南自贸港建设。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 27, Zhanjiang held a mobilization meeting to promote the coordinated development of two national strategies, with municipal Party secretary Yu Gang attending and speaking, deploying integration with the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area and Hainan Free Trade Port.

articles.title_zh: 省委横琴工委召开2026年度第22次会议 以更实举措推进横琴粤澳深度合作区第二阶段建设
articles.title_en: Provincial Hengqin Working Committee Holds 22nd Meeting in 2026 to Advance Second Phase of Hengqin-Macau Deep Cooperation Zone
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，受珠海市委书记陈勇委托，省委横琴工委副书记聂新平主持召开省委横琴工委2026年度第22次会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，部署横琴粤澳深度合作区第二阶段建设。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 27, entrusted by Zhuhai Party Secretary Chen Yong, Deputy Secretary Nie Xinping chaired the 22nd meeting of the Provincial Hengqin Working Committee to convey Xi Jinping's important speeches and arrange the second-phase construction of the Hengqin-Macau Cooperation Zone.

articles.title_zh: 淄博市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Standing Committee of Zibo Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，淄博市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记对西藏泥石流灾害的重要指示精神，研究经济运行工作，市委书记马晓磊主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 27, the Standing Committee of Zibo Municipal Party Committee met to convey Xi Jinping's instructions on the Tibet mudslide and discuss economic work. Ma Xiaolei chaired and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 第十六届中国国际数字出版博览会主论坛举行
articles.title_en: Main Forum of 16th China International Digital Publishing Expo Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，第十六届中国国际数字出版博览会主论坛在济南举行，中宣部副部长姜辉、山东省长周乃翔出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 27, the main forum of the 16th China International Digital Publishing Expo was held in Jinan. Jiang Hui, deputy head of the CPC Publicity Department, and Zhou Naixiang, governor of Shandong, attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 外交部回应泥石流伤亡人员国籍构成：还在核实中
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: Nationalities of Mudslide Victims Still Being Verified
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月28日，外交部就西藏吉隆泥石流灾害伤亡人员国籍构成问题回应称，相关信息正在核实中。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, 2026, the Foreign Ministry responded to queries about the nationalities of casualties in the Jilong mudslide in Tibet, stating that relevant information is still being verified.

articles.title_zh: 三部门：完善商品住房预售管理，有力有序推行商品住房现房销售
articles.title_en: Three Departments Improve Pre-sale Management and Promote Spot Sales of Commercial Housing
articles.summary_zh: 住房城乡建设部、自然资源部、金融监管总局联合印发通知，规范预售条件、加强资金监管，并推行现房销售。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Housing, MNR and NFRA jointly issued a notice to regulate pre-sale conditions, strengthen fund supervision, and promote spot sales.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development
Reform of Commercial Housing Sales System

tags_en: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development
Reform of Commercial Housing Sales System

articles.title_zh: 首批救援队伍抵达吉隆口岸核心位置，开展排查搜救
articles.title_en: First Rescue Team Arrives at Core Area of Gyirong Port for Search and Rescue
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月28日，首批救援队伍抵达西藏吉隆口岸核心位置，开展排查搜救。此前吉隆发生泥石流，已致5人遇难、558人失联。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, 2026, the first batch of rescue teams arrived at the core area of Gyirong Port in Tibet to conduct search and rescue operations. A previous mudslide there left 5 dead and 558 missing.

articles.title_zh: 西藏吉隆泥石流已致5人遇难、558人失联
articles.title_en: Gyirong Mudslide in Tibet Kills 5, 558 Missing
articles.summary_zh: 据西藏自治区应急管理厅消息，截至28日15时，吉隆泥石流灾害已造成5人遇难，558人失联，其中外籍人员260人，救援正在进行。
articles.summary_en: As of 3 p.m. on Aug 28, the mudslide disaster in Gyirong, Tibet has left 5 dead and 558 missing, including 260 foreigners. Rescue operations are underway.
