tags.name_en: Emergency Management Department of Tibet Autonomous Region

tags_zh: 西藏自治区应急管理厅
tags_en: Emergency Management Department of Tibet Autonomous Region

articles.title_zh: 探访“雄安之眼”：一座数字新城的算力底座
articles.title_en: Exploring 'Xiong'an Eye': The Computing Power Foundation of a Digital New City
articles.summary_zh: 长城网探访雄安城市计算中心，该中心提供通算、智算、超算服务，已服务200多个业务系统，为数字雄安构筑算力底座。
articles.summary_en: Changcheng Net visited the Xiong'an Urban Computing Center, which provides general, AI, and supercomputing services, supporting over 200 business systems and building the computing power foundation for digital Xiong'an.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行丨看三个文化IP如何盘活文化家底
articles.title_en: Vibrant China Tour: Three Cultural IPs Revitalize Cultural Heritage
articles.summary_zh: 近日，记者走访山东淄博、潍坊，探访淄博琉璃、坊茨小镇、1532文化产业园三个文化IP，它们通过技艺创新、影视出圈和工业遗存活化，让老文化焕发新活力。
articles.summary_en: Reporters visited Zibo and Weifang, Shandong, to explore three cultural IPs—Zibo colored glaze, Fangzi Town, and 1532 Cultural Industry Park—which are revitalizing heritage through craft innovation, TV-series driven tourism, and industrial site reuse.

articles.title_zh: 福州市委常委会召开会议学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁主持市委常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，听取海上丝绸之路相关活动筹备汇报，并审议新兴产业规划。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, Guo Ningning, deputy secretary of the provincial party committee and Fuzhou party secretary, chaired a standing committee meeting to study Xi Jinping's important speech, review preparations for Maritime Silk Road events, and discuss emerging industry plans.

articles.title_zh: “上海精神”引领上合组织行稳致远
articles.title_en: 'Shanghai Spirit' Guides SCO's Steady Progress
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平将于8月30日至9月3日出席在比什凯克举行的上海合作组织峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping will attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organization Summit in Bishkek from Aug 30 to Sep 3 and pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt.

articles.title_zh: 习言道｜始终为人民利益和幸福而努力工作
articles.title_en: Xi's Quote: Always Work for the People's Interests and Happiness
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记近日作出重要指示，强调树立和践行正确政绩观是长期任务，要求党员干部立党为公、为民造福、真抓实干，努力创造经得起检验的实绩。
articles.summary_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping recently made an important instruction, emphasizing that establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements is a long-term task, requiring Party members and officials to serve the public, benefit the people, and work in a down-to-earth manner.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席将出席上合峰会并访问吉尔吉斯斯坦和埃及
articles.title_en: President Xi to Attend SCO Summit and Visit Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平将于8月30日至9月3日出席在比什凯克举行的上海合作组织峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦和埃及进行国事访问；自2013年以来，他多次阐述深化上合务实合作的主张。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping will attend the SCO summit in Bishkek from Aug 30 to Sep 3 and pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt, highlighting his long-standing call for practical cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 曾赞荣调研创新型产业发展工作时强调：锚定智能化绿色化融合化方向 加快推动产业体系实现升级发展
articles.title_en: Zeng Zanrong Inspects Innovative Industry Development, Stresses Smart, Green and Integrated Upgrades
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日上午，青岛市委书记曾赞荣到市南区、市北区调研创新型产业发展，强调锚定智能化、绿色化、融合化方向，加快推动产业体系升级。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Aug 28, Zeng Zanrong, Party secretary of Qingdao, inspected innovative industries in Shinan and Shibei districts, stressing smart, green and integrated development.

articles.title_zh: “四川造”新能源汽车又上新，产业“下半场”怎么拼
articles.title_en: Sichuan-Made NEVs Debut as Industry Enters 'Second Half'
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，捷达M6首台车在成都下线并庆祝成都基地达成700万辆产量，标志四川新能源汽车产业加速布局，新车型接连量产。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the first Jetta M6 rolled off the line in Chengdu, marking the 7-million-unit milestone for the Chengdu base and signaling Sichuan's accelerated push in the NEV industry.

articles.title_zh: 王浩在台风“沙德尔”防御工作会商调度会议上强调坚决夺取防汛防台全面胜利
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Chairs Meeting on Typhoon Sader Defense, Stresses Winning Flood Control
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日上午，浙江省委书记王浩在省防指主持召开台风“沙德尔”防御工作会商调度会，强调打好陆上防御战，科学谋划后续工作，坚决夺取防汛防台全面胜利。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 28, Wang Hao, Secretary of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee, chaired a meeting on typhoon Sader defense, stressing land-based defense and follow-up work to secure full victory in flood and typhoon prevention.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷会见美国联邦参议员戴安斯一行
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Meets U.S. Senator Steve Daines and Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 28日下午，浙江省长刘捷在杭州会见美国联邦参议员戴安斯一行，双方表示将加强产业科创、贸易投资等领域合作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Aug. 28, Zhejiang Governor Liu Jie met with U.S. Senator Steve Daines and his delegation in Hangzhou. Both sides pledged to enhance cooperation in industry, sci-tech innovation, trade and investment.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议召开 决定任命史志军为省政府副省长
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 24th Session, Appoints Shi Zhijun as Vice Governor
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，江苏省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议召开，省委书记信长星主持，决定任命史志军为省政府副省长。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the 24th session of the Standing Committee of the 14th Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress was held, chaired by Xin Changxing, and decided to appoint Shi Zhijun as Vice Governor of the provincial government.

articles.title_zh: 中共江苏省委召开民主协商会
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial CPC Committee Holds Democratic Consultation Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，中共江苏省委召开民主协商会，省委书记信长星主持并就有关人事安排作说明，各民主党派、工商联和无党派人士一致赞同。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee held a democratic consultation meeting. Secretary Xin Changxing presided and explained personnel arrangements; attendees unanimously agreed.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省委理论学习中心组召开学习会
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee's Theoretical Study Group Holds Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，江苏省委理论学习中心组召开学习会，省委书记信长星主持并讲话，交流学习贯彻习近平总书记对江苏工作重要讲话精神的调研成果。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the Theoretical Study Group of the CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee held a meeting chaired by Secretary Xin Changxing to exchange research findings on implementing Xi Jinping's important speeches on Jiangsu's work.

articles.title_zh: 安徽下好创新先手棋（活力中国调研行）
articles.title_en: Anhui Takes the Lead in Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 安徽上半年GDP增长5.6%跻身全国前十，以科技创新引领产业发展，在量子计算、新能源汽车等领域取得突破，推动经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: In H1 2026, Anhui's GDP grew 5.6% year-on-year, ranking top 10 nationally. Led by technological innovation, the province made breakthroughs in quantum computing and NEVs, driving high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 龙岩市：健全“五个要素” 推动机构编制监督与审批全链条贯通
articles.title_en: Longyan City Improves Full-Chain Integration of Institutional Staffing Supervision and Approval
articles.summary_zh: 龙岩市探索建立机构编制监督检查与审批管理联动机制，通过源头管控、过程监管、协同联动和刚性约束，构建全链条闭环式“审管一体”格局。
articles.summary_en: Longyan City has explored a linkage mechanism between institutional staffing supervision and approval management, building a closed-loop integrated pattern through source control, process supervision, coordination, and rigid constraints.

articles.title_zh: 南方电网贵州电网公司发布2025年社会责任实践报告
articles.title_en: China Southern Power Grid Guizhou Power Grid Releases 2025 Social Responsibility Report
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，南方电网贵州电网公司发布2025年社会责任实践报告，显示电网建设投资110.71亿元，新能源装机占比达37.04%，切实履行电力保供、绿色转型、服务民生等职责。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Guizhou Power Grid Company of China Southern Power Grid released its 2025 Social Responsibility Report, showing grid investment of 11.071 billion yuan and new energy accounting for 37.04% of installed capacity, fulfilling duties in power supply, green transition, and public services.

articles.title_zh: 全力推动旅居产业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Guizhou Promotes High-Quality Development of Residence Tourism Industry
articles.summary_zh: 贵州大力发展旅居产业，创新产品业态，形成全域联动格局。2025年全省旅居15天以上人群达238万人次。
articles.summary_en: Guizhou is vigorously developing its residence tourism industry, innovating products and forming a region-wide coordinated pattern. In 2025, 2.38 million people stayed for over 15 days.

articles.title_zh: 安顺市人民代表大会常务委员会决定任免名单
articles.title_en: Appointment and Removal List by Anshun Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月26日，安顺市第五届人大常委会第三十七次会议通过多项人事任免，任命彭渊、朱亚军为副市长，并调整多个部门负责人。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, 2026, the 37th session of the 5th Anshun Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee approved appointments and removals, appointing Peng Yuan and Zhu Yajun as deputy mayors and adjusting several departmental heads.

articles.title_zh: “九五”普法从政策驱动向依法实施转变（权威发布）
articles.title_en: The 9th Five-Year Legal Publicity Plan Shifts from Policy-driven to Law-based Implementation
articles.summary_zh: 司法部等相关部门发布“九五”普法规划，提出法治宣传教育从政策驱动向依法实施转变，构建精准普法新模式，为未来5年普法工作画出“施工图”。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Justice and other departments released the 9th Five-Year Plan for Legal Publicity, shifting legal education from policy-driven to law-based implementation and outlining a clear roadmap for the next five years.

articles.title_zh: 市场监管总局发布陪诊服务标准
articles.title_en: SAMR Releases National Standard for Medical Escort Services
articles.summary_zh: 市场监管总局近日批准发布《社会化陪同就医服务 基本要求》国家标准，针对陪同就医服务乱象建立服务框架，引导行业规范发展。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation recently approved and released a national standard for socialized medical escort services, establishing a framework to regulate the industry and promote its sound development.

articles.title_zh: 为强国建设培养更多“会创造的人”
articles.title_en: Cultivating More 'Creative Minds' for National Strength
articles.summary_zh: 浙江大学党委书记在人民日报发文，强调高校应以系统性变革赋能创新人才培养，为强国建设提供人才支撑。
articles.summary_en: The Party Secretary of Zhejiang University argues in People's Daily that universities should drive systematic reforms to cultivate innovative talents and support national strength.

articles.title_zh: 坚守初心正道 勇担时代使命
articles.title_en: Upholding Original Aspirations, Undertaking the Mission of the Times
articles.summary_zh: 《中国新闻工作者职业道德准则》颁布实施35周年座谈会日前在京召开，与会代表交流新闻职业道德建设经验，强调坚守党性原则、服务人民。
articles.summary_en: A symposium marking the 35th anniversary of the Code of Professional Ethics for Chinese Journalists was held in Beijing, where representatives discussed strengthening professional ethics and upholding the Party's principles.

articles.title_zh: 葛店泛半导体产业园实现“建成即满园”
articles.title_en: Gedian Pan-Semiconductor Industrial Park Achieves Full Occupancy Upon Completion
articles.summary_zh: 近日，武汉都市圈核心区的葛店泛半导体产业园招商完成率近100%，实现“建成即满园”目标，标志着葛店开发区深化都市圈产业协同迈出实质性步伐。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Gedian Pan-Semiconductor Industrial Park in the core area of Wuhan Metropolitan Area achieved nearly 100% leasing, realizing the goal of "full occupancy upon completion," marking a substantial step in Gedian's industrial synergy within the metropolitan area.

articles.title_zh: 行进中国｜红花山上的“绿色芯片”
articles.title_en: Green Chips on Honghua Mountain
articles.summary_zh: 四川开江县红花山林业科研团队通过组培快繁技术保存繁育林木种质资源，自主选育省级良种，推动万亩叶用银杏产业园建设。
articles.summary_en: At Honghua Mountain in Kaijiang County, Dazhou, Sichuan, forestry researchers use tissue culture to preserve and propagate forest germplasm, developing provincial-level improved varieties and building a 10,000-mu ginkgo leaf industrial park.

articles.title_zh: 第33届杨凌农高会面向全国征集“四新”农业科技成果
articles.title_en: 33rd Yangling Agri High-Tech Fair Seeks 'Four New' Agricultural Achievements Nationwide
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，第33届杨凌农高会面向全国征集“四新”农业科技成果，申报截止9月30日。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, the organizing committee of the 33rd Yangling Agri High-Tech Fair announced a nationwide call for 'Four New' agricultural sci-tech achievements, with a deadline of September 30.

articles.title_zh: 新疆党委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神 研究部署防灾减灾救灾和安全生产等工作
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speech and Instructions, Deploy Disaster Prevention and Production Safety Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，新疆维吾尔自治区党委常委会召开会议，自治区党委书记陈小江主持，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署防灾减灾救灾、安全生产和扫黑除恶等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, the Standing Committee of the Xinjiang Regional Party Committee held a meeting chaired by Secretary Chen Xiaojiang to study Xi Jinping's important speech, and deploy disaster prevention, work safety, and anti-crime efforts.

articles.title_zh: 心齐则力聚！“齐”字当选2026“一带一路”年度汉字
articles.title_en: United in Heart, United in Strength! Character 'Qi' Selected as 2026 Belt and Road Annual Character
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，2026“一带一路”年度汉字发布活动在新疆乌鲁木齐举行，“齐”字当选年度汉字，由中国公共关系协会与乌鲁木齐市政府共同主办。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the 2026 Belt and Road Annual Character release event was held in Urumqi, Xinjiang, where 'Qi' was selected, co-hosted by China Public Relations Association and Urumqi Municipal Government.

articles.title_zh: 吉隆县泥石流灾害抢险救援有序推进
articles.title_en: Rescue Operations Advance After Debris Flow in Jilong County
articles.summary_zh: 吉隆县发生泥石流灾害后，日喀则市启动应急响应，1200余人投入救援，妥善安置499人，疏散转移555名游客。
articles.summary_en: After debris flow in Jilong County, Shigatse City activated emergency response, deploying over 1,200 rescuers, settling 499 people and evacuating 555 tourists.

articles.title_zh: 拓展国际经贸互利合作空间
articles.title_en: Expand Space for Mutually Beneficial International Economic and Trade Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 文章借7月30日中央政治局会议提出的“拓展国际经贸互利合作空间”要求，梳理了我国在服务贸易、进口扩大、双向投资等领域的新举措与进展。
articles.summary_en: Drawing on the Political Bureau meeting's call to expand space for international economic and trade cooperation, the article reviews China's new measures and progress in services trade, imports, and two-way investment.

articles.title_zh: 嘉兴秀洲推动城市与乡村双向赋能、共生共荣
articles.title_en: Jiaxing Xiuzhou Promotes Two-Way Empowerment and Symbiotic Coexistence of Urban and Rural Areas
articles.summary_zh: 近日，浙江省发改委等发布城乡融合监测报告，秀洲区连续两年居全省二类地区首位，城乡居民收入倍差缩小至1.39:1。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang provincial authorities released a report on urban-rural integration; Xiuzhou District ranked first in its category for two consecutive years, with urban-rural income gap narrowing to 1.39:1.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就尼泊尔遭受泥石流灾害向尼泊尔总统鲍德尔致慰问电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Condolences to Nepalese President over Landslide Disaster
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，习近平就尼泊尔泥石流灾害向尼泊尔总统鲍德尔致慰问电，李强向尼泊尔总理巴伦德拉致慰问电，表示哀悼和援助意愿。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, President Xi Jinping sent condolences to Nepalese President Paudel over the landslide disaster, and Premier Li Qiang sent condolences to Nepalese Prime Minister Barrendra, expressing willingness to assist relief efforts.

articles.title_zh: 国家主席习近平任免驻外大使
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Appoints and Recalls Ambassadors
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平根据全国人大常委会决定，任免驻斯里兰卡、乌干达、澳大利亚等国的驻外大使，涉及多名大使的卸任与任命。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping, based on decisions of the NPC Standing Committee, appointed and recalled ambassadors to Sri Lanka, Uganda, Australia, and other countries.

articles.title_zh: 陈武同志遗体在京火化 习近平等到八宝山革命公墓送别
articles.title_en: Chen Wu's Remains Cremated in Beijing; Xi Jinping and Others Pay Last Respects at Babaoshan
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，全国政协副主席陈武同志遗体在北京八宝山革命公墓火化，习近平等党和国家领导人前往送别并慰问亲属。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, the remains of Chen Wu, Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, were cremated at Babaoshan Revolutionary Cemetery in Beijing. Xi Jinping and other leaders paid last respects and expressed condolences to his family.

articles.title_zh: 《新时代治国理政纪实》第一卷入藏英国大英图书馆
articles.title_en: First Volume of 'Records of Governance in the New Era' Acquired by British Library
articles.summary_zh: 新华社8月27日报道，《新时代治国理政纪实》第一卷已正式入藏英国大英图书馆，该书由新华通讯社编撰，展现习近平总书记领航中国的伟大实践。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on August 27 that the first volume of "Records of Governance in the New Era" has been officially acquired by the British Library. Compiled by Xinhua News Agency, it showcases Xi Jinping's great practice in leading China.

articles.title_zh: 中印边界问题特别代表第25次会晤达成8点成果共识
articles.title_en: Special Representatives of China and India Reach Eight-Point Consensus at 25th Meeting on Border Issue
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，中印边界问题特别代表第25次会晤在北京举行，王毅同多瓦尔达成8点成果共识，包括成立划界专家小组、新增边境会谈会晤点等。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the 25th meeting of Special Representatives on the China-India boundary question was held in Beijing. Wang Yi and Ajit Doval reached an eight-point consensus, including establishing a delimitation expert group and adding new border meeting points.

articles.title_zh: 人民币跨境支付系统已覆盖192个国家和地区
articles.title_en: RMB Cross-Border Payment System Covers 192 Countries and Regions
articles.summary_zh: 中国人民银行副行长陆磊表示，截至2026年6月底，人民币跨境支付系统已覆盖192个国家和地区，并将延长大额支付系统运行时间。
articles.summary_en: PBOC Vice Governor Lu Lei said the RMB cross-border payment system covers 192 countries and regions as of end-June 2026, and the large-value payment system service hours will be extended.

articles.title_zh: 中华人民共和国主席令（第八十四号）
articles.title_en: Order of the President of the People's Republic of China (No. 84)
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平发布主席令，公布全国人大常委会关于修改律师法的决定，自2026年9月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping issued an order promulgating the NPC Standing Committee's decision to amend the Lawyers Law, effective September 1, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 词元何以成为智能经济发展的重要引擎
articles.title_en: How Tokens Become an Important Engine for Smart Economy Development
articles.summary_zh: 清华大学教授唐杰撰文指出，词元作为AI生成式内容的基本单位，已成为促进我国智能经济发展的新型数据要素，其贡献效能由模型智能水平、API调用量和智能转化效率共同决定。
articles.summary_en: Professor Tang Jie of Tsinghua University argues that tokens, as basic units of AI-generated content, have become a new data element driving China's smart economy, with their contribution determined by model intelligence, API calls, and conversion efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 深圳市政协委员周海斌：聚合碎片化流量 打造深圳海外城市品牌
articles.title_en: Shenzhen CPPCC Member Zhou Haibin: Consolidate Fragmented Traffic to Build Shenzhen's Overseas City Brand
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，深圳市政协委员周海斌在委员议事厅上建议聚合碎片化流量，打造深圳海外城市品牌，推动企业产品与城市品牌深度绑定。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Shenzhen CPPCC member Zhou Haibin suggested at the Members' Briefing Hall to consolidate fragmented online traffic to build Shenzhen's overseas city brand, linking enterprise products with the city brand.

articles.title_zh: 深圳市政协委员余治国：打造全球逐梦舞台 深圳最值得看见的是“人”
articles.title_en: Shenzhen CPPCC Member Yu Zhiguo: What Shenzhen Is Most Worth Seeing Is 'People'
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，深圳市政协第121期“委员议事厅”举行，市政协委员余治国建议将深圳科技基因转化为科幻奇观，打造全球逐梦舞台。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, the 121st session of "Members' Deliberation Hall" of Shenzhen CPPCC was held, where member Yu Zhiguo suggested turning Shenzhen's tech DNA into sci-fi spectacles to build a global stage for dreamers.

articles.title_zh: 深化中央企业与重庆市合作座谈会在京举行
articles.title_en: Symposium on Deepening Cooperation between Central Enterprises and Chongqing Held in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日上午，深化中央企业与重庆市合作座谈会在北京举行，重庆市委书记袁家军、国务院国资委主任程福波出席并讲话，会后举行重大合作项目签约。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 27, a symposium on deepening cooperation between central enterprises and Chongqing was held in Beijing. Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun and SASAC Director Cheng Fubo attended and spoke, followed by signing of major cooperation projects.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军陈新武会见国务院国资委党委书记、主任程福波
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun and Chen Xinwu Meet with SASAC Party Secretary Cheng Fubo
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日上午，重庆市委书记袁家军、市长陈新武在北京会见国务院国资委党委书记、主任程福波，双方就深化央地合作、推动国资国企改革等进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 27 morning, Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun and Mayor Chen Xinwu met in Beijing with Cheng Fubo, SASAC Party Secretary and Director, to discuss deepening central-local cooperation and SOE reform.

articles.title_zh: 医疗保障法出台 这些看点值得关注
articles.title_en: Medical Security Law Promulgated: Key Highlights
articles.summary_zh: 十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议8月28日表决通过医疗保障法，自2027年1月1日起施行，聚焦公民医保权益、优化医保服务和基金监管。
articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of the 14th NPC passed the Medical Security Law on August 28, effective January 1, 2027, focusing on rights, services, and fund supervision.

articles.title_zh: 省委宣传部出台《繁荣互联网条件下新大众文艺的若干措施》
articles.title_en: Hunan Provincial Publicity Department Issues Measures to Promote New Mass Literature and Art in the Internet Era
articles.summary_zh: 湖南省委宣传部近日出台措施，繁荣互联网条件下新大众文艺，激发全省文化创新创造活力。
articles.summary_en: The Publicity Department of the Hunan Provincial Party Committee has issued measures to promote new mass literature and art under internet conditions, stimulating cultural innovation and creativity across the province.

articles.title_zh: 省政协党组理论学习中心组召开学习会 张义珍主持
articles.title_en: Provincial CPPCC Party Leadership Group Holds Study Session, Chaired by Zhang Yizhen
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，省政协党组理论学习中心组召开学习会，深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于基层工作方法的重要论述，省政协党组书记、主席张义珍主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, the Party Leadership Group of the Provincial CPPCC held a study session on Xi Jinping's important discourses on grassroots work methods, chaired by Zhang Yizhen, Secretary of the Party Leadership Group and Chairman of the Provincial CPPCC.

articles.title_zh: 赵乐际主持全国人大常委会第二十四次会议闭幕会并讲话
articles.title_en: Zhao Leji Chairs Closing Meeting of 24th Session of NPC Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 全国人大常委会委员长赵乐际8月28日主持十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议闭幕会，强调要深入学习贯彻习近平法治思想，适应改革发展需要，着力提高立法质量。
articles.summary_en: NPC Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji chaired the closing meeting of the 24th session on August 28, stressing the need to study Xi Jinping Thought on Rule of Law and improve legislative quality.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Pay State Visit to Kyrgyzstan
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平应吉尔吉斯斯坦总统扎帕罗夫邀请，即将对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问，这将是他第三次访吉。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping, at the invitation of Kyrgyz President Japarov, will soon pay a state visit to Kyrgyzstan, his third such visit.

articles.title_zh: 农业法完成修订
articles.title_en: Agriculture Law Revised and Passed by NPC Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议8月28日表决通过新修订的农业法，自2027年1月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of the 14th NPC passed the revised Agriculture Law at its 24th session on August 28, effective January 1, 2027.

articles.title_zh: 国家防总、应急管理部针对江西湖南启动防汛四级应急响应
articles.title_en: National Flood Control HQ and Emergency Management Ministry Activate Level-IV Response for Jiangxi and Hunan
articles.summary_zh: 8月28日，受台风“沙德尔”影响，国家防总、应急管理部针对江西、湖南启动防汛四级应急响应。
articles.summary_en: On August 28, due to Typhoon Shadel, the National Flood Control Headquarters and the Ministry of Emergency Management activated a Level-IV emergency response for Jiangxi and Hunan.

articles.title_zh: 《中国新闻工作者职业道德准则》颁布实施35周年座谈会在京召开
articles.title_en: Symposium Held in Beijing for 35th Anniversary of Chinese Journalists' Code of Professional Ethics
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，中华全国新闻工作者协会在北京召开《中国新闻工作者职业道德准则》颁布实施35周年座谈会，与会者回顾准则作用，探讨全媒体时代新闻职业道德建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, the All-China Journalists Association held a symposium in Beijing to mark the 35th anniversary of the Code of Professional Ethics for Chinese Journalists, reviewing its role and discussing ethical construction in the all-media era.

articles.title_zh: 全国医疗卫生机构总诊疗人次超106亿
articles.title_en: China's Medical Institutions Record Over 10.6 Billion Patient Visits
articles.summary_zh: 国家卫生健康委8月28日发布《2025年我国卫生健康事业发展统计公报》，显示2025年全国医疗卫生机构总诊疗人次106.5亿，居民人均预期寿命79.25岁。
articles.summary_en: The National Health Commission released its 2025 statistical bulletin on August 28, showing 10.65 billion patient visits at medical institutions and an average life expectancy of 79.25 years.

articles.title_zh: 天津市政府召开第114次常务会议 张工主持
articles.title_en: Tianjin Government Holds 114th Executive Meeting, Zhang Gong Presides
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日下午，天津市市长张工主持召开市政府第114次常务会议，研究部署防汛减灾工作，审议卫生健康、文商旅体融合“十五五”规划。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 27, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong chaired the 114th executive meeting of the municipal government, studying flood prevention and reviewing 15th Five-Year plans for healthcare and culture-tourism-sports integration.

articles.title_zh: 天津市委常委会召开会议 陈敏尔主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Chen Min'er Chairs Tianjin Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，天津市委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示和讲话精神，研究部署防汛和'117项目'盘活利用工作。市委书记陈敏尔主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 27, Tianjin Party committee met to study Xi's directives and speech, deploy flood control and 117 Project reuse. Chen Min'er chaired.

articles.title_zh: 陈敏尔张工赴“117项目”周边区域调研
articles.title_en: Chen Min'er and Zhang Gong Visit Surrounding Areas of '117 Project' for Digital Economy Research
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，天津市委书记陈敏尔、市长张工到滨海高新区数字经济产业园调研'117项目'周边区域数字经济发展，强调推动数字经济健康发展，加快形成新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Tianjin Party Secretary Chen Min'er and Mayor Zhang Gong visited the Digital Economy Industrial Park in Binhai High-Tech Zone to survey digital economy development around the '117 Project', emphasizing healthy growth and new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜会见乌兹别克斯坦旅游委员会主席
articles.title_en: Erkin Tuniyaz Meets Chairman of Uzbekistan Tourism Committee
articles.summary_zh: 27日下午，新疆维吾尔自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在乌鲁木齐会见乌兹别克斯坦旅游委员会主席阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·阿库洛夫一行，双方就深化旅游合作等交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 27, Xinjiang regional chairman Erkin Tuniyaz met with Abdulaziz Akulov, chairman of the Uzbekistan Tourism Committee, in Urumqi to discuss deepening tourism cooperation.

articles.title_en: Liu Jie Chairs Meeting on Typhoon Defense Work
articles.summary_zh: 27日，浙江省委副书记、省长刘捷两次在省防汛防台应急指挥中心主持召开台风“沙德尔”防御会商调度会议，要求再排查隐患、再落实任务，确保人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Liu Jie, Deputy Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee and Governor, chaired two typhoon defense meetings, urging thorough risk re-inspection and implementation of tasks.

articles.title_zh: 打虎！江西省省长叶建春被查
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Governor Ye Jianchun Investigated for Discipline Violations
articles.summary_zh: 据中央纪委国家监委网站8月27日消息，江西省委副书记、省长叶建春涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: According to the CCDI website on August 27, Ye Jianchun, Deputy Secretary of the Jiangxi Provincial Committee and Governor of Jiangxi Province, is suspected of serious disciplinary and legal violations and is under investigation.

articles.title_zh: 卫生健康部门开展西藏吉隆县泥石流受灾医疗应急工作
articles.title_en: Health Authorities Carry Out Medical Emergency Response for Landslide Victims in Gyirong County, Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，尼泊尔一侧泥石流造成西藏吉隆县吉隆口岸重大伤亡，国家卫健委安排医疗救援，委负责同志已赴西藏指导应急处置。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 26, a landslide on the Nepalese side caused heavy casualties at Gyirong Port, Gyirong County, Tibet. The National Health Commission dispatched medical teams and sent officials to guide emergency response.

articles.title_zh: 湖北省人大教育科学文化卫生委员会原副主任委员王炜被“双开”
articles.title_en: Wang Wei, Former Deputy Director of Hubei Provincial People's Congress Committee, Expelled from Party and Public Office
articles.summary_zh: 湖北省纪委监委对省人大教育科学文化卫生委员会原副主任委员王炜严重违纪违法问题进行立案审查调查，决定给予其开除党籍和公职处分，并移送检察机关依法审查起诉。
articles.summary_en: Hubei provincial disciplinary inspection committee investigated Wang Wei, former deputy director of the provincial people's congress education, science, culture and health committee, for serious disciplinary and legal violations, expelling him from the Party and public office and referring his case to prosecutors.

articles.title_zh: 十四届全国人大常委会举行第七十二次委员长会议 听取有关草案和议案审议情况汇报 赵乐际主持
articles.title_en: 14th NPC Standing Committee Holds 72nd Chairpersons' Meeting to Hear Reports on Draft Laws
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日下午，十四届全国人大常委会第七十二次委员长会议在北京举行，赵乐际主持，听取多项法律草案修改及审议情况汇报。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 27, the 72nd Chairpersons' Meeting of the 14th NPC Standing Committee was held in Beijing, chaired by Zhao Leji, to hear reports on amendments and deliberations of several draft laws.

articles.title_zh: 中国国防部：靖国神社是名副其实的“战犯神社”
articles.title_en: China's Defense Ministry: Yasukuni Shrine is a 'Shrine to War Criminals'
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，中国国防部发言人张晓刚在例行记者会上批评日本政要参拜靖国神社，并指责民进党当局媚日恋殖。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 27, Chinese Defense Ministry spokesman Zhang Xiaogang criticized Japanese politicians' visits to Yasukuni Shrine and accused Taiwan's DPP authorities of being pro-Japanese.

articles.title_zh: 中国发布首版全国几何基准影像
articles.title_en: China Releases First National Geometric Reference Imagery
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，自然资源部在北京举行例行发布会，发布中国首版覆盖全部陆地国土的几何基准影像，空间分辨率达0.5米，定位精度提升一倍以上。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, the Ministry of Natural Resources released China's first national geometric reference imagery covering all land territory at a press conference in Beijing, with 0.5m resolution and doubled positioning accuracy.

articles.title_zh: 中国国防部：中东（帝汶）、中印尼将进一步深化防务合作
articles.title_en: China's Defense Ministry: China-Timor-Leste and China-Indonesia to Deepen Defense Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 中国国防部8月27日在北京举行例行记者会，发言人张晓刚表示，国防部长董军访问东帝汶并出席中印尼“2+2”会议，将进一步深化双多边防务合作。
articles.summary_en: At a Beijing press conference, MND spokesman Zhang Xiaogang said Defense Minister Dong Jun's visits to Timor-Leste and Indonesia will deepen bilateral defense cooperation.

articles.title_zh: HICOOL 2026全球创业者峰会在北京开幕
articles.title_en: HICOOL 2026 Global Entrepreneur Summit Opens in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日晚，HICOOL 2026全球创业者峰会在北京开幕，600余家展商参展，开幕式上发起成立全球创业服务联盟并启动全球OPC支持计划。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of August 26, the HICOOL 2026 Global Entrepreneur Summit opened in Beijing, attracting over 600 exhibitors. The Global Entrepreneurship Service Alliance and the global OPC support program were launched at the opening ceremony.

articles.title_zh: 中国国防部：国际社会应坚决遏止日本“新型军国主义”妄动
articles.title_en: China's Defense Ministry: International Community Must Resolutely Curb Japan's 'New Militarism'
articles.summary_zh: 中国国防部8月27日在北京例行记者会上，发言人张晓刚批评日本加速再军事化，呼吁国际社会遏止日本“新型军国主义”妄动。
articles.summary_en: At a routine press conference in Beijing on Aug 27, Chinese Defense Ministry spokesman Zhang Xiaogang criticized Japan's accelerated remilitarization and urged the international community to curb Japan's 'new militarism' tendencies.

articles.title_zh: 司法部：“九五”普法要做到人群在哪里，普法就跟进到哪里
articles.title_en: MOJ: Legal Publicity Should Follow People Wherever They Are
articles.summary_zh: 司法部副部长胡卫列8月27日在北京表示，“九五”普法要推进精准普法，做到人群在哪里，普法就跟进到哪里，并探索精准普法新模式。
articles.summary_en: Hu Weilie, Vice Minister of Justice, said in Beijing on Aug 27 that the 9th Five-Year legal education campaign should adopt precise publicity, following people wherever they are.

articles.title_zh: "2026·中国—南非人权研讨会"在浙江杭州举办
articles.title_en: 2026 China-South Africa Human Rights Symposium Held in Hangzhou, Zhejiang
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，"2026·中国—南非人权研讨会"在浙江杭州举办，由中国人权发展基金会和南非约翰内斯堡大学非洲—中国研究中心共同主办，主题为"共同现代化与人权发展"。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, the 2026 China-South Africa Human Rights Symposium was held in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, co-hosted by the China Foundation for Human Rights Development and the Africa-China Research Center of the University of Johannesburg, focusing on 'Common Modernization and Human Rights Development.'

articles.title_zh: 国防部介绍中泰、中白、中埃等多场中外军联合训练情况
articles.title_en: Defense Ministry Briefs on Joint Military Training with Thailand, Belarus, Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 国防部新闻发言人张晓刚介绍中泰“鹰击-2026”、中白“神鹰-2026”及中埃“文明之鹰-2026”等多场中外军联合训练情况，表示联训提升双方技战术水平，深化务实合作。
articles.summary_en: Defense Ministry spokesman Zhang Xiaogang briefed on multiple joint military exercises with Thailand, Belarus, and Egypt, saying they enhanced tactical skills and deepened practical cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 陆慷会见日本年轻国会议员代表团
articles.title_en: Lu Kang Meets Japanese Young Parliamentarian Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日上午，中共中央对外联络部副部长陆慷在北京会见日本年轻国会议员代表团，就中日关系及历史、台湾等原则问题阐明中方立场。
articles.summary_en: On August 27 morning, Lu Kang, Vice Minister of the International Department of the CPC Central Committee, met in Beijing with a delegation of young Japanese parliamentarians and expounded China's stance on principles including history and Taiwan.

tags.name_en: International Department of CPC Central Committee

tags_en: International Department of CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 多方合力支持救援 全力做好应急处置
articles.title_en: Multi-Party Efforts Support Rescue, Full Emergency Response
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，西藏吉隆县因尼泊尔一侧泥石流造成重大伤亡失联，习近平总书记作出重要指示，多部门启动应急响应，全力救援。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, a mudslide from Nepal caused heavy casualties and missing persons in Gyirong County, Tibet. General Secretary Xi Jinping gave instructions, and multiple departments activated emergency responses to rescue.

articles.title_zh: 《中国新闻工作者职业道德准则》颁布实施35周年座谈会在京召开
articles.title_en: Seminar Held in Beijing on 35th Anniversary of Code of Ethics for Chinese Journalists
articles.summary_zh: 中华全国新闻工作者协会8月26日在京召开座谈会，纪念《中国新闻工作者职业道德准则》颁布实施35周年，研讨加强新时代新闻职业道德建设。
articles.summary_en: The All-China Journalists Association held a seminar in Beijing on Aug. 26 to mark the 35th anniversary of the Code of Ethics for Chinese Journalists and discuss strengthening professional ethics in journalism.

articles.title_zh: 密切联系群众 履行代表职责 为扎实推进乡村全面振兴作出新贡献
articles.title_en: Stay Close to the People, Fulfill Deputy Duties, Make New Contributions to Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日上午，全国人大常委会委员长赵乐际同列席常委会会议的人大代表座谈，强调要密切联系群众，履行代表职责，为巩固拓展脱贫攻坚成果、推进乡村全面振兴作贡献。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Aug 26, Zhao Leji, chairman of the NPC Standing Committee, met with NPC deputies attending the session, urging them to stay close to the people and contribute to rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 习近平对西藏日喀则市吉隆县遭受泥石流灾害作出重要指示强调
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Makes Important Instructions on Mudslide Disaster in Jilong County, Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，西藏日喀则市吉隆县因尼泊尔一侧泥石流造成重大人员伤亡失联，习近平作出重要指示要求全力搜救，李强作出批示。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 26, a mudslide in Jilong County, Shigatse, Tibet, caused heavy casualties and missing persons. Xi Jinping ordered all-out rescue efforts, and Li Qiang issued instructions.

articles.title_zh: 抓好规划实施 加快推进新型工业化
articles.title_en: Accelerating New Industrialization Through Effective Plan Implementation
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，国务院新闻办举行发布会，介绍“十五五”规划实施和新型工业化推进情况，提出到2035年培育约100家新兴产业示范园区。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, the State Council Information Office held a press conference on implementing the 15th Five-Year Plan and advancing new industrialization, aiming to cultivate about 100 emerging industry demonstration parks by 2035.

articles.title_zh: 全国政协十四届常委会第十八次会议闭幕
articles.title_en: Wang Huning Chairs Closing Meeting of CPPCC Standing Committee on Common Prosperity
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，全国政协十四届常委会第十八次会议在京闭幕，以改善民生和推进共同富裕为议题，王沪宁主持并讲话，会议通过多项人事任免。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, the 18th session of the 14th CPPCC National Committee's Standing Committee concluded in Beijing, focusing on improving people's livelihood and promoting common prosperity. Wang Huning chaired the meeting and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将出席2026年上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Attend 2026 SCO Summit and Pay State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 外交部发言人26日宣布，国家主席习近平将于8月30日至9月3日出席在比什凯克举行的上海合作组织峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦和埃及进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: Foreign Ministry spokesperson announced on Aug 26 that President Xi Jinping will attend the SCO Summit in Bishkek and pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt from Aug 30 to Sep 3.

articles.title_zh: 中印边界问题特别代表第二十五次会晤达成8点成果共识
articles.title_en: 25th Special Representatives Meeting on China-India Boundary Issues Reaches 8-Point Consensus
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，中印边界问题特别代表第二十五次会晤在北京举行，王毅同多瓦尔会谈，达成8点成果共识。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the 25th Special Representatives' Meeting on the China-India Boundary Question was held in Beijing, where Wang Yi and Doval reached an eight-point consensus.

articles.title_zh: 中央政法委印发通知要求学习宣传云南独龙江边境派出所先进事迹
articles.title_en: Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission Issues Notice to Learn from Dulongjiang Border Police Station
articles.summary_zh: 中央政法委近日印发通知，号召全国政法机关和干警学习独龙江边境派出所先进事迹，忠诚担当，锻造政法铁军。
articles.summary_en: The Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission recently issued a notice calling on political and legal organs and officers nationwide to learn from the advanced deeds of the Dulongjiang border police station.

tags.name_en: Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission

tags_en: Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥在安徽合肥出席财政科学管理试点座谈会
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Attends Symposium on Fiscal Scientific Management in Hefei
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日至26日，中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥在安徽合肥出席财政科学管理试点座谈会并调研，强调要提升财政工作水平，更好服务中国式现代化建设。
articles.summary_en: From August 25 to 26, Ding Xuexiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended a symposium on fiscal scientific management pilot work in Hefei, Anhui, and stressed improving fiscal work to better serve Chinese-style modernization.

articles.title_zh: 十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议审议多部法律草案和报告
articles.title_en: The 14th NPC Standing Committee Reviews Draft Laws and Reports at Its 24th Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议审议道路交通安全法修订草案、反跨境腐败法草案等多部法律草案和报告，涉及自动驾驶、反腐败、企业破产等内容。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the 24th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee reviewed multiple draft laws and reports, including the revised road traffic safety law, anti-cross-border corruption law, and enterprise bankruptcy law.

articles.title_zh: 营造公平有序的市场竞争环境
articles.title_en: Creating a Fair and Orderly Market Competition Environment
articles.summary_zh: 文章围绕7月30日中央政治局会议提出的“营造公平有序的市场竞争环境”，介绍全国统一大市场建设、整治“内卷式”竞争、优化民营经济发展环境等政策举措。
articles.summary_en: Based on the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau meeting, the article discusses measures to create a fair and orderly market competition environment, including building a unified national market, combating involution-style competition, and optimizing the environment for private economy development.

articles.title_zh: 加大保障和改善民生力度，扎实推进全体人民共同富裕
articles.title_en: Strengthen Efforts to Improve People's Livelihood and Advance Common Prosperity
articles.summary_zh: 全国政协十四届常委会第十八次会议举行大会发言，多位常委围绕共同富裕、民生保障等提出建议。
articles.summary_en: The 18th session of the Standing Committee of the 14th CPPCC National Committee held group speeches, with members offering suggestions on common prosperity and livelihood security.

articles.title_zh: 国家统计局解读2026年1—7月工业企业利润数据
articles.title_en: NBS Interprets Industrial Profits Data for Jan-Jul 2026
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局工业司首席统计师于卫宁解读称，1—7月规模以上工业企业利润同比增长17.6%，电子行业利润高速增长，高技术制造业引领作用明显。
articles.summary_en: Yu Weining, chief statistician of the NBS Industry Department, said profits of industrial enterprises above designated size grew 17.6% year-on-year in Jan-Jul, with electronics and high-tech manufacturing leading growth.

articles.title_zh: 习言道｜始终为人民利益和幸福而努力工作
articles.title_en: Xi's Quote: Always Work for the People's Interests and Happiness
articles.summary_zh: 近日，习近平总书记作出重要指示，强调树立和践行正确政绩观是一项长期任务，必须久久为功，不断巩固拓展学习教育成果，持续推动党员干部立党为公、为民造福、真抓实干。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently stressed that fostering a correct view of political achievements is a long-term task, urging sustained efforts to consolidate education results and serve the people.

articles.title_zh: 市委召开常委会会议学习习近平总书记重要文章研究部署卫生健康等工作
articles.title_en: Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi's Article and Arrange Health Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，安康市委召开常委会会议，学习习近平总书记重要文章，研究部署卫生健康、全面依法治市、为基层减负和信访等工作，市委书记柯昌万主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, the Ankang Municipal Party Committee held a standing committee meeting to study an important article by Xi Jinping and arrange work on health, law-based governance, reducing burdens on grassroots, and petition handling. Ke Changwan chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 省委财经委员会召开会议
articles.title_en: Provincial Financial and Economic Affairs Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，云南省委财经委员会在昆明召开会议，研究统筹推进矿产资源开发，促进资源经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, the Yunnan Provincial Financial and Economic Affairs Committee held a meeting in Kunming to study coordinated mineral resource development and promote high-quality growth of the resource economy.

tags_en: Provincial Financial and Economic Affairs Committee

articles.title_zh: 中国人民银行保山市分行关于江泽民诞辰100周年普通纪念币发行公告
articles.title_en: Announcement on Issuance of Commemorative Coin for 100th Anniversary of Jiang Zemin's Birth by Baoshan Branch of PBC
articles.summary_zh: 中国人民银行保山市分行公告，将于8月31日起线上预约发行江泽民诞辰100周年普通纪念币，共4000枚，每人限约20枚。
articles.summary_en: The Baoshan Branch of the People's Bank of China announced online reservation for the commemorative coin of the 100th birthday of Jiang Zemin, with 4,000 coins available and a limit of 20 per person.

articles.title_zh: 亿嘉和集团东北亚国际创新中心落地浑南区 霍步刚出席签约仪式
articles.title_en: Yijiahe Group's Northeast Asia International Innovation Center Lands in Hunnan District; Huo Bugang Attends Signing Ceremony
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，沈阳市政府与亿嘉和集团签署战略合作框架协议，共建东北亚国际创新中心，市委书记霍步刚出席签约仪式。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Shenyang Municipal Government signed a strategic cooperation framework agreement with Yijiahe Group to build the Northeast Asia International Innovation Center; Party Secretary Huo Bugang attended the ceremony.

articles.title_zh: 吕志成在调研重点城建项目时强调 高质高效推进项目建设 提升城市品质增进民生福祉
articles.title_en: Lü Zhicheng Stresses Efficient Construction of Major Urban Projects to Enhance City Quality and Livelihood
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，沈阳市委副书记、市长吕志成调研重点城建项目，强调高质高效推进项目建设，提升城市品质增进民生福祉。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Lü Zhicheng, Deputy Secretary of the Shenyang Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, inspected key urban construction projects, emphasizing efficient construction to improve city quality and people's livelihood.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁省军区第十五次党代会召开 许昆林出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Attends and Addresses 15th CPC Congress of Liaoning Provincial Military Command
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日至26日，中国共产党辽宁省军区第十五次代表大会在沈阳召开，省委书记、省军区党委第一书记许昆林出席并讲话，强调贯彻习近平强军思想，推进国防动员和后备力量建设。
articles.summary_en: The 15th CPC Congress of the Liaoning Provincial Military Command was held in Shenyang from Aug 25-26. Provincial Party Secretary Xu Kunlin attended and spoke, emphasizing implementation of Xi Jinping's thinking on military strengthening and advancing national defense mobilization.

tags.name_en: Goal of Building a Strong Military

tags_en: Goal of Building a Strong Military

articles.title_zh: 市委召开专题会议 扎实推进开发区整合优化改革 激发高质量发展内生动力 霍步刚吕志成出席
articles.title_en: Shenyang Municipal Party Committee Holds Special Meeting on Advancing Development Zone Integration and Optimization Reform
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，沈阳市委召开专题会议，听取开发区整合优化改革进展，市委书记霍步刚主持并讲话，市长吕志成出席。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, the Shenyang Municipal Party Committee held a special meeting to review progress on development zone integration and optimization reform. Party Secretary Huo Bugang presided and gave a speech; Mayor Lyu Zhicheng attended.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会（扩大）会议传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神 安排部署贯彻落实工作
articles.title_en: Chifeng Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting Conveys Xi Jinping's Important Speech and Arranges Implementation
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，赤峰市委书记唐毅主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，安排部署贯彻落实工作，并研究基层减负、服务业发展等事项。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Tang Yi, Secretary of the CPC Chifeng Municipal Committee, chaired an enlarged meeting of the Standing Committee to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speech, arrange implementation work, and discuss grassroots burden reduction and service industry development.

articles.title_zh: 习近平对西藏日喀则市吉隆县遭受泥石流灾害作出重要指示
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Makes Important Instructions on Mudslide Disaster in Gyirong County, Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，因尼泊尔一侧泥石流造成西藏吉隆县重大伤亡，习近平作出重要指示要求全力搜救，李强作出批示。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 26, a mudslide from Nepal caused heavy casualties in Gyirong County, Tibet. Xi Jinping gave important instructions on search and rescue, and Li Qiang made instructions.

articles.title_zh: 中国长期保持吉尔吉斯斯坦第一大贸易伙伴地位
articles.title_en: China Remains Kyrgyzstan's Largest Trading Partner
articles.summary_zh: 商务部新闻发言人黄玲8月27日表示，中国长期保持吉尔吉斯斯坦第一大贸易伙伴地位，今年1至7月中吉贸易额达117亿美元。
articles.summary_en: MOFCOM spokesperson Huang Ling said on Aug 27 that China remains Kyrgyzstan's largest trading partner, with trade reaching $11.7 billion in Jan-Jul this year.

articles.title_zh: 生命至上闻令而动，最大限度减少伤亡——贯彻落实习近平总书记重要指示精神各方协力开展西藏吉隆县泥石流抢险救援
articles.title_en: Lifesaving First, Acting on Orders, Minimizing Casualties — Coordinated Rescue Efforts in Tibet's Gyirong County Under Xi Jinping's Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，西藏吉隆口岸因尼泊尔一侧泥石流致重大人员伤亡，265人失联。习近平总书记作出重要指示，各方全力开展抢险救援。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 26, a mudslide on Nepal's side caused major casualties at Gyirong Port in Tibet, with 265 missing. President Xi Jinping instructed all-out rescue efforts.

articles.title_zh: 我国经济发展新动能指数保持较快增长
articles.title_en: China's New Economic Momentum Index Keeps Fast Growth
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局8月27日发布2025年经济发展新动能指数，测算结果显示该指数为153.0，同比增长12.5%，新动能继续培育壮大。
articles.summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics released the 2025 new economic momentum index on August 27, showing the index reached 153.0, up 12.5% year on year, as new growth drivers continue to expand.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席将出席上合组织峰会并访问吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping to Attend SCO Summit and Visit Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 新华社北京8月26日电，国家主席习近平将于8月30日至9月3日出席在比什凯克举行的上海合作组织峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, Aug 26 - President Xi Jinping will attend the SCO Summit in Bishkek and pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt from Aug 30 to Sep 3.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将出席上合组织峰会并访问吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Attend SCO Summit and Visit Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 习近平主席将于8月30日至9月3日出席在比什凯克举行的上合组织峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问，共商合作大计。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping will attend the SCO Summit in Bishkek and pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt from August 30 to September 3, discussing cooperation and promoting global governance.

articles.title_zh: 汪尚学主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Wang Shangxue Chairs Dingxi Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日上午，定西市委常委会召开会议，由市委书记汪尚学主持，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，安排部署贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 26, the Standing Committee of the Dingxi Municipal Party Committee held a meeting chaired by Secretary Wang Shangxue to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and arrange implementation.

articles.title_zh: 李生潜在定西高新区调研时强调做强平台载体
articles.title_en: Li Shengqian Visits Dingxi High-tech Zone, Stresses Strengthening Platform Carriers
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日下午，定西市委副书记、代市长李生潜在定西高新区调研，强调锚定功能定位、做强平台载体，为打造陇中工业集聚地提供支撑。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, Li Shengqian, acting mayor of Dingxi, visited the Dingxi High-tech Zone and stressed strengthening platforms to build an industrial hub in central Gansu.

articles.title_zh: 汪尚学主持召开五届市委全面深化改革委员会第十二次会议
articles.title_en: Wang Shangxue Chairs 12th Meeting of the Fifth Municipal Committee for Comprehensive Deepening Reforms
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日上午，定西市委书记汪尚学主持召开市委全面深化改革委员会第十二次会议，强调聚焦重点难点、精准攻坚突破，以改革新成效为全市高质量追赶发展蓄势赋能。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 26, Wang Shangxue, secretary of the Dingxi Municipal Party Committee, chaired the 12th meeting of the Municipal Committee for Comprehensive Deepening Reforms, emphasizing targeted breakthroughs in key areas to empower high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见出席2026耐心资本到辽宁——金融投资联盟投融资对接活动嘉宾代表
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet with Guests at 2026 Patient Capital to Liaoning Financial Investment Alliance Matchmaking Event
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见出席2026耐心资本到辽宁金融投资联盟投融资对接活动的嘉宾代表，双方就深化金融合作、支持辽宁振兴发展进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Liaoning Provincial Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei met in Shenyang with guests attending the 2026 Patient Capital to Liaoning financial investment alliance matchmaking event, discussing deeper financial cooperation to support Liaoning's revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁吴贤德分赴福清罗源督导检查防御台风工作
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning and Wu Xiande Inspect Typhoon Defense in Fuqing and Luoyuan
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，福州市委书记郭宁宁、市长吴贤德分赴福清、罗源督导检查防御台风“沙德尔”工作，要求严阵以待确保人民群众生命安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Guo Ningning, Party Secretary of Fuzhou, and Mayor Wu Xiande inspected typhoon defense work in Fuqing and Luoyuan, urging all-out efforts to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁吴贤德分赴福清罗源督导检查防御台风工作
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning and Wu Xiande Inspect Typhoon Defense Work in Fuqing and Luoyuan
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁和市长吴贤德分赴福清、罗源督导检查防御台风“沙德尔”工作，强调要严阵以待，全力保障人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Guo Ningning, Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Municipal Party Committee, and Wu Xiande, Mayor, went to Fuqing and Luoyuan to inspect typhoon defense work for Typhoon Shadel, emphasizing full preparedness to protect people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会召开主任会议党组理论学习中心组学习（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Hegang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Directors' Meeting and Party Group Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，鹤岗市人大常委会党组书记、主任李万军主持召开第五十五次主任会议和党组理论学习中心组学习（扩大）会议，听取相关工作汇报并研究人大会议议程及人事任免。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Li Wanjun, Party Secretary and Director of the Standing Committee of Hegang Municipal People's Congress, chaired the 55th Directors' Meeting and the Party Group Theoretical Learning Center Group (Expanded) Meeting, hearing reports and discussing agenda and personnel appointments.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡在调研督导文明创建工作时强调马上就办真抓实干提升城市精细化管理水平
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Emphasizes Immediate Action and Solid Work to Improve Urban Fine Management During Inspection of Civilized City Campaign
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日下午，市委副书记、代市长黄韡前往相山区调研督导文明创建工作，强调要马上就办、真抓实干，提升城市精细化管理水平。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 27, Huang Wei, deputy secretary of the municipal party committee and acting mayor, inspected civilized city construction in Xiangshan District, stressing immediate action and solid work to enhance refined urban management.

articles.title_zh: 全市文明创建工作调度会召开 蒋曦出席并讲话 黄韡主持
articles.title_en: Citywide Civilization Creation Work Dispatch Meeting Held; Jiang Xi Attends and Speaks, Huang Wei Chairs
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日上午，市委书记蒋曦出席全市文明创建工作调度会并讲话，市委副书记、代市长黄韡主持，要求整治问题、常态长效推进文明创建。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 27, Municipal Party Secretary Jiang Xi attended and spoke at the city's civilization creation work dispatch meeting, chaired by acting Mayor Huang Wei, urging problem rectification and long-term effectiveness.

articles.title_zh: 韦朝晖主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Wei Zhaohui Chairs Meeting of CPC Huaihua Municipal Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日下午，怀化市委书记韦朝晖主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习中央政治局会议和习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署下半年经济工作等。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 26, Wei Zhaohui, secretary of the CPC Huaihua Municipal Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to convey the spirit of the Political Bureau meeting and Xi Jinping's speeches, and to arrange economic work for H2.

articles.title_zh: 市十五届人大常委会召开第三十二次会议
articles.title_en: Huangshi Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 32nd Session
articles.summary_zh: 26日，黄石市十五届人大常委会召开第三十二次会议，审议多项报告和条例草案，通过人事任免事项并举行宪法宣誓仪式。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, the Standing Committee of the 15th Huangshi Municipal People's Congress held its 32nd session, reviewing reports and draft regulations, approving personnel appointments, and holding a constitutional oath ceremony.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将出席上合组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Attend SCO Summit and Pay State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平将于8月30日至9月3日出席在比什凯克举行的上海合作组织峰会，并应吉尔吉斯斯坦总统扎帕罗夫、埃及总统塞西邀请对两国进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping will attend the SCO Summit in Bishkek and pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt from Aug 30 to Sep 3 at the invitation of their presidents.

articles.title_zh: 市七届人大常委会召开第五十四次会议 通过人事任免
articles.title_en: Jieyang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 54th Meeting, Approves Personnel Changes
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日下午，揭阳市七届人大常委会召开第五十四次会议，表决通过关于市八届人大代表名额分配的决定及人事任免事项。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 26, the Standing Committee of the 7th Jieyang Municipal People's Congress held its 54th meeting, approving decisions on allocation of deputy quotas for the 8th Municipal People's Congress and personnel appointments and removals.

articles.title_zh: 七届市委第九轮巡察完成反馈
articles.title_en: 7th Municipal Party Committee Completes 9th Round of Inspection Feedback
articles.summary_zh: 七届市委第九轮巡察反馈工作近日全部完成，市委巡察组向14个单位党组织反馈情况并提出整改意见。
articles.summary_en: The 9th round of inspection feedback of the 7th Jieyang Municipal Party Committee has been recently completed. The inspection teams reported findings to 14 Party organizations and put forward rectification requirements.

articles.title_zh: 陈良贤率队到揭阳调研
articles.title_en: Chen Liangxian Leads Team for Research Visit to Jieyang
articles.summary_zh: 25日至26日，省政府党组成员陈良贤到揭阳调研“百千万工程”、重点项目建设和富民产业培育，并接访协调解决欠薪问题。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 25-26, Chen Liangxian, member of the provincial government party group, visited Jieyang to research the "Baiqianwan Project," key construction projects, and rural industry development, and received petitioners to address wage arrears.

articles.title_zh: 严金海主持自治区十二届人大常委会第七十二次主任会议
articles.title_en: Yan Jinhai Chairs 72nd Director Meeting of Regional People's Congress Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日上午，自治区人大常委会主任严金海主持召开自治区十二届人大常委会第七十二次主任会议，听取多项报告并研究相关议程。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 25, Yan Jinhai, director of the Standing Committee of the Regional People's Congress, chaired the 72nd director meeting, hearing reports and studying agendas.

articles.title_zh: 二届市委常委会第134次会议召开
articles.title_en: The 134th Meeting of the Standing Committee of the Second Municipal Party Committee Convened
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，林芝市委书记巴塔主持召开二届市委常委会第134次会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，并安排部署贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Bata, Secretary of the Linzhi Municipal Party Committee, chaired the 134th meeting of the Standing Committee of the Second Municipal Party Committee, conveying the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and arranging implementation.

articles.title_zh: 李强在黑龙江、吉林调研时强调 多措并举稳产增产 全力夺取秋粮丰收 持续提升农业综合生产能力确保粮食安全
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Visits Heilongjiang and Jilin, Stressing Measures to Secure Autumn Grain Harvest and Enhance Agricultural Production Capacity
articles.summary_zh: 李强8月24日至26日在黑龙江、吉林调研，强调多措并举夺取秋粮丰收，提升农业综合生产能力，确保粮食安全。
articles.summary_en: Li Qiang inspected Heilongjiang and Jilin from Aug 24-26, stressing measures to secure autumn harvest and enhance agricultural production capacity for food security.

articles.title_zh: 王君正第一时间赶赴受灾现场指挥救援工作
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Rushes to Disaster Site to Command Rescue Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，西藏日喀则市吉隆县因尼泊尔一侧泥石流造成重大人员伤亡，习近平总书记作指示，自治区党委书记王君正赶赴现场指挥救援。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 26, a mudslide caused heavy casualties in Gyirong County, Shigatse, Tibet. President Xi Jinping gave instructions, and regional Party chief Wang Junzheng rushed to the scene to direct rescue operations.

articles.title_zh: 自治区领导赴拉萨市堆龙德庆区调研安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Autonomous Region Leaders Visit Doilungdêqên District, Lhasa to Inspect Work Safety
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日上午，西藏自治区副主席罗梅率队赴拉萨市堆龙德庆区调研安全生产工作，实地察看学校、医院等场所并强调抓好民生领域安全生产。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 26, Luo Mei, Vice Chairwoman of the Tibet Autonomous Region, led a team to Doilungdêqên District, Lhasa to inspect work safety, visiting schools and a hospital and stressing safety in livelihood sectors.

articles.title_zh: 全市防汛防台风工作视频会召开
articles.title_en: Longyan Holds Citywide Video Conference on Flood and Typhoon Prevention
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，龙岩市召开防汛防台风工作视频会，市委书记胡盛强调严之又严实之又实防御，保障人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, Longyan held a citywide video conference on flood and typhoon prevention. Party Secretary Hu Sheng stressed stringent and practical defense measures to safeguard people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 市委召开经济工作专题会议
articles.title_en: Municipal Party Committee Holds Special Economic Work Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，盘锦市委召开经济工作专题会议，分析经济运行情况并部署下步工作。市委书记王炳森主持并讲话，市长邢鹏作部署。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, the Panjin Municipal Party Committee held an economic work meeting to analyze the economic situation and arrange next steps. Secretary Wang Bingsen presided, Mayor Xing Peng outlined tasks.

articles.title_zh: 王君正第一时间赶赴受灾现场指挥救援工作
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Rushes to Disaster Scene to Command Rescue Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，西藏日喀则市吉隆县吉隆口岸因尼泊尔一侧泥石流造成重大人员伤亡失联，自治区党委书记王君正第一时间赶赴现场指挥救援，强调贯彻习近平总书记重要指示，全力搜救。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 26, a mudslide from Nepal caused heavy casualties and missing at Gyirong Port in Tibet's Gyirong County. Wang Junzheng, secretary of the regional Party committee, rushed to the scene to direct rescue, stressing implementation of Xi Jinping's instructions.

articles.title_zh: 罗梅率队赴拉萨市堆龙德庆区调研安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Luo Mei Leads Team to Inspect Work Safety in Doilungdêqên District, Lhasa
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日上午，西藏自治区副主席罗梅率队赴拉萨市堆龙德庆区调研安全生产工作，实地察看学校、医院等场所。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 26, Luo Mei, Vice-Chairperson of the Tibet Autonomous Region, led a team to inspect work safety in Doilungdêqên District, Lhasa, visiting schools and a hospital.

articles.title_zh: 严金海主持自治区十二届人大常委会第七十二次主任会议
articles.title_en: Yan Jinhai Chairs 72nd Director Meeting of Regional People's Congress Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日上午，自治区人大常委会主任严金海主持召开自治区十二届人大常委会第七十二次主任会议，听取多项报告并研究议程。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 25, Yan Jinhai, chairman of the Standing Committee of the Regional People's Congress, chaired the 72nd director meeting to review reports and agenda.

articles.title_zh: 汕头市委书记庄悦群主持召开专题会议研究城市管理工作
articles.title_en: Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn Chairs Special Meeting on Urban Management
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日下午，汕头市委书记庄悦群主持召开市委书记专题会议，研究部署城市管理工作，强调构建'1+3+6'大城管体系，提升城市精细化管理水平。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 26, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn chaired a special meeting to study urban management, emphasizing the construction of a '1+3+6' comprehensive city management system to improve refined governance.

articles.title_zh: 汕头市人民政府与中国电信广东分公司签署战略合作框架协议
articles.title_en: Shantou Municipal Government and China Telecom Guangdong Branch Sign Strategic Cooperation Framework Agreement
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日上午，汕头市政府与中国电信广东分公司签署战略合作框架协议，双方将在数字经济等领域深化合作，市委书记庄悦群、市长陈涛等出席见证。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, the Shantou Municipal Government and China Telecom Guangdong Branch signed a strategic cooperation framework agreement to deepen cooperation in digital economy and other fields. Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn and Mayor Chen Tao attended.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群到市“百千万工程”指挥部办公室调研并召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Visits Municipal 'Baiqianwan Project' Command Office and Chairs Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日上午，汕头市委书记庄悦群到市“百千万工程”指挥部办公室调研并召开座谈会，强调锚定“五年显著变化”目标，推动城乡区域协调发展。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 25, Zhuang Yuequn, Secretary of the Shantou Municipal Party Committee, visited the command office of the municipal "Baiqianwan Project" and chaired a symposium, emphasizing the goal of achieving significant changes in five years and promoting coordinated urban-rural development.

articles.title_zh: 李强在黑龙江、吉林调研时强调 多措并举稳产增产 全力夺取秋粮丰收
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Inspects Heilongjiang and Jilin, Stresses Autumn Grain Harvest and Food Security
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日至26日，国务院总理李强在黑龙江、吉林调研，强调多措并举稳产增产，夺取秋粮丰收，提升农业综合生产能力。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 24 to 26, Premier Li Qiang inspected Heilongjiang and Jilin, emphasizing measures to stabilize and increase grain output, secure autumn harvest, and enhance comprehensive agricultural productivity.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞会见国家消防救援局局长周天
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Meets Zhou Tian, Chief of National Fire and Rescue Administration
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，宁夏回族自治区党委书记李邑飞在银川会见应急管理部副部长、国家消防救援局局长周天，双方就消防救援和应急管理等工作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, Li Yifei, Party Secretary of Ningxia, met with Zhou Tian, Vice Minister of Emergency Management and Director of the National Fire and Rescue Administration, in Yinchuan. They exchanged views on fire rescue and emergency management work.

articles.title_zh: 徐龙督导调研重点生态环境问题整改情况
articles.title_en: Xu Long Inspects Rectification of Key Ecological Environment Problems
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，石嘴山市委副书记、市长徐龙督导调研重点生态环境问题整改落实情况，强调科学精准推进整改，守牢生态安全底线。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, Xu Long, deputy secretary of the CPC Shizuishan Municipal Committee and mayor, inspected the rectification of key ecological environment problems, urging scientific and precise efforts to safeguard ecological security.

articles.title_zh: 杨青龙在调研星海湖生态环境整治情况时强调 以系统思维推进星海湖生态环境整治 持续巩固提升整治成果
articles.title_en: Yang Qinglong Inspects Xinghai Lake Ecological Restoration, Stresses Systematic Approach
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，石嘴山市委书记杨青龙调研星海湖生态环境整治，强调以系统思维推进整治，巩固提升成果，实现人与自然和谐共生。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Yang Qinglong, secretary of the Shizuishan Municipal Party Committee, inspected the ecological restoration of Xinghai Lake, emphasizing a systematic approach to consolidate and enhance restoration results for harmonious coexistence between humans and nature.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会会议暨市委常委会议军会议召开
articles.title_en: Taizhou Party Committee Holds Standing Committee and Military Work Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，泰州市委常委会暨市委常委会议军会议召开，市委书记姜冬冬主持，学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究部署人民武装和防台风工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, the Taizhou Municipal Party Committee held a standing committee and military work meeting, chaired by Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong, to study Xi Jinping's important instructions and deploy militia and typhoon defense work.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会会议暨市委常委会议军会议召开
articles.title_en: Taizhou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting and Military Work Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，泰州市委常委会会议暨市委常委会议军会议召开，市委书记姜冬冬主持并讲话，学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究部署人民武装和防御台风工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, the Taizhou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee meeting and military work meeting was held, chaired by Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong, studying Xi Jinping's important instructions and deploying militia work and typhoon defense.

articles.title_zh: 黄强胡玉亭会见退役军人事务部党组书记、部长裴金佳
articles.title_en: Huang Qiang and Hu Yuting Meet with Pei Jinjia, Party Secretary and Minister of Veterans Affairs
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，吉林省委书记黄强、省长胡玉亭在长春会见退役军人事务部部长裴金佳，双方就退役军人工作交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Jilin Provincial Party Secretary Huang Qiang and Governor Hu Yuting met with Pei Jinjia, Minister of Veterans Affairs, in Changchun to discuss veterans work.

articles.title_zh: 张海波会见中国外运股份有限公司客人
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Meets Sinotrans Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，威海市委书记张海波会见中国外运股份有限公司董事长张翼一行，双方就加强合作、发展实体经济进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Zhang Haibo, Party secretary of Weihai, met with Zhang Yi, chairman of Sinotrans, to discuss cooperation and support for the real economy.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省小微特具身智能重点实验室在锡启动建设
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Key Laboratory for Small-Micro Special Embodied Intelligence Launches in Wuxi, CETHIK and Nanjing University Sign Strategic Agreement
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，江苏省小微特具身智能重点实验室在无锡启动建设，中电海康集团与南京大学签署战略合作协议，市委书记杜小刚会见陈宗年、郑海荣一行。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 26, the Jiangsu Key Laboratory for Small-Micro Special Embodied Intelligence started construction in Wuxi, where CETHIK Group and Nanjing University signed a strategic cooperation agreement. Party Secretary Du Xiaogang met with Chen Zongnian and Zheng Hairong.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰会见中国人民银行陕西省分行党委书记、行长傅国文一行
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Meets Head of PBOC Shaanxi Branch
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，省委常委、市委书记蒿慧杰会见中国人民银行陕西省分行行长傅国文，就深化金融合作、支持西安经济发展进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Hao Huijie, member of the Standing Committee of the Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Xi'an Municipal Party Committee, met with Fu Guowen, Party Secretary and President of the Shaanxi Branch of the People's Bank of China, to discuss financial cooperation and support for Xi'an's economic development.

articles.title_zh: 高新区召开建筑施工领域安全生产暨“打非治违”工作推进会
articles.title_en: High-tech Zone Holds Meeting on Construction Safety and Special Rectification
articles.summary_zh: 高新区近日召开建筑施工领域安全生产暨“打非治违”工作推进会，传达专项行动精神，部署排查整治未批先建、违规作业等非法违法行为。
articles.summary_en: The High-tech Zone recently held a meeting on work safety in construction and the 'crackdown on illegal and non-compliant acts' campaign, deploying investigation and rectification of illegal acts such as unapproved construction and irregular operations.

tags.name_en: Crackdown on Illegal and Non-compliant Acts

tags_en: Crackdown on Illegal and Non-compliant Acts

articles.title_zh: 建安区委书记高雁调研农村集体“三资”清查整治工作
articles.title_en: Gao Yan, Secretary of Jian'an District Party Committee, Inspects Rural Collective 'Three Assets' Audit and Rectification
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，建安区委书记高雁赴五女店镇调研农村集体“三资”清查整治工作，强调全面摸排问题、动真碰硬整改，以钉钉子精神抓好专项整治。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Gao Yan, Secretary of the Jian'an District Party Committee, visited Wunvdian Town to inspect the audit and rectification of rural collective assets, emphasizing thorough problem identification and staunch rectification.

articles.title_zh: 宋占华到张得镇调研乡村振兴等工作
articles.title_en: Song Zhanhua Visits Zhangde Town to Survey Rural Vitalization
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，禹州市委书记宋占华到张得镇调研乡村振兴、基层治理和产业发展，强调发展特色产业，改善人居环境，推动乡村全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Song Zhanhua, Secretary of Yuzhou Municipal Party Committee, visited Zhangde Town to survey rural vitalization, grassroots governance, and industrial development, emphasizing specialty industries and a livable environment.

articles.title_zh: 张国平到襄城县工信局、县科技局、县开发区开展调研
articles.title_en: Zhang Guoping Conducts Research at Xiangcheng County Industry, Science and Technology Departments and Development Zone
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，襄城县县长张国平到县工信局、县科技局、县开发区调研并座谈，研判经济形势，部署下阶段重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, County Magistrate Zhang Guoping visited the county's industry, science and technology departments and development zone to assess economic conditions and arrange key tasks for the next phase.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平调研沿海高质量发展工作
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Investigates High-Quality Coastal Development Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，盐城市委书记严汉平调研沿海高质量发展工作，强调向海图强、向绿而兴、向新转型，打造沿海新增长极。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Yan Hanping, Secretary of the Yancheng Municipal CPC Committee, inspected coastal high-quality development work, emphasizing maritime strength and green transformation to build a new coastal growth pole.

articles.title_zh: 烟台市委常委会召开会议传达学习习近平总书记重要指示、重要文章精神 研究高标准农田建设突出问题整治等工作
articles.title_en: Yantai Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Instructions and Article Spirit, Discusses Rectification of High-Standard Farmland Issues
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日上午，烟台市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记关于防灾减灾的重要指示和文章精神，研究高标准农田建设突出问题整治等工作，市委书记江成主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 27, Yantai Municipal Party Committee meeting conveyed Xi Jinping's disaster-prevention instructions and Qiushi article, and discussed high-standard farmland rectification. Jiang Cheng presided.

articles.title_zh: 财政精准滴灌激活阳江产业高质量发展新动能
articles.title_en: Fiscal Precision Irrigation Unleashes New Momentum for High-Quality Industrial Development in Yangjiang
articles.summary_zh: 阳江市财政部门近两年优化财政资金配置，通过专项债券、省级专项资金和财政奖补等方式，精准支持海上风电、五金刀剪技改及企业扩产增效，为产业高质量发展注入动能。
articles.summary_en: Over the past two years, Yangjiang's fiscal departments have optimized fund allocation, using special bonds, provincial funds, and subsidies to support offshore wind power, hardware technology upgrades, and enterprise expansion, boosting high-quality industrial development.

articles.title_zh: 余金富到阳春市调研农业农村重点工作
articles.title_en: Yu Jinfu Investigates Key Agricultural and Rural Work in Yangchun
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，阳江市委副书记、市长余金富到阳春市调研农业普查、高标准农田建设等重点工作，强调强化耕地保护，推动农业提质增效。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 26, Yu Jinfu, deputy secretary and mayor of Yangjiang, visited Yangchun to inspect key agricultural and rural work, stressing arable land protection and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 阳江市委常委会会议召开
articles.title_en: Yangjiang Municipal Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，阳江市委常委会会议召开，传达学习习近平总书记在纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会等重要讲话精神，研究贯彻落实意见，市委书记卢一先主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 26, the Yangjiang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met, conveying Xi Jinping's recent speech spirit and making arrangements. Lu Yixian chaired.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉调研道路积涝治理及污水处理工作
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Inspects Road Waterlogging and Sewage Treatment Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉调研道路积涝治理及污水处理工作，强调系统提升城市排水防涝能力，确保人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Zhao Xuhui, member of the Standing Committee of the Party Committee of the Autonomous Region and Secretary of Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee, inspected road waterlogging and sewage treatment, calling for systematic improvement of urban drainage and flood prevention capabilities to safeguard people's lives and property.

tags.name_en: Yinchuan Municipal Committee of the CPC

tags_en: Yinchuan Municipal Committee of the CPC

articles.title_zh: 唐浩然参加投票选举岳阳楼区第七届人民代表大会代表
articles.title_en: Tang Haoran Votes in Election of Yueyanglou District People's Congress Deputies
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，市委副书记、代理市长唐浩然在市政府机关投票站参加岳阳楼区第七届人民代表大会代表换届选举投票，依法行使民主权利。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Tang Haoran, deputy secretary of the Yueyang Municipal Party Committee and acting mayor, voted at the municipal government polling station in the election for deputies to the 7th Yueyanglou District People's Congress.

articles.title_zh: 唐浩然赴君山区调研
articles.title_en: Tang Haoran Investigates Junshan District
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，岳阳市代理市长唐浩然赴君山区调研督导经济运行、项目建设和安全生产等工作，强调高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Tang Haoran, acting mayor of Yueyang, visited Junshan District to inspect economic operation, project construction, and safety production, stressing high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 湛江市政府赴京拜会中粮集团推动深度合作
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Government Visits COFCO in Beijing to Promote Deep Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，湛江市长李勇毅赴京拜会中粮集团，与中粮集团总经理白勇座谈，双方在食糖、油脂加工等领域达成合作共识，并促成中粮糖业与广东金岭糖业签署战略合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi visited COFCO in Beijing and met with COFCO President Bai Yong. They reached consensus on cooperation in sugar, oil processing, and logistics, and facilitated a strategic cooperation agreement between COFCO Sugar and Guangdong Jinling Sugar.

articles.title_zh: 我市组织收看湛江市防风防汛调度会并部署防风防汛工作
articles.title_en: Local City Attends Zhanjiang Typhoon and Flood Prevention Meeting and Deploys Measures
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，湛江市召开防风防汛调度会，市委书记余钢部署台风“紫檀”防御工作，我市设分会场收听收看并部署本级工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, Zhanjiang Party Secretary Yu Gang chaired a typhoon and flood prevention meeting to deploy defense against Typhoon Zitan. Our city watched via sub-venue and held its own meeting to implement directives.

articles.title_zh: 杨杰东主持召开2026年第二十次党工委会议暨第十五次管委会主任办公会议
articles.title_en: Yang Jiedong Chairs 20th Party Working Committee Meeting and 15th Management Committee Directors' Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日上午，湛江经开区党工委副书记、管委会主任杨杰东主持召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示和上级会议精神，研究基础教育、法治建设、党员发展等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 26, Yang Jiedong, Deputy Secretary of the Party Working Committee and Director of the Management Committee of Zhanjiang Economic Development Zone, chaired a meeting to convey and study important instructions from General Secretary Xi Jinping and higher-level meeting spirits, focusing on basic education, legal construction, and Party member development.

tags.name_en: Party Working Committee of Zhanjiang Economic Development Zone

tags_en: Party Working Committee of Zhanjiang Economic Development Zone

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐主持召开市政府党组会议、常务会议 研究进一步做好基础教育和安全防范工作
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Chairs Municipal Government Party Group and Executive Meetings on Basic Education and Safety
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，珠海市委副书记、市长吴泽桐主持召开市政府党组会议、常务会议，研究部署基础教育和安全防范工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Wu Zetong, Deputy Secretary of the Zhuhai Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, chaired the municipal government's Party group and executive meetings to study basic education and safety prevention work.

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐主持召开市政府全体会议 持续推动经济向新向优向好发展 努力完成全年经济社会发展目标任务
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Chairs Municipal Government Plenary Meeting to Boost Economic Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，珠海市委副书记、市长吴泽桐主持召开市政府全体会议，部署下半年经济社会发展工作，强调推动经济向新向优向好发展。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 26, Zhuhai Mayor Wu Zetong chaired a municipal government plenary meeting to arrange H2 economic and social development work, emphasizing high-quality economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 2026对话山东—越南·中国（山东）经贸合作及企业对接交流会举行
articles.title_en: 2026 Dialogue on Shandong-Vietnam Economic and Trade Cooperation and Enterprise Matchmaking Exchange Held in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日上午，2026对话山东—越南·中国（山东）经贸合作及企业对接交流会在济南举行，山东省委书记林武作主旨演讲，越南北宁省委书记阮鸿泰致辞，双方签署友好合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 26, the 2026 Dialogue on Shandong-Vietnam Economic and Trade Cooperation and Enterprise Matchmaking Exchange was held in Jinan. Shandong Provincial Party Secretary Lin Wu delivered a keynote speech, and Bac Ninh Provincial Party Secretary Nguyen Hong Thai addressed the event, with both sides signing a friendly cooperation agreement.

articles.title_zh: 运-20驰援，西藏灾害救出2人，3人遇难、558人失联
articles.title_en: Y-20 Aircraft Rushes Aid to Tibet Disaster, 2 Rescued, 3 Dead, 558 Missing
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，西藏日喀则市通报吉隆县泥石流灾害救援进展，已救出2人，3人遇难、558人失联，运-20及多支救援力量持续驰援。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Shigatse, Tibet, reported rescue progress after a mudslide in Gyirong County: 2 rescued, 3 dead, 558 missing. Y-20 aircraft and multiple rescue teams are rushing to aid.

articles.title_zh: 水利部：尼泊尔与我国两河交汇处现明显堰塞湖，未来3天溃泄风险高
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources: Landslide Lake at Nepal-China River Confluence, High Breach Risk in 3 Days
articles.summary_zh: 水利部8月27日通报，尼泊尔错坚河汇入普热普强藏布交汇处出现明显堰塞湖，水量约200万立方米，未来3天溃泄风险高。目前正密切监视并演算洪水，为抢险救援提供支撑。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Water Resources reported on Aug 27 that a landslide lake has formed near the confluence of the Cuojian River in Nepal and the Purepuqiang Zangbu, with an estimated 2 million cubic meters of water and a high risk of breaching within three days. Monitoring and flood analysis are underway.

articles.title_zh: 访华日本议员已会见中方官员？外交部回应
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Responds to Reports of Visiting Japanese Lawmakers Meeting Chinese Official
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，外交部发言人林剑在例行记者会上回应日本议员访华会见中方官员一事，指出中日关系面临严重困难，敦促日本当局反思纠错。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Foreign Ministry spokesman Lin Jian responded at a regular press conference to reports that visiting Japanese lawmakers met Chinese officials, saying Sino-Japanese relations face serious difficulties and urging Japan to reflect and correct course.

articles.title_zh: 默茨：为中尼洪灾痛心，随时提供支持
articles.title_en: Merz: Deeply Saddened by Floods in China and Nepal, Ready to Provide Support
articles.summary_zh: 德国总理默茨8月26日发文对中尼洪灾表示哀悼，联合国秘书长古特雷斯也发声声援。吉隆口岸泥石流致3人遇难、265人失联。
articles.summary_en: German Chancellor Merz expressed condolences on Aug 26 over the floods in Nepal and China, while UN chief Guterres voiced solidarity. Landslide at Gyirong Port killed 3 and left 265 missing.

articles.title_zh: 运-20起飞赶赴西藏救援
articles.title_en: Y-20 Transport Aircraft Takes Off for Rescue Mission in Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，西部战区空军一架运-20搭载指导组赶赴西藏，组织日喀则吉隆县泥石流灾害联合救援；应急管理部等调派中国救援队增援。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, a Y-20 aircraft of the Western Theater Command Air Force took off for Tibet to coordinate rescue efforts after a mudslide hit Gyirong County, Shigatse. China Rescue Team was dispatched to assist.

articles.title_zh: 灌云县综合治理中心办事大厅被曝“9点无人”，次日不让市民带手机进门
articles.title_en: Guanyun County Service Center Accused of Empty Desks at 9am, Then Banning Phones Next Day
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日至26日，江苏灌云县综治中心办事大厅被曝窗口9点无人到岗，次日又禁止市民带手机进入，引发舆论质疑。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 25-26, Guanyun County's governance center was accused of empty service windows at 9am, then banned visitors from bringing phones, sparking public criticism.

articles.title_zh: 中国驻菲律宾大使馆：在菲绑架团伙头目邱某某被遣返，多次策划实施针对中国公民的严重暴力案件
articles.title_en: Chinese Embassy in Philippines: Kidnapping Gang Leader Qiu Repatriated for Targeting Chinese Citizens
articles.summary_zh: 中国驻菲律宾大使馆表示，在菲绑架团伙头目邱某某已被遣返，其多次策划实施针对中国公民的严重暴力案件。
articles.summary_en: The Chinese Embassy in the Philippines announced the repatriation of Qiu, a kidnapping gang leader, who had repeatedly planned serious violent cases against Chinese citizens.

articles.title_zh: 新时代“商战”？北京市监局首判AIGC商业秘密行政处罚
articles.title_en: New Era 'Business War'? Beijing Regulators Issue First Administrative Penalty in AIGC Trade Secret Case
articles.summary_zh: 北京市朝阳区市场监管局27日披露，对一起AIGC行业商业秘密侵权案作出行政处罚，对私自复制、使用原单位AI商业软件并携密跳槽的行为处以10万元罚款，系北京首例。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 27, Beijing Chaoyang District Market Regulation Bureau disclosed its first administrative penalty in an AIGC trade secret case, fining 100,000 yuan for copying and using former employer's AI software after job-hopping.

tags.name_en: Beijing Chaoyang District Market Regulation Bureau
