articles.title_zh: 深夜撞杆强闯高速，7辆“百吨王”落网！吉林警方：全部行拘
articles.title_en: Jilin Police Detain 7 'Hundred-Ton' Truck Drivers After Nighttime Toll Barrier Smash
articles.summary_zh: 吉林省四平高速交警专项整治，连破多起百吨王深夜撞杆闯卡案，7名司机全部被行政拘留。
articles.summary_en: Jilin expressway traffic police conducted a special campaign, capturing seven severely overloaded trucks that forced their way through toll gates at night; all seven drivers were administratively detained.

articles.title_zh: 罗源全面转移危险区域群众
articles.title_en: Luoyuan Fully Evacuates Residents from Dangerous Areas
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，为应对台风“沙德尔”逼近，福州市罗源县全面摸排并转移危险区域群众889人，同时加强海上和陆上防御部署。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, as Typhoon Sader approached, Luoyuan County in Fuzhou evacuated 889 residents from high-risk areas and strengthened coastal and inland defense measures.

articles.title_zh: 备好物资 连江水库群科学调度迎风雨
articles.title_en: Lianjiang Reservoirs Gear Up for Typhoon with Scientific Scheduling and Supplies
articles.summary_zh: 台风“沙德尔”逼近，连江县水库群全面防御，科学预泄腾库、储备物资，确保安全度汛。
articles.summary_en: As Typhoon Shadel approaches, Lianjiang County's reservoirs have fully activated defense, with scientific pre-discharge and stocked materials to ensure flood safety.

articles.title_zh: 周祖翼赴福州连江检查防御台风工作
articles.title_en: Zhou Zuyi Inspects Typhoon Defense Work in Lianjiang, Fuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，福建省委书记周祖翼赴福州市连江县检查防御第18号台风“沙德尔”各项措施落实情况，强调以临战状态抓实抓细防御措施，筑牢防汛防台风坚固防线。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Zhou Zuyi, Secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee, visited Lianjiang County, Fuzhou, to inspect typhoon defense measures for Typhoon Shadl, emphasizing a wartime state to implement all precautions.

articles.title_zh: 开闸腾库 福清预留空间防内涝
articles.title_en: Fuqing Releases Reservoir Water to Prevent Urban Flooding
articles.summary_zh: 今年第18号台风“沙德尔”逼近，福清市防指提升防台风应急响应至Ⅲ级，开闸腾库、转移人员，并排查隐患防内涝。
articles.summary_en: As Typhoon Shadel approaches, Fuqing raised its typhoon response to Level III, opened reservoirs to reserve flood capacity, evacuated personnel, and inspected hazards to prevent urban waterlogging.

articles.title_zh: 福州：闻“风”而动防在先
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Acts Proactively Against Typhoon with Flood Control Measures
articles.summary_zh: 为应对台风“沙德尔”可能带来的强降水，福州市城区水系联排联调中心连日来开展排水防涝工作，提前腾出库容、疏通管网、前置抢险力量。
articles.summary_en: To cope with heavy rainfall from Typhoon Shadel, Fuzhou's urban water system dispatching center has been preparing drainage and flood control works, including reserving storage capacity, unclogging pipes, and prepositioning emergency crews.

articles.title_zh: 福州：申请住宅专项维修资金网上可办
articles.title_en: Fuzhou: Application for Residential Special Maintenance Funds Now Available Online
articles.summary_zh: 今年6月福州印发维修资金网上办理流程，8月26日首批3个项目完成拨付，平均耗时26天，线上办理更便捷。
articles.summary_en: In June, Fuzhou issued an online procedure for residential special maintenance funds. On Aug 26, the first batch of 3 projects was completed, averaging 26 days, making online applications more convenient.

tags.name_en: Fuzhou Housing and Urban-Rural Development Bureau

tags_en: Fuzhou Housing and Urban-Rural Development Bureau

articles.title_zh: “沙德尔”可能登陆闽浙一带沿海 福州28日有雨
articles.title_en: Typhoon Sadar May Make Landfall along Fujian-Zhejiang Coast; Fuzhou Expects Rain on Aug 28
articles.summary_zh: 记者从气象部门获悉，第18号台风“沙德尔”可能登陆闽浙沿海，福州市防指于8月26日提升防台风应急响应至Ⅲ级。
articles.summary_en: Fuzhou raised its typhoon emergency response to Level III on Aug 26 as Typhoon Sadar may make landfall along the coast of Fujian and Zhejiang.

tags.name_en: Fujian Provincial Ocean and Fisheries Bureau

tags_en: Fujian Provincial Ocean and Fisheries Bureau

articles.title_zh: 赵龙赴中央驻闽有关单位和企业调研
articles.title_en: Zhao Long Investigates Central Agencies and Enterprises in Fujian
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日至26日，福建省长赵龙赴中央驻闽有关单位和企业调研安全生产、防汛防台风和高质量发展等工作。
articles.summary_en: From August 25 to 26, Fujian Governor Zhao Long visited central agencies and enterprises in Fujian to inspect work safety, flood and typhoon preparedness, and high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 周祖翼赴省属国企调研
articles.title_en: Zhou Zuyi Inspects Provincial SOEs
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，福建省委书记周祖翼赴省国资委、省工控集团、省投资集团调研，强调聚焦主责主业，深化改革创新，推动国资国企高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Zhou Zuyi, Secretary of the CPC Fujian Provincial Committee, visited the Fujian Provincial SASAC and provincial SOEs, calling for deeper reforms and high-quality development of state-owned assets.

articles.title_zh: 福州印发知识产权专项资金管理办法 单个项目最高支持100万元
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Issues Measures for Special Funds on Intellectual Property, Max Support 1 Million Yuan per Project
articles.summary_zh: 福州市政府办公厅印发知识产权专项资金管理办法，围绕知识产权创造、运用、保护等全链条出台8项措施，单个项目最高支持100万元。
articles.summary_en: Fuzhou government issued measures for special funds on intellectual property, covering 8 measures across creation, application, protection, etc., with up to 1 million yuan support per project.

articles.title_zh: 曾赞荣会见徐鹏一行
articles.title_en: Zeng Zanrong Meets Xu Peng and Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日上午，山东省委常委、青岛市委书记曾赞荣会见中国船舶集团党组书记、董事长徐鹏一行，双方就深化海工装备等领域合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 27, Zeng Zanrong, member of the Standing Committee of the Shandong Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of Qingdao Municipal Party Committee, met with Xu Peng, Party Secretary and Chairman of China State Shipbuilding Corporation, to discuss deepening cooperation in marine engineering equipment.

articles.title_zh: 青岛市十七届人大常委会第三十七次会议举行
articles.title_en: Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 37th Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，青岛市十七届人大常委会第三十七次会议举行，审议节水条例、民营经济促进条例等法规草案和多项工作报告，梅建华主持。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 27, the 37th session of the 17th Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee reviewed draft regulations on water conservation and private economy promotion and other reports, chaired by Mei Jianhua.

articles.title_zh: 青岛市十七届人大常委会第三十七次会议召开联组会议对我市职业教育工作情况进行专题询问
articles.title_en: Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Joint Meeting to Inquire on Vocational Education
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日下午，青岛市十七届人大常委会第三十七次会议召开联组会议，就职业教育工作情况开展专题询问，市人大常委会主任梅建华出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 27, the Standing Committee of the 17th Qingdao Municipal People's Congress held a joint meeting to conduct special inquiries on vocational education. Director Mei Jianhua attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 全市防御第18号台风“沙德尔”工作部署会召开 林涛主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Citywide Meeting on Defense Against Typhoon Shadel Held, Lin Tao Chairs
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，厦门市召开防御第18号台风“沙德尔”工作部署会，市委书记林涛主持并讲话，强调全力保障人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Xiamen held a citywide deployment meeting on defense against Typhoon Shadel. Party Secretary Lin Tao chaired and spoke, stressing full protection of people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 国家统计局：1—7月份全国规模以上工业企业利润增长17.6%
articles.title_en: Industrial Profits of Above-Scale Enterprises Rise 17.6% in Jan-July
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局公布数据显示，1—7月全国规模以上工业企业利润总额同比增长17.6%，达45820.6亿元。
articles.summary_en: According to the National Bureau of Statistics, total profits of above-scale industrial enterprises rose 17.6% year-on-year to 4.582 trillion yuan in the first seven months.

articles.title_zh: 一条鱼如何游出200亿的大产业？
articles.title_en: How One Fish Swims into a 20-Billion-Yuan Industry
articles.summary_zh: 福建宁德发展大黄鱼产业，2025年产量22.2万吨，全产业链产值超200亿元，产品远销60多个国家和地区。
articles.summary_en: Ningde, Fujian develops large yellow croaker industry, with 2025 output of 222,000 tonnes, industry chain value exceeding 20 billion yuan, and exports to over 60 countries.

articles.title_zh: 王晓晖主持召开重点产业建圈强链和开发区提质增效工作推进会
articles.title_en: Wang Xiaohui Chairs Meeting on Industrial Chain and Development Zone Enhancement
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，四川省委书记王晓晖主持召开重点产业建圈强链和开发区提质增效工作推进会，强调建强产业链、建好开发区，省长施小琳作工作部署。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Sichuan Provincial Party Secretary Wang Xiaohui chaired a meeting on industrial chain strengthening and development zone upgrading, with Governor Shi Xiaolin making work arrangements.

articles.title_zh: 上合组织成立25周年 比什凯克峰会值得期待
articles.title_en: SCO Marks 25th Anniversary, Bishkek Summit Promising
articles.summary_zh: 今年是上海合作组织成立25周年，年度峰会将于8月31日至9月1日在吉尔吉斯斯坦首都比什凯克举行，旨在强化成员国共识、协调发展战略。
articles.summary_en: As the Shanghai Cooperation Organization marks its 25th anniversary, the annual summit will be held on Aug 31-Sep 1 in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, aiming to strengthen consensus and coordinate development strategies.

articles.title_zh: 英国实施全球首例AI实时辅助脑外科手术
articles.title_en: UK Performs World's First AI-Assisted Real-Time Brain Surgery
articles.summary_zh: 英国伦敦国家神经病学和神经外科医院为一名患者实施全球首例AI实时辅助脑外科手术，切除脑垂体肿瘤，患者已康复。
articles.summary_en: A hospital in London performed the world's first AI-assisted real-time brain surgery to remove a pituitary tumor; the patient has recovered.

tags.name_en: National Hospital for Neurology and Neurosurgery, London

articles.title_zh: 中国女排前队长孙玥带香港青少年参观雨花台烈士纪念馆
articles.title_en: Sun Yue, Former Chinese Women's Volleyball Captain, Takes Hong Kong Youth to Visit Yuhuatai Martyrs' Memorial Hall
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，中国女排前队长孙玥带领香港青少年代表团参观南京雨花台烈士纪念馆，感悟红色历史。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Sun Yue, former captain of the Chinese women's volleyball team, led a delegation of Hong Kong youth to visit the Yuhuatai Martyrs' Memorial Hall in Nanjing to learn about revolutionary history.

articles.title_zh: 新版《有机产品认证目录》发布 涉及1087种产品
articles.title_en: New Edition of Organic Product Certification Catalog Released, Covering 1,087 Products
articles.summary_zh: 市场监管总局（国家认监委）8月27日发布新版《有机产品认证目录》，共涉及1087种产品，删除312种低效品类，新增25种产品。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, the State Administration for Market Regulation (CNCA) released the new Organic Product Certification Catalog, covering 1,087 products. It removed 312 inefficient categories and added 25 new products.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷主持召开台风“沙德尔”防御工作会商调度会议
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Chairs Coordination Meeting on Typhoon 'Sadel' Defense
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，浙江省委副书记、省长刘捷两次赴省防汛防台应急指挥中心主持召开台风“沙德尔”防御工作会商调度会议，强调再研判、再排查、再落实，坚决打好防台攻坚仗。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Liu Jie, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee and Governor of Zhejiang, twice chaired a coordination meeting on typhoon 'Sadel' defense at the provincial flood control and typhoon emergency command center, emphasizing re-assessment, re-inspection, and re-implementation to ensure safety.

articles.title_zh: 【活力中国调研行】把古老行业重做一遍，山东这两家企业活力很“夯”
articles.title_en: Vitality China Research Tour: Shandong's Two Enterprises Reimagine Ancient Industries
articles.summary_zh: 央视网报道，山东济宁新能船业通过“船电分离”模式降低新能源船使用成本，宏济堂通过数字化溯源提升产品信任，展现传统产业转型升级活力。
articles.summary_en: CCTV reports that two Shandong enterprises, Xinneng Shipyard and Hongjitang, innovate by separating batteries from ships and using digital traceability, revitalizing traditional industries.

articles.title_zh: 各方全力以赴开展西藏吉隆县泥石流抢险救援
articles.title_en: All Parties Go All Out in Rescue and Relief for Mudslide in Gyirong County, Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，因尼泊尔一侧泥石流，西藏日喀则市吉隆县吉隆口岸发生重大灾害，致3人遇难、558人失联。习近平总书记作出重要指示，各方全力开展抢险救援。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, a major mudslide from Nepal struck Gyirong Port in Gyirong County, Shigatse, Tibet, leaving 3 dead and 558 missing. General Secretary Xi Jinping gave important instructions, and all parties are racing against time in rescue and relief.

articles.title_zh: 全球媒体聚焦 | 中国推动AI技术大规模应用
articles.title_en: Global Media Spotlight: China Promotes Large-Scale AI Application
articles.summary_zh: 新加坡亚洲新闻台8月27日发表署名文章称，中国AI发展路径侧重低成本、开放化、规模化落地，推动AI深度应用于实体经济，并成为多国技术合作方。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Singapore's CNA published an article stating that China's AI development focuses on low-cost, open, and large-scale application, deeply integrating AI into the real economy and serving as a tech partner for multiple countries.

articles.title_zh: 部分省份农村高额彩礼问题综合整治经验交流会在瑞金召开
articles.title_en: Experience Exchange Meeting on Rectifying High Bride Prices in Rural Areas Held in Ruijin
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，部分省份农村高额彩礼问题综合整治经验交流会在江西瑞金召开。韩文秀、胡凯红出席并讲话，陈永奇致辞，强调治理高额彩礼、推进移风易俗。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, an experience-sharing meeting on comprehensive governance of high bride prices in rural areas was held in Ruijin, Jiangxi. Han Wenxiu and Hu Kaihong attended and addressed, while Chen Yongqi delivered a speech, emphasizing efforts to curb high bride prices and promote new social customs.

articles.title_zh: 叶建春被查，江西省委：坚决拥护党中央决定
articles.title_en: Ye Jianchun Under Investigation; Jiangxi Provincial Committee Firmly Supports CPC Central Committee Decision
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日晚，江西省委常委会召开扩大会议，通报叶建春涉嫌严重违纪违法，接受中央纪委国家监委纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of August 27, the Standing Committee of the Jiangxi Provincial Committee held an enlarged meeting to report that Ye Jianchun is suspected of serious disciplinary violations and is under review and investigation by the CCDI and National Supervisory Commission.

articles.title_zh: 窥探飞行日志等敏感数据，境外间谍盯上我国巡检无人机
articles.title_en: Foreign Spies Target China's Inspection Drones for Sensitive Data
articles.summary_zh: 国家安全部8月27日发布安全提示，披露境外间谍情报机关持续渗透我国网联无人机巡检平台，窃取飞行日志等敏感数据，并提醒加强网络安全防护。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, the Ministry of State Security issued a security alert, revealing that foreign intelligence agencies have been penetrating China's networked drone inspection platforms to steal sensitive data such as flight logs, and urged enhanced cybersecurity measures.

articles.title_zh: 达不到召开理事会人数比例要求，银川市法官协会、女法官协会公告解散
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Judges Association and Women Judges Association Announce Dissolution
articles.summary_zh: 银川市法官协会、市女法官协会因部分理事失联、达不到召开理事会人数比例要求，经业务主管单位银川市中级人民法院同意，公告自行解散并启动注销程序。
articles.summary_en: The Yinchuan Judges Association and Women Judges Association announced dissolution because some council members were unreachable and the quorum for council meetings could not be met, with approval from the supervisory unit, the Yinchuan Intermediate People's Court, and began cancellation procedures.

articles.title_zh: 安徽出台科学技术奖励办法实施细则
articles.title_en: Anhui Issues Implementation Rules for Science and Technology Awards
articles.summary_zh: 安徽省科学技术厅近日印发《安徽省科学技术奖励办法实施细则》，细化奖励范围、提名条件、评审标准等，自8月30日起施行。
articles.summary_en: Anhui Science and Technology Department issued implementation rules for science and technology awards, specifying nomination conditions and review standards, effective from Aug 30.

articles.title_zh: 周祖翼赵龙赴福建省应急指挥中心会商调度台风“沙德尔”防御工作
articles.title_en: Zhou Zuyi and Zhao Long Coordinate Typhoon Sha De'er Defense in Fujian
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日上午，福建省委书记周祖翼、省长赵龙赴省应急指挥中心召开视频会议，会商调度第18号台风“沙德尔”防御工作，强调全力保障人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 26, Zhou Zuyi, Secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee, and Zhao Long, Governor of Fujian, visited the provincial emergency command center to hold a video conference to coordinate defense against Typhoon Sha De'er, stressing efforts to protect people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 福州将发布茉莉花茶窨制工艺省级地方标准
articles.title_en: Fuzhou to Release Provincial Standard for Jasmine Tea Scenting Process
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，福州市政府新闻办发布会宣布，第六届福州茉莉花茶文化节和第五届福州茶叶交易会将于9月4日至7日在福州举办，届时将发布茉莉花茶窨制工艺省级地方标准。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, at a press conference held by the Fuzhou Municipal Government, it was announced that the 6th Fuzhou Jasmine Tea Culture Festival and the 5th Fuzhou Tea Trade Fair will be held from September 4 to 7 in Fuzhou, where a provincial standard for jasmine tea scenting process will be released.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省推动中医药“六位一体”高质量发展
articles.title_en: Gansu Promotes High-Quality TCM Development with 'Six-in-One' Strategy
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省政府新闻办举行发布会，宣布“十五五”期间推动中医药事业、产业、文化、人才、科技、开放“六位一体”高质量发展，力争2030年建成中医药强省。
articles.summary_en: At a press conference, Gansu provincial government announced a 'six-in-one' strategy to boost traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, aiming to become a strong TCM province by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 广西出台专利申请前评估工作指引
articles.title_en: Guangxi Issues Guidelines for Pre-Application Patent Evaluation
articles.summary_zh: 广西市场监管局联合教育厅等五部门印发专利申请前评估指引，对财政支持项目强制评估，推动专利从数量规模向质量价值转型。
articles.summary_en: Guangxi's market regulation authority, together with education, science, health, and state-assets departments, issued guidelines for pre-application patent evaluation, mandating assessment for government-funded projects to boost patent quality.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁会见中央社会工作部部长吴汉圣
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Meets with Minister Wu Hansheng of Central Social Work Department
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，河南省委书记刘宁在郑州会见中央社会工作部部长吴汉圣一行，双方就社会工作高质量发展座谈交流。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 26, Liu Ning, Henan Provincial Party Secretary, met with Wu Hansheng, Minister of the Central Social Work Department, in Zhengzhou to discuss high-quality social work development.

articles.title_zh: 我国首个卫星数据跨境加工贸易区揭牌成立
articles.title_en: China's First Cross-border Satellite Data Processing Trade Zone Inaugurated
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月26日，在文昌国际航空航天论坛开幕式上，海南航天数据跨境加工贸易区揭牌成立，这是我国首个聚焦卫星数据跨境加工的贸易区。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, 2026, the Hainan Aerospace Data Cross-border Processing Trade Zone was inaugurated at the Wenchang International Aerospace Forum, becoming China's first trade zone for cross-border satellite data processing.

articles.title_zh: 河北大力推动产业关键核心技术攻关
articles.title_en: Hebei Promotes Breakthroughs in Key Industrial Core Technologies
articles.summary_zh: 河北省近年构建“产业出题、科技答题、市场阅卷”机制，聚焦重点产业滚动支持科技攻关项目，推动关键核心技术突破，加速成果转化与新质生产力形成。
articles.summary_en: Hebei Province has established a coordinated mechanism for technological research, focusing on key industries and rolling support for projects to achieve breakthroughs in core technologies and boost new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 用好红色资源 激发奋进力量
articles.title_en: Make Good Use of Red Resources to Inspire Striving Force
articles.summary_zh: 海南琼海市持续擦亮红色娘子军名片，用好红色资源，激励干部群众干事创业，推动革命老区发展。
articles.summary_en: Qionghai City in Hainan continues to promote the Red Detachment of Women brand, leveraging red resources to inspire officials and the public to work hard and advance development of the old revolutionary base.

articles.title_zh: 我国首个卫星数据跨境加工贸易区揭牌成立
articles.title_en: China's First Cross-border Satellite Data Processing Trade Zone Established
articles.summary_zh: 2026文昌国际航空航天论坛开幕，海南航天数据跨境加工贸易区揭牌成立，系我国首个聚焦卫星数据跨境加工的贸易区。
articles.summary_en: At the 2026 Wenchang International Aerospace Forum, Hainan Aerospace Data Cross-border Processing Trade Zone was inaugurated, becoming China's first trade zone for cross-border satellite data processing.

articles.title_zh: 许勤：加力推动服务业优质高效发展 加快龙江全面振兴全方位振兴
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Calls for High-Quality Development of Service Industry to Boost Heilongjiang's Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，黑龙江省服务业大会在哈尔滨召开，省委书记许勤强调实施服务业扩能提质行动，推动服务业优质高效发展，加快龙江全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, Heilongjiang Province held a service industry conference in Harbin. Party Secretary Xu Qin stressed implementing actions to expand and upgrade the service sector for high-quality development and revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲主持召开黑龙江省政府第八次全体会议
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Chairs 8th Plenary Session of Heilongjiang Provincial Government
articles.summary_zh: 27日，黑龙江省委副书记、省长梁惠玲主持召开省政府第八次全体会议，强调贯彻党中央国务院决策部署，全力完成全年经济社会发展目标任务。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 27, Liang Huiling, governor of Heilongjiang, chaired the 8th plenary session of the provincial government, urging implementation of central decisions to achieve annual economic and social development goals.

articles.title_zh: 党建调研行丨三湘潮涌处 党旗别样红
articles.title_en: Party Building Research Tour: Red Banners Wave Across Hunan's Land
articles.summary_zh: 人民网党建调研行深入湖南长沙、岳阳等地，调研基层党组织如何将政治优势、组织优势转化为产业发展和治理优势，总结党建引领基层治理和产业发展的湖南经验。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily Online's party building research tour visited Changsha, Yueyang and other places in Hunan to investigate how grassroots party organizations translate political and organizational advantages into industrial development and governance improvements, summarizing Hunan's experience in party-led governance and industrial growth.

articles.title_zh: 李强在黑龙江、吉林调研时强调 多措并举稳产增产 全力夺取秋粮丰收 持续提升农业综合生产能力确保粮食安全
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Visits Heilongjiang and Jilin, Stressing Measures to Ensure Autumn Grain Harvest and Enhance Agricultural Capacity
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日至26日，国务院总理李强在黑龙江、吉林调研，强调多措并举夺取秋粮丰收，提升农业综合生产能力，确保粮食安全。
articles.summary_en: From August 24 to 26, Premier Li Qiang visited Heilongjiang and Jilin, stressing measures to ensure autumn grain harvest and enhance agricultural production capacity for food security.

articles.title_zh: 徐州出台新政赋能科创大走廊建设
articles.title_en: Xuzhou Issues New Policy to Boost Sci-Tech Innovation Corridor
articles.summary_zh: 近日，徐州印发《关于支持徐州科创大走廊创新引领发展的若干措施（试行）》，对创新中心、实验室及人才给予最高1000万元研发支持和500万元资助，推动科创大走廊建设。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Xuzhou issued a new policy to support its Sci-Tech Innovation Corridor, offering up to 10 million yuan in R&D support for innovation centers and 5 million yuan for top talents.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省小微特具身智能重点实验室在无锡启动建设
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Key Laboratory for Small/Micro Embodied Intelligence Launches in Wuxi
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，江苏省小微特具身智能重点实验室在无锡启动建设，中电海康集团与南京大学同步签署战略合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, the Jiangsu Provincial Key Laboratory for Small/Micro Embodied Intelligence was launched in Wuxi, with CETHIK Group and Nanjing University signing a strategic cooperation agreement.

articles.title_zh: 江苏出台三年行动计划 促进生物医药产业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues Three-Year Action Plan to Promote High-Quality Development of Biomedical Industry
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，江苏省工信厅发布《江苏省促进生物医药产业高质量发展三年行动计划》，目标到2028年产业规模和创新药械数量保持全国领先。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 26, Jiangsu Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology issued a three-year action plan to promote high-quality development of the biomedical industry, aiming to keep the province's industry scale and innovative drugs/devices leading nationwide by 2028.

tags.name_en: Jiangsu Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Jiangsu Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 坚决打赢集中整治攻坚决战
articles.title_en: Resolutely Win the Decisive Battle of Concentrated Rectification
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，江西省召开群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作调度会，省委常委、省纪委书记时玉宝出席并讲话，对下一阶段攻坚任务进行再动员、再部署。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, Jiangxi Province held a work scheduling meeting on the concentrated rectification of misconduct and corruption around the people. Shi Yubao, member of the Standing Committee of the Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection, attended and delivered a speech, re-mobilizing and redeploying the next stage of key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 稀土废渣废水中钍铀检测国标发布
articles.title_en: National Standard for Thorium and Uranium Detection in Rare Earth Waste Residue and Wastewater Released
articles.summary_zh: 近日，国家市场监督管理总局、国家标准化管理委员会发布稀土废渣废水中钍铀检测国家标准，由江西省钨与稀土产品质检中心主导制定，填补了相关领域空白。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the State Administration for Market Regulation and the Standardization Administration issued a national standard for detecting thorium and uranium in rare earth waste residue and wastewater, led by Jiangxi Tungsten and Rare Earth Product Quality Inspection Center, filling a domestic gap.

tags.name_zh: 国家市场监督管理总局
国家标准化管理委员会

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古自治区妇女第十三次代表大会胜利闭幕
articles.title_en: The 13th Women's Congress of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Concludes Successfully
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，内蒙古自治区妇女第十三次代表大会闭幕，自治区党委副书记、政法委书记时光辉出席并讲话，孙艾芳当选新一届妇联主席。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, the 13th Women's Congress of Inner Mongolia concluded. Shi Guanghui, Deputy Secretary of the Regional Party Committee, attended and spoke. Sun Aifang was elected chairwoman of the new Women's Federation.

articles.title_zh: 包钢调研基层医疗服务和医保基金管理工作
articles.title_en: Bao Gang Inspects Community Health Services and Medical Insurance Fund Management
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，内蒙古自治区主席包钢在呼和浩特调研基层医疗服务和医保基金管理工作，强调守护群众看病钱。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Bao Gang, chairman of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, inspected community health services and medical insurance fund management in Hohhot, stressing protecting people's medical funds.

articles.title_zh: 7月全国查处违反中央八项规定精神问题27995起
articles.title_en: Nationwide Inspections Uncover 27,995 Cases of Violations of Central Eight-Point Regulations in July
articles.summary_zh: 中央纪委国家监委公布7月全国查处违反中央八项规定精神问题27995起，批评教育和处理34683人，给予党纪政务处分23422人。
articles.summary_en: In July, nationwide inspections found 27,995 cases violating the Central Eight-Point Regulations, with 34,683 people criticized or educated, and 23,422 disciplined.

articles.title_zh: 王毅会见美国驻华大使庞德伟
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets with US Ambassador to China
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京会见美国驻华大使庞德伟，双方就构建中美建设性战略稳定关系交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, met with US Ambassador to China Pang Dewei in Beijing to exchange views on building a constructive strategic stable relationship.

articles.title_zh: 5名公安先进典型代表与中外记者见面
articles.title_en: Five Outstanding Police Representatives Meet Chinese and Foreign Journalists
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，国务院新闻办举行中外记者见面会，5名公安先进典型代表交流基层工作经历。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, the State Council Information Office held a press conference where five outstanding police representatives shared their grassroots experiences.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将出席上合组织峰会并访问吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Attend SCO Summit and Visit Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平将于8月30日至9月3日出席在比什凯克举行的上海合作组织峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问，推动高质量共建“一带一路”合作。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping will attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organization Summit in Bishkek and pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt from Aug 30 to Sep 3, promoting high-quality Belt and Road cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 王毅会见乌兹别克斯坦总统办公厅主任米尔济约耶娃
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets Head of Uzbek Presidential Administration
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京会见乌兹别克斯坦总统办公厅主任米尔济约耶娃，双方就双边关系与合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, met with the Head of the Uzbek Presidential Administration Saida Mirziyoyeva in Beijing, exchanging views on bilateral relations and cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 全省防汛工作视频调度会议召开
articles.title_en: Provincial Flood Control Video Conference Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日上午，青海省召开防汛工作视频调度会议，省长罗东川主持并讲话，部署新一轮强降雨防范应对工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 26, Qinghai Province held a flood control video conference. Governor Luo Dongchuan presided and deployed measures against the new round of heavy rainfall.

articles.title_zh: 四川省委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Sichuan Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，四川省委常委会召开会议，省委书记王晓晖主持，传达学习习近平总书记有关重要讲话精神和中央有关会议精神，研究四川省贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: Sichuan Provincial Party Committee met Aug 26, chaired by Wang Xiaohui, to study implementation of Xi Jinping's speeches and central meeting decisions.

tags.name_en: Study and Implement the Spirit of the Central Authorities

tags_en: Study and Implement the Spirit of the Central Authorities

articles.title_zh: 十二届四川省委第九轮巡视完成第二批进驻
articles.title_en: Sichuan Provincial Party Committee Completes Second Batch of 9th Inspection Round
articles.summary_zh: 截至8月25日，十二届四川省委第九轮巡视完成第二批进驻，对17个省直部门（单位）开展巡视，现场巡视将于9月中旬结束。
articles.summary_en: As of August 25, the 9th round of inspections by the 12th Sichuan Provincial Party Committee completed its second batch, covering 17 provincial departments, with on-site inspections ending in mid-September.

articles.title_zh: 成都印发《直播电商提能培育三年行动计划》
articles.title_en: Chengdu Issues Three-Year Action Plan for Livestream E-Commerce
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，成都印发《直播电商提能培育三年行动计划（2026—2028年）》，提出到2028年直播电商网络零售额突破1500亿元，建设全国特色产业带直播标杆城市。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Chengdu issued the Three-Year Action Plan for Livestream E-Commerce Enhancement (2026-2028), aiming to exceed 150 billion yuan in online retail sales by 2028 and establish itself as a national benchmark for livestream e-commerce in industrial belts.

articles.title_zh: 广元市委举行新闻发布会介绍第九次党代会精神
articles.title_en: Guangyuan Holds Press Conference on Ninth Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，中共广元市委举行新闻发布会，介绍市第九次党代会和市委九届一次全会情况，解读未来五年八个方面重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, the CPC Guangyuan Municipal Committee held a press conference to introduce the 9th Party Congress and the 9th Committee's first plenary session, outlining eight key tasks for the next five years.

articles.title_zh: 四川泸县亮相国家卫生健康委新闻发布会 为啥？
articles.title_en: Sichuan's Luxian County Showcases at National Health Commission Press Conference
articles.summary_zh: 四川泸县在国家卫生健康委新闻发布会上介绍县域医疗卫生服务体系建设经验，聚焦资源布局优化、基层能力提升和健康服务内涵拓展。
articles.summary_en: Luxian County in Sichuan presented its county-level medical service system at a National Health Commission press conference, focusing on optimizing resources, enhancing grassroots capacity, and expanding health services.

articles.title_zh: 山东巨野：情暖童心护成长 巾帼关爱暖人心
articles.title_en: Shandong Juye: Women's Federation Delivers Warmth to Children in Need
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，山东省巨野县麒麟镇妇联开展困境儿童专项慰问活动，为辖区困境儿童送上物资和关怀，倾听心声，了解生活学习现状。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, the Women's Federation of Qilin Town, Juye County, Shandong, carried out a special visit to children in need, delivering supplies and care, listening to their voices, and learning about their life and study conditions.

articles.title_zh: “家国情怀 跨山越海——侨批历史文化展”开展
articles.title_en: 'Family Sentiment Across Mountains and Seas' - Qiaopi Historical and Cultural Exhibition Opens in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，“家国情怀 跨山越海——侨批历史文化展”在济南市图书馆开展，省委常委、统战部部长邓云锋出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On August 27, the "Family Sentiment Across Mountains and Seas" Qiaopi Historical and Cultural Exhibition opened at Jinan Library; Deng Yunfeng, head of the United Front Work Department, attended and spoke.

tags.name_en: Jinan Municipal United Front Work Department

tags_en: Jinan Municipal United Front Work Department

articles.title_zh: 工业设计，为制造业打开新空间（大数据观察）
articles.title_en: Industrial Design Opens New Space for Manufacturing
articles.summary_zh: 记者探访江苏、广东、山东等地，展示工业设计深度融入制造业全链条，助力企业降本增效，推动产业转型升级。
articles.summary_en: Reporters visit Jiangsu, Guangdong, and Shandong to show how industrial design is deeply embedded in manufacturing chains, helping companies cut costs and upgrade industries.

articles.title_zh: 到2030年，上海战略性新兴产业增加值达2.1万亿元
articles.title_en: Shanghai Targets 2.1 Trillion Yuan in Strategic Emerging Industries by 2030
articles.summary_zh: 昨天公布的《上海市战略性新兴产业发展“十五五”规划》提出，到2030年上海战略性新兴产业增加值达2.1万亿元，重点提升集成电路、生物医药、人工智能三大先导产业，并布局12个新兴支柱产业赛道和10个前沿技术方向。
articles.summary_en: The "15th Five-Year Plan" for Strategic Emerging Industries in Shanghai, released yesterday, sets a 2030 target of 2.1 trillion yuan in value-added, focusing on IC, biomedicine, and AI, plus 12 new pillar tracks and 10 frontier technologies.

articles.title_zh: 市域崇明线启动列车调试 最高运行时速120公里
articles.title_en: Chongming Line Starts Train Commissioning with Top Speed of 120 km/h
articles.summary_zh: 上海市域崇明线正式进入列车交付和调试验证阶段，一列调试列车从浦东金吉路站出发至崇明陈家镇站，全程约23分钟，过江仅十余分钟。列车最高运行时速120公里，搭载全自动无人驾驶系统。
articles.summary_en: Shanghai's Chongming Line has entered train delivery and commissioning, with a test train running from Jilu Road Station to Chenjia Town in about 23 minutes, including only 10 minutes crossing the river. Trains feature 120 km/h top speed and fully automatic driverless operation.

articles.title_zh: 天津市调解工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Tianjin Holds Citywide Mediation Work Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，天津市委依法治市办、市高院、市司法局、市综治中心联合召开全市调解工作会议，市委常委、政法委书记衡晓帆和市高院院长李静出席并讲话，部署下一步任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Tianjin jointly held a citywide mediation work conference. He Xiaofan, Standing Committee member and Political-Legal Affairs Secretary, and Li Jing, President of the Higher People's Court, attended and spoke, deploying next-step tasks.

articles.title_zh: 京津冀零碳产业联盟成立 携手破解区域降碳堵点
articles.title_en: Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Zero-Carbon Industry Alliance Established to Tackle Regional Carbon Reduction Bottlenecks
articles.summary_zh: 近日，河北省绿色低碳循环发展协会、北京市绿色产业发展促进会、天津市节能协会及远景科技集团等共同成立京津冀零碳产业联盟，旨在破解三地降碳堵点、构建零碳产业生态。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Hebei Green Low-Carbon Circular Development Association, Beijing Green Industry Development Promotion Association, Tianjin Energy Conservation Association, and Envision Group jointly established the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Zero-Carbon Industry Alliance to address regional carbon reduction bottlenecks and build a zero-carbon industrial ecosystem.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江主持召开自治区党委全面深化改革委员会会议
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang Chairs CPC Xinjiang Committee Meeting on Deepening Reforms
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，新疆自治区党委全面深化改革委员会召开会议，听取改革进展汇报，研究部署重点工作，自治区党委书记陈小江主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 26, the CPC Xinjiang Autonomous Region Committee's Commission for Deepening Reform held a meeting to hear reform progress and plan key work. Party Secretary Chen Xiaojiang presided and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜会见全国妇联系统港澳执委和特邀代表考察团
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang and Erkin Tuniyaz Meet Hong Kong-Macao Women's Federation Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，新疆党委书记陈小江、自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在乌鲁木齐会见全国妇联系统港澳执委和特邀代表考察团，双方就深化新疆与港澳妇女事业交流合作、铸牢中华民族共同体意识等进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Chen Xiaojiang, Party Secretary of Xinjiang, and Erkin Tuniyaz, Chairman of the region, met with a delegation of Hong Kong and Macao executive committee members and specially invited representatives of the All-China Women's Federation in Urumqi to discuss exchanges on women's affairs and strengthening the sense of community for the Chinese nation.

articles.title_zh: 西藏第一时间启动救援 多路力量驰援灾区
articles.title_en: Tibet Launches Immediate Rescue, Multiple Forces Rush to Disaster Area
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，尼泊尔侧泥石流致西藏日喀则吉隆口岸重大伤亡失联，习近平作出指示，自治区党委书记王君正赶赴现场指挥救援。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, a mudslide in Nepal caused heavy casualties at Gyirong Port in Shigatse, Tibet. Xi Jinping gave instructions, and regional Party chief Wang Junzheng rushed to the scene to direct rescue.

articles.title_zh: HICOOL 2026全球创业者峰会在京开幕 尹力致辞 殷勇出席
articles.title_en: HICOOL 2026 Global Entrepreneurs Summit Opens in Beijing; Yin Li Delivers Speech, Yin Yong Attends
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日晚，HICOOL 2026全球创业者峰会在北京开幕，北京市委书记尹力致辞，市长殷勇出席。峰会吸引141个国家和地区超万个创业项目。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Aug 26, the HICOOL 2026 Global Entrepreneurs Summit opened in Beijing. Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li delivered a speech; Mayor Yin Yong attended, with over 10,000 projects from 141 countries.

articles.title_zh: 北京市政府召开常务会议 研究现代服务业扩能提质等事项 市长殷勇主持
articles.title_en: Beijing Mayor Yin Yong Chairs Municipal Government Executive Meeting on Modern Service Industry
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日上午，北京市政府召开常务会议，研究现代服务业扩能提质、“十五五”时期国际交往中心建设等事项，市长殷勇主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 26, the Beijing Municipal Government held an executive meeting chaired by Mayor Yin Yong to discuss upgrading the modern service industry and enhancing the city's role as an international exchange center during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 北京市委党的建设工作领导小组会议召开 尹力主持
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal Party Committee Holds Party Building Leadership Group Meeting, Chaired by Yin Li
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，北京市委党的建设工作领导小组会议召开，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示和中央会议精神，听取学习教育工作总结汇报，部署建立健全正确政绩观长效机制。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, the Beijing Municipal Party Committee's Party Building Leadership Group meeting was held, chaired by Yin Li. It conveyed General Secretary Xi Jinping's instructions and central committee spirit, reviewed the education campaign summary on correct performance views, and deployed long-term mechanisms.

articles.title_zh: 《习近平文化文选》第一卷、第二卷主要篇目介绍
articles.title_en: Introduction to Main Articles of Selected Works of Xi Jinping on Culture, Volumes I and II

articles.summary_en: Volumes I and II of Selected Works of Xi Jinping on Culture, edited by the CPC Central Committee's Party History and Literature Research Institute, include 78 key works on cultural development from Nov 2012 to Feb 2026, some first published.

articles.summary_en: On August 27, the two volumes of Xi Jinping's Selected Works on Culture, compiled by the CPC Central Committee's Institute of Party History and Literature, were published by Central Literature Publishing House and distributed nationwide.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会举行会议 研究部署巩固拓展学习教育成果等工作
articles.title_en: Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Study and Deploy Consolidating Education Outcomes
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日上午，重庆市委常委会举行会议，市委书记袁家军主持并讲话，研究部署巩固拓展学习教育成果、河长制林长制及固废污染整治等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Aug 26, the Standing Committee of the Chongqing Municipal Party Committee held a meeting chaired by Yuan Jiajun to study and deploy consolidation of education outcomes, river/lake chief system, forest chief system, and solid waste pollution remediation.

articles.title_zh: 全省防汛专题调度会议召开 刘宁主持并讲话 王凯出席
articles.title_en: Provincial Flood Control Dispatch Meeting Held, Liu Ning Presides and Addresses
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，全省防汛专题调度会议在省应急指挥部召开，省委书记刘宁主持并讲话，省长王凯出席并作部署，分析研判当前防汛形势，安排部署防汛救灾和台风防范应对工作。

Liu Ning, secretary of the provincial party committee, presided and addressed, while Governor Wang Kai attended and made arrangements. The meeting analyzed the current flood situation and deployed flood relief and typhoon prevention tasks.

articles.title_zh: 受习近平总书记委托，李强抵达西藏吉隆指导抢险救灾工作

articles.title_zh: 我国首版全国几何基准影像成果发布

articles.title_zh: 王浩：全面高标准做好应对各项工作 坚决打赢打好防御台风“沙德尔”硬仗

articles.title_zh: 济南市工商联第十六次代表大会开幕

articles.title_zh: 王君正与国家开发银行党委副书记黄志强座谈

articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，岳阳市委副书记、代理市长唐浩然赴岳阳县调研经济运行、项目建设和安全生产工作。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 25, Tang Haoran, deputy secretary of the Yueyang Municipal Party Committee and acting mayor, visited Yueyang County to inspect economic operation, project construction, and production safety.

articles.title_zh: 卢荣春赴罗定调研督导虫媒传染病防控工作
articles.title_en: Lu Rongchun Visits Luoding to Supervise Vector-borne Disease Prevention and Control
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日上午，云浮市委书记卢荣春到罗定市调研督导虫媒传染病防控工作，实地察看环境整治并召开座谈会。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 25, Lu Rongchun, Party Secretary of Yunfu, visited Luoding to supervise vector-borne disease prevention and control, inspected environmental remediation, and chaired a symposium.

articles.title_zh: 全市防御台风“紫檀”工作调度会召开
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Holds Typhoon Zitan Defense Coordination Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日上午，湛江市委书记余钢主持召开全市防御台风“紫檀”工作调度会，部署防御措施。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Aug 25, Zhanjiang Party Secretary Yu Gang chaired a city-wide meeting to coordinate typhoon Zitan defense measures.

articles.title_zh: 杨杰东会见宝武清能总裁魏炜一行 共商零碳园区建设合作
articles.title_en: Yang Jiedong Meets Baowu Clean Energy President Wei Wei for Zero-Carbon Park Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，湛江经开区管委会主任杨杰东会见宝武清洁能源总裁魏炜一行，双方就零碳园区合作建设进行座谈，探索东海岛绿色低碳发展新路径。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 25, Yang Jiedong, director of Zhanjiang Economic Development Zone, met with Wei Wei, president of Baowu Clean Energy, to discuss zero-carbon park cooperation and explore green low-carbon development for Donghai Island.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Article
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁主持市委常委会会议，学习习近平总书记重要文章《加快建设健康中国》，研究贯彻落实措施并部署防御台风等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, Guo Ningning, Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Municipal Party Committee, chaired a meeting of the Fuzhou Municipal Standing Committee to study Xi Jinping's important article 'Accelerating the Construction of a Healthy China' and made arrangements for typhoon defense and other work.

articles.title_zh: 各地持续优化涉企服务 推动政策红利直达快享
articles.title_en: Localities Improve Enterprise Services to Deliver Policy Dividends Fast
articles.summary_zh: 新华社北京8月26日电，各地持续优化营商环境，推行惠企政策全程网办、直达快享，打通政策落地最后一公里。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reports that localities are improving business environments, implementing full online processing and direct delivery of enterprise-benefiting policies to ensure quick access.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世举行会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with King Abdullah II of Jordan
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，国家主席习近平在北京同来华国事访问的约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世举行会谈，双方就深化中约战略伙伴关系达成共识。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, President Xi Jinping held talks in Beijing with King Abdullah II of Jordan, who was on a state visit, and they agreed to deepen the China-Jordan strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 三部门调拨3万件中央救灾物资，支持西藏做好灾害救助工作
articles.title_en: Three Departments Allocate 30,000 Central Relief Supplies to Support Tibet Disaster Relief
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，国家防灾减灾救灾委员会办公室、应急管理部会同国家粮食和物资储备局向西藏日喀则市吉隆县调拨3万件中央救灾物资，支持泥石流灾害救助。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, the Office of the National Disaster Prevention and Relief Commission, the Ministry of Emergency Management, and the National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration allocated 30,000 central relief supplies to Gyirong County, Shigatse, Tibet, to support mudslide disaster relief.

tags.name_zh: 国家粮食和物资储备局
tags.name_en: National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration

tags_zh: 国家粮食和物资储备局
tags_en: National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration

articles.title_zh: 城市C位留给国士：河南江西湖北多地跟进在户外大屏滚动播放科学家海报
articles.title_en: City Centers Honor National Heroes: Henan, Jiangxi, Hubei Follow Up with Scientist Posters on Outdoor Screens
articles.summary_zh: 近日，河南郑州、江西南昌、湖北襄阳等地跟进在户外大屏播放科学家海报，将‘城市C位’留给钱学森、袁隆平、邓稼先等功勋科学家。
articles.summary_en: Recently, cities including Zhengzhou, Nanchang, and Xiangyang followed suit by displaying scientist posters on outdoor screens, honoring national heroes like Qian Xuesen, Yuan Longping, and Deng Jiaxian.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军陈新武在武隆区彭水县调研并召开现场会
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun and Chen Xinwu Visit Wulong and Pengshui, Hold On-Site Meeting on Grassroots Safety
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日至25日，重庆市委书记袁家军、市长陈新武赴武隆区、彭水县调研，并召开全市群防群治提升基层除险固安实战能力百日攻坚行动现场会。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 24 to 25, Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun and Mayor Chen Xinwu visited Wulong and Pengshui, and held an on-site meeting on grassroots safety and disaster prevention.

articles.title_zh: 南宁出台快递用工指引及劳动合同范本
articles.title_en: Nanning Issues Employment Guidelines and Labor Contract Template for Express Delivery Industry
articles.summary_zh: 南宁市邮政管理局、市总工会、市人社局日前联合印发快递行业劳动用工管理指引及劳动合同示范文本，围绕劳动报酬、休息休假等6方面规范用工，保障从业人员权益。
articles.summary_en: Nanning's Postal Administration, Federation of Trade Unions, and Human Resources Bureau jointly issued employment guidelines and a labor contract template for the express delivery industry, covering six aspects including wages and rest leaves to protect workers' rights.

articles.title_zh: 巩固拓展学习教育成果 以正确政绩观推动支点建设取得新突破
articles.title_en: Hubei Provincial Party Committee Consolidates Learning Education Results for New Breakthroughs in Pivot Construction
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日下午，湖北省委常委会（扩大）会议召开，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示，总结树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，部署巩固拓展成果、建立长效机制。中央指导组组长蒋卓庆、省委书记关志鸥出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 25, Hubei Provincial Party Committee held an expanded meeting to study Xi Jinping's instructions and summarize education on correct political achievement view, deciding to consolidate results. Jiang Zhuoqing and Guan Zhiou spoke.

articles.title_zh: 始终以正确政绩观担当作为、履职尽责
articles.title_en: Always Acting with a Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 全国开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，广大党员干部以正确政绩观推动发展、造福群众，取得明显成效。
articles.summary_en: The nationwide education campaign on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements has achieved notable results, guiding officials to promote development and benefit the people.

articles.title_zh: 海南发布第四批生态产品价值实现典型案例
articles.title_en: Hainan Releases Fourth Batch of Typical Cases of Eco-Product Value Realization
articles.summary_zh: 近日，海南省国家生态文明试验区建设和生态环境保护督察工作领导小组办公室公布第四批生态产品价值实现典型案例，共6个案例入选，展示各市县在生态产品价值转化方面的创新实践。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the leading group office for Hainan's national ecological civilization pilot zone and ecological environment protection supervision released the fourth batch of typical cases of eco-product value realization, with six cases selected, showcasing innovative practices in eco-product value transformation.

articles.title_zh: 选对赛道，赋予汽车新定义
articles.title_en: Choosing the Right Track: Giving Cars a New Definition
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报与中国汽车报调研组刊发系列报道，回顾我国新能源汽车产业在顶层设计引领下实现换道超车，产销量连续11年居世界第一，并推动智能网联化新定义。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily and China Automotive News research group review the development of China's new energy vehicle industry, which has ranked first in production and sales for 11 consecutive years, driven by top-level design of electrification, intelligence, and connectivity.

articles.title_zh: 南京溧水等多地推动暑期休闲转向深度体验
articles.title_en: Nanjing Lishui and Other Places Promote Deep-Experience Summer Leisure
articles.summary_zh: 暑期文旅消费旺季，南京溧水、武汉、云南昭通等地推出短途度假、户外溯溪、康养旅居等深度体验项目，推动休闲消费从“到此一游”转向深度体验。
articles.summary_en: During the summer tourism peak, places including Lishui (Nanjing), Wuhan, and Zhaotong (Yunnan) promote short-break vacations, outdoor stream hiking, and wellness stays, shifting leisure from sightseeing to deep experience.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁新能源汽车“换挡加速”
articles.title_en: Liaoning's New Energy Vehicle Industry Accelerates
articles.summary_zh: 1月至7月，辽宁新能源汽车产量达13.24万辆，同比增长29.4%，吉利、宝马、奇瑞等龙头车企和产业链项目助推产业加速发展。
articles.summary_en: From January to July, Liaoning's NEV output reached 132,400 units, up 29.4% year-on-year, driven by projects from Geely, BMW, and Chery.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁推动行政复议从单一窗口向全域服务转变
articles.title_en: Liaoning Promotes Transformation of Administrative Reconsideration from Single Window to Full-Service
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，辽宁省政府新闻办召开新闻发布会，通报新修订行政复议法实施以来全省新收行政复议案件7.2万余件，行政复议化解行政争议主渠道作用不断显现。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the Information Office of Liaoning Provincial Government held a press conference, reporting over 72,000 new administrative reconsideration cases since the revised law took effect, highlighting its growing role as the main channel for resolving administrative disputes.

articles.title_zh: 始终以正确政绩观担当作为、履职尽责
articles.title_en: Always Act with a Correct View of Political Achievements and Fulfill Duties
articles.summary_zh: 中央部署在全党开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，各级党组织和党员干部通过学查改取得明显成效。
articles.summary_en: The Party-wide education on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements has achieved notable results, with party organizations and officials improving through study, inspection, and rectification.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中主持召开全区防汛救灾工作视频调度会
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong Chairs Regional Video Conference on Flood Control and Disaster Relief
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日晚，自治区党委书记王伟中主持召开全区防汛救灾工作视频调度会，强调全面细致抓好防汛救灾，保障人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of August 25, Wang Weizhong, Party Secretary of Inner Mongolia, chaired a regional video conference on flood control and disaster relief, emphasizing thorough implementation to safeguard people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 自治区人民政府召开重点工作推进会议
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Regional Government Holds Key Work Promotion Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，自治区人民政府召开重点工作推进会议，自治区主席包钢部署“两重”建设、“两新”工作和“六张网”规划及财政风险防控等任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, the regional government held a key work meeting; Chairman Bao Gang deployed tasks on major projects, new initiatives, six networks planning, and fiscal risk prevention.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏银川市全面推进中央安全生产考核巡查二季度明查暗访反馈问题整改工作
articles.title_en: Yinchuan City Promotes Rectification of Problems Found in Central Work Safety Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 宁夏银川市针对中央安全生产考核巡查组二季度明查暗访反馈的问题，全面推进整改，已实现15项重大事故隐患清零，对19家企业、18名责任人罚款共计1029.99万元。
articles.summary_en: Yinchuan, Ningxia, has pushed forward rectification of problems found by the central work safety inspection in Q2, eliminating 15 major hidden dangers and fining 19 enterprises and 18 individuals a total of 10.2999 million yuan.

articles.title_zh: 这座硬核“超级充电宝”，正在硬控川西新能源
articles.title_en: Hardcore 'Super Power Bank' Bolsters New Energy in Western Sichuan
articles.summary_zh: 四川省甘孜州道孚县正建设全球海拔最高的抽水蓄能电站，总装机210万千瓦，已进入主体施工前攻坚期，建成后日储电量达1260万千瓦时，将助力川西新能源消纳。
articles.summary_en: Daofu pumped-storage power station, the world's highest-altitude such facility in Sichuan, is entering the critical pre-construction phase. With 2.1 GW capacity and daily storage of 12.6 GWh, it will support new energy consumption in western Sichuan.

articles.title_zh: 同心同行——两岸青年交流季上海站活动在沪举行
articles.title_en: Shanghai Hosts Cross-Strait Youth Exchange Season Event
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，“同心同行——两岸青年交流季上海站”活动在上海开幕，约1000名两岸各界人士和青年代表参加，国台办主任宋涛、上海市长龚正等出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 25, the Shanghai leg of the Cross-Strait Youth Exchange Season opened in Shanghai, attended by about 1,000 people. Song Tao, head of the Taiwan Affairs Office, and Shanghai Mayor Gong Zheng delivered remarks.

tags.name_en: Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council

tags_en: Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 鲁迅文学周在沪启动
articles.title_en: Lu Xun Literature Week Kicks Off in Shanghai
articles.summary_zh: 2026中国文学盛典·鲁迅文学周启动仪式8月25日在上海鲁迅公园举办，鲁迅文学奖首次落地上海，颁奖典礼将永久在上海举行。
articles.summary_en: The launch ceremony of the 2026 Lu Xun Literature Week was held on August 25 in Shanghai's Lu Xun Park, marking the first time the Lu Xun Literature Prize has come to Shanghai. The award ceremony will be permanently held in Shanghai.

articles.title_zh: 工业和信息化部绿色低碳标准化技术委员会成立
articles.title_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Establishes Green and Low-Carbon Standardization Technical Committee
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部近日成立绿色低碳标准化技术委员会，由71名委员组成，秘书处设在中国电子技术标准化研究院，将推动节能降碳等领域标准制修订。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology recently established a Green and Low-Carbon Standardization Technical Committee, comprising 71 members from government, research institutes, universities, associations, and leading enterprises. It will promote standards development in energy conservation, carbon reduction, and cleaner production.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 十二届省委第九轮巡视完成反馈
articles.title_en: Twelfth Provincial Party Committee Inspection Round Completes Feedback
articles.summary_zh: 近日，山西省委部署的十二届省委第九轮巡视反馈工作全部完成，8月19日召开集中反馈会议，8月20日至24日各巡视组向被巡视单位逐一反馈，部署整改工作。
articles.summary_en: The feedback for the 12th Provincial Party Committee inspection round has been fully completed. On August 19, a centralized feedback meeting was held, and from August 20-24, inspection teams provided individual feedback to inspected units and deployed rectification work.

articles.title_zh: 天津滨海机场联合东方航空推出“津沪快线”产品
articles.title_en: Tianjin Binhai Airport and China Eastern Airlines Launch 'Tianjin-Shanghai Express' Service
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日上午，天津滨海机场联合中国东方航空举办“津沪快线”产品发布会，推出一体化空中快线服务，加密津沪航线班次，提升出行效率。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 25, Tianjin Binhai Airport and China Eastern Airlines held a launch event for the 'Tianjin-Shanghai Express,' introducing an integrated air shuttle service with increased flight frequency.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行｜东海“捕风者”
articles.title_en: Vibrant China Research Trip: 'Wind Catchers' of the East China Sea
articles.summary_zh: 记者走进金风科技温州总装厂，探访全球首台16兆瓦漂浮式风机的总装过程，了解温州以“链主+链群”模式打造海上风电产业链，海外订单已占一半以上。
articles.summary_en: Reporters visited Goldwind's Wenzhou assembly plant to see the world's first 16MW floating wind turbine, and learned how Wenzhou builds its offshore wind industry chain with the 'chain leader + cluster' model. Overseas orders account for over half.

articles.title_zh: 坪山区人大代表王寿群：期待坪山推动法商资源转化为产业生产力
articles.title_en: Pingshan District People's Congress Rep Wang Shouqun Expects Legal and Business Resources to Boost Industrial Productivity
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，深圳市坪山区第三届人民代表大会第一次会议开幕，区人大代表王寿群期待推动法商资源转化为产业生产力。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, the first session of the third Pingshan District People's Congress opened; deputy Wang Shouqun expects legal and business resources to be transformed into industrial productivity.

articles.title_zh: 坪山区人大代表彭风雷：做强先进制造业，推动坪山制造走向世界
articles.title_en: Pingshan District NPC Deputy Peng Fenglei: Strengthen Advanced Manufacturing and Promote Pingshan Manufacturing to the World
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，深圳市坪山区第三届人民代表大会第一次会议开幕，区人大代表彭风雷表示期待坪山做强先进制造业，推动坪山制造走向世界。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, the first session of the Third People's Congress of Pingshan District, Shenzhen, opened. District deputy Peng Fenglei expressed expectations for Pingshan to strengthen advanced manufacturing and promote local manufacturing globally.

tags.name_en: Manufacturing as the Foundation of the District

tags_en: Manufacturing as the Foundation of the District

articles.title_zh: 袁家军陈新武赴武隆彭水调研并召开群防群治百日攻坚现场会
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun and Chen Xinwu Visit Wulong and Pengshui, Hold On-site Meeting on Mass Prevention Campaign
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日至25日，重庆市委书记袁家军、市长陈新武赴武隆区、彭水县调研，并召开全市群防群治提升基层除险固安实战能力百日攻坚行动现场会。袁家军强调要深化群防群治“162”工作体系，夯实基层风险防控基础。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 24 to 25, Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun and Mayor Chen Xinwu visited Wulong and Pengshui districts and chaired an on-site meeting on the 100-day campaign to enhance grassroots disaster prevention and response capabilities. Yuan urged deepening the "162" mass prevention system.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁以人大代表身份到郑州市中原区人大代表联络站参加活动
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Attends Activity at Deputies' Liaison Station in Zhengzhou as NPC Deputy
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，河南省委书记刘宁以人大代表身份到郑州市中原区人大代表联络站参加活动，强调践行全过程人民民主，推动基层治理提质增效。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, Liu Ning, Secretary of Henan Provincial Party Committee, participated in an activity at a deputies' liaison station in Zhengzhou as a people's congress deputy, emphasizing whole-process people's democracy and improving grassroots governance.

articles.title_zh: 强基础、拓应用，人工智能如何打开发展新空间
articles.title_en: Strengthening Foundations and Expanding Applications: How AI Opens New Development Space
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，工业和信息化部副部长辛国斌在国新办发布会上介绍“十五五”时期推动人工智能产业发展的举措，强调技术攻关、生态培育和场景应用。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 26, Vice Minister of MIIT Xin Guobin outlined plans at a State Council Information Office press conference to promote AI industry development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 信长星在江苏交控和省农垦集团调研时强调 为建设交通强省农业强省再立新功
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing Visits Jiangsu Transportation and Agricultural Reclamation Groups, Urges Building Strong Transportation and Agricultural Province
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，江苏省委书记信长星到江苏交通控股有限公司和省农垦集团调研，强调深化改革创新，为建设交通强省、农业强省再立新功。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, Party Secretary Xin Changxing of Jiangsu visited Jiangsu Communications Holding and Jiangsu Agricultural Reclamation Group, urging reform and innovation to build a strong transportation province and agricultural province.

articles.title_zh: 从预算执行报告看更加积极的财政政策精准发力
articles.title_en: Budget Execution Report Shows More Proactive Fiscal Policy
articles.summary_zh: 财政部副部长林泽昌8月25日向全国人大常委会会议报告今年以来预算执行情况，显示财政政策更加积极，预算执行总体平稳。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, Vice Finance Minister Lin Zechang reported to the NPC Standing Committee on budget execution this year, showing more proactive fiscal policy and stable budget performance.

articles.title_zh: 国家能源局协调指导西藏吉隆县泥石流灾害抢修复电
articles.title_en: National Energy Administration Coordinates Power Restoration after Landslide in Gyirong County, Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，国家能源局就西藏日喀则市吉隆县泥石流灾害协调指导抢修复电，已派出发电车和应急照明设备赶赴灾区。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, the National Energy Administration coordinated power restoration after a landslide in Gyirong County, Tibet, dispatching generator vehicles and emergency lighting equipment.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”，中国制造业这样争“先”
articles.title_en: China's Manufacturing Sector Strives for 'Leading Edge' During 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，国新办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列新闻发布会，工信部副部长辛国斌介绍加快发展先进制造业、优化产业结构的部署。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, at a State Council Information Office press conference on the '15th Five-Year Plan', Vice Minister of Industry and Information Technology Xin Guobin outlined measures to accelerate advanced manufacturing and optimize industrial structure.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 陈敏尔：扎实做好新时代新征程我市人大工作 为全面建设社会主义现代化大都市提供重要制度保障
articles.title_en: Chen Min'er Stresses Solid Work on People's Congress in New Era to Provide Institutional Guarantee for Building Modern Socialist Metropolitan
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，天津市委人大工作会议召开，市委书记陈敏尔出席并讲话，强调坚持和完善人民代表大会制度，做好新时代人大工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the Tianjin Municipal Party Committee held a work conference on people's congress affairs. Party Secretary Chen Min'er attended and stressed upholding and improving the system of people's congresses.

articles.title_zh: 王浩：高度重视 迅速行动 科学应对 坚决守护好人民群众生命财产安全
articles.title_en: Wang Hao: Attach Great Importance, Act Quickly, Respond Scientifically to Safeguard People's Lives and Property
articles.summary_zh: 25日下午，浙江省委书记王浩主持召开省委专题会议，研判台风“沙德尔”走势并部署防御工作，强调坚持人民至上、生命至上，坚决守护人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of the 25th, Zhejiang Provincial Party Secretary Wang Hao chaired a special meeting to assess Typhoon Shadel and deploy defense efforts, stressing people-first and life-first principles to safeguard lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 王浩：勇于创新 抢抓机遇 在融入创新浙江建设中实现更好更快发展
articles.title_en: Wang Hao: Innovate Bravely, Seize Opportunities, Achieve Better and Faster Development in Building an Innovative Zhejiang
articles.summary_zh: 25日上午，浙江省委书记王浩在杭州调研企业创新发展，强调支持企业聚力科技创新、因地制宜发展新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of the 25th, Wang Hao, Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee, visited enterprises in Hangzhou to promote innovation-driven development and new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 律师法修改拟明确鼓励支持律师依法提供法律援助
articles.title_en: Lawyers Law Amendment to Encourage Pro Bono Legal Aid
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，律师法修正草案提请十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议二次审议，鼓励和支持律师参与公益法律服务。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the draft amendment to the Lawyers Law was submitted for second review at the 24th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee, encouraging lawyers to participate in public interest legal services.

articles.title_zh: 耕地保护和质量提升法草案三审 进一步加大对黑土地保护力度
articles.title_en: Draft Law on Farmland Protection and Quality Improvement Passes Third Review, Strengthening Black Soil Protection
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，耕地保护和质量提升法草案提请十四届全国人大常委会三次审议，三审稿加大对黑土地保护和高标准农田建设资金监管力度。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the draft law on farmland protection and quality improvement was submitted for its third review to the Standing Committee of the 14th NPC, with the revised draft strengthening black soil protection and supervision of high-standard farmland construction funds.

articles.title_zh: 道路交通安全法拟修订 明确“暴走团”治理措施
articles.title_en: Draft Amendment to Road Traffic Safety Law Targets 'Walking Groups'
articles.summary_zh: 道路交通安全法修订草案8月25日提请十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议审议，明确对“暴走团”等违法占用道路行为的治理措施。
articles.summary_en: A draft amendment to the Road Traffic Safety Law was submitted for review at the 24th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee on Aug 25, specifying measures to regulate illegal road occupation by 'walking groups'.

articles.title_zh: 《“十五五”时期三级医院对口帮扶县级医院工作方案》发布
articles.title_en: Work Plan Released for County-Level Hospital Assistance in 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 国家卫生健康委等五部门8月25日联合发布《“十五五”时期三级医院对口帮扶县级医院工作方案》，要求支援医院向县级医院派驻至少5名管理和专业技术人员，提升县级医院服务能力。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 25, the National Health Commission and four other departments released a work plan for tertiary hospitals to assist county hospitals in the 15th Five-Year Plan period, requiring at least five personnel be dispatched.

tags_en: National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine

articles.title_zh: 水法修订草案二审 明确国家建立完善与用水户承受能力相适应的水价形成机制
articles.title_en: Water Law Amendment Draft Undergoes Second Review, Clarifying Water Pricing Mechanism Adapted to Users' Affordability
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，水法修订草案提请十四届全国人大常委会二次审议，明确建立与用水户承受能力相适应的水价形成机制，促进水资源节约集约利用。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the revised Water Law draft was submitted for second review to the NPC Standing Committee, clarifying a water pricing mechanism adapted to users' affordability to promote water conservation and intensive use.

articles.title_zh: 武陵深处“红土地” 振兴路上“再出发”
articles.title_en: Red Land in Deep Wuling Mountains: Setting Off Again on the Road to Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 报道重庆酉阳县南腰界镇依托长征国家文化公园建设，修缮革命文物，发展红色旅游，带动乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: A report on Youyang County, Chongqing, where the town of Nanyaojie has renovated revolutionary relics and developed red tourism under the Long March National Cultural Park project, boosting rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 国家公共数据资源登记平台已登记量超30万项
articles.title_en: National Public Data Registration Platform Exceeds 300,000 Items
articles.summary_zh: 国家数据局介绍，国家公共数据资源登记平台登记量已超30万项，覆盖国民经济97个大类，促进供需对接。
articles.summary_en: The National Data Administration said the national public data registration platform has logged over 300,000 items, covering all 97 categories of the national economy, facilitating supply-demand matching.

articles.title_zh: 农业法修订草案二审 拟完善农民权益保护
articles.title_en: Agricultural Law Revision Draft Undergoes Second Review, Aiming to Improve Protection of Farmers' Rights
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，农业法修订草案提请十四届全国人大常委会二次审议，拟完善农民权益保护内容，并规定建立健全整治形式主义为基层减负长效机制。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the revised draft of the Agricultural Law was submitted to the 14th NPC Standing Committee for a second review, aiming to improve protection of farmers' rights and establish a long-term mechanism to reduce burdens at the grassroots level.

articles.title_zh: 反跨境腐败法草案首次提请审议 中国拟完善反腐败涉外法律体系
articles.title_en: Draft Law Against Cross-Border Corruption Submitted for First Review; China to Enhance Foreign-Related Anti-Corruption Legal System
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，反跨境腐败法草案提请十四届全国人大常委会会议首次审议，草案共六章四十七条，旨在完善反腐败涉外法律体系。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the draft law against cross-border corruption was submitted for first review to the 14th NPC Standing Committee. The draft has 6 chapters and 47 articles, aiming to improve China's foreign-related anti-corruption legal system.

articles.title_zh: 国家数据局发布新一批50个公共数据“跑起来”示范场景
articles.title_en: National Data Administration Releases New Batch of 50 Demonstration Scenarios for Public Data "Get Moving"
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，国家数据局举办发布会，发布第五批50个公共数据“跑起来”示范场景，副局长陈荣辉介绍相关情况，旨在释放公共数据价值。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the National Data Administration held a press conference to release the fifth batch of 50 demonstration scenarios for public data "getting moving". Deputy Director Chen Ronghui introduced the details, aiming to unlock the value of public data.

articles.title_zh: 山东省人大监察和司法委员会原副主任委员苏立科被开除党籍
articles.title_en: Su Like, Former Deputy Director of Shandong Provincial People's Congress Committee, Expelled from Party
articles.summary_zh: 据山东省纪委监委消息，山东省人大监察和司法委员会原副主任委员苏立科因严重违纪违法被开除党籍，涉嫌犯罪问题移送检察机关。
articles.summary_en: Su Like, former deputy director of the Shandong Provincial People's Congress Supervision and Judicial Committee, was expelled from the Party for serious disciplinary violations, and suspected crimes were transferred to prosecutors.

articles.title_zh: 交付“满月”！世界航运巨头达飞首购“绿船”选择武汉设计
articles.title_en: CMA CGM's First Pure Electric Inland Vessel, Designed by Wuhan Team, Marks One Month of Delivery
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，法国达飞集团订购的首条纯电内河船“达飞182TEU”交付满月，停泊越南盖梅港，该船由武汉理工大学团队牵头设计。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the first pure electric inland vessel 'CMA CGM 182TEU' ordered by France's CMA CGM, designed by Wuhan University of Technology, completed one month since delivery at Gemalink Port, Vietnam.

articles.title_zh: 李强会见约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets with King Abdullah II of Jordan
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日上午，国务院总理李强在北京人民大会堂会见来华进行国事访问的约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世，双方就深化合作、共建“一带一路”等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 24, Premier Li Qiang met with Jordan's King Abdullah II at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. They exchanged views on deepening cooperation and jointly building the Belt and Road.

articles.title_zh: 韩正会见科威特外交大臣杰拉赫
articles.title_en: Han Zheng Meets Kuwaiti Foreign Minister Abdullah Ali Al-Yahya
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，国家副主席韩正在北京会见科威特外交大臣杰拉赫，双方就中科关系及共同关心的问题进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Vice President Han Zheng met with Kuwaiti Foreign Minister Abdullah Ali Al-Yahya in Beijing to discuss bilateral ties and issues of mutual concern.

articles.title_zh: 陈武同志逝世
articles.title_en: Comrade Chen Wu Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 全国政协副主席陈武因病医治无效，于2026年8月24日15时05分在北京逝世，享年72岁。
articles.summary_en: Chen Wu, Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, passed away from illness in Beijing on August 24, 2026, at the age of 72.

articles.title_zh: 全国小麦收购量超9000万吨
articles.title_en: National Wheat Purchases Exceed 90 Million Tons
articles.summary_zh: 国家粮食和物资储备局数据显示，全国累计收购小麦超9000万吨，并在江西、湖南、河南、安徽启动最低收购价预案，保护种粮农民利益，稳定市场预期。
articles.summary_en: The National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration reported that wheat purchases nationwide have exceeded 90 million tons. Minimum purchase price plans were activated in Jiangxi, Hunan, Henan and Anhui to support farmers and stabilize the market.

articles.title_zh: 以树立和践行正确政绩观新成效开创中国式现代化新局面
articles.title_en: Achieving New Progress in Correct View of Political Achievements to Open New Prospects for Chinese Modernization
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，中央党的建设工作领导小组召开会议，总结树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，部署建立长效机制。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, the Central Leading Group for Party Building held a meeting to summarize the education on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements and to plan long-term mechanisms.

articles.title_zh: 推动高质量发展行稳致远
articles.title_en: Promoting High-Quality Development for Steady Progress
articles.summary_zh: 钟才文发表评论，强调贯彻落实中央政治局会议部署，加大逆周期调节，推动经济持续向新向优向好发展。
articles.summary_en: Zhong Caiwen comments on the implementation of the Central Political Bureau's deployment, emphasizing counter-cyclical adjustments to promote sustained high-quality economic development.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with King Abdullah II of Jordan
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日下午，国家主席习近平在北京人民大会堂同约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世举行会谈，双方见证签署多项合作文件并发表联合声明。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 24, President Xi Jinping held talks with Jordan's King Abdullah II, who was on a state visit, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. They witnessed the signing of cooperation documents and issued a joint statement.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致电祝贺阿拉姆吉尔就任孟加拉国总统
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulations to Alamgir on His Inauguration as Bangladesh President
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，国家主席习近平致电阿拉姆吉尔，祝贺他就任孟加拉国总统，表示愿赓续传统友谊，推进共建“一带一路”，深化合作，引领新时代中孟命运共同体建设走深走实。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory message to Alamgir on his inauguration as President of Bangladesh, expressing willingness to enhance traditional friendship, advance Belt and Road cooperation, and deepen the China-Bangladesh community with a shared future.

articles.title_zh: “清朗·网络娱乐团播乱象整治”专项行动取得成效
articles.title_en: Special Campaign Against Online Variety Show Chaos Achieves Results
articles.summary_zh: 中央网信办8月24日通报，自专项行动启动以来，已处置违规直播间7200余个，严惩违规账号2200余个，并清退问题严重的团播MCN机构。
articles.summary_en: The CAC reported on Aug 24 that since the campaign began, it has handled over 7,200 illegal livestream rooms, punished over 2,200 accounts, and removed problematic MCN agencies.

articles.title_zh: 多台风对我国造成持续强降雨影响
articles.title_en: Multiple Typhoons Bring Persistent Heavy Rain to China
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日中国气象局通报，西北太平洋同时有4个台风活动，需防范持续性强降水和次生灾害。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 24, China Meteorological Administration warned of four simultaneous typhoons in the Western Pacific, requiring precautions against persistent heavy rain and secondary disasters.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠顾刚会见中国工程院院士贲德一行
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui and Gu Gang Meet with CAE Academician Ben De
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，长春市委书记张恩惠、市长顾刚会见中国工程院院士贲德一行，祝贺其荣获2025年度国家最高科学技术奖，并就长春科技创新与光电产业发展交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Zhang Enhui, Secretary of Changchun Municipal Party Committee, and Mayor Gu Gang met with Ben De, academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, congratulating him on winning the 2025 National Highest Science and Technology Award and discussing sci-tech innovation and optoelectronic industry development.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央办公厅 国务院办公厅印发《党政领导干部生态环境损害责任追究办法》
articles.title_en: General Offices of CPC Central Committee and State Council Issue Measures for Accountability for Ecological Damage
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅印发《党政领导干部生态环境损害责任追究办法》，要求各地区各部门遵照执行，对生态环境损害实行党政同责、终身追究。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council recently issued the Measures for Accountability of Party and Government Leading Cadres for Ecological Environment Damage, requiring all regions and departments to implement them, with lifelong accountability and joint responsibility of party and government.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省政府与圆通速递签署战略合作协议

articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，江苏省政府与圆通速递签署战略合作协议，省长刘小涛会见圆通速递董事局主席喻渭蛟并见证签约。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, the Jiangsu provincial government signed a strategic cooperation agreement with YTO Express. Governor Liu Xiaotao met with YTO chairman Yu Weijiao and witnessed the signing.

articles.title_zh: 沈阳市政府召开第二十一届十次全体（扩大）会议 吕志成主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Shenyang Municipal Government Holds Its 21st Plenary (Enlarged) Meeting; Lv Zhicheng Chairs
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，沈阳市市长吕志成主持召开市政府全体（扩大）会议，部署下半年经济工作，要求咬定全年目标，努力实现“十五五”良好开局。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 24, Shenyang Mayor Lv Zhicheng chaired the municipal government plenary meeting to deploy H2 economic work, urging full-year targets and a good start to the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 霍步刚在中国科学院金属研究所主持召开座谈会时指出 强化产学研融通创新 携手打造院地合作典范
articles.title_en: Huo Bugang Chairs Symposium at Institute of Metal Research, Emphasizing Industry-Academia-Research Integration and Institute-Local Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，沈阳市委书记霍步刚在中国科学院金属研究所主持召开座谈会，强调强化产学研融通创新，打造院地合作典范。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Huo Bugang, Secretary of Shenyang Municipal Party Committee, chaired a symposium at the Institute of Metal Research, CAS, emphasizing stronger industry-academia-research integration and exemplary institute-local cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见中国中检董事长许增德总经理李永吉
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet with CCIC Chairman Xu Zengde and General Manager Li Yongji
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见中国检验认证集团董事长许增德、总经理李永吉一行，就深化合作、助力辽宁振兴发展进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Liaoning Provincial Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei met with CCIC Chairman Xu Zengde and General Manager Li Yongji in Shenyang to discuss deepening cooperation and supporting Liaoning's revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见中国中检董事长许增德总经理李永吉
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet China Inspection & Certification Group Leadership
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见中国检验认证集团董事长许增德、总经理李永吉一行，双方就深化央地合作、推动质量强省建设等交流。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 24, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei met with CCIC Chairman Xu Zengde and GM Li Yongji in Shenyang, discussing cooperation on quality infrastructure and industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 习近平作出重要指示强调 巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果 努力创造经得起实践人民历史检验的实绩
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Important Instructions on Consolidating Education on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央总书记习近平就巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果作出重要指示，中央党建工作领导小组24日召开会议部署落实。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping issued important instructions on consolidating education on correct view of political achievements. The Central Party Building Work Leading Group held a meeting on Aug 24 to implement them.

articles.title_zh: 刘国中出席第十一届亚太经合组织粮食安全部长级会议开幕式并致辞
articles.title_en: Liu Guozhong Attends and Addresses 11th APEC Food Security Ministerial Meeting Opening Ceremony
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理刘国中8月25日在浙江杭州出席第十一届亚太经合组织粮食安全部长级会议开幕式并致辞，提出共建粮食安全体系四点建议。
articles.summary_en: Liu Guozhong, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended and addressed the opening ceremony of the 11th APEC Food Security Ministerial Meeting in Hangzhou, Zhejiang on August 25, proposing four suggestions for building a food security system.

articles.title_zh: 努力实现“十五五”良好开局——从计划执行报告看下半年经济工作重点
articles.title_en: Striving for a Good Start to the 15th Five-Year Plan: Key Economic Work for H2 from Plan Execution Report
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，国家发展改革委副主任王昌林受国务院委托向全国人大常委会报告上半年计划执行情况，称上半年GDP增长4.7%，下半年将实施更积极财政政策和适度宽松货币政策，努力实现“十五五”良好开局。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, NDRC Deputy Director Wang Changlin, on behalf of the State Council, reported to the NPC Standing Committee on H1 plan execution, citing 4.7% GDP growth and outlining H2 policies including more proactive fiscal and moderately loose monetary measures.

articles.title_zh: 报告显示：脱贫攻坚成果持续巩固拓展 常态化帮扶有序推进

articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，国务院关于巩固拓展脱贫攻坚成果的报告提请全国人大常委会审议，显示脱贫攻坚成果持续巩固，常态化帮扶有序推进。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 25, the State Council's report on consolidating poverty alleviation achievements was submitted to the NPC Standing Committee for review, showing steady progress and orderly routine assistance.

articles.title_zh: 我国加快推进公共数据开放共享 赋能千行百业
articles.title_en: China Accelerates Public Data Sharing to Empower Various Industries
articles.summary_zh: 今年我国加快推进公共数据开放共享，强化数据安全技术试点和跨部门数据整合，已发布150个示范场景，赋能气象、交通、医疗等领域。
articles.summary_en: Since this year, China has accelerated public data sharing, strengthening pilot security technologies and cross-department integration, releasing 150 demonstration scenarios across meteorology, transportation, healthcare and more.

articles.title_zh: 全国政协十四届常委会第十八次会议开幕
articles.title_en: 18th Session of CPPCC Standing Committee Opens
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日上午，全国政协十四届常委会第十八次会议在北京开幕，围绕加大保障和改善民生力度、扎实推进全体人民共同富裕协商议政。王沪宁出席，何立峰作报告。
articles.summary_en: The 18th session of the Standing Committee of the 14th CPPCC National Committee opened in Beijing on the morning of Aug 25, focusing on improving people's livelihood and advancing common prosperity. Wang Huning attended and He Lifeng delivered a report.

articles.title_zh: 推动高质量发展行稳致远
articles.title_en: Promoting High-Quality Development Steadily
articles.summary_zh: 文章解读7月30日中央政治局会议部署，强调加大逆周期调节、扩大内需、推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The article interprets the July 30 CPC Central Committee Political Bureau meeting's arrangements, emphasizing counter-cyclical adjustment, expanding domestic demand, and promoting high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央办公厅 国务院办公厅印发《党政领导干部生态环境损害责任追究办法》
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee General Office and State Council General Office Issue Measures for Accountability of Party and Government Leading Cadres for Ecological Environment Damage
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅印发《党政领导干部生态环境损害责任追究办法》，要求各地区各部门遵照执行，明确生态环境损害责任追究情形、方式及终身追究制。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council recently issued the Measures for Accountability of Party and Government Leading Cadres for Ecological Environment Damage, requiring all regions and departments to implement them, specifying accountability scenarios, methods, and lifetime accountability.

articles.title_zh: 十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议在京举行

articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 25, the 24th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee held its first plenary meeting at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, chaired by Chairman Zhao Leji, deliberating several draft laws and hearing reports.

articles.title_zh: 习近平对树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育作出重要指示

articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently issued important instructions on the learning and education of establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements. The Central Party Building Work Leading Group held a meeting in Beijing on August 24 to consolidate and expand the results.

articles.title_zh: 王新伟主持召开省政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Wang Xinwei Chairs Provincial Government Executive Meeting

articles.summary_en: On August 24, Wang Xinwei, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee and Governor, chaired a provincial government executive meeting to review the 15th Five-Year Plan on natural resources, forestry and market regulation.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开西露天矿综合治理专题会议

articles.summary_en: On August 23, Fushun municipal government held a special meeting on comprehensive treatment of the West Open-pit Mine, chaired by Mayor Wang Qinghai, to discuss disaster management, ecological restoration and industrial introduction.

Liu Qiang chaired the meeting.

articles.summary_en: On the morning of the 24th, Qu Xiaojie, Mayor of Jieyang, chaired the municipal government party group meeting and executive meeting to convey Xi Jinping's important speech and instructions, and to study the construction of marine ranch industry chain and urban renewal.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 24, Zeng Fengbao, Secretary of the Jieyang Municipal Party Committee, chaired a meeting of the Standing Committee to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and relevant central documents, and to discuss implementation measures.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 24, President Xi Jinping held talks with King Abdullah II of Jordan at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, agreeing to deepen the China-Jordan strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 揭阳市政法干部深入学习习近平党建思想培训班开班

articles.summary_en: On the morning of Aug 24, a training class for Jieyang's political and legal cadres on Xi Jinping's Party building thought and standardized construction of comprehensive governance centers opened, aiming to strengthen legalized dispute resolution and public security governance.

articles.summary_en: On August 24, Li Hui, Mayor of Taizhou, inspected the Yangtze River levee in Jingjiang, emphasizing the need to strengthen safety barriers and protect the rivers.

Zhang Haibo, secretary of the Weihai Municipal CPC Committee, attended and addressed the meeting.

articles.summary_en: On August 24, the Wuxi Municipal Party Committee held a review meeting on defense against Typhoon 'White Dolphin', listening to reports and planning improvements. Party Secretary Du Xiaogang chaired the meeting.
