articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 24, Yan Hanping, Secretary of the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee, chaired a forum of county (district) party secretaries, stressing political loyalty, responsibility and practical achievements to contribute to high-quality development in the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 山上种茶、地里种菜、水中养鱼……圭岗镇打造立体式产业发展新格局
articles.title_en: Guigang Town Creates a Three-Dimensional Industrial Development Pattern: Tea on Mountains, Vegetables in Fields, Fish in Water

articles.summary_en: Guigang Town in Yangchun develops tea, vegetables, loofah, and fish farming to create a diversified agricultural pattern, boosting rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 中华人民共和国和约旦哈希姆王国关于深化中约战略伙伴关系的联合声明

articles.summary_en: King Abdullah II of Jordan made a state visit to China from August 18 to 24, 2026. The two sides issued a joint statement to deepen the China-Jordan strategic partnership and enhance cooperation in various fields.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江会见滴普科技董事长赵杰辉等企业家一行

articles.summary_en: On Aug 24, Xie Weijiang, Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Yueyang Municipal Party Secretary, visited the petition bureau and received petitioners, stressing lawful resolution of their demands.

articles.summary_en: On August 24, Zhoukou Mayor Zhan Peng visited Chuanhui District to inspect post-disaster recovery, assessing damaged facilities and urging swift restoration of daily life.

articles.summary_en: On August 24, Zhoukou held a weekly meeting on key project construction and enterprise appeals. Party Secretary Huang Yuguo and Mayor Zhan Peng attended and delivered speeches, deploying next-stage work.

articles.summary_en: On August 24, Mayor Zhan Peng visited Chuanhui District to inspect post-disaster reconstruction efforts, viewing damaged facilities and urging swift restoration of normal life and production.

articles.summary_en: On August 24, the provincial 12345 hotline work promotion meeting was held in Jinan. Zhang Haibo, member of the Standing Committee of the Provincial Party Committee and Executive Vice Governor, attended and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 李家超：维护国家安全，没有完成时

articles.summary_en: John Lee said safeguarding national security has no finish line, stressing Hong Kong must continue such efforts.

articles.title_zh: 福州民政部门全力构建“幸福守护链”见闻：有福之州 温暖常在

articles.summary_zh: 福州市民政部门通过长者食堂、养老机构、慈善基金和社会救助等举措，构建覆盖老年人、困难群众、婚姻家庭及殡葬服务的全生命周期“幸福守护链”，温暖民生。
articles.summary_en: Fuzhou civil affairs authorities are building a full-life-cycle 'happiness guardian chain' through elderly care canteens, institutions, charity funds, and social assistance, covering elderly care, relief, marriage, and funeral services.

articles.title_zh: 聚焦五大重点领域！福建出台方案服务青年发展
articles.title_en: Fujian Introduces Plan Focusing on Five Key Areas to Serve Youth Development
articles.summary_zh: 福建金融监管局与共青团福建省委近日联合印发方案，聚焦就业创业、乡村振兴、台青金融服务等五大领域，以金融活水服务青年发展。
articles.summary_en: The Fujian Financial Regulatory Bureau and the Fujian Provincial Committee of the Communist Youth League have jointly issued a plan focusing on five key areas including employment, entrepreneurship, rural revitalization, and financial services for Taiwan youth, aiming to support youth development through financial support.

articles.summary_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping emphasizes the integration of culture and tourism, making tourism a process of experiencing Chinese culture and enhancing cultural confidence.

articles.summary_en: On August 24, the Standing Committee of the Jinan Municipal Party Committee met to study Xi Jinping's important speech and review plans for county economy high-quality development and Safe Jinan construction, chaired by Secretary Liu Qiang.

articles.summary_en: On August 24, the Standing Committee of the Jinan Municipal Party Committee held its 2026 research achievement exchange meeting. Secretary Liu Qiang presided and spoke; Mayor Yu Haitian and CPPCC Chairman Sun Kailian attended, sharing research findings to support a good start for the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记重要指示激励全党树立和践行正确政绩观

articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently made important instructions on consolidating the education campaign on establishing a correct view of political achievements. The Central Party Building Work Leading Group held a meeting on Aug 24 to deploy long-term mechanism work.

articles.title_zh: 成都市出台房地产市场新政，鼓励发放购房补贴
articles.title_en: Chengdu Issues New Real Estate Policies, Encouraging Home Purchase Subsidies
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月25日起，成都市住建局等四部门联合发布房地产市场新政，鼓励发放购房补贴，将公积金贷款最低首付比例降至15%。
articles.summary_en: Effective August 25, 2026, Chengdu's housing authority and three other departments issued new real estate policies, encouraging home purchase subsidies and lowering the minimum down payment for provident fund loans to 15%.

articles.title_zh: 成都出台新规：今年底前买新房，公积金贷款首付低至15%
articles.title_en: Chengdu Cuts Housing Provident Fund Down Payment to 15% for New Homes
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，成都市住建局等4部门联合印发通知，从供给、消费、存量、环境四方面推出十条举措，将购买新建商品住房的公积金贷款最低首付比例降至15%，并给予利息补贴，以促进房地产市场平稳健康发展。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 25, Chengdu housing authority and three departments issued a notice, cutting minimum down payment for housing provident fund loans on new homes to 15% and offering interest subsidies to stabilize the real estate market.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世举行会谈

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 24, President Xi Jinping held talks with King Abdullah II of Jordan at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. This is the king's ninth visit to China since his accession.

articles.title_zh: 让“人造太阳”照进现实
articles.title_en: Bringing the 'Artificial Sun' into Reality

articles.summary_en: The article reports on China's advances in nuclear fusion, including Huanliu-3 achieving 'double 100 million degrees' and the release of a first international fusion standard, and discusses the road to commercialization.

articles.title_zh: '首'字出圈，厦门构建消费新引力场

articles.summary_en: In the first half of this year, Xiamen added over 100 first stores, using policy guidance and scenario empowerment to build a hub for debut economy and boost consumption upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 安徽交通政务服务推出差异化改革措施：用上大模型 办事分分钟
articles.title_en: Anhui Rolls Out Differentiated Transport Administrative Reforms, Using Big Models for Faster Services

articles.title_zh: 安徽六安：人工智能“沉”下去 老区产业“活”起来
articles.title_en: Anhui Lu'an: AI Goes Down to Grassroots, Boosting Old Revolutionary Base Industries

articles.summary_en: Lu'an, Anhui, has been promoting AI applications in manufacturing and agriculture, creating replicable demonstration projects to boost local industries.

articles.title_zh: 十一届福建省委第八轮巡视完成反馈

articles.summary_en: People's Daily publishes a commentary emphasizing that Party members and officials should cultivate their Party spirit throughout their lives, highlighting the importance of a correct view of political achievements through actions in flood relief.

articles.title_zh: 中冶武勘牵头 武汉市首个跨产业女职工创新联盟成立

articles.title_zh: 定安传统村落集中连片保护利用示范项目竣工

articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong Meets Huang Xiaowei, Leader of All-China Women's Federation
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中在呼和浩特会见全国妇联党组书记黄晓薇，双方就妇女儿童事业和妇联工作交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Wang Weizhong, Party Secretary of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, met with Huang Xiaowei, Party Secretary of All-China Women's Federation, in Hohhot to exchange views on women and children's affairs.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古发布今年首批非营利组织免税资格
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Releases First Batch of Non-Profit Tax Exemptions This Year
articles.summary_zh: 内蒙古自治区财政厅、税务局发布通知，公布2026年第一批13户非营利组织的免税资格，有效期至2030年。
articles.summary_en: Inner Mongolia's finance and tax authorities issued a notice granting tax-exempt status to 13 non-profit organizations for the period 2026-2030.

articles.title_zh: 包钢主持召开自治区人民政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Bao Gang Chairs Inner Mongolia Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，内蒙古自治区党委副书记、政府主席包钢主持召开政府常务会议，传达贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，听取整治拖欠农民工工资、高标准农田建设进展汇报，研究审议有关文件。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Bao Gang, deputy secretary of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Party Committee and chairman of the regional government, chaired a government executive meeting to convey the spirit of Xi Jinping's recent important speeches, hear reports on addressing wage arrears for migrant workers and high-standard farmland construction, and review relevant documents.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏发布行政执法规范化建设典型经验案例
articles.title_en: Ningxia Releases Typical Cases of Administrative Law Enforcement Standardization
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，宁夏回族自治区司法厅发布全区行政执法规范化建设典型经验案例，集中展示30个创新实践，涵盖审管联动、柔性执法等，助推法治政府建设和营商环境优化。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, the Justice Department of Ningxia released typical cases of administrative law enforcement standardization, showcasing 30 innovative practices to improve the rule-of-law government and business environment.

articles.title_zh: 青海省人大常委会开展经济工作监督调研
articles.title_en: Qinghai Provincial People's Congress Conducts Economic Work Supervision Research
articles.summary_zh: 近日，青海省人大常委会调研组赴省发改委、工信厅、财政厅、商务厅及重点企业走访调研，了解经济运行情况并征求意见建议。
articles.summary_en: The research group of Qinghai Provincial People's Congress recently visited provincial departments and key enterprises to inspect economic operations and solicit opinions.

articles.title_zh: 青海出台零碳工厂培育实施方案
articles.title_en: Qinghai Unveils Plan to Cultivate Zero-Carbon Factories
articles.summary_zh: 青海省工信厅等部门近日印发《青海省零碳工厂培育建设实施方案（试行）》，分三阶段推进零碳工厂培育，力争2030年全面完善建设体系。
articles.summary_en: Qinghai's industry authorities have issued a plan to cultivate zero-carbon factories in phases, aiming to fully establish the construction system by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 以“高效办成一件事”为牵引 协同务实推动数字政府建设取得更大实效
articles.title_en: Sichuan Meeting Calls for Pragmatic Digital Government Building with 'Efficient Handling of One Thing' as Guide
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，全省数字政府建设工作推进会议在成都召开。省委副书记、省长施小琳出席并讲话，强调以“高效办成一件事”为牵引，加快数据、系统、安全攻坚，推动数字政府建设取得更大实效。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, the provincial digital government construction promotion meeting was held in Chengdu. Governor Shi Xiaolin emphasized taking "efficient handling of one thing" as the guide to accelerate data, system, and security efforts and achieve greater results.

articles.title_zh: 陈吉宁调研市建设交通工作党委：推动党建与业务工作深度融合
articles.title_en: Chen Jining Visits Municipal Construction and Transport Work Party Committee, Urges Deep Integration of Party Building and Work
articles.summary_zh: 市委书记陈吉宁昨天在市建设交通工作党委调研，强调发挥大口党委作用，推动党建与业务深度融合，践行正确政绩观，让老百姓感受人民城市的温暖。
articles.summary_en: Chen Jining, Shanghai Party chief, visited the Municipal Construction and Transport Work Party Committee on Aug. 24, calling for deep integration of Party building and professional work and for serving the people.

tags.name_en: Municipal Construction and Transport Work Party Committee

tags_en: Municipal Construction and Transport Work Party Committee

articles.title_zh: 提升服务力 彰显贡献度 上海高校党政负责干部会议召开
articles.title_en: Shanghai University Party and Administrative Leaders Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 2026年秋季上海高校党政负责干部会议8月24日召开，市委副书记朱忠明出席并讲话，强调提升高等教育服务力。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Autumn Shanghai University Party and Administrative Leaders Meeting was held on Aug 24; Deputy Party Secretary Zhu Zhongming spoke on enhancing higher education service.

articles.title_zh: 全面提升“上海服务”辐射力竞争力
articles.title_en: Gong Zheng Surveys Shanghai's Service Industry Development Plan
articles.summary_zh: 上海市市长龚正昨日调研上海市服务业发展“十五五”规划，强调提升“上海服务”全球辐射力和国际竞争力。
articles.summary_en: Shanghai Mayor Gong Zheng conducted a special survey on the city's 15th Five-Year Plan for service industry development, emphasizing the need to enhance the global reach and competitiveness of 'Shanghai Service'.

articles.title_zh: 全球首个磁共振脑机接口全栈式解决方案发布
articles.title_en: World's First Full-Stack MRI Brain-Computer Interface Solution Released
articles.summary_zh: 在近日举行的全国首届磁共振脑机接口大会上，联影医疗与天津大学共同发布全球首个磁共振脑机接口全栈式解决方案，并联合发起成立磁共振脑机接口创新联盟。
articles.summary_en: At the first National MRI-BCI Conference, United Imaging and Tianjin University jointly launched the world's first full-stack MRI brain-computer interface solution and established an innovation alliance.

articles.title_zh: 陕西两机构入选农业农村部推荐名单
articles.title_en: Two Shaanxi Institutions Listed in MARA Recommended List
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，陕西省农业农村厅透露，农业农村部公布首批农业植物实质性派生品种鉴定机构推荐名单，陕西省农作物种子检验站和农业农村部植物新品种测试（杨凌）分中心入选。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Shaanxi Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs said the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs released the first batch of recommended institutions for essential derivation variety identification of agricultural plants, including two Shaanxi institutions.

articles.title_zh: 全国残联对口援藏工作现场会召开
articles.title_en: National Disabled Persons' Federation Holds On-site Meeting on Aid to Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 近日，全国残联对口援藏工作现场会在拉萨召开，自治区党委书记王君正、中国残联主席程凯出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: The national on-site meeting on paired assistance to Tibet by disabled persons' federations was held in Lhasa, with regional Party secretary Wang Junzheng and CDPF chair Cheng Kai attending and speaking.

articles.title_zh: 云南省人民政府发布一批任免职通知
articles.title_en: Yunnan Provincial Government Issues Batch of Appointment and Removal Notices
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，云南省人民政府发布一批任免职通知，涉及多名厅级干部和高校、国企负责人任免。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the Yunnan Provincial Government issued a batch of appointment and removal notices, involving multiple department-level officials and leaders of universities and state-owned enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 中消协发布《中国消费者绿色消费指南（2026版）》
articles.title_en: China Consumers Association Releases Green Consumption Guide (2026 Edition)
articles.summary_zh: 中国消费者协会近日发布《中国消费者绿色消费指南（2026版）》，提出50条行动建议，引导消费者践行绿色低碳理念。
articles.summary_en: The China Consumers Association released the Green Consumption Guide (2026 Edition), offering 50 action suggestions to encourage green and low-carbon consumption.

articles.title_zh: 闻令而动 竭诚为民
articles.title_en: Five Emergency Management Representatives Share Their Stories at State Council Press Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，国务院新闻办举行“新征程上的奋斗者”中外记者见面会，5名应急管理领域代表围绕防范化解重大安全风险、应急守护为民安展开交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, the State Council Information Office held a press conference where five emergency management representatives discussed risk prevention and disaster response, demonstrating their dedication to public safety.

articles.title_zh: 长三角示范区出台古镇高质量发展实施意见
articles.title_en: Yangtze River Delta Demonstration Zone Issues Implementation Opinions on High-Quality Development of Ancient Towns
articles.summary_zh: 长三角生态绿色一体化发展示范区近日出台实施意见，统一打造“诗画江南·梦里水乡”品牌，推动朱家角、西塘等七大古镇高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The Yangtze River Delta Eco-Green Integrated Development Demonstration Zone recently issued implementation opinions to jointly build the 'Poetic Jiangnan, Dreamy Water Town' brand, promoting high-quality development of seven ancient towns including Zhujiajiao and Xitang.

articles.title_zh: 跨国企业走进北京专场活动举行 尹力致辞 殷勇主持
articles.title_en: Special Event for Multinational Enterprises Entering Beijing Held; Yin Li Delivers Speech and Yin Yong Hosts
articles.summary_zh: 24日，“跨国企业走进北京”首次专场活动在怀柔区举行，140余位跨国企业家参加，北京市委书记尹力致辞，市长殷勇主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, the first "Multinational Enterprises Entering Beijing" event was held in Huairou District. Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li delivered a speech and Mayor Yin Yong hosted, with over 140 multinational executives attending.

articles.title_zh: 创造经得起实践、人民、历史检验的实绩
articles.title_en: Creating Achievements That Stand the Test of Practice, People, and History
articles.summary_zh: 2026年，全党深入开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，在习近平总书记亲自指导下，教育引导党员干部为民造福、以实干出政绩，有效防范和纠治政绩观偏差。
articles.summary_en: In 2026, the whole Party carried out an education campaign to establish and practice a correct view of political achievements, under Xi Jinping's personal guidance, urging officials to serve the people and produce real results while preventing deviations.

articles.title_zh: 中国支付清算协会发布《智能体支付应用自律公约》
articles.title_en: China Payment and Clearing Association Issues Self-Regulatory Convention on Agent Payment Applications
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，中国支付清算协会发布《智能体支付应用自律公约》，对智能体管理、授权管理、防范风险等作出安排，旨在促进智能体支付安全合规发展。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 24, the China Payment and Clearing Association issued the Self-Regulatory Convention on Agent Payment Applications, setting arrangements on agent management, authorization, and risk prevention to promote safe and compliant development.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁：持续营造公平正义法治环境 加快建设更高水平法治河南
articles.title_en: Liu Ning: Foster Fair Legal Environment, Accelerate Rule of Law in Henan
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，河南省委书记刘宁到省法院、省检察院、省司法厅调研，强调持续营造公平正义法治环境，加快建设更高水平法治河南。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Liu Ning, Secretary of the Henan Provincial Party Committee, visited the provincial courts, procuratorate, and justice department, urging a fair and just legal environment and a higher-level rule of law in Henan.

articles.title_zh: 三部门发文 推进家庭医生签约服务
articles.title_en: Three Departments Issue Document to Advance Family Doctor Contract Services
articles.summary_zh: 国家卫生健康委等三部门近日印发通知，部署深化“六个拓展”、做实家庭医生签约服务，明确到2026年底基层相关医师均应开展签约服务。
articles.summary_en: The National Health Commission and two other departments issued a notice to deepen family doctor contract services, requiring relevant grassroots doctors to provide such services by the end of 2026.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛主持召开第八期政企恳谈会
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Chairs 8th Government-Enterprise Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，江苏省省长刘小涛主持召开今年第八期政企恳谈会，围绕海洋经济听取企业和科创平台意见，强调提升海洋开发能力，打造蓝色增长极。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Governor Liu Xiaotao of Jiangsu chaired the 8th government-enterprise symposium to hear opinions on marine economy, emphasizing enhancing marine development capacity and building a blue growth engine.

articles.title_zh: 深刻理解天下为公、天下大同的社会理想
articles.title_en: Deeply Understanding the Social Ideal of a World for All and Great Harmony
articles.summary_zh: 文章阐释中华优秀传统文化中天下为公、天下大同的社会理想，探讨其时代价值及对构建人类命运共同体的启示。
articles.summary_en: This article elaborates on the social ideal of a world for all and great harmony in Chinese traditional culture, exploring its contemporary value and implications for building a community with a shared future for mankind.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 努力实现“十五五”良好开局——从计划执行报告看下半年经济工作重点
articles.title_en: Striving for a Good Start to the 15th Five-Year Plan: Key Economic Priorities for H2 from the Plan Implementation Report
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，国家发展改革委副主任王昌林受国务院委托，向全国人大常委会报告今年以来国民经济和社会发展计划执行情况，介绍上半年GDP增长4.7%，并部署下半年经济工作重点。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, Wang Changlin, deputy director of the National Development and Reform Commission, reported to the NPC Standing Committee on behalf of the State Council on the implementation of the national economic and social development plan, noting 4.7% GDP growth in H1 and outlining H2 economic priorities.

tags.name_en: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

tags_en: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

articles.title_zh: 人大常委会丨报告显示：脱贫攻坚成果持续巩固拓展 常态化帮扶有序推进
articles.title_en: NPC Standing Committee Report: Achievements in Poverty Alleviation Consolidated, Regular Assistance Progressing
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，国务院关于持续巩固拓展脱贫攻坚成果的报告提请全国人大常委会会议审议。报告显示，脱贫县农村居民人均可支配收入5年增长至18627元，常态化帮扶有序推进。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the State Council submitted a report on consolidating poverty alleviation achievements to the NPC Standing Committee for review. Per capita disposable income in ex-poverty counties rose to 18,627 yuan over five years.

articles.title_zh: 我国交通强国指数稳步增长位列世界第五
articles.title_en: China Ranks Fifth Globally in Transport Power Index
articles.summary_zh: 交通运输部8月25日在湖北武汉举行加快建设交通强国大会，发布交通强国指数为90.8，较上年提升0.9，位列全球第五。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 25, the Ministry of Transport released the Transport Power Index of 90.8 at a conference in Wuhan, Hubei, ranking fifth globally, up 0.9 from last year.

articles.title_zh: 8.2万家助餐点 守护长者幸福“食”光
articles.title_en: 82,000 Meal Assistance Sites Safeguard Seniors' Dining Happiness
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，民政部在湖北武汉举行主题活动，宣布全国共有8.2万家老年助餐点，每天为400万余人次老年人提供助餐服务。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 25, the Ministry of Civil Affairs held an event in Wuhan, Hubei, announcing 82,000 senior meal assistance sites nationwide serve over 4 million seniors daily.

articles.title_zh: 深刻理解天下为公、天下大同的社会理想
articles.title_en: Profoundly Understanding the Social Ideal of a World for All and Great Harmony
articles.summary_zh: 文章阐释天下为公、天下大同社会理想的内涵与时代价值，强调其与马克思主义的契合性，倡导构建人类命运共同体。
articles.summary_en: The article explains the connotation and contemporary value of the social ideal of a world for all and great harmony, emphasizing its compatibility with Marxism and advocating building a community with a shared future for mankind.

tags.name_en: Community with a Shared Future for Mankind

tags_en: Community with a Shared Future for Mankind

articles.title_zh: 道路交通安全法修订草案提请审议
articles.title_en: Road Traffic Safety Law Amendment Draft Submitted for Review
articles.summary_zh: 全国人大常委会提请审议道路交通安全法修订草案，共9章170条，明确自动驾驶车行驶条件、违章处理原则等，并聚焦醉驾、盲驾、僵尸车等治理问题。
articles.summary_en: The NPC Standing Committee submitted a draft amendment to the Road Traffic Safety Law for review, with 9 chapters and 170 articles, clarifying conditions for autonomous driving, violation handling principles, and addressing drunk driving, blind driving, and abandoned vehicles.

articles.title_zh: 水利部对5省份启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Activates Level-IV Emergency Response for Flood Control in 5 Provinces
articles.summary_zh: 水利部8月25日对河北、山西、内蒙古、陕西、青海启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，应对新一轮强降雨过程。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 25, the Ministry of Water Resources activated a Level-IV emergency response for flood control in Hebei, Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, Shaanxi and Qinghai in response to heavy rainfall.

articles.title_zh: 树立和践行正确政绩观是一项长期任务
articles.title_en: Establishing and Practicing the Correct View on Political Achievements Is a Long-term Task
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记近日就树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育作出重要指示，强调这是一项长期任务，必须久久为功。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping recently gave important instructions on the education campaign for establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements, emphasizing that it is a long-term task requiring sustained effort.

articles.title_zh: 陈敏尔：对标对表 因地制宜 统筹兼顾 在推动高质量发展上见行见效
articles.title_en: Chen Min'er Urges High-Quality Development in Hedong District Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，天津市委书记陈敏尔赴河东区调研，强调对标对表、因地制宜、统筹兼顾，因地制宜发展新质生产力，推动高质量发展、创造高品质生活。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 24, Chen Min'er, Secretary of Tianjin Municipal Party Committee, inspected Hedong District, urging benchmarking, local adaptation and overall planning to develop new quality productive forces and promote high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江会见香港特别行政区政府律政司司长林定国
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang Meets with Hong Kong Secretary for Justice Paul Lam
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，新疆维吾尔自治区党委书记陈小江在乌鲁木齐会见香港特别行政区政府律政司司长林定国一行，双方就深化法治合作、融入共建“一带一路”等交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Chen Xiaojiang, Party Secretary of Xinjiang, met with Paul Lam, Secretary for Justice of the HKSAR Government, in Urumqi, discussing cooperation in rule of law and the Belt and Road Initiative.

articles.title_zh: 美方个别官员攻击中方科技企业 外交部：捏造事实、颠倒黑白
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Slams US Officials' Attacks on Chinese Tech Firms as 'Fabricated and Unfair'
articles.summary_zh: 中国外交部发言人林剑8月24日在例行记者会上表示，美方个别官员攻击中方科技企业的言论捏造事实、颠倒黑白，是科技霸凌和单边胁迫，中方坚决反对。
articles.summary_en: Foreign Ministry spokesman Lin Jian said at a routine press conference on Aug 24 that US officials' attacks on Chinese tech firms are fabricated and unfair, constituting tech bullying and unilateral coercion, which China firmly opposes.

articles.title_zh: “北京没有冰箱”背后，台湾“名嘴”为何一味炮制“大陆穷酸剧本”？
articles.title_en: Behind 'No Refrigerators in Beijing': Why Taiwan Pundits Keep Fabricating 'Mainland Poverty' Claims?
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，台湾某绿营“名嘴”再抛“北京没有冰箱”反智言论；国台办此前已依法对黄世聪等5名散布谣言的“名嘴”及家属实施惩戒。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, a Taiwan pro-green pundit again made the absurd claim that 'Beijing has no refrigerators.' The State Council's Taiwan Affairs Office had previously punished five such pundits for spreading rumors.

articles.title_zh: 国家体育总局体育基金管理中心副主任罗建彬被查
articles.title_en: Luo Jianbin, Deputy Director of Sports Fund Management Center, Investigated

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江与国家能源集团氢能事业部主任刘玮、上海交通大学副校长曾小勤一行座谈

articles.summary_en: On August 22, Xie Weijiang, Deputy Secretary of Hunan Provincial Committee and Secretary of Yueyang Municipal Committee, held talks with Liu Wei, Director of Hydrogen Energy Division of China Energy, and Zeng Xiaoqin, Vice President of Shanghai Jiao Tong University, on cooperation in hydrogen energy, green fuels, and talent cultivation.

articles.title_zh: 张向阳主持召开区委常委会（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Zhang Xiangyang Chairs Enlarged Meeting of District Party Committee Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 张向阳主持召开区委常委会（扩大）会议，部署群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治决战决胜和蚊媒防控等工作。
articles.summary_en: Zhang Xiangyang chaired an enlarged meeting of the district party committee standing committee, deploying the decisive fight against corruption and misconduct around the people and vector control.

articles.title_zh: 詹鹏主持召开市政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Zhan Peng Chairs Standing Meeting of Zhoukou Municipal Government

articles.summary_en: On August 21, Zhoukou Mayor Zhan Peng chaired a municipal government executive meeting to convey Xi Jinping's important article and speech, and discuss flood control, disaster recovery and economic development measures.

articles.title_zh: 黄玉国到西华县调研指导灾后重建工作
articles.title_en: Huang Yuguo Inspects Post-Disaster Reconstruction in Xihua County
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，周口市委书记黄玉国到西华县调研灾后重建，实地察看受灾房屋、农田排涝及安置点，强调保障群众安全回迁、加快恢复生产生活秩序。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Huang Yuguo, Secretary of Zhoukou Municipal Party Committee, inspected post-disaster reconstruction in Xihua County, visiting flooded houses, farmland drainage and resettlement sites, emphasizing safe return and restoration of normal life.

articles.title_zh: 詹鹏主持召开市政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Zhan Peng Chairs Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，周口市市长詹鹏主持召开市政府常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要文章和讲话精神，部署防汛救灾、灾后恢复和经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Zhoukou Mayor Zhan Peng chaired a municipal government executive meeting to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important article and speech, and deploy flood prevention, disaster recovery and economic work.

articles.title_zh: 郑莉同志任贵阳市委书记、贵安新区党工委书记
articles.title_en: Zheng Li Appointed Secretary of Guiyang Municipal Party Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，贵阳市贵安新区召开领导干部会议，宣布省委决定，郑莉任贵阳市委书记、贵安新区党工委书记，胡忠雄不再担任。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, a leading cadres meeting in Guiyang and Gui'an New Area announced the provincial committee's decision to appoint Zheng Li as Secretary of the Guiyang Municipal Party Committee and Party Working Committee Secretary of Gui'an New Area, replacing Hu Zhongxiong.

articles.title_zh: 全国政协副主席陈武逝世
articles.title_en: Vice Chairman of CPPCC National Committee Chen Wu Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 中国人民政治协商会议第十四届全国委员会副主席陈武同志因病于2026年8月24日15时05分在北京逝世，享年72岁。
articles.summary_en: Chen Wu, Vice Chairman of the 14th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, passed away in Beijing at 15:05 on August 24, 2026, at the age of 72.

articles.title_zh: 厦门一公司用敌敌畏给数十家餐厅消杀？当地最新通报：查扣企业剩余库存药品
articles.title_en: Xiamen Company Accused of Using Insecticide for Restaurant Pest Control; Local Authorities Seize Stock
articles.summary_zh: 厦门一公司涉嫌用敌敌畏为数十家餐厅进行消杀，当地最新通报称已查扣企业剩余库存药品，事件正在调查中。
articles.summary_en: A company in Xiamen is suspected of using dichlorvos to disinfect dozens of restaurants. Local authorities have seized its remaining stock and are investigating.

articles.title_zh: 李家超：香港是内地独角兽企业进军国际的最强跳板
articles.title_en: John Lee: Hong Kong is the Strongest Springboard for Mainland Unicorn Companies Going Global

articles.summary_en: The first Global Unicorn Conference opened in Hong Kong on Aug 24. Chief Executive John Lee said Hong Kong is the strongest springboard for mainland unicorns to go global.

articles.title_zh: 中国农业发展银行湖南省分行原党委书记、行长吴晓轮被开除党籍
articles.title_en: Wu Xiaolun, Former Party Secretary and President of ADBC Hunan Branch, Expelled from Party
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，中央纪委国家监委驻中国农业发展银行纪检监察组和湖北省咸宁市监委通报，吴晓轮严重违纪违法被开除党籍，涉嫌受贿罪、违法发放贷款罪，移送检察机关审查起诉。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, the Discipline Inspection and Supervision Group of the CCDI and the National Commission of Supervision stationed at ADBC, along with the Xianning Municipal Supervision Commission of Hubei, announced that Wu Xiaolun was expelled from the CPC for serious disciplinary and legal violations, suspected of bribery and illegal loan issuance, and transferred to procuratorial organs for review and prosecution.

articles.title_zh: 受贿3195万余元 北京大学原副校长任羽中被判8年

articles.summary_en: On Aug 24, Dandong Intermediate Court sentenced ex-Peking University VP Ren Yuzhong to 8 years for bribery, fined 2.6 million yuan, and confiscated illegal gains.

articles.title_zh: “蘸甲醛”白菜流向江苏宿迁？当地通报

articles.summary_en: Local authorities in Suqian responded to reports that formaldehyde-treated cabbage may have been sold there, with relevant departments intervening.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁吴贤德赴基层调研社会工作开展情况
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning and Wu Xiande Visit Grassroots to Review Social Work

articles.summary_en: On August 24, Guo Ningning, deputy secretary of Fujian Provincial Party Committee and Fuzhou Party Secretary, and Mayor Wu Xiande visited Taijiang and Jin'an to review social work, stressing the new-era 'Fortress Project' and Party building in emerging fields.

articles.summary_en: On August 24, the Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee's Theoretical Study Group held a meeting, with a special lecture on statistical law and performance view. Officials including Guo Ningning attended.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神

articles.summary_zh: 8月24日下午，青岛市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究经济工作和大气污染防治等事项，市委书记曾赞荣主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 24, the Standing Committee of the Qingdao Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech, discuss economic work and air pollution prevention, with Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong presiding.

articles.title_zh: 全市服务业大会召开
articles.title_en: Municipal Service Industry Conference Held in Qingdao

articles.summary_en: On August 24, the municipal service industry conference was held in Qingdao. Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong attended and delivered a speech, deploying actions to expand and improve the service industry.

articles.title_zh: 浙江省委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话和重要文章精神
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speech and Article

articles.title_zh: 中国工程院院士、歼轰7飞机总设计师陈一坚逝世

articles.title_zh: 城市增韧性 家园更宜居

articles.summary_en: This report highlights sponge city construction in Hengshui, smart flood control in Tianjin, and digital pipeline management in Chongqing to enhance urban resilience and safety.

articles.title_zh: 国铁南宁局启动应急响应防御台风“紫檀”

articles.summary_en: China Railway Nanning Group activated emergency response for Typhoon Zitan, implementing speed restrictions, line inspections, and train suspensions to ensure safety, while assisting passengers with refunds and transfers.

articles.title_zh: “人工智能赋能千行百业一线调研行”主题采访活动在南宁启动

articles.summary_en: People's Daily reporters visit energy facilities in Shandong, Ningxia and Shaanxi, highlighting China's balanced energy supply, rapid new energy growth and clean coal use under Xi Jinping's energy security strategy.

articles.title_zh: 河北首次启动自然科学基金非共识项目申报
articles.title_en: Hebei Launches First Application for Non-consensus Projects of Natural Science Fund

articles.summary_en: Hebei has launched the application for 2026 non-consensus projects of its Natural Science Fund, the first special funding channel for high-risk, high-value original research.

articles.summary_en: Hebei Province held a meeting on foreign-related legal services, establishing a 66-expert legal service team and deploying an action plan to support enterprises going global.

articles.title_zh: 陕西出台若干措施推进服务业扩能提质
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Issues Measures to Boost Service Industry
articles.summary_zh: 陕西省人民政府日前印发《陕西省推进服务业扩能提质若干措施》，从壮大科技服务业、发展软件和信息服务业、规范平台经济等方面促进服务业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The Shaanxi Provincial Government issued measures to promote high-quality development of the service industry, covering technology services, software and information services, and platform economy.

articles.title_zh: 云南启动中药材种业创新发展科技计划项目
articles.title_en: Yunnan Launches Science and Technology Program for Innovation and Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine Seed Industry
articles.summary_zh: 8月23日，云南省中药材种业创新发展科技计划项目启动会在云南农业大学举行，18个项目全面启动，聚焦种质资源保护、育种技术创新等关键环节。
articles.summary_en: On August 23, the launch meeting of Yunnan's science and technology program for innovative development of traditional Chinese medicine seed industry was held at Yunnan Agricultural University, with 18 projects fully initiated, focusing on key areas such as germplasm resource conservation and breeding technology innovation.

articles.title_zh: 超强台风“沙德尔”登陆我国？专家解析今年台风缘何偏多
articles.title_en: Super Typhoon Shadel to Hit China? Experts Explain Why Typhoons Are More Frequent This Year
articles.summary_zh: 8月23日，台风“沙德尔”加强为超强台风，预计27日前后影响华东沿海；中央气象台首席预报员张玲解析今年台风偏多与厄尔尼诺有关。
articles.summary_en: On August 23, Typhoon Shadel intensified into a super typhoon and is expected to affect the East China coast around August 27; chief forecaster Zhang Ling of the Central Meteorological Observatory attributes the frequent typhoons to El Niño.

articles.title_zh: 习近平作出重要指示强调巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Emphasizes Consolidating Education on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，中共中央总书记习近平就巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果作出重要指示，中央党的建设工作领导小组召开会议，蔡奇主持，李希出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Xi Jinping made important instructions on consolidating the outcomes of the study and education on the correct view of political achievements. The Central Leading Group for Party Building held a meeting chaired by Cai Qi, with Li Xi attending and speaking.

articles.title_zh: 我国钢铁产业发展如何实现转型蝶变？
articles.title_en: How Has China's Steel Industry Achieved a Transformational Leap?
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾我国钢铁产业从规模领先到高质量发展的转型历程，涵盖产能优化、布局集中、产品升级、智能化和绿色革命，强调中国钢铁已深刻改变全球产业格局。
articles.summary_en: This article reviews the transformation of China's steel industry from scale leadership to high-quality development, covering capacity optimization, layout consolidation, product upgrades, smart manufacturing, and green revolution, highlighting its global impact.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致电祝贺阿拉姆吉尔就任孟加拉国总统
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulations to Alamgir on Assuming Presidency of Bangladesh
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，国家主席习近平致电阿拉姆吉尔，祝贺他就任孟加拉国总统，表示愿推进中孟命运共同体建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory message to Alamgir on his assumption of the presidency of Bangladesh, expressing willingness to advance the China-Bangladesh community with a shared future.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Jordan's King Abdullah II
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日下午，国家主席习近平在北京人民大会堂同来华进行国事访问的约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世举行会谈，并为其举行欢迎仪式。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 24, President Xi Jinping held talks with King Abdullah II of Jordan, who is on a state visit to China, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, followed by a welcoming ceremony.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 中国语言资源保护工程成果展示馆开馆
articles.title_en: China Language Resource Protection Project Achievement Hall Opens
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，位于湖南长沙的中国语言资源保护工程成果展示馆开馆，展出全国汉语方言、少数民族语言和语言文化1800余点语料，标志语保工程成果实现从“数据库”向“活态展”的跨越。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 24, China's Language Resource Protection Project Achievement Hall opened in Changsha, displaying 1,800+ language and culture items, marking a leap from database to living display.

articles.title_zh: 水利部对福建省启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Activates Level-IV Flood Emergency Response for Fujian
articles.summary_zh: 水利部8月24日对福建省启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，并派出工作组赴台风暴雨洪水防御一线。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, the Ministry of Water Resources activated a Level-IV flood emergency response for Fujian and dispatched a work team to the front line.

articles.title_zh: 学习快评丨树立和践行正确政绩观必须久久为功
articles.title_en: Commentary: Cultivating and Practicing Correct View on Political Achievements Requires Long-term Persistence
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记近日就树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育作出重要指示，强调树立和践行正确政绩观是一项长期任务，必须久久为功，巩固拓展学习教育成果。
articles.summary_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping recently made important instructions on learning and education on establishing and practicing the correct view on political achievements, emphasizing that it is a long-term task that requires sustained effort to consolidate and expand the achievements.

articles.title_zh: 美国友人“赛考斯”时隔20余年重返中国：我回到了我的第二个家
articles.title_en: American Friend 'Saikos' Returns to China After Over 20 Years: I'm Back in My Second Home
articles.summary_zh: 应中国教育国际交流协会邀请，支持中国治沙事业的美国友人赛考斯8月23日凌晨抵达北京，将于8月23日至9月1日访问北京、内蒙古、河南三地，与治沙英雄殷玉珍重逢。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of the China Education Association for International Exchange, American friend 'Saikos', who supported China's desertification control, arrived in Beijing early on Aug 23. He will visit Beijing, Inner Mongolia and Henan from Aug 23 to Sep 1 to reunite with desertification fighter Yin Yuzhen.

articles.title_zh: 发挥好支部的战斗堡垒作用
articles.title_en: Give Full Play to the Role of Party Branches as Battle Fortresses
articles.summary_zh: 2006年8月超强台风“桑美”袭击浙江苍南，时任浙江省委书记习近平深入灾区慰问，强调“一个党员一面旗，发挥好支部的战斗堡垒作用”。文章回顾了党的十八大以来党员队伍建设成就。
articles.summary_en: In August 2006, when Typhoon Saomai struck Cangnan, Zhejiang, Xi Jinping, then Zhejiang Provincial Party Secretary, visited the disaster area and stressed that every Party member should be a banner and Party branches should play their role as battle fortresses. The article reviews Party building achievements since the 18th CPC National Congress.

tags.name_en: Fighting Fortress Role of Primary-Level Party Organizations

tags_en: Fighting Fortress Role of Primary-Level Party Organizations

articles.title_zh: 全国多个城市密集出台新政 你的住房公积金有这些新用途→
articles.title_en: Multiple Cities Roll Out New Housing Provident Fund Policies with Expanded Uses
articles.summary_zh: 全国多个城市密集出台住房公积金优化政策，将装修、物业费等纳入提取范围，并放宽灵活就业人员缴存门槛；新修订的《住房公积金管理条例》将于9月20日施行。
articles.summary_en: Cities across China have rolled out optimized housing provident fund policies, expanding withdrawal uses to include renovation and property fees, and easing contribution access for flexible workers. The revised Regulations on Housing Provident Fund Management will take effect on September 20.

articles.title_zh: 美国友人“赛考斯”抵北京：美中两国可以携手共建美好世界
articles.title_en: American Friend 'Sakolsky' Arrives in Beijing: US and China Can Jointly Build a Better World
articles.summary_zh: 应中国教育国际交流协会邀请，支持中国治沙事业的美国友人赛考斯8月23日凌晨抵达北京，开启10天中国之旅，将看望治沙英雄殷玉珍并见证治沙成果。
articles.summary_en: American friend Sakolsky, invited by the Chinese Education Association for International Exchange, arrived in Beijing early on Aug 23 to start a 10-day tour, planning to visit desertification hero Yin Yuzhen and witness afforestation achievements.

articles.title_zh: 新思想引领新征程丨拓展共建“一带一路”合作新空间 铺就共赢之路
articles.title_en: New Thought Leads New Journey | Expanding New Space for Belt and Road Cooperation, Paving a Win-Win Road
articles.summary_zh: 本文报道今年我国与共建“一带一路”国家深化合作，中欧班列提速、新三样出口增长，绿色数字合作拓展，强调共商共建共享，铺就共赢之路。
articles.summary_en: China deepens BRI cooperation: faster China-Europe freight trains, rising new-energy exports, and expanded green/digital projects, pursuing win-win outcomes.

articles.title_zh: 中阿启动干旱、荒漠化和土地退化防治五年行动计划
articles.title_en: China and Arab Nations Launch Five-Year Action Plan to Combat Drought, Desertification and Land Degradation
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，中阿干旱、荒漠化和土地退化国际研究中心指导委员会第二次会议在乌兰巴托召开，正式发布五年行动计划，深化荒漠化防治合作。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, the second meeting of the Steering Committee of the China-Arab Research Center on Drought, Desertification and Land Degradation was held in Ulaanbaatar, officially launching a five-year action plan to deepen cooperation in desertification control.

articles.title_zh: “能演示”走向“能干活”——从两场世界级大会看中国机器人产业新气象
articles.title_en: From 'Demonstration' to 'Real Work': China's Robot Industry Shows New Vitality at Two Global Conferences
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，第二届世界人形机器人运动会在北京开幕，2026世界机器人大会同期举办，展现中国机器人产业从演示走向规模化应用的新趋势。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 22, the 2nd World Humanoid Robot Games opened in Beijing alongside the 2026 World Robot Conference, showcasing China's robot industry moving from demonstrations to large-scale applications.

articles.title_zh: 消费品以旧换新政策惠及1.78亿人次
articles.title_en: Consumer Trade-in Policy Benefits 178 Million People
articles.summary_zh: 财政部今年下达消费品以旧换新资金1875亿元，带动相关商品销售额约1.32万亿元，惠及1.78亿人次。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance allocated 187.5 billion yuan for consumer trade-ins, driving sales of about 1.32 trillion yuan and benefiting 178 million people.

articles.title_zh: 加快现代化产业体系建设
articles.title_en: Accelerating the Construction of a Modern Industrial System
articles.summary_zh: 文章阐述我国加快现代化产业体系建设进展：前7月规模以上工业增加值同比增长5.3%，新动能贡献率50.9%；7月30日中央政治局会议部署加快现代化产业体系建设和'人工智能+'行动。
articles.summary_en: China's industrial value-added grew 5.3% year-on-year in the first seven months, with new drivers contributing 50.9% to growth. The CPC Central Committee Political Bureau meeting on July 30 called for accelerating the modern industrial system and AI+ actions.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能进课堂，如何学得更好（解码“十五五”专项规划）
articles.title_en: AI in Classrooms: How to Learn Better (Decoding the 15th Five-Year Plan Special Program)
articles.summary_zh: 教育部等五部门印发《“人工智能+教育”行动计划》，推动人工智能全学段教育，各地中小学和高校开设相关课程，提升学生人工智能素养。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Education and four other departments issued an action plan for AI-plus-education, promoting AI education across all schooling stages, with schools and universities offering relevant courses to improve students' AI literacy.

articles.title_zh: 站在新起点 “一规引未来”
articles.title_en: Standing at a New Starting Point: A Plan Leads the Future
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，澳门特区政府正式发布《经济和社会发展第三个五年规划（2026—2030年）》，主动对接国家“十五五”规划，旨在推动经济适度多元发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the Macao SAR Government officially released its Third Five-Year Plan for Economic and Social Development (2026-2030), aligning with the national 15th Five-Year Plan to promote moderate economic diversification.

articles.title_zh: 一“出”一“进”，看高水平开放落地生根（深入实施自由贸易试验区提升战略）
articles.title_en: China's High-Level Opening-Up Gains Momentum Through Beijing Free Trade Zone Innovations
articles.summary_zh: 北京自贸试验区通过制度创新，在数据出境、跨境投融资和罕见病药品进口等方面取得突破，促进高水平开放。
articles.summary_en: Beijing Pilot Free Trade Zone has made breakthroughs in data outflow, cross-border investment, and rare-disease drug imports through institutional innovation, advancing high-level opening-up.

articles.title_zh: 搭台铺路，让青春光彩绽放
articles.title_en: Building Stages and Paving Roads to Let Youth Shine
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来，澳门特区政府聚焦青年就业创业，多部门协作推出岗位配对、就业+培训、内地实习等系列措施，全力推动青年发展。
articles.summary_en: Since this year, the Macao SAR Government has focused on youth employment and entrepreneurship, implementing a series of measures such as job matching, employment-plus-training, and internship programs in the mainland to promote youth development.

articles.title_zh: 师徒三代创新“夺冠”记
articles.title_en: Three Generations of Mentors and Apprentices Win Innovation Crown
articles.summary_zh: 报道中车长客李万君劳模创新工作室师徒三代焊接工人，传承技能报国精神，攻克高铁转向架焊接难题，推动中国制造创新。
articles.summary_en: Three generations of welders at CRRC Changchun, led by Li Wanjun, mastered key bogie welding for high-speed trains, showing skill-driven patriotism and boosting China's manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 中国是世界经济增长的积极贡献者和强大稳定锚
articles.title_en: China Is an Active Contributor and Anchor of Stability for Global Economic Growth
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报发表评论指出，中国经济顶压前行、持续向新向优发展，对世界经济增长贡献率保持在30%左右，是全球产供链的稳定锚和互利共赢的实践者。
articles.summary_en: A People's Daily commentary says China's economy progresses steadily despite pressure, contributing about 30% to global growth, serving as a stabilizer of supply chains and a practitioner of win-win cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林会见中国德国商会会员企业代表团
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Meets Delegation of German Chamber of Commerce in China
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，辽宁省委书记许昆林在沈阳会见中国德国商会会员企业代表团，就深化中德经贸合作、推动辽宁全面振兴等交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Xu Kunlin, Secretary of the CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee, met with a delegation of the German Chamber of Commerce in China in Shenyang to discuss deepening economic and trade cooperation and promoting Liaoning's comprehensive revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 中国是世界经济增长的积极贡献者和强大稳定锚
articles.title_en: China Is a Positive Contributor and Strong Stabilizer to Global Economic Growth
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来中国经济顶压前行，上半年增长4.7%，是世界经济增长的主要引擎和稳定锚，为全球发展提供确定性。
articles.summary_en: Since this year, China's economy has advanced against pressure, growing 4.7% in H1, serving as the main engine and stabilizer of world economic growth and providing certainty for global development.

articles.title_zh: 今年以来消费品以旧换新政策惠及1.78亿人次
articles.title_en: Consumer Goods Trade-in Policy Benefits 178 Million People This Year
articles.summary_zh: 财政部下达消费品以旧换新资金1875亿元，带动相关商品销售额约1.32万亿元，惠及1.78亿人次；同时加快超长期特别国债发行使用，支持重大项目建设。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance allocated 187.5 billion yuan for consumer goods trade-ins, driving sales of about 1.32 trillion yuan and benefiting 178 million people. It also accelerated ultra-long-term special treasury bond issuance for major projects.

articles.title_zh: 网上商品和服务零售额前7月增4.8%
articles.title_en: Online Retail Sales of Goods and Services Up 4.8% in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 1-7月全国网上商品和服务零售额增长4.8%，对社会零售总额增长贡献率超五成，电子商务稳定发展，线上线下融合激发消费潜能。
articles.summary_en: In the first seven months, online retail sales of goods and services in China grew 4.8%, contributing over half of the growth in total social retail sales. E-commerce remains stable and innovative, integrating online and offline channels to unleash consumption potential.

articles.title_zh: 我国矿山生态保护修复向绿向新
articles.title_en: China's Mine Ecological Restoration Moves Toward Green and New Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月23日，国家发展改革委表示，我国262个资源型城市持续推进矿山绿色转型，已建成国家级绿色矿山699个。下一步将加快形成“治理—增值—反哺”良性循环。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 23, the National Development and Reform Commission said China's 262 resource-based cities are advancing green transformation of mines, with 699 national-level green mines built. It will speed up a virtuous cycle of governance-value-reinvestment.

articles.title_zh: 王毅会见约旦副首相兼外交大臣萨法迪
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets Jordanian Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Safadi
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅8月23日在北京会见陪同约旦国王访华的约旦副首相兼外交大臣萨法迪。
articles.summary_en: On August 23, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, met in Beijing with Jordanian Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Safadi, who accompanied King Abdullah II on his visit to China.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林会见上海电气集团董事长吴磊
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Meets Wu Lei, Chairman of Shanghai Electric
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，辽宁省委书记许昆林在沈阳会见上海电气集团董事长吴磊，双方就深化合作、清洁能源、智能制造等展开交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin met with Wu Lei, Chairman of Shanghai Electric, in Shenyang to discuss cooperation in clean energy and intelligent manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市组织开展县区（园区）党（工）委领导干部廉政教育活动
articles.title_en: Huai'an Organizes Integrity Education for County-Level Party Committee Leaders
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，淮安市组织县区（园区）党（工）委领导干部赴江苏省廉政教育中心和周恩来纪念馆开展廉政教育活动，市委书记史志军与全体人员集体谈话。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Huai'an organized an integrity education activity for county-level party committee leaders, visiting Jiangsu Provincial Integrity Education Center and Zhou Enlai Memorial Hall. Party Secretary Shi Zhijun had a collective talk with participants.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市组织开展县区（园区）党（工）委领导干部廉政教育活动
articles.title_en: Huaian Holds Integrity Education Activity for Party Committee Leaders
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，淮安市组织县区（园区）党（工）委领导干部廉政教育活动，市委书记史志军与全体人员集体谈话，强调推进党风廉政建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Huaian organized an integrity education activity for party committee leaders of counties and parks. Party Secretary Shi Zhijun held a collective talk, emphasizing strict party discipline and anti-corruption efforts.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰带队赴茂名市考察学习
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Leads Delegation to Maoming for Study Tour
articles.summary_zh: 8月23日上午，汕尾市委书记逯峰率团赴茂名考察，学习“百千万工程”、省运会筹办等经验，茂名市委书记王雄飞陪同。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 23, Shanwei Party chief Lu Feng led a delegation to Maoming to learn experiences in the "Baiqianwan" project and provincial games preparation, with Maoming Party chief Wang Xiongfei accompanying.

articles.title_zh: 第八期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”举行
articles.title_en: Eighth 'Frontier Lecture Hall' for Leading Cadres Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，泰州市举办第八期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”，专家安冉就具身智能产业作专题授课，市委书记姜冬冬等参加学习。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Taizhou held the eighth session of the 'Frontier Lecture Hall' for leading cadres. Expert An Ran lectured on the embodied intelligence industry, attended by Municipal Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong and others.

articles.title_zh: 第八期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”举行
articles.title_en: 8th Frontier Lecture for Leading Cadres Held in Taizhou
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，泰州市举行第八期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”，邀请专家安冉作人工智能（具身智能）产业专题授课，市委书记姜冬冬等市领导参加学习。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Taizhou held its 8th Frontier Lecture for leading cadres, featuring expert An Ran lecturing on embodied AI industry; Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong attended.

articles.title_zh: 2026集成电路（无锡）创新发展大会筹备工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Preparatory Work Meeting for 2026 Wuxi Integrated Circuit Innovation Conference Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，市长蒋锋主持召开2026集成电路（无锡）创新发展大会筹备工作会议，强调精益求精做好各项筹备工作，努力办成高水平行业盛会。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Mayor Jiang Feng chaired the preparatory meeting for the 2026 Wuxi Integrated Circuit Innovation and Development Conference, emphasizing meticulous preparations to host a high-level industry event.

articles.title_zh: 叶牛平主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Ye Niuping Chairs Municipal Government Party Group (Expanded) Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，西安市市长叶牛平主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记在上海考察时的重要讲话精神，研究推进城市更新和基层治理工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Xi'an Mayor Ye Niuping chaired the municipal government party group (expanded) meeting to study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech during his Shanghai inspection and to advance urban renewal and grassroots governance.

articles.title_zh: 叶牛平主持召开市政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Ye Niuping Chairs Xi'an Municipal Government Standing Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，西安市市长叶牛平主持召开市政府常务会议，研究国土空间规划动态维护、政务服务“一网通办”、算力网建设等事项，部署提升城市智慧化水平和职业教育发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Xi'an Mayor Ye Niuping chaired a municipal government standing meeting to discuss dynamic maintenance of territorial planning, integrated online government services, computing network construction, and vocational education development.

articles.title_zh: 襄阳市委书记调整，关志鸥：这是省委反复酝酿、慎重研究决定的
articles.title_en: Xiangyang Party Secretary Adjusted; Guan Zhi'ou: Decision Made After Deliberation by Provincial Committee
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月23日，湖北省委宣布调整襄阳市委书记，省委常委关志鸥表示这是省委反复酝酿、慎重研究决定的。
articles.summary_en: On August 23, 2026, Hubei Provincial Committee announced the adjustment of Xiangyang's Party Secretary, with provincial official Guan Zhi'ou stating it was made after repeated deliberation.

articles.title_zh: 襄阳市委书记调整：彭勇接任
articles.title_en: Peng Yong Appointed Xiangyang Party Secretary, Replacing Wu Haitao
articles.summary_zh: 8月23日，湖北襄阳市召开领导干部会议，宣布省委决定：彭勇任襄阳市委书记，吴海涛不再担任。省委书记关志鸥称这是省委反复酝酿、慎重研究决定的。
articles.summary_en: On August 23, Xiangyang held a cadre meeting announcing the provincial committee's decision to appoint Peng Yong as Xiangyang party secretary, replacing Wu Haitao. Hubei Party Secretary Guan Zhi'ou said the decision was made after careful deliberation.

articles.title_zh: 航行警告！南海部分海域进行实弹射击，禁止驶入
articles.title_en: Navigation Warning: Live-Fire Exercise in Parts of South China Sea, Entry Prohibited
articles.summary_zh: 湛江海事局发布航行警告，8月24日至28日每天8时至18时，南海部分海域进行实弹射击，禁止驶入。
articles.summary_en: Zhanjiang Maritime Safety Administration issued a navigation warning that live-fire exercises will be held in parts of the South China Sea from August 24 to 28, 0800-1800 daily, and entry is prohibited.

articles.title_zh: 两部门对福建启动防汛防台风四级应急响应
articles.title_en: Two Departments Activate Level-IV Emergency Response for Flood and Typhoon in Fujian
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，国家防总、应急管理部针对第20号台风“简拉维”影响，对福建启动防汛防台风四级应急响应。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 22, China's State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters and Ministry of Emergency Management activated a Level-IV emergency response for flood and typhoon in Fujian due to Typhoon Janavi.

articles.title_zh: 福建“十五五”商务发展规划出台
articles.title_en: Fujian Issues 15th Five-Year Commercial Development Plan
articles.summary_zh: 日前，福建省人民政府印发《福建省“十五五”商务发展规划》，提出推动数智赋能商务发展，建设消费大省、贸易强省、引资大省、开放强省。
articles.summary_en: The Fujian Provincial People's Government issued the 15th Five-Year Commercial Development Plan, aiming to boost digitalized commerce and build a strong province in consumption, trade, investment attraction, and openness.

articles.title_zh: 发挥好支部的战斗堡垒作用
articles.title_en: Give Full Play to the Combat Fortress Role of Party Branches
articles.summary_zh: 2006年8月，时任浙江省委书记习近平在超强台风“桑美”袭击浙江苍南时，深入重灾区察看灾情，强调要发挥好支部的战斗堡垒作用。
articles.summary_en: In August 2006, Xi Jinping, then Party Secretary of Zhejiang, visited the disaster area hit by Typhoon Saomai in Cangnan, Zhejiang, and stressed the role of Party branches as battle fortresses.

tags.name_en: Pioneer and Exemplary Role of Party Members

tags_en: Pioneer and Exemplary Role of Party Members

articles.title_zh: 从工厂车间到高速服务区，济南绿色低碳转型再提速
articles.title_en: From Factory Workshops to Highway Service Areas: Jinan Accelerates Green Low-Carbon Transition
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，山东省委书记林武赴济南调研，走访中国重汽和章丘服务区重卡充电示范站，强调绿色低碳转型全链条推进。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Shandong Party Secretary Lin Wu inspected Jinan, visiting Sinotruk and a truck charging demo station, emphasizing whole-chain green transition.

articles.title_zh: 加拿大宣布对美等额反制关税将于9月8日生效
articles.title_en: Canada Announces Retaliatory Tariffs on US to Take Effect Sept 8
articles.summary_zh: 加拿大总理卡尼22日宣布，鉴于美国对200亿美元加拿大商品征收50%关税，加方将于9月8日实施等额报复性关税，涵盖乳制品、钢铁、家电等领域。
articles.summary_en: Canadian PM Carney announced on Aug 22 that Canada will impose matching retaliatory tariffs on Sept 8 in response to US 50% tariffs on C$20 billion of Canadian goods, covering dairy, steel, appliances and more.

articles.title_zh: 多部门联合会商部署防汛防台风工作
articles.title_en: Multiple Departments Hold Joint Consultation on Flood and Typhoon Prevention
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，国家防办、应急管理部组织多部门及省份联合会商，研判台风“沙德尔”“紫檀”及强降雨形势，部署防汛防台风工作，并维持或启动多项应急响应。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, the National Flood Control Office and the Ministry of Emergency Management convened a joint consultation with multiple departments and provinces to assess typhoons 'Saudel' and 'Zitan' and heavy rainfall, deploying flood and typhoon prevention measures and maintaining or activating emergency responses.

articles.title_zh: 殷勇：创新管理体制机制 提升园区运营服务水平和综合效益
articles.title_en: Yin Yong: Innovate Management Systems to Improve Park Operations and Efficiency
articles.summary_zh: 北京市市长殷勇日前到大兴区调研市管企业产业园区，强调创新管理体制机制，提升园区运营服务水平和综合效益，培育新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: Yin Yong, Mayor of Beijing, recently visited Daxing District to inspect state-owned enterprise industrial parks, emphasizing innovative management systems to enhance operations and foster new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行｜这是不是你向往的“慢充”闽生活？
articles.title_en: Vibrant China Research Trip: Is This the 'Slow-Charge' Fujian Life You Yearn For?
articles.summary_zh: 报道福建文旅消费持续升温，深度游兴起，福建通过活化老城、山海赋能等举措打造“闽式”生活体验，释放消费潜力。
articles.summary_en: Reports on Fujian's booming cultural tourism consumption, with deep travel rising. Fujian is enhancing old cities and coastal resources to create the 'Fujian-style' life and unleash consumption potential.

articles.title_zh: 罗文主持召开河北省委理论学习中心组学习会
articles.title_en: Luo Wen Chairs Hebei Provincial Party Committee Theoretical Learning Group Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，河北省委书记罗文主持召开省委理论学习中心组学习会，强调深入学习贯彻习近平经济思想，推动全省经济持续向新向优向好发展，努力实现“十五五”良好开局。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Luo Wen, Secretary of the Hebei Provincial Party Committee, chaired the theoretical learning center group meeting, emphasizing implementation of Xi Jinping's economic thought to promote sustained, high-quality economic development.

articles.title_zh: 太空算力技术创新中心在雄安成立
articles.title_en: Space Computing Technology Innovation Center Established in Xiong'an
articles.summary_zh: 由北京邮电大学、中国星网数科、蓝箭鸿擎共建的太空算力技术创新中心在雄安新区揭牌成立，推动太空算力产学研深度融合。
articles.summary_en: The Space Computing Technology Innovation Center, co-founded by Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, China SatNet Digital Technology, and Landspace Hongqing, was inaugurated in Xiong'an New Area to deepen integration of industry, academia, research, and application.

tags_en: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

articles.title_zh: 水利部对海南等三地启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Activates Level IV Emergency Response for Flood Defense in Hainan and Two Other Regions
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，水利部对广东、广西、海南启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，应对台风“紫檀”带来的强降雨和洪水风险。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, the Ministry of Water Resources activated a Level IV emergency response for flood defense in Guangdong, Guangxi, and Hainan in response to heavy rain and flood risks from Typhoon "Zitan".

articles.title_zh: 冯飞在省发展改革委调研时强调
articles.title_en: Feng Fei Surveys Provincial DRC, Stresses Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，省委书记冯飞调研省发展改革委并召开座谈会，强调要树立和践行正确政绩观，统筹谋划经济发展和项目建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Provincial Party Secretary Feng Fei visited the Provincial Development and Reform Commission and chaired a symposium, stressing the need to establish a correct view of political achievements and coordinate economic development and project construction.

articles.title_zh: 江苏出台12项金融举措赋能城市更新
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Rolls Out 12 Financial Measures to Boost Urban Renewal
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省地方金融管理局、省住建厅等五部门近日联合发布《江苏省金融支持城市更新工作若干措施》，推出12项举措优化城市更新项目金融服务。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu's local financial regulators and housing authorities jointly issued measures to provide 12 financial policies for urban renewal projects.

tags.name_zh: 江苏省地方金融管理局

articles.title_zh: 王伟中包钢会见科技部部长阴和俊
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong and Bao Gang Meet Minister of Science and Technology Yin Hejun
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中、政府主席包钢在呼和浩特会见科技部党组书记、部长阴和俊一行，双方就深化部区科技合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Wang Weizhong, Secretary of the CPC Inner Mongolia Regional Committee, and Bao Gang, Chairman of the Regional Government, met with Yin Hejun, Minister of Science and Technology, in Hohhot to discuss deepening sci-tech cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 2026绿色算力（人工智能）大会举行
articles.title_en: 2026 Green Computing Power (AI) Conference Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，2026绿色算力（人工智能）大会在内蒙古呼和浩特举行，发布多项报告，签约13个重点项目，总投资1361亿元。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, the 2026 Green Computing Power (AI) Conference was held in Hohhot, Inner Mongolia, releasing reports and signing 13 key projects with total investment of 136.1 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 鄂尔多斯“消费帮扶”助农周启动
articles.title_en: Ordos Launches Consumer Support Farmers Week
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，2026年鄂尔多斯市“消费帮扶”助农周暨“暖城多味”消夏周在鄂尔多斯国际会展中心启动，汇集9个旗区2000余种农畜产品，并发放300万元消费券。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, the 2026 Ordos Consumer Support Farmers Week and Warm City Flavors Summer Week kicked off at Ordos International Convention Center, featuring over 2,000 agricultural products from 9 banners and distributing 3 million yuan in consumer vouchers.

articles.title_zh: 印度尼西亚总统普拉博沃会见王毅一行
articles.title_en: Indonesian President Prabowo Meets Wang Yi and His Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 印度尼西亚总统普拉博沃21日在雅加达会见中国外交部长王毅和国防部长董军，双方就加强全面战略合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: Indonesian President Prabowo met with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi and Defense Minister Dong Jun in Jakarta on Aug. 21, exchanging views on strengthening comprehensive strategic cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 吴晓军：坚决克服麻痹思想侥幸心理 落实落细各项防范措施 牢牢守住防汛安全底线
articles.title_en: Wu Xiaojun: Overcome Complacency and Implement Preventive Measures to Safeguard Flood Safety
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，青海省委书记吴晓军在省应急指挥部调度全省防汛工作，强调要克服麻痹思想，落实防范措施，守住防汛安全底线。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Qinghai Provincial Party Secretary Wu Xiaojun directed flood control work at the provincial emergency command center, emphasizing the need to overcome complacency and implement preventive measures to ensure safety.

articles.title_zh: 青海省发布2026年第3号总林（草）长令
articles.title_en: Qinghai Province Issues 2026 No. 3 General Forest (Grass) Chief Order
articles.summary_zh: 青海省近日发布2026年第3号总林（草）长令，聚焦鸟类保护、野生动物致害防控和普法宣传，压实各级林（草）长责任，依法打击破坏野生动物资源行为。
articles.summary_en: Qinghai recently issued its 3rd General Forest (Grass) Chief Order of 2026, focusing on bird protection, wildlife damage prevention, and legal publicity, to strengthen responsibilities and combat illegal wildlife activities.

articles.title_zh: 四川将实施国有林业单位履职能力提升行动
articles.title_en: Sichuan to Launch Action to Enhance Capability of State-Owned Forestry Units
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，四川省林业和草原局印发通知，实施国有林业单位履职能力提升三年行动，三年内实现岗位培训全覆盖。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 22, the Sichuan Provincial Forestry and Grassland Bureau issued a notice to launch a three-year action to enhance the capability of state-owned forestry units, achieving full job training coverage within three years.

articles.title_zh: 四川省两部门联合印发《办法》 工程招投标报价评审新规9月1日起施行

articles.summary_zh: 四川省住建厅和发改委联合印发房屋建筑和市政工程工程量清单招标投标报价评审办法，自2026年9月1日起施行，适用于国有资金投资项目。
articles.summary_en: Sichuan's housing and development reform departments issue new measures for bidding price evaluation of construction and municipal projects, effective Sept. 1, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 2026年四川省企业工资指导线发布 工资增长基准线为5%
articles.title_en: Sichuan Releases 2026 Enterprise Wage Guideline with 5% Benchmark Growth
articles.summary_zh: 近日，四川省人力资源和社会保障厅发布2026年企业工资指导线，工资增长基准线为5%，上线7.5%，下线2%。
articles.summary_en: Sichuan Provincial Department of Human Resources and Social Security recently released the 2026 enterprise wage guideline, with benchmark growth at 5%, upper limit at 7.5%, and lower limit at 2%.

articles.title_zh: 两部门发布红色山洪灾害气象预警
articles.title_en: Two Ministries Issue Red Alert for Flash Floods
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，水利部和中国气象局联合发布红色山洪灾害气象预警，自然资源部与中国气象局发布橙色地质灾害预警，水利部启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应。
articles.summary_en: On Aug. 22, the Ministry of Water Resources and the China Meteorological Administration issued a red alert for flash floods, while the Ministry of Natural Resources issued an orange geological hazard warning.

articles.title_zh: 搬进安置区，同样归属感满满
articles.title_en: Finding a Sense of Belonging in Resettlement Communities
articles.summary_zh: 云南昭通市加强易地扶贫搬迁安置区基层治理，通过党建引领、网格管理和就业帮扶，让35.47万搬迁群众安居乐业。
articles.summary_en: Zhaotong, Yunnan, strengthens grassroots governance in resettlement areas through party building, grid management, and employment support, helping 354,700 relocated residents settle and thrive.

articles.title_zh: 浙江义乌组建企业服务联盟优化营商环境
articles.title_en: Yiwu, Zhejiang Forms Enterprise Service Alliance to Improve Business Environment
articles.summary_zh: 浙江义乌组建企业服务联盟，创新“清单化、可点单、全闭环”助企服务模式，实现从“企业找服务”向“服务找企业”转变，优化当地营商环境。
articles.summary_en: Yiwu, Zhejiang, has formed an enterprise service alliance and pioneered a new assistance model, shifting from 'enterprises seeking services' to 'services seeking enterprises' to improve the local business environment.

articles.title_zh: 加快现代化产业体系建设
articles.title_en: Accelerating the Building of a Modern Industrial System
articles.summary_zh: 本文综述中国加快现代化产业体系建设进展，强调加强基础研究长期支持，深入实施“人工智能+”行动，推动新质生产力发展。
articles.summary_en: This article reviews China's efforts to accelerate the building of a modern industrial system, emphasizing long-term support for basic research and the 'AI+' action to develop new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 报告显示：我国算力全链条绿色化成效初显
articles.title_en: Report: China's Computing Power Shows Initial Green Progress Across Whole Chain
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，2026绿色算力大会在呼和浩特召开，中国信通院发布《绿色算力发展研究报告（2026年）》，显示我国算力规模快速增长，全链条绿色化成效初显。
articles.summary_en: At the 2026 Green Computing Power Conference held in Hohhot on Aug 22, CAICT released a report showing China's computing power industry has made initial green progress across the whole chain, with intelligent computing scale reaching 2185 EFLOPS.

articles.title_zh: 海关总署：APEC各经济体应加大力度消除贸易壁垒
articles.title_en: Customs Chief: APEC Economies Should Intensify Efforts to Remove Trade Barriers
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，APEC海关手续分委会2026年第二次全体会议在辽宁大连召开，中国海关总署副署长张宝峰呼吁各经济体消除贸易壁垒，提升供应链安全与效率。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, the 2nd APEC Sub-Committee on Customs Procedures meeting in 2026 opened in Dalian, Liaoning. Zhang Baofeng, Vice Minister of China's General Administration of Customs, urged APEC economies to remove trade barriers and enhance supply chain security and efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 第48届世界技能大赛中国代表团成立
articles.title_en: China's Delegation for 48th WorldSkills Competition Established
articles.summary_zh: 经人力资源社会保障部批准，第48届世界技能大赛中国代表团近日成立，共220人，含71名选手，将参加全部64个项目。大赛将于9月22日至27日在上海举办。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security has approved the formation of a 220-member Chinese delegation for the 48th WorldSkills Competition, including 71 contestants competing in all 64 events. The competition will be held in Shanghai from September 22 to 27.

articles.title_zh: 提上限、扩范围 多家银行更新个人消费贷贴息细则
articles.title_en: Multiple Banks Update Consumer Loan Subsidy Rules with Higher Caps and Wider Scope
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，财政部、中国人民银行、金融监管总局发布通知后，多家银行更新个人消费贷贴息细则，贴息上限提高至5000元，信用卡分期贴息范围扩大。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 21, after three ministries issued a notice, major banks updated consumer loan subsidy rules, raising annual caps to 5,000 yuan and expanding credit card installment subsidies.

articles.title_zh: 学习手记丨“走技能成才、技能报国之路”
articles.title_en: Learning Notes: The Road to Skill Development and Serving the Country

articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping has emphasized promoting the spirit of craftsmanship and encouraging young people to pursue skill development to serve the country. The 48th WorldSkills Competition will soon be held in Shanghai.

articles.title_en: Colorful Cultural Tourism Lights Up Summer Life

articles.summary_en: This article reports on the booming cultural tourism market in China during the summer of 2026, with various regions launching featured activities to boost consumption and showcasing the trend of cultural-tourism integration.

articles.title_zh: 殷玉珍和“赛考斯” 跨越20多年的“绿色之约”

articles.summary_en: On Aug 23, national labor model Yin Yuzhen reunited with American teacher Ronald Sakolsky in Ordos, who donated $5,000 in 1999 to support her desertification efforts.

articles.title_zh: 陇台携手共链“岐黄”
articles.title_en: Gansu and Taiwan Join Hands in TCM Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，“同源岐黄·陇台共链”台湾中医药界人士来甘考察交流活动在甘肃举行，由全国台联与甘肃省台联共同举办，开展为期七天的考察交流，推动两岸中医药合作。
articles.summary_en: Taiwanese TCM professionals began a week-long exchange in Gansu on Aug 22, co-hosted by the All-China Federation of Taiwan Compatriots and its Gansu branch, to enhance cross-strait TCM cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 今年1—7月高技术产业吸引外资同比增长32.7%
articles.title_en: High-Tech Industries Attract 32.7% More Foreign Investment in Jan-Jul
articles.summary_zh: 商务部数据显示，1—7月全国实际使用外资4383.3亿元，高技术产业实际使用外资1823.1亿元，同比增长32.7%，占全国比重41.6%。
articles.summary_en: According to the Ministry of Commerce, actual foreign investment in China reached 438.33 billion yuan in Jan-Jul, with high-tech industries attracting 182.31 billion yuan, up 32.7% year on year, accounting for 41.6% of the total.

articles.title_zh: 中国经济的韧性与活力
articles.title_en: The Resilience and Vitality of China's Economy
articles.summary_zh: 文章分析今年以来中国经济运行情况，指出上半年GDP增长4.7%，科技创新转化为产业竞争力，产业供应链枢纽地位增强，风险隐患有序化解，展现强大韧性与活力。
articles.summary_en: The article analyzes China's economic performance this year, noting GDP grew 4.7% in H1, with technological innovation boosting industrial competitiveness, stronger supply chain hubs, and orderly risk resolution, demonstrating resilience and vitality.

articles.title_zh: 我国实现多领域高端钢材自主量产
articles.title_en: China Achieves Independent Mass Production of High-End Steel in Multiple Fields
articles.summary_zh: 我国钢铁企业依托全国重点实验室突破核心技术，实现高端特种钢材自主量产，覆盖深海装备、舰船制造、航空航天等领域。
articles.summary_en: Chinese steel enterprises, relying on national key laboratories, have broken through core technologies and achieved independent mass production of high-end special steels, covering deep-sea equipment, shipbuilding, aerospace and other fields.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党第二十届中央纪律检查委员会第六次全体会议公报
articles.title_en: Communiqué of the Sixth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Commission for Discipline Inspection

articles.summary_en: On August 22, 2026, the Sixth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Commission for Discipline Inspection was held in Beijing. Li Xi spoke, and Zhao Shiyong and Zhang Zhong were elected as deputy secretaries.

articles.title_zh: 定西专场新闻发布会举行 李生潜作主题发布
articles.title_en: Dingxi Holds Press Conference on 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日上午，定西市在兰州举行“十五五”发展主题新闻发布会，市委副书记、代市长李生潜介绍“十五五”时期定西经济社会发展思路与举措。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Dingxi held a press conference in Lanzhou on its 15th Five-Year Plan, where Acting Mayor Li Shengqian outlined economic and social development strategies.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党第二十届中央纪律检查委员会第六次全体会议公报
articles.title_en: Communique of the Sixth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Commission for Discipline Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月22日，中国共产党第二十届中央纪律检查委员会第六次全体会议在北京举行，中央纪委委员116人出席，李希讲话，全会选举赵世勇为中央纪委副书记，张忠为中央纪委常委、副书记。
articles.summary_en: The Sixth Plenary Session of the 20th CCDI was held in Beijing on August 22, 2026, with 116 members attending. Li Xi spoke; Zhao Shiyong was elected deputy secretary, and Zhang Zhong was elected standing committee member and deputy secretary.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁吴贤德“四不两直”检查食品安全工作
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning and Wu Xiande Conduct Unannounced Inspection of Food Safety Work

articles.summary_en: On Aug 21, Guo Ningning (provincial deputy secretary and Fuzhou party chief) and Mayor Wu Xiande made an unannounced food safety inspection in Fuzhou, calling for whole-chain supervision to safeguard public health.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁吴贤德“四不两直”检查食品安全工作

articles.summary_en: On August 21, Guo Ningning and Wu Xiande conducted unannounced inspections of food safety in Fuzhou, stressing whole-chain supervision to safeguard public health.

articles.title_zh: 新疆生产建设兵团第七师胡杨河市代表团来淮考察交流

articles.summary_en: From Aug 18-20, a delegation from Huyanghe City, 7th Division of XPCC, visited Huai'an and held talks on deepening counterpart support and building a vocational education community.

articles.title_zh: 市六届人大常委会举行第三十二次会议 任命高靖生为副市长 决定其为代理市长
articles.title_en: Huaihua Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 32nd Session, Appoints Gao Jingsheng as Acting Mayor

articles.summary_en: On August 20-21, the 32nd session of the Huaihua Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee decided to appoint Gao Jingsheng as Vice Mayor and Acting Mayor.

articles.title_zh: 于海田调研创新创业工作时强调 持续优化创新创业生态 为加快强省会建设提供强劲动能
articles.title_en: Yu Haitian Inspects Innovation and Entrepreneurship Work, Emphasizing Optimization of Ecosystem to Boost Provincial Capital Development

articles.summary_en: On August 21, Yu Haitian, Deputy Secretary of the Jinan Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, inspected innovation and entrepreneurship work, emphasizing optimizing the ecosystem to provide strong momentum for building a strong provincial capital.

articles.summary_en: On August 21, the Propaganda Department of the CPC Shanwei Municipal Committee held a meeting on Xi Jinping's Party building thought. Zhou Yi, member of the Standing Committee and head of the Propaganda Department, presided and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开常务会议
articles.title_en: Taizhou Municipal Government Holds Executive Meeting

articles.summary_en: On August 21, Mayor Li Hui of Taizhou chaired a municipal executive meeting to review policies on affordable housing, urban renewal, industrial land efficiency, and internet gold accumulation business.

articles.title_zh: 泰州市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Taizhou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，泰州市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署高铁建设、社会工作等重点工作，市委书记姜冬冬主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, the Standing Committee of the Taizhou Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study the spirit of President Xi Jinping's important speech, and to arrange key work on high-speed rail construction and social work, chaired by Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong.

articles.title_en: Li Hui Chairs Meeting of Taizhou Municipal Government Party Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，泰州市政府党组书记、市长李晖主持召开市政府党组会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话和重要文章精神，并部署防灾减灾等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Li Hui, Party Group Secretary and Mayor of Taizhou Municipal Government, chaired a Party Group meeting to study Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and articles, and to arrange disaster prevention and reduction work.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬专题调研政法工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Inspects Political and Legal Work in Jingjiang

articles.summary_en: On August 21, Jiang Dongdong, Secretary of Taizhou Municipal CPC Committee, conducted a special survey of political and legal work in Jingjiang, emphasizing the Fengqiao Experience and improving grassroots governance.

articles.title_zh: 我市召开群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作推进会

articles.summary_en: From August 20 to 21, the third global dialogue on AI and human development was held in Xi'an, Shaanxi, with UN Deputy Secretary-General Amina Mohammed and Governor Zhao Gang addressing the event.

articles.title_zh: 叶牛平会见奥地利维也纳州联邦商会副主席安德烈·施托尔茨莱希纳

articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，西安市市长叶牛平会见奥地利维也纳州联邦商会副主席安德烈·施托尔茨莱希纳一行，双方就深化友好交流与经贸合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Xi'an Mayor Ye Niuping met with Andreas Stolzlechner, Vice Chairman of the Vienna State Federal Chamber of Commerce, and his delegation to discuss deepening friendly exchanges and cooperation in trade, technology, and culture.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平吴炜会见长三角国创中心主任刘庆
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping and Wu Wei Meet Director of Yangtze Delta National Innovation Center
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日下午，市委书记严汉平、代市长吴炜在盐会见长三角国家技术创新中心主任刘庆，双方就科技创新、产业协同等合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 21, Municipal Party Secretary Yan Hanping and Acting Mayor Wu Wei met with Liu Qing, Director of the Yangtze Delta National Innovation Center, in Yancheng to discuss cooperation in technological innovation and industrial synergy.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平吴炜会见建行江苏省分行行长邹致师
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping and Wu Wei Meet with CCB Jiangsu Branch President Zou Zhishi
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日下午，盐城市委书记严汉平、代市长吴炜会见建行江苏省分行行长邹致师一行，双方就重大项目、科技创新、民营企业等开展务实合作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 21, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping and Acting Mayor Wu Wei met with President Zou Zhishi of CCB Jiangsu Branch to discuss practical cooperation on major projects, technological innovation, and private enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 风电国创中心技术委员会会议在盐召开

articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，风力发电国家技术创新中心第一届技术委员会第二次会议在盐城召开。市委书记严汉平致辞，院士陈学庚、侯保荣出席。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, the second meeting of the first technical committee of the National Innovation Center for Wind Power was held in Yancheng. Secretary Yan Hanping delivered a speech, attended by academicians Chen Xuegeng and Hou Baorong.

articles.title_zh: 姚华明到盖州市调研群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作
articles.title_en: Yao Huaming Visits Gaizhou to Review Campaign Against Corruption and Misconduct Around the People

articles.summary_en: On Aug 21, Yingkou Party chief Yao Huaming visited Gaizhou to inspect the campaign against corruption and misconduct around the people, stressing resolute action against grassroots corruption.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议 听取新一代通信网建设情况汇报等
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting on New-Generation Communication Network Construction
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，国务院总理李强主持召开国务院常务会议，听取新一代通信网建设情况汇报，部署清理拖欠企业账款、改善空气质量等工作，并审议通过两项条例草案。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting to hear reports on new-generation communication network construction, deploy efforts to clear overdue payments to enterprises and improve air quality, and approve two draft regulations.

articles.title_zh: 余钢到赤坎区调研督导
articles.title_en: Yu Gang Conducts Research and Supervision in Chikan District
