articles.summary_en: On August 21, Yu Gang, Secretary of the Zhanjiang Municipal Party Committee, visited Chikan District to supervise the rectification of misconduct and corruption around the people and the prevention of mosquito-borne diseases.

articles.title_zh: 林武在济南调研时强调 以扎实举措推进绿色低碳转型 推动高质量发展不断取得新成效
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Emphasizes Solid Measures for Green Low-Carbon Transition During Jinan Research Visit
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，山东省委书记林武在济南调研，强调推进绿色低碳转型和高质量发展，考察新能源重卡企业和示范站，并走访文明村。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Shandong Provincial Party Secretary Lin Wu inspected Jinan, stressing green low-carbon transition and high-quality development, visiting new energy truck firms and a demonstration station, plus a model village.

articles.title_zh: 属相和董事长不合就要被裁？民生人寿回应
articles.title_en: Minsheng Life Responds to Rumors of Layoffs Based on Zodiac Signs
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，民生人寿回应网传裁员消息，称已对造谣内容证据保全，将追究法律责任。此前有爆料称董事长将所有与自身生肖不合的员工裁掉。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Minsheng Life responded to online layoff rumors, saying it had preserved evidence of the false content and would pursue legal liability. Earlier reports alleged the chairman laid off employees whose zodiac signs clashed with his own.

articles.title_zh: 无惧风浪 中国经济高质量发展行稳致远
articles.title_en: Fearless of Wind and Waves, China's Economy Advances Steadily in High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 报道习近平总书记强调统筹发展和安全，中国经济上半年同比增长4.7%，展现强大韧性，并列举能源、粮食、科技创新等领域的应对举措与成就。
articles.summary_en: The report highlights Xi Jinping's emphasis on coordinating development and security. China's H1 GDP grew 4.7% year-on-year, showing resilience, with achievements in energy, food security, and technological innovation.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行丨新渔光曲 闽东大黄鱼游出大产业
articles.title_en: New Fishery Ode: Large Yellow Croaker Industry Thrives in East China's Fujian
articles.summary_zh: 福建宁德发展深水抗风浪网箱，科技赋能大黄鱼养殖，并延伸加工、文旅等产业链，带动30多万人就业。
articles.summary_en: Ningde, Fujian develops deep-water anti-wave cages, boosts large yellow croaker farming with technology, and extends the industry chain to processing and cultural tourism, employing over 300,000 people.

articles.title_zh: “兰州拉面”改换“青海拉面”后，国家统计局青海调查总队算经济账
articles.title_en: Qinghai Survey Team Calculates Economic Impact of Rebranding 'Lanzhou Lamian' as 'Qinghai Lamian'
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局青海调查总队发布分析显示，青海拉面产业规模庞大，带动牦牛藏羊等高原畜产品发展，成为畜牧市场“稳定器”，助力农牧民增收。
articles.summary_en: The Qinghai Survey Team of the National Bureau of Statistics published an analysis showing the Qinghai lamian industry's large scale, driving highland livestock products like yak and Tibetan sheep and acting as a stabilizer for the livestock market, boosting farmers' incomes.

articles.title_zh: 经自查整顿，中华儿童文化艺术促进会撤销43个二级单位
articles.title_en: China Children's Culture and Arts Promotion Association Revokes 43 Subsidiary Units After Self-Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 中华儿童文化艺术促进会根据中央社会工作部、文化和旅游部、民政部有关精神，经第七届理事会会议决定，分两批撤销43个二级单位。
articles.summary_en: The China Children's Culture and Arts Promotion Association, following the guidance of the Central Social Work Department, Ministry of Culture and Tourism, and Ministry of Civil Affairs, resolved to revoke 43 subsidiary units in two batches.

articles.title_zh: 纠错有奖：湖北孝感市博物馆邀请观众给展陈内容“找茬”
articles.title_en: Xiaogan Museum Invites Visitors to 'Find Faults' in Exhibits with Rewards
articles.summary_zh: 湖北孝感市博物馆推出纠错有奖活动，邀请观众反馈展陈问题。此前国家文物局发文要求加强博物馆陈列展览内容审核，多地博物馆已开展自查。
articles.summary_en: Xiaogan Museum in Hubei launches a reward campaign inviting visitors to report exhibit errors, following a National Cultural Heritage Administration notice on strengthening content review. Museums nationwide have begun self-inspections.

articles.title_zh: 多地博物馆启动陈列展览内容自查校对：展板内容逐字通读，及时修正
articles.title_en: Multiple Museums Launch Self-Checks on Exhibition Content: Reading Panels Word by Word, Timely Corrections
articles.summary_zh: 近日，为落实国家文物局通知，福建泰宁、新疆塔城等地博物馆启动陈列展览内容自查，逐字核对展板，及时修正问题。
articles.summary_en: Recently, to implement the National Cultural Heritage Administration's notice, museums in Taining, Fujian and Tacheng, Xinjiang initiated self-checks of exhibition content, reading panels word by word and correcting issues promptly.

articles.title_zh: “不得以本会文化顾问对外宣传”，又一商会与假总编张龙切割
articles.title_en: Another Chamber of Commerce Cuts Ties with Fake Editor-in-Chief Zhang Long
articles.summary_zh: 陕西省四川南部商会宣布与假总编张龙切割，禁止其以文化顾问名义对外宣传；此前已有多家商会与张龙撇清关系。
articles.summary_en: The Shaanxi Sichuan Southern Chamber of Commerce announced cutting ties with fake editor-in-chief Zhang Long, prohibiting him from using his cultural adviser title. Several other chambers had already distanced themselves from Zhang.

articles.title_zh: 理顺部门职责边界，辽宁多地组建数据和政务服务局
articles.title_en: Liaoning Sets Up Data and Government Service Bureaus in Multiple Cities
articles.summary_zh: 辽宁省数据局更名后，朝阳、盘锦、锦州等多地组建数据和政务服务局，进一步理顺职责，提升政务服务效能。
articles.summary_en: After Liaoning Provincial Data Bureau was renamed, multiple cities including Chaoyang, Panjin, and Jinzhou established Data and Government Service Bureaus to streamline responsibilities and improve administrative efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 守护自然资源 建设美丽中国（权威发布）
articles.title_en: Safeguard Natural Resources, Build a Beautiful China
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，国务院新闻办举行中外记者见面会，5位自然资源领域代表围绕“守护自然资源，建设美丽中国”交流，分享测绘、防灾、深潜、耕地保护、治沙等经验。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, the State Council Information Office held a press meeting where five representatives from the natural resources sector exchanged views on "Safeguarding Natural Resources, Building a Beautiful China," sharing experiences in surveying, disaster prevention, deep-sea diving, farmland protection, and desertification control.

articles.title_zh: 天津市代表团来甘对接东西部协作工作
articles.title_en: Tianjin Delegation Visits Gansu for East-West Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日至21日，天津市代表团来甘对接东西部协作工作，两省市在兰州举行工作交流座谈会，胡昌升、张工讲话，任振鹤主持。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 20-21, a Tianjin delegation visited Gansu to discuss East-West cooperation. A forum was held in Lanzhou with leaders Hu Changsheng and Zhang Gong speaking, chaired by Ren Zhenhe.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃出台羊皮筏子旅游运营安全管理试行办法
articles.title_en: Gansu Issues Trial Measures for Safety Management of Sheepskin Raft Tourism Operations
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省交通运输厅与文化和旅游厅联合印发管理办法，规范全省羊皮筏子旅游运营，明确载客限额、救生设备等安全要求。
articles.summary_en: Gansu's transport and culture departments jointly issued trial measures to regulate sheepskin raft tourism operations, specifying safety rules, passenger limits, and rescue equipment.

tags.name_en: Gansu Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism

tags_en: Gansu Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism

articles.title_zh: 甘肃将启动新一轮农村公路提升五年行动 让和美乡村“因路而兴”
articles.title_en: Gansu to Launch New Five-Year Rural Road Improvement Plan to Boost Beautiful Villages
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，甘肃省推动“四好农村路”高质量发展现场会在临夏州召开，宣布启动新一轮农村公路提升五年行动，推动农村公路从规模扩张转向内涵式发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Gansu Province held a provincial on-site meeting in Linxia Prefecture to promote high-quality development of rural roads, announcing a new five-year rural road improvement initiative to shift from scale expansion to connotative development.

articles.title_zh: 贵州主动融入全面开放格局
articles.title_en: Guizhou Takes Initiative to Integrate into Comprehensive Opening-up Pattern
articles.summary_zh: 贵州用好西部陆海新通道建设机遇，对接粤港澳大湾区和成渝地区双城经济圈，发展特色开放型产业，上半年陆港吞吐量和特色产品出口增长显著。
articles.summary_en: Guizhou leverages the Western Land-Sea New Corridor, links with the Greater Bay Area and Chengdu-Chongqing economic zone, and develops an open economy, with port throughput and specialty exports growing in H1.

articles.title_zh: 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神 研究部署经济运行、中央巡视反馈问题整改等工作
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Convenes to Convey Xi Jinping's Important Speech and Study Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，省委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，研究部署经济运行、中央巡视反馈问题整改、安全生产等工作，省委书记关志鸥主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 21, the Standing Committee of the Provincial Party Committee held a meeting to convey General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and arrange economic operations, rectification of central inspection feedback, work safety, etc., chaired and addressed by Secretary Guan Zhi'ou.

articles.title_zh: 武汉算力公共服务平台3.0版发布 可调度算力1465P
articles.title_en: Wuhan Computing Power Public Service Platform 3.0 Released with 1465P Schedulable Computing Power
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，武汉算力公共服务平台3.0版上线，汇聚全国45家算力服务机构，可调度算力达1465P，并接入全国一体化算力网。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, the Wuhan Computing Power Public Service Platform 3.0 was launched, aggregating 45 computing service providers nationwide with 1465P schedulable computing power, and connected to the national integrated computing network.

articles.title_zh: 全国“新时代好少年”先进事迹发布 黑龙江1名同学1个集体入选
articles.title_en: National Ceremony for 'Good Teenagers of New Era' Held; Heilongjiang Student and Volleyball Team Honored
articles.summary_zh: 中央文明办等部门在沈阳举办2026年全国“新时代好少年”先进事迹发布仪式，黑龙江学生宋睿诚和铁力市第一中学校女排入选。
articles.summary_en: The Central Civilization Office and other departments held the 2026 national ceremony for 'Good Teenagers of New Era' in Shenyang, with a student and a volleyball team from Heilongjiang honored.

articles.title_zh: 党建调研行｜湖南湘江新区：从“项目一线”到“产业前沿” 看红色动能如何破圈？
articles.title_en: Party Building Research Trip | Hunan Xiangjiang New Area: From 'Project Frontline' to 'Industry Frontier' – How Red Momentum Breaks Boundaries?
articles.summary_zh: 近日，人民网党建调研行深入湖南长沙、岳阳等地，报道湘江新区以党建引领企业发展、技术攻关和产业协同的实践路径。
articles.summary_en: Recently, People's Daily Online's Party building research team visited Changsha, Yueyang, and other places in Hunan, reporting on Xiangjiang New Area's path of using Party leadership to drive enterprise development, technological breakthroughs, and industrial synergy.

articles.title_zh: 江苏五部门联手出台城市更新金融“政策包”
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues Financial Policy Package for Urban Renewal
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省地方金融管理局等五部门近日联合发布金融支持城市更新若干措施，推出十二项具体举措，优化城市更新项目金融服务。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu's five departments jointly issued measures to support urban renewal with 12 specific policies, improving financial services for urban renewal projects.

tags.name_en: Jiangsu Provincial Local Financial Supervision Bureau

articles.title_zh: 南丰县多部门联合开展重点场所安全检查
articles.title_en: Nanfeng County Multi-Department Joint Safety Inspection of Key Places
articles.summary_zh: 近日，江西抚州南丰县多部门对超市、回收公司、加油站等重点场所开展安全大检查，发现安全隐患10处并限期整改。
articles.summary_en: Recently, multiple departments in Nanfeng County, Fuzhou, Jiangxi, conducted safety inspections at key places such as supermarkets, recycling companies, and gas stations, found 10 hidden dangers and ordered rectification within a time limit.

articles.title_zh: 总投资42亿元高性能芳纶纤维项目在定南县开工
articles.title_en: High-Performance Aramid Fiber Project with 4.2 Billion Yuan Investment Breaks Ground in Dingnan County
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，总投资42亿元的博林高性能间位芳纶纤维项目在江西赣州定南县开工，建成后将形成年产9000吨产能，旨在实现高端芳纶材料国产替代。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, the 4.2-billion-yuan Bolin high-performance meta-aramid fiber project broke ground in Dingnan County, Ganzhou, Jiangxi, aiming at domestic substitution of high-end aramid materials with an annual capacity of 9,000 tons.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中包钢会见华为公司副董事长、轮值董事长徐直军
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong and Bao Gang Meet with Xu Zhijun, Huawei Rotating Chairman
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中、政府主席包钢在呼和浩特会见华为公司轮值董事长徐直军，双方就绿色算力、人工智能等领域合作交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Wang Weizhong, Secretary of the Inner Mongolia Regional Party Committee, and Bao Gang, Chairman of the Regional Government, met with Xu Zhijun, Rotating Chairman of Huawei in Hohhot, to discuss cooperation in green computing power and AI.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委召开常委会会议暨理论学习中心组学习会
articles.title_en: Autonomous Regional Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting and Theoretical Study Group Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，自治区党委召开常委会会议暨理论学习中心组学习会，传达学习习近平总书记在纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会上的重要讲话等，研究部署相关工作。自治区党委书记王伟中主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, the Party Committee of the Autonomous Region held a standing committee meeting and a theoretical study group session, conveying and studying General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the centenary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, and researching related work. Wang Weizhong, Secretary of the Regional Party Committee, presided over the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 青海出台“三书一函”制度实施办法
articles.title_en: Qinghai Issues Implementation Measures for 'Three Documents and One Letter' System
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，青海省市场监督管理局印发“三书一函”制度实施办法，以提醒敦促函、整改通知书、约谈通知书、挂牌督办通知书为抓手，统筹柔性监管与刚性执法。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Qinghai Provincial Market Supervision Administration issued the implementation measures for the 'Three Documents and One Letter' system, using reminder letters, rectification notices, interview notices, and supervision notices to integrate flexible supervision with rigid law enforcement.

tags.name_zh: 青海省市场监督管理局

tags_zh: 青海省市场监督管理局

articles.title_zh: 林武在济南调研
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Conducts Research in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，山东省委书记林武在济南调研，察看中国重汽新能源重卡、充电示范站及王老村，强调推进绿色低碳转型和乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Lin Wu, Secretary of the Shandong Provincial Party Committee, visited Jinan to inspect Sinotruk's new energy trucks, charging stations, and Wanglao Village, emphasizing green low-carbon transition and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 下半年财政政策重点是什么？发布会要点梳理来了
articles.title_en: Key Fiscal Policy Priorities for H2 Unveiled at Press Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，国新办举行新闻发布会，财政部有关负责人介绍积极财政政策作用，并回应下半年财政政策重点。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 21, the State Council Information Office held a press conference, where officials from the Ministry of Finance elaborated on proactive fiscal policies and outlined key priorities for H2.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁省党政代表团来疆考察对接对口支援与合作发展工作
articles.title_en: Liaoning Provincial Party and Government Delegation Visits Xinjiang for Counterpart Support and Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日至21日，辽宁省党政代表团赴新疆考察，并于21日在乌鲁木齐与新疆及兵团召开对口支援工作座谈会，深化合作发展。
articles.summary_en: From August 19 to 21, a Liaoning provincial party and government delegation visited Xinjiang. On August 21, a counterpart support symposium was held in Urumqi to deepen cooperation and development.

articles.title_zh: 党代表李康荣：打造深港消费新闭环
articles.title_en: Party Delegate Li Kangrong: Building a New Shenzhen-Hong Kong Consumption Loop
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，深圳市罗湖区第九次党代会开幕，党代表李康荣提出打造“引进来”“留下来”“买起来”“再回来”的深港消费新闭环。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, the 9th Party Congress of Luohu District, Shenzhen opened; delegate Li Kangrong proposed a new Shenzhen-Hong Kong consumption loop to attract, retain, purchase, and return.

articles.title_zh: 张西明在阜阳市颍上县调研
articles.title_en: Zhang Ximing Conducts Research in Yingshan County, Fuyang City
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，安徽省政协主席张西明在阜阳市颍上县调研，视察委员工作室和光伏电站，强调助力皖北全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Zhang Ximing, chairman of Anhui Provincial CPPCC, conducted research in Yingshan County, Fuyang City, visiting a CPPCC member studio and a photovoltaic power station, emphasizing support for comprehensive revitalization of northern Anhui.

articles.title_zh: 梁言顺在合肥市调研
articles.title_en: Liang Yanshun Inspects Flood Control Works in Hefei
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，安徽省委书记梁言顺在合肥调研老旧水库改造和城市防洪工程，强调要全面提升防灾减灾救灾能力。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Liang Yanshun, Secretary of Anhui Provincial Party Committee, inspected old reservoir renovation and urban flood control projects in Hefei, emphasizing comprehensive enhancement of disaster prevention and mitigation capabilities.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军主持全市统一战线暑期谈心活动暨2026年调研协商座谈会
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun Chairs United Front Summer Talk and 2026 Consultation Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日下午，重庆市委举行全市统一战线暑期谈心活动暨2026年调研协商座谈会，市委书记袁家军主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 21, the Chongqing Municipal Party Committee held a United Front summer talk and 2026 consultation meeting, chaired by Secretary Yuan Jiajun.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军会见四川大学党委书记甘霖、校长汪劲松一行
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun Meets Sichuan University Party Secretary Gan Lin and President Wang Jinsong
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日上午，重庆市委书记袁家军会见四川大学党委书记甘霖、校长汪劲松一行，双方就深化校地合作、服务成渝地区双城经济圈建设进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 21, Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun met with Sichuan University Party Secretary Gan Lin and President Wang Jinsong to deepen university-local cooperation and support the Chengdu-Chongqing economic circle.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议 刘宁主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Committee Holds Meeting Chaired by Liu Ning
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，河南省委书记刘宁主持召开省委常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话和文章，研究全省经济工作、防灾减灾等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Liu Ning, secretary of the Henan Provincial Party Committee, chaired a meeting of the Standing Committee, studying Xi Jinping's important speeches and articles and discussing economic work and disaster prevention.

articles.title_zh: 信长星刘小涛会见中国长安汽车集团董事长朱华荣
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing and Liu Xiaotao Meet Chairman of Changan Automobile Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，江苏省委书记信长星、省长刘小涛在南京会见中国长安汽车集团董事长朱华荣，双方表示将加强产业链合作，推动汽车产业升级。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 20, Jiangsu Party Secretary Xin Changxing and Governor Liu Xiaotao met with Changan Auto Chairman Zhu Huarong in Nanjing to discuss enhancing industrial chain cooperation and promoting auto industry upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 广东全面建设海洋强省
articles.title_en: Guangdong Advances Comprehensive Marine Province Building
articles.summary_zh: 广东省2025年海洋生产总值达2.04万亿元，连续31年居全国首位。文章综述广东在陆海统筹、科技创新、开放合作、生态保护等方面全面建设海洋强省的举措与成效。
articles.summary_en: Guangdong's marine economy hit 2.04 trillion yuan in 2025, ranking top in China for 31 years. The article reviews its comprehensive maritime province building via land-sea coordination, innovation, opening-up, and eco-protection.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 习近平强党兴党的故事：发挥好支部的战斗堡垒作用
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Story on Strengthening the Party: Give Full Play to the Role of Party Branches
articles.summary_zh: 2006年8月，超强台风“桑美”袭击浙江苍南，时任浙江省委书记习近平深入灾区慰问，强调“一个党员一面旗，发挥好支部的战斗堡垒作用”。
articles.summary_en: In August 2006, when Super Typhoon Saomai hit Cangnan, Zhejiang, Xi Jinping, then Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee, visited the disaster area and stressed that every Party member should be a banner and the Party branch should play a strong role.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 尹力为市委法律顾问颁发聘书并座谈
articles.title_en: Yin Li Presents Appointments to Municipal Party Committee Legal Advisers and Holds Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日上午，第四届市委法律顾问聘任仪式举行，北京市委书记尹力颁发聘书并座谈，勉励大家当好“法治智囊团”，为首都发展贡献智慧和力量。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 20, the fourth appointment ceremony for municipal party committee legal advisers was held. Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li presented certificates and held a symposium, encouraging advisers to serve as a 'rule-of-law think tank' for the capital's development.

articles.title_zh: 财政部：下半年财政政策将从三方面发力，或有增量政策在路上
articles.title_en: Finance Ministry: Fiscal Policy to Focus on Three Areas in H2, Possible Incremental Policies
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，国新办发布会上，财政部副部长廖岷介绍下半年财政政策将从加快资金使用、加力扩大内需、加强财政改革管理三方面发力，并透露或将出台增量政策。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 21, at a State Council Information Office press conference, Vice Finance Minister Liao Min said fiscal policy will focus on three areas: accelerating fund use, boosting domestic demand, and strengthening fiscal reform, with possible incremental policies ahead.

articles.title_zh: 中国与瑞士宣布完成自贸协定升级谈判
articles.title_en: China and Switzerland Announce Completion of Upgraded Free Trade Agreement Talks
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，商务部部长王文涛在伯尔尼会见瑞士联邦主席帕姆兰，共同宣布完成中瑞自贸协定升级谈判并签署谅解备忘录。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Commerce Minister Wang Wentao met with Swiss President Parmelin in Bern, jointly announcing the conclusion of upgraded FTA negotiations and signing an MoU.

articles.title_zh: 财政部：超2500万名婴幼儿及其家庭领到2026年度育儿补贴
articles.title_en: Ministry of Finance: Over 25 Million Infants and Families Receive 2026 Childcare Subsidy
articles.summary_zh: 财政部在国新办发布会上介绍，2026年超2500万名婴幼儿及其家庭领取育儿补贴，并加大教育、社保、卫生等民生投入。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference, the Ministry of Finance said over 25 million infants and families received the 2026 childcare subsidy, with increased spending on education, social security, and health.

articles.title_zh: 财政部：“十五五”时期我国将建设更为强大稳固的财政
articles.title_en: Ministry of Finance: China to Build Stronger and More Stable Public Finance During 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 国新办发布会上，财政部副部长廖岷介绍，过去五年全国一般公共预算收入106万亿元、支出135万亿元，“十五五”时期将构建更强大稳固的财政。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference, Vice Finance Minister Liao Min said fiscal revenue and expenditure grew over the past five years, and China will build a stronger and more stable public finance during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 湖北省武汉市委常委、市委秘书长曾晟接受审查调查
articles.title_en: Zeng Sheng, Member of Standing Committee of CPC Wuhan Municipal Committee and Secretary-General, Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 据湖北省纪委监委消息，武汉市委常委、市委秘书长曾晟涉嫌严重违纪违法，接受纪律审查和监察调查。

articles.title_zh: 社会消费商品和服务零售总额前7月同比增2.6%
articles.title_en: Retail Sales of Consumer Goods and Services Up 2.6% in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 商务部介绍，1—7月社会消费商品和服务零售总额同比增长2.6%，社会消费品零售总额28.77万亿元，增长1.2%。服务零售额增长5.0%，暑期消费潜力释放。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce reported retail sales of consumer goods and services rose 2.6% year-on-year in the first seven months. Total retail sales of consumer goods reached 28.77 trillion yuan, up 1.2%; service retail sales grew 5.0%.

articles.title_zh: 我国与APEC其他经济体进出口前7月同比增21%
articles.title_en: China's Imports and Exports with Other APEC Economies Up 21% in First 7 Months
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日召开的2026年APEC海关与商界对话会披露，1—7月我国与APEC其他经济体进出口总额达18.03万亿元，同比增长21%，增速高于货物贸易整体水平。
articles.summary_en: At the 2026 APEC Customs and Business Dialogue on Aug 20, it was reported that China's trade with other APEC economies reached 18.03 trillion yuan in Jan-Jul, up 21% year-on-year, outpacing overall growth.

articles.summary_en: On August 20, State Councilor Shen Yiqin visited Beijing to inspect the football youth training system, emphasizing the need to accelerate its construction and improve the cultivation of reserve talents for competitive sports.

articles.title_zh: 促内需 财政金融协同政策“组合拳”迎来优化

articles.summary_en: On Aug 21, China's MOF, PBOC and NFRA issued a notice to optimize fiscal-financial policies to boost domestic demand, expanding subsidy coverage, adding banks and raising loan caps.

articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on Aug 21, the Ministry of Finance said China's proactive fiscal policy includes a budget exceeding 30 trillion yuan, boosting domestic demand, people's wellbeing and new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 中国印尼外长防长“2+2”对话机制举行第二次部长级会议

articles.summary_en: On August 21, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi and Indonesian Foreign Minister Sugiyono co-chaired the first China-Indonesia Comprehensive Strategic Dialogue meeting in Jakarta, reaching broad consensus on building a shared future.

articles.title_zh: 杨政昆在玉溪抚投公司调研国资国企运营情况
articles.title_en: Yang Zhengkun Inspects Yuxi Foutou Company on SOE Operations
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，玉溪市委书记杨政昆到玉溪抚投公司调研国资国企运营情况，强调明确发展目标、突出效益导向，加快建设现代国有企业。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Yuxi Party Secretary Yang Zhengkun visited Yuxi Foutou Company to inspect state-owned enterprise operations, emphasizing clear development goals, efficiency orientation, and building modern SOEs.

articles.title_zh: 全市扫黑除恶专项斗争会议召开
articles.title_en: Municipal Meeting on Special Campaign Against Gang Crime Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，全市扫黑除恶专项斗争会议召开，市领导谢运策出席并讲话，强调深化扫黑除恶专项斗争，增强群众安全感。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, the city-wide meeting on the special campaign against gang crime was held; city leader Xie Yunce attended and spoke, emphasizing deepening the campaign to enhance public security.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江主持召开专题会议听取市第九次党代会课题调研情况汇报
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Chairs Meeting on Ninth Municipal Party Congress Research
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，湖南省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江主持召开专题会议，听取市第九次党代会课题调研情况汇报。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Xie Weijiang, Deputy Secretary of the Hunan Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Yueyang Municipal Party Committee, chaired a special meeting to hear reports on research for the Ninth Municipal Party Congress.

articles.title_zh: 坡头区召开“百千万工程”2026年上半年工作总结分析会
articles.title_en: Potou District Holds Work Review Meeting for H1 2026 of Bai Qian Wan Project
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，坡头区召开“百千万工程”2026年上半年工作总结分析会，区委书记刘剑出席并讲话，强调压实责任、攻坚克难，确保如期实现“五年显著变化”目标。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Potou District held a work review meeting for the first half of 2026 under the Bai Qian Wan Project; District Party Secretary Liu Jian attended and stressed responsibility and overcoming difficulties to achieve the five-year goal.

articles.title_zh: 郭力铭杨雪芹带领调研组到郸城县调研
articles.title_en: Guo Liming and Yang Xueqin Lead Research Team to Dancheng County
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，周口市人大常委会主任郭力铭、副主任杨雪芹带队赴郸城县调研“人大代表在行动”主题活动，走访代表并座谈。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Guo Liming, Director of the Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, and Vice Director Yang Xueqin led a research team to Dancheng County to inspect the "People's Congress Representatives in Action" campaign and met with representatives.

articles.title_zh: 市政协召开党组会议暨十届七十三次主席会议 为人工智能高质量发展贡献政协智慧和力量
articles.title_en: Zhuhai CPPCC Meeting Pushes for High-Quality AI Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，市政协召开党组会议暨十届七十三次主席会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，围绕人工智能调研建言。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 20, Zhuhai Municipal CPPCC held a Party Group and Chairman's meeting to study Xi's speech and advise on AI high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 全省高标准农田建设突出问题整治百日攻坚行动工作部署会议召开
articles.title_en: Provincial Work Deployment Meeting on 100-Day Campaign to Rectify Outstanding Issues in High-Standard Farmland Construction Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，全省高标准农田建设突出问题整治百日攻坚行动工作部署会议召开，省委副书记、省长周乃翔出席并讲话，强调保障国家粮食安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, a provincial work deployment meeting was held to launch a 100-day campaign to rectify outstanding issues in high-standard farmland construction. Zhou Naixiang, Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Governor, attended and delivered a speech, emphasizing national food security.

articles.title_zh: 省委理论学习中心组进行集体学习 高质量打造乡村振兴齐鲁样板 不断开创农业农村现代化新局面
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Committee Theoretical Learning Center Group Conducts Collective Study for Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日下午，山东省委理论学习中心组集体学习，省委书记林武主持，强调高质量打造乡村振兴齐鲁样板。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 20, the Shandong Provincial Party Committee Theoretical Learning Center Group held a collective study session, chaired by Secretary Lin Wu, emphasizing high-quality rural revitalization in Qilu.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日上午，山东省委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究经济运行、大气污染防治等事项，省委书记林武主持。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 20, the Standing Committee of the Shandong Provincial Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech, and to discuss economic performance and air pollution prevention and control. Lin Wu, Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee, presided over the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 林武会见国家能源集团客人
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Meets National Energy Group Guests
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日下午，山东省委书记林武在济南会见国家能源集团董事长邹磊一行，双方就深化能源合作、推动能源转型和绿色低碳高质量发展等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 20, Shandong Provincial Party Secretary Lin Wu met with Zou Lei, Chairman of National Energy Group, in Jinan to deepen energy cooperation and promote green, low-carbon high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: "支联会"煽动颠覆国家政权罪名成立，驻港国家安全公署：支持严惩
articles.title_en: "Alliance" Found Guilty of Subversion, National Security Office Supports Severe Punishment
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，香港特区高等法院裁定"支联会"及李卓人、邹幸彤煽动颠覆国家政权罪名成立，驻港国家安全公署表示支持严惩。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 21, the High Court of HKSAR convicted the Alliance and Li Zhuoren, Zou Xintong of subverting state power. The National Security Office supports severe punishment.

articles.title_zh: 应急机械拉手存在安全隐患，多品牌集中召回超427万辆车
articles.title_en: Multiple Brands Recall Over 4.27 Million Vehicles Over Emergency Handle Safety Hazards
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，国家市场监管总局发布多家车企召回信息，因应急机械拉手等安全隐患，特斯拉、吉利、小米等品牌合计召回超427万辆车。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, China's State Administration for Market Regulation published recalls from multiple automakers over emergency handle safety hazards, involving over 4.27 million vehicles including Tesla, Geely, Xiaomi, etc.

articles.title_zh: 安以轩取丈夫陈荣炼在台4422万存款遭拒，银行称涉洗钱
articles.title_en: An Yixuan Fails to Withdraw 44.22 Million Yuan Deposit of Husband Chen Ronglian; Bank Cites Money Laundering
articles.summary_zh: 台湾艺人安以轩的丈夫陈荣炼因非法赌博、洗钱入狱，其在台北富邦银行的约4422万元存款遭银行以涉洗钱为由拒绝提取，陈荣炼起诉银行败诉，台湾高等法院仍判其败诉。
articles.summary_en: Taiwanese actress An Yixuan's husband Chen Ronglian, imprisoned for illegal gambling and money laundering, had his deposit of about 44.22 million yuan in Taipei Fubon Bank refused by the bank citing money laundering. Chen's lawsuit against the bank failed in both first instance and appeal.

articles.title_zh: 国家能源局：7月城乡居民生活用电量同比下降5.1%
articles.title_en: National Energy Administration: Urban and Rural Residential Electricity Consumption Fell 5.1% Year-on-Year in July
articles.summary_zh: 国家能源局8月21日发布7月全社会用电量数据，7月全社会用电量10400亿千瓦时，同比增长1.7%；城乡居民生活用电量同比下降5.1%。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, the National Energy Administration released July electricity consumption data, showing total consumption of 1,040 TWh, up 1.7% year-on-year, while residential consumption fell 5.1%.

articles.title_zh: 受贿6344万，国家中医药管理局原局长于文明一审获刑十五年
articles.title_en: Former TCM Administration Head Yu Wenming Sentenced to 15 Years for Bribery
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月21日，天津市第一中级人民法院一审公开宣判国家中医药管理局原局长于文明受贿案，判处有期徒刑十五年，并处罚金人民币六百万元。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, 2026, Tianjin First Intermediate People's Court sentenced Yu Wenming, former head of the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, to 15 years in prison and a fine of 6 million yuan for bribery.

tags.name_zh: 天津市第一中级人民法院

tags_zh: 天津市第一中级人民法院

articles.title_zh: 习近平：中厄自贸协定释放红利、彰显潜力
articles.title_en: Xi: China-Ecuador FTA Releases Dividends and Shows Potential
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，国家主席习近平在北京同厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚举行会谈，指出中厄自贸协定释放红利、彰显中国超大规模市场潜力。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, President Xi Jinping held talks with Ecuadorian President Noboa in Beijing, stating that the China-Ecuador FTA has released dividends and demonstrated the potential of China's super-large market.

articles.title_zh: 首单新能源汽车从长乐机场空运出口
articles.title_en: First New Energy Vehicles Exported by Air from Changle Airport
articles.summary_zh: 两辆国产新能源汽车从福州长乐机场空运出口至英国，系该机场首次保障此类业务，标志着机场解锁大容量锂电池特货空运资质。
articles.summary_en: Two domestically made NEVs were airfreighted from Fuzhou Changle Airport to the UK, the airport's first such operation, marking its new capability for large-capacity lithium battery special cargo.

articles.title_zh: 福建发布脑机接口科技产业发展行动计划
articles.title_en: Fujian Releases Action Plan for Brain-Computer Interface Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 福建省科技厅等六部门印发《福建省脑机接口科技产业发展行动计划（2026—2030年）》，提出到2030年产业规模突破30亿元，打造全国特色应用示范基地。
articles.summary_en: Fujian's science and technology department and five other agencies issued an action plan for brain-computer interface industry development (2026-2030), aiming to exceed 3 billion yuan in output by 2030 and build a national demonstration base.

tags.name_en: Fujian Provincial Department of Science and Technology

articles.title_zh: 王兴兴：宇树科技推进物理AI机器人模型自进化
articles.title_en: Wang Xingxing: Unitree Advances Self-Evolution of Physical AI Robot Models
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月21日，宇树科技创始人王兴兴在世界机器人大会主论坛透露，公司将推进物理AI机器人模型自进化，旨在提升机器人开发效率与泛化能力。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, 2026, Unitree founder Wang Xingxing revealed at the World Robot Conference that the company will advance self-evolution of physical AI robot models to improve development efficiency and generalization.

articles.title_zh: 布局未来产业 福建发布脑机接口科技产业发展行动计划
articles.title_en: Fujian Releases Action Plan for Brain-Computer Interface Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 福建省科技厅等六部门印发脑机接口科技产业发展行动计划，构建全链条生态，目标2030年产业规模突破30亿元。
articles.summary_en: Fujian's science and technology department and five other agencies issued an action plan to develop the brain-computer interface industry, aiming for an industrial scale exceeding 3 billion yuan by 2030.

tags.name_en: Fujian Provincial Department of Science and Technology

tags_en: Fujian Provincial Department of Science and Technology

articles.title_zh: 福建多地开展扫码缴费弹窗广告发布行为专项治理 让扫码缴费回归便民本位
articles.title_en: Fujian Launches Special Rectification on Pop-up Ads in Scan-to-Pay Services to Restore Convenience
articles.summary_zh: 近日，福建省多地在停车场、充电桩等扫码缴费场景开展弹窗广告专项治理，强化监管与行业自律，让扫码缴费回归便民本位。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Fujian Province has launched special rectification on pop-up ads in scan-to-pay services at parking lots and charging stations, strengthening supervision and industry self-discipline to restore convenience.

articles.title_zh: 最高法点赞福州市人大代表城市管理行业联络站工作
articles.title_en: Supreme Court Praises Fuzhou People's Congress Urban Management Liaison Station
articles.summary_zh: 最高法点赞福州市人大代表城市管理行业联络站工作。今年初，该联络站协助化解一起行政协议纠纷，助当事人拿到权属证书并撤诉，获评全省法院典型案例。
articles.summary_en: Supreme Court praised Fuzhou People's Congress urban management station. It helped settle an administrative dispute, enabling a citizen to obtain property certificate and withdraw lawsuit. Rated a typical case.

articles.title_zh: 吴泳铭：阿里AI年化收入突破495亿元
articles.title_en: Wu Yongming: Alibaba's AI Annualized Revenue Exceeds 49.5 Billion Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴发布2027财年第一季度财报，CEO吴泳铭称AI成为阿里云增长核心引擎，AI相关产品年化收入突破495亿元，占云外部商业化收入35%。
articles.summary_en: Alibaba released its Q1 FY2027 results; CEO Wu Yongming said AI is the core growth engine for Alibaba Cloud, with AI-related annualized revenue exceeding RMB 49.5 billion, accounting for 35% of external cloud revenue.

articles.title_zh: 世界机器人大会上，济南亮出三张工程机器人硬核底牌
articles.title_en: Jinan Unveils Three Cutting-edge Construction Robots at World Robot Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日下午，山东大学与济南市机器人产业发展办公室在北京2026世界机器人大会上联合主办工程机器人专题活动，展示校地协同创新成果，推动产业发展。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 19, Shandong University and Jinan Robot Industry Development Office co-hosted a special session on construction robots at the 2026 World Robot Conference in Beijing, showcasing collaborative innovations and boosting industrial development.

articles.title_zh: 林武在济南调研
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Conducts Research in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，山东省委书记林武在济南调研，强调以扎实举措推进绿色低碳转型，推动高质量发展，并实地考察新能源重卡、充电示范站和乡村振兴项目。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Lin Wu, Secretary of CPC Shandong Provincial Committee, conducted research in Jinan, stressing green low-carbon transition and high-quality development. He visited new energy heavy truck facilities and rural revitalization projects.

articles.title_zh: 国家统计局：2026年我国早稻生产保持稳定
articles.title_en: China's Early Rice Output Stable in 2026, NBS Says
articles.summary_zh: 2026年全国早稻产量565.8亿斤，连续6年稳定在560亿斤以上，播种面积略有增加，单产有所下降，总体保持稳定。
articles.summary_en: China's early rice output reached 565.8 billion jin in 2026, down 0.8% year-on-year but staying above 560 billion jin for six consecutive years, with planting area slightly increased.

articles.title_zh: 四川发布“十五五”城市更新规划 系统部署7大任务
articles.title_en: Sichuan Releases 15th Five-Year Urban Renewal Plan with Seven Major Tasks
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，四川省政府新闻办举行发布会，解读《四川省城市更新“十五五”规划》，省住建厅厅长邓立军介绍相关情况，规划提出到2030年目标并部署7大任务。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 21, the Sichuan Provincial Government held a press conference to unveil the 15th Five-Year Urban Renewal Plan, outlining goals by 2030 and deploying seven key tasks for urban renewal.

articles.title_zh: 与中国的联系，是贯穿我人生的故事
articles.title_en: My Connection with China Is a Lifelong Story
articles.summary_zh: 哥伦比亚驻华大使卡夫雷拉回顾其60余年与中国的情缘，称赞中国发展成就，表示哥伦比亚已加入共建“一带一路”，希望继续推动两国合作。
articles.summary_en: Colombian Ambassador to China Cabrera reflects on his 60-year bond with China, praises China's development, and expresses hope for continued bilateral cooperation under the Belt and Road.

articles.title_zh: 第二十九届成都国际车展开幕 新能源汽车备受关注
articles.title_en: Chengdu Auto Show Opens, NEVs Draw Wide Attention
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，第二十九届成都国际汽车展览会在中国西部国际博览城开幕，汇集近120个品牌，新能源车型成为焦点。
articles.summary_en: The 29th Chengdu International Auto Show opened on Aug 21 at the Western China International Expo City, featuring nearly 120 brands and spotlighting new energy vehicles.

articles.title_zh: 王晓晖施小琳会见厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚
articles.title_en: Wang Xiaohui and Shi Xiaolin Meet with Ecuadorian President Noboa
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，四川省委书记王晓晖、省长施小琳在成都会见厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚，双方就加强各领域交流合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 21, Wang Xiaohui, Secretary of CPC Sichuan Provincial Committee, and Shi Xiaolin, Governor of Sichuan, met with Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa in Chengdu to discuss enhancing exchanges and cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 四川率先启动省级城市更新创新模式试点
articles.title_en: Sichuan Takes Lead in Launching Provincial Urban Renewal Innovation Pilot
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，四川省政府新闻办举行发布会，宣布在全国率先启动省级城市更新创新模式试点，遴选德阳、彭州、仪陇、射洪4个试点城市，省级财政给予支持。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 21, Sichuan held a press conference on its 15th Five-Year urban renewal plan, launching the province's first pilot program for innovative urban renewal, selecting 4 cities with provincial fiscal support.

articles.title_zh: 中国与瑞士完成自贸协定升级谈判
articles.title_en: China and Switzerland Conclude Upgraded FTA Negotiations
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，商务部部长王文涛在伯尔尼会见瑞士联邦主席帕姆兰，共同宣布完成中瑞自贸协定升级谈判并签署谅解备忘录。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Commerce Minister Wang Wentao met with Swiss President Parmelin in Bern, jointly announcing the conclusion of upgrade negotiations of the China-Switzerland FTA and signing an MOU.

articles.title_zh: 财政部：财政金融协同促内需政策已经优化完善 8月1日起实施
articles.title_en: Finance Ministry: Fiscal-Financial Policies to Boost Domestic Demand Optimized, Effective from Aug 1
articles.summary_zh: 财政部副部长廖岷表示，财政金融协同促内需政策已优化完善，自8月1日起实施，包括拓宽贴息范围、增加经办机构、提高额度上限等三项新举措。
articles.summary_en: Vice Minister of Finance Liao Min said fiscal-financial policies to boost domestic demand have been optimized and will take effect from Aug 1, featuring expanded subsidy coverage, more handling institutions, and higher caps.

articles.title_zh: 三部门发布关于进一步做好财政金融协同促内需政策有关工作的通知
articles.title_en: Three Departments Issue Notice on Enhancing Fiscal and Financial Coordination to Boost Domestic Demand
articles.summary_zh: 财政部、中国人民银行、金融监管总局联合发布通知，扩大贴息范围，提高贷款贴息额度，以激发民间投资、促进居民消费。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance, the People's Bank of China, and the National Financial Regulatory Administration jointly issued a notice to expand subsidy scope and raise loan interest subsidy limits to boost private investment and consumer spending.

articles.title_zh: 财政部：财政金融协同促内需一揽子政策已惠及企业622万家
articles.title_en: Ministry of Finance: Package of Fiscal and Financial Policies to Boost Domestic Demand Has Benefited 6.22 Million Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 财政部副部长廖岷在国新办发布会上介绍，财政金融协同促内需一揽子政策实施6个多月，已惠及居民1.13亿人次、企业622万家。
articles.summary_en: Vice Minister Liao Min of the Ministry of Finance said at a State Council Information Office press conference that the package of fiscal and financial policies to boost domestic demand has benefited 113 million residents and 6.22 million enterprises in over six months.

articles.title_zh: 下半年财政部将及时谋划出台务实管用的增量政策
articles.title_en: Ministry of Finance to Roll Out Practical Incremental Policies in H2
articles.summary_zh: 财政部副部长廖岷8月21日在国新办发布会上表示，下半年将重点加快资金使用、加力扩大内需，并及时谋划出台务实管用的增量政策。
articles.summary_en: Vice Finance Minister Liao Min said at a State Council Information Office press conference on Aug 21 that the ministry will speed up fund use, boost domestic demand, and introduce practical incremental policies in the second half.

articles.title_zh: 住苏全国政协委员在宿迁调研座谈
articles.title_en: National CPPCC Members in Jiangsu Conduct Research in Suqian
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日至20日，省政协组织住苏全国政协委员赴宿迁调研，围绕促进城乡居民增收、推进共同富裕开展座谈，为省政协专题议政性常委会会议作准备。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 19 to 20, the Jiangsu Provincial CPPCC organized National CPPCC members in Jiangsu to conduct research in Suqian on increasing urban and rural residents' income and promoting common prosperity.

articles.title_zh: 徐州市委书记会见“外卖诗人”王计兵：做徐州新大众文艺繁荣发展的带动者
articles.title_en: Xuzhou Party Secretary Meets 'Courier Poet' Wang Jibing, Encouraging Cultural Vitality
articles.summary_zh: 徐州市委书记宋乐伟会见“外卖诗人”王计兵，祝贺其获鲁迅文学奖，勉励其创作更多优秀作品，做徐州新大众文艺繁荣发展的带动者。
articles.summary_en: Xuzhou Party Secretary Song Lewei met with 'courier poet' Wang Jibing, congratulating him on winning the Lu Xun Literature Prize and encouraging him to promote the flourishing of new mass literature in Xuzhou.

articles.title_zh: 祖国不会忘记！送别“两弹一星”元勋王希季院士
articles.title_en: Farewell to Wang Xiji, Hero of China's 'Two Bombs and One Satellite' Program
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日上午，社会各界在北京八宝山殡仪馆送别“两弹一星”元勋、中国科学院院士王希季，享年105岁。他毕生奉献于中国航天事业。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 20, people bid farewell to Wang Xiji, CAS academician and 'Two Bombs, One Satellite' hero, in Beijing. He dedicated his life to China's space endeavor.

articles.title_zh: 《促进网信企业高质量发展行动计划（2026-2030年）》印发
articles.title_en: Plan for Promoting High-Quality Development of Cyberspace Enterprises (2026-2030) Issued
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中央网络安全和信息化委员会印发《促进网信企业高质量发展行动计划（2026-2030年）》，提出7项行动21条举措，促进网信企业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission issued the Action Plan for Promoting High-Quality Development of Cyberspace Enterprises (2026-2030), outlining 7 actions and 21 measures.

tags.name_zh: 中央网络安全和信息化委员会

tags_zh: 中央网络安全和信息化委员会

articles.title_zh: 福建安溪：一片“金叶子”玩出新花样
articles.title_en: Fujian Anxi: A 'Golden Leaf' Brings New Tricks to Industry
articles.summary_zh: 中宣部组织的“活力中国调研行”福建采访团近日走进安溪，探访茶产业“现代农业+文旅”发展模式，当地茶产业综合产值达460.5亿元。
articles.summary_en: The 'Vibrant China Research Tour' organized by the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee recently visited Anxi, Fujian, to explore the tea industry's 'modern agriculture + cultural tourism' model, with a combined output value of 46.05 billion yuan.

tags.name_en: Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee

tags_en: Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 福建洛江：千年古桥“潮”起来
articles.title_en: Ancient Bridge in Fujian's Luojiang Goes Trendy
articles.summary_zh: 中宣部组织的“活力中国调研行”走进泉州洛江，探访洛阳桥保护与文旅开发。千年古桥经活化利用，带动古街消费，成为文旅融合新引擎。
articles.summary_en: A research tour organized by the CPC Central Committee's Publicity Department visited Luojiang, Quanzhou, to explore the preservation and cultural-tourism development of the ancient Luoyang Bridge. The revitalized bridge has boosted local consumption and cultural tourism.

articles.title_zh: 福建省委理论学习中心组学习会召开
articles.title_en: Fujian Provincial Party Committee Holds Theoretical Learning Center Group Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，福建省委理论学习中心组学习会在福州召开，省委书记周祖翼主持并讲话，强调深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于社会工作和基层工作方法的重要论述。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, the Fujian Provincial Party Committee held its theoretical learning center group meeting in Fuzhou, chaired by Secretary Zhou Zuyi, emphasizing in-depth study of Xi Jinping's important expositions on social work and grassroots work methods.

articles.title_zh: 福建省委常委会召开会议 周祖翼主持并研究贯彻落实措施
articles.title_en: Fujian Provincial Party Committee Holds Meeting Chaired by Zhou Zuyi to Study Implementation
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，福建省委书记周祖翼主持召开省委常委会会议，学习习近平总书记在纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会上的重要讲话精神，研究贯彻落实措施。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Zhou Zuyi, Secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to study and implement the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the centenary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃发布“十五五”中医药振兴发展重点任务
articles.title_en: Gansu Releases Key Tasks for TCM Revitalization during 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，甘肃省政府新闻办举行新闻发布会，发布“十五五”中医药振兴发展重点任务，锚定2030年基本建成中医药强省目标，实施“六位一体”建设任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, the Gansu provincial government held a press conference to release key tasks for traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, aiming to basically build Gansu into a strong TCM province by 2030 through a six-in-one strategy.

articles.title_zh: 水利部继续发布洪水黄色预警
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Continues to Issue Yellow Flood Warning
articles.summary_zh: 水利部8月20日发布洪水黄色预警，预计20日至22日多地有强降雨，部分河流可能超警，并向13省份发出靶向预警。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Water Resources issued a yellow flood warning on August 20, predicting heavy rain in many areas from Aug 20 to 22 and possible river flooding, and sent targeted alerts to 13 provinces.

articles.title_zh: 深挖红色资源 做实党性教育
articles.title_en: Deepening Party Spirit Education by Tapping Red Resources
articles.summary_zh: 近日，人民网党建调研行走进贵州，探访贵阳、遵义、毕节等地，报道贵州深挖红色资源，通过修复遗迹、创新演艺、现场教学等方式做实党性教育。
articles.summary_en: Recently, People's Daily Online's Party building research tour visited Guizhou, exploring Guiyang, Zunyi, Bijie and other places, reporting on Guizhou's efforts to strengthen Party spirit education by tapping red resources through site restoration, innovative performances, and on-site teaching.

articles.title_zh: 两部门印发意见推动服务类社会救助发展
articles.title_en: Two Ministries Issue Guidelines to Promote Development of Service-Oriented Social Assistance
articles.summary_zh: 民政部、财政部日前印发《关于积极发展服务类社会救助的指导意见》，推动社会救助由单一物质救助向“物质+服务”综合救助模式转变。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Civil Affairs and the Ministry of Finance issued guidelines to promote service-oriented social assistance, shifting from material-only aid to a comprehensive model combining material and services.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁到鹤壁市浚县接待来访群众
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Receives Petitioning Residents in Xun County, Hebi City
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日下午，河南省委书记刘宁到鹤壁市浚县接待来访群众，强调落实领导干部接访下访包案制度，切实解决群众急难愁盼问题。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 20, Liu Ning, Secretary of the Henan Provincial Party Committee, received petitioning residents in Xun County, Hebi City, emphasizing the implementation of the leader reception and case-handling system to address people's urgent concerns.

articles.title_zh: 发挥优势促进文旅体融合发展 全方位加强文物保护传承利用
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Urges Integrated Development of Culture, Tourism and Sports in Henan
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日至20日，河南省委书记刘宁到安阳市、郑州市调研文物保护和文化旅游体育融合发展工作，强调加强文物保护传承利用，深挖文旅消费潜力。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 19 to 20, Liu Ning, Secretary of Henan Provincial Party Committee, visited Anyang and Zhengzhou to inspect cultural relic protection and integrated development of culture, tourism and sports, emphasizing enhanced protection and utilization of cultural relics.

articles.title_zh: 交通需求与人工智能技术加速对接
articles.title_en: Transport Demand and AI Technology Accelerate Integration
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，交通运输部召开新闻发布会解读《“人工智能+交通运输”典型应用场景创新行动方案》，发布首批41个典型场景，助力规模化创新应用。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, the Ministry of Transport held a press conference to interpret the action plan for typical application scenarios of AI + transportation, releasing the first batch of 41 typical scenarios to boost large-scale innovative applications.

articles.title_zh: 河北省委书记罗文主持召开全省消防安全视频调度会议
articles.title_en: Luo Wen Chairs Hebei Fire Safety Video Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日晚，河北省委书记罗文主持召开全省消防安全视频调度会议，强调抓好安全生产，省长王正谱作工作部署，省委副书记王陆进出席。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of August 20, Luo Wen, Secretary of the Hebei Provincial Party Committee, chaired a provincial fire safety video conference, stressing production safety. Governor Wang Zhengpu made arrangements, and Deputy Secretary Wang Lujin attended.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲到漠河市调研
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Investigates Mohe City
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日至20日，黑龙江省委副书记、省长梁惠玲到大兴安岭地区漠河市调研县域经济发展、兴边富民情况，检查森林防灭火和防汛工作，强调坚持生态优先、绿色发展。
articles.summary_en: From August 19 to 20, Liang Huiling, Deputy Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee and Governor, visited Mohe City to inspect county economy development, border prosperity initiatives, and forest fire and flood prevention work, stressing ecological priority and green development.

articles.title_zh: 宏观政策发力提效
articles.title_en: Macro Policy Gains Momentum and Efficiency
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，习近平总书记主持中共中央政治局会议，要求实施更加积极的财政政策和适度宽松的货币政策，加大逆周期调节力度。文章综述政策发力提效，推动经济持续向好。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, General Secretary Xi Jinping chaired a CPC Central Political Bureau meeting, calling for a more proactive fiscal policy and moderately loose monetary policy with stronger counter-cyclical adjustments. The article reviews policy implementation boosting economic improvement.

articles.title_zh: 江西省省级林业补助专项资金管理新规出台
articles.title_en: New Regulations Issued for Jiangxi Provincial Forestry Subsidy Fund Management
articles.summary_zh: 近日，江西省财政厅、省林业局联合印发管理办法，优化林业补助资金支持方向和分配机制，强化绩效导向。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Jiangxi Provincial Department of Finance and Forestry Bureau jointly issued measures to optimize forestry subsidy fund allocation and enhance performance evaluation.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中调研督导群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作时强调 以扎实有力举措推进集中整治攻坚决战 全力抓出群众满意的成效
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong Stresses Solid Measures in Campaign Against Corruption and Misconduct Among the People
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中深入呼和浩特市调研督导群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作，强调要动真碰硬整治农村集体“三资”等问题。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Wang Weizhong, Party Secretary of Inner Mongolia, visited Hohhot to supervise the campaign against corruption and misconduct, emphasizing tough measures on rural collective assets.

articles.title_zh: 包钢调研全区养老产业高质量发展工作
articles.title_en: Bao Gang Investigates High-Quality Development of Elderly Care Industry in Inner Mongolia
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，内蒙古自治区党委副书记、自治区主席包钢在自治区民政厅调研养老产业发展和养老服务领域腐败问题集中整治工作，要求系统谋划“十五五”养老产业，加强信息化建设，严查侵害老年人利益行为。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Bao Gang, Deputy Party Secretary and Chairman of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, visited the regional civil affairs department to inspect elderly care industry development and anti-corruption efforts in elderly services, calling for systematic planning and digital empowerment.

articles.title_zh: 银川推动政务数据安全有序高效利用
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Promotes Safe and Efficient Use of Government Data
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，银川市数据局与交警部门利用AI优化交通信号灯测试；银川加快数据湖建设，政务数据流通利用基础设施已建成试运行。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 20, Yinchuan's data bureau and traffic police tested AI-optimized traffic signals; the city is advancing its data lake infrastructure for secure government data utilization.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央、国务院、中央军委关于给张陆颁发“二级航天功勋奖章” 授予武飞、张洪章“英雄航天员”荣誉称号并颁发“三级航天功勋奖章”的决定
articles.title_en: Decision to Award Zhang Lu Second-Class Aerospace Merit Medal and Honor Wu Fei, Zhang Hongzhang as Heroic Astronauts
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月20日，中共中央、国务院、中央军委决定，给张陆颁发“二级航天功勋奖章”，授予武飞、张洪章“英雄航天员”荣誉称号并颁发“三级航天功勋奖章”，以表彰他们为神舟二十一号任务作出的贡献。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, 2026, the CPC Central Committee, the State Council and the Central Military Commission decided to award Zhang Lu the Second-Class Aerospace Merit Medal, and confer the honorary title of 'Heroic Astronaut' on Wu Fei and Zhang Hongzhang with Third-Class Aerospace Merit Medals.

articles.title_zh: 850吨鲜果枸杞订单签约杭州
articles.title_en: 850 Tons Fresh Wolfberry Order Signed in Hangzhou
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日，“神奇柴达木鲜果枸杞产销对接展销会”在杭州举行，10家青浙企业签约，采购鲜果枸杞850吨，订单额超千万元，标志德令哈枸杞首次规模化进入杭州市场。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 15, at the 'Magic Qaidam Fresh Wolfberry Production-Marketing Fair' in Hangzhou, 10 Qinghai and Zhejiang enterprises signed contracts for 850 tons of fresh wolfberry, worth over 10 million yuan, marking Delingha's first large-scale entry into Hangzhou market.

articles.title_zh: 四川推动废旧动力电池综合利用管理立法
articles.title_en: Sichuan Promotes Legislation for Comprehensive Utilization of Retired Power Batteries
articles.summary_zh: 四川省政府新闻办8月20日发布会透露，废旧动力电池回收利用管理已纳入省政府2026年立法计划，拟将暂行办法升级为政府规章，增加强制性措施。
articles.summary_en: At a press conference on August 20, Sichuan announced that management of retired power battery recycling has been included in the provincial government's 2026 legislative plan, upgrading current rules with mandatory measures.

articles.title_zh: 高质量打造乡村振兴齐鲁样板 不断开创农业农村现代化新局面
articles.title_en: Shandong Holds Study Session on High-Quality Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日下午，山东省委理论学习中心组集体学习，省委书记林武主持，强调高质量打造乡村振兴齐鲁样板，开创农业农村现代化新局面。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 20, the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee's theoretical study group held a collective study, chaired by Secretary Lin Wu, focusing on high-quality rural revitalization and opening new prospects for agricultural and rural modernization.

tags.name_en: Agriculture, Rural Areas and Farmers Work

tags_en: Agriculture, Rural Areas and Farmers Work

articles.title_zh: 《上海市教育发展“十五五”规划》发布 加快建设教育强市
articles.title_en: Shanghai Releases 15th Five-Year Plan for Education Development
articles.summary_zh: 上海市政府日前印发《上海市教育发展“十五五”规划》，对加快教育强市建设作出部署，提出到2030年取得突破性进展。
articles.summary_en: The Shanghai Municipal Government has issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Education Development, outlining measures to build a strong education city and achieve breakthroughs by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 龚正主持上海市政府常务会议 要求全力保持经济平稳健康运行
articles.title_en: Gong Zheng Chairs Shanghai Municipal Government Executive Meeting to Maintain Steady Economic Performance
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，上海市委副书记、市长龚正主持召开市政府常务会议，要求落实国务院全体会议精神，扎实做好下半年工作，全力保持经济平稳健康运行。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Gong Zheng, Deputy Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, chaired an executive meeting of the municipal government, calling for implementation of the State Council plenary meeting spirit, solid work in H2, and maintaining stable and healthy economic performance.

articles.title_zh: 加快形成区域经济新增长点
articles.title_en: Accelerate Formation of New Regional Economic Growth Points
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，上海市市长龚正赴宝山区开展经济运行下沉调研，走访开利集团和上海钢联，强调加快转型升级、形成区域经济新增长点。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Shanghai Mayor Gong Zheng visited Baoshan District to investigate economic operation, touring Carrier and Shanghai Ganglian, urging faster transformation and new regional growth points.

articles.title_zh: “大国重器”再添新成员，浅吃水智能铺排船开工
articles.title_en: Construction of Shallow-draft Intelligent Paving Ship, a New 'Major National Equipment', Begins
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，中交上航局上海交建公司浅吃水智能铺排船建造项目正式开工，该船实现浅吃水与高性能兼备，并采用全电系统和智能技术。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 18, CCCC Shanghai Dredging's Shanghai Communications Construction subsidiary started building a shallow-draft intelligent paving ship. It combines shallow draft with high performance and uses all-electric and smart technologies.

articles.title_zh: 陈吉宁率上海市代表团在新疆喀什地区和草湖项目区学习考察
articles.title_en: Chen Jining Leads Shanghai Delegation on Inspection Tour in Kashgar and Caohu, Xinjiang
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日至20日，上海市委书记陈吉宁率上海市代表团在新疆喀什地区和草湖项目区学习考察，深化对口援疆工作，走访护边员、产业园区、医院、学校等。
articles.summary_en: From August 19 to 20, Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Jining led a delegation to Kashgar and Caohu project area in Xinjiang to inspect and promote paired assistance work, visiting border guards, industrial parks, hospitals and schools.

articles.title_zh: 陕西省稳增长工作调度会召开
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Holds Meeting on Stable Economic Growth
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，陕西省稳增长工作调度会在西安召开。省委书记赵一德主持并讲话，省长赵刚作工作部署，强调做好稳增长工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Shaanxi Province held a coordination meeting on stable growth in Xi'an. Secretary Zhao Yide presided and spoke, Governor Zhao Gang made work arrangements to ensure stable economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 总投资5.9亿元碳化硅材料项目在西安开工
articles.title_en: 5.9 Billion Yuan Silicon Carbide Materials Project Breaks Ground in Xi'an
articles.summary_zh: 近日，蓝辉科技碳化硅材料生产研发基地建设项目在西安市高陵区开工，总投资约5.9亿元，预计年产值9.58亿元。
articles.summary_en: The Silicon Carbide Materials R&D and Production Base project, with a total investment of 590 million yuan, recently broke ground in Gaoling District, Xi'an. It is expected to generate an annual output value of 958 million yuan.

articles.title_zh: 山西省启动“红色文化山西行”大思政课品牌建设
articles.title_en: Shanxi Launches 'Red Culture Shanxi Tour' Ideological and Political Education Brand
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，山西省文物局与省教育厅联合启动“红色文化山西行”大思政课品牌建设，推动革命文物资源融入大中小学思政教育。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 12, Shanxi Provincial Cultural Relics Bureau and Education Department jointly launched a brand program integrating revolutionary heritage into ideological and political education in schools.

articles.title_zh: 首部产业工人队伍建设改革蓝皮书发布
articles.title_en: First Blue Book on Reform of Industrial Workforce Development Released
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，《中国产业工人队伍建设改革报告（2026）》在北京发布，这是国内首部系统总结产业工人队伍建设改革成果的蓝皮书。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, the Blue Book 'China Industrial Workforce Development Reform Report (2026)' was released in Beijing, the first systematic summary of reform achievements in China.

articles.title_zh: 两部门印发意见推动服务类社会救助发展
articles.title_en: Two Departments Issue Guidelines to Promote Development of Service-Oriented Social Assistance
articles.summary_zh: 民政部、财政部近日印发《关于积极发展服务类社会救助的指导意见》，推动社会救助由单一物质救助向“物质+服务”综合救助模式转变。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Civil Affairs and the Ministry of Finance issued guidelines to promote service-oriented social assistance, shifting from material aid to a comprehensive 'material + service' model.

articles.title_zh: 天津市印发政府投资基金重点投资领域清单
articles.title_en: Tianjin Issues List of Key Investment Areas for Government Investment Funds
articles.summary_zh: 天津市发展改革委等4部门印发《天津市政府投资基金重点投资领域清单》，明确9个重点产业方向，赋能科技创新和产业升级。
articles.summary_en: Tianjin's Development and Reform Commission and three other departments issued a list of key investment areas for government investment funds, covering nine industries including green petrochemicals, autos, and high-end equipment, to boost tech innovation and industrial upgrading.

tags.name_en: Tianjin Municipal Development and Reform Commission

tags_en: Tianjin Municipal Development and Reform Commission

articles.title_zh: 天津公安发布17项服务举措便民助企
articles.title_en: Tianjin Police Unveils 17 Service Measures to Benefit People and Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 近日，天津市公安局发布服务保障高质量发展系列举措，涵盖5方面17项服务，包括优化政务服务、涉企保障、打击犯罪、引才聚智及服务滨海新区，持续打造服务型公安机关。
articles.summary_en: Tianjin Municipal Public Security Bureau recently issued a series of measures covering 17 service items in 5 areas, including government services, enterprise support, crime crackdown, talent attraction, and Binhai New Area services, to build a service-oriented police force.

articles.title_zh: 上海市代表团来疆考察对接对口支援与合作发展工作
articles.title_en: Shanghai Delegation Visits Xinjiang for Counterpart Support and Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日至20日，上海市代表团赴新疆考察对接对口支援与合作发展工作，沪疆两地领导共同谋划十五五时期对口援疆工作。
articles.summary_en: From August 19 to 20, a Shanghai delegation visited Xinjiang to discuss counterpart support and cooperation, with leaders planning aid work for the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 聚力提质增效 厚植发展动能
articles.title_en: Enhancing Quality and Efficiency for Development
articles.summary_zh: 回顾习近平总书记指示后西藏一年发展，基础设施完善、特色产业壮大，经济指标增速领先，高质量发展见成效。
articles.summary_en: A review of Tibet's development one year after President Xi Jinping's instructions, highlighting improved infrastructure, growing industries, and leading economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 云南推动绿电资源优势转化为产业优势
articles.title_en: Yunnan Promotes Turning Green Power Advantages into Industrial Advantages
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，2026腾冲科学家论坛·绿电价值转化专题活动举行，近500名院士专家围绕绿电优势转化为产业优势开展研讨，助力云南高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the 2026 Tengchong Scientists Forum's special session on green power value transformation was held, with nearly 500 academicians and experts discussing how to convert Yunnan's green power advantages into industrial advantages to boost high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 云南省政协十三届二十一次常委会会议在昆召开
articles.title_en: Yunnan Provincial CPPCC Standing Committee Meeting Held in Kunming
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，云南省政协十三届二十一次常委会会议在昆明召开，围绕大力发展云南低空经济业态协商议政，省政协主席刘晓凯主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, the 13th session of the 21st Standing Committee of the Yunnan Provincial CPPCC was held in Kunming to discuss the development of Yunnan's low-altitude economy, chaired by Liu Xiaokai.

articles.title_zh: 王宁王予波与瑞幸咖啡联合创始人、首席执行官郭谨一举行工作会谈
articles.title_en: Wang Ning and Wang Yubo Hold Working Talks with Luckin Coffee Co-founder and CEO Guo Jinyi
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，云南省委书记王宁、省长王予波在昆明与瑞幸咖啡联合创始人郭谨一举行会谈，就深化咖啡产业合作达成共识。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Yunnan Party Secretary Wang Ning and Governor Wang Yubo held talks with Luckin Coffee co-founder Guo Jinyi in Kunming, agreeing to deepen coffee industry cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 交通需求与人工智能技术加速对接（政策解读）
articles.title_en: Transport Demand and AI Technology Accelerate Integration (Policy Interpretation)
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，交通运输部召开新闻发布会解读《“人工智能+交通运输”典型应用场景创新行动方案》，发布首批41个典型场景，推动AI与交通深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, the Ministry of Transport held a press conference to interpret the action plan on AI+transport typical application scenarios, releasing the first batch of 41 scenarios to promote deep integration of AI and transportation.

articles.title_zh: 绍兴柯桥推出现代纺织产业链党建联建机制
articles.title_en: Shaoxing Keqiao Launches Party Building Joint Mechanism for Modern Textile Industry Chain
articles.summary_zh: 近日，绍兴市柯桥区在齐贤街道百布·齐贤汇产业园推出现代纺织产业链党建联建机制，以党建纽带打通上下游壁垒，为纺织产业高质量发展注入红色动能。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Keqiao District in Shaoxing launched a Party-building joint mechanism for the modern textile industry chain at the Baibu Qixianhui Industrial Park, aiming to break down barriers between upstream and downstream enterprises and boost high-quality development of the textile industry.

articles.title_zh: 开源共享赋能创新 中国AI智惠世界
articles.title_en: Open Source and Shared Innovation: China's AI Benefits the World
articles.summary_zh: 习近平倡导开放共赢，国产开源大模型密集上新，Kimi K3成全球最大开源模型，中国AI开源引领全球。
articles.summary_en: At the 2026 World AI Conference, Xi Jinping advocated open and win-win global AI governance. Chinese open-source models, including Kimi K3 with 2.8 trillion parameters, surged, making China's downloads the world's largest.

articles.title_zh: 尹力为市委法律顾问颁发聘书并座谈，勉励大家 当好“法治智囊团” 为首都发展贡献智慧和力量
articles.title_en: Yin Li Presents Appointment Letters to Legal Advisors and Encourages Them to Serve as 'Rule of Law Think Tank'
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日上午，第四届市委法律顾问聘任仪式举行，北京市委书记尹力为法律顾问颁发聘书并座谈，勉励他们为首都发展贡献法治智慧和力量。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 20, the fourth appointment ceremony for municipal legal advisors was held. Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li presented appointment letters and encouraged the advisors to contribute legal wisdom to the capital's development.

articles.title_zh: 《网络数据安全风险评估办法》今起实施 公安部答问
articles.title_en: Measures for Network Data Security Risk Assessment Take Effect Today; MPS Answers Questions
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，《网络数据安全风险评估办法》正式实施，公安部就评估服务认证及自身监管职责等热点问题答问。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, the Measures for Network Data Security Risk Assessment came into effect, with the Ministry of Public Security answering questions on certification and its regulatory duties.

articles.title_zh: 坚持以党的政治建设为统领
articles.title_en: Uphold Political Construction as the Guide for Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 文章阐述以党的政治建设为统领的重大意义、科学内涵和实践要求，强调全面从严治党首先要从政治上看。
articles.summary_en: The article explains the significance, scientific connotation and practical requirements of upholding political construction as the guide for overall Party building, stressing the need to view strict governance of the Party from a political perspective.

articles.title_zh: 斩断互联网“免费搭车”行为 最高法新规解读：转载必须先授权再使用
articles.title_en: Supreme Court's New Rules: Authorization Required Before Reposting Content
articles.summary_zh: 最高法8月20日发布新规，修改著作权民事纠纷司法解释，明确网络转载须先授权再使用，自9月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, the Supreme People's Court issued amended judicial interpretation on copyright civil disputes, requiring authorization before online reposting, effective from September 1.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开第88次常务会议 审议“十五五”智能网联新能源汽车之都建设规划
articles.title_en: Chongqing Municipal Government Holds 88th Executive Meeting to Review Intelli-Connected NEV Capital Plan
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日下午，重庆市市长陈新武主持召开市政府第88次常务会议，听取信访、安全生产等工作汇报，审议“十五五”智能网联新能源汽车之都建设规划。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 19 afternoon, Chongqing Mayor Chen Xinwu chaired the 88th executive meeting to review work reports and the 15th Five-Year Plan for building a smart connected new-energy vehicle capital.

articles.title_zh: 加快推动“两院一湾”建设 高水平打造人工智能创新应用高地
articles.title_en: Accelerate 'Two Institutes and One Bay' Construction to Build a High-Level AI Innovation Hub
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日下午，重庆市委书记袁家军、市长陈新武赴南岸区调研重庆通用人工智能研究院并召开专题座谈会，强调加快“两院一湾”建设，打造人工智能创新应用高地。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun and Mayor Chen Xinwu visited the Chongqing General Artificial Intelligence Research Institute in Nan'an District and held a symposium, urging faster development of the 'Two Institutes and One Bay' to build an AI innovation hub.

tags.name_en: Chongqing General Artificial Intelligence Research Institute
