articles.title_zh: 陈刚主持召开自治区党委书记专题会议研究漓江生态环境保护工作
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Chairs Regional Party Committee Special Meeting on Lijiang River Ecological Protection
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚主持召开书记专题会议，研究漓江生态环境保护工作，自治区主席韦韬出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Chen Gang, Secretary of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Regional Party Committee, chaired a special meeting to study the ecological protection of the Lijiang River, with Regional Chairman Wei Tao attending and speaking.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁到鹤壁市浚县接待来访群众
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Receives Petitioning Public in Junxian County, Hebi
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日下午，河南省委书记刘宁到鹤壁市浚县接待来访群众，强调落实领导干部接访下访包案制度，切实解决群众急难愁盼问题。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 20, Liu Ning, Secretary of the Henan Provincial Party Committee, received petitioning residents in Junxian County, Hebi City, emphasizing the implementation of the system for leading officials to receive visits and handle cases.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁在调研文旅体融合发展工作时强调 发挥优势促进文旅体融合发展 全方位加强文物保护传承利用
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Emphasizes Cultural Heritage Protection and Integrated Development of Culture, Tourism and Sports during Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日至20日，河南省委书记刘宁赴安阳、郑州调研文物保护与文旅体融合发展，强调加强文物保护利用，推动文旅产业成为支柱产业。
articles.summary_en: From August 19 to 20, Liu Ning, Secretary of Henan Provincial Party Committee, inspected cultural relic protection and integrated development of culture, tourism and sports in Anyang and Zhengzhou, stressing the need to strengthen protection and utilization of cultural relics and build tourism into a pillar industry.

articles.title_zh: 孔昌生在省政协月协商座谈会上指出 更好发挥政协优势作用 积极助力社会信用体系建设
articles.title_en: Kong Changsheng Urges Better Use of CPPCC Role to Support Social Credit System Construction
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，河南省政协召开月协商座谈会，围绕加强社会信用体系建设开展协商议政，省政协主席孔昌生出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, the Henan Provincial Committee of CPPCC held a monthly consultation meeting on enhancing the social credit system, with Chairman Kong Changsheng attending and delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁会见2026豫台经贸洽谈会暨两岸智能装备制造对接活动重要嘉宾和台商代表
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Meets Taiwan Guests at Henan-Taiwan Economic and Trade Fair
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，河南省委书记刘宁在鹤壁市会见出席2026豫台经贸洽谈会暨两岸智能装备制造对接活动的台湾嘉宾和台商代表，就深化豫台经贸合作交流会谈。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Liu Ning, Secretary of Henan Provincial Party Committee, met with Taiwan guests and business representatives attending the 2026 Henan-Taiwan Economic and Trade Fair and Cross-Strait Intelligent Equipment Manufacturing Matchmaking Event in Hebi to discuss deepening economic cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 湖南高新产投集团成立 毛伟明为公司揭牌
articles.title_en: Hunan High-Tech Investment Group Established, Mao Weiming Unveils Company
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，新组建的湖南高新产业投资集团有限公司在长沙揭牌成立，省委副书记、省长毛伟明为公司揭牌并调研。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Hunan High-Tech Industrial Investment Group was inaugurated in Changsha. Provincial Governor Mao Weiming attended the unveiling and toured the company.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明主持召开省委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Shen Xiaoming Chairs Hunan Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，湖南省委书记沈晓明主持召开省委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，听取消防安全和信访工作汇报。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Shen Xiaoming, Secretary of the CPC Hunan Provincial Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech and hear reports on fire safety and petition work.

articles.title_zh: 财政部介绍“十五五”财政改革发展有关情况
articles.title_en: MOF Briefs on Fiscal Reform and Development for 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 国新办8月21日举行发布会，财政部副部长廖岷等介绍“十五五”财政改革发展，提出建设强大稳固平衡可持续财政，并部署下半年增量政策。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on Aug 21, the Ministry of Finance outlined fiscal reform plans for the 15th Five-Year Plan period, emphasizing stronger, sustainable public finance and new incremental policies for H2.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年座谈会举行
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Holds Symposium Marking 100th Anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's Birth
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，江苏省纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年座谈会在扬州举行，省委书记信长星出席并讲话，强调学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，传承弘扬江泽民同志的崇高风范。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 20, Jiangsu held a symposium in Yangzhou commemorating the 100th anniversary of Jiang Zemin's birth. Party Secretary Xin Changxing spoke, emphasizing Xi Jinping's speech and Jiang's legacy.

articles.title_zh: 省政府召开常务会议暨经济运行调度会 刘小涛主持
articles.title_en: Provincial Government Holds Executive Meeting and Economic Operation Dispatch Meeting, Chaired by Liu Xiaotao
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，江苏省省长刘小涛主持召开省政府常务会议暨经济运行调度会，研究部署当前重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Liu Xiaotao, Governor of Jiangsu, chaired a provincial government executive meeting on economic operation and key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 让文旅在传承与创新中紧密相融
articles.title_en: Let Culture and Tourism Blend Closely Through Inheritance and Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 新华社发表学习手记，阐释习近平总书记关于文旅融合的重要论述，强调以文塑旅、以旅彰文，推动旅游强国建设。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua published a study note elaborating on Xi Jinping's remarks on integrating culture and tourism, emphasizing shaping tourism through culture and promoting tourism with culture to advance a strong tourism country.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 进一步满足人民群众多元安居需求
articles.title_en: State Council Overhauls Housing Provident Fund Regulations to Meet Diverse Housing Needs
articles.summary_zh: 国务院公布修改《住房公积金管理条例》的决定，自9月20日起施行，将灵活就业人员纳入自愿缴存范围，并拓宽公积金提取使用范围，更好满足群众多元安居需求。
articles.summary_en: The State Council published a decision to amend the Housing Provident Fund Regulations, effective September 20, allowing flexible employment personnel to voluntarily contribute and expanding withdrawal uses to better meet diverse housing needs.

articles.title_zh: 2026年全国早稻总产量565.8亿斤
articles.title_en: China's 2026 Early Rice Output Reaches 28.292 Million Tons
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局发布公告，2026年全国早稻总产量2829.2万吨（565.8亿斤），比2025年下降0.8%；播种面积略有增加，单产略降。
articles.summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics announced that China's early rice output in 2026 totaled 28.292 million tons (56.58 billion jin), down 0.8% year on year; sown area increased slightly while yield per unit area decreased.

articles.title_zh: 7月全社会用电量再次突破万亿千瓦时 创历史新高
articles.title_en: July Electricity Consumption Exceeds One Trillion kWh Again, Hits Record High
articles.summary_zh: 国家能源局8月21日发布数据显示，7月全社会用电量达10400亿千瓦时，同比增长1.7%，创月度用电量历史新高。
articles.summary_en: The National Energy Administration reported on Aug 21 that total electricity consumption in July reached 1.04 trillion kWh, up 1.7% year-on-year, setting a new monthly record.

articles.title_zh: 陈敏尔：抓住机遇 凝心聚力 善作善成 以一域之为服务高质量发展全局
articles.title_en: Chen Miner: Seize Opportunities and Serve Overall High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，天津市委书记陈敏尔赴西青区调研，强调抓住京津冀协同发展等机遇，加快形成新质生产力，以一域之为服务高质量发展全局。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Tianjin Party Secretary Chen Miner inspected Xiqing District, stressing seizing opportunities from Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei coordination and accelerating new quality productive forces to serve high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 上海市代表团来疆考察对接对口支援与合作发展工作
articles.title_en: Shanghai Delegation Visits Xinjiang to Advance Counterpart Support and Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日至20日，上海市代表团赴新疆考察对接对口支援与合作发展工作，上海市委书记陈吉宁与新疆自治区党委书记陈小江等参加。
articles.summary_en: From August 19 to 20, a Shanghai delegation visited Xinjiang to discuss counterpart support and cooperation, with Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Jining and Xinjiang Party Secretary Chen Xiajiang attending.

tags.name_en: Shanghai Municipal Committee of the CPC

tags_en: Shanghai Municipal Committee of the CPC

articles.title_zh: 艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在塔城地区调研时强调以创新思维改革办法务实作风做好重点工作
articles.title_en: Erkin Tuniyaz Urges Innovation and Reform in Tacheng Inspection Tour
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日至20日，自治区党委副书记、自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在塔城市调研农业、民生、教育、重点项目等工作，强调以创新思维、改革办法、务实作风做好三季度重点工作，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: From August 19 to 20, Erkin Tuniyaz, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Xinjiang Regional Committee and Chairman of the Regional Government, inspected agriculture, livelihood, education and key projects in Tacheng city, urging innovative thinking and practical measures to promote high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷：强化创新驱动 提升发展质效
articles.title_en: Governor Liu Jie Stresses Innovation-Driven Development and Quality Improvement
articles.summary_zh: 20日，浙江省委副书记、省长刘捷在绍兴新昌县调研，强调强化创新驱动、提升发展质效，并到社会治理中心接待来访群众。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 20, Liu Jie, deputy secretary of Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee and governor, inspected Xinchang County, Shaoxing, emphasizing innovation-driven development and meeting with petitioners.

articles.title_zh: 外交部回应美国学者批驳“中国冲击”论调
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Responds to US Scholar's Rebuttal of 'China Shock' Narrative
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，外交部发言人林剑表示，中国发展带给世界的是机遇而非冲击，是赋能而非挤压。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian said China's development brings opportunities, not shocks, and empowerment, not squeezing, to the world.

articles.title_zh: 许家印被判处无期徒刑 恒大集团、恒大地产等案一审宣判
articles.title_en: Xu Jiayin Sentenced to Life Imprisonment in Evergrande Group Case
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月20日上午，广东省深圳市中级人民法院对恒大集团、恒大地产及许家印案一审公开宣判，许家印被判处无期徒刑，并处没收个人全部财产；恒大集团和恒大地产分别被判处罚金88.2亿元和70亿元。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 20, 2026, Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court sentenced Xu Jiayin to life imprisonment with property confiscation, and fined Evergrande Group and Evergrande Real Estate 8.82b and 7b yuan respectively.

articles.title_zh: 张超超当选石家庄市委书记 王素文、李瑞峰当选市委副书记
articles.title_en: Zhang Chaochao Elected CPC Shijiazhuang Municipal Committee Secretary; Wang Suwen and Li Ruifeng Elected Deputy Secretaries
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日下午，石家庄市委十二届一次全会选举张超超为市委书记，王素文、李瑞峰为市委副书记，并选出新一届市委常委。
articles.summary_en: At the first plenary session of the 12th CPC Shijiazhuang Municipal Committee held on the afternoon of August 19, Zhang Chaochao was elected secretary, while Wang Suwen and Li Ruifeng were elected deputy secretaries.

articles.title_zh: 台湾前“深绿”媒体人彭文正表态：不惜代价推动两岸和平统一
articles.title_en: Former Taiwan 'Deep Green' Media Personality Peng Wen-cheng Vows to Promote Peaceful Reunification at All Costs
articles.summary_zh: 台湾前“深绿”媒体人彭文正18日在线上访谈中表示，将不惜代价推动两岸和平统一，认为和平统一是台湾没有选项的选择，并呼吁民进党当局与大陆谈判。
articles.summary_en: On Aug. 18, former Taiwan 'deep green' media figure Peng Wen-cheng said he will promote peaceful reunification at all costs, urging the DPP to negotiate with the mainland.

articles.title_zh: 王卫星：民进党当局污名化统战 刻意制造对立隔阂
articles.title_en: Wang Weixing: DPP Authorities Stigmatize United Front, Deliberately Create Division
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，2026年两岸关系研讨会在武汉开幕，全国台湾研究会副会长王卫星致辞，批评民进党当局污名化统战政策，刻意制造两岸对立。
articles.summary_en: At the 2026 Cross-Strait Relations Symposium in Wuhan on Aug 20, Wang Weixing, vice president of the National Taiwan Studies Association, criticized the DPP for stigmatizing the united front policy and deliberately creating cross-strait division.

articles.title_zh: 2026年两岸关系研讨会在武汉开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 Cross-Strait Relations Symposium Opens in Wuhan
articles.summary_zh: 2026年两岸关系研讨会8月20日在武汉开幕，两岸有关人士和专家学者160余人参加，围绕两岸关系和平发展、融合发展等议题展开交流。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Cross-Strait Relations Symposium opened in Wuhan on August 20, bringing together over 160 experts and scholars from both sides to discuss peaceful and integrated development of cross-strait relations.

articles.title_zh: 中国240小时过境免签“朋友圈”增至57国
articles.title_en: China's 240-Hour Transit Visa-Free Policy Expanded to 57 Countries
articles.summary_zh: 中国国家移民管理局8月20日发布公告，将吉尔吉斯斯坦、越南纳入240小时过境免签和海南30天入境免签政策，适用国家分别增至57个和61个。
articles.summary_en: China's National Immigration Administration announced on Aug 20 that Kyrgyzstan and Vietnam citizens are eligible for 240-hour transit visa-free and Hainan 30-day visa-free policies, expanding coverage to 57 and 61 countries respectively.

articles.title_zh: 台湾首次试射运载火箭宣告失败，背后藏有哪些野心与落差？
articles.title_en: Taiwan's First Launch Vehicle Test Fails, Exposing Ambitions and Gaps
articles.summary_zh: 台湾“中科院”19日在屏东九鹏基地首次试射运载火箭，因轨道异常自毁坠毁，引发村民恐慌。专家指该火箭实为“军用主导、兼顾民用”，暴露台方野心与技术落差。
articles.summary_en: Taiwan's first launch vehicle test at Jiupeng base on Aug 19 failed and self-destructed, alarming nearby villagers. Experts say it was military-dominated, exposing ambition and technological gaps.

tags.name_en: Chung-Shan Institute of Science and Technology

tags_en: Chung-Shan Institute of Science and Technology

articles.title_zh: 习近平致电祝贺鲍卡就任匈牙利总统
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Congratulates Boka Andras on Assuming Hungarian Presidency
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，国家主席习近平致电鲍卡·安德拉什，祝贺他就任匈牙利总统，并强调推动中匈新时代全天候全面战略伙伴关系发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory message to Andras Boka on his inauguration as President of Hungary, emphasizing the advancement of the China-Hungary all-weather comprehensive strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 安康市委常委会会议研究部署经济稳增长社会工作生态环境保护和全面从严治党等事项
articles.title_en: Ankang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting Arranges Economic Stability, Social Work, Ecological Protection and Full Strict Party Governance
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，安康市委书记柯昌万主持召开市委常委会会议，学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，听取并研究部署经济稳增长、社会工作、生态环境保护和全面从严治党等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Ankang Municipal Party Committee Secretary Ke Changwan chaired a Standing Committee meeting to study Xi Jinping's important speech, hear reports, and arrange work on economic stability, social work, ecological protection and strict Party governance.

articles.title_zh: 长春召开2026年县域高质量发展推进会议
articles.title_en: Changchun Holds 2026 County High-Quality Development Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，长春市召开2026年县域高质量发展推进会议，市委书记张恩惠讲话、市长顾刚主持，部署县域高质量发展重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Changchun held the 2026 County High-Quality Development Conference. Party Secretary Zhang Enhui spoke and Mayor Gu Gang presided, deploying key tasks for county development.

articles.title_zh: 黄强在长春调研时强调 高质量推进城市更新 下实功增进民生福祉
articles.title_en: Huang Qiang Stresses High-Quality Urban Renewal During Changchun Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，吉林省委书记黄强在长春调研城市更新工作，强调践行人民城市理念，高质量推进城市更新，增进民生福祉。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Huang Qiang, Secretary of Jilin Provincial Party Committee, inspected urban renewal in Changchun, stressing a people-centered approach to improve urban quality and residents' well-being.

articles.title_zh: 我国工业经济新动能贡献持续增强
articles.title_en: China's Industrial Economy Sees Growing Contribution from New Growth Drivers
articles.summary_zh: 今年1—7月，高技术制造业等新动能对规模以上工业增加值增长贡献率约五成，集成电路、智能设备等行业增长加快，7月工业品出口保持两位数增长。
articles.summary_en: From January to July, new growth drivers like high-tech manufacturing contributed about half of the growth in industrial value-added output, with integrated circuits and smart equipment accelerating, while exports maintained double-digit growth in July.

articles.title_zh: 韩国总统李在明会见王毅
articles.title_en: ROK President Lee Jae-myung Meets with Wang Yi
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，韩国总统李在明在首尔青瓦台会见中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅。
articles.summary_en: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung met with Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, at the Blue House in Seoul on Aug 20.

articles.title_zh: 中国已成为厄瓜多尔第二大贸易伙伴
articles.title_en: China Becomes Ecuador's Second-Largest Trading Partner
articles.summary_zh: 商务部新闻发言人何亚东8月20日称，中厄自贸协定生效两年来双边贸易额快速增长，今年上半年达98.3亿美元，中国已成为厄瓜多尔第二大贸易伙伴。两国于8月18日签署经贸合作路线图等文件。
articles.summary_en: Ministry spokesperson He Yadong said on Aug 20 that bilateral trade under the China-Ecuador FTA grew rapidly, reaching $9.83 billion in H1 2026, making China Ecuador's second-largest trading partner. The two countries signed a roadmap and memorandum on Aug 18.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央 国务院 中央军委关于给张陆颁发“二级航天功勋奖章” 授予武飞、张洪章“英雄航天员”荣誉称号并颁发“三级航天功勋奖章”的决定
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee, State Council and CMC Decide to Award Zhang Lu and Confer Heroic Astronaut Titles on Wu Fei and Zhang Hongzhang
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央、国务院、中央军委决定表彰神舟二十一号航天员张陆、武飞、张洪章，分别颁发功勋奖章和授予荣誉称号。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee, State Council and Central Military Commission have decided to honor astronauts Zhang Lu, Wu Fei and Zhang Hongzhang for their outstanding contributions to the Shenzhou-21 manned spaceflight mission.

articles.title_zh: 市委理论学习中心组召开专题学习会
articles.title_en: Dingxi Party Committee Theoretical Learning Center Group Holds Special Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，定西市委理论学习中心组召开专题学习会，围绕学习贯彻习近平党建思想开展专题研讨，市委书记汪尚学主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, the Theoretical Learning Center Group of Dingxi Municipal Party Committee held a special study session on Xi Jinping's Party-building thought, chaired by Party Secretary Wang Shangxue.

articles.title_zh: 汪尚学李生潜会见侯国树一行
articles.title_en: Wang Shangxue and Li Shengqian Meet Hou Guoshu
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，定西市委书记汪尚学、代市长李生潜会见中铁六局董事长侯国树，就深化地企合作进行座谈。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 19, Dingxi Party Secretary Wang Shangxue and Acting Mayor Li Shengqian met Hou Guoshu, Chairman of China Railway Sixth Group, to discuss deepening local-enterprise cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Ecuadorian President Noboa
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日下午，国家主席习近平在北京人民大会堂同来华进行国事访问的厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚举行会谈，并共同见证多项合作文件签署。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 18, President Xi Jinping held talks with Ecuadorian President Noboa at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, and they witnessed the signing of cooperation documents.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁吴贤德在福州新区（长乐区）调研
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning and Wu Xiande Investigate in Fuzhou New Area (Changle District)
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，福建省委副书记、福州市委书记郭宁宁和市长吴贤德在福州新区（长乐区）调研，察看人工智能智算中心等项目建设，强调推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 19, Guo Ningning, deputy secretary of Fujian Provincial Party Committee and Fuzhou Party Secretary, and Mayor Wu Xiande inspected AI computing center and tech companies in Fuzhou New Area, urging innovation-driven development.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱主持召开市委理论学习中心组第八次集体学习会议
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Chairs 8th Collective Study Meeting of Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Study Center Group
articles.summary_zh: 20日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱主持召开市委理论学习中心组集体学习会议，强调学习贯彻总体国家安全观，筑牢国家安全防线。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 20, Hegang Municipal Party Committee Secretary Wang Xingzhu chaired a collective study session of the Party Committee Theoretical Study Center Group, emphasizing implementation of the holistic approach to national security.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研企业科技创新和上市工作
articles.title_en: Huai'an Party Chief Inspects Enterprise Sci-Tech Innovation and Listing Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，淮安市委书记史志军调研企业科技创新和上市工作，强调提升创新体系效能，促进科技创新和产业创新深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 19, Huai'an Party Secretary Shi Zhijun visited enterprises to inspect sci-tech innovation and listing work, stressing enhancing innovation system efficiency and deep integration of tech and industrial innovation.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会党组会议、第五十六次主任会议召开
articles.title_en: Huaian Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Party Group Meeting and 56th Director Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，淮安市人大常委会党组会议和第五十六次主任会议召开，常务副主任周青主持，传达学习中央政治局会议精神，研究换届选举等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, the Party Group Meeting and the 56th Director Meeting of the Standing Committee of Huaian Municipal People's Congress were held, chaired by Executive Deputy Director Zhou Qing, to study the election work and other issues.

articles.title_zh: 市委书记史志军调研企业科技创新和上市工作
articles.title_en: Party Secretary Shi Zhijun Investigates Enterprise Sci-tech Innovation and Listing Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，淮安市委书记史志军调研企业科技创新和上市工作，强调促进科技创新和产业创新融合，因地制宜发展新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Shi Zhijun, Secretary of Huai'an Municipal Party Committee, inspected enterprises' scientific innovation and listing work, emphasizing deeper integration of technology and industry innovation to develop new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡会见上海应用技术大学党委书记郭庆松一行
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Meets with Party Secretary Guo Qingsong of Shanghai Institute of Technology
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日上午，淮北市委副书记、代市长黄韡会见来淮考察的上海应用技术大学党委书记郭庆松一行，双方就深化市校合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 20, Huang Wei, deputy secretary of the Huaibei Municipal Party Committee and acting mayor, met with Guo Qingsong, Party secretary of Shanghai Institute of Technology, and his delegation to discuss deepening city-university cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦在调研重点交通项目建设工作时强调高标准高质量推进项目建设 全面提升综合交通发展能级
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi Emphasizes High-Standard Construction of Key Transport Projects During Research Visit
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日下午，淮北市委书记蒋曦到濉溪县调研重点交通项目建设，察看双堆集站及美丽公路等，要求高标准推进、深化交旅融合。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 20, Jiang Xi, Secretary of the Huaibei Municipal Party Committee, visited Suixi County to inspect key transport projects, including the Shuangduiji Station and scenic roads, urging high-standard construction and tourism-transport integration.

articles.title_zh: 韦朝晖主持召开市委审计委员会第十次会议
articles.title_en: Wei Zhaohui Chairs 10th Meeting of Municipal Audit Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日上午，怀化市委书记、市委审计委员会主任韦朝晖主持召开市委审计委员会第十次会议。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 20, Wei Zhaohui, Secretary of the Huaihua Municipal CPC Committee and Director of the Municipal Audit Committee, chaired the 10th meeting of the Municipal Audit Committee.

articles.title_zh: 市十五届人大常委会召开第56次主任会议
articles.title_en: Huangshi Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 56th Director Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，市十五届人大常委会召开第56次主任会议，俞远汉主持，审议多项条例草案和报告。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, the 56th director meeting of the Standing Committee of the 15th Huangshi Municipal People's Congress was held, chaired by Yu Yuanhan, reviewing draft regulations and reports.

articles.title_en: Xiamen Party Secretary Lin Tao Visits Longyan to Research Mountain-Sea Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，厦门市委书记林涛到龙岩调研山海协作工作，强调以更大力度推动两地优势互补、协同发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Xiamen Party Secretary Lin Tao visited Longyan to research mountain-sea cooperation, emphasizing greater synergy and coordinated development.

articles.title_zh: 龙岩市领导调研推进为民办实事工作
articles.title_en: Longyan Mayor Inspects Public Welfare Projects
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，龙岩市长蔡琳深入中心城区调研为民办实事工作，察看工会驿站、老旧小区电梯加装和精品福道工程，强调高质量办好民生实事。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Longyan Mayor Cai Lin inspected central urban area's people-benefit projects, visiting union service stations, old community elevator installations, and scenic walkways, stressing high-quality livelihood services.

articles.title_zh: 汕头市委常委会召开会议 认真学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神 研究做好新时代‘侨’的文章
articles.title_en: Shantou Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Instructions on Overseas Chinese Affairs
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日上午，汕头市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记对侨务工作的重要指示精神和全国侨务工作会议精神，研究部署新时代‘侨’的文章。市委书记庄悦群主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 19, the Shantou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee held a meeting to study Xi Jinping's instructions on overseas Chinese affairs and the national conference spirit, and to plan relevant work. Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn chaired and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰率队拜访广东广播电视台
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Leads Delegation to Visit Guangdong Radio and Television Station
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日下午，市委书记逯峰率队拜访广东广播电视台，与台长李宜航座谈，双方就深化战略合作、加强新闻宣传、推动文旅融合等进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 19, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng led a delegation to visit Guangdong Radio and Television Station, holding talks with its Party Secretary and Director Li Yihang on deepening strategic cooperation, enhancing news publicity, and promoting cultural-tourism integration.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰率队拜访省文化和旅游厅
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Leads Delegation to Visit Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日下午，汕尾市委书记逯峰率队拜访省文化和旅游厅，与厅长郭大杰座谈，双方就推动汕尾文化和旅游高质量发展进行深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 19, Lu Feng, Secretary of the Shanwei Municipal Party Committee, led a delegation to visit the Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism and held talks with Director Guo Dajie on promoting high-quality cultural and tourism development in Shanwei.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬专题调研人才工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Conducts Special Survey on Talent Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬专题调研人才工作，强调深入实施人才强市战略，深化产才融合。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Jiang Dongdong, Secretary of the Taizhou Municipal Party Committee, conducted a special survey on talent work, emphasizing the implementation of the strategy of strengthening the city through talent and deepening industry-talent integration.

articles.title_zh: 黄强在长春调研时强调 高质量推进城市更新 下实功增进民生福祉
articles.title_en: Huang Qiang Stresses High-Quality Urban Renewal and People's Well-being During Changchun Visit
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，吉林省委书记黄强在长春调研城市更新工作，强调践行人民城市理念，高质量推进城市更新，增进民生福祉。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Huang Qiang, Secretary of the Jilin Provincial Party Committee, inspected urban renewal work in Changchun, emphasizing high-quality renewal to improve people's well-being.

articles.title_zh: 第三十六期省各民主党派、工商联负责人和无党派人士代表研讨班在威海举办
articles.title_en: The 36th Provincial Seminar for Democratic Parties, Federation of Industry and Commerce, and Non-Party Representatives Held in Weihai
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日至19日，第三十六期省各民主党派、工商联负责人和无党派人士代表研讨班在威海举办。省委常委、统战部部长邓云锋出席并讲话，市委书记张海波介绍经济社会发展情况。
articles.summary_en: From August 17 to 19, the 36th provincial seminar for leaders of democratic parties, the Federation of Industry and Commerce, and non-party representatives was held in Weihai. Deng Yunfeng, Standing Committee member of the Provincial Party Committee and head of the United Front Work Department, attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 孔凡萍主持召开市政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Kong Fanping Chairs Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，威海市委副书记、市长孔凡萍主持召开市政府常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话，研究经济运行、防灾减灾等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Kong Fanping, Deputy Secretary of the Weihai Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, chaired an executive meeting of the municipal government to convey Xi Jinping's important speeches, study economic operation, and review related matters.

articles.title_zh: 威海市工商业联合会（总商会）第十三次代表大会召开
articles.title_en: 13th Congress of Weihai Federation of Industry and Commerce Held

articles.summary_en: On August 19, the 13th Congress of Weihai Municipal Federation of Industry and Commerce (Chamber of Commerce) was held to review past work and plan for the future. Party Secretary Zhang Haibo attended and spoke, and Zhang Shandong was elected as the new chairman.

Hao Huijie, provincial standing committee member and municipal party secretary, chaired the meeting.

articles.summary_en: On August 19, Xi'an held a meeting to deepen the property service '100-Day Action'. Provincial Party Committee Standing Member and Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie stressed improving service quality and governance.

Jiang Cheng, Deputy Director of the Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee and Municipal Party Secretary, presided and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 烟台市委常委会召开会议传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神

articles.summary_en: On August 19, Zhao Xuhui, member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Ningxia Regional Committee and Secretary of the Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee, inspected grassroots governance led by Party building, stressing the need to uphold and strengthen the Party's overall leadership and improve grassroots governance efficiency.

articles.summary_en: On August 19, Yuxi held a symposium to celebrate the 9th Chinese Doctors' Day. Party Secretary Yang Zhengkun and Mayor Hu Jianghui attended and stressed the role of medical workers in building a healthy Yuxi.

articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 19, Zhanjiang Municipal Party Secretary Yu Gang chaired the 9th Plenary Session of the 12th Municipal Party Committee Audit Committee, with Mayor Li Yongyi in attendance, to review and deploy audit work.

articles.title_zh: 市五届人大常委会党组（扩大）会议暨第五十六次主任会议召开

articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 19, the 5th Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Party Group (Enlarged) Meeting and the 56th Director's Meeting were held, reviewing reports on law enforcement inspections, budgets, audits, and related agendas.

articles.title_en: Provincial Government Party Group Meeting Held to Study General Secretary Xi Jinping's Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，山东省委副书记、省长周乃翔主持召开省政府党组会议，学习习近平总书记重要讲话和关于三农工作重要论述，研究落实措施。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Zhou Naixiang, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee and Governor, chaired a provincial government party group meeting to study Xi Jinping's important speeches and measures for implementation.

articles.title_zh: 习近平：在纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会上的讲话

articles.summary_en: On August 17, 2026, Xi Jinping delivered a speech at the ceremony marking the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, paying tribute to his achievements and calling on learning from his noble character.

articles.summary_en: From Aug 18 to 19, An Lijia, member of the NPC Standing Committee and deputy director of the Finance and Economy Committee, led a research team to Zibo to investigate financial work and visited several enterprises to hear opinions and suggestions.

articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月20日凌晨，河北省秦皇岛市海港区一处底层商业店铺发生火灾，致8人死亡、3人受伤，明火已扑灭，起火原因正在调查。
articles.summary_en: At about 3:40 a.m. on Aug 20, 2026, a fire broke out in a ground-floor commercial shop in Haigang District, Qinhuangdao, Hebei, killing 8 and injuring 3. The fire was extinguished by 4:30 a.m.; cause is under investigation.

articles.summary_en: Luo Wen chaired the fire safety video conference in Hebei, stressing work safety; Wang Zhengpu made arrangements.

articles.summary_en: From Aug 10-15, 2026, 'Vital China Research Tour' visited Hunan, exploring how the province boosts consumption via renovated old spaces and cultural experiences, with night economy and tourism as key drivers.

articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 20, the Standing Committee of the Shandong Provincial Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech and discuss economic operation, air pollution prevention and other matters.

articles.title_zh: 福兴创新实验室第一届理事会第一次理事会议召开
articles.title_en: First Council Meeting of Fuxing Innovation Laboratory Held

articles.summary_en: On August 20, Fuzhou Mayor Wu Xiande chaired the first council meeting of Fuxing Innovation Laboratory, approving its charter and emphasizing integration of tech and industrial innovation.

articles.title_zh: 福建省出台“人工智能+制造”行动计划 （2026-2028年）
articles.title_en: Fujian Issues Action Plan for 'AI + Manufacturing' (2026-2028)
articles.summary_zh: 近日，福建省直八部门联合印发《福建省“人工智能+制造”行动计划（2026-2028年）》，提出到2028年培育20个工业垂直模型，形成100个典型应用场景。
articles.summary_en: Recently, eight provincial departments in Fujian jointly issued the 'AI + Manufacturing' Action Plan (2026-2028), aiming to cultivate 20 industrial vertical models and form 100 typical application scenarios by 2028.

articles.title_zh: 从“四个宁可”到“七个坚持”，正确政绩观一脉相承
articles.title_en: From 'Four Rathers' to 'Seven Persistences': A Consistent View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 近日出版的《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《提高防灾减灾救灾能力》，强调坚持人民至上、生命至上，系统总结“七个坚持”宝贵经验。
articles.summary_en: The latest issue of Qiushi magazine published an important article by General Secretary Xi Jinping on enhancing disaster prevention, mitigation and relief capabilities, emphasizing people-first and life-first principles and summarizing seven key persistences.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚举行会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Ecuadorian President Noboa

articles.summary_en: On August 18, President Xi Jinping held talks with Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa in Beijing, emphasizing that the China-Ecuador FTA has unleashed dividends and highlighted China's vast market potential, and expressing willingness to elevate bilateral relations.

articles.title_zh: 2026世界润滑技术大会在青岛开幕 张惠出席并致辞

articles.summary_en: The 2026 World Lubrication Technology Conference opened in Qingdao on the morning of Aug. 19. Zhang Hui, deputy secretary of the Qingdao Municipal Party Committee, attended and delivered a speech, emphasizing green development and industry-university-research cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 假总编张龙个人微博已无法打开，曾在微博晒出众多社会聘书

articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月20日晚，冒充香港中文大学客座教授的张龙微博认证账号无法打开，延安大学、河北美术学院等校表态讨论取消其头衔，西安汽车职业大学宣布解除聘任。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 20, 2026, the verified Weibo account of Zhang Long, who impersonated a CUHK adjunct professor, went offline. Several universities moved to revoke his titles; Xi'an Automotive Vocational University terminated his appointment.

articles.title_zh: 假总编张龙再被打假：陕西省内蒙古商会否认其是商会“传媒顾问”
articles.title_en: Fake 'Chief Editor' Zhang Long Discredited Again: Shaanxi Inner Mongolia Chamber of Commerce Rejects His 'Media Consultant' Title
articles.summary_zh: 陕西省内蒙古商会发布声明，否认授予张龙“传媒顾问”头衔，并宣布相关聘书作废，这是继香港中文大学后又一机构澄清与其无关。
articles.summary_en: The Shaanxi Inner Mongolia Chamber of Commerce issued a statement denying that it had granted Zhang Long the title of 'Media Consultant' and declaring related certificates void, following a similar clarification by Chinese University of Hong Kong.

articles.title_zh: 八部门联合部署2026年度检验检测机构“双随机、一公开”监督抽查

articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation, together with seven other departments, issued a notice to launch nationwide 'double random, one public' supervisory inspections on inspection and testing institutions, planning to inspect 120 institutions.

articles.title_zh: 澎湃新闻打假后，西安汽车职业大学解除张龙客座教授聘任关系
articles.title_en: Xi'an Automotive Vocational University Dismisses Zhang Long as Guest Professor after Media Fact-Check
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，西安汽车职业大学发布声明，自即日起解除张龙客座教授聘任关系，禁止其以该校名义开展活动。此前澎湃新闻曝光其多项虚假头衔。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Xi'an Automotive Vocational University announced it had terminated Zhang Long's guest professorship and barred him from using its name. The move followed The Paper's exposure of his fraudulent titles.

articles.title_zh: 全总：力争5年推动35万家以上用人单位建立工会
articles.title_en: ACFTU Aims to Establish Unions in 350,000+ Employers Within Five Years
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，中华全国总工会发布《中国工运事业和工会工作“十五五”规划》，力争五年推动35万家以上用人单位建立工会。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 20, the ACFTU released its 15th Five-Year Plan for union work, aiming to establish unions in over 350,000 employers within five years.

tags.name_en: Protection of New Employment Groups' Rights

tags_en: Protection of New Employment Groups' Rights

articles.title_zh: 中国广电联合会声明：拥有50多个社会头衔的张龙与我会没有任何关系
articles.title_en: China Federation of Radio and Television Declares No Ties with Zhang Long
articles.summary_zh: 中国广电联合会声明，社会人士张龙与该会无任何关系，未授予其任何头衔，并保留追究法律责任的权利。
articles.summary_en: The China Federation of Radio and Television issued a statement declaring that Zhang Long, a social figure with over 50 titles, has no relationship with the federation and was never granted any title, reserving the right to pursue legal action.

articles.title_zh: 《中国自动驾驶规模化应用蓝皮书（2026）》在渝发布
articles.title_en: China's Autonomous Driving Application Bluebook (2026) Released in Chongqing
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，《中国自动驾驶规模化应用蓝皮书（2026）》在重庆举办的汽车新质生产力发展论坛上正式发布，中国经济信息社张瑾对蓝皮书进行了解读。
articles.summary_en: The China Autonomous Driving Large-Scale Application Bluebook (2026) was released on Aug 20 at a forum in Chongqing. Zhang Jin explained it.

articles.title_zh: 南宁五象新区释放人工智能产业招商“强引力”
articles.title_en: Nanning Wuxiang New Area Shows Strong Appeal in AI Industry Investment
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，南宁五象新区在新闻发布会上介绍人工智能产业招商成效，已签约国内项目102个，落地外资企业19家，并设立50亿元产业基金支持发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Wuxiang New Area in Nanning reported AI industry investment progress, with 102 domestic projects signed and 19 foreign enterprises settled, backed by a 5 billion yuan industry fund.

articles.title_zh: 武汉打通数据壁垒 力推智慧物流网建设
articles.title_en: Wuhan Builds Smart Logistics Network by Breaking Data Barriers
articles.summary_zh: 武汉通过多式联运与供应链金融平台及公共信息平台，整合多方数据，打破物流信息壁垒，降低企业物流成本，提升货物周转效率。
articles.summary_en: Wuhan has launched multi-modal transport and supply chain platforms to integrate data from customs, ports, and logistics, breaking information barriers to cut costs and improve cargo efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 让数据跨境流动又快又好（深入实施自由贸易试验区提升战略）
articles.title_en: Making Cross-Border Data Flow Faster and Better (Deepening the Implementation of the Free Trade Zone Enhancement Strategy)
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报报道上海自贸试验区临港新片区以制度创新促进数据跨境流动，通过场景化试点备案和负面清单管理，降低企业合规成本，助力外资企业发展。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily reports on Lingang New Area of Shanghai Pilot Free Trade Zone promoting cross-border data flow through institutional innovation, including pilot filing and negative list management, reducing compliance costs for foreign-funded enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 江苏高邮赴宁波举行农文旅融合推介会 10个产业项目集中签约
articles.title_en: Gaoyou Holds Agricultural, Cultural and Tourism Promotion Conference in Ningbo, 10 Projects Signed
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，江苏高邮在浙江宁波举办农文旅融合推介会，现场签约10个产业项目，涵盖特色农业、文旅开发等领域。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 20, Gaoyou, Jiangsu held a promotion conference in Ningbo to boost agricultural, cultural and tourism integration, signing 10 industrial projects covering agriculture, tourism and supply chain.

tags.name_en: Integration of Agriculture, Culture and Tourism

tags_en: Integration of Agriculture, Culture and Tourism

articles.title_zh: 淮安市淮安区今年前7月签约亿元项目59个
articles.title_en: Huai'an District Signs 59 Projects of 100 Million Yuan Each in First 7 Months
articles.summary_zh: 淮安市淮安区近日举办智能制造产业链大赛并现场签约3个科创项目；今年1-7月新签约亿元项目59个，新开工20个，重大项目提速提质。
articles.summary_en: Huai'an District recently held a smart manufacturing chain competition and signed 3 projects on site. From Jan to Jul, it signed 59 projects worth over 100 million yuan each and started 20 major projects.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏与哈工大启动青年工程师联合培养
articles.title_en: Ningxia and Harbin Institute of Technology Launch Joint Training for Young Engineers
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，宁夏回族自治区与哈尔滨工业大学在银川召开青年工程师培养启动会议，自2026年起每年选派优秀青年骨干赴哈工大访学研修。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region and Harbin Institute of Technology held a kickoff meeting in Yinchuan to launch a joint training program, sending outstanding young engineers to HIT for study and research from 2026.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏银川召开全市服务业大会
articles.title_en: Yinchuan, Ningxia Holds Citywide Service Industry Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，宁夏银川市召开全市服务业大会，部署“十五五”时期服务业高质量发展，加快建设“一区两地五中心”。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Yinchuan, Ningxia held a citywide service industry conference to advance high-quality development of the service sector during the 15th Five-Year Plan period and build 'one zone, two bases, five centers'.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”时期 以更大力度推动西宁—海东都市圈一体化发展实现新突破
articles.title_en: Qinghai to Boost Xining-Haidong Metropolitan Area Integration in 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，青海省发展改革委在“开局起步十五五”系列发布会上介绍，“十四五”时期西宁—海东都市圈一体化成效凸显，“十五五”时期将从五方面重点发力。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 20, the Qinghai Provincial Development and Reform Commission said at a press conference that the Xining-Haidong metropolitan area made significant integration progress during the 14th Five-Year Plan period, and outlined five key areas for the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 四川省纪委监委：2人被查
articles.title_en: Sichuan Discipline Inspection Commission: Two Officials Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 昨日，四川省纪委监委发布消息，成都城建投资管理集团副总经理宋博文、四川华西海外投资建设有限公司总经理王建忠涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: The Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection announced the investigation of two officials - Song Bowen, deputy general manager of Chengdu Urban Construction Investment Management Group, and Wang Jianzhong, general manager of Sichuan Huaxi Overseas Investment Construction Co., Ltd. - for suspected serious disciplinary violations.

tags.name_en: Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection

tags_en: Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection

articles.title_zh: 让数据跨境流动又快又好
articles.title_en: Making Cross-Border Data Flow Faster and Better
articles.summary_zh: 上海自贸试验区临港新片区推进数据跨境流动制度创新，优化备案和负面清单管理，吸引外资并发展数字文化出海产业。
articles.summary_en: Shanghai's Lingang New Area promotes institutional innovation in cross-border data flow, optimizing filing and negative list management to attract foreign investment and develop digital cultural export industries.

articles.title_zh: 西康高铁启动按图试运行
articles.title_en: Xi'an-Ankang High-Speed Railway Starts Trial Runs
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，西康高铁正式进入按图试运行阶段，西安至安康铁路运行时间将缩短至1小时以内，助力秦巴山区乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, the Xi'an-Ankang high-speed railway entered trial runs, cutting travel time between the two cities to under one hour and boosting rural revitalization in the Qinba Mountains.

articles.title_zh: 不负“日光”
articles.title_en: Living Up to the Sunlight
articles.summary_zh: 文章介绍西藏利用丰富日照资源发展光伏、农业、文旅等特色产业，探索“日光经济”新路径。
articles.summary_en: The article explores how Tibet leverages its abundant sunshine to develop photovoltaic, agriculture, cultural tourism and other distinctive industries, exploring a 'sunlight economy'.

articles.title_zh: 云南省政府召开党组会议常务会议
articles.title_en: Yunnan Provincial Government Holds Party Group and Executive Meetings
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，云南省政府党组书记、省长王予波主持召开省政府党组会议和常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，研究部署经济等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Yunnan Governor Wang Yubo chaired the provincial government's Party group and executive meetings, conveying Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and studying economic and related work.

articles.title_zh: 交通运输部：加快推进人工智能与交通运输深度融合
articles.title_en: Transport Ministry Accelerates Deep Integration of AI and Transport
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，交通运输部举行专题新闻发布会，介绍“人工智能+交通运输”典型应用场景创新行动有关情况，表示将加快推进人工智能与交通运输深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, the Ministry of Transport held a press conference to introduce the typical application scenario innovation action for 'AI + transportation', vowing to accelerate deep integration of AI and transport.

articles.title_zh: 商务部：反对欧方滥用单边工具打压中国企业
articles.title_en: Ministry of Commerce Opposes EU's Abusive Use of Unilateral Tools to Suppress Chinese Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 商务部新闻发言人何亚东表示，反对欧方滥用单边工具打压中国企业，中方已依法认定相关调查构成不当域外管辖措施。
articles.summary_en: He Yadong, spokesperson for the Ministry of Commerce, said China opposes the EU's abusive use of unilateral tools to suppress Chinese companies, and has legally deemed relevant investigation practices as improper extraterritorial jurisdiction.

articles.title_zh: 陈新武：奋战三季度攻坚下半年 确保“十五五”良好开局
articles.title_en: Chen Xinwu Chairs Chongqing Municipal Government Meeting on Economic Growth
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日下午，重庆市市长陈新武主持召开市政府第八次全体会议，强调奋战三季度、攻坚下半年，全力拼经济促发展，确保“十五五”良好开局。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 19, Chongqing Mayor Chen Xinwu chaired the eighth plenary meeting of the municipal government, emphasizing efforts to boost the economy in Q3 and H2 to ensure a good start for the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚主持召开自治区党委书记专题会议 研究广西算力建设工作
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Chairs Regional Party Committee Meeting on Guangxi's Computing Power Construction
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚主持召开书记专题会议，研究广西算力建设工作，提出打造面向东盟的人工智能国际合作高地。
articles.summary_en: On Aug. 18, Chen Gang, Secretary of the CPC Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Regional Committee, chaired a special meeting to study computing power construction in Guangxi, aiming to build an international AI cooperation hub facing ASEAN.

articles.title_zh: 省委理论学习中心组举行集体学习研讨
articles.title_en: Henan Provincial Party Committee Holds Theoretical Study Session on Grassroots Governance
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，河南省委理论学习中心组举行集体学习研讨，省委书记刘宁主持并讲话，强调深化党建引领基层高效能治理，推动基层工作提质提效。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, the Henan Provincial Party Committee's Theoretical Study Center Group held a collective study session. Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning presided and stressed deepening Party building to improve grassroots governance efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 1至7月湖南经济延续向优向新发展态势
articles.title_en: Hunan Economy Continues Improving in First 7 Months
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，湖南省统计局发布数据，1至7月全省经济运行总体平稳，规模工业增加值同比增长2.6%，装备制造业和高技术制造业增速加快。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 19, Hunan Provincial Bureau of Statistics reported steady economic performance in first 7 months, with industrial value-added up 2.6% and faster growth in equipment and high-tech manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 湖南省市场监管局召开行业协会商会收费专项检查工作推进会
articles.title_en: Hunan Market Supervision Bureau Holds Meeting on Special Inspection of Charges by Industry Associations and Chambers of Commerce
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，湖南省市场监管局召开行业协会商会收费专项检查工作推进会，明确“八必须八严禁”和“345”工作方案，以规范收费秩序、减轻企业负担、优化营商环境。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Hunan Provincial Market Supervision Administration convened a meeting to advance special inspections on charges by industry associations and chambers of commerce, setting rules and a work plan to reduce corporate burdens and improve the business environment.

articles.title_zh: 各地水利部门多措并举度汛观察
articles.title_en: Water Resources Departments Nationwide Take Multiple Measures for Flood Season
articles.summary_zh: 今年汛期我国多地遭遇暴雨台风，各级水利部门运用科技手段、完善机制、加强值守，全力防汛抗洪。
articles.summary_en: This year's flood season saw heavy rains and typhoons across China; water resources departments at all levels used technology, improved mechanisms, and strengthened duty to fight floods.

articles.title_zh: 第七届中非媒体合作论坛在京开幕 发布深化广电视听交流合作宣言
articles.title_en: 7th China-Africa Media Cooperation Forum Opens in Beijing, Releases Declaration on Deepening Radio and TV Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 第七届中非媒体合作论坛20日在北京开幕，发布共同宣言深化广电视听交流合作。中非双方约400名代表参会，其中33位非洲国家部级嘉宾创历届新高。
articles.summary_en: The 7th China-Africa Media Cooperation Forum opened in Beijing on Aug 20, releasing a joint declaration to deepen radio and TV exchanges and cooperation. About 400 delegates from China and 45 African countries attended, including 33 ministerial-level guests, a record high.

articles.title_zh: 两部门发文推动服务类社会救助发展
articles.title_en: Two Ministries Issue Document to Promote Development of Service-Based Social Assistance
articles.summary_zh: 民政部、财政部近日联合印发《关于积极发展服务类社会救助的指导意见》，推动社会救助由单一物质救助向“物质+服务”综合模式转变。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Civil Affairs and the Ministry of Finance jointly issued a guidance document to promote service-based social assistance, shifting from material aid to a comprehensive "material + service" model.

articles.title_zh: 又有2244个建制村实现“快递进村”
articles.title_en: 2,244 More Villages Gain Express Delivery Access
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，国家邮政局表示，“快递进村”专项试点启动以来，截至7月底，17个试点县新增2244个建制村实现快递进村。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, the State Post Bureau said that since the pilot program, 2,244 villages across 17 pilot counties had gained express delivery services by the end of July.

articles.title_zh: 交通运输部：以人工智能推动安全治理从“事后处置”转向“事前预警”
articles.title_en: Ministry of Transport: AI Drives Safety Governance Shift from Post-incident Response to Pre-warning
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，交通运输部举行专题新闻发布会，科技司司长徐文强表示要以人工智能推动安全治理从“事后处置”转向“事前预警”。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 20, the Ministry of Transport held a press conference; Xu Wenqiang, director of the Science and Technology Department, said AI should shift safety governance from post-incident handling to advance warning.

articles.title_zh: 工业和信息化部再次批复开展卫星物联网业务商用试验
articles.title_en: MIIT Again Approves Commercial Trials for Satellite IoT Services
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部日前批复浙江时空道宇科技有限公司开展卫星物联网业务商用试验，试验期两年，进一步扩大向民营开放。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology recently approved Zhejiang SpaceTime Doyu Technology Co. to carry out two-year commercial trials for satellite IoT services, further opening the business to private enterprises.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 葛慧君在泰安市调研
articles.title_en: Ge Huijun Conducts Research in Tai'an
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日至19日，山东省政协主席葛慧君到泰安新泰市、宁阳县调研县域经济发展和政协工作。
articles.summary_en: From August 18 to 19, Ge Huijun, chairwoman of the Shandong Provincial CPPCC, visited Xintai and Ningyang in Tai'an to research county economy and CPPCC work.

articles.title_zh: 天津市政府召开第113次常务会议 张工主持
articles.title_en: Tianjin Municipal Government Holds 113th Executive Meeting Chaired by Zhang Gong
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日下午，天津市市长张工主持召开市政府第113次常务会议，听取安全生产情况，审议应急管理“十五五”规划等。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 19, Mayor Zhang Gong chaired the 113th executive meeting of Tianjin Municipal Government, reviewing work safety and deliberating the 15th Five-Year Plan for emergency management and fire services.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷在湖州长兴检查指导灾后恢复工作 强调有力有序有效推进灾后恢复
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Inspects Post-Disaster Recovery in Changxing, Huzhou
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，浙江省委副书记、省长刘捷赴湖州市长兴县看望慰问受灾群众并检查指导灾后恢复工作，强调要总结经验、补齐短板，提高防灾减灾救灾能力。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Liu Jie, Deputy Secretary of CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee and Governor of Zhejiang, visited Changxing County in Huzhou to comfort affected residents and inspect post-disaster recovery, urging efforts to enhance disaster prevention and response capabilities.

articles.title_zh: 近期货车肇事导致的群死群伤事故多发 公安部交管局发布提醒
articles.title_en: Traffic Management Bureau Issues Warning as Truck Accidents Cause Multiple Casualties
articles.summary_zh: 公安部交管局发布提醒，近期多地接连发生货车肇事导致群死群伤事故，提示货车司机遵规守法、文明驾驶。
articles.summary_en: The Traffic Management Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security issued a warning after a series of deadly truck accidents in several regions, urging truck drivers to obey traffic laws and drive safely.

tags.name_en: Traffic Management Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security

tags_en: Traffic Management Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security

articles.title_zh: 中国首次实现重复使用运载火箭陆地回收
articles.title_en: China Achieves First Land Recovery of Reusable Carrier Rocket
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，朱雀三号运载火箭在东风商业航天创新试验区成功发射，实现中国首次重复使用运载火箭陆地可控回收。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 19, the Zhuque-3 rocket launched from Dongfeng Commercial Aerospace Innovation Experimental Zone, achieving China's first controlled land recovery of a reusable rocket booster.

articles.title_zh: 不锈钢也能造火箭？能！中美两国都选它
articles.title_en: Stainless Steel Rockets? Yes! Both China and US Choose It
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，朱雀三号运载火箭在东风商业航天创新试验区成功发射并着陆回收，成为中国首款入轨并实现陆地回收的不锈钢运载火箭。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 19, the Zhuque-3 rocket launched from Dongfeng Commercial Space Innovation Test Zone and successfully landed, becoming China's first stainless steel rocket to reach orbit and recover on land.

articles.title_zh: 《给阿嬷的情书》在桃园“特别放映”爆火，为何仍无缘台湾院线？
articles.title_en: 'A Letter to Grandma' Wins Audiences in Taoyuan But Remains Absent from Taiwan Cinemas
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月15日至16日，大陆电影《给阿嬷的情书》在桃园电影节“特别放映”单元展映，反响热烈、门票抢空，引发岛内对放宽大陆电影准入的呼吁。
articles.summary_en: Mainland Chinese film "A Letter to Grandma" was warmly received at special screenings during the 2026 Taoyuan Film Festival on Aug 15-16, with tickets selling out rapidly, prompting calls to relax restrictions on mainland films in Taiwan.

articles.title_zh: 嫦娥七号飞行任务器箭组合体完成垂直转运 计划近日择机实施发射
articles.title_en: Chang'e-7 Spacecraft-Rocket Combination Completes Vertical Transfer, Launch Planned Soon
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，嫦娥七号探测器和长征五号遥十四运载火箭在文昌航天发射场完成垂直转运至发射区，计划近日择机发射。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 19, the Chang'e-7 probe and Long March-5 Y14 rocket completed vertical transfer to the launch pad at Wenchang Space Launch Site, with launch planned soon.

articles.title_zh: 国台办：赖清德假民主真独裁 恶名远扬
articles.title_en: Taiwan Affairs Office: Lai Ching-te's Fake Democracy, True Dictatorship Is Notorious
articles.summary_zh: 国台办发言人朱凤莲批评赖清德顽固坚持“台独”分裂立场，挑起政治恶斗，打压异己，加剧台湾社会内耗撕裂。
articles.summary_en: Zhu Fenglian, spokesperson for the Taiwan Affairs Office, criticized Lai Ching-te for stubbornly adhering to separatist stance, inciting political strife, suppressing dissent, and intensifying social division in Taiwan.

articles.title_zh: 国台办回应陆配徐春莺被判刑7年
articles.title_en: Taiwan Affairs Office Responds to Mainland Spouse Xu Chunying's 7-Year Sentence
articles.summary_zh: 国台办发言人朱凤莲就陆配徐春莺被判刑7年回应，谴责民进党当局以安全理由起诉是司法迫害，支持两岸婚姻家庭维护权益。
articles.summary_en: Zhu Fenglian, spokesperson for the Taiwan Affairs Office, responded to the 7-year sentence of mainland spouse Xu Chunying, condemning DPP authorities for judicial persecution and supporting cross-strait marriage families.

articles.title_zh: 台陆委会妄称民众进出大陆会有风险 国台办回应
articles.title_en: Taiwan Affairs Office Rebuts Risk Claims on Mainland Travel
articles.summary_zh: 国台办发言人朱凤莲回应台陆委会言论，驳斥所谓风险论，强调台湾民众来大陆安全合法，并批评民进党当局阻挠两岸交流。
articles.summary_en: Zhu Fenglian, spokesperson for the State Council Taiwan Affairs Office, dismissed the Taiwan Affairs Council's claims of risks for Taiwan residents visiting the mainland, stressing legal protection and criticizing the DPP authorities for obstructing cross-strait exchanges.

articles.title_zh: 台陆委会称其工作是“抵御中共统战” 国台办回应
articles.title_en: Taiwan Affairs Office Responds to MAC's Claim of 'Resisting CPC United Front'
articles.summary_zh: 国台办发言人朱凤莲回应台陆委会‘抵御中共统战’言论，强调统战是大团结大联合，民进党当局歪曲抹黑、阻挠两岸交流，必将遭到台湾民众反对。
articles.summary_en: Taiwan Affairs Office spokesperson Zhu Fenglian refuted the MAC's 'resisting united front' claim, saying united front is for unity, and DPP's distortion will be rejected by Taiwanese people.

articles.title_zh: 台湾观众希望《八仙！》《欢迎来龙餐馆》早日在岛内上映 国台办回应
articles.title_en: Taiwan Audiences Hope Films 'Eight Immortals!' and 'Welcome to Dragon Restaurant' Release Soon; Taiwan Affairs Office Responds
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，国务院台办例行新闻发布会上，发言人朱凤莲回应台湾观众期待大陆影片上映，表示支持两岸影视交流，希望相关影片尽快在台湾上映。
articles.summary_en: At a regular press conference on Aug 19, spokesperson Zhu Fenglian responded to Taiwan audiences' expectations for mainland films, expressing support for cross-strait film exchanges and hoping the films will be released in Taiwan soon.

articles.title_zh: 国台办回应台湾同胞反对“台独”勾连日本
articles.title_en: Taiwan Affairs Office Responds to Taiwanese Compatriots' Opposition to 'Taiwan Independence' Collusion with Japan
articles.summary_zh: 国台办发言人朱凤莲表示，赞赏台湾统派团体纪念抗战胜利和台湾光复、反对“台独”勾连日本的正义行动，谴责民进党当局背叛民族历史。
articles.summary_en: Spokesperson Zhu Fenglian praised Taiwanese groups for commemorating the victory in the War of Resistance and opposing Taiwan independence collusion with Japan, while condemning the DPP authorities.

articles.title_zh: 民进党当局封锁“台青e家” 国台办：本质是惧怕种种抹黑大陆的谎言被戳穿
articles.title_en: Taiwan Affairs Office: DPP's Blocking of 'Taiwan Youth e-Home' Shows Fear of Lies Being Exposed
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，国务院台办发言人朱凤莲回应民进党当局封锁“台青e家”平台，指责其恶意抹黑、惧怕谎言被戳穿。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 19, State Council Taiwan Affairs Office spokesperson Zhu Fenglian responded to the DPP authorities' blocking of the 'Taiwan Youth e-Home' platform, accusing them of malicious slander and fear of being exposed.

articles.title_zh: 国台办介绍国共两党青年双向交流机制化平台情况
articles.title_en: Taiwan Affairs Office Briefs on Institutionalized CCP-KMT Youth Exchange Platform
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，国台办例行发布会介绍，为落实习近平总书记会见中国国民党主席郑丽文讲话精神，已建立国共两党青年双向交流机制化平台。8月24日至28日将在上海举办两岸青年交流季活动。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 19, the State Council's Taiwan Affairs Office briefed on the institutionalized CCP-KMT youth exchange platform following Xi Jinping's meeting with KMT chair. Activities will be held in Shanghai Aug 24-28.

articles.title_zh: 国台办发言人七夕祝福两岸有情人
articles.title_en: Taiwan Affairs Office Spokesperson Sends Qixi Festival Blessings to Cross-Strait Couples
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，国务院台办例行新闻发布会上，发言人朱凤莲祝愿两岸有情人终成眷属，并介绍第五届海峡两岸七夕牵手会在厦门举办。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 19, at the State Council Taiwan Affairs Office regular press conference, spokesperson Zhu Fenglian wished cross-strait couples happiness and announced the 5th Cross-Strait Qixi Gathering in Xiamen.

articles.title_zh: 李永金同志逝世
articles.title_en: Li Yongjin Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 原北京军区副司令员兼空军司令员李永金因病于8月6日在北京逝世，享年84岁。
articles.summary_en: Li Yongjin, retired deputy military region commander and former head of Beijing Military Region Air Force, died of illness in Beijing at 84 on Aug 6.

articles.title_zh: 中国民营航天首次实现火箭入轨回收
articles.title_en: China's Private Space Sector Achieves First Orbital Rocket Recovery
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，朱雀三号运载火箭在东风商业航天创新试验区实现一子级回收，成为中国首型成功回收的民营运载火箭。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, the Zhuque-3 rocket launched at the Dongfeng Commercial Aerospace Innovation Test Zone and its first stage landed successfully, making it China's first recoverable private launch vehicle.

articles.title_zh: 专家详解“同病同付”政策：推动形成有序就医格局
articles.title_en: Experts Explain 'Same Disease, Same Payment' Policy: Promoting Orderly Medical Treatment
articles.summary_zh: 国家卫健委专家任静详解“同病同付”政策，表示该政策旨在推动有序就医，提升基层服务能力，不影响患者费用。
articles.summary_en: Ren Jing, an expert from the National Health Commission, explains the 'same disease, same payment' policy, aiming to promote orderly medical treatment and improve primary healthcare capacity without affecting patient costs.

articles.title_zh: 嫦娥七号器箭组合体完成垂直转运
articles.title_en: Chang'e-7 Spacecraft and Rocket Assembly Completes Vertical Transport
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，嫦娥七号器箭组合体垂直转运至发射区，计划近日择机实施发射。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, the Chang'e-7 spacecraft and rocket assembly was vertically transported to the launch area, with launch planned in the coming days.

articles.title_zh: 公布《国务院关于修改〈住房公积金管理条例〉的决定》
articles.title_en: State Council Publishes Decision to Amend Housing Provident Fund Management Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强签署国务院令，公布修改后的《住房公积金管理条例》，拓宽提取范围、简化手续，自2026年9月20日起施行。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council order to publish amendments to the Regulations on Housing Provident Fund Management, expanding withdrawal scope and simplifying procedures, effective from September 20, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 民族地区家庭学用国家通用语言文字展示活动举办
articles.title_en: Event Held to Showcase Ethnic Minority Families' Learning and Use of National Common Language
articles.summary_zh: 近日，教育部、国家语委联合全国妇联、国家民委在新疆举办“传承好家风 共筑家国梦”民族地区家庭学用国家通用语言文字展示活动，旨在提高民族地区家庭使用国家通用语言文字的能力。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Ministry of Education, the State Language Commission, together with the All-China Women's Federation and the National Ethnic Affairs Commission, held an event in Xinjiang to showcase ethnic minority families' learning and use of the national common language, aiming to enhance their language skills.

articles.title_zh: 国务院发布修订后的《住房公积金管理条例》
articles.title_en: State Council Issues Revised Regulations on Housing Provident Fund Management
articles.summary_zh: 国务院发布第三次修订后的《住房公积金管理条例》，自发布之日起施行，扩大提取情形，支持灵活就业人员自愿缴存。
articles.summary_en: The State Council issued the revised Regulations on Housing Provident Fund Management, effective upon publication, expanding withdrawal conditions and allowing flexible employment workers to voluntarily contribute.

articles.title_zh: 智能技术赋能古老灌区
articles.title_en: Smart Technology Empowers Ancient Irrigation District
articles.summary_zh: 宁夏青铜峡灌区现代化改造工程采用预制拼装和数字化技术，实现节水增效，让古老灌区焕发新活力。
articles.summary_en: The modernization project of Qingtongxia Irrigation District in Ningxia adopts prefabricated assembly and digital technology to save water and improve efficiency, revitalizing the ancient irrigation area.

articles.title_zh: 赵乐际主持召开十四届全国人大常委会第七十一次委员长会议
articles.title_en: Zhao Leji Chairs 71st Meeting of 14th NPC Standing Committee Chairmen's Council
articles.summary_zh: 十四届全国人大常委会第七十一次委员长会议18日上午在北京举行，赵乐际主持会议。会议决定十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议8月25日至28日在京举行，并建议审议多部法律草案。
articles.summary_en: The 71st Chairmen's Council meeting of the 14th NPC Standing Committee was held in Beijing on the morning of Aug 18, chaired by Zhao Leji. It decided to hold the 24th NPC Standing Committee session in Beijing from Aug 25 to 28, and proposed reviewing several draft laws.

articles.title_zh: 财政部、应急管理部再次预拨6000万元中央自然灾害救灾资金
articles.title_en: Ministries Allocate Additional 60 Million Yuan for Disaster Relief in Henan
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，财政部、应急管理部再次预拨6000万元中央自然灾害救灾资金，支持河南防汛应急抢险救灾，保障受灾群众基本生活。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Emergency Management allocated another 60 million yuan in central disaster relief funds to support flood control and emergency rescue in Henan, ensuring basic living standards for affected residents.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Ecuadorian President Noboa
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日下午，国家主席习近平在北京人民大会堂同厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚举行会谈，双方见证签署多项合作文件。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 18, President Xi Jinping held talks with Ecuadorian President Noboa at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, witnessing the signing of multiple cooperation documents.

articles.title_zh: 吉林粮食品牌发展大会在长春举行 胡玉亭出席并致辞
articles.title_en: Jilin Grain Brand Development Conference Held in Changchun; Governor Hu Yuting Delivers Speech
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，吉林粮食品牌发展大会在长春举行，省长胡玉亭出席并致辞，强调打造万亿级农产品加工业，推动粮食产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, the Jilin Grain Brand Development Conference was held in Changchun. Governor Hu Yuting attended and delivered a speech, emphasizing building a trillion-yuan agricultural product processing industry and promoting high-quality development of the grain sector.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 牢固树立和践行正确政绩观 以扎实工作成效兑现为民承诺
articles.title_en: Changchun Party Committee Meeting Emphasizes Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，市委书记张恩惠主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要批示精神，研究部署全市重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Zhang Enhui, Secretary of the Changchun Municipal Party Committee, chaired a Standing Committee meeting to convey and study important speeches and instructions of General Secretary Xi Jinping and deploy key municipal work.

articles.title_zh: 王新伟主持召开省政府全体扩大会议
articles.title_en: Wang Xinwei Chairs Liaoning Provincial Government Plenary Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，辽宁省委副书记、省长王新伟主持召开省政府第十一次全体扩大会议，部署下半年经济工作，强调完成全年目标任务，实现“十五五”良好开局。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Wang Xinwei, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee and Governor, chaired the 11th plenary meeting of the provincial government, deploying work for the second half of the year and stressing achieving annual targets and a good start for the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 沈阳市委常委会召开会议研究县域经济发展等工作
articles.title_en: Shenyang Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting on County Economy Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，沈阳市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究侨务工作、纪检监察和县域经济发展等事项，市委书记霍步刚主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the Standing Committee of the Shenyang Municipal Party Committee met to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions, focusing on overseas Chinese affairs, discipline inspection, and county economy. Party Secretary Huo Bugang presided over the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见中国石化董事长侯启军
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet with Sinopec Chairman Hou Qijun
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见中国石化董事长侯启军，双方就深化合作、推动石化产业转型及绿色低碳发展进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei met with Sinopec Chairman Hou Qijun in Shenyang to discuss deepening cooperation, refining industry transformation, and green low-carbon development.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议 许昆林主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Standing Committee Meets, Xu Kunlin Presides and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，辽宁省委常委会召开会议，省委书记许昆林主持并讲话，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和重要指示精神，研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, the Standing Committee of the Liaoning Provincial Party Committee held a meeting, presided over by Secretary Xu Kunlin, to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions, and to discuss implementation plans.

articles.title_zh: 沈阳市委召开专题会议 一刻不停优化营商环境 为实现全面振兴提供坚实支撑
articles.title_en: Shenyang Party Committee Holds Special Meeting on Business Environment Optimization
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，沈阳市委召开专题会议，市委书记霍步刚主持并讲话，强调一刻不停优化营商环境，为实现全面振兴提供支撑。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 18, Shenyang Municipal Party Committee held a special meeting chaired by Secretary Huo Bugang, emphasizing continuous improvement of the business environment to support comprehensive revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 唐毅会见沙师弟（重庆）网络科技有限公司董事长王植一行
articles.title_en: Tang Yi Meets Wang Zhi, Chairman of Shashidi (Chongqing) Network Technology Co., Ltd.
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，赤峰市委书记唐毅会见沙师弟（重庆）网络科技有限公司董事长王植一行，双方就现代物流产业合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 19, Tang Yi, Party Secretary of Chifeng, met with Wang Zhi, chairman of Shashidi (Chongqing) Network Technology, and his delegation to discuss cooperation in modern logistics.

articles.title_zh: 中老铁路货物运输突破9000万吨
articles.title_en: China-Laos Railway Cargo Transport Exceeds 90 Million Tons
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，中老铁路全线累计运输货物突破9000万吨，其中跨境货物超2100万吨，累计开行货物列车超8万列。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the China-Laos Railway surpassed 90 million tons of cumulative cargo transport, including over 21 million tons of cross-border cargo, with over 80,000 freight trains operated.

articles.title_zh: 李强会见厄瓜多尔总统
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets with Ecuadorian President
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强19日在京会见来华进行国事访问的厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚，双方就深化合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang met with Ecuadorian President Noboa, who is on a state visit to China, in Beijing on the 19th. The two sides exchanged views on deepening cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 谌贻琴调研第20届亚运会备战工作时强调 全力做好备战参赛工作 为建设体育强国再立新功
articles.title_en: Shen Yiqin Inspects Asian Games Preparation, Urges Full Effort for Sporting Power
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，国务委员谌贻琴到体育总局训练局调研名古屋亚运会备战工作，看望慰问运动员教练员，强调全力备战，为体育强国再立新功。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, State Councilor Shen Yiqin visited the training bureau of the General Administration of Sport in Beijing to inspect Nagoya Asian Games preparations, encouraging athletes and coaches to strive for excellence and contribute to building a sporting power.

articles.title_zh: 刘国中在天津调研时强调 建设优质高效医疗服务体系 更好满足人民群众健康需求
articles.title_en: Liu Guozhong Visits Tianjin, Stresses Building High-Quality Medical Service System
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理刘国中在天津调研，强调建设优质高效医疗服务体系，推动脑机接口等卫生健康领域新质生产力发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Liu Guozhong, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, visited Tianjin to stress building a high-quality medical service system and advancing new quality productive forces in health like brain-computer interfaces.

articles.title_zh: 各地做好田间管理 夯实粮食丰收基础
articles.title_en: Localities Strengthen Field Management to Solidify Foundation for Grain Harvest
articles.summary_zh: 全国秋粮进入产量形成关键期，各地抢抓农时开展智慧灌溉、绿色防控、雨后管护等田间管理，全力夯实稳产丰产基础。
articles.summary_en: As autumn grain enters key yield formation period, local governments nationwide are intensifying field management using smart irrigation, green pest control, and post-rain recovery measures to secure a stable harvest.

articles.title_zh: 上半年机械工业规上企业增加值增长6.4%
articles.title_en: China's Machinery Industry Value-Added Up 6.4% in H1
articles.summary_zh: 据中国机械工业联合会数据，上半年机械工业规上企业增加值同比增长6.4%，出口额5593.3亿美元，智能设备制造等行业增长显著。
articles.summary_en: In H1, value-added of China's machinery industry above designated size rose 6.4% year on year, with exports reaching $559.33 billion; smart equipment manufacturing grew strongly.

articles.title_zh: 王毅同智利外长佩雷斯会谈
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Holds Talks with Chilean Foreign Minister Perez
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅19日在北京同智利外长佩雷斯举行会谈，就深化中智关系及APEC合作等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, held talks with Chilean Foreign Minister Perez in Beijing, exchanging views on deepening bilateral ties and APEC cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 今年前7月国家铁路发送货物23.5亿吨
articles.title_en: National Railway Freight Volume Reaches 2.35 Billion Tons in First 7 Months
articles.summary_zh: 2026年1至7月，国家铁路累计发送货物23.5亿吨，同比增长0.7%，为降低全社会物流成本、保障国民经济运行提供支撑。
articles.summary_en: China's national railway transported 2.35 billion tons of cargo from January to July 2026, up 0.7% year-on-year, supporting logistics cost reduction and economic stability.

articles.title_zh: 王毅将访问韩国、印尼
articles.title_en: Wang Yi to Visit South Korea and Indonesia
articles.summary_zh: 外交部发言人19日宣布，应韩国外长赵显、印尼外长苏吉约诺邀请，王毅将于8月19日至22日访问韩国、印尼，并主持中印尼全面战略对话机制首次会议。
articles.summary_en: Foreign Ministry spokesman announced on Aug 19 that Wang Yi will visit South Korea and Indonesia from Aug 19 to 22 at the invitation of their foreign ministers, and will chair the first meeting of the China-Indonesia Comprehensive Strategic Dialogue.

articles.title_zh: 何立峰会见智利外长佩雷斯
articles.title_en: He Lifeng Meets with Chilean Foreign Minister Perez
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理何立峰在北京人民大会堂会见智利外长佩雷斯，双方就深化中智关系与务实合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, He Lifeng, member of the CPC Central Political Bureau and Vice Premier, met with Chilean Foreign Minister Perez at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing to discuss deepening bilateral relations and practical cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 李生潜主持召开五届市政府第118次常务会议
articles.title_en: Li Shengqian Chairs the 118th Executive Meeting of Dingxi Municipal Government
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，定西市委副书记、代市长李生潜主持召开五届市政府第118次常务会议，研究分析全市1-7月经济运行形势，部署政府系统落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Li Shengqian, deputy secretary of the Dingxi Municipal Party Committee and acting mayor, chaired the 118th executive meeting of the municipal government to analyze the city's economic performance from January to July and arrange follow-up work.

articles.title_zh: 李强签署国务院令 公布《国务院关于修改〈住房公积金管理条例〉的决定》
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Order to Amend Housing Provident Fund Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强日前签署国务院令，公布修改住房公积金管理条例的决定，自2026年9月20日起施行，拓宽提取使用范围、提升管理服务效能。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council order to amend the Housing Provident Fund Management Regulations, effective Sept 20, 2026, expanding withdrawal and use scope and improving management efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见中国石化董事长侯启军
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet Sinopec Chairman Hou Qijun
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见中国石化董事长侯启军一行，就深化合作、推动石化产业转型升级和绿色低碳发展进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 18, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei met Sinopec Chairman Hou Qijun in Shenyang to discuss deeper cooperation and green transformation of the petrochemical industry.

articles.title_zh: 王新伟主持召开省政府第十一次全体扩大会议
articles.title_en: Wang Xinwei Chairs Expanded Meeting of Liaoning Provincial Government
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，省委副书记、省长王新伟主持召开省政府第十一次全体扩大会议，强调全力完成全年目标任务，努力实现“十五五”良好开局。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 18, Wang Xinwei, governor of Liaoning, chaired the 11th expanded plenary of the provincial government, urging all-out efforts to complete yearly targets and start the 15th Five-Year Plan well.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱调研卫生健康工作并向医务工作者致以节日问候
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Investigates Health Work and Extends Festival Greetings to Medical Workers
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日中国医师节，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱调研基层卫生机构，慰问一线医务人员，强调提升医疗服务质效。
articles.summary_en: On the Chinese Doctors' Day, Hegang Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu visited grassroots health institutions, greeted frontline medical workers, and stressed improving medical services.

articles.title_zh: 邓维元采取“四不两直”方式深入市商务局和市经济合作服务中心调研
articles.title_en: Deng Weiyuan Conducts Unannounced Inspection of Municipal Commerce Bureau and Economic Cooperation Service Center
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，鹤岗市委副书记、市长邓维元采取“四不两直”方式到市商务局和市经济合作服务中心调研，强调优化营商环境，推动商务贸易高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Deng Weiyuan, deputy secretary of the Hegang Municipal Party Committee and mayor, conducted an unannounced inspection of the Municipal Commerce Bureau and Economic Cooperation Service Center, stressing improving the business environment and promoting high-quality development of commerce and trade.
