articles.title_zh: 淮安市政府专题推进物业管理服务提质增效
articles.title_en: Huai'an Municipal Government Special Meeting on Improving Property Management Services
articles.summary_zh: 近日，淮安市政府召开物业管理服务突出问题专项整治暨物业提质增效现场推进会，市长顾坤强调要持续推动物业管理服务提质增效。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Huai'an Municipal Government held a site meeting on special rectification of property management issues and improvement, where Mayor Gu Kun stressed continuous efforts to enhance property services.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市政府专题推进物业管理服务提质增效
articles.title_en: Huaian Municipal Government Holds On-site Meeting to Improve Property Management Services
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，淮安市市长顾坤主持召开物业管理服务突出问题专项整治暨物业提质增效现场推进会，并赴多个小区督导检查，强调持续推动物业管理服务提质增效。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Huaian Mayor Gu Kun chaired an on-site meeting on special rectification of property management services and visited communities to push for quality and efficiency improvements.

articles.title_zh: 市委书记史志军调研大运河沿线生态环境治理工作
articles.title_en: Huai'an Party Secretary Inspects Grand Canal Ecological Environment Improvement
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，淮安市委书记史志军调研大运河沿线生态环境治理工作，强调坚持生态优先、绿色发展，以高水平生态保护支撑高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Shi Zhijun, Party Secretary of Huai'an, inspected ecological environment improvement along the Grand Canal, stressing ecological priority and green development to support high-quality growth.

articles.title_zh: 史志军调研大运河沿线生态环境治理工作
articles.title_en: Shi Zhijun Inspects Ecological Environment Governance along Grand Canal
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，淮安市委书记史志军调研大运河沿线生态环境治理工作，强调生态优先、绿色发展，实地察看船闸工程、生态农业和水域修复项目。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Shi Zhijun, Secretary of Huai'an Municipal Party Committee, inspected ecological environment governance along the Grand Canal, emphasizing ecological priority and green development, and visited projects on ship locks, eco-agriculture and water restoration.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡在调研督导文明创建工作时强调聚焦短板抓整改 精细治理促提升
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Inspects Civilized City Creation Work, Stresses Targeted Rectification and Refined Governance
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日上午，淮北市委副书记、代市长黄韡赴相山区调研督导文明创建工作，强调聚焦短板抓整改，提升城市功能品质。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 19, Huang Wei, deputy secretary of the CPC Huaibei Municipal Committee and acting mayor, visited Xiangshan District to inspect civilized city creation work, stressing targeted rectification and refined urban governance.

articles.title_zh: 科产融合，赋能制造业转型升级
articles.title_en: Integrating Science and Industry to Empower Manufacturing Transformation and Upgrading
articles.summary_zh: 淮南市坚持工业立市，推动制造业向智能化、集群化转型升级，通过数智改造、揭榜挂帅等举措，培育专精特新企业，促进产业生态优化。
articles.summary_en: Huainan City adheres to building a strong industrial city, promoting the transformation and upgrading of manufacturing towards intelligence and clustering through digital transformation and open competition mechanisms, fostering specialized and innovative enterprises and optimizing the industrial ecosystem.

articles.title_zh: 情暖残疾学子 以奋斗书写青春华章
articles.title_en: Warm Care for Disabled Students: Writing a Youth Chapter with Endeavor
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日上午，市残联前往八公山区看望慰问两名成绩优异的残疾学生，送上慰问金和祝福，鼓励他们奋发成才。
articles.summary_en: On August 18 morning, the Municipal Disabled Persons' Federation visited two disabled students in Bagongshan District who excelled in entrance exams, offering congratulations, care, and encouragement for their future.

articles.title_zh: 于海田调研齐长城遗址保护工作
articles.title_en: Yu Haitian Inspects Qi Great Wall Heritage Protection
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，济南市委副书记、市长于海田到长清区调研齐长城遗址保护工作，强调筑牢文物安全屏障，高质量做好遗址保护传承利用。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Yu Haitian, mayor of Jinan, inspected Qi Great Wall ruins protection in Changqing District, stressing solid security barriers and high-quality preservation and utilization.

articles.title_zh: 惠来县领导会见国家电投广东公司董事长白利超一行
articles.title_en: Huilai County Leaders Meet Chairman of SPIC Guangdong Company
articles.summary_zh: 近日，惠来县委书记魏洁林、县长陈晓平会见国家电投广东公司董事长白利超一行，双方就深化政企合作、清洁能源及算电协同等项目进行交流探讨。
articles.summary_en: Huilai County Party Secretary Wei Jielin and County Mayor Chen Xiaoping met with Bai Lichao, Chairman of SPIC Guangdong Power, to discuss deepening cooperation on clean energy and computing-power coordination projects.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保调研推进揭惠铁路项目建设
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao Inspects and Promotes Jiehui Railway Project
articles.summary_zh: 18日下午，揭阳市委书记曾风保调研揭惠铁路普宁段征拆进展，强调加快征拆攻坚，保障项目平稳顺利推进。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Aug 18, Zeng Fengbao, secretary of the Jieyang Municipal Party Committee, inspected land acquisition and demolition for the Jiehui Railway in Puning, urging faster progress to ensure smooth construction.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰调研督导重点交通项目建设和粮食储备工作
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Inspects Key Transport Projects and Grain Reserve Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日上午，市委副书记、市长曲晓杰到揭东区、榕城区调研督导粤东城际铁路、揭惠铁路建设和粮食储备工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 18, Qu Xiaojie, deputy secretary of the municipal party committee and mayor, inspected the construction of the Guangdong East Intercity Railway and Jiehui Railway, as well as grain and material reserves, in Jiedong and Rongcheng districts.

articles.title_zh: 刘国中在天津调研时强调 建设优质高效医疗服务体系 更好满足人民群众健康需求
articles.title_en: Liu Guozhong Inspects Tianjin, Stresses Building High-Quality Medical Service System
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理刘国中在天津调研医疗卫生工作，强调建设优质高效医疗服务体系，推动脑机接口等新质生产力发展，并向医务工作者致以医师节问候。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Liu Guozhong, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, inspected medical and health work in Tianjin, emphasizing building a high-quality medical service system and promoting new quality productive forces like brain-computer interfaces, while greeting medical workers on Doctors' Day.

articles.title_zh: 李强会见厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets Ecuadorian President Noboa
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日上午，国务院总理李强在北京人民大会堂会见来华国事访问的厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚，就深化双边关系与合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 19, Premier Li Qiang met with Ecuadorian President Noboa at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, discussing bilateral ties and cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 朱镕基同志遗体在京火化 习近平等到八宝山革命公墓送别
articles.title_en: Zhu Rongji's Remains Cremated in Beijing; Xi Jinping and Others Bid Farewell at Babaoshan
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，朱镕基同志遗体在北京八宝山革命公墓火化，习近平、李强等党和国家领导人前往送别，胡锦涛送花圈表示哀悼。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the remains of Comrade Zhu Rongji were cremated at Babaoshan Revolutionary Cemetery in Beijing. Xi Jinping, Li Qiang and other party and state leaders attended the farewell, and Hu Jintao sent a wreath.

articles.title_zh: 王君正与全国人大社会委副主任委员宋秀岩座谈
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Holds Talks with Song Xiuyan, Deputy Director of NPC Social Affairs Committee
articles.summary_zh: 近日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正在拉萨与全国人大社会委副主任委员宋秀岩一行座谈，就医疗保障等工作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Wang Junzheng, Secretary of CPC Tibet Regional Committee, held talks with Song Xiuyan, Deputy Director of NPC Social Affairs Committee, in Lhasa. They discussed medical insurance and other livelihood issues.

articles.title_zh: 王君正与全国人大社会委副主任委员宋秀岩座谈
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Holds Talks with Song Xiuyan, Deputy Director of NPC Social Development Affairs Committee
articles.summary_zh: 近日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正在拉萨与全国人大社会建设委员会副主任委员宋秀岩一行座谈，就医疗保险工作调研交流。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the CPC Tibet Autonomous Region Committee, held talks with Song Xiuyan, Deputy Director of the NPC Social Development Affairs Committee, in Lhasa on medical insurance research.

articles.title_zh: 中共汕尾市委八届十二次全会召开 决定今年12月召开市第九次党代会
articles.title_en: CPC Shanwei Municipal Committee Holds 12th Plenary Session, Decides to Convene 9th Municipal Party Congress in December
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，中共汕尾市委八届十二次全会召开，决定2026年12月召开市第九次党代会。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, the 12th Plenary Session of the CPC Shanwei Municipal Committee was held, deciding to convene the 9th Municipal Party Congress in December 2026.

articles.title_zh: 杨青龙调研全市电石化工产业时强调推动产业向精深加工和高端延伸
articles.title_en: Yang Qinglong Emphasizes Deep Processing and High-End Upgrading of Carbide Chemical Industry During Research Visit
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，石嘴山市委书记杨青龙调研多家电石化工企业，强调要坚定信心、抢抓机遇，推动产业向精深加工和高端延伸。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Yang Qinglong, Party Secretary of Shizuishan, visited carbide chemical enterprises and stressed firm confidence and seizing opportunities to advance the industry toward deep processing and high-end upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 石嘴山市政府召开常务会议研究经济运行等工作
articles.title_en: Shizuishan Municipal Government Holds Executive Meeting on Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，石嘴山市市长徐龙主持召开市政府常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，听取经济运行汇报并部署下一步工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Mayor Xu Long of Shizuishan chaired a municipal government executive meeting to convey Xi Jinping's important speech, hear reports on economic performance, and arrange next steps.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞在自治区党委网信办调研时强调提高网络综合治理效能
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Stresses Network Governance Efficiency During Ningxia Cyberspace Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，自治区党委书记李邑飞调研网信工作，强调提高网络综合治理效能，汇聚正能量推进宁夏现代化建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Li Yifei, Secretary of the Ningxia Regional Party Committee, inspected cyberspace affairs, urging better network governance to boost modernization.

articles.title_zh: 全省市县乡三级人大换届选举工作会议召开 信长星出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Provincial-Municipal-County-Township People's Congress Election Work Conference Held, Xin Changxing Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，江苏省召开全省市县乡三级人大换届选举工作会议，省委书记信长星出席并讲话，强调做好换届选举工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Jiangsu Province held a conference on the elections for people's congresses at city, county, and township levels. Xin Changxing, secretary of the Provincial Party Committee, attended and stressed the importance of the election work.

articles.title_zh: 通化市人大常委会党组召开扩大会议
articles.title_en: Tonghua Municipal People's Congress Party Group Holds Enlarged Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，通化市人大常委会党组书记、主任宋钦炜主持召开党组扩大会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话指示精神，研究部署县乡人大换届选举等重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Song Qinwei, Secretary of the Party Leadership Group and Director of Tonghua Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, chaired an enlarged Party group meeting to convey Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and study key tasks including county and township people's congress elections.

articles.title_zh: 张海波会见国家能源集团客人
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Meets Delegation from China Energy Investment Corporation
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，威海市委书记张海波会见国家能源集团副总经理傅振邦一行，就深化能源保供、新能源开发利用等领域合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Zhang Haibo, Party Secretary of Weihai, met with Fu Zhenbang, Vice President of China Energy Investment Corporation, to discuss cooperation in energy supply and new energy development.

articles.title_zh: 打造高能级科创平台赋能新质生产力发展
articles.title_en: Building High-Level Sci-Tech Platform to Empower New Quality Productive Forces
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，无锡市长蒋锋调研深海技术科学太湖实验室，强调打造高能级科技创新平台，赋能地方产业和新质生产力发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Wuxi Mayor Jiang Feng inspected the Taihu Laboratory of Deepsea Technology and Science, stressing the need to build a high-level sci-tech innovation platform to empower local industries and new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰督导检查城市精细化管理“百日攻坚”工作
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Inspects Urban Fine Management '100-Day Campaign'
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，省委常委、市委书记蒿慧杰在西安督导检查城市精细化管理整治提升“百日攻坚”工作，强调以绣花功夫提高精细化水平。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Hao Huijie, member of the Standing Committee of the Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Municipal Party Committee, inspected the '100-Day Campaign' for urban fine management in Xi'an, emphasizing meticulous efforts to improve management quality.

articles.title_zh: 范耀江到县属国有公司座谈并作专题授课
articles.title_en: Fan Yaojiang Chairs Symposium and Gives Lecture at County-Owned State Companies
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，县委书记范耀江主持召开县属国有公司座谈会并作专题授课，强调规范运作、合规经营，提升国有公司市场化运营能力。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, County Party Secretary Fan Yaojiang chaired a symposium on county-owned state companies and delivered a lecture on project operation and compliance, emphasizing standardized and compliant management.

articles.title_zh: 吴炜调研新能源发电项目
articles.title_en: Wu Wei Inspects New Energy Power Generation Projects
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，盐城市委副书记、代市长吴炜调研新能源发电项目，强调构建新型能源体系，推动绿色低碳转型。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Wu Wei, deputy secretary of the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee and acting mayor, inspected new energy power generation projects, emphasizing the development of a new energy system and green low-carbon transformation.

articles.title_zh: 张明康在城建、交通重点项目建设情况现场推进会上强调强化服务保障攻坚堵点难点 推动重点项目建设提速增效
articles.title_en: Zhang Mingkang Attends On-site Meeting on Urban Construction and Transportation Projects
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日上午，烟台市委副书记、市长张明康赴城建、交通重点项目施工现场召开现场推进会，强调强化服务保障、攻坚堵点难点，推动项目建设提速增效。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 19, Zhang Mingkang, Deputy Secretary of Yantai Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, attended an on-site meeting on key urban construction and transportation projects, urging better services and solving bottlenecks to accelerate construction.

articles.title_zh: 阳江市委八届十一次全会举行
articles.title_en: Yangjiang Municipal Party Committee Holds 11th Plenary Session
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月18日，中国共产党阳江市第八届委员会第十一次全体会议在江城召开，总结部署工作，追认对关华勋开除党籍处分。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, 2026, the 11th Plenary Session of the 8th Yangjiang Municipal Party Committee was held in Jiangcheng to review work and endorse the expulsion of Guan Huaxun.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉调研“菜篮子”工程建设并督导乡村振兴考核评估问题整改工作
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Inspects "Vegetable Basket" Project and Supervises Rectification of Rural Revitalization Assessment Issues
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉调研“菜篮子”工程，督导巩固拓展脱贫攻坚成果同乡村振兴有效衔接考核评估问题整改，强调促进产业提质增效，推进乡村全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 18, Zhao Xuhui, Party Secretary of Yinchuan, inspected the "vegetable basket" project and supervised rectification of rural revitalization assessment issues, urging industrial upgrading for comprehensive rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 张雨浦调研县域经济高质量发展等工作时强调因地制宜发展特色产业 提质增效做强县域经济
articles.title_en: Zhang Yupu Stresses Developing Distinctive Industries to Boost County Economy
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，宁夏回族自治区主席张雨浦到灵武市调研县域经济高质量发展，强调因地制宜做强特色产业，并督导中央巡视及督察反馈问题整改。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 19, Zhang Yupu, chairman of Ningxia, visited Lingwu to promote high-quality development of county economy and inspect rectification of central inspection issues.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江会见博鼎集团董事长王立峰等一行
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Meets Boding Group Chairman Wang Lifeng and Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，湖南省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江会见博鼎集团董事长王立峰一行，双方就深化合作、推动项目落地进行交流，谢卫江表示将优化营商环境。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Xie Weijiang, Deputy Secretary of the Hunan Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Yueyang Municipal Party Committee, met with Wang Lifeng, Chairman of Boding Group, and his delegation to discuss deepening cooperation and project implementation, pledging to optimize the business environment.

articles.title_zh: 博鼎岳阳飞轮储能调频电站及产业化项目开工
articles.title_en: Boding Yueyang Flywheel Energy Storage Power Station and Industrialization Project Breaks Ground
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，博鼎岳阳飞轮储能调频电站及产业化项目在岳阳临港高新区开工，代理市长唐浩然出席并宣布开工。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the Boding Yueyang flywheel energy storage frequency regulation power station and industrialization project broke ground in Yueyang Lingang High-tech Zone; acting Mayor Tang Haoran attended and announced the start.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Chairs Meeting of Yueyang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神和中央有关会议精神，研究贯彻意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Xie Weijiang, Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Committee and Secretary of the Yueyang Municipal Party Committee, chaired a meeting of the Standing Committee to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and central meetings, and discuss implementation measures.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院第十二次全体会议 强调努力完成全年经济社会发展目标任务
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs 12th Plenary Meeting of State Council, Stresses Achieving Annual Economic and Social Development Goals
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强8月17日主持召开国务院第十二次全体会议，贯彻党中央决策部署，部署全年经济社会发展工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Premier Li Qiang chaired the 12th plenary meeting of the State Council, emphasizing implementation of CPC Central Committee decisions and advancing annual economic and social development goals.

articles.title_zh: 黄玉国主持召开市第六次党代会报告征求意见座谈会
articles.title_en: Huang Yuguo Chairs Meeting to Solicit Opinions on Report for the 6th Municipal Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，周口市委书记黄玉国主持召开市第六次党代会报告征求意见座谈会，听取各县（市、区）和市直单位意见建议，要求高质量起草党代会报告。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Huang Yuguo, secretary of the Zhoukou Municipal Party Committee, chaired a symposium to solicit opinions on the report for the sixth municipal party congress, listening to suggestions from various districts and municipal units and urging high-quality drafting of the report.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁到周口漯河督导调研防汛和灾后重建工作
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Inspects Flood Control and Post-Disaster Reconstruction in Zhoukou and Luohe
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，河南省委书记刘宁到周口、漯河督导调研防汛和台风“白海豚”强降雨灾后重建工作，看望慰问基层党员干部群众。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Henan Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning visited Zhoukou and Luohe to inspect flood control and post-disaster reconstruction after Typhoon Baidujiang, and expressed condolences to grassroots party members and cadres.

articles.title_zh: 全市上半年经济形势分析会暨联评互鉴专题会召开
articles.title_en: Zhuhai Holds H1 Economic Situation Analysis Meeting and Joint Evaluation Exchange
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日上午，珠海市召开上半年经济形势分析会暨联评互鉴专题会，市委书记陈勇主持并讲话，部署下半年重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 18, Zhuhai held its H1 economic situation analysis and joint evaluation exchange meeting, where Party Secretary Chen Yong presided and spoke, deploying key work for H2.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔在日照调研时强调 扬长优势 做强特色着力推动高质量发展
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Emphasizes High-Quality Development During Investigation in Rizhao
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，山东省委副书记、省长周乃翔在日照市调研，强调要扬长优势、做强特色，因地制宜发展新质生产力，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Zhou Naixiang, Deputy Secretary of the Shandong Provincial Party Committee and Governor, conducted an investigation in Rizhao, emphasizing leveraging advantages, strengthening distinctive features, and promoting high-quality development through new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔主持召开省政府常务会议 研究当前全省经济运行情况
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Chairs Provincial Government Executive Meeting on Economic Operation
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，山东省委副书记、省长周乃翔主持召开省政府常务会议，研究当前全省经济运行情况，部署下步重点工作，并审议通过《山东省安全生产风险管控办法（修订草案）》。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Zhou Naixiang, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee and Governor, chaired a provincial government executive meeting to study economic operation, deploy key tasks, and approve the revised Shandong Work Safety Risk Control Measures.

articles.title_zh: 中国航天事业开拓者之一刘纪原逝世
articles.title_en: Liu Jiyuan, Pioneer of China's Space Industry, Dies
articles.summary_zh: 中国航天事业开拓者、原航天工业总公司总经理刘纪原因病于2026年8月17日在北京逝世，享年93岁。
articles.summary_en: Liu Jiyuan, a pioneer of China's aerospace industry and former general manager of the China Aerospace Corporation, died in Beijing on August 17, 2026, at the age of 93.

articles.title_zh: “朱雀三号”遥二箭回收成功，我国首次实现火箭陆地回收
articles.title_en: Zhuque-3 Second Test Rocket Successfully Recovered, China Achieves First Land Recovery of a Rocket
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，朱雀三号遥二运载火箭在东风商业航天创新试验区发射，一子级成功着陆于甘肃民勤，实现我国首次火箭陆地回收。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, the Zhuque-3 Y2 carrier rocket launched from the Dongfeng Commercial Aerospace Innovation Test Zone, with its first stage successfully landing in Minqin, Gansu, marking China's first land recovery of a rocket.

articles.title_zh: 福州市人大常委会召开党组（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Party Group (Expanded) Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，福州市人大常委会召开党组（扩大）会议，传达学习省委、市委全会精神，研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the Fuzhou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held a Party Group (Expanded) meeting to convey and study the spirit of the provincial and municipal party plenary sessions and discuss implementation measures.

Implementing the Spirit of Plenary Sessions

articles.title_zh: 习近平：中方始终从战略高度和长远角度看待中厄关系
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping: China Always Views China-Ecuador Relations from Strategic and Long-Term Perspective
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日下午，国家主席习近平在北京人民大会堂同来华进行国事访问的厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚举行会谈。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 18, President Xi Jinping held talks with Ecuadorian President Noboa, who was on a state visit to China, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing.

articles.title_zh: 小米重磅旗舰9月登场：全球首发新一代玄戒芯片
articles.title_en: Xiaomi's Flagship Phone to Debut in September: Featuring New Xuanjie Chip
articles.summary_zh: 小米集团总裁卢伟冰确认，小米旗舰手机将于9月登场，首发新一代玄戒芯片，实现软硬芯云融合。
articles.summary_en: Xiaomi's president Lu Weibing confirmed that the flagship phone will launch in September with the new Xuanjie chip, integrating software, hardware, chip, and cloud.

articles.title_zh: 曾赞荣调研医工融合创新发展工作并看望一线医务工作者
articles.title_en: Zeng Zanrong Investigates Medical-Engineering Integration Innovation and Visits Medical Workers
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日中国医师节当天，青岛市委书记曾赞荣调研医工融合创新发展工作，看望一线医务工作者，强调加快医工交叉融合创新。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Chinese Doctors' Day, Qingdao Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong investigated medical-engineering integration innovation and visited frontline medical workers, emphasizing acceleration of cross-disciplinary innovation.

articles.title_zh: 青岛市人大常委会主任会议召开
articles.title_en: Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Chair's Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，青岛市十七届人大常委会主任会议第112次会议召开，市人大常委会主任梅建华主持，听取上半年代表建议办理情况汇报，决定常委会第三十七次会议8月下旬举行。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, the 112th chair's meeting of the 17th Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee was held, chaired by Mei Jianhua, to hear reports on handling deputies' suggestions and decide the 37th session in late August.

articles.title_zh: 天天学习丨十份入党申请书
articles.title_en: Daily Study: Ten Party Membership Applications
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾习近平在陕西延川梁家河插队期间，历经十次递交入党申请书，最终于1974年1月正式加入中国共产党并担任大队支部书记的经历。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews Xi Jinping's experience during his stay in Liangjiahe, Yanchuan, Shaanxi, where he submitted ten Party membership applications and was finally admitted to the CPC in January 1974, later serving as the village branch secretary.

articles.title_zh: 建设更高水平自贸试验区 打造改革开放新高地
articles.title_en: Building Higher-Level Pilot Free Trade Zones to Create New Heights of Reform and Opening Up
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记指出深入推进制度型开放，我国23个自贸试验区以制度创新为核心，加快打造新时代改革开放新高地，在离岸贸易、负面清单、零关税等方面取得新进展。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping called for deeper institutional opening-up. China's 23 pilot free trade zones, centered on institutional innovation, are accelerating efforts to become new heights of reform and opening up, with progress in offshore trade, negative lists, and zero-tariff policies.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚举行会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Ecuadorian President Noboa
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日下午，国家主席习近平在北京人民大会堂同来华进行国事访问的厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚举行会谈，双方将释放自贸协定红利，拓展经贸与人文合作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 18, President Xi Jinping held talks with Ecuadorian President Noboa, who was on a state visit to China, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, to expand cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 云汉芯城发布半年报：2026上半年归母净利润跨越式增长，平台价值加速重估
articles.title_en: Yunhan Xincheng Releases Semi-Annual Report: Net Profit Soars in H1 2026, Platform Value Reassessed
articles.summary_zh: 云汉芯城发布2026年半年报，上半年归母净利润大幅增长，交易客户数和订单数同比分别增长18.26%和38.55%，平台价值加速重估。
articles.summary_en: Yunhan Xincheng released its H1 2026 report, showing a surge in net profit attributable to shareholders, with transaction customers and orders up 18.26% and 38.55% YoY, accelerating platform value reassessment.

articles.title_zh: 商务部等9部门联合印发意见 激发下沉市场活力、活跃县域消费
articles.title_en: Nine Ministries Issue Guidelines to Boost Vitality in Lower-Tier Markets and County-Level Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 商务部等9部门8月18日联合印发《关于进一步激发下沉市场活力 活跃县域消费的意见》，提出18条举措，国新办同日举行发布会介绍相关情况。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, nine ministries including the Ministry of Commerce jointly issued an opinion to boost lower-tier market vitality and county-level consumption, followed by a State Council Information Office press conference.

articles.title_zh: 长江十年行｜一炉钢火转身向绿 江畔千亿村的破立实践
articles.title_en: Yangtze River Decade: A Steel Furnace Turns Green, Riverside Village's Break-and-Build Practice
articles.summary_zh: 近日，荔枝新闻记者走进江苏江阴长江村。十年来，该村关停化工厂，发展循环经济，年产值从328亿元增至1200亿元，实现生态美、产业兴、百姓富。
articles.summary_en: Litchi News visits Jiangyin's Changjiang Village. Over 10 years, it shut chemical plants, built a circular economy, growing output from 32.8B to 120B yuan, achieving green growth and shared prosperity.

articles.title_zh: 管西又管东？张龙担任总编辑的“中国东部网”也是假网站
articles.title_en: Zhang Long, Editor of 'China Eastern Net', Also a Fake Website
articles.summary_zh: 澎湃新闻8月19日报道，自称“打造中国东部第一主流媒体”的中国东部网系假网站，其名誉总编辑张龙亦是西部新闻网总编辑。
articles.summary_en: The Paper reported on Aug 19 that China Eastern Net, claiming to be a major media outlet, is a fake website; its honorary editor-in-chief Zhang Long is also editor-in-chief of Western News Net.

articles.title_zh: 假冒“港中大客座教授”“西部新闻网总编”，张龙50多个头衔从何而来
articles.title_en: Zhang Long's 50+ Fake Titles Exposed: From 'CUHK Visiting Professor' to 'Western News Network Editor-in-Chief'
articles.summary_zh: 本文揭露男子张龙假冒“香港中文大学客座教授”“西部新闻网总编”等50多个头衔，香港中文大学已声明与其无任何关系。
articles.summary_en: This report exposes Zhang Long, who falsely claimed over 50 titles including 'CUHK Visiting Professor' and 'Editor-in-Chief of Western News Network.' CUHK has confirmed no affiliation with him.

articles.title_zh: 延安大学鲁迅艺术学院：学校将开会讨论取消张龙客座教授聘任
articles.title_en: Yan'an University Lu Xun Art College to Discuss Cancellation of Zhang Long's Guest Professorship
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，延安大学鲁迅艺术学院党委书记董振文表示，校方将开会讨论取消社会人士张龙客座教授聘任。此前张龙被曝冒充香港中文大学客座教授。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 19, the Party secretary of Lu Xun Art College at Yan'an University said the school will discuss revoking Zhang Long's guest professorship, after Zhang was exposed for falsely claiming to be a guest professor at Chinese University of Hong Kong.

articles.title_zh: 重庆出台措施培育推广专利密集型产品
articles.title_en: Chongqing Issues Measures to Cultivate and Promote Patent-Intensive Products
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，重庆市知识产权局透露，重庆近日印发《重庆市专利密集型产品培育推广办法》，旨在培育壮大专利密集型产业规模。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Chongqing Municipal Intellectual Property Office revealed that Chongqing recently issued the Measures for Cultivating and Promoting Patent-Intensive Products to expand the scale of patent-intensive industries.

articles.title_zh: 重庆发布“数联陆海”系列产品
articles.title_en: Chongqing Unveils 'Shulian Luhai' Product Series
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，重庆在两江新区发布“数联陆海W—BRIDGE”产品体系一期，6款数字化产品亮相，为西部陆海新通道提供数字支撑。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Chongqing launched the first phase of the 'Shulian Luhai W-BRIDGE' product system in Liangjiang New Area, unveiling six core digital products to support the New International Land-Sea Trade Corridor.

articles.title_zh: 凝聚共识 汇聚力量 共同推动“十五五”开好局起好步
articles.title_en: Building Consensus and Pooling Strength to Jointly Push for a Good Start of the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，2026年广东省党外人士暑期座谈会在广州召开，省委书记黄坤明主持并讲话，强调凝聚共识，推动“十五五”良好开局。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, 2026, the Guangdong Non-Party Figures Summer Symposium was held in Guangzhou. Provincial Party Secretary Huang Kunming presided and spoke, calling for consensus to ensure a good start for the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 来宾发布十余个文旅投资项目 诚邀各方共拓发展新机遇
articles.title_en: Laibin Releases Over Ten Cultural Tourism Investment Projects, Inviting Cooperation for New Development Opportunities
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，由来宾市人民政府主办的文旅产业招商推介会在南宁举办，发布十余个文旅投资项目。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the cultural tourism investment promotion conference hosted by Laibin Municipal Government was held in Nanning, releasing over ten key projects.

articles.title_zh: 引导更多品牌连锁企业向县域下沉
articles.title_en: Guide More Brand Chain Enterprises to Expand into County Markets
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，国务院新闻办举行新闻发布会，介绍激发下沉市场活力、活跃县域消费有关情况，商务部等部门印发意见引导品牌连锁企业向县域下沉，促进农村消费升级。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the State Council Information Office held a press conference on boosting county-level consumption. The Ministry of Commerce and other departments issued guidelines to guide more brand chain enterprises to expand into county markets.

articles.title_zh: 深化航空物流合作 赋能内陆开放高地
articles.title_en: Deepening Air Logistics Cooperation to Empower Inland Open Highland
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，河南省委常委、常务副省长张敏在郑州会见马士基集团执行副总裁克里斯托夫·赫曼一行，就深化航空物流、多式联运等领域合作交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Zhang Min, Standing Committee Member and Executive Vice Governor of Henan, met with Maersk Executive Vice President Christoph Hermann in Zhengzhou to discuss deeper cooperation in air logistics and multimodal transport.

articles.title_zh: 新国标发布，化妆品怎么选（有问有答）
articles.title_en: New Mandatory National Standard for Cosmetics Released, Effective 2028

articles.summary_en: The Standardization Administration of China issued the first mandatory national standard for cosmetics, 'Cosmetics - General Safety Requirements', effective in 2028, with stricter controls on high-risk products such as children's cosmetics.

articles.title_en: 10 AI Projects Ink Deal to Join OPC Community at 'Jingkai Made' Competition
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，"经开智造"全国AI智能体大赛颁奖路演在武汉市经开区举行，14个获奖项目中10家签约入驻OPC社区。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 17, the award ceremony and roadshow of the 'Jingkai Made' National AI Agent Competition was held in Wuhan Economic & Technological Development Zone, with 10 of 14 winners signing to join OPC Community.

articles.title_zh: 李殿勋在武汉调研大健康产业发展时强调推动高质量发展
articles.title_en: Li Dianxun Surveys Health Industry Development in Wuhan, Stresses High-Quality Growth
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日上午，湖北省委副书记、省长李殿勋在武汉东湖新技术开发区调研大健康产业发展，强调坚持需求牵引和创新驱动，更加科学务实推动全省大健康产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 18, Li Dianxun, Deputy Secretary of the Hubei Provincial Party Committee and Governor, visited the East Lake High-tech Development Zone in Wuhan to survey health industry development, emphasizing demand-driven and innovation-led advancement for high-quality growth.

articles.title_zh: 河北新能源货运发展规模稳居全国前列
articles.title_en: Hebei Leads Nation in New Energy Freight Development Scale
articles.summary_zh: 河北省出台系列扶持政策，新能源货运发展规模居全国前列。8月14日，辛集市星耀物流集团的光伏物流场站展示了绿色补能、高效集约的货运模式。
articles.summary_en: Hebei has introduced policies to lead the nation in new energy freight. On Aug 14, a solar-powered logistics station in Xinji showcased green freight operations.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江启动人工智能教育教学研究中心建设
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Launches AI Education and Teaching Research Center Construction
articles.summary_zh: 近日，黑龙江省人工智能教育教学研究中心启动建设，由省教育厅支持、哈尔滨工业大学牵头，联合多所高校设立分中心，打造'AI+龙江优势领域'发展格局。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Heilongjiang Province launched the construction of its AI education and teaching research center, led by Harbin Institute of Technology with provincial education department support, establishing branch centers across multiple universities to build an 'AI + Heilongjiang advantageous fields' pattern.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲到哈工大先研院调研
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Investigates HIT Advanced Technology Research Institute
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，黑龙江省委副书记、省长梁惠玲到哈尔滨工业大学先进技术研究院调研创新创业生态圈建设和科技成果转化工作，强调推动科技成果产业化，加快形成新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Liang Huiling, Deputy Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee and Governor, visited the Advanced Technology Research Institute of Harbin Institute of Technology to survey innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem construction and technology commercialization, stressing the acceleration of new productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 超聚变常州AI赋能中心于8月18日启动
articles.title_en: Chaoshu Fusion Changzhou AI Empowerment Center Launched on August 18
articles.summary_zh: 超聚变常州AI赋能中心8月18日启动，聚焦新能源、高端装备等产业，提供AI算力支撑、数智化诊断等服务，并发布“超常计划”培育人才。
articles.summary_en: The Chaoshu Fusion Changzhou AI Empowerment Center was launched on Aug 18, focusing on new energy and high-end equipment, offering AI computing, digital diagnosis, and talent training, with the 'Super Chang Plan' unveiled.

articles.title_zh: 江苏出台“人工智能+”工业软件行动方案
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues Action Plan for "AI+" Industrial Software
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省工信厅印发《江苏省“人工智能+”工业软件突破发展行动方案（2026—2028年）》，部署五大行动推动工业软件智能化转型。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu's Department of Industry and Information Technology issued an action plan (2026-2028) to integrate AI into industrial software, outlining five major initiatives.

articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues Measures to Boost Commercialization of Scientific and Technological Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 近日，江苏印发《关于突出市场导向建设科技成果转化高地的实施意见》，提出20条举措和22项支持政策，破除科技成果转化难题，将于8月21日施行。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu has issued an implementation opinion on building a highland for commercialization of scientific and technological achievements with market orientation, proposing 20 measures and 22 supporting policies to tackle difficulties in transforming research outputs. It takes effect on August 21.

articles.title_zh: 首府出台工作举措护航奶业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Hohhot Issues Measures to Support High-Quality Dairy Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 近日，呼和浩特市人民检察院出台知识产权检察护航奶业工作举措，聚焦乳业全产业链知识产权保护，以高质效检察履职服务“世界乳都”发展。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Hohhot People's Procuratorate issued work measures for IP protection to support the dairy industry, focusing on full-chain IP protection to serve the development of the 'World Dairy Capital'.

articles.title_zh: 自治区出台18条举措促进词元经济高质量发展
articles.title_en: Autonomous Region Issues 18 Measures to Promote High-Quality Development of Token Economy
articles.summary_zh: 近日，内蒙古六部门联合印发18条举措，聚焦绿色算力和词元产业全链条，推动词元经济高质量发展，打造全国供给地和出海枢纽。
articles.summary_en: Inner Mongolia's six departments jointly issued 18 measures to boost the high-quality development of the token economy, focusing on green computing power and the full industry chain, aiming to become a national supply hub and overseas gateway.

articles.title_zh: 全区服务业大会召开
articles.title_en: Regional Service Industry Conference Convened
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，全区服务业大会在呼和浩特召开，自治区党委书记王伟中出席并讲话，强调推动内蒙古服务业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the regional service industry conference was held in Hohhot. Wang Weizhong, Party Secretary of Inner Mongolia, attended and spoke, emphasizing high-quality development of the service industry.

articles.title_zh: 中央宣传部、国家卫生健康委联合发布“最美医生”先进事迹
articles.title_en: Central Publicity Department and National Health Commission Jointly Release 'Most Beautiful Doctors' Advanced Deeds
articles.summary_zh: 中央宣传部与国家卫生健康委在中国医师节前夕联合发布“最美医生”先进事迹，王秋等9名医务工作者入选。
articles.summary_en: The Central Publicity Department and the National Health Commission jointly released the advanced deeds of 'Most Beautiful Doctors' before Chinese Doctors' Day, with nine medical workers including Wang Qiu selected.

articles.title_zh: 甘河工业园区年产22万吨低氧铜杆项目开工
articles.title_en: Construction Starts on 220,000-ton Low-Oxygen Copper Rod Project in Ganhe Industrial Park
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，青海鑫鼎铜源新材料有限公司投资3亿元的年产22万吨低氧铜杆连铸连轧生产线项目在西宁甘河工业园区开工，将补齐区域铜精深加工短板。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Qinghai Xinding Tongyuan New Material Co., Ltd. started construction of a 220,000-ton low-oxygen copper rod continuous casting and rolling line project in Ganhe Industrial Park, Xining, with a total investment of 300 million yuan, aiming to strengthen regional copper deep processing.

articles.title_zh: 川企发布机器人任务执行系统
articles.title_en: Sichuan Enterprise Releases Robot Task Execution System
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，成都人形机器人创新中心发布全球首个复杂语言指令集全自主超长视野机器人任务执行系统，实现自主决策规划，完成长时序任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, the Chengdu Humanoid Robot Innovation Center released the world's first fully autonomous long-horizon task execution system for complex language instructions, enabling autonomous decision-making and long-sequence task completion.

articles.title_zh: 成都发布人形机器人“大脑”新架构
articles.title_en: Chengdu Unveils New 'Brain' Architecture for Humanoid Robots
articles.summary_zh: 成都人形机器人创新中心发布人形机器人决策规划与作业操作统一架构，旨在解决机器人“出实验室就失灵”难题。
articles.summary_en: Chengdu Humanoid Robot Innovation Center released a unified architecture for decision-making and operation of humanoid robots, addressing the issue of robots failing outside labs.

articles.title_zh: 2026年四川省“最美医务工作者”现场交流活动在蓉举行
articles.title_en: 2026 Sichuan 'Most Beautiful Medical Workers' Exchange Event Held in Chengdu
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日晚，四川省“最美医务工作者”现场交流活动在成都举行，省委常委郑莉等出席并颁发证书，评选出20名“最美医务工作者”。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of August 18, the exchange event for Sichuan's 'Most Beautiful Medical Workers' was held in Chengdu, with Provincial Party Standing Committee member Zheng Li attending and presenting certificates to 20 honorees.

articles.title_en: New Batch of Business Environment 'Media Observer' Co-construction Projects Released
articles.summary_zh: 昨天，深化营商环境“媒体观察员”共建机制推进会在上海召开，发布2026—2027年度36个共建项目。市委常委、宣传部部长赵嘉鸣出席。
articles.summary_en: Yesterday, a meeting to deepen the "Media Observer" co-construction mechanism for business environment was held in Shanghai, releasing 36 co-construction projects for 2026-2027. Zhao Jiaming, member of the Standing Committee of the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee and head of the Propaganda Department, attended.

articles.title_zh: 上海：造全球最大舱容LNG船，开工即提速
articles.title_en: Shanghai Accelerates Construction of World's Largest-Capacity LNG Carrier
articles.summary_zh: 上海正在建造全球舱容最大的QC-Max型LNG船，今年前7个月船舶出口400.9亿元，同比增长64.1%，高端船舶占比达84%。
articles.summary_en: Shanghai is building the world's largest QC-Max LNG carrier; ship exports reached 40.09 billion yuan in the first seven months, up 64.1% year-on-year, with high-end vessels accounting for 84%.

articles.title_zh: 秦创投中试平台产业链图谱发布
articles.title_en: Qin Chuangyuan Pilot Platform Industry Chain Map Released
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，秦创原科技创新投资集团下属公司发布中试平台产业链图谱，覆盖六大产业赛道，开放对接通道。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, a subsidiary of Qinchuangyuan S&T Innovation Investment Group released a pilot platform industry chain map covering six industrial tracks, opening channels for tech projects.

articles.title_zh: 新疆维吾尔自治区政府召开常务会议 审议通过妇女儿童及残疾人事业相关规划等
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Government Holds Executive Meeting to Approve Plans for Women, Children and Disabled
articles.summary_zh: 18日下午，自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜主持召开自治区政府常务会议，审议通过妇女儿童发展、残疾人保障等“十五五”规划，并研究消防安全管理等规定。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 18, the regional government held an executive meeting chaired by Chairman Erkin Tuniyaz to approve 15th Five-Year plans for women, children and disabled persons, and reviewed fire safety regulations.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜会见吉尔吉斯斯坦副总理阿昆别科夫
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang and Erkin Tuniyaz Meet Kyrgyzstan's Deputy Prime Minister Akunbekov
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，自治区党委书记陈小江、自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在乌鲁木齐会见吉尔吉斯斯坦副总理阿昆别科夫一行，双方就深化经贸、能源等领域合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Xinjiang Party Secretary Chen Xiaojiang and Chairman Erkin Tuniyaz met with Kyrgyzstan's Deputy Prime Minister Akunbekov in Urumqi to discuss cooperation in trade, energy, and other areas.

articles.title_zh: 中国人民银行林芝市分行多维度织密县域金融服务保障网
articles.title_en: Linzhi Branch of People's Bank of China Weaves County-Level Financial Service Network
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来，中国人民银行林芝市分行通过现金安全、绿色金融和精准滴灌实体经济等措施，织密县域金融服务保障网，支持边境地区乡村振兴与生态保护。
articles.summary_en: Since the start of this year, the Linzhi Branch of the People's Bank of China has strengthened county-level financial services through cash security, green finance, and targeted support for the real economy, boosting rural revitalization and ecological protection in border areas.

articles.title_zh: 商务部：重点从4个方面加大稳外贸工作力度
articles.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Focus on Four Aspects to Boost Foreign Trade
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日，商务部新闻发言人何咏前在例行新闻发布会上表示，2026年将从四个方面加大稳外贸工作力度，包括落实政策、拓展市场、培育新动能、推动进出口平衡发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 15, Ministry of Commerce spokesperson He Yongqian said at a regular press conference that in 2026 China will intensify efforts to stabilize foreign trade in four aspects, including policy implementation, market diversification, new drivers, and balanced import-export growth.

articles.title_zh: 让企业站到科技创新前沿
articles.title_en: Putting Enterprises at the Forefront of Scientific and Technological Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 浙江围绕企业需求组织攻关，推动创新要素加速汇聚，培育壮大专精特新企业，助力企业站到科技创新前沿。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang organizes R&D around enterprise needs, accelerates the convergence of innovation factors, and fosters specialized and innovative SMEs, helping enterprises stand at the forefront of technological innovation.

articles.title_zh: 北京市政府召开常务会议 研究“十五五”时期推动京津冀协同发展等事项 市长殷勇主持会议
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal Government Holds Executive Meeting on Coordinated Development of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei During 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日下午，北京市政府召开常务会议，市长殷勇主持，研究“十五五”时期推动京津冀协同发展、疏解整治促提升及经济运行等事项。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 18, the Beijing Municipal Government held an executive meeting chaired by Mayor Yin Yong to study coordinated development of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, non-capital function relief, and economic operations.

articles.title_zh: 推进体制机制创新 加快培育发展新质生产力
articles.title_en: Promoting Institutional Innovation to Accelerate the Development of New Quality Productive Forces
articles.summary_zh: 文章阐述高校应以体制机制创新打通教育链、人才链、产业链、创新链，加快培育发展新质生产力，服务中国式现代化。
articles.summary_en: The article elaborates that universities should use institutional innovation to integrate education, talent, industry, and innovation chains, accelerating new quality productive forces to serve Chinese modernization.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致电祝贺鲍卡就任匈牙利总统
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulations to Boka on Assuming Hungarian Presidency
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，国家主席习近平致电鲍卡·安德拉什，祝贺他就任匈牙利总统，表示愿推动中匈新时代全天候全面战略伙伴关系行稳致远。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, President Xi Jinping sent a message to András Boka, congratulating him on assuming the presidency of Hungary and expressing willingness to advance the China-Hungary all-weather comprehensive strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 深化对“第二个结合”的理解与把握
articles.title_en: Deepening Understanding of the 'Second Combination'
articles.summary_zh: 本文阐述“第二个结合”的重大意义，指出其巩固文化主体性、揭示中国道路必然性、推动世界文明发展的历史贡献。
articles.summary_en: This article elaborates on the significance of the 'Second Combination,' highlighting its role in consolidating cultural subjectivity, revealing the necessity of the Chinese path, and contributing to world civilization.

articles.title_zh: 王凯主持召开省政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Wang Kai Chairs Provincial Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，河南省省长王凯主持召开省政府常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要文章精神，研究灾后恢复、新型储能产业发展等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Henan Governor Wang Kai chaired a provincial government executive meeting to convey General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and articles, and to discuss post-disaster recovery and new energy storage industry development.

articles.title_zh: 省政协党组扩大会议和主席会议召开
articles.title_en: Henan Provincial CPPCC Holds Party Group and Chairman Meetings
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，省政协主席孔昌生主持召开省政协党组扩大会议和主席会议，学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究召开省政协十三届常委会第二十一次会议有关事宜。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Kong Changsheng, chairman of the Henan Provincial CPPCC, presided over the Party Group and Chairman's meetings to study Xi Jinping's important speeches and discuss arrangements for the 21st session of the Standing Committee.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁到周口漯河督导调研防汛和灾后重建工作
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Inspects Flood Control and Post-Disaster Reconstruction in Zhoukou and Luohe
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，河南省委书记刘宁到周口、漯河督导防汛和台风“白海豚”灾后重建，强调推进恢复重建，提升防灾减灾能力。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Henan Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning inspected flood control and post-disaster reconstruction in Zhoukou and Luohe following Typhoon 'White Dolphin', urging orderly recovery and enhanced disaster prevention capabilities.

articles.title_zh: 中非经贸总部大厦拓展区启动
articles.title_en: China-Africa Economic and Trade Headquarters Building Expansion Zone Launched
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，加纳、莫桑比克、坦桑尼亚经贸投资对接会暨中非经贸总部大厦拓展区启动仪式在长沙举行，铭诚绿谷智慧产业园正式列入拓展区。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the economic and trade investment matchmaking conference for Ghana, Mozambique, and Tanzania and the launch ceremony of the expansion zone of the China-Africa Economic and Trade Headquarters Building were held in Changsha, with Mingcheng Lügu Smart Industrial Park officially included.

articles.title_zh: 全省市县乡三级人大换届选举工作会议召开 信长星出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing Attends Provincial Conference on People's Congress Election Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，江苏省召开市县乡三级人大换届选举工作会议，省委书记信长星出席并讲话，强调做好换届选举工作。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 18, Jiangsu held a conference on people's congress elections at city, county and township levels; provincial party secretary Xin Changxing attended and stressed ensuring smooth elections.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛在科研院所调研科技创新工作 以高水平科技创新引领新质生产力发展
articles.title_en: Governor Liu Xiaotao Visits Research Institutes to Boost Sci-Tech Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，江苏省省长刘小涛来到中国科学院工业人工智能研究所、紫金山实验室调研科技创新工作，强调以高水平科技创新引领新质生产力发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Governor Liu Xiaotao of Jiangsu visited the Institute of Industrial AI and Purple Mountain Laboratories to inspect sci-tech innovation, stressing high-level innovation to drive new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 王毅将访问韩国、印尼
articles.title_en: Wang Yi to Visit South Korea and Indonesia
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，外交部宣布王毅将于19日至22日访问韩国、印尼，并主持中印尼全面战略对话机制首次会议。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, the Foreign Ministry announced that Wang Yi will visit South Korea and Indonesia from Aug 19-22, and chair the first meeting of the China-Indonesia Comprehensive Strategic Dialogue.

articles.summary_en: The National Library Foundation established its Yangshi Lei Cultural Heritage Fund in Beijing and released cultural products inspired by the Yangshi Lei archives.

articles.summary_en: Ahead of Chinese Doctors' Day, the Central Propaganda Department and the National Health Commission released stories of 9 'Most Beautiful Doctors' to honor medical professionals.

articles.title_zh: 嫦娥七号计划近日择机实施发射 器箭组合体完成垂直转运

articles.summary_en: On Aug 19 at 07:35, the Zhuque-3 Y2 rocket launched from Dongfeng Commercial Aerospace Innovation Test Area, with its first stage successfully landing, achieving China's first land recovery of a rocket.

articles.summary_en: On August 18, Zhou Naixiang, Deputy Secretary of CPC Shandong Provincial Committee and Governor of Shandong, conducted a research visit in Rizhao, emphasizing developing new quality productive forces and promoting high-quality development.

articles.summary_zh: 18日上午，浙江省省长刘捷出席全省政协主席暑期读书会，作经济社会发展情况和下半年重点工作专题报告，强调高质量完成全年目标任务。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 18, Governor Liu Jie of Zhejiang Province attended the provincial CPPCC chairmen summer reading session and delivered a special report on economic and social development and key work for the second half of the year, emphasizing high-quality completion of annual targets.

articles.title_zh: 王浩：坚定信心 服务大局 主动作为 更好助力保障高质量发展建设共同富裕示范区
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Attends Opening of Summer Study Class for People's Congress Directors in Zhejiang
articles.summary_zh: 18日下午，全省各级人大常委会主任暑期读书班在杭州开班。省委书记王浩出席并讲话，强调人大要服务大局，助力共同富裕示范区建设。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 18, the summer study class for directors of provincial people's congress standing committees opened in Hangzhou. Wang Hao, Party Secretary of Zhejiang, attended and delivered a speech, emphasizing the role of people's congresses in serving the overall situation and supporting the construction of a common prosperity demonstration zone.

articles.title_zh: 四部门发布《关于加强医院法治建设的意见》
articles.title_en: Four Departments Issue Opinions on Strengthening Hospital Legal Governance

articles.summary_en: On August 18, the National Health Commission and three other departments jointly issued guidelines to strengthen legal governance in hospitals, requiring public hospitals to implement the director responsibility system under Party committee leadership and enhance compliance review.

articles.title_zh: 商务部：每天有超过1亿件包裹进出农村
articles.title_en: Commerce Ministry: Over 100 Million Parcels Enter and Leave Rural Areas Daily

articles.summary_en: On August 18, the State Council Information Office held a briefing on invigorating county-level consumption. Assistant Commerce Minister Yuan Xiaoming said over 100 million parcels move in and out of rural areas daily, boosting rural consumption.

articles.title_zh: 中方回应帕劳总统涉中国导弹试射言论：用心险恶，不值一评

articles.summary_en: On August 18, Foreign Ministry spokesman Lin Jian responded to Palau President Surangel Whipps Jr.'s remarks on China's missile test, calling them baseless, malicious, and not worth commenting.

articles.title_zh: 纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会在京隆重举行

articles.summary_en: On August 17, a grand gathering was held in Beijing to mark the 100th anniversary of Jiang Zemin's birth. Xi Jinping praised his contributions and called for learning his noble character.

articles.summary_en: The CCDI and National Supervisory Commission investigated Xu Yiding, former vice president of Agricultural Development Bank of China, and decided to expel him from the Party and public office; suspected bribery transferred to procuratorate.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就印度尼西亚发生强烈地震向印尼总统普拉博沃致慰问电

articles.summary_en: On August 17, President Xi Jinping sent a message of condolences to Indonesian President Prabowo over a strong earthquake in Indonesia, expressing condolences on behalf of the Chinese government and people.

articles.summary_en: On August 18, Tengchong City held an on-site meeting to apply the 'Ten Million Project' experience for rural revitalization. Party Secretary Ma Zixing attended and spoke, with Deputy Party Secretary Zhao Xiaolei presiding.

articles.summary_en: On August 17, Zhang Enhui, Secretary of the Changchun Municipal Party Committee, inspected the organization of the 25th Changchun Agricultural Expo, urging to amplify its brand effect and boost rural revitalization through technological innovation.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 18, President Xi Jinping held a ceremony at the Great Hall of the People to welcome Ecuadorian President Novoa for a state visit to China.

articles.title_zh: 三部门发文优化城乡社区岗位吸纳高校毕业生就业

articles.title_zh: 淮北市政府与交通银行安徽省分行举行政银交流活动
articles.title_en: Huaibei Municipal Government and Bank of Communications Anhui Branch Hold Government-Bank Exchange Event
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日上午，淮北市政府与交通银行安徽省分行政银交流活动在淮举行，代市长黄韡和交行安徽省分行行长谢金海出席并致辞，双方共商政银合作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 18, Huaibei Municipal Government and Bank of Communications Anhui Branch held a government-bank exchange event in Huaibei. Mayor Huang Wei and Branch President Xie Jinhai attended and delivered speeches.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦会见交通银行安徽省分行行长谢金海一行
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi Meets with Xie Jinhai, President of Bank of Communications Anhui Branch
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日上午，淮北市委书记蒋曦会见交通银行安徽省分行行长谢金海一行，双方就深化金融合作、支持地方转型发展进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 18, Jiang Xi, Secretary of Huaibei Municipal Party Committee, met with Xie Jinhai, President of Bank of Communications Anhui Branch, to discuss deepening financial cooperation and supporting local transformation.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群会见上海潮汕联谊会会长陈湖文一行
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Meets President of Shanghai Chaoshan Association
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日下午，汕头市委书记庄悦群会见上海潮汕联谊会会长陈湖文一行，就深化经贸合作、助力“百千万工程”等交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 17, Shantou CPC Secretary Zhuang Yuequn met with Chen Huwen, president of the Shanghai Chaoshan Association, to discuss deepening economic cooperation and supporting the "Bai Qian Wan Project."

articles.title_zh: 汕头市镇（街道）党政主要负责同志推动“百千万工程”落地落实专题研讨班开班
articles.title_en: Seminar for Shantou Town and Street Officials on 'Baiqianwan Project' Opens; Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日上午，汕头市镇（街道）党政主要负责同志‘百千万工程’专题研讨班在市委党校开班，市委书记庄悦群出席并作专题辅导报告。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 17 morning, a seminar for Shantou town and street Party and government chiefs on the 'Baiqianwan Project' opened at the Municipal Party School; Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn attended and gave a guidance report.

articles.title_zh: 汕尾市委常委会召开会议研究部署意识形态、扫黑除恶、基层治理等工作
articles.title_en: Shanwei Municipal Committee Meeting Focuses on Ideology, Crime Crackdown, and Grassroots Governance
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，汕尾市委书记逯峰主持召开市委常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署意识形态、扫黑除恶、基层治理等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Lu Feng, Secretary of the Shanwei Municipal Party Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to study and deploy ideological work, anti-crime campaigns, and grassroots governance.

articles.title_zh: 汕尾市委常委会召开会议 研究部署意识形态、扫黑除恶、基层治理等工作
articles.title_en: Shanwei Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Study and Deploy Ideological, Anti-Gang, and Grassroots Governance Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，汕尾市委书记逯峰主持召开市委常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，研究部署意识形态、扫黑除恶、基层治理等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Lu Feng, Secretary of the Shanwei Municipal Party Committee, chaired a meeting of the Standing Committee to study and deploy ideological work, anti-gang efforts, and grassroots governance.

articles.title_zh: 李国强到岱岳区调研
articles.title_en: Li Guoqiang Visits Daiyue District for Research
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，泰安市委副书记、市长李国强到岱岳区调研粮食生产、高标准农田建设、大气污染防治等工作，强调统筹粮食安全、生态保护、产业提质和民生保障。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Li Guoqiang, Deputy Secretary of the Tai'an Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, visited Daiyue District to inspect grain production, high-standard farmland construction, and air pollution control, emphasizing coordinated efforts in food security, ecological protection, and people's livelihood.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议 黄强主持
articles.title_en: Huang Qiang Chairs Meeting of Jilin Provincial Party Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，吉林省委书记黄强主持召开省委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和中央文件精神，研究部署安全生产、乡村振兴等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Huang Qiang, Secretary of the Jilin Provincial Party Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to convey and study important speeches by General Secretary Xi Jinping and central documents, and to arrange work on work safety and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 中共威海市委召开党外人士座谈会
articles.title_en: CPC Weihai Municipal Committee Holds Symposium with Non-Party Personages
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，中共威海市委召开党外人士座谈会，听取各民主党派、工商联和无党派人士代表对市委常委会工作的意见建议，市委书记张海波主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, the CPC Weihai Municipal Committee held a symposium with non-party personages to hear opinions from representatives of democratic parties, the Federation of Industry and Commerce, and personages without party affiliation on the work of the Standing Committee. Municipal Party Secretary Zhang Haibo presided and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 赵一德在调研服务业发展并主持召开座谈会时强调全力促进服务业优质高效发展 为高质量发展现代化建设提供有力支撑
articles.title_en: Zhao Yide Stresses High-Quality Service Industry Development During Survey and Symposium in Xi'an
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，陕西省委书记赵一德在西安市调研服务业发展并主持召开座谈会，强调全力促进服务业优质高效发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Zhao Yide, Secretary of the CPC Shaanxi Provincial Committee, surveyed the service industry in Xi'an and chaired a symposium, stressing efforts to promote its high-quality and efficient development.

articles.title_zh: 朱镕基同志遗体在京火化 习近平等到八宝山革命公墓送别
articles.title_en: Comrade Zhu Rongji's Remains Cremated in Beijing; Xi Jinping and Others Bid Farewell at Babaoshan
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，朱镕基同志遗体在北京八宝山革命公墓火化，习近平、李强等党和国家领导人前往送别，胡锦涛送花圈哀悼。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the remains of Comrade Zhu Rongji were cremated at Babaoshan Revolutionary Cemetery in Beijing. Party and state leaders including Xi Jinping and Li Qiang bid farewell, and Hu Jintao sent a wreath.

articles.title_zh: 鄢陵县召开防汛救灾工作专题会议
articles.title_en: Yanling County Holds Special Meeting on Flood Control and Disaster Relief
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，鄢陵县召开防汛救灾工作专题会议，县委书记袁树林主持并讲话，强调压实责任、抓好灾后恢复重建，确保人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Yanling County held a special meeting on flood control and disaster relief. County Party Secretary Yuan Shulin presided and emphasized consolidating responsibilities and post-disaster reconstruction to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 省供销合作总社党组书记、理事会主任童孟进带队到襄城县调研
articles.title_en: Tong Mengjin Leads Delegation to Survey Xiangcheng County
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日下午，省供销合作总社党组书记、理事会主任童孟进带队到襄城县调研供销系统综合改革、农业社会化服务及基层供销社建设工作，对当地成效给予肯定。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 17, Tong Mengjin, Party Secretary and Director of the Provincial Supply and Marketing Cooperative, led a delegation to Xiangcheng County to inspect comprehensive reforms, agricultural socialized services, and grassroots cooperative development.

tags.name_en: Supply and Marketing Cooperative Comprehensive Reform

tags_en: Supply and Marketing Cooperative Comprehensive Reform

articles.title_zh: 中国致公党烟台市第八次代表大会召开
articles.title_en: 8th Congress of China Zhi Gong Party Yantai Committee Convened
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，中国致公党烟台市第八次代表大会召开，选举产生新一届委员会，纪洪芳当选主任委员。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the 8th Congress of the China Zhi Gong Party Yantai Committee was held, electing a new committee with Ji Hongfang as chairwoman.

articles.title_zh: 阳西县组织学生开展军训
articles.title_en: Yangxi County Organizes Student Military Training
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，阳西县人民武装部联合县教育局在广二师附属阳西二中、阳西县崇文学校举行学生军训动员大会，旨在加强青少年国防教育。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, the Yangxi County People's Armed Forces Department and the County Education Bureau held a student military training mobilization meeting at two local schools to strengthen national defense education for youth.

tags.name_en: Yangxi County People's Armed Forces Department

tags_en: Yangxi County People's Armed Forces Department

articles.title_zh: 陶少华主持召开银川市第十六届人民政府第117次常务会议
articles.title_en: Tao Shaohua Chairs 117th Executive Meeting of Yinchuan Municipal Government
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，银川市市长陶少华主持召开市政府常务会议，部署三季度经济工作、安全生产及双拥工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Mayor Tao Shaohua chaired the 117th executive meeting of Yinchuan Municipal Government, deploying Q3 economic work, safety production, and double-support work.

articles.title_zh: 谢运策到华容县督战群腐集中整治工作
articles.title_en: Xie Yunce Inspects Anti-Corruption Campaign in Huarong County
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，岳阳市委常委、市纪委书记谢运策率调研组到华容县督战群众身边腐败和作风问题集中整治工作，并主持召开座谈会。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Xie Yunce, a standing committee member of the Yueyang Municipal Party Committee and head of the municipal discipline inspection commission, led a team to Huarong County to inspect the centralized campaign against corruption and misconduct among the people and presided over a seminar.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江主持召开专题会议研究学习教育突出问题整改整治工作
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Chairs Special Meeting on Rectification of Learning Education Issues
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，湖南省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江主持召开专题会议，听取全市学习教育突出问题整改整治工作进展并部署下一步工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Xie Weijiang, Deputy Secretary of Hunan Provincial Party Committee and Yueyang Municipal Party Secretary, chaired a special meeting to review progress on rectifying prominent issues in learning education.

articles.title_zh: 王崧到周口市督导调研防汛救灾工作
articles.title_en: Wang Song Inspects Flood Control and Disaster Relief Work in Zhoukou
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，河南省委常委、宣传部部长王崧到周口市督导调研防汛救灾工作，察看积水点、安置点等，慰问受灾群众和一线人员。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Wang Song, member of the Standing Committee of the Henan Provincial Party Committee and head of the Propaganda Department, inspected flood control and disaster relief work in Zhoukou, visiting waterlogging sites and resettlement points.

articles.title_zh: 全省审计查出问题整改工作视频会议召开
articles.title_en: Provincial Video Conference on Rectification of Audit-Discovered Issues Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，全省审计查出问题整改工作视频会议召开，省委副书记、省长周乃翔出席并讲话，部署中央和省级预算执行审计查出问题整改工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, a provincial video conference on rectifying audit-discovered issues was held. Zhou Naixiang, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee and Governor, attended and delivered a speech, deploying rectification work for central and provincial budget execution audit findings.

articles.title_zh: 非洲多国限制“台湾护照”
articles.title_en: African Countries Restrict 'Taiwan Passports'
articles.summary_zh: 近期乌干达、南非、摩洛哥、肯尼亚等多个非洲国家奉行一个中国政策，对持台湾旅行证件人员入境做出限制。
articles.summary_en: Several African countries, including Uganda, South Africa, Morocco, and Kenya, have recently restricted entry for holders of Taiwan travel documents, citing the One-China policy.

articles.title_zh: 香港宏福苑火灾报告延期至10月底前完成
articles.title_en: Hong Kong Hong Fu Yuan Fire Report Delayed to End of October
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，香港大埔宏福苑火灾独立调查委员会表示已获行政长官同意，将提交报告期限延至10月底。委员会已举行30场听证会，听取80名证人证言。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the independent committee investigating the Hong Fu Court fire in Tai Po said it has obtained the Chief Executive's approval to extend the report deadline to end of October. The committee has held 30 hearings and heard 80 witnesses.

articles.title_zh: 四部门联合发布意见加强医院法治建设
articles.title_en: Four Departments Issue Opinions to Strengthen Hospital Legal System
articles.summary_zh: 近日，国家卫生健康委、教育部、国家中医药局、国家疾控局联合印发《关于加强医院法治建设的意见》，部署医院法治体系建设，明确提出到2030年基本建成完善的医院法治工作体系。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the National Health Commission, Ministry of Education, National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine and National Disease Control Bureau jointly issued Opinions on Strengthening Hospital Legal System, deploying hospital rule-of-law construction and aiming to build a complete legal framework by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 一汽车顶着停车场收费员开行，广东佛山通报
articles.title_en: Guangdong Foshan Reports Car Driving Toward Parking Attendant
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，广东佛山通报一起汽车顶着停车场收费员开行的事件，引发社会关注。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Foshan, Guangdong reported an incident where a car drove toward a parking attendant, drawing public attention.

articles.title_zh: 内地媒体人冒充港中大客座教授走穴近三年，校方打假：从未聘用
articles.title_en: Mainland Media Person Impersonated CUHK Visiting Professor for Three Years; University Denies Employment
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，香港中文大学发布声明，否认曾聘用自称“客座教授”的内地媒体人张龙，称其与校方无任何雇佣、教学或授权关系。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the Chinese University of Hong Kong issued a statement denying that it had ever employed a mainland media person named Zhang Long, who claimed to be a CUHK visiting professor, saying there is no relationship with him.

tags.name_en: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

tags_en: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

articles.title_zh: 国务院修改《住房公积金管理条例》
articles.title_en: State Council Amends Regulations on Housing Provident Fund
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强签署国务院令，公布修改后的《住房公积金管理条例》，自2026年9月20日起施行，拓宽提取范围，支持灵活就业人员缴存。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council decree to amend regulations on the housing provident fund, effective Sept. 20, 2026, expanding withdrawal uses and allowing flexible employment workers to contribute.

articles.title_zh: 受贿数额特别巨大，宁夏回族自治区政府原主席刘慧被提起公诉
articles.title_en: Liu Hui, Former Chairwoman of Ningxia Government, Indicted for Bribery of Especially Huge Amount
articles.summary_zh: 最高人民检察院通报，宁夏回族自治区政府原主席刘慧涉嫌受贿，数额特别巨大，已由菏泽市人民检察院提起公诉。
articles.summary_en: The Supreme People's Procuratorate announced that Liu Hui, former chairwoman of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region, was indicted for bribery with an especially huge amount. The Heze Municipal People's Procuratorate filed the public prosecution.

articles.title_zh: 从前7个月数据看中国经济向新向优
articles.title_en: Interpreting China's Economy in First 7 Months: Moving Toward Innovation and Quality
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局17日发布数据显示，今年1至7月中国经济运行总体平稳，新动能成长壮大，延续向新向好态势。
articles.summary_en: Data released by the National Bureau of Statistics on Aug 17 show China's economy remained stable in the first seven months, with new growth drivers expanding and the trend toward innovation and quality continuing.

articles.title_zh: 福建历史文化街区激活文旅新热潮
articles.title_en: Fujian Historical and Cultural Blocks Revitalize Cultural Tourism Boom
articles.summary_zh: 福建福州上下杭等历史文化街区以“非遗+国潮+夜游”激活文旅新热潮，2025年三大街区接待超5500万人次，推动“古厝经济”发展。
articles.summary_en: Historical blocks in Fujian, such as Shangxiahang in Fuzhou, are thriving with intangible heritage, national trend, and night tours, receiving over 55 million visits in 2025 and boosting the ancient building economy.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开党组（扩大）会议 深入学习贯彻习近平文化思想
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Government Holds Party Group (Enlarged) Meeting to Study Xi Jinping Thought on Culture
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，福州市政府党组（扩大）会议召开，深入学习贯彻习近平文化思想及关于文化和自然遗产保护传承利用的重要指示精神，市长吴贤德主持并发言。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the Fuzhou Municipal Government held a Party Group (Enlarged) meeting to study Xi Jinping Thought on Culture and his important instructions on cultural and natural heritage protection, chaired by Mayor Wu Xiande.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开党组会议和常务会议
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Government Holds Party Group Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，福州市市长吴贤德主持召开市政府党组会议和常务会议，研究贯彻落实中央及省市委全会精神，审议新兴产业和未来产业发展专项规划。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Fuzhou Mayor Wu Xiande chaired the municipal government's Party group and executive meetings to implement central and provincial committee directives and review plans for emerging and future industries.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记指引企业坚定不移走高质量发展之路
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Guides Enterprises Along the Path of High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 文章综述习近平总书记高度重视企业发展，强调坚持两个毫不动摇，指引各类企业走高质量发展道路，聚焦创新与实体经济。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews Xi Jinping's emphasis on supporting enterprises of all ownership types, guiding them toward high-quality development with focus on innovation and the real economy.

articles.title_zh: 青岛科创大走廊融合发展座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Qingdao Holds Symposium on Integrated Development of Science and Innovation Corridor
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日上午，青岛科创大走廊融合发展座谈会召开，市委书记曾赞荣出席并讲话，强调整合资源要素，强化科技引领，推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 18, Qingdao held a symposium on integrated development of the Science and Innovation Corridor. Municipal Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong attended and spoke, emphasizing resource integration and technology-led deep integration of technological and industrial innovation.

articles.title_zh: 任刚会见国家能源集团客人
articles.title_en: Ren Gang Meets Guest from China Energy Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，青岛市市长任刚会见国家能源集团副总经理傅振邦一行，双方就新能源领域合作洽谈，并签署战略合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Mayor Ren Gang of Qingdao met with Fu Zhenbang, Vice President of China Energy Group, to discuss new energy cooperation and signed a strategic cooperation agreement.

articles.title_zh: 曾赞荣调研创新型产业发展工作
articles.title_en: Zeng Zanrong Inspects Innovative Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，青岛市委书记曾赞荣到崂山区调研创新型产业发展，强调强化企业创新主体地位，加快发展新赛道、壮大新动能。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Zeng Zanrong, Party Secretary of Qingdao, inspected innovative industry development in Laoshan District, stressing the role of enterprises as innovation leaders and the need to accelerate new tracks and momentum.

articles.title_zh: 中船集团国企开放日暨品牌宣传周在“爱达·花城号”正式启动 第二艘国产邮轮冲刺11月交付
articles.title_en: CSSC SOE Open Day and Brand Promotion Week Launches on 'Adora Flora City', Second Domestic Cruise Ship Targets November Delivery
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，中船集团国企开放日暨品牌宣传周在上海外高桥造船公司的第二艘国产大型邮轮“爱达·花城号”上启动，该邮轮计划11月交付。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, CSSC launched its SOE Open Day and Brand Promotion Week aboard the second domestically-built cruise ship "Adora Flora City" in Shanghai, which is scheduled for delivery in November.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷在全省政协主席暑期读书会上作经济形势报告 高质量完成全年目标任务 为实现“十五五”良好开局作出新贡献
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Delivers Economic Report at Provincial CPPCC Chairmen's Summer Reading Session
articles.summary_zh: 18日上午，浙江省省长刘捷在全省政协主席暑期读书会上作经济形势报告，强调高质量完成全年目标任务，为实现“十五五”良好开局作出新贡献。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 18, Governor Liu Jie of Zhejiang gave a report on economic situation at the provincial CPPCC chairmen's summer reading session, urging high-quality fulfilment of annual targets and a good start for the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 市委理论学习中心组举行专题学习会 袁家军主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Holds Thematic Study Session, Yuan Jiajun Chairs and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日上午，重庆市委理论学习中心组举行专题学习会，市委书记袁家军主持并讲话，强调树立大抓基层导向，开创“十五五”开局之年基层工作新局面。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 17, the theoretical study center group of the Chongqing Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to study excerpts from Xi Jinping's discourses on grassroots work methods. Yuan Jiajun, municipal party secretary, presided over the meeting and stressed strengthening grassroots work.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚到南宁调研AI+文化产业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Visits Nanning to Research AI-Enabled Cultural Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚到南宁市调研AI+文化产业高质量发展，强调推动AI赋能，形成商业闭环，开展面向东盟的AI+文化交流合作。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 17, Chen Gang, Party Secretary of Guangxi, visited Nanning to research AI-enabled cultural industry development, urging AI empowerment and ASEAN-oriented cultural exchanges.

articles.title_zh: 全省群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治攻坚决战工作推进会召开
articles.title_en: Provincial Conference Held on Intensified Campaign against Corruption and Misconduct around the People
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，河南省召开群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治攻坚决战工作推进会，省委书记刘宁出席并讲话，中央纪委国家监委第五督导组组长王荣军到会指导。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Henan Province held a conference to intensify the campaign against corruption and misconduct affecting the people. Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning attended and spoke, while Wang Rongjun, head of the fifth supervision group of the CCDI and NSS, provided guidance.

articles.title_zh: 湖南实施智能机器人十大重点工程
articles.title_en: Hunan Launches Ten Key Projects for Intelligent Robot Industry
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，湖南举行新闻发布会，解读智能机器人产业发展实施意见，提出到2030年产业链营收突破2000亿元，进入全国第一梯队。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Hunan held a press conference to explain its implementation opinions on the intelligent robot industry, aiming for over 200 billion yuan in revenue by 2030 and entry into the national first tier.

articles.title_zh: 赵乐际主持召开十四届全国人大常委会第七十一次委员长会议 决定十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议8月25日至28日在京举行
articles.title_en: Zhao Leji Chairs 71st Chairmen's Meeting of 14th NPC Standing Committee, Decides 24th Session to Be Held Aug 25-28 in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 十四届全国人大常委会第七十一次委员长会议18日上午在北京举行，赵乐际主持，决定第二十四次常委会会议8月25日至28日在京召开。
articles.summary_en: The 71st Chairmen's Meeting of the 14th NPC Standing Committee was held in Beijing on Aug 18, chaired by Zhao Leji, deciding the 24th session of the committee to convene from Aug 25 to 28 in Beijing.

tags.name_en: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

tags_en: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 我们的“十五五”丨未来五年，大好河山添新绿
articles.title_en: 15th Five-Year: Greener Land for the Future
articles.summary_zh: “十五五”开局之年，生态环境部等部门联合印发《生态保护“十五五”规划》，提出完善城市绿地系统、提升生态质量指数等目标。
articles.summary_en: At the start of the 15th Five-Year period, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment and other departments jointly issued the Plan for Ecological Protection during the 15th Five-Year Plan, setting targets to improve urban green spaces and raise the ecological quality index.

articles.title_zh: 两部门预拨6000万元支持河南应急抢险救灾
articles.title_en: Two Ministries Allocate 60 Million Yuan for Emergency Relief in Henan
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，财政部、应急管理部预拨6000万元中央自然灾害救灾资金，支持河南防汛应急抢险救灾工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Emergency Management allocated 60 million yuan in central disaster relief funds to support flood emergency response and rescue in Henan.

articles.title_zh: 赵一德在调研服务业发展并主持召开座谈会时强调 全力促进服务业优质高效发展 为高质量发展现代化建设提供有力支撑
articles.title_en: Zhao Yide Emphasizes High-Quality Development of Service Industry at Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，陕西省委书记赵一德在西安调研服务业发展并主持召开座谈会，强调要促进服务业优质高效发展，为高质量发展提供支撑。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Shaanxi Party Secretary Zhao Yide visited Xi'an to inspect service industry development and chaired a symposium, emphasizing high-quality development of the service sector to support modernization.

articles.title_zh: 赵刚主持召开省政府党组会议
articles.title_en: Zhao Gang Chairs Shaanxi Provincial Government Party Group Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，陕西省省长赵刚主持召开省政府党组会议，学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署国防和军队建设及侨务工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Shaanxi Governor Zhao Gang chaired a Party Group meeting of the provincial government to study Xi Jinping's important speeches and deploy national defense and overseas Chinese affairs work.

articles.title_zh: 张工赴津南区调研
articles.title_en: Zhang Gong Inspects Jinnan District
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日上午，天津市长张工赴津南区调研，走访多家高新技术企业，强调坚持创新引领、深化产教融合，增强发展动力。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 17, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong visited Jinnan District, inspecting several high-tech enterprises and stressing innovation-driven development and industry-education integration.

articles.title_zh: 陈敏尔：坚持“四个以文” 推进城市更新 进一步提升城市业态功能品质
articles.title_en: Chen Min'er: Uphold 'Four Advances' to Promote Urban Renewal and Improve City Functions and Quality
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，天津市委书记陈敏尔调研城市特色建筑焕新利用，强调坚持“四个以文”，推进城市更新，提升城市业态功能品质。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Tianjin Party Secretary Chen Min'er toured historic buildings and commercial districts, stressing cultural preservation and urban renewal to improve city functions and quality.

articles.title_zh: 王浩在绍兴调研强调集中精力抓好项目谋划招引建设
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Stresses Project Planning and Attraction During Shaoxing Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，浙江省委书记王浩在绍兴调研，强调集中精力抓好项目谋划招引建设，深入企业了解科技创新，要求加快创新浙江建设，为高质量发展注入新动力。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 17, Wang Hao, Party Secretary of Zhejiang, inspected Shaoxing, urging focused efforts on project planning and attraction, and visited tech firms to boost innovation-driven development.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江发生2026年第2号洪水
articles.title_en: Flood No.2 of 2026 Hits Heilongjiang
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日8时，黑龙江漠河水文站水位涨至警戒水位，洪水编号为2026年第2号。水利部维持Ⅳ级应急响应，派组协助防汛。
articles.summary_en: At 08:00 on August 17, the water level at Mohe Hydrological Station in Heilongjiang reached the warning level, triggering the designation of Flood No.2 of 2026. The Ministry of Water Resources maintained a Level-IV emergency response and dispatched work groups to assist flood control.

articles.title_zh: 遵义市仁怀市委原常委、茅台镇党委原书记王远强被“双开”
articles.title_en: Former Renhuai Official Wang Yuanqiang Expelled from Party and Public Office
articles.summary_zh: 据遵义市纪委监委消息，经遵义市委批准，对仁怀市委原常委、茅台镇党委原书记王远强严重违纪违法问题立案审查调查，决定给予其开除党籍和公职处分，并移送检察机关审查起诉。
articles.summary_en: According to the Zunyi Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection, Wang Yuanqiang, former Standing Committee member of Renhuai Municipal Party Committee and former Party Secretary of Moutai Town, was expelled from the Party and public office for serious disciplinary violations and suspected bribery, with his case transferred to prosecutors.

articles.title_zh: 阿塞拜疆语版《习近平的文化情缘》亮相阿国家台
articles.title_en: Azerbaijani Version of "Xi Jinping's Cultural Bonds" Debuts on Azerbaijan's National TV
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月14日，中央广播电视总台译制的阿塞拜疆语版《习近平的文化情缘》在巴库启播，并在阿国家电视台和ARB24电视台播出，促进中阿文化交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the Azerbaijani version of "Xi Jinping's Cultural Bonds", produced by China Media Group, premiered in Baku and aired on Azerbaijan's national TV and ARB24, boosting cultural exchange.

articles.title_zh: 习近平：江泽民同志的一生，是光辉的一生、战斗的一生
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping: Comrade Jiang Zemin's Life Was Glorious and Militant
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日上午，纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会在北京人民大会堂举行，习近平出席并发表重要讲话，高度评价江泽民同志的一生。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 17, a ceremony for the 100th anniversary of Jiang Zemin's birth was held in Beijing. Xi Jinping attended and praised Jiang's glorious life.

articles.title_zh: 1至7月全国铁路完成固定资产投资4406亿元
articles.title_en: Railway Fixed Asset Investment Reaches 440.6 Billion Yuan in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 今年1至7月，全国铁路完成固定资产投资4406亿元，多个重点工程取得积极进展。
articles.summary_en: China's railway fixed asset investment reached 440.6 billion yuan from January to July, with steady progress on key projects.

articles.title_zh: 习近平牵挂的那片林海
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Concerned Forest Sea
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾习近平总书记对塞罕坝林场建设者的重要指示和实地考察，讲述三代人荒原变林海的生态奇迹，强调传承塞罕坝精神。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews Xi Jinping's important instructions and field inspection of the Saihanba forest farm, highlighting the ecological miracle of turning wasteland into forest sea and the spirit of Saihanba.

articles.title_zh: 神二十三乘组在轨80余天 多项空间科学实（试）验有序推进
articles.title_en: Shenzhou-23 Crew Completes 80+ Days in Orbit, Space Experiments Progress
articles.summary_zh: 神舟二十三号乘组三名航天员已在轨驻留80余天，空间科学实验和在轨训练有序推进。
articles.summary_en: The Shenzhou-23 crew of three astronauts has spent over 80 days in orbit, with space science experiments and in-orbit training progressing steadily.

articles.title_zh: 黄土塬上长出新职业（老区新事）
articles.title_en: New Occupations Spring Up on the Loess Plateau (New Stories in Old Revolutionary Areas)
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃庆阳依托“东数西算”工程，发展数据标注、无人机驾驶等数字产业，带动群众家门口就业，昔日“陇东粮仓”有了“数字粮食”。
articles.summary_en: Qingyang, Gansu, leverages the 'East Data, West Computing' project to develop digital industries like data annotation and drone piloting, creating local jobs and transforming the once grain-producing region.

articles.title_zh: 前7月全国铁路发送旅客28亿人次
articles.title_en: China's Railways Carry 2.8 Billion Passengers in First 7 Months
articles.summary_zh: 国铁集团数据显示，今年前7月全国铁路发送旅客28亿人次，同比增长4.1%，再创历史同期新高，其中外籍旅客增长32.5%。
articles.summary_en: China's railways carried 2.8 billion passengers in the first seven months, up 4.1% year-on-year, a record high, with foreign passengers up 32.5%.
