articles.title_zh: 上半年新改建农村公路3.4万公里
articles.title_en: China Rebuilds 34,000 km of Rural Roads in First Half
articles.summary_zh: 交通运输部8月16日发布数据：上半年全国农村公路完成固定资产投资1443亿元，新改建3.4万公里。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Transport reported on Aug 16 that rural road investment reached 144.3 billion yuan in H1, with 34,000 km newly built or upgraded.

articles.title_zh: 以扎实举措推进农业农村现代化
articles.title_en: Solid Measures to Advance Agricultural and Rural Modernization
articles.summary_zh: “十五五”开局之年，我国夏粮产量首次突破3000亿斤，各地区各部门坚持农业农村优先发展，推进乡村振兴，农业科技和产业提质增效。
articles.summary_en: In the first year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, China's summer grain output exceeded 300 billion jin for the first time. Various regions and departments are prioritizing agricultural and rural development to boost rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 推动企业发展更上一层楼，为国家作出更大贡献——习近平总书记指引企业坚定不移走高质量发展之路
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Guides Enterprises to Steadfastly Follow the Path of High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 新华社8月16日发文，习近平总书记高度重视企业发展，强调坚持基本经济制度、鼓励创新，指引各类企业坚定不移走高质量发展之路，为推进中国式现代化贡献力量。
articles.summary_en: On August 16, Xinhua reported that President Xi Jinping attaches great importance to enterprise development, emphasizing adherence to the basic economic system and encouraging innovation to guide enterprises of all types on the path of high-quality development, contributing to Chinese modernization.

articles.title_zh: 赤峰市委理论学习中心组举行集体学习会
articles.title_en: Chifeng Municipal Party Committee Holds Collective Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，赤峰市委书记唐毅主持召开市委理论学习中心组集体学习会，深入学习习近平经济思想，研讨推动全市高质量发展的思路建议。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 17, Tang Yi, secretary of Chifeng Municipal Party Committee, chaired a collective study session of the Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Learning Center Group to study Xi Jinping's economic thought and discuss high-quality development plans.

articles.title_zh: 纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会在京隆重举行 习近平发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Commemoration Ceremony for Jiang Zemin's 100th Birthday Held in Beijing, Xi Jinping Delivers Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日上午，中共中央、全国人大常委会、国务院、全国政协、中央军委在北京人民大会堂隆重举行纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会，习近平发表重要讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, top Chinese leaders held a grand ceremony in Beijing to commemorate the 100th anniversary of Jiang Zemin's birth, with Xi Jinping delivering an important speech.

articles.title_zh: 国务院关于《特殊教育发展提升“十五五”行动计划》的批复
articles.title_en: State Council Approves Action Plan for Special Education Development During 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 国务院批复同意《特殊教育发展提升“十五五”行动计划》，要求加快建设高质量特殊教育体系，保障残疾儿童青少年受教育机会。
articles.summary_en: The State Council approved the Action Plan for Special Education Development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, urging the construction of a high-quality special education system and ensuring educational opportunities for children with disabilities.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院第十二次全体会议
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs the 12th Plenary Meeting of the State Council
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强8月17日主持召开国务院第十二次全体会议，强调扎实做好经济工作，努力完成全年经济社会发展目标任务。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired the 12th plenary meeting of the State Council on August 17, emphasizing solid economic work to achieve annual economic and social development targets.

articles.title_zh: 《江泽民外交文选》出版发行
articles.title_en: Selected Diplomatic Works of Jiang Zemin Published
articles.summary_zh: 经中共中央批准，由中央党史和文献研究院、外交部编辑的《江泽民外交文选》出版发行，收入江泽民1989年至2003年外交著作115篇。
articles.summary_en: Approved by the CPC Central Committee, the Selected Diplomatic Works of Jiang Zemin, edited by the CPC Central Committee Institute of Party History and Literature and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, has been published nationwide, containing 115 diplomatic works from 1989 to 2003.

articles.title_zh: 江泽民生平和思想研讨会在京举行 蔡奇出席开幕式并讲话
articles.title_en: Seminar on Jiang Zemin's Life and Thought Held in Beijing; Cai Qi Attends Opening and Delivers Speech
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，江泽民生平和思想研讨会在北京举行，中共中央政治局常委蔡奇出席开幕式并讲话，强调深化“三个代表”重要思想研究。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, a seminar on Jiang Zemin's life and thought was held in Beijing. Cai Qi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, attended and spoke, emphasizing deepening research on the 'Three Represents' important thought.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林会见浦发银行董事长张为忠行长谢伟
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Meets with SPDB Chairman Zhang Weizhong and President Xie Wei
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，辽宁省委书记许昆林在沈阳会见浦发银行董事长张为忠、行长谢伟一行，就深化金融合作、支持辽宁振兴进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Xu Kunlin, Secretary of the CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee, met with Zhang Weizhong, Chairman of SPDB, and Xie Wei, President, in Shenyang to discuss deepening financial cooperation and supporting Liaoning's revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦在市委理论学习中心组学习研讨会议上强调 坚定不移贯彻总体国家安全观以高水平安全保障高质量发展
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi Chairs Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Learning Center Group Meeting, Stresses Holistic National Security Approach
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日下午，淮北市委理论学习中心组举行学习研讨会议，市委书记蒋曦主持并讲话，强调贯彻总体国家安全观，以高水平安全保障高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 17, the Huaibei Municipal Party Committee held a theoretical learning center group meeting. Secretary Jiang Xi presided and stressed implementing the holistic approach to national security to safeguard high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院第十二次全体会议强调 深入贯彻落实党中央决策部署 努力完成全年经济社会发展目标任务
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs 12th Plenary Session of State Council, Emphasizes Implementing CPC Central Committee Decisions to Achieve Annual Economic and Social Development Goals
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，国务院总理李强主持召开国务院第十二次全体会议，强调要深入贯彻落实党中央决策部署，努力完成全年经济社会发展目标任务，实现“十五五”良好开局。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Premier Li Qiang chaired the 12th plenary session of the State Council, emphasizing the need to implement the CPC Central Committee's decisions and strive to achieve the annual economic and social development goals, ensuring a good start to the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰：倒排工期挂图作战 推动项目早日惠民
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie: Reverse Scheduling and Mapping Operations to Deliver Projects to People
articles.summary_zh: 15日下午，揭阳市市长曲晓杰赴揭阳体育中心和黄岐山云道调研重点民生项目建设，现场协调施工难题，强调倒排工期、挂图作战，确保项目早日惠民。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 15, 2026, Qu Xiaojie, Mayor of Jieyang, visited the Jieyang Sports Center and Huangqishan Cloud Path to inspect key livelihood projects, addressing construction issues and urging efficient scheduling for early public benefit.

articles.title_zh: 教育对口支援西藏工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Conference on Education Paired Assistance to Tibet Held in Lhasa
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，教育对口支援西藏工作会议在拉萨召开。西藏自治区党委书记王君正、教育部部长怀进鹏出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the Conference on Education Paired Assistance to Tibet was held in Lhasa. Wang Junzheng, Party Secretary of Tibet Autonomous Region, and Huai Jinpeng, Minister of Education, attended and addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 王君正：教育对口支援西藏工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng: Conference on Education Counterpart Support for Tibet Convened
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，教育对口支援西藏工作会议在拉萨召开，西藏自治区党委书记王君正、教育部部长怀进鹏出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the Conference on Education Counterpart Support for Tibet was held in Lhasa. Wang Junzheng, Party Secretary of Tibet Autonomous Region, and Huai Jinpeng, Minister of Education, attended and delivered speeches.

articles.title_zh: 叶小钢音乐工作室落地汕尾 助力打造滨海音乐之城

articles.summary_en: Ye Xiaogang's music studio was established in Shanwei; the Urban District Government signed a five-year strategic cooperation agreement with his team to boost the city's music industry.

articles.title_zh: 威海市人民政府与山东高速集团签署战略合作协议
articles.title_en: Weihai Municipal Government and Shandong High-speed Group Sign Strategic Cooperation Agreement

articles.summary_en: On August 14, the Weihai Municipal Government and Shandong High-speed Group held a signing ceremony for a strategic cooperation agreement, focusing on transportation infrastructure, new energy, low-altitude economy and other fields.

articles.title_zh: 蒋锋检查受台风“白海豚”影响点位修复工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Feng Inspects Repair Work at Sites Affected by Typhoon Dolphin
articles.summary_zh: 8月16日，无锡市长蒋锋检查受台风“白海豚”影响点位修复工作，强调做好防台“后半篇文章”，保障群众生产生活安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 16, Wuxi Mayor Jiang Feng inspected repair work at sites affected by Typhoon Dolphin, stressing thorough follow-up efforts to ensure public safety and orderly life.

articles.title_zh: 魏都区召开农村集体“三资”清查整治工作推进会
articles.title_en: Weidu District Holds Work Meeting on Rural Collective 'Three Assets' Cleanup and Rectification
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，魏都区召开农村集体“三资”清查整治工作推进会，区委书记何长成讲话，部署下一阶段攻坚任务，强调以超常规举措开展专项治理。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Weidu District held a work meeting on the inspection and rectification of rural collective "three assets". District Party Secretary He Changcheng delivered a speech, deploying next-stage tasks and stressing extraordinary measures for the special governance.

articles.title_zh: 建安区：雨后田间忙管护 多管齐下筑牢秋粮安全防护墙

articles.summary_en: After continuous rain, the agriculture department of Jian'an District in Xuchang, Henan, sent agronomists to guide farmers on drainage, foliar fertilization, and pest control to safeguard autumn grain production.

articles.title_zh: 张国平调研防汛排涝及农业生产工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Guoping Inspects Flood Control and Agricultural Production

articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 15, County Magistrate Zhang Guoping visited townships to inspect flood control and agricultural production, urging accelerated drainage and field management to reduce crop losses.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会会议召开
articles.title_en: Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting Held

articles.summary_en: On August 14, the Standing Committee of the Yangjiang Municipal Party Committee convened to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech, focusing on AI industry development. Secretary Lu Yixian presided over the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 部署全面从严治党与经济发展等工作
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting on Party Discipline and Economic Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，银川市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署全面从严治党、经济发展、扫黑除恶等工作。自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee held a meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and deploy work on full and rigorous Party self-governance, economic development, and cracking down on gang crimes. Zhao Xuhui, member of the Standing Committee of the Party Committee of the Autonomous Region and Secretary of the Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee, presided over and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 杨政昆在元江县调研文旅融合发展情况
articles.title_en: Yang Zhengkun Inspects Cultural Tourism Development in Yuanjiang County

articles.summary_en: On Aug 14, Yang Zhengkun, Party secretary of Yuxi, inspected cultural tourism integration in Yuanjiang County, stressing comparative advantages and core branding for high-quality tourism.

articles.title_zh: 谢运策到岳阳县督战群腐集中整治工作

articles.summary_zh: 近日，岳阳市委常委、市纪委书记、市监委主任谢运策到岳阳县督战群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作，并主持召开座谈会，强调要算好底账、拧紧责任、整治顽疾、加力办案、促进长治长效。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Xie Yunce, member of the Standing Committee and secretary of the Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection of Yueyang, went to Yueyang County to supervise the concentrated rectification of unhealthy practices and corruption issues around the masses, and presided over a symposium, emphasizing intensified efforts and long-term effectiveness.

articles.summary_en: DeepSeek adjusted its API pricing effective Aug 17, introducing peak-valley pricing with off-peak rates at half of peak rates, in response to rising computing costs.

articles.summary_en: A grand ceremony marking the centenary of Jiang Zemin's birth was held in Beijing on the morning of August 17. Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Chinese President, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, attended and delivered an important speech.

articles.title_zh: “好年华 聚福州”第六届人才大会举行

Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Fuzhou Party Secretary Guo Ningning delivered a speech, and Mayor Wu Xiande presided over the event.

articles.title_en: Three Dialogues Amid Mountains and Rivers

articles.summary_en: On July 17, President Xi Jinping announced at the 2026 World AI Conference that China's meteorological intelligent early warning solution "Mazu" will be deployed in 30 countries. The article reviews Mazu culture and Fujian's "OTS" forecasting technology and "1262" mechanism.

articles.summary_zh: 江西1至7月重点建设项目完成投资1488.66亿元，昌九高铁进入静态验收阶段，省发改委多举措保障项目建设提速增效。
articles.summary_en: From January to July, Jiangxi's key construction projects completed investment of 148.866 billion yuan. The Changjiu high-speed railway entered static inspection as the provincial development commission accelerated project implementation.

articles.title_zh: 风鹏正举 辽沈焕新
articles.title_en: Liaoning Embarks on New Journey of Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾习近平总书记2022年考察辽宁后，辽宁在红色传承、生态治理、科技创新、民生保障、防汛救灾等方面取得新成效，展现振兴发展新气象。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews Liaoning's progress in red heritage, ecological conservation, sci-tech innovation, people's livelihood, and flood control since Xi Jinping's 2022 inspection, showcasing new momentum of revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 包钢在呼伦贝尔市调研
articles.title_en: Bao Gang Conducts Research in Hulunbuir
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日至16日，内蒙古自治区主席包钢在呼伦贝尔市调研群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治、秋季森林草原防灭火、生态环境保护等工作。
articles.summary_en: From August 14 to 16, Bao Gang, Chairman of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, conducted research in Hulunbuir on centralized rectification of misconduct and corruption, autumn forest and grassland fire prevention, and ecological environment protection.

articles.title_zh: 弥合鸿沟 推动人工智能普惠包容发展
articles.title_en: Bridging the Digital Divide and Promoting Inclusive Development of AI
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记强调广泛开展国际合作，帮助全球南方国家加强能力建设，弥合数智鸿沟。中国通过卫星遥感服务、研修培训等务实举措，推动人工智能普惠包容发展。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping calls for broad international cooperation to help Global South countries build capacity and bridge the digital divide. China is advancing inclusive AI development through satellite remote sensing services, training programs, and other practical measures.

articles.title_zh: 向上向善 推动人工智能健康有序发展
articles.title_en: Promoting Healthy and Ordered Development of Artificial Intelligence
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报综述文章，阐述中国推动人工智能向‘有益、安全、公平’方向发展的实践，包括举办机器人运动会、深圳防汛智能应用、新疆智慧医疗等。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily commentary on China's efforts to develop AI in a beneficial, safe, and fair direction, featuring robot games, Shenzhen flood control, and telemedicine in Xinjiang.

articles.title_zh: 纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会在京隆重举行 习近平出席大会并发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends Centenary Commemoration of Comrade Jiang Zemin in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月17日，纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会在北京隆重举行，中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平出席并发表重要讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, 2026, a grand gathering commemorating the 100th birthday of Comrade Jiang Zemin was held in Beijing, where Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, attended and delivered an important speech.

articles.title_zh: 青港两地签署《关于加强农渔业合作的协议》
articles.title_en: Qinghai and Hong Kong Sign Agreement on Agricultural and Fishery Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，青海省农业农村厅等与香港渔农自然护理署签署协议，加强农渔业合作，拓展青海绿色有机农畜产品供港渠道。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Qinghai's agriculture authorities signed an agreement with Hong Kong's Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department to boost agricultural and fishery cooperation and expand Qinghai's green organic products to Hong Kong.

tags.name_en: Agriculture and Rural Affairs Department of Qinghai Province
Green Organic Agricultural and Livestock Products

tags_en: Agriculture and Rural Affairs Department of Qinghai Province
Green Organic Agricultural and Livestock Products

articles.title_zh: 四川制定出台19条措施推进算力网建设
articles.title_en: Sichuan Issues 19 Measures to Boost Computing Network Construction
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，四川省发展改革委等部门联合印发推进算力网建设的政策措施，出台19条措施，构建“一区一带两节点”布局，打造算力高地。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Sichuan's development and reform commission and other departments jointly issued policies with 19 measures to promote computing network construction, forming a 'one zone, one belt, two nodes' layout.

articles.title_zh: 四川推出二十条措施为基金投资“松绑减负”
articles.title_en: Sichuan Introduces 20 Measures to Ease Restrictions on Fund Investment
articles.summary_zh: 近日，四川省政府办公厅印发实施意见，推出20条措施，放宽返投限制、允许全额容亏，为基金投资松绑减负。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the General Office of the Sichuan Provincial Government issued implementation opinions, introducing 20 measures to ease restrictions on fund investment, including relaxing return investment requirements and allowing full loss tolerance.

articles.title_zh: 山东省“双贴息”政策实施半年
articles.title_en: Shandong's 'Dual Interest Subsidy' Policy Marks Six Months
articles.summary_zh: 2026年上半年，山东省财政厅落实个人消费贷款贴息与服务业经营主体贷款贴息政策，分别惠及居民290.39万户、服务业经营主体13.46万家，撬动新发放贷款超5000亿元。
articles.summary_en: In the first half of 2026, Shandong's Department of Finance implemented loan interest subsidy policies for personal consumption and service industry entities, benefiting 2.9039 million households and 134,600 service businesses, and leveraging over 500 billion yuan in new loans.

articles.title_zh: 上海完整社区：让寸土寸金空间服务于人
articles.title_en: Shanghai Complete Communities: Serving People in Every Inch of Land
articles.summary_zh: 上海升级完整社区建设，从设施完善到治理创新，探索超大城市基层单元迭代，目标到2027年底覆盖率60%。
articles.summary_en: Shanghai upgrades complete community construction, from infrastructure to governance innovation, aiming to cover 60% of communities by 2027.

articles.title_zh: 技术经理人，深度参与企业成长
articles.title_en: Technology Managers Play Deep Role in Enterprise Growth
articles.summary_zh: 陕西等地加强技术经理人队伍建设，推动科技成果转化。陕西计划到2027年新增技术转移转化专业职称资格人才1000名，已培训3000余名技术经理人。
articles.summary_en: Shaanxi and other regions strengthen technology manager teams to boost commercialization of research. Shaanxi plans to add 1,000 professionals with technical transfer titles by 2027, and has trained over 3,000 managers.

articles.title_zh: 智慧城市数据利用顶层框架国际标准发布
articles.title_en: International Standard Released for Smart City Data Utilization Top-Level Framework
articles.summary_zh: 国际标准化组织（ISO）与国际电工委员会（IEC）联合发布由我国专家牵头制定的智慧城市数据利用国际标准，填补该领域综合性国际标准空白。
articles.summary_en: ISO and IEC jointly released an international standard on smart city data utilization framework, led by Chinese experts, filling a gap in comprehensive international standards.

articles.title_zh: 中越青年在文山调研交流
articles.title_en: Chinese and Vietnamese Youth Exchange in Wenshan
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日至14日，中越青年友好交流活动在云南文山举行，40名青年代表围绕创业就业、产业发展等主题调研交流。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 10 to 14, a China-Vietnam youth friendship exchange was held in Wenshan, Yunnan, with 40 young delegates discussing entrepreneurship, industry, and cultural exchanges.

articles.title_zh: 丽水推动职称评审与产业人才培育精准契合
articles.title_en: Lishui Aligns Professional Title Evaluation with Industrial Talent Development
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省丽水市将中级职称评审委员会建在产业链上，下放评审权限至行业协会和企业，累计培育产业工程师521人，推动职称评审与产业人才精准对接。
articles.summary_en: Lishui, Zhejiang, established intermediate title review committees on industrial chains, delegating evaluation authority to industry associations and enterprises, cultivating 521 industrial engineers to align title evaluation with talent needs.

articles.title_zh: 阿塞拜疆语版节目《习近平的文化情缘》启播活动在巴库举行
articles.title_en: Azerbaijani Version of Xi Jinping's Cultural Bonds Launches in Baku
articles.summary_zh: 由中央广播电视总台译制的首部阿塞拜疆语版节目《习近平的文化情缘》启播活动日前在阿塞拜疆首都巴库举行，旨在向国际受众阐释习近平文化思想。
articles.summary_en: The Azerbaijani-language premiere of China Media Group's program Xi Jinping's Cultural Bonds was held in Baku, showcasing Xi's thoughts on cultural inheritance and promoting cross-cultural exchange.

articles.title_zh: 引领全面建设社会主义现代化强国的历史性跨越
articles.title_en: Leading the Historic Leap towards Building a Modern Socialist Country
articles.summary_zh: 文章阐述中国式现代化理论的形成发展、丰富内涵与实践伟力，强调以该理论为指引全面推进强国建设、民族复兴伟业。
articles.summary_en: The article elaborates on the formation, rich connotations, and practical power of Chinese-style modernization theory, emphasizing its role in guiding the comprehensive building of a great modern socialist country.

articles.title_zh: 习近平：在纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会上的讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Speech at the Centenary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's Birth
articles.summary_zh: 习近平在纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会上发表讲话，高度评价江泽民同志的历史贡献，号召全党学习其崇高风范。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping delivered a speech at the centenary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, highly praising his historical contributions and calling on the whole Party to learn from his noble character.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就印度尼西亚发生强烈地震向印尼总统普拉博沃致慰问电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Condolences to Indonesian President Prabowo over Earthquake
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，国家主席习近平就印尼强烈地震向印尼总统普拉博沃致慰问电，对遇难者表示哀悼并致以诚挚慰问。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, President Xi Jinping sent a condolence message to Indonesian President Prabowo over a strong earthquake, expressing condolences for the victims and the injured.

articles.title_zh: 纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会在京隆重举行 习近平出席大会并发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Commemoration of Jiang Zemin's 100th Birthday Held in Beijing; Xi Jinping Attends and Delivers Speech
articles.summary_zh: 纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会17日上午在北京隆重举行，中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平出席大会并发表重要讲话。
articles.summary_en: The grand gathering marking the 100th anniversary of Jiang Zemin's birth was held in Beijing on the morning of August 17. Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, attended and delivered an important speech.

articles.title_zh: 梁言顺在界首市委党校调研
articles.title_en: Liang Yanshun Visits Party School of Jieshou
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日下午，安徽省委书记梁言顺在界首市委党校调研，强调强化党校姓党、牢记党校初心，不断提高办学治校水平。
articles.summary_en: On August 15 afternoon, Anhui Provincial Party Secretary Liang Yanshun visited the Party School of Jieshou, emphasizing adherence to the Party's principles and improving the school's governance and education.

articles.title_zh: “十四五”期间市场监管部门部署开展专项行动 促进优化营商环境
articles.title_en: Market Regulatory Authorities Launch Special Campaign to Improve Business Environment During 14th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: “十四五”时期，市场监管部门开展滥用行政权力排除限制竞争执法专项行动，查处案件290件，促进优化营商环境和服务全国统一大市场。
articles.summary_en: During the 14th Five-Year Plan period, market regulators carried out special enforcement actions against administrative abuse to exclude or restrict competition, handling 290 cases to optimize the business environment and support the national unified market.

tags.name_zh: 国家市场监督管理总局

tags_zh: 国家市场监督管理总局

articles.title_zh: 两部门发文提出2030年国内油气供应量目标
articles.title_en: Two Ministries Set Target for Domestic Oil and Gas Supply by 2030
articles.summary_zh: 国家发改委、国家能源局近日印发《石油天然气发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年国内油气供应量达4.4亿吨油当量，并部署管道建设、绿色转型等重点任务。
articles.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Oil and Gas Development, setting a target of 440 million tons of oil equivalent in domestic supply by 2030, along with key tasks in pipeline construction and green transition.

articles.title_zh: 多部门发文进一步保障农业灌溉用水安全
articles.title_en: Multiple Departments Issue Notice to Further Ensure Safety of Agricultural Irrigation Water
articles.summary_zh: 生态环境部会同工信部、农业农村部等部门近日联合印发通知，加强工业、畜禽养殖等企业污水污染风险防范，保障农业灌溉用水安全。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Ecology and Environment and other departments have jointly issued a notice to strengthen pollution risk prevention from industrial and livestock enterprises, ensuring the safety of agricultural irrigation water.

articles.title_zh: 国家防办、应急管理部向新疆增调中央抗旱物资
articles.title_en: National Flood Control Office and Emergency Management Ministry Send Drought Relief Supplies to Xinjiang
articles.summary_zh: 应新疆防汛抗旱总指挥部请求，国家防总办公室、应急管理部会同国家粮食和储备局向新疆增调抗旱水泵等中央抗旱物资，支持抗旱减灾。
articles.summary_en: At Xinjiang's request, the National Flood Control Office and Emergency Management Ministry, with the National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration, sent drought relief supplies including pumps and generators.

articles.title_zh: 文献纪录片《江泽民》丨 第12集 《大道行歌》
articles.title_en: Documentary 'Jiang Zemin' Episode 12: 'Song of the Great Way'
articles.summary_zh: 为纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年，中共中央宣传部等联合摄制的十二集文献纪录片《江泽民》播出。本集回顾1985年江泽民主持马克思、恩格斯雕像揭幕及推动马克思主义中国化的历程。
articles.summary_en: To commemorate the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, the 12-episode documentary 'Jiang Zemin' was co-produced by the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee and others. This episode reviews Jiang's unveiling of the Marx and Engels statues in 1985 and his promotion of the Sinicization of Marxism.

tags.name_en: Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee

tags_en: Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 提高防灾减灾救灾能力
articles.title_en: Enhancing Disaster Prevention, Mitigation and Relief Capabilities
articles.summary_zh: 8月16日出版的第16期《求是》杂志发表中共中央总书记习近平的重要文章《提高防灾减灾救灾能力》，强调坚持党的全面领导，提升防灾减灾救灾能力水平。
articles.summary_en: The 16th issue of Qiushi magazine, issued on August 16, publishes an important article by CPC General Secretary Xi Jinping on enhancing disaster prevention, mitigation and relief capabilities, stressing Party leadership and improving disaster response.

articles.title_zh: “推动企业发展更上一层楼，为国家作出更大贡献”——习近平总书记指引企业坚定不移走高质量发展之路
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Guides Enterprises to Pursue High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月16日，新华社发表综述，回顾习近平总书记深入企业调研、部署支持各类企业发展的系列论述，引领企业走自主创新和高质量发展之路。
articles.summary_en: On August 16, Xinhua published a review of Xi Jinping's important speeches and deployments on supporting enterprise development, guiding enterprises to pursue innovation and high-quality growth.

articles.title_zh: 朱镕基同志遗体18日火化 天安门等地将下半旗志哀
articles.title_en: The Body of Comrade Zhu Rongji to Be Cremated on the 18th; Flags to Fly at Half-Mast in Tiananmen and Other Places
articles.summary_zh: 新华社北京8月16日电，朱镕基同志遗体将于18日在北京火化，天安门、新华门等地将下半旗志哀。
articles.summary_en: According to Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, Aug. 16 - The body of Comrade Zhu Rongji will be cremated in Beijing on the 18th, and flags will fly at half-mast at Tiananmen, Xinhua Gate and other places.

articles.title_zh: 织密农村物流网 释放乡村新活力
articles.title_en: Rural Logistics Networks Enhanced, Unleashing New Rural Vitality
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来，各地持续升级农村物流体系，通过冷链直达田间、客货邮融合等方式，补齐城乡流通短板，7月份电商物流农村业务量同比增长超20%。
articles.summary_en: Since this year, regions have been upgrading rural logistics networks through cold-chain direct delivery and passenger-freight bus integration, bridging urban-rural gaps, with rural e-commerce logistics volume growing over 20% year-on-year in July.

articles.title_zh: 纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会17日上午在京隆重举行 习近平将出席大会并发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Attend Grand Meeting Commemorating 100th Anniversary of Jiang Zemin's Birth
articles.summary_zh: 纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会将于8月17日上午10时在人民大会堂举行，习近平将出席并发表重要讲话。
articles.summary_en: A grand meeting commemorating the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth will be held at 10 a.m. on August 17 at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. Xi Jinping will attend and deliver an important speech.

articles.title_zh: 以源头创新激发产业发展新动能
articles.title_en: Original Innovation Drives New Impetus for Industrial Development
articles.summary_zh: 全国重点实验室聚焦产业链关键环节，集中攻关核心技术，推动油气采收率提升、氢能防爆涂料等成果落地，促进新质生产力加速形成。
articles.summary_en: The national key laboratories focus on key links of industrial chains, tackling core technologies, and promoting application of innovations like enhanced oil recovery and hydrogen safety coatings, accelerating new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 汕头市政府召开党组（扩大）会议、常务会议
articles.title_en: Shantou Municipal Government Holds Party Group (Expanded) Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日下午，汕头市市长陈涛主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议、常务会议，传达学习上级精神，部署城乡区域协调发展、学习“义乌发展经验”等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 14, Chen Tao, Secretary of the Party Group and Mayor of Shantou, chaired the expanded Party Group meeting and executive meeting to convey higher-level directives and deploy work on urban-rural coordination and learning from Yiwu's development experience.

articles.title_zh: 2026年汕尾开渔文旅活动举行
articles.title_en: 2026 Shanwei Fishing Season Cultural Tourism Event Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月16日，2026年汕尾开渔文旅活动在汕尾市城区海港文旅码头举行，市委书记逯峰出席并讲话，启动开渔。
articles.summary_en: On August 16, the 2026 Shanwei Fishing Season Cultural Tourism Event was held at the Harbor Cultural Tourism Pier in Shanwei's urban area. Municipal Party Secretary Lu Feng attended, delivered a speech, and launched the fishing season.

articles.title_zh: 全市党委（党组）理论学习中心组学习会暨第七期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”举行
articles.title_en: Taizhou Holds Leadership Study Session Featuring Lecture on Embodied Intelligent Robots
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，泰州市举行全市党委（党组）理论学习中心组学习会暨第七期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”，华中科技大学教授陈学东作专题授课，市委书记姜冬冬等参加。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Taizhou held a Party committee theoretical study session featuring a lecture by Professor Chen Xuedong on embodied intelligent robots, attended by municipal leaders.

articles.title_zh: 绿发中科锂电容量产线项目签约
articles.title_en: Green Development Zhongke Lithium Capacitor Production Line Project Signed
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，姜堰经济开发区与北京绿发中科锂电容科技有限公司签约，总投资30亿元建设锂电容量产线项目，市委书记姜冬冬出席。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the Jiangyan Economic Development Zone signed an agreement with Beijing Green Development Zhongke Lithium Capacitor Technology Co., Ltd. for a 3 billion yuan lithium capacitor production line project, attended by Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong.

articles.title_zh: 绿发中科锂电容量产线项目签约
articles.title_en: Green Development Zhongke Lithium Capacitor Production Line Project Signed
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，姜堰经济开发区与北京绿发中科锂电容科技有限公司签约，建设总投资30亿元的锂电容量产线，年产900万支全碳型锂离子电容器。市委书记姜冬冬、中国绿发董事长孙瑜出席。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 13, Jiangyan Economic Development Zone signed a 3-billion-yuan lithium-capacitor project with Beijing GD Zhongke. Municipal Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong and GD Chairman Sun Yu attended.

articles.title_zh: 全市党委（党组）理论学习中心组学习会暨第七期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”举行
articles.title_en: City-Wide Party Committee (Party Group) Theoretical Learning Center Group Session and 7th Leading Cadres' 'Frontier Lecture Hall' Held

articles.summary_en: On August 13, Taizhou held its municipal Party committee (Party group) theoretical learning center group session and the 7th Leading Cadres' Frontier Lecture Hall, where Chen Xuedong lectured on embodied intelligent robots, with Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong attending.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰督导检查“保回迁”项目建设进展并主持召开专题会

articles.summary_en: On August 15, Hao Huijie, member of the Standing Committee of Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of Xi'an Municipal Party Committee, inspected resettlement housing projects and chaired a special meeting, stressing that residents must be relocated and housed on time with satisfaction.

articles.title_zh: 四胎能休产假吗？四川崇州人社局：生育第四孩不能享受90天延长产假

articles.summary_en: In response to a netizen's query, Chongzhou HR Bureau in Sichuan stated that a fourth child is entitled to the basic 98-day maternity leave but not the 90-day extended leave under provincial regulations.

articles.summary_en: Jiangmen Maritime Safety Administration issued a navigation warning that military training will be conducted in parts of the South China Sea from 0000 to 1200 on Aug 16-17, with entry prohibited.

articles.title_zh: 多地官方纠偏：别把社会工作部叫成“社工部”
articles.title_en: Officials in Multiple Regions Correct Misnomer: Don't Call the Social Work Department 'Shegongbu'
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，陕西韩城市委社会工作部发文指出，不应将“社会工作部”简称为“社工部”，以免混淆党的职能部门与专业服务人员。河南淇县等地也已作出类似纠偏。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the Social Work Department of the CPC Hancheng Municipal Committee warned against abbreviating 'Social Work Department' as 'Shegongbu', as it confuses Party functions with professional social workers.

articles.title_zh: 从四张成绩单看美丽中国建设新图景
articles.title_en: Beautiful China: Four Report Cards Show Green Development Progress
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月，在《生态环境法典》施行之际，文章以四张成绩单展示我国在降碳、减污、扩绿、增长方面的绿色发展成就，强调生态文明建设成效。
articles.summary_en: In August 2026, as the Ecological Environment Code took effect, the article uses four report cards to showcase China's achievements in carbon reduction, pollution control, greening, and growth, highlighting progress in ecological civilization.

articles.title_zh: 习言道丨良好生态环境是最普惠的民生福祉
articles.title_en: Xi's Words: Good Ecological Environment Is the Most Inclusive Public Wellbeing
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记指出良好生态环境是最公平的公共产品和最普惠的民生福祉，强调越是发展任务重越要重视生态环境保护。全国生态日之际，重温其重要讲话。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping pointed out that a good ecological environment is the most equitable public product and the most inclusive public wellbeing, stressing that ecological protection must be enhanced as development tasks grow. His important remarks are reviewed on China's National Ecological Day.

articles.title_zh: 洪秀柱：一湾浅浅的海峡隔不开血脉 国家统一是历史大势
articles.title_en: Hung Hsiu-chu: The Shallow Strait Cannot Separate Blood Ties; National Reunification Is the Historical Trend
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日，中国国民党前主席洪秀柱在广东阳江表示，海峡隔不开血脉，国家统一是历史大势，和平统一需依靠民间交流与文化联结。
articles.summary_en: On August 15, Hung Hsiu-chu, former chairman of the Chinese Kuomintang, said in Yangjiang, Guangdong that the Strait cannot separate blood ties, national reunification is the historical trend, and peaceful reunification relies on people-to-people exchanges and cultural bonds.

articles.title_zh: 从造梦到造物：AI科研实验室助力新材料创新
articles.title_en: From Dream to Reality: AI Research Lab Drives Innovation in New Materials

articles.summary_en: At the AI-driven research lab in Hefei, Anhui, the USTC Center for Scientific Intelligence and Material Creation has achieved breakthroughs in new materials and pesticides, promoting deep integration of industry, academia, and research.

articles.title_zh: 深化拓展“AI+” 江苏制造加速拥抱智能时代
articles.title_en: Deepen and Expand 'AI+': Jiangsu Manufacturing Accelerates to Embrace the Intelligent Era
articles.summary_zh: 近日，“活力中国调研行”采访团探访江苏多地，人工智能正与制造业深度融合，推动江苏制造智能化转型，上半年规上工业增加值同比增长6.7%。
articles.summary_en: Recently, a "Vibrant China Research Tour" team visited multiple places in Jiangsu. AI is deeply integrating with manufacturing, driving Jiangsu's smart transformation. In H1, value-added industrial output grew 6.7% year-on-year.

articles.title_zh: 严禁臆造“非遗大师”，福建惠安呼吁石雕从业者摒弃虚假噱头

articles.summary_en: Hui'an County tourism authority issued a proposal urging stone carving practitioners to stop using fake 'intangible heritage master' titles and regulate the use of heritage logos.

articles.title_zh: 广西出台方案加强旅游市场综合监管

articles.summary_en: On Aug 14, Shandong Provincial Department of Agriculture issued technical guidance proposing mechanized measures such as drainage and emergency harvesting to mitigate disasters for corn, soybean, and peanut production.

articles.summary_en: On August 16, Qiushi magazine published an important article by General Secretary Xi Jinping on enhancing disaster prevention, mitigation, and relief capabilities. Xi has repeatedly instructed on flood control and relief, emphasizing the protection of people's lives and property and maintaining social stability.

articles.title_zh: 梁言顺在阜阳市调研检查防汛工作

articles.summary_en: On August 15, Liang Yanshun, Secretary of the Anhui Provincial Party Committee, inspected flood control work in Fuyang City, emphasizing a solid flood prevention and disaster relief line.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚韦韬深入钦州市调研并召开平陆运河建成通航倒计时30天推进会
articles.title_en: Chen Gang, Wei Tao Inspect Qinzhou and Convene Meeting on 30-Day Countdown to Pinglu Canal Opening
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日至15日，自治区党委书记陈刚、自治区主席韦韬在钦州调研，并召开平陆运河建成通航倒计时30天推进会，强调确保安全高质量通航。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 14 to 15, Chen Gang, Party Secretary of Guangxi, and Wei Tao, Chairman of the Autonomous Region, inspected Qinzhou and convened a meeting on the 30-day countdown to the completion and opening of the Pinglu Canal, stressing ensuring safe and high-quality navigation on time.

articles.title_zh: 李国英刘宁在周口许昌漯河指导调度防汛救灾工作
articles.title_en: Li Guoying and Liu Ning Direct Flood Control in Zhoukou, Xuchang, Luohe
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日至15日，国家防总副总指挥、水利部部长李国英和河南省委书记刘宁赴周口、许昌、漯河指导调度防汛救灾，强调坚持人民至上、生命至上，打好防汛救灾硬仗。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 14 to 15, Li Guoying, Vice Commander of the National Flood Control Headquarters and Minister of Water Resources, and Liu Ning, Henan Provincial Party Secretary, visited Zhoukou, Xuchang and Luohe to direct flood control and disaster relief, stressing a people-first approach.

articles.title_zh: 湖南怀化：箱包“出海记”
articles.title_en: Luggage 'Goes Global' in Huaihua, Hunan

articles.summary_en: On August 15, a reporter team visited Huaihua International Land Port in Hunan, finding that the local luggage and leather goods industry, benefiting from rail-sea intermodal transport, saw total output exceed 6 billion yuan and export 210 million yuan in H1.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记指引企业坚定不移走高质量发展之路
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Guides Enterprises to Firmly Follow the Path of High-Quality Development

articles.summary_en: This Xinhua review highlights Xi Jinping's guidance for enterprises to pursue high-quality development, emphasizing innovation, real economy, and equal support for state-owned, private, and foreign firms.

articles.summary_en: On Aug 15, the Memorial Hall of the Victims in Nanjing Massacre announced newly collected artifacts, while Harbin and Guangzhou also released and accepted historical materials exposing Japanese invasion crimes.

articles.summary_en: On August 16, the Ministry of Emergency Management dispatched 13 drainage teams to Zhoukou, Henan, all arriving by 9 a.m. and starting operations with a total capacity of about 220,000 cubic meters per hour.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷在省水利厅主持召开防汛工作视频调度会议
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Chairs Flood Control Video Conference at Provincial Water Resources Department
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日上午，浙江省委副书记、省长刘捷在省水利厅主持召开防汛工作视频调度会议，部署防汛救灾工作，要求坚决维护群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Aug 15, Liu Jie, deputy secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee and governor, presided over a flood control video conference at the Provincial Water Resources Department to arrange flood prevention and disaster relief, urging protection of people's lives and property.

articles.summary_en: On August 15, 2026, the Supreme People's Procuratorate released model cases on public interest litigation for a Beautiful China, reporting 73,000 environmental cases since 2025 and answering questions on implementing the Ecological Environment Code.

articles.title_zh: 拒绝遗忘日本罪行的“马库斯”们：无论国籍，真相是唯一的立场
articles.title_en: The 'Marcuses' Who Refuse to Forget Japan's Crimes: Truth Is the Only Stance Regardless of Nationality
articles.summary_zh: 法国青年马库斯与中国青年钟灏松在东京涩谷街头呼吁日本正视侵华历史，马库斯曾捐赠外祖父拍摄的日军侵华照片。文章批评日本首相高市早苗在长崎纪念仪式上的表态及修改历史表述的行为。
articles.summary_en: French youth Marcus and Chinese youth Zhong Haosong rallied in Tokyo's Shibuya to urge Japan to face its wartime aggression. The article criticizes Japanese PM Takaichi Sanae's stance and attempts to revise historical narratives.

articles.title_zh: 把伟大抗战精神一代代传下去
articles.title_en: Carry Forward the Great Spirit of the Anti-Japanese War from Generation to Generation
articles.summary_zh: 2025年7月7日，习近平总书记在山西阳泉参观百团大战纪念馆，缅怀抗战烈士，强调讲好抗战故事，把伟大抗战精神一代代传下去。
articles.summary_en: On July 7, 2025, General Secretary Xi Jinping visited the Memorial Hall of the Hundred Regiment Campaign in Yangquan, Shanxi, to honor fallen heroes and called for carrying forward the great spirit of the Anti-Japanese War.

articles.title_zh: 习近平生态文明思想引领美丽中国建设谱新篇
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Thought on Ecological Civilization Leads New Chapter in Building Beautiful China
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日，第四个全国生态日到来之际，《中华人民共和国生态环境法典》正式施行，以习近平生态文明思想为魂和纲，开启生态环境保护法典化时代。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 15, the Ecological Environment Code of the People's Republic of China took effect on the 4th National Ecology Day, marking a new era of codified ecological protection guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Ecological Civilization.

articles.title_zh: 中国人民银行将发行江泽民诞辰100周年纪念币
articles.title_en: China's Central Bank to Issue Commemorative Coins for Jiang Zemin's 100th Birthday
articles.summary_zh: 中国人民银行8月14日发布公告，定于8月17日起发行江泽民诞辰100周年纪念币，共4枚，均为法定货币。
articles.summary_en: The People's Bank of China announced on August 14 that it will issue commemorative coins for the 100th birthday of Jiang Zemin starting from August 17, 2026, including 4 coins as legal tender.

articles.title_zh: 追火箭带火滨海小城文旅
articles.title_en: Rocket Launch Boosts Coastal Town's Cultural Tourism
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，山东海阳成功发射捷龙三号火箭，吸引5万余名航天迷观光，带动文旅关联消费同比增长40%。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 5, a rocket launch in Haiyang, Shandong attracted over 50,000 space fans, boosting local cultural tourism consumption by 40% year-on-year.

articles.title_zh: 让中国式现代化的底色更加亮丽
articles.title_en: Making the Foundation of Chinese Modernization More Beautiful
articles.summary_zh: 文章从降碳、减污、扩绿、增长四方面展现美丽中国建设新图景，强调《生态环境法典》8月15日施行，推动绿色低碳转型。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews China's ecological progress in carbon reduction, pollution control, greening, and green growth, highlighting the implementation of the Ecological Environment Code and the green transition.

articles.title_zh: 推动经济持续向新向优向好发展
articles.title_en: Promoting Sustained Economic Innovation, Optimization, and Improvement
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报评论文章分析上半年GDP增长4.7%，强调下半年经济工作要向‘向新、向优、向好’发展，加快新旧动能转换，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily commentary analyzes 4.7% GDP growth in H1, emphasizing H2 work should focus on innovation, quality, and improvement, accelerating the shift in growth drivers for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 中央宣传部等部门联合印发通知要求开展生态环境法典学习宣传工作
articles.title_en: Central Propaganda Department and Others Issue Notice on Promoting Ecological Environment Code Study
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中央宣传部等19部门联合印发通知，部署开展《中华人民共和国生态环境法典》学习宣传工作，要求纳入“九五”普法重点内容。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Central Propaganda Department and other 18 departments jointly issued a notice to promote the study and publicity of the Ecological Environment Code, incorporating it into the 9th Five-Year Plan for legal awareness.

articles.title_zh: 多部门支持河南应对洪涝灾害
articles.title_en: Multiple Departments Support Henan in Flood Response
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，国家防灾减灾救灾委员会针对河南严重洪涝灾害启动国家四级救灾应急响应，多部门调拨中央救灾和防汛物资及资金，支持河南抗洪抢险。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 14, the National Disaster Prevention and Mitigation Committee activated a Level-IV emergency response for Henan's severe floods; multiple departments dispatched central relief and flood-control supplies and funds.

articles.title_zh: 雷锋精神代代传承
articles.title_en: Lei Feng Spirit Inherited Generation by Generation
articles.summary_zh: 辽宁抚顺持续推动学雷锋活动融入日常、化作经常，涌现出大量志愿者和“百姓雷锋”，让雷锋精神代代传承。
articles.summary_en: Fushun, Liaoning, continues to integrate Lei Feng spirit into daily life, with over 250,000 volunteers and 1,700 service teams, passing on the spirit from generation to generation.

articles.title_zh: 市政府专题调度经济稳增长工作
articles.title_en: Municipal Government Holds Special Meeting on Steady Economic Growth
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，长春市委副书记、市长顾刚主持召开经济稳增长工作调度会议，分析经济运行情况，安排三季度和下半年重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Gu Gang, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Changchun Municipal Committee and Mayor, chaired a coordination meeting on steady economic growth, analyzing the economic situation and arranging key tasks for Q3 and the second half of the year.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠会见欧摩威集团执行董事会成员鲍里斯·梅格尔一行
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui Meets Oumowei Group Executive Board Member Boris Maegel
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，吉林省委常委、长春市委书记张恩惠会见欧摩威集团高管鲍里斯·梅格尔一行，就深化汽车产业合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Zhang Enhui, member of the Standing Committee of the Jilin Provincial Committee and Secretary of the Changchun Municipal Committee, met with Boris Maegel, executive board member of Oumowei Group, to discuss deepening cooperation in the automobile industry.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林会见浦发银行董事长张为忠、行长谢伟
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Meets Chairman Zhang Weizhong and President Xie Wei of SPD Bank
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，辽宁省委书记许昆林在沈阳会见浦发银行董事长张为忠、行长谢伟，双方就深化金融合作、支持辽宁振兴发展等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Xu Kunlin, Secretary of the Liaoning Provincial Party Committee, met with Zhang Weizhong and Xie Wei, Chairman and President of SPD Bank, in Shenyang to discuss deepening financial cooperation and supporting Liaoning's revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《提高防灾减灾救灾能力》
articles.title_en: Qiushi Magazine Publishes Important Article by General Secretary Xi Jinping on Enhancing Disaster Prevention, Mitigation and Relief Capabilities
articles.summary_zh: 8月16日出版的《求是》杂志将发表习近平总书记重要文章，强调坚持党的全面领导，提高防灾减灾救灾能力。
articles.summary_en: The Qiushi magazine issue published on August 16 will carry an important article by General Secretary Xi Jinping, stressing Party leadership and enhancing disaster prevention, mitigation and relief capabilities.

articles.title_zh: 截至6月底电动汽车充电基础设施总数同比增长43.2%
articles.title_en: EV Charging Infrastructure Grows 43.2% YoY to 23.057 Million by End of June
articles.summary_zh: 国家能源局数据显示，截至6月底我国电动汽车充电基础设施总数达2305.7万个，同比增长43.2%；县域充电设施覆盖率达98.61%。
articles.summary_en: According to the National Energy Administration, China's EV charging infrastructure reached 23.057 million units by end of June, up 43.2% year-on-year; county coverage reached 98.61%.

articles.title_zh: 多地出现强降雨天气 防汛救灾加紧进行
articles.title_en: Heavy Rains Hit Multiple Regions, Flood Control and Disaster Relief Underway
articles.summary_zh: 近期我国多地出现强降雨，河南周口堤防溃口正在封堵，浙江发生内涝，国家防总等部门调拨物资并提升防汛应急响应。
articles.summary_en: Heavy rains hit multiple regions in China. A levee breach in Henan is being repaired; Zhejiang faces flooding. Authorities have sent supplies and raised emergency response levels.

articles.title_zh: 今年前7月全国铁路发送旅客28亿人次
articles.title_en: Passenger Trips on National Railways Reach 2.8 Billion in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日从国铁集团获悉，1至7月全国铁路发送旅客28亿人次，同比增长4.1%，创历史同期新高。
articles.summary_en: China's national railways carried 2.8 billion passenger trips in the first seven months of this year, up 4.1% year on year, setting a record high for the period, according to China State Railway Group on August 15.

articles.title_zh: 中国人民银行将发行江泽民诞辰100周年纪念币
articles.title_en: PBOC to Issue Commemorative Coins for Jiang Zemin's 100th Birthday
articles.summary_zh: 中国人民银行8月14日公告，将于8月17日起发行江泽民诞辰100周年纪念币，共4枚，含普通纪念币1枚、金质2枚、银质1枚。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 14, the People's Bank of China announced it will issue commemorative coins from Aug 17 for the 100th anniversary of Jiang Zemin's birth, including 1 regular and 3 precious metal coins.

articles.title_zh: 我国多措并举加快绿色低碳发展
articles.title_en: China Takes Multiple Measures to Accelerate Green and Low-Carbon Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日，2026年全国生态日主场活动在内蒙古呼伦贝尔市举办，国家发展改革委等多部门发布生态文明建设成果，明确多项绿色低碳发展举措。
articles.summary_en: On August 15, the 2026 National Ecology Day event was held in Hulunbuir, Inner Mongolia. The NDRC and other departments released achievements in ecological civilization and outlined green development measures.

articles.title_zh: 市委五届十三次全会暨全市上半年经济运行分析会议召开
articles.title_en: 13th Plenary Session of Dingxi Municipal Party Committee and Economic Analysis Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，定西市委五届十三次全会暨全市上半年经济运行分析会议召开，市委书记汪尚学讲话，审议通过关于因地制宜发展新质生产力的意见，部署下半年重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the 13th Plenary Session of the Dingxi Municipal Party Committee and the city's first-half economic operation analysis meeting were held. Party Secretary Wang Shangxue delivered a speech, and the session reviewed and approved guidelines on developing new quality productive forces according to local conditions and arranged key work for the second half of the year.

articles.title_zh: 市委五届十三次全会暨全市上半年经济运行分析会议召开
articles.title_en: Dingxi Municipal Party Committee Holds 13th Plenary Session and H1 Economic Analysis Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，定西市委五届十三次全会暨全市上半年经济运行分析会议召开，市委书记汪尚学讲话，研究部署发展新质生产力、构建现代化产业体系等工作。
articles.summary_en: Dingxi Party Committee held its 13th Plenary Session and H1 economic meeting on Aug 14. Secretary Wang Shangxue spoke on new quality productive forces and industrial modernization.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研推进港口一体化运营
articles.title_en: Mayor Gu Kun Surveys Promotion of Integrated Port Operation
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，淮安市市长顾坤调研推进港口一体化运营，强调加快构建专业市场机制，提升港口一体化运营水平，服务支撑高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Mayor Gu Kun of Huai'an surveyed the promotion of integrated port operation, stressing faster construction of professional market mechanisms and higher port operation standards to support high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研推进港口一体化运营
articles.title_en: Municipal Leaders Investigate to Advance Integrated Port Operation
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，淮安市市长顾坤调研推进港口一体化运营，强调整合资源、提升效益，加快现代化内河港口建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Huai'an Mayor Gu Kun investigated integrated port operation, emphasizing resource integration and efficiency to build modern inland waterway ports.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市委书记史志军调研税收工作
articles.title_en: Huai'an Party Secretary Shi Zhijun Investigates Tax Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，淮安市委书记史志军调研税收工作，强调要贯彻落实习近平总书记关于税收工作的重要论述，为淮安高质量发展贡献税务力量。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Shi Zhijun, Secretary of the Huai'an Municipal Party Committee, inspected tax work, emphasizing implementation of Xi Jinping's important instructions on taxation and contribution to high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 市委书记史志军调研税收工作
articles.title_en: Shi Zhijun, Huai'an Party Secretary, Inspects Tax Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，淮安市委书记史志军调研税收工作，强调落实税费政策、优化服务，助力淮安高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Shi Zhijun, Party Secretary of Huai'an, inspected tax work, emphasizing the implementation of tax policies and improved services to support Huai'an's high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 林武在济南调研时强调 深化改革创新强化AI+赋能 促进服务业优质高效发展
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Emphasizes AI+ Empowerment in Jinan Inspection to Boost Service Industry
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，山东省委书记林武在济南调研文化创意、广告、储能、金融、能源等服务行业，强调深化改革创新，强化AI+赋能，促进服务业优质高效发展。省委副书记、济南市委书记刘强参加。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Lin Wu, Secretary of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee, inspected cultural creativity, advertising, energy storage, finance, and energy sectors in Jinan, urging reform and AI+ empowerment for high-quality service sector development. Liu Qiang attended.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开党组会议：以作风之变推动工作之变 以工作落实体现作风提升
articles.title_en: Shantou Government Holds Party Group Meeting to Boost Work Style and Implementation
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日下午，汕头市市长陈涛主持召开市政府党组会议，研究开展“干部作风提升年”行动，要求以作风之变推动工作之变。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 14, Shantou Mayor Chen Tao chaired a Party Group meeting of the municipal government to study the 'Cadre Work Style Improvement Year' action, calling for improved work style to drive work implementation.

articles.title_zh: 汕头市委常委会召开会议 研究部署安全生产、人工智能、城市建设和基础教育等工作
articles.title_en: Shantou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting on Safety, AI, Urban Construction and Basic Education
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日下午，汕头市委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，研究部署安全生产、人工智能、城市建设和基础教育等工作，市委书记庄悦群主持。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 13, the Standing Committee of the Shantou Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions, and to deploy work on work safety, artificial intelligence, urban construction and basic education, chaired by Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn.

articles.title_zh: 朔州市政府召开第62次常务会议
articles.title_en: Shuozhou Municipal Government Holds 62nd Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，朔州市市长吴秀玲主持召开市政府第62次常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究安全生产、高端化工产业集群规划等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Mayor Wu Xiuling chaired the 62nd executive meeting of Shuozhou Municipal Government to convey Xi Jinping's important speeches and study work on work safety and high-end chemical industry cluster planning.

articles.title_zh: 朔州市委理论学习中心组举行集体学习
articles.title_en: Shuozhou Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Study Center Group Holds Collective Study
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，朔州市委理论学习中心组举行集体学习，市委书记王帅红主持，集中学习《习近平党建文选》和习近平强军思想。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the Shuozhou Municipal Party Committee's Theoretical Study Center Group held a collective study session, chaired by Secretary Wang Shuaihong, focusing on Xi Jinping's selected works on Party building and his thought on strengthening the military.

articles.title_zh: 生物医药产业链产学研交流会举办
articles.title_en: Taizhou Hosts Industry-University-Research Exchange on Biopharmaceutical Industry Chain
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，泰州市举办生物医药产业链产学研交流会，市委书记姜冬冬出席并致辞，强调人才创新赋能医药产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Taizhou hosted a biopharmaceutical industry-university-research exchange; Municipal Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong attended and delivered remarks to boost high-quality development of the pharmaceutical industry through talent innovation.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Taizhou Municipal Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，泰州市委常委会召开会议，市委书记姜冬冬主持，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要文章精神，研究部署健康中国、产业链、反腐败和扫黑除恶等重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the Taizhou Municipal Party Committee held a standing committee meeting chaired by Secretary Jiang Dongdong to study and implement important articles of General Secretary Xi Jinping and deploy key tasks including Healthy China, industrial chains, anti-corruption, and anti-gang work.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Taizhou Municipal Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，泰州市委常委会召开会议，学习习近平总书记重要文章精神，研究部署重点工作，市委书记姜冬冬主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the Taizhou Municipal Party Committee held a standing committee meeting to study President Xi's important article and arrange key work, chaired by Municipal Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Weihai Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，威海市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话、重要指示精神，研究贯彻落实意见，部署服务业发展等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the Standing Committee of the Weihai Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions, and to arrange implementation measures including service industry development.

articles.title_zh: 市领导到宜兴现场检查督导防汛救灾工作
articles.title_en: City Leaders Visit Yixing to Inspect Flood Control and Disaster Relief Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，无锡市委书记杜小刚、市长蒋锋冒雨到宜兴市湖氵父镇检查督导防汛救灾工作，要求全力保障群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Wuxi Party Secretary Du Xiaogang and Mayor Jiang Feng visited Hufu Town in Yixing in the rain to inspect flood control and disaster relief, stressing all-out efforts to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 赵一德在全省生态文明建设暨秦岭生态环境保护工作会议上强调筑牢生态安全屏障 加快绿色发展步伐 推动美丽陕西建设不断提质增效
articles.title_en: Zhao Yide Calls for Stronger Ecological Protection and Green Development in Shaanxi
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，全省生态文明建设暨秦岭生态环境保护工作会议在西安召开，省委书记赵一德出席并讲话，强调筑牢生态安全屏障，推动美丽陕西建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the provincial conference on ecological civilization and Qinling ecological protection was held in Xi'an. Party Secretary Zhao Yide stressed strengthening ecological security and promoting high-quality development of beautiful Shaanxi.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平吴炜会见中国中车集团董事长孙永才
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping and Wu Wei Meet with Sun Yongcai, Chairman of CRRC Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日下午，盐城市委书记严汉平、代市长吴炜会见中国中车集团董事长孙永才一行，双方就深化务实合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 14, Yan Hanping, Secretary of Yancheng Municipal Party Committee, and Wu Wei, acting mayor, met with Sun Yongcai, Chairman of CRRC Group, to discuss deepening cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市委理论学习中心组召开学习交流会
articles.title_en: Yancheng Municipal Party Committee Holds Theoretical Learning Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日下午，盐城市委理论学习中心组召开学习交流会，围绕习近平总书记关于基层工作方法的重要论述开展研讨，市委书记严汉平主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 14, the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee's Theoretical Learning Central Group held a meeting to study Xi Jinping's important expositions on grassroots work methods, chaired by Municipal Party Secretary Yan Hanping.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会组织召开贯彻实施生态环境法典座谈会
articles.title_en: Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Symposium on Implementing the Ecological Environment Code
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日下午，周口市人大常委会召开贯彻实施生态环境法典座谈会，部署学法用法、执法监督和普法宣传工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 14, the Standing Committee of Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress held a symposium on implementing the Ecological Environment Code, arranging law enforcement supervision and legal publicity.

articles.title_zh: 王凯在周口现场研究堤防溃口处置工作
articles.title_en: Wang Kai Inspects Levee Breach Handling in Zhoukou
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，河南省省长王凯与国家防总办公室主任陈敏等到周口市贾鲁河堤防溃口现场，研究细化处置方案并看望转移避险群众。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Governor Wang Kai of Henan and others inspected the Jialu River levee breach in Zhoukou, studied response plans, and visited relocated residents.

articles.title_zh: 林武在济南调研时强调 深化改革创新强化AI+赋能 促进服务业优质高效发展
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Urges Reform, Innovation and AI+ Empowerment During Jinan Research Trip to Boost Service Industry
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，山东省委书记林武在济南调研，强调深化改革创新、强化人工智能应用赋能，促进服务业优质高效发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Lin Wu, Secretary of CPC Shandong Provincial Committee, stressed during a research trip in Jinan the need to deepen reform and innovation and strengthen AI application to promote high-quality development of the service industry.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔在潍坊调研时强调 锐意进取 担当实干 推动经济持续向新向优向好发展
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Stresses Steady Economic Progress During Weifang Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，山东省委副书记、省长周乃翔在潍坊调研，强调贯彻总书记指示，推动经济向新向优向好发展，并考察文旅、企业及农业项目。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Zhou Naixiang, Deputy Secretary of the Shandong Provincial Party Committee and Governor, inspected Weifang, stressing implementation of the General Secretary's instructions to promote high-quality economic development, and visited cultural, industrial, and agricultural projects.

articles.title_zh: 河南周口贾鲁河堤坝117米溃口顺利合龙
articles.title_en: 117-Meter Breach on Jialu River Levee in Zhoukou, Henan Successfully Closed
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日晚，河南省周口市贾鲁河东岸117米溃口成功合龙，应急管理部调度多方救援力量封堵，后续将进行防渗加固。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of August 15, the 117-meter breach on the east bank of the Jialu River in Zhoukou, Henan was successfully closed. Multiple rescue forces dispatched by the Ministry of Emergency Management completed the plugging, and follow-up reinforcement is underway.

articles.title_zh: 重庆：14名市管“一把手”不适宜担任现职，被调整
articles.title_en: Chongqing Adjusts 14 Municipal 'Top Officials' Found Unfit for Current Positions
articles.summary_zh: 重庆市委对14名不适宜担任现职的市管“一把手”作出调整。
articles.summary_en: Chongqing municipal party committee adjusts 14 municipal-managed principal officials deemed unfit for their current posts.

articles.title_zh: 筑牢美丽中国建设的法治基石
articles.title_en: Consolidating the Legal Foundation for a Beautiful China
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月15日全国生态日，《中华人民共和国生态环境法典》开始施行，这是继民法典后我国第二部法典。习近平总书记强调用最严格制度最严密法治保护生态环境，推动美丽中国建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 15, 2026, China's National Ecology Day, the Ecological Environment Code took effect, the country's second law named 'code' after the Civil Code. President Xi Jinping stressed protecting the ecological environment with the strictest systems and laws, promoting a beautiful China.

articles.title_zh: 机器人采访“机器人”：一群年轻人造出“童年机甲梦”
articles.title_en: Robot Interviews Robot: Young Engineers Realize Childhood Mecha Dreams
articles.summary_zh: 记者探访苏州人形机器人企业魔法原子，采访00后工程师万少杰，讲述机器人从实验室到工厂的突破，展现中国AI产业青年力量。
articles.summary_en: Reporters visited Suzhou-based robot firm Magic Atom, interviewing post-00s engineer Wan Shaojie, telling the story of humanoid robots moving from labs to factories, showcasing young Chinese AI talent.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁吴贤德会见科大讯飞董事长刘庆峰
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning and Wu Xiande Meet iFlytek Chairman Liu Qingfeng
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，福建省委副书记、福州市委书记郭宁宁和市长吴贤德会见科大讯飞董事长刘庆峰，双方就深化战略合作、培育人工智能产业生态等进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Guo Ningning, Deputy Secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee, and Mayor Wu Xiande met with Liu Qingfeng, Chairman of iFlytek, to discuss deepening strategic cooperation and fostering the AI industry ecosystem.

articles.title_zh: 市政府党组理论学习中心组进行集体学习 于海田主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Jinan Municipal Government Party Group Holds Collective Study Session Chaired by Yu Haitian
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，济南市政府党组理论学习中心组集体学习，深入学习贯彻习近平生态文明思想，认真学习《中华人民共和国生态环境法典》，市长于海田主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the Jinan Municipal Government Party Group held a collective study session on Xi Jinping's ecological civilization thought and the Ecological Environment Code, chaired by Mayor Yu Haitian.

articles.title_zh: “泉城干部大学堂”专题讲座举行 于海田韩金峰孙开连杨峰出席 魏琪嘉作报告
articles.title_en: Quancheng Cadre University Lecture Held with Mayor Yu Haitian and Other Leaders Attending; Wei Qijia Delivers Report
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，“泉城干部大学堂”专题讲座在济南举行，邀请国家信息中心研究员魏琪嘉围绕服务业扩能提质作专题授课，市领导于海田等出席。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, a special lecture of the Quancheng Cadre University was held in Jinan, where Wei Qijia, a researcher from the State Information Center, gave a lecture on expanding and improving the service industry, attended by municipal leaders including Yu Haitian.

articles.title_zh: 厦门市政府党组召开会议
articles.title_en: Xiamen Municipal Government Party Group Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 近日，厦门市政府党组召开会议，学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神，传达省委、市委全会精神，研究贯彻落实措施。
articles.summary_en: The Xiamen Municipal Government Party Group recently held a meeting to study the important speech and instructions of General Secretary Xi Jinping, convey the spirit of the provincial and municipal party committee plenary sessions, and implement measures for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 厦门将大力实施城市更新行动 实施方案印发
articles.title_en: Xiamen Issues Implementation Plan for Urban Renewal Action
articles.summary_zh: 厦门市印发《厦门市城市更新工作实施方案》，提出九大重点任务，力争到2030年形成具有厦门特色的可持续城市更新路径。
articles.summary_en: Xiamen issued the Implementation Plan for Urban Renewal Action, proposing nine key tasks and aiming to form a sustainable urban renewal path with Xiamen characteristics by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 四川11所高校上榜！2026软科世界大学学术排名发布
articles.title_en: Sichuan's 11 Universities Listed in 2026 Academic Ranking of World Universities
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日，软科发布2026世界大学学术排名，四川11所高校上榜，其中四川大学等3所入围全球500强，四川大学升至全球第77名。
articles.summary_en: On August 15, the 2026 Academic Ranking of World Universities was released by ShanghaiRanking, with 11 universities from Sichuan listed, including Sichuan University among the global top 500, rising to 77th.

articles.title_zh: 外交部驳美涉黄岩岛言论：敦促美方停止在南海渲染紧张、挑动对抗
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Refutes US Remarks on Scarborough Shoal, Urges US to Stop Stoking Tension in South China Sea
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆驳斥美国务院有关黄岩岛言论，强调黄岩岛是中国固有领土，中方设自然保护区属主权范围，敦促美方停止渲染紧张和挑动对抗。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 15, MFA spokesperson Guo Jiakun refuted US State Department remarks on Scarborough Shoal, stressing it is China's inherent territory and urging the US to stop stoking tensions and confrontation in the South China Sea.

articles.title_zh: 国铁集团：1至7月全国铁路发送旅客28亿人次，再创新高
articles.title_en: China Railway: 2.8 Billion Passenger Trips in Jan-Jul, a New Record
articles.summary_zh: 国铁集团8月15日发布数据，1至7月全国铁路发送旅客28亿人次、同比增长4.1%，再创历史同期新高。
articles.summary_en: China State Railway Group said on Aug 15 that national railways handled 2.8 billion passenger trips in Jan-Jul, up 4.1% year-on-year, a record high for the period.

articles.title_zh: 产用融合，机器人产业加速“奔跑”
articles.title_en: Production-Application Integration Accelerates Robot Industry
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，芜湖机器人产业园多家企业满负荷生产，2025年产业规模突破400亿元，正加速智能化转型。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, robot enterprises in Wuhu Industrial Park operated at full capacity; the industry scale exceeded 40 billion yuan in 2025, accelerating intelligent transformation.

articles.title_zh: 引导企业“出村入园” 泉州台商投资区协同推动产业集聚安全发展
articles.title_en: Guiding Enterprises into Parks: Quanzhou Taiwan Business Zone Promotes Industrial Clustering and Safe Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，泉州台商投资区举办“出村入园”企业签约仪式暨交流座谈会，15家企业集中签约，引导零散村居企业进驻标准化园区，推动产业集聚和安全生产。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Quanzhou Taiwan Business Zone held a signing ceremony for the "out-of-village into-park" initiative, with 15 enterprises signing agreements to move into standardized industrial parks, promoting industrial clustering and safety.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃新能源装机占比超过65%
articles.title_en: Gansu's New Energy Installed Capacity Exceeds 65% of Total
articles.summary_zh: 截至2026年7月底，甘肃省电源总装机容量达12745万千瓦，其中新能源装机8297万千瓦、占65.1%，风光主导多能互补电源格局基本成型。
articles.summary_en: As of end-July 2026, Gansu's total installed power capacity reached 127.45 GW, with new energy at 82.97 GW (65.1%), basically forming a wind-solar dominant multi-energy complementary structure.

articles.title_zh: 李殿勋在汉调研多式联运并召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Li Dianxun Investigates Multimodal Transport in Wuhan and Holds Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日下午，湖北省委副书记、省长李殿勋在武汉市调研多式联运并召开座谈会，研究推进全省多式联运发展及建设“汉交所”相关工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 14, Li Dianxun, Deputy Secretary of the Hubei Provincial Party Committee and Governor, investigated multimodal transport in Wuhan and held a symposium to discuss promoting provincial multimodal transport development and the construction of the "Han Exchange".

articles.title_zh: 文旅融合激活发展新动能
articles.title_en: Cultural Tourism Integration Activates New Development Momentum
articles.summary_zh: 2026年暑期，河北省以文旅融合激活发展新动能，推出新业态新场景新服务，打造京津游客周末休闲首选目的地。
articles.summary_en: In the summer of 2026, Hebei Province activated new momentum through cultural tourism integration, introducing new business forms, scenes, and services to become a top weekend destination for Beijing-Tianjin tourists.

articles.title_zh: 以钉钉子精神把集中整治抓紧抓实持续推动全面从严治党向基层延伸
articles.title_en: Luo Wen Calls for Persistent Efforts to Tackle Misconduct and Corruption at Grassroots Level in Hebei
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，河北省群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作推进会在石家庄召开，省委书记罗文出席并讲话，强调以钉钉子精神推进集中整治，全面从严治党向基层延伸。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Hebei Province held a promotion meeting on concentrated rectification of misconduct and corruption around the people in Shijiazhuang. Provincial Party Secretary Luo Wen stressed persistent efforts to extend full and strict Party governance to grassroots.

articles.title_zh: 研究部署海南省危险货物全链条安全监管和港口安全运行工作
articles.title_en: Hainan Provincial Party Committee Holds Special Meeting on Dangerous Goods and Port Safety Supervision
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，海南省委召开专题会议，研究部署危险货物全链条安全监管和港口安全运行工作，省委书记冯飞主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Hainan Provincial Party Committee held a special meeting to study and deploy whole-chain safety supervision of dangerous goods and port safety operations, chaired by Secretary Feng Fei.

articles.title_zh: 全力推动开放政策落地见效 在高标准建设海南自由贸易港上展现更大作为
articles.title_en: Push Forward Opening-Up Policies and Build Hainan Free Trade Port with Greater Efforts
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，海南省委书记冯飞在省委深改办（自贸港工委办）调研，强调推动自贸港核心政策落地，深化制度集成创新。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Hainan Provincial Party Secretary Feng Fei visited the Provincial Deep Reform Office (FTP Work Committee Office), urging effective implementation of core FTP policies and deepening institutional innovation.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省人大就人工智能产业发展公开征集社会意见建议
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Solicits Public Opinions on AI Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，江苏省人大常委会网站发布公告，就人工智能产业发展相关问题公开征集社会意见建议。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee posted a notice on its website soliciting public opinions on AI industry development.

articles.title_zh: 苦干实干努力完成全年经济社会发展目标任务
articles.title_en: Work Hard and Strive to Accomplish Annual Economic and Social Development Goals
articles.summary_zh: 连日来，江西省纪委监委、省委组织部等分别召开会议，传达学习省委十五届十次全会精神，研究贯彻落实意见。陈永奇、庄兆林、时玉宝等省领导出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: Over the past few days, the Jiangxi Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection, Provincial Party Committee Organization Department and other departments held meetings to convey and study the spirit of the 15th Plenary Session of the Provincial Party Committee. Provincial leaders including Chen Yongqi, Zhuang Zhaolin, Shi Yubao, Lu Xiaoqing and Zhang Ying attended and delivered speeches.

articles.title_zh: 江西省委常委会召开会议认真学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Provincial Standing Committee Holds Meeting to Study and Implement Xi Jinping's Important Speeches and Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，江西省委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神，审议江西省'十五五'科技创新规划和新型工业化规划。省委书记尹弘主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the Standing Committee of Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions, reviewing the provincial 15th Five-Year plans for scientific and technological innovation and new industrialization. Secretary Yin Hong presided.

articles.title_zh: 王晓晖主持召开省委专题会议 部署防灾减灾救灾和安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Wang Xiaohui Chairs Provincial Committee Meeting on Disaster Prevention and Safety
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，四川省委书记王晓晖主持召开省委专题会议，部署防灾减灾救灾和安全生产工作，强调坚持人民至上、生命至上，切实维护人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 14, Sichuan Provincial Party Secretary Wang Xiaohui chaired a special meeting to deploy disaster prevention, mitigation, relief and work safety, stressing people-first and life-first principles to safeguard people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 成都出台《方案》促进资源环境要素市场化配置
articles.title_en: Chengdu Issues Work Plan to Boost Market-Based Allocation of Resource and Environmental Factors
articles.summary_zh: 成都市委深改委审议通过《方案》，部署20项改革任务，以市场化机制激活碳排放权、用水权等绿色资产价值，推动降碳减污扩绿增长。
articles.summary_en: Chengdu's Deep Reform Committee approved a work plan with 20 reform tasks to activate green assets like carbon emission rights and water use rights through market mechanisms, promoting green transition.

articles.title_zh: 四川出台城市更新“十五五”规划
articles.title_en: Sichuan Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Urban Renewal
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，四川省人民政府网站发布《四川省城市更新“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年城市更新行动取得重要进展，并明确六大基础工程和两大重点工程。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the People's Government of Sichuan Province issued its 15th Five-Year Plan for Urban Renewal, aiming for significant progress by 2030 and outlining six basic projects and two key projects.

articles.title_zh: 山东省纪委监委公开曝光5起“四风”典型问题
articles.title_en: Shandong Discipline Inspection Commission Exposes Five Typical 'Four Winds' Problems
articles.summary_zh: 山东省纪委监委日前公开曝光5起“四风”典型问题，涉及违规收礼、公车私用、违规吃喝、超标准接待和以罚代管，相关责任人受到党纪政务处分。
articles.summary_en: The Shandong Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection recently exposed five typical 'four winds' problems, involving officials accepting gifts, using public vehicles for private purposes, illegal eating and drinking, excessive reception, and replacing management with fines. The responsible persons were punished.

tags.name_en: Shandong Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection

tags_en: Shandong Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection

articles.title_zh: 更好抢抓机遇力争取得更多突破进展
articles.title_en: Better Seize Opportunities and Strive for More Breakthroughs
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月14日，上海市委书记陈吉宁在临港新片区调研并主持座谈会，强调优化产业生态、深化制度创新、强化科技创新，市长龚正出席。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, 2026, Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Ji'ning visited Lingang New Area and chaired a symposium, emphasizing industrial ecology, institutional innovation, and scientific innovation. Mayor Gong Zheng attended.

articles.title_zh: 打造“书卷气”“烟火气”文化场景
articles.title_en: Gong Zheng Visits Shanghai Book Fair to Promote Cultural Scenes with 'Bookish' and 'Lively' Atmosphere
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，上海市市长龚正参观上海书展，要求持续扩大书展溢出效应，打造兼具“书卷气”与“烟火气”的文化场景。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 14, Shanghai Mayor Gong Zheng visited the Shanghai Book Fair, calling for expanding its spillover effect and creating cultural scenes with both 'bookish' and 'lively' atmosphere.

articles.title_zh: 临港推出首批OPC“揭榜挂帅”场景清单
articles.title_en: Lingang Releases First Batch of OPC 'Open Competition' Scenario List
articles.summary_zh: 中国（上海）自由贸易试验区临港新片区近日发布首批OPC“揭榜挂帅”场景清单，聚焦软件信息、数字文化等五大赛道的25个场景，为超级个体提供产业订单资源。
articles.summary_en: The Lingang Special Area of China (Shanghai) Pilot Free Trade Zone recently released its first batch of OPC 'Open Competition' scenario lists, covering 25 scenarios in five tracks including software and digital culture, providing industrial order resources for super individuals.

articles.title_zh: 陕西四部门联合部署防汛抗旱保秋粮工作
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Four Departments Jointly Deploy Flood and Drought Prevention to Ensure Autumn Grain Harvest
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，陕西省农业农村厅等四部门联合印发通知，启动秋粮抗灾夺丰收百日行动，部署防汛抗旱和秋粮田间管理等措施。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, four Shaanxi provincial departments jointly issued a notice to launch a 100-day campaign to ensure autumn grain harvest amid flood and drought prevention efforts.

articles.title_zh: 筑牢生态安全屏障 加快绿色发展步伐 推动美丽陕西建设不断提质增效
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Holds Meeting on Ecological Civilization and Qinling Mountain Protection
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，陕西省生态文明建设暨秦岭生态环境保护工作会议在西安召开。省委书记赵一德强调筑牢生态安全屏障，加快绿色发展步伐，推动美丽陕西建设提质增效。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Shaanxi held the provincial meeting on ecological civilization construction and Qinling ecological protection in Xi'an. Party Secretary Zhao Yide stressed building a strong ecological security barrier and accelerating green development.

tags.name_en: Shaanxi Provincial Committee of the CPC

tags_en: Shaanxi Provincial Committee of the CPC

articles.title_zh: 推动经济持续向新向优向好发展
articles.title_en: Promoting Sustained, Improved and Upgraded Economic Development
articles.summary_zh: 文章解读上半年GDP同比增长4.7%，阐述下半年经济工作方向，强调加快新旧动能转换、优化经济结构、扩大内需，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The article analyzes the 4.7% GDP growth in H1, outlining the economic work focus for H2, emphasizing accelerating transition to new growth drivers, optimizing economic structure, and expanding domestic demand for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 中国首次集中发布西中南沙岛礁生态系统状况
articles.title_en: China Releases First Comprehensive Report on Ecosystem of Xisha, Zhongsha and Nansha Islands
articles.summary_zh: 中国首次集中发布西中南沙岛礁生态系统状况，9个岛礁生态整体优良但各具差异。自然资源部南海局发布公报，西沙恢复良好，黄岩岛生物多样性丰富，南沙部分岛礁退化严重。
articles.summary_en: China released its first centralized report on the ecosystem status of islands and reefs in the Xisha, Zhongsha and Nansha areas, showing generally good conditions with variations. The South China Sea Bureau of the Ministry of Natural Resources released the 2025 monitoring reports, highlighting restoration progress and ongoing degradation in some southern reefs.

tags.name_en: South China Sea Bureau, Ministry of Natural Resources

tags_en: South China Sea Bureau, Ministry of Natural Resources

articles.title_zh: 建设人与自然和谐相处、共生共荣的宜居城市
articles.title_en: Hangzhou Advances Construction of Livable City in Harmony with Nature
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记强调建设宜居城市，杭州推进公园绿地、非遗传承、智慧社区等建设，提升城市品质。
articles.summary_en: Following Xi Jinping's call for livable cities, Hangzhou has advanced urban renewal, expanded green parks, preserved intangible cultural heritage, and developed smart communities.

articles.title_zh: 尹力调研市属媒体和市委网信办 强调以正确政绩观引领干事创业精气神
articles.title_en: Yin Li Visits Municipal Media and Cyberspace Office, Stresses Correct Performance View to Boost Officials' Spirit
articles.summary_zh: 近日，北京市委书记尹力到北京日报社、北京广播电视台、新京报社和市委网信办调研，强调以正确政绩观引领党员干部鼓足干事创业精气神，为“十五五”首都高质量发展汇聚力量。
articles.summary_en: Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li recently visited major municipal media outlets and the Cyberspace Affairs Office, urging cadres to uphold a correct view of achievements and work energetically for the capital's high-quality development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 20余国驻华外交官走进北京顺义
articles.title_en: Foreign Diplomats from 20+ Countries Visit Beijing's Shunyi District
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，来自20多个国家的驻华外交官参加“外交官看中国——感知北京一区一品顺义行”活动，参观北汽越野智能工厂、友谊医院顺义院区及燕京啤酒文化节，感受顺义区发展活力。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, diplomats from over 20 countries joined the 'Diplomats Look at China' event in Shunyi, Beijing, visiting BAIC's off-road plant, Friendship Hospital, and the Yanjing Beer Festival, experiencing the district's development vitality.

articles.title_zh: 北京市委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神 研究加强党校工作和机关党建等事项
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Convey Xi's Instructions and Study Party School and Party Building Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日下午，北京市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和指示精神，研究加强党校工作、机关党建及推进国际赛事名城建设等事项，市委书记尹力主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 14, the Standing Committee of the Beijing Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech and instructions, discuss strengthening party school work and party building, and measures to build an international sports events city. The meeting was chaired by Party Secretary Yin Li.

articles.title_zh: 民为邦本、为政以德的治理思想
articles.title_en: The Governance Thought of 'People as the Foundation of the State' and 'Governance by Virtue'
articles.summary_zh: 文章阐述民为邦本、为政以德这一中华优秀传统治理思想的历史渊源、发展脉络与当代价值，强调其对治国理政和党的初心使命的启示。
articles.summary_en: This article elaborates on the historical origins and contemporary value of the traditional Chinese governance thought of 'people as the foundation of the state' and 'governance by virtue', emphasizing its inspiration for governance and the Party's original mission.

articles.title_zh: 如何筑牢灾害治理的坚实屏障
articles.title_en: How to Build a Solid Barrier for Disaster Governance
articles.summary_zh: 《求是》杂志编辑部发文，解读习近平总书记《提高防灾减灾救灾能力》重要讲话，强调坚持“七个坚持”，提升灾害治理能力。
articles.summary_en: Qiushi Journal editorial interprets Xi Jinping's speech on enhancing disaster prevention, mitigation and relief capabilities, emphasizing the 'seven adherences' to improve disaster governance.

articles.title_zh: 钢铁产业调查：传统产业转型升级之路怎么走
articles.title_en: Steel Industry Survey: How Should Traditional Industries Transform and Upgrade?
articles.summary_zh: 求是杂志社经济编辑部与中国钢铁工业协会联合调研，分析我国钢铁产业从产能、布局到绿色转型的发展成就，并探讨当前挑战与高质量发展路径。
articles.summary_en: A joint survey by Qiushi magazine and CISA analyzes China's steel industry achievements in capacity, layout, and green transformation, and explores current challenges and paths for high-quality development.

tags.name_en: Transformation and Upgrading of Traditional Industries

tags_en: Transformation and Upgrading of Traditional Industries

articles.title_zh: 纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年
articles.title_en: Commemorating the 100th Anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's Birth
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央党史和文献研究院发表纪念文章，缅怀江泽民同志丰功伟绩，号召学习其崇高风范，坚定不移走中国特色社会主义道路。
articles.summary_en: The Institute of Party History and Literature of the CPC Central Committee published an article commemorating the 100th anniversary of Jiang Zemin's birth, recalling his contributions and calling for learning from his noble character to uphold the path of socialism with Chinese characteristics.
