articles.title_zh: 以词元为引擎推动智能经济高质量发展
articles.title_en: Token as Engine for High-Quality Development of Intelligent Economy
articles.summary_zh: 本文论述以词元为引擎推动智能经济高质量发展，引用习近平在2026世界人工智能大会讲话，分析词元的引擎作用、发展特征及路径。
articles.summary_en: This article discusses using tokens as the engine for high-quality development of the intelligent economy, citing Xi Jinping's speech at the 2026 World AI Conference, analyzing roles, features and paths.

articles.title_zh: 着力破解服务消费发展的卡点堵点
articles.title_en: Striving to Remove Bottlenecks in Service Consumption Development
articles.summary_zh: 《求是》杂志记者专访商务部研究院流通与消费研究所所长董超，分析服务消费发展现状、卡点堵点及对策建议。
articles.summary_en: Qiushi Journal interviews Dong Chao, director of the Institute for Circulation and Consumption Research at the CAITEC, on the bottlenecks in service consumption development and policy recommendations.

articles.title_zh: 以高质量供给拓展内需增长新空间
articles.title_en: Expanding New Space for Domestic Demand Growth through High-Quality Supply
articles.summary_zh: 文章围绕7月30日中央政治局会议部署，阐述以高质量供给拓展内需增长新空间，提出增强优质供给、扩大有效投资、加快产业体系建设等举措。
articles.summary_en: Centering on the July 30 CPC Central Political Bureau meeting, this article expounds on expanding domestic demand via high-quality supply, stressing better supply, effective investment, and industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 全力落实防灾减灾救灾重点任务
articles.title_en: Fully Implement Key Tasks for Disaster Prevention, Mitigation and Relief
articles.summary_zh: 中共应急管理部委员会发文，部署落实习近平总书记关于提高防灾减灾救灾能力的重要讲话精神，强调从源头预防、科技支撑、法治保障等方面提升综合防灾减灾能力。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Emergency Management Ministry Committee published an article on implementing Xi Jinping's directives on disaster prevention, mitigation and relief, emphasizing source prevention, technological support, and legal safeguards.

articles.title_zh: 中华民族共同体的历史演进与中华民族伟大复兴
articles.title_en: The Historical Evolution of the Chinese Nation Community and the Great Rejuvenation of the Chinese Nation
articles.summary_zh: 潘岳在《求是》撰文，系统阐述中华民族共同体的历史演进与实现中华民族伟大复兴的内在联系，强调铸牢中华民族共同体意识。
articles.summary_en: Pan Yue writes in Qiushi, elaborating on the historical evolution of the Chinese nation community and its connection to the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation, emphasizing the consolidation of the sense of community for the Chinese nation.

articles.title_zh: 提高防灾减灾救灾能力
articles.title_en: Enhancing Disaster Prevention, Mitigation, and Relief Capabilities
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记4月28日在二十届中央政治局第二十五次集体学习上发表讲话，强调提高防灾减灾救灾能力，推动灾害治理向事前预防转型。
articles.summary_en: On April 28, General Secretary Xi Jinping delivered a speech at the 25th collective study session of the 20th CPC Central Political Bureau, emphasizing enhancing disaster prevention, mitigation, and relief capabilities and shifting disaster governance to pre-disaster prevention.

articles.title_zh: 市委人才工作领导小组会议召开 袁家军主持并讲话 陈新武出席
articles.title_en: Chongqing Municipal Talent Work Leading Group Meeting Held; Yuan Jiajun Chairs and Speaks; Chen Xinwu Attends
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日上午，重庆市委人才工作领导小组会议召开，市委书记袁家军主持并讲话，强调实施科技创新和人才强市首位战略，建设创新强市。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Chongqing's Municipal Talent Work Leading Group meeting was held. Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun presided and spoke, emphasizing the top-priority strategy of sci-tech innovation and talent to build an innovative city.

articles.title_zh: 全区安全生产和消防工作暨第三季度防范重特大安全事故电视电话会议召开
articles.title_en: Guangxi Holds Video Conference on Work Safety and Fire Control for Q3
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，全区安全生产和消防工作暨第三季度防范重特大安全事故电视电话会议召开，自治区主席韦韬出席并讲话，强调守牢安全发展底线。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the region's work safety and fire control work and Q3 major accident prevention video conference was held. Wei Tao, Chairman of the Autonomous Region, attended and spoke, emphasizing the need to hold the bottom line of safe development.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚在设区市有关领导干部任职集体谈话会上强调 自觉践行新时代好干部标准 在新起点新岗位上书写无愧于时代无愧于人民的崭新篇章
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Stresses New-Era Standards for Good Officials at Collective Talk with Newly Appointed City-Level Leaders
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，广西自治区党委在南宁召开设区市领导干部任职集体谈话会，自治区党委书记陈刚出席会议并讲话，强调自觉践行新时代好干部标准。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the Party Committee of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region held a collective talk in Nanning for newly appointed city-level leaders. Party Secretary Chen Gang stressed the need to consciously practice the standards for good officials in the new era.

articles.title_zh: 王凯在周口现场研究堤防溃口处置工作
articles.title_en: Wang Kai Directs Levee Breach Response in Zhoukou
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，河南省省长王凯在周口市现场研究贾鲁河堤防溃口处置工作，强调加快处置、保障群众安全，并看望转移安置群众。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Henan Governor Wang Kai inspected the Jialu River levee breach site in Zhoukou, directed emergency response, and visited relocated residents.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明在长沙调研新消费
articles.title_en: Shen Xiaoming Inspects New Consumption in Changsha
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，湖南省委书记沈晓明在长沙调研新消费，强调创新消费场景、优化服务供给，满足群众消费需求，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Shen Xiaoming, Secretary of the Hunan Provincial Party Committee, inspected new consumption in Changsha, emphasizing innovation in consumption scenarios and optimizing service supply to meet diverse needs and boost high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明在长沙调研科产深度融合工作
articles.title_en: Mao Weiming Inspects Deep Integration of Sci-Tech and Industry in Changsha
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日上午，湖南省委副书记、省长毛伟明在长沙调研科技创新和产业创新深度融合工作，强调深化产学研协同攻关，加速成果转化。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 14, Hunan Governor Mao Weiming visited Changsha to research sci-tech and industrial innovation integration, urging stronger collaboration and faster conversion of achievements.

articles.title_zh: 把北京建设得更美
articles.title_en: Building a More Beautiful Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 文章报道北京贯彻习近平生态文明思想，推进花园城市建设和百万亩造林工程，建成千园之城，实现生态惠民。
articles.summary_en: Beijing implements Xi Jinping's thought on ecological civilization, advancing garden city construction and million-mu afforestation, becoming a city of a thousand parks and benefiting residents with green spaces.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 学习新语｜绿色承诺一以贯之
articles.title_en: Unwavering Green Commitment
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日是第四个全国生态日，生态环境法典正式实施。习近平生态文明思想引领我国生态文明建设取得历史性成就。
articles.summary_en: August 15 marks the fourth National Ecology Day and the official implementation of the Ecological Environment Code. Xi Jinping's thought on ecological civilization has led historic achievements in China's ecological progress.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 习近平强党兴党的故事丨抓好农村基层组织建设
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Story of Strengthening the Party: Building Strong Rural Grassroots Organizations
articles.summary_zh: 2007年6月，时任上海市委书记习近平在闵行区调研时强调，农村基层组织要抓好经济和党建、村务管理；党的十八大以来，其重要指示为新时代农村基层组织建设提供根本遵循，引领乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: In June 2007, Xi Jinping, then Shanghai Party Secretary, urged rural grassroots organizations in Minhang to balance economic development with Party building and village management. His later instructions have guided rural grassroots Party building and rural revitalization since the 18th CPC National Congress.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 切实担负起管党治党政治责任
articles.title_en: Earnestly Shoulder the Political Responsibility of Party Governance
articles.summary_zh: 新华社“学习新语”栏目推出“铸魂强党”系列，系统梳理党的十八大以来习近平总书记关于落实管党治党政治责任的重要论述。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua's 'Learning New Words' launches a series on Party-building, reviewing Xi Jinping's important statements on the political responsibility of strict Party governance since the 18th CPC National Congress.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 水利部：沙颍河周口段水位今明两天仍将维持超保
articles.title_en: Ministry: Shaying River Water Level at Zhoukou to Remain Above Warning Level
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日，水利部称贾鲁河堤坝溃口成功合龙，沙颍河周口段水位仍将超保，已派工作组指导抢险。
articles.summary_en: On August 15, the Ministry of Water Resources said the breach of the Jialu River levee was closed, but the water level at Zhoukou section of the Shaying River remains above warning level.

articles.title_zh: 山东省委书记林武在济南市调研
articles.title_en: Shandong Party Secretary Lin Wu Inspects Jinan for Service Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，山东省委书记林武在济南调研服务业发展，强调抢抓人工智能机遇，深化“AI+服务业”，促进服务业优质高效发展。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 14, Lin Wu, Secretary of Shandong Provincial Party Committee, visited enterprises in Jinan to boost high-quality service industry development, emphasizing AI application and innovation.

articles.title_zh: 王浩：强化极限思维 科学统筹调度 全力筑牢防汛救灾安全防线
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Inspects Flood Control Work in Dongtiaoxi River Basin
articles.summary_zh: 台风“白海豚”过后，东苕溪流域持续高水位。14日下午，浙江省委书记王浩检查指导防汛工作，强调强化极限思维、科学统筹调度，筑牢防汛救灾安全防线。
articles.summary_en: After Typhoon 'White Dolphin', Dongtiaoxi basin water levels stayed high. On the afternoon of Aug 14, Zhejiang Party Secretary Wang Hao inspected flood control, urging extreme thinking and scientific coordination to safeguard lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 丁一凡：没有跨文化理解，区域国别研究只是资料汇编
articles.title_en: Ding Yifan: Without Cross-Cultural Understanding, Area Studies Are Just Data Compilation
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，中国人民大学举办“区域国别学与全球领导力”系列讲座第十四场，丁一凡强调跨文化理解对区域国别研究和全球领导力的重要性。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Renmin University held the 14th lecture on regional country studies and global leadership, where Ding Yifan stressed the importance of cross-cultural understanding.

articles.title_zh: 全球人形机器人将齐聚北京“打擂”
articles.title_en: Global Humanoid Robots to Compete in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 第二届世界人形机器人运动会将于8月22日在北京国家速滑馆开幕，已吸引六大洲16国666支队伍、2056台机器人参赛。
articles.summary_en: The second World Humanoid Robot Games will kick off on August 22 at the National Speed Skating Oval in Beijing, attracting 666 teams and 2,056 robots from 16 countries across six continents.

articles.title_zh: 2026海峡两岸青年创新创业大赛圆满收官
articles.title_en: 2026 Cross-Strait Youth Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition Concludes Successfully
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日至14日，2026海峡两岸青年创新创业大赛在江苏常州举行，吸引209个项目参赛，12个项目现场签约落地。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Cross-Strait Youth Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition was held in Changzhou, Jiangsu from Aug 10 to 14, attracting 209 projects, with 12 signing on site.

articles.title_zh: 台湾民间团体集会反对日本右翼扩军与干涉台湾问题
articles.title_en: Taiwanese Civil Groups Rally Against Japanese Right-Wing Militarism and Interference in Taiwan Issue
articles.summary_zh: 多个台湾民间团体14日在台北日本台湾交流协会前集会，反对日本右翼扩军和干涉台湾问题，并发表声明捍卫国家主权与领土完整。
articles.summary_en: Multiple Taiwanese civil groups rallied on Aug 14 outside the Japan-Taiwan Exchange Association in Taipei to oppose Japanese right-wing expansion and interference in Taiwan affairs, issuing a statement defending national sovereignty and territorial integrity.

articles.title_zh: 国防部：中方将继续在仁爱礁附近海域开展维权执法行动
articles.title_en: Defense Ministry: China to Continue Law-Enforcement Operations near Ren'ai Reef
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日下午，国防部新闻发言人陈曦就仁爱礁问题表态，坚决反对菲澳指责，强调仁爱礁是中国固有领土，中方将继续维权执法行动。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Defense Ministry spokesman Chen Xi expressed firm opposition to Philippine-Australian accusations, stressed Ren'ai Reef is Chinese territory, and said China will continue rights-enforcement operations.

articles.title_zh: 加速推进！我国多个重大工程刷新“进度条”
articles.title_en: Multiple Major Projects in China Accelerate Progress
articles.summary_zh: 这两天，我国多个重大工程建设取得关键突破，包括连云港至仪征原油管道投产、狮子洋大桥锚碇完工、三峡枢纽通过量达1亿吨、西康高铁启动试运行等。
articles.summary_en: In the past two days, multiple major construction projects in China achieved key breakthroughs, including the operation of the Lianyungang-Yizheng crude oil pipeline, completion of the Shiziyang Bridge anchorage, a 100-million-ton throughput at the Three Gorges hub, and the trial run of the Xi'an-Ankang high-speed railway.

articles.title_zh: 两部门对河南启动国家四级救灾应急响应
articles.title_en: Two Departments Launch Level-IV Disaster Relief Emergency Response for Henan
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，国家防灾减灾救灾委员会针对台风残涡及强降雨对河南的灾害影响，启动国家四级救灾应急响应，并调拨3万件中央救灾物资支持灾区。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 14, the National Disaster Prevention, Mitigation and Relief Committee activated a Level-IV emergency response for Henan due to typhoon remnants and heavy rainfall, and allocated 30,000 relief supplies.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省委常委、副省长程晓波接受审查调查
articles.title_en: Gansu Vice Governor Cheng Xiaobo Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省委常委、副省长程晓波涉嫌严重违纪违法，主动投案，正接受中央纪委国家监委纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: Cheng Xiaobo, member of the Gansu Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee and vice governor, voluntarily surrendered and is under disciplinary review for suspected serious violations of party discipline and law.

tags.name_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

tags_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

articles.title_zh: 雄忻高铁正线铺轨全部完成
articles.title_en: Xiongxin High-Speed Railway Main Line Track Laying Completed
articles.summary_zh: 日前，雄忻高铁在雄安新区完成正线铺轨，全线342公里，为按期开通运营奠定基础。
articles.summary_en: The main line track laying of the Xiongxin High-Speed Railway was completed in Xiong'an New Area recently, laying a solid foundation for its scheduled operation.

articles.title_zh: 仿生“蝴蝶效应”服务健康检测 中国团队研发出新型无泵空气采样器
articles.title_en: Chinese Team Develops Pump-Free Air Sampler Inspired by Butterfly Effect for Health Detection
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，中科院理化所董智超研究员团队发布名为FACE的新型无泵空气采样器，受蝴蝶卷喙饮蜜启发，可低成本便捷检测呼吸系统传染病和空气污染。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, a research team led by Dong Zhichao at the Technical Institute of Physics and Chemistry, CAS, unveiled the FACE pump-free air sampler, inspired by butterflies' proboscis feeding, enabling low-cost detection of respiratory infections and air pollution.

tags.name_zh: 中国科学院理化技术研究所
tags.name_en: Technical Institute of Physics and Chemistry, CAS

tags_zh: 中国科学院理化技术研究所

articles.title_zh: 国防部：“台独”死局演不赢、改不了
articles.title_en: Ministry of National Defense: 'Taiwan Independence' Deadlock Can't Be Won or Changed
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，国防部新闻发言人陈曦就涉军问题表示，“台独”死局演不赢、改不了，解放军持续提升反分裂反干涉实战能力。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Defense Ministry spokesman Chen Xi said the 'Taiwan independence' deadlock cannot be won or changed, and the PLA will continue to enhance its combat capabilities against separatism and interference.

articles.title_zh: 当AI浪潮重塑医疗：两岸医界的“韧性”之思
articles.title_en: When AI Wave Reshapes Healthcare: Reflections on 'Resilience' from Cross-Strait Medical Circles
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日至15日，第十五届海峡两岸医院院长论坛在浙江杭州举行，主题为‘韧性与永续’，两岸医界人士共议AI浪潮下医疗行业变革与合作。
articles.summary_en: The 15th Cross-Strait Hospital Presidents Forum took place in Hangzhou, Zhejiang from Aug 13 to 15, themed 'Resilience and Sustainability', where medical experts from both sides discussed healthcare transformation and cooperation amid the AI wave.

articles.title_zh: 违法违规收集使用个人信息 75款移动应用被点名
articles.title_en: 75 Mobile Apps Named for Illegally Collecting Personal Information
articles.summary_zh: 国家计算机病毒应急处理中心通报，75款移动应用因违法违规收集使用个人信息被点名，涉及未明示隐私政策、未征得同意收集信息等问题；上期通报的72款中仍有24款已下架。
articles.summary_en: The National Computer Virus Emergency Response Center named 75 mobile apps for illegally collecting and using personal information, covering issues such as missing privacy policies and collecting data without consent; 24 of the previously reported 72 apps were removed after re-inspection.

articles.title_zh: 新一轮空气质量持续改善行动方案正抓紧制定
articles.title_en: New Round of Air Quality Improvement Action Plan Being Drafted
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，国务院新闻办举行发布会，生态环境部部长黄润秋介绍上半年生态环境质量持续向好，并透露正在制定新一轮空气质量持续改善行动方案。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the State Council Information Office held a press conference. Minister of Ecology and Environment Huang Runqiu said the environment improved in H1 and a new action plan for air quality improvement is being drafted.

articles.title_zh: 加强新时代廉洁文化建设
articles.title_en: Strengthening the Culture of Integrity in the New Era
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾了习近平总书记对新时代廉洁文化建设的重要论述与实践，强调通过标本兼治、文化育廉推进全面从严治党，引领党风政风焕然一新。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews Xi Jinping's key statements and practices on building a culture of integrity in the new era, emphasizing both symptom and root governance to advance full and rigorous Party self-governance.

articles.title_zh: 伊春林区转型记
articles.title_en: Yichun Forest Area: A Story of Transformation
articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江省伊春市依托红松、桦树汁等资源，推动林区经济转型、生态保护与职工生活改善，森林覆盖率达83.8%。
articles.summary_en: Yichun, Heilongjiang, leverages resources such as Korean pine and birch sap to drive forest economy transformation, ecological protection, and improvement of workers' livelihoods; forest coverage has reached 83.8%.

articles.title_zh: 安全应急装备产业发展“十五五”规划印发
articles.title_en: 15th Five-Year Plan for Safety and Emergency Equipment Industry Issued
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部、应急管理部近日联合印发《安全应急装备产业发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年重点领域产业规模达1.4万亿元。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the Ministry of Emergency Management jointly issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for the safety and emergency equipment industry, targeting 1.4 trillion yuan in key sectors by 2030.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 宁波以科技创新塑造先进制造业新优势
articles.title_en: Ningbo Leverages Technological Innovation for Advanced Manufacturing Edge
articles.summary_zh: 8月，宁波以科技创新推动先进制造业升级，上半年规上工业增加值同比增长8.9%，正加快打造先进制造业基地。
articles.summary_en: In August, Ningbo is leveraging technological innovation to upgrade its advanced manufacturing sector. In H1, the added value of industrial enterprises above designated size grew 8.9% year on year.

articles.title_zh: 浙江扎实推进共同富裕示范区建设
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Progresses in Building Demonstration Zone for Common Prosperity
articles.summary_zh: 浙江深入实施‘八八战略’和‘千万工程’，推进共同富裕示范区建设，五年多来城乡收入差距持续缩小，上半年农村居民人均可支配收入同比增长6.0%。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang has been implementing the 'Double-Eight Strategy' and the 'Thousand Villages Demonstration Project' to build a demonstration zone for common prosperity. Over five years, the urban-rural income gap has narrowed, and rural per capita disposable income rose 6.0% year-on-year in H1.

articles.title_zh: 宝鸡市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Baoji Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，宝鸡市委常委会召开会议，学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，审议政绩观学习教育总结报告等，市委书记陈晓勇主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the Standing Committee of the Baoji Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and review the summary report on political achievement education, chaired by Secretary Chen Xiaoyong.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠在长春警备区党委七届一次全体会议上强调 忠诚履职 担当作为 奋力开创长春警备区建设发展新局面
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui Stresses Loyalty and Responsibility at Changchun Garrison Party Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，长春警备区党委七届一次全体会议召开，张恩惠当选党委第一书记并讲话，强调忠诚履职、担当作为，奋力开创警备区建设发展新局面。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Zhang Enhui was elected first secretary of the Party Committee of Changchun Garrison at its first plenary session, calling for loyalty and responsibility to create a new situation for the garrison's development.

articles.title_zh: 习近平生态文明思想引领美丽中国建设谱新篇
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Thought on Ecological Civilization Leads New Chapter in Building Beautiful China
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日第四个全国生态日，《中华人民共和国生态环境法典》正式施行，以习近平生态文明思想为根本遵循，标志着生态环境保护进入法典化时代。
articles.summary_en: On August 15, the fourth National Ecology Day, the Ecological Environment Code of the People's Republic of China took effect, guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Ecological Civilization, marking a new era of codified ecological protection.

articles.title_zh: 沈阳组团赴京考察老龄产业 达成多项合作共识
articles.title_en: Shenyang Delegation Visits Beijing for Aging Industry Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日至10日，沈阳市政府组织代表团赴北京考察老龄产业，与北京达成多项合作共识，推动银发经济跨区域协同发展。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 9 to 10, a Shenyang municipal delegation visited Beijing to inspect the aging industry, reaching multiple cooperation agreements to promote cross-regional silver economy development.

articles.title_zh: 前7个月金融总量合理增长 社会融资环境保持宽松
articles.title_en: Financial Aggregate Grows Rationally in First Seven Months, Social Financing Stays Loose
articles.summary_zh: 中国人民银行8月14日发布数据显示，7月末M2同比增长7.7%，社融存量同比增长7.4%，融资环境宽松，贷款利率保持低位。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 14, the People's Bank of China reported M2 up 7.7% y/y and outstanding social financing up 7.4% y/y at end-July, with lending rates at historic lows.

articles.title_zh: 应习近平邀请 厄瓜多尔总统将访华
articles.title_en: Ecuadorian President to Visit China at Xi Jinping's Invitation
articles.summary_zh: 应国家主席习近平邀请，厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚将于8月16日至23日对中国进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of Chinese President Xi Jinping, Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa will pay a state visit to China from August 16 to 23.

articles.title_zh: 7月末民营企业再贷款余额约8000亿元 金融服务实体经济质效不断提升
articles.title_en: Private Enterprise Reloan Balance Reaches about 800 Billion Yuan at End of July, Financial Services for Real Economy Improve
articles.summary_zh: 中国人民银行发布二季度货币政策执行报告显示，7月末民营企业再贷款余额约8000亿元，金融服务实体经济质效不断提升。
articles.summary_en: The People's Bank of China's Q2 monetary policy report shows the balance of reloans to private enterprises reached about 800 billion yuan by end of July, with improved financial services for the real economy.

tags.name_en: Financial Services for the Real Economy

tags_en: Financial Services for the Real Economy

articles.title_zh: 多地降雨持续 防汛救灾加紧进行
articles.title_en: Rainfall Persists in Multiple Regions; Flood Control and Relief Efforts Stepped Up
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日至14日，河南等地强降雨致堤防溃口，被困人员已全部转移；水利部、应急管理部等部门调拨物资、预拨资金支持抢险救灾。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 13 to 14, heavy rain caused levee breaches in Henan and other areas; all trapped people were rescued. Ministries dispatched supplies and funds for flood control and disaster relief.

articles.title_zh: 新一轮空气质量持续改善行动方案正抓紧制定
articles.title_en: New Action Plan for Sustained Air Quality Improvement Being Drafted
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，国务院新闻办举行发布会，生态环境部介绍上半年生态环境质量持续向好，并透露正在抓紧制定新一轮空气质量持续改善行动方案。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the State Council Information Office held a press conference; the Ministry of Ecology and Environment said environmental quality kept improving in H1 and a new action plan for air quality improvement is being drafted.

articles.title_zh: 总书记的人民情怀
articles.title_en: The General Secretary's Affection for the People
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，习近平总书记主持中共中央政治局会议，强调持之以恒推进全面从严治党。文章回顾其推动新时代廉洁文化建设的实践。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, General Secretary Xi Jinping chaired a meeting of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau, emphasizing sustained efforts to enforce strict party governance. The article reviews his practices in promoting a culture of integrity.

articles.title_zh: 政策发力激活入境消费 多地离境退税显著增长
articles.title_en: Policy Measures Activate Inbound Consumption, Departure Tax Rebates Surge in Multiple Regions
articles.summary_zh: 7月1日离境退税2.0版新政落地实施满月，杭州、广州、四川、北京等地退税申请量和金额大幅增长，入境消费市场活跃。
articles.summary_en: A month after the launch of the upgraded departure tax rebate policy on July 1, applications and amounts have surged in Hangzhou, Guangzhou, Sichuan and Beijing, boosting inbound consumption.

articles.title_zh: 定西市委五届十三次全会暨全市上半年经济运行分析会议召开
articles.title_en: Dingxi Municipal Party Committee Holds 13th Plenary Session and Economic Analysis Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，定西市委五届十三次全会暨全市上半年经济运行分析会议召开，总结上半年工作，部署下半年任务，研究制定发展新质生产力意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the 13th Plenary Session of the 5th Dingxi Municipal Party Committee and the city's H1 economic operation analysis meeting were held to summarize H1 work, deploy H2 tasks, and study an opinion on developing new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林在沈阳市康平县、法库县调研
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Investigates in Kangping and Faku Counties, Shenyang
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日至13日，辽宁省委书记许昆林在沈阳市康平县、法库县调研，实地了解风光制氢、生物化工、低空经济等产业项目及生态民生情况，强调因地制宜推动县域经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: From August 12 to 13, Xu Kunlin, Secretary of Liaoning Provincial Party Committee, investigated Kangping and Faku counties in Shenyang, inspecting hydrogen, biochemical, low-altitude economy projects and ecological livelihood, emphasizing high-quality county development.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁吴贤德与中国邮政集团董事长刘爱力座谈交流
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning, Wu Xiande Hold Talks with China Post Group Chairman Liu Aili
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁和市长吴贤德与中国邮政集团董事长刘爱力座谈，双方就深化现代物流、金融服务等领域合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 14, Guo Ningning, Wu Xiande and Liu Aili of China Post Group held talks on deepening cooperation in logistics and finance.

articles.title_zh: 中共福州市委十二届十二次全会举行
articles.title_en: 12th Plenary Session of 12th CPC Fuzhou Municipal Committee Convened
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月13日，中共福州市委十二届十二次全会在福州举行，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁讲话，会议讨论了构建具有福州特色的创新体系推动高质量发展的意见。
articles.summary_en: The 12th Plenary Session of the 12th CPC Fuzhou Municipal Committee was held in Fuzhou on Aug 13, 2026. Municipal Party Secretary Guo Ningning spoke at the session on building a distinctive innovation system for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 市委理论学习中心组召开学习会
articles.title_en: Huai'an Municipal Party Committee Holds Theoretical Learning Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，市委理论学习中心组召开学习会，深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想，市委书记史志军主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Learning Center Group held a study session to thoroughly study Xi Jinping's thought on Party building, chaired by Municipal Party Secretary Shi Zhijun.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研推进省市民生实事项目建设
articles.title_en: Mayor Gu Kun Inspects Provincial and Municipal Livelihood Projects
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，淮安市市长顾坤到淮安区、清江浦区调研省市民生实事项目，察看就业、养老、医疗、道路、排涝等建设情况，强调用心用情把实事办好。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Gu Kun, mayor of Huai'an, inspected provincial and municipal livelihood projects in Huai'an and Qingjiangpu districts, visiting employment service stations, nursing homes, health centers, rural roads, and flood control facilities, emphasizing efforts to deliver tangible benefits to residents.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研推进省市民生实事项目建设
articles.title_en: Municipal Leaders Inspect Provincial and Municipal Livelihood Projects
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，市长顾坤到淮安区、清江浦区调研省市民生实事项目建设，强调用心用情用力把实事办好。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Mayor Gu Kun visited Huai'an and Qingjiangpu districts to inspect provincial and municipal livelihood projects, emphasizing efforts to deliver tangible benefits to the public.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡在调研督导矿山生态修复工作时强调压实责任闭环整改 筑牢生态安全屏障
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Inspects Mine Ecological Restoration, Stresses Responsibility and Rectification
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日下午，淮北市委副书记、代市长黄韡赴杜集区调研矿山生态修复工作并召开专题会议，强调压实责任、闭环整改，筑牢生态安全屏障。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 14, Huang Wei, deputy mayor and acting mayor of Huaibei, inspected mine ecological restoration in Duji District and chaired a special meeting, stressing responsibility and rectification for ecological security.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会党组召开（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Huangshi Municipal People's Congress Party Group Holds Enlarged Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 13日，黄石市人大常委会党组召开（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和重要指示精神，总结政绩观学习教育工作。俞远汉主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 13, the Party Group of Huangshi Municipal People's Congress held an enlarged meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and directives, and summarized the education on establishing correct views on performance. Yu Yuanhan presided and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 驻鲁金融机构座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Forum on Financial Institutions in Shandong Held in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，济南市委、市政府召开驻鲁金融机构座谈会，市委书记刘强出席并讲话，强调深化政银企合作，推动金融与地方经济双向赋能。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the Jinan Municipal Party Committee and Government held a forum with financial institutions in Shandong. Party Secretary Liu Qiang attended and called for deeper cooperation between the government, banks, and enterprises to promote mutual empowerment of finance and local economy.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保：围绕“四好”建设要求 做好城市更新文章
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao Emphasizes 'Four Good' in Urban Renewal Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日上午，揭阳市委书记曾风保到普宁市调研城市更新和“百千万工程”新型城镇化工作，并召开专题会议，强调围绕“四好”建设要求做好城市更新。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 13, Zeng Fengbao, Secretary of Jieyang Municipal Party Committee, visited Puning to inspect urban renewal and 'Baiqianwan' new urbanization, chaired a special meeting on 'Four Good' construction requirements.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保：围绕“四好”建设要求 做好城市更新文章
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao Emphasizes Urban Renewal with 'Four Good' Construction Requirements
articles.summary_zh: 13日上午，揭阳市委书记曾风保到普宁市调研城市更新和“百千万工程”新型城镇化工作，并召开市委书记专题会议，强调围绕“四好”建设要求做好城市更新文章。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Zeng Fengbao, Secretary of the Jieyang Municipal Party Committee, visited Puning to inspect urban renewal and new urbanization work, and chaired a special meeting to emphasize implementing the 'Four Good' requirements in urban renewal.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰:加快交通基础设施建设 赋能“百千万工程”纵深推进
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie: Accelerating Transport Infrastructure to Empower 'Bai Qian Wan' Project
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日下午，揭阳市市长曲晓杰赴普宁市调研“百千万工程”及交通基础设施建设，强调加快项目建设，壮大县域经济。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 13 afternoon, Qu Xiaojie, Mayor of Jieyang, inspected 'Bai Qian Wan' Project and transport infrastructure in Puning, urging faster construction and county economy growth.

articles.title_zh: 总书记的人民情怀
articles.title_en: The General Secretary's Affection for the People
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，习近平总书记主持中共中央政治局会议，强调持之以恒推进全面从严治党。文章回顾新时代廉洁文化建设，倡导干部清正、政府清廉、政治清明。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, General Secretary Xi Jinping chaired a CPC Central Committee Political Bureau meeting, emphasizing sustained efforts to enforce strict party governance. The article reviews the building of a culture of integrity in the new era, advocating clean officials, clean government, and political clarity.

articles.title_zh: 龙岩市政府党组会议和常务会议召开
articles.title_en: Longyan Municipal Government Holds Party Group and Executive Meetings
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，龙岩市市长蔡琳主持召开市政府党组会议和常务会议，研究禁毒示范城市创建、城市更新和深化医改等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Mayor Chai Lin chaired the municipal government's Party group and executive meetings, deliberating on anti-drug demonstration city, urban renewal, and healthcare reform.

articles.title_zh: 省政协主席周波在盘锦走访所联系企业
articles.title_en: Provincial CPPCC Chairman Zhou Bo Visits Enterprises in Panjin
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，省政协主席周波到盘锦市走访所联系企业，深入生产车间和实验室调研，并召开座谈会听取企业诉求，强调精准服务企业。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Zhou Bo, Chairman of the Provincial CPPCC, visited enterprises in Panjin, inspected workshops and labs, and held a symposium to address enterprise concerns, emphasizing precise services.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群赴高新区调研
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Inspects Shantou High-tech Zone
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日下午，汕头市委书记庄悦群到汕头高新区调研，强调发展新质生产力，打造全市科技创新策源地。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 12, Zhuang Yuequn, Secretary of the Shantou Municipal Party Committee, visited Shantou High-tech Zone, emphasizing the development of new quality productive forces and building the city's sci-tech innovation source.

articles.title_zh: 汕头召开会议专题研究部署国资国企改革工作
articles.title_en: Shantou Holds Special Meeting on SOE Reform
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，汕头市委书记庄悦群主持召开专题会议，研究部署国资国企改革，强调要做强做优做大国有资本和国有企业。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn chaired a special meeting to study SOE reform, emphasizing strengthening state-owned capital and enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 市“百千万工程”指挥部会议暨党建引领镇村片区组团高质量发展座谈会召开 逯峰主持会议
articles.title_en: Shanwei Holds Meeting on 'Bai Qian Wan Project' and Rural Cluster Development; Lu Feng Chairs
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，汕尾市召开“百千万工程”指挥部会议暨党建引领镇村片区组团高质量发展座谈会，市委书记逯峰主持并讲话，强调锚定全域镇村共富共美，推动“百千万工程”提质增效。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Shanwei held its 'Bai Qian Wan Project' command meeting and symposium on party building-led high-quality development of town-village clusters. Municipal Party Secretary Lu Feng presided and spoke, emphasizing common prosperity and beauty across towns and villages.

articles.title_zh: 市“百千万工程”指挥部会议暨党建引领镇村片区组团高质量发展座谈会召开 逯峰主持会议
articles.title_en: Shanwei Holds Command Meeting on 'Baiqianwan Project' and Party-Building-Led Regional Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，汕尾市召开“百千万工程”指挥部会议暨党建引领镇村片区组团高质量发展座谈会，市委书记逯峰主持并讲话，强调深耕“百千万工程”，推动全域镇村共富共美。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Shanwei held a meeting on the 'Baiqianwan Project' and high-quality development of towns and villages led by party building. Party Secretary Lu Feng chaired and urged deep implementation for common prosperity.

articles.title_zh: 新一轮空气质量持续改善行动方案正抓紧制定
articles.title_en: New Action Plan for Sustained Air Quality Improvement Being Drafted
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，国务院新闻办举行发布会，生态环境部部长黄润秋介绍上半年生态环境质量持续向好，并透露正抓紧制定新一轮空气质量持续改善行动方案。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on Aug 13, Ecology and Environment Minister Huang Runqiu said environmental quality improved in H1 2026 and a new air quality improvement action plan is being drafted.

articles.title_zh: 李国强调研外贸工作
articles.title_en: Li Guoqiang Investigates Foreign Trade Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日上午，泰安市委副书记、市长李国强调研外贸工作并召开座谈会，强调推动泰安开放型经济和对外贸易高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 13, Li Guoqiang, Deputy Secretary of Taian Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, investigated foreign trade work and chaired a symposium, emphasizing high-quality development of Taian's open economy and foreign trade.

articles.title_zh: 泰州高质量发展恳谈会召开
articles.title_en: Taizhou Holds High-Quality Development Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，泰州高质量发展恳谈会召开，市委书记姜冬冬主持，院士专家及企业代表围绕科技创新和产业创新深度融合建言献策。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Taizhou held a high-quality development symposium. Municipal Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong chaired the meeting, where experts and enterprise representatives discussed deep integration of scientific and technological innovation with industrial innovation.

articles.title_zh: “泰有引力”人才高质量发展大会召开
articles.title_en: 'Tai You Yin Li' Talent High-Quality Development Conference Held in Taizhou
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，“泰有引力”人才高质量发展大会在泰州召开，省政协副主席马余强、中科大校长常进、市委书记姜冬冬致辞，并表彰先进、聘请顾问、启动系列活动。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 12, the 'Tai You Yin Li' High-Quality Talent Development Conference was held in Taizhou, where Ma Yuqiang, Chang Jin, and Jiang Dongdong gave speeches. Awards and advisor appointments were also made.

articles.title_zh: “泰有引力”人才高质量发展大会召开
articles.title_en: Taizhou Hosts High-Quality Talent Development Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，“泰有引力”人才高质量发展大会在泰州召开，省政协副主席马余强、中科大校长常进、市委书记姜冬冬致辞，表彰先进并发布人才政策。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the 'Taiyou Yinli' high-quality talent development conference was held in Taizhou. Vice Chairman of Jiangsu Provincial CPPCC Ma Yuqiang, USTC President Chang Jin, and Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong delivered speeches, honoring outstanding contributors and releasing new talent policies.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛会见中金公司董事长陈亮
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Meets CICC Chairman Chen Liang
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，江苏省省长刘小涛在南京会见中金公司董事长陈亮，双方就金融赋能新质生产力发展、深化资本市场合作等交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao met with CICC Chairman Chen Liang in Nanjing to discuss financial support for new quality productive forces and capital market cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 张海波到文登区调研经济发展工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Investigates Economic Development in Wendeng District
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，市委书记张海波到文登区调研经济发展，走访多家企业，强调推进项目建设、支持企业做大做强。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Zhang Haibo, Party Secretary of Weihai, visited Wendeng District to inspect economic development, emphasizing project construction and support for enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 孔凡萍主持召开市人民政府工作征求意见建议座谈会
articles.title_en: Kong Fanping Chairs Government Work Consultation Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，威海市市长孔凡萍主持召开座谈会，通报经济社会发展情况，征求民主党派、工商联和无党派人士意见建议。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 13, Weihai Mayor Kong Fanping chaired a consultation meeting to brief on economic and social development and solicit opinions from non-Communist parties and non-partisan figures.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Standing Committee of Wuhu Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，芜湖市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，审议垃圾分类工作举措，市委书记徐志主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the Standing Committee of Wuhu Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and review waste sorting measures, chaired by Party Secretary Xu Zhi.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰调研物业服务管理'百日行动'并主持召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Inspects Property Management '100-Day Action' and Chairs Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，陕西省委常委、西安市委书记蒿慧杰调研全市物业服务管理'百日行动'并主持召开座谈会，强调强化党建引领，提升物业服务质量。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 13, Hao Huijie, Xi'an city Party chief, inspected the '100-Day Action' on property management and chaired a symposium, urging Party leadership to improve services.

articles.title_zh: 赵一德在西安市雁塔区主持召开信访工作专题会
articles.title_en: Zhao Yide Chairs Meeting on Petition Work in Xi'an's Yanta District
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，陕西省委书记赵一德在西安市雁塔区主持召开信访工作专题会，强调把群众急难愁盼放在心上，以更有成效的信访工作造福于民。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Shaanxi Provincial Party Secretary Zhao Yide chaired a special meeting on petition work in Yanta District, Xi'an, stressing the need to keep people's concerns in mind and serve the people more effectively.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰叶牛平会见上海证券交易所党委书记、理事长邱勇一行
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie and Ye Niuping Meet Qiu Yong, Party Secretary and Chairman of Shanghai Stock Exchange
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰、市长叶牛平会见上交所理事长邱勇一行，双方就深化资本市场合作、支持西安企业利用多层次资本市场发展进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie and Mayor Ye Niuping met with Qiu Yong, chairman of the Shanghai Stock Exchange, to discuss deepening capital market cooperation and supporting local enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛会见中金公司董事长陈亮
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Meets CICC Chairman Chen Liang
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，江苏省长刘小涛在南京会见中金公司董事长陈亮，双方就深化金融服务实体经济、支持科技创新等合作交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Governor Liu Xiaotao met with Chen Liang, Chairman of CICC, in Nanjing to discuss cooperation in financial services for the real economy and technological innovation.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市政府党组（扩大）会议召开
articles.title_en: Yancheng Municipal Government Party Group Holds Enlarged Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日下午，盐城市政府党组（扩大）会议召开，代市长吴炜主持并讲话，深入学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和文章精神，部署经济发展、基础教育、健康盐城等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 13, Yancheng Municipal Government held an enlarged Party Group meeting, chaired by acting Mayor Wu Wei, to study Xi Jinping's recent speeches and articles and deploy work on economic development, basic education, and health.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平调研抓党建促乡村振兴和党建引领基层治理工作
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Investigates Party Building to Boost Rural Revitalization and Grassroots Governance
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，盐城市委书记严汉平在响水县等地调研抓党建促乡村振兴和党建引领基层治理工作，强调坚持党建引领，建强战斗堡垒，并主持召开座谈会听取意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Yan Hanping, Secretary of the CPC Yancheng Municipal Committee, visited Xiangshui County to inspect party-building efforts for rural revitalization and grassroots governance, emphasizing party leadership and holding a symposium to solicit opinions.

articles.title_zh: 余金富到江城区调研督导
articles.title_en: Yu Jinfu Conducts Research and Supervision in Jiangcheng District
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，市委副书记、市长余金富到江城区调研督导高标准农田建设和农村集体“三资”管理专项整治工作，强调守住粮食安全红线，规范“三资”管理。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Yu Jinfu, deputy secretary of the municipal party committee and mayor, went to Jiangcheng District to inspect and supervise the construction of high-standard farmland and the special rectification of rural collective asset management, emphasizing food security and standardized management.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会开展《城乡规划法》执法检查
articles.title_en: Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Conducts Law Enforcement Inspection of Urban and Rural Planning Law
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日至13日，阳江市人大常委会副主任黄秀军率执法检查组对全市贯彻实施《城乡规划法》情况开展执法检查，要求强化顶层设计，推进乡村振兴战略。
articles.summary_en: From August 12 to 13, Huang Xiujun, deputy director of the Yangjiang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, led an inspection team to check the implementation of the Urban and Rural Planning Law, urging stronger top-level design and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 阳江市民政部门持续优化婚姻登记政务服务
articles.title_en: Yangjiang Civil Affairs Department Continues to Optimize Marriage Registration Services
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来，阳江市民政部门持续优化婚姻登记政务服务，落实错峰预约、一窗联办等便民举措，截至6月30日全市办理结婚登记3993对，并深化婚俗改革和婚姻家庭辅导。
articles.summary_en: Since this year, Yangjiang civil affairs departments have continuously optimized marriage registration services with measures like off-peak appointments and one-window processing. By June 30, 3,993 marriage registrations were made, while advancing wedding customs reform and family counseling.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞张雨浦会见工业和信息化部部长李乐成
articles.title_en: Li Yifei and Zhang Yupu Meet Minister of Industry and Information Technology Li Lecheng
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，宁夏回族自治区党委书记李邑飞、主席张雨浦在银川会见工业和信息化部部长李乐成，双方就深化部区合作、推进新型工业化等进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Li Yifei, Party Secretary of Ningxia, and Zhang Yupu, Chairman of Ningxia, met with Li Lecheng, Minister of Industry and Information Technology, in Yinchuan to discuss deepening cooperation and advancing new industrialization.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉调研灵武市奶产业高质量发展情况
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Inspects Dairy Industry Development in Lingwu
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉调研灵武市奶产业高质量发展并召开座谈会，强调精耕细作、改革创新、科技赋能，推动奶产业全产业链升级。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Zhao Xuhui, member of the Standing Committee of the Regional Party Committee and Secretary of Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee, visited Lingwu City to inspect the high-quality development of the dairy industry and chaired a symposium, emphasizing refined work, reform and innovation, and technological empowerment to promote whole-industry-chain upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 唐浩然与五凌电力总经理谭本刚、湖南盐业集团总经理陈伟一行座谈
articles.title_en: Tang Haoran Holds Talks with Executives of Wuling Power and Hunan Salt Industry Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，岳阳市代市长唐浩然与五凌电力、湖南盐业集团负责人座谈，就新能源开发、废盐利用等深化合作。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Yueyang's acting mayor Tang Haoran met with executives of Wuling Power and Hunan Salt Industry Group to deepen cooperation on new energy and salt utilization.

articles.title_zh: 市七届人大常委会召开第三十八次会议 卢荣春出席会议并讲话
articles.title_en: Yunfu Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 38th Meeting; Lu Rongchun Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日下午，云浮市七届人大常委会召开第三十八次会议，审议代表名额分配和选举时间决定等报告，表决通过人事任免事项，市委书记、市人大常委会主任卢荣春出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 12, the 38th meeting of the Standing Committee of the 7th Yunfu Municipal People's Congress was held, deliberating reports such as the decision on deputy quota allocation and election arrangements, and voting on personnel appointments. Lu Rongchun, Municipal Party Secretary and Director of the Standing Committee, attended and gave a speech.

articles.title_zh: 我市出台行动方案加快推进装配式建筑产业高质量发展 全力打造粤港澳大湾区装配式建筑供给示范基地
articles.title_en: Yunfu Issues Action Plan to Accelerate High-Quality Development of Prefabricated Building Industry and Build a Supply Demonstration Base for the Greater Bay Area
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，云浮市印发行动方案，提出到2030年装配式建筑占新建建筑比例达50%，打造粤港澳大湾区装配式建筑供给示范基地。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Yunfu issued an action plan to make prefabricated buildings account for 50% of new construction by 2030 and build a supply demonstration base for the Greater Bay Area.

articles.title_zh: 余钢到吴川调研并督导安全生产整改工作
articles.title_en: Yu Gang Conducts Research and Supervises Safety Production Rectification in Wuchuan
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，湛江市委书记余钢到吴川市调研传统产业转型升级和改革深化工作，并督导中央安全生产考核巡查反馈问题整改。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Zhanjiang Party Secretary Yu Gang visited Wuchuan to research traditional industry upgrading and reform deepening, and supervised rectification of safety production issues.

articles.title_zh: 市十五届人大常委会召开第四十九次会议
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 49th Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，湛江市十五届人大常委会举行第四十九次会议，听取多项报告并任命刘增文为副市长。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the 49th session of the Zhanjiang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee was held, hearing reports and appointing Liu Zengwen as vice mayor.

articles.title_zh: 杨杰东主持召开2026年第十九次党工委会议暨第十四次管委会主任办公会议
articles.title_en: Yang Jiedong Chairs 19th Party Working Committee Meeting and 14th Administrative Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日下午，湛江经开区党工委副书记、管委会主任杨杰东主持召开党工委会议暨管委会主任办公会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究经济工作等事项。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 14, Yang Jiedong, Deputy Secretary and Director of Zhanjiang Economic Development Zone, chaired a Party working committee meeting to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and study economic work.

articles.title_zh: 张向阳主持召开区委常委会（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Zhang Xiangyang Chairs District Party Committee Standing Committee (Enlarged) Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日下午，区委书记张向阳主持召开区委常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记对重庆彭水山体崩塌的重要指示，部署防灾减灾和群众身边不正之风与腐败问题集中整治工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 12, District Party Secretary Zhang Xiangyang chaired an enlarged meeting of the District Party Committee Standing Committee, conveying Xi Jinping's important instructions on the Pengshui landslide in Chongqing and deploying disaster prevention and mitigation as well as centralized rectification of corruption around the people.

articles.title_zh: 省政协调研组来我市调研
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial CPPCC Delegation Conducts Research in Zibo
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日至13日，省政协副主席刘均刚带队到淄博调研绿色低碳高质量发展先行区建设。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 12 to 13, Liu Jungang, vice chairman of the Shandong Provincial CPPCC, led a delegation to Zibo to survey green, low-carbon, high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔到浪潮集团调研并主持召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Visits Inspur Group and Chairs Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，山东省委副书记、省长周乃翔到浪潮集团调研并主持召开座谈会，强调坚持稳中求进，强化科技创新，加快建设世界新一代信息技术龙头企业。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Zhou Naixiang, Deputy Secretary of CPC Shandong Provincial Committee and Governor, visited Inspur Group and chaired a symposium, emphasizing steady progress, sci-tech innovation, and building a world-leading new-generation IT enterprise.

articles.title_zh: 赵庆文调研督导经济运行、安全生产和粮食生产工作
articles.title_en: Zhao Qingwen Inspects Economic Operation, Work Safety and Grain Production
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，淄博市委副书记、市长赵庆文到淄博经开区、临淄区、淄博高新区调研督导经济运行、安全生产和粮食生产工作，强调高效统筹、精准发力，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Zhao Qingwen, Deputy Secretary of the Zibo Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, visited Zibo Economic Development Zone, Linzi District, and Zibo High-tech Zone to supervise economic operation, work safety, and grain production, emphasizing coordinated efforts for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 山东召开重点考察调研成果协商座谈会
articles.title_en: Shandong Holds Consultative Symposium on Key Research Findings
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日下午，山东省重点考察调研成果协商座谈会在济南召开，省委常委、统战部部长邓云锋主持并讲话，各民主党派省委会主委等介绍情况。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 13, Shandong held a consultative symposium on key research findings in Jinan. Deng Yunfeng, member of the Standing Committee and head of the United Front Work Department, presided and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会党组（扩大）会议召开
articles.title_en: Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Enlarged Party Group Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，市人大常委会党组书记、主任孙庆雷主持召开党组（扩大）会议，传达学习市委十三届十一次全会精神，研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 13, Sun Qinglei, Party group secretary of the Municipal People's Congress, chaired an enlarged meeting to convey the plenary spirit of the municipal party committee and study implementation measures.

tags.name_en: Standing Committee of the Municipal People's Congress

tags_en: Standing Committee of the Municipal People's Congress

articles.title_zh: 香港警察正式成立仪仗队，驻港部队到场指导
articles.title_en: Hong Kong Police Officially Establish Ceremonial Guard with PLA Garrison Guidance
articles.summary_zh: 据香港警察消息，香港警察仪仗队于8月7日正式成立，首批40名队员正在香港警察学院受训，驻港部队三军仪仗队到场指导。
articles.summary_en: According to Hong Kong police, the Hong Kong Police ceremonial guard was officially established on August 7, with 40 members training at the Hong Kong Police College under guidance from the PLA Hong Kong Garrison.

articles.title_zh: 厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚将访华
articles.title_en: Ecuador's President Noboa to Visit China
articles.summary_zh: 据外交部8月14日消息，应习近平主席邀请，厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚将于8月16日至23日对中国进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: According to the Foreign Ministry on August 14, at the invitation of President Xi Jinping, Ecuadorian President Noboa will pay a state visit to China from August 16 to 23.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省副省长程晓波任上被查
articles.title_en: Gansu Vice Governor Cheng Xiaobo Investigated While in Office
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，中央纪委国家监委通报，甘肃省委常委、副省长程晓波涉嫌严重违纪违法，主动投案，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the CCDI and National Supervisory Commission reported that Cheng Xiaobo, member of the Gansu Provincial Party Committee and Vice Governor, is under investigation for suspected serious disciplinary and legal violations after voluntarily surrendering himself.

articles.title_zh: 湖南煤矿发生瓦斯事故致7人失联，曾多次受到检查
articles.title_en: Gas Outburst at Hunan Coal Mine Leaves 7 Missing, Mine Had Been Inspected Repeatedly
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日5时08分，湖南涟源市杨梅山煤矿发生瓦斯突出事故，致7人失联，1人正在抢救。该矿曾多次接受安全检查。
articles.summary_en: At 5:08 a.m. on August 14, a gas outburst accident occurred at Yangmeishan Coal Mine in Lianyuan, Hunan, leaving 7 missing and 1 under rescue. The mine had been inspected multiple times.

articles.title_zh: 雄安人工智能实训基地正式投入运营
articles.title_en: Xiong'an AI Training Base Officially Put into Operation
articles.summary_zh: 近日，雄安人工智能实训基地正式投入运营，配备机器人创训中心和25个特色实训室，面向企业、院校和个人提供人工智能实训服务，形成“一院一园一平台一基地”产业格局。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Xiong'an AI Training Base officially commenced operations, featuring a robot innovation center and 25 special training rooms, providing AI practical training for enterprises, institutions and individuals, forming the 'one institute, one park, one platform, one base' industry layout.

articles.title_zh: 河北省群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作推进会召开
articles.title_en: Hebei Holds Meeting on Rectifying Misconduct and Corruption Around the People
articles.summary_zh: 河北省召开群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作推进会，省委书记罗文强调以钉钉子精神抓紧抓实，持续推动全面从严治党向基层延伸。
articles.summary_en: Hebei held a meeting on rectifying misconduct and corruption around the people; Provincial Party Secretary Luo Wen stressed implementing the campaign with persistence and extending full and strict Party governance to the grassroots.

articles.title_zh: 林武在济南调研时强调深化改革创新强化AI+赋能促进服务业优质高效发展
articles.title_en: Shandong Party Secretary Lin Wu Stresses AI+ Empowerment for Service Sector During Jinan Visit
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，山东省委书记林武在济南调研，强调深化改革创新，强化AI+赋能，促进服务业优质高效发展。省委副书记、济南市委书记刘强参加。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Lin Wu, Secretary of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee, stressed deepening reform and innovation and empowering with AI+ to promote high-quality development of the service industry during a research tour in Jinan. Liu Qiang, Deputy Secretary and Jinan Party Secretary, participated.

articles.title_zh: 暑期“工厂游”火了：流水线变风景线
articles.title_en: Summer 'Factory Tours' Boom: Assembly Lines Become Scenic Spots
articles.summary_zh: 文化和旅游部等七部门印发通知鼓励发展工业旅游，暑期工厂游受热捧，形成参观、体验与消费的良性循环，展现中国制造实力。
articles.summary_en: A seven-department notice encourages industrial tourism. Factory tours have become popular this summer, offering immersive experiences like chocolate-making and shipyard visits, fostering brand-consumer bonds and showcasing China's manufacturing strength.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁吴贤德与中国邮政集团董事长刘爱力座谈交流
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning, Wu Xiande Hold Talks with China Post Group Chairman Liu Aili
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，福建省委副书记、福州市委书记郭宁宁、市长吴贤德与中国邮政集团董事长刘爱力座谈，就深化现代物流、金融服务等合作交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Guo Ningning, Deputy Secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee and Fuzhou Municipal Party Secretary, and Mayor Wu Xiande held talks with Liu Aili, Chairman of China Post Group, on deepening cooperation in modern logistics and financial services.

articles.title_zh: 福州市全面深化实施新时代“堡垒工程”
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Deepens Implementation of New-era 'Fortress Project'
articles.summary_zh: 福州市全面深化实施新时代“堡垒工程”，推动党组织向海上、产业链、科研一线延伸，以高质量党建引领高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Fuzhou deepens the new-era 'Fortress Project', extending Party organizations to maritime, industrial chains, and sci-tech fronts to drive high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 全市深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想全面深化实施新时代“堡垒工程”推进会召开
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Holds Meeting to Deepen Implementation of New Era 'Fortress Project' under Xi's Party Building Thought
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，全市深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想全面深化实施新时代“堡垒工程”推进会召开，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁讲话，市长吴贤德主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Fuzhou held a meeting to study and implement Xi Jinping's Party building thought and deepen the new era 'Fortress Project'. Party Secretary Guo Ningning spoke, and Mayor Wu Xiande presided.

articles.title_zh: 连江：一座堡垒的35年山海接力
articles.title_en: Lianjiang: A Fortress's 35-Year Relay from Mountains to Sea
articles.summary_zh: 连江县35年来坚持实施“堡垒工程”，在海上党建、军地共建、新就业群体党建等方面成效显著，夯实基层治理。
articles.summary_en: Lianjiang County has persisted in implementing the 'Fortress Project' for 35 years, achieving notable results in maritime party building, military-civilian co-construction, and party building for new employment groups.

articles.title_zh: 总书记心系国家公园：给子孙后代留下珍贵的自然资产
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends to National Parks: Preserving Precious Natural Assets for Future Generations
articles.summary_zh: 在第四个全国生态日之际，习近平总书记强调国家公园建设，旨在为子孙后代留下珍贵的自然资产。
articles.summary_en: On the occasion of the fourth National Ecology Day, President Xi Jinping emphasized national park development to preserve precious natural assets for future generations.

articles.title_zh: 连江：一座堡垒的35年山海接力
articles.title_en: Lianjiang: 35-Year Relay Across Mountains and Sea to Build a Party Fortress
articles.summary_zh: 福建连江县35年来持续实施‘堡垒工程’，加强基层党建，打造海上、双拥、流动三大堡垒，推动基层治理与产业发展。
articles.summary_en: For 35 years, Lianjiang County in Fujian has implemented the 'Fortress Project' to strengthen grassroots Party building, creating maritime, military-civilian, and mobile fortresses to boost governance and industry.

articles.title_zh: 中共福州市委十二届十二次全会举行
articles.title_en: 12th Plenary Session of CPC Fuzhou Municipal Committee Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，中共福州市委十二届十二次全会在福州举行，由市委常委会主持，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁讲话，讨论构建具有福州特色的创新体系推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the 12th Plenary Session of the CPC Fuzhou Municipal Committee was held in Fuzhou, chaired by the Standing Committee, with Guo Ningning delivering a speech on building a distinctive innovation system for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 福建出台工业数智化转型项目实施方案
articles.title_en: Fujian Issues Implementation Plan for Industrial Digital-Intelligent Transformation Projects
articles.summary_zh: 福建省工信厅出台实施方案，明确工业数智化转型项目支持范围、标准及奖励，最高补助100万元。
articles.summary_en: Fujian's Department of Industry and Information Technology issued an implementation plan for industrial digital-intelligent transformation projects, specifying support scope, standards, and rewards up to 1 million yuan.

articles.title_zh: 驻鲁金融机构座谈会召开 刘强讲话
articles.title_en: Liu Qiang Speaks at Symposium on Financial Institutions in Shandong
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，济南市委、市政府召开驻鲁金融机构座谈会，市委书记刘强出席并讲话，强调深化金融合作，推动经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Jinan Municipal Party Committee and Government held a symposium with financial institutions operating in Shandong. Party Secretary Liu Qiang attended and spoke on deepening financial cooperation for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 市政协党组扩大会议召开
articles.title_en: CPPCC Municipal Party Group Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日下午，青岛市政协党组扩大会议召开，传达学习习近平总书记重要文章和市委全会精神，孟庆斌主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 14, the Party Group of the Qingdao Municipal CPPCC held an enlarged meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important article and the spirit of the municipal party committee plenary session. Meng Qingbin chaired the meeting and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 市政府党组扩大会议召开 任刚主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Ren Gang Chairs Enlarged Meeting of Municipal Government Party Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日下午，青岛市委副书记、市长、市政府党组书记任刚主持召开市政府党组会议，传达学习中央有关精神和市委全会部署，研究下步经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 13, Ren Gang, Deputy Secretary of the Qingdao Municipal Committee and Mayor, chaired a meeting of the Municipal Government Party Group to convey central directives and study next-step economic work.

articles.title_zh: 全市区市、镇领导班子换届工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Municipal Meeting on Leadership Transition for Districts and Towns Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日上午，青岛市召开区市、镇领导班子换届工作会议，市委书记曾赞荣讲话，部署换届工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 14, Qingdao held a meeting on leadership transitions for district and town teams; Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong spoke and made arrangements.

articles.title_zh: 市政府常务会议召开 任刚主持会议
articles.title_en: Qingdao Municipal Government Holds Executive Meeting Chaired by Mayor Ren Gang
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，青岛市市长任刚主持召开市政府常务会议，听取上半年政府工作报告和市办实事进展，研究消防安全，审议通过服务业扩能提质实施方案。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 13, Qingdao Mayor Ren Gang chaired a municipal government executive meeting reviewing half-year work progress, fire safety, and a service industry expansion plan.

tags.name_en: Service Industry Expansion and Quality Improvement

tags_en: Service Industry Expansion and Quality Improvement

articles.title_zh: 外交部发言人就厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚访华答记者问
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Answers Questions on Ecuadorian President Noboa's Visit to China
articles.summary_zh: 应习近平主席邀请，厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚将于8月16日至23日对中国进行国事访问。外交部发言人14日就相关问题答记者问。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of President Xi Jinping, Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa will pay a state visit to China from August 16 to 23. The Foreign Ministry spokesperson answered questions on August 14.

articles.title_zh: 守护美丽中国 生态环境法典8月15日起施行
articles.title_en: Ecological Environment Code of China to Take Effect on August 15
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，新华社报道，《中华人民共和国生态环境法典》将于8月15日起施行，标志着我国生态环境法治建设进入新阶段。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on Aug 14 that the Ecological Environment Code of the People's Republic of China will take effect on Aug 15, marking a new stage in China's ecological environment legal construction.

articles.title_zh: 厦门市人大常委会党组会议暨理论学习中心组学习会召开
articles.title_en: Xiamen Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Party Group Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，厦门市人大常委会党组书记、主任杨国豪主持召开党组会议暨理论学习中心组学习会，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和省委、市委全会精神。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Yang Guohao, Party Secretary and Director of the Standing Committee of Xiamen Municipal People's Congress, chaired a Party group meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and the plenary sessions of the provincial and municipal party committees.

articles.title_zh: 王浩检查指导东苕溪流域防汛工作
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Inspects Flood Control Work in East Tiaoxi River Basin
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日下午，浙江省委书记王浩检查指导东苕溪流域防汛工作，强调强化极限思维、科学统筹调度，全力筑牢防汛救灾安全防线。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 14, Wang Hao, Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee, inspected flood control work in the East Tiaoxi River basin, emphasizing extreme thinking and scientific coordination to build a strong safety line against flood disasters.

articles.title_zh: 分好“蛋糕”富民惠民 浙江扎实推进共同富裕示范区建设
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Advances Common Prosperity Demonstration Zone Construction
articles.summary_zh: 浙江扎实推进共同富裕示范区建设，通过巡回诊疗、托育一体化等举措，推进基本公共服务均等化，让群众共享发展成果。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang has advanced the construction of a common prosperity demonstration zone, promoting equal access to basic public services through mobile clinics and integrated childcare, benefiting residents.

articles.title_zh: AI造车，让“安徽智造”驶上世界赛道
articles.title_en: AI-Powered Car Manufacturing Drives 'Anhui Smart Manufacturing' onto the World Stage
articles.summary_zh: 安徽新能源汽车产业形成智造、芯片、电池、算力闭环，2025年产销量居全国第一，并加速出海。
articles.summary_en: Anhui's NEV industry forms a closed loop covering AI manufacturing, chips, batteries, and computing, ranking first nationally in 2025, and is accelerating global expansion.

articles.title_zh: 流水线变风景线，暑期“工厂游”火了
articles.title_en: Assembly Lines Turn into Scenic Spots: Summer 'Factory Tours' Catch Fire
articles.summary_zh: 今年暑期，工业旅游成为新热点。文化和旅游部等七部门印发通知鼓励发展工业旅游，上海等地工厂推出参观体验项目，吸引游客打卡。
articles.summary_en: This summer, industrial tourism has become a new hotspot. Seven departments including the Ministry of Culture and Tourism issued a notice to encourage industrial tourism, and factories in Shanghai and elsewhere launched tour experiences.

articles.title_zh: 牛津能源研究所专家：中国新能源发展持续超额完成目标
articles.title_en: Oxford Institute Expert: China's New Energy Development Continues to Exceed Targets
articles.summary_zh: 近日，英国牛津能源研究所高级研究员安德斯·霍夫表示，中国新能源发展速度持续超越规划目标，能源转型不断提速。
articles.summary_en: Anders Hove, senior researcher at the Oxford Institute for Energy Studies, said China's new energy development continues to exceed planning targets, with accelerating energy transition.

articles.title_zh: 江苏出台“成果转化20条”推动科技成果转化
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues '20 Measures for Achievement Transformation' to Boost Sci-Tech Commercialization
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，江苏省政府召开新闻发布会，介绍将于8月21日施行的“成果转化20条”，含20条措施和22条支持政策，旨在突出市场导向建设科技成果转化高地。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the Jiangsu Provincial Government held a press conference to introduce the '20 Measures for Achievement Transformation,' effective August 21, comprising 20 measures and 22 supporting policies to build a market-oriented highland for sci-tech commercialization.

articles.title_zh: 江苏就人工智能产业发展公开征求意见
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Seeks Public Opinions on AI Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，江苏省人大常委会办公厅发布公告，就人工智能产业发展相关问题公开征集社会意见建议，相关条例草案已进行一审。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 14, the General Office of Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee issued a notice to solicit public opinions on AI industry development, with the draft regulation already in first review.

tags.name_en: General Office of Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee

articles.title_zh: 工作途中遇山洪，和田干部米日班·买吐肉孜不幸牺牲年仅30岁
articles.title_en: Hotan Cadre Miriban Maituruzi Dies at 30 in Flash Flood While on Duty
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月，策勒县委办公室副主任米日班·买吐肉孜在安全转移125名群众后，次日奔赴工作途中遭遇山洪，不幸牺牲，年仅30岁。
articles.summary_en: In June 2026, Miriban Maituruzi, deputy director of the County Party Committee Office in Cele County, died in a flash flood while heading to work after safely evacuating 125 residents. She was 30.

articles.title_zh: 单项冠军县，何以扛打｜辽西凌源：撑起全国三成鲜切百合供给
articles.title_en: Single Champion County: Lingyuan in Western Liaoning Supplies 30% of China's Fresh-cut Lilies
articles.summary_zh: 报道介绍辽宁凌源市发展鲜切花产业，年产鲜切百合占全国三成，并通过科研推动种球国产化，带动乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: The report profiles Lingyuan, Liaoning, which produces 30% of China's fresh-cut lilies, and highlights its efforts in bulb localization to boost rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 程晓波被查，甘肃：坚决拥护党中央决定
articles.title_en: Cheng Xiaobo Investigated; Gansu Firmly Supports CPC Central Committee Decision
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，甘肃省委常委会召开会议，传达党中央关于免去程晓波省委常委、委员和副省长的决定，通报其涉嫌严重违纪违法被审查调查，表示坚决拥护。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 14, Gansu Provincial Party Committee met to convey the CPC Central Committee's decision to remove Cheng Xiaobo and announced his investigation for alleged disciplinary violations, expressing firm support.

articles.title_zh: 中国空间技术研究院发布讣告：沉痛悼念“两弹一星”元勋、中科院院士王希季
articles.title_en: China Academy of Space Technology Issues Obituary Mourning "Two Bombs, One Satellite" Hero Academician Wang Xiji
articles.summary_zh: 中国空间技术研究院发布讣告，称“两弹一星”元勋、中科院院士王希季因病于2026年8月12日在北京逝世，享年105岁。
articles.summary_en: China Academy of Space Technology issued an obituary announcing that Wang Xiji, a "Two Bombs, One Satellite" hero and CAS academician, died of illness in Beijing on August 12, 2026, at the age of 105.

articles.title_zh: 7月各种自然灾害共造成全国1672.9万人次受灾，死亡失踪318人
articles.title_en: Natural Disasters in July Affect 16.729 Million, 318 Dead or Missing
articles.summary_zh: 国家防灾减灾救灾委员会办公室、应急管理部会商分析2026年7月全国自然灾害情况，共造成1672.9万人次受灾，死亡失踪318人。
articles.summary_en: The Office of the National Disaster Prevention and Mitigation Committee and the Ministry of Emergency Management reported that natural disasters in July 2026 affected 16.729 million people, with 318 dead or missing.

articles.title_zh: 福建宁德福安一船厂发生火灾，消防员池坷杰英勇牺牲年仅23岁
articles.title_en: Fire at Shipyard in Fu'an, Fujian Kills 23-Year-Old Firefighter
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，福建福安一船厂发生火灾，消防员池坷杰在救援中因船只爆炸牺牲，年仅23岁。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, a fire broke out at a shipyard in Fu'an, Fujian. Firefighter Chi Kejie died in an explosion during rescue operations at age 23.

articles.title_zh: 长沙天符宫对联解读被指有误，文旅局已安排调查
articles.title_en: Errors Found in Couplet Interpretations at Tianfu Palace, Changsha Bureau Investigates
articles.summary_zh: 近日，长沙市级文保单位天符宫重新开放，有网友指出其内多副对联解读文字有误。8月14日，长沙市文旅广电局回应已安排调查。
articles.summary_en: After the reopening of Tianfu Palace, a municipal heritage site in Changsha, netizens pointed out multiple errors in the interpretations of couplets. On August 14, the Changsha Culture, Tourism, Radio and Television Bureau said it had initiated an investigation.

articles.title_zh: 摄影展又现抄袭，江苏省摄影家协会通报撤销一作品入选资格
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Photographers Association Revokes Awarded Work for Plagiarism
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省摄影家协会通报，经查实杨某宇的组照中一幅作品非原创，撤销其两幅作品入选资格，展方已将涉事作品撤下。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu Photographers Association announced that a work by Yang Mouyu was not original, revoking eligibility of two works and removing the exhibited piece.

articles.title_zh: 著名森林经理学家、中国科学院院士唐守正逝世
articles.title_en: Tang Shouzheng, Renowned Forest Management Scientist and CAS Academician, Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 中国科学院院士、著名森林经理学家唐守正因病医治无效，于2026年8月12日逝世，享年85岁。
articles.summary_en: Tang Shouzheng, an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and renowned forest management scientist, died of illness on August 12, 2026, at the age of 85.

articles.title_zh: 安徽青阳：成立康养旅居联盟 加快长三角康养旅居目的地建设
articles.title_en: Qingyang, Anhui: Health & Wellness Alliance Formed to Build Yangtze River Delta Destination
articles.summary_zh: 青阳县民政局牵头成立‘青·廿一’康养旅居联盟，整合全县康养资源，助力长三角康养旅居目的地建设；九芙蓉颐养中心预计8月下旬试运营。
articles.summary_en: The Qingyang County Civil Affairs Bureau has taken the lead in establishing the 'Qing·21' Health and Wellness Alliance, integrating local resources to build a Yangtze River Delta destination. The Jiufurong Care Center is expected to begin trial operation in late August.

articles.title_zh: 中环新能源成功中标淮南凤台138MW光伏电站项目
articles.title_en: Zhonghuan New Energy Wins 138MW PV Power Station Project in Huainan Fengtai
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中环新能源中标淮南凤台138MW水面光伏电站项目，将采用其“环曦—W”组件，助力采煤沉陷区光伏建设。
articles.summary_en: Zhonghuan New Energy recently won the bid for a 138MW water-surface PV power station in Huainan Fengtai, using its Huanxi-W modules, contributing to coal mining subsidence area development.

articles.title_zh: 安徽出台措施加快数智供应链发展
articles.title_en: Anhui Issues Measures to Accelerate Digital-Intelligent Supply Chain Development
articles.summary_zh: 安徽省人民政府办公厅近日印发《安徽省加快数智供应链发展行动方案（2026—2028年）》，提出到2028年培育50家左右省级数智供应链领军企业等目标。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of Anhui Provincial People's Government recently issued the Action Plan for Accelerating Digital-Intelligent Supply Chain Development (2026-2028), setting goals including cultivating about 50 provincial-level leading enterprises by 2028.

tags.name_zh: 安徽省人民政府办公厅
tags.name_en: General Office of Anhui Provincial People's Government

tags_zh: 安徽省人民政府办公厅
tags_en: General Office of Anhui Provincial People's Government

articles.title_zh: 国新办发布会点赞重庆“拍污口”
articles.title_en: State Council Information Office Praises Chongqing's 'Photo Reporting of Sewage Outlets'
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，国新办发布会点赞重庆治水创新，从“排污口”到“拍污口”体现全社会协同共治。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the State Council Information Office praised Chongqing's water governance innovation, where the shift from 'sewage outlets' to 'photo-reported outlets' reflects whole-society collaborative governance.

tags.name_en: Regulation of Sewage Outlets into Rivers

tags_en: Regulation of Sewage Outlets into Rivers

articles.title_zh: 有福之州更好造福人民群众
articles.title_en: The Blessed City Fuzhou Better Serves the People
articles.summary_zh: 福州市落实习近平总书记重要讲话精神，推进城市更新，打造现代化人民城市，增进民生福祉。
articles.summary_en: Fuzhou implements Xi Jinping's important speech, promotes urban renewal, and builds a modern people's city to improve people's well-being.

articles.title_zh: 生态赋能 绿筑未来——福建能源石化集团启动全省首家“无废集团”建设
articles.title_en: Ecological Empowerment, Green Future: Fujian Energy and Petrochemical Group Launches Province's First 'Zero-Waste Group' Construction
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日上午，福建能源石化集团发布《“无废集团”建设实施方案》，成为全省首家全面启动“无废集团”建设的省属国有企业，将构建五大特色循环产业链。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Fujian Energy and Petrochemical Group released its 'Zero-Waste Group' construction plan, becoming the first provincial SOE to launch such initiative, and will build five characteristic circular industrial chains.

articles.title_zh: 首届全国柰李种业创新与产业高质量发展研讨会在古田县召开
articles.title_en: First National Plum Seed Industry Innovation and High-Quality Development Symposium Held in Gutian County
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日至12日，首届全国柰李种业创新与产业高质量发展研讨会在福建省古田县召开，专家学者共话种业创新与产业升级。
articles.summary_en: On August 11-12, the first national symposium on Nai plum seed industry innovation and high-quality development was held in Gutian County, Fujian, gathering experts to discuss seed innovation and industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 广西部署2026年秋季征兵工作
articles.title_en: Guangxi Deploys 2026 Autumn Conscription Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，广西召开2026年秋季征兵工作动员部署会议，总结上半年工作并部署下半年任务，强调把好兵员质量关和廉洁征兵。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Guangxi held a mobilization meeting for the 2026 autumn conscription, summarizing first-half results and arranging recruitment tasks, emphasizing quality and integrity.

articles.title_zh: 广西出台海洋经济发展“十五五”规划
articles.title_en: Guangxi Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Marine Economy Development
articles.summary_zh: 广西壮族自治区政府办公厅印发《广西海洋经济发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年海洋生产总值占地区生产总值比重达10%左右，打造现代海洋产业体系。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of the People's Government of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Marine Economy Development, aiming to raise the marine economy to about 10% of regional GDP by 2030 and build a modern marine industry system.

articles.title_zh: 《安全应急装备产业发展“十五五”规划》印发
articles.title_en: Plan for Safety and Emergency Equipment Industry Development in 15th Five-Year Plan Issued
articles.summary_zh: 近日，工信部、应急管理部联合印发《安全应急装备产业发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年重点领域产业规模达1.4万亿元，建设10个产业集群和70个特色园区。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the Ministry of Emergency Management jointly issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for the Safety and Emergency Equipment Industry, aiming for an industrial scale of 1.4 trillion yuan in key areas by 2030, with 10 industrial clusters and 70 special parks.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 实实在在降低失能老年人的照护负担（热议）
articles.title_en: Effectively Reducing the Care Burden of Disabled Elderly (Hot Discussion)
articles.summary_zh: 民政部数据显示，面向中度以上失能老年人发放养老服务消费补贴已累计核销65.12亿元，约200万老年人受益。文章呼吁扩大服务供给、提升服务质量。
articles.summary_en: According to the Ministry of Civil Affairs, elderly care consumption subsidies for moderately and severely disabled seniors have amounted to 6.512 billion yuan, benefiting about 2 million seniors. The article calls for expanding supply and improving quality of elderly care services.

articles.title_zh: 关志鸥在九州通医药集团调研时强调 更大力度促进民营经济健康发展高质量发展
articles.title_en: Guan Zhiou Inspects Jointown Pharmaceutical Group, Stresses Boosting Private Economy
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日下午，湖北省委书记关志鸥到九州通医药集团调研民营经济和产业发展，强调优化营商环境，更大力度促进民营经济健康发展、高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 13, Guan Zhiou, Secretary of the Hubei Provincial Party Committee, visited Jointown Pharmaceutical Group to inspect private economy development and stressed optimizing the business environment to promote healthy and high-quality growth of the private economy.

articles.title_zh: “人工智能+”点亮产业民生新场景
articles.title_en: 'AI+' Lights Up New Scenarios in Industry and Livelihood
articles.summary_zh: 河北省深化拓展“人工智能+”，在钢铁、医疗、交通等领域应用大模型和具身智能机器人，并建设省级中试基地，推动产业升级。
articles.summary_en: Hebei province is expanding 'AI+' applications in steel, medical, transportation and other fields, developing large models and embodied intelligent robots, and building provincial pilot bases to accelerate industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 城市更新，让生活更美好
articles.title_en: Urban Renewal, Making Life Better
articles.summary_zh: 河北省以'绣花功夫'推进城市更新，通过老旧小区改造、口袋公园建设、供热管网更新等举措，改善居民生活，提升城市品质。
articles.summary_en: Hebei Province promotes urban renewal with meticulous efforts, including old community renovation, pocket parks, and heating pipeline upgrades, improving residents' lives and urban quality.

articles.title_zh: 冯飞在白沙调研学习教育和经济社会发展并巡林
articles.title_en: Feng Fei Inspects Education, Economic Development and Forest Patrol in Baisha
articles.summary_zh: 海南省委书记冯飞8月13日在白沙黎族自治县调研学习教育和经济社会发展情况，并开展巡林，强调统筹高水平保护和高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Hainan Party Secretary Feng Fei visited Baisha on Aug 13 to inspect learning education and socio-economic development, and conducted a forest patrol, stressing coordinated high-level protection and quality development.

articles.title_zh: 党建调研行｜从“群英”到“善治”，湖南岳阳基层治理的“党建密码”
articles.title_en: Party Building Research Trip: The 'Party Building Code' of Yueyang's Grassroots Governance from 'Qunying' to 'Good Governance'
articles.summary_zh: 人民网党建调研行报道湖南岳阳“群英断是非”工作法，以党建引领群众参与基层治理，化解物业、邻里等纠纷。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily Online's Party building research trip reports on Yueyang's 'Qunying Duanshi Fei' working method, using party building to lead mass participation in grassroots governance and resolve property and neighborhood disputes.

articles.title_zh: 江苏发布三年行动计划 打造商业航天高质量发展高地
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Releases Three-Year Action Plan to Build a High-Quality Development Hub for Commercial Aerospace
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，江苏省工信厅解读《江苏省商业航天高质量发展三年行动计划(2026—2028年)》，提出到2028年重点企业年产值达600亿元，打造商业航天高质量发展高地。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 13, Jiangsu's Department of Industry and Information Technology interpreted a three-year action plan for commercial aerospace, aiming to build a high-quality development hub with key enterprises' annual output reaching 60 billion yuan by 2028.

tags.name_en: Jiangsu Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Jiangsu Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 江苏省人大常委会拟安排15名公民旁听会议
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Plans to Arrange 15 Citizens to Observe Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，江苏省人大常委会办公厅发出公告，开放公民旁听省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议的申请报名，会议拟于9月下旬在南京举行，安排15名公民旁听。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress announced the opening of applications for citizens to observe the 24th session of the 14th Provincial People's Congress, scheduled for late September in Nanjing, with 15 spots.

articles.title_zh: 常州：推动法典进企业、进社区、进校园
articles.title_en: Changzhou Promotes Ecological Environment Code into Enterprises, Communities and Schools
articles.summary_zh: 常州市在“苏超”赛事第二现场开展《中华人民共和国生态环境法典》普法宣传活动，并推进法典培训和法规清理等工作。
articles.summary_en: Changzhou carried out publicity activities for the Ecological Environment Code at a football match venue, and advanced training and regulation cleanup for environmental law enforcement.

articles.title_zh: 江苏发布20条措施加快建设科技成果转化高地
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues 20 Measures to Accelerate Building a High Ground for Sci-Tech Achievement Commercialization
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，江苏省政府召开新闻发布会，发布《关于突出市场导向建设科技成果转化高地的实施意见》，提出20条措施促进科技成果转化。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the Jiangsu Provincial Government held a press conference to release implementation opinions with 20 measures to promote the commercialization of scientific and technological achievements.

articles.title_zh: 南京发布“十五五”枢纽经济发展规划
articles.title_en: Nanjing Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Hub Economy Development
articles.summary_zh: 近日，南京市发布“十五五”枢纽经济发展规划，提出到2030年建成链接全球的国际交通门户枢纽等四大战略定位，并部署六大重点任务。
articles.summary_en: Nanjing recently issued its 15th Five-Year Plan for hub economy development, setting four strategic positions including a global transport hub and six key tasks by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 静态验收！昌九高铁步入竣工验收首个阶段
articles.title_en: Static Acceptance Launches for Nanchang-Jiujiang High-Speed Railway
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，京港高速铁路南昌至九江段正式启动静态验收，预计10月11日前完成，为后续联调联试和运行试验奠定基础。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, the Nanchang-Jiujiang section of the Beijing-Hong Kong high-speed railway started static acceptance, scheduled to finish by October 11, paving the way for further testing.

articles.title_zh: “沙戈荒”崛起新能源绿洲
articles.title_en: New Energy Oases Rise in Desert, Gobi and Barren Land
articles.summary_zh: “十五五”时期，“三北”风电光伏基地将新增装机3.7亿千瓦以上。记者走访宁夏、内蒙古、新疆等地，报道“沙戈荒”新能源基地建设运营成效。
articles.summary_en: During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, wind and solar bases in the Three-North region will add over 370 GW of capacity. Reporters visited Ningxia, Inner Mongolia, and Xinjiang to cover the construction and operation of new energy bases in desert, Gobi, and barren areas.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古启动重点行业能效与碳效领跑者企业推荐工作
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Launches Recommendation of Leading Enterprises in Energy and Carbon Efficiency in Key Industries
articles.summary_zh: 近日，内蒙古自治区工信厅、发改委和市场监督管理局联合印发通知，启动2026年度重点行业能效与碳效领跑者企业推荐工作。
articles.summary_en: Inner Mongolia's industry, development reform and market regulation authorities jointly issued a notice to launch the 2026 recommendation of leading enterprises in energy and carbon efficiency in key industries.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中包钢会见叶向东徐树彪并共同见证签约
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong, Bao Gang Meet China Huadian Leaders and Witness Signing
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中、主席包钢在呼和浩特会见中国华电集团董事长叶向东、总经理徐树彪，并共同见证双方签署全面深化战略合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Wang Weizhong, Party Secretary of Inner Mongolia, and Bao Gang, Chairman of the Regional Government, met with China Huadian Chairman Ye Xiangdong and General Manager Xu Shubiao in Hohhot, and witnessed the signing of a comprehensive strategic cooperation agreement.

articles.title_zh: 自治区政协召开民主监督式协商会 助力建设国家重要农畜产品生产基地
articles.title_en: Regional CPPCC Holds Democracy-Based Consultative Meeting on Agricultural and Livestock Production Base
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，自治区政协召开民主监督式协商会，围绕推进农牧业绿色品牌建设、助力建设国家重要农畜产品生产基地进行协商。自治区政协主席张延昆出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the Inner Mongolia Regional Committee of the CPPCC held a democratic consultative meeting on promoting green brand building of agriculture and animal husbandry, contributing to building a nationally important production base for agricultural and livestock products. Zhang Yankun, chairman of the regional committee, attended and delivered a speech.
