articles.title_zh: “沙戈荒”崛起新能源绿洲
articles.title_en: New Energy Oasis Rises in Desert, Gobi and Barren Lands
articles.summary_zh: 报道我国在沙漠、戈壁、荒漠地区建设大型风电光伏基地的进展，“十五五”时期“三北”基地将新增装机3.7亿千瓦以上，并介绍了智慧运维、绿电外送等举措。
articles.summary_en: This report covers China's progress in building large-scale wind and solar bases in deserts, Gobi and barren lands, with the 'Three North' bases adding over 370 GW of capacity during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, and highlights smart O&M and green power transmission.

articles.title_zh: 中央宣传部等部门联合印发通知要求开展生态环境法典学习宣传工作
articles.title_en: Central Publicity Department and Other Departments Issue Notice on Promoting Study and Publicity of Ecological Environment Code
articles.summary_zh: 中央宣传部等19个部门和单位联合印发通知，部署开展《中华人民共和国生态环境法典》学习宣传工作，要求纳入“九五”普法重点内容，深入宣传其时代价值。
articles.summary_en: The Central Publicity Department and other 19 departments jointly issued a notice to promote the study and publicity of the Ecological Environment Code, requiring its integration into the 9th Five-Year legal awareness campaign.

articles.title_en: Liu Jie Urges Concrete Measures to Jointly Promote Breakthroughs in Dual Carbon Work
articles.summary_zh: 13日，浙江省委副书记、省长刘捷在嘉兴专题调研“双碳”工作并主持召开企业座谈会，强调政企携手推动“双碳”工作破局成势。
articles.summary_en: On the 13th, Liu Jie, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee and Governor of Zhejiang, conducted a special survey on dual carbon work in Jiaxing and chaired an enterprise symposium, urging joint efforts between government and enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 黄润秋谈“十五五”生态环境建设：聚焦“四个更加注重”
articles.title_en: Huang Runqiu on '15th Five-Year Plan' Ecological Progress: Four Priorities
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，国新办举行发布会，生态环境部部长黄润秋介绍“十五五”时期生态环境建设将聚焦“四个更加注重”，包括环保为民、源头治理、改革创新和全民参与。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, at a State Council Information Office press conference, Minister of Ecology and Environment Huang Runqiu said the 15th Five-Year Plan period will focus on four priorities for ecological progress, including serving the people, source control, reform and innovation, and public participation.

articles.title_zh: 河南启用泥河洼蓄滞洪区
articles.title_en: Henan Activates Nihewa Flood Detention Basin
articles.summary_zh: 河南省根据沙颍河水系水情，于8月13日2时启用泥河洼蓄滞洪区，提前转移群众，水利部部长李国英主持会商部署。
articles.summary_en: Based on water conditions in the Shaying River system, Henan activated the Nihewa flood detention basin at 2:00 on August 13, with prior evacuation of residents. Minister Li Guoying chaired a meeting to coordinate flood control.

articles.title_zh: 碧水入赣，十年实践何以写就“江”来答卷？
articles.title_en: Clear Waters Flow into Jiangxi: How Ten Years of Practice Wrote a 'River' Answer
articles.summary_zh: 2026年长江大保护十周年之际，江西从“靠江吃江”转向“护江守江”，在生态修复、产业转型、文脉传承与跨省协同治理中交出答卷。
articles.summary_en: In 2026, as the Yangtze River Protection marks its 10th year, Jiangxi shifts from river exploitation to protection, with ecological recovery, green industries, cultural preservation, and trans-provincial co-governance along its 152-km shore.

articles.title_zh: 生态环境部：“十五五”时期 应对气候变化将聚焦“五个重点”
articles.title_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment: Climate Action to Focus on 'Five Priorities' in 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，国新办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”发布会，生态环境部副部长李高介绍“十五五”时期应对气候变化将聚焦五个重点，涵盖绿色低碳转型、碳市场建设等。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 13, Vice Minister Li Gao told a State Council Information Office press conference that climate action during the 15th Five-Year Plan will focus on five priorities, including green low-carbon transition and carbon market development.

articles.title_zh: 全国碳排放权交易市场累计成交量突破9.3亿吨
articles.title_en: China's Carbon Market Cumulative Trading Volume Exceeds 930 Million Tons
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，国新办举行发布会，生态环境部部长黄润秋介绍，截至7月底，全国碳排放权交易市场累计成交量突破9.3亿吨，有力促进绿色低碳转型。
articles.summary_en: At a press conference on Aug 13, Minister of Ecology and Environment Huang Runqiu said the national carbon market's cumulative trading volume surpassed 930 million tons by end of July, boosting green and low-carbon transition.

articles.title_zh: 生态环境部：确保到2030年全国森林覆盖率达到25.8%
articles.title_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment: Ensure National Forest Coverage Reaches 25.8% by 2030
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，国新办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列新闻发布会，生态环境部部长黄润秋介绍《美丽中国建设“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年全国森林覆盖率达25.8%。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the State Council Information Office held a press conference where Ecology and Environment Minister Huang Runqiu introduced the 15th Five-Year Plan for Beautiful China, aiming for forest coverage of 25.8% by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 厦金“小三通”客运航线2023年复航以来运送旅客逾500万人次
articles.title_en: Xiamen-Kinmen 'Mini Three Links' Ferry Route Carries Over 5 Million Passengers Since 2023 Resumption
articles.summary_zh: 截至8月12日，厦金“小三通”客运航线自2023年复航以来累计运送旅客突破500万人次。8月1日起临时增班，每周五至周一船班从24班增至28班。
articles.summary_en: As of August 12, the Xiamen-Kinmen 'Mini Three Links' passenger route has carried over 5 million passengers since its resumption in 2023. Temporary extra sailings were added from August 1, raising weekend sailings from 24 to 28 per week.

articles.title_zh: 山东省烟台市原一级巡视员杨洪旭接受审查调查
articles.title_en: Former Yantai Inspector Yang Hongxu under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，据山东省纪委监委消息，烟台市原一级巡视员杨洪旭涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Yang Hongxu, former first-level inspector of Yantai, Shandong, is under disciplinary review and supervisory investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law, according to the Shandong Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision.

tags.name_en: Shandong Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision

tags_en: Shandong Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision

articles.title_zh: 中泰警方联合侦破一起跨国信用卡盗刷案
articles.title_en: Chinese and Thai Police Jointly Solve Cross-border Credit Card Fraud Case
articles.summary_zh: 近日，公安部与泰国皇家警察总署联合开展收网行动，摧毁跨国信用卡盗刷犯罪窝点，抓获9名嫌疑人，涉案金额超500万元。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Ministry of Public Security and the Royal Thai Police jointly conducted an operation, dismantling cross-border credit card fraud networks and arresting 9 suspects, with involved amounts exceeding 5 million yuan.

articles.title_zh: 台湾学子北京研学体验传统文化与冰雪运动
articles.title_en: Taiwanese Students Experience Traditional Culture and Ice Sports in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，台湾学子重走科举路研习营一行在北京参观故宫、体验冰壶等项目，感受双奥场馆魅力和历史文化。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Taiwanese students on the Imperial Examination Route Study Camp visited the Forbidden City and tried curling in Beijing, experiencing the charm of the dual-Olympic venues and Chinese history.

articles.title_zh: 追忆“两弹一星”元勋王希季：转行拓荒，铺就中国航天路
articles.title_en: Remembering Wang Xiji, 'Two Bombs, One Satellite' Hero: Paving China's Space Path
articles.summary_zh: 中国科学院院士、“两弹一星功勋奖章”获得者王希季因病于8月12日在北京逝世，享年105岁。他为中国航天事业作出多项首创贡献。
articles.summary_en: Wang Xiji, academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and recipient of the 'Two Bombs, One Satellite' Meritorious Medal, died of illness in Beijing on August 12 at age 105. He made pioneering contributions to China's space program.

articles.title_zh: 六部门联合印发《生态保护“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: Six Ministries Jointly Issue the 15th Five-Year Plan for Ecological Protection
articles.summary_zh: 生态环境部会同自然资源部等六部门联合印发《生态保护“十五五”规划》，明确生态保护总体要求、重点任务和重大工程。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment, together with five other ministries, issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Ecological Protection, outlining key tasks and major projects.

articles.title_zh: 生态环境部：上半年我国生态环境质量持续向好
articles.title_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment: China's Ecological Environment Quality Continues to Improve in H1
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，生态环境部部长黄润秋在国新办发布会上介绍，上半年我国生态环境质量持续向好，PM2.5平均浓度同比下降6.2%，地表水Ⅰ—Ⅲ类水质断面比例达86.5%。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 13, Minister Huang Runqiu said at a State Council Information Office press conference that China's ecological environment quality improved in H1, with PM2.5 down 6.2% year-on-year and 86.5% of surface water sections at Grade I-III.

articles.title_zh: 中国全方位推动人工智能全球治理走深走实
articles.title_en: China Promotes Comprehensive Global AI Governance
articles.summary_zh: 在2026世界人工智能大会开幕式上，习近平主席强调用人类智慧和国际共识引领AI发展。中国全方位推动AI全球治理，世界人工智能合作组织成立，38国为创始成员国。
articles.summary_en: At the opening of the 2026 World AI Conference, President Xi Jinping stressed guiding AI development with human wisdom and international consensus. China comprehensively advances global AI governance, and the World AI Cooperation Organization was founded with 38 founding member states.

articles.title_zh: 朱镕基同志逝世
articles.title_en: Former Premier Zhu Rongji Passes Away at 98
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央、全国人大常委会、国务院、全国政协沉痛宣告，国务院原总理朱镕基同志因病医治无效，于2026年8月12日在北京逝世，享年98岁。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee, NPC Standing Committee, State Council and CPPCC National Committee announced with deep sorrow that Comrade Zhu Rongji, former Premier of the State Council, passed away in Beijing on August 12, 2026, at the age of 98.

articles.title_zh: 5年10万亿元消费增量有支撑
articles.title_en: Consumption Growth of 10 Trillion Yuan in 5 Years Supported
articles.summary_zh: 《扩大消费“十五五”规划》提出到2030年社会消费品零售总额达60万亿元左右，未来5年有约10万亿元增量，政策支撑与消费升级为其提供保障。
articles.summary_en: The 15th Five-Year Plan for Expanding Consumption targets retail sales of about 60 trillion yuan by 2030, implying a 10-trillion-yuan increase in five years, supported by policies and consumption upgrades.

articles.title_zh: 青海湟源县基层干部因地制宜抓实乡村产业
articles.title_en: Grassroots Officials in Huangyuan County, Qinghai Promote Rural Industry According to Local Conditions
articles.summary_zh: 本文报道青海湟源县基层干部在乡村产业发展中善用科学决策，通过草山有偿使用、露营项目优化、棠梨叶茶升级等实践，展现因地制宜、生态优先的基层治理路径。
articles.summary_en: This article reports on grassroots officials in Huangyuan County, Qinghai, improving scientific decision-making in rural industry development, through cases of paid use of grasslands, optimization of campsite projects, and upgrading of Tangli leaf tea, showcasing local-conditions-based and ecology-first governance.

articles.title_zh: 生态环境法典的原创性意义与世界贡献
articles.title_en: Original Significance and Global Contribution of the Ecological Environment Code
articles.summary_zh: 2026年3月12日，十四届全国人大四次会议通过《生态环境法典》，本文阐述其立法意义与国际贡献。
articles.summary_en: Adopted by the NPC on March 12, 2026, the Ecological Environment Code is analyzed for its original significance and global contribution to environmental governance.

articles.title_zh: 将学习教育成果固化为制度机制（树立和践行正确政绩观）
articles.title_en: Institutionalizing Learning Outcomes (Establishing and Practicing a Correct View of Political Achievements)
articles.summary_zh: 近期，各地区各部门各单位持续深入开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，一体推进学查改，将学习教育成果固化为制度机制，造福于民、推动发展。
articles.summary_en: Recently, all regions, departments and units have continued to deepen the learning and education on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements, integrating learning, inspection and rectification, and institutionalizing the learning outcomes to benefit the people and promote development.

articles.title_zh: 平陆运河实船试验正式启动
articles.title_en: Pinglu Canal Real-Ship Test Officially Launched
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，西部陆海新通道骨干工程平陆运河实船试验正式启动，为9月通航做准备。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the real-ship test of the Pinglu Canal, a key project of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor, was officially launched to prepare for its opening to navigation in September.

articles.title_zh: 追光的你 | 总书记为何称焦裕禄精神是一盏明灯？
articles.title_en: Why the General Secretary Calls Jiao Yulu's Spirit a Beacon of Light
articles.summary_zh: 本文回顾焦裕禄在兰考治理“三害”的事迹，展现习近平总书记对焦裕禄精神的崇敬与概括，称其是一盏明灯。
articles.summary_en: This article reviews Jiao Yulu's efforts to fight sandstorms, waterlogging, and salinization in Lankao County, and highlights General Secretary Xi Jinping's reverence for Jiao's spirit, calling it a beacon of light.

articles.title_zh: 综合立体交通网建设加快向西部纵深推进
articles.title_en: Comprehensive Transport Network Construction Accelerates in Western China
articles.summary_zh: “十五五”开局之年，我国综合立体交通网建设加快向西部推进。8月12日，平陆运河启动全线实船试验，西部交通基建加速升级。
articles.summary_en: In the first year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, China accelerates transport network construction in the west. On Aug 12, the Pinglu Canal starts full-scale ship trials, upgrading western infrastructure.

articles.title_zh: 陈晓勇在督导检查再生水利用问题整改时强调 全力确保如期高质量完成整改任务
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaoyong Inspects Recycled Water Utilization Rectification Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日下午，宝鸡市委书记陈晓勇督导检查再生水利用问题整改，强调要加快工程进度，确保如期高质量完成整改任务。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 12, Chen Xiaoyong, Secretary of the Baoji Municipal Party Committee, inspected the rectification of recycled water utilization, urging accelerated progress to ensure high-quality completion on schedule.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠到双阳区莲花山生态旅游度假区调研时强调 抓实项目建设 赋能产业提质 奋力推动长春高质量发展
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui Investigates Shuangyang District and Lianhuashan Eco-tourism Resort, Stressing Project Construction and Industrial Upgrading
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日至11日，长春市委书记张恩惠到双阳区、莲花山生态旅游度假区调研，强调抓实项目建设，赋能产业提质，推动长春高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: From August 10 to 11, Zhang Enhui, Party Secretary of Changchun, visited Shuangyang District and Lianhuashan Eco-tourism Resort, stressing solid project construction and industrial upgrading to promote high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 胡玉亭到公主岭市调研 强调发挥农高区示范引领作用加快推动农业强省建设
articles.title_en: Hu Yuting Visits Gongzhuling, Urges Agricultural Demonstration Zone to Lead Province's Agri-Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，吉林省省长胡玉亭到公主岭市调研重点项目建设、现代农业发展等工作，强调发挥农高区示范带动作用，推动农业大省向农业强省迈进。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Jilin Governor Hu Yuting inspected key projects and modern agriculture in Gongzhuling, urging the agricultural high-tech zone to lead the province's shift from a large to a strong agricultural province.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见出席新辽经贸理事会第十一次会议的新加坡客人
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet Singaporean Guests Attending the 11th Session of Singapore-Liaoning Economic and Trade Council
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见新加坡社会及家庭发展部部长马善高一行，就深化新辽经贸合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei met with Singapore's Minister for Social and Family Development Masagos Zulkifli in Shenyang to discuss deepening economic and trade cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林在抚顺市检查督导灾后重建工作
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Inspects Post-Disaster Reconstruction in Fushun
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，辽宁省委书记许昆林到抚顺市检查督导灾后重建，强调加快重建、保障民生、提升防灾能力。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 10, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin inspected post-disaster reconstruction in Fushun, stressing accelerated rebuilding, people's livelihoods, and disaster resilience.

articles.title_zh: 新加坡—辽宁经济贸易理事会第十一次会议在沈阳召开 王新伟马善高出席并致辞
articles.title_en: 11th Singapore-Liaoning Economic and Trade Council Meeting Held in Shenyang; Wang Xinwei and Masagos Zulkifli Attend and Address
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，新加坡—辽宁经济贸易理事会第十一次会议在沈阳召开，辽宁省委副书记、省长王新伟与新加坡社会及家庭发展部部长马善高出席并致辞，现场签约6个重点项目。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, the 11th Singapore-Liaoning Economic and Trade Council Meeting was held in Shenyang. Wang Xinwei, Deputy Secretary of Liaoning Provincial Committee and Governor, and Masagos Zulkifli, Singapore's Minister for Social and Family Development, attended and delivered speeches, with six key projects signed on site.

articles.title_zh: 《安全应急装备产业发展“十五五”规划》发布
articles.title_en: Plan for Safety and Emergency Equipment Industry Development (15th Five-Year Plan) Released
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部、应急管理部8月13日发布《安全应急装备产业发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年重点领域产业规模达1.4万亿元。
articles.summary_en: The MIIT and the Ministry of Emergency Management released the 15th Five-Year Plan for the Safety and Emergency Equipment Industry on August 13, aiming for a key-sector output of 1.4 trillion yuan by 2030.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 国务院关于修改和废止部分行政法规的决定
articles.title_en: State Council Decision on Amending and Repealing Some Administrative Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 国务院公布第843号令，决定修改12部行政法规、废止3部行政法规，以贯彻实施生态环境法典，自2026年8月15日起施行。
articles.summary_en: The State Council issued Order No. 843, deciding to amend 12 and repeal 3 administrative regulations to implement the Ecological Environment Code, effective from August 15, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 金融服务实体经济质效不断提升
articles.title_en: Financial Services for Real Economy Improve in Quality and Efficiency
articles.summary_zh: 中国人民银行发布报告称，适度宽松的货币政策效果持续显现，科技、绿色、普惠、养老及数字经济产业贷款增速均高于全部贷款，中小微民营企业融资成本下降。
articles.summary_en: The People's Bank of China reported that the moderately loose monetary policy has been effective, with loans to technology, green, inclusive, elderly care, and digital economy sectors growing faster than overall loans, and financing costs for small and micro private enterprises declining.

articles.title_zh: 《国家综合气象观测系统建设“十五五”规划》印发
articles.title_en: National Comprehensive Meteorological Observation System Construction Plan for the 15th Five-Year Plan Issued
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中国气象局与国家发展改革委联合印发《国家综合气象观测系统建设“十五五”规划》，对未来5年国家综合气象观测系统建设作出部署。
articles.summary_en: Recently, China Meteorological Administration and National Development and Reform Commission jointly issued the plan for the next five years to optimize observation layout and enhance disaster prevention and meteorological services.

tags.name_zh: 国家发展和改革委员会

tags_zh: 国家发展和改革委员会

articles.title_zh: 我国全面推进美丽中国建设
articles.title_en: China Advances Comprehensive Construction of a Beautiful China
articles.summary_zh: 国务院新闻办今天举行发布会，生态环境部介绍“十五五”开局之年美丽中国建设进展，前7个月全国PM2.5平均浓度同比下降6.2%，地表水优良水体比例达86.5%，并设定2030年目标。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment reported progress on building a Beautiful China, with PM2.5 down 6.2% year-on-year and 86.5% of surface water at good quality in the first seven months.

articles.title_zh: 我国加快推动新一代通信网建设
articles.title_en: China Accelerates Construction of Next-Generation Communication Networks
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来，我国加快新一代通信网建设，推进5G-A升级、6G部署和卫星互联网组网，持续完善空天地海一体化信息通信布局。
articles.summary_en: Since the beginning of this year, China has accelerated the construction of next-generation communication networks, promoting 5G-A upgrades, 6G deployment, and satellite internet networking to improve the integrated space-air-ground-sea information communication layout.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 李强签署国务院令 公布《国务院关于修改和废止部分行政法规的决定》
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Order to Amend and Repeal Some Administrative Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，国务院总理李强签署国务院令，公布《国务院关于修改和废止部分行政法规的决定》，自8月15日起施行，涉及修改12部、废止3部行政法规以贯彻生态环境法典。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council order announcing the decision to amend and repeal some administrative regulations, effective August 15, to implement the Ecological Environment Code.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见出席新辽经贸理事会第十一次会议的新加坡客人
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet Singapore Guests at 11th Singapore-Liaoning Economic and Trade Council Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见新加坡社会及家庭发展部部长马善高一行，就深化双方经贸合作等交流。

articles.title_zh: 朱镕基同志逝世
articles.title_en: Comrade Zhu Rongji Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月12日11时06分，国务院原总理朱镕基同志因病医治无效在北京逝世，享年98岁。中共中央、全国人大常委会、国务院、全国政协发布讣告。

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱主持召开市委常委会会议并讲话

articles.summary_en: On August 13, Wang Xingzhu, secretary of the Hegang Municipal Party Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions.

articles.title_zh: 史志军调研淮安海关工作

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研淮安海关工作

articles.summary_en: On August 12, Shi Zhijun, Party Secretary of Huai'an, inspected Huai'an Customs, stressing improving regulation and service to boost foreign trade.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡调研城市更新工作并主持召开专题会强调高水平推进城市更新

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 13, Huang Wei, deputy secretary of the Huaibei Municipal Party Committee and mayoral candidate, inspected urban renewal work in Duji District and chaired a special meeting, emphasizing coordinated quality improvement and high-level urban renewal.

articles.title_zh: 韦朝晖调研㵲水大型灌区项目建设

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 11, Wei Chaohui, Secretary of the Huaihua Municipal Party Committee, inspected the construction of the Wushui Large Irrigation District project.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会党组理论学习中心组举行学习会议
articles.title_en: Chen Rujiang Chairs Study Meeting of Municipal People's Congress Party Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日上午，市人大常委会党组理论学习中心组举行学习会议，市人大常委会党组书记、主任陈儒江主持并讲话，学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神及中央政治局会议精神。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 12, the Party Leadership Group of the Municipal People's Congress held a study meeting chaired by Chen Rujiang to convey recent important speeches by General Secretary Xi Jinping and the spirit of the CPC Central Political Bureau meeting.

articles.title_zh: 深入学习贯彻中央政治局会议精神 奋力完成全年经济社会发展目标任务
articles.title_en: Wu Zhiling Chairs Huangshi Government Standing Meeting on Economic Tasks
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，黄石市市长吴之凌主持召开市政府常务会议，传达学习中央政治局会议精神，研究农业农村、港口物流、应急体系等'十五五'发展规划。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Huangshi Mayor Wu Zhiling chaired a government standing meeting to convey the spirit of the CPC Central Political Bureau meeting and discuss the 15th Five-Year Plan for agriculture, port logistics, and emergency response.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰调研重点项目及古城保育活化工作

articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，揭阳市委副书记、市长曲晓杰赴榕城区调研重点项目及古城保育活化工作，强调保护与发展并重，补齐民生短板。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 12, Mayor Qu Xiaojie of Jieyang inspected key projects and ancient city conservation in Rongcheng, stressing protection-development balance and livelihood improvement.

articles.title_zh: 中共揭阳市委七届十一次全会召开 决定今年12月召开市第八次党代会
articles.title_en: Jieyang Municipal Party Committee Holds 11th Plenary Session, Decides to Convene 8th Party Congress in December
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，中共揭阳市委七届十一次全会召开，审议通过关于召开市第八次党代会的决议，并追认开除黄锐亮党籍的处分决定。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the 11th Plenary Session of the CPC Jieyang Municipal Committee was held, approving the resolution to convene the 8th Municipal Party Congress and ratifying the expulsion of Huang Ruiliang from the Party.

articles.title_zh: 国务院关于修改和废止部分行政法规的决定
articles.title_en: State Council Decision on Amending and Repealing Certain Administrative Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月31日国务院常务会议通过决定，修改12部行政法规、废止3部，以贯彻实施生态环境法典，自8月15日起施行。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, 2026, the State Council executive meeting approved a decision to amend 12 and repeal 3 administrative regulations, effective August 15, to implement the Ecological Environment Code.

articles.title_zh: 李强签署国务院令 公布《国务院关于修改和废止部分行政法规的决定》
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Decree on Amending and Repealing Administrative Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强签署国务院令，公布《国务院关于修改和废止部分行政法规的决定》，自2026年8月15日起施行，修改12部、废止3部行政法规。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council decree to amend and repeal some administrative regulations, effective Aug 15, 2026, revising 12 and repealing 3 regulations to support the Eco-Environment Code.

articles.title_zh: 学习宣传贯彻《中华人民共和国生态环境法典》座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Symposium on Studying and Implementing the Ecological Environment Code of the People's Republic of China Convened
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日上午，学习宣传贯彻《中华人民共和国生态环境法典》座谈会在拉萨召开，自治区领导旦巴、肖友才等出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 12, a symposium on studying and implementing the Ecological Environment Code of the People's Republic of China was held in Lhasa, with regional leaders Danba and Xiao Youcai attending and delivering speeches.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央 全国人大常委会 国务院 全国政协讣告朱镕基同志逝世
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee, NPC Standing Committee, State Council, and CPPCC National Committee Announce the Passing of Comrade Zhu Rongji
articles.summary_zh: 中国共产党中央委员会等机构沉痛宣告，国务院原总理朱镕基同志因病医治无效，于2026年8月12日在北京逝世，享年98岁。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee and other national institutions announced with deep sorrow that Comrade Zhu Rongji, former Premier of the State Council, passed away at 11:06 on August 12, 2026 in Beijing at the age of 98.

articles.title_zh: 王君正主持召开自治区党委审计委员会会议

articles.summary_en: Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the CPC Tibet Regional Committee, chaired a meeting of the Regional Party Committee Audit Commission, stressing higher audit quality to support high-quality economic and social development.

articles.summary_en: On August 13, 2026, Yigong Township in Bomi County developed watermelon farming to increase villagers' incomes, paving a sweet road to rural revitalization and common prosperity.

articles.title_zh: 西藏自治区首届牦牛产业发展大会开幕

articles.summary_en: On August 12, the first yak industry development conference of Tibet Autonomous Region opened in Nagqu, with regional chairman Gamagzedeng attending and delivering a speech emphasizing high-quality development of the yak industry.

articles.summary_en: On August 12, the Longyan Municipal Party Committee and Government held a briefing on the first half of 2026 work. Party Secretary Hu Sheng presided, Mayor Cai Lin reported, and opinions from retired cadres were solicited.

articles.title_zh: 那曲市组织集中收看庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会

articles.summary_en: On July 1, Nagqu City organized a centralized viewing of the live broadcast of the 105th anniversary celebration of the CPC. Municipal Party Secretary Zhang Haibo attended and emphasized firm ideals and mission.

articles.summary_en: On Aug 12, Wang Junzheng, secretary of the CPC Tibet Regional Committee, chaired a meeting of the regional audit committee, stressing higher audit quality to serve high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰会见长安银行党委书记、董事长张全明一行
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Meets with Zhang Quanming, Party Secretary and Chairman of Chang'an Bank
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，陕西省委常委、西安市委书记蒿慧杰会见长安银行党委书记、董事长张全明一行，就深化政银合作、支持西安高质量发展进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Hao Huijie, member of the Standing Committee of the Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Xi'an Municipal Party Committee, met with Zhang Quanming, Party Secretary and Chairman of Chang'an Bank, to discuss deepening government-bank cooperation and supporting Xi'an's high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 金华市新乡商会莅临高新区考察调研
articles.title_en: Jinhua Xinxiang Chamber of Commerce Visits High-tech Zone
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，金华市新乡商会会长李文春一行到高新区考察调研，管委会副主任张好勇陪同，双方就深化合作、助推产业出海进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, a delegation from Jinhua Xinxiang Chamber of Commerce led by President Li Wenchun visited the High-tech Zone for inspection and research, accompanied by Deputy Director Zhang Haoyong of the Management Committee, discussing deeper cooperation and overseas market expansion.

articles.title_zh: 全市科技强农推进会召开
articles.title_en: Yancheng Holds Meeting to Advance Agricultural Science and Technology
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，盐城市召开全市科技强农推进会，代市长吴炜出席并讲话，强调科技赋能智慧农业，推动农业大市向农业强市迈进。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Yancheng held a citywide meeting on advancing agricultural science and technology. Acting Mayor Wu Wei attended and stressed the role of technology and smart agriculture in building a strong agricultural city.

articles.title_zh: 余金富到阳江海陵湾新区调研重点项目建设情况
articles.title_en: Yu Jinfu Investigates Key Project Construction in Yangjiang Hailing Bay New Area
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，阳江市市长余金富率队到阳江海陵湾新区调研重点项目建设，强调要推动项目提速提质增效。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Yangjiang Mayor Yu Jinfu led a team to inspect key project construction in Hailing Bay New Area, urging accelerated, high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 港澳青少年到阳江研学交流
articles.title_en: Hong Kong and Macao Youth Participate in Study Tour in Yangjiang
articles.summary_zh: 近日，约70名港澳青少年在广东阳江参加研学交流活动，参观海丝馆、核电基地等，进行历史科技与国家安全教育。
articles.summary_en: Recently, about 70 teenagers from Hong Kong and Macao participated in a study tour in Yangjiang, Guangdong, visiting the Maritime Silk Road Museum and nuclear power base for historical, technological and national security education.

articles.title_zh: 李军对仙人岛经开区危化品生产企业开展实名制安全包保
articles.title_en: Li Jun Inspects Chemical Firm under Named Safety Responsibility System
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，营口市长李军到仙人岛经开区中海沥青公司检查危化品安全生产，落实实名制包保制度。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Li Jun, Mayor of Yingkou, inspected CNOOC Bitumen Co. in Xianrendao Economic Development Zone to enforce hazardous chemical safety and the named responsibility system.

articles.title_zh: 李军调研重点项目建设情况
articles.title_en: Li Jun Inspects Key Project Construction
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，营口市委副书记、市长李军到华能营口海上风电项目和仙人岛海水淡化项目现场调研，强调抢抓施工黄金期，以重大项目牵引有效投资扩大。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Li Jun, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Yingkou Municipal Committee and Mayor, inspected the Huaneng Yingkou Offshore Wind Power Project and the Xianrendao Seawater Desalination Project, emphasizing seizing the construction window to expand effective investment.

articles.title_zh: 李军对仙人岛经开区危化品生产企业开展实名制安全包保
articles.title_en: Li Jun Conducts Named Safety Guarantee for Hazardous Chemical Enterprises in Xianrendao Economic Development Zone
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，市委副书记、市长李军到仙人岛经开区中海沥青公司检查危化品安全生产，强调压实主体责任、守住安全底线。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Mayor Li Jun inspected hazardous chemical safety at CNOOC Asphalt in Xianrendao Economic Development Zone, emphasizing corporate responsibility and safety bottom line.

articles.title_zh: 杨政昆调研玉溪农产品出口情况时强调 抓住关键环节 加快推动外向型农业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Yang Zhengkun Inspects Agricultural Product Exports in Tonghai and Huaning
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，市委书记杨政昆到通海县、华宁县调研农产品出口，强调抓实“品质、品牌、标准、定价、交易”五个关键环节，推动外向型农业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Yang Zhengkun, Party Secretary of Yuxi, inspected agricultural product exports in Tonghai and Huaning counties, emphasizing five key links to promote high-quality development of export-oriented agriculture.

articles.title_zh: 唐浩然赴岳阳临港高新区调研
articles.title_en: Tang Haoran Visits Yueyang Lingang High-tech Zone for Research
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，岳阳市代理市长唐浩然赴岳阳临港高新区调研产业项目和安全生产，强调服务企业、推动产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, acting mayor Tang Haoran of Yueyang visited the Lingang High-tech Zone to inspect industrial projects and production safety, emphasizing enterprise services and high-quality industrial development.

articles.title_zh: 云浮军分区主要领导赴罗定检查指导征兵工作
articles.title_en: Yunfu Military Sub-area Leaders Inspect Conscription Work in Luoding
articles.summary_zh: 近日，云浮军分区主要领导率工作组赴罗定市检查指导征兵体检工作，强调严把体检关、选送优质兵，并与应征青年和体检医生交流。
articles.summary_en: Recently, leaders of the Yunfu Military Sub-area led a team to Luoding to inspect conscription medical checks, stressing strict standards and quality selection, and exchanged views with recruits and doctors.

articles.title_zh: 卢荣春率队调研重点项目建设和房地产行业发展情况
articles.title_en: Lu Rongchun Leads Research on Key Projects and Real Estate Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日上午，云浮市委书记卢荣春率队调研重点项目建设和房地产行业发展情况，强调铆足干劲推动下半年经济持续向稳向好，市长李庆新参加。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 11, Yunfu City Party Secretary Lu Rongchun led a research team to inspect key project construction and real estate development, emphasizing efforts to stabilize the economy in H2.

articles.title_zh: 卢荣春率队到云城区南盛镇调研督导“百千万工程”工作
articles.title_en: Lu Rongchun Leads Inspection of 'Baiqianwan Project' in Nansheng Town, Yuncheng District
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日下午，云浮市委书记卢荣春率队到云城区南盛镇调研督导“百千万工程”，强调推进镇村风貌提升和乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 11, Yunfu Party Secretary Lu Rongchun toured Nansheng Town to supervise the 'Baiqianwan Project', urging rural development and environmental upgrades.

articles.title_zh: 李庆新调研督导全域土地综合整治工作
articles.title_en: Li Qingxin Inspects Comprehensive Land Improvement Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，云浮市市长李庆新到罗定市调研全域土地综合整治，强调以土地要素高效配置赋能“百千万工程”。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Li Qingxin, mayor of Yunfu, inspected comprehensive land improvement in Luoding, emphasizing efficient land allocation to empower the 'Hundred-Thousand-Ten Thousand Project'.

articles.title_zh: 湛江市领导调研“百千万工程”及农产品物流体系建设工作
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Officials Inspect Rural Development and Agricultural Logistics
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，湛江市长李勇毅到霞山、麻章、遂溪调研“百千万工程”及农产品物流体系，强调促进农业提质增效。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi visited Xiashan, Mazhang, and Suixi to inspect rural development and agricultural logistics, emphasizing agricultural upgrading.

tags.name_en: Hundreds, Thousands, and Tens of Thousands Project

tags_en: Hundreds, Thousands, and Tens of Thousands Project

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐赴金湾区走访调研外资及高新技术企业 全力抓好产业生态建设 以高水平服务助力企业做大做强
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Visits Foreign and High-Tech Enterprises in Jinwan District to Strengthen Industrial Ecology
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，珠海市委副书记、市长吴泽桐赴金湾区走访调研外资及高新技术企业，强调抓好产业生态建设，以高水平服务助力企业做大做强。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Wu Zetong, Mayor of Zhuhai, visited foreign and high-tech enterprises in Jinwan District, stressing industrial ecology and high-quality services to support business growth.

articles.title_zh: 中共淄博市委十三届十一次全体会议举行
articles.title_en: CPC Zibo Municipal Committee Holds 11th Plenary Session
articles.summary_zh: 中共淄博市委十三届十一次全会于8月12日召开，市委书记马晓磊作工作报告，审议通过推进农业农村现代化的意见，并确认开除王立明党籍。
articles.summary_en: The 11th plenary session of the CPC Zibo Municipal Committee was held on Aug. 12. Ma Xiaolei delivered a work report. The session approved a plan on agricultural and rural modernization and confirmed the expulsion of Wang Liming from the Party.

articles.title_zh: 广东宣布上调最低工资标准
articles.title_en: Guangdong Announces Increase in Minimum Wage Standards
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，广东省人民政府印发通知，自2026年9月1日起全面上调全省最低工资标准，分为三类档位，广州、深圳分别调整为2680元/月和2700元/月。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the People's Government of Guangdong Province issued a notice to raise the minimum wage standards across the province from September 1, 2026, with three tiers, setting Guangzhou at 2,680 yuan/month and Shenzhen at 2,700 yuan/month.

articles.title_zh: 商务部：明日起对印度进口单模光纤继续征反倾销税，为期5年
articles.title_en: Ministry of Commerce to Continue Anti-dumping Duties on Indian Single-Mode Optical Fiber for 5 Years from Tomorrow
articles.summary_zh: 商务部公布对印度进口单模光纤反倾销措施期终复审裁定，自2026年8月14日起继续征收反倾销税，实施期限为5年。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Commerce announced to continue anti-dumping duties on single-mode optical fiber from India for five years starting August 14, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 牢记嘱托 感恩奋进·奋力谱写中国式现代化建设河北篇章丨兴农富民共建和美乡村
articles.title_en: Hebei Advances Rural Revitalization to Build Beautiful Villages
articles.summary_zh: 河北省认真学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神，学习运用“千万工程”经验，扎实推进乡村全面振兴，筑牢粮食安全基础，发展特色产业，建设宜居宜业和美乡村。
articles.summary_en: Hebei has been earnestly implementing important instructions from General Secretary Xi Jinping, applying the 'Ten Million Project' experience to promote rural revitalization, ensure food security, develop distinctive industries, and build livable and beautiful villages.

articles.title_zh: 王正谱在石家庄市衡水市调研
articles.title_en: Wang Zhengpu Visits Shijiazhuang and Hengshui for Research
articles.summary_zh: 河北省省长王正谱在石家庄、衡水调研，强调发挥科创平台作用，加快产业转型升级，培育经济发展新动能。
articles.summary_en: Governor Wang Zhengpu of Hebei visited Shijiazhuang and Hengshui, emphasizing the role of sci-tech innovation platforms to accelerate industrial transformation and foster new economic drivers.

articles.title_zh: 本周日 福州迎来开渔季
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Fishing Season Opens This Sunday
articles.summary_zh: 福建省北纬26度30分以北海域8月11日开捕，福州海域将于8月16日12时开渔，近1700艘渔船结束休渔出海。
articles.summary_en: Fishing in waters north of 26°30′N in Fujian started on Aug 11; Fuzhou's season opens at noon Aug 16, with nearly 1,700 boats leaving port.

articles.title_zh: 福州大健康智造产业园10月投用
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Health-Tech Manufacturing Park to Open in October
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，记者从闽侯经济技术开发区获悉，岁金智谷二期福州大健康智造产业园建设进入收尾阶段，预计10月投用，已引进14家企业。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 11, the Minhou Economic and Technological Development Zone said the second phase of Suijin Zhigu Fuzhou Health-Tech Manufacturing Park is in final construction and expected to open in October, with 14 companies signed.

articles.title_zh: 福州市人大常委会向社会公开征集立法项目建议
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Calls for Public Suggestions on Legislative Projects
articles.summary_zh: 福州市人大常委会自即日起至9月15日向社会公开征集五年立法规划和2027年立法工作计划建议项目，以推进科学立法、民主立法、依法立法。
articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of Fuzhou Municipal People's Congress is publicly soliciting proposals for its 2027-2031 five-year legislative plan and 2027 work plan from now until Sept 15, 2026, to advance scientific, democratic, and law-based legislation.

tags.name_en: Fuzhou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee

tags_en: Fuzhou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee

articles.title_zh: 福州鼓楼核心商务区信和片区交通整治见成效
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Gulou Business District Traffic Improvement Shows Results
articles.summary_zh: 福州市人大代表陈勇牵头推动鼓楼信和片区交通整治，缓解停车难、行车难，白领和外卖骑手受益。
articles.summary_en: Fuzhou people's congress deputy Chen Yong led traffic improvements in the Gulou Xinhe business area, easing parking and traffic congestion for office workers and delivery riders.

articles.title_zh: 福州有个工会“就业超市”
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Has a Union 'Employment Supermarket'
articles.summary_zh: 福州市总工会打造“工会稳岗就业创业服务超市”，将就业服务从“送岗位”延伸至“育能力”，累计发布岗位逾10万个，惠及职工超20万人次。
articles.summary_en: The Fuzhou Federation of Trade Unions has built an 'employment supermarket' that extends services from job placement to skill training, posting over 100,000 positions and benefiting over 200,000 workers.

articles.title_zh: 市人民政府开展服务业经济运行督导调研 于海田参加
articles.title_en: Municipal People's Government Conducts Supervision and Research on Service Industry Economic Operation; Yu Haitian Participates
articles.summary_zh: 近日，济南市人民政府领导带队到各区县督导调研服务业经济运行，市长于海田参加，强调推动服务业扩能提质，冲刺三季度目标。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Municipal People's Government led teams to various districts and counties to supervise and investigate service industry economic operation. Mayor Yu Haitian participated, emphasizing expansion and quality improvement to achieve annual targets.

articles.title_zh: 曾赞荣调研创新型产业发展工作时强调：加强产业技术攻关和新赛道培育 因地制宜加快发展新质生产力
articles.title_en: Zeng Zanrong Inspects Innovative Industries, Urges Tech Breakthroughs and New Growth Tracks
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日下午，青岛市委书记曾赞荣到西海岸新区调研创新型产业，强调加强技术攻关和新赛道培育，加快发展新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 13, Qingdao Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong visited West Coast New Area to research innovative industries, urging enhanced technological breakthroughs and new track cultivation to accelerate new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 青岛市人大常委会党组扩大会议暨党组理论学习中心组集体学习举行
articles.title_en: Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Party Group Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日上午，青岛市人大常委会党组扩大会议暨理论学习中心组集体学习举行，传达学习中央政治局会议和市委全会精神，研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 13, the Party Group meeting of the Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee was held to convey and study the spirit of the Political Bureau meeting and the municipal party committee plenum.

tags.name_en: Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee

tags_en: Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee

articles.title_zh: 中共厦门市第十四次代表大会10月召开
articles.title_en: CPC Xiamen Municipal 14th Congress to Convene in October
articles.summary_zh: 厦门市委十三届十一次全会决定，中国共产党厦门市第十四次代表大会定于2026年10月召开。大会将总结工作、选举新一届市委和市纪委等。
articles.summary_en: The 14th CPC Xiamen Municipal Congress is scheduled for October 2026, as decided at the 11th Plenary Session of the 13th CPC Xiamen Municipal Committee. It will review work and elect new municipal party committee and disciplinary commission.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：中方敦促有关国家停止滥用多边军控机制
articles.title_en: Chinese FM Urges Relevant Countries to Stop Abusing Multilateral Arms Control Mechanism
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在记者会上表示，美国等国在日内瓦裁军谈判会议搞所谓共同发言纯属政治目的，中方敦促其停止滥用多边军控机制。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun stated that the so-called joint statement by the US and others at the Geneva Conference on Disarmament is purely for political purposes, urging them to stop abusing the multilateral arms control mechanism.

articles.title_zh: 王浩在全省检察工作会议上强调坚定践行“三个监督” 忠实履行职责使命
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Stresses Firmly Implementing 'Three Supervisions' at Provincial Procuratorial Work Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，第十八次全省检察工作会议在杭州召开，浙江省委书记王浩出席并讲话，强调坚定践行“三个监督”，为高质量发展建设共同富裕示范区提供司法保障。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the 18th Provincial Procuratorial Work Conference was held in Hangzhou. Zhejiang Party Secretary Wang Hao attended and stressed firmly implementing the 'Three Supervisions' to provide judicial support for building a common prosperity demonstration zone.

articles.title_zh: 做大“蛋糕”缩小差距 浙江扎实推进共同富裕示范区建设
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Promotes Common Prosperity Demonstration Zone by Enlarging 'Cake' and Narrowing Gaps
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省深入实施‘八八战略’，通过山海协作和‘千万工程’推进共同富裕示范区建设，持续缩小城乡、地区、收入差距，城乡居民收入倍差降至1.81。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang has implemented the 'Double-Eight Strategy' and advanced the common prosperity demonstration zone through mountain-sea collaboration and the 'Ten Million Project', narrowing urban-rural, regional, and income gaps, with the urban-rural income ratio falling to 1.81.

articles.title_zh: 长沙消费，活力全开
articles.title_en: Changsha Consumption in Full Swing
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日至11日，大河财立方记者随调研团走访长沙零食王国、渔人码头、东茅街茶馆等消费地标，展现长沙沉浸式消费、夜经济等新场景。长沙夜间消费占全天消费比重达64%。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 10-11, reporters toured Changsha landmarks like Snack Kingdom, Yuren Wharf, and Dongmaojie Teahouse, highlighting immersive consumption and night economy. Night spending accounts for 64% of daily consumption.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省人大常委会开放公民旁听会议报名
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Opens Registration for Citizens to Observe Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，江苏省人大常委会办公厅发布公告，开放公民申请旁听省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议，会议9月下旬在南京举行，设15个旁听名额。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the General Office of Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee announced that citizens can apply to observe the 24th session in late September in Nanjing, with 15 seats available.

tags.name_en: Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee

tags_en: Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记关切事：实干笃行绘新绿
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Concern: Down-to-Earth Efforts Paint a New Green
articles.summary_zh: 在第4个全国生态日来临之际，记者深入黑龙江、湖北、山东等地，记录各地践行习近平生态文明思想、推进污染防治与绿色转型的实践。
articles.summary_en: As the 4th National Ecological Day approaches, reporters visited Heilongjiang, Hubei, Shandong and other provinces to document local practices in pollution control and green transformation under Xi Jinping's ecological civilization thought.

articles.title_zh: 兰州大学原校长、著名磁学及磁性材料专家李发伸逝世
articles.title_en: Li Fashen, Former Lanzhou University President and Magnetic Materials Expert, Dies
articles.summary_zh: 兰州大学原校长、著名磁学及磁性材料专家李发伸因病医治无效，于2026年8月13日在兰州逝世，享年86岁。
articles.summary_en: Li Fashen, former president of Lanzhou University and renowned magnetic materials expert, died of illness in Lanzhou on August 13, 2026, at the age of 86.

articles.title_zh: 西藏持续深化民族团结进步促进法落地实施
articles.title_en: Tibet Continues to Deepen Implementation of Ethnic Unity and Progress Promotion Law
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，西藏自治区政府新闻办举行新闻发布会，介绍学习宣传贯彻民族团结进步促进法情况。西藏已累计开展宣传活动1882场，受教育群众25.8万余人次。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the Information Office of the Tibet Autonomous Region Government held a press conference on the implementation of the Ethnic Unity and Progress Promotion Law. Tibet has held 1,882 promotional events reaching over 258,000 people.

tags.name_en: Ethnic Unity and Progress Promotion Law
Sense of Community for the Chinese Nation

Sense of Community for the Chinese Nation

articles.title_zh: 西藏自治区首届牦牛产业发展大会开幕
articles.title_en: Tibet's First Yak Industry Development Conference Opens
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，西藏自治区首届牦牛产业发展大会在那曲市开幕，自治区主席嘎玛泽登出席并致辞，强调推动牦牛产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the first Yak Industry Development Conference of Tibet Autonomous Region opened in Nagqu. Chairman Garma Tseden attended and delivered a speech, emphasizing high-quality development of the yak industry.

articles.title_zh: 浙江发布脑机接口产学研联动18条支持举措
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Releases 18 Support Measures for Brain-Computer Interface Industry-Academia-Research Collaboration
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，浙江省政府办公厅发布《关于推进脑机接口产学研联动的若干措施》，提出18条支持举措，构建产学研联动机制。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the General Office of the Zhejiang Provincial Government issued measures to promote brain-computer interface industry-academia-research collaboration, proposing 18 supporting measures.

articles.title_zh: 浙江推出外卖聚集区管理模式
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Introduces Management Model for Food Delivery Clusters
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，浙江省市场监管局推出外卖聚集区管理模式，采取证照校验、电子证照公示、AI非现场监管等措施，治理无堂食外卖乱象。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the Zhejiang Provincial Market Supervision Administration introduced a management model for food delivery clusters, featuring license verification, electronic license display, and AI-based off-site supervision to tackle irregularities in delivery-only restaurants.

articles.title_zh: 曾赞荣调研创新型产业发展工作时强调：加强产业技术攻关和新赛道培育 因地制宜加快发展新质生产力
articles.title_en: Zeng Zanrong Inspects Innovative Industrial Development, Stressing Tech Breakthroughs and New Tracks
articles.summary_zh: 今天下午，市委书记曾赞荣到西海岸新区调研创新型产业发展，强调加强技术攻关和新赛道培育，因地制宜发展新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: This afternoon, Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong visited West Coast New Area to inspect innovative industrial development, emphasizing technological breakthroughs and fostering new tracks to develop new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 以深化周边发展融合推动构建周边命运共同体
articles.title_en: Deepening Neighborhood Development Integration to Build a Community with a Shared Future for Neighboring Countries
articles.summary_zh: 《十五五规划纲要》提出深化周边发展融合，文章从硬联通、软联通、心相通等维度阐释构建周边命运共同体的路径与意义。
articles.summary_en: The 15th Five-Year Plan proposes deepening neighborhood development integration. This article elaborates on paths to build a community with a shared future for neighboring countries through infrastructure connectivity, institutional connectivity, and people-to-people bonds.

tags.name_en: Community with a Shared Future for Neighboring Countries

tags_en: Community with a Shared Future for Neighboring Countries

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行｜人工智能从“浙”里起飞
articles.title_en: Vibrant China Research Tour: AI Takes Off from Zhejiang
articles.summary_zh: 7月17日习近平总书记在世界人工智能大会发表主旨讲话后，记者深入浙江调研，报道人工智能在技术研发、产业转化、场景应用等方面的发展成效。
articles.summary_en: After President Xi Jinping's keynote speech at the World AI Conference on July 17, reporters visited Zhejiang to report on AI progress in R&D, industrial transformation, and application scenarios.

articles.title_zh: 王清宪与尤政等院士专家座谈
articles.title_en: Wang Qingxian Holds Talks with You Zheng and Other Academicians
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日下午，安徽省长王清宪在合肥与尤政等院士专家座谈，围绕仪器仪表产业合作与创新生态进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 12, Anhui Governor Wang Qingxian met with academician You Zheng and other experts in Hefei to discuss cooperation and innovation in the instrumentation industry.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚韦韬在南宁调研并召开台风灾后恢复重建推进会
articles.title_en: Chen Gang and Wei Tao Inspect Hengzhou and Chair Typhoon Recovery Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚、自治区主席韦韬在南宁横州市调研并召开台风“美莎克”灾后恢复重建推进会，强调加快重建，提升防灾减灾能力。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 12, Guangxi Party Secretary Chen Gang and Governor Wei Tao visited Hengzhou and chaired a meeting on typhoon 'Maysak' recovery, urging accelerated reconstruction and improved disaster resilience.

articles.title_zh: 王凯到省水利厅调度水库安全运行
articles.title_en: Wang Kai Coordinates Reservoir Safety at Provincial Water Resources Department
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日下午，河南省省长王凯到省水利厅调度水库安全运行，强调抓实抓细水库、河道全链条防御工作，确保安全度汛。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 12, Henan Governor Wang Kai went to the Provincial Water Resources Department to coordinate reservoir safety operations, emphasizing comprehensive flood prevention measures.

articles.title_zh: 省政协党组扩大会议和主席会议召开
articles.title_en: Provincial CPPCC Holds Party Group Enlarged Meeting and Chairman's Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，省政协主席孔昌生主持召开党组扩大会议和主席会议，学习习近平总书记重要讲话和文章精神，研究部署正确政绩观学习教育工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, CPPCC Provincial Chairman Kong Changsheng chaired the Party Group Enlarged Meeting and Chairman's Meeting to study Xi Jinping's important speeches and articles, and to deploy education on correct view of political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁在郑州市督导调研防汛工作
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Inspects Flood Control Work in Zhengzhou
articles.summary_zh: 受台风影响河南多地出现强降雨，8月12日省委书记刘宁在郑州市督导调研防汛工作，强调坚决打赢防汛救灾攻坚战，确保人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: Amid heavy rainfall triggered by Typhoon Baidujuan, Henan Party Secretary Liu Ning visited Zhengzhou on August 12 to inspect flood control efforts, urging a firm fight to safeguard people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁会见中国能源建设集团董事长倪真
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Meets Chairman of China Energy Engineering Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，河南省委书记刘宁在郑州会见中国能源建设集团董事长倪真，双方就加强新型能源体系等领域合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Liu Ning, Secretary of Henan Provincial Party Committee, met with Ni Zhen, Chairman of China Energy Engineering Group in Zhengzhou, discussing cooperation in new energy systems and other fields.

articles.title_zh: 河南省防指调度强降雨防范应对工作
articles.title_en: Henan Provincial Flood Control Headquarters Coordinates Heavy Rainfall Prevention
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日上午，河南省防汛抗旱指挥部调度强降雨防范应对工作，省委书记刘宁作出批示，省长王凯现场调度，要求落实防汛措施，确保人民安全。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Aug 12, Henan Provincial Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters coordinated heavy rainfall prevention. Party Secretary Liu Ning gave instructions, and Governor Wang Kai directed on-site, urging implementation of flood control measures to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 智涌雄安 未来已来——雄安新区人工智能产业聚势勃发
articles.title_en: AI Industry Thrives in Xiong'an New Area
articles.summary_zh: 近日，雄安人工智能实训基地在雄安新区启动区科学园片区正式投运，首届人工智能实训班同步开班，标志着雄安人工智能产业“一院一园一平台一基地”发展格局全面形成。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Xiong'an AI Training Base was officially put into operation in the Science Park of the Xiong'an New Area startup zone, with the first AI training class launching simultaneously, marking the full formation of the 'one institute, one park, one platform, one base' AI industry pattern.

articles.title_zh: 新能源汽车迎来两个“首次”突破，怎么看
articles.title_en: New Energy Vehicles Achieve Two 'Firsts' in Market Share, What Does It Mean?
articles.summary_zh: 7月新能源汽车国内销量占比达68.1%，出口占比连续两月超50%，首次双双突破半壁江山，标志其成为市场主流。
articles.summary_en: In July, NEVs accounted for 68.1% of domestic sales and over 50% of exports for two consecutive months, marking their first-ever majority share and cementing their mainstream status.

articles.title_zh: 长沙：小剧场激活演艺新空间
articles.title_en: Changsha: Small Theaters Activate New Performing Arts Spaces
articles.summary_zh: 长沙小剧场《长沙》等演艺新空间发展迅速，2025年长沙市政府与省文旅厅联合印发“演艺新空间十条”支持建设演艺名城，今年上半年已建成111个项目，演出1.4万场。
articles.summary_en: Changsha's small theaters like "Changsha" are booming. In 2025, the city government and provincial culture department issued ten measures to support new performance spaces. In H1 this year, 111 projects were built with 14,000 shows.

articles.title_zh: 省政府与上海国投公司举行工作会谈
articles.title_en: Hunan Provincial Government Holds Working Talks with Shanghai State Investment Company
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日上午，湖南省政府与上海国有资本投资有限公司在长沙举行工作会谈，省长毛伟明与上海国投公司董事长袁国华出席，会后三方签署“十五五”战略合作框架协议。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 12, the Hunan Provincial Government held talks with Shanghai State Investment Company in Changsha. Governor Mao Weiming and Chairman Yuan Guohua attended, and a strategic cooperation framework agreement for the 15th Five-Year Plan period was signed.

articles.title_zh: 长沙宁乡市：内陆县城何以“出海”
articles.title_en: Ningxiang: How an Inland County Town Goes Global
articles.summary_zh: 2025年宁乡对外实际投资15.08亿美元，占长沙市的59.46%、湖南省的45.89%，通过政策赋能、产业抱团，实现内陆县城“出海”转型。
articles.summary_en: Ningxiang's outbound investment reached $1.508 billion in 2025, accounting for 45.89% of Hunan's total. Through policy support and industrial clustering, the inland county transformed from exporting products to investing globally.

articles.title_zh: 中国全方位推动人工智能全球治理走深走实
articles.title_en: China Promotes Global AI Governance in Depth
articles.summary_zh: 2026世界人工智能大会在上海开幕，习近平主席发表讲话，强调以人类智慧和国际共识引领AI发展，中国全方位推动AI全球治理走深走实。
articles.summary_en: At the 2026 World AI Conference in Shanghai, President Xi Jinping stressed guiding AI with human wisdom and consensus, as China pushes forward global AI governance.

articles.title_zh: 西南医科大学通报：已对言语失当辅导员严肃批评教育
articles.title_en: Southwest Medical University Reports Serious Criticism of Counselor for Inappropriate Remarks
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，西南医科大学通报，对在年级QQ群发布教材选购不当言论的辅导员杜某予以严肃批评教育，责令其公开致歉。
articles.summary_en: On Aug. 13, Southwest Medical University issued a notice saying it had seriously criticized counselor Du for inappropriate remarks on textbook purchases and ordered him to apologize publicly.

articles.title_zh: 我国正抓紧制定新一轮空气质量持续改善行动方案
articles.title_en: China Drafts New Action Plan for Air Quality Improvement
articles.summary_zh: 生态环境部副部长徐必久在国新办发布会上表示，我国正抓紧制定第四个“大气十条”，即新一轮空气质量持续改善行动方案。
articles.summary_en: Xu Bijiu, Vice Minister of Ecology and Environment, said at a State Council Information Office press conference that China is drafting a new action plan for air quality improvement, the fourth 'Air Ten Articles'.

articles.title_zh: 张宏等3人获2026未来科学大奖
articles.title_en: Zhang Hong and Two Others Awarded 2026 Future Science Prize
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月13日，2026未来科学大奖在北京揭晓，张宏、赵东元、袁新意分获生命科学奖、物质科学奖和数学与计算机科学奖。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, 2026, the 2026 Future Science Prize was announced in Beijing, with Zhang Hong, Zhao Dongyuan, and Yuan Xinyi winning the Life Science, Material Science, and Mathematics & Computer Science awards respectively.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”开局之年各地培育壮大新兴产业观察
articles.title_en: Observation on Nurturing Emerging Industries across Regions at the Start of the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 新华社记者近日赴十多个省份调研显示，新能源、新材料、智能机器人、生物医药等新兴产业加快突破，集群成势，为经济高质量发展注入新动能。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reporters toured over a dozen provinces, finding emerging industries such as new energy, new materials, intelligent robots, and biomedicine advancing and clustering, boosting high-quality economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 国务院关于修改和废止部分行政法规的决定
articles.title_en: Decision of the State Council on Amending and Repealing Certain Administrative Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 国务院决定修改12部行政法规、废止3部行政法规，以贯彻实施生态环境法典，决定自2026年8月15日起施行。
articles.summary_en: The State Council decided to amend 12 administrative regulations and repeal 3, to implement the Ecological Environment Code, effective from August 15, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 持续加强普惠性基础性兜底性民生建设 不断增强各族群众获得感幸福感安全感
articles.title_en: Continuously Strengthen Inclusive, Basic, and Bottom-line Livelihood Programs to Enhance People's Sense of Gain, Happiness, and Security
articles.summary_zh: 自治区党委书记陈小江、自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜8月12日在自治区民政厅调研座谈，强调持续加强民生建设，提升养老服务、社会救助和社会福利水平。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Xinjiang Party Secretary Chen Xiaojiang and Chairman Erkin Tuniyaz visited the regional Department of Civil Affairs to stress enhancing inclusive, basic, and bottom-line livelihood programs, including elderly care, social assistance, and welfare services.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷：持续构建开放融合的优质产业生态 不断提升新能源汽车产业核心竞争力
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Stresses Better Industrial Ecosystem to Boost NEV Competitiveness
articles.summary_zh: 12日，省委副书记、省长刘捷在杭州调研新能源汽车企业，强调构建开放融合的优质产业生态，提升核心竞争力。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Liu Jie, Deputy Secretary of CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee and Governor, visited NEV enterprises in Hangzhou, urging an open and integrated industrial ecosystem to boost core competitiveness.

articles.title_zh: 两岸家庭丹东研学厚植爱国情怀
articles.title_en: Cross-Strait Families Study Trip in Dandong Fuels Patriotic Sentiment
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，两岸婚姻家庭亲子夏令营在辽宁丹东举行，数十个海峡两岸家庭走进抗美援朝纪念馆、登丹东舰，开展红色研学，厚植爱国情怀。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, dozens of cross-strait families joined a study tour in Dandong, visiting the Memorial to the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea and the warship Dandong, deepening patriotic feelings through immersive red education.

articles.title_zh: 检察机关依法分别对惠新安、苏发吉、韦远明、饶卫提起公诉
articles.title_en: Procuratorates File Charges Against Hui Xin'an, Su Faji, Wei Yuanming, and Rao Wei
articles.summary_zh: 近日，山东、云南、广西三省区检察机关分别对惠新安、苏发吉、韦远明、饶卫涉嫌受贿案提起公诉，四人被指控利用职务便利非法收受财物，数额特别巨大。
articles.summary_en: Recently, procuratorates in Shandong, Yunnan, and Guangxi prosecuted Hui Xin'an, Su Faji, Wei Yuanming, and Rao Wei for bribery, alleging illegal acceptance of huge assets.

articles.title_zh: 中国海军第49批护航编队起航赴亚丁湾
articles.title_en: China's 49th Naval Escort Fleet Departs for Gulf of Aden
articles.summary_zh: 中国海军第49批护航编队12日上午从海南三亚某军港起航，赴亚丁湾、索马里海域执行护航任务。
articles.summary_en: The 49th Chinese naval escort fleet departed from a military port in Sanya, Hainan on the morning of the 12th, heading to the Gulf of Aden and Somali waters for an escort mission.

articles.title_zh: 中国海军第49批护航编队起航赴亚丁湾
articles.title_en: Chinese Navy's 49th Escort Flotilla Departs for Aden Gulf
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日上午，中国海军第49批护航编队从海南三亚某军港起航，赴亚丁湾、索马里海域执行护航任务。编队由昆明舰、岳阳舰和骆马湖舰组成。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 12, the Chinese Navy's 49th escort flotilla departed from a military port in Sanya, Hainan, for escort missions in the Gulf of Aden and Somali waters. The flotilla consists of destroyer Kunming, frigate Yueyang, and supply ship Luomahu.

articles.title_zh: 国家防总、应急管理部将针对河南的防汛应急响应提升至三级
articles.title_en: National Flood Control Headquarters and Ministry of Emergency Management Raise Flood Emergency Response to Level III for Henan
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，国家防总、应急管理部将针对河南的防汛四级应急响应提升至三级，以应对强降雨。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 12, the national flood control headquarters and the Ministry of Emergency Management raised the flood emergency response for Henan from Level IV to Level III due to heavy rain.

articles.title_zh: 我国主导的生命科学领域国际学术期刊《Vita》纸质刊首期发布
articles.title_en: China's Leading International Life Sciences Journal 'Vita' Launches First Print Issue
articles.summary_zh: 今天，我国主导的生命科学领域国际学术期刊《Vita》纸质刊首期发布。该刊对标国际顶刊，将建立“以文评刊”的科学评价体系。
articles.summary_en: Today, China's leading international academic journal in life sciences, Vita, released its first print issue. The journal aims to benchmark top international journals and establish a science-based evaluation system.

articles.title_zh: 欧冶云商原董事、总裁金文海接受审查调查
articles.title_en: Jin Wenhai, Former Director and President of Ouyeel Cloud Commerce, Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 据中央纪委国家监委驻中国宝武纪检监察组消息，欧冶云商股份有限公司原董事、总裁金文海涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: According to the discipline inspection team stationed at China Baowu by the CCDI and NCS, Jin Wenhai, former director and president of Ouyeel Cloud Commerce Co., Ltd., is under investigation for suspected serious disciplinary and legal violations.

articles.title_zh: 《生态保护“十五五”规划》印发
articles.title_en: Ecological Protection "15th Five-Year Plan" Issued
articles.summary_zh: 生态环境部、自然资源部等联合印发《生态保护“十五五”规划》，构建从山顶到海洋的保护治理大格局。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment, the Ministry of Natural Resources and other departments jointly issued the "15th Five-Year Plan" for Ecological Protection, aiming to build a comprehensive protection and governance pattern from mountaintops to oceans.

articles.title_zh: 天津打造红色文化传播和育人矩阵
articles.title_en: Tianjin Builds Red Culture Dissemination and Education Matrix
articles.summary_zh: 天津统筹用好红色资源，打造全域覆盖的红色文化传播和育人矩阵，深入开展大思政课等教育活动。
articles.summary_en: Tianjin integrates red resources to build a city-wide red culture education network, promoting revolutionary traditions through exhibitions and immersive courses.

articles.title_zh: 上半年互联网业务收入同比增10.1%
articles.title_en: Internet Business Revenue Up 10.1% in First Half of Year
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部数据显示，上半年我国互联网业务收入10675亿元，同比增长10.1%，利润总额和研发经费投入均实现两位数增长。
articles.summary_en: According to MIIT data, China's internet business revenue reached 1.0675 trillion yuan in H1, up 10.1% year-on-year, with both total profit and R&D spending seeing double-digit growth.

articles.summary_en: Pakistani Senator Kakar praised the Belt and Road Initiative and the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor for bringing development opportunities to Pakistan, and looked forward to deepening bilateral cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》印发
articles.title_en: NDRC and NEA Issue 15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局近日印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》，明确到2030年现代煤炭产业体系基本建成，大型现代化煤矿产能比重提升至87%。
articles.summary_en: NDRC and NEA issue the 15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry, targeting a modern coal industry system by 2030, with large modern mines reaching 87% of capacity.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就哥伦比亚发生强烈地震向哥伦比亚总统德拉埃斯普列亚致慰问电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Condolences to Colombian President over Strong Earthquake

articles.summary_en: On August 11, President Xi Jinping sent a message of condolences to Colombian President de la Espriella over the strong earthquake, expressing deep condolences and sincere sympathy.

articles.summary_en: From August 6 to 10, a youth football team from California, US, played friendly matches in Urumqi, Xinjiang, and toured local sites, enhancing Sino-US grassroots exchanges.

articles.title_zh: 我国出口含“新”量不断攀升
articles.title_en: China's Exports Show Increasing Innovation Content
articles.summary_zh: 今年前7月我国货物贸易进出口总值超30万亿元，同比增长17.3%；7月高技术产品出口增长超五成，绿色低碳产品出口持续高速增长。
articles.summary_en: In the first seven months, China's foreign trade totaled over 30 trillion yuan, up 17.3% year on year; high-tech product exports grew over 50% in July, with green and low-carbon products continuing rapid growth.

articles.title_zh: 生产向绿，工程机械畅销海外（高质量发展微视角）
articles.title_en: Green Production Boosts Construction Machinery Exports
articles.summary_zh: 上半年我国工程机械出口金额同比增长21.7%，电动化装备助力海外矿山绿色转型，柳工等企业出口表现亮眼。
articles.summary_en: In H1, China's construction machinery exports rose 21.7% YoY. Electric equipment aids overseas mines' green transition, with LiuGong's exports performing strongly.

articles.title_zh: 把草原养好 把牛羊养精 把日子过好
articles.title_en: Nurturing Grassland, Refining Livestock, and Improving Lives
articles.summary_zh: 内蒙古锡林郭勒盟牧民乌尼巴图一家三代从“千畜户”转型为精养优质牛羊，落实草畜平衡政策，实现了生态改善与牧民增收双赢。
articles.summary_en: In Xilingol League, Inner Mongolia, herder Uribatu's family transformed from a 'thousand-head household' to refined quality livestock, implementing grass-livestock balance policy, achieving both ecological improvement and income growth.

articles.title_zh: 深学笃行习近平外交思想 奋力开创中国特色大国外交新局面
articles.title_en: Study and Practice Xi Jinping's Diplomatic Thought to Open New Prospects for Major-Country Diplomacy with Chinese Characteristics
articles.summary_zh: 王毅在《人民日报》发表署名文章，阐述深入学习《习近平外交文选》第一、二卷，强调深学笃行习近平外交思想，开创中国特色大国外交新局面。
articles.summary_en: Wang Yi published a signed article in People's Daily, elaborating on the study of Xi Jinping's diplomatic thought and calling for new achievements in major-country diplomacy.

articles.title_zh: 公安部部署开展深化扫黑除恶专项斗争
articles.title_en: Public Security Ministry Launches Deepened Crackdown on Gang Crimes
articles.summary_zh: 公安部近日指挥全国公安机关开展扫黑除恶专项斗争第一轮集中收网行动，打掉犯罪团伙1000余个，抓获犯罪嫌疑人8200余名。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Public Security recently coordinated nationwide police operations against gang crimes, dismantling over 1,000 criminal groups and arresting more than 8,200 suspects in the first round.

articles.title_zh: 牛恺主持召开市政府第十三次常务会议
articles.title_en: Niu Kai Chairs Baoji Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，市长牛恺主持召开市政府常务会议，部署深化扫黑除恶专项斗争和信访“三个专项”工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Mayor Niu Kai chaired a municipal government executive meeting to deploy intensified anti-crime campaign and petition work.

articles.title_zh: 牛恺主持召开市政府党组会议
articles.title_en: Niu Kai Chairs Baoji Municipal Government Party Group Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，宝鸡市长牛恺主持召开市政府党组会议，学习贯彻中共中央政治局会议和省委全会精神，强调稳增长、推项目、抓党建。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Baoji Mayor Niu Kai chaired a Party Group meeting of the municipal government to study the spirit of the Political Bureau meeting and the provincial Party committee plenary, emphasizing stable growth, project advancement, and Party building.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议 认真学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Yunnan Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting to Study and Implement Xi Jinping's Important Speech and Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，云南省委常委会在昆明召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记7月30日中央政治局会议关于经济形势的重要讲话精神，省委书记王宁主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, the Standing Committee of the Yunnan Provincial Party Committee met in Kunming to study and implement Xi Jinping's important speech on the economic situation delivered at the July 30 Politburo meeting. Wang Ning chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 顾刚调研重点企业发展情况
articles.title_en: Gu Gang Inspects Development of Key Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 近日，长春市市长顾刚带队调研多家重点企业，了解生产经营情况并现场解决问题，推动经济稳增长。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Changchun Mayor Gu Gang led a team to inspect key enterprises, learn about operations, and solve problems on site to boost stable economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见出席新辽经贸理事会第十一次会议的新加坡客人
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin, Wang Xinwei Meet Singapore Guests Attending 11th Singapore-Liaoning Economic & Trade Council Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见新加坡社会及家庭发展部部长马善高一行，就深化新辽经贸合作等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Xu Kunlin, Secretary of the CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee, and Wang Xinwei, Governor of Liaoning, met in Shenyang with Singapore Minister for Social and Family Development Masagos Zulkifli to discuss deepening economic and trade cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 唐毅主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议暨市委全面深化改革委员会会议
articles.title_en: Tang Yi Chairs Enlarged Meeting of CPC Chifeng Municipal Committee and Municipal Commission for Deepening Overall Reform
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，赤峰市委书记唐毅主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议暨市委全面深化改革委员会会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和重要指示批示精神，安排部署贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Tang Yi, Secretary of the CPC Chifeng Municipal Committee, chaired an enlarged meeting of the Standing Committee and the Municipal Commission for Deepening Overall Reform to convey and study Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions, and arrange implementation work.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就哥伦比亚发生强烈地震向哥伦比亚总统德拉埃斯普列亚致慰问电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Extends Condolences to Colombian President over Strong Earthquake

articles.summary_en: On August 11, President Xi Jinping sent a message of condolence to Colombian President over a strong earthquake, expressing deep condolences and sincere sympathy.

articles.title_zh: 唐毅到市防汛抗旱指挥部督导防汛减灾和应急值守工作
articles.title_en: Tang Yi Inspects Flood Control and Emergency Duty Work in Chifeng
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，赤峰市委书记唐毅以“四不两直”方式到市防汛抗旱指挥部督导防汛减灾和应急值守工作，强调压实责任、落实措施，保障人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Tang Yi, Party Secretary of Chifeng, made an unannounced visit to the Municipal Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters to inspect flood control and emergency duty work, emphasizing the need to implement measures to protect people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 我国汽车出口延续强劲增长态势
articles.title_en: China's Auto Exports Maintain Strong Growth Momentum
articles.summary_zh: 7月我国汽车出口104.3万辆，同比增长81.3%；其中新能源汽车出口55.3万辆，同比增长145.5%。出口连续两个月突破100万辆。
articles.summary_en: In July, China's auto exports reached 1.043 million units, up 81.3% YoY; NEV exports hit 553,000 units, up 145.5%. Exports exceeded one million for two consecutive months.

articles.title_zh: 市场监管总局批准发布338项重要国家标准
articles.title_en: Market Regulatory Administration Approves 338 Important National Standards
articles.summary_zh: 近日，市场监管总局批准发布338项重要国家标准，涵盖高新技术、安全生产和百姓生活等领域。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation recently approved and released 338 important national standards covering high-tech, work safety, and people's daily life.

articles.title_zh: 上半年互联网业务收入同比增10.1%
articles.title_en: Internet Business Revenue Up 10.1% in First Half of Year
articles.summary_zh: 工信部数据显示，上半年我国互联网企业业务收入10675亿元，同比增长10.1%，利润总额和研发经费投入均实现两位数增长。
articles.summary_en: According to MIIT data, China's internet business revenue reached 1.0675 trillion yuan in H1, up 10.1% year-on-year, with both profits and R&D spending growing by double digits.

articles.title_zh: 全国蔬菜供应总体形势平稳
articles.title_en: Overall Stable Vegetable Supply across China
articles.summary_zh: 全国在田蔬菜面积达1.06亿亩，各产区统筹调度、错峰上市，保障市场充足供应。受高温影响，高原和北方产区成为保供主力，价格运行稳健。
articles.summary_en: China has 106 million mu of vegetables in fields. Coordinated scheduling and staggered listings ensure sufficient supply. Highland and northern areas are key suppliers amid heat, with stable prices.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央 全国人大常委会 国务院 全国政协讣告朱镕基同志逝世
articles.title_en: Obituary: Zhu Rongji, Former Premier, Passes Away at 98
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央、全国人大常委会、国务院、全国政协沉痛宣告，国务院原总理朱镕基同志因病于2026年8月12日在北京逝世，享年98岁。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee, NPC Standing Committee, State Council and CPPCC National Committee announced with deep sorrow that Comrade Zhu Rongji, former Premier of the State Council, died of illness in Beijing on August 12, 2026, at the age of 98.

articles.title_zh: 各地各部门积极应对强降雨天气
articles.title_en: Regions and Departments Actively Respond to Heavy Rainfall
articles.summary_zh: 受“白海豚”残余环流影响，中东部出现强降雨，河南、湖北、北京等地积极应对，国家防总将河南防汛应急响应提升至三级。
articles.summary_en: Heavy rain caused by the residual circulation of Typhoon Baiting hit central and eastern China. Henan, Hubei and Beijing took active measures including rescue, drainage and evacuation; China's national flood control authority raised the emergency response for Henan to Level III.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Fushun Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Convened Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，抚顺市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示和省委书记许昆林调研讲话精神，研究部署贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, the Fushun Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee convened a meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions and Provincial Party Secretary Xu Kunlin's research speech.

articles.title_zh: 新加坡—辽宁经济贸易理事会第十一次会议在沈阳召开 王新伟马善高出席并致辞
articles.title_en: 11th Singapore-Liaoning Economic and Trade Council Meeting Held in Shenyang; Wang Xinwei and Masagos Zulkifli Attend and Address
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，新加坡—辽宁经济贸易理事会第十一次会议在沈阳召开，辽宁省省长王新伟与新加坡社会及家庭发展部部长马善高出席并致辞，现场签约6个重点项目。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, the 11th Singapore-Liaoning Economic and Trade Council meeting was held in Shenyang. Governor Wang Xinwei and Singapore's Minister for Social and Family Development Masagos Zulkifli attended and delivered speeches, with six key projects signed.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁吴贤德调研推动重点项目建设并开展护河爱水清洁家园活动
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning and Wu Xiande Inspect Major Projects and Launch River Protection Campaign
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁与市长吴贤德赴福州台江、仓山、晋安调研重点项目建设，并开展护河爱水清洁家园活动，强调推动项目提质增效。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Guo Ningning, Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Party Secretary of Fuzhou, and Mayor Wu Xiande inspected major projects in Taijiang, Cangshan, and Jin'an, and launched a river protection campaign.

articles.title_zh: 邓维元调研我市乡村振兴工作并开展巡田
articles.title_en: Deng Weiyuan Investigates Rural Revitalization Work and Conducts Field Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，鹤岗市市长邓维元赴兴安区、东山区调研乡村振兴，查看粮食仓储、人居环境、玉米示范田等，强调落实田长制，推进乡村全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Hegang Mayor Deng Weiyuan visited rural areas to inspect rural revitalization, stressing farmland protection and high-standard farmland construction.

articles.title_zh: 市领导集体参加军事日活动 王兴柱 邓维元等参加
articles.title_en: Hegang Municipal Leaders Attend Military Day Activities
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，鹤岗市领导集体参加2026年“军事日”活动，市委书记王兴柱、市长邓维元等体验军事生活，强调军地协同联动。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Hegang municipal leaders, including Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu and Mayor Deng Weiyuan, attended the 2026 Military Day activities, experiencing military training and emphasizing civil-military coordination.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研推进专精特新企业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Mayor Gu Kun Investigates High-quality Development of Specialized and Innovative Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，市长顾坤到金湖县、淮安工业园区调研专精特新企业，强调强化项目引培和科技创新，培育更多专精特新企业。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Mayor Gu Kun visited Jinhu County and Huaian Industrial Park to promote high-quality development of specialized and innovative enterprises, emphasizing talent cultivation and technological innovation.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研推进专精特新企业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Municipal Leaders Investigate Specialized and Innovative Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，市长顾坤到金湖县、淮安工业园区调研专精特新企业，强调强化项目引培和科技创新，优化产业生态，培育更多专精特新企业。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Mayor Gu Kun visited Jinhu County and Huai'an Industrial Park to inspect specialized and innovative enterprises, emphasizing stronger project recruitment and technological innovation to foster a better industrial ecosystem.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研推进群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作
articles.title_en: Shi Zhijun Inspects Work on Rectifying Unhealthy Tendencies and Corruption
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，淮安市委书记史志军到涟水县调研推进群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作，强调坚决整治、务求实效。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Shi Zhijun, Secretary of Huai'an Municipal Party Committee, visited Lianshui County to inspect the centralized rectification of unhealthy tendencies and corruption around the people, emphasizing resolute action and tangible results.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研推进群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作
articles.title_en: City Leaders Visit Lianshui to Promote Crackdown on Corruption Around the People
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，淮安市委书记史志军到涟水县调研群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作，实地察看小区、泵站、康养中心，强调要坚决整治腐败和作风问题。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Shi Zhijun, Secretary of Huai'an Municipal Party Committee, visited Lianshui County to inspect the campaign against corruption and misconduct around the people, emphasizing resolute remediation.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡在基金招商暨皖北全面振兴专项资金项目专题会上强调强化基金赋能 提速项目攻坚
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Chairs Special Meeting on Fund-Backed Investment and Northern Anhui Revitalization Projects
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日上午，淮北市委副书记、市长候选人黄韡主持召开基金招商暨皖北全面振兴专项资金项目专题会，强调强化基金赋能，提速项目攻坚。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 12, Huang Wei, deputy secretary of the Huaibei Municipal Party Committee and mayoral candidate, chaired a special meeting on fund-backed investment and special funds for comprehensive revitalization of northern Anhui, stressing stronger fund empowerment and faster project breakthroughs.

articles.title_zh: 韦朝晖调研㵲水大型灌区项目建设
articles.title_en: Wei Zhaohui Inspects Construction of Wushui Large Irrigation District Project
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日下午，怀化市委书记韦朝晖调研㵲水大型灌区项目建设，强调高质高效推进、打造民心工程，并调研文旅融合发展。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 11, Huaihua Municipal Party Secretary Wei Zhaohui inspected the Wushui Large Irrigation District project, stressing high-quality and efficient construction to build a people's project, and also inspected cultural tourism development.

articles.title_zh: 郄英才、吴之凌与国开行湖北省分行王少丹一行座谈
articles.title_en: Qie Yingcai and Wu Zhiling Hold Talks with Wang Shaodan of CDB Hubei Branch
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，黄石市委书记郄英才与国家开发银行湖北省分行党委书记王少丹座谈，双方就深化政银务实合作深入交流，市长吴之凌出席。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 11, Huangshi Party Secretary Qie Yingcai held talks with Wang Shaodan, Party Secretary of CDB Hubei Branch, on deepening government-bank cooperation. Mayor Wu Zhiling attended.

articles.summary_en: On August 10, Lhasa Party Secretary Dawa Tsering chaired an enlarged Standing Committee meeting to convey and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speech.
