articles.title_en: Futu Securities Fined 1.8 Billion Yuan: From Tencent Roots to US Ambitions
articles.summary_zh: 中国证监会对富途证券等跨境券商处以罚款，其中富途被罚18.5亿元，以整治跨境证券业务和资本外流。
articles.summary_en: China's securities regulator fined Futu Securities and other cross-border brokers, with Futu penalized 1.85 billion yuan, in a crackdown on cross-border securities business and capital outflows.

articles.title_zh: 中国汽车出口，连续两个月破百万辆
articles.title_en: China's Auto Exports Surpass One Million Units for Two Consecutive Months
articles.summary_zh: 中国汽车工业协会8月12日发布数据显示，7月新能源汽车销量占比首超60%，汽车出口连续两月破百万辆。
articles.summary_en: Data from the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers on August 12 showed NEV sales exceeded 60% of monthly new car sales in July, with exports topping one million units for two straight months.

articles.title_zh: 游客自驾遭奔驰堵路后冲突受伤，警方通报：行拘2人
articles.title_en: Tourist Injured in Conflict After Mercedes Blocks Road; Police Detain 2
articles.summary_zh: 警方通报，游客自驾途中遭奔驰车堵路引发冲突受伤，两名涉事人员被行政拘留。
articles.summary_en: Police reported that a tourist was injured in a conflict after a Mercedes blocked the road, and two people were administratively detained.

articles.title_zh: 男子直播淫秽内容获利0.1元被判刑
articles.title_en: Man Sentenced for Livestreaming Pornography, Earning Only 0.1 Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 男子江某深夜直播淫秽视频获利0.1元，被寿县人民法院以传播淫秽物品牟利罪判处拘役4个月，缓刑6个月，并处罚金2000元。
articles.summary_en: Jiang was sentenced to 4 months' detention (suspended for 6 months) and fined 2,000 yuan for livestreaming pornographic content, netting only 0.1 yuan.

articles.title_zh: 醉酒后智驾系统“代驾”？广东法院判了：构成危险驾驶罪
articles.title_en: Drunk Driver Using Driver-Assist Function Sentenced for Dangerous Driving in Guangdong
articles.summary_zh: 广东深圳宝安区法院审结一起危险驾驶案，郭某醉酒后开启智能驾驶辅助系统上路，被判处拘役二个月并处罚金6000元。
articles.summary_en: The Bao'an District Court in Shenzhen, Guangdong concluded a dangerous driving case, sentencing Guo, who drove with driver-assist activated while intoxicated, to two months' detention and a 6,000 yuan fine.

tags.name_zh: 深圳市宝安区人民法院

tags_zh: 深圳市宝安区人民法院

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁吴贤德调研推动重点项目建设并开展“护河爱水、清洁家园”活动
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning and Wu Xiande Inspect Key Projects and Launch River Protection Campaign
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，福建省委副书记、福州市委书记郭宁宁和市长吴贤德赴台江、仓山、晋安调研重点项目建设，并开展“护河爱水、清洁家园”活动。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Guo Ningning, deputy secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee and Fuzhou Party chief, and Mayor Wu Xiande inspected key projects and launched a river protection campaign in Fuzhou.

articles.title_zh: 福州公开征集十类黑恶犯罪线索
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Police Solicit Tips on Ten Types of Gang-Related Crimes
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，福州市公安局发布公告，即日起至2027年7月向社会公开征集十类涉黑涉恶违法犯罪线索。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Fuzhou Public Security Bureau issued a notice soliciting tips on ten types of gang-related crimes from the public until July 2027.

articles.title_zh: 省政府党组会议和省政府常务会议召开
articles.title_en: Fujian Provincial Government Holds Party Group and Executive Meetings
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，福建省省长赵龙主持召开省政府党组会议和常务会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，部署下半年经济、安全生产、科技创新等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Zhao Long, Governor of Fujian, chaired the provincial government party group and executive meetings to convey Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions, and to arrange work on economy, work safety, and innovation.

articles.title_zh: 职工AI创作成果有奖征集活动启动
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Launches AI Creation Contest for Workers
articles.summary_zh: 8月，福州市职工产业互联网工匠学院启动全市职工AI创作成果有奖征集活动，面向掌握AI技能的职工征集短视频和智能体作品，截至本月20日。
articles.summary_en: In August, Fuzhou Workers' Industrial Internet Craft Academy launched an AI creation contest for local workers, calling for AI videos and AI agent works by the 20th.

articles.title_zh: 福州二手燃油豪车价格一个多月跌近3万元
articles.title_en: "Nearly 30,000 Yuan Drop in a Month": Used Luxury Fuel Car Prices in Fuzhou Plunge
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，福州二手车市场二手燃油豪车价格两个月内普遍下跌20%，宝马、保时捷等车型降价明显，新能源渗透率上升及新车降价是主要原因。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, prices of used luxury fuel cars in Fuzhou fell about 20% in two months, with BMW and Porsche models declining sharply due to new car price cuts and rising EV penetration.

articles.title_zh: 织就更密更暖的社会保障安全网
articles.title_en: Weaving a Denser and Warmer Social Security Safety Net
articles.summary_zh: 面对“十五五”新挑战，我国持续深化社会保障制度改革，新就业形态人员职业伤害保障试点全面推开，首部社会救助法出台，长期护理保险制度进入全面推行阶段。
articles.summary_en: Facing new challenges in the 15th Five-Year Plan period, China is deepening social security reforms, expanding pilot occupational injury insurance for new employment forms, issuing the first social assistance law, and rolling out long-term care insurance nationwide.

articles.title_zh: 中共青岛市委十三届十次全体会议举行
articles.title_en: CPC Qingdao Municipal Committee Holds 10th Plenary Session
articles.summary_zh: 中共青岛市委十三届十次全会8月12日举行，市委书记曾赞荣作讲话，全会审议通过给予潘峰开除党籍的处分。
articles.summary_en: The 10th plenary session of the 13th CPC Qingdao Municipal Committee was held on August 12, 2026. Zeng Zanrong, municipal party secretary, delivered a speech. The session approved the expulsion of Pan Feng from the Party.

articles.title_zh: 厦门市委常委会召开会议研究贯彻意见
articles.title_en: Xiamen Municipal Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，厦门市委书记林涛主持召开市委常委会会议，学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话指示精神，研究贯彻意见，并审议教育规划等事项。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Xiamen Municipal Party Committee Secretary Lin Tao chaired a Standing Committee meeting to study Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions, discuss implementation opinions, and review the education plan.

articles.title_zh: 织就更密更暖的社会保障安全网
articles.title_en: Weaving a Denser and Warmer Social Security Safety Net
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记强调织密社会保障安全网。我国持续深化社保改革，新就业形态职业伤害保障试点全国推开，首部社会救助法出台，长护险制度全面推行。
articles.summary_en: China expands occupational injury protection to new employment forms, enacts its first social assistance law, and rolls out long-term care insurance nationwide, after Xi Jinping's call for a dense social security net.

articles.title_zh: 最高法发布7件特许经营典型案例 明确被特许人享有“冷静期”单方解除权
articles.title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases 7 Typical Franchise Cases Clarifying Franchisees' Cooling-off Rescission Right
articles.summary_zh: 今天，最高人民法院发布7件特许经营典型案例，明确被特许人享有“冷静期”单方解除权，规范特许经营市场。
articles.summary_en: Today, the Supreme People's Court released seven typical franchise cases, clarifying franchisees' unilateral rescission right during the cooling-off period.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷在杭州专题调研新能源汽车企业发展情况时强调 持续构建开放融合的优质产业生态 不断提升新能源汽车产业核心竞争力
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Emphasizes Building Open and Integrated Industrial Ecosystem for NEV Industry During Hangzhou Research Tour
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，浙江省委副书记、省长刘捷在杭州调研新能源汽车企业，强调构建开放融合的产业生态，提升核心竞争力。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Liu Jie, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee and Governor of Zhejiang, visited new energy vehicle companies in Hangzhou, emphasizing the need to build an open and integrated industrial ecosystem and enhance core competitiveness.

articles.title_zh: 马斯克：强烈推荐大家去中国看看
articles.title_en: Musk: Strongly Recommends People Visit China
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，特斯拉CEO马斯克在社交媒体发文称赞中国，强烈推荐大家去看看，其母亲梅耶·马斯克也发文赞同，国际民众对中国好感度上升。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 11, Tesla CEO Elon Musk praised China on social media and strongly recommended visiting. His mother Maye Musk agreed, citing cities' charm and safety.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛会见哈电集团董事长黄伟
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao Meets with Huang Wei, Chairman of Harbin Electric Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，江苏省省长刘小涛会见哈电集团董事长黄伟，并共同见证镇江市与哈电集团签署战略合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao met with Huang Wei, Chairman of Harbin Electric Group, and witnessed the signing of a strategic cooperation agreement between Zhenjiang and Harbin Electric Group.

articles.title_zh: 平陆运河实船试验正式启动，工程进度超98%
articles.title_en: Pinglu Canal Full-scale Ship Trial Officially Launched, Project Progress Exceeds 98%
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，平陆运河实船试验正式启动，首次进行全航道、全船型试验，工程整体进度已超98%，预计9月正式通航。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the full-scale ship trial of the Pinglu Canal was officially launched, marking the first all-channel, all-vessel-type test. The project progress has exceeded 98%, with official navigation expected in September.

articles.title_zh: 避免“新官不理旧账”，衡阳市探索党政正职离任交接工作新机制
articles.title_en: Hengyang Explores New Mechanism for Handover of Party and Government Officials
articles.summary_zh: 衡阳市探索党政正职离任交接新机制，通过标准化清单、交心谈话和联合监督，确保交接规范有序，避免“新官不理旧账”。
articles.summary_en: Hengyang explores a new mechanism for handover between outgoing and incoming Party and government officials, using standardized checklists, heart-to-heart talks, and joint supervision to ensure orderly transitions.

tags.name_en: Management of Party and Government Officials

tags_en: Management of Party and Government Officials

articles.title_zh: 旅游客运车辆扎堆列队占道、低速压车，乌鲁木齐呼吁规范驾驶
articles.title_en: Tourist Buses Lining Up and Occupying Lanes, Urumqi Calls for Standardized Driving
articles.summary_zh: 正值文旅出行旺季，乌鲁木齐针对旅游客运车辆在高速公路列队占道、低速压车等危险驾驶行为发出倡议，呼吁企业和驾驶员规范驾驶、落实安全责任。
articles.summary_en: During the peak tourism season, Urumqi issued an initiative against dangerous driving behaviors such as tourist buses lining up and occupying lanes, calling on companies and drivers to drive safely and fulfill safety responsibilities.

articles.title_zh: 尹力调度部署防汛防台风工作 强调抓实抓细各项防御措施
articles.title_en: Yin Li Directs Flood and Typhoon Prevention Efforts, Stresses Detailed Defense Measures
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日上午，北京市委书记尹力调度部署防汛防台风工作，强调抓实抓细各项防御措施，确保人民群众生命财产安全。市长殷勇一同调度。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 11, Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li deployed flood and typhoon prevention work, stressing detailed defensive measures to protect people's lives and property. Mayor Yin Yong attended.

articles.title_zh: 周祖翼在福州调研社会工作
articles.title_en: Zhou Zuyi Inspects Social Work in Fuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，福建省委书记周祖翼赴福州调研社会工作，强调以党建引领基层治理，推动社会工作高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Zhou Zuyi, Secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee, visited Fuzhou to inspect social work, stressing party leadership in community governance.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省出台失业保险稳岗扩岗新政
articles.title_en: Gansu Issues New Policies for Unemployment Insurance Stability and Expansion
articles.summary_zh: 近日，甘肃省人社厅等四部门联合印发通知，2026年全年推行稳岗返还、一次性扩岗补助等政策，优化技能提升补贴，并夯实失业人员生活保障，以稳就业惠企利民。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Gansu's Human Resources and Social Security Department and three other departments jointly issued a notice to implement stable job return and one-time expansion subsidies for 2026, optimize skill upgrade subsidies, and strengthen unemployment insurance benefits to stabilize employment.

tags.name_en: Gansu Provincial Human Resources and Social Security Department

tags_en: Gansu Provincial Human Resources and Social Security Department

articles.title_zh: 平陆运河实船试验正式启动
articles.title_en: Pinglu Canal Real-ship Test Officially Launched
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，平陆运河实船试验正式启动，将分阶段完成通航验证与航标效能检测，为2026年9月如期通航奠定基础。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the real-ship test of the Pinglu Canal was officially launched to verify navigation and beacon effectiveness in stages, laying a solid foundation for the canal to open to navigation in September 2026.

articles.title_zh: 湖北出台指导意见规范民间河湖长工作
articles.title_en: Hubei Issues Guidance to Regulate Civil River and Lake Chiefs
articles.summary_zh: 湖北省河湖长制办公室联合省委社工部等部门印发《指导意见》，规范民间河湖长选育、履职、管理、保障全链条体系，推动河湖管护提质增效。
articles.summary_en: Hubei's River and Lake Chief Office, together with provincial social work departments, issued guidelines to standardize the selection, performance, management, and support of civil river and lake chiefs, improving water management.

articles.title_zh: 雄安人工智能实训基地正式投运
articles.title_en: Xiong'an AI Training Base Officially Put into Operation
articles.summary_zh: 河北雄安新区人工智能实训基地正式投运，并举办首届人工智能实训班开班仪式，将服务北京非首都功能疏解和新区人工智能产业发展。
articles.summary_en: The AI training base in Xiong'an New Area, Hebei, officially started operation with the first training class, supporting the relocation of non-capital functions and AI industry development.

articles.title_zh: 办好民生实事，提升幸福成色
articles.title_en: Handle People's Livelihood Matters Well to Boost Happiness
articles.summary_zh: 河北省今年加大民生保障力度，财政民生支出占比超80%，推进20项民生工程，在就业、养老、托育等方面提升群众幸福感。
articles.summary_en: Hebei Province has intensified livelihood security this year, with fiscal spending on people's livelihood exceeding 80% and 20 livelihood projects advancing, improving residents' well-being in employment, elderly care, and childcare.

articles.title_zh: 坚持向海图强 打造深海科技创新策源地和产业聚集高地
articles.title_en: Feng Fei Inspects Sanya, Vows to Build Deep-Sea Tech Innovation Hub
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，海南省委书记冯飞在三亚调研，强调坚持向海图强，打造深海科技创新策源地和产业聚集高地，并听取学习教育和经济社会发展汇报。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Hainan Provincial Party Secretary Feng Fei inspected Sanya, stressing building a deep-sea tech innovation source and industrial highland, and heard reports on study education and economic development.

articles.title_zh: 正式开工！储能技术（海南）共享实验室落地海口国家高新区
articles.title_en: Construction Officially Starts for Energy Storage Technology (Hainan) Shared Laboratory in Haikou National High-tech Zone
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，储能技术（海南）共享实验室装修工程开工仪式在海口国家高新区举行，标志着这一面向海南全省储能产业的公共技术服务平台进入实质性建设阶段。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, the renovation commencement ceremony for the Energy Storage Technology (Hainan) Shared Laboratory was held in Haikou National High-tech Zone, marking the platform's substantive construction phase.

articles.title_zh: 许勤梁惠玲会见中国石油天然气集团党组书记、董事长戴厚良
articles.title_en: Xu Qin and Liang Huiling Meet with CNPC Chairman Dai Houliang
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，黑龙江省委书记许勤、省长梁惠玲在哈尔滨会见中国石油天然气集团党组书记、董事长戴厚良一行，双方就深化战略合作、保障能源安全等交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, and Liang Huiling, Governor, met with Dai Houliang, Party Secretary and Chairman of CNPC, in Harbin to discuss strategic cooperation and energy security.

articles.title_zh: 党建引领幸福来 老旧社区焕新颜
articles.title_en: Party Building Leads to Happiness, Old Community Gets New Look
articles.summary_zh: 人民网党建调研行近日深入湖南长沙、岳阳等地，报道咸嘉新村社区以党建引领基层治理，通过民情联络室、红色物业等举措提升治理效能。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily Online's Party Building research trip visited Changsha and Yueyang in Hunan, highlighting Xianjia Xincun community's party-led governance through people's liaison offices and red property management.

articles.title_zh: 江苏“人工智能+”培训全面开花 每年计划培训超20万人次
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Launches Comprehensive "AI+" Training, Aiming Over 200,000 Trainees Annually
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省全面开展“人工智能+”技术技能专项培训行动，计划每年培训超20万人次，以补齐群众AI技能短板、打通就业堵点。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu has launched a comprehensive "AI+" technical skills training initiative, aiming to train over 200,000 people annually to address AI skill gaps and employment bottlenecks.

articles.title_zh: 8月11日太湖水位持续上涨 江苏启动防汛三级应急响应
articles.title_en: Taihu Lake Water Level Rises, Jiangsu Activates Level III Emergency Response
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，太湖受台风影响水位持续上涨，达警戒水位并编号为2026年第1号洪水，江苏省启动防汛三级应急响应，调度水利工程排水。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Taihu Lake water level kept rising above warning level due to typhoon, prompting Jiangsu to activate a Level III flood-control emergency response and dispatch water conservancy projects for drainage.

tags.name_en: Jiangsu Provincial Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters

articles.title_zh: 江西省政府召开第137次常务会议
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Provincial Government Holds 137th Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，江西省省长叶建春主持召开第137次省政府常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和指示精神，审议通过2025年度江西省科学技术奖拟授奖名单。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Jiangxi Governor Ye Jianchun chaired the 137th executive meeting of the provincial government, which deliberated and approved the proposed list of 2025 Jiangxi Science and Technology Awards.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中会见非洲国家驻华使节
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong Meets African Ambassadors to China
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中在呼和浩特会见出席“2026非洲国家驻华大使巡讲·内蒙古”活动的多国驻华使节。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Wang Weizhong, Party Secretary of Inner Mongolia, met in Hohhot with ambassadors from Mauritania, Malawi, Kenya, Mozambique, Nigeria and other countries attending the 2026 Africa Ambassadors' Tour in Inner Mongolia.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古能源集团新一代煤电示范项目开工
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Energy Group Starts Construction of New-Generation Coal Power Demonstration Project
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，总投资25.44亿元的内蒙古能源集团包头喜桂图二期新一代煤电示范项目在包头市石拐区开工，建成后将提升蒙西电网调峰能力，年节约标准煤约15万吨。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, the Inner Mongolia Energy Group's Xigui Phase II new-generation coal power demonstration project with a total investment of 2.544 billion yuan started construction in Shiguai District, Baotou. It will enhance peak regulation and save about 150,000 tons of standard coal annually.

articles.title_zh: 美国俄勒冈州艺术体操代表团到内蒙古交流访问
articles.title_en: Oregon Rhythmic Gymnastics Delegation Visits Inner Mongolia for Exchange

articles.summary_en: Today, the Cybersecurity Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security released 10 typical cases of crimes infringing on personal information, with numerous suspects in various regions subjected to criminal coercive measures or prosecuted.

articles.title_en: China Builds 578 National Chronic Disease Prevention Demonstration Zones
articles.summary_zh: 截至8月10日，我国已建成国家慢性病综合防控示范区578个，计划到2035年总数达820个，促进居民健康。
articles.summary_en: As of August 10, China has built 578 national demonstration zones for comprehensive chronic disease prevention and control, with a plan to reach 820 by 2035 to improve public health.

articles.title_zh: 从1.45万亿斤看粮食安全如何保障
articles.title_en: How to Ensure Food Security: Target of 1.45 Trillion Jin
articles.summary_zh: 《加快农业农村现代化“十五五”规划》提出粮食综合生产能力到2030年提升至1.45万亿斤左右，专家解读目标既稳又进。
articles.summary_en: The 15th Five-Year Plan for Agricultural and Rural Modernization sets a binding target to raise comprehensive grain production capacity to about 1.45 trillion jin by 2030, with experts saying the goal balances stability and progress.

articles.title_zh: 深化扫黑除恶专项斗争第一轮集中收网
articles.title_en: First Round of Concentrated Enforcement in Deepening Special Campaign Against Gang Crimes
articles.summary_zh: 公安部近日指挥全国公安机关开展深化扫黑除恶专项斗争第一轮集中收网行动，打掉犯罪团伙1000余个，抓获犯罪嫌疑人8200余名。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Public Security recently directed nationwide police in the first round of a concentrated operation against gang crimes, dismantling over 1,000 criminal gangs and arresting more than 8,200 suspects.

articles.title_zh: 融合发展，老区文旅更红火
articles.title_en: Integrated Development Fuels Tourism Boom in Old Revolutionary Base Areas
articles.summary_zh: 江西瑞金、重庆綦江、甘肃会宁等地依托红色旅游资源，通过沉浸式演艺、红色旅游路线、研学活动等推动文旅融合，助力老区发展。
articles.summary_en: Ruijin in Jiangxi, Qijiang in Chongqing and Huining in Gansu leverage red tourism resources through immersive performances, red tourism routes and study tours to promote cultural-tourism integration and boost development of old revolutionary areas.

articles.title_zh: 上半年全国社会物流总额为181.1万亿元
articles.title_en: China's total social logistics value reaches 181.1 trillion yuan in H1
articles.summary_zh: 中国物流与采购联合会公布数据显示，上半年全国社会物流总额为181.1万亿元，同比增长5.1%，高端制造、绿色低碳等新动能增势良好。
articles.summary_en: China Federation of Logistics & Purchasing data shows social logistics totaled 181.1 trillion yuan in H1, up 5.1% YoY, with strong growth in high-end manufacturing and green low-carbon sectors.

articles.title_zh: “每日读画”三百期座谈会在京举办
articles.title_en: Symposium on 300th Episode of 'Daily Painting Reading' Held in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，“每日读画”300期座谈会在人民日报社举办，人民日报社总编辑陈建文等出席并讲话，研讨推动栏目高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 10, a symposium on the 300th episode of 'Daily Painting Reading' was held at People's Daily, attended by Editor-in-Chief Chen Jianwen, to discuss improving the column.

articles.title_zh: 浙江扎实推进共同富裕示范区建设
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Advances Demonstration Zone for Common Prosperity
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省扎实推进共同富裕示范区建设，通过产业升级、山海协作、扩中提低等举措，缩小城乡、地区、收入差距，取得显著成效。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang is advancing its demonstration zone for common prosperity, narrowing urban-rural, regional, and income gaps through industrial upgrading, mountain-sea cooperation, and wealth redistribution.

articles.title_zh: 南水北调东中线一期工程调水量超900亿立方米
articles.title_en: South-North Water Diversion Project's Eastern and Central Routes Exceed 90 Billion Cubic Meters in Total Water Transferred
articles.summary_zh: 截至8月10日，南水北调东中线一期工程累计调水量超900亿立方米，中线超800.5亿立方米，东线超99.5亿立方米，为沿线1.95亿人提供稳定优质水源。
articles.summary_en: As of August 10, the eastern and central routes of the South-to-North Water Diversion Project have transferred over 90 billion cubic meters of water, with the central route exceeding 80.05 billion and the eastern route over 9.95 billion, providing stable quality water supply to 195 million people.

articles.title_zh: 上半年完成交通固定资产投资1.5万亿元
articles.title_en: Transport Fixed-Asset Investment Reaches 1.5 Trillion Yuan in H1
articles.summary_zh: 今年上半年，我国交通固定资产投资完成1.5万亿元，其中公路、水运分别完成1.0万亿元和1099亿元。货运量、港口吞吐量、人员流动量均保持增长。
articles.summary_en: In H1, China's transport fixed-asset investment hit 1.5 trillion yuan, with highways 1.0 trillion and waterways 109.9 billion. Freight volume, port throughput, and passenger flows all grew.

articles.title_zh: 不断创造高质量发展新业绩（树立和践行正确政绩观）
articles.title_en: Continuously Create New Achievements in High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 各地深入开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，以新发展理念校准政绩观，推动高质量发展，并列举多地在生态治理、区域协作、安全生产等方面的整改成效。
articles.summary_en: Localities are deepening education on a correct view of political achievements, using new development concepts to drive high-quality growth, with cases in ecology, regional coordination, and safety.

articles.title_zh: 加快构建城乡融合发展新格局
articles.title_en: Accelerating the Construction of a New Pattern of Urban-Rural Integrated Development
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记指出要构建新型城乡关系，各地因地制宜推进城乡融合发展，加快构建城乡融合新格局。
articles.summary_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping emphasized building a new type of urban-rural relationship. Regions across China are taking local approaches to advance integrated urban-rural development and accelerate the formation of a new pattern.

articles.title_zh: 中共安康市委五届十一次全会召开
articles.title_en: CPC Ankang Municipal Committee Holds 11th Plenary Session
articles.summary_zh: 中共安康市委五届十一次全会召开，深入学习贯彻党的二十大和二十届历次全会精神，总结部署全市工作。
articles.summary_en: The 11th plenary session of the 5th CPC Ankang Municipal Committee was held to study and implement the spirit of the 20th CPC National Congress and previous plenary sessions, summarizing and deploying city-wide work.

tags.name_en: Studying and Implementing the Spirit of the 20th CPC National Congress

tags_en: Studying and Implementing the Spirit of the 20th CPC National Congress

articles.title_zh: 马子兴调研矿业高质量发展工作
articles.title_en: Ma Zixing Investigates High-Quality Mining Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，腾冲市委书记马子兴带队调研矿业高质量发展，深入矿山企业检查安全生产和生态环保，强调推动产业绿色安全转型。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Ma Zixing, Party secretary of Tengchong, led a survey on high-quality mining development, visiting mines to inspect safety and environmental protection, urging green and secure industrial transformation.

articles.title_zh: 吕志成在于洪区调研时强调 强化项目牵引 壮大产业集群
articles.title_en: Lyu Zhicheng Inspects Key Projects in Yuhong District, Stresses Industrial Cluster Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，沈阳市市长吕志成到于洪区调研重点项目建设，强调强化项目牵引、壮大产业集群，为区域经济高质量发展蓄势赋能。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Lyu Zhicheng, Mayor of Shenyang, inspected key projects in Yuhong District, emphasizing strengthening project support and industrial clusters for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 各地抢抓农时做好田间管理
articles.title_en: All Regions Seize Farming Season for Field Management
articles.summary_zh: 近期，东北、河北、陕西、四川等地抢抓农时，通过智能监测、飞防作业、跨区农机调配等措施做好田间管理，夯实粮食丰收基础。
articles.summary_en: Recently, regions including Northeast China, Hebei, Shaanxi, and Sichuan have been seizing the farming season to strengthen field management through smart monitoring, drone spraying, and cross-regional machinery dispatch, solidifying the foundation for a bumper grain harvest.

articles.title_zh: 多部门联合印发《生态保护“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: Multiple Departments Jointly Issue '15th Five-Year Plan for Ecological Protection'
articles.summary_zh: 生态环境部、自然资源部等部门联合印发《生态保护“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年生态质量改善、生物多样性丧失趋势缓解等目标。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment and other departments jointly issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Ecological Protection', setting targets for improved ecological quality and mitigated biodiversity loss by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就哥伦比亚发生强烈地震向哥伦比亚总统致慰问电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Condolences to Colombian President over Strong Earthquake
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，国家主席习近平就哥伦比亚发生强烈地震向哥伦比亚总统德拉埃斯普列亚致慰问电，表达深切哀悼和诚挚慰问。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, President Xi Jinping sent a condolence message to Colombian President de la Espriella over the strong earthquake, expressing deep mourning and sincere sympathy.

articles.title_zh: 国务院办公厅关于重点林区“十五五”期间森林年采伐限额的复函
articles.title_en: State Council Approves Forest Harvest Quotas for Key Forest Areas for 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 国务院办公厅复函，原则同意国家林草局编制的重点林区“十五五”期间森林年采伐限额，要求严格执行、不得突破，并加强监督管理，推动森林可持续经营。
articles.summary_en: The State Council General Office approved the forest harvest quotas for key forest areas for the 15th Five-Year Plan period, requiring strict enforcement and sustainable forest management.

articles.title_zh: 汪尚学主持召开五届市委审计委员会第十一次会议
articles.title_en: Wang Shangxue Chairs 11th Meeting of Municipal Party Committee Audit Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，定西市委书记汪尚学主持召开五届市委审计委员会第十一次会议，强调以高质量审计监督护航经济社会高质量追赶发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Wang Shangxue, Secretary of the Dingxi Municipal Party Committee, chaired the 11th meeting of the Municipal Party Committee Audit Committee, emphasizing high-quality audit supervision to support high-quality economic and social development.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林在抚顺市检查督导灾后重建工作
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Inspects Post-Disaster Reconstruction in Fushun
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，省委书记许昆林到抚顺市检查督导灾后重建工作，实地察看受灾情况，强调加快重建、保障群众生活。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Party Secretary Xu Kunlin inspected post-disaster reconstruction in Fushun, emphasizing swift rebuilding and safeguarding residents' livelihoods.

articles.title_zh: 高键主持召开灾后重建工作推进会
articles.title_en: Gao Jian Chairs Post-disaster Reconstruction Work Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，市委书记高键在顺城区前甸镇台山村主持召开现场会，传达省委书记许昆林指示精神，部署全市灾后重建和防汛减灾工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Fushun Municipal Party Secretary Gao Jian chaired an on-site meeting at Taishan Village to convey the instructions of Provincial Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and deploy post-disaster reconstruction and flood prevention work.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林在抚顺市检查督导灾后重建工作
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Inspects Post-Disaster Reconstruction in Fushun
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，辽宁省委书记许昆林到抚顺市检查督导灾后重建工作，强调要保障群众基本生活，加快重建进度，确保群众温暖过冬。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Liaoning Provincial Party Secretary Xu Kunlin visited Fushun to inspect and supervise post-disaster reconstruction, emphasizing the need to ensure residents' basic livelihood and accelerate rebuilding.

articles.title_zh: 邓维元主持召开市政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Deng Weiyuan Chairs Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，鹤岗市市长邓维元主持召开市政府常务会议，学习文物保护法，研究部署高质量转型发展重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Deng Weiyuan, mayor of Hegang, chaired a municipal government executive meeting to study the cultural relics protection law and deploy key tasks for high-quality transformation.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调度推进“六张网”规划建设
articles.title_en: Mayor Gu Kun Directs Planning of 'Six Networks' Infrastructure
articles.summary_zh: 近日，淮安市市长顾坤赴多区调研“六张网”建设并召开推进会，强调加快构建现代化基础设施体系，推动高质量发展和民生改善。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Gu Kun, Mayor of Huai'an, visited districts to inspect the 'Six Networks' construction and chaired a promotion meeting, calling for faster development of modern infrastructure to boost quality growth and people's well-being.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研淮阴区经济运行和淮安高新区改革发展工作
articles.title_en: Municipal Leaders Visit Huaiyin District to Review Economic Performance and Huai'an High-Tech Zone Reform
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，市委书记史志军调研淮阴区经济运行和淮安高新区改革发展工作，强调贯彻习近平总书记对江苏工作重要讲话精神，推动经济稳中有进。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Shi Zhijun, Secretary of the Huai'an Municipal Party Committee, visited Huaiyin District to inspect economic performance and the reform of Huai'an High-Tech Zone, stressing implementation of Xi Jinping's important remarks on Jiangsu's work.

articles.title_zh: 史志军调研淮阴区经济运行和淮安高新区改革发展工作
articles.title_en: Shi Zhijun Inspects Economic Operation and Reform & Development in Huaiyin District and Huai'an High-tech Zone
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，淮安市委书记史志军调研淮阴区经济运行和淮安高新区改革发展，强调要稳中求进，强化工业支撑，深化改革创新。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Shi Zhijun, Secretary of Huai'an Municipal Party Committee, visited Huaiyin District to inspect economic operation and reform & development of Huai'an High-tech Zone, emphasizing steady progress, industrial support and reform innovation.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市人民政府 市领导调度推进“六张网”规划建设
articles.title_en: Mayor Gu Kun Promotes 'Six Networks' Planning in Huai'an
articles.summary_zh: 近日，市长顾坤先后到淮阴区、淮安区、清江浦区、淮安经开区调研“六张网”建设并召开推进会，强调抢抓政策机遇，加快构建现代化基础设施体系。
articles.summary_en: Mayor Gu Kun recently visited Huaiyin, Huai'an, Qingjiangpu and Huai'an Economic Development Zone to inspect the 'Six Networks' construction and held a promotion meeting, emphasizing seizing policy opportunities to accelerate modern infrastructure.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦黄韡看望慰问老干部
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi and Huang Wei Visit and Extend Greetings to Retired Cadres
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日上午，淮北市委书记蒋曦、市长候选人黄韡看望慰问王邦杰等市级老干部，致以问候并感谢贡献。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 11, Huaibei Party Secretary Jiang Xi and mayoral candidate Huang Wei visited retired municipal cadres, expressing greetings and gratitude for their contributions.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦黄韡看望慰问老干部致以诚挚问候 听取意见建议
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi and Huang Wei Visit Retired Cadres with Sincere Greetings and Seek Opinions
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日上午，淮北市委书记蒋曦和市长候选人黄韡看望慰问老干部，听取意见建议，感谢他们为淮北发展作出的贡献。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 11, Huaibei Party Secretary Jiang Xi and mayoral candidate Huang Wei visited retired cadres, expressed gratitude for their contributions, and sought their opinions.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡会见皖能集团客人
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Meets with Wenergy Group Officials
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日上午，淮北市委副书记、市长候选人黄韡会见皖能集团副总经理徐文宫一行，双方就新能源产业和绿色转型等合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 11, Huang Wei, deputy secretary of the Huaibei Municipal Party Committee and mayoral candidate, met with Xu Wengong, deputy general manager of Wenergy Group, to discuss cooperation in new energy and green transformation.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Standing Committee of Huainan Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日上午，淮南市委常委会召开会议，传达学习中央和省委有关会议精神，研究贯彻落实意见，市委书记朱艾勇主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 10, the Standing Committee of the Huainan Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study the spirit of the central and provincial meetings and discuss implementation measures. Party Secretary Zhu Aiyong presided over and addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 济南市印发《推进服务业扩能提质行动方案（2026—2030年）》
articles.title_en: Jinan Issues Action Plan to Expand and Upgrade Service Industry (2026-2030)
articles.summary_zh: 济南市人民政府印发《推进服务业扩能提质行动方案（2026—2030年）》，提出到2030年服务业增加值力争达1.2万亿元以上，并明确金融、交通、教育等领域发展目标。
articles.summary_en: Jinan municipal government issued an action plan to expand and upgrade its service industry from 2026 to 2030, aiming for added value exceeding 1.2 trillion yuan by 2030, with specific targets for finance, transport, education and other sectors.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰主持召开市政府党组会议和常务会议
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Chairs Municipal Government Party Group Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10日上午，揭阳市市长曲晓杰主持召开市政府党组会议和常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，部署全面从严治党及下半年经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 10, Qu Xiaojie, Mayor of Jieyang, chaired the municipal government party group meeting and executive meeting to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and deploy work on strict party governance and economic development.

articles.title_zh: 王君正主持召开自治区党委常委会会议 认真传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Chairs CPC Tibet Regional Committee Meeting to Study Xi's Recent Important Speeches
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正主持召开自治区党委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，研究贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the CPC Tibet Regional Committee, chaired a Standing Committee meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and discuss implementation.

articles.title_zh: 国务院办公厅关于重点林区“十五五”期间森林年采伐限额的复函
articles.title_en: Reply of the General Office of the State Council on the Annual Forest Harvest Quota for Key Forest Areas during the 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 国务院办公厅复函同意国家林草局编制的重点林区“十五五”期间森林年采伐限额，要求严格执行、不得突破，并加强管理推进生态保护。
articles.summary_en: The State Council approved the forest harvest quota for key forest areas (2026-2030), requiring strict enforcement and enhanced forest management for ecological protection.

tags_en: General Office of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 王君正主持召开自治区党委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Chairs Standing Committee Meeting of Regional Party Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正主持召开党委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，研究部署贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Wang Junzheng, Party Secretary of Tibet Autonomous Region, presided over a Standing Committee meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and deploy implementation.

articles.title_zh: 李晖调度防汛防台风工作
articles.title_en: Li Hui Directs Flood and Typhoon Prevention Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，泰州市领导李晖调度防汛防台风工作，要求落实防御措施，保障人民群众安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Li Hui directed flood and typhoon prevention work in Taizhou, urging thorough implementation of defensive measures to protect public safety.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬检查防汛防台风工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Inspects Flood Prevention and Typhoon Defense Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬到医药高新区（高港区）检查防汛防台风工作，察看排涝设施和危化品企业，并召开防御台风'白海豚'工作会议，要求压实责任、排查隐患，保障群众安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Jiang Dongdong, Secretary of the Taizhou Municipal Party Committee, inspected flood and typhoon prevention work in the Medical High-tech Zone (Gaogang District), visited drainage facilities and chemical enterprises, and chaired a meeting on defending against Typhoon Dolphin, urging responsibility and risk inspection to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬检查防汛防台风工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Inspects Flood and Typhoon Prevention Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬到医药高新区检查防汛防台风工作，要求压实责任、落实防御举措，保障人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Jiang Dongdong, Party Secretary of Taizhou, inspected flood and typhoon prevention work in the Medical High-tech Zone, urging responsible measures to protect people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 全市防范应对第13号台风“白海豚”工作调度会议召开
articles.title_en: Weihai Holds Meeting on Typhoon 'White Dolphin' Response
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，威海市召开防范应对第13号台风“白海豚”工作调度会议，市委书记张海波讲话，市长孔凡萍主持，部署防汛防台风工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Weihai held a meeting on typhoon 'White Dolphin' response. Party Secretary Zhang Haibo spoke, and Mayor Kong Fanping presided over the deployment of flood and typhoon prevention work.

articles.title_zh: 市领导检查调度积水排涝等台风“白海豚”防御工作
articles.title_en: City Leaders Inspect and Coordinate Flood Drainage and Typhoon "White Dolphin" Defense Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，无锡市委书记杜小刚、市长蒋锋到市城运中心检查调度台风“白海豚”防御工作，要求严防次生灾害，确保群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Wuxi Party Secretary Du Xiaogang and Mayor Jiang Feng visited the city operations center to inspect and coordinate typhoon "White Dolphin" defense, emphasizing disaster prevention and public safety.

articles.title_zh: 市领导实地检查督导排涝防汛工作
articles.title_en: Municipal Leaders Inspect Flood Drainage and Control Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，无锡市委书记杜小刚、市长蒋锋分别到受淹小区、积水路段和京杭运河无锡段，检查督导排涝防汛工作，要求全力保障群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 10, Wuxi Party Secretary Du Xiaogang and Mayor Jiang Feng inspected flooded communities and roads, urging swift drainage and flood control to safeguard lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 赵一德调研检查秦岭生态环境保护工作
articles.title_en: Zhao Yide Inspects Ecological Protection of Qinling Mountains
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，陕西省委书记赵一德调研秦岭生态环境保护工作，强调以更严要求守护秦岭，推动智慧管山和生态修复。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Shaanxi Party Secretary Zhao Yide inspected the Qinling ecological environment, stressing stricter measures for protection and smart management.

articles.title_zh: 赵刚调研秦创原平台建设并主持召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Zhao Gang Inspects Qinchuangyuan Platform and Chairs Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，陕西省长赵刚在西安调研秦创原平台建设并主持召开座谈会，强调强化改革赋能、优化运行机制，推动更多科技成果转化为现实生产力。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Governor Zhao Gang of Shaanxi Province visited Xi'an to inspect the Qinchuangyuan platform and presided over a symposium, stressing reform and optimizing operation mechanisms to convert S&T achievements into real productivity.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰在市委审计委员会会议上强调把准正确方向 坚持问题导向 以强有力审计监督保障各项工作部署落地落实
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Stresses Strong Audit Supervision at Municipal Audit Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，西安市委审计委员会召开会议，省委常委、市委书记蒿慧杰主持并讲话，强调以强有力审计监督保障各项部署落实。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, the Xi'an Municipal Audit Committee held a meeting chaired by Hao Huijie, member of the Standing Committee of the Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Municipal Party Committee, who stressed strong audit supervision to ensure implementation of all deployments.

articles.title_zh: 魏建平主持召开全市防汛备汛工作视频调度会
articles.title_en: Wei Jianping Chairs Citywide Video Conference on Flood and Typhoon Preparedness
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日上午，新乡市委书记魏建平主持召开全市防汛备汛工作视频调度会，部署防范13号台风“白海豚”，要求严防死守，确保群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 10, Wei Jianping, Secretary of the Xinxiang Municipal Party Committee, chaired a citywide video conference on flood and typhoon preparedness, deploying measures against Typhoon Dolphin and demanding strict defense to protect public safety.

articles.title_zh: 魏建平检查督导防汛防台风工作
articles.title_en: Wei Jianping Inspects Flood and Typhoon Prevention Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日下午，新乡市委书记魏建平深入市水利局、卫辉市检查督导防汛防台风工作，要求落实防御措施，确保人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 10, Xinxiang Municipal Party Secretary Wei Jianping inspected flood and typhoon prevention work at the Municipal Water Bureau and Weihui City, urging implementation of defensive measures to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 许昌市自然资源和规划局召开地质灾害防御视频调度会
articles.title_en: Xuchang Natural Resources and Planning Bureau Holds Video Dispatch Meeting on Geological Disaster Defense
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日下午，许昌市自然资源和规划局召开台风“白海豚”地质灾害防御视频调度会，局长乔晓光参会并讲话，部署巡查排查、预警叫应、转移避险等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 10, Xuchang Municipal Bureau of Natural Resources and Planning held a video dispatch meeting on geological disaster defense against Typhoon 'White Dolphin', with Director Qiao Xiaoguang attending and making remarks.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平会见西北大学副校长张志飞一行
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Meets with Zhang Zhifei, Vice President of Northwest University
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日下午，盐城市委书记严汉平会见西北大学副校长张志飞一行，双方就深化校地合作、推动产业发展等事宜进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 10, Yan Hanping, Secretary of the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee, met with a delegation led by Zhang Zhifei, Vice President of Northwest University, to exchange views on deepening university-local cooperation and industrial development.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛主持召开文旅产业高质量发展座谈会
articles.title_en: Governor Liu Xiaotao Chairs Symposium on High-Quality Development of Cultural Tourism
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，江苏省省长刘小涛主持召开文旅产业高质量发展座谈会，强调促进文旅体商深度融合，赋能经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao chaired a symposium on high-quality development of cultural tourism, emphasizing deep integration of culture, sports, and commerce to boost economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记在中央政治局会议上的重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee Meeting Conveys Xi Jinping's Spirit of Politburo Meeting Speech
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，江苏省委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记在中央政治局会议上的重要讲话精神，研究贯彻落实举措，确保完成全年发展目标任务。省委书记信长星主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, the Standing Committee of the CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee held a meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the Politburo meeting and to study implementation measures. Xin Changxing, Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee, presided over the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 吴炜检查防汛防台风工作
articles.title_en: Wu Wei Inspects Flood and Typhoon Prevention Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日上午，盐城市代市长吴炜在市区检查防汛防台风工作，强调拧紧责任链条，全力筑牢防汛防台风坚固防线。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 10, Wu Wei, acting mayor of Yancheng, inspected flood and typhoon prevention work in the urban area, emphasizing tightened responsibility and solid defenses.

articles.title_zh: 中国农工民主党烟台市第九次代表大会召开
articles.title_en: Yantai Committee of Chinese Peasants' and Workers' Democratic Party Holds 9th Congress
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，中国农工民主党烟台市第九次代表大会召开，选举产生新一届委员会，崔伟当选主任委员。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, the 9th Congress of the CPWDP Yantai Committee was held, electing a new committee with Cui Wei as chairman.

articles.title_zh: 余金富会见斯里兰卡驻广州总领事一行
articles.title_en: Yu Jinfu Meets Sri Lankan Consul General in Guangzhou
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，阳江市市长余金富会见斯里兰卡驻广州总领事一行，双方就文化旅游、现代农业、进出口贸易等领域合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Yangjiang Mayor Yu Jinfu met with Sri Lankan Consul General in Guangzhou, discussing cooperation in cultural tourism, modern agriculture, and trade.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉调研城市更新工作并督导重点项目建设推进情况
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Inspects Urban Renewal Work and Supervises Key Projects
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉调研城市更新工作，督导道路、保障房、排水管网及危旧房改造重点项目推进情况。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Zhao Xuhui, member of the Party Standing Committee of the Autonomous Region and Secretary of the Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee, inspected urban renewal work and supervised key projects including roads, affordable housing, drainage networks, and renovation of dilapidated buildings.

articles.title_zh: 唐浩然调研文旅消费市场并督导安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Tang Haoran Inspects Cultural Tourism Consumption Market and Supervises Safety Production
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，岳阳市代理市长唐浩然调研君山岛、岳阳楼等景区文旅消费市场并督导安全生产工作，现场交办安全隐患整改。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, acting mayor Tang Haoran of Yueyang inspected cultural tourism consumption at scenic spots and supervised safety production, ordering rectification of hidden dangers.

articles.title_zh: 总投资约36亿元 碳酸钙全产业链及全降解生物科技新材料项目落户罗定
articles.title_en: Calcium Carbonate Industry Chain and Fully Degradable Bio-tech New Material Project (3.6 Billion Yuan) Settles in Luoding
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，总投资约36亿元的碳酸钙全产业链及全降解生物科技新材料产业项目正式签约落户广东罗定，助力当地资源型产业绿色升级。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, a 3.6-billion-yuan calcium carbonate and fully degradable bio-tech new material project signed to settle in Luoding, boosting local green industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 市委召开常委会会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神 研究服务保障国防和军队现代化建设等工作
articles.title_en: Yunfu Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi's Speech on National Defense
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日下午，云浮市委召开常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记在中央政治局第二十七次集体学习时的重要讲话精神，研究服务保障国防和军队现代化建设等工作，市委书记卢荣春主持。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 7, the Yunfu Municipal Party Committee held a standing committee meeting to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the 27th collective study session of the Political Bureau, and to discuss work on serving and safeguarding national defense and military modernization. The meeting was chaired by Municipal Party Committee Secretary Lu Rongchun.

articles.title_zh: 卢荣春会见新一轮佛山对口帮扶云浮工作队
articles.title_en: Lu Rongchun Meets New Foshan Assistance Work Team for Yunfu
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，佛山对口帮扶云浮工作队完成新老交接，云浮市委书记卢荣春会见新老队员，感谢佛山支援并寄语新队员续写帮扶新篇章。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the Foshan-Yunfu pairing assistance work team completed its handover. Yunfu Party Secretary Lu Rongchun met with team members, expressing gratitude for Foshan's support and encouraging the new team to continue the collaboration.

articles.title_zh: 杨杰东主持召开2026年第十八次党工委（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Yang Jiedong Chairs 2026 18th Party Working Committee (Enlarged) Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日上午，湛江经开区党工委副书记、管委会主任杨杰东主持召开党工委（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究部署防灾减灾工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 11, Yang Jiedong, Deputy Secretary and Director of the Administrative Committee of Zhanjiang Economic Development Zone, chaired the 18th Party Working Committee (Enlarged) Meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions and arrange disaster prevention and reduction work.

articles.title_zh: 湛江市雷州青年运河管理局召开2026年重点工作谋划推进会议
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Leizhou Youth Canal Administration Holds 2026 Key Work Planning Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，湛江市雷州青年运河管理局召开2026年重点工作谋划推进会议，部署下半年重点工作，包括水库环境治理、项目建设等任务。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Zhanjiang Leizhou Youth Canal Administration held a meeting to plan and advance key work for 2026, deploying tasks such as reservoir environmental governance and project construction.

articles.title_zh: 陈勇出席格力电器2026届大学生入职活动并致辞
articles.title_en: Chen Yong Attends Gree Electric's 2026 College Graduate Onboarding Event and Delivers Speech
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，珠海市委书记陈勇出席格力电器2026届大学生入职活动并致辞，勉励青年人才把'小我'融入强国建设、深耕科技创新；格力电器董事长董明珠出席。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Zhuhai Party Secretary Chen Yong attended Gree Electric's 2026 college graduate onboarding event and delivered a speech, encouraging young talents to root in Zhuhai and pursue scientific innovation. Gree Chairman Dong Mingzhu also attended.

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐调研公共交通优化服务工作 持续推动公共交通体系提质增效 让群众出行更加便捷舒适安全
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Inspects Public Transport Optimization to Improve Service Quality and Travel Convenience
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，珠海市委副书记、市长吴泽桐在香洲区调研公共交通优化服务，强调提升运行效率、改善服务，让群众出行更便捷、舒适、安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Wu Zetong, Deputy Secretary and Mayor of Zhuhai, inspected public transport in Xiangzhou, urging efficiency and better services for safer, more convenient travel.

articles.title_zh: 省政府党组会议召开
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial Government Party Group Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，省委副书记、省长周乃翔主持召开省政府党组会议，研究巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果，以正确政绩观推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Governor Zhou Naixiang chaired a meeting of the provincial government party group to consolidate and expand the results of education on establishing a correct view of political achievements, promoting high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 全省防范应对第13号台风“白海豚”工作调度会议召开
articles.title_en: Shandong Holds Meeting on Typhoon 'Dolphin' Response
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日上午，山东省防范应对第13号台风“白海豚”工作调度会议在济南召开，省委书记林武讲话，省长周乃翔主持，部署防台风工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 10, Shandong Province held a coordination meeting in Jinan to address Typhoon 'Dolphin'. Provincial Party Secretary Lin Wu spoke and Governor Zhou Naixiang presided, deploying typhoon prevention measures.

articles.title_zh: 淄博市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Zibo Municipal Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日下午，淄博市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和重要指示精神，研究贯彻落实意见，部署全面从严治党、经济运行、生态环保等工作。市委书记马晓磊主持。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 10, the Standing Committee of the Zibo Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study important speeches and instructions from General Secretary Xi Jinping, and discuss implementation measures, including party building, economic operation, and environmental protection. Ma Xiaolei, city party secretary, presided.

articles.title_zh: 国防部：中国印尼海军舰艇，将位台岛以东海域开展通航演练
articles.title_en: Defense Ministry: Chinese and Indonesian Navy Ships to Hold Passage Exercise East of Taiwan
articles.summary_zh: 8月中旬，中国海军红河舰将与印尼海军“莱”号护卫舰位台岛以东海域举行通航演练，重点开展通信操演、海上补给等科目。
articles.summary_en: In mid-August, the Chinese Navy's Honghe frigate and the Indonesian Navy's Le frigate will hold a passage exercise east of Taiwan, focusing on communication and replenishment drills.

articles.title_zh: 中星4B卫星发射失利，原因正在进一步排查
articles.title_en: ChinaSat-4B Satellite Launch Fails, Cause Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日20时02分，我国在文昌航天发射场使用长征七号改运载火箭发射中星4B卫星，火箭飞行异常，发射任务失利。具体原因正在进一步分析排查。
articles.summary_en: On August 10 at 20:02, China launched the ChinaSat-4B satellite using a Long March 7A rocket from Wenchang Space Launch Site, but the rocket malfunctioned and the launch failed. The cause is being investigated.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古警方通报“一辆警车擅自更换车标”：立即成立调查组
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Police Report Unauthorized Replacement of Police Car Emblem, Investigation Team Established
articles.summary_zh: 内蒙古警方通报一辆警车擅自更换车标，已立即成立调查组。
articles.summary_en: Inner Mongolia police reported a police car with unauthorized emblem replacement and immediately established an investigation team.

articles.title_zh: 山西500岁明代城墙遭“毁灭式修缮”
articles.title_en: 500-Year-Old Ming Dynasty City Wall in Shanxi Suffers 'Destructive Restoration'
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月媒体调查发现，山西吕梁中阳县明代古城墙在2025年被县林业局以修缮名义拆旧建新，原貌尽失。
articles.summary_en: In July 2026, media found that a Ming Dynasty city wall in Zhongyang County, Shanxi, was demolished and rebuilt under the guise of restoration by the county forestry bureau in 2025.

articles.title_zh: 外交部回应“日企高管在华涉案被拘留”：依法查处违法犯罪案件
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Responds to Detention of Japanese Corporate Executives in China: Crackdown on Illegal Activities in Accordance with Law
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆就两名日本公民涉嫌走私罪被拘留一事回应称，中方主管部门依法查处违法犯罪案件。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said Chinese authorities are handling the case of two Japanese nationals detained for suspected smuggling in accordance with the law.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 认真学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神 郭宁宁主持并研究贯彻落实措施
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting Held to Study and Implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's Important Speech and Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神，研究贯彻落实措施，并审议福州市“十五五”相关规划。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Guo Ningning, Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions, and reviewed plans for the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开党组会议和常务会议
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Government Holds Party Group and Executive Meetings
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，福州市长吴贤德主持召开市政府党组会议和常务会议，研究基础教育、招商、食品工程及新区建设等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Fuzhou Mayor Wu Xiande chaired the municipal government's Party group and executive meetings, discussing basic education, investment attraction, food safety, and new district development.

articles.title_zh: 济南出台五年行动方案，到2030年服务业增加值力争达1.2万亿元以上
articles.title_en: Jinan Issues Five-Year Action Plan Targeting Service Industry Added Value Above 1.2 Trillion Yuan by 2030
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，济南市人民政府印发《推进服务业扩能提质行动方案(2026—2030年)》，提出到2030年服务业增加值力争达1.2万亿元以上，并明确金融、交通、文旅等领域量化目标。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Jinan Municipal Government issued the Action Plan for Expanding and Upgrading the Service Industry (2026-2030), aiming to lift service industry added value to over 1.2 trillion yuan by 2030, with quantitative targets for finance, transportation, culture, and tourism.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要论述 研究安全生产、社会工作等事项
articles.title_en: Jinan Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Expositions and Discuss Work Safety and Social Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，济南市委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要论述，研究安全生产、社会工作等事项，市委书记刘强主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, the Standing Committee of the CPC Jinan Municipal Committee held a meeting to study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important expositions and discuss work safety, social work, and other matters. Liu Qiang, Secretary of the Municipal Party Committee, presided over and addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 实干开新局｜新动能顶“梁”立柱
articles.title_en: New Momentum Supports the Economy in Practical Work for a New Chapter
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记2026年多次就培育未来产业、发展新质生产力作出部署，上半年新动能对经济增长贡献率超四成。
articles.summary_en: In 2026, General Secretary Xi Jinping made multiple deployments on fostering future industries and developing new quality productive forces. In H1, new growth drivers contributed over 40% to economic growth.

tags.name_en: Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee

tags_en: Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 外交部就一些菲律宾籍人员涉嫌违法被查处答问
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Responds to Handling of Philippine Nationals Suspected of Illegal Acts
articles.summary_zh: 外交部发言人郭嘉昆10日表示，百余名菲律宾公民因非法就业、非法居留被依法处理，并称执法规范文明。
articles.summary_en: Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said on Aug 10 that over 100 Philippine nationals were lawfully handled for illegal employment and residence, noting civilized law enforcement.

articles.title_zh: 厦门市委市政府与厦门大学召开座谈会 共促“两创”融合
articles.title_en: Xiamen Municipality and Xiamen University Hold Symposium on Innovation Integration
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，厦门市委市政府与厦门大学召开座谈会，市委书记林涛主持，双方共商市校合作，推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, the Xiamen Municipal Party Committee and Government held a symposium with Xiamen University, chaired by Party Secretary Lin Tao, to discuss cooperation and deep integration of technological and industrial innovation.

articles.title_zh: 【新思想引领新征程】织就更密更暖的社会保障安全网
articles.title_en: Weaving a Denser and Warmer Social Security Safety Net
articles.summary_zh: 报道中国持续深化社会保障制度改革，推动社会救助、职业伤害保障、长期护理保险等制度完善，织密民生保障安全网。
articles.summary_en: The report highlights China's ongoing reforms to social security, improving social assistance, occupational injury protection, and long-term care insurance to strengthen the safety net for people's livelihoods.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议 认真学习贯彻习近平总书记重要论述重要文章精神 研究我省贯彻落实意见 省委书记王浩主持
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Articles, Wang Hao Presides
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，浙江省委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要文章《加快建设健康中国》精神，听取扫黑除恶等工作汇报，研究部署贯彻落实意见，省委书记王浩主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, the Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee held a meeting chaired by Secretary Wang Hao to study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's article on accelerating Healthy China and to review implementation plans.

articles.title_zh: 省政府党组第98次会议暨省政府第121次常务会议召开 刘捷主持
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Chairs Provincial Government Party Group and Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 11日上午，浙江省长刘捷主持召开省政府党组会议暨常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，听取“千项万亿”重大项目推进情况汇报。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 11, Governor Liu Jie chaired the provincial government party group and standing committee meeting, conveying Xi Jinping's important speeches and reviewing progress on major projects.

articles.title_zh: 一诺千金 笃行致远
articles.title_en: Every Promise Counts: Perseverance in Fulfilling Commitments
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日新华社综述回顾习近平主席在APEC、进博会、中非合作等场合的承诺及兑现成效，展现中国言必信、行必果的大国担当。
articles.summary_en: An Xinhua review on Aug. 9 recalls President Xi Jinping's promises at APEC, CIIE and on Africa cooperation, showcasing China's credibility and responsibility as a major country.

articles.title_zh: 江苏与中国大唐集团签署战略合作协议
articles.title_en: Jiangsu and China Datang Corporation Sign Strategic Cooperation Agreement
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，江苏省委书记信长星、省长刘小涛会见中国大唐集团董事长吕军、总经理李向良，双方签署战略合作协议，将在能源项目建设和绿电供给等方面深化合作。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Jiangsu Party Secretary Xin Changxing and Governor Liu Xiaotao met with China Datang Chairman Lv Jun and General Manager Li Xiangliang, signing a strategic cooperation agreement to enhance energy projects and green power supply.

articles.title_zh: 文献纪录片《江泽民》11日晚开始播出
articles.title_en: Documentary Series on Jiang Zemin Premieres on August 11
articles.summary_zh: 为纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年，十二集文献纪录片《江泽民》于8月11日晚在总台央视综合频道首播。
articles.summary_en: To commemorate the 100th anniversary of Jiang Zemin's birth, the 12-episode documentary series 'Jiang Zemin' premiered on CCTV-1 on the evening of August 11.

articles.title_zh: 对话复旦大学李银胜：AI会带来“文化人”的黄金时代
articles.title_en: Dialogue with Fudan University's Li Yinsheng: AI Ushers in Golden Age for 'Cultured People'
articles.summary_zh: 复旦大学副教授李银胜近日在上海举行的AI时代品牌健康度研讨会上接受专访，称生成式AI将带来“文化人”的黄金时代，并探讨品牌健康管理与AI治理。
articles.summary_en: Li Yinsheng, associate professor at Fudan University, said in an interview at an AI brand health seminar in Shanghai that generative AI will usher in a golden age for cultured people, and discussed brand health management and AI governance.

articles.title_zh: 部分博物馆出现停电、空调瘫痪等情况，国家文物局发布紧急通知
articles.title_en: National Cultural Heritage Administration Issues Urgent Notice on Museum Safety After Power Outages
articles.summary_zh: 国家文物局办公室发布紧急通知，要求各博物馆加强大客流应对和基础设施保障，确保观众和文物安全。
articles.summary_en: The National Cultural Heritage Administration issued an urgent notice requiring museums to improve crowd management and infrastructure maintenance to ensure visitor and artifact safety, following power outages and air conditioning failures.

articles.title_zh: 多家期刊发布AI使用规范：严禁AI洗稿或替代人工学术把关
articles.title_en: Multiple Journals Issue AI Usage Rules: Banning AI Ghostwriting and Replacing Human Academic Review
articles.summary_zh: 多家学术期刊发布AI使用规范，要求作者、审稿专家和编辑不得依赖AI完成核心学术工作，严禁AI洗稿或替代人工把关。
articles.summary_en: Several academic journals have issued AI usage guidelines, prohibiting AI from dominating paper writing, peer review, or editorial decisions, and requiring human oversight.

articles.title_zh: 用AI篡改照片参加摄影赛，两人被取消省级摄影家协会会员资格
articles.title_en: Two Lose Provincial Photography Association Membership for AI-Altered Photos in Competition
articles.summary_zh: 辽宁省摄影家协会日前召开主席团会议，取消许振礼、佟飞等五人会员资格，二人因用AI篡改照片参赛被取消奖项。
articles.summary_en: Liaoning Provincial Photographers Association revoked the membership of Xu Zhenli and Tong Fei for using AI-altered photos in competitions, voiding their awards.

articles.title_zh: 教育部原副部长、江苏省原副省长王湛逝世
articles.title_en: Wang Zhan, Former Vice Minister of Education and Former Vice Governor of Jiangsu, Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 教育部原副部长、江苏省原副省长王湛因病医治无效，于2026年8月10日在南京逝世，享年80岁。
articles.summary_en: Wang Zhan, former vice minister of education and former vice governor of Jiangsu, died of illness in Nanjing on August 10, 2026, at the age of 80.

articles.title_zh: 多地民政部门公告，一批未经登记的“摄影家协会”被取缔、劝散
articles.title_en: Civil Affairs Departments in Multiple Regions Ban Unregistered Photographers' Associations
articles.summary_zh: 近期多地民政部门发布公告，依法取缔或劝散了一批未经登记的“摄影家协会”，以维护文化行业秩序。
articles.summary_en: Recently, civil affairs departments in multiple regions have issued announcements to ban or dissolve unregistered 'photographers' associations' for operating without legal registration, disrupting cultural industry order.

articles.title_zh: 央地合作！这一低空企业在合肥包河揭牌成立
articles.title_en: Central-Local Joint Venture Low-Altitude Enterprise Established in Baohu, Hefei
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，中信海合低空科技（合肥）有限公司在合肥包河区揭牌成立，由中信海直与合肥国先控股共同出资组建，将推动低空经济规模化发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, CITIC Haihe Low-Altitude Technology (Hefei) Co., Ltd. was inaugurated in Baohu District, Hefei, jointly funded by CITIC Offshore Helicopter and Hefei Guoxian Holdings to promote low-altitude economy.

articles.title_zh: 淮阜高铁启动接触网热滑试验
articles.title_en: Huaifu High-Speed Railway Starts Overhead Contact Line Hot-Run Test
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日，安徽境内新建淮蚌、淮阜高铁同时启动全线接触网热滑试验，8月10日试验列车在蒙城县进行热滑，为联调联试创造条件。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 9, the new Huai-Beng and Huai-Fu high-speed railways in Anhui simultaneously started full-line contact wire hot-run tests. On Aug 10, a test train ran the test in Mengcheng County, paving the way for joint commissioning.

articles.title_zh: 北京市防汛抗旱指挥部连续调度部署防汛防台风有关工作
articles.title_en: Beijing Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters Continues Coordinating Flood and Typhoon Prevention Work
articles.summary_zh: 日前，北京市防汛抗旱指挥部连续召开会议，部署防汛防台风工作，分析台风“白海豚”影响，市长殷勇主持并强调做好系统准备。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Beijing Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters held consecutive meetings to deploy flood and typhoon prevention, analyzing the impact of Typhoon White Dolphin. Mayor Yin Yong chaired and stressed systematic preparedness.

tags.name_en: Beijing Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters

articles.title_zh: 晋江出台安全生产大排查大整治期间关怀帮扶中小企业八条措施
articles.title_en: Jinjiang Issues Eight Measures to Support SMEs During Safety Inspections
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，晋江市委、市政府印发《安全生产大排查大整治期间关怀帮扶中小企业八条措施》，从用工、资金、用电等方面助企纾困，统筹经济发展与安全生产。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Jinjiang Municipal Party Committee and Government issued eight measures to support SMEs during safety inspections, covering employment, financing, and electricity costs to balance development and safety.

articles.title_zh: 广西出台海洋经济发展“十五五”规划
articles.title_en: Guangxi Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Marine Economy Development
articles.summary_zh: 近日，广西壮族自治区政府办公厅印发《广西海洋经济发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年海洋生产总值占地区生产总值比重达10%左右，推动海洋经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The Guangxi government recently issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for marine economy, aiming to raise marine GDP to about 10% of regional GDP by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 水利部对冀鲁豫鄂4省份启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Activates Level-IV Emergency Response for Flood Control in Four Provinces
articles.summary_zh: 水利部于8月10日对河北、山东、河南、湖北启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，应对台风“白海豚”和冷空气带来的强降雨。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, the Ministry of Water Resources activated a Level-IV emergency response for flood control in Hebei, Shandong, Henan, and Hubei provinces to address heavy rainfall from Typhoon "White Dolphin" and cold air.

articles.title_zh: 湖北加快建设“荆楚安澜”现代水网
articles.title_en: Hubei Accelerates Building 'Jingchu Anlan' Modern Water Network
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，湖北省省长李殿勋主持召开省政府常务会议，研究“十五五”对口援藏援疆工作，审议《湖北省水安全保障“十五五”规划》，部署加强水库安全管理。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Governor Li Dianxun of Hubei chaired a provincial government executive meeting to study paired assistance to Tibet and Xinjiang for the 15th Five-Year Plan, review the Water Security Plan, and arrange reservoir safety management.

tags.name_en: Paired Assistance to Tibet and Xinjiang

tags_en: Paired Assistance to Tibet and Xinjiang

articles.title_zh: 文化遗产保护利用焕新出彩
articles.title_en: Cultural Heritage Protection and Utilization Shines with New Brilliance
articles.summary_zh: 河北统筹实施文物保护项目502个，推进长城、大运河国家文化公园建设，非遗工坊建设等，让文化遗产在守正创新中焕新出彩。
articles.summary_en: Hebei has coordinated 502 cultural relic protection projects, advanced the construction of the Great Wall and Grand Canal National Cultural Parks, and built intangible cultural heritage workshops, making cultural heritage shine through innovation.

articles.title_zh: 保持高度警觉 时刻严阵以待 全力以赴做好台风“白海豚”防范应对工作
articles.title_en: Luo Wen Chairs Hebei Video Conference on Typhoon Baihaitun Response
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日下午，河北省委书记罗文主持召开全省防范应对台风“白海豚”视频调度会议，省长王正谱作工作部署，强调全力保障人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 10, Hebei Provincial Party Secretary Luo Wen chaired a video conference on typhoon Baihaitun response, with Governor Wang Zhengpu outlining arrangements to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 冯飞调研海南生物医药产业强调锚定“创新、国际化、特色化”定位高质量发展
articles.title_en: Feng Fei Inspects Hainan Biomedical Industry, Stresses Innovation, Internationalization, and Distinctive Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，海南省委书记冯飞在海口调研生物医药产业发展情况并召开座谈会，强调锚定“创新、国际化、特色化”定位，推动产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Feng Fei, Secretary of Hainan Provincial Party Committee, inspected the biomedical industry in Haikou and chaired a symposium, emphasizing innovation, internationalization, and distinctive development.

articles.title_zh: 国家人工智能应用中试基地启动仪式举办
articles.title_en: National AI Application Pilot Base Launch Ceremony Held
articles.summary_zh: 近日，黑龙江省“人工智能+”赋能行业高质量发展峰会暨国家人工智能应用中试基地（农业领域农作物种植方向）启动仪式在哈尔滨市举办，省委常委、常务副省长陈少波出席并揭牌。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the launch ceremony of the National AI Application Pilot Base for crop cultivation was held in Harbin, Heilongjiang Province. Chen Shaobo, member of the Standing Committee of the Provincial Party Committee and Executive Vice Governor, attended and unveiled the base.

articles.title_zh: 许勤主持黑龙江省委理论学习中心组第五十三次集体学习
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Chairs 53rd Collective Study Session of Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee Theoretical Study Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，黑龙江省委书记许勤主持省委理论学习中心组第五十三次集体学习，强调忠实践行习近平法治思想，建设更高水平法治黑龙江，梁惠玲等参加学习交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, chaired the 53rd collective study session of the provincial committee's theoretical study group, emphasizing faithful practice of Xi Jinping's Thought on the Rule of Law and building a higher-level rule-of-law Heilongjiang. Liang Huiling and others attended.

tags.name_en: Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law

tags_en: Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law

articles.title_zh: 党建引领 赋能金融向实而行
articles.title_en: Party Building Leads Finance to Serve Real Economy
articles.summary_zh: 近日，人民网党建调研行深入湖南长沙、岳阳等地，报道工商银行湖南省分行以党建引领金融服务实体经济，助力重大项目建设和企业走出去。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily Online's Party building research tour visited Changsha and Yueyang, Hunan, reporting on ICBC Hunan Branch's party-building-led financial services supporting the real economy and major projects.

articles.title_zh: 湖南出台对非经贸合作三年行动计划
articles.title_en: Hunan Issues Three-Year Action Plan for Economic and Trade Cooperation with Africa
articles.summary_zh: 近日，湖南省正式印发《湖南省对非经贸合作三年行动计划（2026-2028年）》，聚焦六大优势产业，深化湘非经贸深度合作。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Hunan Province issued the Three-Year Action Plan for Economic and Trade Cooperation with Africa (2026-2028), focusing on six advantageous industries to deepen Hunan-Africa trade ties.

Economic and Trade Cooperation with Africa

articles.title_zh: 台风“白海豚”持续影响江苏 8月14日前仍有较强降水
articles.title_en: Typhoon 'Baihaitun' Continues to Affect Jiangsu with Heavy Rainfall Expected Until Aug 14
articles.summary_zh: 受第13号台风“白海豚”影响，8月10日至14日江苏有明显降水过程，省气象台发布台风蓝色、暴雨黄色等预警，10日多地降水量居全国前列。
articles.summary_en: Affected by Typhoon Baihaitun (No. 13), Jiangsu has experienced significant rainfall from Aug 10 to 14. The provincial meteorological observatory issued typhoon and rainstorm warnings; several cities ranked top nationally in precipitation on Aug 10.

articles.title_zh: 江苏十部门联合出台相关举措支持非遗小微企业文创发展
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Ten Departments Jointly Issue Measures to Support Cultural and Creative Development of Intangible Cultural Heritage Small and Micro Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，江苏省文旅厅会同十部门联合印发《关于支持江苏省非物质文化遗产小微企业文创发展的若干措施（试行）》，提出16条措施支持非遗小微企业文创发展。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 10, Jiangsu's Department of Culture and Tourism and ten other departments issued measures supporting cultural and creative development of intangible cultural heritage (ICH) small and micro enterprises, proposing 16 supportive measures.

articles.title_zh: 江西省直机关学习大讲堂聚焦因地制宜发展未来产业
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Provincial Study Lecture Focuses on Developing Future Industries
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，2026年第3期江西省直机关学习大讲堂举行，省委书记尹弘等省领导参加，邀请专家张立围绕因地制宜前瞻布局和发展未来产业作专题授课。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, the third session of the Jiangxi Provincial Study Lecture was held, with Provincial Party Secretary Yin Hong and other leaders attending. Expert Zhang Li gave a lecture on developing future industries according to local conditions.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中包钢会见中国能建董事长倪真
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong and Bao Gang Meet with China Energy Engineering Group Chairman Ni Zhen
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中、自治区主席包钢在呼和浩特会见中国能建董事长倪真，双方就能源、基础设施等合作交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Wang Weizhong, Secretary of Inner Mongolia CPC Committee, and Bao Gang, Chairman of the Regional Government, met with Ni Zhen, Chairman of China Energy Engineering Group, in Hohhot to discuss cooperation on energy and infrastructure.

articles.title_zh: 包钢主持召开自治区人民政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Bao Gang Chairs Standing Meeting of Autonomous Region Government
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，内蒙古自治区主席包钢主持召开政府常务会议，传达学习中央政治局会议精神，部署经济工作、扩大内需等重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Bao Gang, chairman of Inner Mongolia, presided over a standing meeting of the regional government to convey the spirit of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau meeting and arrange key economic tasks.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏印发实施意见深化科技特派员制度
articles.title_en: Ningxia Issues Implementation Opinions to Deepen Science and Technology Commissioner System
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，宁夏印发实施意见，明确科技特派员选派、服务及激励机制，促进城乡融合发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Ningxia issued implementation opinions to clarify selection, service, and incentive mechanisms for science and technology commissioners to promote urban-rural integration.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏循环经济发展“十五五”规划发布
articles.title_en: Ningxia Releases 15th Five-Year Plan for Circular Economy Development
articles.summary_zh: 宁夏发布循环经济发展“十五五”规划，提出到2030年城市生活垃圾资源化利用率达75%，一般工业固废综合利用率达60%等目标。
articles.summary_en: Ningxia has issued its 15th Five-Year Plan for circular economy development, setting targets for 2030 including a 75% resource utilization rate for municipal solid waste and a 60% comprehensive utilization rate for general industrial solid waste.

articles.title_zh: 中国经济持续释放确定性红利
articles.title_en: China's Economy Continues to Release Certainty Dividends
articles.summary_zh: 今年上半年，中国GDP同比增长4.7%，进出口规模首破25万亿元，制造业增加值占比提升，新设外资企业增长5.3%，国际机构上调中国增长预期，中国经济持续释放确定性红利。
articles.summary_en: In H1 2026, China's GDP grew 4.7% year-on-year, foreign trade surpassed 25 trillion yuan for the first time, and new foreign-funded enterprises rose 5.3%. International institutions raised China's growth forecast, as the economy continues to release certainty dividends.

articles.title_zh: 青海省深化扫黑除恶专项斗争视频会议召开
articles.title_en: Qinghai Holds Video Conference on Deepening Special Campaign against Gang Crimes
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，青海省深化扫黑除恶专项斗争视频会议在西宁召开，传达学习中央和省委会议精神，动员部署全省扫黑除恶专项斗争工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, a video conference on deepening the special campaign against gang crimes was held in Xining, Qinghai, to convey the spirit of central and provincial meetings and mobilize deployment of the work.

articles.title_zh: 四川省纪委监委：2人严重违纪违法被处分
articles.title_en: Sichuan Commission for Discipline Inspection Announces Punishment of Two Officials for Serious Violations
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，四川省纪委监委通报：袁勇、何康军因严重违纪违法被开除党籍和公职，涉嫌犯罪问题移送检察机关。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, the Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection reported that Yuan Yong and He Kangjun were expelled from the Party and dismissed from public office for serious disciplinary and legal violations, and their suspected crimes were transferred to prosecutors.

tags.name_en: Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection
