articles.title_zh: 山东省防范应对第13号台风“白海豚”工作调度会议召开
articles.title_en: Shandong Holds Meeting on Typhoon Baiji Prevention and Response
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日上午，山东省在济南召开防范应对第13号台风“白海豚”工作调度会议，省委书记林武出席并讲话，部署防汛防台风工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 10, Shandong held a work coordination meeting in Jinan on Typhoon Baiji response. Party Secretary Lin Wu delivered a speech, deploying flood and typhoon prevention efforts.

articles.title_zh: 山东省政府党组会议召开
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial Government Party Group Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，山东省委副书记、省长周乃翔主持召开省政府党组会议，研究巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果的具体措施。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Zhou Naixiang, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee and Governor, chaired a meeting of the Provincial Government Party Group to study measures to consolidate and expand the learning and education achievements on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔主持召开省政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Chairs Shandong Provincial Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，山东省委副书记、省长周乃翔主持召开山东省政府常务会议，研究群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治、安全生产、防范和打击非法金融活动等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Zhou Naixiang, Deputy Party Secretary and Governor of Shandong, chaired a provincial government executive meeting to discuss anti-corruption campaigns, work safety, and combating illegal financial activities.

articles.title_zh: 上海全面践行人民城市理念
articles.title_en: Shanghai Fully Implements the People's City Concept
articles.summary_zh: 上海持续推进人民城市建设，在旧改、保障性租赁住房、公共空间改造等方面广泛听取民意，改善民生。
articles.summary_en: Shanghai continues to build a people's city by renovating old neighborhoods, expanding rental housing, and creating public spaces, listening to residents' needs.

articles.title_zh: 打好打赢台风防御这场大仗硬仗
articles.title_en: Win the Tough Battle of Typhoon Defense
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，上海市委书记陈吉宁两次到市防汛指挥部检查调度台风“白海豚”防御工作，要求把损失和影响降到最低，全力保障市民安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Jining twice visited the city's flood control headquarters to inspect typhoon 'White Dolphin' defense work, urging to minimize losses and impact and ensure citizens' safety.

articles.title_zh: 以更严要求更实举措守护秦岭宁静和谐美丽
articles.title_en: Zhao Yide Emphasizes Protecting Qinling Mountains with Stricter Requirements
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，陕西省委书记赵一德调研检查秦岭生态环境保护工作，强调以更严要求更实举措守护秦岭宁静和谐美丽。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Zhao Yide, Secretary of Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee, inspected the ecological environment protection of the Qinling Mountains and stressed stricter measures to safeguard its tranquility and beauty.

articles.title_zh: 陕西出台方案强化地下水资源管理执法
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Issues Plan to Strengthen Law Enforcement on Groundwater Management
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，陕西省地下水保护与监测中心日前印发《深化水资源管理执法年专项行动方案》，聚焦地下水超采治理、监督管控和监测预警，严厉整治涉地下水违法违规行为。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the Shaanxi Provincial Groundwater Protection and Monitoring Center issued an action plan to deepen law enforcement on water resource management, focusing on overexploitation control, supervision, and warning to crack down on illegal groundwater activities.

articles.title_zh: 天津市西青区：首个“联合验收”住宅项目获批准入证
articles.title_en: Tianjin Xiqing District: First 'Joint Acceptance' Residential Project Gets Delivery Permit
articles.summary_zh: 近日，天津市西青区政务服务办依托“联合验收一件事”改革机制，为珺璟和苑项目8栋住宅楼核发新建住宅商品房准许交付使用许可，成为该区首个此类项目。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Xiqing District Government Service Office of Tianjin issued the first delivery-use permit for residential commercial housing under the 'Joint Acceptance' reform, covering 8 buildings of the Junjing Heyuan project.

articles.title_zh: 天津市静海区持续推进水利基础设施改造
articles.title_en: Tianjin's Jinghai District Continues Water Conservancy Infrastructure Upgrades
articles.summary_zh: 天津市静海区推进迎丰、管铺头两座泵站改扩建，已完成机组安装调试并投运，预计9月底前竣工，提升团泊地区排涝能力。
articles.summary_en: Jinghai District, Tianjin, has completed installation and trial operation of pumps at two upgraded pumping stations, expected to fully finish by end of September to improve flood drainage in Tuanbo area.

articles.title_zh: 王君正主持召开自治区党委常委会会议 认真传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Chairs Meeting of CPC Tibet Regional Committee to Convey Xi Jinping's Important Speech Spirits
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正主持召开自治区党委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，研究贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Wang Junzheng, secretary of the CPC Tibet Autonomous Regional Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches.

articles.title_zh: 云南省多举措推动储蓄国债纳入个人养老金政策落地
articles.title_en: Yunnan Promotes Inclusion of Savings Bonds in Personal Pension Scheme
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月，储蓄国债正式纳入个人养老金投资产品池。人民银行云南省分行构建本土化服务体系，推动政策落地，6月全省购买国债金额达1315.34万元。
articles.summary_en: In June 2026, savings bonds were included in personal pension investment products. The PBC Yunnan Branch built localized services, with 13.1534 million yuan of bonds purchased via pension accounts in June.

articles.title_zh: 以科学的思想方法推进管党治党——习近平党建思想理论品格系列述评之六
articles.title_en: Promoting Party Governance with Scientific Thinking Methods — The Sixth Commentary on Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 新华社北京8月10日电，文章系统阐述习近平党建思想蕴含的科学思想方法，强调以科学思维方式、严密制度体系和高超领导艺术推进管党治党。
articles.summary_en: The Xinhua commentary systematically elaborates the scientific methods of thinking embodied in Xi Jinping's thought on party building, emphasizing scientific thinking, a rigorous institutional system, and superb leadership art to advance strict party governance.

articles.title_zh: 现代化产业体系究竟意味着什么
articles.title_en: What Does a Modern Industrial System Really Mean?
articles.summary_zh: 文章系统阐述现代化产业体系的理论内涵，指出它是现代化国家的物质技术基础，强调以实体经济为根基，加快构建具有智能化、绿色化、融合化特征的现代化产业体系。
articles.summary_en: This article elaborates on the modern industrial system, stating it is the material and technological foundation of a modern country, emphasizing the real economy as its root and advancing an intelligent, green, and integrated industrial system.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就哥伦比亚强烈地震向哥伦比亚总统致慰问电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Condolences to Colombian President Over Strong Earthquake
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，国家主席习近平致电哥伦比亚总统德拉埃斯普列亚，就哥伦比亚发生强烈地震表示深切哀悼和诚挚慰问。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, President Xi Jinping sent a message to Colombian President del Espriella, expressing deep condolences over the strong earthquake in Colombia.

articles.title_zh: 梁言顺深入黄山市随机督导台风“白海豚”防范应对工作
articles.title_en: Liang Yanshun Conducts Unannounced Inspection of Typhoon Preparedness in Huangshan
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，安徽省委书记梁言顺以“四不两直”方式深入黄山市随机督导台风“白海豚”防范应对工作，强调落实防汛防台风措施，确保群众安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Anhui Provincial Party Secretary Liang Yanshun made an unannounced inspection of typhoon 'White Dolphin' preparedness in Huangshan, urging full implementation of flood and typhoon response measures to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 陈新武在武隆区调研督导百日攻坚行动时强调 突出抓好群防群治 筑牢除险固安基层防线
articles.title_en: Chen Xinwu Visits Wulong District to Supervise 100-Day Campaign
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，重庆市代市长陈新武到武隆区调研督导群防群治百日攻坚行动，强调突出抓好群防群治，筑牢除险固安基层防线。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Chen Xinwu, acting mayor of Chongqing, visited Wulong District to supervise the 100-day campaign, stressing mass prevention and grassroots safety.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Guangxi Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚主持召开自治区党委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要文章和中央有关会议精神，研究部署健康中国、基础教育、反腐等贯彻落实措施。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Chen Gang, Party Secretary of Guangxi, chaired a Standing Committee meeting of the Regional Party Committee to convey and study Xi Jinping's important articles and central policies, deploying measures on health, education, and anti-corruption.

articles.title_zh: 省防指召开台风防范应对会议 刘宁作出批示 王凯主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Provincial Flood Control Headquarters Holds Meeting on Typhoon Response; Liu Ning Gives Instructions, Wang Kai Chairs and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，河南省防汛抗旱指挥部召开会议部署台风“白海豚”防范应对工作，省委书记刘宁作出批示，省长王凯主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Henan Provincial Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters held a meeting to deploy typhoon "Baihaitun" prevention efforts. Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning gave instructions, and Governor Wang Kai chaired and addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行｜长沙：老厂区里长出新艺术
articles.title_en: Changsha: Old Factory Areas Give Birth to New Art
articles.summary_zh: 新华社记者8月10日在长沙“油脂厂·1936”文旅项目看到，老厂区经改造变身艺术空间，长沙通过城市更新激活闲置老旧厂区。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Xinhua reporters visited the 'Oil Factory 1936' cultural tourism project in Changsha, where old factory areas have been transformed into art spaces, showcasing Changsha's urban renewal efforts.

articles.title_zh: 湖南启动“千百十”企业培育三年行动
articles.title_en: Hunan Launches Three-Year Action Plan to Cultivate Leading Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 近日，湖南省人民政府办公厅印发《湖南省“千百十”企业培育行动实施方案（2026—2028年）》，提出到2028年培育营收过千亿企业8家、过百亿企业60家、过十亿企业400家。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of the Hunan Provincial People's Government issued a three-year action plan to cultivate a tiered system of leading enterprises, aiming for 8 firms with revenue over 100 billion yuan, 60 over 10 billion, and 400 over 1 billion by 2028.

tags.name_en: General Office of the Hunan Provincial People's Government

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明主持召开省政府第97次常务会议
articles.title_en: Mao Weiming Chairs 97th Executive Meeting of Hunan Provincial Government
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，省长毛伟明主持召开湖南省政府第97次常务会议，研究部署智能机器人产业、水网电网物流网建设、城市更新等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Governor Mao Weiming chaired the 97th executive meeting of the Hunan Provincial Government, discussing smart robotics, infrastructure networks, and urban renewal.

articles.title_zh: “活力中国调研行”走进湖南
articles.title_en: 'Vibrant China' Research Tour Kicks Off in Hunan
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，中宣部组织的“活力中国调研行”湖南集中采访活动在长沙启动，120多名记者将赴多地开展6天调研。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, the "Vibrant China" research tour organized by the CPC Central Committee's Publicity Department was launched in Changsha, Hunan. Over 120 journalists will conduct six-day field visits across the province.

tags.name_en: Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee

tags_en: Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛会见中兴通讯董事长方榕
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Meets ZTE Chairman Fang Rong
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日，江苏省省长刘小涛会见中兴通讯董事长方榕，并共同见证南京市与中兴通讯签署深化战略合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On August 9, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao met with ZTE Chairman Fang Rong and witnessed the signing of a deepened strategic cooperation agreement between Nanjing and ZTE.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛主持召开文旅产业高质量发展座谈会
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Chairs Symposium on High-Quality Development of Cultural Tourism Industry
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，江苏省省长刘小涛主持召开文旅产业高质量发展座谈会，强调深挖本土文化底蕴，丰富文旅新业态，推动文旅产业成为支柱产业、民生产业、幸福产业。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Governor Liu Xiaotao of Jiangsu chaired a symposium on high-quality development of the cultural tourism industry, emphasizing tapping local cultural heritage and fostering new business forms to make it a pillar industry.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议 信长星主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Meets, Xin Changxing Presides and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，江苏省委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记在中央政治局会议上的重要讲话精神等，研究贯彻落实举措，省委书记信长星主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, the Standing Committee of the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the Central Political Bureau meeting, and study implementation measures. Xin Changxing, Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee, presided and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 学习新语·铸魂强党丨推进作风建设常态化长效化
articles.title_en: Learning New Words: Strengthening the Party's Soul | Promoting the Normalization and Long-term Effectiveness of Work Style Construction
articles.summary_zh: 新华社“学习新语”栏目推出“铸魂强党”系列，系统梳理习近平总书记关于推进作风建设常态化长效化的重要论述。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua's 'Learning New Words' column launches a series on strengthening the Party, summarizing Xi Jinping's important remarks on normalizing and long-term improving work style.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 自然资源“一张图”建设扎实推进 推动跨部门跨层级数据共享共用
articles.title_en: Natural Resources 'One Map' Initiative Promotes Cross-Departmental Data Sharing
articles.summary_zh: 自然资源部扎实推进自然资源“一张图”建设，依托系统实现用地、用林、用草、用海联动审批，平均审批时长压缩33%，提升数字化治理能力。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Natural Resources advances the 'One Map' initiative, enabling integrated approval for land, forest, grassland, and sea use, cutting average approval time by 33% and boosting digital governance.

articles.title_zh: 应急管理部向工贸企业发出安全生产工作提示 严防六类生产安全事故
articles.title_en: Ministry of Emergency Management Issues Work Safety Alert to Industrial and Trade Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 应急管理部向工贸企业发出安全生产工作提示，严防有限空间作业中毒窒息、高温熔融金属喷爆等六类事故，并加强“厂中厂”“园中园”安全治理。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Emergency Management issued a work safety alert to industrial and trade enterprises, urging prevention of six types of accidents including poisoning, electrocution, mechanical injury, falls, and chemical explosions, and strengthening safety governance for shared workshops and parks.

articles.title_zh: 开幕倒计时 在首钢提前剧透2026服贸会
articles.title_en: Countdown to Opening: Preview of 2026 CIFTIS at Shougang Park
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，2026年服贸会倒计时一个月系列宣传活动在北京首钢园区举行，相关负责人介绍了本届服贸会亮点。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, a month-countdown promotional event for the 2026 CIFTIS was held at Shougang Park in Beijing, where officials introduced highlights of the fair.

articles.title_zh: 陈敏尔张工到市防汛抗旱指挥部办公室调度防汛防台风工作
articles.title_en: Chen Min'er and Zhang Gong Dispatch Flood and Typhoon Prevention Work at Municipal Headquarters
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，天津市委书记陈敏尔、市长张工到市防汛抗旱指挥部办公室调度部署防汛防台风工作，强调落实落细各项措施，保障人民安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Tianjin Party Secretary Chen Min'er and Mayor Zhang Gong visited the municipal flood control headquarters to coordinate typhoon and flood prevention, emphasizing meticulous implementation of safety measures.

articles.title_zh: 自治区质量和知识产权强区工作领导小组召开全体会议
articles.title_en: Autonomous Region Quality and Intellectual Property Strengthening Leading Group Holds Plenary Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日上午，自治区党委副书记、自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜主持召开质量和知识产权强区工作领导小组全体会议，研究部署中央考核整改工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 10, Erkin Tuniyaz, Deputy Secretary of the regional Party committee and Chairman of the autonomous region, chaired a plenary meeting of the Quality and Intellectual Property Strengthening Leading Group to study and deploy rectification work after the central assessment.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登主持召开会议专题研究农业农村重点工作
articles.title_en: Gama Zedeng Chairs Meeting on Key Agricultural and Rural Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，西藏自治区党委副书记、自治区主席嘎玛泽登在拉萨主持召开会议，专题研究农业农村重点工作，强调推动农牧业增效益、农牧民增收入、农牧区增活力。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Gama Zedeng, deputy secretary of the regional Party committee and chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region, chaired a meeting in Lhasa on key agricultural and rural work, urging efforts to increase agricultural efficiency, farmers' income, and rural vitality.

articles.title_zh: 福建省委常委会召开会议 认真学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Fujian Provincial Party Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，福建省委书记周祖翼主持召开省委常委会会议，学习中央政治局会议精神和习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究贯彻落实措施。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Zhou Zuyi, Secretary of Fujian Provincial Party Committee, chaired a Standing Committee meeting to study the spirit of the CPC Central Political Bureau meeting and Xi Jinping's important speech, and to discuss implementation measures.

articles.title_zh: 全市服务业大会召开
articles.title_en: Nanyang Holds Citywide Service Industry Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，南阳市服务业大会召开，市委书记王智慧讲话，代市长刘冰主持，部署推动服务业优质高效发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Nanyang held its citywide service industry conference. Party Secretary Wang Zhihui delivered a speech, and acting Mayor Liu Bing presided over the meeting, aiming to promote high-quality development of the service sector.

articles.title_zh: 旦巴：促进高质量充分就业维护农民工薪酬权益
articles.title_en: Danba: Promote High-Quality Full Employment and Safeguard Migrant Workers' Pay
articles.summary_zh: 近日，西藏自治区党委常委、常务副主席旦巴调研就业服务中心和项目点，强调促进高质量充分就业，维护农民工薪酬权益。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Danba, Executive Vice Chairman of Tibet Autonomous Region, inspected employment service center and project sites, emphasizing high-quality full employment and protecting migrant workers' wage rights.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登主持召开会议专题研究农业农村重点工作
articles.title_en: Gama Zedeng Chairs Meeting on Key Agricultural and Rural Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，西藏自治区主席嘎玛泽登在拉萨主持召开会议专题研究农业农村重点工作，强调强化协调联动，推动农牧业增效益、农牧民增收入、农牧区增活力。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Gama Zedeng, Chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region, chaired a meeting in Lhasa to study key agricultural and rural work, stressing coordinated efforts to improve agricultural efficiency, increase farmers' incomes, and invigorate rural areas.

articles.title_zh: 王君正调研南北山绿化工程时强调 科学有序推进国土绿化 努力创建国家生态文明高地
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Inspects South-North Mountain Greening Project, Stresses Ecological Civilization
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正调研拉萨南北山绿化工程，强调贯彻习近平生态文明思想，科学推进国土绿化，创建国家生态文明高地。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Regional Party Committee, inspected the South-North Mountain Greening Project in Lhasa, stressing implementation of Xi Jinping's thought on ecological civilization and advancing land greening to build a national ecological civilization highland.

articles.title_zh: 陆河县委书记程永东：乘势而上 聚力攻坚 奋力书写“五年显著变化”精彩答卷
articles.title_en: Cheng Yongdong, Party Secretary of Luhe County: Seize the Momentum to Deliver a Brilliant Answer for 'Five-Year Significant Changes'
articles.summary_zh: 陆河县委书记程永东接受采访，提出聚力产业攻坚、做强县城龙头等五大举措，奋力实现“五年显著变化”目标，推动县域经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Cheng Yongdong, Party Secretary of Luhe County, outlined five major measures including industrial development and county town upgrading to achieve the 'Five-Year Significant Changes' goal and boost high-quality economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 杨青龙在调研全市生态环境系统工作情况时强调 坚决扛起生态文明建设政治责任 以正确政绩观引领生态环境保护工作
articles.title_en: Yang Qinglong Inspects Ecological Environment Work in Shizuishan, Stresses Political Responsibility for Ecological Civilization
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，石嘴山市委书记杨青龙调研全市生态环境系统，强调扛起生态文明建设政治责任，以正确政绩观引领生态环境保护工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Yang Qinglong, Secretary of the Shizuishan Municipal Party Committee, inspected the city's ecological environment system, stressing political responsibility for ecological civilization and guiding environmental protection with a correct view of achievements.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞宣布自治区第十七届运动会暨第十届民族传统体育运动会开幕
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Opens 17th Regional Games and 10th Ethnic Traditional Sports Meet
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日晚，自治区第十七届运动会暨第十届民族传统体育运动会在银川览山公园开幕。自治区党委书记李邑飞宣布开幕，自治区主席张雨浦、政协主席陈雍出席。
articles.summary_en: On August 8, the 17th Regional Games and 10th Ethnic Traditional Sports Meet opened in Yinchuan. Party Secretary Li Yifei declared it open, with Regional Chairman Zhang Yupu and CPPCC Chairman Chen Yong attending.

articles.title_zh: 李国强调研城建重点项目建设
articles.title_en: Li Guoqiang Inspects Major Urban Construction Projects
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日，泰安市委副书记、市长李国强调研城建重点项目，要求统筹项目建设、民生改善与历史文化保护，推进城市有机更新。
articles.summary_en: On August 8, Li Guoqiang, Deputy Secretary and Mayor of Tai'an, inspected key urban construction projects, emphasizing coordination of project development, livelihood improvement, and historical preservation.

articles.title_zh: 邓云锋来泰调研 杨洪涛陪同
articles.title_en: Deng Yunfeng Inspects Tai'an, Accompanied by Yang Hongtao
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，山东省委常委、统战部部长邓云锋到泰安调研，泰安市委书记杨洪涛陪同，实地考察东平湖、戴村坝等地，强调落实黄河战略、发展民营经济等。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Deng Yunfeng, member of the Standing Committee of the Shandong Provincial Committee and head of the United Front Work Department, visited Tai'an for research, accompanied by Yang Hongtao, secretary of the Tai'an Municipal Committee. They inspected Dongping Lake and Daicun Dam, emphasizing the Yellow River strategy and development of the private economy.

tags.name_en: Ecological Protection of the Yellow River Basin

tags_en: Ecological Protection of the Yellow River Basin

articles.title_zh: 信长星刘小涛检查调度我省防御台风“白海豚”工作
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing and Liu Xiaotao Inspect and Coordinate Typhoon 'White Dolphin' Defense Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日下午，江苏省委书记信长星、省长刘小涛到省防汛抗旱指挥部，对防御台风“白海豚”工作进行再检查再调度，强调落细落实措施、压紧压实责任，确保人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 9, Jiangsu Party Secretary Xin Changxing and Governor Liu Xiaotao visited the provincial flood control and drought relief headquarters to re-check and coordinate typhoon "White Dolphin" defense, emphasizing detailed measures and responsibility to ensure public safety.

tags.name_en: Provincial Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters

tags_en: Provincial Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters

articles.title_zh: 黄强会见韩国忠清南道议会代表团
articles.title_en: Huang Qiang Meets Delegation of South Chungcheong Provincial Council
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，吉林省委书记黄强在长春会见韩国忠清南道议会议长赵哲纪率领的代表团，双方就深化友好合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Huang Qiang, Secretary of Jilin Provincial Committee, met with a delegation led by Cho Cheol-gi, Speaker of South Chungcheong Provincial Council, in Changchun to discuss deepening friendly cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 蒋锋主持召开防台防汛视频调度会
articles.title_en: Jiang Feng Chairs Video Dispatch Meeting on Flood and Typhoon Prevention
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日，无锡市长蒋锋视频调度防台防汛工作，强调落实防台措施，保障群众安全。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 9, Wuxi Mayor Jiang Feng held a video dispatch on typhoon and flood prevention, urging full implementation of safety measures.

articles.title_zh: 佛山市顺德区工商联代表团莅临高新区调研
articles.title_en: Foshan Shunde Federation of Industry and Commerce Delegation Visits High-tech Zone for Research
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，佛山市顺德区工商联党组书记朱艺婷率20余名企业代表到高新区调研，了解产业现状，探寻跨区域合作。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Zhu Yiting, Party Secretary of Shunde District Federation of Industry and Commerce, led a delegation of over 20 entrepreneurs to research the High-tech Zone, exploring industrial conditions and cross-regional cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 魏建平到市人民群众来访接待中心接访时强调用心用情做好信访工作 依法依规解决群众诉求
articles.title_en: Wei Jianping Meets Visitors at Petition Center, Stressing Earnest Lawful Handling of Complaints
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，新乡市委书记魏建平到市人民群众来访接待中心接访，强调用心用情做好信访工作，依法依规解决群众诉求。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Wei Jianping, secretary of Xinxiang Municipal Party Committee, received petitioners at the municipal petition center, stressing earnest and lawful handling of complaints.

articles.title_zh: 魏建平：坚持正确导向 突出内容为王 把《树人报》办出特色办出水平办出影响力
articles.title_en: Wei Jianping Calls for Making 'Shuren Daily' a High-Quality Newspaper for Youth Education
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，《树人报》创刊仪式在新乡日报社举行，市委书记魏建平出席并讲话，强调坚持正确导向、内容为王，办好少年儿童报纸。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the launch ceremony of 'Shuren Daily' was held at Xinxiang Daily. Municipal Party Secretary Wei Jianping attended and spoke, emphasizing correct orientation and quality content for youth education.

articles.title_zh: 中国气象局领导调研新乡市高标准农田气象服务体系建设工作
articles.title_en: CMA Leaders Visit Xinxiang to Review High-Standard Farmland Meteorological Service System
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，中国气象局领导到新乡市调研高标准农田气象服务体系建设试点并召开总结交流会，肯定新乡试点经验，将加大支持力度。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, leaders from the China Meteorological Administration visited Xinxiang to inspect the pilot high-standard farmland meteorological service system and held a summary meeting, praising Xinxiang's experience and pledging further support.

articles.title_zh: 高新区召开党工委会议
articles.title_en: High-tech Zone Holds Party Working Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，高新区召开党工委会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，部署全面从严治党、经济发展、卫生健康和信访等工作。党工委书记孙毅主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the High-tech Zone held a Party Working Committee meeting to study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions, deploying work on strict Party governance, economic development, health, and petition handling. Secretary Sun Yi presided and addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 长葛市委书记张忠民主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Zhang Zhongmin Chairs Standing Committee Meeting of Changge Municipal Party Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，长葛市委书记张忠民主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署集中整治群众身边不正之风和腐败问题、基层治理、落实中央八项规定精神等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Zhang Zhongmin, Party Secretary of Changge, chaired a meeting of the Standing Committee of the CPC Changge Municipal Committee. The meeting conveyed Xi Jinping's important speech and studied work on deepening grassroots governance, anti-corruption, and implementing the Party's eight-point frugality code.

articles.title_zh: 全市防御台风“白海豚”视频调度会召开
articles.title_en: Yancheng Holds Video Dispatch Meeting on Typhoon 'White Dolphin' Defense
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日下午，盐城市召开防御台风“白海豚”视频调度会，市委书记严汉平主持并讲话，代市长吴炜出席，部署防汛防台风工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 9, Yancheng held a video conference on typhoon defense. Party Secretary Yan Hanping presided and spoke; acting Mayor Wu Wei attended, deploying flood and typhoon prevention work.

articles.title_zh: 信长星刘小涛检查调度我省防御台风“白海豚”工作
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing and Liu Xiaotao Inspect Typhoon 'Baihaitun' Defense Work in Jiangsu
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日下午，江苏省委书记信长星、省长刘小涛到省防汛抗旱指挥部检查调度台风“白海豚”防御工作，强调落细落实措施，确保人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 9, Jiangsu Party Secretary Xin Changxing and Governor Liu Xiaotao visited the provincial flood control headquarters to coordinate Typhoon 'Baihaitun' defense, urging implementation of preventive measures to safeguard lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 江城区上半年经济稳中有升，产业根基持续夯实
articles.title_en: Jiangcheng District Sees Steady Economic Growth and Solid Industrial Base in H1
articles.summary_zh: 江城区召开2026年上半年经济形势分析会，披露上半年GDP达181.39亿元，同比增长2.8%，工业投资增长35%，财政收入增20.6%。
articles.summary_en: Jiangcheng District held an economic analysis meeting for H1 2026, reporting GDP of 18.139 billion yuan, up 2.8% year on year, with industrial investment up 35% and fiscal revenue up 20.6%.

articles.title_zh: 卢一先到江城区调研“山月故里·艺术原乡”项目
articles.title_en: Lu Yixian Surveys 'Shanyue Guli·Art Xiang' Project in Jiangcheng District
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日，阳江市委书记卢一先到江城区调研“山月故里·艺术原乡”项目，强调挖掘关山月文化内涵，打造艺术高地。
articles.summary_en: On August 9, Lu Yixian, Secretary of Yangjiang Municipal Committee, inspected the 'Shanyue Guli·Art Xiang' project in Jiangcheng District, emphasizing cultural development.

articles.title_zh: 营口市委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Yingkou Municipal Party Standing Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speeches
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日，营口市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和指示精神，研究部署贯彻落实工作，市委书记姚华明主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 9, the Standing Committee of the CPC Yingkou Municipal Committee held a meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions, and made arrangements for implementation. Yao Huaming, the municipal party secretary, presided over the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议听取五大党组工作汇报
articles.title_en: Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Hears Reports from Five Party Groups
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日，营口市委常委会召开会议，听取市人大常委会、市政府、市政协、市法院、市检察院党组工作汇报，市委书记姚华明主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 9, the Standing Committee of the Yingkou Municipal Party Committee met to hear work reports from the party groups of the Municipal People's Congress, Government, CPPCC, Court, and Procuratorate. Party Secretary Yao Huaming chaired and addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 卢荣春会见省铁投集团总经理蓝汝宁
articles.title_en: Lu Rongchun Meets with General Manager of Provincial Railway Investment Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日下午，云浮市委书记卢荣春会见广东省铁路建设投资集团有限公司总经理蓝汝宁，双方就深化政企合作、推进轨道交通建设等座谈交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 6, Lu Rongchun, Secretary of Yunfu Municipal Party Committee, met with Lan Runing, General Manager of Guangdong Railway Construction Investment Group, to discuss deepening government-enterprise cooperation and advancing rail transit construction.

articles.title_zh: 李庆新到云城区调研基层治理工作 强化法治思维 注重工作实效 切实以高水平治理护航高质量发展
articles.title_en: Li Qingxin Investigates Grassroots Governance in Yuncheng District, Emphasizing Rule of Law and High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，云浮市市长李庆新到云城区调研基层治理工作，强调强化法治思维，提升基层治理效能，以高水平治理护航高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Li Qingxin, Mayor of Yunfu, visited Yuncheng District to research grassroots governance, stressing rule-of-law thinking and efficient governance for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 我市经贸代表团出访印度尼西亚、澳大利亚
articles.title_en: Mayor Li Yongyi Leads Zhanjiang Trade Delegation to Indonesia and Australia
articles.summary_zh: 8月2日至8日，市长李勇毅率湛江市经贸代表团出访印度尼西亚、澳大利亚，开展经贸交流，促成多项合作协议。
articles.summary_en: From August 2 to 8, Mayor Li Yongyi led a trade delegation from Zhanjiang to Indonesia and Australia, promoting trade and investment cooperation and signing several collaboration agreements.

articles.title_zh: 雷州市召开2026年上半年经济形势分析会暨市委财经委会议
articles.title_en: Leizhou Holds H1 2026 Economic Analysis and City Party Committee Financial Affairs Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，雷州市召开经济形势分析会，总结上半年经济运行情况，部署下半年重点工作。市委书记吴松江主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Leizhou held a meeting to analyze H1 2026 economic trends, summing up the first half and planning key work for the second half. Party Secretary Wu Songjiang chaired and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 詹鹏主持召开市政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Zhan Peng Chairs Zhoukou Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，周口市市长詹鹏主持召开市政府常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，听取污染防治和开发区整改工作汇报。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Zhoukou Mayor Zhan Peng chaired a municipal government executive meeting to convey the spirit of Xi Jinping's important speech and hear reports on pollution control and development zone rectification.

articles.title_zh: 詹鹏主持召开市政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Zhan Peng Chairs Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，周口市市长詹鹏主持召开市政府常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，听取污染防治和开发区问题整改汇报。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Zhoukou Mayor Zhan Peng chaired a municipal government executive meeting, conveying the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech and hearing reports on pollution prevention and development zone rectification.

articles.title_zh: 广东省第十七届运动会暨第十届残疾人运动会开幕式在茂名举行
articles.title_en: Guangdong 17th Provincial Games and 10th Games for the Disabled Open in Maoming
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日晚，广东省第十七届运动会暨第十届残疾人运动会开幕式在茂名举行，省委书记黄坤明宣布开幕，省长孟凡利致辞。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of August 9, the opening ceremony of Guangdong's 17th Provincial Games and 10th Paralympic Games was held in Maoming. Provincial Party Secretary Huang Kunming declared the Games open, and Governor Meng Fanli delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 黑社会集团涉洗黑钱超6亿港元，香港警方卧底调查拘捕147人
articles.title_en: Hong Kong Police Bust Triad Money Laundering Ring, Arrest 147
articles.summary_zh: 香港警方于8月7日至8日展开打击黑帮洗黑钱行动，拘捕147人，该集团涉嫌利用傀儡户口清洗超6亿港元黑钱。
articles.summary_en: Hong Kong police conducted undercover investigations and arrested 147 people on Aug 7-8 for allegedly laundering over HK$600 million through mule accounts.

articles.title_zh: 我国发现多起“Sorry”勒索病毒攻击事件
articles.title_en: China Detects Multiple 'Sorry' Ransomware Attacks
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，国家计算机病毒应急处理中心发布预警，称境内发现多起“Sorry”勒索病毒攻击事件，主要针对Linux服务器，造成数据加密和泄露风险。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, China's National Computer Virus Emergency Response Center issued a warning about multiple 'Sorry' ransomware attacks in China, targeting Linux servers and posing data encryption and leakage risks.

articles.title_zh: 新疆生产建设兵团生态环境局原党组书记、局长吴彬接受纪律审查和监察调查
articles.title_en: Wu Bin, Former Party Secretary and Director of Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps Ecological Environment Bureau, Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月10日，新疆生产建设兵团生态环境局原党组书记、局长吴彬因涉嫌严重违纪违法，接受新疆生产建设兵团纪委监委纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, 2026, Wu Bin, former Party Secretary and Director of the Ecological Environment Bureau of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, is under disciplinary review and supervision investigation for suspected serious disciplinary and legal violations.

articles.title_zh: 极兔被罚7万元，此前一网点工人误将油门当刹车致1死
articles.title_en: J&T Express Fined 70,000 Yuan Over Fatal Accident at Shenzhen Depot
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，国家邮政局对极兔速递有限公司罚款7万元，因其未按规定履行安全保障统一管理责任。此前，该公司深圳转运中心发生致1人死亡的生产安全事故。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, 2026, the State Post Bureau fined J&T Express 70,000 yuan for failing to fulfill unified safety management duties, following a fatal accident at its Shenzhen transfer center in May.

articles.title_zh: 受贿6798万余元，中国一重原副总经理陆文俊被判15年
articles.title_en: Lu Wenjun, Former Deputy General Manager of China First Heavy Industries, Sentenced to 15 Years for Bribery of 67.98 Million Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，湘潭市中级人民法院一审公开宣判中国一重原副总经理陆文俊受贿案，判处其有期徒刑15年，并处罚金500万元。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Xiangtan Intermediate People's Court sentenced Lu Wenjun, former deputy general manager of China First Heavy Industries, to 15 years in prison and a fine of 5 million yuan for accepting bribes totaling over 67.98 million yuan.

articles.title_zh: 武汉通报天桥打人事件：街道城管协管员金某等3人被刑拘
articles.title_en: Wuhan Reports Overpass Assault: Three Including Urban Management Aides Detained
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日晚，武汉市武昌区一城管协管员与摊主发生冲突，双方互殴，3名协管员因涉嫌故意伤害被刑事拘留。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Aug 9, a clash occurred between a city management aide and stall owners in Wuchang, Wuhan, leading to mutual assault; three aides were criminally detained for intentional injury.

articles.title_zh: 罗文主持召开河北省防范应对台风“白海豚”视频调度会议
articles.title_en: Luo Wen Chairs Hebei Video Conference on Typhoon "White Dolphin" Preparedness
articles.summary_zh: 河北省召开防范应对台风“白海豚”视频调度会议，省委书记罗文主持、省长王正谱部署，要求全力做好防汛防台风工作。
articles.summary_en: Hebei held a video conference on typhoon "White Dolphin" preparedness; Provincial Party Secretary Luo Wen chaired and Governor Wang Zhengpu deployed work, urging full efforts in flood and typhoon prevention.

articles.title_zh: 党建引领基层高效能治理一线调研丨方寸之间，如何筑起暖心港湾
articles.title_en: Party Building Leads Grassroots Governance: How a Small Space Becomes a Warm Harbor
articles.summary_zh: 今年夏天，郑州各地党群服务中心推出暑期托管、助餐等暖心服务，并吸纳外卖骑手等新就业群体参与基层治理，让社区阵地活起来。
articles.summary_en: This summer, party-mass service centers in Zhengzhou launched summer childcare, meal assistance, and recruited delivery riders as mobile grid workers, making grassroots governance more efficient and warm.

articles.title_zh: 一只易拉罐的出海密码
articles.title_en: The Export Code of a Soda Can
articles.summary_zh: 今年上半年郑州外贸进出口达3518.4亿元，同比增长28.2%。巩义铝加工企业通过绿色低碳和技术创新，推动易拉罐材料出口增长，成为外贸亮点。
articles.summary_en: In H1 2026, Zhengzhou's foreign trade reached 351.84 billion yuan, up 28.2% YoY. Aluminum processors in Gongyi boosted can material exports via green tech and innovation, driving growth.

articles.title_zh: 用电负荷连创新高 中国力保居民“空调自由”
articles.title_en: China Ensures Air Conditioning Freedom as Electricity Load Hits Record Highs
articles.summary_zh: 入夏以来，中国用电负荷屡创新高，8月7日达15.57亿千瓦，电力行业多措并举保障居民度夏用电，国家能源局等确保“空调自由”。
articles.summary_en: China's electricity load hit record highs this summer, reaching 1.557 billion kW on Aug 7. Power sector and NEA are taking steps to guarantee residents' 'AC freedom' during peak heat.

articles.title_zh: “一人公司”，究竟是个啥样？
articles.title_en: One-Person Companies Thrive in Hangzhou's AI Ecosystem
articles.summary_zh: 随着AI技术迭代，一人公司（OPC）在杭州加速涌现。杭州市政府推出Token券、市场监管举措等政策，打造全国“AI+OPC”创业新高地。
articles.summary_en: As AI evolves, one-person companies (OPCs) are surging in Hangzhou. The city has rolled out measures like Token vouchers and market regulations to build a national AI+OPC startup hub.

articles.title_zh: 福州瑞科医药健康产业园二期年底竣工 打造两岸生物医药融合“桥头堡”
articles.title_en: Ruike Pharmaceutical Health Industrial Park Phase II in Fuzhou to Complete by Year-End, Boosting Cross-Strait Biomedicine Integration
articles.summary_zh: 福州瑞科医药健康产业园二期预计今年12月竣工，届时园区总面积将达10万平方米，计划招引近300家生物医药企业，打造两岸生物医药融合‘桥头堡’。
articles.summary_en: The second phase of the Ruike Pharmaceutical Health Industrial Park in Fuzhou is expected to be completed in December, expanding the park to 100,000 square meters and aiming to attract nearly 300 biomedical firms, serving as a bridgehead for cross-strait biomedical integration.

articles.title_zh: 新思想引领新征程丨丰收背后的“稳”与“进”
articles.title_en: New Thinking Leads New Journey: The 'Stability' and 'Progress' Behind the Bumper Harvest
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记强调粮食安全，今年我国夏粮总产量首次突破3000亿斤，河南等地加强气象监测和高标准农田建设，推动藏粮于地、藏粮于技战略落实。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping stressed food security; this year's summer grain output exceeded 300 billion jin for the first time. Henan and other regions strengthened meteorological monitoring and high-standard farmland construction to implement the strategy of storing grain in land and technology.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Qingdao Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi's Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，青岛市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究审议经济、科创、民生等工作，市委书记曾赞荣主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 10, the Standing Committee of CPC Qingdao Municipal Committee met to study Xi Jinping's important speech, covering economic, sci-tech and livelihood issues. Zeng Zanrong chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 王晓晖施小琳会见农业农村部党组书记、部长张柱
articles.title_en: Wang Xiaohui and Shi Xiaolin Meet with Minister of Agriculture and Rural Affairs Zhang Zhu
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，四川省委书记王晓晖、省长施小琳在成都会见农业农村部党组书记、部长张柱一行，双方就做好三农领域重点工作等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Sichuan Provincial Party Secretary Wang Xiaohui and Governor Shi Xiaolin met with Zhang Zhu, Minister of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, in Chengdu, exchanging views on key agricultural and rural work.

articles.title_zh: 新思想引领新征程丨丰收背后的“稳”与“进”
articles.title_en: New Thought Leads New Journey: The 'Stability' and 'Progress' Behind the Bumper Harvest
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来我国深入实施国家粮食安全战略，夏粮总产量首次突破3000亿斤。各地通过建设田间气象站、高标准农田和升级农机装备，落实藏粮于地、藏粮于技。
articles.summary_en: China has implemented the national food security strategy, with summer grain output exceeding 300 billion jin for the first time. Field weather stations, high-standard farmland, and upgraded machinery have boosted yields.

articles.title_zh: 城市更新记
articles.title_en: Urban Renewal Chronicle
articles.summary_zh: 记者走访北京草厂胡同、沈阳牡丹社区、武汉青和居，展现城市更新改善居民生活，践行人民城市理念。
articles.summary_en: Reporters visit Caochang Hutong in Beijing, Mudan Community in Shenyang, and Qingheju in Wuhan, showcasing urban renewal improving residents' lives and fulfilling the people-centered city concept.

articles.title_zh: 把握消费市场新趋势
articles.title_en: Seizing New Trends in the Consumer Market
articles.summary_zh: 文章分析当前消费市场趋势，指出体验式新型消费增速显著，服务消费占比提升，并建议从供需双向发力培育壮大新型消费。
articles.summary_en: The article analyzes current consumer market trends, noting robust growth in experience-based new consumption and rising service consumption share, while suggesting supply-demand coordination to expand new consumption.

articles.title_zh: 为国争光！江苏两名中学生获国际人工智能奥林匹克竞赛金、银牌
articles.title_en: Two Jiangsu Middle School Students Win Gold and Silver at International AI Olympiad
articles.summary_zh: 8月2日至8日，第三届国际人工智能奥林匹克在哈萨克斯坦阿斯塔纳举行，江苏南京外国语学校邵子熙获金牌、范廷轩获银牌。
articles.summary_en: From August 2 to 8, the Third International AI Olympiad was held in Astana, Kazakhstan. Jiangsu students Shao Zixi and Fan Tingxuan from Nanjing Foreign Language School won gold and silver medals respectively.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行｜在这里，“种子”为什么能够长成“森林”
articles.title_en: Vibrant China Research Trip: How Do 'Seeds' Grow into 'Forests' in Jiangsu
articles.summary_zh: 江苏以扎实产业根基和机制创新推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合，区域创新能力全国第二，高新技术产业产值占比超五成。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu promotes deep integration of technological and industrial innovation with a solid industrial base and institutional innovation, ranking second in regional innovation capability with high-tech industry output exceeding half of total.

articles.title_zh: 复旦团队发布AI品牌健康度指数：品牌叙事规则正被AI重写
articles.title_en: Fudan Team Releases AI Brand Health Index: Brand Narrative Rules Being Rewritten by AI
articles.summary_zh: 复旦团队发布AI品牌健康度指数（AI-BHI），提出C-B-A三层架构，为企业构建长期数字认知资产提供指南。
articles.summary_en: Fudan team releases AI Brand Health Index (AI-BHI) with a C-B-A three-layer framework, providing guidance for enterprises to build long-term digital cognitive assets.

articles.title_zh: 尹力调度部署防汛防台风工作
articles.title_en: Yin Li Directs Flood and Typhoon Prevention Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日下午，北京市委书记尹力调度部署防汛防台风工作，强调筑牢安全屏障，确保城市平稳运行，切实维护人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 9, Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li directed flood and typhoon prevention arrangements, stressing safety barriers and safeguarding people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 充电桩CCC认证 自8月开始强制实施
articles.title_en: Charging Piles CCC Certification Becomes Mandatory from August
articles.summary_zh: 国家市场监管总局对电动汽车供电设备CCC认证自8月1日起强制实施，未获认证不得出厂、销售、进口或使用，以强化质量安全源头治理。
articles.summary_en: Since August 1, CCC certification for electric vehicle power supply equipment is mandatory. Products without certification cannot be manufactured, sold, imported, or used. Regulators will conduct safety tests and enterprise inspections.

articles.title_zh: 福州严格规范审批涉企行政检查
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Standardizes Administrative Inspections on Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日，福州市印发严格规范涉企行政检查十条措施，实行清单管理、计划审批，推行服务型监管，优化营商环境。
articles.summary_en: On August 9, Fuzhou issued ten measures to standardize administrative inspections on enterprises, implementing list management, plan approval, and service-oriented supervision to improve the business environment.

articles.title_zh: 广西推出“复工复产贷”助力受灾经营主体恢复发展
articles.title_en: Guangxi Launches "Resumption Loan" to Support Disaster-Affected Businesses
articles.summary_zh: 广西四部门推出“复工复产贷”政策，通过提高贴息和担保费用补贴标准，精准支持受灾企业复工复产。
articles.summary_en: Guangxi's four departments launched a "Resumption Loan" policy, raising subsidy standards for interest and guarantee fees to precisely support disaster-affected enterprises resuming production.

articles.title_zh: 《黄帝故里拜祖大典活动规范》正式发布
articles.title_en: Local Standard for Huangdi Hometown Ancestor Worship Ceremony Released
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，河南省地方标准《黄帝故里拜祖大典活动规范》正式发布，将于2026年10月23日起实施，标志着拜祖大典迈入标准化、规范化举办新阶段。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Henan Province released the local standard for the Huangdi Hometown Ancestor Worship Ceremony, effective October 23, 2026, marking a new stage of standardization.

articles.title_zh: 第八届全国职工优秀技术创新成果交流活动启动
articles.title_en: 8th National Workers' Excellent Technological Innovation Achievement Exchange Activity Launched
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中华全国总工会等四部门印发通知，正式启动第八届全国职工优秀技术创新成果交流活动，征集展示职工创新成果并纳入国家科技奖提名推荐范围。
articles.summary_en: The All-China Federation of Trade Unions and three other departments launched the 8th National Workers' Excellent Technological Innovation Achievement Exchange Activity to collect and display workers' innovation achievements.

articles.title_zh: 向绿而行，厚植生态底色
articles.title_en: Going Green: Hebei Strengthens Its Ecological Foundation
articles.summary_zh: 河北深入推进绿色转型，空气质量持续改善，白洋淀水质稳定，塞罕坝林场混交林比例提升，可再生能源装机占比达73.6%。
articles.summary_en: Hebei advances green transformation: air quality improves, Baiyangdian water quality remains stable, Saihanba forest mix ratio rises, and renewable energy accounts for 73.6% of installed capacity.

articles.title_zh: 海南省印发指导意见 加强和规范政府系统行政规范性文件备案审查
articles.title_en: Hainan Issues Guidance to Strengthen Filing and Review of Administrative Normative Documents
articles.summary_zh: 海南省政府办公厅近日印发指导意见，加强和规范全省行政规范性文件备案审查，系全国首份，旨在形成闭环管理，支撑自贸港高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Hainan's provincial government office issued guidance to strengthen filing and review of administrative normative documents, the first nationwide, aiming for closed-loop management to support the free trade port.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省政府召开党组（扩大）会议暨常务会议
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Provincial Government Holds Party Leadership (Expanded) Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10日，黑龙江省省长梁惠玲主持召开省政府党组（扩大）会议暨常务会议，传达学习中央会议精神，部署下半年经济工作和分级诊疗体系。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Governor Liang Huiling chaired the provincial government's Party leadership (expanded) meeting and executive meeting to convey the spirit of central meetings and arrange H2 economic work and a hierarchical diagnosis and treatment system.

articles.title_zh: 做实党建“动力源” 跑出产业“加速度”
articles.title_en: Party Building as Power Source Accelerates Industrial Development
articles.summary_zh: 近日，人民网党建调研行深入湖南长沙、岳阳等地，调研企业党建如何赋能科技创新与产业协同，总结红色领航推动高质量发展的湖南经验。
articles.summary_en: Recently, People's Daily Online's Party building research tour visited Changsha and Yueyang in Hunan to explore how grassroots Party organizations turn political advantages into industrial development and governance, summarizing Hunan's experience of Party building empowering high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: “氢”风徐来 前景可期
articles.title_en: Hydrogen Energy Brings a Breeze of Promising Prospects
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报报道，我国氢能产业正从技术示范迈向规模化、商业化，在绿氢炼化、纯氢冶金等领域取得进展，但成本与市场机制仍是瓶颈。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily reports that China's hydrogen energy industry is moving from demonstration to commercial scale, with progress in green hydrogen refining and pure hydrogen metallurgy, though costs and market mechanisms remain bottlenecks.

articles.title_zh: 南京发布夜市地图 集纳近百个点位
articles.title_en: Nanjing Releases Night Market Map with Nearly 100 Locations
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日，南京市城管局正式推出各区夜市点位图，集纳近百处夜市点位，方便市民游客打卡“夜金陵”，标志着南京夜间经济精细化治理新阶段。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 8, Nanjing Urban Management Bureau launched a night market map covering nearly 100 locations to help residents and tourists explore the city's night economy, marking a new stage of refined governance.

articles.title_zh: 江苏成立“AI+新材料”产业联盟
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Establishes "AI + New Materials" Industry Alliance
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省工信厅指导，由苏州实验室牵头组建的“AI+新材料”产业联盟在苏州吴江区成立，旨在推动新材料与人工智能产业融合发展。
articles.summary_en: Guided by Jiangsu Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology, the "AI + New Materials" Industry Alliance, led by Suzhou Laboratory, was established in Wujiang District, Suzhou, to promote the integrated development of new materials and AI industries.

articles.title_zh: 江苏决定集中打包修改、废止一批省级地方性法规
articles.title_en: Jiangsu to Amend and Repeal a Batch of Provincial Local Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日至31日，江苏省十四届人大常委会第二十三次会议召开，审议供销合作社条例等草案，并决定集中打包修改、废止一批省级地方性法规。
articles.summary_en: From July 29 to 31, the 23rd session of the 14th Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee reviewed draft regulations and decided to amend and repeal a batch of provincial local regulations.

articles.title_zh: 江西省出台新一轮深化零基预算改革三年行动方案
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Introduces New Three-Year Action Plan for Deepening Zero-Based Budget Reform
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，江西省印发《省级预算项目支出标准体系建设新一轮三年行动方案（2026—2028年）》，力争到2028年底建立覆盖省级财政重点领域的支出标准体系。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Jiangxi Province issued a new three-year action plan (2026-2028) for building provincial budget project expenditure standards, aiming to establish a comprehensive standard system by the end of 2028.

articles.title_zh: 包钢在包头市调研
articles.title_en: Bao Gang Conducts Research in Baotou
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日至9日，内蒙古自治区政府主席包钢在包头市调研稀土产业、重大项目、科技创新和安全生产等工作。
articles.summary_en: From August 8 to 9, Bao Gang, Chairman of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Government, inspected rare earth industry, major projects, tech innovation and safety production in Baotou.

articles.title_zh: 潮涌千帆志昂扬——党中央、国务院邀请优秀专家人才代表北戴河休假侧记
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee and State Council Invite Outstanding Experts for Beidaihe Retreat
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日至7日，党中央、国务院邀请60位优秀专家人才代表在北戴河休假，主题为“奋进十五五”，蔡奇受习近平总书记委托看望专家。
articles.summary_en: From August 1 to 7, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council invited 60 outstanding experts and talents to a retreat in Beidaihe, themed "Striving for the 15th Five-Year Plan". Cai Qi, entrusted by General Secretary Xi Jinping, visited the experts.

articles.title_zh: 以正确政绩观引领海关事业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Guiding High-Quality Development of Customs with a Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 海关总署署长署名文章，阐述全国海关深入开展正确政绩观学习教育，践行人民海关为人民宗旨，以实干担当推动海关事业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: An article by the head of the General Administration of Customs elaborates on the customs system's education on correct views of political achievements, serving the people with practical actions to promote high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 全球首创M-G同步并网装备技术成果发布
articles.title_en: World's First M-G Synchronous Grid-Connection Equipment Technology Released
articles.summary_zh: 近日，东方电气集团东方电机有限公司与国网江苏电力在江苏盐城联合发布全球首创M-G同步并网装备技术成果，世界首套兆瓦级装备已在盐城大丰海上风电试验基地稳定运行超2000小时。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Dongfang Electric Machinery and State Grid Jiangsu Electric Power jointly released the world's first M-G synchronous grid-connection equipment technology in Yancheng, Jiangsu. The first MW-level equipment has operated stably for over 2,000 hours at the Dafeng offshore wind power test base.

articles.title_zh: 推动高质量充分就业取得新进展（“十五五”开好局起好步）
articles.title_en: Promoting New Progress in High-Quality and Full Employment (Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan)
articles.summary_zh: 文章综述了今年以来各地落实就业优先战略，通过稳岗扩岗、技能培训、重点群体帮扶等举措，促进高质量充分就业，并引用习近平总书记指示和中央政治局会议部署。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews local implementation of the employment-first strategy this year, including stabilizing jobs, skills training, and support for key groups, citing Xi Jinping's remarks and Political Bureau meeting decisions.

articles.title_zh: 日照港上吞吐数据的“云上码头”悄悄开工了
articles.title_en: Rizhao Port's 'Cloud Terminal' for Data Throughput Quietly Goes into Operation
articles.summary_zh: 日照港建成5万兆主干网络和统一大数据平台，打造“云上码头”，推动数据要素流通与港口智能化，提升作业效率超30%。
articles.summary_en: Rizhao Port has built a 50-terabit backbone network and unified big data platform, creating a 'cloud terminal' to enhance data flow and port intelligence, boosting operational efficiency by over 30%.

articles.title_zh: 山东印发重点扶持区域引进急需紧缺人才项目管理办法
articles.title_en: Shandong Issues Management Measures for Introducing Urgently Needed Talent Projects in Key Support Areas
articles.summary_zh: 山东省发展改革委等三部门联合印发管理办法，明确2026年至2030年每年支持不超过90个人才项目，重点项目最高资助200万元。
articles.summary_en: Shandong's Development and Reform Commission and other departments jointly issued measures to support up to 90 talent projects annually from 2026 to 2030, with key projects receiving up to 2 million yuan.

articles.title_zh: 陈吉宁检查调度台风防御工作
articles.title_en: Chen Jining Inspects Typhoon Defense Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日，上海市委书记陈吉宁两次前往市防汛指挥部检查调度台风“白海豚”防御工作，要求确保百姓平安、城市安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 9, Chen Jining, Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee, visited the city's flood control headquarters twice to inspect and coordinate typhoon 'White Dolphin' defense work, emphasizing efforts to ensure public safety and city security.

articles.title_zh: 核验资质、规范补贴，上海启动网约车行业“清网行动”
articles.title_en: Shanghai Launches 'Clean Network' Campaign for Ride-hailing Industry
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，上海市网约车协同监管工作专班召开部署会，宣布启动网约车行业“清网行动”，九部门联动，重点整治资质、补贴和数据问题。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 10, Shanghai's ride-hailing supervision task force held a meeting to launch a 'Clean Network' campaign, involving nine departments to regulate qualifications, subsidies, and data.

articles.title_zh: 以能源转型支撑经济社会发展全面绿色转型
articles.title_en: Energy Transition to Support Comprehensive Green Transformation of Economic and Social Development
articles.summary_zh: 2026能源经济与碳达峰碳中和高质量发展论坛8月6日在陕西榆林举行，人民日报社总编辑陈建文、陕西省省长赵刚等出席，围绕能源绿色转型、双碳目标等议题展开研讨。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Forum on Energy Economy and High-Quality Development for Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality was held on Aug 6 in Yulin, Shaanxi, with People's Daily's Chen Jianwen and Shaanxi Governor Zhao Gang attending, discussing green energy transition and dual carbon goals.

articles.title_zh: 陕西成立低空经济领域“一院、一中心”
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Establishes "One Institute, One Center" for Low-Altitude Economy
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，陕西省低空经济产业研究院和低空装备联合试验检测中心揭牌成立，由省发改委推动，依托陕西电子信息集团，联合多所高校和60余家企业。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Shaanxi's Low-Altitude Economy Industry Research Institute and Joint Testing Center were inaugurated, promoted by the provincial DRC and backed by Shaanxi Electronics Group with universities and 60+ enterprises.

articles.title_en: Low-Carbon Path for New Energy Vehicle Full Industry Chain Takes Shape
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，在西安举行的2026能源经济与碳达峰碳中和高质量发展论坛上，人民日报中国品牌发展研究院发布“企业绿色低碳发展研究”第二阶段成果，聚焦新能源汽车全产业链低碳转型。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 6, at the 2026 Energy Economy and Carbon Peak & Carbon Neutrality Forum in Xi'an, People's Daily's China Brand Development Research Institute released the second-phase findings of its Green Low-Carbon Development Research, focusing on the NEV industry chain's low-carbon transformation.

articles.title_en: Research Report on Innovation Practice of Yulin Energy Revolution Demonstration Zone (2026) Released
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，人民日报中国品牌发展研究院在榆林发布《榆林能源革命创新示范区创新实践研究报告（2026）》，展现能源转型经验。

articles.title_en: Building a New Energy System to Promote High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，新型能源体系建设论坛在陕西榆林举行，各界代表围绕新型能源体系、绿色低碳转型等议题交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the Forum on Building a New Energy System was held in Yulin, Shaanxi, where participants discussed green low-carbon transformation and high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 拉萨市推动冬虫夏草出口取得新突破
articles.title_en: Lhasa Makes New Breakthrough in Export of Cordyceps
articles.summary_zh: 拉萨市商务局介绍，自2025年11月以来，拉萨市虫草合规自主出口货值达850万元，主要销往香港、东南亚等地，成为全区首个打通标准化外贸通道的城市。
articles.summary_en: Lhasa's commerce bureau says since Nov 2025, compliant self-export of cordyceps reached 8.5 million yuan, mainly to Hong Kong and Southeast Asia, making Lhasa the first city in the region to establish a standardized foreign trade channel.

articles.title_zh: 中共云南省委通过关于深入学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神开创云南发展新局面的意见
articles.title_en: Yunnan Provincial Party Committee Adopts Opinions on Implementing Xi's Keynote Speech and Opening New Development Prospects
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月4日，中国共产党云南省第十一届委员会第十次全体会议通过意见，要求深入学习贯彻习近平总书记在庆祝建党105周年大会上的重要讲话精神，坚定信心接续奋斗，开创云南发展新局面。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, 2026, the 10th Plenary Session of the 11th Yunnan Provincial Committee of the CPC adopted opinions on studying and implementing Xi Jinping's important speech at the CPC's 105th anniversary celebration, urging confidence and continued efforts to open new development prospects in Yunnan.

articles.title_zh: 浙江加快推动高等教育服务现代化产业体系
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Accelerates Higher Education to Serve Modern Industrial System
articles.summary_zh: 浙江发布行动方案，提出到2028年新增或升级500个以上学科专业，培养急需人才30万名，科技成果转化超200亿元，以七项计划破解产学研用难题。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang issued an action plan to add or upgrade over 500 disciplines, train 300,000 urgently needed talents, and achieve over 20 billion yuan in tech transfer by 2028, with seven initiatives to bridge industry-academia gaps.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行｜会做家务的机器人来了！
articles.title_en: Humanoid Robot 'NAVIAI' Takes on Household Chores in Ningbo
articles.summary_zh: 在浙江宁波甬水桥科创中心，人形机器人“领航者NAVIAI”展示家务能力，能熨衣、烹饪等，并可在商超、实验室应用，体现中国人形机器人产业发展。
articles.summary_en: At the Yongshuiqiao Innovation Center in Ningbo, Zhejiang, the humanoid robot 'NAVIAI' demonstrates household skills like ironing and cooking, showcasing China's progress in humanoid robotics.

articles.title_zh: 2026国际基础科学大会在京开幕 尹力致辞 殷勇出席
articles.title_en: 2026 International Basic Science Conference Opens in Beijing; Yin Li Delivers Speech, Yin Yong Attends
articles.summary_zh: 9日上午，2026国际基础科学大会在北京怀柔区开幕，北京市委书记尹力致辞，市委副书记、市长殷勇出席。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 9, the 2026 International Basic Science Conference opened in Huairou, Beijing. Yin Li, Secretary of the Beijing Municipal CPC Committee, delivered a speech; Yin Yong, Deputy Secretary and Mayor, attended.

articles.title_zh: 深刻把握习近平生态文明思想的科学性和真理性
articles.title_en: Deeply Grasping the Scientificity and Truthfulness of Xi Jinping's Thought on Ecological Civilization
articles.summary_zh: 本文系统阐述习近平生态文明思想的形成发展、理论内涵与实践伟力，强调其科学性和真理性，为全面推进美丽中国建设提供思想指导。
articles.summary_en: This article systematically expounds the formation, theoretical connotation, and practical power of Xi Jinping's Thought on Ecological Civilization, emphasizing its scientificity and truthfulness, providing ideological guidance for comprehensively advancing the construction of a Beautiful China.

articles.title_zh: 儿童青少年近视防控成效如何？
articles.title_en: How Effective Are Myopia Prevention and Control Efforts for Children and Adolescents?
articles.summary_zh: 据教育部数据，2021年至2024年全国学生总体近视率实现“四连降”，2024年降至50.3%，较2018年下降3.3个百分点，防控成效稳步显现。
articles.summary_en: According to Ministry of Education data, the national student myopia rate fell for four consecutive years from 2021 to 2024, reaching 50.3% in 2024, down 3.3 percentage points from 2018, showing steady progress in prevention and control.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军陈新武会见农业农村部部长张柱
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun and Chen Xinwu Meet Minister of Agriculture Zhang Zhu
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日下午，重庆市委书记袁家军、代理市长陈新武会见农业农村部部长张柱一行，双方就深化部市合作、推动农业农村现代化等交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 9, Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun and Acting Mayor Chen Xinwu met with Zhang Zhu, Minister of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, to discuss cooperation and rural modernization.

articles.title_en: New Pulse of Intelligent Manufacturing

articles.summary_en: Hunan Daily reports on how data elements empower Hunan's manufacturing industry, with companies like Zoomlion, Xiangsteel, and Sany using industrial large models and algorithms to improve efficiency and quality.

articles.title_zh: 信长星刘小涛检查调度江苏省防御台风“白海豚”工作
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing, Liu Xiaotao Inspect Jiangsu's Typhoon 'Baihaitun' Defense Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日下午，江苏省委书记信长星、省长刘小涛到省防汛抗旱指挥部检查调度台风“白海豚”防御工作，要求落细落实措施、压紧压实责任，确保人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Aug 9, Jiangsu Party Secretary Xin Changxing and Governor Liu Xiaotao inspected the provincial flood control headquarters to coordinate Typhoon Baihaitun defense, urging thorough implementation of measures to ensure people's safety.

articles.summary_zh: 2013年11月，习近平总书记在湘西十八洞村首次提出“精准扶贫”，并说“我是人民的勤务员”，展现为民情怀。
articles.summary_en: In November 2013, General Secretary Xi Jinping first proposed 'targeted poverty alleviation' in Shibadong Village, western Hunan, saying 'I am the people's attendant.'

articles.title_zh: 水利部滚动会商部署台风“白海豚”暴雨洪水防御工作
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Holds Rolling Meeting to Deploy Flood and Typhoon Defense for Typhoon 'White Dolphin'
articles.summary_zh: 水利部10日举行专题会商，分析第13号台风“白海豚”态势，部署暴雨洪水防御工作，强调山洪、水库、堤防等五方面重点。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, the Ministry of Water Resources held a special meeting to analyze Typhoon 'White Dolphin' and redeploy flood and typhoon defense work, emphasizing five key areas including mountain torrents, reservoirs, and dikes.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”开局之年城市地下管网建设观察
articles.title_en: Observing Urban Underground Pipeline Construction in the First Year of the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 十五五开局之年，我国城市地下管网建设加速推进，全国将建设改造约77万公里管网，各地创新施工与智慧监测技术，提升城市安全韧性。
articles.summary_en: In the first year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, China is accelerating urban underground pipeline construction, upgrading about 770,000 km of networks with smart monitoring to enhance urban safety and resilience.

articles.summary_en: From Aug 1-7, the CPC Central Committee and State Council invited 60 expert representatives to a retreat in Beidaihe. On Aug 3, Cai Qi, on behalf of Xi Jinping, visited and encouraged them to strive for the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 两部门紧急预拨1.8亿元中央自然灾害救灾资金
articles.title_en: Two Ministries Allocate 180 Million Yuan for Natural Disaster Relief
articles.summary_zh: 财政部、应急管理部8月10日紧急预拨1.8亿元中央自然灾害救灾资金，支持华东多省防汛防台风和内蒙古、新疆等地抗旱救灾。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Emergency Management urgently allocated 180 million yuan to support flood and typhoon relief in several eastern provinces and drought relief in Inner Mongolia and Xinjiang.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷主持召开台风“白海豚”防御工作视频调度会议
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Chairs Video Conference on Typhoon Defense Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日，浙江省委副书记、省长刘捷在省防汛防台应急指挥中心主持召开台风“白海豚”防御工作视频调度会议，强调聚焦台风登陆关键期，狠抓防御工作落实。
articles.summary_en: On August 9, Liu Jie, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee and Governor, chaired a video conference on typhoon defense at the provincial emergency command center, emphasizing key preparedness as Typhoon Dolphin approaches.

articles.title_zh: 王浩督导检查防台工作 强调坚决打赢防御台风“白海豚”这场硬仗
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Inspects Typhoon Prevention Work, Urges All-Out Effort to Defeat Typhoon Baihaitun
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日，浙江省委书记王浩督导检查防台工作，强调众志成城、全力以赴，坚决打赢防御台风“白海豚”这场硬仗。
articles.summary_en: On August 9, Wang Hao, Secretary of Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee, inspected typhoon prevention efforts and urged a united, all-out effort to win the battle against Typhoon Baihaitun.

articles.title_zh: 学习新语·铸魂强党｜学懂弄通做实党的创新理论
articles.title_en: Learning New Words · Strengthening the Party with Soul: Understanding and Implementing the Party's Innovative Theory
articles.summary_zh: 新华社“学习新语”栏目推出“铸魂强党”系列融合报道，系统梳理党的十八大以来习近平总书记关于用党的创新理论凝心铸魂的重要论述。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua's "Learning New Words" column launched the "Strengthening the Party with Soul" multimedia series, systematically reviewing Xi Jinping's important remarks on uniting the Party with innovative theory since the 18th CPC National Congress.

articles.title_zh: 未来五年 地质灾害防范会有哪些变化？
articles.title_en: What Changes Can Be Expected in Geological Disaster Prevention in the Next Five Years?
articles.summary_zh: 国务院成立灾害调查评估组彻查重庆彭水山体崩塌原因，自然资源部发布“十五五”地质灾害防治实施方案，提出搬迁5万户等目标。
articles.summary_en: The State Council set up an investigation team for a major landslide in Chongqing, and the Ministry of Natural Resources issued a five-year plan for geological disaster prevention, targeting relocation of 50,000 households.

articles.title_zh: 台湾学生低成本游广东Vlog走红：镜头内外，交流升温
articles.title_en: Taiwanese Student's Low-Cost Vlog of Guangdong Goes Viral: Cross-Strait Exchanges Warm Up

articles.title_zh: 霞浦49万吨海洋养殖碳汇挂牌交易
articles.title_en: Xiapu's 490,000 Tons of Marine Aquaculture Carbon Sinks Listed for Trading
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日，霞浦县海洋养殖碳汇项目在福建省海峡资源环境交易中心正式挂牌交易，已签发493931吨碳汇量。
articles.summary_en: On August 8, Xiapu County's marine aquaculture carbon sink project was officially listed for trading at the Fujian Strait Resources and Environment Trading Center, with 493,931 tons of certified carbon sinks put on the market.

articles.title_zh: 福建构建“369”新兴产业和未来产业体系
articles.title_en: Fujian Builds '369' Emerging and Future Industry System
articles.summary_zh: 近日，福建省人民政府印发《福建省“十五五”新兴产业和未来产业发展规划》，提出构建“369”新兴产业和未来产业体系，到2030年工业战略性新兴产业产值占规上工业产值比重达35%左右。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Fujian Provincial People's Government issued the 'Fujian 15th Five-Year Plan for Emerging and Future Industries', proposing a '369' system with strategic emerging industries accounting for about 35% of industrial output by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 总书记点赞的非遗苗绣焕发新生机
articles.title_en: Miao Embroidery Praised by General Secretary Xi Gains New Vitality
articles.summary_zh: 2021年2月，习近平在贵州毕节化屋村考察苗绣产业，称赞苗绣既是文化又是产业；如今苗绣获数字化保护并融入大众生活，助力乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: In February 2021, Xi Jinping visited Huawu Village in Bijie, Guizhou, to inspect Miao embroidery, calling it both culture and industry. Now, Miao embroidery is digitally preserved and enters daily life, boosting rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 习近平与世界遗产：鼓浪琴韵
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and World Heritage: Gulangyu's Musical Charm
articles.summary_zh: 中新社推出微视频，讲述习近平对文化遗产保护的重视，以及厦门鼓浪屿的保护与申遗历程。
articles.summary_en: China News Service releases a micro-video featuring Xi Jinping's commitment to cultural heritage protection, focusing on the preservation and UNESCO listing of Gulangyu in Xiamen.

articles.title_zh: 培育壮大新兴产业和未来产业
articles.title_en: Cultivating and Expanding Emerging and Future Industries
articles.summary_zh: 本文探析培育壮大新兴产业和未来产业的重大意义、现实基础与重点任务，强调把握科技革命机遇，推动经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: This article analyzes the significance, foundations, and key tasks of fostering emerging and future industries, emphasizing seizing technological revolution opportunities for high-quality economic development.

articles.title_zh: 中国零关税举措开启中非经贸合作新阶段——访尼日尔工商会经济专家马加吉
articles.title_en: China's Zero-Tariff Measures Open New Phase of China-Africa Economic Cooperation: Interview with Niger Chamber of Commerce Expert Magagi
articles.summary_zh: 尼日尔工商会经济专家马加吉表示，中国零关税举措开启中非经贸合作新阶段，体现中国支持自由贸易、推动共同发展，为非洲企业创造更多机遇。
articles.summary_en: Magagi, an economic expert at the Niger Chamber of Commerce, said China's zero-tariff measures open a new phase of China-Africa economic cooperation, reflecting China's support for free trade and common development, creating more opportunities for African enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 新能源汽车产业链提速 产业升级筑牢增长支点
articles.title_en: New Energy Vehicle Industry Chain Accelerates, Upgrading Bolsters Growth
articles.summary_zh: 今年上半年新能源汽车产销突破700万辆，产业链协同发力，产业升级筑牢增长支点。
articles.summary_en: In H1 2026, China's new energy vehicle production and sales exceeded 7 million units, with the industry chain driving upgrade and growth.

articles.title_zh: “相信我们将有更多实实在在的合作成果”（中国—吉尔吉斯斯坦媒体高质量共建“一带一路”联合采访）
articles.title_en: Believe We Will Have More Tangible Cooperation Results: China-Kyrgyzstan Media Joint Interview on High-Quality Belt and Road Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日至7日，中吉两国记者在吉尔吉斯斯坦走访共建“一带一路”合作项目，涵盖基础设施、经贸、人文等领域，记录中吉互利合作实践。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 1-7, journalists from China and Kyrgyzstan visited Belt and Road cooperation projects across Kyrgyzstan, covering infrastructure, trade, and people-to-people exchanges, documenting bilateral win-win cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行丨安徽的定力与活力
articles.title_en: Vitality China Research Tour: Anhui's Steadfastness and Vitality
articles.summary_zh: 新华社合肥8月8日电 “活力中国调研行”走进安徽，分析其产业发展的定力与活力，展现其从“小透明”到“网红省份”的逆袭。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua's 'Vitality China' research tour visited Anhui on Aug. 8, analyzing its industrial steadiness and vitality, showing its rise from an unnoticed province to a popular one.

articles.title_zh: 年中经济观察丨以河溪流域为脉 打造乡村振兴示范片区
articles.title_en: Mid-Year Economy Watch: Building Rural Revitalization Demonstration Zones Along River Basins
articles.summary_zh: 福建漳州以河溪流域为脉，实施“一县一溪一特色”项目，连片推进乡村振兴，将生态优势转化为经济优势。
articles.summary_en: Zhangzhou, Fujian, builds rural revitalization demonstration zones along river basins, implementing a 'one county, one river, one feature' project to turn ecological advantages into economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 从“煤电大省”到新能源高地：江苏靠什么加速跨越？
articles.title_en: How Jiangsu Is Leaping from Coal-Power Province to New-Energy Hub
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日至8日，第四届新型电力系统太湖论坛在南京举行，聚焦新型能源体系建设。江苏新能源装机占比超50%，海上风电规模居全国首位。
articles.summary_en: The 4th Taihu Forum on New-Type Power Systems was held in Nanjing on Aug 7-8, focusing on building a new energy system. Jiangsu's renewable energy installed capacity exceeds 50%, with offshore wind power ranking first nationwide.

articles.title_zh: 两年内二度更名：《辽宁民族研究》改为《东北民族研究》
articles.title_en: Liaoning Ethnic Studies Renamed Northeast Ethnic Studies for Second Time in Two Years
articles.summary_zh: 国家新闻出版署2026年7月28日批复同意《辽宁民族研究》更名为《东北民族研究》，出版单位变更为大连民族大学内设编辑部，这是该刊两年内第二次更名。
articles.summary_en: The National Press and Publication Administration approved on July 28, 2026, renaming 'Liaoning Ethnic Studies' to 'Northeast Ethnic Studies', with the publisher changed to an editorial office at Dalian Minzu University, marking the journal's second rename in two years.

articles.title_zh: 新任河北省委书记罗文到西柏坡纪念馆广场，向五大书记塑像敬献花篮、鞠躬致敬
articles.title_en: Luo Wen, New Hebei Party Secretary, Pays Tribute at Xibaipo Memorial
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日，新任河北省委书记罗文到平山县调研，赴西柏坡纪念馆敬献花篮，并走访卫生院和村庄，强调弘扬西柏坡精神、推进乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: On August 8, Luo Wen, the new Party secretary of Hebei, visited Pingshan County, paying respects at the Xibaipo Memorial and stressing the spirit of Xibaipo and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 金昌全力打造千亿级新能源及新能源电池产业
articles.title_en: Jinchang Strives to Build a 100-Billion-Yuan New Energy and Battery Industry
articles.summary_zh: 金昌市依托风光资源和镍钴禀赋，打造千亿级新能源及新能源电池产业，2025年产值达701亿元，计划2030年突破千亿元。
articles.summary_en: Jinchang City leverages its wind-solar resources and nickel-cobalt endowment to build a 100-billion-yuan new energy and battery industry, with output reaching 70.1 billion yuan in 2025 and targeting over 100 billion yuan by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 《林木采种技术》国家标准在张掖启动修订
articles.title_en: National Standard for Forest Seed Collection Enters Revision in Zhangye
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，《林木采种技术》国家标准修订启动暨研讨会在张掖召开，由张掖市林草局和甘肃省祁连山水源涵养林研究院主办。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, the national standard for forest seed collection entered its revision phase at a launch and seminar in Zhangye, hosted by the Zhangye Forestry and Grassland Bureau and the Gansu Qilian Mountain Water Conservation Forest Research Institute.

tags.name_en: Gansu Qilian Mountain Water Conservation Forest Research Institute

tags_zh: 甘肃省祁连山水源涵养林研究院

articles.title_zh: 平陆运河完成首次全航段巡航检查
articles.title_en: Pinglu Canal Completes First Full-Route Cruise Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日至8日，广西海事局派出“海巡1003”船对平陆运河全航段进行首次巡航检查，标志着运河通航实船验证取得突破性进展。
articles.summary_en: From August 7 to 8, the Guangxi Maritime Safety Administration dispatched the patrol ship "Haixun 1003" to conduct the first full-route inspection of the Pinglu Canal, marking a breakthrough in the canal's navigation verification.

articles.title_zh: 河北省部署深化扫黑除恶专项斗争
articles.title_en: Hebei Province Deploys Enhanced Crackdown on Organized Crime
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，河北省召开深化扫黑除恶专项斗争视频会议，省委副书记王陆进强调要扎实开展专项斗争，建设更高水平平安河北。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Hebei Province held a video conference to intensify the special campaign against organized crime. Deputy Party Secretary Wang Lujin stressed the need to carry out the campaign solidly to build a safer Hebei.

articles.title_zh: 扎实做好新时代人民武装工作 不断开创河北省国防动员和后备力量建设新局面
articles.title_en: Luo Wen Stresses Solid People's Armed Forces Work at Hebei Provincial Military Affairs Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，2026年河北省委议军会议在石家庄召开，省委书记罗文讲话，强调做好新时代人民武装工作，开创国防动员和后备力量建设新局面。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the 2026 Hebei Provincial Party Committee Military Affairs Meeting was held in Shijiazhuang. Secretary Luo Wen stressed solid people's armed forces work and new progress in national defense mobilization and reserve force building.

articles.title_zh: 牢记习近平总书记殷切嘱托 大力弘扬西柏坡精神 以更加奋发有为的精神状态走好新的赶考之路
articles.title_en: Luo Wen Stresses Carrying Forward Xibaipo Spirit in Pingshan County Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日，河北省委书记罗文到平山县调研，强调牢记习近平总书记殷切嘱托，大力弘扬西柏坡精神，走好新的赶考之路，并考察基层医疗和乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: On August 8, Luo Wen, Secretary of the CPC Hebei Provincial Committee, visited Pingshan County, emphasizing the need to carry forward the Xibaipo spirit and take the new road of examination, while inspecting grassroots medical care and rural vitalization.

articles.title_zh: 江苏“新”潮涌动制造迭代
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Embraces Innovation-Driven Manufacturing Upgrade
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日，人民日报头版报道江苏以科技创新推动制造业升级，通过攻关核心技术、贯通创新链产业链，培育新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 9, People's Daily front page reported Jiangsu's innovation-driven manufacturing upgrade, achieving breakthroughs in core technologies and fostering new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 尹弘在庐山调研旅游发展和改革推进情况
articles.title_en: Yin Hong Inspects Tourism Development and Reform in Lushan
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日，江西省委书记尹弘在庐山调研旅游发展和改革推进情况，强调做实唱响“庐山天下悠”品牌。
articles.summary_en: On August 8, Yin Hong, Secretary of Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee, inspected Lushan's tourism development and reform, urging to enhance the 'Lushan World Leisure' brand.

articles.title_zh: 江西省级退休干部座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Holds Symposium for Provincial Retired Cadres
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日，江西省召开省级退休干部座谈会，省委书记尹弘主持并传达省委全会精神，省长叶建春通报上半年经济社会发展情况。
articles.summary_en: On August 8, Jiangxi Province held a symposium for provincial retired cadres. Provincial Party Secretary Yin Hong presided and conveyed the spirit of the provincial party committee plenary, while Governor Ye Jianchun briefed on economic and social development in the first half of the year.

articles.title_zh: 为持续推动乡村全面振兴提供保障
articles.title_en: Providing Guarantee for Sustained Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 农业农村领域紧抓整治形式主义为基层减负，通过‘云上赣农’等平台整合服务，减少填表报数，推动乡村全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: The agricultural and rural sectors are intensifying efforts to reduce burdens on grassroots officials by combating formalism, using platforms like 'Cloud Jiangxi Agriculture' to streamline services and boost rural revitalization.

tags_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

articles.title_zh: 宁夏发布2026年第二批向民间资本推介项目
articles.title_en: Ningxia Releases Second Batch of Projects Recommended to Private Capital in 2026
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，宁夏回族自治区发展改革委发布2026年第二批向民间资本推介项目清单，共106个项目，计划总投资650亿元，涵盖新能源、新材料等领域。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the Development and Reform Commission of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region released the second batch of projects recommended to private capital in 2026, with 106 projects totaling 65 billion yuan in planned investment, covering new energy, new materials and other fields.
