articles.title_zh: 青海两大水产产业项目签约落地
articles.title_en: Two Major Aquatic Industry Projects Signed and Launched in Qinghai
articles.summary_zh: 青海省农业农村厅在青洽会期间推动循化县签约两大水产产业项目，总投资1.2亿元，涵盖虹鳟鱼育苗和冷水鱼精深加工。
articles.summary_en: During the 27th Qinghai Green Development Investment and Trade Fair, the Qinghai Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs facilitated the signing of two aquatic industry projects in Xunhua County, with a total investment of 120 million yuan, covering rainbow trout breeding and cold-water fish processing.

tags.name_en: Qinghai Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

tags_en: Qinghai Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

articles.title_zh: 《青海省文化和旅游发展“十五五”规划》出台
articles.title_en: Qinghai Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Cultural and Tourism Development
articles.summary_zh: 近日，青海省政府印发《青海省文化和旅游发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年旅游总人次1亿、总花费1000亿元的目标。
articles.summary_en: The Qinghai provincial government has issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for cultural and tourism development, targeting 100 million tourist trips and 100 billion yuan in tourism spending by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 夏繁科技联盟“十五五”行动方案发布
articles.title_en: Summer Breeding Tech Alliance Unveils 15th Five-Year Action Plan
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日，2026夏繁高地（马尔康）建设暨第二届中国阿坝·夏繁科学家大会在马尔康召开，发布夏繁科技联盟“十五五”行动方案及“揭榜挂帅”科技攻关项目，省政协副主席何树平出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 8, the 2nd China Aba Summer Breeding Scientists Conference in Maerkang released the 15th Five-Year Action Plan and key research projects. He Shuping, Vice Chair of Sichuan CPPCC, attended.

articles.title_zh: 四川省纪委监委：1人被开除党籍 1人被“双开”
articles.title_en: Sichuan Discipline Watchdog: One Ex-Official Expelled from Party, Another from Party and Public Office
articles.summary_zh: 四川省纪委监委通报：成都市原国土资源局巡视员森林被开除党籍，达州市农业农村局原二级调研员朱宏鹏被开除党籍和公职，二人均涉嫌受贿犯罪，已移送检察机关。
articles.summary_en: The Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection announced that Sen Lin, former inspector of Chengdu Land Resources Bureau, was expelled from the CPC, and Zhu Hongpeng, former second-level researcher of Dazhou Agriculture and Rural Bureau, was expelled from the CPC and dismissed from public office, both suspected of bribery and transferred to prosecutors.

tags.name_en: Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection

tags_en: Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection

articles.title_zh: 山东省退役军人思想政治工作现场会在烟台龙口召开
articles.title_en: Shandong Holds On-site Meeting on Veterans' Political Thought Work in Longkou
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，山东省退役军人思想政治工作现场会在龙口市召开，省退役军人厅副厅长高志国出席并讲话，部署推进全省退役军人思想政治工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Shandong Province held an on-site meeting in Longkou to promote political thought work for veterans, attended by Deputy Director Gao Zhiguo of the Provincial Veterans Affairs Department.

articles.title_zh: 山东省出台8项措施拓展深化环评改革
articles.title_en: Shandong Issues 8 Measures to Deepen EIA Reform
articles.summary_zh: 近日，山东省生态环境厅印发通知，提出8项环评改革措施，优化营商环境，为企业减负。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Shandong Provincial Department of Ecology and Environment issued a notice proposing 8 EIA reform measures to optimize the business environment and reduce burdens on enterprises.

tags.name_en: Shandong Provincial Department of Ecology and Environment

tags_en: Shandong Provincial Department of Ecology and Environment

articles.title_zh: 第四届山东（沂水）食品博览会开幕
articles.title_en: 4th Shandong (Yishui) Food Expo Opens
articles.summary_zh: 第四届山东（沂水）食品博览会8月9日在山东临沂沂水县开幕，展示食品产业成果，促进供需对接与国际合作。
articles.summary_en: The 4th Shandong (Yishui) Food Expo opened in Yishui County, Linyi, Shandong, showcasing local food industry achievements and promoting cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 北京市第十七届运动会开幕 尹力宣布开幕 殷勇致开幕辞
articles.title_en: 17th Beijing Municipal Games Open; Yin Li Declares Games Open, Yin Yong Delivers Opening Speech
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日，北京市第十七届运动会在国家体育馆开幕，市委书记尹力宣布开幕，市长殷勇致开幕辞。
articles.summary_en: On August 8, the 17th Beijing Municipal Games opened at the National Indoor Stadium. Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li declared the Games open, and Mayor Yin Yong delivered an opening speech.

articles.title_zh: 国家统计局：7月份CPI同比上涨0.5%
articles.title_en: NBS: China's CPI Rises 0.5% Year-on-Year in July
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局8月9日发布数据，7月全国CPI同比上涨0.5%，PPI同比上涨3.5%，涨幅均有所回落。
articles.summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics released data on Aug 9 showing China's July CPI rose 0.5% year-on-year, while PPI increased 3.5%, with both gains moderating.

articles.title_zh: 以强烈的使命担当勇担复兴重任——习近平党建思想理论品格系列述评之四
articles.title_en: Shouldering the Great Mission of National Rejuvenation with Strong Sense of Responsibility
articles.summary_zh: 新华社述评阐述习近平党建思想强烈的使命担当理论品格，强调发挥伟大工程在'四个伟大'中的决定性作用，推进全面从严治党。
articles.summary_en: An Xinhua commentary expounds the strong sense of mission in Xi Jinping's Party building thought, stressing the decisive role of the great project and full and strict Party self-governance.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚调研广西中医药传承创新发展情况并主持召开中医药工作座谈会
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Surveys Guangxi TCM Inheritance and Innovation and Chairs Work Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚调研中医药传承创新发展并主持座谈会，强调以开放促产业、产学研融合，推动中医药（壮瑶医药）高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Chen Gang, Secretary of the Guangxi Autonomous Regional Party Committee, visited TCM institutions and chaired a symposium, emphasizing open cooperation and industry-academia-research integration to promote high-quality development of Guangxi's TCM (Zhuang and Yao medicine).

articles.title_zh: 刘宁王凯在郑州市督导调研防汛备汛工作
articles.title_en: Liu Ning and Wang Kai Inspect Flood Control Work in Zhengzhou
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日，河南省委书记刘宁、省长王凯在郑州市督导调研防汛备汛工作，强调绷紧防汛安全之弦，守牢安全生产底线。
articles.summary_en: On August 8, Henan Party Secretary Liu Ning and Governor Wang Kai inspected flood control and preparedness in Zhengzhou, stressing safety and disaster prevention.

articles.title_zh: 我省出台对非经贸合作三年行动计划
articles.title_en: Hunan Issues Three-Year Action Plan for Economic and Trade Cooperation with Africa
articles.summary_zh: 近日，《湖南省对非经贸合作三年行动计划（2026-2028年）》经省政府常务会议审议通过并印发，提出到2028年对非进出口额达800亿元，聚焦12个重点非洲国家和六大优势产业。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Hunan provincial government approved and issued the Three-Year Action Plan for Economic and Trade Cooperation with Africa (2026-2028), aiming to reach 80 billion yuan in trade with Africa by 2028, focusing on 12 key African countries and six advantageous industries.

tags.name_en: Economic and Trade Cooperation with Africa

tags_en: Economic and Trade Cooperation with Africa

articles.title_zh: 湖南聚力攻坚，挺进芯片上游“无人区”
articles.title_en: Hunan Pushes into the 'No Man's Land' Upstream of Chips
articles.summary_zh: 2026年初夏，长沙韶光芯材完成近4亿元C+轮融资，累计融资超12亿元。这家深耕光掩模基板40余年的企业，正推动国产半导体材料替代，湖南正构建上游产业链生态。
articles.summary_en: In early summer 2026, Shaoguang Xincai in Changsha closed a nearly 400 million yuan C+ round, raising over 1.2 billion yuan in total. The firm, focused on photomask substrates for 40+ years, is advancing domestic semiconductor materials as Hunan builds an upstream ecosystem.

articles.title_zh: 以深厚的为民情怀增进人民福祉——习近平党建思想理论品格系列述评之五
articles.title_en: Enhancing People's Well-being with Deep Affection for the People: The Fifth Review of Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 新华社8月9日播发述评，系统阐述习近平党建思想的为民情怀，强调以人民为中心的价值取向和理论品格，为管党治党提供根本遵循。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua published a commentary on Aug. 9 elaborating Xi Jinping's thought on Party building, emphasizing people-centered values and deep affection for the people as its core.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 国家防总对上海江西启动防汛防台风四级应急响应
articles.title_en: National Flood Control Headquarters Activates Level-IV Typhoon Response in Shanghai and Jiangxi
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日，国家防总对上海、江西启动防汛防台风四级应急响应，并组织多部门会商部署台风“白海豚”防范应对工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 9, the National Flood Control Headquarters activated a Level-IV emergency response for typhoon defense in Shanghai and Jiangxi and held a joint consultation to deploy measures against Typhoon Beluga.

articles.title_zh: 国防部征兵办公室印发征兵工作人员职业道德准则
articles.title_en: Ministry of National Defense Conscription Office Issues Code of Professional Ethics for Conscription Staff
articles.summary_zh: 8月9日，国防部征兵办公室印发《征兵工作人员职业道德准则》，向社会公开并自公布之日起施行，提出25条具体道德规范。
articles.summary_en: On August 9, the Ministry of National Defense Conscription Office issued the Code of Professional Ethics for Conscription Staff, effective from the date of publication, with 25 specific ethical norms.

articles.title_zh: 王浩在全省防御应对台风“白海豚”工作视频调度会上强调 狠抓落实一贯到底 确保交出防汛防台高分答卷
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Stresses Thorough Implementation at Provincial Conference on Defense Against Typhoon Baihaitun
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日，浙江省委书记王浩在全省防御台风“白海豚”工作视频调度会上强调，以工作确定性应对台风不确定性，确保交出防汛防台高分答卷。
articles.summary_en: On August 8, at a provincial video conference on defense against Typhoon Baihaitun, Wang Hao, Secretary of CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee, stressed using certainty in work to counter typhoon uncertainty and ensuring successful flood and typhoon prevention.

articles.title_zh: 最是真情暖人心——中国元首外交的世界情怀与大国气派
articles.title_en: Warmest Feelings Touch Hearts: World Vision and Great-Power Manner of China's Head-of-State Diplomacy
articles.summary_zh: 新华社8月6日播发综述，回顾习近平主席在国际交往中与普通民众亲切互动的温暖瞬间，展现中国元首外交的人民情怀与世界胸怀。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua published a review on August 6, recalling warm moments of President Xi Jinping's cordial interactions with ordinary people during international engagements, showcasing the people-centered vision and global breadth of China's head-of-state diplomacy.

articles.title_zh: “福建智造”助力“妈祖”方案海外应用
articles.title_en: Fujian's Smart Tech Boosts Overseas Application of 'Mazu' Early Warning Scheme
articles.summary_zh: 福建省气象部门近日介绍，将发挥技术优势支持中国气象局‘妈祖’方案海外应用，已建成智能预报技术体系并纳入该方案。
articles.summary_en: Fujian meteorological authorities said they will leverage technical advantages to support the overseas application of CMA's 'Mazu' early warning scheme, having integrated its intelligent forecasting system into it.

articles.title_zh: 交通运输部启动台风二级防御响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Transport Activates Level-II Typhoon Defense Response
articles.summary_zh: 交通运输部8月8日启动台风二级防御响应，应对第13号台风“白海豚”带来的大风和强降雨影响。
articles.summary_en: On August 8, the Ministry of Transport activated a Level-II typhoon defense response to cope with strong winds and heavy rain brought by Typhoon Dolphin.

articles.title_zh: 气象智能预警方案“妈祖”正加快全球推广应用
articles.title_en: Mazu Weather Early Warning Solution Accelerates Global Deployment
articles.summary_zh: 中国气象局国际合作司司长张兴赢8月5日在福建湄洲岛受访表示，“妈祖”气象智能预警方案已在多国落地，未来将加快在全球推广，推动30个国家定制化应用。
articles.summary_en: Zhang Xingying, director of the International Cooperation Department of the China Meteorological Administration, said on Meizhou Island that the Mazu early warning solution has been adopted in many countries and will be promoted globally, targeting customized deployment in 30 countries.

articles.title_zh: 国家防总对江苏安徽启动防汛防台风四级应急响应
articles.title_en: National Flood Control Headquarters Activates Level-IV Emergency Response for Jiangsu and Anhui
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日，国家防总对江苏、安徽启动防汛防台风四级应急响应，部署防御第13号台风“白海豚”，强调全面转移避险、排查风险隐患。
articles.summary_en: On August 8, the National Flood Control Headquarters activated a Level-IV emergency response for flood and typhoon prevention in Jiangsu and Anhui, deploying measures against Typhoon Baidolphin, including evacuation and risk screening.

articles.title_zh: 中国东方电气集团有限公司原董事宋致远被查
articles.title_en: Song Zhiyuan, Former Director of Dongfang Electric Group, Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日，中国东方电气集团有限公司原党组副书记、董事宋致远涉嫌严重违纪违法，接受中央纪委国家监委纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: On August 8, Song Zhiyuan, former deputy Party secretary and director of Dongfang Electric Group, is under disciplinary and supervisory investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

tags.name_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

tags_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

articles.title_zh: 总书记引经据典话廉政（一）
articles.title_en: General Secretary Quotes Classics on Clean Governance (I)
articles.summary_zh: 文章梳理习近平总书记关于廉政文化的经典引用，推出系列学习内容第一期，引导党员干部正心修身。
articles.summary_en: The article compiles General Secretary Xi Jinping's classic quotes on clean governance, launching the first part of a learning series to guide officials in self-cultivation.

articles.title_zh: 中国东方电气集团原党组副书记、董事宋致远被查
articles.title_en: Song Zhiyuan, Former Deputy Party Secretary of Dongfang Electric, under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 中央纪委国家监委8月8日通报，中国东方电气集团原党组副书记、董事宋致远涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: On Aug. 8, the CCDI and National Supervisory Commission announced that Song Zhiyuan, former deputy Party secretary and director of Dongfang Electric Group, is under review and investigation for suspected serious disciplinary and legal violations.

articles.title_zh: 杭州欧美同学会聚力浙西发展 海归人才共话创新创业
articles.title_en: Hangzhou Western Returned Scholars Association Boosts Development of Western Zhejiang
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日至7日，杭州欧美同学会在杭州建德举行工作交流暨浙西海归创新创业推进活动，旨在凝聚海归人才力量，推动区域交流合作。会长叶鉴铭出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 6 to 7, the Hangzhou Western Returned Scholars Association held a working exchange and innovation event in Jiande, Hangzhou, to rally overseas returnees for regional development. President Ye Jianming attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 新思想引领新征程丨服务消费扩容升级 激发内需新活力
articles.title_en: New Ideas Lead New Journey | Service Consumption Expands and Upgrades to Stimulate New Vitality in Domestic Demand
articles.summary_zh: 服务消费持续扩容升级，今年上半年服务零售额同比增长5.3%，居民服务性消费支出占比达45.7%，成为拉动内需重要引擎。
articles.summary_en: Service consumption continues to expand and upgrade, with service retail sales up 5.3% year-on-year in H1 and service spending accounting for 45.7% of residents' consumption, becoming a key engine for domestic demand.

articles.title_zh: 健康中国建设综述：全民健身与全民健康深度融合
articles.title_en: Overview of Healthy China Initiative: Deep Integration of National Fitness and Public Health
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日迎来第十八个全民健身日，文章综述健康中国建设成就，涵盖公共卫生、医疗服务、健康生活方式等，强调全民健身与全民健康深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On August 8, the 18th National Fitness Day, this article reviews achievements in the Healthy China initiative, covering public health, medical services, and healthy lifestyles, emphasizing deep integration of national fitness and public health.

articles.title_zh: 共享制造，生产也能“拼单”
articles.title_en: Shared Manufacturing: Production Can Also 'Pool Orders'
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局会议强调发展新兴支柱产业后，共享制造模式在北京、四川眉山、山东新泰等地兴起，通过共享工厂、检验检测平台和喷涂中心等助力产业降本增效。
articles.summary_en: Following a CPC Central Committee Political Bureau meeting emphasizing new pillar industries, shared manufacturing is emerging in Beijing, Sichuan's Meishan, and Shandong's Xintai, using shared factories, testing platforms, and coating centers to boost efficiency and cut costs.

articles.title_zh: 规上文化企业营收同比增长4.6%
articles.title_en: Revenue of Large Cultural Enterprises Up 4.6% Year on Year
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局数据显示，上半年全国规模以上文化及相关产业企业实现营业收入72026亿元，同比增长4.6%。
articles.summary_en: According to the National Bureau of Statistics, revenue of large cultural and related enterprises reached 7.2026 trillion yuan in H1, up 4.6% year on year.

articles.title_zh: 上半年规上轻工业实现营收11.2万亿元
articles.title_en: Light Industry Above Designated Size Achieves Revenue of 11.2 Trillion Yuan in H1
articles.summary_zh: 中国轻工业联合会发布数据显示，上半年规模以上轻工业增加值同比增长5.0%，营业收入11.2万亿元，可穿戴智能设备零售额增速超一倍。
articles.summary_en: China Light Industry Council data shows H1 value-added output above designated size grew 5.0% YoY, revenue reaching 11.2 trillion yuan, with wearable device retail sales more than doubling.

articles.title_zh: 努力提升粮食能源资源安全保障能力（总书记的人民情怀）
articles.title_en: Striving to Enhance Food, Energy and Resource Security: The General Secretary's Devotion to the People
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记7月30日主持中共中央政治局会议，要求统筹发展和安全、抓好农业生产，并回顾其在多地考察时强调粮食和能源安全的重要性。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, General Secretary Xi Jinping chaired a CPC Central Political Bureau meeting, urging coordinated development and security and ensuring a good autumn harvest, while recalling his inspections stressing the importance of food and energy security.

articles.title_zh: 我国外汇储备规模为34188亿美元
articles.title_en: China's Foreign Exchange Reserves Hit $3.4188 Trillion
articles.summary_zh: 截至7月末，我国外汇储备规模为34188亿美元，较6月末上升25亿美元，升幅0.07%，经济展现韧性和活力。
articles.summary_en: As of end-July, China's foreign exchange reserves reached $3,418.8 billion, up $2.5 billion from end-June, reflecting economic resilience.

articles.title_zh: 前7月我国货物贸易进出口同比增长17.3%
articles.title_en: China's Foreign Trade Up 17.3% in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 据海关统计，今年前7月我国货物贸易进出口总值30.13万亿元，同比增长17.3%，其中出口增长14%，进口增长22%。
articles.summary_en: According to customs statistics, China's total goods trade in the first seven months reached 30.13 trillion yuan, up 17.3% year-on-year, with exports rising 14% and imports 22%.

articles.title_zh: 紧紧抓住那些惠及面广、牵一发而动全身的工作——突出重点推进健康中国建设观察
articles.title_en: Focus on Key Tasks with Broad Benefits to Advance Healthy China Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日全民健身日，文章观察我国健康中国建设成效，强调健全公共卫生体系、建设优质高效医疗服务体系、倡导健康文明生活方式等重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On China's National Fitness Day, this article reviews progress in building a Healthy China, highlighting priorities in public health systems, high-quality medical services, and healthy lifestyles.

articles.title_zh: 让古老的“砖石”讲述中国故事
articles.title_en: Ancient 'Bricks and Stones' Tell China's Story at Berlin Exhibition
articles.summary_zh: 8月，“天府乐土·四川汉代画像艺术展”在德国柏林中国文化中心举行，通过画像砖、拓片、民乐等展示汉代巴蜀文化，促进中德文化交流。
articles.summary_en: In August, the 'Sichuan Han Dynasty Art Exhibition' is held at the Chinese Cultural Center in Berlin, featuring brick reliefs, rubbings and folk music to showcase Han-era Bashu culture and boost Sino-German cultural exchange.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠就深化走遍长春行动做好城市更新工作开展调研
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui Surveys Urban Renewal Work in Changchun
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，长春市委书记张恩惠调研城市更新工作，实地查看大冬会场馆改造、供热、净水和加装电梯等民生项目，强调问需于民、问计于民、问效于民，推动城市建设管理再上新台阶。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Zhang Enhui, Secretary of the Changchun Municipal Party Committee, inspected urban renewal work, visiting projects including Winter Universiade venues, heating supply, water purification, and elevator installations, emphasizing a people-centered approach to improve urban management.

articles.title_zh: 总书记的人民情怀
articles.title_en: The General Secretary's Devotion to the People
articles.summary_zh: 文章阐述习近平总书记对扩大内需的重视，强调扩大内需是战略之举，并回顾其在各地考察及政策部署，指出内需拉动经济增长，增进民生福祉。
articles.summary_en: The article expounds on General Secretary Xi Jinping's emphasis on expanding domestic demand as a strategic move, reviewing his inspections and policy deployments, and noting that domestic demand drives economic growth and improves people's wellbeing.

articles.title_zh: 霍步刚主持召开市委专题会议时强调 着力谋实高质量项目 扎实推进“六张网”等规划建设
articles.title_en: Huo Bugang Chairs Municipal Party Committee Special Meeting on High-Quality Projects and 'Six Networks' Planning
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，沈阳市召开专题会议，听取“六张网”等项目汇报，市委书记霍步刚主持并讲话，强调谋划高质量项目，推进规划建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Shenyang held a special meeting to review projects like the "Six Networks". Municipal Party Secretary Huo Bugang presided and stressed planning high-quality projects.

articles.title_zh: 上半年我国医药工业创新加速突破
articles.title_en: China's Pharmaceutical Industry Accelerates Innovation in First Half of Year
articles.summary_zh: 今年上半年，我国医药工业创新加速突破，38款创新药获批上市，其中国产31款，11个新靶点药品全部自主研，产业动能持续增强。
articles.summary_en: In the first half of this year, China's pharmaceutical industry accelerated innovation with 38 innovative drugs approved, 31 being domestically developed, and all 11 new-target drugs independently researched, boosting industrial momentum.

articles.title_zh: 上半年我国经营主体结构持续优化
articles.title_en: China's Business Entities Structure Continues to Optimize in H1
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日，市场监管总局公布数据显示，上半年我国经营主体结构持续优化，新兴产业和未来产业企业保持增长，高技术制造业增势强劲。
articles.summary_en: On August 8, the State Administration for Market Regulation released data showing China's business entity structure continued to optimize in H1, with emerging and future industries growing and high-tech manufacturing booming.

articles.title_zh: 各美其美，美美与共——中国元首外交的世界情怀与大国气派
articles.title_en: Beauty in Diversity, Harmony in Sharing: The Global Vision and Magnanimity of China's Head-of-State Diplomacy
articles.summary_zh: 新华社综述回顾习近平主席在联合国教科文组织、墨西哥奇琴伊察等地关于文明交流互鉴的重要论述，展现中国元首外交的世界情怀与大国气派。
articles.summary_en: An Xinhua review recalls President Xi Jinping's remarks on civilizational exchanges and mutual learning at UNESCO headquarters, Chichen Itza and other places, demonstrating the global vision and broad-mindedness of China's head-of-state diplomacy.

articles.title_zh: 前7月我国货物贸易进出口同比增长17.3%
articles.title_en: China's Foreign Trade Up 17.3% in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 据海关统计，今年前7月我国货物贸易进出口总值30.13万亿元，同比增长17.3%，其中出口增长14%，进口增长22%。
articles.summary_en: China's total goods trade reached 30.13 trillion yuan in Jan-Jul, up 17.3% year-on-year, with exports up 14% and imports up 22%, according to customs data.

articles.title_zh: 新订单指数回升 物流业景气指数保持在扩张区间
articles.title_en: New Orders Index Rebounds, Logistics Industry Prosperity Index Stays in Expansion Zone
articles.summary_zh: 中国物流与采购联合会数据显示，7月物流业景气指数为50.4%，保持在扩张区间，新订单指数连续5个月回升。
articles.summary_en: China Federation of Logistics & Purchasing data shows July logistics prosperity index at 50.4%, remaining in expansion territory, with new orders index rising for fifth consecutive month.

articles.title_zh: 总书记的人民情怀
articles.title_en: The General Secretary's People-first Sentiment
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记强调坚持高质量发展和高水平安全相互促进，多次考察调研并部署粮食和能源安全工作，确保粮食和能源供给稳定。
articles.summary_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping stresses promoting both high-quality development and high-level security, conducting inspections and deployments to safeguard food and energy supply stability.

articles.title_zh: 上半年规上轻工业实现营收11.2万亿元
articles.title_en: Above-Scale Light Industry Achieves 11.2 Trillion Yuan Revenue in H1
articles.summary_zh: 中国轻工业联合会发布数据显示，上半年规模以上轻工业增加值同比增长5.0%，实现营业收入11.2万亿元；轻工商品出口4870.4亿美元，同比增长6.7%，消费升级趋势明显。
articles.summary_en: The China Light Industry Federation reported a 5.0% year-on-year growth in value-added output of above-scale light industry in H1 2026, with operating revenue reaching 11.2 trillion yuan. Exports of light industrial goods rose 6.7% to $487.04 billion.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市长顾坤接待信访群众
articles.title_en: Huai'an Mayor Gu Kun Receives Petitioners
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，淮安市市长顾坤到市人民来访接待中心开展接访活动并调研信访工作，强调要用心用情用力解决群众急难愁盼。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Huai'an Mayor Gu Kun visited the city's petition reception center to receive petitioners and inspect petition work, stressing efforts to resolve people's urgent concerns.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市委书记史志军到金湖县调研
articles.title_en: Shi Zhijun, Secretary of Huai'an Municipal Party Committee, Investigates Jinhu County
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，淮安市委书记史志军到金湖县调研，走访企业项目，召开座谈会，强调经济运行稳中有进、提质增效。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Shi Zhijun, Secretary of Huai'an Municipal Party Committee, visited Jinhu County to inspect enterprises and projects, chaired a symposium, and emphasized stable and high-quality economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 高靖生赴部分县（区）调研经济社会发展情况

articles.title_zh: 创新涌动，坚韧向前——解读前7个月我国外贸成绩单
articles.title_en: Innovation Surges, Resilience Endures: Interpreting China's Foreign Trade Performance in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 海关总署8月7日发布数据显示，今年前7个月我国货物贸易进出口30.13万亿元，同比增长17.3%，机电产品出口占比超六成，外贸向高端化、智能化、绿色化转型。
articles.summary_en: Customs data on Aug 7 showed China's goods trade reached 30.13 trillion yuan in the first seven months, up 17.3% year on year, with mechanical and electrical products accounting for over 60% of exports.

articles.title_zh: 让内需成为经济发展的主动力
articles.title_en: Let Domestic Demand Become the Main Driver of Economic Development
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记强调扩大内需是战略之举，今年中央政治局会议部署加力扩大内需、优化供给，内需已成为拉动经济增长的主动力。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping emphasized that expanding domestic demand is a strategic move. The CPC Central Committee Politburo meeting deployed measures to boost domestic demand and improve supply, making it a major driver of economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 国际奥委会发布报告 聚焦网络恶意攻击与体育
articles.title_en: IOC Issues Report on Cyber Abuse and Sport
articles.summary_zh: 国际奥委会发布报告《网络恶意攻击与体育》，聚焦2024年巴黎奥运会和2026年米兰-科尔蒂纳冬奥会，甄别出近2.5万条攻击性内容。
articles.summary_en: IOC issues report "Cyber Abuse and Sport" focusing on Paris 2024 and Milan-Cortina 2026, identifying nearly 25,000 abusive posts.

articles.title_zh: 坚持民生优先 推动学习教育成果落到实处
articles.title_en: Prioritizing People's Livelihood to Turn Learning Education Achievements into Practice
articles.summary_zh: 学习开展以来，吉林长春、内蒙古兴安盟一体推进学查改，聚焦群众急难愁盼问题，推动整改落实。
articles.summary_en: Since launching the campaign, Changchun and Hinggan League have advanced study, investigation, and rectification together, solving pressing problems and delivering tangible results.

articles.title_zh: “人工智能+”，解锁更多新可能
articles.title_en: 'AI+' Unlocks New Possibilities
articles.summary_zh: 光明日报报道，人工智能正深入融入经济社会各领域，应用场景加速拓展，自主创新步伐加快。国家发展改革委表示将统筹高质量发展和高水平安全，加快人工智能法立法进程。
articles.summary_en: Guangming Daily reports AI is deeply integrating into economy and society, with expanding applications and faster independent innovation. NDRC pledges balanced development and safety, accelerating AI legislation.

articles.title_zh: 王浩在全省防御应对13号台风“白海豚”工作视频调度会上强调 狠抓落实一贯到底 以工作确定性应对台风不确定性 确保交出防汛防台高分答卷
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Emphasizes Solid Implementation at Provincial Video Conference on Typhoon 'White Dolphin' Defense
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日，浙江省委省政府召开防御台风“白海豚”视频调度会，省委书记王浩强调狠抓落实，确保防汛防台安全。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 8, Zhejiang provincial party committee and government held a video conference on typhoon 'White Dolphin' defense; Party Secretary Wang Hao stressed implementation to ensure flood and typhoon safety.

articles.title_zh: 上半年新能源重卡销量再创新高
articles.title_en: New Energy Heavy Truck Sales Hit New High in H1
articles.summary_zh: 今年上半年全国新能源重卡累计销量约14万辆，同比增长78.6%，国家安排220亿元超长期特别国债支持老旧营运货车报废更新。
articles.summary_en: In the first half of this year, sales of new energy heavy trucks in China reached about 140,000 units, up 78.6% year-on-year, with 22 billion yuan in ultra-long-term special treasury bonds supporting scrapping and renewal of old trucks.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行丨弯道超车 如何“皖”美提速
articles.title_en: Vitality China Survey: How Anhui's Auto Industry Overtakes on the Curve
articles.summary_zh: 央视“活力中国调研行”走进安徽，报道其汽车产业五年间从全国第八跃居第一，2025年产量、新能源汽车产量和出口量均居全国首位。
articles.summary_en: CCTV's Vitality China Survey visits Anhui, reporting that its auto industry rose from 8th to 1st in China in five years, leading the country in production, NEV output, and exports in 2025.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省政府与华为签署深化战略合作协议
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Government and Huawei Sign Deepened Strategic Cooperation Agreement
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，江苏省政府与华为在南京签署深化战略合作协议，双方将以人工智能为核心深化全方位合作，省长刘小涛会见华为轮值董事长徐直军并见证签约。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 6, Jiangsu and Huawei signed a deepening strategic cooperation agreement in Nanjing, focusing on AI. Governor Liu Xiaotao met Huawei's rotating chairman Xu Zhijun and witnessed the signing.

articles.title_zh: 江苏部署防御台风“白海豚”工作
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Deploys Defensive Work Against Typhoon "Baitun"
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，江苏省政府部署防御台风“白海豚”工作，要求加强预警、排查隐患、转移人员，确保人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the Jiangsu provincial government deployed measures against Typhoon "Baitun," emphasizing early warning, hazard inspection, and evacuation to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 原北京军区副司令员兼北京军区空军司令员李永金逝世，享年84岁
articles.title_en: Li Yongjin, Former Deputy Commander of Beijing Military Region and Commander of Beijing Military Region Air Force, Dies at 84
articles.summary_zh: 原北京军区副司令员兼北京军区空军司令员李永金因病医治无效，于2026年8月6日在北京逝世，享年84岁。
articles.summary_en: Li Yongjin, former deputy commander of Beijing Military Region and commander of its air force, died of illness in Beijing on August 6, 2026, at age 84.

articles.title_zh: 抗美援朝老战士、著名沉积地质学家郭云麟逝世
articles.title_en: Guo Yunlin, Veteran of War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea and Renowned Sedimentary Geologist, Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 抗美援朝老战士、著名沉积地质学家、原地质矿产部地质研究所党委书记兼所长郭云麟因病医治无效，于2026年8月6日在北京逝世，享年94岁。
articles.summary_en: Guo Yunlin, veteran of the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea, renowned sedimentologist, and former Party chief of the Institute of Geology, passed away in Beijing at 94 on Aug 6, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 央视中文国际频道迎来新主播孙亚鹏、李秋莹
articles.title_en: CCTV-4 Welcomes New Anchors Sun Yapeng and Li Qiuying
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日至7日，央视中文国际频道的《中国新闻》栏目迎来新主播孙亚鹏和李秋莹，两人均为2025年中央广播电视总台主持人大赛（新闻主播季）的参与者。
articles.summary_en: On August 6-7, CCTV-4's China News program welcomed new anchors Sun Yapeng and Li Qiuying, both participants of the 2025 CMG Host Competition (News Anchor Season).

articles.title_zh: 北京获评2029年“世界建筑之都”称号
articles.title_en: Beijing Named 2029 World Capital of Architecture
articles.summary_zh: 联合国教科文组织5日正式授予北京2029年“世界建筑之都”称号，北京成为全球第四座获此殊荣的城市，将主办2029年第30届世界建筑师大会。
articles.summary_en: UNESCO officially designated Beijing as the World Capital of Architecture for 2029, making it the fourth city to receive this honor and host of the 30th World Congress of Architects.

articles.title_zh: 全国数标委明确：所谓“数据国家标准编制费”系冒名收取
articles.title_en: National Data Standards Committee Clarifies: 'Data National Standard Compilation Fee' Is Fraudulent
articles.summary_zh: 全国数据标准化技术委员会秘书处发表声明，否认以“标准挂名”“参编署名”等名义收取费用，提醒公众警惕冒名收费诈骗。
articles.summary_en: The Secretariat of the National Data Standardization Technical Committee issued a statement denying any fees under the guise of standard listing or compilation, warning against fraudulent collection.

tags_zh: 全国数据标准化技术委员会

articles.title_zh: 青海发布三项拉面地方标准 推动产业标准化品牌化
articles.title_en: Qinghai Issues Three Local Standards for Lamian Noodles to Boost Industrial Standardization and Branding
articles.summary_zh: 近日，青海省市场监督管理局发布三项青海拉面地方标准，涵盖品质、赛事和区域品牌，旨在推动拉面产业标准化、品牌化发展。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Qinghai Provincial Administration for Market Regulation issued three local standards for Qinghai lamian noodles, covering quality, events, and regional branding, to promote standardized and branded development of the industry.

articles.title_zh: 衣昕玉、苗鉴、程龙、谯禾林4名烈士被追授为“中国武警忠诚卫士”
articles.title_en: Four Martyrs Posthumously Conferred with 'Loyal Guard of Chinese Armed Police' Title
articles.summary_zh: 武警部队追授衣昕玉、苗鉴、程龙、谯禾林4名烈士“中国武警忠诚卫士”称号。
articles.summary_en: The Armed Police Force posthumously conferred the title of 'Loyal Guard of Chinese Armed Police' on four martyrs: Yi Xinyu, Miao Jian, Cheng Long, and Qiao Helin.

articles.title_zh: 江淮新能源EZ6全新上市
articles.title_en: JAC New Energy EZ6 Officially Launched
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，江淮新能源EZ6在合肥正式上市，举行大客户战略签约仪式，该车为城配纯电轻卡，主打低能耗与高性价比。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, JAC's new energy EZ6 was officially launched in Hefei, with a strategic signing ceremony for key customers. The pure electric light truck targets urban delivery with low energy consumption and high cost performance.

articles.title_zh: 222个服务业项目签约
articles.title_en: 222 Service Industry Projects Signed in Hefei
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日记者从合肥市投资促进局获悉，上半年全市新签约重点服务业项目222个，其中生产性服务业项目153个。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the Hefei Investment Promotion Bureau reported that 222 key service industry projects were signed in the first half of the year, including 153 producer service projects.

articles.title_zh: 重庆野生动物保护新规11月1日起实施
articles.title_en: Chongqing Wildlife Protection Regulations to Take Effect Nov 1
articles.summary_zh: 重庆市人大常委会通过新修订的野生动物保护规定，将于2026年11月1日施行，明确禁止利用无人机等科技手段猎捕，并强化放生规范和信用惩戒。
articles.summary_en: Chongqing's newly revised wildlife protection regulations, passed by the municipal people's congress, take effect on Nov 1, 2026, banning high-tech hunting tools and strengthening release and credit penalties.

articles.title_zh: 福建省召开赓续实施新时代“堡垒工程”推进会
articles.title_en: Fujian Holds Meeting to Advance the New Era "Fortress Project"
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，福建省深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想、赓续实施新时代“堡垒工程”推进会在福州召开。省委书记周祖翼出席并讲话，强调夯实基层党建，做好村（社区）“两委”换届工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, a meeting to study Xi Jinping's thought on Party building and advance the new-era "Fortress Project" was held in Fuzhou, Fujian Province. Provincial Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi attended and stressed strengthening grassroots Party organizations and village-level leadership transitions.

articles.title_zh: 台青走进政协：从“受益者”到“建言者”
articles.title_en: Taiwan Youth Engage with CPPCC: From "Beneficiaries" to "Advisors"
articles.summary_zh: 在闽台湾青年通过参与政协协商，从政策受益者转变为公共事务参与者，多名台青的提案被采纳并落实。
articles.summary_en: Taiwan youth in Fujian have transformed from policy beneficiaries to public affairs participants through CPPCC consultative democracy, with their proposals adopted and implemented.

articles.title_zh: 福建省委常委会召开会议 认真学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Fujian Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Study and Implement Xi Jinping's Important Speech Spirit
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，福建省委书记周祖翼主持召开省委常委会会议，学习中央政治局会议等精神，研究贯彻落实措施。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Fujian Provincial Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi presided over a Standing Committee meeting to study the spirit of key central meetings and deliberate on implementation measures.

articles.title_zh: 油橄榄国家林业和草原局重点实验室启动
articles.title_en: Key Laboratory of Oil Olive of National Forestry and Grassland Administration Launched
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，油橄榄国家林业和草原局重点实验室启动会暨第一届学术委员会会议在兰州举行，将为全国油橄榄产业高质量发展提供科技支撑。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the launch meeting of the Key Laboratory of Oil Olive of the National Forestry and Grassland Administration was held in Lanzhou, providing scientific support for the high-quality development of the oil olive industry.

articles.title_zh: 河南省委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Henan Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，省委书记刘宁主持召开省委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要文章《加快建设健康中国》，部署多项工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Secretary Liu Ning chaired the Henan Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee meeting, conveying and studying General Secretary Xi Jinping's important article on accelerating the construction of a Healthy China and making arrangements for various tasks.

articles.title_zh: 筑牢粮食安全根基 推动农业强省建设
articles.title_en: Securing Food Security Foundation to Promote Agricultural Province Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日至7日，河南省人大常委会副主任张弓带队赴安阳、新乡，就推动农业强省建设、保障粮食安全开展调研。
articles.summary_en: From August 5 to 7, Zhang Gong, deputy director of the Standing Committee of Henan Provincial People's Congress, led a delegation to Anyang and Xinxiang to investigate agricultural development and food security.

articles.title_zh: 湖北：促进形成区域经济投入产出总体平衡与良性循环的发展格局
articles.title_en: Hubei Promotes Balanced Regional Economic Input-Output and Virtuous Cycle
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日上午，湖北省省长李殿勋主持召开省政府专题会议，研究统筹推进国有“三资”管理改革、财政零基预算改革和投融资体制改革，促进区域经济平衡发展。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 7, Hubei Governor Li Dianxun chaired a provincial government meeting to advance reforms on state-owned assets, zero-based budgeting, and investment/financing, aiming for balanced regional economic development.

articles.title_zh: 湖北首个宇树科技产业学院成立
articles.title_en: Hubei's First Unitree Technology Industry College Established
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，长江工程职业技术学院与宇树科技共建的湖北省首个宇树科技产业学院正式成立，旨在培养具身智能机器人领域高技能人才。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the first Unitree Technology Industry College in Hubei was jointly established by Changjiang Engineering Vocational and Technical College and Unitree Technology, aiming to cultivate skilled talents in embodied intelligent robots.

articles.title_en: Hainan Provincial Party Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speech and Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，海南省委常委会（扩大）会议召开，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和重要指示精神，研究部署全面从严治党、经济发展、深化扫黑除恶专项斗争等工作，省委书记冯飞主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the Standing Committee of the Hainan Provincial Party Committee held an enlarged meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech and instructions, arranging work on full and strict Party governance, economic development, and deepening the anti-gang campaign. The meeting was chaired by provincial party secretary Feng Fei.

articles.title_zh: 从“三个时间刻度”感悟新时代中国
articles.title_en: Understanding the New Era China through 'Three Time Markers'
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报发表评论文章，从三个时间刻度感悟新时代中国，强调同时间赛跑、奋进新征程，展现中国在脱贫、科技、国际担当等方面成就。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily commentary reflects on the new era China through three time markers, emphasizing racing with time and striving, showcasing achievements in poverty alleviation, technology, and international responsibility.

articles.title_zh: 江苏推出4项增量措施优化自然资源要素保障
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Unveils Four Incremental Measures to Optimize Natural Resource Support
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，江苏省自然资源厅召开新闻发布会，解读《关于进一步优化自然资源要素保障有关措施的通知》，推出完善成片开发征收土地报批等四项增量措施，以服务重大项目建设和高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 7, Jiangsu Provincial Department of Natural Resources held a press conference to interpret a notice on further optimizing natural resource guarantee, introducing four measures to streamline land and forest use approval for major projects and high-quality development.

tags.name_en: Jiangsu Provincial Department of Natural Resources

tags_en: Jiangsu Provincial Department of Natural Resources

articles.title_zh: 中共江西省委十五届十次全会举行
articles.title_en: 10th Plenary Session of 15th CPC Jiangxi Provincial Committee Held
articles.summary_zh: 中共江西省委十五届十次全会8月7日在南昌召开，审议通过关于召开省第十六次党代会的决议，部署下一步工作。
articles.summary_en: The 10th plenary session of the 15th CPC Jiangxi Provincial Committee was held in Nanchang on Aug 7, 2026, approving a resolution to convene the 16th Provincial Party Congress and outlining future work.

articles.title_zh: 江西体彩2025年社会责任报告发布
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Sports Lottery Releases 2025 Social Responsibility Report
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，江西省体育彩票2025年社会责任报告发布会在九江市举行，公布2025年全省销售体育彩票105.07亿元，筹集公益金24.4亿元。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the release conference of Jiangxi Sports Lottery's 2025 Social Responsibility Report was held in Jiujiang, announcing sales of 10.507 billion yuan and public welfare fund of 2.44 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Study Xi Jinping's Recent Important Speeches and Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，自治区党委常委会召开会议，传达学习中央政治局会议精神和习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署贯彻落实工作，王伟中主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the Standing Committee of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Regional Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study the spirit of the Political Bureau meeting and Xi Jinping's important speeches, with Wang Weizhong presiding.

tags.name_en: Full and Strict Governance over the Party

articles.title_zh: 王伟中包钢会见刘铁祥曲光吉并共同见证签约
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong and Bao Gang Meet Liu Tiexiang and Qu Guangji and Witness Signing
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中、主席包钢在呼和浩特会见中航集团董事长刘铁祥、总经理曲光吉，并见证双方签署战略合作框架协议。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Wang Weizhong, Party Secretary of Inner Mongolia, and Bao Gang, Chairman of the Regional Government, met with Liu Tiexiang and Qu Guangji, Chairman and GM of Air China Group, in Hohhot and witnessed the signing of a strategic cooperation framework agreement.

articles.title_zh: 青海省政府召开党组会议和常务会议
articles.title_en: Qinghai Provincial Government Holds Party Leadership Group Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，青海省政府党组书记、省长罗东川主持召开省政府党组会议和常务会议，传达学习中央精神，研究部署经济运行、碳达峰、生态规划等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Luo Dongchuan, Secretary of the Party Leadership Group and Governor of Qinghai, chaired the provincial government's Party group and executive meetings to convey central directives and arrange work on economic operations, carbon peaking, and ecological planning.

articles.title_zh: 中共宝鸡市委十三届十次全会召开

articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，中共宝鸡市委十三届十次全会在宝鸡召开，市委书记陈晓勇作报告并讲话，市长牛恺安排经济工作，审议通过召开市第十四次党代会的决议。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the 13th Plenary Session of the CPC Baoji Municipal Committee was held, where Party Secretary Chen Xiaoyong delivered a report and Mayor Niu Kai arranged economic work, approving a resolution to convene the 14th Municipal Party Congress.

articles.title_zh: 顾刚调研粮食安全和农业一二三产融合工作
articles.title_en: Gu Gang Inspects Grain Security and Integrated Development of Agriculture
articles.summary_zh: 近日，长春市委副书记、市长顾刚调研粮食安全和农业一二三产融合工作，强调稳粮保供、延链增值，赋能农业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Gu Gang, deputy secretary of the Changchun Municipal Party Committee and mayor, inspected grain security and integrated development of agriculture, emphasizing stable grain supply and value chain extension.

articles.title_zh: 东方之约，相约未来——中国元首外交的世界情怀与大国气派
articles.title_en: Eastern Invitation, Meeting the Future: The World Vision and Great-Power Bearing of China's Head-of-State Diplomacy
articles.summary_zh: 新华社8月5日发表综述，回顾习近平主席主持系列主场外交活动成果，强调中国将主办2026年APEC会议，展现元首外交的世界情怀与大国气派。
articles.summary_en: An Xinhua review on Aug. 5 recalls achievements of President Xi Jinping's home-ground diplomacy, highlighting China's hosting of APEC 2026 and its world vision.

articles.title_zh: 王新伟在省属企业调研并主持召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Wang Xinwei Visits Provincial State-owned Enterprises and Chairs Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，辽宁省省长王新伟到部分省属企业调研并主持召开座谈会，强调深化改革创新、做强做优做大国有企业和国有资本。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Governor Wang Xinwei of Liaoning Province visited provincial state-owned enterprises and chaired a symposium, emphasizing deepening reform and innovation to strengthen state-owned enterprises and capital.

articles.title_zh: 市政协召开“擦亮国家历史文化名城品牌 打造区域性文化中心”双月协商会 于学利出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Shenyang Municipal CPPCC Holds Bimonthly Consultation Meeting on Cultural Heritage City Brand
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，沈阳市政协召开双月协商会，聚焦擦亮国家历史文化名城品牌、打造区域性文化中心，市政协主席于学利出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the Shenyang Municipal CPPCC held a bimonthly consultation meeting on polishing the national historical and cultural city brand and building a regional cultural center. Chair Yu Xueli attended and delivered remarks.

articles.title_zh: 全市经济运行分析“一对一”调度会议召开 栾天猛主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Luan Tianmeng Chairs Chifeng Economic Operation Analysis Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，赤峰市委副书记、市长栾天猛主持召开全市经济运行分析“一对一”调度会议，研判上半年经济形势，部署下一步重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Luan Tianmeng, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Chifeng Municipal Committee and Mayor, chaired a one-on-one scheduling meeting to analyze the city's economic performance in H1 and deploy key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 中塔人士共话《习近平谈治国理政》第五卷
articles.title_en: Chinese and Tajik Officials Discuss Volume V of Xi Jinping: The Governance of China
articles.summary_zh: 中国外文局、中国驻塔吉克斯坦大使馆等联合举办《习近平谈治国理政》第五卷交流会，中塔人士共同探讨其理念与实践意义。
articles.summary_en: Co-hosted by China International Publishing Group and the Chinese Embassy in Tajikistan, the event discussed Volume V of Xi Jinping's works, highlighting its global significance.

articles.title_zh: 以心相交，成其久远——中国元首外交的世界情怀与大国气派
articles.title_en: Heart-to-Heart Ties for Lasting Friendship: China's Head-of-State Diplomacy
articles.summary_zh: 新华社8月7日播发综述，回顾习近平主席与外国友人的亲切交往，展现中国元首外交的人民友好与世界情怀。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 7, Xinhua published a review recounting President Xi Jinping's warm exchanges with foreign friends, highlighting the people-centered and peace-oriented nature of China's head-of-state diplomacy.

articles.title_zh: 我国外贸进出口规模连续5个月超过4万亿元
articles.title_en: China's Foreign Trade Exceeds 4 Trillion Yuan for 5 Consecutive Months
articles.summary_zh: 海关总署8月7日发布数据显示，7月份我国进出口总值4.66万亿元，同比增长19.2%，连续5个月超过4万亿元；出口增长17.8%，进口增长21.2%。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the General Administration of Customs released data showing China's imports and exports reached 4.66 trillion yuan in July, up 19.2% year on year, exceeding 4 trillion for five consecutive months. Exports rose 17.8%, imports 21.2%.

articles.title_zh: 《民用航空发展“十五五”规划》发布
articles.title_en: Civil Aviation Development Plan for the 15th Five-Year Plan Period Released
articles.summary_zh: 中国民航局8月7日发布《民用航空发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年民航安全、服务、基础设施迈向国际一流，并推进六大体系建设。
articles.summary_en: China's Civil Aviation Administration released the 15th Five-Year Plan for civil aviation development on August 7, aiming for world-class safety, services and infrastructure by 2030, with six major systems to be built.

articles.title_zh: 最是真情暖人心——中国元首外交的世界情怀与大国气派
articles.title_en: Sincerity Warms Hearts: The World Vision and Great-Power Bearing of China's Head-of-State Diplomacy
articles.summary_zh: 新华社北京8月6日电，文章回顾习近平主席外交活动中与各国民众亲切互动的温暖瞬间，展现中国元首外交的人文情怀与大国气派。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua, Beijing, Aug 6 - This article recalls the warm moments of President Xi Jinping's friendly interactions with people from various countries, showcasing the human touch and great-power bearing of China's head-of-state diplomacy.

articles.title_zh: 我国重点生态保护区域保护成效显著
articles.title_en: Significant Progress Made in Protecting Key Ecological Areas in China
articles.summary_zh: 生态环境部公布最新评估，全国452处国家级自然保护区优良率达98.9%，生态保护红线内生态环境总体好转。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment released an assessment showing that 98.9% of the 452 national nature reserves rate excellent or good, and the ecological environment within the ecological protection red line is generally improving.

articles.title_zh: 总书记的人民情怀
articles.title_en: The General Secretary's Commitment to the People
articles.summary_zh: 文章阐述习近平总书记高度重视扩大内需，强调坚持内需主导、投资于人，指出扩大内需是战略之举，为经济发展注入动力。
articles.summary_en: The article expounds Xi Jinping's emphasis on expanding domestic demand, stressing it as a strategic move to drive economic growth and improve people's livelihoods.

articles.title_zh: 大面积单产提升持续加力 夯实秋粮稳产基础
articles.title_en: Efforts to Boost Per-Unit Crop Yields Intensify to Solidify Autumn Grain Production Base
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日立秋，我国秋粮进入产量形成关键期。农业农村部持续推进大面积单产提升行动，各地应用新技术新装备，夯实秋粮稳产基础。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the Start of Autumn, China's autumn grain entered a critical yield-forming period. The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs continued to advance large-scale yield enhancement, with new technologies and equipment consolidating the foundation for stable production.

articles.title_zh: 蒋冰主持召开市委专题会议
articles.title_en: Jiang Bing Chairs Special Meeting of Dandong Municipal Party Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，丹东市委书记蒋冰主持召开市委专题会议，部署信访工作，强调维护群众利益和社会稳定。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Jiang Bing, Secretary of the Dandong Municipal Party Committee, chaired a special committee meeting on petition work, emphasizing safeguarding people's interests and social stability.

articles.title_zh: 蒋冰接待群众来访时强调：用心用情做好信访工作 依法依规解决群众诉求
articles.title_en: Jiang Bing Meets Petitioners, Stresses Doing Petition Work with Heart and Resolving Appeals According to Law
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，丹东市委书记蒋冰接待来访群众，强调用心用情做好信访工作，依法依规解决群众诉求。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Jiang Bing, Party Secretary of Dandong, met with petitioners and stressed the importance of doing petition work with heart and resolving people's appeals in accordance with the law.

articles.title_zh: 蒋冰赴振兴区调研并主持召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Jiang Bing Visits Zhenxing District and Chairs Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，丹东市委书记蒋冰赴振兴区调研企业安全生产、项目建设并主持召开座谈会，强调高质量发展和高水平安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Jiang Bing, Secretary of the Dandong Municipal Party Committee, visited Zhenxing District to inspect enterprise safety and project construction, and chaired a symposium on high-quality development and security.

articles.title_zh: 高键主持召开全市项目谋划推进及金融支持工作会议
articles.title_en: Gao Jian Chairs Meeting on Project Planning and Financial Support
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，抚顺市委书记高键主持召开专题会议，听取全市项目谋划及金融支持情况，研究部署下阶段工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Fushun Municipal Party Secretary Gao Jian chaired a special meeting to hear reports on city-wide project planning and financial support, and to arrange next-stage work.

articles.title_zh: 王新伟在省属企业调研并主持召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Wang Xinwei Visits Provincial SOEs and Chairs Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，辽宁省委副书记、省长王新伟到部分省属企业调研并主持召开座谈会，强调深化改革创新，做强做优做大国有企业和国有资本。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Wang Xinwei, Deputy Secretary of the Liaoning Provincial Party Committee and Governor, visited provincial state-owned enterprises and chaired a symposium, emphasizing deepening reform and innovation to strengthen state-owned enterprises and capital.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁与来榕参加第十四届海峡青年荟的两岸嘉宾座谈
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning Meets with Cross-Strait Guests at 14th Straits Youth Festival
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁在福州与参加第十四届海峡青年荟的两岸嘉宾及青年代表座谈。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Guo Ningning, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Fujian Provincial Committee and Secretary of the Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee, held a symposium in Fuzhou with cross-strait guests and youth representatives attending the 14th Straits Youth Festival.

articles.title_zh: 市领导到盱眙县调研
articles.title_en: Municipal Leaders Conduct Research in Xuyi County
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，淮安市委书记史志军到盱眙县调研，察看重点项目建设并召开座谈会，强调攻坚三季度、冲刺下半年，确保“十五五”开好局。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Shi Zhijun, Secretary of Huai'an Municipal Party Committee, visited Xuyi County to inspect key projects and chair a symposium, urging efforts to boost economic growth in the third quarter and ensure a good start to the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研重点工业企业运行情况
articles.title_en: Huai'an Mayor Gu Kun Visits Key Industrial Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 近日，淮安市市长顾坤赴淮安经开区等地调研重点工业企业运行情况，强调强化创新赋能、优化服务保障，支持企业做大做强。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Mayor Gu Kun of Huai'an visited key industrial enterprises in Huai'an Economic Development Zone and other districts, emphasizing innovation empowerment and service optimization to support enterprise growth.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研重点工业企业运行情况
articles.title_en: Municipal Leaders Visit Key Industrial Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 近日，淮安市市长顾坤赴淮安经开区等地调研重点工业企业，强调强化创新赋能、优化服务保障，巩固工业经济稳中向好态势。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Gu Kun, mayor of Huai'an, visited key industrial enterprises in Huai'an Economic Development Zone and other areas, emphasizing innovation and service optimization to consolidate stable industrial growth.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会调研财政运行和国有资产管理工作座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Symposium on Fiscal Operation and State-Owned Assets Management Held by Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，淮安市人大常委会召开调研财政运行和国有资产管理工作座谈会，常务副主任周青主持并讲话，听取上半年财政经济、债务管理、国资运营等情况汇报。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the Standing Committee of Huai'an Municipal People's Congress held a symposium on fiscal operation and state-owned assets management. Deputy Director Zhou Qing chaired and addressed the meeting, hearing reports on fiscal economy, debt management, and SOE operations.

articles.title_zh: 市委书记史志军到盱眙县调研
articles.title_en: Municipal Party Secretary Shi Zhijun Investigates in Xuyi County
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，市委书记史志军到盱眙县调研，强调攻坚三季度、冲刺下半年，推动经济运行稳中有进。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Municipal Party Secretary Shi Zhijun visited Xuyi County, urging efforts to stabilize economic growth and ensure a good start for the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 十六届市政协三十次常委会议召开
articles.title_en: 16th Municipal CPPCC Standing Committee Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日下午，淮南市政协主席蔡宜骅主持召开十六届市政协三十次常委会议，审议通过提案工作条例及人事事项。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 6, CPPCC Huainan Municipal Committee Chairman Cai Yihua chaired the 16th session of the Standing Committee, reviewing and approving the proposal work regulations and personnel matters.

articles.title_zh: 王兵建：从优秀士兵到“皖美村支书”
articles.title_en: Wang Bingjian: From Outstanding Soldier to 'Beautiful Village Party Secretary'
articles.summary_zh: 在大通区九龙岗镇王楼村，退役军人王兵建担任村党支部书记近20年，带领村民发展产业、建设美丽乡村，使村庄面貌焕然一新。
articles.summary_en: In Wanglou Village, veteran Wang Bingjian served as village party secretary for nearly 20 years, leading villagers to develop industries and build a beautiful countryside, transforming the village.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰带队到揭西县调研
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Leads Research Trip to Jiexi County
articles.summary_zh: 6日上午，揭阳市市长曲晓杰到揭西县调研，强调深入实施传统产业焕新工程，推进百千万工程和粮食安全工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 6, Qu Xiaojie, Mayor of Jieyang, led a research team to Jiexi County, emphasizing the implementation of the Renewal Project for traditional industries and the advancement of the Bai Qian Wan Project and food security.

articles.title_zh: 汕头市党政代表团来揭考察交流
articles.title_en: Shantou Party Delegation Visits Jieyang for Exchanges
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，汕头市委书记庄悦群率党政代表团到揭阳考察交流，揭阳市委书记曾风保陪同，双方就深化汕潮揭都市圈合作等展开交流。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 6, 2026, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn led a delegation to Jieyang for exchanges, accompanied by Jieyang Party Secretary Zeng Fengbao, discussing cooperation under the Shan-Chao-Jie metropolitan circle.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁主持召开市委理论学习中心组集体学习会
articles.title_en: Dawa Ciren Chairs Collective Study Session of CPC Lhasa Municipal Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，自治区党委常委、拉萨市委书记达娃次仁主持召开市委理论学习中心组集体学习会，强调深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于城市工作的重要论述。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Dawa Ciren, Member of the Standing Committee of the Regional Party Committee and Secretary of the Lhasa Municipal Party Committee, chaired a collective study session of the Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Learning Center Group on Xi Jinping's important expositions on urban work.

articles.title_zh: 王君正参加拉萨市城关区人大代表换届选举投票
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Votes in Lhasa Chengguan District People's Congress Deputy Election
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正在拉萨市城关区参加人大代表换届选举投票，强调依法行使选举权，践行全过程人民民主。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Wang Junzheng, Party Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Region, voted in the deputy election of Lhasa Chengguan District People's Congress, stressing lawful exercise of voting rights and whole-process people's democracy.

articles.title_zh: 2026中国西藏第七届跨喜马拉雅国际公路自行车极限赛闭幕式暨颁奖仪式在日喀则市举行

articles.summary_en: On Aug 6, 2026, the closing ceremony of the 7th Trans-Himalaya International Road Cycling Race was held in Shigatse. Gao Zhidan and Garma Tseden attended and presented awards.

articles.summary_en: On August 1, 2026, Nagqu Municipal Party Secretary Zhang Haibo and Mayor Zhaxi Dorje visited troops at Nagqu Military Sub-command to greet grassroots soldiers on the 99th Army Day.

articles.title_zh: 刘冰主持召开全市重点项目第二次调度会并讲话
articles.title_en: Liu Bing Chairs Second Citywide Key Projects Scheduling Meeting

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 6, Liu Bing, acting mayor of Nanyang, chaired the city's second key projects scheduling meeting to accelerate construction of projects including Baihe Power Plant and Nanyang Jiangying Airport expansion.

articles.summary_en: Chinese and Tajik officials exchanged views on Volume V of Xi Jinping: The Governance of China, under the theme 'Hand in Hand on the Modernization Path, Building a China-Tajikistan Community with a Shared Future,' co-hosted by CIPG and the Chinese Embassy in Tajikistan.

articles.summary_en: On August 5, Tsering Tashi, member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Tibet Regional Committee and head of its United Front Work Department, visited monasteries in Shannan to inspect religious affairs management and temple safety.

articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Casts Vote in Lhasa Chengguan District People's Congress Election
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正在拉萨参加城关区人大代表换届选举投票，强调依法行使选举权，践行全过程人民民主。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the CPC Tibet Autonomous Regional Committee, voted at a polling station in Lhasa for the reelection of deputies to the Chengguan District People's Congress, emphasizing the exercise of the right to vote in accordance with the law and whole-process people's democracy.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群带队赴潮州市学习考察
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Leads Delegation to Study in Chaozhou
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，汕头市委书记庄悦群带队赴潮州市学习考察，谋划推动汕潮揭都市圈高质量发展，潮州市长蔡淡群参加。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Zhuang Yuequn, Secretary of the Shantou Municipal Party Committee, led a delegation to Chaozhou for study and inspection, aiming to promote high-quality development of the Shantou-Chaozhou-Jieyang metropolitan area. Chaozhou Mayor Cai Danqun joined.

articles.title_zh: 汕头市召开领导干部警示教育会暨党章党规党纪教育培训班
articles.title_en: Shantou Holds Warning Education Meeting and Party Discipline Training for Leading Officials
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日下午，汕头市召开领导干部警示教育会暨党章党规党纪教育培训班，市委书记庄悦群出席并讲话，强调树立正确政绩观，深化以案明纪。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 5, Shantou held a warning education meeting and Party discipline training for leading officials. Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn attended and stressed the importance of a correct view on political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 认真学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神 研究部署经济发展、科技创新、审计等工作
articles.title_en: Shantou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speeches, Deploys Work on Economy, Innovation and Audit
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日上午，汕头市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，研究部署经济发展、科技创新、审计等工作，市委书记庄悦群主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 5, the Standing Committee of the Shantou Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches, and deployed work on economic development, scientific innovation, and auditing. Zhuang Yuequn, the municipal party secretary, presided over the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰到陆丰市调研督导“百千万工程”推进情况
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Inspects Lufeng on 'Baiqianwan Project' Progress
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，汕尾市委书记逯峰到陆丰市调研督导“百千万工程”推进情况，强调强化项目牵引、打造特色品牌，推动县镇村高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Lu Feng, Secretary of the Shanwei Municipal Party Committee, visited Lufeng City to inspect the progress of the 'Baiqianwan Project', emphasizing project-driven growth, distinctive branding, and high-quality development of counties, towns, and villages.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰到陆丰市调研督导“百千万工程”推进情况
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Inspects Lufeng on 'Bai Qian Wan' Project Progress
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，汕尾市委书记逯峰到陆丰市调研督导“百千万工程”推进情况，强调强化项目牵引、打造特色品牌，促进城乡融合发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Lu Feng, secretary of Shanwei Municipal Party Committee, visited Lufeng to inspect the progress of the 'Bai Qian Wan' project, stressing project-led development and distinctive branding to promote urban-rural integration.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰会见粤检集团党委书记、董事长张志华
articles.title_en: Lü Feng Meets with Chairman of Guangdong Inspection and Testing Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，汕尾市委书记逯峰会见了粤检集团党委书记、董事长张志华，双方就深化检验检测认证业务合作等进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Shanwei Municipal Party Secretary Lü Feng met with Zhang Zhihua, Party Secretary and Chairman of Guangdong Inspection and Testing Group, to discuss deepening cooperation in inspection, testing and certification.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰会见粤检集团党委书记、董事长张志华
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Meets Zhang Zhihua, Party Secretary and Chairman of Guangdong Inspection Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，汕尾市委书记逯峰会见粤检集团党委书记、董事长张志华，双方就深化检验检测认证业务合作、推进打造国家质检中心等深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 7, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng met with Zhang Zhihua, Party Secretary and Chairman of Guangdong Inspection Group, to discuss deepening inspection and certification cooperation and advancing the construction of a national quality inspection center.

articles.title_zh: 朔州市委常委会召开会议研究部署经济工作
articles.title_en: Shuozhou Party Committee Holds Meeting on Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 近日，朔州市委常委会召开会议，学习习近平总书记在中央政治局会议上的重要讲话精神，听取2026年上半年全市经济运行情况汇报，研究部署下一步工作。市委书记王帅红主持会议。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Shuozhou Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the CPC Central Political Bureau meeting, hear reports on the city's economic performance in the first half of 2026, and arrange next-step work. Party Secretary Wang Shuaihong chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开常务会议
articles.title_en: Taizhou Municipal Government Holds Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，泰州市政府召开常务会议，市长李晖主持，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，传达学习社会救助法，部署交通拥堵治理、安全生产等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Taizhou Municipal Government held an executive meeting chaired by Mayor Li Hui to study Xi Jinping's remarks, learn the Social Assistance Law, and address traffic congestion and safety issues.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬专题调研学习教育开展情况
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Conducts Special Research on Learning and Education Campaign
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬到泰兴市调研树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育开展情况，参观红色教育基地、走访企业，强调以实干成效检验学习教育成果。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Jiang Dongdong, Secretary of the Taizhou Municipal Party Committee, visited Taixing to inspect the learning campaign on establishing and practicing a correct view of achievements, emphasizing practical results.

articles.title_zh: 信长星会见乌兹别克斯坦客人
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing Meets with Uzbek Guests
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，江苏省委书记信长星在南京会见乌兹别克斯坦驻华大使法尔霍德·阿尔济耶夫，双方就深化经贸合作与人文交流等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Jiangsu Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing met with Uzbek Ambassador to China Farhod Arziev in Nanjing to discuss deepening economic and cultural cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 李晖主持召开市政府党组会议
articles.title_en: Li Hui Chairs City Government Party Group Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，泰州市政府党组书记、市长李晖主持召开市政府党组会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神，部署经济工作和正确政绩观学习教育。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Li Hui, Secretary of the Party Group and Mayor of Taizhou Municipal Government, chaired a government party group meeting to study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions, and to arrange economic work and education on the correct view of political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬专题调研学习教育开展情况
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Conducts Special Research on Study and Education Implementation
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬到泰兴市专题调研树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育开展情况，强调以实干成效检验学习教育成果。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Jiang Dongdong, Secretary of the Taizhou Municipal Party Committee, conducted a special research visit to Taixing on the study and education of establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements, emphasizing testing results with practical effectiveness.

articles.title_zh: 黄强到延边珲春调研时强调 充分把握历史机遇 坚定不移向海图强 以高水平对外开放推动吉林高质量发展
articles.title_en: Huang Qiang Visits Hunchun, Stresses Grasping Historical Opportunities and High-Level Opening-Up to Boost Jilin's High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日至6日，吉林省委书记黄强到延边州珲春市调研，强调要把握历史机遇，以高水平对外开放推动吉林高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: From August 5 to 6, Jilin Provincial Party Secretary Huang Qiang visited Hunchun, Yanbian, emphasizing the need to seize historical opportunities and promote high-quality development through high-level opening-up.

articles.title_zh: 通化市政府召开党组会议和常务会议
articles.title_en: Tonghua Municipal Government Holds Party Group and Executive Meetings
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，通化市市长高山主持召开市政府党组会议和常务会议，传达学习中央会议精神，研究长期护理保险等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Mayor Gao Shan of Tonghua chaired the municipal government party group and executive meetings to convey central directives and discuss long-term care insurance and other matters.

articles.title_zh: 全市区市、镇领导班子换届工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Meeting on Leadership Transition at District and Town Levels Held in Weihai
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，威海市召开区市、镇领导班子换届工作会议，市委书记张海波出席并讲话，对换届工作进行安排部署。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Weihai held a meeting on leadership transition at district and town levels. Party Secretary Zhang Haibo attended and delivered a speech, deploying the work.

articles.title_zh: 西安市委常委会召开议军会议 强调深化跨军地改革推动军地共建协同发展
articles.title_en: Xi'an Municipal Party Committee Holds Military Work Meeting to Deepen Civil-Military Reform
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，西安市委常委会召开议军会议，省委常委、市委书记蒿慧杰主持并讲话，研究部署新时代人民武装等工作，强调深化跨军地改革，推动军地共建协同发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the Standing Committee of the Xi'an Municipal Party Committee held a military work meeting, chaired by Hao Huijie, to study people's armed forces work and emphasize deepening cross-military-civilian reform.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议认真学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神 部署扫黑除恶专项斗争及群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治等工作
articles.title_en: Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting to Deploy Special Campaign Against Gang Crimes and Rectification of Unhealthy Tendencies and Corruption Around the People
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，市委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记关于扫黑除恶重要指示精神，部署扫黑除恶专项斗争及群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治等工作。省委常委、市委书记蒿慧杰主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the Standing Committee of the Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on the special campaign against gang crimes, and deployed efforts to crack down on gang crimes and rectify unhealthy tendencies and corruption around the people. The meeting was chaired by Hao Huijie, member of the Standing Committee of the Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Municipal Party Committee.

articles.title_zh: 卢希望调研中心城区服务业发展工作
articles.title_en: Lu Xiwang Inspects Service Industry Development in Central Urban Area
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，信阳市市长卢希望调研中心城区服务业发展，强调以更大力度推进服务业扩能提质，助力经济社会高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Mayor Lu Xiwang inspected the development of the service industry in the central urban area, emphasizing efforts to expand and improve the sector to support high-quality economic and social development.

articles.title_zh: 信长星会见乌兹别克斯坦客人
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing Meets Uzbek Ambassador in Nanjing
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，江苏省委书记信长星在南京会见乌兹别克斯坦驻华大使法尔霍德·阿尔济耶夫，双方就深化经贸合作、人文交流等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Jiangsu Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing met with Uzbek Ambassador to China Farhod Arziev in Nanjing, discussing deepening economic cooperation and cultural exchanges.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平吴炜会见金鹰集团中国纤维业务总裁张文涛
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping and Wu Wei Meet with Zhang Wentao, President of RGE's China Fiber Business
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日下午，盐城市委书记严汉平、代市长吴炜会见金鹰集团中国纤维业务总裁张文涛，双方就深化产业合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping and acting Mayor Wu Wei met with Zhang Wentao, President of RGE's China Fiber Business, to discuss deepening industrial cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛专题调研就业创业工作 以更实举措稳就业更优服务促创业
articles.title_en: Governor Liu Xiaotao Visits Nanjing to Promote Employment and Entrepreneurship
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，省长刘小涛在南京市专题调研就业创业工作，强调实施就业优先战略，以更实举措稳就业、更优服务促创业。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao visited Nanjing to inspect employment and entrepreneurship work, stressing the employment-first strategy with solid measures.

articles.title_zh: 张明康在全市人工智能产业工作座谈会议上强调奋力推动人工智能产业加快崛起 为全市高质量发展注入强劲动能
articles.title_en: Zhang Mingkang Stresses Accelerating AI Industry at City Forum
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日下午，烟台市召开人工智能产业工作座谈会议，市长张明康出席并讲话，强调实施“人工智能+”三年行动，推动产业加快崛起。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Aug 7, Yantai held a forum on AI industry. Mayor Zhang Mingkang attended and stressed implementing an AI+ three-year action plan to accelerate the industry's rise.

articles.title_zh: 江成在市政协十四届常委会第二十三次会议上强调发扬优良传统扎实履职尽责广泛凝聚共识 以更高站位更强担当助力烟台高质量发展
articles.title_en: Jiang Cheng Stresses Fostering Fine Traditions and Fulfilling Duties at CPPCC Yantai Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日上午，烟台市政协召开十四届常委会第二十三次会议，市委书记江成出席并讲话，强调发扬优良传统、扎实履职尽责，助力烟台高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 7, the 23rd meeting of the 14th Standing Committee of Yantai CPPCC was held. Municipal Party Secretary Jiang Cheng attended and spoke, urging efforts to serve high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 卢一先到阳东区调研
articles.title_en: Lu Yixian Visits Yangdong District for Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，阳江市委书记卢一先到阳东区调研，强调生态优先、绿色发展，推进环保督察整改和文旅融合。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Lu Yixian, Secretary of the CPC Yangjiang Municipal Committee, visited Yangdong District, emphasizing ecological priority, green development, and the integration of culture and tourism.

articles.title_zh: 余金富到江城区、阳江海陵湾新区（阳江高新区）调研企业生产经营情况
articles.title_en: Yu Jinfu Inspects Enterprise Production and Operations in Jiangcheng and Yangjiang High-tech Zone
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，阳江市委副书记、市长余金富率队到江城区、阳江海陵湾新区（阳江高新区）调研企业生产经营情况，强调实体经济为本、制造业当家。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Yu Jinfu, deputy secretary and mayor of Yangjiang, led a team to inspect enterprise production and operations in Jiangcheng District and the Yangjiang High-tech Zone, emphasizing the real economy and manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 全市经济高质量发展工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Yuxi City Holds Economic High-Quality Development Work Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，玉溪市召开经济高质量发展工作会议，部署下半年工作，确保“十五五”开好局起好步。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Yuxi City held a work conference on high-quality economic development to arrange tasks for the second half of the year and ensure a good start to the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 余红胜在岳阳调研
articles.title_en: Vice Governor Yu Hongsheng Conducts Research in Yueyang
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，副省长余红胜赴岳阳调研集体林权制度改革、洞庭湖生态保护修复情况，并开展巡河工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Vice Governor Yu Hongsheng visited Yueyang to investigate collective forest tenure reform, ecological protection of Dongting Lake, and inspect river management.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江与长三角等地企业家座谈
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Holds Talks with Entrepreneurs from Yangtze River Delta and Other Regions
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，湖南省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江与长三角等地企业家座谈，共商合作，表示将持续优化营商环境。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 6, Xie Weijiang, deputy secretary of Hunan Provincial Committee, held talks with entrepreneurs from the Yangtze River Delta and other areas in Yueyang, pledging to optimize the business environment.

articles.title_zh: 中国物流集团董事长刘敬桢到云浮考察调研
articles.title_en: Liu Jingzhen, Chairman of China Logistics Group, Visits Yunfu for Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，中国物流集团董事长刘敬桢率队到云浮考察调研，市委书记卢荣春陪同，双方就深化央地合作、物流设施建设等交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Liu Jingzhen, Chairman of China Logistics Group, led a team to Yunfu for inspection, accompanied by city Party secretary Lu Rongchun, discussing deepening central-local cooperation and logistics infrastructure.

articles.title_zh: 市委全面依法治市工作会议召开 全力建设更高水平法治云浮 卢荣春出席会议并讲话
articles.title_en: Yunfu Holds City-Wide Meeting on Law-Based Governance; Lu Rongchun Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日上午，云浮市委全面依法治市工作会议召开，市委书记卢荣春出席并讲话，部署当前和今后一个时期全面依法治市工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 6, Yunfu held a municipal meeting on comprehensive law-based governance; Party Secretary Lu Rongchun attended and delivered a speech, deploying work for the current and future periods.

articles.title_zh: 余钢主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议全力推动经济持续向新向优向好 以科技创新驱动湛江高质量发展
articles.title_en: Yu Gang Chairs Enlarged Standing Committee Meeting to Promote Sustained Economic Improvement and High-Quality Development in Zhanjiang
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日上午，湛江市委书记余钢主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神，研究部署经济、防汛、基础教育、科技创新等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 6, Yu Gang, Secretary of the Zhanjiang Municipal Party Committee, chaired an enlarged meeting of the Standing Committee to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions, and to deploy work on the economy, flood control, basic education, and technological innovation.

articles.title_zh: 余钢主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Yu Gang Chairs Enlarged Meeting of Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日上午，市委书记余钢主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和重要指示精神，研究经济、防汛、教育、科技等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 6, Municipal Party Secretary Yu Gang chaired an enlarged meeting of the Standing Committee of the Municipal Party Committee, conveying and studying General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and guiding principles, and arranging for economic, flood control, education, and technology work.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会召开2026年上半年经济运行监督座谈会
articles.title_en: Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Symposium on H1 2026 Economic Operation
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日上午，珠海市人大常委会召开2026年上半年经济运行监督座谈会，强调以人大高质量履职助推经济向好向优。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 6, the Zhuhai Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held a symposium on supervising the economic operation in the first half of 2026, emphasizing high-quality performance of the people's congress.

articles.title_zh: 陈勇主持召开市委常委会会议和省委横琴工委会议 研究部署多项重点工作
articles.title_en: Chen Yong Chairs Municipal Party Committee Meeting and Hengqin Working Committee Meeting

articles.summary_en: On August 6, Chen Yong, Secretary of the Zhuhai Municipal Party Committee, chaired meetings to convey Xi Jinping's important speeches and arrange work on political achievements, AI, and urban renewal.

articles.summary_en: Recently, the Institute of Geology, CAGS, led a team to complete a 1:5,000,000 lunar geological map, anchoring a new lunar stratigraphic time scale with Chinese data.

articles.summary_zh: 国家网信办8月7日发布通知，将前期两份征求意见稿整合完善为《大型个人信息处理者个人信息保护规定（征求意见稿）》，向社会公开征求意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the Cyberspace Administration of China issued a notice to integrate two prior draft rules into the Draft Provisions on Personal Information Protection by Large Processors, soliciting public feedback.

articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月6日，浙江省博物馆就之江馆区“再现圆明园”特展因客流集中导致观众入场受阻一事公开道歉，并公布分时预约等整改措施。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, 2026, the Zhejiang Provincial Museum apologized for entry delays at its 'Old Summer Palace' exhibition due to heavy crowds, and announced time-slot reservation and other improvements.

articles.title_zh: 超30万亿元！今年前7月我国货物贸易进出口同比增长17.3%
articles.title_en: China's Goods Trade Imports and Exports Up 17.3% to Over 30 Trillion Yuan in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 海关总署8月7日发布数据，今年前7个月我国货物贸易进出口总值30.13万亿元，同比增长17.3%。
articles.summary_en: The General Administration of Customs released data on Aug 7 showing China's goods trade imports and exports reached 30.13 trillion yuan in the first seven months of 2026, up 17.3% year-on-year.

articles.title_zh: 河北省委常委会召开扩大会议
articles.title_en: Hebei Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Enlarged Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 河北省委常委会召开扩大会议，深入学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，大力支持国防和军队现代化建设，罗文主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of the Hebei Provincial Party Committee held an enlarged meeting to thoroughly implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech and vigorously support the modernization of national defense and the military. Luo Wen chaired and addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 追光的你｜太行山上新愚公
articles.title_en: Chasing Light: The New Yugong of Taihang Mountain
articles.summary_zh: 本文追忆河北农业大学教授李保国，他扎根太行山30余年，致力于山区生态建设和科技富民，被习近平总书记誉为“太行山上的新愚公”。
articles.summary_en: This article recalls Li Baoguo, a professor at Hebei Agricultural University, who spent over 30 years in the Taihang Mountains on ecological development and poverty alleviation through technology. He was praised by President Xi Jinping as the 'new Yugong of Taihang Mountain'.
