articles.title_zh: 河南省委常委会召开会议 刘宁主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Chairs Henan Provincial Party Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，河南省委书记刘宁主持召开省委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要文章《加快建设健康中国》，研究部署健康河南建设、集中整治群众身边不正之风和腐败问题等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Henan Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning chaired a meeting of the Standing Committee of the Provincial Party Committee. The meeting conveyed and studied General Secretary Xi Jinping's important article 'Accelerating the Building of a Healthy China' and made arrangements for promoting health in Henan and intensifying the rectification of corruption and misconduct around the people.

articles.title_zh: 最新外贸数据公布 四个关键词解读中国经济韧性
articles.title_en: Latest Foreign Trade Data Released: Four Keywords Decode China's Economic Resilience
articles.summary_zh: 海关总署发布前7个月外贸数据，进出口总值30.13万亿元创同期新高，增速逐月提升，高端制造出口亮眼，中西部外贸异军突起。
articles.summary_en: The General Administration of Customs released foreign trade data for the first seven months, with total imports and exports reaching 30.13 trillion yuan, a record high, showing steady growth and strong performance in high-end manufacturing and central-western regions.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开8月份重大项目协调例会
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Government Holds Monthly Major Project Coordination Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，市长吴贤德主持召开市政府8月份重大项目协调例会，听取福银高速马尾亭江至晋安新店段建设等项目汇报，研究协调项目建设有关问题。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Mayor Wu Xiande chaired the August major project coordination meeting, hearing reports on projects including the Fuyin Expressway section and addressing construction issues.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁与来榕参加第十四届海峡青年荟的两岸嘉宾座谈
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning Holds Talks with Cross-Strait Guests at 14th Straits Youth Gathering
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁与来榕参加第十四届海峡青年荟的台湾嘉宾及两岸青年代表座谈，欢迎台胞台青来榕发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Guo Ningning, Deputy Secretary of the Fujian Provincial Committee and Secretary of the Fuzhou Municipal Committee, held talks with Taiwan guests and cross-strait youth representatives attending the 14th Straits Youth Gathering in Fuzhou, welcoming them to develop in Fuzhou.

articles.title_zh: 第四届“好年华 聚福州”闽台青年人才研习营在福州启动
articles.title_en: 4th Cross-Strait Youth Talent Study Camp Kicks Off in Fuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，第四届“好年华 聚福州”闽台青年人才研习营在福州启动，近50名两岸青年将进行为期5天的研学交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, the 4th Cross-Strait Youth Talent Study Camp kicked off in Fuzhou, bringing together nearly 50 young people from both sides for a 5-day exchange.

articles.title_zh: 第十四届海峡青年连心汇在榕举办 周祖翼出席并致辞
articles.title_en: 14th Straits Youth Gathering Held in Fuzhou; Zhou Zuyi Attends and Delivers Speech
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，第十四届海峡青年连心汇在福州举办，福建省委书记周祖翼出席并致辞，强调深化闽台青年交流融合。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the 14th Straits Youth Gathering was held in Fuzhou, where Fujian Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi attended and spoke, emphasizing deeper youth exchanges and integration across the Strait.

articles.title_zh: 福建：筑强基层堡垒 凝聚争先力量
articles.title_en: Fujian Strengthens Grassroots Party Organizations to Rally Pioneering Strength
articles.summary_zh: 福建省委深化实施新时代“堡垒工程”，推进基层党建高质量发展，以高质量党建引领保障高质量发展，凝聚争先力量。
articles.summary_en: Fujian Provincial Party Committee deepens the implementation of the new-era 'Fortress Project' to promote high-quality grassroots Party building, ensuring high-quality development through strong Party leadership.

articles.title_zh: 刘强看望慰问高温一线工作人员
articles.title_en: Liu Qiang Visits and Comforts Frontline Workers in High Temperature
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，济南市委书记刘强调研电力保供及防暑设施运行情况，看望慰问高温一线工作人员，要求落实防暑降温措施。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Liu Qiang, Secretary of Jinan Municipal Party Committee, inspected power supply and cooling facilities, and visited frontline workers, urging effective heat prevention measures.

articles.title_zh: 履职项目化 托起万家“老幼安暖”——全国人大代表卓长立的“项目赋能年”履职印记
articles.title_en: Project-Based Performance: NPC Deputy Zhuo Changli's Imprint in 'Year of Project Empowerment'
articles.summary_zh: 2026年，全国人大代表卓长立以“项目赋能年”为契机，在济南推动AI家政实训、养老托育调研及家政从业者保障等项目，将履职落到实处。
articles.summary_en: In 2026, NPC Deputy Zhuo Changli leveraged Jinan's 'Year of Project Empowerment' to advance AI-integrated home services, elderly and childcare research, and caregiver protection programs.

articles.title_zh: 全市区县、镇领导班子换届工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Leadership Succession Work Conference Held in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，济南市召开区县、镇领导班子换届工作会议，市委书记刘强出席并讲话，市长于海田主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Jinan held a leadership succession work conference for district, county and town governments; Party Secretary Liu Qiang spoke and Mayor Yu Haitian chaired.

articles.title_zh: 曾赞荣调研国际航运中心建设推进情况
articles.title_en: Zeng Zanrong Inspects Progress on International Shipping Center Construction
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日上午，青岛市委书记曾赞荣调研国际航运中心建设，强调加快培育现代航运服务业，市政协主席孟庆斌参加。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 7, Qingdao Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong inspected the construction of the international shipping center, emphasizing the need to accelerate the cultivation of modern shipping services. CPPCC Chairman Meng Qingbin accompanied.

articles.title_zh: 外交部发言人回应日本主流民意反核立场
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Responds to Japan's Anti-Nuclear Stance
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，外交部发言人林剑在记者会上就日本主流民意反核立场表示，日方应倾听民众呼声，停止在核问题上玩火，不要重蹈历史覆辙。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Lin Jian said at a press briefing that Japan should listen to its people and stop playing with fire on nuclear issues, warning against repeating past mistakes.

articles.title_zh: 海关总署：前7个月我国货物贸易进出口增长17.3%
articles.title_en: Customs Administration: China's Goods Trade Imports and Exports Grow 17.3% in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 据海关发布，2026年前7个月我国货物贸易进出口总值30.13万亿元，同比增长17.3%；7月单月增长19.2%。
articles.summary_en: According to customs data, China's goods trade imports and exports totaled 30.13 trillion yuan in the first seven months of 2026, up 17.3% year-on-year; July alone grew 19.2%.

articles.title_zh: 习近平：作为千年古都，要把传统和现代有机融合在一起
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping: Beijing as Ancient Capital Should Integrate Tradition with Modernity
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记强调保护城市历史文化遗产，指出北京作为千年古都要把传统和现代有机融合，并肯定隆福寺街区“绣花织补”式更新改造。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping stresses preserving urban cultural heritage, citing Beijing's Longfu Temple renewal as an example of integrating tradition and modernity through meticulous renovation.

articles.title_zh: 东方之约 相约未来
articles.title_en: The Eastern Promise: Meeting the Future
articles.summary_zh: 新华社5日发文回顾新时代中国主场外交成就，展望2026年APEC深圳会议，强调中国与各方共创亚太美好明天。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Xinhua published a review of China's major-power diplomacy, looking ahead to the 2026 APEC summit in Shenzhen and emphasizing joint efforts for a better Asia-Pacific future.

articles.title_en: Commemoration of 90th Anniversary of Long March: Photo & Video Collection Receives Over 800 Works in First Week
articles.summary_zh: 纪念长征胜利90周年影像征集活动于7月31日在四川启动，一周内收到800余件作品，作品聚焦红色地标与老区新貌。
articles.summary_en: The photo and video collection event commemorating the 90th anniversary of the Long March kicked off in Sichuan on July 31, receiving over 800 works within a week, focusing on red landmarks and new look of old revolutionary areas.

articles.title_zh: 《中国金融租赁公司气候物理风险管理工具》正式发布
articles.title_en: China Financial Leasing Climate Physical Risk Management Tool Released

articles.summary_en: On August 5, with support from IFC, Huzhou Green Finance Research Institute and Jiangsu Financial Leasing jointly released the Climate Physical Risk Management Tool for Chinese financial leasing companies.

articles.summary_en: Shaanxi has promoted apple industry upgrading by cultivating and promoting new domestically-bred varieties, moving from good cultivation to good sales, with total industry chain output over 147 billion yuan in 2025.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”开局之年传统产业转型焕新一线观察
articles.title_en: 15th Five-Year Plan Kickoff Year: Frontline Observations on Traditional Industry Transformation
articles.summary_zh: 新华社报道组赴十多个省份调研传统产业转型升级，展示高附加值产品、智能装备、绿色工厂等新气象，强调以科技创新推动传统产业焕新。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reporters visited over ten provinces to observe traditional industry upgrading, highlighting high-value products, smart equipment, green factories, and innovation-driven revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省委理论学习中心组召开会议
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee Holds Theoretical Study Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，江苏省委理论学习中心组召开学习会，深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于基层工作方法的重要论述，省委书记信长星主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the Theoretical Learning Center Group of the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee held a study session on General Secretary Xi Jinping's important expositions on grassroots work methods. Secretary Xin Changxing presided over and addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 多地志愿者协会更名为社会工作和志愿服务联合会
articles.title_en: Volunteer Associations in Multiple Regions Renamed as Social Work and Volunteer Service Federations
articles.summary_zh: 截至2026年8月，江西彭泽、新疆奎屯、安徽界首、广东韶关等多地志愿者协会、义工协会相继更名为社会工作和志愿服务联合会，业务主管单位调整为各地党委社会工作部，以推动社会工作与志愿服务融合发展。
articles.summary_en: As of August 2026, volunteer associations in Pengze, Kuitun, Jieshou, Shaoguan and other regions have been renamed as Social Work and Volunteer Service Federations, with supervisory units adjusted to local Party committees' social work departments to promote integrated development.

articles.title_en: Benefits of Xinyu Cultural Tourism Card Reduced; Official Cites Market Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，新余市文广旅局回应文旅惠民卡权益缩水，称项目合作属市场行为，权益动态调整。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 7, Xinyu's cultural and tourism bureau responded to the reduced benefits of its tourism card, stating that project cooperation is market-driven with dynamic adjustments.

articles.title_zh: 河南公安机关查实“三支一扶”招募笔试存在组织作弊犯罪行为
articles.title_en: Henan Police Confirm Organized Cheating in 'Three Supports and One Assistance' Recruitment Exam
articles.summary_zh: 8月2日接报案后，河南公安机关查实7月11日“三支一扶”招募笔试存在规模性组织作弊，已抓获团伙主要成员，案件进一步侦办中。
articles.summary_en: After receiving a report on August 2, Henan police confirmed organized cheating in the 'Three Supports and One Assistance' recruitment exam held on July 11, arrested key suspects, and continue investigation.

articles.title_zh: “重庆造”功率半导体项目优化工艺提产能
articles.title_en: Chongqing-Made Power Semiconductor Project Optimizes Process and Boosts Capacity
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，重庆涪陵区新陵微电子6英寸IGBT晶圆产线进行生产调试，该项目5月投产，现处于产能爬坡阶段，第一阶段目标月产6万片，将为汽车、新能源等领域提供功率半导体支持。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, technicians debugged the 6-inch IGBT wafer production line at Xinling Microelectronics in Fuling District, Chongqing. The project, which started production in May, is now ramping up to a first-phase capacity of 60,000 wafers per month, supporting fields such as automotive and new energy.

articles.title_en: 14th Cross-Strait Youth Heart-to-Heart Exchange Held in Fuzhou

articles.summary_en: On August 6, the 14th Cross-Strait Youth Heart-to-Heart Exchange was held in Fuzhou. Fujian Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi attended and delivered a speech, emphasizing deepening cross-strait youth exchanges and integrated development.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省启动2026年度工伤保险费率调整业务
articles.title_en: Gansu Launches 2026 Work Injury Insurance Rate Adjustment
articles.summary_zh: 近日，甘肃省人社厅与国家税务总局甘肃省税务局联合通告，部署2026年度工伤保险费率调整业务，明确办理范围和流程，参保单位9月底前补缴可免滞纳金。

articles.summary_zh: 甘肃景泰县一条山镇推行“村居融合”治理模式，通过“三联六步”工作法，解决城乡接合部管理难题，近期高效处理居民小区设施失修问题。
articles.summary_en: Yitiaoshan Town in Jingtai County, Gansu, promotes a 'village-community integration' governance model with the 'Three Links, Six Steps' method, resolving urban-rural fringe management issues and promptly fixing residential facility problems.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省宣传思想文化重点工作推进会在兰召开
articles.title_en: Gansu Holds Promotion Meeting on Key Cultural and Ideological Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，甘肃省宣传思想文化重点工作推进会在兰州召开，省委常委、宣传部部长张永霞出席并讲话，强调推动宣传思想文化工作提质增效。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Gansu Province held a promotion meeting on key cultural and ideological work in Lanzhou, where Zhang Yongxia, member of the Provincial Party Standing Committee and head of the Propaganda Department, attended and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃巨化项目（一期）三条电源全部投运
articles.title_en: Three Power Sources for Gansu Juhua Project (Phase I) Fully Operational
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日下午，甘肃巨化新材料有限公司高性能硅氟新材料一体化项目（一期）330千伏巨琮变及琮花Ⅰ线成功投运，至此该项目供电工程多电源全部投运。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 6, the 330kV Jucong Substation and line of Gansu Juhua's new materials project (Phase I) were commissioned, completing all power sources.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省跨境贸易高水平开放试点启动
articles.title_en: Gansu Province Launches High-Level Opening-Up Pilot for Cross-Border Trade
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，甘肃省跨境贸易高水平开放试点落地实施，在兰州、白银、金昌三市同步开展，已为15家企业办理28笔业务，总金额2752万美元。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, Gansu Province launched a high-level opening-up pilot for cross-border trade, implemented in Lanzhou, Baiyin, and Jinchang, handling 28 transactions for 15 enterprises totaling $27.52 million.

articles.title_zh: 无人机有了“空中加油站”
articles.title_en: Drones Get 'Aerial Charging Stations'
articles.summary_zh: 哈尔滨工业大学郑州高等研究院研发无人机无线充电系统，可实现无人机自动降落充电，已在郑州龙子湖试点，正与中国铁塔推进产业化。
articles.summary_en: The Harbin Institute of Technology Zhengzhou Advanced Research Institute has developed a wireless charging system that allows drones to land and recharge automatically. Piloted in Zhengzhou's Longzihu area, it is being commercialized with China Tower.

articles.title_zh: 2026年豫和青少年双向交流活动开营仪式举行
articles.title_en: 2026 Henan-Hetian Youth Exchange Program Opens in Zhengzhou
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，2026年豫和青少年双向交流活动开营仪式在郑州举行，省委常委、组织部长王刚出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the opening ceremony of the 2026 Henan-Hetian youth exchange program was held in Zhengzhou, with Wang Gang, member of the Standing Committee of the Provincial Party Committee and head of the Organization Department, attending and delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 税务总局发布《国际运输涉税服务指引》
articles.title_en: Tax Administration Issues Guide on International Transport Tax Services
articles.summary_zh: 国家税务总局发布首个跨境税收行业类指引《国际运输涉税服务指引》，为国际航海、航空、陆路运输提供涉税合规参考。
articles.summary_en: The State Taxation Administration issued its first cross-border tax industry guide, the International Transport Tax Service Guide, providing tax compliance references for international maritime, aviation, and road transport.

articles.title_zh: 湖北：坚持目标牵引与问题导向 办好全省十类重点民生实事
articles.title_en: Hubei: Adhere to Goal-Oriented and Problem-Oriented Approach, Handle Ten Key Livelihood Projects Well
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，湖北省政府召开2026年全省十类重点民生项目推进会，省长李殿勋出席并讲话，部署下步重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the Hubei Provincial Government held a meeting to promote ten key livelihood projects, attended by Governor Li Dianxun, who stressed a goal-oriented and problem-oriented approach and outlined next steps.

articles.title_zh: 抓改革优服务，打造一流营商环境
articles.title_en: Reform and Better Services to Build a First-Class Business Environment
articles.summary_zh: 河北省自2023年以来连续四年聚焦优化营商环境，推行政务服务全域通办、信用代证等改革，提升市场活力，吸引投资兴业。
articles.summary_en: Since 2023, Hebei Province has focused on improving its business environment for four consecutive years, implementing reforms such as full-domain handling and credit instead of certificates to boost market vitality and attract investment.

articles.title_zh: 海南获国务院最严格水资源管理制度考核优秀等次
articles.title_en: Hainan Wins Excellent Rating in State Council's Strictest Water Resources Management Assessment
articles.summary_zh: 近日，水利部公布2025年度实行最严格水资源管理制度考核结果，海南省获优秀等次。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Ministry of Water Resources announced the 2025 assessment results for the strictest water resources management system, and Hainan Province received an excellent rating.

articles.title_zh: 省长刘小明在屯昌调研强调强化以商招商与产业链精准招商
articles.title_en: Governor Liu Xiaoming Stresses Targeted Investment Attraction During Tunchang Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，海南省省长刘小明在屯昌县调研经济社会发展，强调要强化以商招商与产业链精准招商，走特色化、集聚化、融合化产业发展道路，并推进乡村振兴等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Governor Liu Xiaoming of Hainan visited Tunchang County to inspect economic and social development, stressing targeted investment attraction and integrated industrial growth, while promoting rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省委常委会召开会议 许勤主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting, Xu Qin Presides and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，黑龙江省委书记许勤主持召开省委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，审议农业农村现代化“十五五”规划。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee Secretary Xu Qin chaired a standing committee meeting to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and review the 15th Five-Year Plan for agricultural and rural modernization.

articles.title_zh: 抢占新赛道 锻造新优势 长春市二道区上半年经济发展观察
articles.title_en: Seizing New Opportunities: A Review of H1 Economic Development in Changchun's Erdao District
articles.summary_zh: 长春市二道区上半年大力培育新质生产力，推动传统产业升级和新兴产业壮大，数字经济核心企业增长15%，消费市场活力提升。
articles.summary_en: In H1, Changchun's Erdao District fostered new quality productive forces, upgrading traditional industries and expanding emerging ones. Digital economy core enterprises grew 15% and retail sales rose 13.7%.

articles.title_zh: 南京高淳出台“淳10条”扶持自媒体全链条发展
articles.title_en: Gaochun District of Nanjing Issues 'Chun 10 Measures' to Support Full-Chain Development of Self-Media
articles.summary_zh: 近日，南京市高淳区出台江苏省首个自媒体扶持政策“淳10条”，围绕七大维度十条举措覆盖自媒体创作、发展、创业、生活、维权全链条。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Gaochun District of Nanjing issued Jiangsu Province's first policy supporting self-media, the 'Chun 10 Measures', with ten measures covering creation, development, entrepreneurship, living, and rights protection.

articles.title_zh: 连云港设立安防领域10亿元母基金 发布22个应用场景
articles.title_en: Lianyungang Sets Up 1 Billion Yuan Fund for Security Industry, Releases 22 Application Scenarios
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，江苏连云港市安防产业合作发展大会召开，揭牌设立全省首个安防领域10亿元产业母基金，并发布六大类22个安防应用场景，推动千亿级安防产业集群建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the Lianyungang Security Industry Cooperation and Development Conference was held in Jiangsu, unveiling the province's first 1 billion yuan industrial fund for security and releasing 22 application scenarios in six categories to build a 100-billion-yuan security industry cluster.

articles.title_zh: 江苏部署深化扫黑除恶专项斗争等工作
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Deploys Campaign Against Gang Crimes and Telecom Fraud
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，江苏省公安厅召开视频调度会，部署深化扫黑除恶专项斗争、打击治理电信网络诈骗犯罪和专项打击整治等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, Jiangsu Provincial Public Security Department held a video conference to deploy campaigns against gang crimes, telecom fraud, and other targeted crackdowns.

articles.title_zh: 自治区政协召开专题协商会
articles.title_en: Regional CPPCC Holds Special Consultation Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，自治区政协召开“加快构建互嵌式社会结构和社区环境”专题协商会，自治区政府副主席苏和通报情况，政协副主席张磊讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, the Regional CPPCC held a special consultation meeting on accelerating the construction of an inter-embedded social structure and community environment. Vice Chairman Su He briefed the situation, and Vice Chairman Zhang Lei delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中包钢会见来内蒙古参加学术活动的院士专家
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong and Bao Gang Meet Academicians Visiting Inner Mongolia for Academic Activities
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中、主席包钢在呼和浩特会见来参加学术活动的中国科学院、中国工程院院士专家，欢迎并介绍科技创新情况，院士专家表示将深化合作。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Wang Weizhong, Party Secretary of Inner Mongolia, and Bao Gang, Chairman of the Regional Government, met with academicians from the Chinese Academy of Sciences and the Chinese Academy of Engineering in Hohhot to discuss sci-tech innovation and cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 闽宁联合发布12条地理标志文旅线路
articles.title_en: Fujian and Ningxia Jointly Release 12 Geographical Indication Cultural Tourism Routes
articles.summary_zh: 日前，福建省市场监管局与宁夏市场监管厅联合举办闽宁协作30周年地理标志赋能区域经济发展交流活动，共同发布12条地理标志文旅线路，并签署知识产权协同保护合作协议。
articles.summary_en: Fujian and Ningxia jointly held an exchange event on GIs empowering regional economic development, releasing 12 GI cultural tourism routes and signing IP cooperation agreements.

articles.title_zh: 西北首个！国家人工智能产业创新应用先导区落地宁夏银川
articles.title_en: First National AI Industry Innovation Pilot Zone in Northwest China Established in Yinchuan, Ningxia
articles.summary_zh: 近日，宁夏银川获批建设国家人工智能产业创新应用先导区，成为西北地区首个获批城市，标志其人工智能产业迈入国家级战略布局新阶段。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Yinchuan, Ningxia was approved to build a national artificial intelligence industry innovation and application pilot zone, becoming the first city in northwest China to receive such approval, marking a new stage of national strategic layout for the city's AI industry.

articles.title_zh: 切实在生态环境领域为基层减负赋能
articles.title_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment Cuts Bureaucracy to Ease Burden on Grassroots
articles.summary_zh: 生态环境部持续深化拓展整治形式主义，通过压减督察调阅资料、推行非现场执法等措施，切实为基层减负赋能。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment continues to reduce bureaucratic burdens on grassroots units by cutting material requests, promoting non-site supervision, and streamlining inspections.

articles.title_zh: 阿坝州创新全域宣讲推动党的创新理论落地生根
articles.title_en: Aba Prefecture Innovates All-Area Publicity to Spread the Party's Innovative Theory
articles.summary_zh: 阿坝州创新开展“人人都是宣讲员”全域宣讲活动，通过多样形式将党的创新理论送进基层，截至7月24日已刊发相关稿件253条。
articles.summary_en: Aba Prefecture launched an innovative 'Everyone is a Publicity Officer' campaign to bring the Party's innovative theory to grassroots through various forms, with 253 related articles published as of July 24.

articles.title_zh: 成都出台全国首个人工智能地方政府规章
articles.title_en: Chengdu Issues China's First Local Government Regulation on AI Industry
articles.summary_zh: 近日，成都市出台《成都市促进人工智能产业发展办法》，系全国首个人工智能地方政府规章，将于9月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: Chengdu has issued the Measures for Promoting the Development of the AI Industry, the first local government regulation on AI in China, effective September 1st.

articles.title_zh: 上海促进民营经济发展“十五五”规划发布
articles.title_en: Shanghai Releases 15th Five-Year Plan for Private Economy Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，上海市发改委发布《上海市促进民营经济发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年民营经济增加值占比达33%左右等目标，并部署创新、开放等重点方向。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Shanghai Municipal Development and Reform Commission issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for promoting private economy, setting targets such as private economy accounting for about 33% of added value by 2030, and outlining priorities in innovation and opening-up.

articles.title_zh: “沪派江南”首个开工项目，金山新元村9月首秀
articles.title_en: First 'Hupai Jiangnan' Project in Jinshan Xinyuan Village to Debut in September
articles.summary_zh: 作为“沪派江南”首批试点首个开工项目，金山新元村将于9月完成提升改造，重塑千年圩田风貌，让水系重回生活生产中心。
articles.summary_en: As the first pilot project of "Hupai Jiangnan", Xinyuan Village in Jinshan will complete renovation in September, restoring the millennium-old polder landscape and bringing water back to the center of life and production.

articles.title_zh: 赵一德在商洛市检查防汛救灾工作时强调全力以赴防大汛抢大险救大灾
articles.title_en: Zhao Yide Inspects Flood Control and Disaster Relief Work in Shangluo
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，陕西省委书记赵一德到商洛市检查防汛救灾工作，强调全力以赴防大汛抢大险救大灾，切实保障人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Zhao Yide, Secretary of the CPC Shaanxi Provincial Committee, inspected flood control and disaster relief work in Shangluo, emphasizing all-out efforts to protect people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 陕西省公安厅部署开展深化扫黑除恶专项斗争
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Provincial Public Security Department Deploys Deepening Special Campaign Against Organized Crime and Vice
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，陕西省公安厅召开全省公安机关视频会议，部署深化扫黑除恶专项斗争，强调重拳打击新型黑恶犯罪。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, the Shaanxi Provincial Public Security Department held a video conference to deploy deepening the special campaign against organized crime and vice, emphasizing crackdown on new types of gang crimes.

articles.title_zh: 柔性制造，高效匹配差异化需求（经济新方位·制造业新趋势）
articles.title_en: Flexible Manufacturing Efficiently Matches Diversified Demand (New Economic Trends in Manufacturing)
articles.summary_zh: 报道福建泉州和重庆企业通过柔性制造实现小批量、个性化定制，缩短交付周期，体现制造业新趋势。
articles.summary_en: Reports on flexible manufacturing in Quanzhou and Chongqing, enabling small-batch, personalized orders with shorter lead times, reflecting a new manufacturing trend.

articles.title_zh: 山西省首批快速充放电桩太原投运
articles.title_en: Shanxi's First Fast Charging and Discharging Piles Put into Operation in Taiyuan
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，国网太原供电公司迎西充电站新一代V2G双向直流快速充放电桩正式投运，为山西省首批同类设备，有助于电网削峰填谷。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, the Yingxi charging station of State Grid Taiyuan Power Supply Company put into operation a new generation of V2G bidirectional DC fast charging and discharging piles, the first of their kind in Shanxi, helping to peak shave for the grid.

articles.title_zh: 滨海—中关村科创中心项目启动
articles.title_en: Binhai-Zhongguancun Sci-Tech Innovation Center Project Launched
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，滨海—中关村科创中心项目在天津经开区正式启动，将重点培育高端科技服务、未来产业等三大产业集群，推动京津冀协同创新。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the Binhai-Zhongguancun Sci-Tech Innovation Center project was officially launched in Tianjin Economic-Technological Development Area, focusing on high-end technology services and future industries to boost regional innovation collaboration.

articles.title_zh: 拉萨市对外贸易商会成立 填补全区外贸领域社会组织空白
articles.title_en: Lhasa Foreign Trade Chamber of Commerce Established, Filling Regional Gap
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，拉萨市对外贸易商会成立，成为西藏自治区首家对外贸易领域社会组织，旨在搭建政企对接等平台，促进外贸发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, the Lhasa Foreign Trade Chamber of Commerce was established as the first social organization in Tibet's foreign trade sector, aiming to build platforms for government-enterprise cooperation and boost foreign trade.

articles.title_zh: 三江并流世界自然遗产保护状况报告通过省级评审
articles.title_en: Report on Protection Status of Three Parallel Rivers World Natural Heritage Passes Provincial Review
articles.summary_zh: 近日，云南省林业和草原局组织编制的《三江并流世界自然遗产保护状况报告（2026）》通过省级评审，专家认为其客观全面展现保护管理成效。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Three Parallel Rivers World Natural Heritage Protection Status Report (2026), organized by Yunnan Provincial Forestry and Grassland Bureau, passed provincial review. Experts agreed it objectively presents protection management achievements.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能让通关跑出加速度
articles.title_en: AI Accelerates Customs Clearance
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，杭州海关利用AI智能眼镜查获一批精神药品。全国海关正推广智能监管装备，提升通关效率，优化口岸营商环境。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Hangzhou Customs used AI smart glasses to intercept psychotropic drugs. Customs nationwide are deploying intelligent equipment to speed up clearance and improve the port business environment.

articles.title_zh: 构建人类命运共同体理念的形成发展和世界意义
articles.title_en: The Formation, Development and World Significance of the Concept of Building a Community with a Shared Future for Mankind
articles.summary_zh: 文章阐述构建人类命运共同体理念从提出到成为国际共识的发展历程及其世界意义，强调该理念为世界和平与发展提供中国方案。
articles.summary_en: The article elaborates on the development of the Community with a Shared Future for Mankind concept from inception to international consensus, highlighting its significance for world peace and development.

articles.title_zh: 以高度的历史主动把握时代航向
articles.title_en: Seize the Direction of the Times with High Historical Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，新华社发表述评文章，阐释习近平党建思想的历史主动理论品格，强调把握历史规律、推进自我革命，指引新时代党的建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Xinhua published a commentary expounding the theoretical character of historical initiative in Xi Jinping's thoughts on Party building, emphasizing grasping historical laws, advancing self-reform, and guiding Party construction in the new era.

articles.title_zh: “发力提效”释放鲜明政策信号
articles.title_en: 'Intensify and Improve Efficiency' Sends Clear Policy Signal
articles.summary_zh: 近日中共中央政治局会议部署下半年经济工作，提出宏观政策要发力提效，实施更加积极的财政政策和适度宽松的货币政策，加大逆周期调节力度。
articles.summary_en: The recent Politburo meeting called for intensifying macro policy effectiveness, more proactive fiscal policy, moderately loose monetary policy, and stronger counter-cyclical adjustments.

articles.title_zh: 青春小店创业记：让梦想生根
articles.title_en: Youth Shops: Entrepreneurship Stories
articles.summary_zh: 自2023年起，“青春小店”项目累计服务创业青年超5万人次；2026年4月共青团中央等15部门发文鼓励其发展，多地涌现特色小店，激发青年创业活力。
articles.summary_en: The Youth Shop project, launched in 2023, has aided 50,000+ young entrepreneurs. In April 2026, 15 departments led by the CYL issued a policy to support it, as unique shops nationwide boost youth-driven economy.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛专题调研就业创业工作 以更实举措稳就业更优服务促创业
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Investigates Employment and Entrepreneurship in Nanjing
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，江苏省省长刘小涛在南京市调研就业创业工作，强调要实施就业优先战略，以更实举措稳就业、更优服务促创业，并实地考察人力资源服务产业园、AI人才实训基地等。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 5, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao visited Nanjing for employment/entrepreneurship research, urging stable jobs and better services. He toured HR parks and AI talent bases.

articles.title_zh: 信长星会见乌兹别克斯坦客人
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing Meets Uzbek Guests
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，江苏省委书记信长星在南京会见乌兹别克斯坦驻华大使法尔霍德·阿尔济耶夫，双方就深化经贸合作、人文交流等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Xin Changxing, Secretary of Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee, met with Uzbek Ambassador to China Farhod Arziyev in Nanjing to discuss deepening economic and trade cooperation and cultural exchanges.

articles.title_zh: 以鲜明的问题导向加强自身建设——习近平党建思想理论品格系列述评之三
articles.title_en: Building the Party with a Distinct Problem-Oriented Approach — Third Commentary on Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 新华社述评指出，习近平党建思想以鲜明问题导向推进党的自我革命，直面大党独有难题，坚持标本兼治、系统施治，持之以恒全面从严治党。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua commentary says Xi Jinping's thought on Party building adopts a problem-oriented approach to advance self-reform, confronts unique challenges facing the big Party, and promotes comprehensive and rigorous Party governance with sustained efforts.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 学习新语·铸魂强党丨学懂弄通做实党的创新理论
articles.title_en: Studying and Implementing the Party's Innovative Theory
articles.summary_zh: 新华社“学习新语”栏目推出“铸魂强党”系列融合报道，本期围绕“坚持用党的创新理论凝心铸魂”系统梳理习近平总书记重要论述。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua's 'Learning New Words' column launches the 'Strengthening the Party' series, focusing on consolidating the Party with the Party's innovative theory and Xi Jinping's important remarks.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 让药品更好触达患者 网络平台成多款新药首发渠道
articles.title_en: Network Platforms Become Primary Launch Channels for New Drugs, Improving Patient Access
articles.summary_zh: 2025年我国上市新药约120个，网络平台成为新药首发重要渠道，提升偏远地区药品可及性，但线上药学服务仍有待完善。
articles.summary_en: In 2025, about 120 new drugs were launched in China, with online platforms becoming key first-launch channels that improve drug accessibility, though online pharmaceutical services still need improvement.

articles.title_zh: 《民用航空发展“十五五”规划》印发
articles.title_en: China Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Civil Aviation Development
articles.summary_zh: 中国民航局、国家发展改革委、交通运输部近日联合印发《民用航空发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年安全、服务、基础设施等率先迈向国际一流。
articles.summary_en: The Civil Aviation Administration, the National Development and Reform Commission, and the Ministry of Transport jointly issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for civil aviation development, aiming to make safety, services, and infrastructure world-class by 2030.

tags.name_en: Building a Country with Strong Transportation Network

tags_en: Building a Country with Strong Transportation Network

articles.title_zh: 南水北调中线工程调水突破800亿立方米
articles.title_en: South-to-North Water Diversion Middle Route Surpasses 80 Billion Cubic Meters
articles.summary_zh: 截至8月7日，南水北调中线工程累计向北方调水突破800亿立方米，惠及豫冀津京近1.18亿人，为沿线城市发展提供水资源支撑。
articles.summary_en: As of August 7, the middle route of the South-to-North Water Diversion Project has transferred over 80 billion cubic meters of water to northern China, benefiting nearly 118 million people in Henan, Hebei, Tianjin and Beijing.

articles.title_zh: 各地区各部门各单位深入开展学习教育——着力在为民造福上出实招、求实效
articles.title_en: All Regions, Departments and Units Deepen Study and Education to Deliver Tangible Benefits to the People
articles.summary_zh: 当前，各地区各部门各单位深入开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，一体推进学查改，以理论武装、调查研究、开门教育、建章立制等举措，着力在为民造福上出实招、求实效。
articles.summary_en: Currently, various regions, departments and units are deepening the study and education initiative on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements, integrating learning, investigation, and rectification, and focusing on concrete actions to benefit the people.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委十届十六次全会召开
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Regional Party Committee Holds 16th Plenary Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，新疆维吾尔自治区党委十届十六次全会在乌鲁木齐召开，决定今年10月召开自治区第十一次党代会。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the 16th Plenary Session of the 10th Xinjiang Regional Party Committee was held in Urumqi, deciding to convene the 11th Regional Party Congress in October.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在中国铁路乌鲁木齐局集团走访调研
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang and Erkin Tuniyaz Visit and Research at China Railway Urumqi Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，自治区党委书记陈小江、自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜到中国铁路乌鲁木齐局集团调研座谈，强调发挥铁路骨干作用，支持新疆建设交通强区。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Party Secretary Chen Xiaojiang and Chairman Erkin Tuniyaz visited China Railway Urumqi Group, emphasizing the railway's key role in supporting Xinjiang's transportation development.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷主持防汛防台会商会议部署防御台风“白海豚”
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Chairs Flood and Typhoon Prevention Coordination Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 6日下午，浙江省委副书记、省长刘捷在省防汛防台应急指挥中心主持召开台风“白海豚”防御工作会商会议，部署防汛防台工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of the 6th, Liu Jie, Deputy Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee and Governor, chaired a coordination meeting on defense against Typhoon Baiji at the provincial flood and typhoon emergency command center.

articles.title_zh: 广东省安委会约谈汕头市政府
articles.title_en: Guangdong Work Safety Committee Summons Shantou Municipal Government
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，针对2025年度安全生产考核巡查结果排名靠后，广东省安委会约谈汕头市政府主要负责同志，强调要压实责任、防范遏制重特大事故。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Guangdong Provincial Work Safety Committee summoned the main heads of Shantou Municipal Government over its poor performance in the 2025 safety production assessment, urging firm responsibility and prevention of major accidents.

articles.title_zh: 中国黄金协会：上半年我国黄金产量同比下降 消费量同比微增
articles.title_en: China Gold Association: H1 Gold Output Down YoY, Consumption Slightly Up
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，中国黄金协会发布数据，上半年国内黄金产量152.908吨，同比下降14.62%；消费量511.412吨，同比增长1.23%。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the China Gold Association reported H1 domestic gold output of 152.908 tonnes, down 14.62% YoY, while consumption rose 1.23% to 511.412 tonnes.

articles.title_zh: 新疆红其拉甫边检站：在“生命禁区”构筑“精神灯塔”
articles.title_en: Khunjerab Border Inspection Station in Xinjiang: Building a 'Spiritual Lighthouse' in a 'Life-Forbidden Zone'
articles.summary_zh: 红其拉甫出入境边防检查站于帕米尔高原“生命禁区”创新打造党建品牌，通过实景教育、红色教育带和党建共建，强化队伍忠诚履职，服务通关和经济发展。
articles.summary_en: The Khunjerab entry-exit border inspection station in the Pamir Plateau has innovated a party-building brand, using immersive education and red resources to strengthen loyalty and serve border traffic and development.

articles.title_zh: 上合组织“天山-2026”联合网络反恐演习在新疆举行
articles.title_en: SCO Holds 'Tianshan-2026' Joint Cyber Counter-Terrorism Drill in Xinjiang
articles.summary_zh: 7月23日，上合组织成员国主管机关在新疆乌鲁木齐举行“天山-2026”联合网络反恐演习，模拟网络恐怖袭击场景，提升协同处置能力。
articles.summary_en: On July 23, SCO member states' competent authorities held the 'Tianshan-2026' joint cyber counter-terrorism drill in Urumqi, Xinjiang, simulating cyber terror scenarios to enhance coordinated response.

articles.title_zh: 我国编制完成新版全月地质图
articles.title_en: China Completes New Global Lunar Geologic Map
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，中国地质科学院地质研究所透露，我国科研团队编制完成1:500万全月地质图，修正月球地质年代，识别新岩石类型，为月球科研站建设和深空探测提供支撑。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the Institute of Geology, CAGS, announced that Chinese researchers finished a new 1:5,000,000 global lunar geologic map, refining the lunar timescale and identifying new rock types to support future lunar exploration.

articles.title_zh: 中国最高法发布生态环境法典首个配套司法解释
articles.title_en: China's Top Court Issues First Judicial Interpretation on Eco-Environment Code
articles.summary_zh: 最高人民法院8月6日发布关于适用《中华人民共和国生态环境法典》时间效力的若干规定，这是生态环境法典首个配套司法解释，明确了法典适用的时间标准。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the Supreme People's Court issued the first supporting judicial interpretation for the Ecological Environment Code, specifying temporal application rules for the code.

articles.title_zh: 2026年反恐国际研讨会在新疆举行
articles.title_en: 2026 Counter-Terrorism International Symposium Held in Xinjiang
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月4日，反恐国际研讨会在新疆举行，来自20多个国家和国际组织的代表围绕反恐挑战、新兴技术滥用等议题深入探讨并达成共识。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, 2026, the International Symposium on Counter-Terrorism was held in Xinjiang, bringing together representatives from over 20 countries and international organizations to discuss regional counter-terrorism challenges and the misuse of emerging technologies, reaching a series of consensuses.

articles.title_zh: 保障生态环境法典实施 最高法发布首个配套司法解释
articles.title_en: Supreme People's Court Issues First Supporting Judicial Interpretation for Ecological Environment Code
articles.summary_zh: 最高人民法院8月6日举行新闻发布会，发布《关于适用〈中华人民共和国生态环境法典〉时间效力的若干规定》，这是生态环境法典施行后的首个配套司法解释，将于8月15日与法典同步施行。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the Supreme People's Court held a press conference and issued the Provisions on the Time Effect of Application of the Ecological Environment Code of the People's Republic of China, the first supporting judicial interpretation, effective August 15.

articles.title_zh: 向新向优转型提速 上半年我国机械工业行业运行稳中有进
articles.title_en: China's Machinery Industry Maintains Steady Growth in H1 2026
articles.summary_zh: 今年上半年，我国机械工业规模以上企业增加值同比增长6.4%，营业收入16.1万亿元，行业运行稳中有进，转型提速。
articles.summary_en: In H1 2026, China's machinery industry saw a 6.4% year-on-year increase in value-added output and 16.1 trillion yuan in revenue, showing steady progress.

articles.title_zh: 最高法：集中清理生态环境领域司法解释和规范性文件
articles.title_en: Supreme People's Court Announces Cleanup of Ecological Environment Judicial Interpretations
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，最高人民法院举行发布会，通报对生态环境领域26件司法解释、35件司法规范性文件和45件指导性案例进行集中清理，保留、修改或废止相关文件。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the Supreme People's Court held a press conference to report the centralized review of 26 judicial interpretations, 35 normative documents, and 45 guiding cases in the ecological environment field, retaining, amending, or repealing them.

articles.title_zh: 两部门紧急预拨3.3亿元中央自然灾害救灾资金
articles.title_en: Two Ministries Allocate 330 Million Yuan for Disaster Relief
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，财政部、应急管理部紧急预拨3.3亿元中央自然灾害救灾资金，支持黑龙江、辽宁等8省（市）开展应急抢险救灾工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Emergency Management allocated 330 million yuan in central disaster relief funds to support 8 provinces and municipalities in emergency rescue operations.

articles.title_zh: 延伸链条，老区“长”出新产业
articles.title_en: Old Revolutionary Base Areas Grow New Industries by Extending Industrial Chains
articles.summary_zh: 报道福建明溪、广西百色、贵州遵义等地依托资源禀赋，攻克关键技术，延伸产业链，发展生物医药、铝新材料、特种钢丝绳等特色产业，推动老区振兴。
articles.summary_en: Reports on Fujian Mingxi, Guangxi Baise, and Guizhou Zunyi leveraging local resources, overcoming key technologies, and extending industrial chains to develop biopharmaceuticals, new aluminum materials, and special steel wire ropes, boosting the revitalization of old revolutionary base areas.

tags.name_en: Revitalization of Old Revolutionary Base Areas

tags_en: Revitalization of Old Revolutionary Base Areas

articles.title_zh: 以法治力量守护“中华水塔”（坚持和完善人民代表大会制度）
articles.title_en: Guarding the 'Water Tower of China' with the Power of Law (Upholding and Improving the People's Congress System)
articles.summary_zh: 全国人大常委会办公厅在青海举办中华环保世纪行2026年宣传活动，主题为贯彻实施生态环境法典、加强青藏高原生态保护，记者赴多地采访见证法治守护生态。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of the Standing Committee of the NPC organized the 2026 China Environmental Protection Tour in Qinghai, themed on implementing the Ecological Environment Code and strengthening ecological protection on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, with reporters witnessing rule-of-law efforts in safeguarding ecology.

tags.name_en: General Office of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

articles.title_zh: 三个转变看中原
articles.title_en: Three Transformations: A Look at the Central Plains
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报报道河南落实习近平总书记‘三个转变’要求，通过创新驱动、质量革命、品牌赋能，推动制造业由大到强，实现高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily reports on Henan's implementation of President Xi Jinping's 'three transformations' requirement. Through innovation, quality revolution, and brand building, Henan's manufacturing moves from large to strong.

articles.title_zh: 福州深化实施新时代“堡垒工程”
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Deepens Implementation of New 'Fortress Project' in Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 福州市深化实施新时代“堡垒工程”，通过党建引领基层治理，建强党群服务阵地，解决群众急难愁盼问题，推动基层党组织全面进步、全面过硬。
articles.summary_en: Fuzhou is deepening the implementation of the new 'Fortress Project', using party building to guide grassroots governance, strengthen service positions, and solve urgent problems for residents, making community-level party organizations stronger.

articles.title_zh: 帮乡亲们把好收成变为好收益
articles.title_en: Helping Villagers Turn Good Harvests into Good Income
articles.summary_zh: 河北邯郸曲周县科技小院推广绿色生产技术，带动农业增效、农民增收，延伸深加工链条，助力乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: In Quzhou County, Handan, Hebei, science and technology backyards promote green farming techniques, boosting agricultural efficiency and farmers' incomes, and extending processing chains to aid rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 除作风之弊 兴实干之风
articles.title_en: Eradicating Bad Work Styles and Fostering Pragmatism
articles.summary_zh: 2024年8月《整治形式主义为基层减负若干规定》实施以来，中央通报9批27起典型问题，各地通过清单管理、数字化减负等举措减轻基层负担，推动作风建设常态化长效化。
articles.summary_en: Since August 2024, the central authorities have reported 27 typical cases in 9 batches, while localities have reduced grassroots burdens through list-based management and digitalization, promoting a pragmatic work style.

articles.title_zh: 市委召开常委会会议 认真学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神 研究国防动员和后备力量建设防汛防滑救灾等工作 柯昌万主持会议
articles.title_en: Ankang Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting on National Defense Mobilization and Flood Control
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，安康市委召开常委会会议，学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究国防动员、防汛防滑救灾等工作，市委书记柯昌万主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, the Ankang Municipal Party Committee held a standing committee meeting to study Xi Jinping's important speech and discuss national defense mobilization, flood prevention and disaster relief. Party Secretary Ke Changwan chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠顾刚会见中国工程院院士王军志一行
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui and Gu Gang Meet with Academician Wang Junzhi
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，长春市委书记张恩惠、市长顾刚会见中国工程院院士王军志一行，双方就生物医药产业合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Zhang Enhui and Gu Gang met with Wang Junzhi, academician of CAE, to discuss cooperation in the biomedical industry.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠到绿园区调研时强调 抓实项目建设 做强产业支撑 为长春高质量发展蓄势赋能
articles.title_en: Changchun Party Chief Zhang Enhui Tours Lvyuan District, Stresses on Project Construction and Industrial Support
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，长春市委书记张恩惠到绿园区调研，踏查重大项目建设，走访重点企业，强调抓实项目建设、做强产业支撑，为高质量发展蓄势赋能。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Zhang Enhui, Party Secretary of Changchun, visited Lvyuan District to inspect major projects and key enterprises, emphasizing solid project construction and strong industrial support to boost high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Shenyang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Convey Xi Jinping's Important Speech and Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，沈阳市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示及中央有关会议精神，研究部署贯彻落实工作。市委书记霍步刚主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, the Standing Committee of the Shenyang Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's important speech and instructions, as well as relevant central meeting spirits, and to plan implementation. Party Secretary Huo Bugang presided and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 唐毅主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议暨市委党建工作领导小组会议
articles.title_en: Tang Yi Chairs Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting and Party Building Work Leading Group Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，市委书记唐毅主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议暨市委党建工作领导小组会议，传达学习中央政治局会议精神和习近平总书记重要讲话精神，部署贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Municipal Party Committee Secretary Tang Yi chaired the Standing Committee (enlarged) meeting and the Party Building Work Leading Group meeting, conveying the spirit of the recent Political Bureau meeting and General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech, and deploying implementation work.

articles.title_zh: 我国吸引外资结构进一步向新向好
articles.title_en: China's Foreign Investment Structure Further Improves
articles.summary_zh: 上半年高技术产业吸收外资同比增长33.2%，占外资总额42.4%；外资加码在华先进技术投资，引资结构向新向好。
articles.summary_en: In H1, foreign investment in high-tech industry rose 33.2% YoY, accounting for 42.4% of total; MNCs increased investment in advanced tech, improving structure.

articles.title_zh: 上半年我国服务出口增长17.6%
articles.title_en: China's Service Exports Grow 17.6% in H1
articles.summary_zh: 商务部数据显示，今年上半年我国服务进出口总额超3.77万亿元，同比增长8.3%；其中服务出口增长17.6%，贸易逆差收窄。
articles.summary_en: According to the Ministry of Commerce, China's total service imports and exports reached 3.78 trillion yuan in H1, up 8.3% year-on-year, with exports up 17.6% and trade deficit narrowing.

articles.title_zh: 上半年我国机械工业规上企业增加值同比增长6.4%
articles.title_en: China's Machinery Industry Sees 6.4% Growth in H1
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，中国机械工业联合会发布数据显示，上半年我国机械工业规上企业增加值同比增长6.4%，新质生产力发展势头良好。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 6, China Machinery Industry Federation reported a 6.4% year-on-year increase in value-added of above-scale machinery enterprises in H1, with strong growth in new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 7月中国物流业景气指数为50.4% 总体保持扩张
articles.title_en: China's Logistics Prosperity Index at 50.4% in July, Maintaining Expansion
articles.summary_zh: 中国物流与采购联合会发布数据显示，7月中国物流业景气指数为50.4%，较上月回落0.2个百分点，总体保持扩张，新订单指数连续5个月回升。

articles.summary_en: On July 30, Xi Jinping chaired a meeting of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, emphasizing the need to accelerate the development of a modern industrial system, promote breakthroughs in frontier technologies, foster emerging pillar industries, and upgrade traditional industries.

tags.name_en: Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee

tags_en: Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 中共济南市委十二届十次全体会议举行 刘强讲话
articles.title_en: CPC Jinan Municipal Committee Holds 10th Plenary Session, Liu Qiang Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，中共济南市第十二届委员会第十次全体会议举行，市委书记刘强讲话，强调贯彻习近平总书记视察山东重要讲话精神，推进全面从严治党和高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, the 10th Plenary Session of the 12th CPC Jinan Municipal Committee was held, with Municipal Party Secretary Liu Qiang delivering a speech emphasizing implementation of Xi Jinping's guidelines from his Shandong inspection and advancing strict party governance and high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 时政微观察：向新向优向好！中国经济展现强大韧性和活力
articles.title_en: Political Observation: China's Economy Shows Strong Resilience and Vitality
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，中共中央政治局召开会议分析经济形势，部署下半年工作。上半年GDP同比增长4.7%，新动能贡献率超40%。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau met to analyze the economic situation and arrange H2 work. H1 GDP grew 4.7% YoY, with new drivers contributing over 40%.

articles.title_zh: 全省科技大会在济南召开
articles.title_en: Provincial Science and Technology Conference Held in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日下午，全省科技大会在济南召开。省委书记林武讲话，省长周乃翔主持，表彰2025年度山东省科学技术奖获奖者并部署科技创新任务。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 6, the provincial science and technology conference was held in Jinan. Party Secretary Lin Wu delivered a speech, Governor Zhou Naixiang chaired, and the meeting honored winners of the 2025 Shandong Science and Technology Awards and outlined key tasks for innovation.

tags.name_en: Building a Strong Province in Science and Technology

tags_en: Building a Strong Province in Science and Technology

articles.title_zh: 厦门市委上半年工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Xiamen Municipal Party Committee Holds Work Conference for First Half of Year
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，厦门市委召开上半年工作会议，总结上半年工作，部署下半年任务，市委书记林涛主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, the Xiamen Municipal Party Committee held a work conference to review first-half performance and arrange tasks for the second half. Party Secretary Lin Tao presided and addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记今年以来治国理政纪实：砥砺初心使命 把党建设得更加坚强有力
articles.title_en: Documentary on Xi Jinping's Governance: Forging a Stronger CPC with Original Aspirations
articles.summary_zh: 2026年，中国共产党迎来成立105周年。习近平总书记领导全党开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，推进全面从严治党，并在庆祝大会上强调党的建设。
articles.summary_en: In 2026, the CPC marks its 105th anniversary. General Secretary Xi Jinping leads the Party in promoting correct views on political achievements, advancing full and strict governance, and stressing Party building at the celebration conference.

tags.name_en: Full and Strict Governance over the Party

tags_en: Full and Strict Governance over the Party

articles.title_zh: 刘捷主持召开台风“白海豚”防御工作会商会议强调 立足最不利局面做最充分准备 扎实做好防汛防台各项工作
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Chairs Typhoon 'White Dolphin' Defense Work Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日下午，省委副书记、省长刘捷在省防汛防台应急指挥中心主持召开台风“白海豚”防御工作会商会议，部署防汛防台工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Aug 6, Liu Jie, deputy secretary of the provincial party committee and governor, chaired a typhoon defense meeting at the provincial emergency command center.

articles.title_zh: 江西南昌一男子拒服兵役被惩戒：不得录用为公务员，取消优待并罚款
articles.title_en: Man in Nanchang, Jiangxi Punished for Refusing Military Service: Banned from Civil Service, Deprived of Benefits and Fined
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，江西南昌县通报对拒服兵役青年杨天誉的处理决定：纳入国防义务严重失信名单，不得录用为公务员，取消优待并罚款39664元。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, Nanchang County, Jiangxi, announced punishment for Yang Tianyu who refused military service: included in the national defense obligation credit blacklist, banned from civil service, deprived of benefits, and fined 39,664 yuan.

articles.title_zh: 高温带动用电需求增长，多个省级电网用电负荷屡创历史新高
articles.title_en: Heat Wave Drives Power Demand, Multiple Provincial Grids Hit Record Highs
articles.summary_zh: 近期全国多地高温，多个省级电网用电负荷屡创历史新高，辽宁、吉林、山东、天津等地通过跨省互济、储能调用等措施保障电力供应。
articles.summary_en: Amid recent heatwaves across China, multiple provincial power grids hit record highs in load. Liaoning, Jilin, Shandong, Tianjin and others ensured supply via cross-province sharing and storage dispatch.

articles.title_zh: 中国萧军研究会声明打假：从未设立“中国萧军研究会中央国学院”
articles.title_en: China Xiao Jun Research Society Issues Warning: Never Established 'Central Academy of Chinese Studies'
articles.summary_zh: 中国萧军研究会发布打假声明，否认设立所谓“中央国学院”，指其为冒用名义的非法虚假机构，提醒公众警惕并保留追责权利。
articles.summary_en: China Xiao Jun Research Society issued a statement denying establishment of a so-called 'Central Academy', calling it a fake institution misusing its name and warning the public.

articles.title_zh: 安徽省村民委员会选举办法
articles.title_en: Measures of Anhui Province for the Election of Villagers' Committees
articles.summary_zh: 安徽省人大常委会修订通过《安徽省村民委员会选举办法》，自2026年8月15日起施行，规范村民委员会选举，保障村民民主权利。
articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of Anhui Provincial People's Congress revised and passed the Measures for the Election of Villagers' Committees in Anhui Province, effective from August 15, 2026, to regulate the election and safeguard villagers' democratic rights.

articles.title_zh: 广西出台16条措施帮扶就业困难退役军人
articles.title_en: Guangxi Introduces 16 Measures to Assist Veterans with Employment Difficulties
articles.summary_zh: 广西壮族自治区退役军人事务厅等9部门近日印发《就业困难退役军人帮扶若干措施》，推出16条精准举措，涵盖岗位推荐、技能培训、创业扶持和兜底安置等。
articles.summary_en: Guangxi's Veterans Affairs Department and eight other agencies issued 16 measures to help veterans with employment difficulties, covering job recommendations, skills training, entrepreneurship support, and safety-net placement.

articles.title_zh: 湖北孝感：因地制宜发挥优势 找准定位担当作为
articles.title_en: Hubei Xiaogan: Adapting to Local Conditions, Leveraging Advantages, and Taking on Responsibilities
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，湖北省委书记关志鸥在孝感市调研经济社会发展并主持县（市、区）委书记座谈会，强调因地制宜融入武汉都市圈建设，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Hubei Provincial Party Secretary Guan Zhiou inspected Xiaogan's economic and social development and presided over a forum of county party secretaries, urging local adaptation and integration into the Wuhan metropolitan area to boost high-quality growth.

articles.title_zh: 小积分撬动大安全 湖北房五高速实施“暖心管理”模式
articles.title_en: Small Points Leverage Big Safety: Hubei Fangwu Expressway Implements 'Warm-hearted Management' Model
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，湖北交投集团在房五高速推行“积分超市+休息驿站”模式，工人凭安全行为积分兑换物资，有效降低了违章作业，提升安全生产水平。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, Hubei Communications Investment Group launched a 'points supermarket + rest station' model on the Fangwu Expressway, where workers redeem supplies with safety behavior points, effectively reducing violations and improving safety.

articles.title_zh: 压紧压实防汛救灾政治责任 全力维护人民群众生命财产安全
articles.title_en: Stress Political Responsibility for Flood Control to Safeguard People's Lives and Property
articles.summary_zh: 近日，河北省委书记罗文到省应急管理厅、省气象局、省水利厅和石家庄市专题调研防汛工作，强调压紧压实防汛救灾政治责任，全力维护人民群众生命财产安全。省长王正谱参加活动。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Luo Wen, Secretary of Hebei Provincial Party Committee, made a special survey on flood control at the Provincial Emergency Management Department, Meteorological Bureau, Water Resources Department, and Shijiazhuang City, stressing the need to consolidate political responsibility and safeguard people's lives and property. Governor Wang Zhengpu participated.

articles.title_zh: 做强特色产业 壮大县域经济
articles.title_en: Strengthen Special Industries and Expand County Economy
articles.summary_zh: 河北省发展县域特色产业集群，通过数智化转型、共享智造、拓展市场等方式提质增效。2025年重点集群利润同比增长16%。
articles.summary_en: Hebei Province strengthens county industrial clusters through digital transformation, shared manufacturing, and market expansion. Profit of key clusters grew 16% in 2025.

articles.title_zh: 把好事实事办到群众心坎上
articles.title_en: Doing Practical Things for the People
articles.summary_zh: 海南开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，落实为民办实事，涵盖宿舍空调、养老护理、水电抄表到户等民生事项，提升群众获得感。
articles.summary_en: Hainan carries out learning education on correct view of political achievements, implementing practical projects such as dormitory air conditioning, elderly care, and direct utility billing to improve people's well-being.

articles.title_zh: 刘小明在定安调研经济社会发展情况
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaoming Inspects Economic and Social Development in Ding'an
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，海南省省长刘小明在定安县调研经济社会发展情况，强调做强产业链配套、推动产业升级，并调研乡村振兴和垦区土地整治等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Governor Liu Xiaoming of Hainan visited Ding'an County to inspect economic and social development, emphasizing industrial chain support and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 许勤到黑龙江省气象台调度汛期气象监测预报预警工作
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Visits Heilongjiang Provincial Meteorological Observatory to Coordinate Flood Season Weather Monitoring and Warning
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日上午，黑龙江省委书记许勤到省气象台调度汛期气象监测预报预警工作，代表省委、省政府向全省气象系统干部职工表示感谢和慰问，并部署防汛抗洪和减灾救灾工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 6, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, visited the provincial meteorological observatory to coordinate flood season weather monitoring and warning work, expressing gratitude to meteorological staff and deploying flood prevention and disaster relief efforts.

articles.title_zh: 哈尔滨至伊春高铁启动按图运行试验
articles.title_en: Harbin-Yichun High-Speed Railway Starts Trial Operation
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，哈尔滨至伊春高铁启动按图运行试验，动车组由哈尔滨站始发，2小时02分后到达伊春西站。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the Harbin-Yichun high-speed railway began trial operation, with a test train departing Harbin and arriving at Yichun West in 2 hours 2 minutes.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲到五常市和尚志市督导检查防汛救灾工作
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Inspects Flood Control and Disaster Relief Work in Wuchang and Shangzhi
articles.summary_zh: 4日至5日，黑龙江省委副书记、省长梁惠玲到五常市和尚志市督导检查防汛救灾工作，强调做好防灾减灾救灾各项工作，确保人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 4 to 5, Liang Huiling, Deputy Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee and Governor, inspected flood control and disaster relief work in Wuchang and Shangzhi, stressing efforts to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 家门口的“红色阵地”
articles.title_en: The 'Red Position' at the Doorstep
articles.summary_zh: 长沙市天心区通过小区党建和综治中心双阵地，推动基层矛盾就地化解，提升社区治理水平。
articles.summary_en: Tianxin District in Changsha uses community party building and comprehensive governance centers to resolve conflicts locally and improve community governance.

articles.title_zh: 金牌“店小二”升级，园区治理焕新
articles.title_en: Gold 'Shop Assistant' Upgrade Brings New Life to Park Governance
articles.summary_zh: 近日，人民网党建调研行走进湖南长沙县长龙街道，报道其以党建为纽带打造金牌“店小二”驿站，通过党建联盟服务园区企业，解决急难愁盼问题。
articles.summary_en: Recently, People's Daily Online's Party building research team visited Changlong Street, Changsha County, Hunan, reporting on the 'Gold Shop Assistant' service station that uses Party building to serve park enterprises and solve their urgent problems.

articles.title_zh: 江苏出台新政促文体旅联动 经营主体申报不限制注册地
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues New Policy to Promote Integration of Culture, Sports and Tourism
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省财政厅等五部门联合印发《关于进一步促进文体旅联动提振消费的若干政策措施》，聚焦文体旅联动、消费场景焕新和入境旅游提升，奖补申报不受省内外注册地限制。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu's finance department and four other agencies jointly issued a policy to boost cultural, sports and tourism integration, with subsidies open to operators regardless of registration location.

articles.title_zh: 推进信访工作法治化 依法解决群众合理诉求
articles.title_en: Advancing Rule of Law in Petition Work to Resolve People's Legitimate Demands
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，江西省信访工作联席会议全体（扩大）会议召开，省委副书记、政法委书记陈永奇出席并讲话，强调推进信访工作法治化，依法解决群众合理诉求。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, the enlarged meeting of Jiangxi Province's Joint Conference on Petition Work was held. Chen Yongqi, Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission, attended and spoke, emphasizing advancing the rule of law in petition work to resolve people's legitimate demands in accordance with the law.

articles.title_zh: 持续优化铜产业全链条生态 不断提升世界铜都影响力竞争力
articles.title_en: Continuously Optimize Full-Chain Ecology of Copper Industry to Boost World Copper Capital's Influence and Competitiveness
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，省长叶建春在鹰潭调研铜产业高质量发展，强调优化铜产业全链条生态，打造世界铜都。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Governor Ye Jianchun inspected the copper industry in Yingtan, emphasizing the optimization of the whole industry chain ecology to build a world-class copper capital.

articles.title_zh: 2026红山文化大会在朝阳举行
articles.title_en: 2026 Hongshan Culture Conference Held in Chaoyang
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，2026红山文化大会在辽宁朝阳举行，辽宁省委书记许昆林等致辞，强调红山文化保护传承与文明交流互鉴。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, the 2026 Hongshan Culture Conference was held in Chaoyang, Liaoning. Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and others delivered speeches, emphasizing heritage preservation and civilizational exchange.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古“十五五”公路水路发展规划印发
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Highway and Waterway Development
articles.summary_zh: 内蒙古自治区交通运输厅印发“十五五”公路水路发展规划，提出到2030年全区公路通车里程达23.5万公里，全面贯通公路交通主骨架。
articles.summary_en: The Department of Transport of Inner Mongolia issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for highway and waterway development, targeting 235,000 km of highways and a fully connected main road network by 2030.

articles.title_en: Rare Earth High-tech Zone Achieves 'Certificates on Completion' for Industrial Projects
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，稀土高新区资源环境局向包头市常胜工贸有限责任公司送达首张工业项目“竣工即交证”不动产权证书，将办证时限从一个月压缩至5个工作日，优化营商环境。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, the Resource and Environment Bureau of Rare Earth High-tech Zone delivered the first 'certificate on completion' property right certificate to Baotou Changsheng Industry and Trade Co., Ltd., cutting processing time from one month to five working days.

articles.title_zh: 一照通用！银川公安推出便民服务新举措
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Police Launch One-Photo-for-All Convenience Service
articles.summary_zh: 银川市公安局推出“一拍共享、一照通用”便民服务，群众办理公安证照可复用已存档照片，无需重复拍照。
articles.summary_en: Yinchuan Public Security Bureau launched a 'one-photo-for-all' service, allowing citizens to reuse stored photos for police certificates without retaking.

articles.title_zh: 银川实施“区域协同创新”解科技攻关难题
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Implements Regional Collaborative Innovation to Tackle Key Tech Problems
articles.summary_zh: 银川市深化东西部科技合作，实施区域协同创新专项，联合福建、天津等地高校院所攻克蛋鸡病防控、枸杞保鲜等难题，近两年立项20项，带动投资6063万元。
articles.summary_en: Yinchuan deepened east-west tech cooperation, launching regional collaborative innovation projects with institutes in Fujian and Tianjin to tackle poultry disease control and wolfberry preservation. It approved 20 projects in two years, driving 60.63 million yuan in investment.

articles.title_zh: 加快农业农村现代化 扎实推进乡村全面振兴
articles.title_en: Accelerating Agricultural and Rural Modernization for Comprehensive Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 农业农村部部长张柱在北京形势政策报告会上作专题报告，总结“十四五”农业成就并部署“十五五”农业农村现代化任务。
articles.summary_en: Zhang Zhu, Minister of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, delivered a special report in Beijing on agricultural achievements and plans for rural modernization during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_en: Qinghai Four Departments Jointly Issue New Unemployment Insurance Policy for Stable Employment
articles.summary_zh: 青海省人社厅等四部门联合印发通知，实施稳岗返还、一次性扩岗补助和技能提升补贴三项政策，执行至2026年底。
articles.summary_en: Qinghai's HR department and three other agencies jointly issued a notice implementing three policies on unemployment insurance to stabilize employment, effective until end of 2026.

articles.title_en: Sichuan Discipline Inspection: One under Probe, One Expelled from Party and Public Office
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，四川省纪委监委通报，乐山市市中区委常委、政法委书记汪勇接受纪律审查和监察调查；泸县人大常委会原副主任罗万宣被开除党籍和公职。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection announced that Wang Yong, a district official in Leshan, is under investigation, and Luo Wanxuan, former deputy director of the Luxian County People's Congress, has been expelled from the Party and public office.

articles.title_zh: 上汽通用汽车签署合资续约协议 合资期限延长20年
articles.title_en: SAIC-GM Signs Joint Venture Renewal Agreement, Extending Term by 20 Years
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，上汽集团与通用汽车在上海签署合资续约协议，将上汽通用汽车合资期限延长20年至2047年，计划推动更多中国研发制造的车型走向全球。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, SAIC Motor and General Motors signed a joint venture renewal agreement in Shanghai, extending the SAIC-GM joint venture by 20 years to 2047, with plans to bring more China-developed vehicles to global markets.

articles.summary_en: On August 5, Shaanxi Party Secretary Zhao Yide visited Xixian New Area to inspect and preside over a symposium on the 'Three Reforms' for commercializing sci-tech achievements, stressing the transformation of scientific creativity into real productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 山西省委书记唐登杰主持召开省委常委会会议

articles.summary_en: On August 5, Tang Dengjie, Secretary of Shanxi Provincial Party Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to convey central directives, review coal industry safety regulations, and arrange safety, anti-crime, and employment work.

articles.summary_en: Recently, the Action Plan for Promoting 'Station-Industry-City' Integrated Development in the Binhai Airport Station Area was officially released, setting development goals and key tasks to promote coordinated development of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region.

articles.summary_en: On August 1, Tianjin launched its high-level opening-up pilot for cross-border trade. Bank of China Tianjin Branch handled first-batch settlements, simplifying procedures and reducing costs for foreign trade enterprises.

articles.summary_en: The launching meeting of the 2026 Tibet Autonomous Region science and technology project on smart cultural tourism for ancient buildings was recently held in Lhasa, aiming to integrate digital technology with world cultural heritage protection.

articles.summary_en: On August 5, the Yunnan Provincial Government held its 11th plenary meeting and Q3 high-quality development promotion meeting, with Governor Wang Yubo stressing efforts to achieve annual economic targets.

articles.title_zh: 绍兴发布新型城镇化“十五五”规划

articles.summary_en: Shaoxing officially released its 15th Five-Year Plan for new urbanization, aiming to achieve "four leaders" by 2030 and build a modern city.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 5, the Beijing municipal government held an executive meeting to study the construction of an international science and technology innovation center and Zhongguancun world-leading science park during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, chaired by Mayor Yin Yong.

articles.title_zh: 向新而行，共拓全球发展新机遇
articles.title_en: Forge Ahead with Innovation for New Global Opportunities
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局发布数据显示，2025年中国'三新'经济增加值达25.79万亿元，同比增长6.2%，占GDP比重升至18.39%。文章称其为中国高质量发展注入确定性力量。
articles.summary_en: According to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics, China's 'three-new' economy (new industries, new business formats, and new business models) reached 25.79 trillion yuan in 2025, up 6.2% year-on-year, accounting for 18.39% of GDP. The article says it adds certainty to China's high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 教育部发布科学教育“做中学”领航行动指南
articles.title_en: Ministry of Education Issues Guide for Hands-on Science Education

articles.summary_en: On August 4, the Ministry of Education issued a guide to promote hands-on science education in compulsory education, enhancing inquiry-based practice without adding class hours or exams, aiming to improve students' scientific literacy.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚到南宁市调研人工智能发展
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Visits Nanning for AI Development Research

articles.summary_en: From Aug 3 to 4, Chen Gang, Party Secretary of Guangxi, visited Nanning to inspect AI development, emphasizing building an international AI cooperation hub for ASEAN.

articles.title_zh: 徐麟李炳军会见中国工商银行行长刘珺一行

articles.summary_en: On August 5, Guizhou Party Secretary Xu Lin and Governor Li Bingjun met with ICBC President Liu Jun in Guiyang to discuss financial support for Guizhou's high-quality development.

articles.summary_en: On August 5, Governor Wang Kai of Henan Province visited Luoyang to inspect urban renewal work and flood control measures.

articles.summary_en: On August 5, Kong Changsheng, chairman of the Provincial CPPCC, chaired a collective study session of the Party Group Theoretical Learning Center Group to deeply study Xi Jinping's thought on Party building and stress high-quality Party building to lead high-quality performance of duties.

articles.title_en: Understanding China's Economic Resilience and Vitality from 'New' and 'Optimized' Development
articles.summary_zh: 新华社时评解读中央政治局会议关于经济形势的论断，指出中国经济动能向新、结构向优，强调以科技创新和结构优化增强经济韧性活力。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua commentary interprets the Political Bureau's assessment that China's economy is showing new momentum and improved structure, emphasizing innovation and structural optimization to bolster resilience and vitality.

articles.summary_en: From August 4 to 5, Mao Weiming, Deputy Secretary of Hunan Provincial Committee and Governor, inspected future industries including embodied AI and quantum technology in Changsha.

articles.title_zh: 学习新语·铸魂强党丨以党的政治建设为统领加强党的各方面建设

articles.summary_en: Xinhua's 'Learning New Words' column launches the 'Forging the Party's Soul' series. This episode focuses on political construction as the guide, systematically reviewing Xi Jinping's important remarks on party building.

articles.title_zh: 未成年人“偷开”汽车致2死3伤，公安部交管局提示暑假交通安全

articles.summary_en: The Traffic Management Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security reported several road accidents involving minors and issued a summer safety reminder, urging families and schools to prevent illegal driving by teenagers.

articles.title_zh: 航行警告！南海部分海域进行军事训练 禁止驶入

articles.summary_en: Sanya Maritime Safety Administration issued a navigation warning that military training will be held in parts of the South China Sea from August 10 to 14, and entry is prohibited.

articles.summary_en: The 2026 AI Product Application Expo was held in Suzhou, Jiangsu, with nearly 400 companies showcasing AI applications in manufacturing and logistics, and an OPC energy zone supporting one-person companies.

articles.summary_en: The Supreme People's Court and five other departments issued opinions to strengthen management of employed court clerks, clarifying that such positions will no longer occupy special political-legal staffing.

articles.title_zh: 从“落地生根”到“开花结果” 合肥构筑量子技术创新高地

articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，雄安新区召开知识产权保护成果新闻发布会，介绍国家级知识产权保护中心筹建进展，运营后发明专利授权周期将大幅缩短。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Xiong'an New Area held a press conference on IP protection achievements, reporting progress of the national IP protection center that will greatly shorten patent approval time.

articles.title_zh: 植保无人机“农药漂移”伤农 纠纷化解机制亟待完善
articles.title_en: Pesticide Drift from Crop-Dusting Drones Harms Farmers, Dispute Resolution Mechanism Needs Improvement
articles.summary_zh: 植保无人机作业频繁引发“农药漂移”，导致周边作物减产和农药残留，存在鉴定难、举证难、追责难等问题，亟待完善监管和纠纷化解机制。
articles.summary_en: Pesticide drift from crop-dusting drones frequently damages neighboring crops and causes pesticide residue, posing difficulties in identification, evidence, and accountability, requiring improved regulation and dispute resolution.

articles.title_zh: 榆林推动发展方式绿色低碳转型
articles.title_en: Yulin Promotes Green and Low-Carbon Transformation
articles.summary_zh: 陕西省榆林市通过用能权交易、科技降碳、多能融合等措施，推动能源产业绿色低碳转型，谱写高碳城市低碳发展新篇章。
articles.summary_en: Yulin City in Shaanxi Province promotes green and low-carbon transformation through energy use rights trading, technological carbon reduction, and multi-energy integration.

tags.name_en: Carbon Peaking and Carbon Neutrality Goals

tags_en: Carbon Peaking and Carbon Neutrality Goals

articles.title_zh: 上海向“新”而行底气足
articles.title_en: Shanghai Moves toward Innovation with Solid Confidence
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报调研上海基础研究，报道科研人员坐冷板凳、开放大科学装置等举措，上海基础研究支出占比显著提升。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily reports on Shanghai's basic research, highlighting researchers' dedication and open large-scale facilities, with R&D spending ratio significantly rising.

articles.title_zh: 新就业群体“法律明白人”上岗记
articles.title_en: New Employment Groups' 'Legal Advisors' Take Up Their Posts
articles.summary_zh: 浙江、江西、海南等地新就业群体“法律明白人”上岗，为外卖骑手、快递员、网络主播等提供维权引导和普法服务，助力破解维权难、服务弱等痛点。
articles.summary_en: Legal advisors for new employment groups now work across Zhejiang, Jiangxi, and Hainan, providing rights-protection guidance and legal education to delivery riders, couriers, and streamers.

articles.title_zh: 一线实干中增进民生福祉
articles.title_en: Enhancing People's Well-being Through Down-to-Earth Grassroots Work
articles.summary_zh: 北京市今年深入开展“下基层、跑工单、走流程、蹲点位”活动，广大党员干部沉到一线，聚焦群众急难愁盼，推动一批民生实事落地见效。
articles.summary_en: This year, Beijing has carried out a campaign for officials to go to the grassroots, handle work orders, walk through processes, and stay at front-line posts. Party members and cadres have addressed urgent public concerns and delivered tangible benefits to residents.

articles.title_zh: 扎扎实实建设现代化产业体系（总书记的人民情怀）
articles.title_en: Building a Modern Industrial System with Solid Efforts
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，习近平总书记主持中共中央政治局会议，强调加快现代化产业体系建设，统筹培育新动能和更新旧动能，推动传统产业升级与新兴产业壮大。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, General Secretary Xi Jinping chaired a meeting of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau, stressing the acceleration of modern industrial system construction, balancing new and old growth drivers, and promoting industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 规范涉企执法 优化营商环境
articles.title_en: Standardizing Enterprise Law Enforcement to Optimize Business Environment
articles.summary_zh: 今年5月起，全国全面推行“扫码入企”规范涉企执法。浙江、广东等地探索“综合查一次”等做法，行政检查总量同比下降34%，营商环境进一步优化。
articles.summary_en: Since May this year, the 'code-scanning entry' initiative has been rolled out nationwide to standardize law enforcement involving enterprises. Places like Zhejiang and Guangdong have adopted joint inspections, reducing administrative checks by 34% and improving the business environment.

articles.title_zh: 如何让基层首诊从“有”到“优”
articles.title_en: How to Improve Primary Care from "Available" to "Excellent"
articles.summary_zh: 国家卫健委等部门通过提升基层诊疗水平、推动专家号源下沉等举措，引导群众基层首诊，并回应医保报销、用药等关切。
articles.summary_en: The National Health Commission and other departments are improving primary care quality, promoting expert referrals to grassroots facilities, and addressing public concerns about insurance reimbursement and medication.

articles.title_zh: 为世界政党治理贡献了中国智慧
articles.title_en: Chinese Wisdom Contributes to Global Party Governance
articles.summary_zh: 国际人士积极评价中国共产党开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，认为这体现了以人民为中心的发展思想，为世界政党治理贡献了中国智慧。
articles.summary_en: International experts speak highly of the CPC's education on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements, saying it embodies a people-centered development philosophy and contributes Chinese wisdom to global party governance.

articles.title_zh: 国防部新闻发言人就日本政府2026年版《防卫白皮书》答记者问
articles.title_en: Defense Ministry Spokesperson Answers Questions on Japan's 2026 Defense White Paper
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，国防部新闻发言人陈曦就日本2026年版《防卫白皮书》答记者问，批评日方渲染“中国威胁”，敦促日方停止干涉中国内政。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, Defense Ministry spokesman Chen Xi answered questions on Japan's 2026 Defense White Paper, criticizing Japan's hype of 'China threat' and urging it to stop interfering in China's internal affairs.

articles.title_zh: 第25届长春农博会组委会工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Organizing Committee Meeting for 25th Changchun Agricultural Expo Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，第25届长春农博会组委会工作会议召开，副省长刘伟、市长顾刚出席并讲话，部署展会筹备工作，强调打造高质量农业盛会。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, the organizing committee meeting for the 25th Changchun Agricultural Expo was held, attended by Vice Governor Liu Wei and Mayor Gu Gang, who delivered speeches on preparations to build a high-quality agricultural event.

articles.title_zh: 黄强到长春汽开区调研时强调 以深化改革激发创新活力和内生动力 全力打造经济发展主战场主阵地主引擎
articles.title_en: Huang Qiang Visits Changchun Automotive Development Zone, Urges Reform to Boost Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，吉林省委书记黄强到长春汽开区调研，强调深化改革激发创新活力，打造经济发展主战场。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, Jilin Provincial Party Secretary Huang Qiang visited the Changchun Automotive Development Zone, urging deepening reform to stimulate innovation and build it into a key engine of economic development.

articles.title_zh: 沈阳市政协召开常委会会议 为加快制造业‘智改数转’凝聚智慧力量
articles.title_en: Shenyang CPPCC Holds Meeting to Advance Smart Transformation of Manufacturing
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，沈阳市政协召开十六届三十五次常委会会议，围绕加快制造业‘智改数转’协商议政，市委书记霍步刚出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 4, Shenyang CPPCC held its 35th Standing Committee meeting to discuss accelerating smart transformation of manufacturing; Party Secretary Huo Bugang attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: “以天下之利为利”——中国元首外交的世界情怀与大国气派
articles.title_en: "For the Benefit of All Under Heaven" — World Vision and Great-Power Bearing of Chinese Head-of-State Diplomacy
articles.summary_zh: 新华社8月4日综述，回顾习近平主席元首外交，展现中国推动共同发展、促进国际合作的世界情怀与大国担当。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua review on Aug 4 recalls President Xi Jinping's head-of-state diplomacy, showcasing China's vision of common development and international cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 中国气象局联合发改委印发《国家综合气象观测系统建设“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: China Meteorological Administration and NDRC Issue 15th Five-Year Plan for National Comprehensive Meteorological Observation System
articles.summary_zh: 中国气象局与国家发改委近日联合印发《国家综合气象观测系统建设“十五五”规划》，部署未来五年气象观测体系建设，推动构建陆海空天一体化、多行业协同的现代化综合气象观测体系。
articles.summary_en: The China Meteorological Administration and the National Development and Reform Commission recently issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for the National Comprehensive Meteorological Observation System, laying out efforts to build a modern, integrated observation network.
