tags_zh: 国家发展和改革委员会

articles.title_zh: 上半年我国服务进出口总额实现较快增长
articles.title_en: China's Services Trade Volume Grows Rapidly in H1
articles.summary_zh: 商务部数据显示，今年上半年我国服务进出口总额37797.5亿元，同比增长8.3%，其中出口增长17.6%，进口增长2.9%。
articles.summary_en: According to the Ministry of Commerce, China's total services trade reached 3.77975 trillion yuan in H1, up 8.3% year on year, with exports rising 17.6% and imports 2.9%.

articles.title_zh: 上半年产业创新活力进一步激发
articles.title_en: Industrial Innovation Vitality Further Stimulated in First Half of Year
articles.summary_zh: 国家税务总局数据显示，今年上半年支持科技创新和制造业发展的减税降费及退税超1.9万亿元，数字经济核心产业销售收入同比增长8.7%，传统产业转型提速，新兴产业增势强劲。
articles.summary_en: Tax data from the State Taxation Administration shows that in H1, tax and fee reductions and rebates supporting sci-tech innovation and manufacturing exceeded 1.9 trillion yuan, with core digital economy sales revenue up 8.7% year-on-year, traditional industries accelerating transformation, and emerging industries growing strongly.

articles.title_zh: 汪尚学会见中国进出口银行甘肃省分行行长徐强一行
articles.title_en: Wang Shangxue Meets Xu Qiang, President of Gansu Branch of Export-Import Bank of China
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日下午，定西市委书记汪尚学会见中国进出口银行甘肃省分行行长徐强一行，双方就深化政银合作进行座谈交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 4, Wang Shangxue, Secretary of the Dingxi Municipal Party Committee, met with Xu Qiang, President of the Gansu Branch of the Export-Import Bank of China, to discuss deepening government-bank cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 市政协召开树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育第3期读书班
articles.title_en: Fushun Municipal CPPCC Holds 3rd Reading Class on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，抚顺市政协召开树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育第3期读书班暨党组理论学习中心组专题学习会议，市政协主席于万军参加并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Fushun Municipal CPPCC held the 3rd reading class on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements, with Chairman Yu Wanjun attending and speaking.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱主持召开市委书记专题办公会
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Chairs Special Work Meeting of Municipal Party Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱主持召开专题办公会，传达学习省委书记许勤在鹤岗调研时的讲话精神，部署防汛救灾、水利工程等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Hegang Municipal Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu chaired a special work meeting to convey the spirit of Provincial Party Secretary Xu Qin's inspection speech and deploy flood control, water conservancy and other tasks.

articles.title_zh: 许勤到我市调研
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Conducts Research in Jiamusi and Hegang
articles.summary_zh: 4日，省委书记许勤到佳木斯市、鹤岗市调研粮食产能提升重大水利工程建设情况，督导检查防汛抗洪救灾工作，慰问工程建设者和抗洪一线人员。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 4, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, visited Jiamusi and Hegang to inspect major water conservancy projects for grain production capacity, supervise flood control and disaster relief work, and extend condolences to construction workers and frontline flood-fighting personnel.

articles.title_zh: 全市防台防汛复盘暨专题部署会召开
articles.title_en: City-wide Typhoon and Flood Prevention Review and Special Deployment Meeting Convened
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，淮安市召开防台防汛复盘暨专题部署会，市长顾坤要求复盘总结并扎实做好第13号台风“白海豚”防范应对工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Huai'an held a review and deployment meeting on typhoon and flood prevention. Mayor Gu Kun stressed comprehensive review and preparedness for Typhoon No. 13 'Baiji'.

articles.title_zh: 全市防台防汛复盘暨专题部署会召开
articles.title_en: Huai'an Holds Typhoon and Flood Prevention Review and Deployment Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，淮安市长顾坤主持召开全市防台防汛复盘暨专题部署会，强调做好第13号台风“白海豚”防范应对，并部署消防安全工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Mayor Gu Kun of Huai'an chaired a citywide review and deployment meeting on typhoon and flood prevention, emphasizing preparations for Typhoon Dolphin and fire safety.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦会见上海电科智能客人
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi Meets Shanghai Electric Intelligent System Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日下午，淮北市委副书记、市长蒋曦会见上海电科智能系统股份有限公司副总经理赵怀柏一行，双方就智慧城市、数字治理等领域合作交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 5, Jiang Xi, Deputy Secretary of CPC Huaibei Municipal Committee and Mayor, met with Zhao Huaibai, Deputy General Manager of Shanghai Electric Intelligent System Co., Ltd., to discuss cooperation in smart city and digital governance.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保赴普宁调研百千万工程和防汛除险工作
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao Inspects Baiqianwan Project and Flood Control Work in Puning
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，揭阳市委书记曾风保到普宁市调研“百千万工程”和防汛除险工作，强调加快打造典型镇村，提升城乡风貌和民生保障。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, Zeng Fengbao, Secretary of the Jieyang Municipal Party Committee, inspected Puning City's Baiqianwan Project and flood control work, emphasizing the acceleration of building model villages and towns to improve urban-rural landscapes and people's livelihoods.

articles.title_zh: 中国气象局联合发改委印发《国家综合气象观测系统建设“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: China Meteorological Administration and NDRC Issue 15th Five-Year Plan for National Comprehensive Meteorological Observation System
articles.summary_zh: 经国务院批准，中国气象局与国家发改委联合印发《国家综合气象观测系统建设“十五五”规划》，部署未来五年构建陆海空天一体化、智能高效精准的现代化综合气象观测体系。
articles.summary_en: With State Council approval, the China Meteorological Administration and the National Development and Reform Commission jointly issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for building a modern comprehensive meteorological observation system by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 王君正会见班禅额尔德尼·确吉杰布
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Meets Panchen Erdini Qoigyijabu
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正在拉萨会见全国政协常委、中国佛教协会西藏分会会长班禅额尔德尼·确吉杰布，就宗教中国化等话题交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Wang Junzheng, Party Secretary of Tibet Autonomous Region, met with Panchen Erdini Qoigyijabu, a standing committee member of CPPCC and president of Tibet Branch of Buddhist Association of China, in Lhasa.

articles.title_zh: 自治区政协召开“提高网络空间法治化水平 助力营造健康向上的网络生态”专题协商座谈会
articles.title_en: Regional CPPCC Holds Special Consultation Session on Enhancing Cyberspace Rule of Law and Fostering Healthy Online Ecosystem
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，自治区政协在拉萨召开专题协商座谈会，围绕提高网络空间法治化水平、营造健康网络生态建言献策。自治区副主席朱守科出席并讲话，政协副主席白玛旺堆主持。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 4, the Regional CPPCC held a special consultation in Lhasa on improving cyberspace rule of law and fostering a healthy online environment. Vice Chairperson Zhu Shouke spoke; CPPCC Vice Chairperson Baima Wangdui presided.

articles.title_zh: 国务院成立重庆彭水汉葭街道“7·17”特别重大山体崩塌灾害调查评估组
articles.title_en: State Council Establishes Investigation Team for Major Landslide in Chongqing's Pengshui
articles.summary_zh: 国务院成立重庆彭水“7·17”特别重大山体崩塌灾害调查评估组，8月4日在彭水召开第一次全体会议，部署调查评估工作。
articles.summary_en: The State Council set up an investigation and assessment team for the '7·17' major landslide in Pengshui, Chongqing, holding its first plenary meeting on Aug 4 to arrange investigation work.

articles.title_zh: 全市河湖长制林长制工作会议暨“山水龙岩”生态品牌建设推进会召开
articles.title_en: Longyan Holds Meeting on River, Lake and Forest Chief Systems and 'Landscape Longyan' Ecological Brand Construction
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，龙岩市召开全市河湖长制林长制工作会议暨“山水龙岩”生态品牌建设推进会，市委书记胡盛出席并讲话，部署高质量系统化推进生态品牌建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, Longyan City held a city-wide meeting on river/lake chief and forest chief systems and the 'Landscape Longyan' ecological brand construction. Party Secretary Hu Sheng attended and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 王智慧主持召开书记专题会听取巡察情况汇报
articles.title_en: Wang Zhihui Chairs Special Meeting on Inspection for Grain Security
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，南阳市委书记王智慧主持召开书记专题会，听取高标准农田建设突出问题机动巡察情况汇报，强调用好巡察成果，强化整改监督，扛稳粮食安全政治责任。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, Wang Zhihui, Party Secretary of Nanyang, chaired a special meeting to hear reports on mobile inspections of high-standard farmland construction, urging effective use of inspection results and stronger supervision for grain security.

articles.title_zh: 王智慧主持召开市四大班子联席会部署当前重点工作
articles.title_en: Wang Zhihui Chairs Municipal Four Groups Joint Meeting to Deploy Key Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，南阳市委书记王智慧主持召开市四大班子联席会，听取7月份工作汇报，部署8月份重点工作，强调拼发展、保稳定、强党建。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, Wang Zhihui, Secretary of Nanyang Municipal Party Committee, chaired the joint meeting of the four groups to review July work and deploy August priorities, emphasizing development, stability, and party building.

articles.title_zh: 朱守科：自治区政协召开“提高网络空间法治化水平助力营造健康向上的网络生态”专题协商座谈会
articles.title_en: Zhu Shouke Attends CPPCC Symposium on Cyber Rule of Law
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，西藏自治区政协在拉萨召开专题协商座谈会，围绕提高网络空间法治化水平建言献策，自治区副主席朱守科出席并讲话，自治区政协副主席白玛旺堆主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, the Tibet Autonomous Regional Committee of CPPCC held a consultation meeting in Lhasa to offer suggestions on improving the rule of law in cyberspace. Vice Chairman Zhu Shouke attended and spoke; CPPCC Vice Chairman Pema Wangdu presided.

articles.title_zh: 王君正会见班禅额尔德尼·确吉杰布
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Meets Panchen Lama
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正在拉萨会见全国政协常委、中国佛教协会西藏分会会长班禅额尔德尼·确吉杰布，双方就宗教中国化、民族团结等交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Regional Party Committee, met with Panchen Lama, a CPPCC National Committee member, in Lhasa to discuss religious Sinicization and ethnic unity.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群赴澄海区调研 工商并举壮大玩具集群 数贸融合贯通内外市场
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Visits Chenghai District to Boost Toy Cluster with Industry-Trade Integration
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日下午，汕头市委书记庄悦群到澄海区调研，强调加快传统产业与人工智能、数字贸易融合发展，壮大玩具产业集群，推动县域经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 3, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn visited Chenghai District, emphasizing the integration of traditional industries with AI and digital trade to strengthen the toy cluster and promote high-quality county economy.

articles.summary_en: On August 4, Wu Zetong, Deputy Secretary of the Zhuhai Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, chaired a meeting of the Municipal Government Party Group to study work on agriculture, rural areas, Zhuhai-Zunyi cooperation, and the 'Millions Project'.

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐主持召开市政府常务会议 推动经济持续向新向优向好发展
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Chairs Municipal Government Standing Meeting to Promote High-Quality Economic Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，珠海市委副书记、市长吴泽桐主持召开市政府常务会议，传达学习中央和省委有关精神，部署下半年经济工作，推动经济持续向新向优向好发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, Wu Zetong, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Zhuhai Municipal Committee and Mayor, chaired a municipal government executive meeting to convey central and provincial directives and deploy economic work for the second half of the year.

articles.title_zh: 市政协召开十届二十七次常委会会议
articles.title_en: Zhuhai CPPCC Holds 27th Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，市政协召开十届二十七次常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平党建思想，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，听取上半年全市经济社会发展情况通报。市政协主席王开洲主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, the Zhuhai CPPCC held its 27th Standing Committee meeting to study Xi Jinping's thought on Party building, convey the spirit of an important speech by Xi Jinping, and hear a briefing on the city's economic and social development in the first half of the year. Wang Kaizhou, chairman of the CPPCC, presided over the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 马某林，出狱前8天被改判死缓
articles.title_en: Ma Moulin Resentenced to Death with Reprieve 8 Days Before Release
articles.summary_zh: 最高检发布第六十三批指导性案例，披露马某林抢劫再审抗诉案：其作案后仅判十年，经最高检抗诉，甘肃高院再审改判死缓，此时距原判刑满释放仅剩8天。
articles.summary_en: The Supreme People's Procuratorate released its 63rd batch of guiding cases, including Ma Moulin's case. After a procuratorial protest, a Gansu court resentenced Ma to death with a two-year reprieve, just 8 days before his original release.

articles.title_zh: 高温少雨持续，中央调拨百余台发电、抽水设备支持新疆抗旱减灾
articles.title_en: Central Government Allocates Generators and Pumps to Aid Xinjiang Drought Relief
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，国家防总办公室、应急管理部会同国家粮食和储备局调拨抗旱水泵40台、发电机115台等中央抗旱物资，支持新疆做好抗旱减灾工作。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 5, the State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters Office, together with the Ministry of Emergency Management and the National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration, allocated 40 water pumps and 115 generators to support drought relief in Xinjiang.

articles.title_zh: 茶叶圈再无“大师”
articles.title_en: No More "Master" Titles in Tea Industry
articles.summary_zh: 茶叶行业取消“大师”等称号，相关称谓全面废止。
articles.summary_en: The tea industry abolishes "master" titles and related appellations.

articles.title_zh: 副校长下场撮合，笔试第一被第二花钱劝弃考，广东雷州启动问责
articles.title_en: Vice Principal Mediates as Top Scorer Paid to Withdraw from Exam, Leizhou Launches Accountability Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 广东雷州发生考试违规事件，副校长介入撮合，笔试第一名被第二名花钱劝弃考，当地已启动问责。
articles.summary_en: In Leizhou, Guangdong, an exam violation occurred where a vice principal mediated and the top scorer was paid to withdraw by the second-place candidate; local authorities have launched accountability proceedings.

articles.title_zh: 费大厨“全国小炒肉大王”称号，是线上比赛靠图片和视频赢的…
articles.title_en: Fei Dàchú's 'National King of Stir-fried Pork' Title Was Won via Online Photos and Videos...
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中国烹饪协会清理撤销“大师”“名师”等称号，以响应8月1日施行的新规。网友发现费大厨“全国小炒肉大王”称号系2020年线上比赛靠图片和视频赢得。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the China Cuisine Association revoked various titles like "Master" and "Famous Chef" in response to new regulations effective Aug 1. Netizens found that Fei Dàchú's 'National King of Stir-fried Pork' title was won via an online competition based on photos and videos.

articles.title_zh: 依法从轻 国家国防科工局原副局长张建华一审被判10年
articles.title_en: Former Defense Science Agency Deputy Director Zhang Jianhua Sentenced to 10 Years
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月5日，四川达州中院一审宣判国防科工局原副局长张建华受贿、利用影响力受贿案，决定执行有期徒刑十年，并处罚金380万元。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 5, 2026, Dazhou Intermediate People's Court in Sichuan sentenced Zhang Jianhua, ex-deputy director of SASTIND, to 10 years and a fine of 3.8m yuan for bribery and influence peddling.

tags.name_en: Dazhou Intermediate People's Court of Sichuan Province

articles.title_zh: 罗文专题调研防汛工作
articles.title_en: Luo Wen Inspects Flood Control Work
articles.summary_zh: 当前正值防汛关键期，罗文赴省应急管理厅、气象局、水利厅及石家庄水利枢纽调研，强调压实防汛救灾政治责任，全力维护人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: During the critical flood season, Luo Wen inspected flood control work in Hebei, emphasizing political responsibility and public safety.

articles.title_zh: 涉及河南！自然资源部发布地质灾害防治重磅方案
articles.title_en: Ministry of Natural Resources Issues Major Plan for Geological Disaster Prevention Involving Henan
articles.summary_zh: 自然资源部印发《全国地质灾害防治“十五五”实施方案》，提出21个重点防治区，其中3个涉及河南，旨在减少人员伤亡和财产损失。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Natural Resources issued the 15th Five-Year Implementation Plan for National Geological Disaster Prevention, designating 21 key prevention zones, three of which involve Henan, to reduce casualties and property losses.

articles.title_zh: 腾讯“甲骨文数智化”案例入选2026人工智能应用案例集
articles.title_en: Tencent's 'Oracle Bone Digitalization' Case Selected into 2026 AI Application Case Collection
articles.summary_zh: 近日，腾讯“甲骨文数智化”案例在瑞士日内瓦举行的2026人工智能造福人类全球峰会上入选“Innovate for Impact”应用案例集，成为唯一古文字领域案例。
articles.summary_en: Tencent's 'Oracle Bone Digitalization' case was selected into the 'Innovate for Impact' 2026 AI application case collection at the AI for Good Global Summit in Geneva, Switzerland, as the only case in the ancient script field.

articles.title_zh: 山东省委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Standing Committee of Shandong Provincial Party Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日上午，山东省委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究社会治理、再生资源循环利用等事项，省委书记林武主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 5, the Standing Committee of the Shandong Provincial Party Committee held a meeting to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and discuss social governance and recycling industry development. Lin Wu, Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee, presided over the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 不止“过江”更要“破界” 一座城的融城与突围
articles.title_en: More Than Crossing the River: A City's Integration and Breakthrough
articles.summary_zh: 江苏泰兴市以“全面融入上海、全力融入苏南”的“双融”战略，推动产业科创与跨江政务融合，探索县域融入长三角一体化新路径。
articles.summary_en: Taixing, Jiangsu, pursues 'dual integration' with Shanghai and Southern Jiangsu, advancing industrial innovation and cross-river government services to explore a new county-level path in the Yangtze River Delta integration.

articles.title_zh: 何以浙江？闯创之间——活力中国调研行
articles.title_en: Why Zhejiang? Between Pioneering and Innovation - Vitality China Research Trip
articles.summary_zh: 中央宣传部组织'活力中国调研行'采访团深入浙江，报道浙江以民营经济和科技创新驱动高质量发展，展现勇闯'无人区'、走出舒适区、挺进'深水区'的生动实践。
articles.summary_en: A media research trip organized by the Central Publicity Department visited Zhejiang to report on its high-quality development driven by private economy and tech innovation, highlighting bold exploration, self-reform, and ecosystem building.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开党组会议和常务会议
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Government Holds Party Group and Executive Meetings
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，福州市市长吴贤德主持召开市政府党组会议和常务会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记关于人工智能的重要讲话精神，审议创新体系、长期护理保险和消费新业态等文件。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Fuzhou Mayor Wu Xiande chaired a municipal government party group meeting and executive meeting to study Xi Jinping's important speech on AI, deliberating policies on innovation, long-term care insurance, and new consumption formats.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记引领“十五五”开局之年中国经济破浪前行
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Leads China's Economy to Steady Progress in Opening Year of 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 综述习近平总书记引领“十五五”开局之年中国经济稳中求进、高质量发展，涵盖能源、芯片、服务业、民生等领域成就。
articles.summary_en: A review of Xi Jinping's leadership in China's economy during the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, highlighting steady progress and high-quality development in energy, chips, services, and people's livelihood.

articles.title_zh: 2026年度省数字经济创新型企业名单发布 391家企业入选
articles.title_en: 2026 Fujian Digital Economy Innovative Enterprise List Released, 391 Companies Selected
articles.summary_zh: 福建省数据管理局近日发布2026年度省数字经济创新型企业名单，全省共391家企业入选，较去年增加41家，其中独角兽企业2家、未来独角兽企业35家、瞪羚企业354家。
articles.summary_en: Fujian Provincial Data Administration recently released the 2026 list of innovative digital economy enterprises, with 391 companies selected, an increase of 41 from last year, including 2 unicorns, 35 future unicorns, and 354 gazelles.

articles.title_zh: 党外人士座谈会议召开 于海田出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Non-CPC Personages Symposium Held, Yu Haitian Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，济南市召开党外人士座谈会，市委副书记、市长于海田出席并讲话，听取各民主党派、工商联和无党派人士关于经济社会发展的意见建议。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, the CPC Jinan Municipal Committee held a symposium with non-CPC personages. Mayor Yu Haitian attended and delivered remarks, listening to suggestions on economic and social development.

articles.title_zh: 习近平经济思想指引中国经济高质量发展行稳致远
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Economic Thought Guides China's High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 上半年中国经济顶压前行、向新向优，习近平总书记多次部署经济工作，强调推动高质量发展行稳致远。
articles.summary_en: In the first half of the year, China's economy progressed steadily despite pressure, showing new momentum and improved structure. President Xi Jinping made multiple deployments on economic work, emphasizing steady and lasting high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 学习新语｜坚持党的全面领导和党中央集中统一领导
articles.title_en: Learning New Sayings | Upholding the Party's Overall Leadership and the CPC Central Committee's Unified Centralized Leadership
articles.summary_zh: 新华社“学习新语”栏目推出“铸魂强党”系列报道，系统梳理党的十八大以来习近平总书记关于加强党的领导和党中央集中统一领导的重要论述。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua's 'Learning New Sayings' column launches the 'Strengthening the Party' series, systematically reviewing Xi Jinping's important remarks on strengthening Party leadership and the CPC Central Committee's unified centralized leadership since the 18th Party Congress.

tags.name_en: Centralized Unified Leadership of the CPC Central Committee

tags_en: Centralized Unified Leadership of the CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 市政协党组理论学习中心组进行集体学习研讨
articles.title_en: Qingdao CPPCC Party Leadership Group Holds Collective Study and Discussion
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日下午，市政协党组理论学习中心组进行集体学习研讨，深入学习习近平总书记关于树立和践行正确政绩观的重要论述，市政协党组书记、主席孟庆斌主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 5, the Party Leadership Group of the Qingdao CPPCC held a collective study and discussion on General Secretary Xi Jinping's important exposition on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements. Meng Qingbin, Party Secretary and Chairman of the CPPCC, presided over the meeting and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 山东省委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日上午，山东省委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究社会治理、再生资源循环利用等事项，省委书记林武主持。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 5, the Standing Committee of the Shandong Provincial Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches, and discussed social governance and recycling industry development. Lin Wu, Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee, presided.

articles.title_zh: 商务部就对美系列涉华消极措施实施反制答记者问
articles.title_en: Commerce Ministry Responds on Countermeasures Against U.S. Negative Measures on China
articles.summary_zh: 商务部新闻发言人宣布对美国联邦通信委员会和美国土安全部系列涉华消极措施实施反制，包括加强无人机出口管制、将6家美国实体列入反制清单等。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce announced countermeasures against negative U.S. measures by the FCC and DHS, including stricter export controls on drones and adding six U.S. entities to a countermeasure list.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记引领“十五五”开局之年中国经济破浪前行
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Guides China's Economy to Steady Progress in First Year of 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 文章综述习近平总书记引领“十五五”开局之年中国经济发展，强调高质量发展、新质生产力与正确政绩观，上半年经济稳中向好。
articles.summary_en: Review of Xi Jinping's leadership in China's economic development during the first year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, emphasizing high-quality growth, new quality productive forces, and correct view of political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 特朗普敦促美参议院通过全年采用夏令时法案
articles.title_en: Trump Urges US Senate to Pass Year-Round Daylight Saving Time Bill
articles.summary_zh: 美国总统特朗普8月4日在社交媒体发文，敦促国会参议院尽快通过全年采用夏令时的《阳光保护法案》，称绝大多数美国人要求将其永久化。
articles.summary_en: US President Trump on Aug 4 urged the Senate to pass the Sunshine Protection Act to make daylight saving time permanent, saying most Americans want it.

articles.title_zh: 铸魂赋能强根基 知行合一显担当 浙江省各地多措并举推动习近平党建思想学用贯通
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Promotes Study and Application of Xi Jinping's Party Building Thought with Multiple Measures
articles.summary_zh: 近期，浙江省各地依托循迹溯源、干部培训、青年讲堂等载体学习贯彻习近平党建思想，将学习成果转化为产业创新、基层治理、共同富裕的实际举措。
articles.summary_en: Recently, localities across Zhejiang have studied and applied Xi Jinping's Party building thought through various carriers such as tracing visits, cadre training, and youth lectures, turning learning outcomes into practical measures for industrial innovation, grassroots governance, and common prosperity.

articles.title_zh: "飞地粮仓"探索跨省粮食协作新样板
articles.title_en: Enclave Granary Explores New Model of Cross-Provincial Grain Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 今年夏粮创历史新高，吉林等主产区引入浙江、江苏等主销区企业共建"飞地粮仓"，改良盐碱地，探索跨省粮食协作新样板。
articles.summary_en: With record summer grain output, grain-producing regions in Jilin and Heilongjiang have partnered with eastern enterprises to transform saline-alkali land, exploring a new cross-provincial 'enclave granary' model for food security.

articles.title_zh: 透视“十五五”开局之年各省份经济半年报
articles.title_en: Reviewing Provincial Economic Reports for First Half of 2026, the Opening Year of 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 截至7月底，全国31省份2026年上半年经济数据全部公布，经济大省挑大梁，新质生产力加速激活，各地扎实落实党中央部署，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: By end of July, all 31 provincial-level regions published H1 2026 economic data. Major provinces played key roles, new quality productive forces accelerated, and local governments implemented central policies for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 量子密钥“飞入寻常百姓家”
articles.title_en: Quantum Keys 'Fly into Ordinary Homes'
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月，中电信量子集团量子安全能力开放平台“Q-Link”开启内测，以KaaS模式向千行百业输出量子级安全防护，降低企业使用门槛。
articles.summary_en: In July 2026, China Telecom Quantum Group launched internal testing of its 'Q-Link' platform, offering quantum-level security services via KaaS to reduce deployment costs and technical barriers for enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 江苏六部门联合出台方案 推动精细化工产业创新发展
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Six Departments Jointly Issue Plan to Boost Fine Chemical Industry Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省工信厅等六部门联合印发《江苏省加快推动精细化工产业创新发展工作方案》，部署精细化工产业创新发展重点任务，推动产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu's six departments jointly issued a plan to boost innovation in the fine chemical industry, outlining key tasks for high-quality development.

tags_en: Jiangsu Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 天津市委原常委何国模逝世，从事地下工作时阻止了北洋大学南迁
articles.title_en: He Guomo, Former Tianjin Municipal Standing Committee Member, Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 天津市委原常委、市政协原副主席何国模因病于2026年8月2日在津逝世，享年98岁。他曾在地下工作中阻止北洋大学南迁，为天津解放作出贡献。
articles.summary_en: He Guomo, former standing committee member of Tianjin Municipal Committee and vice chairman of Tianjin CPPCC, died of illness in Tianjin on August 2, 2026, at the age of 98. He contributed to Tianjin's liberation by preventing the relocation of Beiyang University.

articles.title_zh: 著名肝病学家冯百芳逝世，曾成功研制中国第一支乙型肝炎疫苗
articles.title_en: Prominent Hepatologist Feng Baifang Dies; Developed China's First Hepatitis B Vaccine
articles.summary_zh: 著名肝病学家、北京大学人民医院教授冯百芳于2026年8月4日在北京逝世，享年95岁。她曾成功研制中国第一支乙型肝炎疫苗。
articles.summary_en: Feng Baifang, a renowned hepatologist and professor at Peking University People's Hospital, passed away in Beijing on August 4, 2026, at age 95. She developed China's first hepatitis B vaccine.

articles.title_zh: 原总参军训部副部长陈有元将军逝世，享年82岁
articles.title_en: Chen Youyuan, Former Deputy Director of PLA General Staff's Training Department, Dies at 82
articles.summary_zh: 原总参谋部军训部副部长陈有元将军因病医治无效，于2026年7月31日在北京逝世，享年82岁。
articles.summary_en: Chen Youyuan, former deputy director of the Training Department of the PLA General Staff Department, died of illness in Beijing on July 31, 2026, at the age of 82.

articles.title_zh: 7月清理385万条电视剧侵权链接，迅雷被纳入侵权重点监测平台
articles.title_en: 385 Million Pirated TV Drama Links Removed in July; Xunlei Added to Key Monitoring Platform
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月，广电总局会同重点省局对热播剧进行重点监测，清理侵权链接385万条，处理侵权账号385个，并将迅雷纳入重点监测平台。
articles.summary_en: In July 2026, the National Radio and Television Administration and provincial administrations monitored popular dramas, removed 3.85 million infringing links, handled 385 infringing accounts, and added Xunlei to key monitoring platforms.

articles.title_zh: 合肥：分层分类推动服务业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Hefei Promotes High-Quality Development of Service Industry with Layered and Classified Measures
articles.summary_zh: 近年来，合肥市分层分类推动服务业高质量发展，服务业增加值占GDP比重达60.9%，获批20余项国家级试点示范，并着力打造创新平台和推动业态融合。
articles.summary_en: In recent years, Hefei has promoted high-quality development of its service industry with layered and classified measures, with service value-added accounting for 60.9% of GDP and over 20 national pilots approved.

tags.name_en: Integration of Advanced Manufacturing and Modern Service Industry

articles.title_zh: 闽澳高层会晤暨闽澳合作会议第五次会议举行
articles.title_en: Fujian-Macau High-Level Meeting and 5th Cooperation Conference Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，闽澳高层会晤暨闽澳合作会议第五次会议在福州举行，福建省委书记周祖翼与澳门特首岑浩辉出席并致辞，见证多领域合作协议签署。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, the Fujian-Macau high-level meeting and the 5th Fujian-Macau Cooperation Conference were held in Fuzhou. Zhou Zuyi and Sam Hou Fai attended, delivered speeches, and witnessed the signing of cooperation agreements.

articles.title_zh: 广东：锚定目标乘势而上 推动“百千万工程”实施提质增效再上台阶
articles.title_en: Guangdong: Seize Momentum to Improve Implementation of 'Bai Qian Wan Project'
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，广东省委书记黄坤明到省“百千万工程”指挥部办公室调研，强调推进“百千万工程”提质增效，并部署防汛防台风工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, Huang Kunming, Secretary of the CPC Guangdong Provincial Committee, visited the provincial command office of the 'Bai Qian Wan Project' to stress high-quality implementation and urged flood and typhoon preparedness.

articles.title_zh: 广西糖业发展“十五五”规划发布
articles.title_en: Guangxi Releases 15th Five-Year Plan for Sugar Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 近日，广西自治区政府办公厅印发《广西糖业发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年建成现代化特色产业体系，筑牢国家糖业安全根基。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the General Office of the Guangxi Regional Government issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Sugar Industry Development', aiming to build a modern industrial system by 2030 and safeguard national sugar security.

articles.title_zh: 贵州印发“人工智能+制造”实施方案
articles.title_en: Guizhou Issues Implementation Plan for 'AI + Manufacturing'

articles.summary_en: Eight departments including Guizhou's Department of Industry and Information Technology issued an 'AI + Manufacturing' implementation plan, aiming to cultivate leading smart factories by 2028.

articles.title_zh: 河南经营主体总量达1140.52万户 稳居全国第一方阵
articles.title_en: Henan's Business Entities Reach 11.4052 Million, Ranking Top in China
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，河南省市场监管局发布会通报，截至2026年6月底全省实有经营主体1140.52万户，居全国第5位，并推出18项培育举措。
articles.summary_en: At a press conference on Aug 4, Henan's market regulator said the province had 11.4052 million registered business entities by end-June 2026, ranking 5th nationally, and rolled out 18 support measures.

articles.title_zh: 李殿勋在武汉调研“人工智能+”行动推进情况并召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Li Dianxun Investigates 'AI+' Action in Wuhan and Holds Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，湖北省省长李殿勋在武汉东湖新技术开发区调研“人工智能+”行动推进情况并召开座谈会，强调以创新应用场景和商业模式为支撑推动取得突破性进展。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Hubei Governor Li Dianxun visited East Lake High-tech Zone in Wuhan and chaired a symposium on the 'AI+' action, emphasizing innovative application scenarios and business models.

articles.title_zh: 中共河北省委召开党外人士座谈会
articles.title_en: Hebei Provincial Party Committee Holds Symposium with Non-Party Personages
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，河北省委召开党外人士座谈会，就当前经济形势和下半年经济工作听取意见建议，省委书记罗文主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, the Hebei Provincial Party Committee held a symposium with non-party personages to solicit opinions on the economic situation and H2 work. Secretary Luo Wen presided and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 海南省“十五五”自然资源保护和利用规划出台 按自贸港产业定位改革自然资源供应方式
articles.title_en: Hainan Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Natural Resources Protection and Utilization
articles.summary_zh: 近日，海南省人民政府办公厅印发《海南省“十五五”自然资源保护和利用规划》，提出五大主要目标，并明确按自贸港产业定位改革自然资源供应方式。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the General Office of Hainan Provincial People's Government issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Natural Resources Protection and Utilization, setting five main goals and reforming resource supply based on Free Trade Port industrial positioning.

articles.title_zh: 三大变化透视海南消费新图景
articles.title_en: Three Major Changes Reveal New Consumption Landscape in Hainan
articles.summary_zh: 2026年上半年，海南自贸港封关运作背景下，离岛免税、入境游、以旧换新等政策推动消费市场增长，呈现客源、格局、动能三大变化。
articles.summary_en: In the first half of 2026, under the closed-loop operation of the Hainan Free Trade Port, policies such as offshore duty-free shopping, inbound tourism, and trade-in programs boosted consumption, showing changes in customers, market structure, and growth momentum.

articles.title_zh: 教育部开展义务教育阶段科学教育“做中学”领航行动
articles.title_en: Ministry of Education Launches 'Learning by Doing' Initiative for Science Education
articles.summary_zh: 近日教育部印发指南，部署开展科学教育“做中学”领航行动，今年9月起在全国小学、初中全面开展。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Education issued a guideline to launch a 'Learning by Doing' initiative for science education, to be rolled out nationwide in primary and secondary schools from September this year.

articles.title_zh: 许勤督导检查哈尔滨市内涝应急处置工作
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Supervises Harbin's Waterlogging Emergency Response
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日下午哈尔滨遭强降雨出现内涝，当晚省委书记许勤赴市城市防内涝指挥调度中心和道里区河松街积水现场督导检查，慰问一线人员。
articles.summary_en: Xu Qin inspected Harbin's waterlogging response on Aug 4 evening after heavy rains, visiting the command center and a Daoli district site to direct work and comfort staff.

articles.title_zh: 教育部开展义务教育阶段科学教育“做中学”领航行动
articles.title_en: MOE Launches 'Learning by Doing' Leadership Action for Science Education in Compulsory Education
articles.summary_zh: 教育部近日印发《义务教育阶段科学教育“做中学”领航行动指南》，部署在全国小学初中开展科学教育“做中学”领航行动，计划于今年9月全面启动。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Education has issued the Guide to the 'Learning by Doing' Leadership Action for Science Education in Compulsory Education, planning to implement it in primary and secondary schools nationwide starting this September.

articles.title_zh: 连云港启动“人工智能+医疗卫生”三年行动计划
articles.title_en: Lianyungang Launches Three-Year Action Plan for AI + Healthcare
articles.summary_zh: 连云港日前召开路演会，启动“人工智能+医疗卫生”三年行动计划（2026—2028年），推动AI在临床诊疗、公共卫生等领域应用。
articles.summary_en: Lianyungang recently launched a three-year action plan (2026-2028) for AI plus healthcare at a roadshow, promoting AI applications in clinical diagnosis, public health, and grassroots medical services.

articles.title_zh: 南京出台政策助力新型农业经营主体提质增效
articles.title_en: Nanjing Introduces Policies to Boost Quality and Efficiency of New Agricultural Business Entities
articles.summary_zh: 南京市政府办公厅印发《关于促进新型农业经营主体高质量发展的若干措施》，从壮大主体队伍、支持新质生产力、做强产业链等方面推出系列举措，推动新型农业经营主体提质增效。
articles.summary_en: Nanjing municipal government issued measures to promote high-quality development of new agricultural business entities, including support for family farms, cooperatives, and leading enterprises, with subsidies and loan incentives.

articles.title_zh: 江西启动2026年早籼稻政策性收储工作
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Launches 2026 Policy-Based Procurement of Early Indica Rice
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日起，江西省启动2026年早籼稻最低收购价执行预案，设立62个收储库点，确保农民售粮需求。
articles.summary_en: Starting August 5, Jiangxi activates the 2026 minimum purchase price plan for early indica rice, with 62 storage points to meet farmers' grain sales.

articles.title_zh: 叶建春在南昌调研生产性服务业发展
articles.title_en: Ye Jianchun Investigates Development of Producer Services in Nanchang
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，江西省省长叶建春在南昌专题调研生产性服务业发展，强调推进生产性服务业向专业化和价值链高端延伸。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, Governor Ye Jianchun of Jiangxi conducted a special survey on producer services development in Nanchang, emphasizing the extension of producer services to specialization and higher value chains.

articles.title_zh: 纳米制造，探索微观世界的无限可能（经济新方位·制造业新趋势）
articles.title_en: Nano Manufacturing: Exploring the Infinite Possibilities of the Microscopic World
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报报道纳米制造在催化剂、动力电池、纺织面料等领域的应用突破，展现中国制造向高端化、智能化、绿色化跃迁的脉动。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily reports breakthroughs in nanomanufacturing in catalysts, power batteries, and textiles, showcasing China's manufacturing upgrading toward high-end, intelligent, and green development.

articles.title_zh: 自治区政协召开知情明政吹风会
articles.title_en: Autonomous Region CPPCC Holds Briefing on Economic Conditions
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，内蒙古自治区政协召开知情明政吹风会，通报上半年经济社会发展情况，并部署相关工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region CPPCC held a briefing, reporting on H1 economic and social development.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古送电上海配套过江工程开工建设
articles.title_en: Construction Starts on River-Crossing Project for Inner Mongolia-Shanghai Power Transmission
articles.summary_zh: 内蒙古库布齐沙漠基地送电上海工程受端配套过江工程日前开工，工程将下穿长江连接上海崇明岛与江苏太仓，计划2030年底建成。
articles.summary_en: The supporting river-crossing project for the Inner Mongolia-to-Shanghai power transmission has started construction, crossing the Yangtze River between Chongming Island, Shanghai and Taicang, Jiangsu, with completion planned by the end of 2030.

articles.title_zh: 今年上半年1535名纪检监察干部被处分
articles.title_en: 1,535 Discipline Inspection Officials Punished in First Half of Year
articles.summary_zh: 中央纪委国家监委8月4日通报，2026年上半年处分纪检监察干部1535人，其中厅局级59人、县处级356人。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 4, the CCDI reported that 1,535 discipline inspection officials were punished in H1 2026, including 59 at bureau level and 356 at division level.

articles.title_zh: 上半年青海省金融总量平稳增长
articles.title_en: Qinghai's Total Financial Volume Grows Steadily in H1
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，中国人民银行青海省分行召开新闻发布会，公布上半年全省金融总量平稳增长，信贷总量稳步增长，对重点领域支持精准有力。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, the People's Bank of China Qinghai Branch held a press conference, stating that the province's total financial volume grew steadily in H1, with steady credit expansion and targeted support for key areas.

articles.title_zh: 构建具有四川特色的商事纠纷调解体系
articles.title_en: Building a Commercial Dispute Mediation System with Sichuan Characteristics
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，四川省法院与省司法厅签署协同推进商事调解合作框架协议，并召开全省商事调解工作推进会议，省委副书记、政法委书记于立军出席。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Sichuan High Court and Justice Department signed a framework agreement on commercial mediation and held a provincial promotion meeting, attended by deputy party secretary Yu Lijun.

articles.title_zh: 地质矿产调查 四川启动“大会战”
articles.title_en: Sichuan Launches Geological and Mineral Survey 'Campaign'
articles.summary_zh: 四川省启动地质矿产调查“大会战”，未来3年投入13亿元实施257个项目，旨在提升基础地质调查覆盖率、实现战略性矿产资源增储上产。
articles.summary_en: Sichuan launched a 'campaign' for geological and mineral survey, investing 1.3 billion yuan over three years for 257 projects to enhance basic survey coverage and boost strategic mineral reserves.

articles.title_zh: 四川4市（州）政府发布人事任免

articles.summary_en: The governments of Mianyang, Bazhong, Ziyang and Ganzi in Sichuan recently announced personnel appointments and dismissals for several bureau-level positions.

articles.title_zh: 四川省纪委监委：1人被查 1人被“双开”
articles.title_en: Sichuan Discipline Commission: One Official Under Investigation, Another Expelled from Party and Public Office
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，四川省纪委监委通报：四川天府新区眉山党工委原常务副书记王枫主动投案接受审查调查；成都市成华区人民法院原党组书记、院长王泽轩严重违纪违法被开除党籍和公职。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection reported that Wang Feng, former deputy secretary of Meishan Party Working Committee, turned himself in for investigation, and Wang Zexuan, former head of Chenghua District Court, was expelled from Party and public office for serious violations.

articles.title_zh: 纳米制造，探索微观世界的无限可能
articles.title_en: Nanomanufacturing: Exploring the Infinite Possibilities of the Microscopic World
articles.summary_zh: 报道纳米制造在工业催化、电池、服装面料等领域的应用，展现中国制造向高端化、智能化、绿色化发展的趋势。
articles.summary_en: The report covers applications of nanomanufacturing in industrial catalysis, batteries, and textiles, showcasing China's manufacturing shift toward high-end, intelligent, and green development.

articles.title_zh: 山东实施村集体和农民收入“双增计划”
articles.title_en: Shandong Implements Dual-Increase Plan for Village and Farmer Incomes
articles.summary_zh: 山东省委实施村集体和农民收入“双增计划”，通过盘活资源、发展产业、完善分配机制，促进农民多渠道增收。
articles.summary_en: Shandong Party Committee launches a plan to increase both village collective and farmer incomes by revitalizing resources, developing industries, and improving distribution mechanisms.

articles.title_zh: 上海向“新”而行底气足
articles.title_en: Shanghai Shows Strong Confidence in Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报调研走访上海科研机构，报道上海加大基础研究投入、开放大科学装置、培养创新人才，原始创新能力显著提升。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily surveys Shanghai's research institutions, reporting increased basic research investment, open large-scale facilities, and talent cultivation, boosting original innovation.

articles.title_zh: 严密有效应对本轮强降雨 扎实做好防汛救灾各项工作
articles.title_en: Zhao Yide Chairs Shaanxi Flood Control Meeting, Stresses Effective Response to Heavy Rainfall
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，陕西省防汛工作调度会在西安召开。省委书记赵一德出席并讲话，强调严密有效应对强降雨，扎实做好防汛救灾各项工作，保障人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, Shaanxi Provincial Flood Control Dispatch Meeting was held in Xi'an. Party Secretary Zhao Yide attended and stressed effective response to heavy rainfall and solid flood control to safeguard people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 陕西启动消费品以旧换新政策落实专项审计调查
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Launches Special Audit on Trade-in Policy Implementation
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，陕西省审计厅启动消费品以旧换新政策落实专项审计调查，运用大数据手段核查补贴资金使用，推动惠民政策落地见效。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, Shaanxi Provincial Audit Office launched a special audit on the implementation of the consumer goods trade-in policy, using big data to verify subsidy management and ensure policy benefits reach the public.

articles.title_zh: 纳米制造，探索微观世界的无限可能（经济新方位·制造业新趋势）
articles.title_en: Nanomanufacturing: Exploring the Infinite Possibilities of the Microscopic World (New Trends in Manufacturing)
articles.summary_zh: 本文介绍纳米制造技术在分子筛催化剂、纳米磷酸铁锂电芯、纳米纤维膜等领域的应用，展现中国制造业向高端化、智能化、绿色化发展的新趋势。
articles.summary_en: This article reports on applications of nanomanufacturing in industrial catalysis, lithium battery cathodes, and textile membranes, showcasing China's manufacturing shift toward high-end, intelligent, and green development.

articles.title_zh: 新疆党委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻中共中央政治局会议和习近平总书记重要讲话精神 研究推进全面从严治党和经济高质量发展等工作
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Party Standing Committee Holds Meeting to Study Spirit of CPC Central Committee Political Bureau Meeting and Xi's Important Speech, Advancing Full and Strict Party Governance and High-Quality Economic Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，新疆维吾尔自治区党委常委会召开会议，自治区党委书记陈小江主持，学习贯彻中共中央政治局会议和习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究全面从严治党与经济高质量发展等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, the Party Standing Committee of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region held a meeting chaired by Chen Xiaojiang, studying the spirit of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau meeting and Xi Jinping's important speeches, focusing on full and strict party governance and high-quality economic development.

articles.title_zh: 中国记协调研组与自治区党委宣传部聚焦“主流媒体优质IP培养”座谈交流
articles.title_en: China Journalists Association Research Team and Regional Party Publicity Department Hold Symposium on Mainstream Media IP Cultivation
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中国记协调研组与西藏自治区党委宣传部召开座谈会，围绕主流媒体优质IP培养深入交流。自治区党委常委、宣传部部长徐芝文、中国记协党组书记崔士鑫出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: The CJA research team and the Publicity Department of the Tibet Autonomous Regional Party Committee held a symposium on mainstream media IP cultivation. Xu Zhiwen and Cui Shixin attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 中共云南省委十一届十次全会在昆举行

articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，中共云南省委十一届十次全会在昆明举行，总结上半年工作，部署下半年任务，并审议通过相关文件与决议。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, the 10th Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Yunnan Provincial Committee was held in Kunming, summarizing the first half year's work, arranging tasks for the second half year, and reviewing related documents and resolutions.

articles.title_zh: 离境退税单增长近三倍！"中国游"持续带火"中国购"
articles.title_en: Tax-refund slips nearly triple as 'China Travel' boosts 'China Shopping'
articles.summary_zh: 今年上半年上海离境退税申请单同比增长近三倍，深圳各大口岸暑期客流屡创新高，便捷支付与退税政策持续激发外籍旅客消费活力。
articles.summary_en: In H1, Shanghai's tax-refund applications nearly tripled YoY; Shenzhen ports hit record summer traffic, as convenient payment and tax-refund policies boost foreign visitors' spending.

articles.title_zh: 李炳军：发挥比较优势加快旅游业提质升级 为高质量发展提供坚实支撑
articles.title_en: Li Bingjun Urges Accelerating Tourism Quality Upgrade for High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日至4日，贵州省委副书记、省长李炳军到安顺市调研，强调发挥比较优势加快旅游业提质升级，为高质量发展提供坚实支撑。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 3 to 4, Li Bingjun, deputy secretary of CPC Guizhou Provincial Committee and governor, inspected Anshun, stressing faster tourism quality upgrade for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 省政协党组理论学习中心组集体学习报告会举行
articles.title_en: Henan CPPCC Party Group Holds Collective Study Session

articles.title_zh: 农户投保从“躲着走”到“愿意投”——河南推行农业保险一线见闻
articles.title_en: Farmers Move from Avoiding to Embracing Agricultural Insurance in Henan
articles.summary_zh: 河南推行农业保险以来，农民从不愿投保转向主动参保，2026年夏收作物承保覆盖面超80%，保险公司运用科技加强防灾减损。
articles.summary_en: Henan's promotion of agricultural insurance has shifted farmers from reluctance to active participation, with over 80% summer crop coverage in 2026, as insurers use technology for disaster prevention and loss reduction.

articles.title_zh: 讲好红色故事 发展乡村产业
articles.title_en: Telling Red Stories Well, Developing Rural Industries
articles.summary_zh: 宁夏西吉县弘扬长征精神，发展红色旅游和特色产业，推进乡村振兴。2025年明台村集体经济收入达41万元，上半年农林牧渔总产值增长6.7%。
articles.summary_en: Xiji County in Ningxia carries forward the Long March spirit, boosts red tourism and specialty industries, and advances rural revitalization. In H1 2026, its agricultural output rose 6.7%.

articles.title_zh: 中央纪委国家监委通报2026年上半年对纪检监察干部监督检查审查调查情况
articles.title_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection Reports on Supervision and Investigation of Discipline Inspection Cadres in First Half of 2026
articles.summary_zh: 2026年上半年，各级纪检监察机关共接收涉及纪检监察干部问题线索1.55万余件，立案1685人，处分1535人，移送司法机关138人。
articles.summary_en: In the first half of 2026, discipline inspection agencies nationwide received over 15,500 leads concerning discipline inspection cadres, filed 1,685 cases, disciplined 1,535 people, and transferred 138 to judicial organs.

articles.title_zh: 国务院总理李强签署国务院令公布修订后的《集成电路布图设计保护条例》
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Order on Revised Integrated Circuit Layout Design Protection Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强日前签署国务院令，公布修订后的《集成电路布图设计保护条例》，自2026年10月15日起施行。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council order announcing the revised Regulations on the Protection of Integrated Circuit Layout Designs, effective from October 15, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 我国经济动能向新结构向优（读数 读势 读根基）
articles.title_en: China's Economic Momentum Shifts to New Structures and Quality
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报报道，我国上半年经济动能向新结构向优，夏粮产量创新高，工业、外贸、消费等领域稳中有进，为实现全年增长目标提供坚实支撑。
articles.summary_en: A People's Daily report highlights China's solid H1 2026 economic performance, including record summer grain harvest, steady industrial growth, strong foreign trade, and expanding consumption, supporting the annual growth target.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党西藏自治区第十届委员会第十次全体会议公报
articles.title_en: The 10th Plenary Session of the 10th CPC Tibet Regional Committee Held in Lhasa
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月3日，中国共产党西藏自治区第十届委员会第十次全体会议在拉萨召开，审议通过关于召开自治区第十一次党代表大会的决议。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, 2026, the 10th Plenary Session of the 10th CPC Tibet Regional Committee was held in Lhasa, approving a resolution on convening the region's 11th Party Congress.

articles.title_zh: 李强签署国务院令 公布修订后的《集成电路布图设计保护条例》
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Order to Publish Revised Regulations on Protection of Integrated Circuit Layout Designs
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强日前签署国务院令，公布修订后的《集成电路布图设计保护条例》，自2026年10月15日起施行。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council order to publish the revised Regulations on the Protection of Integrated Circuit Layout Designs, effective October 15, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 2026年第三季度全市安全生产暨防汛抗旱工作视频会议召开
articles.title_en: Chifeng Holds Q3 2026 Work Safety and Flood Control Video Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，赤峰市市长栾天猛主持召开2026年第三季度全市安全生产暨防汛抗旱工作视频会议，要求强化预警和隐患排查，保障人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Luan Tianmeng, mayor of Chifeng, chaired the city's video conference on work safety and flood/drought control for Q3 2026, urging stronger early warning and hazard investigation to protect lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 大科学装置建设全面提速 创新成果涌现
articles.title_en: Construction of Major Scientific Facilities Accelerates, Innovative Achievements Emerge
articles.summary_zh: 我国大科学装置建设全面提速，高海拔宇宙线观测站发现银河系最高能量粒子加速器，FAST脉冲星发现近1300颗。
articles.summary_en: China's construction of major scientific infrastructures is accelerating. The LHAASO observatory discovered the highest-energy particle accelerator in the Milky Way, and FAST has found nearly 1,300 pulsars.

articles.title_zh: 《全国地质灾害防治“十五五”实施方案》公布
articles.title_en: National 15th Five-Year Plan for Geological Disaster Prevention Released
articles.summary_zh: 自然资源部8月4日公布《全国地质灾害防治“十五五”实施方案》，部署工程治理4200余处、排危除险6100余处、避险搬迁5万户，并明确21个重点防治区。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, the Ministry of Natural Resources released the 15th Five-Year Plan for national geological disaster prevention, deploying over 4,200 engineering treatments, 6,100 risk-elimination projects, and relocation of 50,000 households, identifying 21 key prevention zones.

articles.title_zh: 物流业景气指数继续扩张 市场需求进一步向好
articles.title_en: Logistics Industry Prosperity Index Continues to Expand, Market Demand Further Improves
articles.summary_zh: 中国物流与采购联合会8月4日公布，7月份中国物流业景气指数为50.4%，继续保持扩张；新订单指数连续5个月回升，反映市场需求向好。
articles.summary_en: The China Federation of Logistics & Purchasing announced on August 4 that China's logistics industry prosperity index for July stood at 50.4%, remaining in expansion territory, with new order index rising for five consecutive months, reflecting improving market demand.

articles.title_zh: 四部门印发实施方案 加快建设统一开放的交通运输市场
articles.title_en: Four Departments Issue Implementation Plan to Build Unified Open Transportation Market
articles.summary_zh: 近日，交通运输部等四部门联合印发《交通运输纵深推进全国统一大市场建设实施方案》，部署制度规则衔接、基础设施联通等任务，为全国统一大市场建设提供交通保障。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Ministry of Transport and three other departments jointly issued a plan to advance a unified national transportation market, focusing on institutional alignment, infrastructure connectivity, and coordinated regulation.

articles.title_zh: 国务院成立重庆彭水汉葭街道“7·17”特别重大山体崩塌灾害调查评估组
articles.title_en: State Council Sets Up Investigation and Assessment Team for Chongqing Landslide Disaster
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，国务院在重庆彭水召开“7·17”特别重大山体崩塌灾害调查评估组第一次全体会议，部署调查评估工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, the State Council held the first plenary meeting of the investigation and assessment team for the "7·17" major landslide disaster in Pengshui, Chongqing, to arrange investigation work.

articles.title_zh: 蒋冰调研商贸旅游区文旅融合与商圈提质工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Bing Investigates Cultural Tourism Integration and Commercial District Upgrading
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，丹东市委书记蒋冰率相关部门深入商贸旅游区，调研文旅产业培育、商圈运营管理及旅游服务保障，强调文旅融合与消费提质。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Dandong Party Secretary Jiang Bing led relevant departments to investigate cultural tourism industry cultivation, commercial district management, and tourism services, emphasizing integration and consumption upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 王新伟在东北大学调研并主持召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Wang Xinwei Visits Northeastern University and Chairs Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，辽宁省委副书记、省长王新伟在东北大学调研并主持召开座谈会，强调深化改革创新，推进中国特色、世界一流大学建设，更好赋能辽宁全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 3, Wang Xinwei, Governor of Liaoning, visited Northeastern University and chaired a symposium, emphasizing reform and innovation to build a world-class university and empower regional revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 门泊万里向海开——福州市政协助力扩大高水平对外开放加快建设国际门户枢纽城市
articles.title_en: Fuzhou CPPCC Helps Expand High-Level Opening-Up and Build International Gateway Hub City
articles.summary_zh: 福州市政协今年以来围绕扩大高水平对外开放开展调研协商，7月15日召开专题议政性常委会会议建言建设国际门户枢纽城市，市委书记郭宁宁要求吸纳落实。
articles.summary_en: Since this year, the Fuzhou CPPCC has conducted research and consultation on expanding high-level opening-up. On July 15, it held a special consultative standing committee meeting to advise on building an international gateway hub city, and Party Secretary Guo Ningning urged relevant departments to adopt and implement the suggestions.

articles.title_zh: 汪华东在全市季度工作会议上强调锚定打好“三仗”任务和年度预期目标不动摇
articles.title_en: Wang Huadong Stresses Unwavering Efforts in 'Three Battles' and Annual Targets at Quarterly Work Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日上午，淮北市召开全市季度工作会议，市委书记汪华东强调锚定打好“三仗”任务和年度预期目标不动摇，要求决战三季度、决胜下半年，掀起比学赶超攻坚热潮。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 4, Huaibei held its quarterly work meeting. Party Secretary Wang Huadong stressed unwavering commitment to the 'three battles' and annual targets, calling for a decisive push in Q3 and the second half of the year.

articles.title_zh: 市政府2026年第14次党组会暨理论学习中心组学习会议召开 蒋曦主持会议并讲话
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi Chairs Municipal Government Party Group Meeting and Theoretical Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日下午，淮北市政府召开2026年第14次党组会暨理论学习中心组学习会议，市长蒋曦主持并讲话，强调理论学习与问题整治。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 4, Huaihei Municipal Government held its 14th Party Group meeting and theoretical study session, chaired by Mayor Jiang Xi, emphasizing theoretical study and problem rectification.

articles.title_zh: 高靖生走访看望老领导老同志
articles.title_en: Gao Jingsheng Visits and Greets Former Leaders and Comrades
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日上午，怀化市委副书记、市政府党组书记高靖生走访看望陈志强等老领导老同志，听取意见建议，感谢他们为怀化发展所作贡献。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 3, Gao Jingsheng, Deputy Secretary of the Huaihua Municipal Party Committee and Party Secretary of the Municipal Government, visited and greeted former leaders and comrades, listening to their suggestions and thanking them for their contributions.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开常务会议
articles.title_en: Municipal Government Holds Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日下午，市委副书记、市政府党组书记高靖生主持召开市政府常务会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，分析上半年经济形势并部署下半年工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 3, Gao Jingsheng, Deputy Secretary of the Municipal Party Committee and Party Secretary of the Municipal Government, presided over a routine meeting of the Huaihua Municipal Government to study and implement the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent speeches and analyze the economic performance of the first half year.

articles.title_zh: 欧冬林主持召开市政府第176次常务会议
articles.title_en: Ou Donglin Chairs the 176th Executive Meeting of Huainan Municipal Government
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日上午，淮南市代市长欧冬林主持召开市政府第176次常务会议，研究部署群众身边腐败问题集中整治和重点行业领域本质安全提升工作，审议通过企业高质量发展行动方案。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 3, acting Mayor Ou Donglin of Huainan chaired the 176th executive meeting of the municipal government, deploying campaigns against corruption and safety improvements, and reviewing an action plan for high-quality enterprise development.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰主持召开市政府党组会议、常务会议
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Chairs Municipal Government Party Group Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 3日上午，市长曲晓杰主持召开市政府党组会议和常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和指示精神，研究部署基础教育、交通安全等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 3, Mayor Qu Xiaojie chaired a Party Group meeting and executive meeting of the Municipal Government to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions, and to make arrangements for basic education and traffic safety.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党西藏自治区第十届委员会第十次全体会议在拉萨举行
articles.title_en: 10th Plenary Session of 10th CPC Tibet Regional Committee Held in Lhasa
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，中国共产党西藏自治区第十届委员会第十次全体会议在拉萨举行，自治区党委书记王君正讲话，审议通过召开自治区第十一次党代会的决议。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, the 10th Plenary Session of the 10th Tibet Autonomous Regional Committee of the CPC was held in Lhasa. Wang Junzheng, regional party secretary, delivered a speech, and the session approved a resolution on convening the 11th Regional Party Congress.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群赴南澳县调研:加快建设全域农文旅融合示范区 打造国际滨海休闲旅游目的地
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Inspects Nan'ao County: Building All-for-One Agri-Culture-Tourism Integration Demonstration Zone and International Coastal Leisure Tourism Destination
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日上午，汕头市委书记庄悦群赴南澳县调研，要求加快创建国家5A级景区，打造全域农文旅融合示范区和国际滨海休闲旅游目的地。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 3, Zhuang Yuequn, Secretary of the Shantou Municipal Party Committee, visited Nan'ao County to promote the creation of a national 5A scenic area and build an all-for-one agricultural-culture-tourism integration demonstration zone and an international coastal leisure tourism destination.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委全面深化改革委员会会议召开 李邑飞主持并讲话 张雨浦庄严出席
articles.title_en: Autonomous Region Party Committee Holds Deepening Reform Commission Meeting, Li Yifei Presides and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，自治区党委全面深化改革委员会第37次会议召开，通报改革任务落实情况，审议长期护理保险统筹制度实施方案。自治区党委书记李邑飞主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, the 37th meeting of the Autonomous Region Party Committee Deepening Reform Commission was held to report on reform tasks and review a plan for long-term care insurance pooling. Party Secretary Li Yifei presided and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 四部门印发实施方案 加快建设统一开放的交通运输市场
articles.title_en: Four Departments Issue Plan to Accelerate Unified and Open Transport Market
articles.summary_zh: 近日，交通运输部等四部门联合印发《交通运输纵深推进全国统一大市场建设实施方案》，提出推进市场制度规则衔接、基础设施联通、政府行为尺度统一等六方面重点任务，为全国统一大市场建设提供交通运输服务保障。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Ministry of Transport and three other departments jointly issued an implementation plan to promote the construction of a unified national transport market, focusing on six key tasks including institutional alignment, infrastructure connectivity, and unified government behavior.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬专题调研企业增资扩产工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Investigates Enterprise Expansion in Jingjiang
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬到靖江市专题调研企业增资扩产工作，走访多家企业并强调支持企业技术创新和产业升级。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Jiang Dongdong, Secretary of the Taizhou Municipal Party Committee, conducted a special research on enterprise expansion in Jingjiang, visiting several companies and stressing support for technological innovation and industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬出席伽力森乳蛋白深加工项目开工活动
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Attends Groundbreaking of Galisen Milk Protein Deep-Processing Project
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，伽力森乳蛋白深加工项目在泰州兴化开工，市委书记姜冬冬出席并宣布开工。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, the Galisen milk protein deep-processing project broke ground in Xinghua, Taizhou, with municipal Party secretary Jiang Dongdong attending and announcing the start.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬专题调研企业增资扩产工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Investigates Enterprise Capacity Expansion
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬到靖江市专题调研企业增资扩产工作，走访多家企业，强调支持技术创新和产业升级。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Jiang Dongdong, Secretary of Taizhou Municipal Party Committee, visited Jingjiang to investigate enterprise capacity expansion, touring several companies and emphasizing support for technological innovation and industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 孙简在柳河县调研民族宗教工作
articles.title_en: Sun Jian Inspects Ethnic and Religious Work in Liuhe County
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日上午，副省长、市委书记孙简到柳河县调研民族宗教工作，强调推动新时代党的民族宗教工作高质量发展，巩固民族团结、宗教和谐局面。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 3, Sun Jian, Vice Governor and Municipal Party Secretary, conducted research on ethnic and religious work in Liuhe County, emphasizing high-quality development of ethnic and religious work in the new era and consolidating ethnic unity and religious harmony.

articles.title_zh: 孙简在柳河县调研民族宗教工作
articles.title_en: Sun Jian Investigates Ethnic and Religious Work in Liuhe County
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日上午，副省长、通化市委书记孙简深入柳河县调研民族宗教工作，强调贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，推动民族和睦、宗教和顺。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 3, Sun Jian, Vice Governor and Party Secretary of Tonghua, conducted a special survey on ethnic and religious work in Liuhe County, emphasizing the implementation of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech.

articles.title_zh: 张海波到经开区督导调研经济运行工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Inspects Economic Operation in Economic Development Zone
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，威海市委书记张海波到经开区督导调研经济运行工作，强调发挥开发区主战场优势，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Zhang Haibo, Secretary of the Weihai Municipal Party Committee, visited the Economic Development Zone to supervise and research economic operation, emphasizing leveraging the zone's advantages to promote high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 邢善萍在西安市调研新就业群体服务管理工作
articles.title_en: Xing Shanping Investigates Service Management for New Employment Groups in Xi'an
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，陕西省委副书记邢善萍在西安调研新就业群体服务管理工作，强调党建引领基层治理，做实做细服务管理。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Xing Shanping, Deputy Secretary of the Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee, visited Xi'an to inspect service management for new employment groups, emphasizing party-building leadership in grassroots governance.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议研究经济稳增长基础教育和侨务等工作 蒿慧杰主持
articles.title_en: Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Economic Growth, Basic Education and Overseas Chinese Affairs; Hao Huijie Presides
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，西安市委常委会召开会议，学习中央政治局会议精神，研究部署经济稳增长、基础教育和侨务等工作，省委常委、市委书记蒿慧杰主持。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 3, the Xi'an Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met to study the spirit of the CPC Central Political Bureau meeting and made arrangements for stable economic growth, basic education, and overseas Chinese affairs. Hao Huijie, member of the Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee and Municipal Party Secretary, presided.

articles.title_zh: 淮滨县：朱志勇接待来访群众
articles.title_en: Huaibin County: Zhu Zhiyong Receives Visiting Masses
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，淮滨县委书记朱志勇到县信访接待中心接待来访群众，强调依法及时妥善处置群众合理诉求。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Zhu Zhiyong, county party secretary of Huaibin, received visiting masses at the county petition center, stressing lawful and timely handling of their reasonable demands.

articles.title_zh: 全市安全生产工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Yancheng Holds Citywide Work Safety Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，盐城市召开全市安全生产工作会议，部署中央和省安全生产巡查反馈问题整改工作，市委书记严汉平出席并讲话，代市长吴炜主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Yancheng held a citywide work safety meeting to deploy rectification of problems reported by central and provincial inspection teams. Party Secretary Yan Hanping attended and spoke; Acting Mayor Wu Wei presided.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛在南通调研时强调激发企业活力增强产业动能
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Visits Nantong, Emphasizing Enterprise Vitality and Industrial Momentum
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日至30日，江苏省省长刘小涛在南通调研，了解产业发展和人工智能应用，强调激发企业活力、推动经济向新向优向好发展。
articles.summary_en: From July 29 to 30, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao visited Nantong to inspect industrial development and AI applications, emphasizing enterprise vitality and high-quality economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 中共江苏省委十四届十二次全会举行 信长星讲话
articles.title_en: 12th Plenary Session of 14th CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee Held; Xin Changxing Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，中共江苏省委十四届十二次全会在南京举行，审议通过关于召开省第十五次党代会的决议，决定大会于2026年第四季度在南京召开。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, the 12th Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee was held in Nanjing, approving a resolution to convene the province's 15th Party Congress in Q4 2026 in Nanjing.

articles.title_zh: 江成在全市服务业高质量发展会议上强调把服务业发展摆到突出位置全力推进
articles.title_en: Jiang Cheng Stresses Service Industry Development at Yantai High-Quality Development Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，烟台市委、市政府召开全市服务业高质量发展会议，省人大常委会副主任、市委书记江成出席并讲话，强调把服务业发展摆到突出位置全力推进。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, the Yantai Municipal Party Committee and Government held a conference on high-quality development of the service industry. Jiang Cheng, deputy director of the Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee and municipal party secretary, attended and delivered a speech, emphasizing the need to boost the service industry.

articles.title_zh: 四部门印发实施方案 加快建设统一开放的交通运输市场
articles.title_en: Four Departments Issue Plan to Accelerate Construction of Unified Open Transport Market
articles.summary_zh: 近日，交通运输部等四部门联合印发《交通运输纵深推进全国统一大市场建设实施方案》，部署推进市场制度规则衔接、基础设施联通等六大任务。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Ministry of Transport and three other departments jointly issued an implementation plan for deepening the construction of a unified national market in transport, deploying six major tasks including institutional alignment and infrastructure connectivity.

articles.title_zh: 杨政昆在峨山县调研文旅融合发展情况
articles.title_en: Yang Zhengkun Inspects Cultural-Tourism Integration in Eshan County
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，玉溪市委书记杨政昆在峨山县调研文旅融合发展，强调坚持创新理念推动文旅产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Yang Zhengkun, Party Secretary of Yuxi, visited Eshan County to inspect cultural-tourism integration, stressing innovation-driven high-quality development of the tourism industry.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江与中国能建集团董事长倪真一行座谈
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Holds Talks with Ni Zhen, Chairman of China Energy Engineering Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，湖南省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江与中国能建集团董事长倪真一行座谈，双方就深化能源建设、产业发展等领域合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Xie Weijiang, Deputy Secretary of Hunan Provincial Committee and Yueyang Municipal Party Secretary, held talks with Ni Zhen, Chairman of China Energy Engineering Group, to deepen cooperation in energy construction and industrial development.

articles.title_zh: 云浮市乡村产业人才总量达3.71万人
articles.title_en: Yunfu's Rural Industry Talent Reaches 37,100
articles.summary_zh: 云浮市持续完善乡村产业人才引育留用机制，目前全市乡村产业人才总量已达3.71万人，为乡村振兴和农业强市建设提供人才支撑。
articles.summary_en: Yunfu has improved its rural industry talent system, with the total talent pool reaching 37,100, supporting rural revitalization and agricultural development.

articles.title_zh: 卢荣春主持云浮市上半年经济形势分析会暨市委财经委会议
articles.title_en: Lu Rongchun Chairs Yunfu's H1 Economic Situation Analysis Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，云浮市召开上半年经济形势分析会暨市委财经委会议，市委书记卢荣春主持并讲话，部署下半年经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 3, Yunfu held its H1 economic analysis meeting and municipal finance committee meeting. Party Secretary Lu Rongchun chaired and spoke, deploying work for H2.

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐检查疫情防控并调研民生实事项目推进情况和重点企业
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Inspects Epidemic Prevention and Surveys Livelihood Projects and Key Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，珠海市委副书记、市长吴泽桐赴香洲区检查基孔肯雅热疫情防控，调研民生实事项目进度和重点企业，强调织密防控防线，解决群众急难愁盼问题。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Wu Zetong, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Zhuhai Municipal Committee and Mayor, visited Xiangzhou District to inspect chikungunya fever prevention and control, and surveyed livelihood projects and key enterprises, emphasizing the need to strengthen epidemic prevention and address public concerns.

articles.title_zh: 陈勇赴横琴开展“澳门+横琴”高质量发展专题调研 以科技创新驱动琴澳产业协同
articles.title_en: Chen Yong Conducts Research on 'Macao+Hengqin' High-Quality Development in Hengqin
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日下午，珠海市委书记陈勇赴横琴粤澳深度合作区开展“澳门+横琴”高质量发展专题调研，走访多家科技企业和横琴综合管廊，强调以科技创新驱动琴澳产业协同。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 3, Chen Yong, Secretary of Zhuhai Municipal Party Committee, visited Hengqin to inspect tech firms and public infrastructure, urging innovation-driven industrial synergy for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐调度部署全市防汛工作
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Chairs Flood Control Video Conference in Zhuhai
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，珠海市委副书记、市长吴泽桐主持召开全市防汛视频调度会议，部署强降雨防范工作，全力筑牢汛期安全防线。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Wu Zetong, Deputy Secretary and Mayor of Zhuhai, chaired a citywide flood control video conference to deploy measures against heavy rainfall and ensure safety.

articles.title_zh: 省政府党组会议召开 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Provincial Government Party Group Meeting Held to Convey and Study Xi Jinping's Important Speeches and Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，山东省委副书记、省长周乃翔主持召开省政府党组会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和指示精神，部署下半年经济工作与全面从严治党。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Zhou Naixiang, deputy secretary of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee and governor, chaired a meeting of the provincial government's leading party group to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions, and deploy tasks for economic work and strict party governance.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔会见非洲国家驻华使节代表团
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Meets African Envoys Delegation to China
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，山东省省长周乃翔在济南会见非洲国家驻华使节代表团，表示愿深化与非洲在贸易、农业、基础设施等领域的合作。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Zhou Naixiang, Governor of Shandong Province, met with a delegation of African envoys to China in Jinan, expressing willingness to deepen cooperation with Africa in trade, agriculture, infrastructure and other fields.

articles.title_zh: 中国科学家首获威廉·诺德伯格奖章 获小行星命名
articles.title_en: Chinese Scientist First to Win William Nordberg Medal, Asteroid Named After Him
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月3日，在意大利佛罗伦萨举行的国际空间研究委员会科学大会上，中国气象局王劲松研究员荣获威廉·诺德伯格奖章，成为首位获此殊荣的中国科学家，并获小行星命名。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, at the COSPAR scientific assembly in Florence, Italy, Wang Jinsong of the China Meteorological Administration became the first Chinese scientist to receive the William Nordberg Medal, also gaining an asteroid naming.

articles.title_zh: 军迷鲁某被国家安全机关查获
articles.title_en: Military Fan Lu Apprehended by State Security Organs
articles.summary_zh: 国家安全机关查获一名网名鲁某的军迷，其涉嫌危害国家安全。
articles.summary_en: State security organs apprehended a military fan surnamed Lu, suspected of endangering national security.

articles.title_zh: 中央纪委国家监委通报：上半年1535名纪检监察干部被处分
articles.title_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection Reports 1,535 Discipline Inspection Cadres Disciplined in First Half of 2026
articles.summary_zh: 中央纪委国家监委8月4日通报，2026年上半年全国纪检监察机关对纪检监察干部立案1685人，处分1535人，移送司法机关138人。
articles.summary_en: The CCDI reported on Aug 4 that in the first half of 2026, disciplinary inspection organs filed cases against 1,685 disciplinary inspection cadres, disciplined 1,535, and transferred 138 to judicial organs.

articles.title_zh: 国家邮政局依法对申通快递有限公司立案调查
articles.title_en: State Post Bureau Investigates STO Express Co., Ltd.
articles.summary_zh: 国家邮政局对申通快递有限公司依法立案调查，具体原因未披露。
articles.summary_en: The State Post Bureau has formally filed a case to investigate STO Express Co., Ltd. according to law. Details not disclosed.

articles.title_zh: 陕西汉中一村支书防汛中遇难，市委书记专程前往该村慰问
articles.title_en: Party Chief of Village in Hanzhong Dies in Flood Control; City Party Secretary Visits to Express Condolences
articles.summary_zh: 陕西汉中南郑区立峰村党总支书记李杨在防汛巡查中因车辆侧翻被洪水冲走，不幸遇难。市委书记张烨专程慰问家属。
articles.summary_en: Li Yang, Party chief of Lifeng Village in Nanzheng District, Hanzhong, died after being swept away during flood control patrol. City Party Secretary Zhang Ye visited his family to offer condolences.

articles.title_zh: “冯院长挺喜欢你，你把握好”“给我送点钱”， 邯郸中院：录音属实
articles.title_en: Handan Intermediate Court Confirms Recording Authentic: 'President Feng Likes You, Seize the Opportunity' and 'Give Me Some Money'
articles.summary_zh: 河北省邯郸市中级人民法院就网传“冯院长”不当言论及索贿录音事件回应，确认录音属实。
articles.summary_en: Handan Intermediate People's Court in Hebei confirmed the authenticity of a recording involving 'President Feng' making inappropriate remarks and soliciting bribes.

articles.title_zh: 河南力量赋能超级工程 世界最大直径高铁盾构机成功穿越长江
articles.title_en: World's Largest Diameter High-Speed Railway Shield Machine Successfully Crosses the Yangtze River
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日上午，中铁装备研制的世界最大直径高铁盾构机“领航号”成功穿越长江，实现崇太长江隧道水域段贯通，创下15米级大直径盾构连续掘进11182米的世界纪录。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 30, the world's largest diameter high-speed railway shield machine 'Linghang', developed by China Railway Equipment, successfully crossed the Yangtze River, completing the underwater section of the Chongtai Yangtze River Tunnel and setting a world record of 11,182 meters of continuous boring.

articles.title_zh: 宇通首批机场自动驾驶旅客摆渡车在新疆投运
articles.title_en: Yutong's First Airport Autonomous Shuttle Buses Put into Operation in Xinjiang
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，宇通16辆机场自动驾驶旅客摆渡车在乌鲁木齐天山国际机场投运，开启中国民航自动驾驶载人商业化运营，填补国内空白。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Yutong put 16 autonomous airport shuttle buses into operation at Urumqi Tianshan International Airport, marking China's first commercial autonomous passenger use in civil aviation.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能多项成果落地生根 河南AI产业全搜索
articles.title_en: AI Achievements Take Root in Henan: A Comprehensive Industry Survey
articles.summary_zh: 近日，首批河南造众擎T800人形机器人在郑州高新区下线，7月10日曙光8000十万卡AI超集群在郑州落成，河南AI产业规模已突破千亿元。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the first batch of Henan-made Zhongqing T800 humanoid robots rolled off the line in Zhengzhou High-Tech Zone, and the Sugon 8000 (Dengfeng) 100K AI supercluster was launched in Zhengzhou on July 10. Henan's AI industry scale has exceeded 100 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 全市服务业大会召开
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Holds City-wide Service Industry Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，全市服务业大会在福州召开，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁出席并讲话，强调加快推进服务业扩能提质和优质高效发展，市长吴贤德主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, a city-wide service industry conference was held in Fuzhou. Guo Ningning, Deputy Party Secretary of Fujian and Party Secretary of Fuzhou, spoke on accelerating service industry upgrade, with Mayor Wu Xiande presiding.

articles.title_zh: 十二届福州市委第九轮巡察“回头看”完成反馈
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee Completes Feedback on Ninth Round of Inspection 'Look-back'
articles.summary_zh: 近日，十二届福州市委第九轮巡察‘回头看’反馈工作全部完成，采取集中反馈与‘一对一’反馈结合，强调压实整改责任，推动真改实改。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the feedback for the 9th round of 'look-back' inspections by the 12th Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee was fully completed, combining centralized and one-on-one feedback, emphasizing accountability and thorough rectification.

articles.title_zh: 学习新语·铸魂强党｜办好中国的事情，关键在党
articles.title_en: Learning New Words: Strengthening the Party | The Party Is the Key to China's Affairs
articles.summary_zh: 今年6月全国党建工作座谈会部署学习贯彻习近平党建思想；新华社推出“学习新语”系列报道，首期围绕坚持党的领导，梳理习近平总书记重要论述。
articles.summary_en: In June, a national party building work symposium deployed the study and implementation of Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building. Xinhua's 'Learning New Words' series launched, highlighting Xi's important expositions on upholding the Party's leadership.

articles.title_zh: 中共福建省委十一届十次全会在榕举行
articles.title_en: 10th Plenary Session of 11th CPC Fujian Provincial Committee Held in Fuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，中共福建省委十一届十次全会在福州召开，省委书记周祖翼讲话，审议通过关于召开省第十二次党代会的决议。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, the 10th Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Fujian Provincial Committee was held in Fuzhou. Zhou Zuyi, secretary of the provincial committee, delivered a speech and the session approved a resolution on convening the 12th provincial party congress.

articles.title_zh: 办好中国的事情，关键在党
articles.title_en: The Party is the Key to Running China's Affairs Well
articles.summary_zh: 全国党建工作座谈会部署学习贯彻习近平党建思想，新华社‘学习新语’栏目推出‘铸魂强党’系列报道，首期阐释‘坚持党的领导是中国特色社会主义最本质的特征’。
articles.summary_en: The National Conference on Party Building deployed the study of Xi Jinping's Thoughts on Party Building. Xinhua's 'Learning from New Words' column launched the 'Forging the Party's Soul' series, explaining that upholding Party leadership is the essential feature of socialism with Chinese characteristics.

articles.title_en: CPC Jinan Municipal Standing Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi's Important Speech and Discuss Birth Support, Service Industry Upgrading
articles.summary_zh: 济南市委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，研究全面从严治党、生育支持、服务业扩能提质等事项。市委书记刘强主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of CPC Jinan Municipal Committee held a meeting to study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions, discussing issues including full and strict party self-governance, birth support policies, and service industry upgrading. Liu Qiang, secretary of the municipal party committee, presided over the meeting and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 市中区：凝聚多元解纷合力 共筑基层治理格局
articles.title_en: Shizhong District: Pooling Multi-Party Dispute Resolution Efforts to Build a Grassroots Governance Pattern
articles.summary_zh: 济南市市中区推进综治中心标准化建设，整合多部门力量多元化解矛盾纠纷，提升基层治理效能。
articles.summary_en: Shizhong District of Jinan promotes standardized construction of comprehensive governance centers, integrating multiple departments to resolve disputes and improve grassroots governance.

articles.title_zh: 全市高质量招商引资指挥部会议召开：瞄准发力方向 强化招商举措 全力推动更多高质量项目落地
articles.title_en: Qingdao Holds High-Quality Investment Attraction Meeting to Boost Project Landing
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日下午，青岛市召开高质量招商引资指挥部会议，市委书记曾赞荣出席并讲话，市长任刚主持，部署下步重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, Qingdao held a city-wide meeting on high-quality investment attraction. Municipal Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong delivered a speech, and Mayor Ren Gang presided. The meeting reviewed progress and deployed key tasks.

articles.title_en: Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Party Leadership Group Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日上午，青岛市人大常委会党组扩大会议召开，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，研究部署人大重点工作。
articles.summary_en: The Party Leadership Group meeting of Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee was held on Aug 4 to convey Xi Jinping's important speeches and arrange legislative and supervisory work.

articles.title_zh: 四川启动地质矿产调查“大会战” 未来三年“寻宝”
articles.title_en: Sichuan Launches Three-Year 'Treasure Hunt' for Mineral Resources
articles.summary_zh: 四川省启动地质矿产调查“大会战”，计划三年投入13亿元，实施257个项目，旨在提升基础地质调查覆盖率、实现战略性矿产资源增储上产。
articles.summary_en: Sichuan launched a three-year 'campaign' for geological and mineral survey, investing 1.3 billion yuan in 257 projects to boost basic survey coverage and strategic mineral reserves.

articles.title_zh: 四川启动地质矿产调查大会战，3年实施257个项目
articles.title_en: Sichuan Launches Geological Survey Campaign with 257 Projects over Three Years
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，四川省自然资源厅启动地质矿产调查大会战，未来三年投入13亿元实施257个项目，推动战略性矿产资源增储上产。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, Sichuan Provincial Department of Natural Resources launched a geological and mineral survey campaign, investing 1.3 billion yuan over three years for 257 projects to boost strategic mineral reserves.
