articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记今年以来治国理政纪实丨扎扎实实以科技创新支撑和引领中国式现代化
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Governance Record: Advancing Chinese Modernization through Sci-Tech Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 习近平今年以来围绕科技创新作出一系列重大决策部署，出席世界人工智能大会并发表主旨演讲，主持政治局集体学习聚焦未来产业，考察国家信创园，召开加强基础研究座谈会，引领科技强国建设。
articles.summary_en: Since this year, Xi Jinping has made a series of major decisions on sci-tech innovation, delivering a keynote speech at the World AI Conference, chairing a Politburo study session on future industries, visiting the National Information Technology Application Innovation Park, and chairing a symposium on basic research to build a strong science and technology nation.

articles.title_zh: 《四川省天然林保护修复中长期规划》正式印发 到2035年实施森林修复1270万亩
articles.title_en: Sichuan Issues Medium- and Long-Term Plan for Natural Forest Protection and Restoration, with 12.7 Million Mu of Forest Restoration by 2035
articles.summary_zh: 近日，《四川省天然林保护修复中长期规划》正式印发，明确到2030年修复森林900万亩，到2035年修复1270万亩，并提出三项重点任务。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Medium- and Long-Term Plan for Natural Forest Protection and Restoration in Sichuan Province was officially issued, setting targets of 9 million mu of forest restoration by 2030 and 12.7 million mu by 2035, along with three key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 习近平的“侨”缘
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Bond with Overseas Chinese
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记近日对侨务工作作出重要指示，强调全面贯彻党的侨务政策，凝聚侨心侨力。文章回顾了习近平在福建、浙江等地工作期间与海外侨胞的深厚情谊。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently gave important instructions on overseas Chinese affairs, emphasizing the need to fully implement the Party's policies and unite overseas Chinese. The article reviews Xi's deep ties with overseas Chinese during his work in Fujian and Zhejiang.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记今年以来治国理政纪实丨坚定不移推动高质量发展 努力实现“十五五”良好开局
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Governance Record This Year: Firmly Promoting High-Quality Development for a Good Start of the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 2026年是“十五五”开局之年，习近平总书记作出一系列部署推动高质量发展，央视《新闻联播》推出治国理政纪实系列报道，强调实现良好开局。
articles.summary_en: In 2026, the first year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, General Secretary Xi Jinping made a series of decisions to promote high-quality development. CCTV's News Simulcast launched a series of reports on governance, emphasizing a good start.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行
articles.title_en: Vibrant China Research Trip
articles.summary_zh: 今年7月，江苏泰兴生产力促进中心更名为新质生产力促进中心。泰兴以“全面融入上海、全力融入苏南”的双融战略，推进科创平台与跨江政务通办，探索县域融入长三角新路径。
articles.summary_en: In July, Taixing renamed its productivity center for new-quality productivity and pursues dual integration with Shanghai and southern Jiangsu for innovation and cross-river services.

articles.title_zh: 广州市市长孙志洋会见中国生物制药高管
articles.title_en: Guangzhou Mayor Sun Zhiyang Meets Sino Biopharmaceutical Executives
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日下午，广州市市长孙志洋在广州会见中国生物制药有限公司首席执行长、正大天晴药业集团董事长谢承润一行。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 3, Guangzhou Mayor Sun Zhiyang met in Guangzhou with Xie Chengrun, CEO of Sino Biopharmaceutical and Chairman of Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group.

articles.title_zh: 乡村发展共创营（广东站）将于8月18日在广州举行
articles.title_en: Rural Development Co-creation Camp (Guangdong Station) to Be Held in Guangzhou on August 18
articles.summary_zh: 广东省农业农村厅8月3日透露，'乡村发展共创营（广东站）'活动将于8月18日在广州举行，由字节跳动公益等联合主办，助力乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: The Agriculture and Rural Affairs Department of Guangdong Province announced on August 3 that the Rural Development Co-creation Camp (Guangdong Station) will be held in Guangzhou on August 18, co-hosted by ByteDance Charity and others to support rural revitalization.

tags.name_en: Agriculture and Rural Affairs Department of Guangdong Province

tags_en: Agriculture and Rural Affairs Department of Guangdong Province

articles.title_zh: 安徽科创何以加速“变现”？
articles.title_en: How Does Anhui's Sci-Tech Innovation Accelerate 'Monetization'?
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，安徽创新馆展示量子计算机等大国重器；上半年安徽高技术制造业增加值增长44.6%，通过科技大市场加速成果转化。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Anhui Innovation Hall showcased quantum computers and other major equipment; H1 high-tech manufacturing value-added grew 44.6%, with technology market accelerating commercialization.

articles.title_zh: 上合组织已成为全球南方参与国际秩序重塑的重要平台——访埃及外交事务委员会主任萨阿德
articles.title_en: SCO Becomes Important Platform for Global South in Reshaping International Order: Interview with Egypt's Foreign Affairs Council Head Saad
articles.summary_zh: 新华社开罗8月4日电 埃及外交事务委员会主任萨阿德表示，上合组织为全球南方改革不公平国际秩序创造了有利条件，中国倡议推动上合发展。
articles.summary_en: In an interview with Xinhua in Cairo, Saad, head of Egypt's Foreign Affairs Council, said the SCO creates favorable conditions for the Global South to reform the unjust international order, and China's initiatives drive SCO development.

articles.title_zh: 绿色电力7毫秒就能从金沙江畔抵达长三角
articles.title_en: Green Power from Jinsha River Reaches Yangtze River Delta in 7 Milliseconds
articles.summary_zh: 白鹤滩水电站累计发电量突破2500亿度，清洁电能通过输电线路仅7毫秒即可从金沙江畔抵达长三角，每年可向华东输送超600亿度电。
articles.summary_en: Baihetan Hydropower Station's cumulative generation exceeds 250 billion kWh. Clean power travels from the Jinsha River to the Yangtze River Delta in just 7 milliseconds via UHV lines, delivering over 60 billion kWh annually.

articles.title_zh: 广电总局：7月清理13300余条“AI魔改”违规视频
articles.title_en: NRTA Cleans Up Over 13,300 AI-Altered Videos in July
articles.summary_zh: 国家广播电视总局8月4日通报，7月共清理“AI魔改”违规视频13300余条，处置违规账号30余个，持续推进专项治理。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, the National Radio and Television Administration reported that in July it cleaned up over 13,300 AI-altered videos and dealt with more than 30 accounts, continuing its special crackdown.

articles.title_zh: 地方餐饮协会加速清理“名厨”“名店”：线下门店须摘除销毁荣誉牌匾
articles.title_en: Local Catering Associations Accelerate Cleanup of "Famous Chefs" and "Famous Restaurants": Offline Stores Must Remove and Destroy Honor Plaques
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月4日，河南信阳等地餐饮行业协会响应中国烹饪协会公告，加速清理“大师”“名厨”等荣誉牌匾证书，要求线下门店摘除销毁，线上平台下架相关宣传。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, 2026, catering associations in Xinyang, Henan and elsewhere responded to China Cuisine Association notice, accelerated cleanup of "master" and "famous chef" honor plaques/certificates, requiring offline stores to remove and destroy them and online platforms to take down related promotions.

articles.title_zh: 中国烹饪协会回应“餐饮业一夜间再无大师”
articles.title_en: China Cuisine Association Responds to 'Overnight Loss of All Master Chefs'
articles.summary_zh: 中国烹饪协会宣布全面清理撤销此前颁发的“大师”“名师”及“美食地标城市”称号，回应称受新规限制，未来或不再开展同类评选。
articles.summary_en: The China Cuisine Association announced the revocation of all previously awarded 'Master Chef' and 'Food Landmark City' titles, citing new regulations that may end such evaluations.

articles.title_zh: 西藏一医院公开书记院长申明：坚决不插手干预工程建设
articles.title_en: Hospital in Tibet Publishes Statement by Party Secretary and President Pledging Non-Interference in Construction
articles.summary_zh: 山南市人民医院公开书记院长申明，祁连明、吴强承诺不插手干预工程建设、设备采购等经营性事项，自觉接受监督。
articles.summary_en: The People's Hospital of Shannan, Tibet, published a signed statement by Party Secretary Qi Lianming and President Wu Qiang, pledging not to interfere in construction, equipment procurement, or other business matters, and to accept supervision.

articles.title_zh: 多个省份将召开省级党代会
articles.title_en: Multiple Provinces to Convene Provincial Party Congresses
articles.summary_zh: 近日，山西、内蒙古、辽宁、江苏等省份省级党委召开全会，审议通过关于召开省级党代会的决议，相关党代会将于今年四季度或12月举行。
articles.summary_en: Recently, provincial Party committees in Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, Liaoning, and Jiangsu held plenary sessions and approved resolutions to convene provincial Party congresses, scheduled for Q4 this year or December.

articles.title_zh: 湖南中医药大学原党委书记蔡光先辞世，曾积极推动学校更名大学
articles.title_en: Former Party Secretary Cai Guangxian of Hunan University of Chinese Medicine Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 湖南中医药大学原党委书记蔡光先于8月3日在长沙逝世，享年76岁。他曾积极推动学校更名大学和建设新校区。
articles.summary_en: Cai Guangxian, former Party Secretary of Hunan University of Chinese Medicine, passed away in Changsha on August 3 at age 76. He had actively promoted the university's renaming and new campus development.

articles.title_zh: 清理“攀比内卷不愿休”的职场环境，天津发文推进带薪休假落地
articles.title_en: Tianjin Issues Document to Promote Paid Leave and Tackle 'Unwilling to Rest' Workplace Culture
articles.summary_zh: 天津市人社局等五部门近日发文落实带薪年休假制度，推进应休尽休、引导错峰休假，并倡导摒弃“爱岗敬业不能休”等错误认识，营造健康职场环境。
articles.summary_en: Tianjin's human resources bureau and four other departments recently issued a notice to implement paid annual leave, promoting full leave and staggered vacations, while discouraging misconceptions that equate overwork with dedication.

tags.name_en: Tianjin Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau

tags_en: Tianjin Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau

articles.title_zh: 四川自贡自流井区委书记万春霞病逝，长期在自贡工作
articles.title_en: Wan Chunxia, Party Secretary of Ziliujing District, Dies of Illness at 50
articles.summary_zh: 四川自贡自流井区委书记万春霞因病医治无效，于2026年8月4日逝世，享年50岁。她长期在自贡工作，曾任富顺县委副书记、自流井区区长等职。
articles.summary_en: Wan Chunxia, Party secretary of Ziliujing District, Zigong, Sichuan, passed away on August 4, 2026 at age 50. She had long served in Zigong, including posts in Fushun County and Ziliujing District.

articles.title_zh: 安徽省农科院皖南研究院成立
articles.title_en: Anhui Academy's Wannan Research Institute Founded in Huangshan
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，安徽省农科院皖南研究院在黄山市成立，聚焦六大特色农业产业，开展成果转化与推广应用。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Wannan Research Institute of Anhui Academy of Agricultural Sciences was established in Huangshan, focusing on six specialty agricultural industries to boost technology transfer and application.

articles.title_zh: @广大网友，来和新任重庆市代市长陈新武聊聊您的期盼
articles.title_en: Netizens Invited to Share Expectations with New Acting Mayor Chen Xinwu of Chongqing
articles.summary_zh: 重庆市通过人民网领导留言板邀请网友向新任代市长陈新武留言，表达对重庆发展和“十五五”建设的期望与建议。
articles.summary_en: Chongqing invites netizens to leave messages via People's Daily Online message board to share expectations and suggestions with new acting mayor Chen Xinwu for Chongqing's development and the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 重庆国企稳增长成效亮眼
articles.title_en: Chongqing State-Owned Enterprises Show Strong Growth
articles.summary_zh: 2026年1-6月，重庆市属重点国企营收、利润、增加值同比分别增长2.4%、9%、9.7%，完成投资958.1亿元，盘活资产285.2亿元。
articles.summary_en: From Jan to June 2026, Chongqing's key SOEs posted YoY gains of 2.4% in revenue, 9% in profit, and 9.7% in value-added, with investments reaching 95.81 billion yuan and assets revitalized totaling 28.52 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 陇南组建9个明察暗访组下沉一线开展防汛监督
articles.title_en: Longnan Forms 9 Inspection Teams for Flood Control Supervision
articles.summary_zh: 陇南市纪委监委组建9个防汛明察暗访组，分赴9个县区开展全覆盖监督检查，重点检查防汛责任落实、预警传递、隐患排险等。
articles.summary_en: Longnan's discipline inspection commission formed 9 inspection teams to supervise flood control across 9 counties, focusing on responsibility, alerts, and hazard checks.

tags.name_en: Longnan Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection

tags_en: Longnan Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection

articles.title_zh: 广西出台国土空间详细规划管理新规
articles.title_en: Guangxi Issues New Rules for Detailed Territorial Spatial Planning Management
articles.summary_zh: 日前，广西壮族自治区自然资源厅印发通知并修订编制导则、数据库标准，为全区国土空间详细规划编制、审批和实施提供全链条制度保障。
articles.summary_en: The Department of Natural Resources of Guangxi recently issued a notice and revised guidelines and database standards to provide institutional support for the preparation, approval, and implementation of detailed territorial spatial planning.

articles.title_zh: 五部门启动整治婚介机构乱象专项行动
articles.title_en: Five Ministries Launch Special Campaign to Rectify Marriage Agency Irregularities
articles.summary_zh: 民政部会同中央网信办、工信部、公安部、市场监管总局启动专项整治行动，聚焦婚介机构七类重点问题，为期8个月。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Civil Affairs and four other departments launched a special campaign to tackle malpractices in marriage agencies, focusing on seven key issues from July 2026 to February 2027.

articles.title_zh: 湖北：携手推动长江航运高质量发展
articles.title_en: Hubei: Jointly Promoting High-Quality Development of Yangtze River Shipping
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，湖北省委书记关志鸥赴交通运输部长江航务管理局走访调研，强调携手推动长江航运高质量发展，更好服务国家重大战略实施。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Guan Zhi'ou, Secretary of the Hubei Provincial Party Committee, visited the Yangtze River Administration of the Ministry of Transport, emphasizing joint efforts to promote high-quality development of Yangtze River shipping and serve national major strategies.

tags.name_zh: 交通运输部长江航务管理局
tags.name_en: Yangtze River Administration of the Ministry of Transport

tags_zh: 交通运输部长江航务管理局
tags_en: Yangtze River Administration of the Ministry of Transport

articles.title_zh: 创新驱动，培育发展新质生产力
articles.title_en: Innovation Drives Development of New Quality Productive Forces
articles.summary_zh: 河北省通过强化企业创新主体地位、完善协同攻关机制，推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合，积极培育新质生产力，多项成果获得国家科学技术奖。
articles.summary_en: Hebei Province is fostering new quality productive forces by strengthening enterprise innovation and collaborative R&D, with several achievements winning national science awards and strategic emerging industries growing rapidly.

articles.title_zh: 崖州湾（海南）深海集团成立
articles.title_en: Yazhou Bay (Hainan) Deep-sea Group Established
articles.summary_zh: 崖州湾（海南）深海集团有限公司在三亚崖州湾科技城高新区揭牌成立，将打造省级深海产业运营平台，服务海南自贸港建设。
articles.summary_en: Yazhou Bay (Hainan) Deep-sea Group Co., Ltd. was inaugurated in Sanya Yazhou Bay Science and Technology City, aiming to build a provincial deep-sea industry platform and serve Hainan Free Trade Port.

articles.title_zh: 人民网2026“行进中国”调研行走进海南
articles.title_en: People's Daily Online 2026 'Marching China' Research Trip Enters Hainan
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，人民网2026‘行进中国’调研行走进海南，首站探访海南农垦博物馆，展现海南自贸港建设新气象。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, the People's Daily Online 2026 'Marching China' research trip visited Hainan, first exploring the Hainan Agricultural Reclamation Museum to showcase new progress in the construction of the Hainan Free Trade Port.

articles.title_zh: 海南离境退税“新政”实施首月退税金额110万元 同比增长28.5%
articles.title_en: Hainan's New Departure Tax Refund Policy Yields 1.1M Yuan in First Month, Up 28.5% YoY
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月海南离境退税新政实施首月，海口海关办理境外旅客离境退税6770票，退税金额110万元，同比增长28.5%。
articles.summary_en: In July 2026, the first month of Hainan's new departure tax refund policy, Haikou Customs processed 6,770 tax refunds totaling 1.1 million yuan, up 28.5% year-on-year.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江两项寒区生态环境监测标准发布
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Releases Two Eco-Environment Monitoring Standards for Cold Regions
articles.summary_zh: 近日，黑龙江省发布两项寒区生态环境监测地方标准，填补我国寒区生态环境监测领域标准空白。
articles.summary_en: Heilongjiang recently released two local standards for eco-environment monitoring in cold regions, filling a gap in China's cold-region eco-environment monitoring standards.

tags.name_en: Department of Ecology and Environment of Heilongjiang Province

tags_en: Department of Ecology and Environment of Heilongjiang Province

articles.title_zh: 中国（南京）软件谷夏季招商活动集中签约60个产业项目
articles.title_en: China (Nanjing) Software Valley Summer Investment Activity Signs 60 Industrial Projects
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日，中国（南京）软件谷在南京市雨花台区举行夏季招商活动，现场签约60个产业项目，并启动人工智能生态跃升计划。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, China (Nanjing) Software Valley held a summer investment event in Yuhuatai District, Nanjing, signing 60 industrial projects and launching an AI ecosystem upgrade plan.

articles.title_zh: 第十四届“创业江苏”科技创业大赛行业赛启动
articles.title_en: 14th 'Entrepreneurship Jiangsu' Sci-tech Innovation Competition Industry Finals Kick Off
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，第十四届“创业江苏”科技创业大赛首场行业赛在南京紫金山科技城开赛，79个团队和企业晋级。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, the first industry final of the 14th 'Entrepreneurship Jiangsu' sci-tech innovation competition kicked off at Nanjing Purple Mountain Science and Technology City, with 79 teams and enterprises advancing.

tags.name_en: Jiangsu Provincial Department of Science and Technology

tags_en: Jiangsu Provincial Department of Science and Technology

articles.title_zh: 无锡推出17条举措构建为企服务新生态
articles.title_en: Wuxi Rolls Out 17 Measures to Build New Enterprise Service Ecosystem
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，无锡发布《无锡市企业综合服务体系建设方案》，提出17项具体任务，整合涉企服务资源，构建全链条、全周期、一站式、智慧化服务新生态。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Wuxi released the Plan for Building a Comprehensive Enterprise Service System, proposing 17 specific tasks to integrate enterprise-related services and create a full-chain, full-cycle, one-stop, smart service ecosystem.

articles.title_zh: “电影+”业态，激发消费新活力
articles.title_en: 'Film+' Formats Stimulate New Consumer Vitality
articles.summary_zh: 今年，国家电影局与商务部联合启动“电影+”消费综合试点工作，16个城市入选，推动“电影+旅游”“电影+美食”等业态激发消费活力。
articles.summary_en: This year, the China Film Administration and the Ministry of Commerce jointly launched a comprehensive pilot program for 'Film+' consumption in 16 cities, boosting new business forms such as 'Film+Tourism' and 'Film+Gourmet' to energize consumption.

articles.title_zh: 包钢主持召开自治区人民政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Bao Gang Chairs Standing Committee Meeting of Regional Government
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，内蒙古自治区政府主席包钢主持召开政府常务会议，传达学习全会精神，研究部署经济工作、安全生产整改及招商引资等。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Bao Gang, chairman of Inner Mongolia's regional government, chaired a standing committee meeting to convey the plenum spirit, and to arrange work on economic operation, safety production rectification, and investment promotion.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古西部计划志愿者出征
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Western Plan Volunteers Depart for Grassroots Service
articles.summary_zh: 2026年内蒙古大学生志愿服务西部计划志愿者于7月31日出征，900余名志愿者将奔赴全区各地基层岗位开展志愿服务。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, 2026, over 900 volunteers of the Inner Mongolia Western Plan departed for grassroots positions across the region to provide voluntary service.

articles.title_zh: 全国地质灾害防治“十五五”实施方案公布
articles.title_en: National Plan for Geological Disaster Prevention and Control during 15th Five-Year Plan Released
articles.summary_zh: 自然资源部8月4日公布《全国地质灾害防治“十五五”实施方案》，规划工程治理4200余处、排危除险6100余处，实施避险搬迁5万户。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Natural Resources released the 15th Five-Year Plan for geological disaster prevention on August 4, planning over 4,200 engineering treatments, 6,100 emergency risk eliminations, and relocation of 50,000 households.

articles.title_zh: 四川出台管理办法分类打造场景实验室
articles.title_en: Sichuan Issues Management Measures for Digital Scenario Laboratories
articles.summary_zh: 四川省印发数字化应用场景实验室管理办法，分类建设综合型和行业型场景实验室，计划3年左右建成3个左右综合型、10至20个行业型实验室，9月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: Sichuan issued management measures for digital application scenario laboratories, planning to build about 3 comprehensive and 10-20 industry-specific labs within 3 years, effective Sep 1.

articles.summary_en: Shanxi Province has issued an implementation opinion on systematic protection of cultural relics, aiming to eliminate major risks at key provincial and national protected sites by 2030 and establish a comprehensive protection framework by 2035, with support in law, planning, funding, talent, and publicity.

articles.summary_en: Tianjin Public Transport Group will complete the renewal of 450 new energy buses this year, covering more than 40 routes to improve passenger safety and comfort.

articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，中国共产党西藏自治区第十届委员会第十次全体会议在拉萨举行。自治区党委书记王君正讲话，会议审议通过关于召开自治区第十一次党代会的决议。

articles.summary_en: China's National Development and Reform Commission and National Energy Administration issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for new power system construction, aiming for non-fossil energy to account for 50% of power generation by 2030.

articles.summary_en: Founding conference of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Robot Industry Chain Alliance held in Beijing. Ma Jun and Yan Ying delivered speeches.

Wei Tao, Chairman of the autonomous region, attended and addressed the meeting.

articles.summary_en: On August 3, the 12th Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee was held in Nanjing, approving a resolution to convene the province's 15th Party Congress in Q4 2026 in Nanjing.

articles.summary_en: The article reviews China's industrial performance in H1 of the 15th Five-Year Plan period, highlighting new drivers contributing over 40%, with traditional upgrading, emerging industries, and future industries advancing together for high-quality development.

articles.summary_en: On August 2, the 18th E-commerce Training Camp for Taiwan Compatriot Youth opened in Yunxiao, Fujian, with over 40 Taiwanese youth attending to learn AI e-commerce skills and foster cross-strait exchanges.

articles.title_zh: 专访丨中国式现代化为发展中国家探索现代化道路提供借鉴——访塔吉克斯坦人民民主党第一副主席涅马特佐达
articles.title_en: Chinese Modernization Offers Reference for Developing Countries: Interview with Tajikistan's Deputy Chairman
articles.summary_zh: 塔吉克斯坦人民民主党第一副主席涅马特佐达8月2日在杜尚别接受新华社专访，表示中国式现代化为发展中国家独立探索符合自身国情的发展道路提供了借鉴。
articles.summary_en: Nematzoda, first deputy chairman of Tajikistan's ruling party, said in a Xinhua interview in Dushanbe that Chinese modernization offers a reference for developing countries to explore development paths suited to their national conditions.

articles.title_zh: 推进城市更新 打造“四好”空间
articles.title_en: Promoting Urban Renewal to Create 'Four Good' Spaces

articles.summary_en: Reports on China's urban renewal progress, covering quality housing, old community renovation, complete community construction, and good urban districts, emphasizing people-oriented and high-quality development.

articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference, the Ministry of Transport said the completion rate of the main skeleton of the national comprehensive transport network will rise to 95% by 2030, prioritizing four major corridor projects.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党始终植根人民、与时俱进

articles.summary_en: José Luis Centella, chairman of the Communist Party of Spain, praised the CPC in an interview with People's Daily for its constant adaptation and roots among the people, citing China's poverty alleviation and global initiatives.

articles.title_zh: 去年我国基本养老保险参保人数达107591万

articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Civil Affairs and the National Working Commission on Aging released the 2025 National Aging Program Report, showing basic pension insurance coverage reached 1,075.91 million people by end-2025, with 23.0% of the population aged 60 or above.

articles.summary_en: On March 6, 2026, Xi Jinping delivered a speech at a joint group meeting of the CPPCC session, emphasizing accelerating the building of a Healthy China and setting the strategic goal of achieving it by 2035.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党辽宁省第十三届委员会第十一次全体会议公报

articles.summary_en: On the occasion of the Army Day, Wang Xinwei, deputy secretary of the Liaoning Provincial Party Committee and governor, visited and greeted troops stationed in Liaoning, extending festival greetings and encouraging them to boost combat readiness.

articles.summary_en: China's H1 GDP grew 4.7% with steady improvement. Xi Jinping emphasized new quality productive forces and high-quality development. The CPC Central Committee Politburo meeting affirmed the positive trend.

articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council decree to promulgate the revised Regulations on the Protection of Integrated Circuit Layout Designs, effective from October 15, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 汪尚学主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Wang Shangxue Chairs Standing Committee Meeting of Municipal Party Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月2日上午，定西市委常委会召开会议，市委书记汪尚学主持，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，安排部署贯彻落实工作，并听取防汛救灾汇报。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 2, the Standing Committee of the Dingxi Municipal Party Committee met, chaired by Secretary Wang Shangxue, to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions, arrange implementation work, and hear reports on flood prevention and disaster relief.

articles.title_zh: 总书记的人民情怀
articles.title_en: General Secretary Xi's Affection for the People
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，习近平总书记主持中共中央政治局会议，强调巩固拓展正确政绩观学习教育成果。文章阐述以正确政绩观引领高质量发展，最终是为了造福人民。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, General Secretary Xi Jinping chaired a meeting of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau, stressing consolidation of the learning and education on the correct view of political achievements. The article elaborates on guiding high-quality development with a correct view of achievements, emphasizing that the ultimate goal is to benefit the people.

articles.title_zh: 总书记的人民情怀
articles.title_en: The General Secretary's Affection for the People
articles.summary_zh: 文章强调以正确政绩观引领高质量发展，习近平总书记指出高质量发展是领导干部政绩观的重要内容，并强调为民造福是最大政绩。
articles.summary_en: The article emphasizes guiding high-quality development with a correct view of political achievements. Xi Jinping stresses that high-quality development should be a key part of officials' achievement view and that benefiting the people is the greatest achievement.

articles.title_zh: 邓维元主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Deng Weiyuan Chairs Hegang Municipal Government Party Group (Expanded) Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，鹤岗市市长邓维元主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和重要指示精神，并部署人工智能、产业转型、民生保障等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Deng Weiyuan, mayor of Hegang, chaired an expanded municipal government party group meeting to convey Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and directives, and to deploy work on AI, industrial transformation, and people's livelihoods.

articles.title_zh: 涟水县举行高端电子基材项目开工和签约仪式
articles.title_en: Lianshui County Holds Groundbreaking and Signing Ceremony for High-End Electronic Base Material Projects
articles.summary_zh: 8月2日，涟水县举行高端电子基材项目开工和签约仪式，市领导史志军等出席，该项目聚焦高端电子纱、电子薄布、高速覆铜板等核心赛道。
articles.summary_en: On August 2, Lianshui County held a groundbreaking and signing ceremony for high-end electronic base material projects, attended by city leaders including Shi Zhijun, focusing on advanced electronic yarn, thin cloth, and high-speed CCL sectors.

articles.title_zh: “沿着总书记足迹学思想”沉浸式宣讲走进寿县
articles.title_en: Immersive Lecture on Learning Xi Thought Along General Secretary's Footsteps Enters Shouxian
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日下午，淮南市“沿着总书记足迹学思想”沉浸式宣讲在寿县文化艺术中心举行，由市委宣传部、市委讲师团主办，推动党的创新理论入脑入心。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 31, an immersive lecture on 'Learning Xi Thought Along the General Secretary's Footsteps' was held at Shouxian Cultural and Art Center. Organized by the Municipal Propaganda Department, it aims to make the Party's innovative theory more accessible.

articles.title_zh: 李亦博慰问驻焦部队官兵
articles.title_en: Li Yibo Visits and Greets Troops Stationed in Jiaozuo
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，焦作市委书记李亦博走访慰问驻焦部队官兵，致以节日祝贺，强调军地合力、同心发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Li Yibo, Secretary of the Jiaozuo Municipal Party Committee, visited and greeted officers and soldiers stationed in Jiaozuo, extending holiday congratulations and emphasizing military-civilian unity.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰带队调研纺织服装、五金机电产业
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Leads Research on Textile, Garment, Hardware and Electromechanical Industries
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日至2日，揭阳市市长曲晓杰带队调研企业，强调实施产业"焕新工程"，推动传统产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: From August 1 to 2, Qu Xiaojie, Mayor of Jieyang, led a research visit to enterprises, emphasizing the implementation of the industry "renewal project" to promote high-quality development of traditional industries.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议分析全市上半年经济形势 研究部署下半年经济工作
articles.title_en: Dawa Ciren Chairs Lhasa Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting on Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，拉萨市委书记达娃次仁主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习中央和自治区党委会议精神，分析上半年经济形势，部署下半年经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Dawa Ciren, Secretary of Lhasa Municipal Party Committee, chaired an enlarged Standing Committee meeting to convey central and regional guidelines, analyze H1 economic performance, and arrange H2 work.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁“八一”前夕看望慰问驻市部队官兵
articles.title_en: Dawa Tsering Visits and Consoles Troops in Lhasa Before Army Day
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日上午，自治区党委常委、拉萨市委书记达娃次仁看望慰问驻市部队官兵，代表市四大班子致以节日祝贺，感谢他们为拉萨稳定发展作出的贡献。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 31, Dawa Tsering, member of the Standing Committee of the Regional Party Committee and Secretary of the Lhasa Municipal Party Committee, visited and greeted military officers and soldiers stationed in Lhasa, expressing gratitude for their contributions to the city's stability and development.

articles.title_zh: 拉萨市完成全区首批工会驿站嵌入便民警务站试点
articles.title_en: Lhasa Completes First Batch of Trade Union Service Stations Embedded in Police Service Stations Pilot
articles.summary_zh: 拉萨市完成全区首批工会驿站嵌入便民警务站试点，为户外劳动者提供便民服务。
articles.summary_en: Lhasa completed the first batch of pilot union service stations embedded in police service stations in the region, providing convenience services for outdoor workers.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记关于上半年经济形势和做好下半年经济工作的重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting on Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强7月31日主持召开国务院常务会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，听取新型电网、物流网建设汇报，研究健康优先发展战略，审议通过多项行政法规草案，并核准四个核电项目。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting on July 31 to study Xi Jinping's important speech on the economic situation, hear reports on new power grid and logistics network construction, discuss health-first development strategy, approve regulatory amendments, and approve four nuclear power projects.

articles.title_zh: 林芝市人民政府与2026中国产业转移发展对接活动（西藏）参会代表赴林芝考察调研座谈
articles.title_en: Linzhi Municipal Government Holds Discussion with Delegates of 2026 China Industrial Transfer Matchmaking Event (Tibet)
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，林芝市举办2026中国产业转移发展对接活动（西藏）参会代表考察调研座谈，市委副书记、常务副市长林科聪出席会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Linzhi held a discussion with delegates of the 2026 China Industrial Transfer Matchmaking Event (Tibet). Deputy Mayor Lin Kecong attended and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 王君正：2026中国西藏第七届跨喜马拉雅国际公路自行车极限赛在拉萨开幕
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Attends Opening of 7th Trans-Himalaya International Road Cycling Race in Lhasa
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日上午，2026中国西藏第七届跨喜马拉雅国际公路自行车极限赛在拉萨布达拉宫广场开幕，西藏自治区党委书记王君正出席并宣布比赛开幕。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 1, the 7th Trans-Himalaya International Road Cycling Race opened at Potala Palace Square in Lhasa. Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the CPC Tibet Regional Committee, attended and declared the race open.

articles.title_zh: 国务院公布《关于出境入境管理的规定》
articles.title_en: State Council Issues Regulations on Exit-Entry Administration
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月29日国务院常务会议通过《关于出境入境管理的规定》，以国务院令第841号公布，自9月15日起施行，建立出境安全风险防范制度并规范中介服务。
articles.summary_en: The State Council approved the Regulations on Exit-Entry Administration on June 29, 2026, published as Order No. 841, effective September 15, establishing exit risk prevention measures and regulating agency services.

articles.title_zh: 全市学习运用“千万工程”经验加快发展乡村特色产业推进乡村全面振兴现场会召开
articles.title_en: Longyan Holds On-site Meeting on Rural Revitalization and Specialty Industries
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，龙岩市在武平县召开现场会，市委书记胡盛出席并讲话，强调加快发展乡村特色产业，推动乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Longyan City held an on-site meeting in Wuping County. Party Secretary Hu Sheng emphasized accelerating rural specialty industries and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 王凯在南阳驻马店检查防汛工作
articles.title_en: Wang Kai Inspects Flood Control Work in Nanyang and Zhumadian
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，河南省省长王凯到南阳市、驻马店市检查防汛工作，实地察看水库施工、水源涵养及应急物资储备，强调压实责任、确保安全度汛。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, Henan Governor Wang Kai inspected flood control work in Nanyang and Zhumadian, visiting reservoir construction, water source conservation, and emergency material storage, urging responsibility and safety.

articles.title_zh: 王君正主持召开自治区党委常委会会议研究部署下半年经济工作
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Chairs Meeting of Party Committee Standing Committee to Study and Deploy H2 Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正主持召开自治区党委常委会会议，分析上半年经济形势，部署下半年经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the CPC Tibet Autonomous Regional Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to analyze the first-half economic situation and arrange second-half work.

articles.title_zh: 王君正“八一”前夕看望慰问驻藏部队官兵
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Visits and Greets Troops Stationed in Tibet on Eve of Army Day
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正看望慰问驻藏部队官兵，代表自治区党委和政府向他们致以节日祝贺，感谢其为西藏长治久安和高质量发展所作贡献，并勉励官兵练就过硬本领。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Wang Junzheng, Party chief of Tibet, visited stationed troops and extended festival greetings to servicemen and veterans on behalf of the regional Party committee and government.

articles.title_zh: 王君正出席2026中国西藏第七届跨喜马拉雅国际公路自行车极限赛开幕式并宣布开幕
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Attends and Declares Opening of 7th Trans-Himalaya International Road Cycling Race in Lhasa
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日上午，2026中国西藏第七届跨喜马拉雅国际公路自行车极限赛在拉萨布达拉宫广场开幕，自治区党委书记王君正出席并宣布开幕。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 1 morning, the 7th Trans-Himalaya International Road Cycling Race opened at Potala Palace Square in Lhasa; Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the CPC Tibet Autonomous Region Committee, attended and declared the race open.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞张雨浦陈雍走访慰问驻宁解放军和武警部队官兵
articles.title_en: Li Yifei, Zhang Yupu, Chen Yong Visit PLA and Armed Police Troops in Ningxia
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月31日，宁夏回族自治区党委书记李邑飞、主席张雨浦、政协主席陈雍走访慰问驻宁解放军和武警部队官兵，致以节日祝贺。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, 2026, Ningxia Party Secretary Li Yifei, Chairman Zhang Yupu, and CPPCC Chairman Chen Yong visited PLA and Armed Police troops in Ningxia to extend holiday greetings.

articles.title_zh: 自治区政府召开常务会议
articles.title_en: Ningxia Regional Government Holds Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，自治区主席张雨浦主持召开自治区政府常务会议，研究防汛减灾、退役军人服务保障、人工智能、基础教育等事项。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Chairman Zhang Yupu of the autonomous region presided over a government executive meeting to discuss flood control, veteran services, AI, and basic education.

articles.title_zh: 自治区十三届人大常委会第二十六次会议闭幕 李邑飞主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Chairs Closing of 26th Session of Ningxia Regional People's Congress Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，自治区十三届人大常委会第二十六次会议在银川闭幕，自治区党委书记、人大常委会主任李邑飞主持并讲话，会议表决通过多项法规和决议。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the 26th session of the Ningxia Regional People's Congress Standing Committee closed in Yinchuan. Li Yifei, Party secretary and committee director, presided and spoke, with several regulations and resolutions passed.

articles.title_zh: 黄强到长春经开区调研时强调 扛牢高质量发展使命任务 勇当改革开放的排头兵
articles.title_en: Huang Qiang Surveys Changchun Economic Development Zone, Stresses High-Quality Development and Reform
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，吉林省委书记黄强到长春经开区调研，强调扛牢高质量发展使命任务，勇当改革开放排头兵，并考察跨境电商、光电企业及养老服务。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 3, Huang Qiang, Jilin Party chief, visited Changchun Economic Development Zone, stressing high-quality development and reform efforts, and inspected cross-border e-commerce, optoelectronic firms, and elderly care services.

articles.title_zh: 蒋锋专题调研物业服务工作并召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Mayor Jiang Feng Investigates Property Management Services and Holds Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，无锡市长蒋锋专题调研物业服务工作并召开座谈会，强调提升物业服务规范化、标准化、精细化水平，回应民生关切。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, Wuxi Mayor Jiang Feng conducted a special survey on property management services and held a symposium, stressing standardized and refined services to address public concerns.

articles.title_zh: 无锡市政协专题视察具身智能机器人产业
articles.title_en: Wuxi CPPCC Conducts Special Inspection on Embodied Intelligent Robot Industry
articles.summary_zh: 7月24日，无锡市政协开展具身智能机器人产业发展专题视察，政协委员建言献策，助推产业加速发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 24, the Wuxi CPPCC conducted a special inspection on the embodied intelligent robot industry, with members offering suggestions to accelerate industrial development.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰在市应急指挥中心调度防汛工作
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Directs Flood Control Work at Municipal Emergency Command Center
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，省委常委、市委书记蒿慧杰在市应急指挥中心调度防汛工作，强调保持高度警醒、加强监测预警、强化应急处置，确保人民群众生命财产安全和社会大局稳定。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, Hao Huijie, member of the Provincial Party Standing Committee and Party Secretary of Xi'an, directed flood control work at the Municipal Emergency Command Center, stressing vigilance and monitoring to ensure public safety and social stability.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，新乡市委书记魏建平主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，研究部署重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Wei Jianping, Secretary of Xinxiang Municipal Party Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and arrange key work.

articles.title_zh: 市统计局：应邀为商务部门开展贸易统计业务培训
articles.title_en: Xinyang Statistics Bureau Provides Trade Statistics Training for Commerce System
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日下午，信阳市统计局应市商务局邀请为全市商务系统开展贸易统计业务培训，讲解社消零指标、统计口径等，并强调协作与数据监测。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, 2026, the Xinyang Municipal Statistics Bureau, at the invitation of the Municipal Commerce Bureau, held a training session on trade statistics for the city's commerce system, covering retail sales indicators and statistical standards, emphasizing cooperation and data monitoring.

articles.title_zh: 杨勇调研在建水利项目建设推进工作
articles.title_en: Yang Yong Inspects Construction Progress of Water Conservancy Projects
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日下午，息县县委副书记杨勇、县政府一级调研员闫清勇深入部分乡镇调研在建水利项目，实地察看建设进度，强调要加快施工进度，让民生工程早日惠民。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Yang Yong, deputy secretary of Xi County Party Committee, and Yan Qingyong, first-class researcher of the county government, inspected ongoing water conservancy projects in several townships, emphasizing faster construction and early benefits for the people.

articles.title_zh: 省级爱心专家团队走进阳春
articles.title_en: Provincial Heart Expert Team Visits Yangchun
articles.summary_zh: 近日，南方医科大学珠江医院心血管外科专家团队在阳春市妇幼保健院开展“大爱救心”义诊，免费提供心脏彩超筛查。
articles.summary_en: A cardiac surgery team from Zhujiang Hospital of Southern Medical University held a free heart screening clinic at Yangchun Maternal and Child Health Hospital as part of the "Great Love Saves Hearts" program.

articles.title_en: Lu Yixian Conducts Research in Yangxi County
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，阳江市委书记卢一先到阳西县调研，强调以党建引领基层治理，规范农村集体“三资”管理，推动“百千万工程”走深走实。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, Lu Yixian, Secretary of the Yangjiang Municipal Party Committee, visited Yangxi County to emphasize party building-led grassroots governance and standardized management of rural collective assets, advancing the 'Hundred Million Project'.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会会议召开

articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Yangjiang Municipal Party Committee held a standing committee meeting, chaired by Secretary Lu Yixian, to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech and deploy sci-tech innovation work.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委常委会会议暨党委财经委员会会议召开 李邑飞主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Chairs Party Standing Committee and Financial and Economic Affairs Committee Meeting of Ningxia
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，宁夏回族自治区党委常委会会议暨党委财经委员会会议召开，自治区党委书记李邑飞主持并讲话，部署下半年经济工作和全面从严治党。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, the Party Standing Committee and Financial and Economic Affairs Committee of Ningxia held a joint meeting chaired by Li Yifei, Party Secretary, to address economic work and strict party governance.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉等市领导赴驻银部队开展“八一”走访慰问
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui and Other Municipal Leaders Visit Troops Stationed in Yinchuan for Army Day
articles.summary_zh: 八一建军节来临之际，银川市四套班子领导分别走访慰问驻银部队，向官兵致以节日问候，强调深化双拥共建、共谋军地发展。
articles.summary_en: On the eve of Army Day, Yinchuan's top leaders visited troops stationed in the city, extending holiday greetings and emphasizing deepened military-civilian unity and joint development.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉调研退役军人服务保障和新时代双拥工作
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Inspects Veterans Service and Double Support Work
articles.summary_zh: 近日，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉调研退役军人服务保障和双拥工作，强调巩固军政军民团结。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Zhao Xuhui, member of the Standing Committee of the Regional Party Committee and Secretary of the Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee, inspected veterans service and dual support work, emphasizing the consolidation of military-civilian unity.

articles.title_zh: 李红莉到营口海警局走访
articles.title_en: Li Hongli Visits Yingkou Coast Guard Bureau

articles.summary_en: On July 31, Li Hongli, chairwoman of the CPPCC Municipal Committee, visited the Yingkou Coast Guard Bureau to extend holiday greetings and thanks for safeguarding maritime security.

articles.title_zh: 史卫东走访慰问驻军某部官兵
articles.title_en: Shi Weidong Visits and Greets Officers and Soldiers of a Garrison Unit

articles.summary_en: On July 31, Shi Weidong, director of the Yingkou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, visited and greeted officers and soldiers of a garrison unit, presenting supplies and watching exercises.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开党组会议常务会议 研究经济运行和城市更新等工作
articles.title_en: Yuxi Municipal Government Holds Party Group and Executive Meetings on Economic Operation and Urban Renewal
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，玉溪市市长胡江辉主持召开市政府党组会议和常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和重要指示精神，研究经济运行、城市更新等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 1, Yuxi Mayor Hu Jianghui chaired municipal government party group and executive meetings to convey Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and study economic operation and urban renewal.

articles.title_zh: 市政府党组理论学习中心组举行集中学习 深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想以高质量党建引领高质量发展
articles.title_en: Yuxi Municipal Government Party Group Holds Study Session on Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，玉溪市政府党组理论学习中心组举行集中学习，深入学习习近平党建思想，市长胡江辉主持。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 1, the Party Group Theory Learning Center of Yuxi Municipal Government held a study session on Xi Jinping's thought on Party building, chaired by Mayor Hu Jianghui.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江在岳阳县调研
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Conducts Research in Yueyang County
articles.summary_zh: 8月2日，省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江在岳阳县调研，强调发展乡村特色产业，壮大村集体经济，激活乡村全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: On August 2, Xie Weijiang, Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Yueyang Municipal Party Secretary, visited Yueyang County to research rural specialty industries and village collective economy, emphasizing rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 市政协召开党组会议暨九届第五十四次主席（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Municipal CPPCC Holds Party Group Meeting and 54th Chairman (Expanded) Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，岳阳市政协主席汪涛主持召开党组会议暨主席会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神和防汛救灾重要指示，审议有关议题。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Yueyang CPPCC Chairman Wang Tao presided over a Party group meeting and the 54th chairman (expanded) meeting, conveying Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions on flood relief, and reviewing related topics.

articles.title_zh: 2026年全国“村BA”广东省赛在云浮云安开赛 卢荣春出席开幕式并致辞
articles.title_en: 2026 National 'Cun BA' Guangdong Provincial Tournament Opens in Yunfu Yun'an; Lu Rongchun Attends and Speaks at Opening Ceremony
articles.summary_zh: 8月2日晚，全国和美乡村篮球大赛（村BA）广东省赛在云浮市云安区开幕，市委书记卢荣春出席并致辞，揭幕战云浮云安队战胜深圳深汕队。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of August 2, the Guangdong provincial tournament of the 2026 National 'Village BA' basketball competition opened in Yun'an, Yunfu. Party Secretary Lu Rongchun attended and delivered a speech; in the opening match, Yunfu Yun'an defeated Shenzhen Shenshan.

articles.title_zh: 市委召开常委会会议 认真学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神 研究做好我市科技创新工作 卢荣春主持会议
articles.title_en: Municipal Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting to Study Sci-Tech Innovation Work
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日下午，云浮市委书记卢荣春主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署全市科技创新工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 31, Lu Rongchun, Secretary of the Yunfu Municipal Party Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to convey and study the spirit of Xi Jinping's important speech and deploy sci-tech innovation work.

articles.title_zh: 北上南下，珠海在寻找什么？
articles.title_en: Going North and South: What Is Zhuhai Seeking?
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日至29日，珠海市委书记陈勇率队赴京参加央企对接会，走访多家央企并签署合作协议，推动央地合作促发展。
articles.summary_en: From July 27 to 29, Zhuhai Party Secretary Chen Yong led a delegation to Beijing for a central enterprise matchmaking conference, visiting multiple central enterprises and signing cooperation agreements to promote central-local collaboration.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔主持召开省政府常务会议 研究矿山安全生产等工作
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Chairs Provincial Government Executive Meeting on Mine Safety and Other Issues
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，省委副书记、省长周乃翔主持召开省政府常务会议，研究矿山安全生产、高标准农田建设、发展再生资源循环利用产业等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Zhou Naixiang, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee and Governor, chaired a provincial government executive meeting to discuss mine safety, high-standard farmland construction, and the development of the recycling industry.

articles.title_zh: 我国海工装备新接订单金额大增近122%，占全球份额超八成
articles.title_en: China's New Orders for Marine Engineering Equipment Surge Nearly 122%, Capturing Over 80% Global Market
articles.summary_zh: 自然资源部8月3日发布数据，上半年我国海洋生产总值5.5万亿元，同比增长5.1%；海工装备新接订单金额同比大增121.9%，占全球份额超八成。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Natural Resources released data on Aug 3 showing China's marine economy grew steadily in H1, with gross marine product rising 5.1% to 5.5 trillion yuan. New orders for marine engineering equipment surged 121.9%, capturing over 80% of the global market.

articles.title_zh: 构成重大威胁！我国发现一批境外恶意网址和IP，涉美、德、荷等国
articles.title_en: Major Threat: China Discovers Batch of Malicious Overseas URLs and IPs Involving US, Germany, Netherlands, etc.
articles.summary_zh: 我国发现一批来自美国、德国、荷兰等国的境外恶意网址和IP，构成重大网络安全威胁。
articles.summary_en: China has discovered a batch of malicious overseas URLs and IP addresses from countries including the US, Germany, and the Netherlands, posing a major cybersecurity threat.

articles.title_zh: 中国烹饪协会清理各类称号 “中国烹饪大师”“之乡、之都”等全部作废
articles.title_en: China Cuisine Association Revokes Various Culinary Titles Including 'Chinese Master Chef' and 'Hometown of Food'
articles.summary_zh: 中国烹饪协会近日宣布清理各类烹饪称号，包括“中国烹饪大师”“美食之乡”“美食之都”等，所有相关称号全部作废。
articles.summary_en: The China Cuisine Association recently announced the cleanup of various culinary titles, revoking all such titles as 'Chinese Culinary Master', 'Hometown of Gastronomy', and 'Capital of Gastronomy'.

articles.title_zh: 修订后的《集成电路布图设计保护条例》公布
articles.title_en: Revised Regulations on Protection of Integrated Circuit Layout Designs Published
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强日前签署国务院令，公布修订后的《集成电路布图设计保护条例》，自2026年10月15日起施行，旨在鼓励集成电路技术创新。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council decree to publish the revised regulations on protection of integrated circuit layout designs, effective Oct 15, 2026, to encourage innovation.

articles.summary_en: Entrusted by Xi Jinping, Cai Qi visited summer vacation experts in Beidaihe on August 3, extending sincere greetings to talents on behalf of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council.

articles.title_zh: 中共河北省委十届十一次全会在石家庄举行
articles.title_en: 11th Plenary Session of 10th Hebei Provincial CPC Committee Held in Shijiazhuang
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，中共河北省委十届十一次全会在石家庄举行，省委书记罗文讲话，全会审议通过关于召开省第十一次党代会的决议，决定2026年11月召开。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 3, the 11th Plenary Session of the 10th Hebei Provincial Committee of the CPC was held in Shijiazhuang. Provincial Party Secretary Luo Wen spoke, and the session approved a resolution to convene the 11th Provincial Party Congress in November 2026.

articles.title_zh: 王正谱主持召开河北省政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Wang Zhengpu Chairs Hebei Provincial Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 河北省省长王正谱主持召开省政府常务会议，研究经济运行、人工智能发展、基础教育、防灾减灾救灾等工作。
articles.summary_en: Hebei Governor Wang Zhengpu chaired a provincial government executive meeting to discuss economic operation, AI development, basic education, and disaster prevention and relief.

articles.title_zh: 河南省修订实施代表法办法 为18万各级人大代表履职“撑腰鼓劲”
articles.title_en: Henan Revises Implementation Measures for Deputies Law to Support 180,000 People's Congress Deputies
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，河南省十四届人大常委会第二十五次会议审议通过修订后的代表法实施办法，为全省18万余名各级人大代表依法履职提供法治保障。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, the 25th session of the 14th Henan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee approved the revised implementation measures for the Deputies Law, providing legal guarantees for over 180,000 deputies at all levels.

articles.title_zh: 聚焦高风险高价值 上海基础研究跑出创新加速度
articles.title_en: Shanghai Accelerates Basic Research Innovation with High-Risk, High-Value Focus
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来，上海深入推进高风险高价值基础研究，在细胞合成、海洋实验室等领域取得突破，加速建设国际科技创新中心。
articles.summary_en: Since this year, Shanghai has advanced high-risk, high-value basic research, achieving breakthroughs in cell synthesis and marine laboratories, accelerating the building of an international science and technology innovation center.

articles.title_zh: 闯出融合新路 书写创新答卷——福建以创新驱动引领高质量发展
articles.title_en: Fujian Charts New Path of Innovation-Driven High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 福建以创新驱动引领高质量发展，在科技创新与产业创新深度融合上闯出新路，全省研发经费投入年均增长10.5%，国家高新技术企业数量年均增长24%，推动现代化产业体系建设。
articles.summary_en: Fujian is advancing innovation-driven high-quality development, forging new paths in integrating technological and industrial innovation, with R&D spending rising 10.5% annually and high-tech enterprises growing 24% yearly during the 14th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 福州开展内河水系客渡运专项安全检查
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Conducts Special Safety Inspection of Inland River Passenger Ferry Services

articles.summary_en: On July 28, enforcement officers from Fuzhou Water Transport Center conducted special safety inspections at ferry docks in Jin'an Lake Park and Guangming Harbor Park to ensure passenger safety on inland waterways.

articles.title_zh: 福州发布民办学校报读提示

articles.summary_zh: 8月2日，福州市教育局发布民办学校报读提示，提醒学生和家长通过正规渠道入学，勿信“特殊捷径”，并强调缴费要认准专户、按学期缴纳。
articles.summary_en: Fuzhou's education bureau on Aug 2 warned against 'shortcuts' in private school enrollment, urging official channels and semester-based payments.

articles.title_zh: 蓝鳍金枪鱼全产业链项目在榕签约
articles.title_en: Bluefin Tuna Full Industry Chain Project Signed in Fuzhou

articles.summary_en: Recently, a signing ceremony for a strategic cooperation agreement on the bluefin tuna full industry chain was held in Fuzhou, where four parties will jointly build a complete industry chain to promote independent and controllable development.

articles.title_zh: 福清“少林大道”改造启动 明年5月1日前全面通车

articles.summary_en: Dongzhang Town of Fuqing started the upgrade of the Shaolin Avenue (County Road X170), with 50 million yuan investment, expected to fully open to traffic by May 1, 2027.

articles.title_zh: 在党的旗帜下书写强军兴军新荣光

articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping stresses implementing Xi Jinping Thought on Strengthening the Military, upholding political loyalty, reform, technology, talent, and rule of law in military building, as the PLA strives for its centenary goal.

articles.summary_en: On August 1, Qiushi magazine published an important article by Xi Jinping titled 'Accelerating the Building of a Healthy China', emphasizing the Party's leadership and the need to advance health construction with key priorities.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 3, the Qingdao Municipal Party Committee held a standing committee meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions as well as the provincial party committee plenary session spirit. Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong presided and spoke.

articles.summary_en: On the occasion of the 99th anniversary of the PLA, the whole army implements Xi Jinping's thought on strengthening the military, advancing political and other reforms, while the Southern Theater Command conducts joint sea-air exercises near Huangyan Island.

articles.summary_en: Zhenjiang's transportation and housing departments have new party secretaries: Guo Jijun for the Transportation Bureau and Pan Jie for the Housing and Urban-Rural Development Bureau.

articles.summary_en: On July 30, the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau met to plan H2 economic work, emphasizing 'new, quality, and good development' and policies to accelerate industrial transformation.

articles.title_zh: 许勤梁惠玲会见李书福：进一步深化汽车研发生产等方面务实合作
articles.title_en: Xu Qin and Liang Huiling Meet Li Shufu: Deepening Pragmatic Cooperation in Auto R&D and Production
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，黑龙江省委书记许勤、省长梁惠玲在哈尔滨会见吉利控股集团董事长李书福一行，双方就深化汽车研发生产等领域合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 1, Xu Qin, Secretary of CPC Heilongjiang Provincial Committee, and Governor Liang Huiling met with Geely Holding Chairman Li Shufu in Harbin to discuss deeper cooperation in auto R&D, manufacturing and new energy vehicles.

articles.title_zh: 量子科技，未来不可限量
articles.title_en: Quantum Technology: A Boundless Future
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报报道我国量子科技产业化进展，合肥、广州等地在量子计算、通信、测量领域形成产业链，推动前沿技术突破，助力未来产业发展。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily reports on China's quantum technology industrialization, with Hefei and Guangzhou building industrial chains in quantum computing, communication, and sensing, driving frontier breakthroughs and future industries.

articles.title_zh: 殷勇调度部署强降雨防范应对工作
articles.title_en: Yin Yong Dispatches and Deploys Heavy Rain Prevention and Response Work
articles.summary_zh: 昨天，北京市长殷勇到市应急指挥中心召开全市防汛调度会议，部署强降雨防范应对工作，确保城市安全平稳运行和群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: Yesterday, Beijing Mayor Yin Yong held a citywide flood control coordination meeting at the Emergency Command Center to deploy measures against heavy rainfall, ensuring urban safety and public safety.

articles.title_zh: 福建率先开展森林“四库”联动试点区建设
articles.title_en: Fujian Pioneers Forest 'Four Reservoirs' Linkage Pilot Zone
articles.summary_zh: 福建在全国率先部署森林“四库”联动试点区建设，探索生态保护与经济发展协同路径，通过改革创新激活林业综合效益。
articles.summary_en: Fujian takes the lead in launching a pilot zone for linking forest's 'four reservoirs' (water, money, grain, carbon), exploring coordinated ecological and economic development through reform and innovation.

articles.title_zh: 广西推出“平陆贷”助力企业向海发展
articles.title_en: Guangxi Launches 'Pinglu Loan' to Boost Maritime Economy
articles.summary_zh: 广西多部门联合推出“平陆贷”产品，提供财政贴息和担保补贴，覆盖向海经济全产业链，助力企业向海发展，单户企业年度最高可获300万元贴息和120万元担保补贴。
articles.summary_en: Guangxi has jointly launched the 'Pinglu Loan' product with fiscal discount and guarantee subsidies to support the maritime economy. Each enterprise can receive up to 3 million yuan annual interest subsidy and 1.2 million yuan guarantee fee subsidy.

articles.title_zh: 两部门联合发布红色山洪灾害气象预警
articles.title_en: Two Departments Jointly Issue Red Warning for Mountain Flood Disasters
articles.summary_zh: 8月2日，水利部和中国气象局联合发布红色山洪灾害气象预警，国家防总、应急管理部持续会商，针对多省份启动应急响应。
articles.summary_en: On August 2, the Ministry of Water Resources and the China Meteorological Administration jointly issued a red warning for mountain flood disasters, while the State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters and the Ministry of Emergency Management held consultations and activated emergency responses for multiple provinces.

articles.title_zh: 推进城市更新 打造“四好”空间

articles.summary_en: A report on China's urban renewal progress, focusing on achievements in 'good housing, good neighborhoods, good communities, and good urban areas,' including affordable housing, old community renovation, and complete community development.

articles.title_zh: 《“十五五”公共机构节能降碳工作方案》印发
articles.title_en: "15th Five-Year Plan" Work Plan for Energy Conservation and Carbon Reduction in Public Institutions Issued

articles.summary_en: The Government Offices Administration and the National Development and Reform Commission recently issued the "15th Five-Year Plan" work plan for energy conservation and carbon reduction in public institutions, setting targets for continuous improvement of energy efficiency by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 河北推动算力资源转化成产业优势
articles.title_en: Hebei Transforms Computing Power Resources into Industrial Advantages

articles.summary_en: Hebei leverages computing hubs in Zhangjiakou and Langfang to develop intelligent computing and the token economy, turning computing resources into industrial advantages.

articles.title_zh: @广大网友 来和新任河北省委书记罗文聊聊您的期盼
articles.title_en: Netizens Invited to Share Hopes with New Hebei Party Secretary Luo Wen
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，河北省召开全省领导干部会议，宣布罗文任河北省委书记；罗文表示将坚持以人民为中心的发展思想，欢迎网友通过人民网领导留言板留言。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Hebei Province held a meeting of leading cadres, announcing Luo Wen as Secretary of the CPC Hebei Provincial Committee. Luo said he would adhere to a people-centered development philosophy and welcomed netizens to leave messages through the People's Daily Online leadership message board.

articles.title_zh: 2026海南省企业100强榜单发布 百强企业整体规模与质效“双提升”

articles.summary_en: The Hainan Enterprise Federation and Hainan Entrepreneurs Association released the 2026 Top 100 Enterprises list, with revenue and total assets up 5% and 14% year-on-year, showing improved scale and efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 解读江苏经济“半年报”：底盘稳、动能新、结构优

articles.summary_en: On August 3, Jiangxi Province released a recruitment announcement for postdoctoral talents, offering 1,605 positions across 240 stations, with funding support and incentives for those staying in Jiangxi.

articles.summary_zh: 财政部会同农业农村部、水利部下达21.54亿元资金，支持多省开展洪涝、地震等灾后救灾和农业生产恢复，助力秋粮丰收。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance, together with the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs and the Ministry of Water Resources, allocated 2.154 billion yuan for disaster relief and agricultural recovery across multiple provinces, aiming to secure autumn grain harvest.

articles.title_zh: 司法部、国家知识产权局负责人就《集成电路布图设计保护条例》修订答记者问
articles.title_en: Ministry of Justice and CNIPA Officials Answer Questions on Revision of Integrated Circuit Layout Design Protection Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，司法部、国家知识产权局负责人就《集成电路布图设计保护条例》修订答记者问，介绍条例修订背景、总体思路及完善程序、强化保护、促进运用等举措。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, officials from the Ministry of Justice and the CNIPA answered questions on the revision of the Integrated Circuit Layout Design Protection Regulations, covering background, overall approach, and improvements in application procedures, protection, and utilization.

articles.summary_en: The CAC recently cracked down on online group broadcast violations, handling over 1,840 accounts for vulgar content and induced tipping.

articles.title_en: Government Offices Administration Completes Asset Verification and Governance for Central Administrative Institutions
articles.summary_zh: 国管局近期完成中央行政事业单位房屋、土地、公务用车资产核查治理，摸清资产底数，推动解决历史遗留问题，为“十五五”时期盘活存量资产奠定基础。
articles.summary_en: GOSA completed asset verification for central administrative institutions' housing, land, and vehicles, clarifying data and resolving legacy issues to boost asset utilization in the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Natural Resources released H1 marine economy data on Aug 3, showing marine passenger traffic up 4.6% year on year, with marine tourism shifting to immersive and diversified experiences.

articles.summary_en: On August 3, the Cyberspace Administration of China deepened the 'Qinglang' special action, disposing of over 1,840 violating group live-streaming accounts in accordance with laws and regulations.

articles.title_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs: Coordinate Field Management and Disaster Prevention, Mitigation and Relief
articles.summary_zh: 农业农村部近日在山东德州召开全国秋粮生产现场推进会，部署农业防灾减灾救灾工作，确保秋粮丰收。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs recently held a national autumn grain production meeting in Dezhou, Shandong, to coordinate field management and disaster prevention efforts for a bumper harvest.

articles.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for New Power System, targeting initial completion by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 智慧病房加速落地 行业标准有待统一
articles.title_en: Smart Wards Accelerate Deployment but Industry Standards Still Need Unification
articles.summary_zh: 智慧病房应用场景持续拓展，预计到2029年20%新建及改造医院将配置AI智慧病房，但行业标准不统一、成本高、数据合规等问题制约规模化普及。
articles.summary_en: Smart wards are expanding rapidly with AI-enabled systems, but lack of unified standards, high costs, and data compliance concerns hinder large-scale adoption.

articles.title_zh: “妈祖”为全球应对气候变化贡献中国智慧
articles.title_en: Mazu AI Early Warning Program Contributes China's Wisdom to Global Climate Response
articles.summary_zh: 在2026世界人工智能大会上，习近平指出推动“妈祖”方案在30国落地。中国气象局发布该AI预警方案，已助力多国防灾减灾。
articles.summary_en: At the 2026 World AI Conference, Xi Jinping highlighted the Mazu program's rollout in 30 countries. China Meteorological Administration has deployed the AI early warning system, boosting disaster preparedness worldwide.

articles.title_zh: 中国社会科学院在北京举办科技考古与文化遗产保护国际学术研讨会
articles.title_en: CASS Hosts International Symposium on Archaeological Science and Cultural Heritage Protection in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日至8月1日，中国社会科学院在北京举办科技考古与文化遗产保护国际学术研讨会，300余位中外专家学者与会，围绕文明探源、遗产保护等议题交流。
articles.summary_en: CASS held an international symposium in Beijing on July 31-Aug 1 on sci-tech archaeology and heritage protection, drawing over 300 experts for exchanges on civilization origins and preservation.

articles.title_zh: 水利部：2025年全国用水总量5944.5亿立方米
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources: Total National Water Use in 2025 Reaches 594.45 Billion Cubic Meters
articles.summary_zh: 水利部发布2025年水资源数据，全国用水总量5944.5亿立方米，用水效率提升，节水成效显著。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Water Resources released 2025 water resources data, showing total national water use of 594.45 billion cubic meters, with improved water efficiency and notable water conservation results.

articles.title_zh: 中国海军舰艇编队抵达印度尼西亚进行友好访问
articles.title_en: Chinese Naval Fleet Arrives in Indonesia for Friendly Visit
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月2日上午，中国海军戚继光舰、昆仑山舰编队抵达印度尼西亚泗水丹戎佩拉港，开启为期4天的友好访问。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 2 local time, a Chinese naval fleet comprising the Qi Jiguang and Kunlunshan ships arrived at Tanjung Perak Port in Surabaya, Indonesia, for a four-day friendly visit.

articles.title_zh: 包钢板材厂爆炸事故调查报告公布：62人被追责问责
articles.title_en: Investigation Report on Baotou Steel Plate Plant Explosion Released: 62 People Held Accountable
articles.summary_zh: 8月2日，内蒙古自治区应急管理厅公布包钢板材厂重大容器爆炸事故调查报告，认定该事故为重大生产安全责任事故，对62名相关人员追责问责。
articles.summary_en: On August 2, the Inner Mongolia Emergency Management Department released the investigation report on the major container explosion at Baotou Steel Plate Plant, identifying it as a serious production safety liability accident and holding 62 people accountable.

articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Chairs CPC Central Committee Political Bureau Collective Study on Military Modernization
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，中共中央政治局就‘高质量推进国防和军队现代化’举行集体学习，习近平主持并强调强化政治引领、深化创新发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held a collective study on high-quality advancement of national defense and military modernization, chaired by Xi Jinping, who stressed political guidance and innovation.

articles.title_zh: 多重优势支撑中国经济“向新”“向优”
articles.title_en: Multiple Strengths Underpin China's Economy Moving Toward Innovation and Optimization
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，国家发展改革委召开上半年发展改革形势通报会，判断经济呈动能向新、结构向优态势，强调宏观政策发力，协同推进重大工程。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the National Development and Reform Commission held a briefing on H1 economic conditions, judging the economy as moving toward innovation and optimization, and emphasizing stronger macro policies and major projects.

articles.title_zh: 湖北宣恩县持续做好治水兴城文章
articles.title_en: Xuan'en County, Hubei Persists in Water Management and Urban Development
articles.summary_zh: 湖北宣恩县持续治水兴城，通过修建水库、治理污水、发展水上夜游，实现贡水河从水患扰民到水城同兴的转变，带动旅游产业蓬勃发展。
articles.summary_en: Xuan'en County in Hubei has persisted in water management, transforming the Gongshui River from a flood hazard to a scenic urban asset through reservoir construction, sewage treatment, and night tours, boosting local tourism revenue.

articles.title_zh: 《黄岩岛国家级自然保护区管理办法》印发
articles.title_en: Measures for Administration of Huangyan Island National Nature Reserve Issued
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，自然资源部、国家林业和草原局、中国海警局、海南省人民政府联合印发《黄岩岛国家级自然保护区管理办法》，就管理机制、管护措施、法律责任等作出规定。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 1, four Chinese agencies jointly issued management measures for the Huangyan Island National Nature Reserve, covering management, protection, and legal liability.

articles.title_zh: 国家防灾减灾救灾委员会办公室、应急管理部向吉林、黑龙江派出工作组并调拨中央救灾物资
articles.title_en: China Sends Work Groups and Allocates Relief Supplies to Jilin and Heilongjiang
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，国家防灾减灾救灾委员会办公室、应急管理部向吉林、黑龙江派出工作组并调拨1.1万件中央救灾物资；水利部和中国气象局联合发布红色山洪灾害气象预警。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 1, China's disaster relief authorities sent work groups to Jilin and Heilongjiang and allocated 11,000 central relief supplies. A red flash flood warning was issued.

articles.title_zh: 省心省事，早稻收储全托管
articles.title_en: Worry-Free Early Rice Harvesting and Storage with Full Outsourcing
articles.summary_zh: 浙江温州探索建设新型农事服务中心，为种粮大户提供早稻收割、烘干、除杂、储存等全程托管服务，提升收储效率，减少损耗。
articles.summary_en: Wenzhou, Zhejiang is piloting new agricultural service centers offering full outsourcing for early rice harvesting, drying, and storage, improving efficiency and reducing losses.

articles.title_zh: 上海稳步建设全球科创高地
articles.title_en: Shanghai Steadily Builds Global Sci-Tech Innovation Hub
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月2日，《人民日报》报道，上海深化基础研究先行区建设，加速成果转化，联动长三角协同创新，稳步建设全球科技创新高地。
articles.summary_en: On August 2, 2026, People's Daily reported that Shanghai is deepening its pilot zone for basic research, accelerating technology transfer, and collaborating with the Yangtze River Delta to steadily build a global sci-tech innovation hub.

articles.title_zh: 在党的旗帜下书写强军兴军新荣光
articles.title_en: Writing New Glory of Strengthening the Military Under the Party's Flag
articles.summary_zh: 在建军99周年之际，习近平强调贯彻新时代强军思想，全军推进政治建军、改革强军等；8月1日南部战区在黄岩岛举行海空联合演训。
articles.summary_en: On the occasion of the 99th anniversary of the PLA, President Xi Jinping stressed implementing the Party's thinking on strengthening the military. On Aug 1, the Southern Theater Command conducted joint air-sea exercises near Huangyan Island.

articles.title_zh: 央行下半年将在提高金融服务实体经济质效等方面发力
articles.title_en: Central Bank to Focus on Improving Financial Services for Real Economy in H2
articles.summary_zh: 中国人民银行8月1日召开下半年工作会议，部署实施适度宽松的货币政策，提高金融服务实体经济质效，防范化解金融风险。
articles.summary_en: The People's Bank of China held its H2 work meeting on Aug 1, vowing to implement a moderately loose monetary policy, improve financial services for the real economy, and prevent financial risks.

articles.title_zh: 我国美丽乡村建设实现良好开局
articles.title_en: China Achieves Good Start in Beautiful Village Construction
articles.summary_zh: 自2025年1月《美丽乡村建设实施方案》发布以来，全国完成2.4万余个行政村环境整治，农村生活污水治理率提升至55%，近970万群众直接受益。
articles.summary_en: Since the Beautiful Village Construction Action Plan took effect in January 2025, over 24,000 villages have been renovated, rural sewage treatment rate reached 55%, benefiting nearly 9.7 million people.

articles.title_zh: 我国轻工业经济运行稳中有进
articles.title_en: China's Light Industry Posts Steady Growth in H1
articles.summary_zh: 中国轻工业联合会数据显示，上半年我国轻工业生产平稳，消费市场扩容，出口较快增长，结构持续优化。
articles.summary_en: According to China National Light Industry Council, H1 saw steady production, expanding consumption and faster export growth in the light industry, with optimized structure.

articles.title_zh: 总书记的人民情怀
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Calls for Correct View of Political Achievements to Drive High-quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记近期在中共中央政治局会议和集体学习中强调，要树立和践行正确政绩观，以正确政绩观引领高质量发展，并考察山东德州强调为民造福是最大政绩。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping stressed a correct view of political achievements to lead high-quality development at CPC Central Committee meetings and a study session, and urged people-centered governance during a Shandong visit.

articles.title_zh: 全省安全生产“打非治违”工作部署会议暨省安委会三季度工作会议召开 王新伟出席并讲话

articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，辽宁省召开全省安全生产“打非治违”工作部署会议暨省安委会三季度工作会议，省长王新伟出席并讲话，部署重点行业领域打非治违工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Liaoning Province held a work deployment meeting on safety production and the Q3 meeting of the Provincial Safety Committee. Governor Wang Xinwei attended and spoke, deploying crackdowns on illegal activities in key industries.

articles.title_zh: 朔州市委召开议军会议研究部署党管武装工作
articles.title_en: Shuozhou Municipal Party Committee Holds Military Affairs Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，朔州市委召开议军会议，传达学习习近平总书记关于国防和军队建设的重要讲话重要指示精神，研究部署党管武装工作。市委书记王帅红主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Shuozhou Municipal Party Committee held a military affairs meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech on national defense and military building, and to deploy party-led armed forces work. Wang Shuaihong, municipal party chief, presided and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬率团慰问泰州舰官兵

articles.summary_en: On July 31, 2026, Jiang Dongdong, Party Secretary of Taizhou, led a delegation to a naval port in Zhoushan, Zhejiang, to greet officers and soldiers of the naval vessel Taizhou ahead of Army Day.

articles.title_zh: 第五期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”举行
articles.title_en: The Fifth 'Frontier Lecture Hall' for Leading Cadres Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，泰州市举行第五期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”，邀请华东理工大学副校长阎海峰作“生物医药产业发展前沿态势”专题授课，市领导李晖、张余松等参加学习。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 1, Taizhou held the fifth 'Frontier Lecture Hall' for cadres. Yan Haifeng, a university professor, lectured on biomedical industry trends. Leaders Li Hui and Zhang Yusong attended.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬率团慰问泰州舰官兵
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Leads Delegation to Visit Crew of Taizhou Ship
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，市委书记姜冬冬率团赴浙江舟山慰问海军泰州舰官兵，致以节日问候，表示将深化双拥共建。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Municipal Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong led a delegation to Zhoushan, Zhejiang to greet the crew of naval ship Taizhou, expressing holiday greetings and commitment to strengthen military-civilian unity.

articles.title_zh: 蒋锋调研集成电路产业重点企业
articles.title_en: Mayor Jiang Feng Inspects Key Integrated Circuit Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，无锡市长蒋锋调研集成电路重点企业，强调巩固“芯”优势，抢拓新赛道，做优做强地标产业。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, Wuxi Mayor Jiang Feng visited key integrated circuit companies, urging consolidation of chip advantages and strengthening the benchmark industry.

articles.title_zh: 苏信合作工作座谈会在苏州召开
articles.title_en: Suzhou-Xinyang Cooperation Symposium Held in Suzhou
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，苏信对口合作座谈会在苏州举行，苏州市市长王维、信阳市市长卢希望出席并讲话，总结工作进展，谋划合作事宜，推动两地对口合作走深走实。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Suzhou-Xinyang counterpart cooperation symposium was held in Suzhou. Mayors Wang Wei and Lu Xiwang attended and spoke, summarizing progress and planning further cooperation.

tags.name_en: Revitalization of Old Revolutionary Base Areas

tags_en: Revitalization of Old Revolutionary Base Areas

articles.title_zh: 严汉平调研市区文博场馆
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Inspects Cultural and Museum Venues in Yancheng
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日上午，盐城市委书记严汉平到市区文博场馆调研，强调要深耕文脉资源、提升功能品质，打造文化传承交流展示“会客厅”。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 1, Yan Hanping, Secretary of the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee, visited cultural and museum venues in the city, emphasizing the need to deeply cultivate cultural resources and enhance functional quality to build a 'reception hall' for cultural inheritance, exchange, and display.

articles.title_zh: 吴炜调研促消费工作
articles.title_en: Wu Wei Inspects Consumption Promotion Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日上午，盐城市代市长吴炜在市区调研促消费工作，强调放大“苏超”效应，激发消费活力。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 1, Wu Wei, acting mayor of Yancheng, inspected consumption promotion work in the urban area, emphasizing leveraging the "Suchao" effect to boost consumption vitality.

articles.title_zh: 卢荣春走访慰问驻云部队官兵
articles.title_en: Lu Rongchun Visits and Greets Troops Stationed in Yunfu
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日上午，云浮市委书记卢荣春率队到驻云部队走访慰问，向官兵致以节日祝贺，市政协主席梁丽娴参加。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 30, Lu Rongchun, Secretary of the Yunfu Municipal Party Committee, led a team to visit troops stationed in Yunfu and extended festive greetings, with CPPCC Chairman Liang Lixian also attending.

articles.title_zh: 云浮市装配式建筑产业对接交流会在北京举行 卢荣春出席并致辞
articles.title_en: Yunfu Prefabricated Building Industry Exchange Conference Held in Beijing; Lu Rongchun Attends and Delivers Speech
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日下午，云浮市装配式建筑产业对接交流会在北京举行，市委书记卢荣春出席并致辞，现场签约6个项目。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 28, the Yunfu Prefabricated Building Industry Exchange Conference was held in Beijing, attended by Yunfu Party Secretary Lu Rongchun, with six projects signed on site.

articles.title_zh: 李庆新到郁南县督导检查防汛备汛工作
articles.title_en: Li Qingxin Inspects Flood Prevention in Yunan County
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，云浮市市长李庆新到郁南县督导检查防汛备汛工作，强调抓实抓细各项防御措施，确保安全度汛。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Yunfu Mayor Li Qingxin visited Yunan County to inspect flood prevention work, urging detailed defensive measures to ensure safety during the flood season.

articles.title_zh: 卢荣春率队赴京开展拜访交流和招商推介活动
articles.title_en: Lu Rongchun Leads Delegation to Beijing for Exchange and Investment Promotion
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月27-28日，云浮市委书记卢荣春率队赴北京，拜访中国中医科学院、RCEP产业合作委员会、中国节能环保集团等单位，围绕开放合作、绿色发展等座谈交流，推进项目对接。
articles.summary_en: On July 27-28, 2026, Lu Rongchun, Party Secretary of Yunfu, led a delegation to Beijing to visit the China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences, RCEP Industrial Cooperation Committee, and China Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Group for exchanges on opening-up and green development.

articles.title_zh: 李庆新走访慰问武警云浮支队官兵
articles.title_en: Li Qingxin Visits Officers and Soldiers of Yunfu Armed Police Detachment
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，云浮市委副书记、市长李庆新率队走访慰问武警云浮支队官兵，代表市委、市政府致以节日祝贺，并表示将继续支持部队建设。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Li Qingxin, Deputy Secretary of the Yunfu Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, visited officers and soldiers of the Yunfu Armed Police Detachment, conveying festival greetings and pledging continued support for military development.

articles.title_zh: 习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想与广东实践·绿美广东生态建设研讨会在云浮举行
articles.title_en: Seminar on Xi Jinping Thought and Green Guangdong Ecological Construction Held in Yunfu
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，由广东省习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想研究中心主办的绿美广东生态建设研讨会在云浮举行，市委书记卢荣春出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Seminar on Green and Beautiful Guangdong Ecological Construction hosted by the Guangdong Research Center for Xi Jinping Thought was held in Yunfu, where Party Secretary Lu Rongchun attended and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 重庆部署扫黑除恶：重点打击利用网络平台和“软暴力”手段有组织实施的黑恶犯罪
articles.title_en: Chongqing Deploys Crackdown on Organized Crime, Targeting Online Platforms and 'Soft Violence'
articles.summary_zh: 重庆近日召开深化扫黑除恶专项斗争部署会议，明确重点打击利用网络平台和‘软暴力’手段有组织实施的黑恶犯罪，并部署为期一年的专项斗争。
articles.summary_en: Chongqing recently held a meeting to deepen the special campaign against organized crime, focusing on cracking down on network-based and 'soft violence' organized criminal activities, and deploying a one-year campaign.

articles.title_zh: 王某破坏军婚：与现役军人配偶同居致其怀孕堕胎，被判2年
articles.title_en: Wang Sentenced to 2 Years for Destroying Military Marriage by Cohabiting with Active-Duty Soldier's Spouse
articles.summary_zh: 男子王某与现役军人配偶同居致其怀孕堕胎，构成破坏军婚罪，被判处有期徒刑2年。
articles.summary_en: A man named Wang was sentenced to 2 years in prison for living with the spouse of an active-duty soldier, causing pregnancy and abortion, in violation of military marriage protection.

articles.title_zh: 中国驻巴使馆证实一名中国公民在巴基斯坦遭遇雪崩失联
articles.title_en: Chinese Embassy in Pakistan Confirms Chinese Citizen Missing After Avalanche
articles.summary_zh: 中国驻巴基斯坦大使馆8月1日证实，一名中国公民7月30日在布洛阿特峰附近遭遇雪崩后失联，使馆已启动领事保护应急机制，敦促巴方全力搜救。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, the Chinese Embassy in Pakistan confirmed that a Chinese citizen went missing after an avalanche near Broad Peak on July 30. The embassy has activated consular protection emergency mechanism and urged Pakistani authorities to search.

articles.title_zh: 浙江省委原副书记吴敏达逝世，参与研制摄影机记录了首枚氢弹试爆
articles.title_en: Wu Minda, Former Deputy Secretary of Zhejiang Provincial Committee, Passes Away; He Helped Develop Camera That Recorded First Hydrogen Bomb Test
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省委原副书记吴敏达因病于2026年8月1日在杭州逝世，享年98岁。他曾参与研制高速摄影机，记录我国首枚氢弹试爆。
articles.summary_en: Wu Minda, former deputy secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Committee, died of illness in Hangzhou on August 1, 2026, at age 98. He helped develop a high-speed camera that recorded China's first hydrogen bomb test.

articles.title_zh: 安徽亳州城管局通报一公职人员涉嫌婚内出轨：已成立调查组
articles.title_en: Anhui Bozhou Urban Management Bureau Reports Public Official Suspected of Extramarital Affairs
articles.summary_zh: 安徽亳州城管局通报一名公职人员涉嫌婚内出轨，并称已成立调查组。
articles.summary_en: Anhui Bozhou Urban Management Bureau reported a public official suspected of extramarital affairs and said it has set up an investigation team.

articles.title_zh: 不开空调室温25℃，江苏徐州一地试点集中供冷
articles.title_en: Central Cooling Pilot in Xuzhou, Jiangsu Keeps Rooms at 25°C Without Air Conditioning
articles.summary_zh: 江苏徐州试点集中供冷，利用废弃矿井水为居民降温，室温保持25℃左右，能耗降低50%。
articles.summary_en: Xuzhou, Jiangsu pilots central cooling using abandoned mine water, keeping rooms around 25°C without AC, cutting energy use by 50%.

articles.title_zh: 创新引领 未来之城生机勃勃
articles.title_en: Innovation Leads a Flourishing City of the Future
articles.summary_zh: 3月23日，习近平总书记考察雄安新区并发表重要讲话，强调以改革创新为引领。雄安新区九年多建设取得重大成果，正打造新时代创新高地和高质量发展样板。
articles.summary_en: On March 23, General Secretary Xi Jinping visited Xiong'an New Area and delivered an important speech emphasizing innovation and reform. After nine years of development, Xiong'an has achieved major progress and is becoming a model of high-quality development and a new innovation hub.

articles.title_zh: 换道领跑的河南动力：培育壮大“新字号”
articles.title_en: Henan's Momentum for Lane-Changing Leapfrogging: Fostering the 'New Brand' Industrial Clusters
articles.summary_zh: 今年7月，2026河南省人工智能大会在郑州举行，全省人工智能产业规模突破千亿元；新能源汽车产量大幅增长，河南正加快打造5000亿级智能终端产业集群，建设全国领先的新能源汽车产业基地。
articles.summary_en: In July, the 2026 Henan Artificial Intelligence Conference was held in Zhengzhou, with the province's AI industry scale exceeding 100 billion yuan. NEV output has surged, and Henan is building a 500-billion-yuan intelligent terminal cluster and a leading NEV industry base.

articles.title_zh: 福建省发布“十五五”新型冶金产业集群行动方案
articles.title_en: Fujian Releases Action Plan for 15th Five-Year New Metallurgical Industry Cluster
articles.summary_zh: 近日，福建省出台“十五五”新型冶金产业集群高质量发展行动方案，明确到2030年集群规模力争达8800亿元，推动产业向高端化、智能化、绿色化转型。
articles.summary_en: Fujian recently issued its 15th Five-Year action plan for high-quality development of new metallurgical industry clusters, targeting 880 billion yuan by 2030 and advancing high-end, intelligent, and green transformation.

articles.title_zh: “十四五”福建海洋科技创新交出亮眼答卷
articles.title_en: Fujian's Marine Sci-Tech Innovation Delivers Impressive Results in 14th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: “十四五”期间，福建建成120个海洋科创平台，在海上风电、海水制氢、水产种业等领域取得标志性成果，为海洋经济高质量发展提供支撑。
articles.summary_en: During the 14th Five-Year Plan period, Fujian built 120 marine sci-tech innovation platforms, achieving landmark results in offshore wind power, seawater hydrogen production, and aquatic seed industry, supporting high-quality marine economy growth.
