tags_en: Prospering the Sea with Science and Technology

articles.title_zh: 金砖出海快线在厦启动
articles.title_en: BRICS Going-Global Express Lane Launches in Xiamen
articles.summary_zh: 当日，金砖出海快线首场活动在厦门举办，尼日利亚专场对接吸引近200人参加。
articles.summary_en: The first event of the BRICS Going-Global Express Lane, a Nigeria-themed matchmaking session, was held in Xiamen with nearly 200 participants.

articles.title_zh: 学习·故事丨古厝焕新生
articles.title_en: Learning Story: Ancient Houses Get New Life
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记强调政绩观关乎立党为公、执政为民，回顾其在福州任上叫停林觉民故居拆迁、保护三坊七巷历史街区的往事。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping emphasizes that the view on political achievements concerns serving the people, recalling his past actions in Fuzhou to stop the demolition of Lin Juemin's former residence and protect the Three Lanes and Seven Alleys historic district.

articles.title_zh: 新一代信息技术及人工智能领域企业家青岛行活动举行，任刚出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Qingdao Hosts Event for Entrepreneurs in New-Generation IT and AI; Mayor Ren Gang Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日下午，新一代信息技术及人工智能领域企业家青岛行活动在青岛举行，市委副书记、市长任刚出席并讲话，介绍产业发展并欢迎企业家投资。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 1, Qingdao held an event for entrepreneurs in new-generation IT and AI. Mayor Ren Gang attended and delivered a speech, inviting investment and outlining the city's industrial development plans.

articles.title_zh: 学习·故事丨古厝焕新生
articles.title_en: Learning Story: Ancient Houses Reborn
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记强调政绩观为民之本，回顾其上世纪90年代在福州叫停拆迁、保护林觉民故居及三坊七巷的往事。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping stresses that the fundamental of political achievement is serving the people, recalling his protection of Lin Juemin's former residence and the Three Lanes and Seven Alleys in Fuzhou in the early 1990s.

articles.title_zh: 学习新语丨坚定不移走中国特色强军之路
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Emphasizes Unswervingly Following the Path of Building a Strong Military with Chinese Characteristics
articles.summary_zh: 今天是八一建军节，文章回顾习近平总书记领航强军事业取得历史性成就，强调坚定不移走中国特色强军之路、如期实现建军一百年奋斗目标。
articles.summary_en: On Army Day, the article reviews Xi Jinping's leadership in achieving historic accomplishments in military development and his emphasis on firmly following the path of building a strong military with Chinese characteristics and achieving the centenary goal of the PLA.

articles.title_zh: 投资于“物”与“人”协同发力，投资逻辑再观察
articles.title_en: Synergy of Investment in 'Things' and 'People': A Fresh Look at Investment Logic
articles.summary_zh: 2026年上半年江苏投资呈现“见物更见人”趋势，硬投资与软投入协同发力，推动产业升级和民生改善。
articles.summary_en: In H1 2026, Jiangsu's investment shows a trend of seeing both infrastructure and people, with hard and soft investments jointly driving industrial upgrading and livelihood improvement.

articles.title_zh: 62人被追责问责，包钢板材厂爆炸事故调查报告公布
articles.title_en: 62 People Held Accountable After Baogang Steel Plate Factory Explosion
articles.summary_zh: 8月2日，内蒙古应急管理厅公布包钢板材厂重大容器爆炸事故调查报告。事故发生于1月18日，造成10死84伤，认定系重大生产安全责任事故，对62人追责问责。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 2, Inner Mongolia Emergency Management Dept released the investigation report on a major vessel explosion at Baogang Steel Plate Factory. The Jan 18 accident killed 10 and injured 84; it was deemed a serious liability accident, with 62 people held accountable.

articles.title_zh: 河南2026年“三支一扶”计划发现有考试作弊行为
articles.title_en: Henan Uncovers Cheating in 2026 'Three Supports and One Assistance' Program
articles.summary_zh: 8月2日，河南“三支一扶”领导小组通报，2026年招募发现考试作弊行为，已停职调查省人事考试中心负责人，公安机关成立专案组侦查。
articles.summary_en: On August 2, Henan's 'Three Supports and One Assistance' leading group reported cheating in the 2026 recruitment exam. The official in charge of the provincial personnel examination center has been suspended, and police have set up a special investigation team.

articles.title_zh: 社会团体分支机构规范称谓：“会长”“秘书长”等纷纷改名
articles.title_en: Social Organizations Standardize Titles for Branch Leaders: 'Presidents' and 'Secretary-Generals' Renamed
articles.summary_zh: 民政部公布《社会团体分支机构、代表机构管理办法》，自2026年8月1日起施行，要求分支机构负责人改称主任委员等，各协会纷纷调整称谓。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Civil Affairs issued measures effective Aug 1, 2026, renaming branch leaders as chairpersons and vice chairpersons, prompting associations to adjust titles.

articles.title_zh: 澎湃新闻发布AI底座战略，打造智媒时代“信任引擎”
articles.title_en: The Paper Unveils AI Foundation Strategy, Building a 'Trust Engine' for Intelligent Media
articles.summary_zh: 澎湃新闻在12周年之际发布AI底座战略，推出星座、星途、星映三大AI创作工作台，并聘请首批顾问，打造智媒时代‘信任引擎’。
articles.summary_en: On its 12th anniversary, The Paper launched an AI foundation strategy, introducing three AI creation workbenches and appointing first advisory board members to build a 'trust engine' for intelligent media.

articles.title_zh: 殷勇：持续完善产业支持政策 提升医药健康产业发展能级
articles.title_en: Yin Yong: Improve Industrial Support Policies to Boost Pharmaceutical and Health Industry
articles.summary_zh: 日前，北京市委副书记、市长殷勇到北京经济技术开发区调研医药健康产业发展，强调持续完善产业支持政策，提升产业发展能级，打造具有全球竞争力的医药健康产业高地。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Yin Yong, deputy secretary of the Beijing municipal Party committee and mayor, visited the Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area to inspect the pharmaceutical and health industry, emphasizing continuous improvement of industrial support policies to enhance the industry's development level.

articles.title_zh: 福建省自然资源厅全方位推动自然资源营商环境优化升级
articles.title_en: Fujian Provincial Department of Natural Resources Comprehensively Promotes Optimization of Natural Resources Business Environment
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来，福建省自然资源厅通过强化要素保障、推进试点改革、优化审批服务、深化数据赋能，全方位推动自然资源领域营商环境优化升级。
articles.summary_en: Since the beginning of this year, Fujian Provincial Department of Natural Resources has optimized the business environment by strengthening factor guarantees, advancing pilot reforms, improving approval services, and deepening data-driven reforms.

tags.name_en: Fujian Provincial Department of Natural Resources

tags_en: Fujian Provincial Department of Natural Resources

articles.title_zh: 贡水河畔话三变
articles.title_en: Three Transformations by the Gongshui River
articles.summary_zh: 湖北宣恩县持续治水兴城，通过防洪、治污和开发水上旅游，让贡水河实现三次转变，推动生态与经济发展双赢。
articles.summary_en: Xuan'en County, Hubei, has been managing the Gongshui River through flood control, pollution treatment, and water tourism, achieving three transformations and promoting both ecology and economy.

articles.title_zh: 华中农大师生调研土地要素如何撬动乡村
articles.title_en: Huazhong Agricultural University Teachers and Students Survey How Land Factors Revitalize Rural Areas
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日至29日，华中农业大学师生赴湖北枣阳熊集镇、王城镇调研土地要素激活乡村发展动能，实地走访农业公司、村湾及菌菇基地等。
articles.summary_en: From July 27 to 29, teachers and students from Huazhong Agricultural University visited Xiongji and Wangcheng towns in Zaoyang, Hubei, to investigate how land factors drive rural development, including high-standard farmland, water-fertilizer integration, and farmland consolidation.

articles.summary_en: At a July 31 press conference, Hainan outlined a multi-dimensional service system covering resettlement, training, employment, entrepreneurship, and social security to help veterans integrate into the Free Trade Port.

articles.title_zh: 水利部针对黑龙江省启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Activates Level IV Flood Response for Heilongjiang
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，水利部针对黑龙江省启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，应对松花江、嫩江支流可能发生的编号洪水。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, the Ministry of Water Resources activated a Level IV flood response for Heilongjiang Province to address potential numbered floods in tributaries of the Songhua and Nen rivers.

articles.title_zh: 领航丨矢志强军向复兴
articles.title_en: Charting the Course: Forging a Strong Military Toward National Rejuvenation
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾习近平主席领导人民军队强军建设，强调党对军队的绝对领导，提出新时代政治建军方略，引领国防和军队现代化取得历史性成就。
articles.summary_en: A retrospective on President Xi Jinping's leadership in strengthening the People's Army, emphasizing the Party's absolute leadership over the military and the strategy of political army-building, achieving historic progress in national defense modernization.

articles.title_zh: 两部门联合发布红色山洪灾害气象预警
articles.title_en: Two Ministries Issue Red Flash Flood Meteorological Warning
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，水利部和中国气象局联合发布红色山洪灾害气象预警，预计黑龙江南部、四川东北部等地山洪灾害可能性很大；水利部向12省份发出靶向预警，应急管理部启动地质灾害四级应急响应。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Ministry of Water Resources and the China Meteorological Administration issued a red flash flood warning for parts of Heilongjiang and Sichuan. Targeted alerts were sent to 12 provinces, and a Level IV geological disaster response was activated.

articles.title_zh: “德耀中华·弘扬大庆精神（铁人精神）”专题活动举行
articles.title_en: Special Event Held to Promote Daqing Spirit and Iron Man Spirit
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，“德耀中华·弘扬大庆精神（铁人精神）”专题活动在黑龙江大庆举行，通过多种形式展现道德模范先进事迹，活动由中央精神文明建设办公室主办。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the special event 'Virtue Shines in China · Promoting Daqing Spirit (Iron Man Spirit)' was held in Daqing, Heilongjiang, showcasing the deeds of moral models through various forms. It was hosted by the Central Spiritual Civilization Development Office.

articles.title_zh: 浙江以考古前置机制破解文物保护与城市建设矛盾
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Uses Pre-Archaeological System to Balance Heritage Protection and Urban Construction
articles.summary_zh: 浙江全面推行考古前置机制，通过制度改革和数字化管理，实现文物保护与工程建设无缝衔接，大批珍贵遗存得以原址保护。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang has fully implemented a pre-excavation archaeological survey system, using institutional reform and digital management to seamlessly coordinate heritage protection with construction, preserving many valuable sites in situ.

articles.title_zh: 第五届链博会推介会在芝加哥举办
articles.title_en: 5th Chain Expo Promotion Conference Held in Chicago
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，中美经贸合作论坛暨第五届链博会推介会在美国芝加哥举办，中美两国政商界代表180余人参会。
articles.summary_en: The China-US Economic and Trade Cooperation Forum and promotion conference for the 5th Chain Expo was held in Chicago on July 30, with over 180 representatives from political and business circles attending.

articles.title_zh: 国防部举办招待会庆祝建军99周年

articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Ministry of National Defense held a reception at the Great Hall of the People to celebrate the 99th anniversary of the PLA, with Defense Minister Dong Jun attending and delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 不断推动退役军人工作高质量发展
articles.title_en: Promoting High-Quality Development of Veterans Affairs

articles.summary_en: On July 31, Minister of Veterans Affairs Pei Jinjia outlined plans for high-quality development of veterans affairs during the 15th Five-Year Plan period at a State Council Information Office press conference, covering job placement and service support.

articles.title_zh: 加快建设健康中国
articles.title_en: Accelerating the Building of a Healthy China
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日出版的《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《加快建设健康中国》，强调到2035年建成健康中国，必须统筹谋划、加紧推进。
articles.summary_en: The Qiushi Journal published an important article by President Xi Jinping on August 1, emphasizing the strategic decision to build a Healthy China by 2035 and the need to make decisive progress during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主持中共中央政治局第二十七次集体学习
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Chairs 27th Group Study Session of CPC Central Committee Political Bureau
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局7月30日下午就高质量推进国防和军队现代化进行第二十七次集体学习，习近平主持并发表讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held its 27th group study session on high-quality advancement of national defense and military modernization. Xi Jinping presided and delivered an important speech.

articles.title_zh: 联合发布十二名“最美新时代革命军人”
articles.title_en: Twelve 'Most Beautiful New Era Revolutionary Soldiers' Jointly Announced
articles.summary_zh: 在中国人民解放军建军99周年之际，中央宣传部与中央军委政治工作部联合发布12名“最美新时代革命军人”，激励广大官兵忠诚奋斗。
articles.summary_en: On the 99th anniversary of the PLA, the CPC Central Committee's Publicity Department and the CMC Political Work Department jointly announced 12 'Most Beautiful New Era Revolutionary Soldiers' to inspire officers and soldiers.

articles.title_zh: 做好退役军人服务保障，让尊重关爱落地有声

articles.summary_en: On July 31, at a State Council Information Office press conference, Minister of Veterans Affairs Pei Jinjia pledged improved resettlement and services for veterans during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 柯昌万主持安康市委常委会（扩大）会议 强调攻坚三季度决胜下半年

articles.summary_en: On July 31, Ke Changwan, secretary of the Ankang Municipal Party Committee, chaired an enlarged standing committee meeting to analyze H1 economy and arrange key H2 tasks.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 坚定信心 保持定力 提高质效 推动经济向新向优向好发展
articles.title_en: Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting to Promote High-Quality Economic Development
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，长春市委书记张恩惠主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习中央政治局会议精神，部署全面从严治党及经济工作，强调推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Zhang Enhui, Secretary of Changchun Municipal Party Committee, chaired a Standing Committee meeting to convey the spirit of the CPC Central Political Bureau meeting and deploy work on strict Party governance and economic development, emphasizing high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠主持召开市委审计委员会第九次全体会议
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui Chairs 9th Plenary Meeting of Municipal Party Committee Audit Commission
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，长春市委书记张恩惠主持召开市委审计委员会第九次全体会议，强调做好审计监督“下半篇文章”，为长春高质量发展提供保障。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Zhang Enhui, Secretary of the CPC Changchun Municipal Committee, chaired the 9th plenary meeting of the Municipal Party Committee Audit Commission, emphasizing high-quality audit supervision to support Changchun's high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 省领导走访慰问驻苏部队官兵
articles.title_en: Provincial Leaders Visit and Greet Troops Stationed in Jiangsu
articles.summary_zh: 在八一建军节前夕，省委常委、常务副省长马欣和省委常委、政法委书记李耀光分别走访慰问驻苏部队官兵，致以节日祝福。
articles.summary_en: On the eve of Army Day, Ma Xin and Li Yaoguang, Jiangsu provincial leaders, visited troops stationed in Jiangsu and conveyed festive greetings.

articles.title_zh: 中国民主促进会沈阳市第十五次代表大会召开
articles.title_en: Shenyang Congress of China Association for Promoting Democracy Convenes
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日至31日，中国民主促进会沈阳市第十五次代表大会召开，选举产生新一届委员会，原阳当选主任委员。
articles.summary_en: The 15th Congress of the Shenyang Municipal Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy was held on July 30-31, electing a new committee with Yuan Yang as chairman.

articles.title_zh: 超长期特别国债资金精准发力 加快补齐民生短板
articles.title_en: Ultra-long-term Special Treasury Bond Funds Precisely Target People's Livelihood

articles.summary_en: Since this year, 200 billion yuan of ultra-long-term special treasury bond funds for equipment updates have been precisely allocated to people's livelihood sectors such as medical devices and elevator installation, accelerating the improvement of living standards.

articles.title_zh: 《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《加快建设健康中国》
articles.title_en: Qiushi Journal Publishes Important Article by Xi Jinping on Accelerating Building a Healthy China
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日出版的《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章，强调到2035年建成健康中国，要求统筹谋划、加紧推进。
articles.summary_en: The 15th issue of Qiushi magazine published on August 1 carries an important article by Xi Jinping, emphasizing the strategic decision to build a Healthy China by 2035 and urging coordinated planning and accelerated progress.

articles.title_zh: 两部门联合印发“十五五”公共机构节能降碳工作方案
articles.title_en: Two Ministries Issue Work Plan for Energy Conservation and Carbon Reduction in Public Institutions during the 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日消息，国管局和国家发展改革委联合印发《“十五五”公共机构节能降碳工作方案》，部署公共机构节能降碳工作，提出到2030年单位建筑面积碳排放下降8.5%等目标。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, the National Government Offices Administration and the National Development and Reform Commission issued a joint work plan to promote energy conservation and carbon reduction in public institutions during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, targeting an 8.5% cut in carbon emissions per unit of floor area by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 铁路暑运过半 消夏旅游列车激发消费活力
articles.title_en: Railway Summer Travel Reaches Midpoint, Tourist Trains Boost Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 国铁集团数据显示，全国铁路暑运已发送旅客4.32亿人次；铁路部门加密开行避暑旅游专列，激发暑期消费新活力。
articles.summary_en: China State Railway Group reports 432 million passenger trips in summer travel. Railway authorities added tourist trains to boost consumption.

articles.title_zh: 我国现代化水网建设提速
articles.title_en: China Accelerates Modern Water Network Construction
articles.summary_zh: 记者从水利部了解到，今年1至6月全国实施水利项目3.3万个，完成投资5151亿元，南水北调引江补汉等重大工程加快建设。
articles.summary_en: According to the Ministry of Water Resources, China implemented 33,000 water projects with investment of 515.1 billion yuan in H1, accelerating key projects like the Hanjiang-to-Weihe River Water Diversion.

articles.title_zh: 谋发展——深刻认识“最本质的特征”和“最大优势”
articles.title_en: Seeking Development: Deeply Understanding the 'Essential Feature' and 'Greatest Strength'
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记主持中央政治局会议，强调坚持党的领导、推动高质量发展，指出中国共产党领导是中国特色社会主义最本质的特征和最大优势。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping chaired a CPC Central Committee Political Bureau meeting, emphasizing Party leadership and high-quality development, stating that CPC leadership is the most essential feature and greatest strength of socialism with Chinese characteristics.

articles.title_zh: 五年规划发布 全国供销合作社将全面升级为农服务
articles.title_en: Five-Year Plan Released: Supply and Marketing Cooperatives to Upgrade Agricultural Services Nationwide
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，中华全国供销合作总社发布《全国供销合作社“十五五”发展规划》，部署18项重点任务，提升农资流通与社会化服务能力，助力粮食安全与乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, the All-China Federation of Supply and Marketing Cooperatives released the 15th Five-Year Development Plan, outlining 18 key tasks to enhance agricultural supply and services for food security and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在中共中央政治局第二十七次集体学习时强调 强化政治引领 深化创新发展 高质量推进国防和军队现代化

articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee Political Bureau held its 27th collective study on high-quality national defense and military modernization on July 30. Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, presided and stressed political guidance and innovative development for the modernization drive.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党辽宁省第十三届委员会第十一次全体会议公报

articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月31日，中共辽宁省第十三届委员会第十一次全体会议在沈阳召开，省委书记许昆林作工作报告，会议审议通过省第十四次党代会决议，并追认给予王心宇留党察看二年处分。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, 2026, the 11th Plenary Session of the 13th CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee was held in Shenyang. Xu Kunlin, Secretary of the Provincial Committee, delivered a work report. The session approved a resolution on convening the 14th Provincial Party Congress and confirmed a two-year probationary Party membership penalty for Wang Xinyu.

articles.summary_en: On July 31, the second municipal veteran cadres briefing meeting of 2026 was held in Fuzhou, chaired by Zhang Zhong, director of the Standing Committee of the Municipal People's Congress, to brief on H1 economic and social development.

articles.title_zh: 哈密市医疗保障局就完善生育保障措施公开征求意见

articles.summary_en: Hami Medical Security Bureau drafted a notice on maternity protection measures and opened public consultation from July 22 to improve the maternity insurance system and raise protection levels.

articles.title_zh: 高靖生走访市人大常委会机关和市政协机关

articles.title_zh: 韦朝晖讲授树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育专题党课

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰带队调研市重点项目建设

articles.title_zh: 外交部就菲律宾在黄岩岛划设所谓“领海基线”发表声明
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Statement on Philippines' Unlawful Baseline in Huangyan Island
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，中国外交部发表声明，坚决反对菲律宾在中国领土黄岩岛划设所谓“领海基线”，指出其严重侵犯中国主权，非法无效。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, China's Foreign Ministry issued a statement resolutely opposing the Philippines' unlawful baselines in Huangyan Island, calling them illegal and invalid and a serious violation of China's sovereignty.

articles.title_zh: 省政府召开常务会议
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Chairs Jiangsu Provincial Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，江苏省政府召开常务会议，省长刘小涛主持，部署经济运行、产业发展、科技强农、食品安全等工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Jiangsu Provincial Government held an executive meeting chaired by Governor Liu Xiaotao, deploying work on economic operation, industrial development, agricultural technology, and food safety.

articles.title_zh: 整合重组歌舞团、戏曲剧团、话剧团等，吉林市演艺集团揭牌
articles.title_en: Jilin City Performing Arts Group Unveiled After Restructuring of Local Art Troupes
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月31日，吉林市演艺集团揭牌，整合市歌舞团、戏曲剧团、话剧团等国有文艺资源，推动文旅融合发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, 2026, Jilin City Performing Arts Group was inaugurated, integrating municipal song-and-dance, opera, and drama troupes and other state-owned cultural resources to boost cultural-tourism integration.

articles.title_zh: 中国烹饪协会：“中国烹饪大师”“之乡、之都”等称号全部作废
articles.title_en: China Cuisine Association Revokes All 'Culinary Master' and 'Hometown of Cuisine' Titles
articles.summary_zh: 中国烹饪协会近日连发公告，废止其历年评定的“中国烹饪大师”“名师”及“之乡、之都”等称号，以落实民政部等新规。
articles.summary_en: China Cuisine Association recently revoked all 'Culinary Master' and 'Hometown of Cuisine' titles it had awarded, to comply with new regulations on social organization commendations.

articles.title_zh: 10万人南昌八一广场观看升旗，建军百年将有更多期待
articles.title_en: 100,000 Attend Flag-Raising at Nanchang Bayi Square Ahead of PLA Centennial
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，约10.2万群众在南昌八一广场观看升旗仪式。背景中的陆军博物馆计划于2027年8月1日前开放，将融入“八一”文化展示圈。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 1, about 102,000 people attended a flag-raising ceremony at Nanchang's Bayi Square. The Army Museum behind is scheduled to open by Aug 1, 2027, joining the Bayi cultural display circle.

articles.title_zh: AI浪潮下的传播新格局：变什么，守什么？
articles.title_en: New Communication Landscape in the AI Wave: What Changes, What Remains?
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，2026外滩新媒体学术交流会在上海举行，澎湃新闻主办总编圆桌研讨，多位主流媒体负责人探讨AI浪潮下媒体变革的变与不变。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the 2026 Bund New Media Academic Exchange was held in Shanghai, where The Paper hosted a chief editors' roundtable discussing what changes and what remains in media amid the AI wave.

articles.title_zh: 湖南两所高校因学校情况有变临时调整录取通知书签发人
articles.title_en: Two Hunan Universities Adjust Admission Letter Signers Due to Changed Circumstances
articles.summary_zh: 湖南省教育厅近日公告，因学校情况变化，南华大学和益阳医学高等专科学校调整录取通知书签发人，改为党委书记签发。此前南华大学校长夏昆因涉嫌严重违纪违法被查。
articles.summary_en: Hunan Education Department adjusted admission letter signers at two universities to their Party secretaries after President Xia Kun of University of South China was investigated for serious discipline violations.

articles.title_zh: 首批全国生育友好城市创建已启动，哪些城市有意？
articles.title_en: First Batch of National Childbirth-Friendly City Program Launched, Which Cities Are Interested?
articles.summary_zh: 国家卫健委5月公布创建管理办法，启动全国生育友好城市创建；黑龙江穆棱、大兴安岭及湖北天门等地已宣布争创。
articles.summary_en: The National Health Commission published management rules in May to launch a national childbirth-friendly city program; cities like Muleng, Daxing'anling and Tianmen have announced bids to join.

articles.title_zh: 从发改委连续三场发布会看中国人工智能发展
articles.title_en: China's AI Development: Insights from Three Consecutive NDRC Press Conferences
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国家发展改革委举行发布会，强调发展国产算力，披露全国智能算力规模达去年同期2.8倍，首个全国产10万卡AI超集群投用。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the NDRC held a press conference emphasizing domestic computing power, disclosing that national intelligent computing power reached 2.8 times the previous year and the first fully domestic 100,000-card AI cluster is in operation.

articles.title_zh: 福建省“八一”军政座谈会举行
articles.title_en: Fujian Holds 'August 1st' Military-Political Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，福建省委书记周祖翼、省长赵龙走访慰问驻闽部队并出席省“八一”军政座谈会，共话军民鱼水深情。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Fujian Provincial Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi and Governor Zhao Long visited troops stationed in Fujian and attended the provincial military-political symposium to promote civil-military unity.

articles.title_zh: 林业总产值突破万亿元 福建林业“十五五”发展规划出台
articles.title_en: Fujian Issues 15th Five-Year Forestry Development Plan Aiming for Trillion-Yuan Output
articles.summary_zh: 近日，福建省林业局印发《福建省“十五五”林业发展规划》，提出到2030年森林覆盖率达65.88%、林业产业总产值突破1万亿元。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Fujian Provincial Forestry Bureau issued the 15th Five-Year Forestry Development Plan, setting targets of 65.88% forest coverage and over 1 trillion yuan in forestry output by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 广东省领导慰问驻粤部队官兵
articles.title_en: Guangdong Leaders Visit Military Units Stationed in Province
articles.summary_zh: 八一建军节前夕，广东省委、省政府领导率省拥军慰问团走访慰问驻粤部队，致以节日祝贺和诚挚慰问。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of the 99th Army Day, leaders of the Guangdong Provincial Party Committee and Government led teams to visit and extend festive greetings to military personnel stationed in Guangdong.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省出台知识产权领域首部综合性地方性法规
articles.title_en: Gansu Issues First Comprehensive Local Regulation on Intellectual Property
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，甘肃省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议表决通过《甘肃省知识产权促进和保护条例》，系该省知识产权领域首部综合性地方性法规，将于2026年9月1日施行。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the 24th session of the 14th Gansu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee passed the Regulation on Promotion and Protection of Intellectual Property in Gansu, the province's first comprehensive local regulation on IP, effective from September 1, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃修订实施代表法办法
articles.title_en: Gansu Revises Implementation Measures for Deputies Law
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议表决通过《甘肃省实施〈代表法〉办法（修订）》，自2026年9月1日起施行，以保障代表依法履职。
articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of the 14th Gansu Provincial People's Congress approved the revised measures for implementing the Deputies Law at its 24th session on July 30, effective September 1, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省年轻一代民营经济人士培育计划启动
articles.title_en: Gansu Launches Training Program for Young Private Entrepreneurs
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省委统战部、省工商联启动年轻一代民营经济人士培育计划，首期选拔约50名青年企业家进行一年期培训，提升其政治素养与经营能力。
articles.summary_en: Gansu's United Front Work Department and Federation of Industry and Commerce launched a program to cultivate young private entrepreneurs, selecting about 50 for a year-long training to enhance political literacy and business capabilities.

tags.name_en: United Front Work Department of Gansu Provincial CPC Committee

tags_en: United Front Work Department of Gansu Provincial CPC Committee

articles.title_zh: 广西四部门联合推出“复工复产贷”政策
articles.title_en: Guangxi Four Departments Jointly Launch "Work Resumption and Production Loan" Policy
articles.summary_zh: 广西四部门联合推出“复工复产贷”政策，提高贷款贴息和担保费补贴比例，为受灾地区经营主体恢复生产提供融资支持。自设立以来已入库1207户，19户获贷2.52亿元。
articles.summary_en: Guangxi's four departments jointly launched the "Work Resumption and Production Loan" policy, increasing subsidies for loan interest and guarantee fees to support business recovery in disaster-hit areas. Since its launch, 1,207 entities have been registered, and 19 have received subsidized loans totaling 252 million yuan.

articles.title_zh: 广西跨境贸易高水平开放试点今起实施
articles.title_en: Guangxi Launches High-Level Open Pilot for Cross-Border Trade
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日起，广西在南宁、柳州、防城港、钦州、崇左五市实施跨境贸易高水平开放试点，深化面向东盟的金融开放门户建设，优化优质企业贸易外汇收支便利化政策。
articles.summary_en: Starting August 1, Guangxi implements a high-level opening-up pilot for cross-border trade in five cities, aiming to deepen financial opening toward ASEAN and optimize trade foreign exchange facilitation for quality enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 加快构建体现湖北优势的现代化产业体系
articles.title_en: Hubei Accelerates Building Modern Industrial System with Local Advantages
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日上午，湖北省委理论学习中心组举行集体学习，围绕加快构建体现湖北优势的现代化产业体系开展研讨，省委书记关志鸥主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 31, the Hubei Provincial Party Committee's theoretical study group held a collective session on building a modern industrial system with local advantages, chaired by Secretary Guan Zhiou.

articles.title_zh: 不断推动退役军人工作高质量发展（权威发布·开局起步“十五五”）
articles.title_en: Continuously Promoting High-Quality Development of Veterans Affairs
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国务院新闻办公室举行发布会，退役军人事务部部长裴金佳介绍“十五五”时期推动退役军人工作高质量发展的有关情况。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the State Council Information Office held a press conference where Minister of Veterans Affairs Pei Jinjia introduced plans for high-quality development of veterans affairs during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 河北省召开全省领导干部会议
articles.title_en: Hebei Holds Provincial Leaders Meeting; Luo Wen Appointed Party Secretary
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，河北省召开全省领导干部会议，中央组织部副部长黄建发宣布中央决定：罗文任河北省委书记，倪岳峰不再担任。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Hebei held a provincial leaders meeting. Huang Jianfa, deputy head of the Central Organization Department, announced that Luo Wen was appointed Hebei Party secretary, replacing Ni Yuefeng.

tags.name_en: Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee

tags_en: Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 冯飞率海南省“八一”拥军慰问团看望慰问驻琼部队官兵
articles.title_en: Feng Fei Leads Hainan Army Day Condolence Group to Visit Troops Stationed in Hainan
articles.summary_zh: 省委书记冯飞7月31日率海南省“八一”拥军慰问团在海口走访慰问驻琼部队，代表省委省政府致以节日祝贺，并强调军地合力支持自贸港建设。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Feng Fei, Secretary of Hainan Provincial Party Committee, led the Hainan 'August 1st' Army Day condolence delegation to visit troops stationed in Hainan in Haikou, conveying holiday greetings on behalf of the provincial party committee and government, and emphasizing military-civilian cooperation to support the free trade port construction.

tags.name_en: Supporting the Army and Honoring Military Families

tags_en: Supporting the Army and Honoring Military Families

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲：全力做好强降雨防范应对工作 切实保障人民群众生命财产安全
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Urges Full Preparedness for Heavy Rainfall to Protect People's Lives and Property
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，黑龙江省防汛抗旱指挥部召开防范应对近期强降雨视频调度会议，省长梁惠玲强调全力做好强降雨防范应对工作，保障人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Heilongjiang Provincial Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters held a video conference on heavy rainfall response, where Governor Liang Huiling stressed full preparedness to protect lives and property.

tags.name_zh: 黑龙江省防汛抗旱指挥部
tags.name_en: Heilongjiang Provincial Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters

tags_zh: 黑龙江省防汛抗旱指挥部
tags_en: Heilongjiang Provincial Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters

articles.title_zh: 江苏市县乡三级人大换届选举时间确定
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Sets Dates for County, Township People's Congress Elections
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，江苏省人大常委会通过决定，明确全省市县乡三级人大换届选举时间，县乡两级代表将于2026年12月底前选出。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee passed a decision setting the timeline for the three-level people's congress elections, with county and township deputies to be elected by the end of December 2026.

articles.title_zh: 尹弘叶建春宋福龙陈永奇等分组走访慰问驻赣部队
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Provincial Leaders Visit Troops Stationed in Jiangxi Ahead of Army Day
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日至31日，江西省委书记尹弘、省长叶建春等省四套班子领导分组走访慰问驻赣部队，代表江西人民向官兵致以节日问候，强调大力弘扬双拥传统，支持国防和军队现代化建设。
articles.summary_en: From July 30 to 31, Yin Hong, Ye Jianchun and other provincial leaders visited troops stationed in Jiangxi, conveying festival greetings and emphasizing support for national defense and military modernization.

tags.name_en: Supporting the Military and Veteran Families

tags_en: Supporting the Military and Veteran Families

articles.title_zh: 晒成绩谋新篇 从一场发布会读懂宜春的现在和未来
articles.title_en: Yichun Unveils Achievements and Blueprint at Press Conference
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，江西省政府新闻办与宜春市政府联合召开新闻发布会，市长谭赣明等介绍“十四五”成绩及“十五五”规划目标，提出GDP年均增长5%左右等目标。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Jiangxi Provincial Government Information Office and Yichun Municipal Government held a press conference. Mayor Tan Ganming presented achievements and 15th Five-Year Plan goals, targeting annual GDP growth of about 5%.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党内蒙古自治区第十一届委员会第十二次全体会议公报
articles.title_en: Communiqué of the 12th Plenary Session of the 11th Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Committee of the CPC
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月31日，中国共产党内蒙古自治区第十一届委员会第十二次全体会议在呼和浩特举行，审议通过关于召开自治区第十二次党代会的决议，部署下半年工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, 2026, the 12th Plenary Session of the 11th Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Committee of the CPC was held in Hohhot, deliberating and adopting a resolution on convening the region's 12th Party Congress and deploying work for the second half of the year.

articles.title_zh: 包钢会见出席2026年世界奶业大会的嘉宾代表
articles.title_en: Bao Gang Meets Delegates Attending 2026 World Dairy Conference
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，内蒙古自治区主席包钢会见出席2026年世界奶业大会的国际组织嘉宾，表示愿深化奶业国际合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Bao Gang, chairman of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, met with international guests attending the 2026 World Dairy Conference and expressed willingness to deepen dairy cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主持中共中央政治局第二十七次集体学习 强调高质量推进国防和军队现代化
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Chairs 27th Collective Study of CPC Central Committee Political Bureau on High-Quality Military Modernization
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，中共中央政治局就高质量推进国防和军队现代化进行第二十七次集体学习，习近平主持并讲话，强调强化政治引领、深化创新发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held its 27th group study on high-quality modernization of national defense and the military. Xi Jinping presided and stressed strengthening political guidance and deepening innovation.

articles.title_zh: 庆祝中国共产党成立105周年优秀舞台艺术作品展演在京拉开帷幕
articles.title_en: Exhibition of Outstanding Stage Art Works for 105th Anniversary of the CPC Opens in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，由中央宣传部、文化和旅游部主办的庆祝中国共产党成立105周年优秀舞台艺术作品展演在北京开幕，12部作品参演。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the exhibition of outstanding stage art works celebrating the 105th anniversary of the CPC, hosted by the Publicity Department and the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, opened in Beijing, featuring 12 works.

tags.name_en: Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee

tags_en: Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 就《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》答记者问
articles.title_en: Officials Answer Questions on State Council Regulations on Exit-Entry Administration
articles.summary_zh: 司法部、公安部、国家移民局负责人就《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》答记者问，介绍制定背景及出境入境管理新规。
articles.summary_en: Officials from the Ministry of Justice, Ministry of Public Security, and National Immigration Administration answered questions on the State Council regulations on exit-entry administration, explaining background and key provisions.

articles.title_zh: 中共山东省委十二届十一次全体会议举行
articles.title_en: 11th Plenary Session of CPC Shandong Provincial Committee Held
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月31日，中共山东省委十二届十一次全体会议在济南举行，审议通过关于推进农业农村现代化的意见。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, 2026, the 11th Plenary Session of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee was held in Jinan, adopting a resolution on advancing agricultural and rural modernization.

articles.title_zh: 奋力开创农业农村现代化新局面
articles.title_en: Striving to Create a New Prospect for Agricultural and Rural Modernization
articles.summary_zh: 山东省委十二届十一次全体会议审议通过关于推进农业农村现代化的意见，部署打造乡村振兴齐鲁样板，扎实推动农业强省建设。
articles.summary_en: The 11th Plenary Session of the 12th CPC Shandong Provincial Committee deliberated and approved a plan to promote agricultural and rural modernization, aiming to build a model for rural revitalization in Qilu.

articles.title_zh: 中央安全生产考核巡查组第六组向上海市反馈明查暗访情况
articles.title_en: Sixth Central Work Safety Inspection Team Reports Findings to Shanghai
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，中央安全生产考核巡查组第六组向上海市反馈明查暗访情况，组长周星通报，上海市委书记陈吉宁作表态发言，强调动真碰硬抓整改。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the sixth Central Work Safety Inspection Team gave feedback to Shanghai on its inspection findings; team leader Zhou Xing reported, and Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Jining pledged resolute rectification.

articles.title_zh: 弘扬双拥光荣传统 提升服务保障效能 推动退役军人工作高质量发展取得新成效
articles.title_en: Carry Forward the Fine Tradition of Supporting the Army and Prioritizing Benefits for Veterans to Promote High-Quality Development of Veterans Affairs
articles.summary_zh: 近日，陕西省委书记赵一德在省退役军人事务厅调研，强调要弘扬双拥光荣传统，提升服务保障效能，推动退役军人工作高质量发展取得新成效。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Zhao Yide, Secretary of the CPC Shaanxi Provincial Committee, visited the Provincial Department of Veterans Affairs, emphasizing the need to carry forward the tradition of supporting the army and prioritizing benefits for veterans, improve service support efficiency, and promote high-quality development of veterans affairs.

articles.title_zh: 陕西省委常委会召开议军会议 研究部署加强新时代人民武装工作
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee Holds Military Affairs Meeting on People's Armed Forces Work
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，陕西省委常委会召开议军会议，深入学习贯彻习近平强军思想，研究部署加强新时代人民武装工作，省委书记赵一德主持。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Standing Committee of the Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee, chaired by Zhao Yide, held a military affairs meeting to deploy strengthening people's armed forces work.

articles.title_zh: 31省份经济“半年报”出炉
articles.title_en: Half-Year Economic Reports of 31 Provincial Regions Released
articles.summary_zh: 全国31省份上半年经济数据陆续出炉，广东、江苏总量领先，西藏、浙江等地增速领跑，总体运行平稳，GDP均实现正增长。
articles.summary_en: Economic data for the first half of the year from 31 provincial regions has been released, with Guangdong and Jiangsu leading in GDP and Tibet, Zhejiang, and others posting the fastest growth. All regions reported positive GDP growth.

articles.title_zh: 云南省委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Yunnan Provincial Party Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speech and Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，云南省委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，分析上半年经济运行情况，部署下一步工作，省委书记王宁主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Standing Committee of Yunnan Provincial Party Committee held a meeting to study Xi Jinping's important speech and instructions, analyze economic performance in H1, and deploy next steps, chaired by Wang Ning.

articles.title_zh: 云南省实施打造一流营商环境三年行动成效显著
articles.title_en: Yunnan Achieves Notable Results in Three-Year Campaign to Optimize Business Environment
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，云南省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议审议优化营商环境报告，显示全省经营主体超684万户，民营经济增加值占GDP比重升至53.5%。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, Yunnan provincial legislature reviewed a government report on business environment, showing over 6.84 million market entities and private economy contributing 53.5% of provincial GDP.

articles.title_zh: 黄荷凤：未来医院里，“瘦子”也可能来看肥胖症
articles.title_en: Huang Hefeng: Future Hospitals May See 'Thin' Patients with Obesity Risk
articles.summary_zh: 中国科学院院士黄荷凤在2026精准医疗创新转化与数智化发展交流会上表示，医学模式正从“以病人为中心”向“以健康为中心”转变，未来医院将接诊更多表面健康但存在潜在风险的人群。
articles.summary_en: Academician Huang Hefeng stated at the 2026 Precision Medicine Innovation and Digitalization Development Conference that the medical model is shifting from patient-centered to health-centered care, and future hospitals will see more seemingly healthy individuals with potential health risks.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议 刘宁主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Chairs Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，省委书记刘宁主持召开省委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，部署经济发展、全面从严治党、安全生产等工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning chaired a meeting of the Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and deploy economic development, comprehensive Party discipline, and work safety.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛走访慰问驻苏部队子弟兵
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Visits and Consoles Officers and Soldiers of Air Force Unit in Jiangsu
articles.summary_zh: 八一建军节来临之际，省长刘小涛走访慰问中国人民解放军空军某部，向驻苏部队官兵致以节日问候，强调支持国防和军队现代化建设。
articles.summary_en: On the eve of Army Day, Governor Liu Xiaotao visited an Air Force unit to extend holiday greetings to officers and soldiers, stressing support for national defense and military modernization.

articles.title_zh: 省政府召开常务会议 刘小涛主持
articles.title_en: Provincial Government Holds Executive Meeting Chaired by Liu Xiaotao
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，江苏省政府召开常务会议，省长刘小涛主持，部署经济运行、产业发展、科技强农、食品安全、信访、金融等工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Jiangsu Provincial Government held an executive meeting chaired by Governor Liu Xiaotao to arrange work on economic operation, industrial development, agricultural technology, food safety, petitions, and finance.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议学习贯彻中央政治局会议和习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee Holds Meeting to Study Central Political Bureau Meeting Spirit
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，江苏省委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻中央政治局会议和习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究贯彻落实举措，省委书记信长星主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Standing Committee of the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee held a meeting to study and implement the spirit of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and important speeches of General Secretary Xi Jinping, chaired by Secretary Xin Changxing.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记指引加快建设健康中国
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Guides Accelerated Construction of Healthy China
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《加快建设健康中国》，强调坚持党对卫生与健康工作的领导，走中国特色卫生与健康发展道路，突出重点推进健康中国建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, the Qiushi Journal published an important article by General Secretary Xi Jinping on accelerating the building of a Healthy China, emphasizing Party leadership and a development path with Chinese characteristics in health work.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 坚定不移走中国特色强军之路
articles.title_en: Firmly Follow the Path of Building a Strong Military with Chinese Characteristics
articles.summary_zh: 八一建军节之际，回顾党的十八大以来习近平总书记领航强军事业取得的历史性成就，强调坚定不移走中国特色强军之路。
articles.summary_en: On Army Day, review the historic achievements in military development under President Xi Jinping's leadership since the 18th CPC National Congress, and reaffirm commitment to the path of building a powerful military with Chinese characteristics.

articles.title_zh: 英雄城市再创辉煌
articles.title_en: Heroic City Achieves New Splendor
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾习近平总书记2016年对唐山提出‘三个努力建成’嘱托，报道唐山在京津冀协同发展中经济总量破万亿，港口吞吐量居世界第二，机器人产业快速发展，正全方位融入协同发展大局。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews Xi Jinping's 2016 instruction for Tangshan to achieve 'three goals', and reports the city's progress in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei coordinated development: GDP exceeding one trillion yuan, port throughput ranking second globally, and booming robotics industry.

articles.title_zh: 王浩：改革创新 落实落细 确保交出高质量发展和高水平安全良性互动的高分答卷
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Emphasizes Reform and Innovation for High-Quality Development and High-Level Security
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，浙江省委书记王浩到省气象局、省水利厅、省自然资源厅、省海洋经济厅调研，强调改革创新、落实落细，确保高质量发展和高水平安全良性互动。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Wang Hao, Secretary of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee, visited provincial departments including meteorology, water resources, natural resources, and marine economy, stressing reform and innovation for high-quality development and high-level security.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷在舟山调研强调持续激发海岛县高质量发展内生动力
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Investigates Zhoushan, Stresses Endogenous Development of Island Counties
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省省长刘捷于7月29日至31日在舟山调研，强调发挥比较优势、打响特色品牌，持续激发海岛县高质量发展内生动力。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang Governor Liu Jie conducted a special survey in Zhoushan from July 29 to 31, stressing comparative advantages and distinctive brands to continuously unleash the endogenous momentum for high-quality development of island counties.

articles.title_zh: 国家发改委回应二季度GDP增速回落
articles.title_en: NDRC Responds to Q2 GDP Growth Slowdown
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国家发改委举行7月新闻发布会，回应二季度GDP增速回落，称5、6月份指标回升，经济长期向好。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the National Development and Reform Commission held a press conference, responding to the Q2 GDP growth slowdown, saying indicators rebounded in May and June and the economy remains sound in the long run.

articles.title_zh: 国家发改委：我国人工智能在全产业链多环节实现快速突破
articles.title_en: NDRC: China's AI Achieves Rapid Breakthroughs Across Full Industrial Chain
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国家发改委介绍上半年我国人工智能发展，算力规模达去年同期2.8倍，国产大模型下载量破100亿次，下一步抓好创新、应用、生态。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, NDRC said China's AI innovation accelerated in H1, with computing power at 2.8 times last year's level and domestic large-model downloads exceeding 10 billion. Next steps focus on innovation, application, and ecosystem.

articles.title_zh: 国家税务总局发布首个跨境税收行业类指引
articles.title_en: State Taxation Administration Issues First Cross-Border Tax Industry Guideline
articles.summary_zh: 国家税务总局近日发布首个跨境税收行业类指引《国际运输涉税服务指引》，为国际航海、航空、陆路等跨境运输企业提供涉税合规参考。
articles.summary_en: China's State Taxation Administration has recently issued its first cross-border tax industry guideline, the International Transport Tax Service Guideline, providing tax compliance references for enterprises in international maritime, aviation, and land transport.

articles.title_zh: 国家发改委：今年7550亿元中央预算内投资已基本下达完毕
articles.title_en: NDRC: 755 Billion Yuan Central Budgetary Investment Basically Allocated This Year
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国家发展改革委在发布会上表示，今年7550亿元中央预算内投资已基本下达完毕，并加大民生类投资，其中以工代赈资金395亿元已下达。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the NDRC said at a press conference that this year's 755 billion yuan of central budgetary investment has been basically allocated, with increased livelihood investment, including 39.5 billion yuan for work-relief programs.

articles.title_zh: 最高人民法院发布4件涉军维权司法典型案例
articles.title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases Four Typical Cases on Military-Related Rights Protection
articles.summary_zh: 最高人民法院发布4件涉军维权司法典型案例，涉及军用土地保护、军工企业破产重整、退役军人权益保障和军人军属司法救助。
articles.summary_en: The Supreme People's Court released four typical judicial cases on protecting military-related rights, covering military land protection, restructuring of military enterprises, veterans' rights, and judicial assistance for military families.

articles.title_zh: 庆祝中国共产党成立105周年优秀舞台艺术作品展演在京拉开帷幕
articles.title_en: Celebration of 105th Anniversary of CPC Foundings: Excellent Stage Art Performances Kick Off in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 庆祝中国共产党成立105周年优秀舞台艺术作品展演于2026年7月31日在北京拉开帷幕，由中央宣传部、文化和旅游部主办，12部优秀作品参演，活动将持续至9月。
articles.summary_en: The exhibition of outstanding stage art works celebrating the 105th anniversary of the CPC kicks off on July 31, 2026 in Beijing. Hosted by the Central Publicity Department and the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, 12 works will be performed through September.

articles.title_zh: 非法收受财物1.24亿余元 四川南充市委原书记古正举一审被判无期
articles.title_en: Gu Zhengju, Former Nanchong Party Secretary, Sentenced to Life Imprisonment for Bribes of 124 Million Yuan

articles.summary_en: Gu Zhengju, former Party secretary of Nanchong, Sichuan, was sentenced to life imprisonment in the first instance for illegally accepting bribes totaling over 124 million yuan.

articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，官方通报国家电网原董事长辛保安涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受中央纪委国家监委纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, authorities announced that Xin Bao'an, former chairman of State Grid, is under investigation for alleged serious discipline violations.

articles.title_zh: 国家发改委详解中国“空调自由”：系统构筑“四道保险”
articles.title_en: NDRC Details China's 'Air Conditioning Freedom': Building a 'Four-Layer Safety Net'
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国家发改委新闻发言人蒋毅在北京表示，中国通过系统构筑“四道保险”，保障了能源安全和“空调自由”。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Jiang Yi, spokesperson for the National Development and Reform Commission, said in Beijing that China has ensured energy security and 'air conditioning freedom' through a four-layer safety net.

articles.title_zh: 从道路避险到跨境耕种 北斗走向世界
articles.title_en: From Road Hazard Avoidance to Cross-Border Farming: BeiDou Goes Global

articles.summary_en: On July 31, the BeiDou-3 system marked its sixth anniversary, showcasing its positioning technology in road safety and cross-border farming, with products exported to over 140 countries.

articles.title_zh: 菲尔兹奖双星的数学人生
articles.title_en: Two Chinese Mathematicians Awarded Fields Medal
articles.summary_zh: 北京时间7月23日，2026年国际数学家大会在美国费城举行，中国学者王虹和邓煜获菲尔兹奖，这是中国籍数学家首次获此奖项。
articles.summary_en: On July 23, 2026, at the International Congress of Mathematicians in Philadelphia, Chinese scholars Wang Hong and Deng Yu won the Fields Medal, the first time Chinese nationals received the award.

articles.title_zh: 航行警告！渤海海峡黄海北部执行军事任务 禁止驶入

articles.summary_en: Dalian Maritime Safety Administration issued a navigation warning that military missions will be held in parts of the Bohai Strait and northern Yellow Sea from 16:00 Aug 2 to 16:00 Aug 16, and entry is prohibited.

articles.summary_en: China's Satellite Navigation System Administration announced on July 31 that the BeiDou system has completed its in-orbit upgrade, aiming to provide more stable and reliable positioning, navigation and timing services.

articles.title_en: Chinese Experts Teach Us How to Live a Better Life

articles.summary_en: The first pilot project of the China-Ethiopia agricultural cooperation poverty reduction demonstration village has made concrete progress over the past year, as Chinese experts taught local villagers farming skills and helped them increase income.

articles.title_zh: 深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想 推动新时代新征程纪检监察工作高质量发展

articles.summary_en: The central disciplinary body published a signed article in People's Daily, stressing to fully implement Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building for high-quality discipline inspection and supervision in the new era.

articles.title_zh: 决定召开二十届五中全会 分析研究当前经济形势和经济工作
articles.title_en: Politburo Meeting Decides to Convene Fifth Plenary Session, Analyzes Economic Situation
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局7月30日召开会议，决定今年10月召开二十届五中全会，研究全面从严治党，分析经济形势，部署下半年经济工作。习近平主持会议。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee Politburo met on July 30, deciding to convene the Fifth Plenary Session in October to study full and rigorous Party self-governance, analyze the economic situation, and arrange H2 economic work. Xi Jinping chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 三个视角看电力供需新变化
articles.title_en: Three Perspectives on New Changes in Electricity Supply and Demand
articles.summary_zh: 国家能源局数据显示，上半年全社会用电量同比增长5.3%，可再生能源发电量占比首次超四成，能源结构持续优化。
articles.summary_en: Data from the National Energy Administration shows first-half electricity consumption up 5.3% year on year, with renewable generation exceeding 40% of total for the first time, reflecting ongoing energy structure optimization.

articles.title_zh: 全国人大常委会举办2026年第3期全国人大代表学习班
articles.title_en: NPC Standing Committee Holds 2026 Third Session of Training for NPC Deputies
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日至29日，全国人大常委会在河北举办2026年第3期全国人大代表学习班，187名代表围绕学习贯彻民族团结进步促进法开展履职学习。
articles.summary_en: From July 27 to 29, the NPC Standing Committee held the 2026 third training session for NPC deputies in Hebei, with 187 deputies studying the Law on Promoting Ethnic Unity and Progress.

articles.summary_en: On July 24, the CPC Central Committee held a symposium with non-party personages in Zhongnanhai. Xi Jinping presided and delivered an important speech, listening to opinions on the current economic situation and H2 economic work.

articles.title_zh: 向着建军一百年奋斗目标阔步前行
articles.title_en: Striding Forward to the Centenary Goal of the People's Army

articles.summary_en: Youjiang District in Baise, Guangxi integrates social sciences with folk arts to deliver party theory briefings, holding over 60 interactive sessions since 2025.

articles.title_zh: 习近平：加快建设健康中国
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping: Accelerate Building a Healthy China

articles.title_zh: 红色研学热 转型动能足
articles.title_en: Red Study Tour Boom Drives Transformation
articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江大庆赓续红色基因，发展红色研学游，上半年接待游客175万人次；同时加快页岩油开发与产业转型，油与非油产业比值调整至31.3:68.7。
articles.summary_en: Daqing, Heilongjiang, promotes red-tourism study tours, receiving 1.75 million visitors in H1, while accelerating shale oil development and industrial transformation, with non-oil industry value accounting for 68.7%.

articles.title_zh: 加快建设健康中国
articles.title_en: Accelerating the Construction of a Healthy China
articles.summary_zh: 7月21日，国家卫生健康委党组书记、主任雷海潮在形势政策系列报告会上作“加快建设健康中国”专题报告，总结历史成就并部署“十五五”重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On July 21, Lei Haichao, Secretary of the Party Leadership Group and Director of the National Health Commission, delivered a special report titled 'Accelerating the Construction of a Healthy China' at a series of policy briefings, summarizing achievements and outlining key tasks for the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 养老服务消费补贴惠及约200万名中度以上失能老年人
articles.title_en: Elderly Care Consumption Subsidies Benefit About 2 Million Disabled Seniors
articles.summary_zh: 民政部7月30日发布会透露，养老服务消费补贴项目已核销消费券1079.92万次，金额65.12亿元，约200万名中度以上失能老年人受益。
articles.summary_en: At a July 30 press conference, the Ministry of Civil Affairs said the elderly care consumption subsidy program had redeemed 10.7992 million vouchers worth 6.512 billion yuan, benefiting about 2 million moderately or severely disabled seniors.

articles.title_zh: 人民军队永远跟党走
articles.title_en: People's Army Forever Follows the Party
articles.summary_zh: 文章介绍获评全国'两优一先'的我军先进典型强军故事，展现新时代人民军队永远跟党走的忠诚与担当。
articles.summary_en: The article highlights the stories of PLA model units and individuals awarded the national 'Two Excellent and One Advanced' titles, showcasing their loyalty to the Party and commitment to military strengthening.

articles.title_zh: 长春市委常委会召开会议 部署开发区改革和高质量发展
articles.title_en: Changchun Municipal Party Committee Meeting on Development Zone Reform and High-quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，长春市委书记张恩惠主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，部署深化开发区改革、公安工作等事项。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Zhang Enhui, Secretary of the Changchun Municipal Party Committee, chaired a meeting to convey Xi Jinping's important instructions and arrange reforms of development zones and public security work.

articles.title_zh: 顾刚走访慰问驻长部队和优抚对象
articles.title_en: Gu Gang Visits and Extends Greetings to Troops in Changchun and Recipients of Special Care
articles.summary_zh: 八一建军节前夕，长春市委副书记、市长顾刚走访慰问驻长部队官兵和优抚对象，代表市委、市政府送上节日祝福与诚挚问候。
articles.summary_en: On the eve of Army Day, Gu Gang, Deputy Secretary of Changchun Municipal Committee and Mayor, visited troops stationed in Changchun and recipients of special care, conveying holiday greetings on behalf of the municipal party committee and government.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠走访慰问驻长部队官兵和优抚对象代表
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui Visits Troops and Veterans' Representatives in Changchun
articles.summary_zh: 八一建军节前夕，长春市委书记张恩惠走访慰问驻长部队官兵和抗美援朝老战士，强调做好双拥工作。
articles.summary_en: On the eve of Army Day, Zhang Enhui, Secretary of Changchun Municipal Party Committee, visited officers and soldiers stationed in Changchun and a veteran of the Korean War, emphasizing the importance of supporting the military and caring for their families.

articles.title_zh: 庄劲松主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Zhuang Jinsong Chairs Standing Committee Meeting of CPC Changdu Municipal Committee
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，昌都市委书记庄劲松主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神和王沪宁在西藏调研时的讲话精神，研究贯彻工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Zhuang Jinsong, secretary of the CPC Changdu Municipal Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and Wang Huning's remarks during his research trip in Tibet, and to plan implementation.

articles.title_zh: 霍步刚“八一”前夕走访慰问武警部队和参战退役军人
articles.title_en: Huo Bugang Visits Armed Police and Veterans Ahead of Army Day
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，沈阳市委书记霍步刚走访慰问武警部队和参战退役军人，强调传承军爱民民拥军传统，巩固军政军民团结。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Huo Bugang, Secretary of the Shenyang Municipal Party Committee, visited armed police and veterans, stressing military-civilian unity and honoring revolutionary heroes.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记关于上半年经济形势和做好下半年经济工作的重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting to Implement Xi Jinping's Guidance on Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国务院总理李强主持召开国务院常务会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，听取新型电网、物流网建设情况汇报，研究健康优先发展战略，审议通过多项行政法规草案，并核准辽宁庄河等四个核电项目。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting to study Xi Jinping's important speech on the economic situation, review new power grid and logistics network plans, discuss health-first development, approve draft regulations, and greenlight four nuclear power projects including Zhuanghe Phase I.

articles.title_zh: 李强签署国务院令 公布《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Order Promulgating Regulations on Exit-Entry Administration
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强签署国务院令，公布《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》，自2026年9月15日起施行，规范出境入境管理。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council order to promulgate the Regulations on Exit-Entry Administration, effective September 15, 2026, to regulate exit-entry management.

articles.title_zh: 国务院关于出境入境管理的规定
articles.title_en: State Council Regulations on Exit and Entry Administration
articles.summary_zh: 国务院公布第841号令，通过《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》，自2026年9月15日起施行，规范出境入境秩序。
articles.summary_en: The State Council issued Order No.841, adopting the Regulations on Exit and Entry Administration, effective September 15, 2026, to regulate exit-entry order.

articles.title_zh: 国务院印发《知识产权保护和运用“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: State Council Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for IP Protection and Utilization
articles.summary_zh: 国务院印发《知识产权保护和运用“十五五”规划》，部署知识产权创造、运用、保护、管理、服务等任务，提出到2030年知识产权强国建设取得决定性进展。
articles.summary_en: The State Council issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for IP Protection and Utilization, outlining tasks in IP creation, application, protection, management, and services, aiming for decisive progress in building an IP power by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 政策发力提效 推动经济持续向新向优向好发展
articles.title_en: Policy Efforts to Boost Economy for Sustained, High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委7月31日表示，下半年宏观政策将发力提效，确保完成全年预期目标；将协同推进重大工程和“两重”“两新”建设，稳定提振消费，加快人工智能产业布局等。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the National Development and Reform Commission said macro policies will be intensified in H2 to meet annual targets, advance major projects, boost consumption, and accelerate AI development.

articles.title_zh: 我国推动退役军人工作提质增效
articles.title_en: China Promotes Quality and Efficiency of Veterans Affairs
articles.summary_zh: 国务院新闻办公室7月31日举行发布会，退役军人事务部介绍“十五五”时期推动退役军人工作提质增效情况，包括拓宽安置渠道、完善就业创业支持体系等。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the State Council Information Office hosted a press conference where the Ministry of Veterans Affairs introduced plans to enhance veterans work, including wider placement channels and better employment support.

articles.title_zh: 陈文清在全国扫黑除恶专项斗争视频会议上强调 扎实开展深化扫黑除恶专项斗争 努力建设更高水平的平安中国
articles.title_en: Chen Wenqing Stresses Deepening Campaign Against Organized Crime at National Video Conference
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，中共中央政治局委员、中央政法委书记陈文清在全国扫黑除恶专项斗争视频会议上强调，扎实开展为期一年的深化扫黑除恶专项斗争，努力建设更高水平的平安中国。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Chen Wenqing, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, stressed at a national video conference to carry out a one-year campaign to deepen the special fight against organized crime and build a safer China.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在中共中央政治局第二十七次集体学习时强调 强化政治引领 深化创新发展 高质量推进国防和军队现代化
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Stresses Strengthening Political Leadership and Deepening Innovation for High-Quality Modernization of National Defense and Military at 27th Collective Study Session of CPC Central Political Bureau
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局7月30日下午就高质量推进国防和军队现代化进行第二十七次集体学习，习近平主持并发表重要讲话，强调强化政治引领、深化创新发展，如期实现建军一百年奋斗目标。
articles.summary_en: The Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held its 27th collective study session on high-quality modernization of national defense and military on the afternoon of July 30. Xi Jinping presided and delivered an important speech, emphasizing political leadership and innovative development to achieve the centenary goal of the People's Liberation Army.

articles.title_en: State Council Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for IPR Protection and Utilization
articles.summary_zh: 国务院日前印发《知识产权保护和运用“十五五”规划》，明确了“十五五”时期知识产权工作的目标指标、重点任务和12项专项工程。
articles.summary_en: The State Council issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Intellectual Property Protection and Utilization, setting goals, tasks, and 12 special projects for the 2026-2030 period.

articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting

articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting on July 31 to study the spirit of President Xi's remarks on the economy, and approved amendments to regulations and four nuclear power projects.

articles.title_zh: 今年7550亿元中央预算内投资基本下达完毕
articles.title_en: This Year's 755 Billion Yuan Central Budgetary Investment Basically Fully Allocated
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国家发展改革委新闻发布会透露，今年7550亿元中央预算内投资已基本下达完毕；以工代赈资金395亿元，实施项目7800余个，带动150万人就业。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the NDRC press conference revealed that this year's 755 billion yuan central budget investment has been basically fully allocated; 39.5 billion yuan was used for work-relief programs, funding over 7,800 projects and employing 1.5 million people.

articles.title_zh: 推动经济持续向新向优向好发展——从中央政治局会议看下半年经济工作着力点
articles.title_en: Promoting Sustained Economic Progress Towards New, Quality, and Favorable Development: Insights from the Central Politburo Meeting on H2 Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，中共中央政治局召开会议，分析研究当前经济形势，部署下半年经济工作，强调推动经济持续向新向优向好发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held a meeting to analyze the economic situation and arrange work for the second half of the year, emphasizing sustained progress towards new, quality, and favorable economic development.

articles.title_zh: 《工业绿色低碳发展“十五五”规划》发布
articles.title_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Releases 15th Five-Year Plan for Green Low-Carbon Industrial Development
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部7月31日发布《工业绿色低碳发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年工业领域二氧化碳排放达峰，规模以上工业单位增加值能耗下降10%以上等目标。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology released the 15th Five-Year Plan for Green Low-Carbon Industrial Development on July 31, setting targets such as peaking industrial CO2 emissions by 2030 and reducing energy intensity by over 10%.

articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee Politburo Meets to Decide Fifth Plenary Session and Analyze Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局7月30日召开会议，决定今年10月召开二十届五中全会，研究全面从严治党重大问题，分析当前经济形势并部署下半年经济工作。习近平主持会议。
articles.summary_en: The Politburo of the CPC Central Committee met on July 30, deciding to convene the Fifth Plenary Session in October, studying major issues of full and rigorous Party self-governance, analyzing the current economic situation, and deploying H2 economic work. Xi Jinping chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁省委常委会召开议军会议 许昆林主持并讲话

articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，辽宁省委常委会召开议军会议，学习贯彻习近平强军思想，听取省军区及省直部门汇报，研究推动人民武装工作高质量发展。省委书记许昆林主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Liaoning Provincial Party Committee held a military work conference, studying Xi Jinping's thought on strengthening the military, hearing reports from the provincial military command and departments, to promote high-quality development of people's armed forces. Party Secretary Xu Kunlin chaired and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 吴贤德在城区督导检查生态环境保护工作并开展“护河爱水、清洁家园”活动
articles.title_en: Wu Xiande Inspects Eco-Environment Protection Work in Fuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，福州市长吴贤德赴晋安区、鼓楼区督导检查生态环境保护工作，强调落实省生态环保督察问题整改，以高水平保护支撑高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Fuzhou Mayor Wu Xiande visited Jin'an and Gulou districts to inspect eco-environmental protection work, emphasizing rectification of issues identified by provincial inspectors to support high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 关于注销哈密市林业和草原局所属部分事业单位的公告（第一次）
articles.title_en: Hami Forestry and Grassland Bureau Announces Cancellation of Affiliated Public Institution
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月31日，哈密市林业和草原局发布公告，根据《事业单位登记管理暂行条例》，注销哈密市林果业技术推广中心。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, 2026, Hami Forestry and Grassland Bureau announced the cancellation of Hami Forest Fruit Technology Promotion Center in accordance with the Regulations on the Registration Management of Public Institutions.

articles.title_zh: 邓维元主持召开全市强降雨防范工作视频调度会议
articles.title_en: Deng Weiyuan Chairs Citywide Video Dispatch Meeting on Heavy Rainfall Prevention
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，鹤岗市市长邓维元主持召开全市强降雨防范工作视频调度会议，强调做好防汛救灾准备，保障人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Deng Weiyuan, Mayor of Hegang, chaired a citywide video dispatch meeting on heavy rainfall prevention, emphasizing comprehensive flood control preparations to protect people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市人民政府 市政协党组理论学习中心组学习会和主席办公会召开
articles.title_en: Huai'an Municipal CPPCC Party Group Holds Theoretical Learning Center Group Meeting and Chairman's Office Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，淮安市政协党组理论学习中心组学习会和主席办公会召开，市政协党组书记、主席赵正兰主持会议并讲话，强调树立正确政绩观，部署下一阶段重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Huai'an Municipal CPPCC Party Group held its theoretical learning center group meeting and chairman's office meeting. Zhao Zhenglan, Party Group Secretary and Chairman, presided over and delivered a speech, emphasizing a correct view of political achievements and deploying next-stage key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会党组理论学习中心组学习会、主任月度办公会召开
articles.title_en: Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Party Group Holds Theoretical Learning Center Group Meeting and Monthly Director's Office Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，淮安市人大常委会党组理论学习中心组学习会、主任月度办公会召开，周青主持会议并讲话，传达学习习近平党建文选等精神，部署下一阶段重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Party Group of the Standing Committee of Huai'an Municipal People's Congress held a theoretical learning center group meeting and monthly director's office meeting. Zhou Qing chaired and addressed the meeting, conveying the spirit of Xi Jinping's Party building anthology and other documents, and deploying key tasks for the next stage.

articles.title_zh: 淮安举行“双高协同”产学研对接活动暨火炬科技成果直通车
articles.title_en: Huai'an Holds Industry-Academia-Research Matching Event and Torch Sci-Tech Achievements Express
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，淮安举行“双高协同”产学研对接活动，市委书记史志军致辞，院士沈政昌作主旨演讲，现场签约重点合作项目并启动火炬科技成果直通车。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Huai'an held an industry-academia-research matching event. Municipal Party Secretary Shi Zhijun addressed the meeting, academician Shen Zhengchang delivered a keynote speech, key cooperation projects were signed, and the Torch Sci-Tech Achievements Express was launched.

articles.title_zh: 双高协同·校（院）企双进产学研对接活动淮安专场举行
articles.title_en: Huaian Hosts Industry-University-Research Matchmaking Event

articles.summary_en: On July 30, Huaian hosted an industry-university-research matchmaking event. City Party Secretary Shi Zhijun addressed the event, and CAE academician Shen Zhengchang delivered a keynote speech to promote tech transfer.

articles.title_zh: 韦朝晖主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Wei Zhaohui Chairs Meeting of Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日下午，怀化市委书记韦朝晖主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记对基础教育和侨务工作的重要指示精神，研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 30, Wei Zhaohui, Secretary of the Huaihua Municipal Party Committee, chaired a meeting of the Standing Committee of the Municipal Party Committee to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on basic education and overseas Chinese affairs, and to study implementation opinions.

articles.title_zh: 韦朝晖贺遵庆走访慰问驻怀部队官兵

articles.summary_en: On July 29-30, Wei Zhaohui, secretary of Huaihua Municipal Party Committee, and He Zunqing, deputy secretary, visited garrison troops to extend holiday greetings and respect.

articles.title_zh: 于海田主持召开市政府常务会议

articles.title_zh: 福州市“八一”军政座谈会举行

articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，福州市举行“八一”军政座谈会，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁与市长吴贤德走访慰问驻榕部队并出席，共叙军民鱼水情，共商军地新发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Fuzhou held a military-civilian symposium for Army Day. Guo Ningning, Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Party Secretary of Fuzhou, and Mayor Wu Xiande visited stationed troops and attended the meeting to promote military-civilian unity.

articles.title_zh: 市委召开上半年工作会议
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee Holds Mid-Year Work Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，福州召开市委上半年工作会议，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁出席并讲话，强调坚定信心、攻坚三季度、决胜全年红，市长吴贤德主持并部署工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Fuzhou held its mid-year municipal party committee work meeting. Guo Ningning, deputy secretary of the provincial party committee and municipal party secretary, stressed confidence and striving for a strong second half, while Mayor Wu Xiande presided and outlined tasks.

articles.title_zh: 吴贤德在城区督导检查生态环境保护工作并开展“护河爱水、清洁家园”活动
articles.title_en: Wu Xiande Inspects Eco-Environmental Protection Work in Urban Fuzhou and Launches 'River Care and Clean Home' Activity
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，福州市长吴贤德在晋安区、鼓楼区督导检查生态环保督察问题整改，并开展“护河爱水、清洁家园”活动，强调以高水平保护支撑高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Fuzhou Mayor Wu Xiande inspected rectification of ecological and environmental issues in Jin'an and Gulou districts and launched a 'River Care and Clean Home' campaign, stressing high-level protection to support high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: "博创八闽"绿色低碳与新能源专场在厦举行
articles.title_en: 'Bo Chuang Ba Min' Green Low-Carbon and New Energy Special Session Held in Xiamen
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日至30日，绿色低碳与新能源专场对接活动在厦门嘉庚创新实验室举行，100余人参会，征集31个优质项目，多家企业达成初步合作意向。
articles.summary_en: From July 29 to 30, the 'Bo Chuang Ba Min' monthly matchmaking event on green low-carbon and new energy was held at Jiageng Innovation Laboratory in Xiamen, attracting over 100 participants. 31 quality projects were collected, and several companies reached preliminary cooperation intentions.

articles.title_zh: 中斯友谊之树根深叶茂
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Slovak President, Vowing to Deepen Strategic Partnership
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，习近平主席在人民大会堂同斯洛伐克总统佩列格里尼举行会谈，强调打造中斯战略伙伴关系。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, President Xi Jinping held talks with Slovak President Pellegrini at the Great Hall of the People, vowing to build a China-Slovakia strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 济滨、济枣高铁建设有序推进 济南“米字型”高铁网加快成形
articles.title_en: Jinan-Binzhou and Jinan-Zaozhuang High-Speed Rail Construction Advances, Jinan's 'Spoke-Shaped' Network Takes Shape
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，山东省省长周乃翔在济南、滨州调研铁路建设，要求保障济滨高铁年内通车，加快济枣等高铁项目建设。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Shandong Governor Zhou Naixiang visited Jinan and Binzhou to inspect railway projects, urging timely opening of the Jinan-Binzhou HSR and faster progress on other lines.

articles.title_zh: 奔腾中国·质胜未来丨既要“放得活”，又要“管得好”
articles.title_en: Galloping China · Quality Wins the Future | A Balance of 'Letting Go' and 'Managing Well'
articles.summary_zh: 市场监管总局在7省市开展强制清算试点推动“僵尸企业”退出，文章阐述既要“放得活”又要“管得好”，构建高水平市场经济体制。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation launched a pilot in seven provinces to force liquidation of 'zombie companies', illustrating the balance between an effective market and a proactive government.

articles.title_zh: 趵眼丨一束光和一颗星，照见济南向上生长的力量
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Tours High-Tech, Satellite Firms and University in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日至29日，山东省委书记林武在济南调研邦德激光、济南卫星、山东科技大市场、山东大学，强调产业、科技、创新一体化推进。
articles.summary_en: From July 28 to 29, Shandong Party Secretary Lin Wu visited Bond Laser, Jinan Satellite, Shandong S&T Market and Shandong University in Jinan, stressing integrated industrial and technological innovation.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能、“六张网”……这些产业澎湃中国经济新动能
articles.title_en: AI and 'Six Networks' Inject New Momentum into China's Economy
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委7月新闻发布会介绍，109项重大工程加快实施，人工智能产业保持30%以上增长，7550亿元中央预算内投资基本下达。
articles.summary_en: At the July press conference, the NDRC said 109 major projects are accelerating, AI industry grew over 30%, and 755 billion yuan of central budget investment has been basically allocated.

articles.title_zh: 王晓晖施小琳于立军率省委省政府慰问团走访慰问驻川部队
articles.title_en: Wang Xiaohui, Shi Xiaolin, and Yu Lijun Lead Provincial Delegation to Visit Troops in Sichuan
articles.summary_zh: 在建军99周年之际，四川省委书记王晓晖、省长施小琳、省委副书记于立军率慰问团走访驻川部队，向官兵致以节日问候。
articles.summary_en: On the occasion of the 99th anniversary of the PLA, Sichuan Provincial Party Secretary Wang Xiaohui, Governor Shi Xiaolin, and Deputy Party Secretary Yu Lijun led a delegation to visit troops stationed in Sichuan, extending holiday greetings.

articles.summary_en: On July 28, President Xi Jinping held talks with Slovak President Pellegrini at the Great Hall of the People, discussing the development of China-Slovakia strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 中马各界探讨人工智能赋能经贸合作新机遇
articles.title_en: Chinese and Malaysian Sectors Discuss New Opportunities for AI-Empowered Economic and Trade Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 2026陆海财经论坛7月30日在吉隆坡举行，中马政商学界代表探讨人工智能赋能产业升级与经贸合作新机遇。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Land-Sea Financial and Economic Forum was held in Kuala Lumpur on July 30, where Chinese and Malaysian political, business, and academic representatives discussed AI-empowered industrial upgrading and new opportunities for economic and trade cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 外交部回应日本设立“国家情报局”：日方应深刻汲取历史教训 慎重行事
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Responds to Japan's Establishment of 'National Intelligence Agency': Japan Should Learn from History and Act with Caution
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，外交部发言人毛宁就日本正式设立“国家情报局”回应称，日方应深刻汲取历史教训，慎重行事。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning responded to Japan's establishment of a 'National Intelligence Agency', saying Japan should learn from historical lessons and act prudently.

articles.title_zh: 用好机遇优势 克服困难挑战——国家发展改革委解读当前经济热点
articles.title_en: Seize Opportunities, Overcome Challenges: NDRC Interprets Current Economic Hotspots
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委7月31日举行新闻发布会，解读上半年经济形势，介绍'六张网'建设、扩大内需和能源发展等政策举措。
articles.summary_en: The NDRC held a press conference on July 31 to interpret H1 economic performance and explain plans for infrastructure networks, domestic demand expansion, and energy development.

articles.title_zh: 国家发改委发布会：下半年经济工作释放重要信号

articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国家发展改革委举行新闻发布会，表示我国经济长期向好趋势未变，将抓紧研究制定扩大内需战略实施方案，围绕提振消费、激发投资等发力。
articles.summary_en: At a July 31 press conference, NDRC said China's long-term economic fundamentals remain unchanged and will draft a strategy to boost domestic demand, focusing on consumption and investment.

articles.title_zh: 不断推动退役军人工作高质量发展——国新办发布会展望“十五五”时期退役军人工作发展前景
articles.title_en: Press Conference Outlines High-Quality Development of Veterans Affairs During 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国务院新闻办公室举行发布会，退役军人事务部部长裴金佳等介绍“十五五”时期退役军人工作高质量发展情况，涵盖安置就业、服务保障、优抚双拥等内容。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the State Council Information Office held a press conference where veterans affairs officials outlined plans for high-quality development of veterans work during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, covering placement, employment, services, and support.

articles.title_zh: 金沙水拍云崖暖：云南推动长征精神与长江文化交融共生
articles.title_en: Yunnan Promotes Integration of Long March Spirit and Yangtze River Culture
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，云南依托金沙江沿线的红色遗址，推动长征精神与长江文化融合，建设长征国家文化公园，推出文旅研学路线。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Yunnan promoted the integration of Long March spirit and Yangtze River culture along the Jinsha River, building a national cultural park and launching cultural tourism routes.

articles.title_zh: 柔性“电子皮肤”填补机器人“感知盲区”
articles.title_en: Flexible 'Electronic Skin' Bridges Robot Perception Gap
articles.summary_zh: 浙江清华柔性电子技术研究院研发柔性触觉感知末端，实现“电子皮肤”量产，填补机器人具身智能感知盲区，推动人工智能产业发展。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang Tsinghua Flexible Electronics Technology Research Institute developed a flexible tactile sensing terminal, achieving mass production of 'electronic skin' that fills the perception gap in embodied AI robots, advancing the AI industry.

articles.summary_zh: 斯洛伐克总统佩列格里尼首次对中国进行国事访问，称中国十年巨变令人震撼。
articles.summary_en: Slovak President Pellegrini made his first state visit to China, saying he was impressed by China's great changes over the past decade.

articles.title_zh: 00后“数采员”：给具身智能机器人当“老师”
articles.title_en: Post-00s Data Collectors: Teaching Embodied Intelligent Robots
articles.summary_zh: 00后年轻人担任具身智能机器人数据采集员，为机器人提供动作示范；清华柔电院现有近300名数采员。
articles.summary_en: Post-00s youth work as data collectors for embodied intelligent robots, demonstrating actions for robots; the Tsinghua Flexible Electronics Research Institute has nearly 300 such collectors.

articles.title_zh: 细读经济大省半年报：两省上半年GDP首次突破7万亿元
articles.title_en: Two Provinces Break 7-Trillion-Yuan GDP in H1, Economic Powerhouses' Reports Show
articles.summary_zh: 2026年上半年，广东、江苏等6个经济大省经济数据发布，广东、江苏GDP首次突破7万亿元，新兴产业增长强劲。
articles.summary_en: In H1 2026, six major economic provinces released data; Guangdong and Jiangsu's GDP exceeded 7 trillion yuan for the first time, with robust growth in emerging industries.

articles.title_zh: 信长星走访慰问驻苏部队子弟兵
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing Visits and Comforts Troops in Jiangsu

articles.summary_en: On the eve of Army Day, Jiangsu Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing visited an air force unit of the Eastern Theater Command to extend greetings to the troops on behalf of the provincial government and encourage them to achieve new merits.

articles.title_zh: AI时代，主流媒体如何孵化爆款IP？
articles.title_en: How Can Mainstream Media Cultivate Viral IPs in the AI Era?
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，由上海报业集团澎湃新闻主办的“逐浪·共生”2026外滩新媒体学术交流在上海举行，多家主流媒体代表探讨AI时代打造爆款IP的方法论。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the 2026 Bund New Media Academic Exchange hosted by The Paper (Shanghai Media Group) was held in Shanghai, where representatives from major media outlets discussed methodologies for creating viral IPs in the AI era.

articles.summary_en: On July 31, the 2026 Bund New Media Academic Exchange hosted by The Paper (Shanghai United Media Group) was held in Shanghai, where deans from four universities discussed communication ecology and media roles amid the AI wave.

articles.title_zh: 三部门负责人就《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》答记者问

articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强签署第841号国务院令，公布《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》，自2026年9月15日起施行，司法部、公安部、国家移民局负责人就规定答记者问。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed State Council Order No. 841, promulgating the Regulation on Exit-Entry Administration, effective September 15, 2026. Heads of the Ministry of Justice, Ministry of Public Security, and National Immigration Administration answered questions on the regulation.

articles.title_zh: 国防部举办盛大招待会，热烈庆祝中国人民解放军建军99周年

articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国防部在北京人民大会堂举行招待会庆祝建军99周年，国防部长董军出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Ministry of National Defense held a reception at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing to celebrate the 99th anniversary of the PLA, with Defense Minister Dong Jun attending and delivering a speech.

articles.title_en: CCDI and National Supervisory Commission Hold Further Meeting on Rectifying Misconduct and Corruption
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，中央纪委国家监委召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记关于集中整治工作的重要批示精神，对集中整治再调度再推动，刘金国出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the CCDI and National Supervisory Commission held a meeting to convey Xi Jinping's instructions on intensifying the campaign against misconduct and corruption, with Liu Jinguo attending and speaking.

articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Quantum Technology Committee of Anhui Provincial Science and Industry Innovation Association was established in Hefei, releasing the first provincial-level financial product system for the quantum industry.

articles.title_zh: 重庆通过两项立法护航科技创新

articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Standing Committee of the Chongqing Municipal People's Congress approved two laws on scientific and technological innovation, effective from September 1 and October 1, to support innovation through legislation.

articles.title_en: Chronicle of Pengshui Mountain Collapse Rescue

articles.summary_en: On July 17, a mountain collapse hit Hanjia Street, Pengshui County. Xi Jinping issued important instructions, Li Qiang made instructions, and Zhang Guoqing guided on site. Chongqing carried out rescue and safely evacuated over 1,100 people.
