articles.title_zh: 南宁推出住房公积金“组合拳”促消费
articles.title_en: Nanning Introduces Housing Provident Fund Measures to Boost Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，南宁住房公积金管理委员会发布新政策，推出装修提取、车位购买、贷款提额、租房支持等六大惠民举措，自8月1日起实施，支持刚性和改善性住房需求。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the Nanning Housing Provident Fund Management Committee issued new policies covering decoration withdrawal, parking space purchase, loan limits, and rental support, effective from August 1, to support rigid and improved housing needs.

tags.name_zh: 南宁住房公积金管理委员会
tags.name_en: Nanning Housing Provident Fund Management Committee

tags_zh: 南宁住房公积金管理委员会
tags_en: Nanning Housing Provident Fund Management Committee

articles.title_zh: 黎平推出系列夏季文旅体活动激活夏日消费
articles.title_en: Liping Launches Summer Cultural and Tourism Activities to Boost Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，黎平古城翘街举行“叮叮糖”主题音乐会，该县以此为契机推出系列夏季文旅体活动，涵盖音乐会、篮球赛、村歌展演、农博展销等，以激活县域消费活力。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, a "Dingdingtang" themed concert was held at Qiaojie Street in Liping ancient town. The county launched a series of summer cultural and sports activities, including concerts, basketball games, village song performances, and agricultural expos, to boost local consumption.

articles.title_zh: 2026年“奔跑吧·少年”全国青少年阳光体育大会在郑州开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 'Run, Youth' National Youth Sunshine Sports Conference Opens in Zhengzhou
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日晚，2026年“奔跑吧·少年”全国青少年阳光体育大会在郑州开幕，国家体育总局局长高志丹与河南省委书记刘宁共同启动开幕，省长王凯出席。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of July 30, the 2026 'Run, Youth' National Youth Sunshine Sports Conference opened in Zhengzhou. Gao Zhidan, Director of the General Administration of Sport, and Liu Ning, Secretary of the Henan Provincial Party Committee jointly launched the event; Governor Wang Kai attended.

tags.name_en: General Administration of Sport of China

tags_en: General Administration of Sport of China

articles.title_zh: 刘宁“八一”前夕走访慰问驻豫部队
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Visits Troops Stationed in Henan Ahead of Army Day
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，河南省委书记刘宁到开封市走访慰问驻豫部队，代表省委省政府向广大官兵致以节日祝贺和诚挚问候。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Liu Ning, Secretary of Henan Provincial Party Committee, visited troops in Kaifeng, expressing holiday greetings and sincere regards on behalf of the provincial party committee and government.

articles.title_zh: 两部门部署区划地名文物名录建设试点
articles.title_en: Two Departments Deploy Pilot Program for Building Cultural Relics List of Administrative Place Names
articles.summary_zh: 民政部办公厅与国家文物局办公室近日联合印发通知，开展区划地名文物名录建设试点，计划在全国遴选15个左右试点地区。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of the Ministry of Civil Affairs and the General Office of the National Cultural Heritage Administration recently issued a notice to carry out pilot work on building a list of cultural relics related to administrative divisions and place names, selecting about 15 pilot areas nationwide.

tags.name_en: General Office of the Ministry of Civil Affairs
Cultural Relics of Administrative Divisions and Place Names

tags_en: General Office of the Ministry of Civil Affairs
Cultural Relics of Administrative Divisions and Place Names

articles.title_zh: 点石成金的河南魔法
articles.title_en: Henan's Magic of Turning Stone into Gold
articles.summary_zh: 河南立足矿产资源优势，推动钨钛、铜基材料、先进钢铁等产业升级，多家上市企业半年报业绩大涨，实现“点石成金”的转型发展。
articles.summary_en: Henan leverages its mineral resources to upgrade industries such as tungsten, copper-based materials, and advanced steel. Several listed companies reported doubled profits in half-year results, showcasing a transformation from raw resources to high-value products.

articles.title_zh: 上海建设6G未来产业培育区，探索新一代通信网应用场景
articles.title_en: Shanghai Builds 6G Future Industry Cultivation Zone to Explore New-Generation Communication Network Applications
articles.summary_zh: 上海松江区建设6G未来产业培育区，以6G信通智谷为核心，集聚产业链企业，探索6G技术应用场景，推动万物智联落地。
articles.summary_en: Shanghai's Songjiang District is building a 6G future industry cultivation zone centered on the 6G Infocom Valley, gathering industry chain enterprises to explore 6G application scenarios and advance the Internet of Everything.

articles.title_zh: 牢固树立和践行正确政绩观在高标准建设海南自由贸易港新征程中奋勇前进
articles.title_en: Firmly Establish and Practice Correct View of Political Achievements to Strive Forward on New Journey of High-Standard Construction of Hainan Free Trade Port
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，海南省委八届九次全会在海口召开，审议通过关于民主集中制和建设生态环境友好型自由贸易港的意见，省委书记冯飞讲话，强调树立和践行正确政绩观。
articles.summary_en: The 9th Plenary Session of the 8th Hainan Provincial Committee of the CPC was held in Haikou on July 30, reviewing and approving opinions on democratic centralism and building an eco-friendly free trade port. Secretary Feng Fei called for establishing a correct view of political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲：坚定不移抓招商上项目 塑造发展新动能新优势
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Stresses Firm Commitment to Investment and Projects for New Growth Momentum
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，黑龙江省省长梁惠玲在双鸭山市宝清县召开的省招商引资领导小组调度会上强调，要坚定不移抓招商上项目，培育新质生产力，塑造发展新动能新优势。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Governor Liang Huiling of Heilongjiang stressed at a meeting in Baoqing County, Shuangyashan, firm commitment to investment and projects to foster new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省发布“龙江农知大模型”
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Releases 'Longjiang Agricultural Knowledge AI Model'
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，“龙江农知大模型”在哈尔滨正式发布，该模型由省农科院与中国农科院农业信息研究所共同研发，旨在服务黑龙江省现代农业发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the 'Longjiang Agricultural Knowledge AI Model' was officially released in Harbin, jointly developed by Heilongjiang Academy of Agricultural Sciences and the Agricultural Information Institute of CAAS, aiming to support modern agriculture.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省召开食品安全突出问题整治会议
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Holds Meeting on Addressing Outstanding Food Safety Issues
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，黑龙江省召开食品安全突出问题整治会议，总结年初以来食品安全工作，部署下一步重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Heilongjiang Province held a meeting on food safety rectification, summarizing work since the beginning of the year and deploying key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 淮安发布产业工人大轮训实施方案
articles.title_en: Huaian Issues Implementation Plan for Large-Scale Training of Industrial Workers
articles.summary_zh: 淮安市总工会等八部门联合印发《淮安产业工人大轮训实施方案（2026—2030年）》，每年培训产业工人不少于20万人次，成为江苏首个落地该任务的设区市。
articles.summary_en: Huaian's trade union and seven other departments issued a plan to train industrial workers, aiming at no less than 200,000 trainees annually, making Huaian the first city in Jiangsu to implement the provincial task.

articles.title_zh: 江苏人工智能产业上半年营收超2400亿元
articles.title_en: Jiangsu AI Industry Revenue Exceeds 240 Billion Yuan in H1
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，江苏省十四届人大常委会第二十三次会议审议省政府关于全面推动人工智能创新发展情况的报告。上半年全省人工智能产业营业收入2431.13亿元，同比增长17.32%。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Jiangsu's 14th Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee reviewed a government report on AI development, showing H1 2026 revenue of 243.113 billion yuan, up 17.32% year-on-year.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省人工智能产业联盟在南京成立
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Establishes AI Industry Alliance in Nanjing
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，江苏省人工智能产业联盟在南京成立，由240余家单位共同发起，并发布重点服务商推荐目录。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Jiangsu Artificial Intelligence Industry Alliance was established in Nanjing, initiated by over 240 organizations, with a recommended service provider list released.

articles.title_zh: 江苏发布全国首个OPC知识产权合规指引
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues Nation's First OPC IP Compliance Guidelines
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，江苏省知识产权局等三部门联合发布全国首个省级OPC知识产权合规指引，为人工智能“一人公司”提供知识产权合规指南。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, three Jiangsu provincial departments jointly issued the nation's first provincial-level OPC IP compliance guidelines, providing IP compliance guidance for AI 'one-person companies'.

articles.title_zh: 江西省领导“军事日”活动暨省委理论学习中心组集体学习举行
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Leaders Hold Military Day Event and Party Committee Theory Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，江西省领导“军事日”活动暨省委理论学习中心组集体学习在南昌举行，省委书记尹弘主持并讲话，强调深入学习贯彻习近平强军思想。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Jiangxi provincial leaders held a 'Military Day' activity and the Party Committee Theoretical Learning Center group study in Nanchang. Provincial Party Secretary Yin Hong presided and stressed implementing Xi Jinping's thought on strengthening the military.

tags.name_en: Xi Jinping Thought on Strengthening the Military

tags_en: Xi Jinping Thought on Strengthening the Military

articles.title_zh: “神农”从云端走向地头
articles.title_en: 'Shennong' Moves from Cloud to Farmland
articles.summary_zh: 中国农业大学团队发布神农大模型4.0和农业世界模型1.0，人工智能赋能农业，推动农业现代化。
articles.summary_en: China Agricultural University team released Shennong AI model 4.0 and agricultural world model 1.0, boosting AI-enabled agriculture and modernization.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Party Standing Committee of Autonomous Region Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，自治区党委常委会召开会议，传达学习全国党校校长会议精神，听取全面从严治党、公安工作等汇报，部署相关工作。自治区党委书记王伟中主持。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Standing Committee of the CPC Autonomous Regional Committee held a meeting to convey the spirit of the national conference of party school principals and hear reports on full and strict party governance and public security work. Wang Weizhong, Party secretary of the region, presided.

articles.title_zh: 包钢向自治区人大常委会组成人员和部分人大代表通报上半年全区经济社会发展情况
articles.title_en: Bao Gang Briefs Autonomous Regional People's Congress Standing Committee Members and Deputies on H1 Economic and Social Development
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日下午，自治区党委副书记、政府主席包钢向自治区人大常委会组成人员和部分人大代表通报上半年全区经济社会发展情况，并提出下半年重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 29, Bao Gang, Deputy Secretary of the Regional Party Committee and Chairman of the Regional Government, briefed members of the Standing Committee of the Regional People's Congress and some deputies on the economic and social development in the first half of the year, outlining key tasks for the second half.

articles.title_zh: 河北省委主要负责同志职务调整
articles.title_en: Personnel Adjustment of Hebei Provincial Party Committee Leadership
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央决定，罗文任河北省委书记；倪岳峰不再担任河北省委书记，另有任用。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee has decided that Luo Wen will serve as Secretary of the Hebei Provincial Party Committee, succeeding Ni Yuefeng who has been transferred to another post.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在中共中央政治局第二十七次集体学习时强调 强化政治引领 深化创新发展 高质量推进国防和军队现代化
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Chairs 27th Collective Study Session of CPC Central Political Bureau on National Defense and Military Modernization
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日下午，中共中央政治局就高质量推进国防和军队现代化进行第二十七次集体学习，习近平主持并发表重要讲话，强调强化政治引领、深化创新发展，如期实现建军一百年奋斗目标。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 30, the 27th collective study session of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee on high-quality advancement of national defense and military modernization was held, chaired by Xi Jinping, who stressed political guidance and innovative development.

articles.title_zh: 决定召开二十届五中全会 分析研究当前经济形势和经济工作
articles.title_en: Political Bureau Decides to Convene Fifth Plenary Session, Analyzes Economic Situation
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局7月30日召开会议，决定今年10月召开二十届五中全会，研究全面从严治党，并分析经济形势部署下半年经济工作。习近平主持会议。
articles.summary_en: The Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee met on July 30, deciding to hold the Fifth Plenary Session in October, studied full and strict party governance, and analyzed the economic situation to arrange work for H2. Xi Jinping presided over the meeting.

tags.name_en: Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee

tags_en: Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 吴晓军罗东川等省领导在“八一”前夕看望慰问驻青部队
articles.title_en: Provincial Leaders Wu Xiaojun and Luo Dongchuan Visit Troops in Qinghai before Army Day
articles.summary_zh: 八一前夕，青海省委书记吴晓军、省长罗东川等省领导看望慰问驻青部队，向官兵致以节日问候。
articles.summary_en: On the eve of Army Day, Qinghai Provincial Party Secretary Wu Xiaojun and Governor Luo Dongchuan visited troops stationed in Qinghai and extended festive greetings to officers and soldiers.

tags.name_en: Unity between the Army and the People

tags_en: Unity between the Army and the People

articles.title_zh: 任命韩海宏为青海省退役军人事务厅厅长
articles.title_en: Han Haihong Appointed Director of Qinghai Provincial Veterans Affairs Department
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，青海省十四届人大常委会第二十三次会议决定任命韩海宏为省退役军人事务厅厅长，免去刘海宁该职务。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Standing Committee of Qinghai Provincial People's Congress appointed Han Haihong as director of the Provincial Veterans Affairs Department, replacing Liu Haining.

articles.title_zh: 四川省2026年“情系国防”优秀典型在蓉发布
articles.title_en: Sichuan Releases 2026 'Devoted to National Defense' Outstanding Models in Chengdu
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，四川省2026年“情系国防”优秀典型发布仪式在成都举行，省委常委、宣传部部长郑莉出席并颁发荣誉证书，选树20名优秀典型。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the release ceremony for Sichuan's 2026 'Devoted to National Defense' outstanding models was held in Chengdu. Zheng Li, member of the Standing Committee of the Sichuan Provincial Party Committee and head of its Publicity Department, attended and presented certificates, with 20 models selected.

tags.name_en: Publicity Department of the CPC Sichuan Provincial Committee

tags_en: Publicity Department of the CPC Sichuan Provincial Committee

articles.title_zh: 总体国家安全观主题宣讲展演活动在成都举行
articles.title_en: Themed Presentation and Performance on Holistic National Security Concept Held in Chengdu
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，总体国家安全观主题宣讲展演活动在成都举行，四川省委副书记、政法委书记于立军出席并会见宣讲员。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, a national security themed event was held in Chengdu; Yu Lijun, deputy secretary of Sichuan and head of its political-legal commission, attended and met participants.

articles.title_zh: 四川召开整治形式主义为基层减负专项工作机制会议
articles.title_en: Sichuan Holds Meeting on Reducing Burdens on Grassroots
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，四川省整治形式主义为基层减负专项工作机制2026年第三次会议在成都召开，省委常委、秘书长田庆盈出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Sichuan held the third meeting of its special mechanism on reducing burdens on grassroots units, attended by provincial leader Tian Qingying.

articles.title_zh: 山东省退役军人代表座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Shandong Holds Symposium for Veterans' Representatives
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，山东省退役军人代表座谈会在济南召开，省委书记林武讲话，省长周乃翔主持，强调做好退役军人服务保障，激励退役军人投身现代化建设。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, a symposium for veterans' representatives was held in Jinan, Shandong. Party Secretary Lin Wu spoke and Governor Zhou Naixiang presided, emphasizing service and support for veterans.

articles.title_zh: 推进超大城市新型电力系统建设
articles.title_en: Shanghai Pushes Forward Construction of New-Type Power System for Megacity
articles.summary_zh: 上海市长龚正昨日开展上海能源发展“十五五”规划专项调研，并出席蒙电入沪过江工程建设动员会，强调加快超大城市新型电力系统建设。
articles.summary_en: Shanghai Mayor Gong Zheng conducted a special research on the city's 15th Five-Year Plan for energy development and attended the mobilization meeting for the Mengdian-to-Shanghai cross-river project, emphasizing acceleration of new-type power system construction in the megacity.

articles.title_zh: 上海社会科学院揭牌成立区域国别研究院
articles.title_en: Shanghai Academy of Social Sciences Inaugurates Institute of Area and Country Studies
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，上海社会科学院区域国别研究院揭牌仪式暨“东南亚新态势与中国企业出海”学术研讨会在上海举行，权衡等出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Shanghai Academy of Social Sciences inaugurated its Institute of Area and Country Studies and held a seminar on "New Trends in Southeast Asia and Chinese Enterprises Going Global" in Shanghai.

articles.title_zh: 万物智联，加速照进现实
articles.title_en: Internet of Everything Accelerates into Reality
articles.summary_zh: 上海松江区建设6G未来产业培育区，探索新一代通信网应用场景，推动万物智联发展，计划2030年产业规模突破千亿元。
articles.summary_en: Shanghai's Songjiang District is building a 6G future industry cultivation zone to explore new-generation communication network application scenarios, promoting the Internet of Everything with a plan to exceed 100 billion yuan by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 上海举行政法领导干部专题研讨班 朱忠明授课
articles.title_en: Zhu Zhongming Lectures at Shanghai Political and Legal Cadre Seminar
articles.summary_zh: 2026年度上海政法领导干部专题研讨班7月30日至31日举行，市委副书记、政法委书记朱忠明授课，强调建设德才兼备的高素质上海政法队伍。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Shanghai Political and Legal Leading Cadre Seminar was held from July 30 to 31. Zhu Zhongming, Deputy Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Committee and Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission, gave a lecture, emphasizing building a high-quality political and legal team with both integrity and ability.

articles.title_zh: 上海文旅大数据发布 多元客群叠加文旅活力持续释放
articles.title_en: Shanghai Releases Cultural Tourism Data Report, Diverse Visitor Groups Drive Momentum
articles.summary_zh: 上海市文化和旅游局发布《上海文旅大数据分析报告》，显示2026年上半年上海接待游客3.13亿人次，同比增长17.60%，全要素旅游消费交易总额达5433.26亿元，同比增长8.75%。
articles.summary_en: Shanghai Municipal Administration of Culture and Tourism released the Cultural Tourism Big Data Analysis Report, showing 313 million tourists in H1 2026, up 17.60% YoY, with total tourism consumption reaching 543.326 billion yuan, up 8.75% YoY.

tags.name_en: Shanghai Municipal Administration of Culture and Tourism

tags_en: Shanghai Municipal Administration of Culture and Tourism

articles.title_zh: 《国家应对气候变化“十五五”规划》印发
articles.title_en: National Climate Change 15th Five-Year Plan Issued
articles.summary_zh: 生态环境部等部门近日联合印发《国家应对气候变化“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年单位GDP二氧化碳排放较2025年降低17%。
articles.summary_en: Several ministries including the Ministry of Ecology and Environment recently issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Addressing Climate Change, aiming to reduce CO2 emissions per unit of GDP by 17% by 2030 compared to 2025.

articles.title_zh: 新疆党委常委会召开会议 研究部署自治区科技创新和巡视整改工作
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting on Sci-Tech Innovation and Inspection Rectification
articles.summary_zh: 新疆维吾尔自治区党委常委会7月30日召开会议，自治区党委书记陈小江主持，研究部署科技创新、巡视整改等工作。
articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of the Xinjiang Party Committee held a meeting on July 30, chaired by Chen Xiaojiang, to study and arrange work on sci-tech innovation and inspection rectification.

articles.title_zh: 王君正主持召开自治区党委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Chairs Meeting of Regional Party Committee Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，自治区党委书记王君正主持召开自治区党委常委会会议，学习习近平党建思想及正确政绩观重要指示精神。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Wang Junzheng, secretary of the regional Party committee, chaired a meeting of the standing committee to study Xi Jinping's thought on Party building and key instructions on establishing a correct view of political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 物流效能提升，支撑产业发展
articles.title_en: Logistics Efficiency Gains Support Industrial Development
articles.summary_zh: 上半年全国社会物流总额181.1万亿元，同比增长5.1%；社会物流总费用与GDP比率为13.9%，物流效能提升，支撑产业发展。
articles.summary_en: In H1, China's total social logistics value reached 181.1 trillion yuan, up 5.1% year-on-year; total logistics costs as a share of GDP stood at 13.9%. Improved logistics efficiency supports industrial development.

articles.title_zh: 长三角（嘉兴）Token运营中心正式启动
articles.title_en: Yangtze River Delta (Jiaxing) Token Operations Center Officially Launched
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，长三角（嘉兴）Token运营中心在嘉兴启动，旨在将算力优势转化为实体经济增长动能，推动AI规模化落地。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Yangtze River Delta (Jiaxing) Token Operations Center was launched in Jiaxing to convert computing power advantages into real economic growth and promote large-scale AI application.

articles.title_zh: 浙江出台《政府规章“立改废”评价工作指引》
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Issues Guidelines for Evaluating Government Rules

articles.summary_en: Zhejiang recently issued guidelines introducing a quantitative evaluation system for government rules, covering their creation, amendment, and abolition, to improve legislative quality and governance.

articles.title_zh: 北京市政府召开常务会议 研究首都环境建设管理等事项 市长殷勇主持会议
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal Government Holds Executive Meeting on Urban Environment Management
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日下午，北京市政府召开常务会议，研究首都环境建设管理、垃圾分类、病有所医、国际赛事名城建设等事项，市长殷勇主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Beijing Municipal Government held an executive meeting chaired by Mayor Yin Yong to discuss urban environment management, waste sorting, healthcare, and international sports city development.

articles.title_zh: 反映新时代全面从严治党壮阔实践的鲜活教材
articles.title_en: A Vivid Textbook Reflecting the Great Practice of Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance in the New Era
articles.summary_zh: 文章评论《习近平党建文选》第一卷、第二卷，论述新时代全面从严治党壮阔实践，强调全面从严治党是党的建设鲜明主题，并阐述健全全面从严治党体系。
articles.summary_en: This article reviews Volumes I and II of Xi Jinping's Selected Works on Party Building, highlighting the great practice of full and rigorous Party self-governance in the new era, emphasizing it as the defining theme of Party building, and elaborating on improving the Party self-governance system.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在中共中央政治局第二十七次集体学习时强调 强化政治引领 深化创新发展 高质量推进国防和军队现代化
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Stresses High-Quality Advancement of National Defense and Military Modernization at 27th Collective Study Session of CPC Central Committee Political Bureau
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局7月30日下午就高质量推进国防和军队现代化举行第二十七次集体学习，习近平主持并发表重要讲话，强调如期实现建军一百年奋斗目标。
articles.summary_en: The Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held its 27th collective study session on high-quality advancement of national defense and military modernization on the afternoon of July 30. Xi Jinping presided over the session and delivered an important speech, stressing the goal of achieving the centenary goal of the People's Liberation Army on schedule.

articles.title_zh: 推动健康中国建设取得决定性进展
articles.title_en: Promote Decisive Progress in Building a Healthy China
articles.summary_zh: 国家卫健委主任雷海潮在《求是》撰文，阐述健康中国建设成就与“十五五”规划部署，强调加强党的领导、健全公共卫生体系、建设优质高效医疗服务体系等。
articles.summary_en: Lei Haichao, head of the National Health Commission, writes in Qiushi to elaborate on achievements and the 15th Five-Year Plan for building a Healthy China, stressing Party leadership, stronger public health systems, and high-quality medical services.

articles.title_zh: 读懂好感度攀升背后的中国魅力
articles.title_en: Understanding the Rising Favorability Behind China's Charm

articles.summary_en: On July 30, Xinhua published a commentary by Xin Shiping, noting that international polls show rising favorability toward China, reflecting global recognition of China's development, governance, and openness.

articles.title_zh: 怎么看上半年中国经济运行和发展态势
articles.title_en: How to View China's Economic Performance and Development Trend in H1
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局新闻发言人接受《求是》专访表示，上半年中国经济顶住压力，GDP同比增长4.7%，新动能对增长贡献超四成，经济运行总体平稳、向新向优。
articles.summary_en: In an interview with Qiushi, the NBS spokesperson said China's economy withstood pressure in H1, with GDP growing 4.7% year-on-year and new drivers contributing over 40% to growth, keeping overall stability.

articles.title_zh: 全力推动下半年经济向新向优向好发展
articles.title_en: Strive to Promote Economic Development Toward New, Superior, and Better Performance in the Second Half of the Year
articles.summary_zh: 文章评论中央政治局7月30日会议部署，强调坚定信心、迎难而上，推动下半年经济持续向新向优向好发展。
articles.summary_en: Commenting on the July 30 Politburo meeting, the article stresses confidence and addressing challenges to promote sustained, high-quality economic development in H2.

articles.title_zh: 揭开“中国挤压论”的伪学术包装
articles.title_en: Unmasking the Pseudo-Academic Packaging of the 'China Squeeze' Theory
articles.summary_zh: 近期美国智库彼得森国际经济研究所提出“中国挤压”概念，并登上主流媒体。本文批判其伪学术本质，指出这是中国威胁论的变体。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Peterson Institute for International Economics proposed the 'China squeeze' concept, which then appeared in mainstream media. This article criticizes its pseudo-academic nature, arguing it is a variant of the 'China threat' narrative.

articles.title_zh: 陈新武任重庆市代市长
articles.title_en: Chen Xinwu Appointed Acting Mayor of Chongqing
articles.summary_zh: 重庆市人大常委会7月31日决定，任命陈新武为重庆市人民政府副市长、代理市长。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Standing Committee of Chongqing Municipal People's Congress decided to appoint Chen Xinwu as Vice Mayor and Acting Mayor of Chongqing.

articles.title_zh: 自治区十四届人大常委会第二十六次会议闭幕
articles.title_en: The 26th Session of the Standing Committee of the 14th Guangxi Regional People's Congress Concludes
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，自治区十四届人大常委会第二十六次会议在广西人民会堂闭幕，决定任命黄汝生为自治区副主席，并表决通过多项法规和人事事项。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the 26th session of the Standing Committee of the 14th Guangxi Regional People's Congress concluded at Guangxi People's Hall, appointing Huang Rusheng as Vice Chairman and approving multiple regulations and personnel matters.

articles.summary_zh: 广西壮族自治区十四届人大常委会第二十六次会议于2026年7月30日通过决议，批准2025年自治区本级决算。

articles.summary_en: On July 30, Chen Gang, Party Secretary of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, chaired a special meeting to study and coordinate AI work, emphasizing building a highland for international AI cooperation with ASEAN.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁“八一”前夕走访慰问驻豫部队

articles.summary_en: On July 30, Liu Ning, Secretary of the Henan Provincial Party Committee, visited troops in Kaifeng and extended festive greetings to officers and soldiers.

articles.title_zh: 2026年“奔跑吧·少年”全国青少年阳光体育大会在郑州开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 National Youth Sunshine Sports Meet Opens in Zhengzhou
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日晚，2026年“奔跑吧·少年”全国青少年阳光体育大会在郑州开幕，国家体育总局局长高志丹与河南省委书记刘宁共同启动大会，省长王凯出席。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of July 30, the 2026 National Youth Sunshine Sports Meet opened in Zhengzhou. Gao Zhidan, head of the General Administration of Sport, and Liu Ning, Henan Provincial Party Secretary, jointly launched the event, with Governor Wang Kai attending.

articles.title_zh: 河北沧州：智慧监管护航新能源项目安全发展
articles.title_en: Smart Supervision Safeguards Safe Development of New Energy Projects in Cangzhou, Hebei
articles.summary_zh: 河北省沧东经济开发区作为国家级零碳园区，构建市、县、企业三级协同安全生产监管体系，利用智慧化平台对重点设备、重大危险源等实施24小时动态监测，推动新能源产业集群安全发展。
articles.summary_en: Cangdong Economic Development Zone in Hebei, a national zero-carbon park, has built a three-level safety supervision system involving the city, county and enterprises, using smart platforms for 24-hour dynamic monitoring of key equipment and major hazards to promote safe development of the new energy industry.

articles.title_zh: 《人工智能拟人化互动服务管理暂行办法》施行
articles.title_en: Interim Measures for AI Anthropomorphic Interactive Services Take Effect
articles.summary_zh: 国家网信办等部门联合公布的《人工智能拟人化互动服务管理暂行办法》于2026年7月15日起施行，对AI拟人化产品的隐私保护、防止情感依赖、科技伦理审查等作出规定。
articles.summary_en: The Interim Measures for AI Anthropomorphic Interactive Services, jointly issued by the Cyberspace Administration of China and other departments, took effect on July 15, 2026, setting rules on privacy protection, preventing emotional dependency, and ethical review.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”时期，工业绿色低碳发展这样推进
articles.title_en: Industrial Green and Low-Carbon Development to Be Advanced in the 15th Five-Year Plan Period

articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology recently issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Industrial Green and Low-Carbon Development, setting goals including peaking CO2 emissions in the industrial sector by 2030 and deploying seven key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 第12批国家组织药品集采在上海开标

articles.summary_en: On July 31, the 12th batch of national centralized drug procurement opened bidding in Shanghai, covering 65 drugs for anti-infection, oncology, and other common treatments.

articles.title_zh: 未来五年退役军人就业培训将更加注重“需求牵引”

articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on July 31, Vice Minister Sui Hongbo said the 15th Five-Year Plan period will emphasize demand-driven training to make veterans' employment training more practical and effective.

articles.title_zh: 工业绿色低碳发展“十五五”规划发布
articles.title_en: Plan for Green and Low-Carbon Industrial Development During the 15th Five-Year Plan Period Released
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部7月31日发布《工业绿色低碳发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年工业领域二氧化碳排放达峰、单位增加值能耗下降10%以上等目标。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology released the 15th Five-Year Plan for Green and Low-Carbon Industrial Development on July 31, setting targets such as peaking CO2 emissions in industry and reducing energy intensity by over 10% by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 应急管理部对陕西甘肃启动国家地质灾害四级应急响应

articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Emergency Management activated a Level-IV national geo-hazard emergency response for Shaanxi and Gansu on July 30, urging local authorities to strengthen prevention and ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 超60城调整优化住房公积金政策
articles.title_en: Over 60 Cities Adjust and Optimize Housing Provident Fund Policies

articles.summary_en: In H1 2026, 60+ Chinese cities adjusted housing provident fund policies, raising loan caps, lowering down payments, and expanding withdrawals to cover purchases, elevator retrofits, and property fees, easing housing burdens.

articles.title_zh: 天津市政府召开第112次常务会议 张工主持
articles.title_en: Tianjin Municipal Government Holds 112th Executive Meeting Chaired by Zhang Gong

articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 30, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong chaired the 112th executive meeting of the municipal government, reviewing the action plan for intelligent robot industry innovation and the 15th Five-Year Plan for financial development.

articles.summary_en: On July 29, the Standing Committee of the Xinjiang Regional People's Congress held a symposium on implementing the Ethnic Unity and Progress Promotion Law, with Chairwoman Zumret Obul attending and stressing effective high-quality implementation.

articles.title_zh: 2026“新疆是个好地方”非物质文化遗产援疆主题展示活动启动

articles.title_zh: 人工智能让通关跑出加速度
articles.title_en: AI Accelerates Customs Clearance
articles.summary_zh: 新华社7月31日报道，海关融合人工智能等新技术提升通关效率，如杭州海关用AI眼镜识别精神药品、白云机场智能监测通道等，海关总署提出到2030年90%以上口岸配备智能查验装备。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on July 31 that customs authorities are integrating AI to speed up clearance, including AI glasses detecting drugs and intelligent monitoring at airports, aiming to equip 90% of ports with smart inspection devices by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议，研究部署基础教育和开发区高质量发展等工作
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting on Basic Education and Development Zones
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日下午，北京市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记对基础教育工作的重要指示，研究部署基础教育、开发区问题整改、巡视整改及高校毕业生就业等工作。市委书记尹力主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, the Beijing Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met to study Xi Jinping's instructions on basic education and discuss work on basic education, development zone rectification, inspection rectification, and graduate employment.

articles.title_zh: 国防部：今年军校报考热度与生源质量均创历史新高
articles.title_en: Defense Ministry: Military Academy Popularity and Quality Hit Record Highs

articles.summary_en: At a routine press conference on July 30, Defense Ministry spokesman Jiang Bin said about 192,000 people applied to military academies this year, with 17,500 admitted from 22 schools, ranking top 6% on average, hitting record highs in popularity and quality.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致电祝贺诺瓦当选连任圣多美和普林西比总统

articles.summary_en: On July 29, President Xi Jinping sent a message to Carlos Nova, congratulating him on his re-election as President of São Tomé and Príncipe, and expressing willingness to elevate the strategic partnership.

articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，威海市委书记张海波到环翠区调研经济运行，实地察看多个产业项目，强调做大工业基本盘，推动经济平稳健康发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Zhang Haibo, Party Secretary of Weihai, investigated economic operation in Huancui District, inspecting industrial projects and emphasizing stable growth of the industrial sector.

articles.title_zh: 西安市委理论学习中心组举行学习会议暨“八一”军事日活动
articles.title_en: Xi'an Municipal Party Committee Holds Theoretical Study Session and "August 1st" Military Day Activity
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，西安市委举行理论学习中心组学习会议暨“八一”军事日活动，贯彻总体国家安全观，蒿慧杰主持并讲话，金一南作专题辅导。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, the Xi'an Municipal Party Committee held a theoretical learning group session and "August 1st" Military Day activity to implement the holistic national security concept. Hao Huijie presided and spoke, and Jin Yinan gave a special lecture.

articles.title_zh: 张宏伟、卢希望会见阳光电源股份有限公司客商
articles.title_en: Zhang Hongwei and Lu Xiwang Meet Sungrow Power Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，信阳市委书记张宏伟、市长卢希望会见阳光电源客商，围绕储能装备制造和绿色船舶研发深化合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Zhang Hongwei, Secretary of the Xinyang Municipal CPC Committee, and Lu Xiwang, Mayor, met a Sungrow Power delegation to deepen cooperation on energy storage equipment and green ship R&D.

articles.title_zh: 江成在市委常委会议军会议上强调巩固发展坚如磐石的军政军民团结 开创国防建设和军队现代化新局面
articles.title_en: Jiang Cheng Chairs Municipal Party Committee Military Affairs Meeting, Stressing Unbreakable Military-Civilian Unity
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，省人大常委会副主任、市委书记江成主持召开市委常委会议军会议，传达学习习近平强军思想，听取人民武装、双拥共建、退役军人等情况，部署下步工作，并向驻烟部队致以节日问候。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Jiang Cheng, deputy director of the Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee and municipal party secretary, chaired a meeting on military affairs, conveying Xi Jinping's thought on strengthening the military and deploying defense mobilization and double-support work.

articles.title_zh: 李强会见斯洛伐克总统佩列格里尼
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets Slovak President Pellegrini
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日下午，国务院总理李强在北京人民大会堂会见来华进行国事访问的斯洛伐克总统佩列格里尼，双方同意深化战略伙伴关系与合作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 29, Premier Li Qiang met Slovak President Pellegrini, who is on a state visit to China, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. They agreed to deepen strategic partnership and cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞调研深化国资国企改革工作并主持召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Investigates SOE Reform and Chairs Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日至30日，宁夏回族自治区党委书记李邑飞深入部分区属国有企业调研并主持召开座谈会，强调聚焦主责主业，深化改革创新，推动国资国企做强做优做大。
articles.summary_en: From July 28 to 30, Li Yifei, Secretary of the CPC Ningxia Regional Committee, visited several district-owned SOEs and chaired a symposium, stressing reform, innovation, and strengthening SOEs.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞分别会见伊利集团董事长潘刚特变电工董事长张新
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Meets with Pan Gang of Yili Group and Zhang Xin of TBEA
articles.summary_zh: 近日，宁夏自治区党委书记李邑飞在银川分别会见伊利集团董事长潘刚和特变电工董事长张新，就深化产业合作进行洽谈。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Li Yifei, Party Secretary of Ningxia, met separately in Yinchuan with Pan Gang, Chairman of Yili Group, and Zhang Xin, Chairman of TBEA, to discuss deepening cooperation in industries.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏自治区政府召开常务会议
articles.title_en: Ningxia Government Holds Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，宁夏自治区主席张雨浦主持政府常务会议，研究防汛减灾、退役军人服务、人工智能、基础教育等工作，听取水网电网建设及民生实事汇报。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Ningxia Chairman Zhang Yupu led a regional government executive meeting on flood control, veterans' services, AI, education, and infrastructure.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉调研督导银川市服务业扩能提质工作
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Inspects and Supervises Yinchuan's Service Industry Expansion and Quality Improvement
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉调研督导全市服务业扩能提质工作，强调加快推动服务业优质高效发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Zhao Xuhui, member of the Standing Committee of the Party Committee of the Autonomous Region and Secretary of the CPC Yinchuan Municipal Committee, inspected and supervised the city's service industry expansion and quality improvement work, emphasizing accelerating high-quality and efficient development.

tags.name_en: Service Industry Expansion and Quality Improvement

tags_en: Service Industry Expansion and Quality Improvement

articles.title_zh: 十五届市政府第133次常务会议召开
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Municipal Government Holds 133rd Executive Meeting on Safety and Livelihood
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日上午，湛江市市长李勇毅主持召开市政府第133次常务会议，研究中央安全生产考核巡查问题整改，听取省市民生实事落实汇报并部署相关工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 28, Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi chaired the 133rd executive meeting, focusing on rectifying issues found by the central work safety inspection and reviewing progress on provincial and municipal livelihood projects.

articles.title_zh: 遂溪县委十四届第164次常委会（扩大）会议召开
articles.title_en: Suixi County Party Committee Holds 164th Standing Committee (Enlarged) Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日上午，遂溪县委副书记、县长张洋主持召开县委十四届第164次常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 27, Zhang Yang, Deputy Secretary and County Mayor of Suixi, chaired the 164th Standing Committee (Enlarged) Meeting, conveying and studying Xi Jinping's important speeches and deliberating implementation measures.

tags.name_en: Full and Strict Governance over the Party

tags_en: Full and Strict Governance over the Party

articles.title_zh: 湛江市市长李勇毅走进人大代表联络站接待群众
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi Visits People's Congress Deputy Liaison Station to Meet Constituents
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日下午，湛江市市长李勇毅以人大代表身份到赤坎区寸金街道人大代表联络站接待群众，实地调研并部署整改安全隐患和交通拥堵问题。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi, as a people's congress deputy, visited a liaison station in Chikan District, inspected safety hazards and traffic congestion, and directed corrective measures.

articles.title_zh: 国家卫生健康委“因地制宜推广三明医改经验”专题新闻发布会在周口举行
articles.title_en: National Health Commission Holds Thematic Press Conference on Promoting Sanming Medical Reform Experience in Zhoukou
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，国家卫生健康委在周口市召开专题新闻发布会，推广三明医改经验，周口市市长詹鹏介绍当地做法。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the National Health Commission held a press conference in Zhoukou City to promote Sanming medical reform experience, with Mayor Zhan Peng introducing local practices.

articles.title_zh: 市五届人大常委会召开第五十五次主任会议
articles.title_en: Fifth Session of Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 55th Director Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日上午，周口市五届人大常委会召开第五十五次主任会议，研究讨论高标准农田建设保护条例执法检查和专题询问实施方案。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 29, the 55th director meeting of the Standing Committee of the Fifth Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress was held to discuss plans for law enforcement inspection of high-standard farmland construction and special inquiries.

articles.title_zh: 国家卫生健康委“因地制宜推广三明医改经验”专题新闻发布会在周口举行
articles.title_en: National Health Commission Holds Thematic Press Conference on Promoting Sanming Medical Reform Experience in Zhoukou
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，国家卫生健康委在周口市召开“因地制宜推广三明医改经验”专题新闻发布会，市长詹鹏出席并介绍情况。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the National Health Commission held a thematic press conference in Zhoukou on promoting Sanming's medical reform experience. Mayor Zhan Peng attended and introduced local practices.

articles.title_zh: 周口市社科界举行学习贯彻习近平文化思想座谈会
articles.title_en: Zhoukou Social Science Community Holds Symposium on Xi Jinping's Cultural Thought
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，周口市社科界学习贯彻习近平文化思想座谈会举行，市委常委、宣传部部长孟鑫出席并讲话，强调深化党的创新理论研究阐释，推动哲学社会科学繁荣发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the social science community of Zhoukou held a symposium on studying and implementing Xi Jinping's Cultural Thought. Meng Xin, member of the Standing Committee of the Municipal Party Committee and head of the Publicity Department, attended and spoke, emphasizing deeper research on the Party's innovative theories and promoting the prosperity of philosophy and social sciences.

articles.title_zh: 马晓磊“八一”前夕走访慰问驻淄部队
articles.title_en: Ma Xiaolei Visits Zibo-based Troops Ahead of Army Day
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日上午，市委书记马晓磊到武警淄博支队走访慰问，代表市委、市政府向驻淄部队官兵和退役军人致以节日祝贺和诚挚问候。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 29, Zibo Municipal Party Secretary Ma Xiaolei visited the Armed Police Zibo Detachment to extend festive greetings and sincere regards to stationed troops and veterans on behalf of the municipal Party committee and government.

articles.title_zh: 林武在济南、山东大学调研时强调 一体推进教育科技人才发展 推动高质量发展不断取得新成效
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Emphasizes Integrated Development of Education, Science, and Talent during Research Visit in Jinan and at Shandong University
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日至29日，省委书记林武在济南市有关企业、山东科技大市场、山东大学调研，强调一体推进教育科技人才发展，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: From July 28 to 29, Lin Wu, Secretary of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee, visited enterprises, Shandong Science and Technology Market, and Shandong University in Jinan, emphasizing integrated development of education, science, and talent to promote high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 淄博市委市人民政府召开上半年全市工作情况通报会
articles.title_en: Zibo Municipal Party Committee and Government Hold Meeting to Brief on First Half Work
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，淄博市委、市政府召开上半年工作情况通报会，市委书记马晓磊向老干部通报经济社会发展情况，市长赵庆文主持。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the Zibo Municipal Party Committee and Government held a briefing on first-half work, with Party Secretary Ma Xiaolei reporting on economic and social development to retired officials and Mayor Zhao Qingwen chairing the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔在调研铁路规划建设并出席工作推进会议时强调 攻坚克难 凝聚合力 扎实推动铁路高质量发展
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Inspects Railway Planning and Attends Promotion Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，山东省委副书记、省长周乃翔在济南、滨州调研铁路规划建设，并出席全省铁路规划建设工作推进会议，强调攻坚克难、凝聚合力，推动铁路高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Zhou Naixiang, Deputy Secretary of the Shandong Provincial Party Committee and Governor, inspected railway planning and construction in Jinan and Binzhou and attended a provincial work promotion meeting, stressing high-quality railway development.

articles.title_zh: 赵庆文走访慰问驻淄部队
articles.title_en: Zhao Qingwen Visits and Extends Greetings to Troops Stationed in Zibo
articles.summary_zh: 八一建军节前夕，淄博市委副书记、市长赵庆文到淄博军分区走访慰问并召开座谈会，向驻淄部队官兵致以节日祝贺。
articles.summary_en: On the eve of Army Day, Zhao Qingwen, Deputy Secretary of the Zibo Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, visited the Zibo Military Sub-district and held a symposium to extend festival greetings to troops stationed in Zibo.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央政治局召开会议 决定召开二十届五中全会 分析研究当前经济形势和经济工作 中共中央总书记习近平主持会议
articles.title_en: CPC Central Political Bureau Holds Meeting to Decide on Fifth Plenary Session and Analyze Economic Situation
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央总书记习近平主持召开中共中央政治局会议，决定召开二十届五中全会，并分析研究当前经济形势和经济工作。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping chaired a CPC Central Political Bureau meeting, deciding to convene the 5th Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee and reviewing current economic conditions.

articles.title_zh: 始终同人民同呼吸、共命运、心连心（总书记的人民情怀）
articles.title_en: Always Breathe the Same Breath, Share the Same Fate, and Stay Heart-to-Heart with the People (The General Secretary's Affection for the People)
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾习近平总书记的人民情怀，强调党始终同人民同呼吸、共命运、心连心，引用其在上海考察时的讲话，指出共产党就是为老百姓服务的，党的根基在人民。
articles.summary_en: Reviewing Xi Jinping's people-centered feelings, it stresses the Party's unity with the people, quoting his Shanghai remark that the Party serves the people and roots in them.

articles.title_zh: 一份40多年前的作风文件
articles.title_en: A Document on Work Style from Over 40 Years Ago
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾1983年习近平在正定县主持制定《关于改进领导作风的几项规定》的历程，强调其与中央八项规定一脉相承，体现鲜明问题导向。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews how Xi Jinping, then Party secretary of Zhengding County, introduced the 'Six Regulations' on improving work style in 1983, highlighting their continuity with the central Party's eight-point regulations.

articles.title_zh: 青岛市级领导走访慰问驻青部队
articles.title_en: Qingdao Leaders Visit Troops Stationed in City Ahead of Army Day
articles.summary_zh: “八一”建军节前夕，青岛市委书记曾赞荣、市长任刚等市领导分别率队走访慰问驻青部队，向官兵致以节日祝贺和诚挚问候，感谢他们为青岛改革发展稳定作出的贡献。
articles.summary_en: On the eve of Army Day, Qingdao leaders including Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong and Mayor Ren Gang visited troops stationed in Qingdao, extending holiday greetings and expressing gratitude for their contributions.

articles.title_zh: 走进茶园，习近平强调做好这篇“大文章”
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Visits Tea Garden, Stresses Tea Culture, Industry and Technology
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾2021年3月习近平在福建武夷山燕子窠生态茶园考察，强调统筹做好茶文化、茶产业、茶科技这篇大文章，展现生态茶园带动乡村振兴的成效。
articles.summary_en: This article reviews Xi Jinping's 2021 visit to a Wuyishan tea garden, where he emphasized tea culture, industry and technology, and the benefits of ecological tea farming for rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 中国经济半年观察：“向新向优”成为关键词
articles.title_en: China's Economy in H1: 'New Momentum and Better Structure' Key Words
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，中共中央政治局召开会议分析经济形势，指出中国经济动能向新、结构向优，上半年GDP同比增长4.7%。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee met to assess the economy, noting new momentum and improved structure, with H1 GDP growing 4.7% YoY.

articles.title_zh: 夯实居民消费基础 提升消费意愿能力——我国加快形成扩大居民消费长效机制观察
articles.title_en: China Steps Up Efforts to Build Long-term Mechanism for Expanding Consumer Spending
articles.summary_zh: 新华社报道，面向“十五五”我国加快形成扩大居民消费长效机制，通过稳就业、促增收、完善社会保障等措施增强居民消费能力与意愿。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reports that China is accelerating the formation of a long-term mechanism to expand household consumption, boosting consumer capacity and willingness through stable employment, income growth, and improved social security.

articles.title_zh: 走进茶园，习近平强调做好这篇“大文章”
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Visits Tea Garden, Emphasizes Making Tea Industry a 'Big Article'
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾2021年3月习近平考察福建武夷山燕子窠生态茶园，强调统筹做好茶文化、茶产业、茶科技‘大文章’，展现茶产业助力绿色发展与乡村振兴的成效。
articles.summary_en: The article revisits Xi Jinping's March 2021 visit to the Yanziwo Ecological Tea Plantation in Wuyishan, where he stressed coordinating tea culture, industry and technology, highlighting achievements in eco-friendly planting and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 陕西文旅厅：不存在“伪史论者”电话骚扰要求拆唐朝古迹情况，将调查追责
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Culture and Tourism Department Denies Harassment by 'Fake History' Callers, Vows Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 陕西省文旅厅回应媒体称，不存在“伪史论者”电话骚扰要求拆除唐朝古迹的情况，已联系原始发布媒体，将调查并追究相关责任。
articles.summary_en: Shaanxi Provincial Culture and Tourism Department denied reports of phone harassment by 'fake history' advocates demanding removal of Tang Dynasty relics, saying it has contacted the media outlet and will investigate and pursue legal responsibility.

tags.name_en: Shaanxi Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism

tags_en: Shaanxi Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism

articles.title_zh: 《社会团体分支机构、代表机构管理办法》即将施行，民政部：将加强刚性执法
articles.title_en: Measures on Social Groups' Branches to Take Effect, Civil Affairs Ministry Vows Stricter Enforcement
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，民政部举行第三季度例行新闻发布会，解读8月1日施行的《社会团体分支机构、代表机构管理办法》，表示将加强刚性执法，规范社会组织管理。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Ministry of Civil Affairs held a press conference to explain the Measures for Management of Branches and Representative Offices of Social Groups, effective Aug. 1, pledging stricter law enforcement.

articles.title_zh: 涉“最忙五人组”等不实内容，市场化活动违法违规行为专项整治典型案件公布
articles.title_en: Typical Cases of Illegal Activities in Market-Oriented Activities Involving False Content such as 'Busiest Five-Person Group' Published
articles.summary_zh: 2026年，市场监管总局开展市场化活动违法违规行为专项整治，公布六起虚假宣传典型案件，涉及虚构榜单、冒用国际组织名义等行为。
articles.summary_en: In 2026, the State Administration for Market Regulation launched a special campaign against illegal activities in market-oriented activities, publishing six typical cases of false publicity, involving fabricated rankings and unauthorized use of international organization names.

articles.title_zh: 《社会团体分支机构、代表机构管理办法》主要解决哪些问题？民政部答澎湃
articles.title_en: Ministry of Civil Affairs Answers Questions on New Measures for Managing Social Organizations' Branches
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，民政部举行第三季度例行新闻发布会，解读《社会团体分支机构、代表机构管理办法》，围绕设立、管理、建设、使用、考核、退出全链条规范管理。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Ministry of Civil Affairs held a press conference to explain the new Measures for Managing Branches and Representative Offices of Social Organizations, covering the full chain of establishment, management, construction, use, assessment, and exit.

articles.title_zh: 民政部：截至目前各地共办理婚姻登记“全国通办”79.8万对
articles.title_en: Ministry of Civil Affairs: 798,000 Couples Nationwide Have Registered Marriages Under National Inter-provincial Service
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，民政部举行第三季度例行新闻发布会，介绍截至6月底全国低保、特困标准及上半年临时救助数据，并通报婚姻登记“全国通办”已办理79.8万对。
articles.summary_en: At a quarterly press conference on July 30, the Ministry of Civil Affairs reported that 798,000 marriage registrations had been completed under the nationwide inter-provincial service, and released data on subsistence allowances and temporary relief.

articles.title_zh: 中华全国律师协会原会长任继圣逝世，享年100岁

articles.summary_en: Ren Jisheng, former president of All China Lawyers Association and retired cadre of Ministry of Justice, died of illness in Beijing on July 15, 2026, at age 100.

articles.title_zh: 民政部：推动构建婚育友好社会，将开展整治婚介机构乱象专项行动

articles.summary_en: At its routine Q3 press conference on July 30, the Ministry of Civil Affairs said it will promote a marriage- and child-friendly society, launch a special campaign against matchmaking agency irregularities, and deploy work on elderly care and child welfare.

articles.title_zh: 厦门市启动2026年减污降碳协同创新标杆项目申报

articles.title_zh: “四良”合力强根基 广西推动热区葡萄质量安全与品质提升

articles.summary_en: Guangxi leverages its subtropical resources to promote hot-zone grape cultivation through improved varieties, techniques, soil, and machinery, achieving 825,900 tons of grapes and a production value exceeding 10 billion yuan in 2025.

articles.title_zh: 让职业选择跟上产业发展新趋势（稳就业·我的求职故事）

articles.summary_en: Yichang, Hubei, expands employment in emerging sectors and offers targeted training, helping electrician Yang Tao transition to a data annotator and rise to project manager.

articles.title_zh: 河北加快建设一体化算力网
articles.title_en: Hebei Accelerates Construction of Integrated Computing Network

articles.summary_en: Hebei is accelerating the construction of an integrated computing network in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, promoting shared computing resources. Its comprehensive computing index ranks first nationwide for two consecutive years, empowering industrial digitalization.

articles.title_zh: 绥化政校企战略合作签约仪式举行

articles.title_zh: 青海发布"3H高原认证"体系 填补全球极端环境质量认证空白
articles.title_en: Qinghai Launches '3H Plateau Certification' System, Filling Global Gap in Extreme Environment Quality Certification

articles.summary_en: On July 30, the construction of the Suining-Neijiang section of the Miansui-Zinei Railway was announced at a promotion event in Suining. The line spans 244 km with a total investment of 53.7 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 大运河上建起“超强大脑”：内河航运产业大脑上线

articles.summary_en: Jining, Shandong, has built an "industry brain" digital platform for inland shipping, integrating port, vessel, and cargo data to improve efficiency and reduce logistics costs.

articles.summary_en: Shanghai Mayor Gong Zheng chaired a municipal government meeting to consolidate economic progress, stabilize key industries, and advance tech services and the international aviation hub.

articles.summary_en: On July 24, the CPC Central Committee held a symposium with non-party personages in Zhongnanhai to solicit opinions on the current economic situation and H2 economic work. Xi Jinping chaired and delivered an important speech, and Li Qiang briefed the attendees.

articles.summary_en: The Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee met on July 30 and decided to convene the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee in October, analyzed the current economic situation and arranged work for the second half of the year. Xi Jinping chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 受贿6253万余元 国家发展改革委原党组成员、副主任徐宪平一审获刑15年

articles.title_zh: 国家知识产权局：我国商标领域立法从“局部修改”向“系统完善”转变升级

articles.title_zh: 截至6月底 我国新一代信息技术领域有效发明专利占总量16.5%

The National Conference on Overseas Chinese Affairs was held in Beijing from July 27 to 28, with Wang Huning attending and delivering a speech.

articles.summary_en: On July 28, 2026, the 25th meeting of the Standing Committee of the 7th Hainan Provincial People's Congress held a joint meeting to conduct a special inquiry on coastal zone protection and utilization management. Party Secretary Feng Fei attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 海南“十五五”水安全保障规划出台 34项重点任务织密全岛现代化水网
articles.title_en: Hainan Issues '15th Five-Year' Water Security Plan with 34 Key Tasks to Build Modern Water Network

articles.summary_en: On July 28, the Hainan Provincial Department of Water Resources released the province's 15th Five-Year Water Security Plan in Haikou, outlining 34 key tasks to establish a modern provincial water network by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 刘小明在海口调研经济社会发展情况
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaoming Investigates Economic and Social Development in Haikou

articles.summary_en: On July 28, Hainan Governor Liu Xiaoming inspected project construction and enterprise operations in Haikou, stressing industrial optimization to achieve annual targets.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省北大荒精神研究会成立
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Provincial Beidahuang Spirit Research Association Established

articles.summary_en: On July 28, the Heilongjiang Provincial Beidahuang Spirit Research Association was established at the Beidahuang Group, aiming to systematically study, inherit, and promote the Beidahuang spirit.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江出台医疗卫生领域人工智能应用工作实施方案
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Issues Implementation Plan for AI Application in Healthcare

articles.summary_en: Heilongjiang's health commission and other departments jointly issued a plan to promote AI application in healthcare, aiming for over 20 typical scenarios by 2027.

articles.title_zh: 财政金融协同发力促内需 湖南出台12条措施激发消费投资活力
articles.title_en: Hunan Issues 12 Measures to Boost Domestic Demand through Fiscal-Financial Coordination

articles.summary_en: Hunan's finance department and other agencies jointly issued measures to boost domestic demand, launching 12 policy steps covering loan subsidies and government investment funds to stimulate consumption and investment.

articles.title_zh: 新版近视防治与斜弱视诊疗指南发布
articles.title_en: New Version of Guidelines for Myopia Prevention and Treatment and Strabismus and Amblyopia Released
articles.summary_zh: 国家卫生健康委办公厅近日印发2026年版近视防治指南、斜视和弱视诊疗指南，旨在提高近视防控和斜弱视诊疗的规范化水平。
articles.summary_en: The National Health Commission recently issued the 2026 editions of guidelines for myopia prevention and treatment, and for strabismus and amblyopia diagnosis and treatment, aiming to improve standardization.

articles.summary_en: Jiangsu Provincial Department of Commerce and seven other departments jointly issued measures to promote high-quality foreign trade development, including 16 specific items covering new product cultivation, financial support, and export credit insurance.

articles.summary_en: On July 28, the 2026 Digital Literacy and Skills Promotion Month, hosted by the Cyberspace Administration of Inner Mongolia, kicked off in Hohhot.

articles.summary_en: On July 28, Wang Weizhong, Party Secretary of Inner Mongolia, and other senior officials attended national defense mobilization exercises and Army Day military activities, delivering greetings to troops.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏对电动自行车违规销售实施信用惩戒
articles.title_en: Ningxia Implements Credit Punishment for Illegal E-bike Sales

articles.summary_en: On July 29, Ningxia market regulators announced credit punishment for illegal e-bike sales at a press conference, having filed 18 cases and collected fines of 162,000 yuan since March.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏投入8800余万元实施农村公路安全防护工程
articles.title_en: Ningxia Invests Over 88 Million Yuan in Rural Road Safety Projects

articles.summary_en: On July 29, Ningxia's Department of Transport announced investment of over 88 million yuan in rural road safety projects, including installing guardrails and signs and renovating 9 dangerous bridges.

articles.title_en: Ningxia Natural Resources Department Launches 2026 Random Inspections in Geological Field
articles.summary_zh: 近日，宁夏回族自治区自然资源厅印发方案，对全区18家单位开展地质勘查和地质灾害防治活动“双随机、一公开”监督检查，以规范行业秩序。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Department of Natural Resources of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region issued a plan to carry out "double random, one open" inspections on geological exploration and geological disaster prevention activities of 18 units, aiming to regulate industry order.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 28, Qinghai Province held a video conference on flood control, attended by Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Governor Luo Dongchuan, who made further arrangements for flood prevention and disaster relief.

articles.title_zh: 海西聚焦核心赛道 推动清洁能源提质增效
articles.title_en: Haixi Focuses on Core Tracks to Promote Clean Energy Efficiency
articles.summary_zh: 7月26日，海西州能源局宣布“十五五”期间将聚焦光热发电、外送基地等核心赛道，推动清洁能源提质增效。
articles.summary_en: On July 26, the Haixi Prefecture Energy Bureau announced that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, it will focus on core tracks such as solar thermal power and transmission bases to improve clean energy quality and efficiency.

articles.summary_en: The General Office of Sichuan Provincial Government issued a plan to boost new energy trucks, aiming for over 40,000 units by 2027, with purchase subsidies and highway toll discounts.

articles.title_zh: 《山东省气候资源保护和开发利用条例》将于10月1日起施行

articles.summary_en: The 25th session of the 14th Shandong Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee passed the regulations on climate resources protection and utilization, effective from October 1.

articles.title_zh: 陈吉宁主持召开上海市委财经委会议研究国际消费中心城市建设和未来产业发展

articles.summary_en: On July 28, 2026, the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee Financial and Economic Work Commission held a meeting chaired by Chen Jining to study the promotion of international consumption center city construction and future industries.

articles.title_zh: 上海市第十六届人大常委会第三十二次会议举行扩大会议
articles.title_en: The 32nd Session of the 16th Shanghai Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Enlarged Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 上海市第十六届人大常委会第三十二次会议扩大会议在世博中心举行，市委书记陈吉宁出席，市长龚正报告上半年经济社会发展情况和下半年工作考虑。
articles.summary_en: The enlarged meeting of the 32nd session of the 16th Shanghai Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee was held at the Expo Center. Party Secretary Chen Jining attended, and Mayor Gong Zheng reported on the city's economic and social development in the first half of the year and plans for the second half.

articles.title_zh: 陈吉宁向老同志通报全市改革发展重点工作
articles.title_en: Chen Jining Briefs Retired Officials on Shanghai's Reform and Development Priorities
articles.summary_zh: 陈吉宁昨日下午向老同志通报上海改革发展重点工作，强调贯彻习近平总书记考察上海重要讲话精神，落实市委全会部署，推进中国式现代化。
articles.summary_en: Chen Jining yesterday afternoon briefed retired officials on Shanghai's reform and development priorities, emphasizing the implementation of General Secretary Xi Jinping's inspection speech and the city's party committee plans to advance Chinese-style modernization.

articles.title_zh: 吕梁市：布局数字产业推动全面转型
articles.title_en: Lvliang City: Deploying Digital Industry to Drive Comprehensive Transformation

articles.summary_en: On July 27, Lvliang City in Shanxi Province is deploying digital industry to drive comprehensive transformation of the resource-based city, with achievements in healthcare and industry.

articles.title_zh: 天津审批提速超50% 助力新能源汽车出口

articles.summary_en: Tianjin Maritime Safety Administration launched a green channel for NEV shipping, cutting approval time by over 50%, with the first fast-track approval completed, boosting exports.

articles.summary_en: On July 28, Tianjin Municipal Education Commission announced at a press briefing that 10 primary and secondary schools will be built or expanded this year, all operational by fall, adding 17,000 seats.

articles.summary_en: On July 28, Xue Bin, Vice Chairman of Xinjiang Autonomous Region and Commander of XPCC, visited the Civil Affairs Bureau and Data Bureau of XPCC, emphasizing correct performance view to advance civil affairs and digital XPCC construction.

articles.summary_en: The Xinjiang Human Resources and Social Security Department and 8 other departments jointly issued the implementation plan for the Work Injury Prevention Five-Year Action Plan (2026-2030), aiming to reduce work injury accident rates.

articles.summary_en: Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps promotes intangible cultural heritage through classes and events to benefit workers and the public.

articles.summary_en: The Tibet Ngari-Central Tibet Grid Interconnection Project started its 2026 annual maintenance on July 30, aiming to eliminate equipment defects and ensure reliable power supply for residents.

articles.summary_en: On July 27, the fourth national conference on paired assistance to Tibet by the civil affairs system was held in Lhasa. Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Regional Party Committee, and Li Changguan, Party Secretary of the Ministry of Civil Affairs, attended and delivered speeches.

articles.summary_en: On July 27, Wang Ning, Secretary of Yunnan Provincial Party Committee, met in Kunming with representatives of Pacific island countries attending the 4th Pacific Island Countries Legislators Seminar, with all sides pledging to strengthen cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 云南省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议闭幕

articles.summary_en: The 24th session of the 14th Yunnan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee concluded in Kunming on July 28, passing multiple local regulations and personnel appointments.

articles.summary_zh: 国新办发布会上，海关总署署长孙梅君介绍《口岸现代化“十五五”规划》，宁波舟山港三次被点名，纳入基础设施改造和智慧口岸工程。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council press conference, General Administration of Customs Director Sun Meijun introduced the '15th Five-Year Plan for Port Modernization', in which Ningbo Zhoushan Port was mentioned three times, included in infrastructure renovation and smart port projects.

articles.title_zh: 北京市委常委会召开会议 认真学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神 研究部署基础教育和开发区高质量发展等工作
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting Studies Basic Education and Development Zone Work
articles.summary_zh: 28日下午，北京市委常委会召开会议，由市委书记尹力主持，传达学习习近平总书记对基础教育和开发区工作的重要指示，研究部署相关落实意见，并听取巡视整改和高校毕业生就业情况汇报。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 28, the Beijing Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee held a meeting chaired by Secretary Yin Li to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on basic education and development zones, and to deliberate on implementation opinions, as well as to hear reports on inspection rectification and graduate employment.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致电祝贺诺瓦当选连任圣多美和普林西比总统
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Congratulates Carlos Vila Nova on Re-election as President of Sao Tome and Principe
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，国家主席习近平致电卡洛斯·诺瓦，祝贺他当选连任圣多美和普林西比民主共和国总统，并表示愿推动中圣普战略伙伴关系不断迈上新台阶。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory message to Carlos Vila Nova on his re-election as President of Sao Tome and Principe, expressing willingness to elevate the strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 中央宣传部授予王戟同志“时代楷模”称号
articles.title_en: Central Propaganda Department Awards Wang Ji the Title 'Role Model of the Times'
articles.summary_zh: 中央宣传部向全社会宣传发布王戟同志先进事迹，授予他“时代楷模”称号。
articles.summary_en: The Central Propaganda Department publicized the exemplary deeds of Wang Ji and conferred on him the title 'Role Model of the Times'.

articles.title_zh: 深刻理解和把握新质生产力的理论价值与实践要求
articles.title_en: Deeply Understanding and Grasping the Theoretical Value and Practical Requirements of New Quality Productive Forces
articles.summary_zh: 文章系统阐述了新质生产力的理论内涵、价值取向和实践路径，强调要以科技创新为核心引擎推动生产力质态跃升。
articles.summary_en: The article systematically elaborates the theoretical connotation, value orientation, and practical path of new quality productive forces, emphasizing the need to drive a leap in productivity quality with technological innovation as the core engine.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚主持召开书记专题会议研究中央生态环境保护督察发现问题整改和调度“三大纠纷”排查化解工作
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Chairs Special Meeting on Central Eco-Environmental Protection Inspection Rectification and 'Three Major Disputes' Resolution
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚主持召开会议，研究中央环保督察整改和“三大纠纷”排查化解工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Chen Gang, Party Secretary of Guangxi, chaired a meeting to study rectification of central eco-environmental protection inspection issues and resolution of 'three major disputes'.

articles.title_zh: 徐麟李炳军会见海关总署署长、党委书记孙梅君一行
articles.title_en: Xu Lin and Li Bingjun Meet with Sun Meijun, Head of General Administration of Customs
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，贵州省委书记徐麟、省长李炳军在贵阳会见海关总署署长孙梅君一行，就深化开放合作、口岸建设等交流。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Guizhou Provincial Party Secretary Xu Lin and Governor Li Bingjun met with Sun Meijun, Director of the General Administration of Customs, in Guiyang to discuss opening-up cooperation and port construction.

articles.title_zh: 贵州省第十一届少数民族传统体育运动会开幕 徐麟宣布开幕
articles.title_en: Guizhou 11th Ethnic Minority Traditional Sports Games Opens, Xu Lin Declares Opening
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，贵州省第十一届少数民族传统体育运动会在凯里市开幕，省委书记徐麟宣布开幕，省长李炳军致辞，展现民族团结和体育风采。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, the 11th Guizhou Ethnic Minority Traditional Sports Games opened in Kaili. Provincial Party Secretary Xu Lin declared the opening, with Governor Li Bingjun delivering a speech, showcasing ethnic unity and sportsmanship.

articles.title_zh: 李炳军会见老挝甘蒙省省委副书记、行政管理委员会主席宋萨阿·恩喜达一行
articles.title_en: Li Bingjun Meets with Laos Khammouane Deputy Party Secretary Somsa'a Enxida
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，贵州省省长李炳军在贵阳会见老挝甘蒙省省委副书记宋萨阿·恩喜达一行，双方就深化友好省关系及经贸合作等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Guizhou Governor Li Bingjun met with Somsa'a Enxida, Deputy Party Secretary of Laos' Khammouane Province, in Guiyang, discussing cooperation in trade, culture, and education.

articles.title_zh: 王凯主持召开省政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Wang Kai Chairs Provincial Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，河南省长王凯主持召开省政府常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究零碳园区建设、人工智能产业等工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Governor Wang Kai of Henan chaired a provincial government executive meeting, conveying Xi Jinping's important speeches and discussing zero-carbon industrial parks, AI industry, and other matters.

articles.title_zh: 湖南发布2026年第2号总林长令
articles.title_en: Hunan Issues 2026 No.2 Chief Forest Chief Order
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，湖南省签发2026年第2号总林长令，聚焦林业产业高质量发展，目标到“十五五”末产值突破7400亿元。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Hunan Province issued the 2026 No.2 Chief Forest Chief Order, focusing on high-quality development of forestry industry, aiming to break through 740 billion yuan by the end of the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明赴省发展改革委调研
articles.title_en: Mao Weiming Inspects Hunan Provincial Development and Reform Commission
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，湖南省委副书记、省长毛伟明赴省发展改革委调研，强调在高质量发展中展现更大作为。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Mao Weiming, Deputy Secretary of the Hunan Provincial Party Committee and Governor, visited the Provincial Development and Reform Commission to emphasize greater achievements in high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 信长星刘小涛张义珍等省领导到省廉政教育中心参观展陈并开展警示教育
articles.title_en: Provincial Leaders Visit Jiangsu Integrity Education Center for Warning Education
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，江苏省委书记信长星、省长刘小涛、省政协主席张义珍等到省廉政教育中心参观展陈，开展警示教育。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, Jiangsu Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing, Governor Liu Xiaotao, and CPPCC Chairman Zhang Yizhen visited the Jiangsu Integrity Education Center for an exhibition and warning education.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记关切事：康庄大道 山海偕行
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Concern: A Broad Road Linking Mountains and Seas
articles.summary_zh: 今年是闽宁协作30年，习近平总书记6月就常态化做好东西部协作作出重要指示，强调总结闽宁协作经验推动共同富裕。30年来闽宁协作使“干沙滩”变“金沙滩”。
articles.summary_en: This year marks the 30th anniversary of Fujian-Ningxia collaboration. In June, Xi Jinping instructed to summarize experience and promote common prosperity. The collaboration turned a 'dry beach' into a 'golden beach' in 30 years.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 水利部对四川省启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Activates Level IV Emergency Response for Flood Control in Sichuan
articles.summary_zh: 水利部7月29日对四川省启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，以应对未来几天暴雨可能引发的洪水灾害。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the Ministry of Water Resources activated a Level IV emergency response for flood control in Sichuan, as heavy rain is forecast to cause flooding in the coming days.

articles.title_zh: 凝心聚力共圆复兴之梦
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Instructions on Overseas Chinese Affairs
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记对侨务工作作出重要指示，强调凝聚侨心侨力，共圆复兴之梦。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping issued important instructions on overseas Chinese affairs, emphasizing uniting the hearts and strengths of overseas Chinese to realize the dream of national rejuvenation.

articles.title_zh: 闽东宁德：“金娃娃”茁壮成长带动山海巨变
articles.title_en: Ningde's 'Golden Projects' Flourish, Driving Great Changes Across Mountains and Sea
articles.summary_zh: 新华社报道福建宁德依托青拓集团、宁德时代等龙头企业，形成四大主导产业，2025年青拓产值超2300亿元，产业带动山区与沿海协同发展。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reports that Ningde, Fujian, led by Tsingshan Group and CATL, has formed four pillar industries. Tsingshan's output exceeded 230 billion yuan in 2025, driving coordinated development of mountainous and coastal areas.

articles.title_zh: 国家互联网信息办公室关于《中华人民共和国反网络暴力法（征求意见稿）》公开征求意见的通知
articles.title_en: CAC Seeks Public Comments on Draft Anti-Cyberbullying Law
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，国家互联网信息办公室会同有关部门起草《中华人民共和国反网络暴力法（征求意见稿）》，向社会公开征求意见，截止日期为8月28日。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the Cyberspace Administration of China released the draft Anti-Cyberbullying Law for public comment, with feedback accepted until August 28.

articles.title_zh: 三部门联合发布《邮政业发展“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: Three Ministries Jointly Issue 15th Five-Year Plan for Postal Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，国家邮政局、国家发展改革委、交通运输部联合发布《邮政业发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年邮政行业寄递业务量达2900亿件等目标。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the State Post Bureau, the National Development and Reform Commission, and the Ministry of Transport jointly issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Postal Industry Development, setting goals including 290 billion parcels by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 2026年工信领域创新任务揭榜挂帅工作启动
articles.title_en: Ministry Launches 2026 Open Competition for Industrial Innovation Tasks
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部等七部门启动2026年工业和信息化领域创新任务揭榜挂帅工作，围绕未来产业、人工智能等6个方向设置24个专题，推动关键技术攻关。
articles.summary_en: The MIIT and six other departments launched the 2026 open competition for innovation tasks in industry and IT, setting 24 topics across six areas including future industries and AI to promote key technology breakthroughs.

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 国新办发布会聚焦“十五五”时期知识产权工作新图景
articles.title_en: State Council Information Office Press Conference Focuses on New Vision for IP Work in 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，国新办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会，国家知识产权局负责人介绍“十五五”时期知识产权工作部署，提出强化新兴领域知识产权保护、提升高价值发明专利指标等。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, at a State Council Information Office press conference, officials from the CNIPA detailed IP work plans for the 15th Five-Year Plan period, including strengthening protection in emerging fields and raising high-value invention patent targets.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”时期推进应对气候变化工作的总抓手——解读《国家应对气候变化“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: Interpretation of the 15th Five-Year Plan for Climate Change Response
articles.summary_zh: 近日，生态环境部等部门联合发布《国家应对气候变化“十五五”规划》，首次系统构建全领域应对气候变化目标体系，是“十五五”时期推进应对气候变化工作的总抓手。29日，生态环境部负责人解读规划重点任务。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment and other departments recently issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Climate Change Response, the main lever for climate action during the period. Officials explained its key tasks on July 29.

articles.title_zh: 安徽铜陵：“智造”变革为老工业城市注入新动能
articles.title_en: Anhui Tongling: 'Smart Manufacturing' Transformation Injects New Momentum into Old Industrial City
articles.summary_zh: 新华社合肥7月29日电，铜陵作为老工业城市，通过智能制造推动产业升级，上半年高技术制造业增加值同比增长86.3%。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on July 29 that Tongling, an old industrial city, is driving industrial upgrading through smart manufacturing, with high-tech manufacturing value-added up 86.3% in H1.

articles.title_zh: 天津市政府第11次专题学习暨全市政府系统领导干部大讲堂举行
articles.title_en: Tianjin Municipal Government Holds 11th Thematic Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日下午，天津市政府举行第11次专题学习，市长张工出席，中国宏观经济研究院院长黄汉权围绕服务业高质量发展作授课。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 28, Tianjin Municipal Government held its 11th thematic study session; Mayor Zhang Gong attended, and Huang Hanquan, president of China Academy of Macroeconomic Research, gave a lecture on high-quality development of the service sector.

articles.title_zh: 陈敏尔张工与新紫光集团董事长李滨一行座谈
articles.title_en: Chen Min'er and Zhang Gong Meet with Unisplendour Group Chairman Li Bin
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，天津市委书记陈敏尔、市长张工与新紫光集团董事长李滨座谈，双方就人工智能、集成电路等领域合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Tianjin Party Secretary Chen Min'er and Mayor Zhang Gong met with Li Bin, Chairman of Unisplendour Group, to discuss cooperation in AI, integrated circuits, and other fields.

articles.title_zh: 王浩在杭州调研文旅工作 强调以文塑旅以旅彰文
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Inspects Cultural Tourism Work in Hangzhou, Stresses Integration of Culture and Tourism
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，浙江省委书记王浩在杭州调研文旅工作，强调以文塑旅、以旅彰文，推动文旅融合。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Zhejiang Provincial Party Secretary Wang Hao inspected cultural tourism work in Hangzhou, emphasizing integrating culture into tourism and promoting cultural tourism development.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷：全力推动双拥工作高质量发展 不断巩固发展坚如磐石的军政军民团结
articles.title_en: Liu Jie: Strive to Promote High-Quality Development of Double Support Work, Consolidate Unshakable Unity between Military and Government
articles.summary_zh: 28日上午，浙江省委副书记、省长刘捷主持召开省双拥领导小组会议，强调全力推动双拥工作高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 28, Liu Jie, Deputy Secretary of Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee and Governor, chaired a meeting of the Provincial Double Support Leading Group, emphasizing high-quality development of double support work.

articles.title_zh: 两部门公布5起烟花爆竹全链条“打非治违”典型案例
articles.title_en: Two Ministries Release 5 Typical Cases of Crackdown on Illegal Fireworks

articles.summary_en: The State Council Work Safety Committee Office and the Ministry of Emergency Management released 5 typical cases of crackdown on illegal fireworks throughout the supply chain to strengthen warning and deterrence.

articles.title_zh: 生态环境部：今年上半年全国环境质量稳中向好
articles.title_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment: National Environmental Quality Stable and Improving in First Half of Year
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，生态环境部召开新闻发布会，介绍今年上半年全国环境质量稳中向好，PM2.5平均浓度同比下降6.6%。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment held a press conference, reporting stable improvement in national environmental quality in the first half of the year, with PM2.5 average concentration down 6.6% year-on-year.

articles.title_zh: 台媒：柯文哲妻子到大陆旅游一周 称赞此行“惊喜、很棒”
articles.title_en: Ko Wen-je's Wife Takes Week-long Trip to Mainland China, Says It's 'Surprising and Great'
articles.summary_zh: 柯文哲妻子陈佩琪到大陆旅游一周，称赞此行惊喜、很棒，回应岛内质疑；国台办发言人朱凤莲表示两岸交流是主流民意。
articles.summary_en: Chen Peiqi, wife of Ko Wen-je, traveled to mainland China for a week, calling the trip 'surprising and great,' responding to Taiwan media criticism; Zhu Fenglian, spokesperson for the Taiwan Affairs Office, said cross-strait exchanges represent mainstream public opinion.

articles.title_zh: 6月全国查处违反中央八项规定精神问题34700起
articles.title_en: 34,700 Violations of Central Eight-point Regulation Disciplined in June
articles.summary_zh: 中央纪委国家监委通报今年6月全国查处违反中央八项规定精神问题34700起，批评教育和处理43318人，给予党纪政务处分28426人。
articles.summary_en: In June, China's top anti-graft agency investigated 34,700 cases of violations of the Central Eight-point Regulation, involving 43,318 people, with 28,426 receiving party or administrative punishments.

articles.title_zh: 省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议在昆召开
articles.title_en: The 24th Session of the 14th Yunnan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Convened in Kunming
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，云南省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议在昆明召开，听取多项法规草案审议结果、工作报告和人事事项。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, the 24th Session of the 14th Yunnan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee convened in Kunming to review multiple draft regulations, hear work reports, and consider personnel matters.

articles.title_zh: 《疾病预防控制“十五五”规划》发布 将健全社会广泛参与的传染病疫情防控工作格局
articles.title_en: China Releases '15th Five-Year Plan' for Disease Prevention and Control
articles.summary_zh: 国家疾控局会同有关部门起草的《疾病预防控制“十五五”规划》经国务院批复同意，已由7部门联合印发，提出到2030年建成现代化疾控体系。
articles.summary_en: The National Disease Control and Prevention Administration drafted the '15th Five-Year Plan' for Disease Prevention and Control, approved by the State Council and jointly issued by 7 departments, aiming to build a modern disease control system by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 李强在河北唐山调研慰问
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Visits and Offers Condolences in Tangshan, Hebei
articles.summary_zh: 受习近平总书记委托，李强总理7月28日在河北唐山调研慰问，强调提升防灾减灾救灾能力。
articles.summary_en: Entrusted by President Xi Jinping, Premier Li Qiang visited Tangshan, Hebei on July 28 to offer condolences and inspect disaster prevention and relief work, stressing the need to enhance capabilities.

articles.title_zh: 上半年税收收入稳步增长 新质生产力发展成效明显
articles.title_en: Stable Growth in Tax Revenue in First Half of Year, New Quality Productive Forces Show Results
articles.summary_zh: 国务院新闻办7月28日举行新闻发布会，国家税务总局介绍上半年税收收入超10万亿元，同比增长4.9%，新质生产力发展成效显著。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, the State Council Information Office held a press conference where the State Taxation Administration reported that tax revenue exceeded 10 trillion yuan in the first half of the year, up 4.9% year-on-year, with notable progress in new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 何立峰出席2026年亚太经合组织林业部长级会议开幕式并致辞
articles.title_en: He Lifeng Attends and Addresses 2026 APEC Ministerial Meeting on Forestry

articles.summary_en: Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng attended and addressed the opening ceremony of the 2026 APEC Ministerial Meeting on Forestry in Shenzhen on July 28.

articles.title_zh: 强化汛期保障，多地多部门多措并举确保民众平安出行
articles.title_en: Strengthen Flood Season Guarantee: Multiple Departments Take Measures to Ensure Safe Travel
articles.summary_zh: 当前正值防汛关键期，交通运输部启动防御响应，多地多部门加强巡查管控，确保民众平安出行。
