articles.summary_zh: 7月28日上午，青岛市委副书记、市长任刚到市北区、李沧区调研单人AI创业家平台建设、人工智能发展等工作，强调培育智能产业，为高质量发展注入新动能。
articles.summary_en: On July 28 morning, Ren Gang, Deputy Secretary of the Qingdao Municipal Committee and Mayor, visited Shibei and Licang districts to inspect the OPIE platform and AI development, stressing the need to cultivate intelligent industries for high-quality growth.

articles.title_zh: 全市人大常委会主任座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Symposium of Directors
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日上午，青岛市人大常委会主任座谈会在市人大代表教育保障中心召开，市人大常委会党组书记、主任梅建华出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 28, the Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held a symposium of directors at the Municipal People's Congress Representative Education Support Center, attended by Mei Jianhua, who delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 2026年《财富》世界500强榜单发布 3家川企上榜
articles.title_en: 2026 Fortune Global 500 List Released: Three Sichuan Enterprises Make the Cut
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月28日，《财富》世界500强榜单发布，3家四川企业上榜，位次呈现两升一降。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, 2026, the Fortune Global 500 list was released, featuring three Sichuan enterprises: Shudao Investment Group, Tongwei Group, and New Hope Holdings. Their rankings showed two rising and one falling.

articles.title_zh: 四川发布“十五五”时期首批城市更新机会清单
articles.title_en: Sichuan Releases First Batch of Urban Renewal Opportunity List for 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，四川在成都发布“十五五”时期首批城市更新机会清单，涵盖1753个项目，计划总投资5218亿元。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Sichuan released the first batch of urban renewal opportunity list for the '15th Five-Year Plan' period in Chengdu, covering 1,753 projects with a total planned investment of 521.8 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 村里来了“洋亲戚” 驻华外交官在袁家村串门“取经”
articles.title_en: Foreign Diplomats Visit Yuanjia Village to Learn about Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，来自多国的驻华外交官走进袁家村，体验乡村振兴模式，与村民交流。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, foreign diplomats from multiple countries visited Yuanjia Village to experience and learn about rural revitalization models, engaging with villagers.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同斯洛伐克总统会谈：相信你这次访问将为中斯关系不断向前发展注入新动力
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Slovak President: Believes This Visit Will Inject New Impetus into the Continuous Development of China-Slovakia Relations
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日上午，国家主席习近平在北京人民大会堂同来华进行国事访问的斯洛伐克总统佩列格里尼举行会谈，双方愿打造中斯战略伙伴关系。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 28, President Xi Jinping held talks with Slovak President Pellegrini, who is on a state visit to China, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. Both sides expressed willingness to build a China-Slovakia strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 时政微视频丨蹚出来一条路子——习近平推动海南自贸港“样板间”建设
articles.title_en: Political Micro-Video: Xi Jinping Promotes Hainan Free Trade Port as a Model
articles.summary_zh: 微视频回顾习近平2022年考察洋浦经济开发区，强调推动港口与自贸港建设，展示2025年封关运作后成果。
articles.summary_en: A micro-video reviews Xi Jinping's 2022 inspection of Yangpu Economic Development Zone, emphasizing port and free trade port development, showcasing achievements after the 2025 island-wide customs closure.

articles.title_zh: 看到一封封侨批，习近平一席话意味深长
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Remarks on Overseas Chinese Letters and Remittances
articles.summary_zh: 习近平近日对侨务工作作出指示，强调凝聚侨心侨力；此前在汕头参观侨批文物馆时发表讲话。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently instructed on overseas Chinese affairs, emphasizing unity; earlier he spoke at a Qiaopi museum in Shantou.

articles.title_zh: 扎实做好生态环境法典实施准备工作——生态环境部回应法典实施相关热点问题
articles.title_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment Responds to Hot Issues on the Implementation of the Ecological Environment Code
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，生态环境部法规与标准司司长赵柯在新闻发布会上介绍法典实施准备工作，包括文件清理、配套措施等进展。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Zhao Ke, Director of the Department of Regulations and Standards of the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, briefed the press on progress in preparing for the implementation of the Ecological Environment Code, including document review and supporting measures.

articles.title_zh: 外交部回应强闯中国使馆的村田晃大被起诉
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Responds to Indictment of Man Who Stormed Chinese Embassy in Japan
articles.summary_zh: 日本东京地方检察厅对持刀闯入中国驻日本使馆的自卫队官员村田晃大提起公诉，外交部发言人林剑28日答问时敦促日方彻查。
articles.summary_en: Japan's Tokyo District Public Prosecutors Office indicted Murata Akihiro, a Self-Defense Force officer who stormed the Chinese embassy in Japan. Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian urged Japan to conduct a thorough investigation.

articles.title_zh: 江西宜春拟推进中考体育过程测评改革，多个县市担忧经费和实施难题
articles.title_en: Yichun, Jiangxi Plans to Reform Middle School PE Exam Process Assessment; Several Counties Worry About Funding and Implementation
articles.summary_zh: 江西宜春市教育体育局公布中考体育改革方案征求意见情况，多个县市教体局反映实施难度和经费问题。
articles.summary_en: Yichun City Education Bureau released feedback on the reform plan for the high school entrance exam physical education, with multiple county education bureaus expressing concerns about implementation difficulties and funding.

articles.title_zh: 市场监管总局查办“最忙五人组”相关违法案件4件，罚款17万元
articles.title_en: Market Regulation Authority Investigates 4 Cases Related to 'Busiest Five' Group, Fines 170,000 Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 市场监管总局今天召开新闻发布会，通报查办节庆展会论坛违法违规行为，其中查办“最忙五人组”相关案件4件，罚款17万元。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation held a press conference today, reporting that during a three-month special rectification, it investigated 4 cases related to the 'Busiest Five' group and imposed fines of 170,000 yuan.

articles.title_zh: 佛山顺德成立全国首个具身智能发展局
articles.title_en: Foshan Shunde Establishes China's First Embodied Intelligence Development Bureau
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月28日，广东佛山顺德区成立全国首个具身智能发展局，由海玉宝任局长，旨在统筹产业发展，推动人工智能与制造业融合。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, 2026, Shunde District in Foshan, Guangdong, established China's first Embodied Intelligence Development Bureau, with Hai Yubao as director, to coordinate industrial development and integrate AI with manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 擅自使用“中国”“全国”等字样，一批非法社会组织被取缔
articles.title_en: Illegal Social Organizations Using 'China' or 'National' Titles Banned
articles.summary_zh: 民政部通报今年上半年全国处置非法社会组织702个，其中一批冒用官方背景、擅自使用“中国”“全国”等字样的组织被依法取缔。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Civil Affairs reported handling 702 illegal social organizations in H1 2026, including groups unauthorizedly using 'China' or 'National' in their names, which were dissolved.

articles.title_zh: 两部文物管理文件出台：规范革命文物保护与国有文物数据管理
articles.title_en: Two Cultural Heritage Management Documents Issued: Regulating Revolutionary Heritage Protection and State-Owned Heritage Data Management
articles.summary_zh: 28日，国家文物局召开新闻发布会，介绍出台《革命文物保护工程技术导则（试行）》和《国有文物资源数据管理办法》。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, the National Cultural Heritage Administration held a press conference to introduce the issuance of two documents: the 'Technical Guidelines for Revolutionary Cultural Relic Protection (Trial)' and the 'Measures for the Management of State-Owned Cultural Relic Resource Data'.

articles.title_zh: 金圆集团成立15周年：服务产业 融合两岸 打造一流科创金融投资集团
articles.title_en: Jinyuan Group Celebrates 15th Anniversary: Serving Industry, Integrating Cross-Strait, Building First-Class Sci-Tech Finance Investment Group
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，厦门金圆集团成立15周年，上海协同中心揭牌，与国泰海通证券签署战略合作，与复旦大学共建研究基地。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Xiamen Jinyuan Group marked its 15th anniversary, inaugurated its Shanghai Collaboration Center, signed a strategic cooperation agreement with GTJA Haitong Securities, and established a research base with Fudan University.

articles.title_zh: 广西新能源汽车充电量首次突破10亿千瓦时
articles.title_en: Guangxi New Energy Vehicle Charging Volume Exceeds 1 Billion kWh for First Time
articles.summary_zh: 2026年上半年，广西新能源汽车充电量达11.86亿千瓦时，同比增长46.96%，绿色出行规模创新高。
articles.summary_en: In the first half of 2026, Guangxi's new energy vehicle charging volume reached 1.186 billion kWh, a year-on-year increase of 46.96%, setting a new record for green travel.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记强调建设全国统一大市场 为创业创新营造更优环境
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Emphasizes Building a Unified National Market to Create a Better Environment for Innovation and Entrepreneurship
articles.summary_zh: 2025年3月，习近平总书记在贵州考察时强调要积极融入全国统一大市场建设，破除地方保护，为全社会创业创新营造稳定公平透明可预期的环境。
articles.summary_en: In March 2025, during an inspection in Guizhou, President Xi Jinping stressed the need to actively integrate into the construction of a unified national market, break down local protectionism, and create a stable, fair, transparent, and predictable environment for entrepreneurship and innovation.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲在哈尔滨市调研农机装备产业项目建设工作
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Investigates Agricultural Machinery Equipment Industry Project Construction in Harbin
articles.summary_zh: 27日至28日，黑龙江省委副书记、省长梁惠玲在哈尔滨市调研农机装备产业项目建设工作，强调加快培育农业新质生产力，推动智能农机产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 27-28, Liang Huiling, Deputy Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee and Governor, inspected agricultural machinery equipment industry projects in Harbin, emphasizing accelerating the cultivation of new agricultural productive forces to promote high-quality development of the intelligent agricultural machinery industry.

articles.title_zh: 许勤：发挥人民政协协商议政职能 促进黑龙江省人工智能高质量发展
articles.title_en: Xu Qin: Leverage Political Consultative Functions to Promote High-Quality AI Development in Heilongjiang
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，黑龙江省政协召开十三届十五次常委会会议，省委书记许勤出席并讲话，强调发挥政协协商议政职能，促进人工智能高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, the Heilongjiang Provincial Political Consultative Conference held its 15th Standing Committee meeting. Provincial Party Secretary Xu Qin attended and spoke, emphasizing the role of political consultation in promoting high-quality AI development.

articles.title_zh: 长江之滨，新能源巨轮何以驶向全球
articles.title_en: New Energy Ships Set Sail Globally from the Yangtze River
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部数据显示，造船业对工业增长贡献率达23.5%；江苏靖江造船业三大指标占全球一定份额，扬子江船业研发清洁能源船，订单排至2030年。
articles.summary_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology data shows shipbuilding contributes 23.5% to industrial growth. Jingjiang, Jiangsu, holds significant global shipbuilding shares; Yangzijiang Shipbuilding develops clean energy vessels with orders through 2030.

articles.title_zh: 江西省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议举行
articles.title_en: 24th Session of 14th Jiangxi Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Convened
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，江西省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议在南昌举行，省委书记、省人大常委会主任尹弘主持，会议听取多项报告并审议人事任免议案。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, the 24th session of the 14th Jiangxi Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee met in Nanchang, chaired by Yin Hong. The meeting heard reports and considered personnel appointments and removals.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古鄂尔多斯发布零碳机场技术成果
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Ordos Releases Zero-Carbon Airport Technical Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 内蒙古鄂尔多斯市7月27日召开全球首个零碳机场技术成果发布会，该技术由北京大学鄂尔多斯能源研究院研发，达到国际领先水平。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, Ordos, Inner Mongolia held a conference to release the world's first zero-carbon airport technical achievement, which was developed by the Peking University Ordos Energy Research Institute and reached international leading level.

articles.title_zh: 青岛市崂山区“十五五”规划纲要发布
articles.title_en: Laoshan District, Qingdao Issues 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 崂山区人民政府印发“十五五”规划纲要，提出打造创新型品质城区，明确十二大战略任务。
articles.summary_en: The People's Government of Laoshan District issued the 15th Five-Year Plan, aiming to build an innovative and quality urban area with twelve strategic tasks.

articles.title_zh: 山东德州推进数字孪生水网建设
articles.title_en: Shandong Dezhou Promotes Digital Twin Water Network Construction
articles.summary_zh: 山东德州通过数字孪生水网平台，实现水资源智能调度，保障农业灌溉和生活用水，提升防汛排涝能力。
articles.summary_en: Dezhou, Shandong, uses a digital twin water network platform for intelligent water resource scheduling, ensuring agricultural irrigation and domestic water supply, and improving flood control and drainage capabilities.

articles.title_zh: 龚正主持召开市政府党组会议
articles.title_en: Gong Zheng Chairs Municipal Government Party Leadership Group Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 上海市市长龚正昨天主持召开市政府党组会议，传达学习市委九次全会精神，部署下半年经济社会发展工作。
articles.summary_en: Shanghai Mayor Gong Zheng yesterday chaired a meeting of the Municipal Government Party Leadership Group to convey and study the spirit of the 9th Plenary Session of the Municipal Party Committee and arrange economic and social development work for the second half of the year.

articles.title_zh: 习近平对侨务工作作出重要指示
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Important Instructions on Overseas Chinese Affairs
articles.summary_zh: 习近平近日对侨务工作作出重要指示，强调凝聚侨心侨力，促进海内外中华儿女团结奋斗。全国侨务工作会议在京召开，王沪宁出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently issued important instructions on overseas Chinese affairs, emphasizing better uniting the hearts and strength of overseas Chinese and promoting unity of Chinese people at home and abroad. The National Conference on Overseas Chinese Affairs was held in Beijing, with Wang Huning attending and delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 《习近平党建思想的时代特质与世界意义》智库报告吉尔吉斯文、俄文版发布
articles.title_en: Kyrgyz and Russian Versions of Think Tank Report on Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building Released
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，在比什凯克举行的上合组织媒体智库峰会上，中共中央党校与新华社联合发布《习近平党建思想的时代特质与世界意义》智库报告吉尔吉斯文、俄文版。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, at the SCO Media and Think Tank Summit in Bishkek, the Party School of the CPC Central Committee and Xinhua News Agency jointly released the Kyrgyz and Russian versions of a think tank report on Xi Jinping's thought on Party building.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Guangxi Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，自治区党委书记陈刚主持召开党委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话、重要指示及中央有关会议精神，研究部署防灾减灾、基础教育、对外开放、审计和经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, Chen Gang, Secretary of the Guangxi Regional Party Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's recent speeches and instructions, and to deploy work on disaster prevention, basic education, opening-up, auditing, and economic development.

articles.title_en: Gathering Overseas Chinese Hearts and Strength for the Chinese Dream
articles.summary_zh: 全国侨务工作会议7月27日至28日在京召开，传达习近平总书记重要指示，强调凝聚侨心侨力共圆中国梦。
articles.summary_en: The National Overseas Chinese Affairs Conference was held in Beijing from July 27 to 28, conveying important instructions from President Xi Jinping on uniting overseas Chinese to fulfill the Chinese Dream.

articles.title_zh: 我国将统筹推进革命文物环境整治工程
articles.title_en: China to Coordinate Revolutionary Relic Environment Renovation Project
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，国家文物局发布《革命文物保护工程技术导则（试行）》，要求统筹推进革命文物环境整治，保护历史环境要素。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, the National Cultural Heritage Administration issued the Technical Guidelines for Revolutionary Relic Protection Engineering (Trial), requiring coordinated promotion of relic environment renovation and protection of historical environmental elements.

articles.title_zh: 各地深入开展学习教育——推动干部转作风、群众得实惠
articles.title_en: Localities Deepen Education Campaign to Improve Cadre Style and Benefit the People
articles.summary_zh: 近期各地结合学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，开展树立正确政绩观学习教育，推动干部转作风、群众得实惠。
articles.summary_en: Recently, localities have been conducting study and education campaigns on establishing a correct view of achievements, integrating with the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech, to improve cadre work style and deliver benefits to the people.

articles.title_zh: 倒计时100天，第九届进博会热力满满
articles.title_en: 100-Day Countdown to 9th CIIE Kicks Off with Great Enthusiasm
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，第九届进博会迎来倒计时100天，第十届招展在上海同步启动，全球展商签约踊跃。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, the 9th China International Import Expo (CIIE) began its 100-day countdown, while the 10th CIIE exhibition recruitment launched simultaneously in Shanghai, attracting global exhibitors.

articles.title_zh: 二卡社区党支部：用心办实事 同心守边疆
articles.title_en: Erka Community Party Branch: Serving the People and Guarding the Border
articles.summary_zh: 今年7月，内蒙古满洲里市二卡社区党支部荣获全国先进基层党组织称号，该支部长期扎根边境，用心办实事。
articles.summary_en: In July this year, the Erka Community Party Branch in Manzhouli, Inner Mongolia, received the national advanced grassroots Party organization award for its long-term dedication to serving the people and guarding the border.

articles.title_zh: 中国农村发展报告2026发布
articles.title_en: China Rural Development Report 2026 Released
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，中国社会科学院农村发展研究所等机构在京联合发布《中国农村发展报告2026》，并举行学术研讨会。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, the Rural Development Institute of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences and other institutions jointly released the China Rural Development Report 2026 and held an academic seminar in Beijing.

articles.title_zh: 英雄的城市 英雄的人民——唐山50年浴火重生的精神密码
articles.title_en: Heroic City, Heroic People: The Spiritual Code of Tangshan's Rebirth Over 50 Years

articles.title_en: Fujian to Form 'Three Tea' Research and Education Consortium
articles.summary_zh: 7月25日，福建省茶学科教院所长座谈会在福州召开，决定组建福建省“三茶”科研院校协作体，推动茶产业科教资源整合。
articles.summary_en: On July 25, the Fujian Tea Science and Education Symposium was held in Fuzhou, where a decision was made to form the Fujian 'Three Tea' Research and Education Consortium to integrate tea industry resources.

articles.title_zh: 景德镇手工瓷业遗存申遗成功
articles.title_en: Jingdezhen Handmade Porcelain Heritage Inscribed on World Heritage List
articles.summary_zh: 7月25日，联合国教科文组织第48届世界遗产大会在韩国釜山将“景德镇手工瓷业遗存”列入《世界遗产名录》，中国世界遗产总数达61项。
articles.summary_en: On July 25, the 48th UNESCO World Heritage Committee session in Busan, South Korea, inscribed 'Jingdezhen Handmade Porcelain Heritage' on the World Heritage List, bringing China's total World Heritage sites to 61.

articles.title_zh: 市委理论学习中心组进行集体学习研讨
articles.title_en: Qingdao Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Study Center Group Holds Collective Study and Discussion
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日上午，青岛市委理论学习中心组进行集体学习研讨，市委书记曾赞荣主持并讲话，强调以正确政绩观引领干事创业。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 27, the Qingdao Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Study Center Group held a collective study and discussion. Zeng Zanrong, Secretary of the Municipal Party Committee, chaired the meeting and emphasized guiding work with a correct view of performance.

articles.title_zh: 让全社会创业创新环境更优——总书记关切在各地落地
articles.title_en: Creating a Better Environment for Entrepreneurship and Innovation Across Society
articles.summary_zh: 2025年3月，习近平总书记强调积极融入全国统一大市场建设，各地破除地方保护、市场分割和“内卷式”竞争，取得阶段性成效。
articles.summary_en: In March 2025, President Xi Jinping stressed the need to integrate into the national unified market, leading regions to break local protection and involution, achieving initial progress.

articles.title_zh: 川流不息 奋进之力——写在习近平总书记来川视察三周年之际
articles.title_en: Continuous Flow of Endeavor: Marking the Third Anniversary of General Secretary Xi Jinping's Inspection of Sichuan
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾了习近平总书记2023年7月来川视察三年来，四川在科技创新、产业升级、乡村振兴、生态保护、改革开放和民生改善等方面取得的显著成就。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews Sichuan's achievements over the past three years since General Secretary Xi Jinping's inspection in July 2023, highlighting progress in innovation, industry, rural revitalization, ecology, reform, and people's livelihoods.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明讲授树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育专题党课
articles.title_en: Shen Xiaoming Delivers Party Lecture on Correct Performance View
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月27日，湖南省委书记沈晓明讲授树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育专题党课。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, 2026, Hunan Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming delivered a lecture on establishing and practicing a correct view of performance.

articles.title_zh: 斯洛伐克总统佩列格里尼抵达北京开始访华
articles.title_en: Slovak President Pellegrini Arrives in Beijing for State Visit
articles.summary_zh: 应国家主席习近平邀请，斯洛伐克总统佩列格里尼7月27日下午抵达北京，开始为期三天的国事访问。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of President Xi Jinping, Slovak President Peter Pellegrini arrived in Beijing on the afternoon of July 27 for a three-day state visit.

articles.title_zh: 王毅将出席全球发展倡议5周年高级别会议
articles.title_en: Wang Yi to Attend High-Level Meeting on 5th Anniversary of Global Development Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 外交部宣布，全球发展倡议5周年高级别会议将于7月28日在北京举行，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅将出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: The Foreign Ministry announced that the high-level meeting on the 5th anniversary of the Global Development Initiative will be held in Beijing on July 28, with Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, attending and delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 乘江河之势，展主城之为，扬州广陵部署下一阶段“六大重点工作”
articles.title_en: Yangzhou Guangling Deploys Next Phase 'Six Key Tasks' at District Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，中共扬州市广陵区第十次代表大会召开，区委书记张伟部署下一阶段六大重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, the 10th Congress of the CPC Yangzhou Guangling District was held, where District Party Secretary Zhang Wei outlined six key tasks for the next phase.

articles.title_zh: 今年上半年全国实施水利项目3.3万个
articles.title_en: China Implements 33,000 Water Projects in First Half of Year
articles.summary_zh: 水利部数据显示，1至6月全国实施水利项目3.3万个，完成投资5151亿元，引江补汉等重大工程加速推进。
articles.summary_en: According to the Ministry of Water Resources, China implemented 33,000 water projects from January to June, with investment reaching 515.1 billion yuan, and major projects like the Yangtze-Han River diversion accelerated.

articles.title_zh: 江苏半年经济观察：关键指标的“升”与“势”
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Economic Observation: Key Indicators Show Rising Momentum in H1 2026
articles.summary_zh: 2026年上半年江苏省消费、投资、出口多项指标回升，社零总额24163.2亿元，固定资产投资降幅收窄，外贸增长23.9%，经济长期向好。
articles.summary_en: In the first half of 2026, Jiangsu's consumption, investment, and exports showed recovery. Total retail sales reached 2.416 trillion yuan, fixed asset investment decline narrowed, and foreign trade grew 23.9%, indicating a positive economic trend.

articles.title_zh: 多地推进“处改科”，遏制头衔“通货膨胀”
articles.title_en: Many Localities Promote 'Office to Section' Reform to Curb Title Inflation
articles.summary_zh: 工人日报报道，近日江苏淮安、无锡、南通、高邮等多地规范内设机构名称，将“处”改“科”，遏制头衔“通货膨胀”。
articles.summary_en: Workers' Daily reports that many localities including Huai'an, Wuxi, Nantong, Gaoyou in Jiangsu have standardized internal agency names, changing 'Offices' to 'Sections' to curb title inflation.

articles.title_zh: 高度重视孤独症群体！守护“星星的孩子” 将有这些新举措
articles.title_en: High Attention to Autism Group! New Measures to Protect 'Children of the Stars'
articles.summary_zh: 27日上午，国务院新闻办举行发布会，中国残联介绍“十五五”规划首次将孤独症全生命周期关爱促进行动单列专栏，提出多项新举措。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 27, the State Council Information Office held a press conference. The China Disabled Persons' Federation introduced that the 15th Five-Year Plan includes a special column for autism full-life-cycle care, proposing multiple new measures.

articles.title_zh: 中国残联：要全面推进城乡无障碍环境建设，打造全龄友好社会环境
articles.title_en: China Disabled Persons' Federation: Promote Urban and Rural Barrier-Free Environment, Build Age-Friendly Society
articles.summary_zh: 近日，国务院批复《残疾人保障和发展“十五五”规划》。7月27日，国新办发布会上，中国残联副主席李东梅表示将全面推进城乡无障碍环境建设。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the State Council approved the 15th Five-Year Plan for Disability Protection and Development. On July 27, at a press conference, Li Dongmei, Vice Chairperson of CDPF, said they will promote barrier-free environment construction in urban and rural areas.

articles.title_zh: 中国残联：要把提高困难和重度残疾人社会保障水平摆在突出位置
articles.title_en: China Disabled Persons' Federation: Improve Social Security for People with Disabilities
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，中国残联党组书记周长奎在国新办发布会上介绍，将提高残疾人社会保障水平，从兜底保障、赋能发展、权益维护、文化供给四方面推进。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, Zhou Changkui, Party secretary of the China Disabled Persons' Federation, stated at a press conference that social security for disabled persons will be enhanced through four aspects: basic guarantees, empowerment, rights protection, and cultural supply.

articles.title_zh: 处置账号3704个，网信部门严管“自媒体”未规范标注信息来源
articles.title_en: Cyberspace Administration Disciplines 3,704 Accounts for Failing to Properly Label Information Sources
articles.summary_zh: 网信部门近期巡查发现自媒体未规范标注信息来源，处置违规账号3704个，纠正错标漏标短视频4.8万余次。
articles.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration recently inspected and found that self-media accounts failed to properly label information sources, handling 3,704 accounts and correcting 48,000 mislabeled or unlabeled short videos.

articles.title_zh: 吉林大学历史文化学院教授李书源逝世，曾任《史学集刊》副主编
articles.title_en: Professor Li Shuyuan of Jilin University Passes Away at 74
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月26日，吉林大学历史文化学院教授李书源在长春逝世，享年74岁。
articles.summary_en: On July 26, 2026, Professor Li Shuyuan of the School of History and Culture at Jilin University passed away in Changchun at the age of 74.

articles.title_zh: 广西壮族自治区政协原副主席莫虚光逝世，享年100岁
articles.title_en: Mo Xuguang, Former Vice Chairman of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region CPPCC, Dies at 100
articles.summary_zh: 广西壮族自治区政协原副主席莫虚光因病医治无效，于2026年7月21日在南宁逝世，享年100岁。
articles.summary_en: Mo Xuguang, former vice chairman of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), died of illness on July 21, 2026 in Nanning at the age of 100.

articles.title_zh: 中国残联：将健全适龄残疾儿童入学评估机制，完善送教上门
articles.title_en: China Disabled Persons' Federation to Improve Assessment Mechanism for Disabled Children's School Enrollment
articles.summary_zh: 中国残联在国新办发布会上表示，将健全适龄残疾儿童入学评估机制，完善送教上门制度，推动义务教育入学率巩固在97%以上。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference, the China Disabled Persons' Federation announced plans to improve the assessment mechanism for compulsory education enrollment of disabled children and enhance home-based education services, aiming to maintain a 97% enrollment rate.

articles.title_zh: 湖北省人大常委会原党组书记、副主任苏晓云逝世，享年75岁
articles.title_en: Su Xiaoyun, Former Party Chief of Hubei Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee, Dies at 75
articles.summary_zh: 湖北省人大常委会原党组书记、副主任苏晓云因病于2026年7月24日在武昌逝世，享年75岁。
articles.summary_en: Su Xiaoyun, former Party Secretary and Deputy Director of Hubei Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee, passed away in Wuchang on July 24, 2026, at the age of 75.

articles.title_zh: 广西推动矿业权登记全面落地
articles.title_en: Guangxi Promotes Full Implementation of Mining Rights Registration
articles.summary_zh: 广西自然资源厅印发《矿业权登记审查内部工作规则》，规范31类登记业务，上线统一登记模块，纳入不动产统一登记体系。
articles.summary_en: Guangxi's Department of Natural Resources issued internal rules for mining rights registration, standardizing 31 types of registration services and launching a unified registration module, integrating mining rights into the real estate unified registration system.

articles.title_en: Guangxi Implements New Policy to Facilitate Foreign Investment
articles.summary_zh: 广西联合多省推出外国投资者主体资格证明跨省互认机制，将办事周期从一两个月压缩至即时办理。
articles.summary_en: Guangxi, together with several provinces, has introduced a cross-province mutual recognition mechanism for foreign investor qualification documents, reducing processing time from 1-2 months to instant processing.

articles.title_zh: 新时代侨务工作综述
articles.title_en: Overview of Overseas Chinese Affairs in the New Era
articles.summary_zh: 文章总结新时代侨务工作成就，强调习近平总书记对侨务工作的指示，展现侨务工作在凝聚侨心、发挥侨力、维护侨益方面的进展。
articles.summary_en: The article summarizes achievements in overseas Chinese affairs in the new era, highlighting President Xi Jinping's instructions and progress in uniting overseas Chinese, leveraging their strengths, and protecting their rights.

articles.summary_en: Hubei implements Xi Jinping's instructions, launches a cadre quality improvement year, boosts future industries and economic development, striving to lead in high-quality development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt.

articles.title_zh: 京津冀出台2项区域协同地方标准
articles.title_en: Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Releases Two Regional Collaborative Standards
articles.summary_zh: 近日，京津冀三地市场监管部门联合发布2项区域协同地方标准，用碳普惠机制促进交通领域减污降碳协同治理。
articles.summary_en: Recently, market regulatory authorities of Beijing, Tianjin, and Hebei jointly released two regional collaborative standards to promote carbon inclusion mechanisms for pollution and carbon reduction in transportation.

articles.title_zh: 海南出台“十五五”开放型经济发展规划 推动缩减自贸港跨境服务贸易负面清单
articles.title_en: Hainan Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Open Economy, Pushes to Cut Cross-Border Services Negative List
articles.summary_zh: 海南省政府办公厅印发《“十五五”海南开放型经济发展规划》，明确推动缩减跨境服务贸易负面清单等重点任务。
articles.summary_en: Hainan provincial government issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for open economy, aiming to reduce the cross-border services trade negative list and other key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 海南发布政商交往正负面清单
articles.title_en: Hainan Issues Positive and Negative Lists for Government-Business Interactions
articles.summary_zh: 海南省印发政商交往行为指引清单，列出正面清单十项和负面清单"六个严禁"，营造一流营商环境。
articles.summary_en: Hainan Province issued guidelines listing positive and negative behaviors for government-business interactions, aiming to improve the business environment.

articles.title_zh: 海南省“十五五”服务业发展规划出台 岛内居民日用消费品免税店将实现市县全覆盖
articles.title_en: Hainan's 15th Five-Year Plan for Service Industry Development Issued, Duty-free Shops for Daily Consumer Goods to Cover All Counties and Cities
articles.summary_zh: 海南省政府办公厅印发《海南省“十五五”服务业发展规划》，提出到2030年服务业增加值占GDP比重维持61%左右，实现免税店市县全覆盖。
articles.summary_en: Hainan Provincial Government Office issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for service industry development, aiming to keep service sector value-added at around 61% of GDP by 2030 and achieve full coverage of duty-free shops for daily consumer goods across all counties and cities.

articles.title_zh: 海南启动红色文旅线上推广活动 发布8条红色旅游精品线路
articles.title_en: Hainan Launches Online Promotion for Red Culture Tourism, Releases 8 High-Quality Red Tourism Routes
articles.summary_zh: 近日，海南省旅游和文化广电体育厅启动红色文旅线上推广活动，发布8条覆盖多市县的红色旅游精品线路。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Department of Tourism, Culture, Radio, Television and Sports of Hainan Province launched an online promotion for red culture tourism, releasing 8 high-quality red tourism routes covering multiple cities and counties.

articles.summary_zh: 7月25日，中央安全生产考核巡查组第四组在南昌召开见面会，组长凌志峰讲话，江西省省长叶建春作表态发言。
articles.summary_en: On July 25, the fourth central work safety inspection team held a meeting in Nanchang. Team leader Ling Zhifeng spoke, and Jiangxi Governor Ye Jianchun gave a statement.

articles.title_zh: 江西省委政法委举办第三期全省“政法大讲堂”
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Provincial Political and Legal Affairs Commission Holds Third Provincial 'Political and Legal Lecture Hall'
articles.summary_zh: 7月25日，江西省委政法委举办第三期全省“政法大讲堂”，省委副书记、省委政法委书记陈永奇主持并讲话，强调学习贯彻习近平党建思想，推进作风建设。
articles.summary_en: On July 25, the Jiangxi Provincial Political and Legal Affairs Commission held the third provincial 'Political and Legal Lecture Hall'. Chen Yongqi, Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Provincial Political and Legal Affairs Commission, presided and delivered a speech, emphasizing the study and implementation of Xi Jinping's thought on party building and promoting work style construction.

articles.summary_en: On July 23, the Ningxia Department of Industry and Information Technology released the list of 2026 key technology bidding projects for industrial innovation, supporting 25 projects focusing on modern chemicals, new materials, etc.

articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 27, President Xi Jinping had a telephone conversation with Brazilian President Lula upon request, exchanging views on building a China-Brazil community with a shared future and global governance.

articles.title_zh: 海西：实施“五大工程” 打造文旅品牌
articles.title_en: Haixi Implements 'Five Major Projects' to Build Cultural Tourism Brand
articles.summary_zh: 7月24日，海西蒙古族藏族自治州在西宁举行新闻发布会，宣布“十五五”期间实施五大工程，打造文旅品牌。
articles.summary_en: On July 24, the Haixi Mongolian and Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture held a press conference in Xining to announce the implementation of five major projects during the 15th Five-Year Plan period to build a cultural tourism brand.

articles.summary_zh: 今天下午，2026年长三角一体化示范区开发者大会在上海召开，发布急需紧缺人才目录、场景能力清单等。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Yangtze River Delta Integration Demonstration Zone Developer Conference was held in Shanghai this afternoon, releasing a list of urgently needed talents and scenario capability lists.

articles.title_en: Pilot for Shanghai (Putuo) National Digital Advertising Industry Park Launched
articles.summary_zh: 国家市场监督管理总局批复同意在上海市普陀区开展为期3年的国家数字广告产业园区试点，为上海打造“国际数字广告之都”筑牢承载支点。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation approved a 3-year pilot for the National Digital Advertising Industry Park in Putuo District, Shanghai, aiming to build Shanghai into an 'International Digital Advertising Capital'.

articles.title_en: Tianjin Continues to Promote 'Jinnong Premium' Brand Cultivation and Upgrading
articles.summary_zh: 天津市农业农村委推进“津农精品”品牌建设，目前品牌达229个，推动农业品牌化、标准化、融合化发展。
articles.summary_en: Tianjin Municipal Agriculture and Rural Committee advances 'Jinnong Premium' brand cultivation, with 229 brands currently, promoting agricultural branding, standardization, and integration.

articles.title_zh: 第四届滇商大会在昆举行

articles.title_zh: 浙江发布人工智能OPC术语团体标准

articles.summary_en: On July 21, Lei Haichao, head of the National Health Commission, stated in Beijing that China has built and continues to consolidate the world's largest medical service, traditional medicine, disease prevention and control, and medical security systems.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同巴西总统卢拉通电话

articles.summary_en: On July 24, Governor Liu Xiaotao met with Geely Chairman Li Shufu in Nanjing to discuss deepening cooperation in new energy vehicles and other areas.

articles.title_zh: 中国世界遗产总数达61项：景德镇手工瓷业遗存申遗成功

articles.title_zh: 两部门预拨1.8亿元支持6省防汛防台风应急抢险救灾

articles.summary_en: On July 27, the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Emergency Management allocated 180 million yuan for flood and typhoon relief in six provinces including Guangdong and Fujian.

articles.summary_en: The article emphasizes the need to find the right focus for serving the people, by proactively identifying problems, innovating solutions, and turning difficulties into favorable outcomes.

articles.summary_en: On July 26, the National Disaster Prevention and Relief Committee Office and the Ministry of Emergency Management, together with the National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration, allocated 25,000 central relief supplies to Guangdong, Jiangxi, and Hunan for typhoon and flood disaster relief and resettlement.

articles.summary_en: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing July 26, an article elaborates on Xi Jinping's important discourse on overseas Chinese affairs, emphasizing uniting overseas Chinese to contribute to national rejuvenation.

articles.title_zh: 我国成为世界上少数红树林面积持续增加的国家之一

articles.summary_en: On July 26, International Day for the Conservation of the Mangrove Ecosystem, the International Mangrove Center officially commenced operations. China's mangrove area reached 31,700 hectares, a 44% increase from the beginning of this century.

articles.title_zh: 截至6月底我国智能算力规模同比增长177%

articles.summary_en: On July 24, Siping Municipal Party Secretary Wang Xiangmin presided over a standing committee meeting to convey and study the spirit of President Xi Jinping's important speech on science and technology innovation.

articles.summary_en: On July 25, Yan Hanping, Secretary of the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee, inspected work safety, emphasizing bottom-line thinking to ensure people's lives and property safety.

articles.title_zh: 市委召开常委会会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神 研究安全稳定、经济发展、审计等工作 卢荣春主持会议

articles.title_zh: 台风“红霞”登陆广东惠州

articles.title_zh: 任刚到上合示范区调研督导经济运行、文旅产业发展等工作

articles.title_en: First Global Unified Technical Regulation for Automated Driving Systems Released, Key Proposals from Chongqing Adopted
articles.summary_zh: 今年6月，由中国等六国牵头制定的全球首个自动驾驶系统统一技术法规（ADS GTR）正式发布，重庆长安汽车参与编制并贡献了多项被采纳的关键提案。
articles.summary_en: In June, the first global unified technical regulation for automated driving systems (ADS GTR), led by China and five other nations, was released, with key proposals from Chongqing's Changan Automobile adopted.

articles.title_zh: 2026年台湾大学生广州实习体验活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Internship Program for Taiwanese University Students Launched in Guangzhou
articles.summary_zh: 2026年台湾大学生广州实习体验活动于7月12日在广州启动，旨在通过实习历练促进两岸青年融合发展。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Internship Program for Taiwanese University Students was launched in Guangzhou on July 12 to promote integration and development between youth from both sides of the strait.

articles.title_zh: 两部门联合发布红色山洪灾害气象预警
articles.title_en: Two Departments Jointly Issue Red Meteorological Warning for Flash Floods
articles.summary_zh: 水利部和中国气象局于7月12日联合发布红色山洪灾害气象预警，提醒辽宁、吉林、安徽等地做好防汛预警和转移避险工作。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Water Resources and China Meteorological Administration jointly issued a red flash flood warning on July 12, urging regions like Liaoning, Jilin, and Anhui to take precautions.

articles.title_zh: 广西出台措施加强重度残疾人托养照护
articles.title_en: Guangxi Introduces Measures to Strengthen Foster Care for Severely Disabled Persons
articles.summary_zh: 广西自治区民政厅等11部门联合印发若干措施，通过摸清底数、加强供给等24条具体举措，构建覆盖城乡的重度残疾人托养照护服务体系。
articles.summary_en: Eleven departments in Guangxi, including the Civil Affairs Department, issued measures featuring 24 specific steps to build a comprehensive foster care service system for severely disabled persons.

articles.title_zh: 广西实施灌区工程与全域土地综合整治
articles.title_en: Guangxi Implements Irrigation District Projects and Comprehensive Land Consolidation
articles.summary_zh: 广西自然资源厅等四部门联合印发工作方案，通过协同实施灌区工程与全域土地综合整治，旨在保障粮食安全并助力乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: Four departments of Guangxi jointly issued a work plan to collaboratively implement irrigation district projects and comprehensive land consolidation to ensure food security and promote rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 湘鄂工程机械产业合作对接会举行 6家湘企与9家鄂企签约
articles.title_en: Hunan and Hubei Construction Machinery Industry Cooperation Meeting Held, Multiple Enterprises Sign Agreements
articles.summary_zh: 7月9日，鄂湘两省工程机械产业合作对接会在湖北随州举办，6家湖南整机制造龙头企业与9家湖北配套企业签署合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On July 9, a cooperation meeting for the construction machinery industry between Hunan and Hubei provinces was held in Suizhou, Hubei, where 6 leading Hunan manufacturers signed agreements with 9 Hubei suppliers.

articles.title_zh: 张工调度本轮强降雨应对工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Gong Coordinates Response to Heavy Rainfall
articles.summary_zh: 7月11日至12日，天津市市长张工调度部署本轮强降雨应对及防汛防台风工作，旨在维护群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: From July 11 to 12, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong coordinated flood and typhoon prevention efforts to respond to heavy rainfall and ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 浙江安吉做强高端装备制造业
articles.title_en: Anji, Zhejiang Strengthens High-end Equipment Manufacturing Industry
articles.summary_zh: 6月末，浙江安吉举办中力股份创新发布会，展示数字化智造实力，推动高端装备制造业成为当地第一大工业产业。
articles.summary_en: At the end of June, Anji, Zhejiang hosted an innovation conference for Zhongli Machinery, showcasing digital manufacturing and promoting high-end equipment as the county's leading industrial sector.

articles.title_zh: 青海省省长罗东川在西宁督导检查消防安全与防汛减灾工作
articles.title_en: Qinghai Governor Luo Dongchuan Inspects Fire Safety and Flood Prevention in Xining
articles.summary_zh: 7月12日，青海省省长罗东川在西宁市突击检查消防安全及防汛减灾工作，要求坚决落实各项防范举措，确保群众安全度汛。
articles.summary_en: On July 12, Qinghai Governor Luo Dongchuan conducted surprise inspections of fire safety and flood prevention in Xining, emphasizing the implementation of safety measures to protect lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同金正恩就《中朝友好合作互助条约》签订65周年互致贺电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Kim Jong Un Exchange Congratulatory Messages on 65th Anniversary of China-DPRK Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月11日，习近平同朝鲜劳动党总书记金正恩就《中朝友好合作互助条约》签订65周年互致贺电，强调巩固中朝传统友谊，维护地区和平稳定。
articles.summary_en: On July 11, 2026, Xi Jinping and Kim Jong Un exchanged congratulatory messages on the 65th anniversary of the China-DPRK Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance, emphasizing the consolidation of traditional ties and regional stability.

articles.title_zh: 刘国中在北京调研强调抓好水库安全度汛工作
articles.title_en: Liu Guozhong Emphasizes Reservoir Safety During Flood Season During Inspection in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 7月12日，国务院副总理刘国中在北京调研水库安全度汛工作，要求全面落实防洪应对措施，切实保障人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On July 12, Vice Premier Liu Guozhong inspected reservoir safety in Beijing, urging the full implementation of flood control measures to protect lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 我国新材料领域持续取得新突破
articles.title_en: China Continues to Make Breakthroughs in New Materials Field
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来，我国新材料产业在智能材料、半导体等领域取得密集突破，产值近10万亿元，成为培育新质生产力的重要引擎。
articles.summary_en: Since the beginning of this year, China's new materials industry has achieved significant breakthroughs in intelligent materials and semiconductors, with an output value of nearly 10 trillion yuan, driving new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 海南自贸港加工增值免关税政策实施5年 享惠货值超121亿元
articles.title_en: Hainan Free Trade Port's Processing Value-Added Duty-Free Policy Marks 5 Years with Over 12.1 Billion Yuan in Benefiting Goods
articles.summary_zh: 海口海关消息，海南自贸港加工增值免关税政策实施5年，内销货值超121亿元，覆盖11个行业，助力海南打造前沿加工基地。
articles.summary_en: Haikou Customs reports that Hainan Free Trade Port's processing value-added duty-free policy has been implemented for five years, with domestic sales value exceeding 12.1 billion yuan across 11 industries.

articles.title_zh: 盐城从新四军历史汲取奋进力量 为民兴业为民造福
articles.title_en: Yancheng Draws Strength from New Fourth Army History to Benefit the People
articles.summary_zh: 江苏盐城传承新四军革命精神，通过建设滨海港和发展海上风电产业，将红色基因转化为推动绿色发展和民生改善的动力。
articles.summary_en: Yancheng, Jiangsu, inherits the revolutionary spirit of the New Fourth Army, transforming red heritage into momentum for green development and improving livelihoods through Binhai Port and offshore wind power.

articles.title_zh: 习近平：打通科技加速向现实生产力转化通道
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping: Clearing the Path for Accelerating the Transformation of Science and Technology into Actual Productivity
articles.summary_zh: 7月8日，习近平在北京出席中国国家科学技术奖励大会等会议并发表重要讲话，号召加快推进高水平科技自立自强，以科技创新支撑中国式现代化。
articles.summary_en: On July 8, Xi Jinping attended several science and technology conferences in Beijing, calling for high-level self-reliance in science and technology to support Chinese modernization.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁到省气象局调研
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Inspects Provincial Meteorological Bureau
articles.summary_zh: 7月11日，省委书记刘宁到省气象局调研防汛备汛及预报预警工作，强调要提升监测预报精准度，筑牢防灾减灾救灾安全防线。
articles.summary_en: On July 11, Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning inspected the Provincial Meteorological Bureau to review flood prevention and forecasting work, emphasizing the need to improve monitoring precision to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 我国统筹部署建设新型电网
articles.title_en: China Strategically Deploys Construction of New Power Grids
articles.summary_zh: 党中央统筹部署建设新型电网等“六张网”重大基础设施，旨在通过构建“主配微”协同体系和技术创新，保障国家能源安全并支撑中国式现代化。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee has deployed the construction of six major infrastructure networks, including new power grids, to ensure national energy security and support Chinese modernization through a 'main-distribution-micro' collaborative system.

articles.title_zh: 山东部署六大行动推动数据赋能人工智能发展
articles.title_en: Shandong Deploys Six Major Actions to Promote Data-Empowered AI Development
articles.summary_zh: 山东省大数据局起草《关于数据赋能人工智能创新发展的实施意见》，通过六大行动推动数据与人工智能协同发展，目标到2028年打造产业高地。
articles.summary_en: The Shandong Provincial Big Data Bureau issued implementation opinions deploying six major actions to promote the synergy between data elements and AI, aiming to build an industry highland by 2028.

articles.title_zh: 云南拟出台措施支持旅居群体创新创业
articles.title_en: Yunnan Plans Measures to Support Innovation and Entrepreneurship for Sojourning Groups
articles.summary_zh: 云南省科技厅起草并征求意见的《若干措施》旨在通过设立服务专区、打造科创社区及提供最高200万元奖励，支持旅居群体在滇创新创业。
articles.summary_en: The Yunnan Provincial Department of Science and Technology has drafted measures to support innovation and entrepreneurship for sojourning groups through service zones, sci-tech communities, and financial rewards of up to 2 million yuan.

articles.title_zh: 浙江省全面启动防台风I级响应，省长刘捷主持防御工作会商调度会议
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Activates Level I Typhoon Response, Governor Liu Jie Chairs Coordination Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 11日上午，浙江省全面启动防台风I级响应，省长刘捷主持召开台风“巴威”防御工作会商调度会议，部署各项防御措施以保障人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of the 11th, Zhejiang Province activated a Level I typhoon response. Governor Liu Jie chaired a coordination meeting to deploy defense measures against Typhoon Bawi to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 习近平会见朝鲜内阁总理朴泰成
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Meets with DPRK Premier Pak Tae-song
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月10日，习近平在北京会见朝鲜内阁总理朴泰成，双方就巩固中朝传统友好、加强战略协作及落实两国领导人共识进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On July 10, 2026, Xi Jinping met with DPRK Premier Pak Tae-song in Beijing to discuss strengthening traditional China-DPRK friendship and enhancing strategic coordination.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同纳米比亚总统恩代特瓦会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Namibian President Ndeetowa
articles.summary_zh: 7月10日下午，国家主席习近平在北京人民大会堂同来华进行国事访问的纳米比亚总统恩代特瓦举行会谈。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 10, President Xi Jinping held talks with Namibian President Ndeetowa, who is on a state visit to China, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同纳米比亚总统恩代特瓦会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Meets with Namibian President Ndeetowa
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月10日，国家主席习近平在北京同纳米比亚总统恩代特瓦举行会谈，两国宣布将双边关系提升为新时代中纳命运共同体。
articles.summary_en: On July 10, 2026, President Xi Jinping held talks with Namibian President Ndeetowa in Beijing, where both leaders announced the elevation of bilateral relations to a China-Namibia Community with a Shared Future in the New Era.

tags.name_en: China-Namibia Community with a Shared Future

tags_en: China-Namibia Community with a Shared Future

articles.title_zh: 李强同朝鲜内阁总理会谈
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Holds Talks with North Korean Premier
articles.summary_zh: 李强同朝鲜内阁总理朴泰成举行会谈，双方强调将落实最高领导人共识，拓展经贸与民生合作，加强战略协调与配合。
articles.summary_en: Li Qiang held talks with North Korean Premier Pak Tae-song, emphasizing the implementation of the consensus between top leaders and expanding cooperation in trade, livelihood, and strategic coordination.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省政府与中国电力建设集团签订“十五五”战略合作协议
articles.title_en: Gansu Provincial Government and PowerChina Sign "15th Five-Year Plan" Strategic Cooperation Agreement
articles.summary_zh: 7月8日，甘肃省政府与中国电力建设集团在兰州签署“十五五”战略合作协议，旨在深化在能源电力、水利及基础设施等领域的合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 8, the Gansu Provincial Government and PowerChina signed a "15th Five-Year Plan" strategic cooperation agreement in Lanzhou to deepen collaboration in energy, water conservancy, and infrastructure.

articles.title_zh: 江西省委常委会召开会议学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting Studies Xi Jinping's Important Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 7月10日，省委书记尹弘主持召开江西省委常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记关于科技创新、防汛救灾、安全生产、外事工作及开发区建设等重要指示精神。
articles.summary_en: On July 10, Provincial Party Secretary Yin Hong chaired a meeting of the Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee to implement Xi Jinping's instructions on sci-tech innovation, flood control, safety, and foreign affairs.

articles.title_zh: 兵团党委常委会研究部署防汛减灾救灾和安全生产工作
articles.title_en: XPCC Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting Deploys Flood Control and Safety Production Work
articles.summary_zh: 7月10日，兵团党委书记何忠友主持召开常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神，部署防汛减灾救灾和安全生产工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 10, He Zhongyou, Secretary of the XPCC Party Committee, chaired a meeting to implement President Xi Jinping's instructions and deploy work on flood control, disaster relief, and safety production.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同金正恩就《中朝友好合作互助条约》签订65周年互致贺电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Kim Jong Un Exchange Congratulatory Messages on 65th Anniversary of China-DPRK Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance
articles.summary_zh: 7月11日，习近平同金正恩就《中朝友好合作互助条约》签订65周年互致贺电，强调巩固中朝传统友谊，共同维护地区和平与发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 11, Xi Jinping and Kim Jong Un exchanged congratulatory messages on the 65th anniversary of the China-DPRK Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance, emphasizing the consolidation of traditional ties and regional peace.

articles.title_zh: 敦煌文化产业示范园区管理委员会原副主任吴永成严重违纪违法被开除党籍
articles.title_en: Wu Yongcheng, Former Deputy Director of Dunhuang Cultural Industry Demonstration Zone Management Committee, Expelled from Party for Serious Violations
articles.summary_zh: 酒泉市纪委监委日前宣布，敦煌文化产业示范园区管理委员会原副主任吴永成因严重违纪违法被开除党籍，其涉嫌犯罪问题已移送检察机关。
articles.summary_en: The Jiuquan Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision announced that Wu Yongcheng, former deputy director of the Dunhuang Cultural Industry Demonstration Zone Management Committee, was expelled from the Party for serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 河南发布农田渍涝灾害风险预警
articles.title_en: Henan Issues Farmland Waterlogging Disaster Risk Warning
articles.summary_zh: 河南省农业农村厅与气象局于7月10日联合发布农田渍涝灾害风险预警，提醒受台风“巴威”影响的地区加强防范。
articles.summary_en: The Henan Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs and the Meteorological Bureau issued a farmland waterlogging risk warning on July 10 due to the impact of Typhoon Bawi.

tags.name_en: Henan Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

tags_en: Henan Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

articles.title_zh: 水利部对黑龙江启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Launches Level IV Emergency Response for Flood Defense in Heilongjiang
articles.summary_zh: 水利部7月11日对黑龙江省启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，以应对台风“巴威”带来的大到暴雨及潜在洪水风险。
articles.summary_en: On July 11, the Ministry of Water Resources launched a Level IV emergency response for flood defense in Heilongjiang Province to address heavy rain and flood risks caused by Typhoon Bawi.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明到湖南大学调研并主持召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Shen Xiaoming Visits Hunan University for Research and Chairs Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 7月10日，湖南省委书记沈晓明到湖南大学调研并主持座谈会，强调要服务国家战略，推动省校双向赋能，助力地方高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 10, Shen Xiaoming, Secretary of the Hunan Provincial Party Committee, visited Hunan University to conduct research and chair a symposium, emphasizing the need to serve national strategies and promote synergy between the province and the university.

articles.title_zh: 四川大学华西第二医院发布医学人才智慧评价系统
articles.title_en: West China Second University Hospital of Sichuan University Releases Intelligent Medical Talent Evaluation System
articles.summary_zh: 7月10日，四川大学华西第二医院在成都发布“创知”医学人才发展智慧系统，旨在通过多元评价体系破解医学人才培养与评价的困境。
articles.summary_en: On July 10, West China Second University Hospital of Sichuan University released the 'Chuangzhi' Intelligent Medical Talent Development System in Chengdu to optimize the evaluation and cultivation of medical professionals.

articles.title_zh: 历史性突破 长征十号乙完成全球首次海上网系回收
articles.title_en: Historic Breakthrough: Long March 10B Completes World's First Sea-Based Net Recovery
articles.summary_zh: 7月10日，长征十号乙运载火箭在海南商业航天发射场成功发射，并完成全球首次海上网系回收，为后续火箭复用飞行奠定基础。
articles.summary_en: On July 10, the Long March 10B rocket was launched from Hainan Commercial Space Launch Site, achieving the world's first sea-based net recovery of its first stage.

articles.title_zh: 上半年新能源汽车出口同比增长1.2倍
articles.title_en: China's New Energy Vehicle Exports Grew by 1.2 Times in First Half of Year
articles.summary_zh: 中国汽车工业协会数据显示，今年1-6月我国汽车出口509.6万辆，其中新能源汽车出口235.5万辆，同比增长1.2倍。
articles.summary_en: According to the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, China exported 5.096 million vehicles from January to June, with NEV exports increasing by 1.2 times to 2.355 million units.

articles.title_zh: 党员干部在抢险救灾一线挺膺担当
articles.title_en: Party Members and Cadres Take Charge in Disaster Relief Efforts
articles.summary_zh: 报道了甘肃、广西、湖北、辽宁等地党员干部在面对山体滑坡、洪水、龙卷风等自然灾害时，冲锋在前开展抢险救灾的先进事迹。
articles.summary_en: The report highlights the efforts of Party members and cadres in Gansu, Guangxi, Hubei, and Liaoning who led disaster relief operations during landslides, floods, and tornadoes.

articles.title_zh: 公安部交管局提示暑期自驾“五要五不要”
articles.title_en: Traffic Management Bureau of Ministry of Public Security Issues "Five Dos and Five Don'ts" for Summer Self-Driving Safety
articles.summary_zh: 公安部交管局针对近期多起暑期自驾交通事故，发布“五要五不要”安全提示，提醒公众文明驾驶，确保出行安全。
articles.summary_en: The Traffic Management Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security issued "Five Dos and Five Don'ts" safety tips for summer self-driving following several fatal road accidents.

tags_en: Traffic Management Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security

articles.title_zh: 中国移动通信集团北京有限公司原副总经理郭旗、刘南被查
articles.title_en: Former Deputy General Managers of China Mobile Beijing Guo Qi and Liu Nan Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 中国移动通信集团北京有限公司原副总经理郭旗、刘南涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受纪律审查和监察调查。

articles.summary_zh: 7月6日，上海徐汇滨江南部片区“研创梦工场”规划正式启动，旨在打造AI硬科技产业化主阵地，促进科研成果转化与产城融合。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, the planning for the "Research and Innovation Dream Factory" in the southern area of Xuhui Waterfront, Shanghai, was officially launched to create a hub for AI hard-tech industrialization.

articles.title_zh: 2026年上海市民营经济人士理想信念报告会举行
articles.title_en: 2026 Report Meeting on Ideals and Beliefs for Private Economy Figures in Shanghai Held
articles.summary_zh: 上海市委统战部与市工商联近日联合举办2026年民营经济人士理想信念报告会，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，增强发展信心。
articles.summary_en: The United Front Work Department of the Shanghai Municipal Committee and the Municipal Federation of Industry and Commerce recently held a report meeting on ideals and beliefs for private economy figures to implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's instructions.

articles.title_zh: 《全国气象发展“十五五”规划》印发
articles.title_en: 15th Five-Year Plan for National Meteorological Development Issued
articles.summary_zh: 中国气象局联合国家发展和改革委员会印发《全国气象发展“十五五”规划》，旨在到2030年显著提升极端天气监测预报预警能力，构建现代气象体系。
articles.summary_en: The China Meteorological Administration and the National Development and Reform Commission issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for National Meteorological Development to enhance extreme weather forecasting and build a modern meteorological system by 2030.

articles.title_zh: “美丽中国行之探访三江源”集中采访启动
articles.title_en: "Beautiful China Tour: Exploring Sanjiangyuan" Concentrated Interview Tour Launches
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日，由中央宣传部等部门主办的“美丽中国行之探访三江源”集中采访在青海西宁启动，旨在展现三江源地区生态保护与绿色发展成效。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, the "Beautiful China Tour: Exploring Sanjiangyuan" concentrated interview tour, hosted by the Central Propaganda Department and other agencies, launched in Xining, Qinghai, to showcase ecological protection and green development.

articles.title_zh: 中央安全生产考核巡查组第二十一组向北京市反馈明查暗访情况
articles.title_en: The 21st Central Work Safety Assessment and Inspection Group Provides Feedback to Beijing Municipality
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日，中央安全生产考核巡查组第二十一组向北京市反馈明查暗访情况，市委书记尹力、市长殷勇参加会议并部署整改工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, the 21st Central Work Safety Assessment and Inspection Group provided feedback on its inspections to Beijing. Party Secretary Yin Li and Mayor Yin Yong attended the meeting to deploy rectification efforts.

articles.title_zh: 中国国际服务贸易交易会工作省部际联席会议召开
articles.title_en: Inter-ministerial and Provincial Joint Meeting on China International Fair for Trade in Services Convened
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月6日，商务部长王文涛与北京市市长殷勇出席服贸会工作省部际联席会议，研究并部署2026年服贸会的筹备工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, 2026, Minister of Commerce Wang Wentao and Beijing Mayor Yin Yong attended a joint meeting to discuss and deploy preparations for the 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services.

articles.title_zh: 深圳公益救援队抵达广西横州开展洪涝救援
articles.title_en: Shenzhen Public Welfare Rescue Team Arrives in Hengzhou, Guangxi for Flood Relief
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月7日，深圳公益救援队抵达广西横州市马岭镇，利用农业无人机向受灾群众运送物资。
articles.summary_en: On July 7, 2026, the Shenzhen Public Welfare Rescue Team arrived in Maling Town, Hengzhou, Guangxi, using agricultural drones to deliver supplies to flood victims.

articles.title_zh: 安徽省深入推动“共同成长计划＋”
articles.title_en: Anhui Province Deeply Promotes 'Common Growth Plan +'
articles.summary_zh: 人民银行安徽省分行等部门联合印发通知，通过实施“共同成长计划＋”，引导金融机构从抵押依赖转向价值驱动，支持科技企业全生命周期融资。
articles.summary_en: The PBOC Anhui Branch and other departments issued a notice to promote the 'Common Growth Plan +', guiding financial institutions to shift from collateral-dependence to value-driven support for tech enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 淮河防总启动防汛四级应急响应
articles.title_en: Huaihe Flood Control Headquarters Activates Level IV Emergency Response
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日，淮河防总和淮委针对台风“美莎克”带来的大到暴雨，启动防汛四级应急响应和洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, the Huaihe Flood Control Headquarters and the Huaihe River Commission activated Level IV emergency responses for flood control and defense due to heavy rains from Typhoon Maisak.

articles.title_zh: 梁言顺调研核聚变能科技创新工作并主持召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Liang Yanshun Investigates Nuclear Fusion Energy Tech Innovation and Chairs Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日，安徽省委书记梁言顺在合肥调研核聚变能科技创新工作并主持座谈会，强调要抢占核聚变能发展制高点，实现高水平科技自立自强。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, Anhui Provincial Party Secretary Liang Yanshun investigated nuclear fusion energy tech innovation in Hefei and chaired a symposium, emphasizing the need to lead in nuclear fusion development and achieve high-level tech self-reliance.

articles.title_zh: 重庆市与哈尔滨工业大学签署深化战略合作协议
articles.title_en: Chongqing Municipality and Harbin Institute of Technology Sign Agreement to Deepen Strategic Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日下午，重庆市人民政府与哈尔滨工业大学签署深化战略合作协议，重点在人工智能、低空经济、人才培养等领域开展合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, the Chongqing Municipal People's Government and Harbin Institute of Technology signed a strategic cooperation agreement to deepen collaboration in AI, low-altitude economy, and talent cultivation.

articles.title_zh: 智驾“强标”发布，明年1月实施，产业链将迎优胜劣汰
articles.title_en: Mandatory National Standard for Smart Driving Released, Effective January Next Year
articles.summary_zh: 工信部发布首个L2级组合驾驶辅助强制性国家标准，将于2027年1月1日起实施，旨在提升智驾安全并推动汽车产业链优胜劣汰。
articles.summary_en: MIIT released the first mandatory national standard for L2 combined driving assistance, effective Jan 1, 2027, to enhance safety and drive industry consolidation.

articles.title_zh: 广东水利部署做好当前西江洪水防御工作
articles.title_en: Guangdong Water Resources Department Deploys Flood Defense for Xijiang River
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日，广东省水利厅发布通知，部署做好西江洪水防御工作，以应对台风“美莎克”带来的强降雨及涨水风险。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, the Guangdong Provincial Department of Water Resources issued a notice to deploy flood defense measures for the Xijiang River in response to heavy rainfall and rising water levels caused by Typhoon Maisak.

articles.title_zh: 任振鹤主持召开省政府常务会议部署防汛抗旱及工业发展工作
articles.title_en: Ren Zhenhe Chairs Provincial Government Executive Meeting to Deploy Flood Control and Industrial Development
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日，甘肃省长任振鹤主持召开省政府常务会议，部署防汛抗旱、强工业行动及开发区发展，并审议通过零基预算改革方案。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, Gansu Governor Ren Zhenhe chaired a provincial government executive meeting to deploy flood and drought prevention, industrial strengthening, and development zone growth, and approved a zero-based budgeting reform plan.

articles.title_zh: 韦韬主持召开台风“美莎克”过境防汛防灾视频调度会
articles.title_en: Wei Tao Chairs Video Scheduling Meeting on Flood and Disaster Prevention for Typhoon Maisak
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日，自治区主席韦韬主持召开视频调度会，部署台风“美莎克”过境期间的防汛防灾工作，要求全力保障人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, Chairman Wei Tao chaired a video scheduling meeting to deploy flood and disaster prevention measures for Typhoon Maisak, emphasizing the protection of lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委组织部号召党员干部在防汛防台风抢险救灾中担当作为
articles.title_en: Organization Department of Autonomous Region Party Committee Calls for Cadres to Take Responsibility in Flood and Typhoon Relief
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日，自治区党委组织部印发通知，要求各级党组织和党员干部在防汛防台风抢险救灾中发挥先锋作用，强化应急值守与一线指挥。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, the Organization Department of the Autonomous Region Party Committee issued a notice urging party organizations and cadres to play a leading role in flood and typhoon relief efforts.

articles.title_zh: 水利部部署台风暴雨洪水防御工作
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Deploys Typhoon and Flood Defense Work
articles.summary_zh: 水利部于7月7日在北京举行专题会商，分析研判台风“美莎克”和“巴威”的影响，部署暴雨洪水防御及险情处置工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 7, the Ministry of Water Resources held a special meeting in Beijing to analyze the impact of Typhoons Mashack and Bavi and deploy flood defense and emergency response measures.

articles.title_zh: 省政协十三届常委会第二十次会议开幕
articles.title_en: The 20th Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 13th Henan Provincial Committee of the CPPCC Opens
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日，河南省政协十三届常委会第二十次会议在郑州开幕，由省政协主席孔昌生主持，重点协商推进科技创新和产业创新深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, the 20th Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 13th Henan Provincial Committee of the CPPCC opened in Zhengzhou, chaired by Chairman Kong Changsheng, focusing on the integration of scientific and industrial innovation.

articles.title_zh: 毛万春在张家界调研 聚力共建大张家界国际旅游区
articles.title_en: Mao Wanchun Conducts Research in Zhangjiajie to Promote the Construction of Greater Zhangjiajie International Tourism Zone
articles.summary_zh: 7月4日至5日，湖南省政协主席毛万春在张家界市开展调研，聚焦大张家界国际旅游区建设、农村公路高质量发展及乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: From July 4 to 5, Mao Wanchun, Chairman of the Hunan Provincial CPPCC, conducted research in Zhangjiajie to promote the construction of the Greater Zhangjiajie International Tourism Zone and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明到中南大学调研并主持召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Shen Xiaoming Visits Central South University for Research and Chairs Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 湖南省委书记沈晓明近日到中南大学调研并主持召开座谈会，强调要立足自身所长，为全省高质量发展作出更大贡献。
articles.summary_en: Shen Xiaoming, Secretary of the Hunan Provincial Party Committee, visited Central South University to conduct research and chair a symposium, emphasizing the university's role in promoting high-quality provincial development.

articles.title_zh: 唇腭裂专病中心在成都成立
articles.title_en: Cleft Lip and Palate Special Disease Center Established in Chengdu
articles.summary_zh: 7月7日，四川首个唇腭裂专病中心在四川大学华西口腔医院揭牌成立，并同步举行“一带一路”国家唇腭裂先进诊疗技术国际培训班。
articles.summary_en: On July 7, Sichuan's first Cleft Lip and Palate Special Disease Center was established at West China Hospital of Sichuan University, alongside a "Belt and Road" international training program.

articles.title_zh: 山东印发食品广告发布合规指引
articles.title_en: Shandong Issues Compliance Guidelines for Food Advertising
articles.summary_zh: 山东省市场监管局印发《食品广告发布合规指引》，明确食品广告不得涉及疾病治疗功能，禁止“大字吸睛、小字免责”并要求标注AI生成内容。
articles.summary_en: The Shandong Provincial Market Supervision Bureau issued the 'Food Advertising Compliance Guidelines,' banning disease treatment claims and 'big font attraction, small font disclaimer' tactics, and requiring AI-generated content labels.

articles.title_zh: 山西发布政府投资基金路线图
articles.title_en: Shanxi Releases Roadmap for Government Investment Funds
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日，山西省发改委发布《山西省政府投资基金重点投资领域清单》，明确10个门类34个大类投资方向，旨在引导社会资本支持新质生产力发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, the Shanxi Provincial Development and Reform Commission released a list of key investment areas for government investment funds to guide social capital toward new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 天津市政府召开第110次常务会议 张工主持
articles.title_en: Tianjin Municipal Government Holds 110th Executive Meeting Chaired by Zhang Gong
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日下午，市长张工主持召开天津市政府第110次常务会议，审议多项条例草案及能源、自然资源、海洋经济等“十五五”规划。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 6, Mayor Zhang Gong chaired the 110th executive meeting of the Tianjin Municipal Government to review several draft regulations and '15th Five-Year Plans' for energy, natural resources, and the marine economy.

articles.title_zh: 以法治力量推动职业教育高质量发展
articles.title_en: Promoting High-Quality Development of Vocational Education through the Rule of Law
articles.summary_zh: 全国人大常委会副委员长蔡达峰率执法检查组赴天津，检查职业教育法实施情况，强调要以法治力量破解难题，推动职业教育高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Cai Dafeng, Vice Chairperson of the NPC Standing Committee, led an inspection team to Tianjin to oversee the implementation of the Vocational Education Law and promote high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 王予波强调系统提升固废综合治理能力水平 加快经济社会发展全面绿色转型
articles.title_en: Wang Yubo Emphasizes Improving Solid Waste Governance and Accelerating Green Transformation
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日，云南省省长王予波在全省固体废物暨磷石膏综合治理工作推进会议上强调，要系统提升固废治理能力，加快经济社会发展全面绿色转型。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, Yunnan Governor Wang Yubo emphasized the need to systematically improve solid waste governance and accelerate the comprehensive green transformation of economic and social development.

articles.title_zh: 云南省政府与中广核签署战略合作协议
articles.title_en: Yunnan Provincial Government and CGN Sign Strategic Cooperation Agreement
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日，云南省政府与中国广核集团有限公司在昆明签署“十五五”战略合作协议，旨在深化绿电与先进制造业等领域的合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, the Yunnan Provincial Government and China General Nuclear Power Corporation (CGN) signed a '15th Five-Year Plan' strategic cooperation agreement in Kunming to deepen cooperation in green energy and advanced manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 乌兰察布市人大常委会主任史良去世
articles.title_en: Shi Liang, Director of the Standing Committee of Ulanqab Municipal People's Congress, Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 乌兰察布市人大常委会主任史良去世。史良曾任鄂尔多斯市委常委、乌兰察布市委副书记等职。
articles.summary_en: Shi Liang, Director of the Standing Committee of the Ulanqab Municipal People's Congress, has passed away. He previously served as a member of the Ordos Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee.

articles.title_en: Former Shaanxi Provincial Committee Member and Xi'an Party Secretary Fang Hongwei Expelled from Party and Public Office
articles.summary_zh: 7月7日，中央纪委国家监委宣布，陕西省委原常委、西安市委原书记方红卫因严重违纪违法被开除党籍和公职，其涉嫌犯罪问题已移送检察机关。
articles.summary_en: On July 7, the CCDI and NSC announced that Fang Hongwei, former member of the Shaanxi Provincial Committee and former Party Secretary of Xi'an, was expelled from the Party and public office for serious disciplinary and legal violations.

articles.title_en: Former First-level Researcher of Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision Li Li Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月6日，四川省纪委监委通报原一级调研员李莉涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, 2026, the Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision announced that Li Li, a former first-level researcher, is under investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 滇藏公路通车50周年：穿越横断山的现代之路
articles.title_en: 50th Anniversary of Yunnan-Tibet Highway: A Modern Road Through the Hengduan Mountains
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月6日，滇藏公路迎来通车50周年。该公路自1950年起建设，打破了横断山的封闭，促进了边疆现代化与民族团结。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, 2026, the Yunnan-Tibet Highway marked its 50th anniversary. Built since 1950, the road broke the isolation of the Hengduan Mountains, promoting frontier modernization and ethnic unity.

articles.title_zh: 6月份中国物流业景气指数加快扩张
articles.title_en: China's Logistics Industry Prosperity Index Expanded Faster in June
articles.summary_zh: 中国物流与采购联合会数据显示，6月份中国物流业景气指数为50.6%，较上月上升0.3个百分点，业务总量和投资指数均有所回升。
articles.summary_en: The China Federation of Logistics & Purchasing reported that China's logistics industry prosperity index rose to 50.6% in June, reflecting growth in business volume and investment.

articles.title_zh: 今年“两重”建设项目清单全部下达完毕
articles.title_en: List of 'Two Major' Construction Projects for the Year Fully Issued
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委近日下达2026年第三批“两重”建设项目，今年共安排8000亿元资金支持1417个重大项目建设。
articles.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission has issued the third batch of 'Two Major' construction projects for 2026, allocating a total of 800 billion yuan to 1,417 major projects this year.

articles.title_zh: 芬兰总统斯图布会见王毅
articles.title_en: Finnish President Stubb Meets Wang Yi
articles.summary_zh: 7月5日，芬兰总统斯图布在图尔库会见外交部长王毅，双方探讨加强高层交往及在绿色经济、人工智能等领域的合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 5, Finnish President Stubb met with Foreign Minister Wang Yi in Turku to discuss strengthening high-level exchanges and cooperation in green economy and AI.

articles.title_zh: 全年2000亿元设备更新资金总额下达完毕
articles.title_en: Total Annual Allocation of 200 Billion Yuan for Equipment Updates Completed
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委等部门已完成全年2000亿元超长期特别国债资金的下达，共支持22个领域约1.1万个设备更新项目。
articles.summary_en: The NDRC and relevant departments have completed the allocation of 200 billion yuan in ultra-long-term special treasury bonds, supporting approximately 11,000 equipment update projects across 22 fields.

articles.title_zh: 刘国中在山东调研强调推动生物医药、农机装备创新及现代化水网建设
articles.title_en: Liu Guozhong Emphasizes Innovation in Biopharmaceuticals, Agricultural Machinery, and Modern Water Network Construction During Shandong Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 国务院副总理刘国中于7月4日至6日在山东调研，强调要推动生物医药和农机装备创新发展，并加快推进现代化水网建设。
articles.summary_en: Vice Premier Liu Guozhong conducted a research tour in Shandong from July 4 to 6, emphasizing the innovation of biopharmaceuticals and agricultural machinery, and the acceleration of modern water network construction.

articles.title_zh: 5月高技术制造业相关物流需求同比增长15.1%
articles.title_en: Logistics Demand for High-Tech Manufacturing Grew 15.1% in May
articles.summary_zh: 中国物流与采购联合会公布数据显示，1-5月全国社会物流总额同比增长5.2%，其中5月高技术制造业相关物流需求同比增长15.1%。

articles.summary_en: On July 4, Henan Governor Wang Kai chaired an expanded meeting of the provincial government party group to study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's speech at the 105th anniversary of the CPC.

articles.summary_en: On July 3, 2026, the Hunan Provincial Department of Commerce released the fourth batch of 26 institutional innovation achievements for the China (Hunan) Pilot Free Trade Zone, covering seven major areas including trade facilitation and China-Africa economic cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 全国青少年国防素养大赛江苏赛区开赛

articles.summary_en: On July 4, the Jiangsu division of the 2025-2026 National Youth National Defense Literacy Competition opened in Nanjing, with nearly 2,000 students competing to enhance their national defense awareness.

articles.summary_en: On July 5, the Office of the National Committee for Disaster Prevention, Reduction and Relief, the Ministry of Emergency Management, and the National Grain and Materials Reserves Administration allocated 15,000 relief items and dispatched working groups to Guangxi and Liaoning.

articles.title_en: Archives of Unit 516 Released, Providing New Evidence of Japanese Chemical Warfare Crimes
articles.summary_zh: 7月5日，侵华日军第七三一部队罪证陈列馆公开了516部队《身上申告书》档案，为揭露侵华日军化学战罪行提供新铁证。
articles.summary_en: On July 5, the Museum of Evidence of War Crimes by Japanese Army Unit 731 released the 'Personal Statement' archives of Unit 516, providing new evidence of chemical warfare crimes committed by the Japanese army.

articles.title_zh: 购在中国·2026山东活力之夏消费季启动
articles.title_en: Shop in China 2026 Shandong Vitality Summer Consumption Season Launched
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月3日，购在中国·2026山东活力之夏消费季启动式在烟台举行，旨在通过多元活动和惠民政策促进全省消费。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, 2026, the launch ceremony of the 'Shop in China' 2026 Shandong Vitality Summer Consumption Season was held in Yantai to promote provincial consumption through diverse activities and policies.

articles.title_zh: 佛得角与青海披露最新合作动向
articles.title_en: Cape Verde and Qinghai Disclose Latest Cooperation Trends
articles.summary_zh: 7月4日，青海—澳门·葡语国家经贸文化交流合作暨第十八届中国—葡语国家文化周（西宁站）在西宁开幕，旨在深化青海与葡语国家的务实合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 4, the Qinghai-Macao·Portuguese-speaking Countries Economic and Trade Culture Exchange and Cooperation and the 18th China-Portuguese-speaking Countries Culture Week opened in Xining to deepen pragmatic cooperation.

articles.summary_en: On July 3, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee announced the appointment of Li Xiaozhen as Director, General Manager, and Deputy Secretary of the Party Group of China South-to-North Water Diversion Group.

articles.title_zh: 郑州市政府被约谈
articles.title_en: Zhengzhou Municipal Government Summoned for Talk
articles.summary_zh: 河南省安委办约谈郑州市政府，要求其深刻汲取教训，加强安全生产隐患排查与基层治理，切实筑牢安全底线。
articles.summary_en: The Henan Provincial Safety Committee Office summoned the Zhengzhou Municipal Government, demanding stricter safety hazard inspections and improved grassroots governance to ensure safety.

articles.title_zh: 湖南省委坚决拥护国家监委决定
articles.title_en: Hunan Provincial Committee Firmly Supports Decision of National Supervisory Commission
articles.summary_zh: 湖南省委召开会议，表示坚决拥护国家监委决定，强调要严守政治纪律，增强纪法意识，扛牢全面从严治党主体责任。
articles.summary_en: The Hunan Provincial Committee held a meeting to express its firm support for the National Supervisory Commission's decision, emphasizing political discipline and strict party governance.

articles.title_en: Two Officials of National Mine Safety Administration's Shanxi Bureau Investigated Over Coal Mine Accident
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月4日，国家矿山安全监察局山西局监察执法八处胡慧松、于张庆两人因涉嫌严重违法，正接受山西省监察委员会调查。
articles.summary_en: On July 4, 2026, Hu Huisong and Yu Zhangqing of the Shanxi Bureau of the National Mine Safety Administration were placed under investigation by the Shanxi Provincial Supervisory Commission for suspected serious violations.
