articles.title_en: Cross-Strait (Fujian) Youth Sports Study Tour Opens in Fuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月4日，第十四届海峡青年荟·海峡两岸（福建）青少年体育研学活动在福州启幕，旨在通过体育研学深化两岸青少年的交流与认同。
articles.summary_en: The 14th Strait Youth Gathering and 2026 Cross-Strait (Fujian) Youth Sports Study Tour opened in Fuzhou on July 4, aiming to deepen exchanges and identity among youth from both sides of the strait.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在人民大会堂为功勋模范党员颁授“七一勋章”
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Awards 'July 1st Medal' to Meritorious Model Party Members at the Great Hall of the People
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日，习近平总书记在人民大会堂为一批作出突出贡献的功勋模范党员颁授“七一勋章”，号召全党向英模学习，发挥榜样作用。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, President Xi Jinping awarded the 'July 1st Medal' to meritorious model Party members at the Great Hall of the People, calling on the Party to learn from these role models.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记在庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会上的重要讲话在香港引发热烈反响
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Speech at the 105th Anniversary of the CPC Sparks Warm Response in Hong Kong
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月4日，香港特区行政长官李家超及各界人士对习近平总书记在庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会上的讲话作出积极反响，强调将坚定贯彻“一国两制”并服务国家发展大局。
articles.summary_en: On July 4, 2026, Chief Executive John Lee and various sectors in Hong Kong responded positively to General Secretary Xi Jinping's speech at the 105th anniversary of the CPC, emphasizing the implementation of 'One Country, Two Systems'.

articles.title_zh: 吴政隆在湖北湖南调研 推动经济向新向优向好发展
articles.title_en: Wu Zhenglong Conducts Research Tours in Hubei and Hunan to Promote Economic Development
articles.summary_zh: 国务委员兼国务院秘书长吴政隆于7月2日至4日在湖北、湖南调研，强调要增强内生动力，推动经济高质量发展并落实党中央、国务院决策部署。
articles.summary_en: State Councilor and Secretary General of the State Council Wu Zhenglong conducted research tours in Hubei and Hunan from July 2 to 4, emphasizing the need to enhance endogenous momentum and promote high-quality economic development.

articles.title_zh: 吴政隆在湖北湖南调研时指出 持续增强内生动力 推动经济向新向优向好发展
articles.title_en: Wu Zhenglong Emphasizes Enhancing Endogenous Momentum and Promoting Economic Development During Research Tours in Hubei and Hunan
articles.summary_zh: 吴政隆在湖北和湖南调研期间指出，应持续增强内生动力，推动经济向新向优向好发展。
articles.summary_en: During research tours in Hubei and Hunan, Wu Zhenglong emphasized the need to continuously enhance endogenous momentum to promote high-quality economic development.

articles.title_zh: 谌贻琴在陕西调研强调促进养老事业和养老产业发展及做强文旅产业
articles.title_en: Chen Yiqin Emphasizes Elderly Care and Cultural Tourism Development During Shaanxi Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 谌贻琴在陕西调研期间，强调要促进养老事业和养老产业发展，并持续做强做大文旅产业。
articles.summary_en: During an inspection in Shaanxi, Chen Yiqin emphasized the need to promote the development of elderly care services and industries, and to further strengthen the cultural tourism sector.

articles.title_zh: 谌贻琴在陕西调研强调促进养老事业和养老产业发展及做强文旅产业
articles.title_en: Chen Yiqin Emphasizes Development of Elderly Care and Culture and Tourism Industries During Shaanxi Visit
articles.summary_zh: 国务委员谌贻琴7月2日至4日在陕西调研民政与文旅工作，强调要促进养老事业和产业发展，并持续做强做大文旅产业。
articles.summary_en: State Councilor Chen Yiqin visited Shaanxi from July 2 to 4 to research civil affairs and culture and tourism, emphasizing the growth of the elderly care industry and the culture and tourism sector.

articles.title_zh: 我国加快建设循环经济高质量发展体系
articles.title_en: China Accelerates Construction of High-Quality Circular Economy Development System
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委宣布未来五年将推出一系列举措建设循环经济高质量发展体系，目标到2030年初步建成全球最大的循环经济体系。
articles.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission announced measures to build a high-quality circular economy system over the next five years, aiming to establish the world's largest such system by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 石宇被指冒充石学敏院士长子及首位亲传弟子
articles.title_en: Shi Yu Accused of Falsifying Identity as Eldest Son and First Disciple of Academician Shi Xuemin
articles.summary_zh: 北京市蓝鹏律师事务所发布声明，指称石宇长期冒充已故中国工程院院士石学敏的长子及首位亲传弟子，其身份信息与公安户籍登记不符。
articles.summary_en: Beijing Lanpeng Law Firm issued a statement claiming that Shi Yu has long falsely represented himself as the eldest son and first disciple of the late Academician Shi Xuemin, contradicting official household registration records.

articles.title_zh: 湖南省委坚决拥护国家监委对张灼华进行监察调查的决定
articles.title_en: Hunan Provincial Committee Firmly Supports National Supervisory Commission's Investigation into Zhang Zhuohua
articles.summary_zh: 4日，湖南省委书记沈晓明主持召开省委常委会会议，通报国家监委对张灼华涉嫌严重职务违法进行监察调查的决定。
articles.summary_en: On the 4th, Hunan Provincial Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming chaired a meeting to notify the decision of the National Supervisory Commission to investigate Zhang Zhuohua for suspected serious duty-related violations.

articles.title_zh: 调查：观复博物馆展出铜佛疑似为海口五公祠失窃文物
articles.title_en: Investigation: Bronze Buddha in Guanfu Museum Suspected to be Stolen Artifact from Haikou's Wugong Temple
articles.summary_zh: 网友指认观复博物馆的一尊铜佛与2000年海口五公祠失窃文物高度相似，目前相关部门正进行核验，涉及古玩市场监管及文物保护法律认定。
articles.summary_en: A bronze Buddha in the Guanfu Museum is suspected to be a stolen artifact from Haikou's Wugong Temple. Authorities are verifying the item, highlighting issues in antique market regulation and relic protection laws.

articles.title_zh: 疑似海口失窃铜佛像现北京私人博物馆，相关部门开展核验
articles.title_en: Suspected Stolen Copper Buddha Statue from Haikou Reappears in Beijing Private Museum, Authorities Launch Verification
articles.summary_zh: 2000年海口五公祠失窃的一尊国家级铜佛像疑似出现在北京观复博物馆，目前海口五公祠管理处正配合文物及公安部门进行核验。
articles.summary_en: A national-level copper Buddha statue stolen from Haikou's Wugongci in 2000 has allegedly reappeared at the Guanfu Museum in Beijing; authorities are now conducting verification.

articles.title_zh: 超752亿元融资需求清单发布 重庆产融对接再提速
articles.title_en: Over 75.2 Billion Yuan Financing Demand List Released to Accelerate Industry-Finance Integration in Chongqing
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，重庆举行“33618”产业链投融资专场活动，发布超752亿元融资需求清单并签署超200亿元投融资协议，旨在推动金融资源赋能制造业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, Chongqing held a special investment and financing event for the '33618' industrial chain, releasing a financing demand list exceeding 75.2 billion yuan and signing agreements worth over 20 billion yuan to support high-quality manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省成立国内首家冰雪运动与健康医学会
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Province Establishes China's First Ice and Snow Sports and Health Medical Association
articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江省近日成立国内首家冰雪运动与健康医学会，旨在打造冰雪运动与医学交叉研究枢纽，推动冰雪产业升级并服务全民健康。
articles.summary_en: Heilongjiang Province recently established China's first Ice and Snow Sports and Health Medical Association to create a cross-disciplinary research hub and upgrade the ice and snow industry.

articles.title_zh: 循环经济发展“十五五”规划印发
articles.title_en: Issuance of the '15th Five-Year Plan for Circular Economy Development'
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委近日印发《循环经济发展“十五五”规划》，目标到2030年主要资源产出率比2025年提高16%左右，推动经济社会全面绿色转型。
articles.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Circular Economy Development,' aiming to increase the main resource output rate by about 16% by 2030 to promote a green transformation.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中、包钢会见国家自然科学基金委主任窦贤康并共同见证签约
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong and Bao Gang Meet NSFC Director Dou Xiankang and Witness Signing Ceremony
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中、自治区主席包钢在呼和浩特会见国家自然科学基金委主任窦贤康，并见证双方签署区域创新发展联合基金协议。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, Inner Mongolia Party Secretary Wang Weizhong and Chairman Bao Gang met NSFC Director Dou Xiankang in Hohhot to witness the signing of a regional innovation development joint fund agreement.

articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong Meets Yang Zhenbin, Party Secretary of Shanghai Jiao Tong University
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中在呼和浩特会见上海交通大学党委书记杨振斌，双方探讨在科研攻关、人才培养及科技成果转化等方面深化务实合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, Wang Weizhong, Secretary of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Party Committee, met with Yang Zhenbin, Party Secretary of Shanghai Jiao Tong University, in Hohhot to discuss deepening cooperation in scientific research, talent cultivation, and technology transfer.

articles.title_zh: 乐山亚洲最大中国同辐放射源研发生产基地全面投产
articles.title_en: Asia's Largest China Isotope & Radiation Corporation R&D and Production Base Fully Operational in Leshan
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，中国同辐放射源研发生产基地在四川乐山夹江全面投产，该基地为亚洲最大，旨在提升国内放射源自主保供能力并壮大核技术应用产业。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, China Isotope & Radiation Corporation's R&D and production base, the largest in Asia, became fully operational in Jiajiang, Leshan, Sichuan, to enhance domestic radiation source supply and nuclear technology application.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔出席全省审计系统专题培训班并讲话
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Attends Special Training Class for Provincial Audit System
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，山东省长周乃翔出席全省审计系统专题培训班并讲话，强调要树立正确政绩观，深化审计质效，推动审计工作高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, Shandong Governor Zhou Naixiang attended a special training class for the provincial audit system, emphasizing the establishment of a correct view of political achievements to enhance audit quality.

articles.title_zh: 殷勇在东城区西城区检查防汛准备工作
articles.title_en: Yin Yong Inspects Flood Prevention Preparations in Dongcheng and Xicheng Districts
articles.summary_zh: 北京市市长殷勇日前在东城区和西城区检查防汛准备工作，强调要压实责任，严防城市内涝，确保首都安全度汛。
articles.summary_en: Beijing Mayor Yin Yong recently inspected flood prevention preparations in Dongcheng and Xicheng districts, emphasizing the need to prevent urban waterlogging and ensure the city's safety during the flood season.

articles.title_zh: 北京市委召开月度工作点评会
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal Committee Holds Monthly Work Review Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，北京市委书记尹力主持召开月度工作点评会，点评平谷、怀柔等区及市水务局、市应急局工作，部署生态保护、防汛及城市运行等重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, Yin Li, Secretary of the Beijing Municipal Committee, chaired a monthly work review meeting to evaluate the performance of several districts and bureaus, emphasizing ecological protection and flood prevention.

articles.title_zh: 长三角联合出台举措助力国际科创中心建设
articles.title_en: Yangtze River Delta Jointly Issues Measures to Support International Science and Technology Innovation Center Construction
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，沪苏浙皖四地市场监管局联合发布若干举措，旨在通过市场监管一体化助力上海（长三角）国际科创中心建设。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, market supervision bureaus from Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Anhui jointly released measures to support the construction of the Shanghai (Yangtze River Delta) International Science and Technology Innovation Center through integrated market regulation.

articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，中央军委在北京举行晋升上将军衔仪式，习近平出席并向张曙光、王刚颁发命令状。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, the Central Military Commission held a promotion ceremony for General rank in Beijing, where Xi Jinping presented orders to Zhang Shuguang and Wang Gang.

articles.title_zh: 中央军委表彰全军优秀共产党员、优秀党务工作者和先进基层党组织
articles.title_en: Central Military Commission Commends Outstanding Party Members, Party Workers, and Grassroots Party Organizations of the PLA
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月2日，中央军委在庆祝中国共产党成立105周年之际发出通报，表彰一批全军优秀共产党员、优秀党务工作者和先进基层党组织。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, 2026, the Central Military Commission issued a notice to commend outstanding CPC members, party workers, and grassroots party organizations across the PLA to mark the 105th anniversary of the CPC.

articles.title_zh: 福田区政协委员陈华建议优化涉外支付场景
articles.title_en: Futian District CPPCC Member Chen Hua Suggests Optimizing Foreign Payment Scenarios
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月2日，在深圳市政协“委员议事厅”活动中，福田区政协委员陈华建议打通涉外支付场景，提升外籍人士在深消费便利度。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, 2026, during the Shenzhen Municipal CPPCC 'Committee Discussion Hall' event, Futian District CPPCC member Chen Hua suggested optimizing foreign payment scenarios to improve consumption convenience for foreigners in Shenzhen.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军会见青山实业董事局主席项光达和华峰集团董事局主席尤小平
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun Meets with Chairmen of Tsingshan Holding Group and Huafeng Group
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日下午，重庆市委书记袁家军会见青山实业主席项光达和华峰集团主席尤小平，探讨在先进制造业、材料及化工等领域的深化合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Secretary Yuan Jiajun met with Xiang Guangda of Tsingshan Holding Group and You Xiaoping of Huafeng Group to discuss deepening cooperation in advanced manufacturing, materials, and chemicals.

articles.title_zh: 三峡实验室正式揭牌
articles.title_en: Three Gorges Laboratory Officially Unveiled
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日上午，重庆市委书记袁家军与中国科学院副院长汪克强等共同为三峡实验室揭牌，该实验室将聚焦生态环境保护与绿色低碳发展。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 2, Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun and CAS Vice President Wang Keqiang jointly unveiled the Three Gorges Laboratory, which will focus on ecological protection and green low-carbon development.

articles.title_zh: 福建省全域实施跨境贸易高水平开放试点
articles.title_en: Fujian Province Implements High-Level Opening Pilot for Cross-Border Trade Province-Wide
articles.summary_zh: 自2026年7月1日起，国家外汇管理局福建省分局将跨境贸易高水平开放试点扩围至福建省全域，旨在构建更便利、开放、安全、智慧的外汇管理体制。
articles.summary_en: Starting July 1, 2026, the Fujian Branch of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange expanded the high-level opening pilot for cross-border trade to the entire province to enhance foreign exchange management.

articles.title_zh: 水利部对三省份启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Initiates Level IV Emergency Response for Flood Defense in Three Provinces
articles.summary_zh: 水利部7月2日对广东、广西、海南三省份启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，并派出工作组赴海南协助指导，以应对强降雨带来的汛情。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, the Ministry of Water Resources launched a Level IV emergency response for flood defense in Guangdong, Guangxi, and Hainan, and dispatched a working group to Hainan to assist in flood prevention.

articles.title_zh: 组合驾驶辅助系统安全国家标准发布
articles.title_en: National Standard for Combined Driving Assistance System Safety Released
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月2日，工业和信息化部等部门发布《智能网联汽车 组合驾驶辅助系统安全要求》强制性国家标准，拟于2027年1月1日起正式实施。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, 2026, the MIIT and other departments released the mandatory national standard 'Safety Requirements for Combined Driving Assistance Systems for Intelligent Connected Vehicles,' effective January 1, 2027.

articles.title_zh: 任振鹤：以科技创新引领产业高质量发展 加力提升产业体系现代化水平
articles.title_en: Ren Zhenhe: Leading High-Quality Industrial Development with Technological Innovation and Enhancing Modernization of Industrial System
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日，甘肃省委副书记、省长任振鹤在白银市出席全省新型工业化推进会并讲话，强调要以科技创新引领产业高质量发展，构建现代化产业体系。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, Ren Zhenhe, Deputy Secretary of the Gansu Provincial Party Committee and Governor of Gansu, attended the provincial new industrialization promotion meeting in Baiyin, emphasizing the role of technological innovation in high-quality industrial development.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃分类推进“五区”基层党建推动经济社会高质量发展
articles.title_en: Gansu Promotes "Five Zones" Primary-Level Party Building to Drive High-Quality Economic and Social Development
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省于2025年印发意见，分类推进农区、牧区、林区、景区、园区“五区”基层党建，旨在通过党建引领产业发展与基层治理，推动经济社会高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Gansu Province issued guidelines in 2025 to implement primary-level party building across five specific zones to enhance governance and drive high-quality economic and social development.

articles.title_zh: 省政协党组扩大会议和主席会议召开
articles.title_en: Provincial CPPCC Party Group Enlarged Meeting and Chairperson's Meeting Convened
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日，省政协主席孔昌生主持召开党组扩大会议和主席会议，学习习近平总书记及省委书记刘宁的讲话精神，研究省政协常委会会议等事宜。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, Kong Changsheng, Chairperson of the Provincial CPPCC, presided over a Party Group enlarged meeting and a Chairperson's meeting to study key directives and plan the upcoming Standing Committee meeting.

articles.title_zh: 河南省出台规划用地新政赋能城市更新
articles.title_en: Henan Province Issues New Planning and Land Use Policies to Empower Urban Renewal
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日，河南省政府新闻办发布《规划用地全链条支持城市更新若干政策》，通过简化审批、优化用地转换等20项措施支持城市更新。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, the Henan Provincial Government Information Office released policies to support urban renewal through 20 measures, including simplifying approvals and optimizing land use conversion.

articles.title_zh: 河南系统部署城市高质量发展工作
articles.title_en: Henan Systematically Deploys Work for High-Quality Urban Development
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日，河南省政府新闻办召开吹风会，解读《关于推动城市高质量发展的实施方案》，重点部署城市体系优化、地下管网建设及财政资金支持。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, the Henan Provincial Government Information Office held a briefing to interpret the "Implementation Plan for Promoting High-Quality Urban Development," focusing on urban system optimization, underground pipe network construction, and financial support.

articles.title_zh: 科创楼宇里的产业新图景
articles.title_en: New Industrial Landscapes in Science and Innovation Buildings
articles.summary_zh: 武汉市武昌区通过建设滨江数创走廊，利用楼宇空间和精细政务服务，推动数字技术与实体经济深度融合，吸引科创企业集聚。
articles.summary_en: Wuchang District in Wuhan is promoting the integration of digital technology and the real economy by developing the Binjiang Digital Innovation Corridor and optimizing government services to attract tech enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省启动俄语特色学校招生改革试点
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Province Launches Enrollment Reform Pilot for Russian-Language Specialty Schools
articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江省启动普通高中俄语特色学校招生改革试点，旨在构建俄语贯通人才培养体系，服务国家向北开放战略。
articles.summary_en: Heilongjiang Province has launched an enrollment reform pilot for Russian-language specialty high schools to build a talent cultivation system supporting the national strategy of opening to the north.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省发布首部冰雪文旅消费地方标准
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Province Releases First Local Standard for Ice and Snow Cultural Tourism Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江省近日发布首部冰雪文旅消费地方标准《冰雪文旅服务消费质量通则》，将于7月14日实施，旨在提升冰雪文旅服务质量与行业规范。
articles.summary_en: Heilongjiang Province has released its first local standard for ice and snow cultural tourism consumption, effective July 14, to enhance service quality and industry standardization.

articles.title_zh: 许勤在哈尔滨督导检查防汛工作
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Supervises Flood Control Work in Harbin
articles.summary_zh: 7月1日，黑龙江省委书记许勤在哈尔滨市督导检查防汛工作，强调要坚持人民至上，全面做好防汛抗旱准备，保障人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, inspected flood control work in Harbin, emphasizing a people-centered approach to ensure safety against floods and droughts.

articles.title_zh: 湖南省召开推进常态化帮扶持续巩固拓展脱贫攻坚成果工作会议
articles.title_en: Hunan Province Holds Meeting on Normalized Assistance to Consolidate Poverty Alleviation Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日，湖南省在长沙召开推进常态化帮扶工作会议，省委书记沈晓明强调要守住不发生规模性返贫底线，促进乡村全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, Hunan Province held a meeting in Changsha to promote normalized assistance. Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming emphasized preventing large-scale return to poverty and promoting rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 防止返贫致贫助力乡村全面振兴 湖南出台18条金融举措
articles.title_en: Hunan Introduces 18 Financial Measures to Prevent Poverty and Support Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 湖南省人民银行分行、金融监管局等部门近日联合印发通知，提出18条具体金融措施，旨在防止返贫致贫并助力乡村全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: The PBOC Hunan Branch, Hunan Financial Regulatory Bureau, and other departments issued a notice outlining 18 financial measures to prevent a return to poverty and support comprehensive rural revitalization in Hunan Province.

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明在宁乡调研产业发展和重大项目建设
articles.title_en: Mao Weiming Inspects Industrial Development and Major Project Construction in Ningxiang
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日下午，湖南省长毛伟明在宁乡市调研产业发展和重大项目建设，强调要加快项目建设，培育新质生产力，为高质量发展蓄势赋能。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 2, Hunan Governor Mao Weiming inspected industrial development and major project construction in Ningxiang, emphasizing the acceleration of project construction and the cultivation of new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 信长星刘小涛看望“七一勋章”获得者赵亚夫
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing and Liu Xiaotao Visit 'July 1st Medal' Recipient Zhao Yafu
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日，省委书记信长星、省长刘小涛看望了“七一勋章”获得者赵亚夫，对其在农业科技和脱贫攻坚方面的贡献表示敬意。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing and Governor Liu Xiaotao visited Zhao Yafu, a 'July 1st Medal' recipient, praising his dedication to agricultural technology and rural poverty alleviation.

articles.title_zh: 南京市委常委、常务副市长林涛任南京仲裁委员会主任
articles.title_en: Lin Tao, Executive Vice Mayor of Nanjing, Appointed Director of Nanjing Arbitration Commission
articles.summary_zh: 7月1日，南京市政府决定由市委常委、常务副市长林涛担任第六届南京仲裁委员会主任。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, the Nanjing Municipal Government appointed Lin Tao, Member of the Standing Committee and Executive Vice Mayor, as the Director of the 6th Nanjing Arbitration Commission.

articles.title_zh: 智库报告解析习近平党建思想的时代特质与世界意义
articles.title_en: Think Tank Report Analyzes Epochal Characteristics and World Significance of Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月2日，中共中央党校国家高端智库与新华社国家高端智库在北京共同发布报告，深入阐释习近平党建思想的时代特质与世界意义。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, 2026, the National High-end Think Tanks of the CPC Central Party School and Xinhua News Agency jointly released a report in Beijing analyzing the epochal characteristics and global significance of Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记在人民大会堂为功勋模范党员颁授“七一勋章”
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Awards 'July 1st Medal' to Merit Model Party Members at the Great Hall of the People
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日，习近平总书记在人民大会堂为一批作出突出贡献的功勋模范党员颁授“七一勋章”，号召全党向英模学习，发挥榜样作用。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, President Xi Jinping awarded the 'July 1st Medal' to merit model party members at the Great Hall of the People, urging the Party to learn from these role models.

articles.title_zh: 支持企业稳岗扩岗 政策“两延续一优化”
articles.title_en: Policies to Support Enterprises in Stabilizing and Expanding Employment: Two Continuations and One Optimization
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月2日，人力资源社会保障部等四部门联合印发通知，延续稳岗返还和扩岗补助政策，优化技能提升补贴，以支持企业稳岗扩岗并助力劳动者提升技能。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, 2026, the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security and three other departments issued a notice to continue job stabilization and expansion subsidies and optimize skill improvement subsidies to support employment.

articles.title_zh: 天津市政协召开十五届六十八次主席会议 王常松主持
articles.title_en: Tianjin Municipal CPPCC Holds 68th Chairman's Meeting of the 15th Committee, Presided over by Wang Changsong
articles.summary_zh: 天津市政协召开十五届六十八次主席会议，由王常松主持，审议通过了第十七次常委会的决定和议程，重点讨论产业链发展与财力增强。
articles.summary_en: The Tianjin Municipal CPPCC held the 68th Chairman's Meeting of the 15th Committee, presided over by Wang Changsong, to approve the agenda for the upcoming 17th Standing Committee meeting.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江、艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在自治区高级人民法院和自治区人民检察院调研座谈
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang and Erken Tunyaz Conduct Research and Symposium at Regional High People's Court and People's Procuratorate
articles.summary_zh: 7月1日，自治区党委书记陈小江和自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在自治区高级人民法院和人民检察院调研座谈，强调要为建设现代化新疆提供有力司法保障。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, Party Secretary Chen Xiaojiang and Chairman Erken Tunyaz visited the regional High People's Court and People's Procuratorate to emphasize providing strong judicial guarantees for the modernization of Xinjiang.

articles.title_zh: 徐树彪任中国华电集团有限公司总经理
articles.title_en: Xu Shubiao Appointed General Manager of China Huadian Corporation
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，中央组织部宣布徐树彪任中国华电集团有限公司董事、总经理、党组副书记，免去其国家电力投资集团有限公司相关职务。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee announced the appointment of Xu Shubiao as Director, General Manager, and Deputy Secretary of the Party Group of China Huadian Corporation.

articles.title_zh: 国台办：台湾经贸不可能“去大陆化”
articles.title_en: TAO: Taiwan's Economy and Trade Cannot Be "De-mainlandized"
articles.summary_zh: 国台办发言人朱凤莲7月2日在北京表示，台湾经贸不可能“去大陆化”，并强调深化两岸融合发展是惠及两岸民生福祉的必由之路。
articles.summary_en: TAO spokesperson Zhu Fenglian stated in Beijing on July 2 that Taiwan's economy and trade cannot be "de-mainlandized," emphasizing that deepening cross-strait integration is the only way to benefit people on both sides.

articles.title_zh: 中国五矿中国三冶集团有限公司原党委书记、董事长赵广利接受审查调查
articles.title_en: Zhao Guangli, Former Party Secretary and Chairman of China Minmetals China Third Metallurgical Group, Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月2日，中国五矿中国三冶集团有限公司原党委书记、董事长赵广利涉嫌严重违纪违法，接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, 2026, Zhao Guangli, former Party Secretary and Chairman of China Minmetals China Third Metallurgical Group, was placed under investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会在京隆重举行
articles.title_en: Celebration Meeting for the 105th Anniversary of the Founding of the Communist Party of China Held in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 7月1日上午，庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会在北京人民大会堂举行，习近平发表重要讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 1, a celebration meeting for the 105th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, where Xi Jinping delivered an important speech.

articles.title_zh: 庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会在京隆重举行
articles.title_en: Grand Celebration of the 105th Anniversary of the Founding of the Communist Party of China Held in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月1日，庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会在北京举行。习近平发表重要讲话并为“七一勋章”获得者颁奖，强调要发扬党的优秀特质，确保党永远不变质。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, 2026, a grand celebration of the 105th anniversary of the CPC was held in Beijing. Xi Jinping delivered a speech and awarded the 'July 1 Medal,' emphasizing the need to uphold the Party's superior qualities.

articles.title_zh: 《习近平谈治国理政》第五卷土耳其推介会在安卡拉举行
articles.title_en: Promotion Event for the Fifth Volume of "Xi Jinping: The Governance of China" Held in Ankara, Turkey
articles.summary_zh: 7月1日，《习近平谈治国理政》第五卷推介会在土耳其安卡拉举行，旨在通过治国理政经验交流增进中土政治互信并推动战略对接。
articles.summary_en: A promotion event for the fifth volume of "Xi Jinping: The Governance of China" was held in Ankara, Turkey on July 1 to enhance political mutual trust and strategic alignment through the exchange of governance experiences.

articles.title_zh: 失业保险稳岗扩岗政策举措延续实施
articles.title_en: Unemployment Insurance Policies for Job Stabilization and Expansion Extended
articles.summary_zh: 人力资源社会保障部等四部门近日印发通知，将稳岗返还、扩岗补助及技能提升补贴三项政策延续实施至2026年底，以支持企业稳定岗位并促进就业。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security and three other departments issued a notice extending three policies, including job stabilization refunds and expansion subsidies, until the end of 2026 to support employment.

articles.title_zh: 国务院批复《体育强国建设“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: State Council Approves the '15th Five-Year Plan for Building a Leading Sports Nation'
articles.summary_zh: 国务院批复同意《体育强国建设“十五五”规划》，要求完善全民健身公共服务体系，改革竞技体育管理体制，加快体育产业升级，建设体育强国。
articles.summary_en: The State Council has approved the '15th Five-Year Plan for Building a Leading Sports Nation,' focusing on improving public fitness services, reforming competitive sports management, and upgrading the sports industry.

articles.title_zh: 各地采取有力措施做好防汛防台风工作
articles.title_en: Various Regions Take Effective Measures for Flood and Typhoon Prevention

articles.summary_zh: 新疆沙雅县林业和草原局与自然资源局发布声明，辟谣关于可办理变更防沙治沙土地性质的虚假信息，并警示相关投资诈骗行为。
articles.summary_en: The Forestry and Grassland Bureau and Natural Resources Bureau of Shaya County, Xinjiang, issued a statement refuting false claims about changing the nature of sand-control land and warning against investment scams.

articles.title_zh: 今起食用油等液态食品散装运输须持准运证，市场监管总局将部署监督检查
articles.title_en: Bulk Transport of Edible Oils and Other Liquid Foods Now Requires Permits; SAMR to Deploy Inspections
articles.summary_zh: 从今日起，植物油、酒类等5大类重点液态食品道路散装运输须持准运证。市场监管总局将部署监督检查，实施全链条可追溯管理以保障食品安全。
articles.summary_en: Starting today, bulk road transport of five categories of key liquid foods, including vegetable oils and alcohol, requires permits. SAMR will deploy inspections to ensure food safety and traceability.

articles.title_zh: “正义审判”特展开展，呈现日本战犯审判全过程
articles.title_en: Special Exhibition "Justice Trial" Opens, Showcasing the Process of Trials for Japanese War Criminals
articles.summary_zh: 7月1日，侵华日军第七三一部队罪证陈列馆与沈阳“九·一八”历史博物馆联合举办《正义审判》特展，系统呈现新中国审判日本战犯的全过程。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, the Museum of Evidence of War Crimes of Japanese Army Unit 731 and the Shenyang "September 18th" History Museum jointly opened the "Justice Trial" exhibition, detailing the process of trials for Japanese war criminals in New China.

articles.title_zh: 北京市郊铁路城市副中心线西段提升工程投运
articles.title_en: Western Section of Beijing Suburban Railway City Sub-center Line Upgrade Project Starts Operation
articles.summary_zh: 北京市郊铁路城市副中心线西段提升工程于2026年7月1日投运，新增3个车站并加密开行，实现房山与通州直连。
articles.summary_en: The western section upgrade of the Beijing Suburban Railway City Sub-center Line started operation on July 1, 2026, adding three stations and enabling direct connection between Fangshan and Tongzhou.

articles.title_zh: 福建省委常委会召开会议研究贯彻落实习近平总书记重要讲话精神

articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，福建省委书记周祖翼主持召开省委常委会会议，研究推进农业农村现代化、闽宁协作及集体林权制度改革等工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Zhou Zuyi, Secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee, chaired a meeting to study the implementation of President Xi Jinping's instructions on rural modernization, Min-Ning collaboration, and forest rights reform.

articles.summary_en: On June 30, Hubei Governor Li Dianxun conducted research in Macheng and Hong'an, emphasizing reform and innovation to promote industrialization, urbanization, and rural revitalization in revolutionary old areas.

articles.summary_en: On June 29, Hubei Provincial Party Secretary Guan Zhiou visited veteran party members in Shiyan and surveyed the ecological protection of the Danjiangkou Reservoir area and the implementation of correct performance views.

articles.summary_en: On June 30, the 'True Materials, Building a Strong Nation' Education Community was established at Wuhan University of Technology to cultivate talent for the building materials, transportation, and automotive industries.

articles.title_zh: 倪岳峰在河北省“两优一先”表彰大会上强调深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想

articles.title_zh: 航天产业为海南文昌老区发展注入新动能

articles.summary_en: Wenchang, Hainan, is leveraging its commercial aerospace launch site and international aerospace city to integrate the aerospace industry with red tourism, boosting local economic growth and industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 弘扬伟大建党精神 传承海南革命文化 奋力谱写中国式现代化海南篇章

articles.title_zh: 宿迁出台江苏首部生物多样性保护领域地方性法规

articles.summary_en: On June 30, Suqian held a press conference to interpret the "Decision on Strengthening Biodiversity Protection," which takes effect on July 1, 2026, to enhance biodiversity conservation through legal frameworks.

articles.title_zh: 两个“南沟”蝶变记

articles.summary_en: The report details how two Nangou villages in Yan'an, Shaanxi, achieved rural revitalization by strengthening grassroots Party organization.

articles.title_zh: 山西省“两优一先”表彰大会举行

articles.summary_en: On June 30, Shanxi Province held a commendation meeting in Taiyuan to honor outstanding CPC members, party workers, and primary-level party organizations. Provincial Party Secretary Tang Dengjie attended and delivered a speech.

articles.summary_en: On June 30, Chen Xiaojiang, Secretary of the Autonomous Region Party Committee, visited veteran party members and relatives of fallen cadres in Urumqi to emphasize party building and the modernization of Xinjiang.

articles.title_zh: 何忠友在“七一”前夕走访慰问兵团老党员
articles.title_en: He Zhongyou Visits Veteran Party Members Ahead of July 1st Anniversary
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，自治区党委副书记、兵团党委书记何忠友走访慰问兵团老党员，强调要传承红色基因，坚决做到“两个维护”，奋力建设现代化兵团。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, He Zhongyou, Deputy Secretary of the Regional Party Committee and Secretary of the Bingtuan Party Committee, visited veteran Party members to emphasize inheriting the 'red gene' and building a modern Bingtuan.

articles.title_zh: 王宁王予波刘洪建等看望慰问老党员老干部
articles.title_en: Wang Ning, Wang Yubo, and Liu Hongjian Visit and Greet Veteran Party Members and Cadres

articles.summary_en: On the eve of July 1st, Yunnan provincial leaders, including Secretary Wang Ning and Governor Wang Yubo, visited veteran Party members and cadres in Kunming to offer greetings and seek advice on provincial development.

articles.title_zh: 多部门会商部署重点地区防汛工作
articles.title_en: Multiple Departments Consult and Deploy Flood Control Work in Key Areas
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，国家防总办公室、应急管理部等部门联合会商部署防汛工作，并启动针对湖南、云南的防汛四级应急响应。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, the State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters Office and the Ministry of Emergency Management held a joint meeting to deploy flood control work and activated Level IV emergency responses for Hunan and Yunnan.

articles.title_zh: 促进民营经济发展壮大 有关部门作出部署
articles.title_en: Relevant Departments Deploy Measures to Promote Growth of Private Economy
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日在南京召开的全国促进民营经济发展壮大现场会上，国家发展改革委与财政部就优化市场环境、提振民间投资信心等政策作出部署。
articles.summary_en: At a national meeting in Nanjing on June 30, the NDRC and Ministry of Finance deployed policies to optimize the market environment and boost confidence in private investment.

articles.title_zh: 丽水莲都发布“房产新政十三条”
articles.title_en: Lishui Liandu District Releases "13 New Real Estate Policies"
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，丽水莲都区发布房地产市场稳定发展措施，出台“房产新政十三条”，为刚需群体、人才及多孩家庭提供最高30万元的购房补贴。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Lishui's Liandu District released "13 New Real Estate Policies" to stabilize the market, offering housing subsidies up to 300,000 yuan for first-time buyers, talents, and multi-child families.

articles.title_zh: 北京市领导看望慰问基层党员
articles.title_en: Beijing Leaders Visit and Comfort Grassroots Party Members
articles.summary_zh: 7月1日，北京市委书记尹力、市长殷勇分别看望慰问基层党员，强调要发挥基层党组织战斗堡垒作用，推动“十五五”经济社会发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li and Mayor Yin Yong visited grassroots party members, emphasizing the role of primary-level party organizations in promoting the '15th Five-Year Plan' for economic and social development.

articles.title_zh: 北京市政府召开常务会议研究加强防汛工作等事项
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal Government Holds Executive Meeting to Study Strengthening Flood Control Efforts
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，北京市长殷勇主持市政府常务会议，研究部署今年防汛工作、现代化产业体系发展及家政服务市场规范化等事项。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Mayor Yin Yong chaired a Beijing Municipal Government executive meeting to discuss flood control, the development of a modern industrial system, and the regulation of the domestic service market.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会上发表讲话

articles.summary_en: Chongqing announced a list of outstanding party members, party workers, and advanced primary-level party organizations, honoring individuals and collectives for their achievements in supervision, rural revitalization, and grassroots governance.

articles.title_zh: 重庆推动产融供需精准对接

articles.summary_en: Implementing President Xi Jinping's instructions, Chongqing is building the '33618' modern manufacturing cluster system and promoting digital-green transformation to foster new quality productive forces.

articles.summary_en: On June 30, 2026, State Grid Chongqing Municipal Electric Power Company completed the operation of 11 key power supply projects for the summer peak to enhance power reliability in Chongqing.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁为全省新一届县（市、区）委书记讲党课

articles.summary_en: On June 30, Henan Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning delivered a party lecture to new county, city, and district party secretaries, emphasizing the need to establish a correct view of achievements to guide high-quality development and efficient governance.

articles.title_zh: 王凯到省生态环境厅调研

articles.summary_en: On June 30, Henan Governor Wang Kai visited the Provincial Department of Ecology and Environment, emphasizing the need to win the battle against pollution and improve ecological quality.

articles.title_zh: 孔昌生为省政协机关全体党员干部讲党课

articles.title_zh: 王凯主持召开省政府常务会议

articles.summary_en: On June 30, Henan Governor Wang Kai chaired a provincial government executive meeting to discuss the development of development zones, food safety, and review the draft of the Henan Province Development Planning Regulations.

articles.title_zh: 省领导分赴全省各地走访慰问

articles.title_en: Beidahuang Holds Launch Ceremony for Comprehensive Strategic Cooperation to Empower Industry
articles.summary_zh: 6月29日，北大荒农垦集团哈尔滨有限公司与北大荒商贸（收储）集团签署全面战略合作协议，旨在通过金融支持推动黑稻收储及大宗贸易等产业协同。
articles.summary_en: On June 29, Beidahuang Reclamation Group Harbin Co., Ltd. and Beidahuang Trade (Storage) Group signed a strategic cooperation agreement to promote industry synergy in black rice storage and bulk trade with financial support.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲走访慰问功勋荣誉表彰获得者覃大清和老党员武高辉
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Visits Honored Experts Qin Daqing and Wu Gaohui
articles.summary_zh: 6月29日，黑龙江省长梁惠玲在哈尔滨走访慰问功勋荣誉表彰获得者覃大清和老党员武高辉，强调以科技创新引领产业振兴，服务国家战略需求。
articles.summary_en: On June 29, Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling visited honored experts Qin Daqing and Wu Gaohui in Harbin, emphasizing the role of technological innovation in driving industrial revitalization and serving national strategic needs.

articles.title_zh: 湖南省“两优一先”表彰大会举行
articles.title_en: Hunan Province Holds Commendation Meeting for Outstanding Party Members, Party Workers, and Primary-level Party Organizations
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，湖南省在长沙举行“两优一先”表彰大会，省委书记沈晓明出席并讲话，动员全省党员弘扬建党精神，助力实现“三高四新”美好蓝图。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Hunan Province held a commendation meeting in Changsha for outstanding party members, party workers, and primary-level party organizations. Provincial Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming delivered a speech to motivate party members to strive for the "Three Highs and Four New" blueprint.

articles.title_zh: 顾国栋履新无锡市新吴区代区长
articles.title_en: Gu Guodong Appointed Acting District Mayor of Xinwu District, Wuxi
articles.summary_zh: 顾国栋现任无锡市新吴区委副书记、代区长。
articles.summary_en: Gu Guodong has been appointed as the Deputy Secretary of the District Committee and Acting District Mayor of Xinwu District, Wuxi.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省委科技委员会召开全体会议 信长星讲话 刘小涛出席
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Science and Technology Committee Holds Plenary Meeting; Xin Changxing Delivers Speech
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，江苏省委书记信长星、省长刘小涛出席省委科技委员会全体会议，研究部署基础研究、长三角国际科技创新中心建设及人工智能驱动科研等工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Jiangsu Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing and Governor Liu Xiaotao attended a plenary meeting of the Provincial Science and Technology Committee to deploy work on basic research, the Yangtze River Delta innovation center, and AI-driven research.

articles.title_zh: 长三角铁路暑期运输7月1日正式启动
articles.title_en: Summer Railway Transport Officially Starts in Yangtze River Delta on July 1
articles.summary_zh: 2026年铁路暑期旅客运输于7月1日在长三角地区正式启动，预计发送旅客1.9亿人次，将通过加开临客和优化运行图满足出行需求。
articles.summary_en: Summer railway transport in the Yangtze River Delta officially began on July 1, 2026, with an expected 190 million passengers. Capacity will be increased via extra trains and optimized schedules.

articles.title_zh: 南京市举行“人工智能+交通运输”路演活动
articles.title_en: Nanjing Holds 'AI + Transportation' Roadshow Event
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，南京市举行“人工智能+交通运输”路演活动，市长李忠军出席并强调要以AI技术加速重塑交通运输体系，推动行业智能化转型。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Nanjing held an 'AI + Transportation' roadshow. Mayor Li Zhongjun attended and emphasized using AI to reshape the transportation system and promote intelligent transformation.

articles.title_zh: 江西省出台19条举措推动行业协会商会深化改革
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Province Introduces 19 Measures to Deepen Reform of Industry Associations and Chambers of Commerce
articles.summary_zh: 江西省委社会工作部、省委组织部、省民政厅近日联合印发《关于推动行业协会商会深化改革的若干举措》，提出19条举措以规范管理并提升行业协会商会服务效能。
articles.summary_en: The Social Work Department, Organization Department, and Civil Affairs Department of Jiangxi Provincial Committee jointly issued 19 measures to deepen the reform and standardize the management of industry associations and chambers of commerce.

articles.title_zh: 大连旅顺博物馆推出伊朗文物精品展
articles.title_en: Lushun Museum in Dalian Launches Iranian Artifacts Exhibition
articles.summary_zh: 7月1日，由伊朗文化遗产、旅游和手工业部等主办的“邂逅千年波斯——伊朗文物精品展”在大连旅顺博物馆开展，展出151件/组珍贵文物。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, the 'Encountering Millennial Persia' exhibition, hosted by the Iranian Ministry of Cultural Heritage, Tourism and Handicrafts and others, opened at the Lushun Museum in Dalian, featuring 151 precious artifacts.

articles.title_zh: 献给中国共产党105岁生日！新华社政论片播出
articles.title_en: Xinhua News Agency Releases Political Documentary Celebrating 105th Anniversary of the CPC
articles.summary_zh: 新华社于7月1日播发大型政论片《习近平党建思想引领强党强国新征程》，庆祝中国共产党成立105周年并阐述习近平党建思想。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua News Agency released a political documentary on July 1 to celebrate the 105th anniversary of the CPC, highlighting Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building.

articles.title_zh: 张工调研中心城区生产性服务业发展
articles.title_en: Zhang Gong Investigates Development of Productive Service Industries in Central Urban Area
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日下午，天津市市长张工调研中心城区生产性服务业发展，强调要强化创新驱动，以生产性服务业扩能提质助推制造业转型升级。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong investigated the development of productive service industries in the central urban area, emphasizing innovation-driven growth to promote the transformation of the manufacturing sector.

articles.title_zh: 陈敏尔、张工、刘桂平在“七一”前夕开展走访慰问活动
articles.title_en: Chen Min'er, Zhang Gong, and Liu Guiping Conduct Visit and Consolation Activities Ahead of July 1st
articles.summary_zh: 在中国共产党成立105周年之际，天津市委书记陈敏尔、市长张工及市委副书记刘桂平走访慰问老党员、功勋党员及殉职干部家属。
articles.summary_en: On the occasion of the 105th anniversary of the CPC, Tianjin officials Chen Min'er, Zhang Gong, and Liu Guiping visited and consoled veteran party members and families of fallen cadres.

articles.title_zh: 张工调度强降雨应对工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Gong Coordinates Response to Heavy Rainfall
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日下午，天津市市长张工调度中心城区强降雨应对工作，部署防汛排涝及交通疏导。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of June 30, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong coordinated response efforts to heavy rainfall in the city's central urban area, focusing on flood drainage and traffic management.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江在乌鲁木齐看望慰问老党员和因公殉职干部亲属
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang Visits Veteran Party Members and Families of Fallen Officials in Urumqi
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，自治区党委书记陈小江在乌鲁木齐看望慰问老党员和因公殉职干部亲属，强调要深入学习习近平党建思想，推进社会主义现代化新疆建设。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Chen Xiaojiang, Secretary of the Xinjiang Autonomous Region Party Committee, visited veteran party members and families of fallen officials in Urumqi, emphasizing the implementation of Xi Jinping's thought on party building to advance Xinjiang's modernization.

articles.title_zh: 新疆伊宁至阿克苏铁路全线开工
articles.title_en: Yining-Aksu Railway in Xinjiang Starts Full-Scale Construction
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月30日，新疆伊宁至阿克苏铁路全线开工建设，建成后将把南北疆客货运输时间由16小时缩短至约8小时。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, 2026, the Yining-Aksu Railway in Xinjiang began full-scale construction, which will reduce travel time between northern and southern Xinjiang from 16 to about 8 hours.

articles.title_zh: 艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在乌鲁木齐慰问老党员和因公殉职干部亲属
articles.title_en: Erken Tunyaz Visits Old Party Members and Relatives of Cadres Who Died in the Line of Duty in Urumqi
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在乌鲁木齐看望慰问老党员和因公殉职干部亲属，强调要为建设社会主义现代化新疆贡献力量。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Chairman Erken Tunyaz visited old party members and relatives of cadres who died in the line of duty in Urumqi, calling for contributions to the modernization of Xinjiang.

articles.title_zh: 1—5月云南省122个开发区新签约产业项目351个
articles.title_en: Yunnan Province's 122 Development Zones Sign 351 New Industrial Projects from January to May
articles.summary_zh: 1—5月，云南省122个开发区新签约产业项目351个，其中亿元以上项目165个，重点聚焦绿色铝、新材料等产业链，推动园区经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: From January to May, 122 development zones in Yunnan Province signed 351 new industrial projects, including 165 projects worth over 100 million yuan, focusing on green aluminum and new materials.

articles.title_zh: 云南成立团队旅游纠纷调解中心
articles.title_en: Yunnan Establishes Group Tour Dispute Mediation Center
articles.summary_zh: 云南省旅行社协会近日成立团队旅游纠纷调解中心，为团队游客与旅行社提供免费协商平台，旨在降低维权门槛并压缩处理周期。
articles.summary_en: The Yunnan Provincial Travel Agency Association recently established a Group Tour Dispute Mediation Center to provide a free negotiation platform for tourists and travel agencies.

articles.title_zh: 《中国供电发展报告（2026）》在杭发布
articles.title_en: "China Power Supply Development Report (2026)" Released in Hangzhou
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月30日，国家能源局在杭州发布《中国供电发展报告（2026）》并召开交流会，旨在提升“获得电力”服务水平，推动供电服务向品质体验转变。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, 2026, the National Energy Administration released the "China Power Supply Development Report (2026)" in Hangzhou and held a meeting to improve "Obtaining Electricity" services.

articles.title_zh: 浙江各地喜迎中国共产党成立105周年
articles.title_en: Various Places in Zhejiang Celebrate the 105th Anniversary of the Communist Party of China
articles.summary_zh: 在庆祝中国共产党成立105周年之际，浙江省各地通过新党员宣誓、主题党日、红色教育及志愿服务等活动迎接党的生日。
articles.summary_en: To celebrate the 105th anniversary of the CPC, various regions in Zhejiang Province held activities including swearing-in ceremonies for new members, theme party days, and red education.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央决定陆治原任中华全国总工会党组书记
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee Appoints Lu Zhiyuan as Party Group Secretary of All-China Federation of Trade Unions
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央决定，陆治原任中华全国总工会党组书记。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee has decided to appoint Lu Zhiyuan as the Party Group Secretary of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions.

articles.title_zh: 程福波任国务院国资委党委书记
articles.title_en: Cheng Fubo Appointed Party Secretary of the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，中央决定由程福波担任国务院国有资产监督管理委员会党委书记。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, the Central Committee decided to appoint Cheng Fubo as the Party Secretary of the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC) of the State Council.

articles.title_zh: 做焦裕禄式的县委书记
articles.title_en: Be a Jiao Yulu-style County Party Secretary
articles.summary_zh: 2015年1月12日，习近平在中央党校县委书记研修班上发表讲话，要求县委书记学习焦裕禄精神，做到心中有党、有民、有责、有戒。
articles.summary_en: On January 12, 2015, Xi Jinping delivered a speech at a seminar for county party secretaries at the Central Party School, urging them to emulate Jiao Yulu's spirit.

articles.title_zh: 退役军人就业创业促进条例
articles.title_en: Regulations on Promoting Employment and Entrepreneurship of Veterans
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月5日，国务院常务会议通过《退役军人就业创业促进条例》，旨在通过教育培训、就业支持和创业扶持，促进退役军人高质量充分就业。
articles.summary_en: On June 5, 2026, the State Council passed the Regulations on Promoting Employment and Entrepreneurship of Veterans to support veterans' employment and entrepreneurship through training and policy incentives.

articles.title_zh: 八部门提出到2030年建设5万张工业5G专网
articles.title_en: Eight Departments Propose Building 50,000 Industrial 5G Private Networks by 2030
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部等八部门于6月30日在北京发布《关于推动工业互联网高质量发展的实施意见》，目标到2030年建设5万张工业5G专网。
articles.summary_en: Eight departments, including the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, issued guidelines in Beijing on June 30 to build 50,000 industrial 5G private networks by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 李强签署国务院令公布《退役军人就业创业促进条例》
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Decree to Publish Regulations on Promoting Employment and Entrepreneurship of Veterans
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强签署国务院令，公布自2026年8月1日起施行的《退役军人就业创业促进条例》，旨在通过教育培训、就业优待和创业扶持鼓励退役军人就业创业。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council decree to publish the Regulations on Promoting Employment and Entrepreneurship of Veterans, effective August 1, 2026, to support veterans through training and employment preferences.

articles.title_zh: 2025年我国水运多项指标稳居世界第一
articles.title_en: China's Water Transport Indicators Rank First Globally in 2025
articles.summary_zh: 国务院新闻办公室6月30日举行发布会，交通运输部数据显示2025年我国港口货物吞吐量和集装箱吞吐量均稳居世界第一。
articles.summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference on June 30, reporting that China's port cargo and container throughput ranked first globally in 2025.

articles.title_zh: 全国夏播粮食进度近八成 夏管全面展开
articles.title_en: Nearly 80% of Summer Grain Sowing Completed as Summer Field Management Begins
articles.summary_zh: 全国夏播粮食进度已近八成，夏季田间管理全面展开，山东、安徽等地通过政策补贴和技术指导夯实秋粮丰收基础。
articles.summary_en: Nearly 80% of summer grain sowing has been completed across China, with summer field management underway in provinces like Shandong and Anhui to ensure a bountiful autumn harvest.

articles.title_zh: 京津冀推出首都都市圈通勤圈一揽子务实举措
articles.title_en: Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Region Launches Package of Measures for Capital Metropolitan Area Commuting Circle
articles.summary_zh: 京津冀交通协同专题工作组印发重点举措，旨在通过优化轨道、铁路、道路及枢纽建设，构建高效便捷的首都都市圈通勤交通网络。
articles.summary_en: The Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Transportation Coordination Special Working Group issued key measures to build an efficient and convenient commuting transport network for the capital metropolitan area.

articles.title_zh: 2026年“特种设备安全日”福建主会场活动在福州举办
articles.title_en: Fujian Hosts Main Event for 2026 'Special Equipment Safety Day' in Fuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月29日，2026年“特种设备安全日”福建主会场活动在福州举办。福建省市场监管局局长黄水木出席并部署特种设备安全监管工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 29, 2026, the main event for 'Special Equipment Safety Day' was held in Fuzhou, Fujian. Huang Shuimu, Director of the Fujian Provincial Administration for Market Regulation, outlined safety supervision goals.

tags.name_en: Fujian Provincial Administration for Market Regulation

tags_en: Fujian Provincial Administration for Market Regulation

articles.title_zh: 最高检发布惩治知识产权恶意诉讼典型案例
articles.title_en: Supreme People's Procuratorate Releases Typical Cases of Punishing Malicious Intellectual Property Litigation
articles.summary_zh: 最高人民检察院于6月29日在北京发布5件惩治知识产权恶意诉讼典型案例，旨在打击以维权之名行牟利之实的行为，营造保护创新的社会氛围。
articles.summary_en: The Supreme People's Procuratorate released five typical cases of punishing malicious intellectual property litigation in Beijing on June 29 to combat the abuse of legal rights for profit and foster an innovative social environment.

articles.title_zh: 雷山做强茶业与文旅产业
articles.title_en: Leishan County Strengthens Tea Industry and Cultural Tourism
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，雷山县长黎琨在黔东南州成立70周年新闻发布会上，介绍了雷山县茶业和文旅产业的发展情况。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Leishan County Mayor Li Kun introduced the development of the tea and cultural tourism industries during a press conference marking the 70th anniversary of Qiandongnan Prefecture.

articles.title_zh: 河北全面启动跨境贸易高水平开放试点
articles.title_en: Hebei Fully Launches High-Level Opening Pilot for Cross-Border Trade
articles.summary_zh: 国家外汇管理局同意河北全域开展跨境贸易高水平开放试点，将于2026年7月1日起实施7项外汇收支便利化举措，以优化营商环境并助力外贸高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration of Foreign Exchange approved a high-level opening pilot for cross-border trade in Hebei, implementing seven foreign exchange facilitation measures starting July 1, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 万泉河河道清淤疏浚工程（干流琼海段）开工建设
articles.title_en: Construction Begins on Wanquan River Dredging Project (Qionghai Section)
articles.summary_zh: 6月29日，万泉河河道清淤疏浚工程（干流琼海段）在琼海市开工，总投资1.59亿元，旨在提升行洪能力并改善水生态环境。
articles.summary_en: On June 29, the Wanquan River dredging project (Qionghai section) commenced in Qionghai City with a total investment of 159 million yuan to enhance flood control and improve the aquatic ecological environment.

articles.title_zh: 2026下半年海南自贸港企业家信心指数发布
articles.title_en: Release of the 2026 Second Half Hainan Free Trade Port Entrepreneur Confidence Index
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月30日，海南省企业联合会、海南省企业家协会与海南大学在海口联合发布2026下半年海南自贸港企业家信心指数，总指数提升至103.71，显示企业家对经济形势趋向乐观。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, 2026, the Hainan Provincial Federation of Enterprises, Hainan Entrepreneurs Association, and Hainan University jointly released the 2026 H2 Hainan FTP Entrepreneur Confidence Index, which rose to 103.71, indicating growing optimism among entrepreneurs.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲走访慰问功勋荣誉表彰获得者覃大清和老党员武高辉
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Visits Honored Individuals Qin Daqing and Wu Gaohui Ahead of July 1st
articles.summary_zh: 6月29日，黑龙江省长梁惠玲在哈尔滨走访慰问功勋荣誉表彰获得者覃大清和老党员武高辉，强调以科技创新引领产业振兴，服务国家战略需求。
articles.summary_en: On June 29, Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling visited honored individuals Qin Daqing and Wu Gaohui in Harbin, emphasizing the use of technological innovation to lead industrial revitalization and serve national strategic needs.

articles.title_zh: 许勤走访慰问老党员困难党员和先进基层党组织
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Visits Veteran Party Members and Advanced Primary-level Party Organizations
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，黑龙江省委书记许勤在哈尔滨走访慰问老党员、困难党员和先进基层党组织，向全省共产党员致以节日问候。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, visited veteran and struggling party members and advanced primary-level party organizations in Harbin to convey greetings.

articles.title_zh: 江苏出台“AI+住建”行动方案 部署14项重点任务
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues "AI + Housing and Urban-Rural Development" Action Plan with 14 Key Tasks

articles.title_zh: 国务院印发《教育发展“十五五”规划》

articles.summary_en: The State Council issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Education Development' to accelerate the construction of a strong education nation and integrate education, science, and talent development.

articles.title_zh: 天津市“两优一先”表彰大会召开

articles.summary_en: On June 29, Tianjin held a commendation meeting for "Two Excellences and One Advanced." Municipal Party Secretary Chen Min'er attended and emphasized implementing Xi Jinping's thoughts on party building to advance modernization in Tianjin.

articles.summary_en: On June 30, 2026, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee met in Beijing to deploy flood control and drought relief work, chaired by Xi Jinping, emphasizing the priority of people's lives.

articles.title_zh: 安徽省“两优一先”表彰大会在合肥召开

articles.summary_en: On June 29, Anhui Province held the "Two Excellences and One Advanced" Commendation Conference in Hefei. Provincial Party Secretary Liang Yanshun attended and delivered a speech to honor outstanding Party members, Party workers, and grassroots organizations.

articles.title_zh: 2026北京数字经济体验周启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Beijing Digital Economy Experience Week Launches
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月27日，2026北京数字经济体验周在北京市东城区启动，聚焦数字消费与AI应用，旨在打造数字消费嘉年华。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Beijing Digital Economy Experience Week launched in Dongcheng District, Beijing on June 27, focusing on digital consumption and AI applications.

articles.title_zh: 广东加快强化产业基础能力建设 打造现代化产业体系
articles.title_en: Guangdong Accelerates Strengthening Industrial Foundation to Build Modern Industrial System
articles.summary_zh: 广东省依托粤港澳大湾区产业优势，通过支持粤芯半导体等企业，加快推动制造业向“智造”升级，构建安全高效的产业链供应链。
articles.summary_en: Guangdong is leveraging the industrial advantages of the Greater Bay Area and supporting companies like Yuexin Semiconductor to upgrade manufacturing to 'intelligent manufacturing' and build a secure, efficient industrial chain.

articles.title_zh: 七部门启动全国社会救助法宣传周活动
articles.title_en: Seven Departments Launch National Social Assistance Law Publicity Week
articles.summary_zh: 民政部等七部门于6月29日至7月5日在全国开展社会救助法宣传周活动，旨在提升困难群众对该法的知晓度并保障其合法权益。
articles.summary_en: Seven departments, including the Ministry of Civil Affairs, launched a National Social Assistance Law Publicity Week from June 29 to July 5 to raise awareness and protect the rights of people in need.

articles.title_zh: 兰州市新增城镇就业3.84万人
articles.title_en: Lanzhou Adds 38,400 New Urban Jobs
articles.summary_zh: 截至5月底，兰州市城镇新增就业3.84万人，市人社局通过实施大学生留兰计划、职业技能培训及创业扶持等措施促进就业。
articles.summary_en: As of the end of May, Lanzhou added 38,400 new urban jobs, with the municipal HRSS Bureau promoting employment through college student retention plans and vocational training.

articles.summary_en: On June 29, 2026, the 17th meeting of the Standing Committee of the 13th CPPCC Gansu Provincial Committee approved a list of personnel appointments and removals.

articles.title_zh: 张晓强“七一”前夕走访慰问老党员和困难党员
articles.title_en: Zhang Xiaoqiang Visits Old and Struggling Party Members Ahead of July 1st
articles.summary_zh: 6月29日，甘肃省委常委、兰州市委书记张晓强在兰州新区走访慰问老党员和困难党员，强调要弘扬建党精神，助力兰州高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 29, Zhang Xiaoqiang, Secretary of the Lanzhou Municipal Committee, visited old and struggling party members in Lanzhou New Area to offer greetings and emphasize the spirit of party building.

articles.title_zh: 六盘水举办刺梨产业专题推介洽谈会促成多项签约
articles.title_en: Liupanshui Holds Rosa Roxburghii Industry Promotion Event to Facilitate Multiple Signings
articles.summary_zh: 六盘水市在第四届中国国际供应链促进博览会期间举办刺梨产业推介会，发布招商项目并促成京黔企业签署多项产销合作协议。
articles.summary_en: Liupanshui City held a Rosa roxburghii industry promotion event during the 4th CISCE, releasing investment projects and facilitating cooperation agreements between Beijing and Guizhou enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 第六届“我家住在长江边”主题宣传活动在湖北宜昌启动
articles.title_en: The 6th 'I Live by the Yangtze River' Theme Promotion Activity Launches in Yichang, Hubei

articles.summary_en: On June 30, the 6th 'I Live by the Yangtze River' theme promotion activity, hosted by the Ministry of Transport, launched in Yichang, Hubei, to support the high-quality development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt.

articles.title_en: Hebei's Consumption Market Grows Steadily at the Start of the 15th Five-Year Plan

articles.summary_en: From January to May 2026, Hebei Province saw a 6.3% year-on-year increase in retail sales of consumer goods, driven by policies to expand domestic demand and trade-in initiatives.

articles.summary_en: On June 29, Hunan Provincial Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming conducted party spirit education activities and visited elderly and distressed party members in Changsha to implement Xi Jinping's party-building thought.

articles.title_zh: 盐宜高铁长江隧道启动盾构掘进
articles.title_en: Shield Tunneling Begins for Yan-Yi High-Speed Railway Yangtze River Tunnel

articles.summary_en: On June 30, shield tunneling commenced for the Yan-Yi High-Speed Railway Yangtze River Tunnel, connecting Jingjiang and Jiangyin in Jiangsu Province.

articles.title_zh: 西十高铁正式通车运营
articles.title_en: Xi-Shi High-Speed Railway Officially Opens for Operation
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，西安至十堰高速铁路正式通车运营。该铁路全长约257公里，旨在加强西北与华中地区的交通联通，推动东中西部协同发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, the Xi'an-Shiyan High-Speed Railway officially opened for operation. Spanning approximately 257 km, it enhances connectivity between Northwest and Central China to promote regional collaborative development.

articles.title_zh: 我国将迎来第22个中国航海日
articles.title_en: China to Celebrate 22nd China Maritime Day
articles.summary_zh: 交通运输部副部长李兴湖6月30日在国新办发布会上宣布，今年7月11日第22个中国航海日的主题为“数智赋能，领航未来”。
articles.summary_en: Vice Minister of Transport Li Xinghu announced on June 30 at a press conference that the theme for the 22nd China Maritime Day on July 11 will be 'Digital and Intelligent Empowerment, Navigating the Future'.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党党员队伍稳步壮大 组织体系日趋严密

articles.summary_en: The Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee reported that by the end of 2025, CPC membership reached 101.286 million with 5.431 million primary-level organizations.

articles.title_zh: 周家斌一审被判处无期徒刑

articles.summary_en: On June 29, a leadership meeting was held in Nanchang to announce the appointment of Sheng Qiuping as the Secretary of the Nanchang Municipal Party Committee and Li Hongjun as Deputy Director of the Standing Committee of the Jiangxi Provincial People's Congress.

articles.summary_en: On June 29, Provincial Party Secretary Yin Hong attended a leading cadre meeting in Nanchang, where Sheng Qiuping was appointed as the Secretary of the Nanchang Municipal Committee.

articles.summary_en: On June 29, 2026, Xu Shubao, former deputy governor of the Agricultural Bank of China Hebei Branch, was placed under investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 天府机场投运五周年成果综述

articles.summary_en: On June 27, Chengdu Tianfu International Airport celebrated its fifth anniversary, reporting over 1.4 million flights and 200 million passengers, significantly boosting the regional airport economy.

articles.summary_en: On June 24, General Secretary Xi Jinping inspected Dezhou, Shandong, calling for joint efforts to walk the 'new Long March road' to create a brighter future.

articles.title_zh: 黄河三角洲自然保护区生态补水启动

articles.title_zh: 网络餐饮食安新规实施半个月，严查“幽灵外卖”将成重点

articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation announced that following the implementation of new food safety rules for online catering, efforts will focus on cracking down on 'ghost kitchens' and no-dine-in delivery services.

articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment reported significant progress in the ten-year ecological restoration of the Yangtze River Economic Belt, highlighting improved water quality and the restructuring of chemical enterprises.

articles.summary_en: The 2026 'Vitality China Research Trip' delegation visited Sugon in Tianjin to investigate immersion liquid cooling technology for computing infrastructure and the local industry ecosystem.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：中国发展军力不针对任何国家
articles.title_en: Ministry of Foreign Affairs: China's Military Development Does Not Target Any Country
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月26日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上表示，中国发展军力是为了维护国家主权、安全和发展利益，不针对任何国家。
articles.summary_en: On June 26, 2026, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun stated at a regular press conference that China's military development is intended to safeguard national sovereignty, security, and development interests, and does not target any country.

articles.title_zh: 郑丽文与唐湘龙对谈访陆感受
articles.title_en: Zheng Liwen and Tang Xianglong Discuss Impressions of Visiting Mainland China
articles.summary_zh: 郑丽文与唐湘龙在对谈中分享访陆感受，赞赏大陆在科技与文化领域展现出的高度自信及“文艺的复兴”。
articles.summary_en: Zheng Liwen and Tang Xianglong shared their impressions of visiting mainland China, praising the high level of confidence shown in technology and culture.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记赴山东德州考察
articles.title_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping Inspects Dezhou, Shandong
articles.summary_zh: 6月24日，习近平总书记赴山东德州考察，重点关注粮食生产、基层党建及乡村振兴，旨在加快农业农村现代化。
articles.summary_en: On June 24, General Secretary Xi Jinping visited Dezhou, Shandong to inspect grain production, grassroots party building, and rural revitalization to accelerate agricultural and rural modernization.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在山东德州考察
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Inspects Dezhou, Shandong

articles.summary_en: On June 24, President Xi Jinping visited Dezhou, Shandong, to inspect grain production, grassroots party building, and rural revitalization, emphasizing the importance of food security and urban-rural integration.

articles.title_zh: 谌贻琴向上海合作组织妇女论坛开幕式发表视频致辞
articles.title_en: Chen Yiqin Delivers Video Address at the Opening Ceremony of the SCO Women's Forum
articles.summary_zh: 6月26日，上海合作组织妇女论坛在吉尔吉斯斯坦比什凯克开幕，国务委员、全国妇联主席谌贻琴发表视频致辞，强调加强妇女领域合作与女性领导力。
articles.summary_en: On June 26, the SCO Women's Forum opened in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan. State Councilor and President of the All-China Women's Federation Chen Yiqin delivered a video address emphasizing cooperation in women's affairs and female leadership.

articles.title_zh: 习近平签署国家主席令
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Signs Presidential Orders
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月26日，国家主席习近平签署第77、78、79号主席令，公布修订后的《商标法》和《注册会计师法》，并免去关志鸥的自然资源部部长职务。
articles.summary_en: On June 26, 2026, President Xi Jinping signed Presidential Orders No. 77, 78, and 79 to promulgate the revised Trademark Law and Certified Public Accountants Law, and to remove Guan Zhiou from the post of Minister of Natural Resources.

articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets with Hun Sen, President of the Cambodian People's Party and President of the Senate
articles.summary_zh: 6月26日下午，国务院总理李强在北京会见柬埔寨人民党主席、参议院主席洪森，双方探讨深化中柬政治互信及各领域务实合作。
articles.summary_en: On June 26, Premier Li Qiang met with Hun Sen, President of the Cambodian People's Party and President of the Senate, in Beijing to discuss deepening political trust and practical cooperation between China and Cambodia.

articles.title_zh: 谌贻琴在江西调研时强调坚决落实就业优先战略 推动体育产业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Chen Yiqin Emphasizes Employment-First Strategy and High-Quality Development of Sports Industry During Jiangxi Visit
articles.summary_zh: 国务委员谌贻琴于6月23日至26日在江西调研就业与体育工作，强调要落实就业优先战略并推动体育产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: State Councilor Chen Yiqin conducted a research trip to Jiangxi from June 23 to 26, emphasizing the implementation of the employment-first strategy and the high-quality development of the sports industry.

articles.title_zh: 到2030年我国将初步建成新型能源体系
articles.title_en: China to Preliminarily Establish New Energy System by 2030
articles.summary_zh: 6月26日，国务院新闻办公室举行发布会，国家能源局介绍“十五五”规划，目标到2030年初步建成新型能源体系，新能源装机比重将超过50%。
articles.summary_en: On June 26, the State Council Information Office held a press conference where the National Energy Administration outlined plans to establish a new energy system by 2030, with renewables exceeding 50% of power capacity.

articles.title_zh: 中华人民共和国和孟加拉人民共和国联合公报

articles.summary_en: Bangladesh Prime Minister Tariq Rahman visited China from June 22 to 26, 2026, meeting with President Xi Jinping and other top leaders to upgrade the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership.

articles.summary_en: On June 25, Foreign Minister Wang Yi met with Austrian Foreign Minister Beate Raininger in Beijing to emphasize mutual respect and win-win cooperation to deepen China-Austria relations.

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥在新疆调研

articles.summary_en: From June 25 to 26, Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang conducted a research tour in Xinjiang, emphasizing high-quality economic and social development, the Silk Road Economic Belt, energy security, and education in ethnic areas.

articles.title_zh: 十四届全国人大常委会第二十三次会议在京闭幕

articles.summary_zh: 十四届全国人大常委会第二十三次会议6月26日在北京闭幕，表决通过新修订的商标法等法律，并决定免去关志鸥的自然资源部部长职务。
articles.summary_en: The 23rd session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee concluded in Beijing on June 26, passing the revised Trademark Law and removing Guan Zhiou as Minister of Natural Resources.

articles.summary_en: The Office of the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission sought public opinion on June 26 regarding a mandatory national standard for government mobile internet applications to standardize management and reduce grassroots burdens.

articles.title_zh: 第九届中国—亚欧博览会开幕

articles.summary_en: The 23rd meeting of the 14th NPC Standing Committee was held in Beijing, featuring special inquiries on the national unified market, platform economy regulation, and transportation logistics.

articles.summary_en: Shi Weixiang, former president of Xi'an Jiaotong University and a pioneer in fluid transmission and control, has passed away at the age of 99.

articles.summary_zh: 全国人大常委会发布公告，罢免马兴瑞、胡衡华等多名人员的第十四届全国人大代表职务，并宣布张安疆代表资格自然终止。

articles.summary_en: On June 26, China's first professional risk co-insurance platform for the quantum information industry was launched in Hefei, established by 10 insurance institutions to provide comprehensive risk protection for quantum enterprises.

articles.summary_en: Jiangsu Railway plans to add 19 pairs of temporary passenger trains during the 2026 summer travel rush from July 1 to August 31 to meet travel demand.

articles.title_zh: 尹弘叶建春会见“赣鄱禁毒先锋”先进集体代表和先进个人

articles.summary_en: On June 24, Jiangxi Provincial Party Secretary Yin Hong and Governor Ye Jianchun met with "Ganpo Anti-Drug Pioneers" in Nanchang to emphasize deepening the people's war against drugs in the new era.

articles.title_zh: 坚决拥护党中央对尹建业的处分决定

articles.summary_en: On June 24, the Standing Committee of the Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee met to notify the decision by the CCDI and NSC to expel Yin Jianye from the Party and public office, emphasizing the deepening of strict Party governance.

articles.summary_en: On June 24, Jiangxi Governor Ye Jianchun conducted a special inspection on power supply security for the summer peak, emphasizing a dual approach of internal guarantees and external supplements to ensure stability.

articles.title_zh: 2026年“青少年党史学习月”活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 'Youth Party History Learning Month' Activities Launched

articles.summary_en: On June 23, the Jiangxi Provincial and Ganzhou Municipal Working Committees for the Care of the Next Generation launched the 2026 'Youth Party History Learning Month' in Xingguo County.

articles.title_zh: 阿拉善盟靶向攻坚推动重点项目落地见效
articles.title_en: Alxa League Promotes Implementation of Key Projects through Targeted Efforts
articles.summary_zh: 阿拉善盟统筹推进产业能源、民生保障等重点项目建设，旨在通过产业升级和基础提升推动区域绿色低碳发展。
articles.summary_en: Alxa League is coordinating the construction of key projects in industrial energy and livelihood security to promote regional green and low-carbon development through industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 包头稀土高新区推行“马路办公”机制整治城市环境
articles.title_en: Baotou Rare Earth High-tech Zone Implements "Roadside Office" Mechanism to Improve Urban Environment
articles.summary_zh: 6月24日，包头稀土高新区城市管理综合行政执法大队通过在问题现场召开“马路办公会”，高效处置城市环境顽疾，整治形式主义，提升治理效能。
articles.summary_en: On June 24, the Urban Management Law Enforcement Brigade of Baotou Rare Earth High-tech Zone held "roadside office meetings" at problem sites to efficiently resolve urban environmental issues and combat formalism.

articles.title_zh: 达拉特—蒙西1000千伏交流输变电工程开工
articles.title_en: Construction Begins on Dalate-Mengxi 1000kV AC Transmission and Transformation Project
articles.summary_zh: 近日，内蒙古第十条特高压通道——达拉特—蒙西1000千伏交流输变电工程开工建设，由国网蒙东电力与内蒙古电力集团合作共建。
articles.summary_en: Construction has recently begun on the Dalate-Mengxi 1000kV AC transmission and transformation project, Inner Mongolia's 10th UHV channel, jointly built by State Grid East Mongolia Electric Power and Inner Mongolia Power Group.

articles.title_zh: 包钢在鄂尔多斯市和包头市调研
articles.title_en: Bao Gang Conducts Research Tours in Ordos and Baotou
articles.summary_zh: 6月22日至24日，内蒙古自治区主席包钢在鄂尔多斯市和包头市调研能源与稀土产业高质量发展，并主持召开经济运行和安全生产座谈会。
articles.summary_en: From June 22 to 24, Bao Gang, Chairman of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, conducted research on the high-quality development of energy and rare earth industries in Ordos and Baotou, and chaired a meeting on economic operation and production safety.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在山东德州考察强调以扎实举措推进农业农村现代化
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Emphasizes Promoting Agricultural and Rural Modernization During Inspection in Dezhou, Shandong
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月24日，习近平在山东德州考察，强调要保障粮食等重要农产品稳定供给，推进宜居宜业和美乡村建设，以扎实举措推进农业农村现代化。
articles.summary_en: On June 24, 2026, Xi Jinping inspected Dezhou, Shandong, emphasizing the need to ensure stable food supply and promote the construction of livable and business-friendly beautiful villages to advance agricultural and rural modernization.

articles.title_zh: 西宁出台巡察建议书制度
articles.title_en: Xining Introduces Inspection Suggestion Letter System
articles.summary_zh: 西宁市委巡察工作领导小组办公室近日印发《西宁市委巡察建议书制度（试行）》，旨在通过制度化管理提升巡察监督治理效能。
articles.summary_en: The Xining Municipal Party Committee Inspection Work Leading Group Office recently issued the 'Xining Municipal Party Committee Inspection Suggestion Letter System (Trial)' to enhance supervision and governance efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 四川发布 139 项农业科技成果
articles.title_en: Sichuan Releases 139 Agricultural Science and Technology Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 6月24日，四川省在遂宁射洪市举行农业科技成果“进园入县”启动会，发布139项农业科技成果，旨在推动技术直达农户并促进成果转化。
articles.summary_en: On June 24, Sichuan Province held a launch meeting in Shehong, Suining, releasing 139 agricultural science and technology achievements to promote technology transfer to farmers.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在山东德州考察农业农村发展和基层党的建设
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Inspects Agricultural and Rural Development and Grassroots Party Building in Dezhou, Shandong
articles.summary_zh: 6月24日，习近平在山东德州考察，就农业农村发展和基层党的建设作出重要指示，强调保障粮食稳定供给并推进宜居宜业和美乡村建设。
articles.summary_en: On June 24, Xi Jinping inspected Dezhou, Shandong, issuing instructions on agricultural and rural development and grassroots party building, emphasizing food security and the construction of beautiful villages.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在山东德州考察强调扎实推进农业农村现代化
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Inspects Dezhou, Shandong, Emphasizing Solid Progress in Agricultural and Rural Modernization
articles.summary_zh: 6月24日，习近平总书记在山东德州考察，强调要以扎实举措推进农业农村现代化，保障粮食安全，并发挥党建引领作用推进乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: On June 24, General Secretary Xi Jinping visited Dezhou, Shandong, emphasizing the need to promote agricultural and rural modernization, ensure food security, and leverage Party leadership for rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 长三角区域警务一体化领导小组会议在沪召开
articles.title_en: Yangtze River Delta Regional Police Integration Leading Group Meeting Held in Shanghai

articles.summary_en: The Yangtze River Delta Regional Police Integration Leading Group meeting was held in Shanghai on June 24, 2026. Mayor Gong Zheng called for stronger regional police cooperation to enhance security and development capabilities.

articles.title_zh: 传承弘扬伟大建党精神系列成果发布
articles.title_en: Release of Series of Achievements in Inheriting and Promoting the Great Founding Spirit of the Party
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月24日，关于学习贯彻习近平党建思想、弘扬伟大建党精神及践行正确政绩观的学术研讨会在上海举办，并发布了相关研究成果。
articles.summary_en: An academic seminar on implementing Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building and promoting the great founding spirit of the Party was held in Shanghai on June 24, 2026, where several research achievements were released.

articles.title_en: Shaanxi Province Launches First Practical Training Camp for Scientific and Technological Achievement Transformation
articles.summary_zh: 6月23日，陕西省科技厅启动首届科技成果转化实战训练营，旨在通过实战培训和孵化，推动硬科技成果从实验室走向市场。

articles.title_zh: 为推进中华民族共同体建设夯实法治根基
articles.title_en: Strengthening the Legal Foundation for Promoting the Construction of the Chinese Nation Community
articles.summary_zh: 国务院新闻办6月24日举行发布会，介绍将于7月1日起施行的《中华人民共和国民族团结进步促进法》，旨在通过法治手段推进中华民族共同体建设。
articles.summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference on June 24 to introduce the Law of the PRC on the Promotion of Ethnic Unity and Progress, effective July 1, to strengthen the legal basis for the Chinese nation community.

articles.title_zh: “非洲铁路人才青藏行”活动在拉萨开幕
articles.title_en: African Railway Talent Qinghai-Tibet Trip Event Opens in Lhasa
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月23日，“非洲铁路人才青藏行”活动在拉萨开幕。西藏自治区主席嘎玛泽登与中国人民对外友好协会会长杨万明出席并致辞，旨在深化中非铁路合作与人文交流。
articles.summary_en: On June 23, 2026, the 'African Railway Talent Qinghai-Tibet Trip' opened in Lhasa. Gama Zeden and Yang Wanming attended to promote China-Africa cooperation in railway construction and cultural exchange.

articles.title_zh: 五部门联合启动工业5G独立专网试点
articles.title_en: Five Departments Jointly Launch Industrial 5G Standalone Private Network Pilot
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部等五部门联合印发通知，启动工业5G独立专网试点，旨在满足大型企业对通信网络和生产数据的管理需求，助力工业互联网赋能。
articles.summary_en: Five departments, including the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, launched a pilot for industrial 5G standalone private networks to meet the network and data management needs of large enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 国务院新闻办举行“新征程上的奋斗者”中外记者见面会
articles.title_en: SCIO Holds 'Strivers on the New Journey' Press Conference for Civil Affairs Workers

articles.summary_en: On June 24, the State Council Information Office held a press conference titled 'Strivers on the New Journey,' featuring five frontline representatives from the civil affairs system.

articles.title_zh: 北京市委常委会召开会议研究东西部协作等事项
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting Discusses East-West Collaboration and Other Matters
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月24日，市委书记尹力主持召开北京市委常委会会议，研究东西部协作、土地承包延包试点及首都公安禁毒工作等事项。
articles.summary_en: On June 24, 2026, Secretary Yin Li chaired a meeting of the Beijing Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee to discuss East-West collaboration, land contract extensions, and public security.

articles.title_zh: 北京市全面开展共产党员献爱心活动 尹力殷勇李秀领带头捐款
articles.title_en: Beijing Launches Communist Party Member Charity Donation Activity, City Leaders Lead by Example
articles.summary_zh: 6月中旬起，北京市开展共产党员献爱心捐献活动，市委书记尹力、市长殷勇等市领导带头捐款，募款用于医疗救助、慈善助学等。
articles.summary_en: Starting mid-June, Beijing launched a charity donation activity for Communist Party members, with city leaders including Yin Li and Yin Yong leading the donations to support medical and educational aid.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在山东德州考察强调推进农业农村现代化
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Emphasizes Agricultural and Rural Modernization During Inspection in Dezhou, Shandong
articles.summary_zh: 6月24日，习近平在山东德州考察时强调，要提升农业综合生产能力，确保粮食稳定供给，因地制宜推进宜居宜业和美乡村建设。
articles.summary_en: On June 24, President Xi Jinping inspected Dezhou, Shandong, emphasizing the need to enhance agricultural production capacity, ensure food security, and promote the construction of beautiful and livable villages.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军调研高能级创新平台建设

articles.summary_en: On June 24, Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Secretary Yuan Jiajun inspected high-level innovation platform construction in Liangjiang New Area, emphasizing the integration of industry, academia, and research to foster new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 广州商品住宅“卖旧买新”试点满月 首例签约
articles.title_en: Guangzhou's 'Sell Old Buy New' Pilot for Commercial Housing Completes First Signing After One Month
articles.summary_zh: 6月25日，广州安居集团举行商品住宅“卖旧买新”试点首例签约活动，旨在通过市场化收购旧房支持居民改善住房并增加保障性住房来源。
articles.summary_en: On June 25, Guangzhou Anju Group held the first signing event for its 'sell old buy new' commercial housing pilot to support housing upgrades and increase affordable housing sources.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升调研省气象局、省地震局，部署防灾减灾工作
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Inspects Provincial Meteorological and Earthquake Bureaus to Strengthen Disaster Prevention and Mitigation
articles.summary_zh: 6月24日，甘肃省委书记胡昌升在省气象局、省地震局调研并主持座谈会，强调要坚持预防为主、防治结合，全力筑牢防灾减灾坚固防线。
articles.summary_en: On June 24, Hu Changsheng, Secretary of the Gansu Provincial Party Committee, inspected the provincial meteorological and earthquake bureaus, emphasizing a prevention-first approach to strengthen disaster mitigation defenses.

articles.title_zh: 白银市与兰州大学签署科技合作协议打造产学研融合典范
articles.title_en: Baiyin City and Lanzhou University Sign Tech Cooperation Agreements to Create Model for Industry-University-Research Integration
articles.summary_zh: 白银市政府与兰州大学近日在白银召开科技合作座谈会并签署三项协议，旨在深化产学研协作，推动资源型城市创新转型。
articles.summary_en: The Baiyin Municipal Government and Lanzhou University recently held a symposium and signed three cooperation agreements in Baiyin to deepen industry-university-research collaboration and promote the innovative transformation of the resource-based city.

articles.title_zh: 西江第1号洪水洪峰平稳通过广西
articles.title_en: First Flood Peak of Xijiang River Passes Smoothly Through Guangxi
articles.summary_zh: 6月24日，西江2026年第1号洪水洪峰平稳通过广西。在自治区党委、政府及水利部指导下，广西水利部门通过科学调度水库有效拦洪削峰，确保防汛形势平稳可控。
articles.summary_en: On June 24, the first flood peak of the Xijiang River in 2026 passed smoothly through Guangxi. Under the guidance of the regional government and Ministry of Water Resources, water authorities effectively managed the flood through scientific reservoir dispatching.

articles.title_zh: 自治区“两优一先”表彰大会召开
articles.title_en: Commendation Meeting for "Two Excellences and One Advanced" Held in Guangxi Autonomous Region

articles.summary_en: On June 24, the Guangxi Autonomous Region Party Committee held a commendation meeting in Nanning to honor outstanding party members, party workers, and grassroots party organizations.

articles.title_zh: 王凯在洛阳市调研产业发展和经济运行工作
articles.title_en: Wang Kai Conducts Research on Industrial Development and Economic Operation in Luoyang

articles.summary_en: On June 24, Governor Wang Kai visited Luoyang to research industrial development and economic operations, visiting enterprises and chairing a symposium to deploy economic growth and industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 省委第十轮巡视第二批次“回头看”完成进驻

articles.summary_en: As of June 24, the second batch of the 10th round of 'look-back' inspections by the Henan Provincial Committee has been deployed, with 8 groups inspecting 16 units.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁到鹤壁市新乡市调研

articles.summary_en: Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning recently visited Hebi and Xinxiang to inspect ecological environmental protection and air pollution control, emphasizing green development and carbon reduction.

articles.title_zh: 湖北出台措施强化自然资源要素保障
