articles.summary_en: Hubei Province issued measures to strengthen natural resource guarantees, prioritizing major projects and livelihood initiatives while streamlining land approval processes to improve efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 关志鸥会见驻华外交官参访活动嘉宾

articles.summary_en: On June 24, Guan Zhiou, Secretary of the Hubei Provincial Party Committee, met with diplomats in China and international think tank experts in Wuhan to discuss expanding high-level opening-up and deepening cooperation in trade, science, and education.

articles.title_zh: “未来之城”探索“未来农业”
articles.title_en: "Future City" Explores "Future Agriculture"
articles.summary_zh: 河北雄安新区通过建设智慧农业科技园和伏羲农场等项目，推动人工智能与农业深度融合，旨在打造智慧农业的“雄安模式”。
articles.summary_en: Xiong'an New Area in Hebei is integrating AI with agriculture through projects like the Smart Agriculture Technology Park and Fuxi Farm to establish the "Xiong'an Model" for smart farming.

articles.title_zh: 许勤弘扬伟大建党精神 奋力谱写中国式现代化龙江新篇章

articles.title_zh: 2025年全国共调配血液358.9万单位

articles.summary_en: The National Health Commission reported that 3.589 million units of blood were allocated nationwide in 2025 and plans to work with the Ministry of Justice to revise the Blood Donation Law.

articles.title_zh: 东京审判庭审记录中文全译本首度完整面世
articles.title_en: First Complete Chinese Translation of Tokyo Trial Records Released

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党的创建文物史料展开展

articles.title_zh: 三文鱼养殖工船“苏海1号”完成首捕

articles.title_zh: 全国政协十四届常委会第十七次会议闭幕
articles.title_en: The 17th Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th CPPCC National Committee Concludes
articles.summary_zh: 全国政协十四届常委会第十七次会议在京闭幕，王沪宁主持会议并强调要以高水平履职服务高质量发展，会议还决定了相关人事任免事项。
articles.summary_en: The 17th meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th CPPCC National Committee concluded in Beijing. Wang Huning presided and emphasized serving high-quality development through high-level performance of duties.

articles.title_zh: 卞志刚被查，国家国防科工局党组坚决拥护党中央决定
articles.title_en: Bian Zhigang Investigated; SASTIND Party Group Firmly Supports Party Central Committee's Decision
articles.summary_zh: 6月24日，国家国防科工局党组召开会议，传达中央纪委国家监委对原副局长卞志刚涉嫌严重违纪违法进行纪律审查和监察调查的决定。
articles.summary_en: On June 24, the Party group of the State Administration for Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense held a meeting to convey the decision of the CCDI and NSC to investigate former deputy director Bian Zhigang for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 全国政协十四届常委会第十七次会议举行全体会议
articles.title_en: Plenary Session of the 17th Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th CPPCC National Committee Held
articles.summary_zh: 全国政协十四届常委会第十七次会议于24日举行全体会议，王沪宁出席，14位常委围绕高质量发展、经济健康发展和社会全面进步作发言。
articles.summary_en: The 17th Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th CPPCC National Committee held a plenary session on the 24th. Wang Huning attended as 14 members spoke on high-quality development and social progress.

articles.title_zh: 无证、未审核剧目不得播出，微短剧新规公开征求意见
articles.title_en: NRTA Seeks Public Comment on New Regulations for Micro-short Dramas
articles.summary_zh: 国家广播电视总局于24日发布《微短剧发展管理办法（征求意见稿）》，拟对微短剧实行分类备案和发行许可制度，规定无证或未审核剧目不得播出。
articles.summary_en: The National Radio and Television Administration issued a draft for public comment on the 'Administrative Measures for the Development of Micro-short Dramas,' introducing a classification and licensing system for broadcasting.

articles.title_zh: 福州长乐国际机场二跑道投运及福州—阿姆斯特丹航线首航
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Changle International Airport's Second Runway Put into Operation and First Flight to Amsterdam Launched
articles.summary_zh: 6月23日，福州长乐国际机场二跑道正式投运，飞行区等级提升至4F，并开通福州至阿姆斯特丹直飞航线，助力高水平对外开放。
articles.summary_en: On June 23, the second runway of Fuzhou Changle International Airport was put into operation, upgrading its flight area to 4F level, and the first direct flight to Amsterdam was launched to support high-level opening-up.

articles.title_zh: 31个省份将差异化推进人工智能发展
articles.title_en: 31 Provinces to Promote Differentiated Development of Artificial Intelligence
articles.summary_zh: 31个省份在“十五五”规划纲要中部署差异化推进人工智能发展，重点围绕算力、算法、数据及“人工智能+”行动构建现代化产业体系。
articles.summary_en: 31 provinces have outlined differentiated AI development in their 15th Five-Year Plan, focusing on computing power, algorithms, data, and "AI+" initiatives to build a modern industrial system.

articles.title_zh: 西十高铁即将开通 鄂陕两省互推文旅优惠
articles.title_en: Xi-Shi High-Speed Railway to Open, Hubei and Shaanxi Launch Mutual Tourism Promotions
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月1日起西十高铁开通运营，湖北与陕西两省文旅部门联动推出互惠优惠举措，旨在促进两地文旅交流。
articles.summary_en: The Xi-Shi High-Speed Railway will open on July 1, 2026, with Hubei and Shaanxi provinces launching mutual tourism discounts to promote regional travel.

articles.title_zh: 许勤参观庆祝中国共产党成立105周年专题展览
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Visits Special Exhibitions Celebrating the 105th Anniversary of the CPC
articles.summary_zh: 6月24日，黑龙江省委书记许勤率省领导参观庆祝中国共产党成立105周年专题展览并重温入党誓词，强调要弘扬建党精神，推动龙江高质量振兴发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 24, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, visited special exhibitions celebrating the 105th anniversary of the CPC and renewed Party oaths, emphasizing the promotion of the Party's founding spirit to drive high-quality revitalization in Heilongjiang.

articles.title_zh: 我国科学家实验证实半导体中“电子可分”
articles.title_en: Chinese Scientists Experimentally Confirm 'Electron Divisibility' in Semiconductors
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月23日，南京大学杜灵杰教授团队在实验中证实半导体中电子在特定条件下可表现为多个部分子，为拓扑量子计算带来新可能。
articles.summary_en: On June 23, 2026, Professor Du Lingjie's team at Nanjing University experimentally confirmed that electrons in semiconductors can behave as multiple quasiparticles under specific conditions, offering new possibilities for topological quantum computing.

articles.title_zh: 刘国中在江苏调研强调打造生物医药和脑机接口产业
articles.title_en: Liu Guozhong Emphasizes Developing Biopharmaceutical and Brain-Computer Interface Industries During Jiangsu Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月22日至23日，国务院副总理刘国中在江苏调研，强调要打造生物医药新兴支柱产业，培育脑机接口未来产业，并部署汛期防灾工作。
articles.summary_en: From June 22 to 23, 2026, Vice Premier Liu Guozhong inspected Jiangsu, emphasizing the development of biopharmaceutical and brain-computer interface industries and deploying flood prevention measures.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁出台新举措促进小剧场繁荣发展
articles.title_en: Liaoning Introduces New Measures to Promote Development of Small Theaters
articles.summary_zh: 辽宁省近日发布《关于促进辽宁省小剧场繁荣发展的指导意见》，旨在通过优化布局、创新运营及深化文旅融合，打造具有辽宁风格的小剧场发展模式。
articles.summary_en: Liaoning Province recently issued guiding opinions to promote the development of small theaters by optimizing layout, innovating operations, and integrating culture and tourism.

articles.title_zh: 2026黄河主题旅游海外推广活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Yellow River Theme Tourism Overseas Promotion Activity Launched
articles.summary_zh: 2026黄河主题旅游海外推广活动在内蒙古乌海市启动，旨在通过沿黄九省文旅合作，推动黄河文化旅游带的海外传播与入境旅游高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Yellow River Theme Tourism Overseas Promotion Activity was launched in Wuhai, Inner Mongolia, aiming to promote the Yellow River cultural tourism belt and inbound tourism through cooperation among nine provinces.

articles.title_en: Ningdong Base Modern Chemical Municipal Industry-Education Integration Consortium Established
articles.summary_zh: 6月23日，由宁东基地管委会、宁夏工商职业技术大学等单位组建的宁东基地现代化工市域产教联合体正式成立，旨在通过产教融合培养化工领域技能人才。
articles.summary_en: On June 23, the Ningdong Base Modern Chemical Municipal Industry-Education Integration Consortium was established by the Ningdong Base Management Committee and Ningxia Industrial and Commercial Vocational University to foster skilled talent in the chemical sector.

articles.title_zh: 四川发布数智产业链合作机会清单
articles.title_en: Sichuan Releases Cooperation Opportunity List for Digital-Intelligent Industry Chain
articles.summary_zh: 6月22日在北京举行的第四届链博会期间，四川省发布数智产业链合作机会清单，推出73个优质项目，总投资达1548亿元。
articles.summary_en: During the 4th CISCE in Beijing on June 22, Sichuan Province released a cooperation opportunity list for the digital-intelligent industry chain, featuring 73 projects with a total investment of 154.8 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 兵团服务业大会召开 深入实施服务业扩能提质行动
articles.title_en: Bingtuan Service Industry Conference Held to Promote Capacity Expansion and Quality Improvement
articles.summary_zh: 6月23日，兵团服务业大会召开。何忠友强调要深入实施服务业扩能提质行动，更好满足民生需要并推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 23, the Bingtuan Service Industry Conference was held. He Zhongyou emphasized implementing actions to expand service industry capacity and improve quality to meet livelihood needs and promote high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 2025年度云南省“最美自然守护者”发布
articles.title_en: 2025 Yunnan Province "Most Beautiful Nature Guardians" Announced
articles.summary_zh: 2025年6月23日，由云南省委宣传部和省自然资源厅主办的2025年度云南省“最美自然守护者”发布仪式在昆明举行，表彰自然资源保护领域的先进典型。
articles.summary_en: On June 23, 2025, the ceremony for the 2025 "Most Beautiful Nature Guardians" of Yunnan Province, hosted by the Provincial Party Committee Publicity Department and the Department of Natural Resources, was held in Kunming to honor exemplary figures in natural resource protection.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在山东德州考察
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Inspects Dezhou in Shandong Province
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月24日，习近平在山东德州考察，强调要以扎实举措推进农业农村现代化，确保粮食稳定供给，推进宜居宜业和美乡村建设。
articles.summary_en: On June 24, 2026, Xi Jinping inspected Dezhou, Shandong, emphasizing the promotion of agricultural and rural modernization, ensuring stable food supply, and building livable and business-friendly beautiful villages.

articles.title_zh: 抓好“三夏”生产 夯实全年丰收根基
articles.title_en: Ensuring 'Three Summers' Production to Consolidate the Foundation for Annual Harvest
articles.summary_zh: 6月24日上午，习近平总书记在山东省德州市听取“三夏”生产工作汇报，强调抓好夏收、夏播和夏管以夯实全年粮食丰收根基。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of June 24, President Xi Jinping visited Dezhou, Shandong Province, to hear reports on 'Three Summers' production, emphasizing the importance of summer harvest, sowing, and management for food security.

articles.title_zh: 梁言顺深入六安市随机调研督导
articles.title_en: Liang Yanshun Conducts Random Inspection and Supervision in Lu'an City
articles.summary_zh: 6月23日，省委书记梁言顺在六安市开展随机调研督导，重点检查防汛救灾和安全生产工作，强调要保障人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On June 23, Provincial Party Secretary Liang Yanshun conducted random inspections in Lu'an City, focusing on flood control and production safety to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 重庆出台农业创业孵化园三年建设方案
articles.title_en: Chongqing Issues Three-Year Construction Plan for Agricultural Entrepreneurship Incubation Parks
articles.summary_zh: 重庆市委农村工作暨实施乡村振兴战略领导小组办公室印发2026-2028年建设方案，首批确定北碚、铜梁、璧山、万州4个农业创业孵化园启动建设。
articles.summary_en: The Office of the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee Rural Work and Rural Revitalization Strategy Leading Group issued a 2026-2028 plan to build agricultural entrepreneurship incubation parks, designating four initial sites.

articles.title_zh: 推动港航贸一体化发展 福建将重点抓五件事
articles.title_en: Fujian to Focus on Five Key Areas to Promote Integrated Development of Ports, Shipping, and Trade
articles.summary_zh: 福建省交通运输厅等三部门近日印发相关措施，通过实施5个方面17项重点任务，旨在打造现代化东南沿海港口群，推动港口经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The Fujian Provincial Department of Transport and two other departments issued measures focusing on 17 tasks across five areas to build a modern southeast coastal port cluster and promote high-quality port economy development.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升在陇南市调研督导防汛防洪防地灾工作
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Conducts Research and Supervision on Flood and Geological Disaster Prevention in Longnan
articles.summary_zh: 6月21日至23日，甘肃省委书记胡昌升在陇南市调研督导防汛防洪、地质灾害防治及“三夏”生产工作，强调要坚决维护人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: From June 21 to 23, Hu Changsheng, Secretary of the Gansu Provincial Party Committee, inspected flood control, geological disaster prevention, and summer harvest production in Longnan to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚主持召开自治区党委全面深化改革委员会第十六次会议暨向海经济高质量发展专题调研会
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Chairs Meeting on Comprehensive Deepening Reform and High-Quality Development of Maritime Economy in Guangxi
articles.summary_zh: 6月23日，广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚主持召开会议，研究制定向海经济发展规划和政策体系，审议通过海洋经济“十五五”规划等文件。
articles.summary_en: On June 23, Chen Gang, Secretary of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Party Committee, chaired a meeting to study the development plan and policy system for the maritime economy and approved the 15th Five-Year Plan for marine economy.

articles.title_zh: 广西“人工智能+气象”创新应用大赛正式启动
articles.title_en: AI + Meteorology Innovation Application Competition Officially Launched in Guangxi
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月24日，由广西气象局和大数据发展局主办的“人工智能+气象”创新应用大赛在南宁启动，旨在利用AI提升气象预报精度并推动中国-东盟合作。
articles.summary_en: On June 24, 2026, the "AI + Meteorology" Innovation Application Competition, hosted by the Guangxi Meteorological Bureau and Big Data Development Bureau, was launched in Nanning to enhance weather forecasting and promote China-ASEAN cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 贵州省卫健委原副主任田艳受贿案一审宣判
articles.title_en: First-instance Verdict Delivered in Bribery Case of Tian Yan, Former Deputy Director of Guizhou Provincial Health Commission
articles.summary_zh: 6月23日，贵州省安顺市中级人民法院一审宣判贵州省卫健委原副主任田艳受贿案，以受贿罪判处其有期徒刑十一年，并处罚金一百一十万元。
articles.summary_en: On June 23, the Anshun Intermediate People's Court of Guizhou Province sentenced Tian Yan, former Deputy Director of the Provincial Health Commission, to 11 years in prison and a fine of 1.1 million yuan for bribery.

articles.title_zh: 高标准高质量建设三峡水运新通道工程
articles.title_en: High-Standard and High-Quality Construction of the Three Gorges Waterway New Channel Project
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，三峡水运新通道工程在湖北宜昌正式开工。中国三峡集团董事长刘伟平表示，该工程将大幅提升航运效率，推动长江经济带高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, the Three Gorges Waterway New Channel Project officially commenced in Yichang, Hubei. Liu Weiping, Chairman of China Three Gorges Corporation, stated that the project will significantly enhance shipping efficiency and promote the high-quality development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt.

articles.title_zh: 雄安新区人工智能产业聚力跃升
articles.title_en: AI Industry in Xiong'an New Area Gathers Momentum for Leapfrog Development
articles.summary_zh: 6月23日，记者团调研雄安新区，报道该区通过建设人工智能产业园和城市计算中心，推动AI产业集聚与智慧城市应用。
articles.summary_en: On June 23, a research team visited Xiong'an New Area to report on the growth of its AI industry, highlighting the AI Industrial Park and City Computing Center.

articles.title_en: Xu Qin Inspects Harbin Logistics Hub and High-end Electrical Equipment Intelligent Manufacturing Base
articles.summary_zh: 6月23日，黑龙江省委书记许勤在哈尔滨调研京东物流枢纽和高端电气装备智造产业基地，强调要扩投资强产业，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 23, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, inspected the JD Logistics Hub and a high-end electrical equipment manufacturing base in Harbin to promote high-quality industrial development.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明毛伟明调研安全环保烟花产品研发进展情况
articles.title_en: Shen Xiaoming and Mao Weiming Inspect R&D Progress of Safe and Eco-friendly Fireworks
articles.summary_zh: 6月23日，湖南省委书记沈晓明和省长毛伟明调研安全环保烟花产品研发进展，强调要加强技术攻关，推动烟花爆竹产业转型升级并提高本质安全水平。
articles.summary_en: On June 23, Hunan Provincial Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming and Governor Mao Weiming inspected the R&D of safe and eco-friendly fireworks, emphasizing technical breakthroughs to promote industrial transformation and safety.

articles.title_zh: 第十五届中国创新创业大赛(江西赛区)启动
articles.title_en: The 15th China Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition (Jiangxi Division) Launches
articles.summary_zh: 江西省科技厅启动第十五届中国创新创业大赛（江西赛区），旨在挖掘优质科创企业，助力新质生产力培育与全省产业链升级。
articles.summary_en: The Jiangxi Provincial Department of Science and Technology launched the 15th China Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition (Jiangxi Division) to foster new quality productive forces and upgrade the industrial chain.

articles.title_zh: 习近平嘱托基层党组织进一步发挥党建引领作用
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Urges Primary-level Party Organizations to Further Play Leading Role of Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 6月24日，习近平总书记在山东德州西于架村考察，要求基层党组织进一步发挥党建引领作用，推进宜居宜业和美乡村建设。
articles.summary_en: On June 24, President Xi Jinping inspected Xiyujia Village in Dezhou, Shandong, urging primary-level party organizations to strengthen party building to promote the construction of livable and business-friendly beautiful villages.

articles.summary_zh: 6月24日，习近平在山东省德州市考察，实地了解“三夏”生产情况，并与种粮大户、农技人员及村民交流。
articles.summary_en: On June 24, Xi Jinping conducted an inspection tour in Dezhou, Shandong Province, to learn about 'Three Summer' agricultural production and interact with farmers and technicians.

articles.title_zh: 九图了解防汛安全科普知识
articles.title_en: Nine Images to Understand Flood Control Safety Knowledge
articles.summary_zh: 应急管理部近日举行发布会，通过海报形式科普极端强降雨、汛期驾车及山区旅游等防灾避险安全知识。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Emergency Management recently held a press conference to popularize safety knowledge for disaster prevention and avoidance during floods and extreme weather.

articles.title_zh: 国家广播电视总局就《微短剧发展管理办法（征求意见稿）》公开征求意见
articles.title_en: National Radio and Television Administration Solicits Public Comments on Draft Administrative Measures for Micro-Short Dramas
articles.summary_zh: 国家广播电视总局发布《微短剧发展管理办法（征求意见稿）》并公开征求意见，旨在通过分类管理和审核许可制度，推动微短剧行业健康规范发展。
articles.summary_en: The National Radio and Television Administration (NRTA) has released a draft of the 'Administrative Measures for the Development of Micro-Short Dramas' for public comment to regulate the industry through categorized management and licensing.

articles.title_zh: 7部门开展报废机动车非法回收拆解专项整治行动
articles.title_en: Seven Departments Launch Special Rectification Action Against Illegal Recovery and Dismantling of Scrapped Motor Vehicles
articles.summary_zh: 商务部等7部门于2026年6月24日发布方案，在全国范围内开展报废机动车非法回收拆解专项整治行动，旨在打击非法拆解并促进行业规范发展。
articles.summary_en: Seven departments, including the Ministry of Commerce, launched a nationwide special rectification action on June 24, 2026, to crack down on illegal recovery and dismantling of scrapped motor vehicles.

articles.summary_zh: 国家矿山安全监察局山西局监察执法八处三级调研员耿青禄因涉留神峪煤矿事故被调查。
articles.summary_en: Geng Qinglu, a researcher at the Shanxi Bureau of the National Mine Safety Administration, is under investigation regarding the Liushenyu coal mine accident.

articles.title_zh: 多部门成立联合调查组，核查“婴幼儿纸尿裤甲酰胺问题”
articles.title_en: Multiple Departments Establish Joint Investigation Team to Probe Formamide Issue in Baby Diapers
articles.summary_zh: 中国多个部门成立联合调查组，针对婴幼儿纸尿裤中存在的甲酰胺问题展开核查。
articles.summary_en: Multiple Chinese departments have formed a joint investigation team to investigate the presence of formamide in baby diapers.

articles.title_zh: 习近平给老党员张连生回信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Letter from Veteran Party Member Zhang Liansheng
articles.summary_zh: 在中国共产党成立105周年之际，习近平总书记给新华社102岁老党员张连生回信，向其及全国老党员、老同志致以诚挚问候。
articles.summary_en: On the 105th anniversary of the CPC, General Secretary Xi Jinping replied to a letter from Zhang Liansheng, a 102-year-old party member of Xinhua News Agency, and extended greetings to veteran party members nationwide.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记回信激励党员干部不忘初心、砥砺前行
articles.title_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping's Reply Letter Encourages Party Members and Cadres to Remain True to Original Aspirations
articles.summary_zh: 在中国共产党成立105周年之际，习近平总书记给新华社老党员张连生回信，勉励新时代共产党人传承红色基因，不忘初心、履职尽责。
articles.summary_en: On the 105th anniversary of the CPC, General Secretary Xi Jinping replied to veteran party member Zhang Liansheng, encouraging new-era communists to inherit red genes and remain true to their original aspirations.

articles.title_zh: 2026年端午节假期国内出游1.24亿人次
articles.title_en: 124 Million Domestic Trips Recorded During 2026 Dragon Boat Festival Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 文化和旅游部数据显示，2026年端午节假期国内出游1.24亿人次，同比增长4.4%，国内出游总花费444.56亿元。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Culture and Tourism reported 124 million domestic trips during the 2026 Dragon Boat Festival holiday, with total spending reaching 44.456 billion yuan, a 4% year-on-year increase.

articles.title_zh: 端午假期全社会跨区域人员流动总量超6.4亿人次
articles.title_en: Over 640 Million Cross-Regional Trips Recorded During Dragon Boat Festival Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 交通运输部数据显示，2026年端午假期期间，全社会跨区域人员流动总量超过6.4亿人次，其中公路出行仍占主流。
articles.summary_en: According to the Ministry of Transport, over 640 million cross-regional trips were made during the 2026 Dragon Boat Festival holiday, with road travel remaining the primary mode.

articles.title_zh: 全国人大常委会启动青藏高原生态保护法执法检查
articles.title_en: NPC Standing Committee Launches Law Enforcement Inspection of Qinghai-Tibet Plateau Ecological Protection Law
articles.summary_zh: 全国人大常委会于6月22日启动青藏高原生态保护法执法检查，计划于7至8月赴川、藏、甘、青、新五省（区）开展实地检查。
articles.summary_en: The NPC Standing Committee launched a law enforcement inspection of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau Ecological Protection Law on June 22, with field visits to five provinces and regions scheduled for July and August.

articles.title_zh: 广东论证将槟榔划为特殊管控品类的可行性
articles.title_en: Guangdong to Study Feasibility of Classifying Betel Nut as Specially Controlled Category
articles.summary_zh: 广东省市场监督管理局回应人大代表建议，将系统论证将槟榔划为特殊管控品类的可行性，旨在填补监管空白并加强公众健康教育。
articles.summary_en: The Guangdong Provincial Administration for Market Regulation is studying the feasibility of classifying betel nut as a specially controlled category to fill regulatory gaps and enhance public health education.

articles.title_en: Bowang District Ecology and Environment Bureau of Ma'anshan City Issues Situation Report
articles.summary_zh: 6月22日，马鞍山市博望区生态环境分局通报杨桥河部分河段水体变红事件，系一包装公司原料泄漏所致，目前已采取拦截处置措施。
articles.summary_en: On June 22, the Bowang District Ecology and Environment Bureau of Ma'anshan reported a water discoloration incident in the Yangqiao River caused by a leak from a packaging company; containment measures have been implemented.

articles.title_en: Fuling, Chongqing Strengthens and Optimizes Characteristic Industries Based on Local Conditions
articles.summary_zh: 重庆涪陵区通过数字化转型和技术升级，做强做优榨菜特色产业，推动生态特色农业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Fuling District in Chongqing is strengthening its characteristic pickled mustard tuber industry through digital transformation and technical upgrades to promote high-quality ecological agriculture.

articles.title_zh: 福州市启动“十五五”城市更新专项规划编制工作
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Launches Compilation of "15th Five-Year Plan" Special Planning for Urban Renewal
articles.summary_zh: 福州市住建局近日组织召开会议，部署启动“十五五”城市更新专项规划编制工作，旨在落实国家顶层设计并推动城市高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The Fuzhou Housing and Urban-Rural Development Bureau recently held a meeting to launch the compilation of the "15th Five-Year Plan" special planning for urban renewal to implement national strategies.

articles.title_zh: 多部门会商部署重点地区防汛工作
articles.title_en: Multiple Departments Consult to Deploy Flood Control Work in Key Regions
articles.summary_zh: 6月21日，国家防总办公室与应急管理部在京组织多部门会商，研判降雨趋势并部署重点地区防汛工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 21, the State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters Office and the Ministry of Emergency Management held a multi-departmental consultation in Beijing to deploy flood control work in key regions.

articles.title_zh: 遵义市以高质量党建引领推动基层高质量发展
articles.title_en: Zunyi City Promotes High-Quality Grassroots Development Through High-Quality Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 贵州省遵义市委常委、市委组织部部长徐永琳接受采访，介绍了遵义市在筑牢基层战斗堡垒、选优配强基层带头人及提升治理效能等方面的党建实践。
articles.summary_en: Xu Yonglin, member of the Zunyi Municipal Committee, detailed the city's practices in strengthening grassroots party organizations, optimizing leadership, and enhancing governance efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 推动海洋经济领域就业稳岗扩容提质
articles.title_en: Promoting Employment Stability, Expansion, and Quality Improvement in the Marine Economy Sector
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月21日，人力资源社会保障部等四部门印发通知，旨在优化海洋经济空间布局，推动海洋经济高质量发展并促进就业创业。
articles.summary_en: On June 21, 2026, four departments, including the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, issued a notice to optimize the spatial layout of the marine economy and promote high-quality development and employment.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省发布“银雪花”金融教育品牌
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Province Launches 'Silver Snowflake' Financial Education Brand
articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江省银行业协会近日发布“银雪花”金融教育品牌并启动2026年普及金融知识万里行活动，旨在提升消费者金融素养，守护合法权益。
articles.summary_en: The Heilongjiang Banking Association launched the 'Silver Snowflake' financial education brand and the 2026 'Financial Knowledge Popularization Ten Thousand Li Journey' to improve consumer financial literacy.

articles.title_zh: 江苏启动品质数码促消费活动
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Launches Quality Digital Product Consumption Promotion Activity
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省商务厅近日启动“苏新消费·品质数码”专项促消费活动，为购买6000元以上手机的消费者提供最高千元补贴。
articles.summary_en: The Jiangsu Provincial Department of Commerce recently launched the 'Su New Consumption · Quality Digital' promotion, offering subsidies up to 1,000 yuan for consumers purchasing phones priced over 6,000 yuan.

articles.title_zh: 资本活水潮涌 江苏半导体“新生代”迎丰收季
articles.title_en: Capital Influx: Jiangsu's "New Generation" of Semiconductor Companies Enter Harvest Season
articles.summary_zh: 近期江苏省半导体企业融资与IPO进程加速，多家企业获得大额投资，得益于省科技厅等部门的政策支撑与国产替代趋势。
articles.summary_en: Semiconductor companies in Jiangsu Province are experiencing a surge in financing and IPOs, supported by provincial government policies and the trend of domestic substitution.

articles.title_zh: 江苏迎峰度夏重点工程全部投运
articles.title_en: Key Power Projects for Summer Peak Demand Fully Operational in Jiangsu
articles.summary_zh: 6月19日，江苏省今年迎峰度夏重点工程全部建成投运，旨在保障夏季电力负荷高峰期间的能源供给。
articles.summary_en: On June 19, all key power projects for summer peak demand in Jiangsu Province became fully operational to ensure energy supply during peak summer loads.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏印发社会团体换届工作指引
articles.title_en: Ningxia Issues Guidelines for Social Organization Term Expiration and Elections
articles.summary_zh: 宁夏回族自治区民政厅近日印发《宁夏社会团体换届工作指引》，旨在规范全区社会团体换届选举工作，提升规范化管理水平。
articles.summary_en: The Department of Civil Affairs of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region recently issued guidelines to standardize the term expiration and election process for social organizations across the region.

articles.title_en: Zigong and Panzhihua Cities in Sichuan Release Pre-appointment Publicity for Officials
articles.summary_zh: 6月18日，四川省自贡市和攀枝花市分别发布干部任前公示，拟任正县级领导职务的人员包括龚弟霞和岳洪。
articles.summary_en: On June 18, Zigong and Panzhihua cities in Sichuan Province released pre-appointment notices for officials Gong Dixia and Yue Hong, both proposed for positive county-level leadership positions.

articles.title_zh: 四川6市政府发布人事任免
articles.title_en: Six Municipal Governments in Sichuan Announce Personnel Appointments and Removals
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月22日，四川省成都市、广元市、南充市、宜宾市、巴中市和眉山市六市政府发布人事任免通知。
articles.summary_en: On June 22, 2026, six municipal governments in Sichuan Province, including Chengdu, Guangyuan, Nanchong, Yibin, Bazhong, and Meishan, announced personnel appointments and removals.

articles.title_zh: 许勤主持黑龙江省委农村工作领导小组会议
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Chairs Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee Rural Work Leading Group Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 6月17日，黑龙江省委书记许勤主持省委农村工作领导小组会议，部署乡村振兴、常态化帮扶及农业农村现代化等工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 17, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, chaired a meeting of the provincial rural work leading group to deploy tasks on rural revitalization and agricultural modernization.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛会见香港特区政府财政司司长陈茂波
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Meets Paul Chan Mo-po, Financial Secretary of the HKSAR Government
articles.summary_zh: 6月19日，江苏省长刘小涛在南京会见香港特区政府财政司司长陈茂波，双方探讨深化苏港在金融、科技、航运等领域的交流合作。
articles.summary_en: On June 19, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao met with Paul Chan Mo-po, Financial Secretary of the HKSAR Government, in Nanjing to discuss deepening cooperation in finance, technology, and shipping.

articles.title_zh: 2026年环保赣江行活动开启
articles.title_en: 2026 Environmental Protection Ganjiang Tour Activity Launched
articles.summary_zh: 2026年，江西省人大常委会启动第32次“环保赣江行”活动，聚焦赣江流域水生态环境质量改善，通过调研、检查和专题询问压实环保责任。
articles.summary_en: In 2026, the Standing Committee of the Jiangxi Provincial People's Congress launched the 32nd 'Environmental Protection Ganjiang Tour' to improve water quality in the Ganjiang River basin through inspections and inquiries.

articles.title_zh: 我国发生今年大江大河首次编号洪水
articles.title_en: China Records First Numbered Flood of Major Rivers This Year
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月22日，水利部通报珠江流域西江出现今年我国大江大河首次编号洪水，广东、广西、贵州三省区已启动应急响应并采取防洪调度措施。
articles.summary_en: On June 22, 2026, the Ministry of Water Resources reported the first numbered flood of major rivers this year in the West River of the Pearl River basin, triggering emergency responses and flood control measures in Guangdong, Guangxi, and Guizhou.

articles.title_zh: 2.19亿元农业生产防灾救灾资金下达
articles.title_en: 219 Million Yuan Allocated for Agricultural Disaster Prevention and Relief
articles.summary_zh: 财政部会同农业农村部下达2.19亿元资金，支持内蒙古、湖北等7省（自治区、直辖市）开展农业生产救灾工作，以减少农业损失并夯实粮食丰收基础。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs allocated 219 million yuan to support agricultural disaster relief in seven provinces and regions to reduce losses and ensure grain harvests.

tags_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

articles.title_zh: 调研山东：AI进医院的机遇与挑战
articles.title_en: Researching Shandong: Opportunities and Challenges of AI in Hospitals
articles.summary_zh: 报道调研山东省智慧医疗现状，分析AI在提升医疗效率方面的作用及其在成本、数据安全和伦理责任方面面临的挑战。
articles.summary_en: The report examines the current state of smart healthcare in Shandong, analyzing AI's role in improving efficiency and the challenges regarding cost, data security, and ethical responsibility.

articles.title_zh: 《山河路漫》首发暨法文版签约仪式举行
articles.title_en: Launch Ceremony and French Edition Signing for "Shan He Lu Man" Held
articles.summary_zh: 上海交通大学出版社与四川路桥主办的《山河路漫》首发暨法文版版权输出签约仪式在上海举行，旨在向世界展示中国共产党形象并推动文化走出去。
articles.summary_en: A launch ceremony and French edition copyright signing for the book "Shan He Lu Man" were held in Shanghai to showcase the image of the CPC and promote Chinese cultural export.

articles.title_zh: 云南第二批重点待招商项目发布
articles.title_en: Yunnan Releases Second Batch of Key Projects for Investment Promotion
articles.summary_zh: 云南省投资促进局近日发布第二批重点待招商项目，涵盖70个项目，计划总投资约475亿元，旨在推动现代化产业体系建设。
articles.summary_en: The Yunnan Provincial Investment Promotion Bureau recently released the second batch of key projects for investment promotion, featuring 70 projects with a total planned investment of approximately 47.5 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 新华语典项目通过验收 打造权威AI时政资讯智能体标杆
articles.title_en: Xinhua Dictionary Project Passes Acceptance Review to Set Benchmark for Authoritative AI Political Information Agent
articles.summary_zh: 6月18日，中国信通院在京组织召开“新华语典”项目验收评审会，该项目通过验收，旨在为党政机关等提供权威AI时政资讯服务。
articles.summary_en: On June 18, the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology held an acceptance review meeting in Beijing for the 'Xinhua Dictionary' project, which passed the review to provide authoritative AI political information services for government agencies and institutions.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央批准开除尹建业党籍
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee Approves Expulsion of Yin Jianye from Party
articles.summary_zh: 6月22日，经中共中央批准，中央纪委国家监委对江西省政协原副主席尹建业给予开除党籍和开除公职处分，并将其涉嫌犯罪问题移送检察机关起诉。
articles.summary_en: On June 22, the CCDI and NSC expelled Yin Jianye, former Vice Chairman of the Jiangxi Provincial CPPCC, from the Party and public office for serious disciplinary and legal violations.

articles.title_zh: 湘西州委书记刘涛部署泸溪县“6·21”火灾事故后的安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Xiangxi Prefecture Party Secretary Liu Tao Deploys Safety Production Work Following "6·21" Fire Accident in Luxi County
articles.summary_zh: 6月21日，湖南湘西泸溪县发生火灾造成6死5伤。州委书记刘涛随即主持召开紧急调度会，部署全州安全生产风险隐患大排查大整治工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 21, a fire in Luxi County, Xiangxi, Hunan, left 6 dead and 5 injured. Party Secretary Liu Tao chaired an emergency meeting to deploy a comprehensive safety risk inspection and rectification campaign across the prefecture.

articles.title_zh: 柳江发生2026年主要江河第1号洪水
articles.title_en: Liujiang River Experiences First Major River Flood of 2026
articles.summary_zh: 6月21日，柳江水位达到警戒水位，被编号为2026年第1号洪水。水利部部长李国英部署防御工作，广西、贵州两省区维持或提升应急响应。
articles.summary_en: On June 21, the Liujiang River reached its warning level, marking the first major river flood of 2026. Minister of Water Resources Li Guoying deployed defense measures, with Guangxi and Guizhou activating emergency responses.

articles.title_zh: 持续开展多领域实试验 神舟二十三号乘组在轨动态更新
articles.title_en: Shenzhou-23 Crew Conducts Multi-field Experiments and On-orbit Updates
articles.summary_zh: 神舟二十三号乘组在空间站开展了菌群营养代谢、视觉运动加工等多领域实试验，并进行了首次医疗救护在轨训练。
articles.summary_en: The Shenzhou-23 crew conducted multi-field experiments on metabolism and visual-motor processing, and performed their first on-orbit medical rescue training in the Chinese Space Station.

articles.title_zh: 自然资源部等五部门推出企业购置不动产转移登记改革举措
articles.title_en: Ministry of Natural Resources and Four Other Departments Launch Reform Measures for Enterprise Real Estate Transfer Registration
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月21日，自然资源部会同公安部等四部门联合印发通知，推出7项改革举措，推动企业购置不动产转移登记“高效办成一件事”，旨在降低企业交易成本并提升办事效率。
articles.summary_en: On June 21, 2026, the Ministry of Natural Resources and four other departments issued a notice introducing seven reform measures to streamline real estate transfer registration for enterprises, aiming to reduce transaction costs and improve efficiency.

articles.title_zh: “支部建在工地上，起到关键作用”
articles.title_en: Party Branches on Construction Sites Play a Key Role
articles.summary_zh: 贵州桥梁建设集团党委通过将党组织建在工程一线，以高质量党建推动基础设施建设，成功攻克花江峡谷大桥等重大工程难题。
articles.summary_en: The Party Committee of Guizhou Bridge Construction Group promotes high-quality infrastructure development by establishing Party branches on construction sites, overcoming technical challenges in projects like the Huajiang Canyon Bridge.

articles.title_zh: 第二届西藏国际传播大会在拉萨举办
articles.title_en: The 2nd Tibet International Communication Conference Held in Lhasa
articles.summary_zh: 第二届西藏国际传播大会在拉萨举办，近300名国内外嘉宾参会并赴西藏多地参访，旨在增强涉藏国际传播效能，向世界展现西藏的真实面貌。
articles.summary_en: The 2nd Tibet International Communication Conference was held in Lhasa, with nearly 300 domestic and foreign guests visiting the region to enhance international communication and showcase the true development of Tibet.

articles.title_zh: 让钢铁实现个性化、定制化生产
articles.title_en: Enabling Personalized and Customized Steel Production
articles.summary_zh: 中国宝武宝钢股份人工智能决策团队利用AI技术优化订单分配、生产工艺及物流配送，实现了钢铁生产的个性化与定制化，显著提升了效率并降低了成本。
articles.summary_en: The AI decision-making team at Baosteel (China Baowu) utilizes AI technology to optimize order allocation, production processes, and logistics, enabling personalized steel production and reducing costs.

articles.title_zh: 广东实施“百千万工程”促进城乡区域协调发展
articles.title_en: Guangdong Implements 'Hundred-Thousand-Ten Thousand Project' to Promote Coordinated Urban-Rural Regional Development
articles.summary_zh: 广东通过实施“百千万工程”，在产业优化、乡村建设和公共服务均衡方面取得进展，旨在解决城乡区域发展不平衡问题。
articles.summary_en: Guangdong is implementing the 'Hundred-Thousand-Ten Thousand Project' to optimize industries, improve rural areas, and balance public services to address urban-rural regional imbalances.

articles.title_zh: 端午假期全社会跨区域人员流动量预计超6.5亿人次
articles.title_en: Cross-Regional Personnel Flow Expected to Exceed 650 Million During Dragon Boat Festival
articles.summary_zh: 交通运输部数据显示，端午假期全社会跨区域人员流动量预计超6.5亿人次，铁路部门通过加开列车等措施应对返程客流高峰。
articles.summary_en: According to the Ministry of Transport, cross-regional personnel flow is expected to exceed 650 million during the Dragon Boat Festival, with railway departments increasing capacity to handle the return peak.

articles.title_zh: 长三角地区进出口连续15个月保持增长
articles.title_en: Import and Export in Yangtze River Delta Region Grow for 15 Consecutive Months
articles.summary_zh: 今年前5个月，长三角地区进出口总值达7.82万亿元，同比增长16.2%，规模创历史同期新高，连续15个月保持增长。
articles.summary_en: In the first five months of this year, the import and export value of the Yangtze River Delta region reached 7.82 trillion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 16.2%, marking a record high and 15 consecutive months of growth.

articles.title_zh: 服务消费提质扩容 假日经济活力迸发
articles.title_en: Service Consumption Quality Improves and Expands as Holiday Economy Gains Vitality
articles.summary_zh: 端午假期期间，服务消费成为拉动假日经济的重要引擎，商务部监测数据显示商圈客流与营业额有所增长，相关政策组合拳显效。
articles.summary_en: During the Dragon Boat Festival, service consumption became a key driver of the holiday economy, with Ministry of Commerce data showing growth in foot traffic and turnover.

articles.title_zh: 6月21日全国铁路预计发送旅客1794万人次
articles.title_en: National Railways Expect 17.94 Million Passengers on June 21
articles.summary_zh: 6月21日端午节假期最后一天，全国铁路预计发送旅客1794万人次，中国国家铁路集团及各地铁路部门通过加开列车等措施保障返程客流。
articles.summary_en: On June 21, the final day of the Dragon Boat Festival holiday, national railways expect to transport 17.94 million passengers, with China State Railway Group increasing capacity to ensure smooth travel.

articles.title_zh: 广东实施“百千万工程”促进城乡区域协调发展
articles.title_en: Guangdong Implements "Hundred-Thousand-Ten Thousand Project" to Promote Coordinated Urban-Rural Regional Development
articles.summary_zh: 广东通过实施“百千万工程”，在产业优化、乡村建设和公共服务均衡方面取得进展，旨在解决城乡区域发展不平衡问题。
articles.summary_en: Guangdong is implementing the "Hundred-Thousand-Ten Thousand Project" to optimize industries, improve rural areas, and balance public services to address regional development imbalances.

articles.title_zh: 南京都市圈“十五五”协同发展图景发布
articles.title_en: "15th Five-Year Plan" Collaborative Development Blueprint for Nanjing Metropolitan Area Released
articles.summary_zh: 6月20日，南京都市圈科技产业融合创新推进会在南京举行，正式发布《南京都市圈“十五五”协同发展图景》，规划未来五年在空间协同、科产融合等方面的发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 20, the "15th Five-Year Plan" Collaborative Development Blueprint for the Nanjing Metropolitan Area was released in Nanjing to guide regional integration and industrial innovation over the next five years.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古首个TIR集结中心开工建设
articles.title_en: Construction Begins on Inner Mongolia's First TIR Assembly Center
articles.summary_zh: 近日，内蒙古自治区首个专业化TIR集结中心在满洲里启动建设，旨在提升口岸通关效率并降低企业物流成本。
articles.summary_en: Construction of Inner Mongolia's first professional TIR assembly center has started in Manzhouli to improve customs clearance efficiency and reduce logistics costs for enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 首批“青海名方”质量标准制修订工作启动
articles.title_en: Revision of Quality Standards for the First Batch of 'Qinghai Famous Prescriptions' Launched
articles.summary_zh: 6月18日，青海省药品监督管理局启动首批“青海名方”医疗机构制剂品种质量标准制修订工作，旨在健全藏药材与制剂质量标准体系。
articles.summary_en: On June 18, the Qinghai Provincial Drug Administration launched the revision of quality standards for the first batch of 'Qinghai Famous Prescriptions' to enhance the standardization of Tibetan and Chinese medicines.

articles.title_zh: 青海实现国内首次多构网设备弱电网黑启动
articles.title_en: Qinghai Achieves China's First Black Start of Weak Grid Using Multiple Grid-Forming Devices
articles.summary_zh: 6月15日，国网青海省电力公司等单位在果洛州成功完成国内首次末端弱支撑电网多构网型设备协同黑启动试验，探索了高比例新能源电网失电重启的新路径。
articles.summary_en: On June 15, State Grid Qinghai Electric Power Company and other entities successfully completed China's first collaborative black start test for weak-support end grids, exploring new technical paths for restarting remote grids with high proportions of new energy.

articles.title_zh: 七部门印发通知促进工业旅游发展
articles.title_en: Seven Departments Issue Notice to Promote Industrial Tourism Development
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月3日，文化和旅游部、中央宣传部、工业和信息化部等七部门联合印发通知，部署保护工业遗产、挖掘工业文化价值及发展工业旅游等重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, 2026, seven departments, including the Ministry of Culture and Tourism and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, issued a notice to promote industrial tourism and the protection of industrial heritage.

articles.title_zh: 陕西部署护鸟禁牧及“三北”工程重点工作
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Deploys Key Tasks for Bird Protection, Grazing Bans, and 'Three-North' Project
articles.summary_zh: 6月15日，陕西省林业局召开专题会议，部署野生鸟类保护、封山禁牧及“三北”工程建设等重点生态工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 15, the Shaanxi Provincial Forestry Bureau held a special meeting to deploy key ecological tasks, including wild bird protection, grazing bans, and the 'Three-North' project.

articles.title_zh: 新疆启动2026年度知识产权服务业统计调查
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Launches 2026 Statistical Survey on Intellectual Property Service Industry
articles.summary_zh: 新疆维吾尔自治区市场监督管理局近日在乌鲁木齐等9个地州市启动2026年度知识产权服务业统计调查，旨在摸清行业实情并优化扶持政策。
articles.summary_en: The Market Supervision Administration of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region recently launched a 2026 statistical survey on the IP service industry across nine prefectures and cities to optimize industry support policies.

articles.title_zh: 云南省出台18条举措培育低空经济增长点
articles.title_en: Yunnan Province Introduces 18 Measures to Cultivate Low-Altitude Economy Growth Points
articles.summary_zh: 云南省政府办公厅印发实施方案，提出18条举措拓展低空经济应用场景，涵盖公共服务、低空运输、农林作业及低空消费等领域。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of the Yunnan Provincial Government issued an implementation plan with 18 measures to expand low-altitude economy application scenarios, covering public services, transport, agriculture, and tourism.

tags_en: General Office of the Yunnan Provincial Government

articles.title_zh: 1—5月云南省新能源电池产业增加值同比增长78.2%
articles.title_en: Yunnan's New Energy Battery Industry Value-Added Grows 78.2% from January to May
articles.summary_zh: 云南省统计局发布数据显示，1—5月云南省新能源电池产业增加值同比增长78.2%，绿色铝产业及服务业等领域亦实现稳步增长。
articles.summary_en: Data from the Yunnan Provincial Bureau of Statistics shows that the value-added of Yunnan's new energy battery industry grew by 78.2% from January to May, with steady growth in green aluminum and service sectors.

articles.title_zh: 浙江宁波：智造拓海外 出口稳增长
articles.title_en: Ningbo, Zhejiang: Expanding Intelligent Manufacturing Overseas to Stabilize Export Growth
articles.summary_zh: 浙江宁波市江北区通过推进制造业“智改数转”和培育先进制造产业集群，提升产品竞争力以稳增长出口。
articles.summary_en: Jiangbei District in Ningbo, Zhejiang, is promoting 'intelligent transformation and digital transition' in manufacturing to enhance competitiveness and stabilize export growth.

articles.title_zh: “法学+外语”涉外法治人才培养联盟在渝成立
articles.title_en: Alliance for 'Law + Foreign Language' Foreign-related Legal Talent Cultivation Established in Chongqing
articles.summary_zh: 6月16日，“法学+外语”涉外法治人才培养联盟在重庆西南政法大学成立，由13所高校共同发起，旨在构建跨校协同育人体系。
articles.summary_en: On June 16, the 'Law + Foreign Language' Alliance for Foreign-related Legal Talent Cultivation was established at Southwest University of Political Science and Law in Chongqing, involving 13 universities to build a collaborative education system.

articles.title_zh: 应急管理部对四地启动国家地质灾害四级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Emergency Management Launches Level IV National Emergency Response for Geological Disasters in Four Provinces
articles.summary_zh: 应急管理部6月20日针对安徽、湖北、湖南、贵州启动国家地质灾害四级应急响应，以应对强降雨带来的地质灾害风险。
articles.summary_en: On June 20, the Ministry of Emergency Management launched a Level IV national emergency response for geological disasters in Anhui, Hubei, Hunan, and Guizhou due to heavy rain risks.

articles.title_zh: 南京都市圈科技产业融合创新推进会在宁召开
articles.title_en: Promotion Meeting on Science and Technology Industry Integration and Innovation of Nanjing Metropolitan Area Held in Nanjing
articles.summary_zh: 6月20日，南京都市圈科技产业融合创新推进会在南京召开，旨在谋划“十五五”科技产业融合创新，推动长三角一体化高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 20, a promotion meeting on science and technology industry integration and innovation of the Nanjing Metropolitan Area was held in Nanjing to plan for the 15th Five-Year Plan and promote high-quality integration of the Yangtze River Delta.

articles.title_zh: 2026年公祭中华人文始祖伏羲大典在甘肃天水举行
articles.title_en: 2026 Public Sacrifice Ceremony for Fuxi Held in Tianshui, Gansu
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月21日，公祭中华人文始祖伏羲大典在甘肃天水举行，台湾新北市同步举行共祭典礼，旨在通过文化传承促进两岸融合发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 21, 2026, the public sacrifice ceremony for Fuxi was held in Tianshui, Gansu, with a simultaneous event in New Taipei City, Taiwan, to promote cross-strait integration through cultural heritage.

articles.title_zh: 上海国际金融中心发展离岸金融行动方案发布
articles.title_en: Action Plan for the Development of Offshore Finance in the Shanghai International Financial Center Released
articles.summary_zh: 6月17日，中国人民银行等六部门联合发布《上海国际金融中心发展离岸金融行动方案》，旨在构建离岸金融业务体系，服务人民币国际化及金融强国建设。
articles.summary_en: On June 17, six departments including the PBOC released an action plan to develop offshore finance in Shanghai, aiming to build an offshore financial system to support RMB internationalization and the goal of becoming a financial powerhouse.

articles.title_zh: 习近平给老党员张连生回信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Letter from Veteran Party Member Zhang Liansheng
articles.summary_zh: 在中国共产党成立105周年之际，习近平总书记给新华社102岁老党员张连生回信，向其及全国老党员、老同志致以诚挚问候。
articles.summary_en: On the 105th anniversary of the CPC, General Secretary Xi Jinping replied to a letter from Zhang Liansheng, a 102-year-old party member at Xinhua News Agency, extending greetings to veteran party members nationwide.

articles.title_zh: 了不起的智能“钢铁裁缝”
articles.title_en: The Amazing Intelligent 'Steel Tailor'
articles.summary_zh: 记者团走进海油工程天津智能制造基地，探访用于重型海洋工程构件的高精度智能焊接机器人系统，推动海洋装备制造向智能化跨越。
articles.summary_en: A journalist group visited the CNOOC Engineering Tianjin Intelligent Manufacturing Base to explore a high-precision intelligent welding robot system for heavy marine engineering components.

articles.title_zh: 脑机接口技术在医疗康复等领域取得突破
articles.title_en: Brain-Computer Interface Technology Achieves Breakthroughs in Medical Rehabilitation and Other Fields
articles.summary_zh: 脑机海河实验室等机构研发的脑机接口技术在脑卒中康复和听障儿童治疗中取得进展，并逐步拓展至航天、工业等领域。
articles.summary_en: Brain-computer interface technologies developed by the Brain-Computer Haihe Laboratory have made progress in stroke rehabilitation and hearing impairment treatment, expanding into aerospace and industry.

articles.title_zh: 浙江启动新一轮财政专项激励政策
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Launches New Round of Special Fiscal Incentive Policies
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省启动2026-2028年财政专项激励政策，每年安排15亿元支持18个县市区，旨在推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合，构建现代化产业体系。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang Province has launched a new round of special fiscal incentive policies for 2026-2028, allocating 1.5 billion yuan annually to 18 districts and cities to integrate technological and industrial innovation.

articles.title_zh: 广西从严审核审批“一把手”从出生地、成长地、工作地调人
articles.title_en: Guangxi Strictly Reviews Transfers of Top Officials from Birthplaces, Growth Places, and Workplaces
articles.summary_zh: 广西自治区通过完善配套机制和构建重点工作机制，从严审核审批“一把手”调任，并强化公务员回避与转任管理，防范政商“旋转门”。
articles.summary_en: Guangxi Autonomous Region has implemented strict review and approval mechanisms for the transfer of top officials and enhanced the management of civil servant recusal and rotation to prevent the "revolving door" between government and business.

articles.title_zh: 驻美大使谢锋邀请“赛考斯”再访华并颁发签证
articles.title_en: Chinese Ambassador to US Xie Feng Invites Mr. Sykes to Visit China Again and Issues Visa
articles.summary_zh: 6月19日，中国驻美大使谢锋邀请美国友人到使馆做客，强调中美人民友好交往的重要性，并邀请“赛考斯”先生再次访华并为其颁发签证。
articles.summary_en: On June 19, Chinese Ambassador to the US Xie Feng hosted American friends at the embassy, emphasizing the importance of people-to-people ties and issuing a visa to Mr. Sykes for his return visit to China.

articles.title_zh: 朱昌杰被查
articles.title_en: Zhu Changjie Placed Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 原新疆维吾尔自治区人民政府副主席朱昌杰因涉嫌违纪违法被调查。
articles.summary_en: Zhu Changjie, former Vice Chairman of the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region Government, has been placed under investigation for suspected violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 新疆维吾尔自治区政府原副主席朱昌杰被查
articles.title_en: Former Vice Chairman of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region Government Zhu Changjie Investigated
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月20日，中国官方通报新疆维吾尔自治区政府原副主席朱昌杰涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受中央纪委国家监委调查。
articles.summary_en: On June 20, 2026, Chinese authorities announced that Zhu Changjie, former Vice Chairman of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region government, is under investigation by the CCDI and NSC for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 中欧班列年开行量十年间增长10.8倍
articles.title_en: China-Europe Railway Express Annual Volume Grows 10.8-Fold Over a Decade
articles.summary_zh: 国铁集团数据显示，中欧班列自2016年启用统一品牌以来，年开行量十年间增长10.8倍，截至2026年6月10日，今年累计开行已突破万列。
articles.summary_en: China Railway reports that the annual volume of the China-Europe Railway Express has increased 10.8-fold since 2016, exceeding 10,000 trains by June 10, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 前5月消费品以旧换新资金惠及超1.1亿人次
articles.title_en: Consumer Goods Trade-in Funds Benefit Over 110 Million People in First Five Months
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委通报，今年前5月“两新”政策持续发力，消费品以旧换新资金惠及超1.1亿人次，设备更新资金支持1.1万多个项目。
articles.summary_en: The NDRC reported that the 'Two News' policy has benefited over 110 million people through consumer goods trade-ins and supported over 11,000 equipment renewal projects in the first five months.

articles.title_zh: 外资机构：越来越开放的中国市场 越来越有吸引力
articles.title_en: Foreign Institutions: Increasingly Open Chinese Market Becomes More Attractive
articles.summary_zh: 陆家嘴论坛推出一系列金融开放和改革举措，包括上海离岸金融行动方案，旨在扩大高水平金融对外开放，增强外资企业信心。
articles.summary_en: The Lujiazui Forum introduced financial opening-up and reform measures, including the Shanghai offshore finance action plan, to expand high-level financial openness and boost foreign investor confidence.

articles.title_zh: 我国科技创新和产业创新融合发展步伐加快
articles.title_en: China Accelerates Integration of Scientific and Technological Innovation with Industrial Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 我国持续推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合，工信部发布重点培育中试平台，中央企业成立科技成果产业化联合体，以新质生产力支撑高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: China is accelerating the integration of sci-tech and industrial innovation, with MIIT launching pilot platforms and central enterprises forming an industrialization consortium to boost high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 内江举办“甜城下午茶”企业服务日活动
articles.title_en: Neijiang Holds 'Sweet City Afternoon Tea' Enterprise Service Day
articles.summary_zh: 6月17日，四川内江市举办第二期“甜城下午茶”企业服务日活动，市委书记冯发贵与企业家交流，现场解决企业诉求以优化营商环境。
articles.summary_en: On June 17, Neijiang, Sichuan held the second 'Sweet City Afternoon Tea' Enterprise Service Day. Municipal Party Secretary Feng Fagui met with entrepreneurs to resolve corporate grievances and optimize the business environment.

articles.title_zh: 广西从严审核审批“一把手”调任机制
articles.title_en: Guangxi Implements Strict Review Mechanism for Transfers of Top Officials
articles.summary_zh: 广西壮族自治区党委组织部通过建立从严审核审批“一把手”调任、回避事项审核及辞职从业限制等机制，防治“近亲繁殖”与政商“旋转门”不正之风。
articles.summary_en: The Organization Department of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Party Committee has established strict review mechanisms for the transfer of top officials and resignation procedures to prevent nepotism and "revolving door" practices.

articles.title_zh: 尹弘在上饶调研高标准农田建设突出问题整治工作

articles.title_en: Former PICC Vice President Yu Xiaoping Placed Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 6月13日，中国人民保险集团原党委委员、副总裁俞小平因涉嫌严重违纪违法，接受中央纪委国家监委的审查调查。
articles.summary_en: On June 13, Yu Xiaoping, former Party Committee member and Vice President of PICC, was placed under investigation by the CCDI and NSC for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 倪强涉嫌受贿被提起公诉
articles.title_en: Ni Qiang Indicted for Taking Huge Bribes
articles.summary_zh: 6月15日，柳州市人民检察院对海南省委原常委、秘书长倪强涉嫌受贿一案提起公诉，指控其利用职务之便非法收受巨额财物。
articles.summary_en: On June 15, the Liuzhou People's Procuratorate filed a public prosecution against Ni Qiang, former Standing Committee member and Secretary-General of the Hainan Provincial Party Committee, for taking huge bribes.

articles.title_zh: 李子柒出任上海第48届世界技能大赛推广大使
articles.title_en: Li Ziqi Appointed as Promotional Ambassador for the 48th WorldSkills Competition in Shanghai
articles.summary_zh: 上海世赛执行局与世界技能组织宣布，李子柒出任上海第48届世界技能大赛推广大使，旨在向世界讲述中国技能故事。
articles.summary_en: The Shanghai WorldSkills Competition Executive Bureau and WorldSkills Organization announced that Li Ziqi has been appointed as the promotional ambassador for the 48th WorldSkills Competition in Shanghai.

articles.title_zh: 前5个月铁路客货运量多项指标创新高
articles.title_en: Railway Passenger and Freight Transport Volumes Hit Record Highs in First Five Months
articles.summary_zh: 今年1至5月，全国铁路客货运量稳步增长，客流量和货运量多项指标创历史新高，有效服务旅游经济和重点物资运输。
articles.summary_en: From January to May, China's railway passenger and freight volumes grew steadily, with multiple indicators hitting record highs, supporting tourism and key material transport.

articles.title_zh: 去年全国活跃数据总量同比增28.46%
articles.title_en: China's National Active Data Volume Increased by 28.46% Year-on-Year Last Year
articles.summary_zh: 国家数据局披露2025年全国活跃数据总量达1.67泽字节，同比增长28.46%，且“数据要素×”三年行动计划提前完成场景打造目标。
articles.summary_en: The National Data Bureau reported that China's active data volume reached 1.67 zettabytes in 2025, up 28.46% YoY, with the 'Data Element ×' action plan achieving its goals ahead of schedule.

articles.title_zh: 张国清在青海调研盐湖产业发展与防灾减灾工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Guoqing Conducts Research on Salt Lake Industry and Disaster Prevention in Qinghai
articles.summary_zh: 国务院副总理张国清于6月12日至14日在青海省调研盐湖产业发展及防灾减灾工作，强调要高质量推进盐湖产业基地建设并提高自然灾害应对能力。
articles.summary_en: Vice Premier Zhang Guoqing visited Qinghai from June 12 to 14 to inspect salt lake industry development and disaster prevention, emphasizing high-quality industrial growth and enhanced disaster response capabilities.

articles.title_zh: 各地做好抢收抢种 筑牢丰收基础
articles.title_en: Various Regions Ensure Urgent Harvesting and Planting to Secure Bumper Harvest
articles.summary_zh: 全国各地正加紧抢收夏粮并做好秋粮抢种，通过推广智能农机作业，确保全年粮食丰产丰收。
articles.summary_en: Various regions across China are accelerating summer grain harvesting and autumn planting, utilizing smart agricultural machinery to ensure a bumper harvest for the year.

articles.title_zh: 1至5月份国家铁路发送货物16.7亿吨
articles.title_en: National Railways Transport 1.67 Billion Tons of Freight from January to May
articles.summary_zh: 1至5月国家铁路累计发送货物16.7亿吨，同比增长1.8%，其中新能源汽车出口和中欧（亚）班列增长显著。
articles.summary_en: From January to May, China's national railways transported 1.67 billion tons of freight, up 1.8% year-on-year, with significant growth in NEV exports and China-Europe/Asia trains.

articles.title_zh: 原航空工业洪都副总工程师、洪都商飞原董事长李代俊病逝
articles.title_en: Former Hongdu Aviation Deputy Chief Engineer and Hongdu Commercial Aircraft Chairman Li Daijun Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 原航空工业洪都副总工程师、洪都商飞原董事长李代俊于2026年6月14日病逝，享年61岁。
articles.summary_en: Li Daijun, former Deputy Chief Engineer of Aviation Industry Hongdu and former Chairman of Hongdu Commercial Aircraft, passed away on June 14, 2026, at the age of 61.

articles.title_zh: 隐功科技新型钠离子电池生产基地落子晋江
articles.title_en: Yingong Technology Establishes New Sodium-ion Battery Production Base in Jinjiang
articles.summary_zh: 近日，江苏隐功科技有限公司与福建芯创产业园区签署协议，在晋江建设总投资15亿元的新型钠离子电池生产基地。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Jiangsu Yingong Technology and Fujian Xinchuang Industrial Park signed an agreement to build a sodium-ion battery production base in Jinjiang with a total investment of 1.5 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 平凉市低空经济场景延伸项目落成发布
articles.title_en: Pingliang City Launches Low-Altitude Economy Scenario Extension Project
articles.summary_zh: 6月13日，平凉市低空经济场景延伸项目落成发布，扶摇低空经济产业园正式揭牌开园，旨在推动低空经济融入城市治理与公共服务。
articles.summary_en: On June 13, Pingliang City launched its Low-Altitude Economy Scenario Extension Project and unveiled the Fuyao Low-Altitude Economy Industrial Park to boost urban governance and public services.

articles.title_zh: 交通运输部启动强降雨三级防御响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Transport Activates Level III Emergency Response for Heavy Rainfall
articles.summary_zh: 6月13日，交通运输部针对中央气象台发布的暴雨黄色预警启动强降雨三级防御响应，并调度多地交通部门做好防汛救灾工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 13, the Ministry of Transport activated a Level III emergency response to heavy rainfall following a yellow rainstorm warning, coordinating flood prevention and disaster relief across multiple provinces.

articles.title_zh: 广西一批电网重点项目密集开工
articles.title_en: A Batch of Key Power Grid Projects Start Construction in Guangxi
articles.summary_zh: 6月11日前后，南方电网广西电网公司在贵港、梧州等地密集开工一批重点输变电项目，计划投资超180亿元以支持区域发展。
articles.summary_en: Around June 11, Southern Power Grid Guangxi Power Grid Company launched several key power transmission and transformation projects in Guigang and Wuzhou, with planned investments exceeding 18 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁省政府发布2026年度立法工作计划
articles.title_en: Liaoning Provincial Government Releases 2026 Annual Legislative Work Plan
articles.summary_zh: 辽宁省政府近日发布2026年度立法工作计划，拟审议无线电管理、文化保护及公共安全等领域的政府规章，为高质量发展提供法治保障。
articles.summary_en: The Liaoning Provincial Government recently released its 2026 annual legislative work plan, proposing regulations on radio management, cultural protection, and public safety to support high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 山西厚植文化资源优势推动文旅融合发展
articles.title_en: Shanxi Leverages Cultural Resource Advantages to Promote Integrated Culture and Tourism Development
articles.summary_zh: 山西省通过科学保护、数字赋能和全域联动，将深厚的历史文化资源转化为发展优势，推动文旅融合发展。
articles.summary_en: Shanxi Province is promoting the integrated development of culture and tourism by leveraging its historical and cultural resources through scientific protection and digital empowerment.

articles.title_zh: 健全养老服务体系 绘就银龄幸福画卷
articles.title_en: Improving the Elderly Care Service System to Enhance the Well-being of the Elderly
articles.summary_zh: 民政部聚焦“十五五”规划，通过优化养老服务供给、完善设施布局及发展银发经济，构建覆盖城乡的普惠养老服务体系。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Civil Affairs is focusing on the 15th Five-Year Plan to build a comprehensive and inclusive elderly care service system by optimizing supply, improving facilities, and developing the silver economy.

articles.title_zh: 第七届跨国公司领导人青岛峰会外宾陆续入境青岛
articles.title_en: Foreign Guests Arrive in Qingdao for the 7th Qingdao Summit for Leaders of Multinational Corporations
articles.summary_zh: 6月13日起，参加第七届跨国公司领导人青岛峰会的境外嘉宾陆续抵达青岛，青岛机场边检站通过设置专用通道等措施提供通关保障。
articles.summary_en: Starting June 13, foreign guests for the 7th Qingdao Summit for Leaders of Multinational Corporations began arriving in Qingdao, with the airport border inspection station providing specialized clearance services.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省发布2026年第3号总林长令
articles.title_en: Gansu Province Issues the 3rd Chief Forest Ranger Order of 2026
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省发布2026年第3号总林长令，印发《甘肃省林长巡林工作管理办法（试行）》，对各级林长巡林频次实行分级量化管理，以加强林草资源保护。
articles.summary_en: Gansu Province issued the 3rd Chief Forest Ranger Order of 2026 and the 'Forest Ranger Patrol Management Measures (Trial)' to implement quantified patrol frequencies for forest rangers at all levels to enhance forest and grassland protection.

articles.title_zh: 第10届南博会现场签约超257亿元能源项目
articles.title_en: 10th China-South Asia Expo Signs Energy Projects Worth Over 25.7 Billion Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 6月13日，第10届南博会绿色能源馆在昆明举行签约仪式，现场签约18个能源项目，总金额超257亿元，重点涵盖跨境能源合作。
articles.summary_en: On June 13, the 10th China-South Asia Expo held a signing ceremony in Kunming, securing 18 energy projects worth over 25.7 billion yuan, with a focus on cross-border energy cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 发力消费升级，青岛“双试点”奖补细则出台
articles.title_en: Qingdao Releases Reward and Subsidy Details for Dual Consumption Pilots
articles.summary_zh: 青岛市出台消费新业态新模式新场景及国际化消费环境建设两项国家试点的奖补细则，利用5亿元中央专项资金推动消费升级。
articles.summary_en: Qingdao has released reward and subsidy details for two national pilots on new consumption formats and international consumption environments, utilizing 500 million yuan in central funds to promote consumption upgrades.

articles.title_zh: 第10届中国—南亚博览会在云南昆明举行
articles.title_en: The 10th China-South Asia Expo Held in Kunming, Yunnan
articles.summary_zh: 6月11日至16日，第10届中国—南亚博览会在云南昆明举行，旨在深化中国与南亚国家的经贸合作，推动“一带一路”高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The 10th China-South Asia Expo was held in Kunming, Yunnan from June 11 to 16, aiming to deepen economic and trade cooperation between China and South Asian countries and promote the high-quality development of the Belt and Road Initiative.

articles.title_zh: 吴为山为湖南省领导授课
articles.title_en: Wu Weishan Delivers Lecture to Hunan Provincial Leaders
articles.summary_zh: 6月13日，著名雕塑家吴为山在湖南省委党校作题为“雕塑与文化”的专题讲座，省委书记沈晓明、省长毛伟明等参加。
articles.summary_en: On June 13, renowned sculptor Wu Weishan delivered a lecture titled 'Sculpture and Culture' at the Hunan Provincial Party School, attended by Provincial Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming and Governor Mao Weiming.

articles.title_zh: 俞小平涉嫌严重违纪违法被查
articles.title_en: Yu Xiaoping Investigated for Serious Violations of Discipline and Law
articles.summary_zh: 6月13日，中央纪委国家监委通报中国人民保险集团原党委委员、副总裁俞小平涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: On June 13, the CCDI and NSC announced that Yu Xiaoping, former Vice President of PICC, is under investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 美国防部将部分中企列入“中国军事企业清单” 商务部回应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Commerce Responds to US Department of Defense Adding Chinese Companies to 'Chinese Military Companies' List
articles.summary_zh: 6月13日，商务部就美国国防部将部分中国企业列入“中国军事企业清单”一事表示强烈不满和坚决反对，敦促美方立即撤销相关措施。
articles.summary_en: On June 13, China's Ministry of Commerce expressed strong dissatisfaction and opposition to the US Department of Defense adding several Chinese companies to the 'Chinese Military Companies' list, urging the US to revoke the measures.

articles.title_zh: 成都简阳一加工场所因在垂钓饵料中违法添加安定药物被查封
articles.title_en: Processing Site in Jianyang, Chengdu Shut Down for Illegally Adding Sedatives to Fishing Bait
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日，成都简阳市市场监管局等部门对一家在垂钓饵料中违法添加地西泮的加工场所进行查封，并对实控人秦某某采取刑事强制措施。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, authorities in Jianyang, Chengdu, shut down a processing site for illegally adding Diazepam to fishing bait and took criminal compulsory measures against the operator, Mr. Qin.

articles.title_zh: 11部门发文推动新能源重卡规模化应用
articles.title_en: 11 Departments Issue Document to Promote Large-scale Application of New Energy Heavy-duty Trucks
articles.summary_zh: 交通运输部等11部门联合发布《推动新能源重卡规模化应用实施方案》，目标到2030年新能源重卡渗透率达40%，旨在加快交通运输领域的绿色低碳转型。
articles.summary_en: Eleven departments, including the Ministry of Transport, issued a plan to promote new energy heavy-duty trucks, aiming for a 40% penetration rate by 2030 to accelerate green transformation in transport.

articles.title_zh: 中国藏语系高级佛学院2026年高级学衔班招生考试结束
articles.title_en: Entrance Exams for 2026 Advanced Degree Class of China Tibetan-language Advanced Buddhist College Conclude
articles.summary_zh: 中国藏语系高级佛学院2026年高级学衔班招生考试在西藏、四川、青海等地结束，共96名考僧参加，旨在培养藏传佛教僧才。
articles.summary_en: Entrance exams for the 2026 Advanced Degree Class of the China Tibetan-language Advanced Buddhist College concluded in Tibet, Sichuan, and Qinghai, with 96 monks participating.

articles.title_zh: 海外华文媒体与香港青年开启广西行
articles.title_en: Overseas Chinese Media and Hong Kong Youth Begin Visit to Guangxi
articles.summary_zh: 2026年海外华文媒体广西行及香港青年广西非遗创造营活动于6月12日在广西贺州市启动，由广西壮族自治区侨务办公室主办。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Overseas Chinese Media Guangxi Trip and Hong Kong Youth Guangxi Intangible Cultural Heritage Creation Camp launched in Hezhou, Guangxi on June 12, organized by the Guangxi Overseas Chinese Affairs Office.

articles.title_zh: 华南师范大学举办吴壮达教授学术思想研讨会促进两岸交流
articles.title_en: South China Normal University Holds Seminar on Professor Wu Zhuangda's Academic Thought to Promote Cross-Strait Exchange
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日，华南师范大学举办吴壮达教授学术思想研讨会暨学术人生专题展，通过展示其地理研究成果，促进两岸文化交流与台湾青年寻根。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, South China Normal University held a seminar and exhibition on Professor Wu Zhuangda's academic thought, promoting cross-strait cultural exchange and root-seeking for Taiwanese youth.

articles.title_zh: 最高人民法院推行“总对总”多元化纠纷解决机制
articles.title_en: Supreme People's Court Promotes "General-to-General" Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism
articles.summary_zh: 最高人民法院牵头建立“总对总”多元化纠纷解决机制，通过与各部委及社会组织协作，提升民商事纠纷化解效率，推进社会治理现代化。
articles.summary_en: The Supreme People's Court has established a "General-to-General" diversified dispute resolution mechanism to improve the efficiency of settling civil and commercial disputes through collaboration with ministries and social organizations.

articles.title_zh: 1至5月全国铁路发送旅客19.69亿人次
articles.title_en: National Railways Transport 1.969 Billion Passengers from January to May
articles.summary_zh: 1至5月全国铁路发送旅客19.69亿人次，多项客运指标创新高，跨境客运及旅游专列规模显著增长。
articles.summary_en: National railways transported 1.969 billion passengers from January to May, with record-high passenger indicators and significant growth in cross-border and tourism rail services.

articles.title_zh: 张凌赫在第十八届海峡论坛呼吁两岸同胞加强交流
articles.title_en: Zhang Linghe Calls for Enhanced Cross-Strait Exchanges at 18th Straits Forum
articles.summary_zh: 6月13日，演员张凌赫在厦门举行的第十八届海峡论坛上发表演讲，呼吁更多台湾同胞来大陆交流，增进两岸心灵契合。
articles.summary_en: On June 13, actor Zhang Linghe delivered a speech at the 18th Straits Forum in Xiamen, calling for more exchanges between Taiwan compatriots and the mainland to enhance mutual understanding.

articles.title_zh: 北斗导航播种、无人机巡田 农田新质生产力跑出三夏“加速度”
articles.title_en: Beidou Navigation and Drones Drive 'New Quality Productive Forces' in Summer Farming
articles.summary_zh: 农业农村部通报小麦机收进度，山东、江西、广东等地通过推广北斗导航和无人机等智慧农业技术，提升三夏生产效率。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs reports wheat harvest progress, with Shandong, Jiangxi, and Guangdong adopting Beidou navigation and drones to boost summer farming efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 跨越时空的井冈山精神照亮革命老区高质量发展新路
articles.title_en: Jinggangshan Spirit Guides High-Quality Development of Revolutionary Old Areas
articles.summary_zh: 报道讲述了江西省如何弘扬井冈山精神，通过乡村振兴、对外开放和产业升级推动革命老区高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The report describes how Jiangxi Province promotes high-quality development in revolutionary old areas by upholding the Jinggangshan Spirit through rural revitalization, opening-up, and industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 全国小麦收获过八成 夏播进入高峰
articles.title_en: Over 80% of Wheat Harvested Nationwide as Summer Sowing Reaches Peak
articles.summary_zh: 农业农村部6月12日数据显示，全国小麦收获进度已过八成，夏播粮食进度近半，智能农机在主产区得到广泛应用。
articles.summary_en: According to the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs on June 12, over 80% of wheat has been harvested nationwide and summer sowing is nearly halfway complete, with smart machinery widely applied.

articles.title_zh: “革命之路·友谊之桥”主题活动在桂林学院举办
articles.title_en: "Revolutionary Road · Bridge of Friendship" Theme Activity Held at Guilin University
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月12日，“革命之路·友谊之桥”主题活动在桂林学院举办，通过专题展等形式传承红色历史，赓续中越革命情谊。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, 2026, the "Revolutionary Road · Bridge of Friendship" theme activity was held at Guilin University to inherit red revolutionary history and strengthen China-Vietnam friendship.

articles.title_zh: 济南举行2026届大学生毕业典礼 诚邀学子留济筑梦
articles.title_en: Jinan Holds 2026 College Graduation Ceremony to Attract Young Talents
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月12日，济南市举行大学生毕业典礼，市委书记刘强出席并致辞，强调将通过完善人才政策吸引高校毕业生留济创业就业。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, 2026, Jinan held a graduation ceremony for college students. Municipal Party Secretary Liu Qiang attended and emphasized the city's efforts to attract graduates through improved talent policies.

articles.title_zh: 三场妇女发展援外培训在广东结业
articles.title_en: Three Foreign Aid Training Programs for Women's Development Conclude in Guangdong
articles.summary_zh: 6月13日，由广东省妇联等组织的三场针对发展中国家女性的援外培训班在广东结业，涵盖人工智能、改革开放及数字创业等主题。
articles.summary_en: On June 13, three foreign aid training programs for women from developing countries, focusing on AI, reform and opening-up, and digital entrepreneurship, concluded in Guangdong.

articles.title_zh: 四川、陕西、甘肃三省高质量推进大熊猫国家公园建设
articles.title_en: Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Gansu Provinces Advance High-Quality Construction of Giant Panda National Park
articles.summary_zh: 四川、陕西、甘肃三省通过高质量建设大熊猫国家公园，在生态保护、绿色发展和民生改善方面取得显著成效，践行“两山”理念。
articles.summary_en: Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Gansu provinces have achieved significant progress in ecological protection, green development, and livelihood improvement through the high-quality construction of the Giant Panda National Park.

articles.title_zh: 赵乐际同新加坡国会议长谢健平会谈
articles.title_en: Zhao Leji Holds Talks with Singaporean Speaker of Parliament Seah Kian Peng
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月12日，全国人大常委会委员长赵乐际在北京同新加坡国会议长谢健平举行会谈，探讨深化中新全方位高质量前瞻性伙伴关系及立法机构合作。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, 2026, Zhao Leji, Chairman of the NPC Standing Committee, held talks with Seah Kian Peng, Speaker of the Parliament of Singapore, in Beijing to deepen the all-round high-quality future-oriented partnership and legislative cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 前4月全国新改建农村公路1.6万公里
articles.title_en: 16,000 km of Rural Roads Newly Built or Renovated Nationwide in First Four Months
articles.summary_zh: 交通运输部数据显示，2026年前4月全国新改建农村公路1.6万公里，固定资产投资821.1亿元，并实施养护工程2.6万公里。
articles.summary_en: According to the Ministry of Transport, 16,000 km of rural roads were newly built or renovated in China during the first four months of 2026, with fixed asset investment reaching 82.11 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 聚力保障“三夏”抢收
articles.title_en: Joint Efforts to Ensure Summer Grain Harvest
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月，农业农村部联合交通、气象、石油石化等部门，通过优化农机通行、气象预警和油料供应，保障全国夏粮抢收工作。
articles.summary_en: In June 2026, the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs coordinated with transport, meteorology, and oil sectors to ensure the national summer grain harvest through optimized machinery transport, weather warnings, and fuel supply.

articles.title_zh: 韩正会见新加坡国会议长谢健平
articles.title_en: Han Zheng Meets Singaporean Speaker of Parliament Chia Jun Lai
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月12日，国家副主席韩正在北京会见新加坡国会议长谢健平，双方探讨加强中新战略沟通与高质量合作。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, 2026, Vice President Han Zheng met with Singaporean Speaker of Parliament Chia Jun Lai in Beijing to discuss strengthening strategic communication and high-quality cooperation between China and Singapore.

articles.title_zh: 江西吉安推动制造业数智化转型
articles.title_en: Ji'an, Jiangxi Promotes Digital and Intelligent Transformation of Manufacturing Industry
articles.summary_zh: 江西吉安市通过培育标杆企业和构建“产业大脑”，系统推动电子信息等制造业的数智化转型，提升产业竞争力。
articles.summary_en: Ji'an City in Jiangxi Province is systematically promoting the digital and intelligent transformation of its manufacturing industry, particularly in electronic information, to enhance industrial competitiveness.

articles.title_zh: 科研成果从实验室加速迈向生产线
articles.title_en: Research Achievements Accelerate Transition from Laboratories to Production Lines
articles.summary_zh: 粤港澳大湾区深化产学研创新协同，通过优化跨境要素流动和打造高水平科创平台，加速科技成果转化，建设国际科技创新中心。
articles.summary_en: The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area is deepening industry-university-research synergy to accelerate the transformation of scientific achievements and build an international innovation center.

articles.title_zh: 2026全球青年发展项目周在上海启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Global Youth Development Project Week Launches in Shanghai
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月12日，2026全球青年发展项目周启动仪式在上海临港举行，来自70多个国家的230余名青年代表参加。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Global Youth Development Project Week launched in Lingang, Shanghai on June 12, 2026, with over 230 youth representatives from more than 70 countries attending.

articles.title_zh: 朝鲜媒体高度评价习近平总书记国事访问重大意义
articles.title_en: North Korean Media Highly Praise Significance of General Secretary Xi Jinping's State Visit
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日至9日，习近平总书记应金正恩邀请对朝鲜进行国事访问，朝鲜媒体对此访在深化朝中友好关系方面的重大意义给予高度评价。
articles.summary_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping paid a state visit to North Korea from June 8 to 9 at the invitation of Kim Jong Un, with North Korean media highly praising the visit's significance in deepening bilateral relations.

articles.title_zh: 前5月我国机电产品出口占整体出口比重超六成
articles.title_en: Mechanical and Electrical Product Exports Account for Over 60% of China's Total Exports in First Five Months
articles.summary_zh: 商务部数据显示，今年1-5月我国机电产品出口增长18.4%，占整体出口比重超六成，外贸整体呈现稳中有进态势。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce reports that China's mechanical and electrical product exports grew by 18.4% in the first five months of the year, accounting for over 60% of total exports.

articles.title_zh: 我国世界自然遗产保护状况持续提升
articles.title_en: China's World Natural Heritage Protection Status Continues to Improve
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月13日，国家林草局表示我国世界自然遗产保护状况持续提升，90%的遗产地综合评估为优良，总数居世界首位。
articles.summary_en: On June 13, 2026, the National Forestry and Grassland Administration reported that China's World Natural Heritage protection status continues to improve, with 90% of sites rated as excellent.

articles.title_zh: 1至5月全国铁路发送旅客超19亿人次
articles.title_en: National Railway Passenger Volume Exceeds 1.9 Billion from January to May
articles.summary_zh: 1至5月，全国铁路发送旅客19.69亿人次，同比增长5.7%，创历史同期新高，跨境客运及外籍旅客出行显著增长。
articles.summary_en: From January to May, China's national railway transported 1.969 billion passengers, a 5.7% year-on-year increase, marking a record high for the period.

articles.title_zh: 我国海洋生态保护修复取得新成效
articles.title_en: China Achieves New Progress in Marine Ecological Protection and Restoration
articles.summary_zh: 我国通过排污管控、产业升级和生态修复，在海口湾、厦门及大鹏湾等地取得显著成效，多个海湾实现水质优良。
articles.summary_en: China has achieved significant results in marine ecological protection and restoration through pollution control and industrial upgrading, improving water quality in numerous bays.

articles.title_zh: 蒙古国总统呼日勒苏赫会见王毅
articles.title_en: Mongolian President Khurelsukh Meets Wang Yi
articles.summary_zh: 6月13日，蒙古国总统呼日勒苏赫在乌兰巴托会见中国外交部长王毅，双方探讨深化中蒙全面战略伙伴关系及共建命运共同体。
articles.summary_en: On June 13, Mongolian President Khurelsukh met with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi in Ulaanbaatar to discuss deepening the China-Mongolia comprehensive strategic partnership and building a community with a shared future.

articles.title_zh: 在北京海淀，看见AI的千万种可能
articles.title_en: Exploring the Endless Possibilities of AI in Haidian, Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 北京海淀中关村AI北纬社区推出“人工智能OPC服务计划”及加速营，为AI“一人公司”提供算力、空间等全链条支持，促进AI创业落地。
articles.summary_en: The Zhongguancun AI North Latitude Community in Haidian, Beijing, launched the "AI OPC Service Plan" and acceleration camps to provide comprehensive support, including computing power and office space, for AI "One Person Companies."

articles.title_zh: 北京四环丰台段主路大修工程开工
articles.title_en: Overhaul Project for Fengtai Section of Beijing's Fourth Ring Road Begins
articles.summary_zh: 北京市交通委宣布四环丰台段主路提升工程于6月12日开工，预计10月竣工，旨在通过城市更新提升道路安全、景观及智慧交通水平。
articles.summary_en: The Beijing Municipal Commission of Transport announced the start of the Fourth Ring Road Fengtai section overhaul on June 12, expected to be completed by October to improve road safety, landscape, and smart traffic systems.

articles.title_zh: 水利部针对7省份启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Launches Level IV Emergency Response for Flood Defense in Seven Provinces
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日20时，水利部针对浙江、福建、江西、湖南、广东、广西、贵州7省份启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，以应对强降雨带来的洪水风险。
articles.summary_en: At 20:00 on June 12, the Ministry of Water Resources launched a Level IV emergency response for flood defense in seven provinces to mitigate risks from heavy rainfall.

articles.title_zh: 省航天领导小组会议部署商业航天高质量发展
articles.title_en: Provincial Aerospace Leadership Group Meeting Deploys High-Quality Development of Commercial Aerospace
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日，省航天领导小组会议在海口召开，由省长刘小明主持，研究部署商业航天高质量发展与高水平安全等重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, the Provincial Aerospace Leadership Group meeting was held in Haikou, chaired by Governor Liu Xiaoming, to deploy key tasks for the high-quality development and security of commercial aerospace.

articles.title_zh: 省政府召开专题会议研究推动海南低空经济高质量发展工作
articles.title_en: Hainan Provincial Government Holds Special Meeting on High-Quality Development of Low-Altitude Economy
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日，海南省长刘小明主持召开专题会议，研究推动海南低空经济高质量发展，强调要优化体制机制、强化政策保障并守牢安全底线。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, Governor Liu Xiaoming chaired a special meeting to promote the high-quality development of Hainan's low-altitude economy, emphasizing mechanism optimization, policy support, and safety supervision.

articles.title_zh: 全国人大常委会职业教育法执法检查组在江苏开展检查
articles.title_en: NPC Standing Committee Inspection Group Conducts Vocational Education Law Review in Jiangsu
articles.summary_zh: 6月10日至12日，全国人大常委会副委员长丁仲礼率执法检查组在江苏开展职业教育法执法检查，强调建设现代职业教育体系。
articles.summary_en: From June 10 to 12, Ding Zhongli, Vice Chairperson of the NPC Standing Committee, led an inspection group to Jiangsu to review the implementation of the Vocational Education Law.

articles.title_zh: 西太湖（常州）先进存储产业园揭牌
articles.title_en: West Taihu (Changzhou) Advanced Storage Industrial Park Unveiled
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月12日，常州举行AI存储产业发展大会，西太湖（常州）先进存储产业园及新型存储介质创新中心正式揭牌。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, 2026, Changzhou held the AI Storage Industry Development Conference, where the West Taihu (Changzhou) Advanced Storage Industrial Park and New Storage Medium Innovation Center were unveiled.

articles.title_zh: 江西省委常委会召开会议研究贯彻落实习近平总书记重要讲话精神

articles.summary_en: On June 12, Yin Hong, Secretary of the Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee, chaired a meeting to study General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent instructions and review measures to improve the province's service industry.

articles.title_zh: 江西省政协十三届常委会第十六次会议闭幕
articles.title_en: The 16th Meeting of the 13th Standing Committee of the Jiangxi Provincial Committee of the CPPCC Concludes
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日，江西省政协十三届常委会第十六次会议在南昌闭幕。会议围绕推动省属国有企业做强做优做大进行协商议政，并审议通过提案工作条例（修订）及人事事项。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, the 16th meeting of the 13th Standing Committee of the Jiangxi Provincial Committee of the CPPCC concluded in Nanchang, focusing on strengthening provincial state-owned enterprises and approving revised proposal regulations.

articles.summary_en: On June 12, the Autonomous Region CPPCC held its 79th Chairman's Meeting chaired by Zhang Yankun to approve the Standing Committee's agenda and personnel matters, and plan a consultation on the biopharmaceutical industry in Hohhot.

articles.summary_en: Inner Mongolia's first AI steelmaking project, 'Baogang Zhiye,' has been deployed at Baogang Shares, transitioning from manual judgment to data-driven autonomous control to improve efficiency and reduce carbon emissions.
