articles.title_en: Launch of 'Buy in China · Shaanxi Bright Life' Consumption Promotion Activity
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日，由陕西省商务厅等部门主办的“购在中国·陕亮生活”消费促进活动在西安启动，旨在通过补贴和促销推动商品消费扩容升级。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, the 'Buy in China · Shaanxi Bright Life' consumption promotion activity was launched in Xi'an by the Shaanxi Provincial Department of Commerce and other agencies to boost commodity consumption.

articles.title_zh: 陕西首条二氧化碳长输管道开工建设
articles.title_en: Construction Begins on Shaanxi's First Long-Distance CO2 Pipeline
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日，陕西省榆林市靖边县首条二氧化碳长输管道开工建设。该项目由延长石油集团投资，旨在通过CCUS技术实现减排并提高油田采收率。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, construction began on Shaanxi's first long-distance CO2 pipeline in Jingbian, Yulin. Invested by Yanchang Petroleum Group, the project utilizes CCUS technology to reduce emissions and enhance oil recovery.

articles.title_zh: 国家防总针对7省份启动防汛四级应急响应
articles.title_en: National Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters Launches Level-IV Emergency Response for Seven Provinces
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月12日，国家防总针对广东、广西等7省份启动防汛四级应急响应，并部署重点部位度汛隐患排查工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, 2026, the National Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters launched a level-IV emergency response for seven provinces to deploy flood control and disaster relief efforts.

articles.title_zh: 2026北京智源大会开幕 殷勇出席并致辞
articles.title_en: 2026 Beijing BAAI Conference Opens with Speech by Yin Yong
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月12日，2026北京智源大会在中关村国际创新中心开幕，北京市市长殷勇出席并致辞，强调将人工智能打造为万亿级产业集群。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, 2026, the 2026 Beijing BAAI Conference opened at the Zhongguancun International Innovation Center. Mayor Yin Yong attended and delivered a speech on developing AI into a trillion-yuan industry cluster.

articles.title_zh: 续写中朝传统友谊崭新篇章——习近平总书记访问朝鲜纪实
articles.title_en: Writing a New Chapter of Traditional China-DPRK Friendship: A Record of General Secretary Xi Jinping's Visit to North Korea
articles.summary_zh: 中央广播电视总台推出时政纪录片，全景记录习近平总书记访问朝鲜的行程及中朝两国最高领导人的会晤。
articles.summary_en: China Media Group released a political documentary providing a comprehensive record of General Secretary Xi Jinping's visit to North Korea and the meetings between the two nations' leaders.

articles.title_zh: 探访具身智能机器人数据与训练基地
articles.title_en: Visiting the Embodied Intelligent Robot Data and Training Base
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日，北京人形机器人创新中心具身智能机器人数据与训练基地展示了其在多场景下的机器人训练能力及开源数据集。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, the Embodied Intelligent Robot Data and Training Base of the Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center showcased its robot training capabilities across multiple scenarios and its open-source dataset.

articles.title_zh: 六届市委第六轮巡视公布市水利局等5个市级单位党组织巡视整改进展情况
articles.title_en: The 6th Municipal Committee Announces Inspection Rectification Progress of Five Municipal Units Including Water Resources Bureau
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日，重庆市委公布了市水利局、市文化旅游委等5个市级单位党组织第六轮巡视整改进展情况。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, the Chongqing Municipal Committee announced the progress of the sixth round of inspection rectification for five municipal units, including the Water Resources Bureau and the Culture and Tourism Commission.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会举行扩大会议研究部署打造内陆开放综合枢纽等工作
articles.title_en: Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Expanded Meeting to Deploy Construction of Inland Open Comprehensive Hub
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日下午，重庆市委书记袁家军主持召开市委常委会扩大会议，审议“十五五”打造内陆开放综合枢纽及现代综合交通运输体系和物流发展规划。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Secretary Yuan Jiajun chaired an expanded meeting to review the 15th Five-Year Plans for building an inland open comprehensive hub and modern transportation and logistics systems.

articles.title_zh: 第三十二届兰洽会促消费活动七月启动
articles.title_en: Consumption Promotion Activities for the 32nd Lanzhou Investment and Trade Fair to Start in July
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省商务厅发布方案，将于7月1日至30日在兰州及全省范围内启动第三十二届兰洽会促消费活动，通过多种惠民举措释放消费活力。
articles.summary_en: The Gansu Provincial Department of Commerce announced that consumption promotion activities for the 32nd Lanzhou Investment and Trade Fair will run from July 1 to 30 across Gansu Province to stimulate consumption.

articles.title_zh: 中央安全生产考核巡查组第三组在广西开展明查暗访
articles.title_en: Central Work Safety Assessment and Inspection Group 3 Conducts Inspections in Guangxi
articles.summary_zh: 6月11日，中央安全生产考核巡查组第三组进驻见面会在南宁召开，该组将于6月11日至25日对广西开展安全生产明查暗访。
articles.summary_en: On June 11, a meeting was held in Nanning for the arrival of the Central Work Safety Assessment and Inspection Group 3, which will conduct safety inspections in Guangxi from June 11 to 25.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚到贵港桂平市检查调研防汛度汛工作
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Inspects Flood Control and Prevention Work in Guiping, Guigang
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日，自治区党委书记陈刚在贵港桂平市调研防汛度汛工作，要求压实责任、强化预警，全力保障人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, Chen Gang, Secretary of the Autonomous Region Party Committee, inspected flood control work in Guiping, Guigang, emphasizing responsibility and early warning to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 河南省委常委会召开会议 刘宁主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Henan Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting Chaired by Liu Ning
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日，河南省委书记刘宁主持召开省委常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，部署全面从严治党及政法队伍建设工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, Liu Ning, Secretary of the Henan Provincial Party Committee, chaired a meeting to study General Secretary Xi Jinping's speeches and deploy work on strict Party governance and political-legal team building.

articles.title_zh: 河南省首次发布低空经济活跃度指数
articles.title_en: Henan Province Releases First Low-Altitude Economy Activity Index
articles.summary_zh: 6月11日，河南省在郑州举行研讨会并首次发布低空经济活跃度指数，旨在为全省低空产业升级和布局提供数据支撑。
articles.summary_en: On June 11, Henan Province released its first low-altitude economy activity index at a seminar in Zhengzhou to provide data support for industrial upgrading and layout.

tags_zh: 郑州航空工业管理学院

articles.title_zh: 省委组织领导干部集中观看沉浸式党性教育课程《您好，焦裕禄》
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Committee Leadership Watches Immersive Party Education Course 'Hello, Jiao Yulu'
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日，河南省委书记刘宁、省长王凯等领导在省委党校观看党性教育课程《您好，焦裕禄》，旨在引导党员干部践行正确政绩观。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, Henan Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning and Governor Wang Kai attended an immersive party education course 'Hello, Jiao Yulu' at the Provincial Party School to promote the correct view of political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 水利部对七省份启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Launches Level IV Emergency Response for Flood Defense in Seven Provinces
articles.summary_zh: 水利部5月19日对江西、湖北、湖南、广东、广西、贵州、海南等七省份启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，以应对持续强降雨。
articles.summary_en: On May 19, the Ministry of Water Resources launched a Level IV emergency response for flood defense in seven provinces to cope with continuous heavy rainfall.

articles.title_zh: 长沙市召开领导干部会议宣布有关人事安排决定
articles.title_en: Changsha Holds Leading Cadres Meeting to Announce Personnel Appointments
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日，湖南省委书记沈晓明出席长沙市领导干部会议，宣布陈竞任中共长沙市委书记，吴桂英不再担任该职。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, Hunan Provincial Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming attended a leading cadres meeting in Changsha to announce the appointment of Chen Jing as the Secretary of the Changsha Municipal Party Committee.

articles.title_zh: 长春光博会开幕 中国光电城发展规划发布
articles.title_en: Changchun Optoelectronics Expo Opens and China Optoelectronics City Development Plan Released
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日，第三届长春国际光电博览会开幕，长春市同步发布中国光电城发展规划，旨在打造世界级光电信息产业高地。
articles.summary_en: The 3rd Changchun International Optoelectronics Expo opened on June 12, with the release of the China Optoelectronics City development plan to build a world-class optoelectronic information industry hub.

articles.title_zh: 南京市国土空间近期实施规划公示 力争2030年常住人口超千万
articles.title_en: Nanjing Publicizes Territorial Space Implementation Plan Aiming for Over 10 Million Residents by 2030
articles.summary_zh: 南京市规划部门于6月12日公示《南京市国土空间近期实施规划（2026～2030年）》，目标在2030年实现常住人口超千万并优化城市空间格局。
articles.summary_en: Nanjing's planning department publicized the Territorial Space Recent Implementation Plan (2026-2030) on June 12, aiming for a permanent population of over 10 million by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 九江“十五五”发展新蓝图发布
articles.title_en: Jiujiang Releases Development Blueprint for the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日，九江市召开新闻发布会解读《九江市国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划纲要》，明确到2030年地区生产总值突破5000亿元等目标。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, Jiujiang held a press conference to interpret its 15th Five-Year Plan, aiming for a GDP exceeding 500 billion yuan by 2030 and focusing on industrial growth.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁省下功夫优化营商环境
articles.title_en: Liaoning Province Strives to Optimize Business Environment
articles.summary_zh: 辽宁省通过纪检监督、政务服务变革及建立省级领导联系企业制度等举措，全面优化营商环境，旨在打造营商环境最佳口碑省。
articles.summary_en: Liaoning Province is comprehensively optimizing its business environment through disciplinary supervision, government service reforms, and a system for provincial leaders to contact enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 浙江省与清华大学签署新一轮战略合作协议
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Province and Tsinghua University Sign New Round of Strategic Cooperation Agreement
articles.summary_zh: 6月11日，浙江省与清华大学在北京签署新一轮战略合作协议，旨在深化教育科技人才一体改革，推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On June 11, Zhejiang Province and Tsinghua University signed a new strategic cooperation agreement in Beijing to deepen reforms in education, science, and talent, and promote the integration of technological and industrial innovation.

articles.title_zh: 陇东学院拟注销6名聘用人员事业编制
articles.title_en: Longdong University Proposes to Cancel Public Institution Status of Six Employees
articles.summary_zh: 陇东学院于6月13日发布公告，拟依法解除与6名擅自离校或未按期返校人员的聘用关系并注销其事业编制。
articles.summary_en: Longdong University announced on June 13 its proposal to terminate employment and cancel the public institution status of six employees who left without approval or failed to return from studies.

articles.title_zh: 才让太赴任西藏自治区党委统战部部长
articles.title_en: Tsering Tai Appointed Minister of the United Front Work Department of Tibet Autonomous Region Party Committee
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正调研统战部，信息显示才让太已任西藏自治区党委常委、统战部部长。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Region Party Committee, conducted research at the United Front Work Department, confirming Tsering Tai's appointment as the Minister of the department.

articles.title_zh: 长沙市领导干部会议召开
articles.title_en: Changsha Municipal Leading Cadres Meeting Convened
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日，长沙市领导干部会议召开，宣布陈竞任中共长沙市委书记，吴桂英不再担任该职。湖南省委书记沈晓明出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, a leading cadres meeting was held in Changsha to announce the appointment of Chen Jing as the Secretary of the Changsha Municipal Party Committee, succeeding Wu Guiying.

articles.title_zh: 长沙市委书记调整
articles.title_en: Adjustment of Changsha Municipal Party Committee Secretary
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日，长沙市召开领导干部会议，宣布陈竞任中共长沙市委书记，吴桂英不再担任该职。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, a leadership meeting in Changsha announced that Chen Jing has been appointed as the Secretary of the Changsha Municipal Party Committee, replacing Wu Guiying.

articles.summary_en: The report describes how Yan'an achieves high-quality development by leveraging the 'Yan'an Spirit' to promote red tourism, upgrade the apple industry, and improve public welfare.

articles.title_zh: 尼泊尔外交部长希西尔将访华
articles.title_en: Nepal's Foreign Minister Shishir to Visit China
articles.summary_zh: 中国外交部12日宣布，应王毅邀请，尼泊尔外交部长希西尔将于6月14日至17日访问中国，旨在深化两国务实合作并推动战略合作伙伴关系发展。
articles.summary_en: China's Foreign Ministry announced on June 12 that Nepal's Foreign Minister Shishir will visit China from June 14 to 17 at the invitation of Wang Yi to deepen bilateral cooperation and strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 公安部：我国电诈案件发案已连续8个月同比下降
articles.title_en: Ministry of Public Security: Telecom Fraud Cases in China Have Declined for Eight Consecutive Months
articles.summary_zh: 公安部于12日召开新闻发布会，通报我国电诈案件发案自2025年10月以来已连续8个月同比下降，并分析了高发诈骗类型及新特点。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Public Security announced at a press conference on the 12th that telecom fraud cases in China have decreased year-on-year for eight consecutive months since October 2025.

articles.title_zh: 四部门部署实施“创业模式引领行动”
articles.title_en: Four Departments Deploy Implementation of 'Entrepreneurship Model Leading Action'
articles.summary_zh: 人社部、发改委、工信部、农业农村部近日印发通知，部署实施“创业模式引领行动”，通过四大模式引导创业主体走特色发展道路。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security and three other departments issued a notice to implement the 'Entrepreneurship Model Leading Action' to guide diverse entrepreneurship through four specific models.

articles.title_en: Chairman of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Wei Tao Investigates Historical Land Exchange Disputes
articles.summary_zh: 6月12日，广西壮族自治区主席韦韬赴河池市大化县调研，重点解决地块置换历史积案，并强调要整治“新官不理旧账”问题，树立正确政绩观。
articles.summary_en: On June 12, Wei Tao, Chairman of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, visited Dahua County, Hechi, to address historical land exchange disputes and emphasize the rectification of "new officials ignoring old debts."

articles.summary_en: On June 12, the Cyberspace Administration of China released its first comprehensive annual report on personal information protection, summarizing 2025 achievements and outlining goals for 2026.

articles.title_en: Beijing Yizhuang Launches City's First 'Sandbox Approval' Plan for New Quality Productive Forces

articles.summary_en: Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area (Yizhuang) has launched the city's first 'sandbox approval' plan for new quality productive forces, piloting it in robot and digital human commercial performances to explore regulatory governance for new business models.

articles.title_zh: 门头沟区发布多项举措助力“人城产”共融共生

articles.title_zh: 脑机接口：为大脑和世界架一座“桥”

articles.summary_en: Beijing has released an action plan (2025-2030) for brain-computer interface (BCI) development, promoting clinical applications of systems like "Bei Nao No. 1" to achieve large-scale commercialization by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 2026年福建省适老化产品供需对接活动在厦门举办

articles.title_zh: 河北省民间投资持续发力平稳增长

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古自治区人民政府与中国石油化工集团签署全面深化战略合作协议

articles.summary_en: On June 10, Suining's Science and Technology and Data Bureaus issued an action plan to attract AI 'One-Person Companies' (OPC) through computing subsidies, financial support, and streamlined government services.

articles.title_zh: “免预约＋免到场”提升出口检查效率
articles.title_en: "No Appointment and No Presence" Mode Improves Export Inspection Efficiency
articles.summary_zh: 青岛海关所属黄岛海关首创试行“免预约+免到场”口岸检查作业模式，显著提升出口检查效率并降低企业物流成本。
articles.summary_en: Huangdao Customs in Qingdao pioneered a "No Appointment and No Presence" inspection mode, significantly improving export efficiency and reducing logistics costs for enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 山东济南：退役风机叶片“再生”记
articles.title_en: Shandong Explores the Regeneration and Recycling of Retired Wind Turbine Blades
articles.summary_zh: 中车山东风电有限公司将退役风机叶片转化为新型人工鱼礁，推动固废资源化利用，响应国家生态环境法典及山东省循环经济政策。
articles.summary_en: CRRC Shandong Wind Power Co., Ltd. converts retired wind turbine blades into artificial reefs, promoting waste resource utilization in line with China's Ecological Environment Code and Shandong's circular economy policies.

articles.summary_en: The Shandong Provincial Department of Human Resources and Social Security has proposed 126 candidates for State Council special allowances and 300 for provincial special allowances, which are currently under public notice.

articles.title_en: Shanghai International Carbon Expo Opens
articles.summary_zh: 2026上海国际碳中和技术、产品与成果博览会于6月10日在上海开幕，上海市长龚正、内蒙古主席包钢及中国气候变化事务特使刘振民出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Shanghai International Carbon Neutrality Technology, Products and Achievements Expo opened in Shanghai on June 10, featuring speeches by Mayor Gong Zheng, Chairman Bao Gang, and Special Envoy Liu Zhenmin.

articles.title_zh: 陈吉宁调研上海新一轮民心工程推进情况
articles.title_en: Chen Jining Inspects Progress of Shanghai's New Round of People's Livelihood Projects
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月10日，上海市委书记陈吉宁在静安区调研新一轮民心工程，强调要践行人民城市理念，推动旧住房改造及“一江一河”空间品质提升。
articles.summary_en: On June 10, 2026, Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Jining inspected the progress of the city's new round of people's livelihood projects in Jing'an District, emphasizing the 'People's City' concept and urban renewal.

articles.title_zh: 上海启动全国首个光计算重点实验室
articles.title_en: Shanghai Launches China's First Key Laboratory for Optical Computing
articles.summary_zh: 6月10日，我国首家光计算省部级重点实验室在上海启动，由上海交通大学牵头并联手曦智科技建设，旨在攻坚AI算力瓶颈。
articles.summary_en: On June 10, China's first provincial-level key laboratory for optical computing was launched in Shanghai, led by Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Xizhi Technology to address AI computing bottlenecks.

articles.title_zh: 浦东与阅文集团签约共建人工智能文创产业基地
articles.title_en: Pudong and China Literature Group Sign Agreement to Co-build AI Cultural and Creative Industry Base
articles.summary_zh: 浦东新区与阅文集团签约共建人工智能文创产业基地，旨在打造“AI+文创”产业出海支点，集聚AI技术与数字内容资源。
articles.summary_en: Pudong New Area and China Literature Group signed an agreement to co-build an AI cultural and creative industry base to support the global expansion of "AI+Cultural Creativity" industries.

articles.title_zh: 上海人工智能产业发展简报（2026年5月刊）
articles.title_en: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Industry Development Brief (May 2026)
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月，上海市全面实施“人工智能+”行动，发布人形机器人量化目标及算力补贴政策，旨在打造智能经济新形态并引领产业变革。
articles.summary_en: In May 2026, Shanghai fully implemented the 'AI+' action, announcing humanoid robot targets and computing subsidies to foster a new form of intelligent economy and lead industrial transformation.

articles.title_zh: 抓紧抓实“三夏”生产 为全年粮食丰收打下坚实基础
articles.title_en: Ensure "Three Summers" Production to Lay a Solid Foundation for Annual Grain Harvest
articles.summary_zh: 6月10日，陕西省委书记赵一德在渭南市调研“三夏”及夏粮收购工作，强调要科学组织抢收作业，确保夏粮颗粒归仓，保障全年粮食丰收。
articles.summary_en: On June 10, Zhao Yide, Secretary of the Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee, inspected "Three Summers" production and grain acquisition in Weinan to ensure a successful annual harvest.

articles.title_zh: 2025年《陕西省生态环境状况公报》发布
articles.title_en: Release of the 2025 Shaanxi Provincial Ecological Environment Status Bulletin
articles.summary_zh: 6月10日，陕西省生态环境厅发布2025年《陕西省生态环境状况公报》，披露全省大气、水、土壤等环境监测数据及生态保护成果。
articles.summary_en: On June 10, the Shaanxi Provincial Department of Ecology and Environment released the 2025 Ecological Environment Status Bulletin, disclosing monitoring data and achievements in air, water, and soil protection.

articles.title_zh: 西藏出台政策推动新就业群体有效参与基层治理
articles.title_en: Tibet Introduces Policies to Promote Participation of New Employment Groups in Primary-level Governance
articles.summary_zh: 西藏自治区党委社会工作部等部门近日出台举措，引导网络主播、配送员等新就业群体参与基层治理，旨在将职业优势转化为治理效能。
articles.summary_en: The Social Work Department of the Tibet Autonomous Region Party Committee and other departments issued measures to encourage new employment groups, such as delivery riders and streamers, to participate in primary-level governance.

articles.title_zh: 西藏大学获批人工智能等2个本科专业
articles.title_en: Tibet University Approved for Two New Undergraduate Majors Including AI
articles.summary_zh: 6月10日，教育部公布本科专业目录，西藏大学获批人工智能和新能源科学与工程两个本科专业，将于2026年秋季首次招生。
articles.summary_en: On June 10, the Ministry of Education announced the undergraduate major catalog, approving AI and New Energy Science and Engineering majors at Tibet University for 2026 autumn enrollment.

articles.title_zh: 2026年“服务消费季”活动在杭州启动
articles.title_en: 2026 'Service Consumption Season' Launched in Hangzhou
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月1日，2026年“服务消费季”活动在浙江杭州启动。商务部部长王文涛强调要通过技术创新和文化融合打造多元消费场景，以释放服务消费潜力。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 'Service Consumption Season' was launched in Hangzhou on June 1, 2026. Minister of Commerce Wang Wentao emphasized creating diverse consumption scenarios through technological innovation and cultural integration to unlock the potential of service consumption.

articles.title_zh: 王予波与出席南博会的国内嘉宾代表座谈
articles.title_en: Wang Yubo Holds Symposium with Domestic Guest Representatives Attending the South Asia Expo
articles.summary_zh: 6月10日，云南省长王予波在昆明与出席第10届南博会暨第30届昆交会的国内嘉宾代表座谈，探讨加强交流合作，助推共建“一带一路”。
articles.summary_en: On June 10, Yunnan Governor Wang Yubo held a symposium in Kunming with domestic guest representatives attending the 10th South Asia Expo and 30th Kunming Trade Fair to promote cooperation and the "Belt and Road" initiative.

articles.title_zh: 树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育继续派出的4个中央指导组完成进驻
articles.title_en: Four Additional Central Guidance Groups Complete Deployment for Education on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 6月10日，根据党中央统一部署，继续派出的4个中央指导组已完成对10个地方和单位的进驻工作，旨在推动树立和践行正确政绩观的学习教育。
articles.summary_en: On June 10, four additional central guidance groups completed their deployment to 10 regions and units to oversee the learning and education on establishing and practicing the correct view of political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 安徽推动金融资源精准配置水利建设
articles.title_en: Anhui Promotes Precise Allocation of Financial Resources for Water Conservancy Construction
articles.summary_zh: 6月11日，安徽省印发《金融支持水利高质量发展行动方案》，通过扩大信贷投放、推广权益抵质押融资等方式，推动金融资源精准配置到水利建设重点领域。
articles.summary_en: On June 11, Anhui Province issued an action plan to support the high-quality development of water conservancy by optimizing financial resource allocation and expanding credit for key water projects.

articles.title_zh: 安徽省实施中药“良方妙剂”工程 赋能中药名方转化
articles.title_en: Anhui Province Implements 'Good Prescriptions and Wonderful Medicines' Project to Empower Transformation of TCM Formulas
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，安徽省在合肥举行“良方妙剂”科研转化平台发布会，旨在通过搭建省级平台推动中药院内制剂向新药转化，防止名方失传。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, Anhui Province held a launch event for the 'Good Prescriptions and Wonderful Medicines' scientific transformation platform in Hefei to promote the conversion of hospital-internal TCM preparations into new drugs.

articles.title_zh: 省委理论学习中心组举行学习会议 梁言顺主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Liang Yanshun Presides over Provincial Party Committee Theoretical Learning Center Group Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 6月10日，安徽省委书记梁言顺主持省委理论学习中心组学习会议，强调要树立正确政绩观，坚持高质量发展，创造经得起检验的实绩。
articles.summary_en: On June 10, Anhui Provincial Party Secretary Liang Yanshun presided over a study meeting, emphasizing the establishment of a correct view of achievements and the pursuit of high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 一枚光谱芯片如何让水会“说话”
articles.title_en: How a Spectral Chip Makes Water 'Speak'
articles.summary_zh: 记者团调研北京海淀区AI原点社区，报道芯视界公司利用光谱芯片实现水质实时监测，展示北京通过建设人工智能创新街区推动产业发展的成效。
articles.summary_en: A research team visited the AI Origin Community in Beijing's Haidian District to report on Xinshijie's spectral chip technology for water monitoring and Beijing's efforts to foster AI innovation clusters.

articles.title_zh: 闽宁两省区立足各自优势推动协同发展
articles.title_en: Fujian and Ningxia Leverage Respective Advantages to Promote Synergistic Development
articles.summary_zh: 6月11日，国务院新闻办公室举行发布会介绍东西部协作成效，福建省农业农村厅厅长陈明旺介绍了闽宁两省区的产业协作模式。
articles.summary_en: On June 11, the State Council Information Office held a press conference on East-West collaboration, where Chen Mingwang of Fujian's Agriculture Department detailed industrial cooperation between Fujian and Ningxia.

articles.title_zh: 福建省一标准实施效果评估方法获全国推广
articles.title_en: Fujian Province's Standard Implementation Evaluation Method Promoted Nationwide
articles.summary_zh: 国家标准委等六部门推广一批标准实施效果评估方法，福建省标准化研究院研发的“综合指数评估法”及武夷红茶评估案例入选。
articles.summary_en: Six departments, including the National Standardization Administration, promoted several standard evaluation methods, including the 'Comprehensive Index Evaluation Method' developed by the Fujian Provincial Institute of Standardization.

articles.title_zh: 福建省出台高危险性体育赛事活动许可实施意见
articles.title_en: Fujian Province Issues Implementation Opinions on Permits for High-Risk Sports Events
articles.summary_zh: 福建省体育局印发实施意见，针对潜水、航空等高危险性体育赛事建立安全监管制度，自2026年5月29日起施行。
articles.summary_en: The Fujian Provincial Sports Bureau issued implementation opinions to establish a safety supervision system for high-risk sports events, effective May 29, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 5月我国新能源汽车产销量同比两位数增长
articles.title_en: China's New Energy Vehicle Production and Sales See Double-Digit Growth in May
articles.summary_zh: 中国汽车工业协会6月10日发布数据显示，2026年5月我国新能源汽车产销分别完成155.4万辆和149.6万辆，同比分别增长22.4%和14.4%。
articles.summary_en: Data released by the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers on June 10 shows that in May 2026, China's NEV production and sales grew by 22.4% and 14.4% year-on-year.

articles.title_zh: 百色芒果上市首日签约额突破1.3亿元
articles.title_en: Baise Mangoes' First Day of Market Launch Sees Contract Value Exceed 130 Million Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 6月10日，百色芒果上市首日签约额突破1.3亿元，百色市通过扩种提质和全产业链建设持续壮大芒果特色产业。
articles.summary_en: On June 10, the first day of Baise mangoes' market launch saw contract values exceed 130 million yuan, driven by the city's efforts to expand production and build a full industry chain.

articles.title_zh: 孔昌生在驻马店市调研
articles.title_en: Kong Changsheng Conducts Research in Zhumadian City
articles.summary_zh: 6月9日至10日，省政协主席孔昌生在驻马店市调研，强调要树立正确政绩观，推动政协工作提质增效，深化协商民主实践。
articles.summary_en: From June 9 to 10, Kong Changsheng, Chairman of the Provincial CPPCC, conducted research in Zhumadian City, emphasizing the need to establish a correct view of political achievements and enhance the efficiency of CPPCC work.

articles.title_zh: 王凯主持召开省规划委员会会议
articles.title_en: Wang Kai Chairs Provincial Planning Commission Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 6月10日，河南省省长王凯主持召开省规划委员会会议，审议郑开同城化发展规划及开封市历史文化名城保护规划等事项。
articles.summary_en: On June 10, Henan Governor Wang Kai chaired a Provincial Planning Commission meeting to deliberate on the Zhengzhou-Kaifeng integration plan and the protection plan for Kaifeng's historical and cultural city.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省开展在建公路水运工程暑期汛期安全检查
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Province Conducts Summer Flood Season Safety Inspections for Highway and Waterway Projects
articles.summary_zh: 近日，黑龙江省交通运输厅组织专项检查组，对全省在建公路水运工程开展暑期汛期安全生产督导检查，排查整治重大安全隐患。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Heilongjiang Provincial Department of Transport organized a special inspection team to conduct safety supervision and hazard rectification for under-construction highway and waterway projects during the summer flood season.

articles.title_zh: 许勤加强生态保护与安全生产督导检查
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Inspects Ecological Protection and Production Safety
articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江省委书记许勤日前赴双鸭山市督导检查生态环境保护和安全生产工作，强调要统筹发展与安全，保护黑土地并严防重特大事故。
articles.summary_en: Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, inspected ecological protection and production safety in Shuangyashan, emphasizing black soil conservation and the prevention of major accidents.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明赴益阳市调研
articles.title_en: Shen Xiaoming Conducts Research Tour in Yiyang City
articles.summary_zh: 6月10日，湖南省委书记沈晓明在益阳市调研，考察智能制造、农村供水及体教融合情况，强调在推动高质量发展中增进民生福祉。
articles.summary_en: On June 10, Hunan Provincial Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming visited Yiyang City to inspect smart manufacturing, rural water supply, and sports-education integration, emphasizing high-quality development and public welfare.

articles.title_zh: 全省安全生产视频会议暨省安委会2026年第二次全会召开
articles.title_en: Provincial Safety Production Video Conference and the Second Plenary Session of the Provincial Safety Committee Held
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月10日，湖南省长毛伟明主持召开全省安全生产视频会议暨省安委会第二次全会，部署安全生产整改、责任追究及防汛工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 10, 2026, Hunan Governor Mao Weiming chaired a provincial safety production video conference and the second plenary session of the Provincial Safety Committee to deploy safety rectification, accountability, and flood prevention efforts.

articles.title_zh: 九江市港口航运管理局一级调研员曹俊良接受纪律审查和监察调查
articles.title_en: Cao Junliang, First-level Researcher of Jiujiang Port and Shipping Administration, Undergoes Disciplinary Review and Supervisory Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 九江市港口航运管理局一级调研员曹俊良涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受九江市纪委监委纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: Cao Junliang, a first-level researcher at the Jiujiang Port and Shipping Administration, is under investigation by the Jiujiang Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervisory Commission for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 习近平与金正恩参谒中朝友谊塔
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Kim Jong Un Visit China-DPRK Friendship Tower
articles.summary_zh: 6月9日，中共中央总书记、国家主席习近平与朝鲜劳动党总书记、国务委员长金正恩在平壤参谒中朝友谊塔，强调要共同维护烈士纪念设施并传承中朝传统友谊。
articles.summary_en: On June 9, Chinese President Xi Jinping and DPRK leader Kim Jong Un visited the China-DPRK Friendship Tower in Pyongyang, emphasizing the maintenance of martyr memorials and the inheritance of traditional friendship.

articles.title_zh: 国务院新闻办举行“新征程上的奋斗者”中外记者见面会
articles.title_en: SCIO Holds Press Conference for "Strivers on the New Journey"
articles.summary_zh: 6月11日，国务院新闻办举行“新征程上的奋斗者”中外记者见面会，5位海关系统代表分享了新时代海关在智慧化改革、贸易便利化及国门安全方面的实践与创新。
articles.summary_en: On June 11, the State Council Information Office held a press conference for "Strivers on the New Journey," where five customs representatives shared experiences in smart reforms, trade facilitation, and national security.

articles.title_zh: 世界华人炎帝故里寻根节在湖北随州举行
articles.title_en: World Chinese Yan Emperor's Hometown Root-Seeking Festival Held in Suizhou, Hubei
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月11日，世界华人炎帝故里寻根节在湖北随州举行，海内外华人齐聚共拜炎帝神农，共溯文明根脉。
articles.summary_en: On June 11, 2026, the World Chinese Yan Emperor's Hometown Root-Seeking Festival was held in Suizhou, Hubei, where overseas Chinese gathered to honor the Yan Emperor and trace their cultural roots.

articles.title_zh: 水利部会商部署强降雨防范应对工作
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Deploys Response Measures for Heavy Rainfall
articles.summary_zh: 水利部于6月11日在北京举行防汛会商，部署应对未来几天我国南北方强降雨过程的防范工作。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Water Resources held a flood control consultation in Beijing on June 11 to deploy prevention and response measures for upcoming heavy rainfall across northern and southern China.

articles.title_zh: 国务院常务会议审议通过《教育发展“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: State Council Executive Meeting Deliberates and Adopts the 15th Five-Year Plan for Education Development
articles.summary_zh: 6月11日，国务院常务会议审议通过《教育发展“十五五”规划》，旨在坚持教育优先发展，推动教育强国建设迈上新台阶。
articles.summary_en: On June 11, the State Council executive meeting deliberated and adopted the 15th Five-Year Plan for Education Development to promote the construction of a leading nation in education.

articles.title_zh: 国新办发布会聚焦东西部协作三十年
articles.title_en: SCIO Press Conference Focuses on 30 Years of East-West Collaboration
articles.summary_zh: 国务院新闻办公室6月11日在北京举行发布会，回顾东西部协作30年成效，并部署常态化帮扶与乡村振兴工作。
articles.summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference in Beijing on June 11 to review 30 years of East-West Collaboration and deploy plans for normalized assistance and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 我国力争“十五五”时期建至少1.2万个便民生活圈
articles.title_en: China Aims to Build at Least 12,000 Convenient Living Circles During 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 商务部等8部门近日印发通知，推广第三批城市一刻钟便民生活圈试点经验并启动先行区申报，力争“十五五”期间建成至少1.2万个便民生活圈。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce and seven other departments issued a notice to promote 15-minute convenient living circle pilots and launch pioneer zone applications, aiming for 12,000 such circles by the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 国务院部署美丽中国建设工作
articles.title_en: State Council Deploys Work on Building a Beautiful China
articles.summary_zh: 6月11日，国务院常务会议审议通过《美丽中国建设“十五五”规划》，部署深入打好污染防治保卫战并积极应对气候变化。
articles.summary_en: On June 11, the State Council executive meeting reviewed and approved the '15th Five-Year Plan for Building a Beautiful China,' focusing on pollution control and climate change.

articles.title_zh: 三峡水运新通道工程正式开工建设
articles.title_en: Construction of Three Gorges Water Transport New Channel Project Officially Begins
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，三峡水运新通道工程正式开工，该工程是“十五五”期间首个开工的国家重大工程，旨在建成全球首个常态化万吨级内河通航枢纽。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, construction began on the Three Gorges water transport new channel, the first national major project of the 15th Five-Year Plan, aiming to create the world's first normalized 10,000-ton inland river navigation hub.

tags.name_en: Three Gorges Water Transport New Channel

tags_en: Three Gorges Water Transport New Channel

articles.title_zh: 太原发布告诫函整治“6·18”价格违法行为
articles.title_en: Taiyuan Issues Warning Letter to Crack Down on Price Violations During "6.18" Shopping Festival
articles.summary_zh: 6月9日，太原市市场监督管理局发布提醒告诫函，针对“6·18”期间的模糊标价、价格欺诈及低于成本销售等违法行为划红线。
articles.summary_en: On June 9, the Taiyuan Market Supervision Administration issued a warning letter to regulate price violations, including ambiguous pricing and price fraud, during the "6.18" shopping festival.

tags.name_zh: 太原市市场监督管理局

articles.title_zh: 陈敏尔调研红桥区强调推进站产城融合发展
articles.title_en: Chen Min'er Inspects Hongqiao District, Emphasizing Integrated Development of Stations, Industries, and Cities
articles.summary_zh: 6月10日，天津市委书记陈敏尔在红桥区调研，强调要深化站产城融合发展，因地制宜发展新质生产力，推动京津冀协同发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 10, Tianjin Party Secretary Chen Min'er inspected Hongqiao District, emphasizing the integrated development of stations, industries, and cities to foster new quality productive forces and Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei coordination.

articles.title_zh: 张工赴天津经开区调研
articles.title_en: Zhang Gong Conducts Research Tour in Tianjin Economic-Technological Development Area
articles.summary_zh: 6月10日，天津市市长张工赴天津经开区调研，强调要因地制宜培育壮大新质生产力，加快传统产业转型升级。
articles.summary_en: On June 10, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong visited the Tianjin Economic-Technological Development Area, emphasizing the cultivation of new quality productive forces and the acceleration of traditional industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 国家农业生物安全科学中心西北中心在疆启动运行
articles.title_en: Northwest Center of National Agricultural Biosafety Science Center Begins Operation in Xinjiang
articles.summary_zh: 6月7日，由中国农科院与昌吉回族自治州人民政府共建的国家农业生物安全科学中心西北中心在新疆启动运行，旨在筑牢国家生物安全屏障。
articles.summary_en: On June 7, the Northwest Center of the National Agricultural Biosafety Science Center, co-built by CAAS and the Changji Government, began operation in Xinjiang to strengthen national biosafety barriers.

articles.title_zh: 2026年环阿尔泰次区域国际合作会议在新疆阿勒泰举行
articles.title_en: 2026 Altai Sub-region International Cooperation Conference Held in Altay, Xinjiang
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月10日，环阿尔泰次区域国际合作会议在新疆阿勒泰举行。陈小江等出席，各国嘉宾探讨共建“一带一路”及区域合作，共签署100项协议。
articles.summary_en: On June 10, 2026, the Altai Sub-region International Cooperation Conference was held in Altay, Xinjiang. Leaders discussed the Belt and Road Initiative and regional cooperation, signing 100 agreements.

articles.title_zh: 云南省最大规模小水电智慧运维平台投运
articles.title_en: Yunnan's Largest Smart Operation and Maintenance Platform for Small Hydropower Plants Put into Operation
articles.summary_zh: 云南省建成投运规模最大的省级小水电智慧运维平台，实现对全省85座水电站的远程智能监控，旨在提升安全生产并降低运维成本。
articles.summary_en: Yunnan Province has launched its largest provincial smart O&M platform for small hydropower plants, enabling remote intelligent monitoring of 85 stations to enhance safety and reduce costs.

articles.title_zh: 云南省出台42条措施激发民间投资活力
articles.title_en: Yunnan Province Introduces 42 Measures to Stimulate Private Investment
articles.summary_zh: 云南省发展改革委等11部门近日出台42条具体措施，旨在拓宽投资领域、优化营商环境，推动民间资本在滇投资。
articles.summary_en: Eleven departments in Yunnan Province, including the Provincial Development and Reform Commission, issued 42 measures to broaden investment fields and optimize the business environment to stimulate private investment.

articles.title_zh: 2025年浙江省生态环境状况公报发布
articles.title_en: Release of the 2025 Zhejiang Provincial Ecological Environment Status Bulletin
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省近日发布2025年生态环境状况公报，地表水和近岸海域水质创历史最优，空气质量持续优化，并推进数智治理。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang Province released its 2025 Ecological Environment Status Bulletin, reporting record-high water quality in surface and coastal waters, improved air quality, and advancements in digital governance.

articles.title_zh: 公安部网安局发布侵犯公民个人信息违法犯罪典型案例
articles.title_en: Cybersecurity Bureau of Ministry of Public Security Releases Typical Cases of Personal Information Infringement Crimes
articles.summary_zh: 6月11日，公安部网安局发布侵犯公民个人信息违法犯罪典型案例，揭露了三种常见的作案类型。
articles.summary_en: On June 11, the Cybersecurity Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security released typical cases of crimes infringing on citizens' personal information, revealing three common types of criminal activities.

articles.title_zh: 浙江实施数字文化IP旅游提升行动
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Implements Digital Culture IP Tourism Enhancement Action
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省文旅厅、省委网信办等10部门印发实施意见，旨在通过数字文化IP与文旅消费融合，培育文旅消费新增长点。
articles.summary_en: Ten departments in Zhejiang, including the Provincial Department of Culture, Radio, Television and Tourism, issued guidelines to integrate digital culture IP with cultural tourism consumption to foster new growth points.

articles.title_zh: 台州三门县探索推动普惠型养老服务改革
articles.title_en: Sanmen County in Taizhou Explores Reform of Inclusive Elderly Care Services
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省台州三门县通过分类施策、财政奖补及“笑脸评价”机制，推动普惠型养老服务改革，有效提升了农村养老机构的服务质量与硬件设施。
articles.summary_en: Sanmen County in Taizhou, Zhejiang, promotes inclusive elderly care reform through categorized measures, financial subsidies, and a "smiley face" evaluation mechanism to improve the quality and facilities of rural nursing homes.

articles.title_zh: 上海市副市长陈宇剑被查
articles.title_en: Shanghai Vice Mayor Chen Yujian Placed Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 6月10日，中央纪委国家监委通报上海市副市长陈宇剑涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: On June 10, the CCDI and NSC announced that Chen Yujian, Vice Mayor of Shanghai, is under investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 国家统计局：5月份居民消费价格同比上涨1.2%
articles.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: Consumer Price Index Rose 1.2% Year-on-Year in May
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局发布数据显示，2026年5月份全国居民消费价格同比上涨1.2%，环比下降0.1%。
articles.summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics reported that China's Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 1.2% year-on-year and fell 0.1% month-on-month in May 2026.

articles.title_zh: 习近平和彭丽媛参谒中朝友谊塔
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan Visit China-DPRK Friendship Tower
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月9日上午，习近平主席和夫人彭丽媛在朝鲜领导人金正恩夫妇陪同下，参谒位于平壤的中朝友谊塔，缅怀志愿军烈士并强调传承中朝友谊。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of June 9, 2026, President Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan visited the China-DPRK Friendship Tower in Pyongyang, accompanied by Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju, to honor the martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同格鲁吉亚总统卡韦拉什维利就中格建交34周年互致贺电并共同宣布将双边关系提升为全面战略伙伴关系
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Georgian President Kavelashvili Exchange Congratulations on 34th Anniversary of Diplomatic Ties and Announce Upgrade to Comprehensive Strategic Partnership
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月9日，国家主席习近平同格鲁吉亚总统卡韦拉什维利互致贺电，庆祝两国建交34周年，并共同宣布将中格关系提升为全面战略伙伴关系。
articles.summary_en: On June 9, 2026, President Xi Jinping and Georgian President Kavelashvili exchanged congratulatory messages on the 34th anniversary of diplomatic ties and jointly announced the upgrade of bilateral relations to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership.

articles.title_zh: 习近平参访朝鲜劳动党中央干部学校
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Visits Workers' Party of Korea Central Cadre School
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月9日，中共中央总书记、国家主席习近平在朝鲜劳动党总书记金正恩陪同下，参访位于平壤的朝鲜劳动党中央干部学校并种树。
articles.summary_en: On June 9, 2026, General Secretary and President Xi Jinping visited the Workers' Party of Korea Central Cadre School in Pyongyang, accompanied by General Secretary Kim Jong Un.

articles.title_zh: 引领中朝关系不断迈向新高度
articles.title_en: Leading China-DPRK Relations to New Heights
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月8日，习近平在平壤同金正恩举行会谈，双方就加强新时期中朝关系的顶层设计、战略指引及务实合作达成共识。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, 2026, Xi Jinping held talks with Kim Jong Un in Pyongyang to strengthen the top-level design, strategic guidance, and pragmatic cooperation of China-DPRK relations.

articles.title_zh: 习近平夫妇出席金正恩夫妇举行的小范围午宴
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping and Spouse Attend Small-scale Luncheon Hosted by Kim Jong Un and Spouse
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月9日，习近平主席和夫人彭丽媛在平壤出席朝鲜劳动党总书记金正恩和夫人李雪主举行的小范围午宴，双方就发展新时代中朝关系及维护地区和平稳定深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On June 9, 2026, President Xi Jinping and his spouse attended a small-scale luncheon hosted by DPRK leader Kim Jong Un and his spouse in Pyongyang to discuss China-DPRK relations and regional stability.

articles.title_zh: 习近平回到北京
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Returns to Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月9日下午，中共中央总书记、国家主席习近平圆满结束对朝鲜国事访问回到北京。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of June 9, 2026, General Secretary and President Xi Jinping returned to Beijing after concluding a state visit to North Korea.

articles.title_zh: 习近平向加拿大新任总督路易丝·阿伯致贺电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Message to New Canadian Governor General Louise Arbor
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，国家主席习近平向加拿大新任总督路易丝·阿伯致贺电，祝贺其就任并表达推动中加新型战略伙伴关系发展的愿望。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory message to Louise Arbor on her appointment as the 31st Governor General of Canada, expressing a desire to promote the China-Canada new strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在平壤与金正恩共同植树
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Kim Jong Un Plant Tree Together in Pyongyang
articles.summary_zh: 6月9日上午，习近平在金正恩陪同下参访朝鲜劳动党中央干部学校并共同植树，旨在深化中朝传统友谊并推动两国关系高水平发展。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of June 9, Xi Jinping visited the Workers' Party of Korea Central Cadre School in Pyongyang and planted a tree with Kim Jong Un to deepen traditional friendship and promote high-level bilateral relations.

articles.title_zh: 人形机器人与具身智能实景实训专项行动启动
articles.title_en: Special Action for Real-scene Training of Humanoid Robots and Embodied AI Launched
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部与国务院国资委联合启动2026年度人形机器人与具身智能实景实训专项行动，旨在通过实景应用验证推动产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: MIIT and SASAC jointly launched the 2026 Special Action for Real-scene Training of Humanoid Robots and Embodied AI to drive high-quality industrial development through real-scene application verification.

articles.title_zh: 5月物价数据释放哪些信息
articles.title_en: Analysis of May Price Data Trends
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局6月10日发布数据显示，5月份全国CPI同比上涨1.2%，物价运行总体平稳，反映出宏观政策实施及供需结构改善。
articles.summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics reported on June 10 that China's CPI rose 1.2% year-on-year in May, indicating stable price movements and improved supply-demand structures.

articles.title_zh: 5月汽车出口延续快速增长态势
articles.title_en: China's Auto Exports Maintain Rapid Growth in May
articles.summary_zh: 中国汽车工业协会数据显示，5月份我国汽车出口量达93万辆，同比增长68.7%，其中新能源汽车出口增长显著。
articles.summary_en: Data from the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers shows that China's auto exports reached 930,000 units in May, a year-on-year increase of 68.7%, with significant growth in NEVs.

articles.title_zh: 5月居民消费价格指数总体平稳 工业生产者出厂价格指数继续上涨
articles.title_en: May CPI Remains Stable and PPI Continues to Rise
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局6月10日发布数据显示，5月份我国居民消费价格指数（CPI）同比上涨1.2%，工业生产者出厂价格指数（PPI）同比上涨3.9%。
articles.summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics reported on June 10 that China's Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 1.2% and the Producer Price Index (PPI) rose 3.9% year-on-year in May.

articles.title_en: Nearly 70% of National Summer Wheat Harvested
articles.summary_zh: 截至6月9日17时，全国夏粮小麦收获进度达68.54%，安徽、河南等省份收获工作进展顺利。
articles.summary_en: As of 5 p.m. on June 9, 68.54% of China's summer wheat has been harvested, with significant progress in provinces such as Anhui and Henan.

articles.title_zh: 第三轮第六批中央生态环保督察完成进驻阶段工作
articles.title_en: The Sixth Batch of the Third Round of Central Ecological and Environmental Protection Inspections Completes On-site Phase
articles.summary_zh: 第三轮第六批中央生态环保督察组已完成在辽宁、吉林、黑龙江、广东、广西、西藏、新疆及新疆生产建设兵团的进驻阶段工作。
articles.summary_en: The sixth batch of the third round of central ecological and environmental protection inspections has completed its on-site work in seven provinces/regions and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记对朝鲜进行国事访问纪实
articles.title_en: Record of General Secretary Xi Jinping's State Visit to the DPRK

articles.summary_en: From June 8 to 9, 2026, General Secretary and President Xi Jinping paid a state visit to the DPRK at the invitation of General Secretary Kim Jong Un to deepen traditional friendship and strategic cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 国务院安委会办公室联合三部委约谈中国交建和中国电建
articles.title_en: State Council Safety Committee Office and Three Ministries Summon CCCC and PowerChina
articles.summary_zh: 国务院安委会办公室联合三部委约谈中国交通建设集团有限公司和中国电力建设集团有限公司。
articles.summary_en: The State Council Safety Committee Office, in conjunction with three ministries, summoned China Communications Construction Company and Power Construction Corporation of China.

articles.title_zh: 中央网信办召开全国网络生态治理工作会议
articles.title_en: Cyberspace Administration of China Holds National Network Ecology Governance Work Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 6月10日，中央网信办在京召开全国网络生态治理工作会议，总结治理成效并部署下一阶段网络生态治理工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 10, the Cyberspace Administration of China held a national network ecology governance work meeting in Beijing to summarize achievements and deploy future tasks.

articles.title_zh: 吉林省将吉林祥云公司纳入国有企业监管范畴
articles.title_en: Jilin Province to Include Jilin Xiangyun Company under State-Owned Enterprise Supervision
articles.summary_zh: 6月9日，吉林省长胡玉亭调研省政数局及吉林祥云公司，强调要将该公司纳入国有企业监管范畴，以推动数字政府建设和数字经济发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 9, Jilin Governor Hu Yuting visited the Provincial Government Services and Digitalization Bureau and Jilin Xiangyun Company, emphasizing the inclusion of the company under SOE supervision to advance digital government and the digital economy.

articles.title_zh: 中交集团、中国电建因安全管理问题被联合约谈
articles.title_en: CCCC and PowerChina Interviewed Over Safety Management Issues
articles.summary_zh: 6月10日，国务院安委会办公室等四部门联合约谈中交集团和中国电建负责人，督促其压实安全生产主体责任，坚决防范重特大灾害事故发生。
articles.summary_en: On June 10, four departments, including the State Council Safety Committee Office, jointly interviewed executives from CCCC and PowerChina to enforce safety production responsibilities and prevent major accidents.

articles.summary_en: Anhui Radio and Television Media Industry Group will launch the "eSports Anhui · Ziyunshan" 2026 series of activities to promote the high-quality development of the eSports and digital culture industries in Anhui.

articles.title_zh: 北京公交专用道实施白色新标线
articles.title_en: Beijing Bus Lanes Implement New White Markings
articles.summary_zh: 北京部分翻修道路的公交专用道标线由黄色改为白色，旨在落实新的国家标准，明确通行规则并减少逆行风险。

articles.summary_zh: 青海省重点交通建设项目G109小峡口改建工程日前建成通车，实现了西宁与海东两市的快速直联。
articles.summary_en: The G109 Xiaoxiakou reconstruction project, a key transportation project in Qinghai Province, has been completed and opened to traffic, providing a fast link between Xining and Haidong.

articles.title_zh: 山西长治沁源县应急管理系统3名负责人接受审查调查
articles.title_en: Three Officials of Emergency Management System in Qinyuan County, Changzhi, Shanxi Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 山西省长治市纪委监委6月7日通报，沁源县应急管理局局长孙晓晔等3名负责人涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受审查调查。
articles.summary_en: On June 7, the Changzhi Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision announced that three officials, including Sun Xiaoye, head of the Qinyuan County Emergency Management Bureau, are under investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

tags.name_en: Changzhi Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision

tags_en: Changzhi Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision

articles.title_zh: 缙云以链群化发展推动电动摩托车产业高端化
articles.title_en: Jinyun Promotes High-end Development of Electric Motorcycle Industry through Chain-Cluster Approach
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省缙云县通过链群化发展和院企协同创新，推动智能短途交通产业向高端化升级，今年一季度产值同比增长16.9%。
articles.summary_en: Jinyun County, Zhejiang Province, is upgrading its smart short-distance transportation industry through chain-cluster development and university-enterprise innovation, with Q1 output value increasing by 16.9%.

tags.name_en: Jinyun County Bureau of Economy and Commerce

tags_en: Jinyun County Bureau of Economy and Commerce

articles.title_zh: 中央安全生产考核巡查组开展明查暗访
articles.title_en: Central Safety Production Inspection Group Conducts Open and Secret Inspections
articles.summary_zh: 2026年度中央安全生产考核巡查组在江苏、辽宁等地开展明查暗访，发现危化品违规存储等重大隐患，相关部门已启动追责问责。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Central Safety Production Inspection Group conducted inspections in Jiangsu and Liaoning, identifying major hazards such as illegal chemical storage and initiating accountability processes.

articles.title_zh: 云南文山州统筹选派104名优秀科级干部到乡镇（街道）挂职
articles.title_en: Wenshan Prefecture in Yunnan Dispatches 104 Section-Level Cadres to Grassroots Townships
articles.summary_zh: 云南省文山州选派104名科级干部到乡镇（街道）挂职锻炼两年，旨在充实基层力量，推动基层治理与产业发展。
articles.summary_en: Wenshan Prefecture in Yunnan Province has dispatched 104 section-level cadres to townships and sub-districts for a two-year temporary posting to strengthen grassroots governance and industrial development.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁省将继续撤并28家省级经济开发区
articles.title_en: Liaoning Province to Further Consolidate 28 Provincial Economic Development Zones
articles.summary_zh: 6月6日央视披露，辽宁省将继续撤并28家省级经济开发区，旨在通过整合优化解决产业同质化和管理重叠问题，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 6, CCTV reported that Liaoning Province will consolidate 28 provincial economic development zones to address industrial homogeneity and administrative overlap, promoting high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 国家安全部就出境游拍摄敏感设施发布安全提示
articles.title_en: Ministry of State Security Issues Safety Tips for Outbound Travelers Regarding Photography of Sensitive Facilities
articles.summary_zh: 国家安全部针对中国公民在海外因拍摄敏感设施被拘押的情况，提醒出境游客遵守当地法律，避免在军事、政府等重点区域拍摄。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of State Security warns Chinese travelers to obey local laws and avoid photographing sensitive areas like military or government facilities to prevent detention abroad.

articles.title_zh: 全国人大常委会启动无障碍环境建设法执法检查
articles.title_en: NPC Standing Committee Launches Law Enforcement Inspection on Barrier-Free Environment Construction Law
articles.summary_zh: 全国人大常委会于6月5日在北京启动无障碍环境建设法执法检查，旨在解决无障碍环境建设中的突出问题，确保法律有效实施。
articles.summary_en: The NPC Standing Committee launched a law enforcement inspection on the Law on the Construction of Barrier-Free Environments in Beijing on June 5 to address key issues and ensure effective implementation.

articles.title_zh: 丰富拓展“三好”内涵 推动中朝关系取得更大发展
articles.title_en: Expanding the Connotation of 'Three Goods' to Promote Greater Development of China-DPRK Relations
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月8日至9日，中共中央总书记、国家主席习近平将应朝鲜劳动党总书记金正恩邀请对朝鲜进行国事访问并举行历史性会晤。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to the DPRK from June 8 to 9, 2026, at the invitation of General Secretary Kim Jong Un for a historic meeting.

articles.title_zh: 国务院新闻办举行“新征程上的奋斗者”中外记者见面会
articles.title_en: SCIO Holds 'Strivers on the New Journey' Press Conference
articles.summary_zh: 6月5日，国务院新闻办举行中外记者见面会，邀请5位广播电视和网络视听行业代表交流如何深耕广电视听服务人民群众。
articles.summary_en: On June 5, the State Council Information Office held a press conference featuring five representatives from the radio, television, and online audio-visual industries to discuss serving the public.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月5日，国务院总理李强在北京主持召开国务院常务会议，审议通过就业优先战略“十五五”规划及退役军人就业创业促进条例，研究新型工业化与未来产业发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 5, 2026, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting in Beijing to approve the 15th Five-Year Plan for employment priority and discuss new industrialization and future industries.

articles.title_zh: 公安机关会同教育部门提醒高考考生诚信赴考
articles.title_en: Public Security Organs and Education Departments Remind Gaokao Candidates to Maintain Integrity
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月5日，公安机关会同教育部门提醒高考考生诚信赴考，并强调将严查严打涉考违法犯罪行为，维护考生合法权益。
articles.summary_en: On June 5, 2026, public security and education authorities reminded Gaokao candidates to maintain integrity and warned that crimes related to the exams will be strictly punished.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同老挝人民革命党中央总书记、国家主席通伦举行会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with General Secretary and President of Laos Thongloun Sisoulith
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月5日，习近平在人民大会堂同来华进行国事访问的老挝国家主席通伦举行会谈，双方就深化中老关系、打造新时代全天候中老命运共同体达成共识。
articles.summary_en: On June 5, 2026, Xi Jinping held talks with Lao President Thongloun Sisoulith in Beijing during the latter's state visit to discuss deepening China-Laos relations and building a China-Laos community with a shared future.

articles.title_zh: 中央党校（国家行政学院）举行2026年春季学期第二批班次毕业典礼
articles.title_en: Central Party School (National Academy of Governance) Holds Graduation Ceremony for Second Batch of 2026 Spring Semester
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月5日，中共中央政治局常委蔡奇出席中央党校（国家行政学院）2026年春季学期第二批班次毕业典礼并为学员颁发证书。
articles.summary_en: On June 5, 2026, Cai Qi, a member of the Politburo Standing Committee, attended the graduation ceremony for the second batch of the 2026 spring semester at the Central Party School.

articles.title_zh: 中华人民共和国和老挝人民民主共和国关于构建新时代全天候中老命运共同体的联合声明
articles.title_en: Joint Statement between the People's Republic of China and the Lao People's Democratic Republic on Building an All-Weather China-Laos Community with a Shared Future in the New Era
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月2日至6日，老挝主席通伦·西苏里对中国进行国事访问。习近平主席同其举行会谈并发表联合声明，双方同意构建新时代全天候中老命运共同体。
articles.summary_en: From June 2 to 6, 2026, Lao President Thonglun Sisoulith paid a state visit to China. President Xi Jinping held talks with him and issued a joint statement to build an all-weather China-Laos community with a shared future in the new era.

tags.name_en: China-Laos Community with a Shared Future

tags_en: China-Laos Community with a Shared Future

articles.title_zh: 全国夏粮小麦收获进度过半
articles.title_en: National Summer Grain Wheat Harvest Progress Exceeds Half
articles.summary_zh: 截至2026年6月5日，全国已收获夏粮小麦1.84亿亩，收获进度达54.29%。
articles.summary_en: As of June 5, 2026, 184 million mu of summer grain wheat have been harvested nationwide, with progress reaching 54.29%.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同老挝国家主席通伦举行会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Laotian President Thongloun Sisoulith
articles.summary_zh: 6月5日下午，习近平在人民大会堂同来华进行国事访问的老挝国家主席通伦举行会谈，强调中老关系的高度重视。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of June 5, Xi Jinping held talks with Laotian President Thongloun Sisoulith at the Great Hall of the People during Thongloun's state visit to China.

articles.title_zh: 中华人民共和国和老挝人民民主共和国关于构建新时代全天候中老命运共同体的联合声明
articles.title_en: Joint Statement between the People's Republic of China and the Lao People's Democratic Republic on Building an All-Weather China-Laos Community with a Shared Future in the New Era
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月2日至6日，老挝主席通伦·西苏里对中国进行国事访问，习近平同其举行会谈并发表关于构建新时代全天候中老命运共同体的联合声明。
articles.summary_en: From June 2 to 6, 2026, Lao President Thonglun Sisoulith paid a state visit to China, where he held talks with President Xi Jinping and issued a joint statement on building an all-weather China-Laos community with a shared future.

tags.name_en: China-Laos Community with a Shared Future

tags_en: China-Laos Community with a Shared Future

articles.title_zh: 我国服务贸易持续扩能提质
articles.title_en: China's Service Trade Continues to Expand Capacity and Improve Quality
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来，我国服务贸易规模稳步增长，知识密集型服务成为重要支撑，前4个月进出口额达1.1万亿元。
articles.summary_en: China's service trade has grown steadily this year, with knowledge-intensive services becoming a key driver, reaching 1.1 trillion yuan in imports and exports in the first four months.

articles.title_zh: 财政金融“组合拳”更大力度支持扩内需
articles.title_en: Fiscal and Financial 'Combination Punch' to Further Support Expanding Domestic Demand
articles.summary_zh: 中国设立1000亿元财政金融协同促内需专项资金，通过贷款贴息、融资担保等方式引导资金流向投资和消费重点领域，以激发市场活力。
articles.summary_en: China has established a 100 billion yuan special fund for fiscal-financial synergy to promote domestic demand, guiding funds into key investment and consumption areas via loan interest subsidies and financing guarantees.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将对朝鲜进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Pay State Visit to North Korea
articles.summary_zh: 应金正恩邀请，习近平将于6月8日至9日对朝鲜进行国事访问，旨在深化中朝友好关系并维护朝鲜半岛和平稳定。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of Kim Jong Un, Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to North Korea from June 8 to 9 to deepen bilateral ties and maintain peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula.

articles.title_zh: 台湾岛东部海域海上交通专项执法行动启动
articles.title_en: Special Maritime Traffic Law Enforcement Action Launched in Waters East of Taiwan Island
articles.summary_zh: 6月6日，交通运输部组织相关海事及救助机构在台湾岛东部海域开展专项执法行动，以应对日菲单方面启动海域划界谈判，维护国家权益。
articles.summary_en: On June 6, the Ministry of Transport launched a special maritime law enforcement action east of Taiwan Island to counter maritime boundary negotiations between Japan and the Philippines and protect national rights.

articles.title_zh: 中国驻罗马尼亚使馆对罗马尼亚众议员窜访台湾表示坚决反对
articles.title_en: Chinese Embassy in Romania Expresses Firm Opposition to Romanian MP's Visit to Taiwan
articles.summary_zh: 中国驻罗马尼亚使馆对罗马尼亚众议员亚历山德鲁·穆拉鲁窜访台湾并发表错误言论表示严重关切和坚决反对，强调一个中国原则是中罗关系的政治基础。
articles.summary_en: The Chinese Embassy in Romania expressed serious concern and firm opposition to Romanian MP Alexandru Muraru's visit to Taiwan and his comments supporting 'Taiwan independence,' emphasizing the One China principle.

articles.title_zh: 北京市政协主席魏小东被查
articles.title_en: Wei Xiaodong, Chairman of Beijing Municipal CPPCC, Placed Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 北京市政协主席魏小东接受调查。魏小东曾任中央编办副主任、北京市委常委、组织部部长等职。
articles.summary_en: Wei Xiaodong, Chairman of the Beijing Municipal CPPCC, is under investigation. He previously served as Deputy Director of the Central Compilation Office and member of the Beijing Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee.

articles.title_zh: 外交部介绍习近平总书记访问朝鲜有关安排
articles.title_en: Ministry of Foreign Affairs Announces President Xi Jinping's Visit to North Korea
articles.summary_zh: 外交部5日宣布，习近平总书记将于6月8日至9日应金正恩邀请对朝鲜进行国事访问，就双边关系及共同关心的问题交换意见。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on June 5 that President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to North Korea from June 8 to 9 at the invitation of Kim Jong Un to discuss bilateral relations.

articles.title_zh: 西藏吐蕃藏王墓现阶段不具备申报世界文化遗产条件
articles.title_en: Tubo King's Tombs in Tibet Currently Not Eligible for World Cultural Heritage Application
articles.summary_zh: 山南市文旅局近日答复人大代表建议，称西藏吐蕃藏王墓在真实性论证、保护管理体系等方面尚不具备申报世界文化遗产的条件。
articles.summary_en: The Shannan Municipal Bureau of Culture and Tourism responded to a proposal, stating that the Tubo King's Tombs in Tibet currently lack the necessary conditions for World Cultural Heritage application.

tags.name_en: Shannan Municipal Bureau of Culture and Tourism

tags_en: Shannan Municipal Bureau of Culture and Tourism

articles.title_zh: 中央安全生产考核巡查组开展明查暗访
articles.title_en: Central Safety Production Inspection Groups Conduct Open and Secret Inspections
articles.summary_zh: 2026年度中央安全生产考核巡查季度明查暗访工作启动，巡查组在江苏、辽宁等地发现危化品违规存储等重大安全隐患并启动追责。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 quarterly central safety production inspections have begun, uncovering major hazards like illegal chemical storage in Jiangsu and Liaoning, leading to rectification and accountability.

articles.title_zh: 中央考核巡查组检查建筑施工领域安全生产
articles.title_en: Central Inspection Team Inspects Safety Production in Construction Sector
articles.summary_zh: 中央安全生产考核巡查组在贵州和新疆等地开展明查暗访，指出部分施工现场安全管理薄弱且存在重大安全隐患。
articles.summary_en: The Central Safety Production Inspection Team conducted inspections in Guizhou and Xinjiang, identifying weak safety management and significant hazards at construction sites.

articles.title_zh: “秦直道”联合申遗获推动：陕西将联合甘肃、内蒙古积极争取
articles.title_en: Joint Application for "Qin Straight Road" World Heritage Status Promoted: Shaanxi to Collaborate with Gansu and Inner Mongolia
articles.summary_zh: 6月3日，陕西省政府回应政协提案，明确将联合甘肃、内蒙古积极争取将“秦直道”遗址纳入世界文化遗产预备名单，并推进跨省保护规划编制。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, the Shaanxi Provincial Government responded to a CPPCC proposal, stating it will collaborate with Gansu and Inner Mongolia to seek the inclusion of the "Qin Straight Road" ruins in the World Heritage Tentative List.

articles.title_zh: 安徽长丰通过靶向培训赋能新能源汽车产业发展
articles.title_en: Changfeng, Anhui Empowers NEV Industry Development Through Targeted Training
articles.summary_zh: 安徽省长丰县构建干部教育培训矩阵，通过实景化培训提升干部服务新能源汽车产业的能力，助力打造产业生态。
articles.summary_en: Changfeng County in Anhui Province has established a cadre training matrix to enhance officials' capabilities in serving the New Energy Vehicle (NEV) industry.

articles.title_zh: 丽泽国际金融城建设提速 城市航站楼预计明年上半年投运
articles.title_en: Construction of Lize International Financial City Accelerates, City Terminal Expected to be Operational by First Half of Next Year
articles.summary_zh: 6月5日，丽泽国际金融城项目推介暨首批签约仪式在京举行，丽泽控股集团与多家企业签约，丽泽城市航站楼预计2027年上半年达到初期投运条件。
articles.summary_en: On June 5, a promotion and signing ceremony for Lize International Financial City was held in Beijing. Lize Holding Group signed with several enterprises, and the Lize City Terminal is expected to be operational by H1 2027.

articles.title_zh: 厦门全力抓好服务保障工作助力高考
articles.title_en: Xiamen Strengthens Service Guarantees to Support College Entrance Examination
articles.summary_zh: 2026年高考前，厦门市委书记林涛和市长伍斌检查考点准备工作，要求确保高考安全、平稳、有序。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of the 2026 Gaokao, Xiamen Municipal Party Secretary Lin Tao and Mayor Wu Bin inspected exam centers to ensure a safe and orderly examination process.

articles.title_zh: 泉州开发区推动原创突破与产业落地
articles.title_en: Quanzhou Development Zone Promotes Original Breakthroughs and Industrial Implementation
articles.summary_zh: 泉州开发区通过建立急难险重工作调度机制，为科创企业提供全周期服务，推动新质生产力集聚和产业升级。
articles.summary_en: Quanzhou Development Zone implements a scheduling mechanism to provide full-cycle services for tech enterprises, promoting the aggregation of new quality productive forces and industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 2025年度中国生态环境十大科技进展发布
articles.title_en: Release of Top Ten Scientific and Technological Advances in China's Ecological Environment for 2025
articles.summary_zh: 6月5日，中国科协生态环境产学联合体在北京发布了2025年度中国生态环境十大科技进展。
articles.summary_en: On June 5, the CAST Ecological Environment Industry-University Consortium released the Top Ten Scientific and Technological Advances in China's Ecological Environment for 2025 in Beijing.

articles.title_zh: 河南省委常委会召开会议 刘宁主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Henan Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting Chaired by Liu Ning
articles.summary_zh: 6月5日，河南省委书记刘宁主持召开省委常委会会议，研究少年儿童工作、高考组织、科技创新与产业融合及文旅产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 5, Liu Ning, Secretary of the Henan Provincial Party Committee, chaired a meeting to discuss youth work, Gaokao organization, sci-tech innovation, and cultural tourism development.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省开放发展工作领导小组会议召开
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Provincial Open Development Work Leading Group Meeting Convened
articles.summary_zh: 6月3日，黑龙江省委书记许勤主持召开省开放发展工作领导小组会议，审议开放龙江建设五年工作实施方案并部署相关工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, chaired a meeting of the provincial open development work leading group to review the five-year implementation plan for 'Open Longjiang' construction.

articles.title_zh: 江西省部署烟花爆竹全链条安全整治
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Province Deploys Full-Chain Safety Rectification for Fireworks and Firecrackers
articles.summary_zh: 6月5日，江西省政府新闻办等部门举行发布会，通报自5月起开展的烟花爆竹全链条安全整治进展，共查处案件693起，抓获450人。
articles.summary_en: On June 5, Jiangxi provincial authorities held a press conference to report progress on the full-chain safety rectification of fireworks and firecrackers since May, resulting in 693 cases and 450 arrests.

articles.title_zh: 江西省委常委会召开会议学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting Studies Xi Jinping's Important Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 6月5日，江西省委书记尹弘主持召开省委常委会会议，研究贯彻落实习近平总书记关于少年儿童培养、中埃合作及革命老区振兴等重要指示精神。
articles.summary_en: On June 5, Yin Hong, Secretary of the Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee, chaired a meeting to implement Xi Jinping's instructions on youth education, China-Egypt cooperation, and the revitalization of revolutionary old areas.

articles.title_zh: 全区安全生产视频会议召开
articles.title_en: Regional Work Safety Video Conference Held in Inner Mongolia
articles.summary_zh: 6月5日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中在呼和浩特主持召开全区安全生产视频会议，强调要压实责任，坚决防范遏制重特大事故发生。
articles.summary_en: On June 5, Wang Weizhong, Party Secretary of Inner Mongolia, chaired a regional work safety video conference in Hohhot to emphasize responsibility and prevent major accidents.

articles.title_zh: 四川省成都市委原副书记、原市长王凤朝严重违纪违法被开除党籍和公职

articles.title_zh: 我国成功发射千帆极轨11组卫星

articles.title_zh: 泉州台商投资区海洋生态修复项目通过审核

articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Natural Resources recently approved a marine ecological restoration project in Quanzhou's Taiwanese Investment Zone, with a planned investment of 380 million yuan to improve the marine environment and coastal disaster resilience.

articles.title_zh: 河南省高院出台16项举措护航文旅强省建设
articles.title_en: Henan Provincial Higher People's Court Introduces 16 Measures to Support Culture and Tourism Development
articles.summary_zh: 6月3日，河南省高级人民法院印发《意见》，提出16项具体举措，旨在通过司法服务保障河南文旅融合高质量发展及文旅强省建设。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, the Henan Provincial Higher People's Court issued a set of opinions featuring 16 measures to provide judicial support for the high-quality development of culture and tourism integration in Henan.

articles.title_zh: “龙江绿碳”构建生态价值转化新范式
articles.title_en: "Longjiang Green Carbon" Constructs a New Paradigm for Ecological Value Transformation

articles.summary_en: Heilongjiang Province has established the "Longjiang Green Carbon" provincial forestry carbon sink trading system, exploring "North Carbon, South Finance" and "Carbon Sink + Finance" models to transform ecological resources into economic value.

articles.title_zh: 深耕“牛芯片”培育“牛明星”
articles.title_en: Deepening "Cattle Chips" and Cultivating "Cattle Stars" for Beef Cattle Breeding

articles.summary_en: Changchun Xinmu Technology Co., Ltd. leverages its national core breeding station to improve beef cattle breeds through scientific breeding, supporting the high-quality development of Jilin's cattle industry and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 2026年第2号辽宁省总林长令签发：坚决打好科尔沁沙地歼灭战
articles.title_en: Liaoning Provincial Chief Forester Order No. 2 of 2026 Issued to Combat Horqin Sandy Land
articles.summary_zh: 辽宁省委书记许昆林与省长王新伟签发2026年第2号总林长令，部署深入推进“三北”工程建设，坚决打好科尔沁沙地歼灭战。
articles.summary_en: Provincial Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei issued the 2nd Chief Forester Order of 2026 to advance the "Three-North" project and combat the Horqin Sandy Land.

articles.summary_en: Multiple areas in Ningxia launched a "Green Exam Protection" special action in June 2026 to ensure a quiet environment for students taking entrance exams by strictly controlling noise sources.

articles.summary_en: A mobilization meeting to support the comprehensive revitalization of Northern Anhui was held in Hefei on June 3. Provincial Party Secretary Liang Yanshun emphasized the integrated development of industrialization, urbanization, and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 应急管理部对三地启动国家地质灾害四级应急响应

articles.summary_en: On June 3, the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee held a study report meeting hosted by Secretary Xin Changxing to discuss the strategic layout and development of future industries.

articles.title_zh: 当前我国夏粮收获进度超四成
articles.title_en: China's Summer Grain Harvest Progress Exceeds 40%

articles.summary_en: As of June 3, the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs reported that 42.23% of China's summer wheat has been harvested, totaling 143 million mu.

articles.summary_en: China's Foreign Ministry announced on June 3 that Myanmar Foreign Minister Tin Maung Swe will pay an official visit to China from June 4 to 6.

articles.title_zh: 韩正会见下任联合国秘书长候选人巴切莱特
articles.title_en: Han Zheng Meets UN Secretary-General Candidate Michelle Bachelet

articles.summary_en: On June 3, 2026, Vice President Han Zheng met with UN Secretary-General candidate Michelle Bachelet in Beijing to discuss supporting the UN's core role and promoting a more just global governance system.

articles.title_zh: 毫不放松抓好“三夏”生产 扎实有效开展常态化监测帮扶
articles.title_en: Liu Guozhong Emphasizes "Three Summers" Production and Normalized Monitoring and Assistance during Hebei Visit
articles.summary_zh: 国务院副总理刘国中6月1日至2日在河北调研，强调要抓好“三夏”生产以夯实粮食丰收基础，并开展常态化监测帮扶以巩固脱贫成果。
articles.summary_en: Vice Premier Liu Guozhong visited Hebei from June 1-2, emphasizing the importance of "Three Summers" agricultural production for food security and normalized monitoring to consolidate poverty alleviation achievements.

articles.title_zh: 韩正会见英国外交大臣库珀
articles.title_en: Han Zheng Meets UK Foreign Secretary David Cooper
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，国家副主席韩正在北京会见英国外交大臣库珀，双方就发展中英全面战略伙伴关系、加强战略沟通及共同应对全球挑战进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Vice President Han Zheng met with UK Foreign Secretary David Cooper in Beijing to discuss developing a comprehensive strategic partnership and strengthening bilateral communication.

articles.title_zh: 重庆以融合化推动产业升级
articles.title_en: Chongqing Promotes Industrial Upgrading through Integration
articles.summary_zh: 重庆市通过推动先进制造业与现代服务业、数智技术与实体经济以及产业链与区域的深度融合，加快构建现代化产业体系。
articles.summary_en: Chongqing is accelerating the construction of a modern industrial system by promoting the deep integration of advanced manufacturing with modern services, digital technology with the real economy, and industrial chains with regional development.

articles.title_zh: 《习近平的文化情缘》等纪录片在老挝启播
articles.title_en: Documentaries Including 'Xi Jinping's Cultural Ties' Premiere in Laos

articles.summary_en: Three Chinese documentaries, including 'Xi Jinping's Cultural Ties,' premiered on mainstream Lao media starting June 1, with Lao President Thongloun Sisoulith sending a congratulatory letter.

articles.summary_en: On June 2, 2026, Foreign Minister Wang Yi held the 11th China-UK Strategic Dialogue with UK Foreign Secretary Cooper in Beijing to discuss the comprehensive strategic partnership and global governance.

articles.title_zh: 王沪宁与欧美同学会第九届理事会会长会成员座谈
articles.title_en: Wang Huning Holds Symposium with Members of the 9th Board of Directors of the Chinese Overseas Students and Scholars Association

articles.summary_en: On June 2, 2026, CPPCC Chairman Wang Huning held a symposium in Beijing with the 9th Board of Directors of the Chinese Overseas Students and Scholars Association to promote the cause of returning to serve the country.

articles.title_zh: 李鸿忠在河北调研县乡两级人大换届选举工作
articles.title_en: Li Hongzhong Inspects County and Township People's Congress Elections in Hebei
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月2日，全国人大常委会副委员长李鸿忠在河北省廊坊、沧州等地调研县乡两级人大换届选举工作，强调要践行全过程人民民主，确保选举风清气正。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, 2026, Li Hongzhong, Vice Chairperson of the NPC Standing Committee, inspected county and township People's Congress elections in Hebei to ensure the practice of whole-process people's democracy.

articles.title_zh: 谁能决定“仅退款”
articles.title_en: Who Decides 'Refund Only': The Conflict Over E-commerce Return Policies
articles.summary_zh: 文章报道了电商平台“仅退款”规则引发的商家与买家纠纷，分析了平台权力失衡问题，并提及国家出台《网络交易平台规则监督管理办法》以规范市场秩序。
articles.summary_en: The article reports on disputes between merchants and buyers caused by e-commerce 'Refund Only' policies, analyzes the imbalance of platform power, and mentions the 'Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Network Transaction Platform Rules' to regulate market order.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记寄望红色基因薪火相传
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Encourages Passing Down "Red Genes" to Young Pioneers
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记在“六一”国际儿童节之际回信中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员，勉励他们传承红色基因，做党和人民的红孩子。
articles.summary_en: On International Children's Day, President Xi Jinping replied to Young Pioneer guides at the Museum of the First CPC National Congress and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Hall, encouraging them to inherit "red genes."

articles.title_zh: 长线外资看好中国 持续加码硬科技
articles.title_en: Long-term Foreign Capital Optimistic About China, Increasing Investment in Hard Tech
articles.summary_zh: 近期，明晟、摩根士丹利等国际金融机构调高对中国科技企业投资比重并上调GDP增速预期，显示外资持续看好中国硬科技与经济前景。
articles.summary_en: Recently, international financial institutions including MSCI and Morgan Stanley have increased investments in Chinese tech firms and raised GDP growth forecasts, reflecting confidence in China's hard tech and economy.

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥在云南调研强调深入推进基础教育高质量发展
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Emphasizes High-Quality Development of Basic Education During Yunnan Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日至2日，国务院副总理丁薛祥在云南调研基础教育及生态环境保护工作，强调要全面贯彻党的教育方针，推进基础教育高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: From June 1 to 2, Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang inspected basic education and ecological protection in Yunnan, emphasizing the implementation of the Party's education policy and high-quality development of basic education.

articles.title_zh: 166家外资企业获增值电信业务经营试点批复
articles.title_en: 166 Foreign-funded Enterprises Receive Approvals for Value-added Telecommunications Business Pilots
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部6月3日宣布，自2025年2月以来已有166家外资企业获得增值电信业务经营试点批复，旨在通过扩大开放促进电信业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology announced on June 3 that 166 foreign-funded enterprises have received approvals for value-added telecommunications business pilots since February 2025 to promote high-quality development.

articles.summary_en: The China Federation of Logistics & Purchasing reported that the logistics industry prosperity index for May was 50.3%, returning to the expansion zone with growth in business volume, new orders, and investment.

articles.title_zh: 全国麦收高效有序推进
articles.title_en: National Wheat Harvest Progresses Efficiently and Orderly
articles.summary_zh: 农业农村部6月3日数据显示，全国冬小麦收获进度已过四成，各地通过强化农机调度确保麦收高效有序推进。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs reported on June 3 that over 40% of winter wheat has been harvested nationwide, with local authorities enhancing machinery scheduling to ensure efficiency.

articles.summary_en: Data released by the China Federation of Logistics & Purchasing shows that China's logistics prosperity index rose to 50.3% in May, returning to the expansion range.

articles.title_en: Tencent Tests AI Agent Prototype to Boost Comeback in AI Sector
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，受腾讯测试AI智能体原型及计划启动合规审批的消息影响，腾讯股价大涨，市场对其AI竞争力预期回升。

articles.title_zh: 骗取贷款890余万元的潜逃嫌疑人被押解回国
articles.title_en: Fugitive Who Defrauded Over 8.9 Million Yuan Extradited to China
articles.summary_zh: 6月3日，在公安部统筹指挥下，辽宁公安机关将潜逃境外十余年、涉嫌骗取贷款890余万元的犯罪嫌疑人高某某押解回国。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, Liaoning public security organs, coordinated by the Ministry of Public Security, extradited suspect Gao, who had fled abroad for over a decade after defrauding banks of over 8.9 million yuan.

articles.title_zh: 私挖盗采矿产致5死，云南省安委会挂牌督办
articles.title_en: Yunnan Provincial Safety Committee Supervises Investigation into Illegal Mining Accident That Killed Five

articles.summary_en: On June 2, the Yunnan Provincial Safety Committee announced a supervised investigation into an illegal mining accident in Qujing that resulted in five deaths.

articles.title_zh: 公安部通报制售作弊芯片干扰尾气检测等环境污染案件
articles.title_en: Ministry of Public Security Reports Environmental Pollution Cases Including Exhaust Test Cheating Chips
articles.summary_zh: 公安部通报了浙江、广西、重庆、四川四地侦破的污染环境刑事案件，涉及制售作弊芯片、非法处置危废及偷排废水等行为。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Public Security reported several environmental pollution criminal cases in Zhejiang, Guangxi, Chongqing, and Sichuan, involving cheating chips for exhaust tests and illegal waste disposal.

articles.title_zh: 赖清德称“受小红书影响，台青把中国当好人”，国台办回应
articles.title_en: Taiwan Affairs Office Responds to Lai Ching-te's Comments on Taiwanese Youth's Perception of China via Xiaohongshu
articles.summary_zh: 6月3日，国台办在例行新闻发布会上回应赖清德关于台湾青年受社交软件影响看待大陆的言论，批评赖当局抹黑并威胁台湾青年。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, the Taiwan Affairs Office responded to Lai Ching-te's remarks about Taiwanese youth's positive view of China influenced by social media, criticizing the Lai administration for smearing and threatening youth.
