articles.title_zh: 王伟中、包钢会见华为高管，推动内蒙古打造“绿色算力+人工智能”应用基地
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong and Bao Gang Meet Huawei Executives to Build "Green Computing + AI" Application Base in Inner Mongolia
articles.summary_zh: 内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中、自治区政府主席包钢会见华为高管，探讨深化战略合作，旨在将内蒙古打造为全国绿色算力高地和人工智能应用基地。
articles.summary_en: Wang Weizhong and Bao Gang, leaders of Inner Mongolia, met with Huawei executives to deepen strategic cooperation and build the region into a national hub for green computing and AI applications.

articles.title_zh: 人民日报开设“美丽中国行”专栏
articles.title_en: People's Daily Launches "Beautiful China Tour" Column
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报开设“美丽中国行”专栏，并于6月2日在四川雅安启动“探访国家公园”集中采访，旨在宣传生态文明建设成效。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily launched the "Beautiful China Tour" column and started a concentrated interview event on national parks in Ya'an, Sichuan on June 2 to promote ecological civilization achievements.

articles.title_zh: 平陆运河全线通水，将于今年9月通航
articles.title_en: Pinglu Canal Fully Watered and Set to Open for Navigation in September
articles.summary_zh: 6月3日上午，平陆运河全线通水并进入有水调试阶段，预计将于今年9月正式通航，将成为西南地区便捷的出海通道。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of June 3, the Pinglu Canal was fully watered and entered the commissioning phase, with official navigation expected to begin in September.

articles.title_zh: 广播电视主流媒体系统性变革引领工程启动实施
articles.title_en: Implementation of the Leading Project for Systematic Reform of Mainstream Radio and Television Media
articles.summary_zh: 国家广播电视总局近日启动实施广播电视主流媒体系统性变革引领工程，旨在通过内容、传播、技术和组织的一体化，推动广电媒体挺进互联网及经济社会发展主战场。
articles.summary_en: The National Radio and Television Administration recently launched a leading project for the systematic reform of mainstream radio and television media to promote integrated production and communication.

articles.title_zh: 科研人员论文投稿致重要技术细节泄密，国安部提醒
articles.title_en: Ministry of State Security Warns Against Leakage of Technical Details via Research Paper Submissions
articles.summary_zh: 国家安全部于6月3日发布安全提示，提醒科研人员在论文投稿、数据存储及学术交流中严守保密要求，防止重要技术细节泄密。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, the Ministry of State Security issued a warning urging researchers to strictly follow confidentiality requirements during paper submissions and academic exchanges to prevent technical leaks.

articles.title_zh: 云南持续整治统计造假突出问题
articles.title_en: Yunnan Continues to Rectify Prominent Statistical Fraud Issues
articles.summary_zh: 云南省针对统计造假和形式主义问题开展专项整治，通过叫停排名通报、实施大数据监测及回溯执法，确保统计数据真实可靠。
articles.summary_en: Yunnan Province is conducting a special rectification campaign against statistical fraud and formalism, utilizing big data monitoring and retrospective enforcement to ensure data reliability.

articles.title_zh: 多省份党政一把手检查2026年高考准备工作
articles.title_en: Heads of Party and Government in Multiple Provinces Inspect Preparations for 2026 Gaokao
articles.summary_zh: 近日，海南、山西、河北等多省份党政负责人调研检查2026年高考准备工作，强调确保考试平稳有序、严明考风考纪，实现“平安高考”。
articles.summary_en: Recently, party and government leaders in provinces including Hainan, Shanxi, and Hebei inspected preparations for the 2026 Gaokao, emphasizing stability, security, and strict examination discipline.

articles.title_zh: 安徽、山西、湖南、辽宁省长深入矿区井下检查安全生产情况
articles.title_en: Governors of Anhui, Shanxi, Hunan, and Liaoning Inspect Mine Safety
articles.summary_zh: 5月下旬至6月初，安徽、山西、湖南、辽宁四省省长分别深入矿区井下，督导检查安全生产工作，强调落实矿山安全“八条硬措施”。
articles.summary_en: From late May to early June, the governors of Anhui, Shanxi, Hunan, and Liaoning conducted on-site inspections of mine shafts to supervise production safety and enforce the 'Eight Hard Measures' for mine safety.

articles.title_zh: 马鞍山开展中高考考点周边酒店价格专项检查
articles.title_en: Ma'anshan Conducts Special Price Inspections of Hotels Near Exam Centers
articles.summary_zh: 马鞍山市市场监管局于5月29日前后开展中高考考点周边酒店价格专项检查，严禁借考试之机牟取暴利，保障考生及家长权益。
articles.summary_en: Ma'anshan Market Supervision Bureau conducted special price inspections of hotels near exam centers around May 29 to prevent price gouging and protect the rights of students and parents.

articles.title_zh: 阜阳成立绿电绿证服务中心以重塑企业竞争力
articles.title_en: Fuyang Establishes Green Power and Green Certificate Service Center to Enhance Enterprise Competitiveness
articles.summary_zh: 阜阳市成立绿电绿证服务中心，旨在为当地企业提供绿电认证和交易服务，助力企业应对国际碳关税并提升绿色竞争力。
articles.summary_en: Fuyang has established a Green Power and Green Certificate Service Center to provide certification and trading services, helping local firms tackle international carbon tariffs and boost green competitiveness.

articles.title_zh: 2026世界旅游城市联合会北京香山旅游峰会开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 World Tourism Cities Organization Beijing Xiangshan Tourism Summit Opens
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月2日，2026世界旅游城市联合会北京香山旅游峰会在北京开幕，市长殷勇出席并就数智引领未来旅游提出建议。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 WTCsO Beijing Xiangshan Tourism Summit opened in Beijing on June 2, 2026. Mayor Yin Yong attended and proposed suggestions for the future of digital tourism.

articles.title_zh: 重庆以融合化推动产业升级
articles.title_en: Chongqing Promotes Industrial Upgrading through Integration
articles.summary_zh: 重庆市通过推动先进制造业与现代服务业、数智技术与实体经济以及产业链与区域的深度融合，加快构建现代化产业体系，打造先进制造业中心。
articles.summary_en: Chongqing is accelerating the construction of a modern industrial system by promoting the deep integration of advanced manufacturing with modern services, digital technology with the real economy, and industrial chains with regional development.

articles.title_zh: 福州市国土空间基础信息平台项目通过验收
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Land Space Basic Information Platform Project Passes Acceptance
articles.summary_zh: 福州市国土空间基础信息平台项目近日通过专家验收，旨在通过数智化治理提升自然资源管理效率，推动国土空间治理现代化。
articles.summary_en: The Fuzhou Land Space Basic Information Platform project recently passed expert acceptance, aiming to enhance natural resource management efficiency through digital governance.

articles.title_zh: 党建引领乡村振兴：福建宁德柏洋村与渔井村的实践探索
articles.title_en: Party Building Leading Rural Revitalization: Practical Explorations in Baiyang and Yujing Villages of Ningde, Fujian
articles.summary_zh: 人民网党建调研团走进福建宁德，调研柏洋村和渔井村如何通过高质量党建引领，分别通过产业升级和治理创新实现乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: A People's Daily research team visited Ningde, Fujian, to study how Baiyang and Yujing villages achieved rural revitalization through high-quality party building, industrial upgrading, and governance innovation.

articles.title_zh: 广东省科技监督与科研诚信系列培训正式启动
articles.title_en: Series of Training on Science and Technology Supervision and Research Integrity Launched in Guangdong Province
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日下午，由科技部十司指导、广东省科技厅主办的科技监督与科研诚信系列培训在华南理工大学正式启动。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of June 2, a series of training sessions on science and technology supervision and research integrity, guided by the Ministry of Science and Technology and hosted by the Guangdong Provincial Department of Science and Technology, was launched at South China University of Technology.

tags.name_en: Guangdong Provincial Department of Science and Technology

tags_en: Guangdong Provincial Department of Science and Technology

articles.title_zh: “2026年高考护航行动”启动实施
articles.title_en: "2026 Gaokao Escort Action" Launched
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月2日，教育部会同网信、公安等部门在北京部署开展“2026年高考护航行动”，旨在通过打击作弊和综合服务保障，确保高考公平与平安。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, 2026, the Ministry of Education, along with cyberspace and public security departments, launched the "2026 Gaokao Escort Action" in Beijing to ensure a fair and safe National College Entrance Examination.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能模型提升沙尘预报精准度
articles.title_en: AI Models Improve Accuracy of Dust Storm Forecasting
articles.summary_zh: 中国气象科学研究院开发的人工智能模型在甘肃等地试运行，大幅提升了沙尘预报的精准度与计算速度，助力防灾减灾。
articles.summary_en: An AI model developed by the Chinese Academy of Meteorological Sciences has been tested in Gansu, significantly improving the accuracy and speed of dust storm forecasting to support disaster mitigation.

articles.title_zh: 2025年甘肃省生态环境状况公报发布
articles.title_en: Release of the 2025 Gansu Province Ecological Environment Status Bulletin
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省政府新闻办召开新闻发布会，发布《2025年甘肃省生态环境状况公报》，通报全省空气、水质及土壤等生态环境状况。
articles.summary_en: The Gansu Provincial Government Information Office released the 2025 Ecological Environment Status Bulletin, reporting on the province's air, water, and soil quality.

articles.title_zh: “鹊桥”行动启动仪式暨首场招商会在南宁举行
articles.title_en: Launch Ceremony of "Magpie Bridge" Action and First Investment Promotion Conference Held in Nanning
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，由广西文旅厅主办的“鹊桥”行动启动仪式暨首场招商会在南宁举行，旨在吸引优质运营商，推动广西文旅业转型升级。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the launch ceremony of the "Magpie Bridge" action and the first investment promotion conference, hosted by the Guangxi Department of Culture and Tourism, were held in Nanning to attract high-quality operators and upgrade the region's tourism industry.

articles.title_zh: 强化责任担当 抓实集中整治 推动全省学习教育不断走深走实
articles.title_en: Strengthen Responsibility and Implement Concentrated Rectification to Deepen Provincial Study and Education
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，河南省委书记刘宁出席全省树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育突出问题集中整治工作推进会，强调要抓好整改整治，特别是解决“新官不理旧账”问题。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Henan Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning attended a meeting on the rectification of problems regarding the correct view of political achievements, emphasizing the need to address the issue of "new officials ignoring old accounts."

articles.title_zh: 商丘探索“一县一特色产业”推动县域经济转型发展
articles.title_en: Shangqiu Explores 'One County, One Characteristic Industry' to Promote County Economic Transformation
articles.summary_zh: 河南省商丘市通过实施“一县一特色产业”战略，在钻石、制冷、家纺等领域打造产业集群，推动县域经济高质量转型发展。
articles.summary_en: Shangqiu City in Henan Province is promoting high-quality county economic transformation by implementing the 'One County, One Characteristic Industry' strategy across various sectors.

articles.title_zh: 关志鸥走访省人大常委会省政府省政协省法院省检察院
articles.title_en: Guan Zhiou Visits Provincial NPC Standing Committee, Government, CPPCC, Court, and Procuratorate
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，湖北省委书记关志鸥走访省人大常委会、省政府、省政协、省法院和省检察院，与领导班子成员交流并部署高质量发展与法治建设工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Hubei Provincial Party Secretary Guan Zhiou visited the provincial NPC Standing Committee, government, CPPCC, court, and procuratorate to exchange views and deploy tasks for high-quality development and the rule of law.

articles.title_zh: 湖北省政府与中国气象局召开“十五五”时期协同共建工作座谈会
articles.title_en: Hubei Provincial Government and China Meteorological Administration Hold Symposium on "15th Five-Year Plan" Collaborative Construction
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，湖北省政府与中国气象局在武汉召开座谈会，研究谋划“十五五”时期气象高质量发展及省部协同共建重点事项。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the Hubei Provincial Government and the China Meteorological Administration held a symposium in Wuhan to plan key collaborative projects for high-quality meteorological development during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period.

articles.title_zh: 中国气象局启动重大气象灾害四级应急响应
articles.title_en: China Meteorological Administration Activates Level IV Emergency Response for Major Meteorological Disasters
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，中国气象局启动重大气象灾害四级应急响应，并与农业农村部联合发布设施农业风灾和冬小麦倒伏风险预警。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the China Meteorological Administration activated a Level IV emergency response for major meteorological disasters and jointly issued agricultural risk warnings with the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

tags_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

articles.title_zh: 首个快递领域国际标准化机构成立
articles.title_en: First International Standardization Body for Express Delivery Established
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月2日，国际标准化组织（ISO）快递服务标准委员会在北京成立，秘书处设在中国并由国家邮政局发展研究中心承担具体工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, 2026, the ISO Express Service Standards Committee was established in Beijing, with its secretariat located in China and managed by the State Post Bureau's Development Research Center.

articles.title_zh: 河北省组建407支常态化农机应急作业服务队
articles.title_en: Hebei Province Establishes 407 Normalized Agricultural Machinery Emergency Service Teams
articles.summary_zh: 河北省组建407支常态化农机应急作业服务队并投入200万台农机具，旨在保障“三夏”期间阴雨天的小麦抢收工作。
articles.summary_en: Hebei Province has formed 407 normalized agricultural machinery emergency service teams and deployed 2 million pieces of equipment to ensure wheat harvesting during the 'Three Summers' period.

articles.title_zh: 河北推动机器人产业跑出“加速度”
articles.title_en: Hebei Promotes Acceleration of Robotics Industry
articles.summary_zh: 河北省今年将深化“北京大脑—河北转化”实践，通过项目建设、京津冀协同及场景应用，推动机器人产业快速发展。
articles.summary_en: Hebei Province will deepen the "Beijing Brain-Hebei Conversion" practice to accelerate the development of its robotics industry through project construction, regional synergy, and scenario applications.

articles.title_zh: 海南省出台关于推动城市高质量发展的实施意见
articles.title_en: Hainan Province Issues Implementation Opinions on Promoting High-Quality Urban Development
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，中共海南省委和海南省人民政府印发实施意见，旨在到2035年基本建成具有海南特色和优势的现代化人民城市，构建与自贸港建设相适应的城市体系。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the CPC Hainan Provincial Committee and the Hainan Provincial Government issued implementation opinions to build modern people-centered cities with Hainan characteristics by 2035, aligning with the Free Trade Port construction.

articles.title_zh: 海南面向全球旅行商推出十大旅游名片
articles.title_en: Hainan Launches Ten Tourism Calling Cards for Global Travel Agents
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月1日，海南省旅游和文化广电体育厅在海口向全球旅行商推出“十大旅游名片”，旨在通过品牌化营销提升海南国际旅游竞争力。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, 2026, the Hainan Provincial Department of Tourism, Culture, Radio, Television and Sports launched "Ten Tourism Calling Cards" in Haikou to enhance Hainan's international tourism competitiveness.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲到牡丹江市督导检查中央生态环境保护督察通报典型案例整改工作
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Inspects Rectification of Typical Cases Reported by Central Ecological and Environmental Protection Inspection in Mudanjiang
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，黑龙江省长梁惠玲到牡丹江市督导检查中央生态环境保护督察通报典型案例的整改工作，强调要从严从实抓好农村环境治理。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling inspected the rectification of typical cases reported by the Central Ecological and Environmental Protection Inspection in Mudanjiang, emphasizing strict rural environmental governance.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省发布寒区公路铜冶炼尾渣路基、基层设计与施工技术规范
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Province Releases Technical Specifications for Copper Smelting Slag in Cold-Region Highway Roadbeds and Bases
articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江省交通运输厅近日发布地方标准，规定铜冶炼尾渣可替代天然砂石用于寒区公路建设，旨在推动交通运输行业绿色低碳发展。
articles.summary_en: The Heilongjiang Provincial Department of Transport released a local standard allowing copper smelting slag to replace natural sand and stone in cold-region highway construction to promote green and low-carbon development.

articles.title_zh: 湖南发布“十五五”制造强省建设施工图
articles.title_en: Hunan Releases Blueprint for Building a Manufacturing Powerhouse during the 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月3日，湖南省工信厅、发改委、财政厅在长沙召开新闻通气会，解读推进新型工业化和制造强省建设的“十五五”规划及相关财政支持政策。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, 2026, Hunan's departments of industry, development and reform, and finance held a press conference in Changsha to interpret the 15th Five-Year Plan for new industrialization and manufacturing powerhouse construction.

articles.title_zh: 水利部部署开展第二批母亲河复苏行动
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Deploys Second Batch of Mother River Recovery Action
articles.summary_zh: 水利部印发《母亲河复苏行动方案（2026—2030年）》，部署开展第二批母亲河复苏行动，旨在到2030年持续改善河湖生态环境。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Water Resources issued the 'Mother River Recovery Action Plan (2026-2030)' to launch the second batch of recovery actions, aiming to improve river and lake ecological environments by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 江苏探索干部离任交接新办法 破解“新官不理旧账”难题
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Explores New Handover Methods for Officials to Ensure Continuity
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省出台干部离任交接实施办法，实现省管正职全覆盖，旨在通过制度化交接破解“新官不理旧账”难题，确保政务连续性。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu Province has implemented new measures for the handover of departing officials to ensure work continuity and prevent new officials from ignoring previous commitments.

articles.title_zh: 江西省首家国家钨与稀土产业计量测试中心在赣州成立
articles.title_en: First National Tungsten and Rare Earth Industry Metrology and Testing Center of Jiangxi Province Established in Ganzhou
articles.summary_zh: 经国家市场监督管理总局批准，国家钨与稀土产业计量测试中心在赣州正式成立，旨在完善战略资源产业计量服务体系，助力产业提质升级。
articles.summary_en: Approved by the State Administration for Market Regulation, the National Tungsten and Rare Earth Industry Metrology and Testing Center was established in Ganzhou to enhance the metrology service system for strategic resources.

articles.title_zh: 尹弘在九江调研强调因地制宜推动县域经济高质量发展
articles.title_en: Yin Hong Conducts Research in Jiujiang to Promote High-Quality County-Level Economic Development
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，江西省委书记尹弘在九江市调研县域经济发展，强调要选准赛道培育主导产业，推动县域经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Yin Hong, Secretary of the Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee, conducted research in Jiujiang to emphasize cultivating dominant industries and promoting high-quality county-level economic development.

articles.title_zh: 江西发布林业生物多样性保护公报
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Releases Forestry Biodiversity Protection Report
articles.summary_zh: 江西省日前发布2026年林业生物多样性保护公报，公布了近两年新增物种数量及就地与迁地保护体系的建设成果。
articles.summary_en: Jiangxi Province recently released the 2026 Forestry Biodiversity Protection Report, detailing new species discovered and the achievements of its in-situ and ex-situ conservation systems.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏银川苏银产业园算电一体化Token超级工厂项目签约
articles.title_en: Signing Ceremony for Computing-Electricity Integrated Token Super Factory Project in Yinchuan, Ningxia
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，银川市人民政府、厦门国贸控股集团、宁夏宝丰集团等单位在宁夏银川签署战略合作协议，共同建设算电一体化Token超级工厂项目，旨在打造“算力之都”。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the Yinchuan Municipal Government, Xiamen ITG Holding Group, and Ningxia Baofeng Group signed strategic agreements in Yinchuan, Ningxia, to build a Computing-Electricity Integrated Token Super Factory to develop the city as a 'Computing Capital'.

articles.title_zh: 革命洪流记（伟大征程）
articles.title_en: Chronicle of the Revolutionary Torrent (The Great Journey)
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾了1923年中共三大会在广州召开的历史意义，并介绍了广州市通过中共三大会址纪念馆等方式赓续红色文化。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews the historical significance of the 3rd National Congress of the CPC held in Guangzhou in 1923 and describes Guangzhou's efforts to preserve red culture.

articles.title_zh: 习近平给中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员回信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Young Pioneer Guides at CPC First Congress and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Halls
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记近日给中共一大纪念馆和南湖革命纪念馆的少先队红领巾讲解员回信，勉励他们传承红色基因，在新征程上跑好历史接力赛。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping recently replied to Young Pioneer guides at the Museum of the First National Congress of the CPC and the Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Hall, encouraging them to inherit the 'red gene' and carry forward the historical legacy.

articles.title_zh: 青海省启动全民数字素养与技能提升月活动
articles.title_en: Qinghai Province Launches Digital Literacy and Skills Improvement Month
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，青海省在西宁启动2026年全民数字素养与技能提升月活动，旨在提升全民人工智能素养并推动数字成果普惠共享。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Qinghai Province launched the 2026 Digital Literacy and Skills Improvement Month in Xining to enhance AI literacy and promote the inclusive sharing of digital achievements.

articles.title_zh: 青海发布实施高速公路收费服务质量评价地方标准
articles.title_en: Qinghai Implements Local Standard for Highway Toll Service Quality Evaluation
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，由青海省交通控股集团牵头编制的《高速公路收费服务质量评价技术规范》地方标准正式实施，旨在补齐服务评价短板，提升高速公路运营管理质量。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, the local standard "Technical Specifications for Evaluation of Highway Toll Service Quality," led by Qinghai Provincial Transportation Holding Group, was officially implemented to standardize and improve highway toll services in Qinghai.

articles.title_zh: 赋能20个领域 四川“人工智能+”这样布局
articles.title_en: Empowering 20 Fields: Sichuan's Layout for 'AI+' Action
articles.summary_zh: 四川省政府办公厅印发《四川省加快推进“人工智能+”一号创新工程实施方案》，旨在通过人工智能赋能20个领域，推进产业升级与民生改善。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of the Sichuan Provincial Government issued an implementation plan for the 'AI+' No. 1 Innovation Project to empower 20 fields and promote industrial upgrading and livelihood improvement.

tags_en: General Office of the Sichuan Provincial Government

articles.title_zh: 2026“一带一路”华侨华人合作发展大会在成都开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 'Belt and Road' Overseas Chinese Cooperation and Development Conference Opens in Chengdu
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月2日，2026“一带一路”华侨华人合作发展大会在成都开幕。四川省委书记王晓晖、中国侨联主席王灵桂及四川省长施小琳等出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 'Belt and Road' Overseas Chinese Cooperation and Development Conference opened in Chengdu on June 2, 2026, attended by Sichuan Party Secretary Wang Xiaohui and ACFROC President Wang Linggui.

articles.title_zh: 山东省政协十三届六十三次主席会议召开
articles.title_en: The 63rd Chairperson's Meeting of the 13th Shandong Provincial Committee of the CPPCC Convened

articles.title_zh: 上海发布生活垃圾分类提质增效三年行动计划

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登在拉萨市调研教育工作

articles.summary_en: On June 2, Gama Zedeng, Chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region, conducted research on education in Lhasa, emphasizing the need to provide quality education to support the modernization of New Tibet.

articles.title_zh: 各省份“十五五”规划纲要公布

articles.title_zh: 北京市政府召开常务会议研究部署安全生产等工作

articles.title_en: Release of the 2025 Social Responsibility (ESG) Action Report for Shandong Listed Companies

articles.summary_en: The Dazhong Daily Zhongguan Think Tank released the 2025 Social Responsibility (ESG) Action Report, analyzing the ESG performance of 159 listed companies in Shandong and providing development suggestions.

articles.title_zh: 山东省政府印发《推进服务业扩能提质实施方案》
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial Government Issues Implementation Plan to Enhance and Upgrade Service Industry
articles.summary_zh: 山东省人民政府近日印发《推进服务业扩能提质实施方案》，部署到2030年服务业增加值达7.2万亿元，重点推动生产性与生活性服务业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The Shandong Provincial Government issued an implementation plan to upgrade the service industry, aiming for a value-added of 7.2 trillion yuan by 2030 through enhancing productive and living services.

articles.title_zh: 山西发布公费农科生招录政策
articles.title_en: Shanxi Releases Recruitment Policy for Government-Funded Agricultural Students
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，山西省招生考试管理中心发布2026年公费农科生定向培养招生细则，计划招录90人，旨在引导优质生源扎根基层，助力乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the Shanxi Provincial Admissions and Examination Management Center released recruitment details for the 2026 government-funded agricultural student program to support rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 陈敏尔、张工与国家能源集团董事长邹磊座谈
articles.title_en: Chen Min'er and Zhang Gong Hold Symposium with Zou Lei, Chairman of National Energy Investment Group
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，天津市委书记陈敏尔、市长张工与国家能源集团董事长邹磊座谈，探讨在能源保供、科技创新及京津冀协同发展等方面的深度合作。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Tianjin Party Secretary Chen Min'er and Mayor Zhang Gong held a symposium with Zou Lei, Chairman of National Energy Investment Group, to discuss deep cooperation in energy supply, tech innovation, and the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei coordinated development.

articles.title_zh: 新疆发展“人工智能+”的机遇与优势
articles.title_en: Opportunities and Advantages of Xinjiang's 'AI+' Development
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，新疆维吾尔自治区党政主要领导就全区推进“人工智能+”工作开展调研并召开座谈会，强调要全面实施“人工智能+”行动以赋能高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, top party and government leaders of Xinjiang conducted research and held a symposium on promoting 'AI+' initiatives to empower high-quality regional development.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江在自治区档案馆调研座谈
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang Conducts Research and Symposium at Regional Archives
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，自治区党委书记陈小江在自治区档案馆调研座谈，强调要提高档案工作质量和服务水平，服务建设社会主义现代化新疆。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Chen Xiaojiang, Secretary of the Regional Party Committee, visited the Regional Archives to emphasize improving archive quality and services to support the modernization of Xinjiang.

articles.title_zh: 新疆三农智库研究中心揭牌成立
articles.title_en: Xinjiang San Nong Think Tank Research Center Established
articles.summary_zh: 近日，由自治区农科院牵头组建的新疆三农智库研究中心正式揭牌成立，旨在为新疆打造优质农牧产品供给基地提供智力支撑。
articles.summary_en: The Xinjiang San Nong Think Tank Research Center, led by the regional Academy of Agricultural Sciences, was recently established to provide intellectual support for Xinjiang's agricultural and livestock product supply base.

articles.title_zh: 王予波检查调度云南省高考准备工作
articles.title_en: Wang Yubo Inspects and Coordinates Gaokao Preparations in Yunnan Province
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，云南省长王予波检查调度全省高考准备工作，强调要严肃考风考纪，确保高考平安有序、公平公正。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Yunnan Governor Wang Yubo inspected preparations for the National College Entrance Examination (Gaokao) to ensure a safe, orderly, and fair process.

articles.title_zh: 浙江省科研诚信指数首次发布
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Province Releases First Scientific Research Integrity Index
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省科技厅发布《浙江省科研诚信指数报告（2024）》，首次在省域层面通过指数形式系统反映科研诚信建设进展。
articles.summary_en: The Zhejiang Provincial Department of Science and Technology released the 2024 Scientific Research Integrity Index Report, marking the first provincial-level effort to systematically track research integrity progress.

articles.title_zh: 快递领域首个国际标准化机构在我国成立
articles.title_en: First International Standardization Body for Express Delivery Established in China
articles.summary_zh: 国际标准化组织（ISO）快递服务标准委员会于6月2日在浙江杭州成立，这是快递领域首个国际标准化机构。
articles.summary_en: The ISO Technical Committee on Express Delivery Services was established in Hangzhou, Zhejiang on June 2, marking the first international standardization body in the express delivery sector.

articles.title_zh: 王莉霞涉嫌受贿被提起公诉
articles.title_en: Wang Lixia Indicted on Bribery Charges
articles.summary_zh: 6月3日，最高检决定逮捕内蒙古自治区党委原副书记、自治区政府原主席王莉霞，大庆市人民检察院已向大庆市中级人民法院提起公诉。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, the Supreme People's Procuratorate ordered the arrest of Wang Lixia, former Deputy Secretary of the Inner Mongolia Party Committee and former Chairwoman of the region's government, who has been indicted for bribery.

articles.title_zh: 王浩会见通伦
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Meets Thongloun
articles.summary_zh: 王浩代表浙江省委、省政府会见老挝领导人通伦，双方探讨深化经贸投资、现代农业、数字经济等领域合作，助力中老友好关系。
articles.summary_en: Wang Hao, representing the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee and Government, met with Laotian leader Thongloun to discuss deepening cooperation in trade, investment, modern agriculture, and the digital economy.

articles.title_zh: 安徽省省长深入煤矿井下检查安全生产
articles.title_en: Anhui Governor Inspects Safety Production at Coal Mine
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，安徽省省长王清宪在淮南市煤矿企业督导检查安全生产工作，强调要守牢生产安全底线，坚决防范重特大事故发生。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Anhui Governor Wang Qingxian inspected safety production at coal mine enterprises in Huainan, emphasizing the need to maintain safety bottom lines and prevent major accidents.

articles.title_zh: 国家卫健委健全社区卫生服务体系 落实“日常疾病在基层解决”
articles.title_en: National Health Commission to Improve Community Health Service System to Resolve Common Diseases at Primary Level
articles.summary_zh: 国家卫健委6月2日发布通知，要求到2030年基本实现建制街道社区卫生服务中心全覆盖，落实“日常疾病在基层解决”。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the National Health Commission issued a notice aiming for full coverage of community health service centers by 2030 to ensure common diseases are treated at the primary level.

articles.title_zh: 中央巡视工作领导小组办公室原主任黎晓宏被查
articles.title_en: Former Director of the Office of the Central Inspection Work Leading Group Li Xiaohong Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月2日，中国官方通报中央巡视工作领导小组办公室原主任黎晓宏涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受中央纪委国家监委调查。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, 2026, Chinese authorities announced that Li Xiaohong, former director of the Office of the Central Inspection Work Leading Group, is under investigation by the CCDI and NSC for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 教育部等八部门联合开展“国聘行动”
articles.title_en: Ministry of Education and Seven Other Departments Jointly Launch "National Recruitment Action"
articles.summary_zh: 教育部、人社部等八部门于5月至12月联合开展“国聘行动”，旨在促进2026届及往届高校毕业生尽早就业。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Education and seven other departments launched the "National Recruitment Action" from May to December to promote employment for 2026 and previous college graduates.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记给少先队红领巾讲解员回信
articles.title_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping Replies to Letter from Young Pioneer Red Scarf Guides
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月30日，习近平总书记给中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员回信，勉励他们传承红色基因，做党和人民的红孩子。
articles.summary_en: On May 30, 2026, General Secretary Xi Jinping replied to a letter from Young Pioneer guides at the First National Congress Memorial Hall and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Hall, encouraging them to inherit the 'red gene'.

articles.title_zh: 中央财政下达育儿补贴补助资金999亿元
articles.title_en: Central Finance Allocates 99.9 Billion Yuan for Childcare Subsidies
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，财政部下达2026年育儿补贴补助资金999亿元，支持各地为符合条件的婴幼儿发放补贴，助力建设生育友好型社会。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the Ministry of Finance allocated 99.9 billion yuan in childcare subsidy funds for 2026 to support local governments in providing subsidies for eligible infants.

articles.title_zh: 国务院印发《加快农业农村现代化“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: State Council Issues "15th Five-Year Plan for Accelerating Agricultural and Rural Modernization"
articles.summary_zh: 国务院日前印发《加快农业农村现代化“十五五”规划》，明确了“十五五”时期农业农村现代化的目标、重点任务和政策措施，以更好推进中国式现代化建设。
articles.summary_en: The State Council issued the "15th Five-Year Plan for Accelerating Agricultural and Rural Modernization," outlining goals and key tasks to advance agricultural modernization and Chinese-style modernization.

articles.title_zh: 我国将培育壮大农业新兴产业和未来产业
articles.title_en: China to Cultivate and Expand Emerging and Future Agricultural Industries
articles.summary_zh: 国务院6月2日公布《加快农业农村现代化“十五五”规划》，提出将培育壮大农业新兴产业和未来产业，发展农业新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the State Council released the '15th Five-Year Plan for Accelerating Agricultural and Rural Modernization,' aiming to cultivate emerging and future agricultural industries and develop new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 刘国中在河北调研强调抓好“三夏”生产与常态化监测帮扶
articles.title_en: Liu Guozhong Emphasizes "Three Summer" Production and Regular Monitoring and Assistance During Hebei Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 国务院副总理刘国中6月1日至2日在河北调研，强调要抓好“三夏”生产以确保粮食丰收，并扎实开展常态化监测帮扶以巩固脱贫成果。
articles.summary_en: Vice Premier Liu Guozhong inspected Hebei from June 1-2, emphasizing the importance of "Three Summer" agricultural production for food security and regular monitoring to prevent return to poverty.

articles.title_zh: 第十一次中英战略对话在北京举行
articles.title_en: The 11th China-UK Strategic Dialogue Held in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，外交部长王毅在北京同英国外交大臣库珀举行第十一次中英战略对话，双方就落实两国领导人共识、深化经贸合作及全球治理等议题交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Foreign Minister Wang Yi held the 11th China-UK Strategic Dialogue with UK Foreign Secretary Cooper in Beijing to discuss implementing leadership consensus, deepening economic cooperation, and global governance.

articles.title_zh: 助力三夏抢收 设备更新政策发力显效
articles.title_en: Equipment Update Policy Boosts 'Three Summers' Grain Harvest
articles.summary_zh: 中国推进大规模设备更新，将粮食干燥机等农机纳入补贴范围，有效助力夏粮抢收并带动相关产业发展。
articles.summary_en: China is promoting large-scale equipment updates, including subsidies for grain dryers and drones, to support the summer grain harvest and boost related industries.

articles.title_zh: 网暴抗洪救灾村干部“戴金耳环”相关网民被行政处罚
articles.title_en: Netizens Punished for Cyberbullying Village Official Over 'Gold Earrings' During Flood Relief
articles.summary_zh: 公安网安部门依法查处15起网暴抗洪救灾村干部的行为，对秦某某、未某某等相关网民实施行政处罚。
articles.summary_en: Public security cyber-police investigated 15 cases of cyberbullying against a village official during flood relief and imposed administrative penalties on several netizens.

articles.title_zh: 中央巡视工作领导小组办公室原主任黎晓宏被查
articles.title_en: Former Director of the Office of the Central Inspection Work Leading Group Li Xiaohong Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，中央纪委国家监委通报，中央巡视工作领导小组办公室原主任黎晓宏涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the CCDI and National Supervisory Commission announced that Li Xiaohong, former Director of the Office of the Central Inspection Work Leading Group, is under investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 山西沁源县委书记赵永进被查

articles.summary_zh: 山西省长治市沁源县委书记赵永进接受调查。
articles.summary_en: Zhao Yongjin, the Party Secretary of Qinyuan County in Changzhi, Shanxi Province, is under investigation.

articles.title_zh: 中方团队列出63项限制出口技术清单
articles.title_en: Chinese Research Team Proposes List of 63 Technologies for Export Restrictions
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，有报道称中方科研团队在《中国科学院院刊》发表研究，拟定一份涵盖63个科技领域的出口管制清单，旨在防止核心技术外流至美西方。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, reports indicated that a Chinese research team proposed a list of 63 technologies for export control in a study published in the Bulletin of the Chinese Academy of Sciences to prevent strategic technology leakage to the West.

articles.title_zh: 银川中小学招聘“围报”事件后续：相关岗位面试开考比例降至1:1
articles.title_en: Follow-up on Yinchuan School Recruitment "Coordinated Application" Incident: Interview Ratio Reduced to 1:1
articles.summary_zh: 宁夏银川市金凤区人社局查实两名体育教师岗位存在违规围报行为，决定取消相关人员面试资格并降低开考比例。
articles.summary_en: The Jinfeng District Human Resources and Social Security Bureau in Yinchuan, Ningxia, disqualified candidates and lowered interview ratios after discovering illegal coordinated applications for PE teacher positions.

articles.title_en: Academician Du Xiangwan Denies Applying Nuclear Technology to Waste Incineration
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，中国工程院院士杜祥琬发表声明，否认网络传闻称其及其团队将核技术应用于垃圾焚烧，并表示将保留追究法律责任的权利。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Academician Du Xiangwan of the Chinese Academy of Engineering issued a statement denying rumors that he and his team applied nuclear technology to waste incineration.

articles.title_zh: 李鸿忠在河北调研县乡两级人大换届选举工作
articles.title_en: Li Hongzhong Conducts Research on County and Township People's Congress Elections in Hebei
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，全国人大常委会副委员长李鸿忠在河北省廊坊、沧州等地调研县乡两级人大换届选举工作，强调要践行全过程人民民主，确保选举风清气正。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Li Hongzhong, Vice Chairperson of the NPC Standing Committee, visited Hebei to research county and township-level NPC elections, emphasizing the practice of whole-process people's democracy.

articles.title_zh: 北京轨道交通R4线一期北段工程正式开工
articles.title_en: Construction of Beijing Rail Transit R4 Line Phase I North Section Officially Begins
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月2日，北京轨道交通R4线一期北段工程建设动员部署会召开，标志着该线路正式进入建设阶段，旨在提升首都东北部交通能级。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, 2026, a mobilization meeting was held for the construction of the Beijing Rail Transit R4 Line Phase I North Section, marking the start of the project to enhance transportation in northeast Beijing.

articles.title_zh: 北京市太空算力产业创新中心正式成立
articles.title_en: Beijing Space Computing Power Industry Innovation Center Officially Established
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，北京市首个太空算力产业创新中心在海淀区正式成立，由北京市经信局批复，北京邮电大学牵头组建。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Beijing's first Space Computing Power Industry Innovation Center was established in Haidian District, approved by the Beijing Municipal Bureau of Economy and Information Technology and led by BUPT.

articles.title_en: Unitree Robotics Passes Listing Committee Review, Aiming to be A-Share's First Embodied AI Stock
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，福建金投基金参投的宇树科技通过上海证券交易所上市委审议，通过科创板首发申请，有望成为A股首家具身智能上市公司。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Unitree Robotics, invested by Fujian Jintou Fund, passed the Shanghai Stock Exchange's listing committee review for its STAR Market IPO, potentially becoming the first embodied AI company listed on A-shares.

articles.title_zh: 2026海峡（福州）渔业周：将更惠民、旺市场、促消费

articles.summary_en: The 2026 Strait (Fuzhou) Fishery Week will be held in Fuzhou from June 12 to 16, focusing on marine technology, Fujian-Taiwan integration, and modern fishery achievements.

articles.title_zh: “启航‘十五五’：中国发展与全球机遇”广东省专题推介会举行
articles.title_en: Guangdong Special Promotion Event 'Sailing into the 15th Five-Year Plan: China's Development and Global Opportunities' Held
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，由外交部与广东省政府联合主办的“启航‘十五五’”专题推介会在广州举行，省长孟凡利与外交部部长助理刘彬出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, the 'Sailing into the 15th Five-Year Plan' promotion event, co-hosted by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Guangdong Provincial Government, was held in Guangzhou.

articles.title_zh: 2026年广西交通运输“安全生产月”活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Guangxi Transport 'Work Safety Month' Activities Launched
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月1日，广西启动交通运输“安全生产月”活动，通过隐患排查、数智赋能和安全宣传提升行业安全发展水平。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, 2026, Guangxi launched the 'Work Safety Month' for the transport sector to enhance safety through risk inspection, digital empowerment, and publicity.

articles.title_zh: 海口东站扩建项目即将开工 总投资1.86亿元
articles.title_en: Haikou East Station Expansion Project to Commence with 186 Million Yuan Investment
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，海口市自然资源和规划局发布海口东站扩建项目规划公示，该项目总投资1.86亿元，旨在提升自贸港交通枢纽服务能级。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, the Haikou Municipal Bureau of Natural Resources and Planning announced the expansion plan for Haikou East Station, with a total investment of 186 million yuan to enhance the transport hub's capacity for the Free Trade Port.

articles.title_zh: 许勤到绥化肇东市调研
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Conducts Research Tour in Zhaodong City, Suihua
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，黑龙江省委书记许勤到绥化肇东市调研，看望受极端天气影响的农户，并主持召开包联企业座谈会，强调做好防灾减灾及支持企业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, visited Zhaodong City in Suihua to inspect disaster relief for farmers and hold a symposium to support the high-quality development of enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 湖南建设年轻人友好省份 实施四大友好行动
articles.title_en: Hunan Builds Youth-Friendly Province and Implements Four Friendly Actions
articles.summary_zh: 湖南省出台《关于建设年轻人友好省份的实施意见》，通过实施就业、创业、生活、成长四大友好行动，吸引并支持青年在湘建功立业。
articles.summary_en: Hunan Province has issued implementation opinions to build a youth-friendly province, launching four friendly actions focusing on employment, entrepreneurship, living, and growth to attract young talent.

articles.title_en: Ye Kun on Standardizing Transportation Law Enforcement and Improving Work Style in Ningxia

articles.summary_en: Ye Kun, Director of the Ningxia Transportation Comprehensive Law Enforcement Supervision Bureau, detailed practices in standardizing law enforcement and improving work style to build a disciplined enforcement team.

articles.title_en: Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision Announces Investigation of Cheng Gang
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，四川省纪委监委通报，四川省住房和城乡建设厅党组成员、副厅长程刚涉嫌严重违纪违法，主动投案并接受审查调查。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision announced that Cheng Gang, Deputy Director of the Provincial Department of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, is under investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law after surrendering voluntarily.

articles.title_zh: 山东省服务业大会召开
articles.title_en: Shandong Province Service Industry Conference Convened
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日上午，山东省服务业大会在济南召开。省委书记林武出席并讲话，部署加快推进服务业扩能提质，打造“山东服务”品牌。
articles.summary_en: The Shandong Province Service Industry Conference was held in Jinan on June 2. Provincial Party Secretary Lin Wu delivered a speech on accelerating the expansion and quality improvement of the service industry.

articles.title_zh: 习近平给中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员回信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Young Pioneer Red-Scarf Guides at CPC First Congress and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Halls
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记在“六一”国际儿童节前夕给中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员回信，勉励他们传承红色基因，在新征程上跑好历史接力赛。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of International Children's Day, President Xi Jinping sent a reply letter to Young Pioneer red-scarf guides at the CPC First Congress and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Halls, encouraging them to inherit 'red genes' and strive for national rejuvenation.

articles.title_zh: 梁言顺王清宪在合肥市看望少年儿童
articles.title_en: Liang Yanshun and Wang Qingxian Visit Children in Hefei
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日上午，安徽省委书记梁言顺和省长王清宪在合肥市看望少年儿童，强调要全面落实立德树人根本任务，促进少年儿童全面发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Anhui Provincial Party Secretary Liang Yanshun and Governor Wang Qingxian visited children in Hefei, emphasizing the fundamental task of fostering virtue through education.

articles.title_zh: 九部门部署做好科研助理岗位开发工作
articles.title_en: Nine Departments Deploy Development of Research Assistant Positions
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部等九部门于2026年6月1日印发通知，部署开发科研助理岗位，旨在促进2026届高校毕业生就业并支撑新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: Nine departments, including the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, issued a notice on June 1, 2026, to develop research assistant positions to promote employment for 2026 graduates and support new quality productive forces.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升调研督导安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Inspects and Supervises Production Safety Work
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，甘肃省委书记胡昌升在甘肃能化集团金河煤矿调研督导安全生产“百日攻坚”行动，强调要践行正确政绩观，坚决维护人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Hu Changsheng, Secretary of the Gansu Provincial Party Committee, inspected the '100-day battle' for production safety at Jinhe Coal Mine, emphasizing the need to safeguard public safety and practice a correct view of political achievement.

articles.title_zh: 任振鹤落实立德树人根本任务 努力办好人民满意的教育
articles.title_en: Ren Zhenhe Stresses Implementing Fundamental Task of Fostering Virtue to Provide Satisfactory Education
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，甘肃省长任振鹤在兰州市看望少年儿童，检查教育领域专项整治并调研思政课建设，强调要深化教育改革并整治教育领域腐败问题。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Gansu Governor Ren Zhenhe visited children in Lanzhou, inspected special rectifications in education, and researched ideological and political courses, emphasizing education reform and anti-corruption.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚在来宾市武宣县开展正确政绩观学习教育督导
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Conducts Supervision on Learning and Practicing Correct View of Political Achievements in Wuxuan County, Laibin
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，自治区党委书记陈刚赴来宾市武宣县督导正确政绩观学习教育，整治“新官不理旧账”问题，并实地调研柳梧铁路建设中的群众诉求。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Chen Gang, Secretary of the Autonomous Region Committee, visited Wuxuan County, Laibin, to supervise education on the correct view of political achievements and address the issue of "new officials ignoring old debts."

articles.title_zh: 教育部等部门开展护航行动助力“平安高考”
articles.title_en: Ministry of Education and Other Departments Launch Escort Action to Ensure 'Safe Gaokao'
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月2日，教育部会同网信、公安等部门部署开展“2026年高考护航行动”，通过打击作弊、净化环境和加强服务保障，确保高考公平与安全。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, 2026, the Ministry of Education and other departments launched the '2026 Gaokao Escort Action' to ensure exam fairness and security through anti-cheating measures and comprehensive services.

articles.title_zh: 湖南市场监管系统启动“三考”护航模式
articles.title_en: Hunan Market Supervision System Launches 'Three Exams' Escort Mode
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月1日，湖南省市场监管系统启动“三考”护航模式，聚焦食品安全、价格秩序等领域，为高考、学考、中考营造安心有序的应考环境。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, 2026, Hunan's market supervision system launched an 'escort mode' for three major exams, focusing on food safety and price order to ensure a secure testing environment.

articles.title_zh: 江苏加快推动“人工智能+医疗健康”发展
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Accelerates Development of "AI + Healthcare"
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省卫生健康委正推动“人工智能+医疗健康”部署落地，通过构建数据资源体系、研发垂类大模型及印发实施方案，提升医疗健康数智化水平。
articles.summary_en: The Jiangsu Provincial Health Commission is promoting the implementation of "AI + Healthcare" by building data resource systems, developing vertical LLMs, and issuing implementation plans to enhance digital health services.

articles.title_zh: 7273辆新能源车从江苏南通出海欧洲
articles.title_en: 7,273 New Energy Vehicles Exported to Europe from Nantong, Jiangsu
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日，装载7273辆新能源汽车的滚装船从江苏南通港启航发往欧洲，标志着南通正式具备大规模商品小汽车出口能力。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, a roll-on/roll-off ship carrying 7,273 new energy vehicles departed from Nantong Port, Jiangsu, for Europe, marking Nantong's capacity for large-scale automobile exports.

articles.title_zh: 习近平考察河南洛阳龙门石窟
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Inspects Longmen Grottoes in Luoyang, Henan
articles.summary_zh: 2025年5月，习近平总书记在河南洛阳考察龙门石窟，强调要保护好、传承好、传播好中华文化瑰宝，推动文旅产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: In May 2025, President Xi Jinping visited the Longmen Grottoes in Luoyang, Henan, emphasizing the protection, inheritance, and promotion of Chinese cultural treasures and the high-quality development of the cultural tourism industry.

articles.title_zh: “美丽中国行之探访国家公园”集中采访启动
articles.title_en: "Beautiful China Tour: Visiting National Parks" Concentrated Interview Event Launched
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，由中央宣传部等部门开展的“美丽中国行之探访国家公园”集中采访在四川省雅安市宝兴县启动，旨在宣传国家公园建设成效。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, a concentrated interview event titled "Beautiful China Tour: Visiting National Parks," organized by the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee and other departments, was launched in Baoxing County, Sichuan Province.

articles.title_zh: 济南新能源装备产业发展成效显著
articles.title_en: Jinan's New Energy Equipment Industry Shows Significant Progress
articles.summary_zh: 济南市通过实施工业强市发展战略及“头号工程”行动方案，重点发展新能源装备产业，旨在打造北方先进制造业基地。
articles.summary_en: Jinan is advancing its new energy equipment industry through the "Industrial Strength City" strategy and "No. 1 Project" action plan to build a northern advanced manufacturing base.

articles.title_zh: 新规6月起实施 一批网络餐饮违法违规案件曝光
articles.title_en: New Regulations on Online Catering Implemented as Illegal Cases Exposed
articles.summary_zh: 国家市场监管总局新规6月起实施，天津市市场监管委近期查处了一批网络餐饮违法违规案件，涉及假健康证及经营地址不符等问题。
articles.summary_en: New SAMR regulations on online catering took effect in June. The Tianjin Municipal Market Supervision Commission has exposed several illegal cases involving fake health certificates and incorrect business addresses.

articles.title_zh: 海油发展渤龙湖科研中试基地（一期）开工
articles.title_en: Construction Begins on CNOOC Development Bolong Lake Research Pilot Base (Phase I)
articles.summary_zh: 海油发展渤龙湖科研中试基地（一期）在天津滨海高新区正式开工，旨在破解海洋油气科技成果产业化瓶颈，支撑国家能源安全与海洋强国战略。
articles.summary_en: Construction of the CNOOC Development Bolong Lake Research Pilot Base (Phase I) has begun in Tianjin's Binhai High-tech Zone to accelerate the industrialization of offshore oil and gas technology.

articles.title_en: Fully Implementing "AI+" Action to Empower High-Quality Development and Modernization in Xinjiang
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，新疆维吾尔自治区党委书记陈小江、自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在乌鲁木齐市和昌吉州调研推进“人工智能+”工作，强调以AI赋能高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Chen Xiaojiang and Erken Tunyaz, top leaders of Xinjiang, conducted research in Urumqi and Changji to promote "AI+" initiatives for high-quality regional development.

articles.title_zh: 云南修订代表法实施办法
articles.title_en: Yunnan Revises Implementation Measures for the Representative Law
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月28日，云南省第十四届人大常委会审议通过了修订后的《云南省实施〈中华人民共和国全国人民代表大会和地方各级人民代表大会代表法〉办法》。

articles.title_en: Central Ecological and Environmental Protection Inspection Reports Sewage Treatment Issues in Huludao, Liaoning
articles.summary_zh: 生态环境部通报辽宁省葫芦岛市生活污水处理短板明显，且当地在多次排查中虚报未发现黑臭水体，被督察组暗查揭露。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment reported severe shortcomings in sewage treatment in Huludao, Liaoning, exposing local authorities for falsely reporting the absence of black and odorous water.

articles.title_zh: 山西省省长卢东亮下矿井检查安全生产
articles.title_en: Shanxi Governor Lu Dongliang Inspects Coal Mine Safety Production
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，山西省省长卢东亮在太原古交市检查煤矿安全生产工作，要求扎实开展专项整治，严厉打击违法生产，确保安全底线。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Shanxi Governor Lu Dongliang inspected coal mine safety production in Gujiao, Taiyuan, calling for special rectification and strict enforcement to ensure safety.

articles.title_zh: 王琳任乌鲁木齐市委书记
articles.title_en: Wang Lin Appointed Party Secretary of Urumqi
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，新疆维吾尔自治区党委书记陈小江、自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜调研“人工智能+”工作，披露王琳已任乌鲁木齐市委书记。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Xinjiang Party Secretary Chen Xiaojiang and Chairman Erkin Tuniyaz conducted research on 'AI+', revealing that Wang Lin has been appointed Party Secretary of Urumqi.

articles.summary_zh: 民政部等7部门日前联合印发通知，在“六一”国际儿童节之际开展“润心伴成长，同心护未来”主题活动，旨在培育儿童精神素养并加强关爱帮扶。
articles.summary_en: Seven departments, including the Ministry of Civil Affairs, launched the 'Nurturing Hearts for Growth, Joining Hands to Protect the Future' activity to promote children's spiritual cultivation and provide care and assistance.

articles.title_zh: 司法部发布内蒙古留守儿童盗窃获不起诉典型案例
articles.title_en: Ministry of Justice Releases Typical Case of Non-Prosecution for Left-Behind Child in Inner Mongolia
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，司法部发布五个未成年人法律援助典型案例，其中内蒙古一起涉留守儿童盗窃案在法律援助下被检察机关决定不起诉。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, the Ministry of Justice released five typical legal aid cases for minors, including a theft case in Inner Mongolia where a left-behind child was not prosecuted.

articles.title_zh: 司法部发布未成年人法律援助典型案例
articles.title_en: Ministry of Justice Releases Typical Cases of Legal Aid for Minors
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，司法部发布五个未成年人法律援助典型案例，其中一起校园霸凌案判决监护人依法承担连带赔偿责任。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, the Ministry of Justice released five typical cases of legal aid for minors, including a school bullying case where guardians were held jointly liable for compensation.

articles.title_zh: 江西省人大常委会原副主任万学文逝世
articles.title_en: Former Deputy Director of Jiangxi Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Wan Xuewen Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 万学文同志于2026年5月25日在南昌逝世，享年85岁。他曾任第十届全国人大常委会委员、江西省人大常委会副主任及农工党江西省委会主委。
articles.summary_en: Comrade Wan Xuewen, former Deputy Director of the Standing Committee of the Jiangxi Provincial People's Congress, passed away in Nanchang on May 25, 2026, at the age of 85.

articles.title_zh: 贵州大学回应“萝卜岗”招聘质疑
articles.title_en: Guizhou University Responds to Allegations of "Tailor-Made" Recruitment Post
articles.summary_zh: 贵州大学因招聘管理岗要求应聘者配偶为该校在职优秀博士而引发“萝卜岗”质疑，校方回应称简化招聘可能有特殊情况。
articles.summary_en: Guizhou University responded to allegations of a "tailor-made" recruitment post after requiring a management position applicant's spouse to be a tenured PhD at the university.

articles.title_zh: 阿东赴云南调研共青团和少先队工作
articles.title_en: A Dong Visits Yunnan to Research Communist Youth League and Young Pioneers Work
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日至29日，共青团中央书记处第一书记阿东赴云南调研共青团和少先队工作，并与云南省委书记王宁就党建带团建及青少年交流等事项进行交流。
articles.summary_en: From May 28 to 29, A Dong, First Secretary of the Secretariat of the CYL Central Committee, visited Yunnan to research CYL and Young Pioneers work and discussed youth exchange with Provincial Party Secretary Wang Ning.

articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，重庆市和四川省通信管理局通报了5款侵害用户权益的违规APP及小程序，要求其在6月9日前完成整改。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, the Communications Administrations of Chongqing and Sichuan reported five non-compliant apps and mini-programs for violating user rights, demanding rectification by June 9.

articles.title_en: Chen Wenqing Visits Kazakhstan

articles.summary_en: Chen Wenqing, Politburo member and Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, visited Kazakhstan from May 29 to June 1 to discuss deepening law enforcement and security cooperation.

articles.summary_en: On May 29, the Qinghai Province Service Industry Conference was held in Xining. Provincial Party Secretary Wu Xiaojun and Governor Luo Dongchuan attended to deploy measures for the high-quality development of the service industry.

articles.title_en: Tibet to Launch 'Tour Tibet' and Other Cultural Tourism Activities During 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 西藏自治区政府常务副主席任维在拉萨举行的专题新闻发布会上表示，西藏将在“十五五”期间推出“畅游西藏”等系列活动，旨在到2030年基本建成文化强区、旅游强区。
articles.summary_en: Ren Wei, Executive Vice Chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region Government, announced at a press conference in Lhasa that Tibet will launch activities like 'Tour Tibet' during the 15th Five-Year Plan to become a cultural and tourism powerhouse by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 西藏持之以恒推进稳定发展生态强边四件大事
articles.title_en: Tibet Persistently Promotes Four Major Tasks of Stability, Development, Ecology, and Border Strengthening
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，西藏在拉萨举行“十五五”专场新闻发布会，由嘎玛泽登等领导介绍西藏在稳定、发展、生态、强边四方面的规划与成效。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, a press conference for the 15th Five-Year Plan was held in Lhasa, where officials outlined Tibet's strategies and achievements in stability, development, ecology, and border strengthening.

articles.title_zh: 西藏将启动首次生物多样性本底调查和物种编目工作
articles.title_en: Tibet to Launch First Biodiversity Baseline Survey and Species Cataloging
articles.summary_zh: 西藏自治区政府常务副主席旦巴宣布，西藏将启动首次生物多样性本底调查和物种编目工作，并探索制定生物多样性保护条例。
articles.summary_en: Danba, Executive Vice Chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region Government, announced the launch of the region's first biodiversity baseline survey and species cataloging.

articles.title_zh: 冯飞在临高调研乡村振兴工作
articles.title_en: Feng Fei Conducts Research on Rural Revitalization in Lingao
articles.summary_zh: 5月30日至31日，省委书记冯飞在临高县铺仔村蹲点调研，强调坚持党建引领，巩固脱贫攻坚成果并扎实推进乡村全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: From May 30 to 31, Provincial Party Secretary Feng Fei conducted a research trip in Puzai Village, Lingao County, emphasizing Party leadership to consolidate poverty alleviation achievements and promote rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古自贸试验区满洲里片区首个落地项目开工
articles.title_en: First Project in Manzhouli Area of Inner Mongolia Free Trade Zone Starts Construction
articles.summary_zh: 5月30日，由内蒙古国贸集团投资建设的满洲里陆港粮油和化肥产业项目开工，这是内蒙古自贸试验区满洲里片区的首个落地项目。
articles.summary_en: On May 30, the Manzhouli Land Port Grain, Oil, and Fertilizer Industry Project invested by Inner Mongolia International Trade Group commenced construction, marking the first project in the Manzhouli area of the Inner Mongolia FTZ.

articles.title_zh: 成渝中线高铁正式启动铺轨
articles.title_en: Track Laying Officially Begins for Chengdu-Chongqing Middle Line High-Speed Railway
articles.summary_zh: 5月30日，成渝中线高铁在四川成都简阳正式启动铺轨施工，标志着项目全面转入线上施工阶段，为全线按期通车奠定基础。
articles.summary_en: On May 30, track laying officially began for the Chengdu-Chongqing Middle Line High-Speed Railway in Jianyang, Chengdu, marking the project's transition to the online construction phase.

articles.title_zh: 寒旱区生态环境区域科技创新联盟成立
articles.title_en: Cold and Arid Region Ecological Environment Regional Science and Technology Innovation Alliance Established
articles.summary_zh: 5月30日，寒旱区生态环境区域科技创新联盟在兰州成立。该联盟由甘肃省科技厅发起，旨在协同攻关寒旱区生态保护与可持续发展等关键技术。
articles.summary_en: On May 30, the Cold and Arid Region Ecological Environment Regional Science and Technology Innovation Alliance was established in Lanzhou to collaborate on ecological protection and sustainable development.

articles.title_zh: 四部门印发教育引导未成年人工作指南
articles.title_en: Four Departments Issue Guidelines for Educating and Guiding Minors
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日，最高人民法院、教育部、共青团中央、全国妇联联合印发工作指南，旨在健全家校社协同育人体系，预防未成年人思想行为偏差。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, the Supreme People's Court, Ministry of Education, CYL Central Committee, and All-China Women's Federation jointly issued guidelines to strengthen the education of minors and prevent behavioral deviations.

articles.title_zh: 公安部部署宣传活动守护未成年人成长
articles.title_en: Ministry of Public Security Deploys Publicity Activities to Protect Minors' Growth
articles.summary_zh: 公安部新闻宣传局于5月31日发出通知，组织开展“守护平安 与你‘童’行”宣传活动，旨在提升未成年人的法治素养和安全意识。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Public Security's News Bureau issued a notice on May 31 to launch the 'Guardian of Peace' campaign to enhance legal literacy and safety awareness among minors.

articles.title_zh: 共青团中央书记处召开扩大会议学习习近平总书记给少先队红领巾讲解员回信精神
articles.title_en: Secretariat of CYL Central Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Reply to Young Pioneers' Red Scarf Commentators
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日，共青团中央书记处召开扩大会议，传达学习习近平总书记给中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员的重要回信精神。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, the Secretariat of the CYL Central Committee held an enlarged meeting to study and implement President Xi Jinping's reply letter to Young Pioneers' red scarf commentators.

articles.title_zh: “歼-8之父”顾诵芬院士逝世，享年96岁
articles.title_en: Academician Gu Songfen, the 'Father of J-8', Passes Away at 96
articles.summary_zh: 中国科学院和中国工程院院士、著名飞机设计大师顾诵芬于2026年5月31日逝世，享年96岁。
articles.summary_en: Gu Songfen, a member of both the Chinese Academy of Sciences and the Chinese Academy of Engineering and a renowned aircraft designer, passed away on May 31, 2026, at the age of 96.

articles.title_zh: 哈尔滨突现强对流天气，市委书记于洪涛与市长王合生部署应对工作
articles.title_en: Harbin Experiences Severe Convective Weather; Party Secretary Yu Hongtao and Mayor Wang Hesheng Deploy Response Measures
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日哈尔滨出现罕见高温及强对流天气，市委书记于洪涛与市长王合生召开视频会议，调度部署极端天气应对工作。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, Harbin experienced rare high temperatures and severe convective weather. Party Secretary Yu Hongtao and Mayor Wang Hesheng held a video conference to deploy emergency response measures.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲到佳木斯市和双鸭山市调研督导中央生态环境保护督察边督边改工作
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Inspects Rectification of Central Ecological and Environmental Protection Inspections in Jiamusi and Shuangyashan
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日，黑龙江省长梁惠玲到佳木斯市和双鸭山市调研督导中央生态环境保护督察边督边改工作，强调要落实整改要求，严守耕地保护红线。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling visited Jiamusi and Shuangyashan to supervise the rectification of central ecological and environmental protection inspections, emphasizing farmland protection.

articles.title_zh: 习近平回信勉励中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Young Pioneer Guides at CPC First Congress and Nanhu Memorial Halls
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月31日，习近平给中共一大纪念馆和南湖革命纪念馆的少先队红领巾讲解员回信，勉励他们传承红色基因，并祝全国少年儿童节日快乐。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, 2026, Xi Jinping replied to Young Pioneer guides at the CPC First Congress and Nanhu Memorial Halls, encouraging them to inherit 'red genes' and wishing children a happy International Children's Day.

articles.title_zh: 北京市委党校成立首都国际传播研究中心
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal Party School Establishes Capital International Communication Research Center
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日，中共北京市委党校举办学术研讨会并宣布成立首都国际传播研究中心，旨在提升国际传播能力，服务国家外宣大局。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, the Beijing Municipal Party School held an academic seminar and announced the establishment of the Capital International Communication Research Center to enhance international communication capabilities.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁到新乡鹤壁调研推进南水北调后续工程高质量发展和防汛备汛工作
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Inspects Xinxiang and Hebi to Promote High-Quality Development of South-to-North Water Diversion Project and Flood Control Preparations
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日，省委书记刘宁到新乡市、鹤壁市调研南水北调后续工程及防汛备汛工作，强调要确保工程、供水与水质安全，坚决守住不发生群死群伤底线。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning visited Xinxiang and Hebi to inspect the South-to-North Water Diversion Project and flood control preparations, emphasizing water security and disaster prevention.

articles.title_zh: 王凯到南阳调研“三夏”生产工作
articles.title_en: Wang Kai Conducts Research on "Three Summers" Production in Nanyang
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日，河南省省长王凯到南阳邓州市调研“三夏”生产及安全生产工作，强调要扛稳粮食安全重任并守住安全发展底线。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, Henan Governor Wang Kai visited Dengzhou, Nanyang to inspect "Three Summers" agricultural production and safety work, emphasizing food security and safety management.

articles.title_zh: 7273辆新能源车从江苏南通出海欧洲
articles.title_en: 7,273 New Energy Vehicles Exported from Nantong, Jiangsu to Europe
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日，装载7273辆新能源汽车的滚装船从江苏南通港启航发往欧洲，标志着南通正式具备大规模商品小汽车出口能力。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, a roll-on/roll-off ship carrying 7,273 new energy vehicles departed from Nantong Port, Jiangsu, for Europe, marking Nantong's capacity for large-scale vehicle exports.

articles.title_zh: 2026年江苏省“新时代好少年”先进事迹发布
articles.title_en: Release of 2026 'New Era Good Youth' Advanced Deeds in Jiangsu Province
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日，江苏省精神文明建设办公室等部门在东台市举行2026年“新时代好少年”先进事迹发布活动，推出30人（组）榜样以引领青少年成长。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, the Jiangsu Provincial Spiritual Civilization Construction Office and other departments held an event in Dongtai to release the advanced deeds of 30 'New Era Good Youth' to inspire teenagers.

articles.title_zh: 天津人工智能传感器产业园开园 首批企业集中签约
articles.title_en: Tianjin AI Sensor Industrial Park Opens with First Batch of Enterprise Signings
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月31日，天津人工智能传感器产业园正式开园，首批10家企业集中签约，并与多家高校、协会达成产教融合与金融赋能合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, 2026, the Tianjin AI Sensor Industrial Park officially opened, featuring the signing of the first batch of 10 enterprises and various cooperation agreements on industry-education integration.

articles.title_zh: 全国人大常委会启动职业教育法执法检查
articles.title_en: NPC Standing Committee Launches Law Enforcement Inspection of Vocational Education Law
articles.summary_zh: 全国人大常委会于6月1日在北京启动职业教育法执法检查，旨在推动法律实施并推进现代职业教育体系建设。
articles.summary_en: The NPC Standing Committee launched a law enforcement inspection of the Vocational Education Law on June 1 in Beijing to promote its implementation and the construction of a modern vocational education system.

articles.title_zh: 打造东中部产业向西转移重要承接地
articles.title_en: Building an Important Receiving Area for the Transfer of Industries from East and Central China to the West
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省委书记胡昌升在《求是》杂志发表署名文章，阐述甘肃打造东中部产业向西转移重要承接地的路径与思考，以推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Hu Changsheng, Secretary of the Gansu Provincial Party Committee, published an article in Qiushi magazine on strategies to make Gansu a key hub for industrial transfer from East and Central China.

articles.title_zh: 2026年四川省革命博物馆纪念馆“一馆一课”宣传展示月启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Sichuan Revolutionary Museum 'One Museum, One Lesson' Promotion Month Launched
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月1日，四川省革命博物馆纪念馆“一馆一课”宣传展示月在绵阳梓潼启动，旨在通过革命文物资源赋能思政教育，传承革命精神。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, 2026, the 'One Museum, One Lesson' promotion month for revolutionary museums was launched in Zitong, Sichuan, aiming to integrate revolutionary cultural relics with ideological and political education.

articles.title_zh: 空间遥感+人工智能 中国团队创新成果助力全球文化遗产保护
articles.title_en: Space Remote Sensing and AI: Chinese Team's Innovation Aids Global Cultural Heritage Protection
articles.summary_zh: 中国科学院空天信息创新研究院HIST团队利用空间遥感与人工智能技术编制全球文化遗产监测图集，为全球文化遗产保护贡献中国智慧。
articles.summary_en: The HIST team of the Chinese Academy of Sciences developed a global cultural heritage monitoring atlas using space remote sensing and AI to support global heritage preservation.

articles.title_zh: 韩正会见巴西外长维埃拉
articles.title_en: Han Zheng Meets Brazilian Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月1日，国家副主席韩正在北京会见巴西外长维埃拉，双方探讨深化中巴战略协作及命运共同体建设。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, 2026, Vice President Han Zheng met with Brazilian Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira in Beijing to discuss deepening China-Brazil strategic coordination and the construction of a community with a shared future.

articles.title_zh: 刚果（金）暴发埃博拉疫情 外交部：中国医疗队在当地坚守
articles.title_en: Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo: China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs Says Medical Teams are on the Ground
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，外交部发言人林剑表示，中国将向暴发埃博拉疫情的刚果（金）提供紧急人道主义援助并派遣医疗专家组，支持非洲抗疫。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, MFA spokesperson Lin Jian announced that China will provide emergency humanitarian aid and dispatch medical experts to DR Congo to combat the Ebola outbreak.

articles.title_zh: 外交部反对《纽约时报》为“台独”谬论提供平台
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Opposes The New York Times Providing Platform for "Taiwan Independence" Fallacies
articles.summary_zh: 外交部发言人林剑6月1日在例行记者会上表示，中方坚决反对《纽约时报》为“台独”谬论提供平台并公然将台湾称为“国家”。
articles.summary_en: Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian stated on June 1 that China strongly opposes The New York Times providing a platform for "Taiwan independence" fallacies and referring to Taiwan as a "country."

articles.title_zh: 外交部对日方推进同北约合作动向表示严重关切
articles.title_en: Ministry of Foreign Affairs Expresses Serious Concern Over Japan's Cooperation with NATO
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月1日，外交部发言人林剑在例行记者会上表示，中方对日本推进同北约合作、扩大自卫队活动范围的动向表示严重关切。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, 2026, MFA spokesperson Lin Jian expressed serious concern over Japan's moves to promote cooperation with NATO and expand the activities of the Self-Defense Forces.

articles.title_zh: 习近平给中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队讲解员回信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Reply Letter to Young Pioneer Guides at CPC Memorial Halls
articles.summary_zh: 在国际儿童节到来之际，习近平给中共一大纪念馆和南湖革命纪念馆的少先队红领巾讲解员回信，予以亲切勉励。
articles.summary_en: On the occasion of International Children's Day, Xi Jinping sent a reply letter to Young Pioneer guides at the First National Congress of the CPC Memorial Hall and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Hall, offering warm encouragement.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：日方近期一系列错误言行 国际社会必须高度警惕
articles.title_en: Ministry of Foreign Affairs: International Community Must Be Highly Vigilant Against Japan's Recent Erroneous Words and Deeds
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，外交部发言人林剑在例行记者会上表示，国际社会必须高度警惕并共同遏制日方的“新型军国主义”言行。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, MFA spokesperson Lin Jian stated during a regular press conference that the international community must remain highly vigilant and jointly curb Japan's "new militarism."

articles.title_zh: 中方回应日本防卫大臣言论：毫无根据、苍白无力
articles.title_en: China Responds to Japanese Defense Minister's Remarks: Groundless and Feeble
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月1日，外交部发言人林剑在例行记者会上回应日本防卫大臣言论，指责日方回避历史罪责并企图军事扩张，威胁地区和平稳定。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, 2026, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian responded to remarks by Japan's Defense Minister, accusing Japan of evading historical responsibility and pursuing military expansion, threatening regional peace and stability.

articles.title_zh: 中方对日方推进同北约合作的动向表示严重关切
articles.title_en: China Expresses Serious Concern Over Japan's Cooperation with NATO
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月1日，中国外交部发言人林剑在例行记者会上表示，中方对日本推进同北约合作、派遣人员前往乌克兰等动向表示严重关切。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, 2026, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian expressed serious concern over Japan's moves to advance cooperation with NATO and deploy personnel to Ukraine.

articles.title_zh: 中方将继续同安理会成员和各方加强在联合国团结协作
articles.title_en: China to Continue Strengthening Unity and Cooperation with UN Security Council Members and All Parties
articles.summary_zh: 外交部发言人林剑6月1日在北京主持记者会，回顾中国担任5月联合国安理会轮值主席的工作，强调将继续践行多边主义并维护联合国宪章。
articles.summary_en: Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian held a press conference in Beijing on June 1, reviewing China's role as the rotating presidency of the UN Security Council in May and emphasizing the commitment to multilateralism.

articles.title_zh: 7部门部署开展2026年“润心伴成长，同心护未来”主题活动
articles.title_en: Seven Departments Deploy 2026 'Nurturing Hearts for Growth, Joining Hearts to Protect the Future' Theme Activity
articles.summary_zh: 七部门部署在2026年“六一”国际儿童节期间开展“润心伴成长，同心护未来”主题活动，旨在加强儿童精神素养培育、权益保障及关爱帮扶。
articles.summary_en: Seven departments deployed the 2026 'Nurturing Hearts for Growth, Joining Hearts to Protect the Future' theme activity for International Children's Day to enhance children's spiritual cultivation, rights protection, and care.

articles.title_zh: 外交部坚决遏制日本“新型军国主义”成势为患
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: Firmly Curb Japan's "Neo-Militarism" from Becoming a Menace
articles.summary_zh: 外交部发言人林剑6月1日在例行记者会上表示，日本官员关于反对被标记为“新型军国主义”的说辞毫无根据，国际社会应共同防范并遏制其成势为患。
articles.summary_en: Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian stated on June 1 that Japan's claims against being labeled as "neo-militaristic" are baseless, urging the international community to curb "neo-militarism."

articles.title_zh: 习近平给少先队红领巾讲解员回信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Reply Letter to Young Pioneer Red-Scarf Guides
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记在“六一”国际儿童节之际，给中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆的少先队红领巾讲解员回信并予以勉励。
articles.summary_en: On the occasion of International Children's Day, President Xi Jinping sent a reply letter to Young Pioneer red-scarf guides at the Memorial Hall of the First National Congress of the CPC and the Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Hall.

articles.title_zh: 各地少先队开展“六一”主题活动
articles.title_en: Young Pioneers Across China Carry Out June 1st Themed Activities
articles.summary_zh: 共青团中央、全国少工委部署开展“六一”国际儿童节主题活动，引导少先队员学习党史、传承红色基因并增长知识本领。
articles.summary_en: The Communist Youth League Central Committee and the National Working Committee for Young Pioneers organized themed activities for International Children's Day to guide Young Pioneers in learning Party history and inheriting the 'red gene'.

articles.title_zh: 习近平回信勉励中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Reply Letter Encouraging Young Pioneer Guides at CPC Memorial Halls
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月31日，习近平给中共一大纪念馆和南湖革命纪念馆的少先队红领巾讲解员回信，勉励他们传承红色基因，并祝全国儿童节日快乐。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, 2026, Xi Jinping sent a reply letter to Young Pioneer guides at the CPC First National Congress Memorial Hall and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Hall, encouraging them to inherit the 'red gene'.

articles.title_zh: 前瞻布局和发展未来产业
articles.title_en: Forward-looking Layout and Development of Future Industries
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月1日，《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章，强调要加强统筹谋划，以科技创新为引领，前瞻布局和发展未来产业。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, 2026, Qiushi magazine published an important article by General Secretary Xi Jinping, emphasizing strategic planning and tech innovation to develop future industries.

articles.title_zh: 强化自然资源保障 不断蓄积发展动能
articles.title_en: Strengthening Natural Resource Security to Accumulate Development Momentum
articles.summary_zh: 自然资源部通过下沉一线、深化改革和数字赋能等措施，优化资源要素配置，保障“十五五”重大项目落地及国家资源安全。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Natural Resources is optimizing resource allocation through frontline services, reform, and digitalization to support major projects for the 15th Five-Year Plan and ensure national resource security.

articles.title_zh: 绿色“处方”上新，小麦抵抗力升级
articles.title_en: New Green "Prescriptions" Enhance Wheat Resistance
articles.summary_zh: 河南省封丘县推广中国农业科学院的“两种一晚一喷”绿色防控技术，有效降低小麦病虫害损失并提升产量与品质。
articles.summary_en: Fengqiu County in Henan Province promoted the "two types, one late, one spray" green control technology from the Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences to reduce wheat losses and increase yields.

articles.title_zh: 让“小胖墩”“小眼镜”少一些
articles.title_en: Reducing 'Little Fatties' and 'Little Glasses'
articles.summary_zh: 报道全国各地落实习近平总书记关于青少年健康的关切，通过增加体育锻炼和近视防控，推动“健康第一”教育理念落地。
articles.summary_en: The report highlights nationwide efforts to implement Xi Jinping's concerns for youth health by increasing physical exercise and myopia prevention to promote the 'health first' education philosophy.

articles.title_zh: 科技赋能夏收夏种 助力粮食稳产丰收
articles.title_en: Technology Empowers Summer Harvest and Planting to Ensure Stable Grain Production
articles.summary_zh: 在“三夏”农忙时节，安徽和新疆等地利用智慧农机和AI机器人赋能夏收夏种，提升作业效率并助力粮食稳产丰收。
articles.summary_en: During the 'Three Summers' farming season, regions such as Anhui and Xinjiang are utilizing smart machinery and AI robots to enhance summer harvesting and planting for stable grain production.

articles.title_zh: 王毅同巴西外长维埃拉举行中巴外长级全面战略对话
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Holds China-Brazil Foreign Ministers' Strategic Dialogue with Brazilian Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，外交部长王毅在北京同巴西外长维埃拉举行第五次中巴外长级全面战略对话，双方探讨深化命运共同体建设及多领域合作。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Foreign Minister Wang Yi held the 5th China-Brazil Foreign Ministers' Strategic Dialogue with Brazilian Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira in Beijing to deepen the community with a shared future and enhance cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 李强签署国务院令公布《国务院关于对外投资的规定》
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Decree to Publish Regulations on Outward Investment
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强签署国务院令，公布《国务院关于对外投资的规定》，旨在促进对外投资高质量发展并维护国家安全，自2026年7月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council decree to publish the "Regulations of the State Council on Outward Investment," effective July 1, 2026, to promote high-quality outward investment and safeguard national security.

articles.title_zh: 我国优化运输结构调整成效明显 去年集装箱多式联运量同比增长超15%
articles.title_en: China's Transport Structure Optimization Shows Significant Results with Over 15% Growth in Multimodal Container Transport
articles.summary_zh: 2025年我国多式联运稳步增长，集装箱多式联运量同比增长超15%，枢纽通道进一步完善，运输结构优化成效明显。
articles.summary_en: In 2025, China's multimodal transport grew steadily, with container volume increasing by over 15% and improved hub channels, showing significant results in optimizing the transport structure.

articles.title_zh: 前4月全国社会物流总额同比增长5.5% 即时零售交易额增长29.2%
articles.title_en: China's Social Logistics Total Grows 5.5% in First Four Months, Instant Retail Up 29.2%
articles.summary_zh: 中国物流与采购联合会数据显示，今年1-4月全国社会物流总额同比增长5.5%，其中工业物流稳健增长，即时零售等新模式发展迅速。
articles.summary_en: Data from the China Federation of Logistics & Purchasing shows that China's social logistics total grew 5.5% from January to April, driven by steady industrial logistics and rapid growth in instant retail.

articles.title_zh: 长征十二号乙遥一运载火箭发射成功
articles.title_en: Long March 12B Y1 Carrier Rocket Successfully Launched
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月1日，长征十二号乙遥一运载火箭在东风商业航天创新试验区成功发射，将千帆极轨08组卫星送入预定轨道。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, 2026, the Long March 12B Y1 carrier rocket was successfully launched from the Dongfeng Commercial Aerospace Innovation Test Zone, placing the Qianfan Polar Orbit 08 satellites into orbit.

articles.title_zh: 中科院院士周成虎被查
articles.title_en: CAS Academician Zhou Chenghu Placed Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 中央纪委国家监委通报，中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所原副所长周成虎涉嫌严重职务违法，目前正接受监察调查。
articles.summary_en: The CCDI and NSC announced that Zhou Chenghu, former deputy director of the CAS Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, is under investigation for serious duty-related violations.

tags.name_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

tags_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

articles.title_zh: 教育部：高考命题突出反套路导向，莫信AI或“专家”押题
articles.title_en: Ministry of Education: Gaokao Question Setting Emphasizes Anti-Pattern Orientation, Warns Against AI and 'Expert' Predictions
articles.summary_zh: 教育部近日发布涉考陷阱案例，提醒考生警惕AI或专家押题骗局，并强调高考命题将突出反套路导向，严厉打击考试作弊。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Education issued warnings against exam prediction scams involving AI and 'experts,' emphasizing an anti-pattern approach to Gaokao question setting and strict crackdowns on cheating.

articles.title_zh: 袁古洁任中央政府驻港联络办副主任
articles.title_en: Yuan Gujie Appointed Deputy Director of the Office of the Central People's Government in the Hong Kong SAR
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，国务院任命袁古洁为中央人民政府驻香港特别行政区联络办公室副主任，并免去刘光源该职务。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, the State Council appointed Yuan Gujie as Deputy Director of the Office of the Central People's Government in the Hong Kong SAR and removed Liu Guangyuan from the position.

articles.title_zh: 反制日菲！中国海警实现环台岛执法
articles.title_en: China Coast Guard Conducts Law Enforcement Patrols Around Taiwan Island to Counter Japan and Philippines
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，中国海警岱山舰编队在台湾岛以东海域开展执法巡查，以反制日本和菲律宾单方面启动该海域划界谈判的行为。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, the China Coast Guard's Daishan ship formation conducted law enforcement patrols in the waters east of Taiwan Island to counter unilateral boundary negotiations initiated by Japan and the Philippines.

articles.title_zh: 董亦军、尹春燕、贺娇龙等拟获全国“两优一先”表彰
articles.title_en: Dong Yijun, Yin Chunyan, and He Jiaolong Proposed for National 'Two Excellences and One Advanced' Commendations
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，《人民日报》公示全国“两优一先”拟表彰对象，其中董亦军、尹春燕、贺娇龙等149名人员拟获评全国优秀共产党员。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, People's Daily announced the proposed candidates for the national 'Two Excellences and One Advanced' awards, with 149 individuals, including Dong Yijun, Yin Chunyan, and He Jiaolong, nominated as National Outstanding Communist Party Members.

articles.title_zh: 我国团队成功实现全球首例人体“猪肝+猪双肾”联合移植
articles.title_en: Chinese Team Achieves World's First Combined Pig Liver and Double Kidney Transplantation into Human
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，广西医科大学第二附属医院孙煦勇团队成功实现全球首例人体“猪肝+猪双肾”联合移植，标志着多器官异种移植进入实质性临床探索阶段。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, a team led by Sun Xuyong from the Second Affiliated Hospital of Guangxi Medical University successfully performed the world's first combined pig liver and double kidney transplant into a human.

articles.title_zh: 安徽各地深入开展对村巡察，织密对村巡察监督网
articles.title_en: Various Regions in Anhui Intensify Village Inspections to Strengthen Supervision Network
articles.summary_zh: 安徽省各地通过创新宣传方式、构建智慧巡察体系及深化巡纪联动，深入开展对村巡察，旨在加强基层监督并促进基层治理。
articles.summary_en: Various regions in Anhui Province are conducting in-depth village inspections through innovative publicity, smart supervision systems, and coordinated disciplinary actions to enhance grassroots governance.

articles.title_zh: 寿宁县探索组建片区共富联合体引领乡村振兴
articles.title_en: Shouning County Explores Common Prosperity Joint Bodies to Lead Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 近日，福建省宁德市寿宁县通过组建片区共富联合体，以高质量党建引领资源共享与产业联动，有效破解村域发展不平衡问题，推动乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Shouning County in Ningde, Fujian, established Common Prosperity Joint Bodies to promote resource sharing and industrial linkage through high-quality party building, addressing unbalanced village development and advancing rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 新修订的《厦门经济特区建筑条例》6月1日起施行
articles.title_en: Newly Revised Xiamen Special Economic Zone Construction Regulations Take Effect on June 1
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月1日起，新修订的《厦门经济特区建筑条例》正式施行，旨在通过法治手段推动建筑业高质量发展，并首创智能建造专章及涉台相关条款。
articles.summary_en: The newly revised Xiamen Special Economic Zone Construction Regulations took effect on June 1, 2026, aiming to promote high-quality development of the construction industry with new chapters on intelligent construction and cross-strait cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 2026年广西全民数字素养与技能提升月启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Guangxi Universal Digital Literacy and Skills Improvement Month Launched
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月1日，广西启动全民数字素养与技能提升月活动，旨在通过多部门协同提升全民数字化能力，筑牢数字广西建设根基。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, 2026, Guangxi launched the Universal Digital Literacy and Skills Improvement Month to enhance digital capabilities across the population and support the construction of Digital Guangxi.

articles.title_zh: 倪岳峰在石家庄看望慰问少年儿童
articles.title_en: Ni Yuefeng Visits and Greets Children in Shijiazhuang
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，河北省委书记倪岳峰在石家庄市看望慰问少年儿童，强调要坚持德智体美劳全面发展，健全未成年人关爱保护体系。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Ni Yuefeng, Secretary of the Hebei Provincial Party Committee, visited children in Shijiazhuang, emphasizing holistic development and the improvement of care and protection systems for minors.

articles.title_zh: 海南省城镇燃气发展规划（2026-2035年）出台
articles.title_en: Hainan Province Issues Urban Gas Development Plan (2026-2035)
articles.summary_zh: 海南省政府办公厅近日印发《海南省城镇燃气发展规划（2026-2035年）》，旨在扩大天然气管道覆盖范围并推动燃气行业数字化转型与高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of the Hainan Provincial Government issued the Urban Gas Development Plan (2026-2035) to expand natural gas pipeline coverage and promote digitalization and high-quality development of the gas industry.

articles.title_zh: 无锡入选中央财政支持实施城市更新行动城市
articles.title_en: Wuxi Selected for Central Government-Supported Urban Renewal Action
articles.summary_zh: 财政部与住建部近日公布2026年度中央财政支持实施城市更新行动评选结果，无锡市成功入选拟支持的15个城市之一。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development announced that Wuxi is among 15 cities selected for the 2026 central government-supported urban renewal action.
