articles.title_zh: 中钨高新西南研发中心在成都开工
articles.title_en: Construction of Zhongwu High-tech Southwest R&D Center Begins in Chengdu
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中钨高新西南研发中心建设项目在成都经开区开工，该项目由中国五矿与成都市合作打造，旨在构建硬质材料及工具领域的协同创新平台。
articles.summary_en: The construction of the Zhongwu High-tech Southwest R&D Center recently began in Chengdu's Economic Development Zone, a collaborative project between China Minmetals and Chengdu to build an innovation platform for hard materials and tools.

articles.title_zh: 习近平给中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员回信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Young Pioneer Guides of First CPC Congress Memorial Hall and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Hall
articles.summary_zh: 在六一国际儿童节前夕，习近平总书记给上海中共一大纪念馆和浙江南湖革命纪念馆的少先队红领巾讲解员回信，予以亲切勉励。
articles.summary_en: On the eve of International Children's Day, President Xi Jinping sent a reply letter to Young Pioneer guides from the First CPC Congress Memorial Hall and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Hall, offering warm encouragement.

articles.title_zh: 2026年山东省交通运输重点工程“强国示范”劳动竞赛启动
articles.title_en: 2026 'Strong Nation Demonstration' Labor Competition for Key Transport Projects Launched in Shandong Province
articles.summary_zh: 山东省交通运输厅与省总工会近日启动2026年全省交通运输重点工程“强国示范”劳动竞赛，共确认64个参赛项目，旨在提升工程质量与施工进度。
articles.summary_en: The Shandong Provincial Department of Transport and the Provincial Federation of Trade Unions recently launched the 2026 'Strong Nation Demonstration' labor competition for key transport projects, involving 64 projects.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席复信参加“共航蔚蓝：中美青年友谊行”活动的两国学生
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Replies to Students Participating in 'Sailing the Blue: China-US Youth Friendship Tour'
articles.summary_zh: 5月23日，习近平主席复信参加“共航蔚蓝：中美青年友谊行”活动的中美学生，强调加强青年交流有助于增进两国了解，推动中美关系稳定健康发展。
articles.summary_en: On May 23, President Xi Jinping replied to Chinese and US students participating in the 'Sailing the Blue: China-US Youth Friendship Tour,' emphasizing that youth exchange helps enhance mutual understanding and promotes the stable development of China-US relations.

articles.title_zh: 浦东政协举行“企业话发展”下午茶活动聚焦生物医药创新
articles.title_en: Pudong CPPCC Holds 'Enterprises Talk Development' Event Focusing on Biopharmaceutical Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，浦东新区政协在张江举行“企业话发展”下午茶活动，与生物医药企业家交流，探讨全链条创新策源及优化营商环境。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, the Pudong New Area CPPCC held an 'Enterprises Talk Development' event in Zhangjiang to discuss biopharmaceutical innovation and optimize the business environment with entrepreneurs.

articles.title_zh: 习近平给中共一大纪念馆等少先队红领巾讲解员回信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Young Pioneer Red Scarf Guides at Revolutionary Memorial Halls
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记在“六一”国际儿童节前夕给中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员回信，勉励青少年传承红色基因，上海相关单位积极响应并深化红色育人教育。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping sent a reply letter to Young Pioneer red scarf guides at the Museum of the First National Congress of the CPC and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Hall, encouraging youth to inherit the 'red gene.'

articles.title_zh: 云南红河推动对越合作向“流域模式”升级
articles.title_en: Honghe, Yunnan Promotes Upgrade of Cooperation with Vietnam to "Basin Model"
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，红河州州长罗萍在新闻发布会上表示，红河州将推动对越合作从“沿边模式”向“流域模式”升级，构建跨境产业廊道并完善互联互通基础设施。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Honghe Governor Luo Ping announced the upgrade of cooperation with Vietnam from a "border-line model" to a "basin model," focusing on cross-border industrial corridors and infrastructure.

articles.title_zh: “七一勋章”提名建议人选公示
articles.title_en: Publicity on Nominated Candidates for the "July 1st Medal"
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央组织部等部门公示了中国共产党成立105周年“七一勋章”的8名提名建议人选，以表彰为党和人民作出杰出贡献的党员。
articles.summary_en: The Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and other departments publicized 8 nominated candidates for the "July 1st Medal" to commemorate the 105th anniversary of the CPC.

articles.title_zh: 最高检：2025年未成年人犯罪和侵害未成年人犯罪实现“双下降”
articles.title_en: Supreme People's Procuratorate: Juvenile Crime and Crimes Against Juveniles See "Double Decline" in 2025
articles.summary_zh: 最高人民检察院于6月1日发布《未成年人检察工作白皮书（2025）》，报告显示2025年未成年人犯罪和侵害未成年人犯罪近五年首次实现“双下降”。
articles.summary_en: The Supreme People's Procuratorate released the 2025 White Paper on Juvenile Prosecution on June 1, reporting the first "double decline" in juvenile crime and crimes against juveniles in five years.

articles.title_zh: 福建省发布32款2026年适老化新产品
articles.title_en: Fujian Province Releases 32 New Age-Friendly Products for 2026
articles.summary_zh: 福建省工信厅近日发布2026年福建省适老化新产品名单，共有32款产品入选，涵盖厦门、宁德等多个地市。
articles.summary_en: The Fujian Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology recently released a list of 32 new age-friendly products for 2026, featuring products from Xiamen, Ningde, and other cities.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省出台16项举措提质提速“三北”工程建设
articles.title_en: Gansu Province Introduces 16 Measures to Improve and Accelerate 'Three-North' Project Construction
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省政府办公厅印发意见，推出16项举措提升“三北”工程建设质量，目标到2030年建成河西走廊防风固沙阻击带。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of Gansu Provincial Government issued guidelines with 16 measures to enhance the 'Three-North' Project, aiming to establish a wind-sand barrier in the Hexi Corridor by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 花艳履新金陵饭店集团总经理
articles.title_en: Hua Yan Appointed General Manager of Jinling Hotel Group
articles.summary_zh: 近日，花艳出任金陵饭店集团党委副书记、总经理。此前，江苏省委组织部已对其任职前公示。
articles.summary_en: Hua Yan has been appointed as the Deputy Secretary of the Party Committee and General Manager of Jinling Hotel Group following a public notice by the Organization Department of the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee.

tags_en: Organization Department of the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee

articles.title_zh: 江西省林业生物多样性保护公报(2026)发布
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Province Releases 2026 Forestry Biodiversity Conservation Bulletin
articles.summary_zh: 江西省林业局日前发布2026年林业生物多样性保护公报，介绍了全省在物种资源更新、保护网络体系完善及科研监测方面的成效。
articles.summary_en: The Jiangxi Provincial Forestry Bureau released the 2026 Forestry Biodiversity Conservation Bulletin, highlighting achievements in species resource updates, protection network improvement, and scientific monitoring.

articles.title_zh: 一批儿童相关国家标准发布
articles.title_en: A Batch of National Standards Related to Children Released
articles.summary_zh: 国家市场监督管理总局近日发布一批儿童相关国家标准，涵盖毛绒玩具、电动童车、儿童伞具及未成年人上网等方面，旨在筑牢儿童安全防护屏障。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation recently released a series of national standards for children's products and internet access to enhance safety protections for minors.

articles.title_zh: 全国共有少先队员1.12亿名
articles.title_en: China Has 112 Million Young Pioneers
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，全国少工委公布数据显示，截至2025年底，全国共有少先队员1.12亿名，中小学校少先队辅导员近300万名。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, the National Working Committee for Young Pioneers reported that as of the end of 2025, there were 112 million Young Pioneers and nearly 3 million counselors nationwide.

tags_en: National Working Committee for Young Pioneers

articles.title_zh: 浙江启动高校计算机及人工智能本科教学改革试点“101计划”
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Launches "101 Plan" Pilot for Undergraduate Teaching Reform in Computer Science and AI
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省在温州启动高校计算机及人工智能本科教学改革试点“101计划”，发布44项改革任务及87门核心课程名单，旨在通过产教融合提升人才培养质量。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang Province launched the "101 Plan" pilot for undergraduate teaching reform in computer science and AI in Wenzhou, releasing 44 reform tasks and 87 core courses to enhance talent cultivation through industry-education integration.

articles.title_zh: 外卖新规实施在即 杭州持续深化外卖聚集区管理
articles.title_en: New Delivery Regulations Imminent as Hangzhou Deepens Management of Delivery Clusters
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日起，《网络餐饮服务经营者落实食品安全主体责任监督管理规定》正式施行，杭州市拱墅区通过推行组团式管理模式加强外卖聚集区监管。
articles.summary_en: New food safety regulations for online catering take effect on June 1, with Hangzhou's Gongshu District implementing a cluster management model to enhance supervision of delivery-only shops.

articles.title_zh: “六一”儿童节前夕，多位省级党政一把手调研小学和幼儿园送上节日祝福
articles.title_en: Provincial Leaders Visit Schools and Kindergartens Ahead of International Children's Day
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日国际儿童节前夕，吉林、山东、宁夏、江西、湖南、湖北等多省省级党政领导分别调研学校，看望少年儿童并送上节日祝福。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of International Children's Day on June 1, provincial leaders from Jilin, Shandong, Ningxia, Jiangxi, Hunan, and Hubei visited schools to greet children and teachers.

articles.title_zh: 前瞻布局和发展未来产业
articles.title_en: Forward-looking Layout and Development of Future Industries
articles.summary_zh: 2026年1月30日，习近平在二十届中央政治局第二十四次集体学习时强调，要前瞻布局和发展未来产业，通过科技创新和政策支持抢占科技制高点。
articles.summary_en: On January 30, 2026, Xi Jinping emphasized the forward-looking layout and development of future industries during the 24th collective study session of the 20th CPC Central Committee Political Bureau.

tags.name_en: Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee

tags_en: Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 海底七十八米，为盾构机换刀
articles.title_en: Changing Cutter Heads for Shield Machines 78 Meters Undersea
articles.summary_zh: 甬舟铁路金塘海底隧道施工中，建设团队通过三元混合气和饱和带压技术，成功解决了海底78米深处盾构机换刀的高压难题。
articles.summary_en: During the construction of the Yongzhou Railway Jintang Undersea Tunnel, teams successfully overcame high-pressure challenges of changing shield machine cutter heads at 78m depth using mixed-gas and saturated pressure technologies.

articles.title_zh: 习近平复信参加“共航蔚蓝：中美青年友谊行”活动的学生
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Students Participating in China-US Youth Friendship Tour
articles.summary_zh: 5月23日，习近平主席复信参加“共航蔚蓝：中美青年友谊行”活动的中美学生，指出“5年邀请5万名美国青少年来华”倡议已提前实现目标。
articles.summary_en: On May 23, President Xi Jinping replied to students in the 'Sailing Together in the Blue: China-US Youth Friendship Tour,' noting that the initiative to invite 50,000 US youth to China has reached its goal ahead of schedule.

articles.title_zh: 首位香港航天员黎家盈乘神舟二十三号奔赴天宫
articles.title_en: First Hong Kong Astronaut Li Jiaying Launches with Shenzhou-23
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月24日，载荷专家黎家盈作为神舟二十三号航天员乘组成员奔赴“天宫”，成为我国首位来自香港的航天员。
articles.summary_en: On May 24, 2026, payload specialist Li Jiaying launched as part of the Shenzhou-23 crew, becoming the first astronaut from Hong Kong.

tags.name_en: Integration of HK and Macao into National Development

tags_en: Integration of HK and Macao into National Development

articles.title_zh: 赵乐际对俄罗斯进行正式友好访问并出席中俄议会合作委员会第十一次会议
articles.title_en: Zhao Leji Pays Official Friendly Visit to Russia and Attends 11th Meeting of China-Russia Parliamentary Cooperation Committee
articles.summary_zh: 全国人大常委会委员长赵乐际于5月27日至30日对俄罗斯进行正式友好访问，在莫斯科同俄方领导人举行会谈并出席中俄议会合作委员会第十一次会议。
articles.summary_en: Zhao Leji, Chairman of the NPC Standing Committee, paid an official friendly visit to Russia from May 27 to 30, holding talks with Russian leaders in Moscow and attending the 11th meeting of the China-Russia Parliamentary Cooperation Committee.

articles.title_zh: 江苏时代楷模先进事迹发布会举行
articles.title_en: Press Conference on the Advanced Deeds of Jiangsu Models of the Times Held
articles.summary_zh: 5月27日，江苏时代楷模先进事迹发布会在南京举行，授予江苏（武进）水稻研究所良种繁育团队及研究员高德荣“江苏时代楷模”称号。
articles.summary_en: On May 27, a press conference was held in Nanjing to honor the "Jiangsu Models of the Times," awarding the title to the breeding team of the Jiangsu (Wujin) Rice Research Institute and researcher Gao Derong.

articles.title_zh: 从2026智博会解码重庆竞逐人工智能赛道的三重逻辑
articles.title_en: Decoding Chongqing's Triple Logic in the AI Race via the 2026 World Intelligence Industry Expo
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月28日至30日，由天津和重庆共同主办的2026世界智能产业博览会举行，展示了重庆在AI+制造、场景应用及区域协作方面的战略布局。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 World Intelligence Industry Expo, co-hosted by Tianjin and Chongqing from May 28-30, showcased Chongqing's strategic focus on AI-driven manufacturing, scenario applications, and regional collaboration.

articles.title_zh: 公安普通高等院校报名和政治考察工作启动
articles.title_en: Registration and Political Review for Public Security Higher Education Institutions Begin
articles.summary_zh: 河北省公安厅于5月28日宣布，2026年公安普通高等院校公安专业河北省招生报名及政治考察工作已启动，截止日期为6月10日。
articles.summary_en: The Hebei Provincial Public Security Department announced on May 28 that registration and political review for 2026 admissions to public security professional programs in Hebei province have begun, with a deadline of June 10.

articles.title_zh: 河北省立法推动特色产业集群提档升级
articles.title_en: Hebei Province Enacts Legislation to Upgrade Characteristic Industrial Clusters
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，河北省十四届人大常委会通过关于促进特色产业集群高质量发展的决定，旨在通过法治保障推动产业集群升级，将于7月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, the Standing Committee of the Hebei Provincial People's Congress passed a decision to promote the high-quality development of characteristic industrial clusters, effective July 1.

articles.title_zh: 许勤调研基础研究工作，强调提升原始创新能力
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Inspects Basic Research to Enhance Original Innovation Capabilities
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，黑龙江省委书记许勤在哈尔滨调研基础研究工作，强调要加大政策支持，提升原始创新能力，为建设科技强国作出贡献。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, inspected basic research in Harbin, emphasizing the need to increase policy support and original innovation to contribute to building a science and technology powerhouse.

articles.title_zh: 中国空间站第十批科学实验样品顺利返回
articles.title_en: Tenth Batch of Scientific Experiment Samples from China Space Station Returns Successfully
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，中国空间站第十批空间科学实验样品随神舟二十二号飞船顺利返回，部分样品已运抵北京并交付科学家研究。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, the tenth batch of space science experiment samples from the China Space Station returned via the Shenzhou-22 spacecraft, with some samples delivered to Beijing for research.

articles.title_zh: 加拿大总理卡尼会见王毅
articles.title_en: Canadian Prime Minister Carney Meets Wang Yi
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，加拿大总理卡尼在渥太华会见中国外交部长王毅，双方探讨构建中加新型战略伙伴关系并深化多领域合作。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, Canadian Prime Minister Carney met with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi in Ottawa to discuss building a new China-Canada strategic partnership and deepening cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 打破区域发展壁垒 亦通武廊四地共建新能源与机器人产业生态圈
articles.title_en: Four Regions of 'Yi-Tong-Wu-Lang' Jointly Build New Energy and Robotics Industry Ecosystem to Break Regional Barriers
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，亦通武廊新能源汽车与机器人产业协同发展专题交流会在北京亦庄举办，旨在通过跨域协同构建产业新生态，助力京津冀高端制造产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, a special exchange meeting on the collaborative development of the new energy vehicle and robotics industries in the 'Yi-Tong-Wu-Lang' region was held in Yizhuang, Beijing, to promote high-quality industrial synergy in the Jing-Jin-Ji region.

articles.title_en: 2026 National Left-behind Children Care and Protection 'Hundred Lectures into Construction Sites' Activity Launched in Changting, Fujian
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月29日，由民政部、国资委等指导，中建集团等八家央企主办的全国留守儿童关爱保护活动在福建长汀启动。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, 2026, the National Left-behind Children Care and Protection activity, guided by the Ministry of Civil Affairs and SASAC and hosted by eight central enterprises including CSCEC, was launched in Changting, Fujian.

articles.title_zh: 《2025年全国生态气象公报》发布
articles.title_en: Release of the 2025 National Ecological Meteorological Bulletin
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月29日，中国气象局发布《2025年全国生态气象公报》，显示2025年全国植被生态质量为2000年以来第二优。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, 2026, the China Meteorological Administration released the 2025 National Ecological Meteorological Bulletin, reporting that China's vegetation ecological quality in 2025 was the second best since 2000.

articles.title_zh: 倪岳峰主持召开省委理论学习中心组学习会强调加快建设更高水平的平安河北
articles.title_en: Ni Yuefeng Chairs Provincial Party Committee Study Meeting to Accelerate Construction of a Higher-Level Peaceful Hebei
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，河北省委书记倪岳峰主持召开省委理论学习中心组学习会，强调要坚定不移贯彻总体国家安全观，统筹发展与安全，建设更高水平的平安河北。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, Hebei Provincial Party Secretary Ni Yuefeng chaired a study meeting, emphasizing the implementation of the overall national security concept to balance development and security for a safer Hebei.

articles.title_zh: 粤港澳游艇“自由行”政策落地
articles.title_en: Yacht Free Travel Policy Implemented in Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，国务院批复同意在粤港澳大湾区内地九市对港澳游艇实行免担保和临时船舶国籍登记政策，正式推动游艇“自由行”落地。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, the State Council approved the implementation of guarantee-free and temporary ship registration policies for Hong Kong and Macao yachts in nine mainland cities of the GBA.

articles.title_zh: 山西省发布2025年全省生态环境质量状况
articles.title_en: Shanxi Province Releases 2025 Provincial Ecological Environment Quality Report
articles.summary_zh: 山西省生态环境厅于5月29日举行新闻发布会，公布2025年全省生态环境质量状况，各项指标创有监测记录以来最好成绩。
articles.summary_en: The Shanxi Provincial Department of Ecology and Environment held a press conference on May 29 to release the 2025 provincial ecological environment quality report, noting record-high performance across all indicators.

articles.title_zh: 王宁与中粮集团董事长李国强会谈
articles.title_en: Wang Ning Meets with COFCO Group Chairman Li Guoqiang
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，云南省委书记王宁在昆明与中粮集团董事长李国强会谈，探讨深化农业全产业链合作，助力乡村振兴与农业农村现代化。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, Yunnan Provincial Party Secretary Wang Ning met with COFCO Group Chairman Li Guoqiang in Kunming to discuss deepening agricultural industry chain cooperation and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 长江朝天门至涪陵河段整治工程竣工验收
articles.title_en: Completion Acceptance of Yangtze River Waterway Improvement Project from Chaotianmen to Fuling
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，由交通运输部组织的长江朝天门至涪陵河段航道整治工程通过竣工验收并正式运行，实现5000吨级货轮可直达重庆中心城区。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, the Yangtze River waterway improvement project from Chaotianmen to Fuling passed completion acceptance by the Ministry of Transport, enabling 5,000-ton cargo ships to reach downtown Chongqing.

articles.title_zh: 重庆启动超大城市现代化治理民主监督
articles.title_en: Chongqing Launches Democratic Supervision of Modern Megacity Governance
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，重庆召开会议启动超大城市现代化治理民主监督，并总结长江（重庆段）生态环境保护民主监督工作。市委常委商奎出席会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, Chongqing held a meeting to launch democratic supervision of modern megacity governance and summarize the supervision of ecological protection for the Yangtze River (Chongqing section).

articles.title_zh: 推进梁滩河流域综合治理工作专题会议召开
articles.title_en: Special Meeting Held to Promote Comprehensive Governance of Liangtan River Basin
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，重庆市人大常委会党组书记、主任王炯出席专题会议，部署贯彻第8号总河长令，推进梁滩河流域综合治理与水生态保护。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, Wang Jiong, Director of the Standing Committee of the Chongqing Municipal People's Congress, attended a special meeting to deploy the implementation of the 8th Chief River Officer Order for the governance of the Liangtan River Basin.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升主持省生态环境保护委员会会议暨祁连山生态环境保护工作推进会议
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Chairs Meeting on Ecological Protection of Qilian Mountains
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，甘肃省委书记胡昌升在兰州主持召开省生态环境保护委员会会议，部署祁连山生态环境保护工作，强调统筹推进山水林田湖草沙一体化保护和系统治理。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, Gansu Provincial Party Secretary Hu Changsheng chaired a meeting in Lanzhou to deploy ecological protection efforts for the Qilian Mountains, emphasizing integrated protection and systematic governance.

articles.title_zh: 2026面向东盟“AI+跨境电商”创新应用大赛启动
articles.title_en: 2026 'AI + Cross-border E-commerce' Innovative Application Competition for ASEAN Launched
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，由广西商务厅、数据局及南宁、柳州、北海三市主办的2026面向东盟“AI+跨境电商”创新应用大赛启动，旨在推动中国与东盟的跨境电商协同发展。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, the 2026 'AI + Cross-border E-commerce' Innovative Application Competition for ASEAN was launched by Guangxi authorities to promote synergistic development of cross-border e-commerce between China and ASEAN.

articles.title_zh: 2026年广西全民数字素养与技能提升月活动启动
articles.title_en: Launch of 2026 Guangxi Universal Digital Literacy and Skills Improvement Month
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月29日，广西全民数字素养与技能提升月活动在南宁启动，旨在通过多部门协同提升全民数字化能力，筑牢数字广西建设根基。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, 2026, the 2026 Guangxi Universal Digital Literacy and Skills Improvement Month was launched in Nanning to enhance public digital capabilities and support the construction of Digital Guangxi.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲要求抓好风险隐患排查整治 确保人民群众生命财产安全
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Urges Risk Hazard Rectification to Ensure Public Safety
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，黑龙江省安委会第二次全体（扩大）会议在哈尔滨召开，省长梁惠玲强调要坚决守牢安全生产底线，开展全域消防及重点领域安全整治。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the Heilongjiang Provincial Safety Committee was held in Harbin. Governor Liang Huiling emphasized safeguarding safety production and conducting comprehensive hazard rectifications.

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明专题研究仲景文化园建设工作
articles.title_en: Mao Weiming Conducts Special Research on the Construction of Zhongjing Cultural Park
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日下午，湖南省长毛伟明主持专题会议研究仲景文化园建设，强调要挖掘中医药价值潜力，打造中医药特色文化园和城市文化地标。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, Hunan Governor Mao Weiming chaired a special meeting on the construction of the Zhongjing Cultural Park, emphasizing the need to unlock the potential of TCM and create a cultural landmark.

articles.title_zh: 山西发布2025年全省生态环境质量状况
articles.title_en: Shanxi Releases 2025 Provincial Ecological Environment Quality Report
articles.summary_zh: 山西省生态环境厅于5月29日举行发布会，公布2025年全省生态环境质量状况，各项指标创历史最好成绩，圆满完成“十四五”目标任务。
articles.summary_en: The Shanxi Provincial Department of Ecology and Environment held a press conference on May 29 to release the 2025 ecological environment quality report, noting record-best indicators and the completion of 14th Five-Year Plan goals.

articles.title_zh: 寒旱区生态环境区域科技创新联盟成立
articles.title_en: Cold and Arid Region Ecological Environment Regional Science and Technology Innovation Alliance Established
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月30日，寒旱区生态环境区域科技创新联盟在甘肃兰州成立，旨在整合西部科研力量，以科技创新赋能生态保护修复。
articles.summary_en: The Cold and Arid Region Ecological Environment Regional Science and Technology Innovation Alliance was established in Lanzhou, Gansu on May 30, 2026, to integrate research efforts for ecological protection in western China.

articles.title_zh: 矢志创新勇攀高峰 加快建设科技强国
articles.title_en: Determined to Innovate and Reach New Heights to Accelerate the Construction of a Strong Science and Technology Nation
articles.summary_zh: 5月30日全国科技工作者日，报道强调习近平总书记对科技创新的重视，并总结了我国在深化科技体制改革及建设科技强国方面取得的进展。
articles.summary_en: On the 10th National Science and Technology Workers' Day (May 30), the report emphasized President Xi Jinping's focus on S&T innovation and summarized China's progress in systemic reforms.

articles.title_zh: 全国安全生产视频会议在京召开
articles.title_en: National Video Conference on Production Safety Held in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月30日，全国安全生产视频会议在京召开。李强总理作出重要批示，要求纵深推进安全生产治本攻坚三年行动，坚决遏制重特大事故多发势头。
articles.summary_en: A national video conference on production safety was held in Beijing on May 30, 2026. Premier Li Qiang issued instructions to advance the three-year action for root-cause safety solutions and curb major accidents.

articles.title_zh: 电力市场交易电量同比增长25.6%

articles.summary_en: On May 28, Henan Governor Wang Kai held a special press conference in Zhengzhou to introduce the province's 15th Five-Year Plan outline and seven key priority tasks.

articles.title_zh: 河南举行“十五五”专场新闻发布会介绍发展规划
articles.title_en: Henan Holds Special Press Conference on 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，河南省举行“十五五”专场新闻发布会，省长王凯等介绍《河南省国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划纲要》及重点工作举措。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, Henan Province held a press conference where Governor Wang Kai and other officials introduced the 15th Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development and key implementation measures.

articles.title_zh: 省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议在郑州闭幕
articles.title_en: The 24th Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th Henan Provincial People's Congress Concludes in Zhengzhou
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议在郑州闭幕。刘宁主持会议并讲话，会议表决通过了关于融入服务全国统一大市场的决定及多项地方性法规。
articles.summary_en: The 24th Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th Henan Provincial People's Congress concluded in Zhengzhou on May 28. Chaired by Liu Ning, the meeting passed decisions on integrating into the national unified market and several local regulations.

articles.title_zh: 省政府党组举行树立和践行正确政绩观集体学习研讨
articles.title_en: Henan Provincial Government Party Group Holds Collective Study on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，河南省省长王凯主持省政府党组集体学习研讨，强调要树立正确政绩观，将政绩体现在高质量发展和为民造福上。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, Governor Wang Kai chaired a collective study session of the Henan Provincial Government Party Group, emphasizing the establishment of a correct view of political achievements to promote high-quality development and public welfare.

articles.title_zh: 商务部：入汛以来全国生活必需品市场运行平稳、供应充足
articles.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Daily Necessities Market Stable and Supply Sufficient Since Start of Flood Season
articles.summary_zh: 商务部新闻发言人何亚东5月28日表示，入汛以来，商务部通过调度重点保供企业，确保受灾地区生活必需品供应充足，市场运行平稳。
articles.summary_en: MOFCOM spokesperson He Yadong stated on May 28 that the ministry has coordinated key supply enterprises to ensure sufficient daily necessities in flood-affected areas, maintaining market stability.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明主持召开省委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Shen Xiaoming Chairs Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，湖南省委书记沈晓明主持召开省委常委会会议，研究安全生产、哲学社会科学发展、营商环境优化及农民增收等事项。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, Hunan Provincial Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming chaired a Standing Committee meeting to discuss safety production, social sciences, business environment optimization, and farmers' income.

articles.title_zh: 江西公安发布5起打击查处涉烟花爆竹典型案例
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Public Security Releases Five Typical Cases of Crackdown on Illegal Fireworks and Firecrackers
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，江西省公安厅发布5起打击查处涉烟花爆竹的典型案例，旨在严厉打击震慑相关违法犯罪活动。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, the Jiangxi Provincial Public Security Department released five typical cases of crackdowns on illegal fireworks and firecrackers to deter related crimes.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”高质量推进城市更新有了“路线图”“任务书”
articles.title_en: The '15th Five-Year Plan' for High-Quality Urban Renewal Provides 'Roadmap' and 'Task List'
articles.summary_zh: 国务院日前印发《城市更新“十五五”规划》，明确了“十五五”时期城市更新的目标指标、重点任务和政策举措，旨在推动城市高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The State Council issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Urban Renewal,' outlining goals, key tasks, and policy measures to promote high-quality urban development by 2030.

articles.title_zh: “山海经”出海综合服务港助力企业出海
articles.title_en: "Shanhaijing" Comprehensive Overseas Service Port Supports Enterprises' Global Expansion
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，山东省政府新闻办举行发布会，介绍通过打造“山海经”出海综合服务港等举措，完善海外综合服务体系，支撑企业高质量出海。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, the Shandong Provincial Government Information Office held a press conference to introduce the "Shanhaijing" Comprehensive Overseas Service Port and other measures to support enterprises' high-quality global expansion.

articles.title_zh: 2026世界智能产业博览会开幕 “人工智能+”催生智能经济新形态
articles.title_en: 2026 World Intelligent Industry Expo Opens, 'AI+' Spawns New Forms of Intelligent Economy
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月28日，由天津市和重庆市人民政府共同主办的世界智能产业博览会在天津召开，探讨“人工智能+”赋能产业升级及智能经济新形态。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 World Intelligent Industry Expo, co-hosted by Tianjin and Chongqing governments, opened in Tianjin on May 28, focusing on 'AI+' empowering industrial upgrades and the new intelligent economy.

articles.title_zh: 2026世界智能产业博览会在天津开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 World Intelligent Industry Expo Opens in Tianjin
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月28日，2026世界智能产业博览会在天津开幕。天津市委书记陈敏尔出席并致辞，中国科协主席万钢作主旨发言，探讨人工智能创新与产业融合。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 World Intelligent Industry Expo opened in Tianjin on May 28, 2026. Chen Min'er, Party Secretary of Tianjin, delivered a speech, and Wan Gang, President of CAST, gave a keynote on AI innovation and industrial integration.

articles.title_zh: 天津人才高质量发展大会召开
articles.title_en: Tianjin High-Quality Talent Development Conference Held
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，天津人才高质量发展大会在天津召开。市委书记陈敏尔出席，万钢、张工致辞，会上启动了“创业天津”青年人才集聚工程并发布人才需求清单。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, the Tianjin High-Quality Talent Development Conference was held in Tianjin. Chen Min'er attended, and Wan Gang and Zhang Gong delivered speeches. The "Entrepreneurship Tianjin" youth talent project was launched.

articles.title_zh: 云南挂牌督办一起致4人死亡道路交通事故查处

articles.summary_en: The Yunnan Provincial Safety Production Committee has decided to launch a supervised investigation into a road traffic accident in Xundian County, Kunming, which killed four people on April 28, 2026.

articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Chinese Embassy in DR Congo advise Chinese citizens to exercise caution and avoid non-essential travel to DR Congo, particularly Ebola-affected areas.

articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment announced on May 29 that most key issues in national nature reserves have been rectified through the 'Green Shield' action and outlined priorities for 2026.

articles.summary_zh: 生态环境部于5月29日宣布，今年将正式启动对国家公园和自然公园生态环境保护成效的评估工作，以确保生态保护与修复落地见效。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment announced on May 29 that it will launch effectiveness evaluations for ecological protection in national and natural parks this year to ensure the efficacy of restoration efforts.

articles.summary_en: Anhui Provincial Development and Reform Commission, Provincial Energy Bureau, and State Grid Anhui launched the V2G 'Wanmei Discharge' activity from May 29 to 31, 2026, offering subsidies to NEV owners for discharging power to the grid.

articles.summary_en: People's Daily's Party Building Research Trip visited Changting, Longyan, Fujian, reporting on how party building leads red tourism and soil erosion control to drive rural revitalization.

articles.summary_en: On May 29, 2026, the Central Propaganda Department and the China Association for Science and Technology jointly released the advanced deeds of the "Most Beautiful Science and Technology Workers" in Beijing to promote the spirit of scientists.

articles.summary_en: A warning education meeting was held in Lhasa, where Tibet Autonomous Region Party Secretary Wang Junzheng emphasized establishing a correct view of political achievements to contribute to the modernization of Tibet.

articles.summary_en: On May 29, the Huaihe River Basin Civilization Revitalization Think Tank Meeting was held in Huainan, Anhui, where the Huaihe Think Tank Alliance Initiative was launched to support the region's high-quality development.

articles.summary_en: On May 29, Yin Qijun, Deputy Director of the Anhui Provincial Auto Office, introduced the development and achievements of the NEV and parts industry in Northern Anhui at a roundtable meeting in Huainan.

articles.summary_en: On May 29, Dai Linlin, Deputy Director of Anhui Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology, emphasized supporting the accelerated layout and high-quality development of new material industries in Northern Anhui.

articles.title_en: Yao Gaoyuan Appointed Vice Governor of Zhejiang Province
articles.summary_zh: 姚高员被任命为浙江省副省长；同时，杜旭亮被任命为杭州市人民政府副市长、代理市长。
articles.summary_en: Yao Gaoyuan has been appointed Vice Governor of Zhejiang Province, and Du Xuliang has been appointed Vice Mayor and Acting Mayor of Hangzhou.

articles.title_zh: 嵩县农商行员工骗贷1600万，涉案信贷员被立案侦查
articles.title_en: Songxian Rural Commercial Bank Employee Defrauds 16 Million Yuan; Loan Officer Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 河南省嵩县农商行原员工李某因骗贷1600余万元被判刑，随后涉案信贷员杨某松等人因涉嫌违法发放贷款罪被立案侦查。
articles.summary_en: Li, a former employee of Songxian Rural Commercial Bank in Henan, was sentenced for defrauding 16 million yuan. Subsequently, loan officer Yang and others were placed under investigation for illegally issuing loans.

articles.title_zh: 习近平复信参加“共航蔚蓝：中美青年友谊行”活动的两国学生
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Students Participating in 'Sailing Together in Blue: China-US Youth Friendship Tour'
articles.summary_zh: 5月23日，国家主席习近平复信参加“共航蔚蓝：中美青年友谊行”活动的中美两国学生，强调青少年是中美关系的未来和希望。
articles.summary_en: On May 23, President Xi Jinping replied to students from China and the US participating in the 'Sailing Together in Blue: China-US Youth Friendship Tour,' emphasizing that youth are the future and hope of China-US relations.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲主持省长办公会议研究推动服务业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Chairs Governor's Office Meeting to Promote High-Quality Development of Service Industry
articles.summary_zh: 5月25日至26日，黑龙江省长梁惠玲主持召开省长办公会议，研究部署全省服务业扩能提质行动，推动服务业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: From May 25 to 26, Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling chaired a meeting to deploy actions for expanding the capacity and improving the quality of the province's service industry.

articles.title_zh: 王毅会见联合国秘书长古特雷斯
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets UN Secretary-General António Guterres
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，外交部长王毅在纽约主持联合国安理会高级别会议期间会见联合国秘书长古特雷斯，双方就维护联合国权威、深化多边合作及一个中国原则等议题进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Foreign Minister Wang Yi met with UN Secretary-General António Guterres in New York during a high-level Security Council meeting to discuss upholding the UN's authority and deepening multilateral cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 谌贻琴在山东调研强调坚定不移实施就业优先战略
articles.title_en: Chen Yiqin Emphasizes Employment-First Strategy During Research Trip to Shandong
articles.summary_zh: 国务委员谌贻琴于5月26日至28日在山东济南、淄博调研就业工作，强调要坚定不移实施就业优先战略，多措并举稳就业促就业。
articles.summary_en: State Councilor Chen Yiqin conducted research on employment in Jinan and Zibo, Shandong from May 26 to 28, emphasizing the implementation of an employment-first strategy to stabilize and promote employment.

articles.title_zh: 武契奇到访嘉兴品尝当地特色美食
articles.title_en: Serbian President Vucic Visits Jiaxing and Tastes Local Specialties
articles.summary_zh: 5月27日，塞尔维亚总统武契奇到访浙江嘉兴，参观敏实集团未来工厂并品尝当地特色美食嘉兴原汤粽。
articles.summary_en: On May 27, Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic visited Jiaxing, Zhejiang, where he toured the Minth Group's future factory and tasted local specialty zongzi.

articles.title_zh: 山东省安全生产工作专题会议召开
articles.title_en: Special Meeting on Work Safety Convened in Shandong Province
articles.summary_zh: 5月27日，山东省在济南召开安全生产工作专题会议，由省委书记林武讲话、省长周乃翔主持，部署排查整治重点领域安全隐患。
articles.summary_en: On May 27, Shandong Province held a special meeting on work safety in Jinan. Party Secretary Lin Wu and Governor Zhou Naixiang attended to deploy efforts in eliminating safety hazards across key sectors.

articles.title_zh: 西康高铁顺利通过接触网平推验收
articles.title_en: Xikang High-speed Railway Successfully Passes Overhead Contact System Acceptance
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月27日，西康高铁接触网平推验收工作顺利完成，为线路后续的热滑试验和联调联试奠定基础。
articles.summary_en: On May 27, 2026, the Xikang High-speed Railway successfully completed the overhead contact system acceptance, laying the foundation for subsequent hot-slide tests and joint commissioning.

articles.title_zh: 省十四届人大常委会第二十三次会议召开
articles.title_en: The 23rd Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th Gansu Provincial People's Congress Held
articles.summary_zh: 5月27日上午，甘肃省十四届人大常委会第二十三次会议在兰州召开，听取了关于地方条例修订、政府债务管理及环境保护等多项报告。
articles.summary_en: The 23rd meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th Gansu Provincial People's Congress was held in Lanzhou on May 27 to review local regulations, government debt management, and environmental protection.

articles.title_zh: 深化城乡土地制度改革 助力大市场建设——民盟中央开展2026年度重点考察调研
articles.title_en: China Democratic League Central Committee Conducts 2026 Key Research on Deepening Urban-Rural Land System Reform to Support Large Market Construction
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月27日，民盟中央主席丁仲礼等在湖北、山东开展重点考察调研，旨在深化城乡土地制度改革，助力大市场建设，为中共中央决策提供参考。
articles.summary_en: On May 27, 2026, the China Democratic League Central Committee, led by Chairperson Ding Zhongli, conducted research in Hubei and Shandong to deepen urban-rural land system reform and support large market construction.

articles.title_zh: 许勤主持召开黑龙江省委理论学习中心组第五十次集体学习
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Chairs the 50th Collective Study Session of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee's Theoretical Study Center Group
articles.summary_zh: 5月27日，黑龙江省委书记许勤主持召开省委理论学习中心组第五十次集体学习，学习习近平经济思想，部署推动黑龙江高质量发展与全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: On May 27, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, chaired the 50th collective study session to study Xi Jinping's economic thought and deploy measures for high-quality development and comprehensive revitalization in Heilongjiang.

articles.title_zh: 深化法治化营商环境建设 长春公安机关发布二十条硬核措施
articles.title_en: Changchun Public Security Organs Release 20 Measures to Deepen Law-based Business Environment
articles.summary_zh: 5月27日，长春市公安局发布二十条深化法治化营商环境建设措施，从经济护航、新业态监管等维度助力长春全面振兴发展。
articles.summary_en: On May 27, the Changchun Public Security Bureau released 20 measures to deepen the construction of a law-based business environment to support the city's overall revitalization and development.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁省数字人才协同创新培育行动启动
articles.title_en: Liaoning Province Launches Digital Talent Collaborative Innovation Cultivation Action
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月27日，辽宁省数字人才协同创新培育行动首站在营口启动，旨在通过政校企协同培育，为数字经济与政府发展提供人才保障。
articles.summary_en: On May 27, 2026, the first stop of Liaoning Province's 2026 Digital Talent Collaborative Innovation Cultivation Action was launched in Yingkou to provide talent support for the digital economy and government.

articles.title_zh: 山东兖州北站扩能改造工程全面竣工
articles.title_en: Yanzhou North Station Expansion and Renovation Project in Shandong Fully Completed
articles.summary_zh: 5月27日，由国铁济南局牵头、中铁十局承建的山东兖州北站扩能改造工程全面竣工，将显著增强鲁南地区的铁路运输能力。
articles.summary_en: On May 27, the expansion and renovation project of Yanzhou North Station in Shandong, led by China Railway Jinan Group and built by China Railway 10th Bureau, was fully completed to enhance regional transport capacity.

articles.title_zh: 天津举行战略合作协议和项目签约活动
articles.title_en: Tianjin Holds Strategic Cooperation Agreement and Project Signing Event
articles.summary_zh: 5月27日，天津市人民政府与中国联通、中国移动等机构签署战略合作协议，市委书记陈敏尔、市长张工出席并见证签约。
articles.summary_en: On May 27, the Tianjin Municipal People's Government signed strategic cooperation agreements with China Unicom, China Mobile, and other organizations, witnessed by Party Secretary Chen Min'er and Mayor Zhang Gong.

articles.title_zh: 商务部回应欧盟拟对进口钢铁加税
articles.title_en: Ministry of Commerce Responds to EU's Proposed Steel Tariffs
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，商务部回应欧盟拟于7月1日实施新钢铁关税政策，称其为贸易保护主义，中方正通过世贸组织框架与欧方谈判以寻求双赢。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, China's Ministry of Commerce responded to the EU's plan to implement new steel tariffs on July 1, calling it trade protectionism and stating that negotiations are underway via the WTO.

articles.title_zh: 国防部：美方应慎之又慎处理台湾问题
articles.title_en: Ministry of National Defense: US Should Be Prudent in Handling Taiwan Issue
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月28日，国防部举行例行记者会，发言人蒋斌表示中方坚决反对美国向台湾地区出售武器，美方应慎之又慎处理台湾问题。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, 2026, the Ministry of National Defense held a regular press conference where spokesperson Jiang Bin stated China's firm opposition to US arms sales to Taiwan and urged the US to be prudent in handling the Taiwan issue.

articles.title_zh: 聚焦新型毒品等热点问题 最高检发布10起涉未成年人典型案例
articles.title_en: Supreme People's Procuratorate Releases 10 Typical Cases Involving Minors Focusing on New Types of Drugs
articles.summary_zh: 最高人民检察院发布10起涉未成年人典型案例，聚焦新型毒品、网络犯罪等热点问题，旨在通过个案办理推动社会治理，实现惩治与保护的统一。
articles.summary_en: The Supreme People's Procuratorate released 10 typical cases involving minors, focusing on new types of drugs and cybercrime to promote social governance and balance punishment with protection.

articles.title_zh: 南航股份公司总工程师李志刚接受审查调查
articles.title_en: Li Zhigang, Chief Engineer of China Southern Airlines, Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月28日，南航股份公司总工程师李志刚因涉嫌严重违纪违法，接受中央纪委国家监委驻南航集团纪检监察组及辽宁省抚顺市监察委员会的审查调查。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, 2026, Li Zhigang, Chief Engineer of China Southern Airlines, was placed under investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 张国清在全国“安全生产月”活动启动仪式上强调提高隐患排查整治质效
articles.title_en: Zhang Guoqing Emphasizes Improving Hazard Investigation and Rectification at National "Work Safety Month" Launch Ceremony
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月28日，国务院副总理张国清在京出席全国“安全生产月”活动启动仪式，强调要深入排查风险隐患，牢牢守住安全发展底线。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, 2026, Vice Premier Zhang Guoqing attended the launch ceremony of the National "Work Safety Month" in Beijing, emphasizing the need to thoroughly investigate risks and ensure the bottom line of safe development.

articles.title_zh: 国务院印发《城市更新“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: State Council Issues "15th Five-Year Plan for Urban Renewal"
articles.summary_zh: 国务院于5月28日印发《城市更新“十五五”规划》，明确了2030年前城市更新的目标指标、重点任务及政策举措，旨在高质量推进城市更新。
articles.summary_en: The State Council issued the "15th Five-Year Plan for Urban Renewal" on May 28, outlining goals, key tasks, and policy measures to promote high-quality urban renewal by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 前4个月全国网上商品和服务零售额增长6.6%
articles.title_en: China's Online Retail Sales of Goods and Services Grow 6.6% in First Four Months
articles.summary_zh: 今年前四个月，全国网上商品和服务零售额同比增长6.6%，其中电子商务带动旅游和餐饮业快速发展，跨境电商进口平台销售额同比增长4.3%。
articles.summary_en: In the first four months of this year, China's online retail sales of goods and services grew by 6.6% year-on-year, with significant growth in tourism, catering, and cross-border e-commerce.

articles.title_zh: 各地一批重大工程扎实推进
articles.title_en: Major Infrastructure Projects Steadily Advance Across China
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日前后，平陆运河、渝万高铁、崇启公铁大桥、大连金州湾机场及青海哇让抽水蓄能电站等一批重大工程取得关键进展。
articles.summary_en: Around May 28, several major infrastructure projects, including the Pinglu Canal and Chongqing-Wanzhou High-speed Railway, achieved key milestones to support high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 我国开展第三次全国残疾人抽样调查
articles.title_en: China to Conduct Third National Sample Survey on Persons with Disabilities
articles.summary_zh: 国务院办公厅5月28日发布通知，决定自2026年6月起开展第三次全国残疾人抽样调查，旨在为完善相关法律政策提供统计支持。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of the State Council issued a notice on May 28 to conduct the third national sample survey on persons with disabilities starting June 2026 to provide statistical support for policy improvements.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁舰赴西太平洋开展训练，国防部回应
articles.title_en: Ministry of National Defense Responds to Liaoning Aircraft Carrier Training in Western Pacific
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，国防部新闻发言人蒋斌在例行记者会上表示，辽宁舰航母编队赴西太平洋开展训练是根据年度计划进行的例行性训练。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, MND spokesperson Jiang Bin stated during a press conference that the Liaoning aircraft carrier formation's training in the Western Pacific is a routine exercise based on an annual plan.

articles.title_zh: 一超载客车追尾货车致13死3伤，公安部派工作组赴河南南阳
articles.title_en: Overloaded Passenger Bus Rear-ends Truck Killing 13 in Henan; Ministry of Public Security Sends Working Group to Nanyang
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月28日凌晨，河南南阳发生一起超载客车追尾货车事故，致13死3伤，公安部已派工作组赴现场指导调查处置工作。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, 2026, an overloaded passenger bus rear-ended a truck in Nanyang, Henan, killing 13 and injuring 3. The Ministry of Public Security has dispatched a working group to guide the investigation.

articles.title_zh: 中国科学院启动2026年“科学人生·百年”主题宣传活动
articles.title_en: Chinese Academy of Sciences Launches 2026 'Scientific Life · Century' Promotion Activity
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，中国科学院学部科学道德建设委员会启动2026年“科学人生·百年”主题宣传活动，旨在系统展示10位百岁诞辰院士的科学精神与贡献。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, the CAS Division Scientific Ethics Construction Committee launched the 2026 'Scientific Life · Century' campaign to showcase the scientific spirit and contributions of 10 academicians celebrating their centennials.

articles.title_zh: 两部门联手系统布局人工智能计量能力建设
articles.title_en: Two Departments Jointly Plan AI Measurement Capability Construction
articles.summary_zh: 市场监管总局与国家发展改革委联合印发《人工智能计量体系和能力建设指引（2026版）》，旨在系统布局人工智能计量能力建设，提升AI技术的可信度与精准度。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation and the National Development and Reform Commission jointly issued guidelines to systematically build AI measurement capabilities, enhancing the reliability and precision of AI technology.

articles.title_zh: 北京发布推动城市高质量发展实施意见
articles.title_en: Beijing Releases Implementation Opinions on Promoting High-Quality Urban Development
articles.summary_zh: 中共北京市委、北京市人民政府发布《关于推动城市高质量发展的实施意见》，目标到2035年初步建成国际一流的和谐宜居之都，部署了148项重点任务。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Beijing Municipal Committee and the Beijing Municipal Government released implementation opinions to promote high-quality urban development, aiming to build an international first-class livable capital by 2035.

articles.title_zh: 平桂区推行“码上”巡察畅通民意
articles.title_en: Pinggui District Implements "QR Code-based" Inspection to Enhance Public Feedback
articles.summary_zh: 平桂区通过投放专属二维码开展“码上巡察”，利用数字化手段收集民意，提升基层巡察监督的针对性和实效性。
articles.summary_en: Pinggui District has launched a "QR Code-based" inspection system to collect public feedback digitally, enhancing the effectiveness of grassroots supervision.

articles.title_zh: 河南南阳高速客车追尾货车致13人遇难3人受伤
articles.title_en: 13 Dead and 3 Injured in Highway Collision Between Bus and Truck in Nanyang, Henan
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月28日凌晨，河南南阳沪陕高速发生客车追尾货车事故，致13死3伤。省委书记刘宁、省长王凯作出批示，要求全力救治并彻查事故原因。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, 2026, a bus rear-ended a truck on the Hu-Shan Expressway in Nanyang, Henan, leaving 13 dead and 3 injured. Provincial leaders Liu Ning and Wang Kai ordered emergency rescue and a thorough investigation.

articles.title_zh: 江苏通州湾示范区召开专家咨询会破解循环经济发展瓶颈
articles.title_en: Tongzhou Bay Demonstration Zone in Jiangsu Holds Expert Consultation Meeting to Overcome Circular Economy Bottlenecks
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，江苏省通州湾江海联动开发示范区举办循环经济产业专家技术咨询会，探讨固废高值化利用及产业发展瓶颈。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, the Tongzhou Bay Jianghai Linkage Development Demonstration Zone in Jiangsu held an expert consultation meeting to discuss high-value utilization of solid waste and circular economy development.

articles.title_zh: 天津算电协同产业发展联盟正式成立
articles.title_en: Tianjin Computing-Electricity Synergy Industry Development Alliance Officially Established
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月28日，中国移动天津公司在国家会展中心（天津）发起成立天津算电协同产业发展联盟，旨在构建算力与电力一体化产业生态。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, 2026, China Mobile Tianjin Company initiated the establishment of the Tianjin Computing-Electricity Synergy Industry Development Alliance in Tianjin to build an integrated industry ecosystem for computing and electricity.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同奥地利总统范德贝伦就中奥建交55周年互致贺电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Austrian President Van der Bellen Exchange Congratulatory Messages on 55th Anniversary of Diplomatic Ties
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，国家主席习近平同奥地利总统范德贝伦互致贺电，庆祝中奥建交55周年，并表示愿共同推动双边关系迈上新台阶。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, President Xi Jinping and Austrian President Van der Bellen exchanged congratulatory messages to celebrate the 55th anniversary of diplomatic ties, pledging to further elevate bilateral relations.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同苏里南总统西蒙斯就中苏建交50周年互致贺电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Suriname President Simons Exchange Congratulatory Messages on 50th Anniversary of Diplomatic Ties
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，国家主席习近平同苏里南总统西蒙斯互致贺电，庆祝两国建交50周年，并表示愿增进战略互信，推动各领域务实合作取得更多成果。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, President Xi Jinping and Suriname President Simons exchanged congratulatory messages to celebrate the 50th anniversary of diplomatic ties, pledging to enhance strategic trust and pragmatic cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 河南“十五五”规划纲要明确地区生产总值年均增长目标为5%左右
articles.title_en: Henan's 15th Five-Year Plan Sets Annual GDP Growth Target at Around 5%
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，河南省省长王凯在新闻发布会上介绍，河南省“十五五”规划纲要已正式印发，明确生产总值年均增长目标为5%左右。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, Henan Governor Wang Kai announced the official release of the province's 15th Five-Year Plan, setting an annual GDP growth target of around 5%.

articles.title_zh: 河南将在“十五五”时期进一步融入服务全国统一大市场

articles.title_en: China's Supreme People's Procuratorate to Supervise Investigation into Shanxi Qinyuan Coal Mine Explosion

articles.summary_en: On May 26, China's Supreme People's Procuratorate announced its decision to supervise the investigation into a major coal mine explosion in Qinyuan, Shanxi, demanding strict punishment for those responsible.

articles.title_zh: 央视曝光境外间谍入侵联网设备窃密手段
articles.title_en: CCTV Exposes Foreign Spies' Methods of Hacking Networked Devices to Steal Secrets
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，央视发布保密科普纪录片《守护》，揭露境外间谍通过伪装身份、网络入侵等手段窃取我国军事及谈判秘密的风险。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, CCTV released a documentary titled "Guardian," exposing the risks of foreign spies stealing Chinese military and negotiation secrets through disguised identities and network intrusions.

articles.title_zh: 北京2026年家庭新能源车指标入围分数线降至36分
articles.title_en: Beijing's 2026 Family New Energy Vehicle Quota Cutoff Score Drops to 36 Points
articles.summary_zh: 北京市公布2026年新能源小客车指标配置结果，家庭指标入围分数线降至36分，共配置家庭指标119,200个。
articles.summary_en: Beijing announced the 2026 new energy vehicle quota allocation results, with the family cutoff score dropping to 36 points and 119,200 family quotas allocated.

articles.title_zh: 让新市民享有更美好生活
articles.title_en: Ensuring a Better Life for New Urban Residents
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，国务院新闻办举行吹风会，介绍国家首次出台的关于在常住地提供基本公共服务的实施意见，旨在完善新市民的就业、住房、教育及医疗保障。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the State Council Information Office held a briefing on the first national implementation opinions for providing basic public services at places of permanent residence to improve employment, housing, education, and healthcare for new urban residents.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省启动“5·26我爱路”主题宣传活动
articles.title_en: Gansu Province Launches '5.26 I Love the Road' Publicity Campaign
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，甘肃省在兰州启动“5·26我爱路”主题宣传活动，旨在通过多部门联动提升公众铁路安全意识，深化平安铁路建设。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Gansu Province launched the '5.26 I Love the Road' publicity campaign in Lanzhou to enhance public railway safety awareness and promote the construction of a 'Peaceful Railway'.

articles.title_zh: 基础电信企业网上营业厅服务国家标准发布
articles.title_en: National Standard for Online Business Hall Services of Basic Telecommunications Enterprises Released
articles.summary_zh: 市场监管总局近日发布《电信和互联网服务 基础电信企业网上营业厅服务规范》国家标准，旨在规范电信服务网上营业厅的信息透明度、无障碍服务及个人信息保护。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation released a national standard to regulate online business halls of basic telecommunications enterprises, focusing on transparency, accessibility, and data protection.

articles.title_zh: 兰州新区召开《兰州新区条例》立法开题暨调研座谈会
articles.title_en: Symposium Held on Legislative Opening and Research for Lanzhou New Area Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，兰州新区召开《兰州新区条例》立法开题暨调研座谈会，正式启动条例起草工作，旨在为新区高质量发展夯实法治基础。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Lanzhou New Area held a symposium on the legislative opening and research for the "Lanzhou New Area Regulations" to officially start the drafting process and strengthen the legal foundation for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 广西深化科技教育融合厚植人工智能创新沃土
articles.title_en: Guangxi Deepens Integration of Science and Education to Foster AI Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，广西在南宁举行新闻发布会，介绍通过深化科技教育融合、推动“人工智能+”行动来培养AI人才的举措。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, a press conference was held in Nanning, Guangxi, to introduce measures for cultivating AI talent through the integration of science and education and the "AI+" initiative.

articles.title_zh: 中国—东盟国家人工智能应用合作中心企业联盟在广西南宁成立
articles.title_en: China-ASEAN AI Application Cooperation Center Enterprise Alliance Established in Nanning, Guangxi
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，中国—东盟国家人工智能应用合作中心企业联盟在广西南宁成立，旨在通过产业链协同推动中国与东盟在人工智能领域的国际合作。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the China-ASEAN AI Application Cooperation Center Enterprise Alliance was established in Nanning, Guangxi, aiming to promote international AI cooperation through industrial chain synergy.

articles.title_zh: 国际生命健康企业海南行合作交流会举行
articles.title_en: International Life and Health Enterprise Hainan Tour Cooperation Exchange Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，国际生命健康企业海南行合作交流会在海口举行。省委书记冯飞、省长刘小明及中信集团负责人出席，旨在推动生命健康产业的国际合作与项目落地。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the International Life and Health Enterprise Hainan Tour Cooperation Exchange Meeting was held in Haikou. Provincial Secretary Feng Fei and Governor Liu Xiaoming attended to promote international cooperation in the life and health industry.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省航空航天产业联盟在无锡成立
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Aerospace Industry Alliance Established in Wuxi
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，江苏省航空航天产业联盟在无锡成立，旨在整合全省资源，推动商业航天、低空经济等核心领域的技术攻关与产业协同发展。
articles.summary_en: The Jiangsu Aerospace Industry Alliance was established in Wuxi on May 26 to integrate provincial resources and promote technological breakthroughs and industrial synergy in commercial spaceflight and the low-altitude economy.

articles.title_zh: 任珠峰在南昌调研经济运行情况
articles.title_en: Ren Zhufeng Conducts Research on Economic Operations in Nanchang
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，江西省委常委、常务副省长任珠峰在南昌调研经济运行情况，强调要加快推动全省经济稳中向好发展，确保实现“双过半”。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Ren Zhufeng, Member of the Standing Committee of the Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee and Executive Vice Governor, conducted research on economic operations in Nanchang to promote steady economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 江西省召开设区市市委书记座谈会 部署学习教育与经济发展工作
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Province Holds Symposium for Municipal Party Committee Secretaries to Deploy Learning Education and Economic Development
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，江西省委召开设区市市委书记座谈会，由省委书记尹弘主持，中央第一指导组组长徐令义出席，研究学习教育、经济发展及安全生产等工作。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee held a symposium for municipal party secretaries, chaired by Secretary Yin Hong and attended by Xu Lingyi, to discuss learning education, economic growth, and safety production.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古自治区政协召开专题协商会聚焦加强同粤港澳大湾区互惠合作
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia CPPCC Holds Special Consultative Meeting on Strengthening Cooperation with Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，内蒙古自治区政协召开专题协商会，探讨加强与粤港澳大湾区互惠合作，以夯实我国向北开放重要桥头堡建设基础。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region CPPCC held a special consultative meeting to discuss strengthening mutual cooperation with the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中会见乌兹别克斯坦共和国驻华大使阿尔济耶夫
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong Meets Uzbekistan Ambassador to China Alziev
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中在呼和浩特会见乌兹别克斯坦驻华大使阿尔济耶夫，双方就加强经贸投资、现代农业、生态治理等领域的务实合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Wang Weizhong, Secretary of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Party Committee, met with Uzbekistan Ambassador to China Alziev in Hohhot to discuss enhancing pragmatic cooperation in trade, investment, modern agriculture, and ecological governance.

articles.title_zh: 王毅谈中国对联合国事业所做贡献
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Discusses China's Contributions to the United Nations
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，外交部长王毅在主持联合国安理会高级别会议时，介绍了中国在维护联合国宪章、推动全球发展及多边主义方面所做的贡献。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Foreign Minister Wang Yi presided over a UN Security Council high-level meeting and detailed China's contributions to upholding the UN Charter, promoting global development, and supporting multilateralism.

articles.title_zh: 王毅主持安理会高级别会议就重振和壮大联合国达成共识
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Chairs High-Level Security Council Meeting on Revitalizing and Strengthening the UN
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，王毅在主持联合国安理会高级别会议后表示，与会各国就维护联合国宪章、重振和壮大联合国以及改革全球治理体系达成重要共识。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Wang Yi stated after chairing a high-level UN Security Council meeting that participants reached a consensus on upholding the UN Charter, revitalizing the UN, and reforming global governance.

articles.title_zh: 广东奋力在推进中国式现代化建设中走在前列
articles.title_en: Guangdong Strives to Lead in Advancing Chinese-style Modernization
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，广东省在广州举行“十五五”专场新闻发布会，省长孟凡利部署了关于先进制造业、粤港澳大湾区建设及城乡协调发展等重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Guangdong held a press conference in Guangzhou regarding the 15th Five-Year Plan, where Governor Meng Fanli outlined goals for advanced manufacturing, GBA development, and urban-rural coordination.

articles.title_zh: 上海市人大常委会会议召开
articles.title_en: Shanghai Municipal NPC Standing Committee Meeting Convened
articles.summary_zh: 上海市十六届人大常委会第三十次会议召开，由黄莉新主持，审议了包括浦东新区区块链应用在内的多项法规草案及监督报告。
articles.summary_en: The 30th meeting of the 16th Shanghai Municipal NPC Standing Committee was held, chaired by Huang Lixin, to deliberate on several draft regulations, including blockchain applications in Pudong, and various supervision reports.

articles.title_zh: 陈吉宁主持上海市实施乡村振兴战略现场推进会
articles.title_en: Chen Jining Chairs Shanghai Meeting on Promoting Rural Revitalization Strategy
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月26日，上海市委书记陈吉宁主持实施乡村振兴战略现场推进会，强调要聚焦科技农业、改善人居环境并促进农民增收，走出超大城市城乡融合发展新路子。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, 2026, Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Jining chaired a meeting to promote the rural revitalization strategy, emphasizing agricultural technology, improved living conditions, and increased farmers' income.

articles.title_zh: AI赋能微短剧产业“沪8条”发布
articles.title_en: Shanghai Releases "8 Measures" to Empower Micro-short Drama Industry with AI
articles.summary_zh: 上海发布《加快推进AI赋能微短剧产业高质量发展的若干措施》（“沪8条”），通过算力补贴、审核机制优化及产业集聚，推动AI微短剧产业高质量发展与文化出海。
articles.summary_en: Shanghai released the "8 Measures" to promote the high-quality development of the AI-powered micro-short drama industry, focusing on computing power subsidies, streamlined review processes, and industrial clustering to support cultural exports.

articles.title_zh: 第48届世界技能大赛使节招待会在京举行
articles.title_en: Diplomatic Reception for the 48th WorldSkills Competition Held in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，第48届世界技能大赛使节招待会在北京举行。人社部部长王晓萍、上海市市长龚正等出席，邀请各方参加将于9月在上海举办的世赛。
articles.summary_en: A diplomatic reception for the 48th WorldSkills Competition was held in Beijing on May 26. Minister Wang Xiaoping and Mayor Gong Zheng invited international guests to the event in Shanghai this September.

articles.title_zh: 更好发挥“两重”“两新”政策效能 为稳增长和高质量发展提供有力支撑
articles.title_en: Better Leverage "Two Heavies" and "Two News" Policies to Support Steady Growth and High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，陕西省委书记赵一德主持召开省委专题会议，研究推进“两重”“两新”工作，旨在通过发挥政策效能促进消费投资，支撑稳增长和高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Zhao Yide, Secretary of the Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee, chaired a special meeting to promote "Two Heavies" and "Two News" policies to boost consumption, investment, and high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 行神州“播”天下—2026年优质网络主播中国行天津行活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Quality Network Anchor China Tour Launches in Tianjin
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，由中央网信办指导、天津市委网信办等主办的2026年优质网络主播中国行天津行活动启动，旨在通过网络主播传播天津新质生产力及高质量发展成果。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the 2026 Quality Network Anchor China Tour launched in Tianjin, guided by the CAC, to promote the city's new quality productive forces and high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 云南省拟出台粮食安全保障条例
articles.title_en: Yunnan Province Proposes Food Security Guarantee Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，《云南省粮食安全保障条例（草案）》提请省十四届人大常委会第二十三次会议审议，旨在通过全链条规范夯实粮食安全根基。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the draft of the Yunnan Province Food Security Guarantee Regulations was submitted to the Standing Committee of the 14th Provincial People's Congress for deliberation to strengthen food security.

articles.title_zh: 北京市政府召开常务会议研究“十五五”时期推进农业农村现代化规划等事项
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal Government Holds Executive Meeting to Study the 15th Five-Year Plan for Agricultural and Rural Modernization
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，北京市长殷勇主持市政府常务会议，研究“十五五”时期推进农业农村现代化规划及密云水库水源保护等事项。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Mayor Yin Yong chaired an executive meeting of the Beijing Municipal Government to discuss the 15th Five-Year Plan for agricultural and rural modernization and the protection of the Miyun Reservoir.

articles.title_zh: 涉企检查频次降40% 重庆“大综合一体化”改革成效明显
articles.title_en: Chongqing's 'Great Comprehensive Integration' Reform Significantly Reduces Enterprise Inspections by 40%
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，重庆市六届人大常委会听取市政府关于法治政府建设的报告，介绍其“大综合一体化”行政执法改革在精简队伍和优化涉企执法方面取得显著成效。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the Standing Committee of Chongqing Municipal People's Congress heard a report on law-based government construction, highlighting the success of the 'Great Comprehensive Integration' reform in streamlining law enforcement and reducing enterprise inspections.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军在重庆市全面推动制造业高质量发展大会上强调开创制造强市新局面
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun Emphasizes Creating New Prospects for Manufacturing City Construction at Chongqing Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，重庆市召开全面推动制造业高质量发展大会，市委书记袁家军强调要以智能化、绿色化、融合化为主攻方向，开创“十五五”开局之年制造强市建设新局面。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Chongqing held a conference on promoting high-quality manufacturing development. Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun emphasized focusing on intelligence, greening, and integration to build a strong manufacturing city for the '15th Five-Year Plan'.

articles.title_zh: 工业和信息化部发布2026年汽车标准化工作要点
articles.title_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Releases 2026 Automotive Standardization Work Points
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部于5月26日在北京发布2026年汽车标准化工作要点，部署质量安全、绿色低碳及新兴领域等标准提升行动，以促进汽车产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology released the 2026 Automotive Standardization Work Points in Beijing to promote high-quality industry development through enhanced safety, green, and emerging technology standards.

articles.title_zh: 国家能源局发布51个“人工智能+”能源高价值场景
articles.title_en: National Energy Administration Releases 51 High-Value "AI+" Energy Scenarios
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，国家能源局在广州举办全国“人工智能+”能源现场推进会，发布首批51个高价值应用场景及发展报告，旨在推动能源产业智能化转型升级。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the National Energy Administration held a promotion meeting in Guangzhou, releasing 51 high-value "AI+" energy scenarios and a development report to drive the intelligent transformation of the energy industry.

articles.title_zh: 2026年甘肃政策性粮油库存检查工作启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Gansu Policy-based Grain and Oil Inventory Inspection Launched
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，甘肃省粮食和物资储备局启动2026年全省政策性粮油库存检查，重点核查库存数量、质量及安全管理情况。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the Gansu Provincial Grain and Material Reserve Bureau launched the 2026 provincial policy-based grain and oil inventory inspection to verify stock quantity, quality, and safety management.

articles.title_zh: 自治区政府与智能机器人企业签署战略合作协议 韦韬见证签约
articles.title_en: Guangxi Autonomous Region Government Signs Strategic Cooperation Agreement with Intelligent Robot Companies, Witnessed by Wei Tao
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，自治区主席韦韬在南宁见证自治区政府与智元创新、广西阶段者机器人公司签署战略合作协议，旨在共建面向东盟的具身智能产业高地。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Chairman Wei Tao witnessed the signing of a strategic cooperation agreement between the Guangxi government and robot companies Zhiyuan Innovation and Guangxi Jieduizhe in Nanning to develop an embodied AI industry hub for ASEAN.

articles.title_zh: 库克群岛岛际船舶启动暨命名仪式在广西梧州举行
articles.title_en: Launch and Naming Ceremony of Cook Islands Inter-Island Vessel Held in Wuzhou, Guangxi
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，库克群岛总理马克·布朗出席在广西梧州举行的岛际船舶启动暨命名仪式，旨在加强中库基础设施与航运合作。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Cook Islands Prime Minister Mark Brown attended the launch and naming ceremony of an inter-island vessel in Wuzhou, Guangxi, to strengthen China-Cook Islands infrastructure and shipping cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 省政协党组理论学习中心组举行树立和践行正确政绩观学习研讨
articles.title_en: Provincial CPPCC Party Group Holds Seminar on Establishing and Practicing Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，省政协党组理论学习中心组举行集体学习研讨，由省政协主席孔昌生主持，探讨如何树立和践行正确的政绩观以服务高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the theoretical learning center group of the Provincial CPPCC held a seminar led by Chairman Kong Changsheng to discuss establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements to serve high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 省委理论学习中心组举行集体学习研讨
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Committee Theoretical Learning Center Group Holds Collective Study and Discussion
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，省委书记刘宁主持省委理论学习中心组集体学习研讨，强调要牢固树立和践行正确政绩观，推动学习教育走深走实。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning chaired a collective study session of the Provincial Party Committee's theoretical learning center group to promote the practice of a correct achievements view.

articles.title_zh: 省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议举行
articles.title_en: The 24th Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th Henan Provincial People's Congress Held
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议在郑州举行，审议了关于全国统一大市场、工伤保险等条例草案及人事任免事项。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the 24th meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th Henan Provincial People's Congress was held in Zhengzhou to review draft regulations and personnel matters.

articles.title_zh: 全省树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育警示教育会召开
articles.title_en: Provincial Warning Education Meeting on Establishing and Practicing Correct View of Achievements Held

articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment released the Technical Guidelines for the Formulation of Basin Water Ecological Environment Quality Standards, effective September 1, 2026, to standardize basin water quality standards.

articles.title_zh: 殷勇会见环球银行金融电信协会全球首席执行官
articles.title_en: Yin Yong Meets CEO of Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication
articles.summary_zh: 北京市市长殷勇日前会见环球银行金融电信协会全球首席执行官哈维尔·塔索，探讨加强金融科技交流合作并优化营商环境。
articles.summary_en: Beijing Mayor Yin Yong met with Javier Tasso, CEO of SWIFT, to discuss strengthening cooperation in fintech and optimizing the business environment in Beijing.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记关切事·关键小事｜街巷里的温暖“家”事
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Concerns: Improving Livelihoods Through Old Community Renovation
articles.summary_zh: 文章报道了内蒙古阿尔山市、辽宁沈阳市和重庆市在习近平总书记指导下，通过推进棚户区和老旧小区改造，切实改善群众居住环境并提升民生福祉。
articles.summary_en: The article reports on the renovation of shantytowns and old communities in Arshan, Shenyang, and Chongqing under the guidance of Xi Jinping to improve living conditions and people's well-being.

articles.title_zh: 最高检全面加强对立案、侦查、审判、执行等活动的法律监督
articles.title_en: Supreme People's Procuratorate to Strengthen Legal Supervision of Case Filing, Investigation, Trial, and Execution
articles.summary_zh: 5月27日，最高检副检察长苗生明在国新办发布会上表示，检察机关将全面加强对立案、侦查、审判、执行等活动的法律监督，严惩司法腐败。
articles.summary_en: On May 27, Miao Shengming, Vice Prosecutor General of the SPP, announced at a press conference that procuratorial organs will strengthen legal supervision over judicial activities and crack down on judicial corruption.

articles.title_zh: 安徽省加快布局“人工智能+政务”赋能政府治理现代化
articles.title_en: Anhui Province Accelerates "AI + Government Affairs" Layout to Empower Modernization of Government Governance
articles.summary_zh: 安徽省近日印发《加快推进“人工智能+政务”行动方案》，旨在通过数智化融合赋能政府治理现代化，并设定了2027年和2030年的阶段性目标。
articles.summary_en: Anhui Province recently issued an action plan to accelerate "AI + Government Affairs" integration, aiming to modernize government governance with specific goals for 2027 and 2030.

articles.title_zh: 共探产教融合新路径 推动中高职发展
articles.title_en: Exploring New Paths for Industry-Education Integration to Promote Vocational Education Development
articles.summary_zh: 2026年职业教育产教融合论坛（粤港澳大湾区）在中新广州知识城举办，探讨职业教育高质量发展并签署战略合作协议。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Vocational Education Industry-Education Integration Forum (GBA) was held in China-Singapore Guangzhou Knowledge City to discuss high-quality vocational education and sign strategic cooperation agreements.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省人民政府关于周立荣等同志职务任免的通知
articles.title_en: Notice of the Gansu Provincial People's Government on Personnel Appointments and Removals of Zhou Lirong and Others
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省人民政府决定周立荣任省统计局局长，巨鸿文任省应急管理厅副厅长，并免去杨汉杰、张志明相关职务。
articles.summary_en: The Gansu Provincial People's Government announced the appointment of Zhou Lirong as Director of the Provincial Bureau of Statistics and Ju Hongwen as Deputy Director of the Provincial Emergency Management Department, along with other personnel changes.

articles.title_zh: 国产600公斤推力级涡扇发动机首飞
articles.title_en: Domestic 600kg Thrust Turbofan Engine Completes First Flight
articles.summary_zh: 中国航发集团旗下四川天府轻型动力科技有限公司研制的F406涡扇发动机圆满完成首飞，填补了我国中小推力涡扇发动机领域多项技术空白。
articles.summary_en: The F406 turbofan engine developed by Sichuan Tianfu Light Power Technology Co., Ltd. under AECC successfully completed its first flight, filling several technical gaps in China's small-to-medium thrust turbofan engines.

articles.title_zh: 我国创新药实现跨越式发展
articles.title_en: China's Innovative Drug Industry Achieves Leapfrog Development
articles.summary_zh: 国家药监局数据显示，我国创新药研发实力显著提升，今年已批准上市19款创新药，对外授权交易额创历史新高，审评审批制度改革成效显著。
articles.summary_en: Data from the NMPA indicates a significant boost in China's innovative drug R&D, with 19 new drugs approved this year and record-high outbound licensing, driven by regulatory reforms.

articles.title_zh: 胜利济阳页岩油国家级示范区累产突破200万吨
articles.title_en: Shengli Jiyang Shale Oil National Demonstration Zone's Cumulative Production Exceeds 2 Million Tons
articles.summary_zh: 胜利济阳页岩油国家级示范区累计产量突破200万吨，标志着我国中低成熟度页岩油勘探开发取得历史性突破。
articles.summary_en: The Shengli Jiyang Shale Oil National Demonstration Zone has exceeded 2 million tons in cumulative production, marking a historical breakthrough in China's exploration and development of medium-to-low maturity shale oil.

articles.title_zh: 太原市迎泽区委原书记李慧严重违纪违法被开除党籍和公职
articles.title_en: Former Yingze District Party Secretary Li Hui Expelled from Party and Public Office for Serious Discipline and Law Violations
articles.summary_zh: 山西省纪委监委对太原市迎泽区委原书记李慧进行立案审查调查，决定给予其开除党籍和公职处分，并将其涉嫌犯罪问题移送检察机关起诉。
articles.summary_en: The Shanxi Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervisory Commission expelled Li Hui, former Party Secretary of Yingze District, Taiyuan, from the Party and public office for serious corruption and law violations.

articles.title_zh: 山西省发布2026年军队院校招收普高毕业生政治考核工作安排
articles.title_en: Shanxi Province Releases Political Assessment Arrangements for 2026 Military Academy Admissions for High School Graduates
articles.summary_zh: 山西省招生考试管理中心近日发布通知，明确2026年军队院校招收普高毕业生的政治考核安排，考核将于6月10日至24日开展。
articles.summary_en: The Shanxi Provincial Admissions and Examination Management Center announced the political assessment arrangements for high school graduates applying to military academies in 2026, to be conducted from June 10 to 24.

articles.title_zh: 自治区领导同志古尔邦节前夕看望老同志
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Regional Leaders Visit Veteran Comrades Ahead of Eid al-Adha
articles.summary_zh: 古尔邦节前夕，陈小江、艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜等自治区领导看望了司马义·铁力瓦尔地等老同志，就新疆“十五五”规划及社会稳定工作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of Eid al-Adha, regional leaders including Chen Xiaojiang and Erken Tunyaz visited veteran comrades to discuss Xinjiang's 15th Five-Year Plan and social stability.

articles.title_zh: 云南省印发《实施方案》推进产业园区用地专项治理
articles.title_en: Yunnan Province Issues Implementation Plan to Promote Special Governance of Industrial Park Land Use
articles.summary_zh: 云南省自然资源厅等部门印发实施方案，通过五项重点任务推进全省产业园区用地专项治理，旨在优化土地配置，推动经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The Yunnan Provincial Department of Natural Resources and other departments issued an implementation plan to govern industrial park land use via five key tasks to optimize land allocation and promote high-quality economic development.

articles.title_zh: 水利部在宁夏召开水预算管理试点建设现场会
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Holds Field Meeting on Water Budget Management Pilots in Ningxia
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，水利部在宁夏银川召开水预算管理试点建设现场会，总结试点成效并部署水预算体系建设重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the Ministry of Water Resources held a field meeting in Yinchuan, Ningxia, to summarize the achievements of water budget management pilots and deploy key tasks for the system's construction.

articles.title_zh: 吉林省推进低效闲置资产资源盘活利用，年度处置目标一千亿元
articles.title_en: Jilin Province Promotes Revitalization of Inefficient and Idle Assets with 100 Billion Yuan Annual Target
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，胡玉亭在专题会议上强调，吉林省要锚定一千亿元的低效闲置资产盘活处置年度目标，通过创新举措释放资源价值，赋能高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Hu Yuting emphasized at a special meeting that Jilin Province aims to revitalize 100 billion yuan of inefficient and idle assets to release resource value and empower high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 白景富同志逝世
articles.title_en: Comrade Bai Jingfu Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 公安部原主持常务工作的副部长、党委副书记白景富同志于2026年4月29日在北京逝世，享年81岁。
articles.summary_en: Bai Jingfu, former Vice Minister and Deputy Party Secretary of the Ministry of Public Security, passed away in Beijing on April 29, 2026, at the age of 81.

articles.title_zh: 海南全面启动2026年林草湿荒调查监测工作
articles.title_en: Hainan Fully Launches 2026 Forest, Grassland, Wetland, and Desertification Survey and Monitoring Work
articles.summary_zh: 5月20日，海南省在海口启动2026年林草湿荒调查监测工作，由省自然资源和规划厅与省林业局联合部署，旨在为自贸港建设提供生态支撑。
articles.summary_en: On May 20, Hainan Province launched the 2026 forest, grassland, wetland, and desertification survey in Haikou to provide ecological support for the Free Trade Port construction.

articles.title_en: Supreme People's Procuratorate Supervises Investigation into Major Coal Mine Explosion in Qinyuan, Shanxi
articles.summary_zh: 5月22日山西沁源县发生煤矿瓦斯爆炸造成重大人员伤亡，最高检现已挂牌督办，要求依法严惩事故主要责任人员。
articles.summary_en: The Supreme People's Procuratorate is supervising the investigation into a gas explosion at a coal mine in Qinyuan, Shanxi on May 22, which caused massive casualties, and has called for strict punishment of those responsible.

articles.title_zh: 留神峪煤矿瓦斯爆炸事故暴露隐蔽工作面等重大违法行为
articles.title_en: Liushenyu Coal Mine Gas Explosion Reveals Major Illegalities Including Hidden Working Faces
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月22日山西长治留神峪煤矿发生瓦斯爆炸造成重大伤亡，初步调查显示该矿存在隐蔽工作面、人员无定位卡等重大违法行为。
articles.summary_en: A gas explosion at Liushenyu Coal Mine in Changzhi, Shanxi on May 22, 2026, caused significant casualties. Preliminary investigations reveal major illegalities, including hidden working faces and lack of personnel positioning cards.

articles.title_zh: 云南首个新的社会阶层人士服务中心成立
articles.title_en: First Service Center for New Social Strata Established in Yunnan
articles.summary_zh: 5月22日，云南首个新的社会阶层人士服务中心在昆明市五华区揭牌，旨在构建引领服务新阶层人士的核心枢纽平台。
articles.summary_en: On May 22, Yunnan's first service center for new social strata was unveiled in Wuhua District, Kunming, aiming to build a hub for guiding and serving new social strata.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同塞尔维亚总统武契奇会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月25日，国家主席习近平在北京同塞尔维亚总统武契奇举行会谈，双方签署多项合作文件并发表联合声明，旨在深化中塞全面战略伙伴关系。
articles.summary_en: On May 25, 2026, President Xi Jinping held talks with Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić in Beijing. The two sides signed over 20 cooperation documents and issued joint statements to deepen the China-Serbia comprehensive strategic partnership.

articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds "Medal of Friendship" Awarding Ceremony for Serbian President Vučić
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月25日，国家主席习近平在北京人民大会堂为塞尔维亚总统武契奇颁授“友谊勋章”，以肯定其对中塞友好关系的贡献。
articles.summary_en: On May 25, 2026, President Xi Jinping awarded the "Medal of Friendship" to Serbian President Vučić at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing to recognize his contributions to China-Serbia relations.

articles.title_zh: 习近平会见巴基斯坦总理夏巴兹

articles.summary_en: On May 25, 2026, President Xi Jinping met with Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif in Beijing to discuss building a China-Pakistan community with a shared future and deepening all-round cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 4月全国查处违反中央八项规定精神问题21889起
articles.title_en: 21,889 Cases of Violating Central Eight-Point Regulation Handled Nationwide in April
articles.summary_zh: 中央纪委国家监委5月25日公布数据显示，今年4月全国共查处违反中央八项规定精神问题21889起，批评教育和处理27852人。
articles.summary_en: On May 25, the CCDI and NSC reported that 21,889 cases of violating the central eight-point regulation were handled nationwide in April, with 27,852 people criticized or processed.

articles.summary_en: On May 25, President Xi Jinping held talks with Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić in Beijing and awarded him the "Medal of Friendship."

articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets with Singaporean Foreign Minister Vivian and Pakistani Army Chief Munir
articles.summary_zh: 5月25日，外交部长王毅在北京分别同新加坡外长维文和巴基斯坦国防军司令穆尼尔会谈会见，讨论双边关系、地区稳定及全球挑战。
articles.summary_en: On May 25, Foreign Minister Wang Yi met with Singaporean Foreign Minister Vivian and Pakistani Army Chief Munir in Beijing to discuss bilateral relations, regional stability, and global challenges.

articles.title_zh: 前4月商品和服务零售合并计算同比增长3.2%
articles.title_en: Combined Retail Sales of Goods and Services Grow 3.2% in First Four Months
articles.summary_zh: 商务部25日介绍，今年1—4月商品和服务零售合并计算同比增长3.2%，消费市场运行平稳，绿色智能产品及服务消费增长明显。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce reported on May 25 that combined retail sales of goods and services grew 3.2% YoY from January to April, driven by trade-in policies and growth in smart products.

articles.title_zh: 广东展团在文博会签约和意向签约超百亿元
articles.title_en: Guangdong Exhibition Group Signs Deals Exceeding 10 Billion Yuan at ICIF
articles.summary_zh: 5月25日，在第二十二届中国（深圳）国际文化产业博览会上，由广东省委宣传部主办的重点文化产业项目签约活动举行，签约及意向签约金额超100亿元。
articles.summary_en: On May 25, at the 22nd China (Shenzhen) International Cultural Industries Fair, a signing event for key cultural industry projects hosted by the Guangdong Provincial Committee Publicity Department resulted in deals and intentions exceeding 10 billion yuan.
