articles.title_zh: 贵州将推动政用、商用、民用领域数智化转型
articles.title_en: Guizhou to Promote Digital and Intelligent Transformation in Government, Commercial, and Civil Sectors
articles.summary_zh: 5月25日，贵州在贵阳举行“十五五”专题新闻发布会，宣布将实施“人工智能+”行动，推动政用、商用、民用领域数智化转型。
articles.summary_en: On May 25, Guizhou held a press conference in Guiyang to announce the implementation of 'AI+' actions to drive digital and intelligent transformation across government, commercial, and civil sectors.

articles.title_zh: 贵州举行开局起步“十五五”专题新闻发布会
articles.title_en: Guizhou Holds Special Press Conference on the Start of the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 5月25日，贵州省长李炳军在贵阳出席“十五五”专题新闻发布会，部署贵州在现代化产业体系、民生保障及生态建设等方面的高质量发展规划。
articles.summary_en: On May 25, Guizhou Governor Li Bingjun attended a press conference in Guiyang to outline the province's high-quality development plans for the 15th Five-Year Plan, focusing on industry, livelihood, and ecology.

articles.title_zh: 王忠林调度推进洪湖流域综合治理工作
articles.title_en: Wang Zhonglin Coordinates Comprehensive Governance of Honghu Basin
articles.summary_zh: 5月25日，湖北省委书记王忠林主持召开会议，调度推进洪湖流域综合治理工作，强调要通过“五个治理”持续改善生态环境。
articles.summary_en: On May 25, Hubei Provincial Party Secretary Wang Zhonglin chaired a meeting to coordinate the comprehensive governance of the Honghu Basin, emphasizing "five types of governance" to continuously improve the ecological environment.

articles.title_zh: 湖北推进“科技金融+”专项行动并研究6G技术创新
articles.title_en: Hubei Promotes "Tech Finance+" Special Action and Researches 6G Technology Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 5月25日，湖北省长李殿勋主持召开省政府常务会议，研究实施“科技金融+”专项行动及促进6G技术创新和产业培育等工作。
articles.summary_en: On May 25, Hubei Governor Li Dianxun chaired a provincial government executive meeting to discuss the "Tech Finance+" special action and the promotion of 6G technology innovation and industrial cultivation.

articles.title_zh: 全国人大常委会启动海南自由贸易港法执法检查
articles.title_en: NPC Standing Committee Launches Law Enforcement Inspection of Hainan Free Trade Port Law
articles.summary_zh: 全国人大常委会于5月25日在北京启动海南自由贸易港法执法检查，旨在评估法律实施情况并推动更高水平的对外开放。
articles.summary_en: The NPC Standing Committee launched a law enforcement inspection of the Hainan Free Trade Port Law in Beijing on May 25 to evaluate its implementation and promote higher-level opening-up.

articles.title_zh: 国家防总办公室组织多部门会商部署防汛救灾工作
articles.title_en: State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters Office Organizes Multi-Departmental Meeting to Deploy Flood Control and Disaster Relief
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月25日，国家防总办公室与应急管理部组织多部门会商部署重点地区防汛救灾工作，水利部与中国气象局联合发布橙色山洪灾害气象预警。
articles.summary_en: On May 25, 2026, the State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters Office and the Ministry of Emergency Management coordinated multi-departmental efforts to deploy flood relief, while an orange flash flood warning was issued.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中、包钢会见国家税务总局局长胡静林
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong and Bao Gang Meet with Hu Jinglin, Director of State Taxation Administration
articles.summary_zh: 5月25日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中、自治区主席包钢在呼和浩特会见国家税务总局局长胡静林，探讨税收支持与区域高质量发展。

articles.summary_zh: 红军老战士、原总后太原基地兵站副站长马志选同志于2026年5月24日在太原逝世，享年108岁。
articles.summary_en: Ma Zhixuan, a Red Army veteran and former deputy station chief of the Taiyuan Base Station of the General Logistics Department, passed away in Taiyuan on May 24, 2026, at the age of 108.

articles.summary_en: The 2026 Beijing Science Week launched with the joint release of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Science Popularization Resource Map, featuring 62 quality sites to promote regional resource sharing.

articles.title_zh: 西洽会签约212个重大项目

articles.summary_en: The 8th China West International Investment and Trade Fair concluded in Chongqing on May 24, signing 212 major projects to promote opening-up and industrial upgrading in Western China.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军指挥调度重庆市防汛救灾工作并召开会议
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun Directs Flood Control and Disaster Relief Efforts in Chongqing

articles.summary_en: On May 24, Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Secretary Yuan Jiajun directed emergency rescue efforts for severe floods and geological disasters and chaired a flood control meeting to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 水利部针对安徽、河南、重庆、陕西启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应

articles.summary_en: On May 24, the Ministry of Water Resources launched a Level IV emergency response for flood defense in Anhui, Henan, Chongqing, and Shaanxi to cope with predicted heavy rainfall.

articles.title_zh: 提振消费专项行动实施一年多来成效明显

articles.summary_en: Since the 'Special Action Plan to Boost Consumption' was issued by the CPC Central Committee and State Council in March 2025, significant progress has been made in commodity, service, and new consumption sectors, supporting economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古部署开展全区煤矿瓦斯防治工作

articles.summary_en: On May 24, the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Safety Production Committee Office and the Mine Safety Supervision Bureau deployed gas prevention work in coal mines and launched comprehensive safety inspections.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古科技活动周在兴安盟启动

articles.summary_en: The 2026 Inner Mongolia Science and Technology Activity Week launched in Hinggan League on May 24, featuring innovation showcases, cooperation signings, and platform unveilings to drive regional development.

articles.title_zh: 国家卫生健康委全力支持伤员救治和心理疏导
articles.title_en: National Health Commission Fully Supports Injury Treatment and Psychological Counseling
articles.summary_zh: 5月24日，国家卫生健康委组织专家组赴山西省，全力支持留神峪煤矿瓦斯爆炸事故伤员的医疗救治与心理疏导工作。
articles.summary_en: On May 24, the National Health Commission organized expert teams to Shanxi Province to provide medical treatment and psychological support for victims of the Liushenyu coal mine gas explosion.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江在博州督导中央生态环境保护督察整改工作

articles.summary_en: On May 24, Chen Xiaojiang, Secretary of the Autonomous Region Party Committee, supervised the rectification of central ecological and environmental protection inspections in Bortala Mongol Autonomous Prefecture.

articles.title_zh: 应急管理部针对安徽启动国家地质灾害四级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Emergency Management Launches Level IV National Emergency Response for Geological Disasters in Anhui
articles.summary_zh: 应急管理部于5月24日针对安徽省启动国家地质灾害四级应急响应，以应对预测的大暴雨及地质灾害风险。
articles.summary_en: On May 24, the Ministry of Emergency Management launched a Level IV national emergency response for geological disasters in Anhui Province to address risks from predicted heavy rainfall.

articles.title_zh: 今年首个红色预警发布，安徽和湖北局地有特大暴雨
articles.title_en: First Red Warning of the Year Issued for Extreme Rainstorms in Anhui and Hubei

articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Water Resources and China Meteorological Administration issued the first red mountain flood warning of the year on May 24, forecasting extreme rainstorms in parts of Anhui and Hubei.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军部署重庆市防汛救灾工作

articles.summary_en: On May 24, Chongqing Municipal Committee Secretary Yuan Jiajun directed emergency rescue efforts and chaired a flood control meeting to ensure the safety of people's lives and property.

articles.title_en: China to Release Integrated Foreign Trade Data for Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
articles.summary_zh: 海关总署出台支持粤港澳大湾区建设措施，将联合港澳研究并适时发布大湾区整体对外货物贸易统计数据，以提升市场一体化水平。
articles.summary_en: The General Administration of Customs issued measures to support the GBA, including collaborating with Hong Kong and Macao to release integrated foreign trade statistics to enhance market integration.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚韦韬会见国家防灾减灾救灾委员会办公室副主任陈敏一行
articles.title_en: Chen Gang and Wei Tao Meet with Chen Min, Deputy Director of the National Committee for Disaster Prevention, Reduction and Relief

articles.summary_en: On May 24, Guangxi Party Secretary Chen Gang and Chairman Wei Tao met with Chen Min, Deputy Director of the National Committee for Disaster Prevention, Reduction and Relief, in Nanning to discuss earthquake relief and recovery in Liuzhou.

articles.title_zh: 2026年河南省科技活动周启动

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明检查煤矿安全监管工作

articles.summary_en: On May 24, Hunan Governor Mao Weiming inspected coal mine safety supervision at the Provincial Energy Group, calling for comprehensive risk rectification to enhance intrinsic safety.

articles.title_zh: 各地各部门全力做好防汛抗洪工作
articles.title_en: Various Regions and Departments Fully Engage in Flood Control and Disaster Relief
articles.summary_zh: 面对近期多地强降雨，国家防总、水利部等部门组织调度，湖南、湖北、重庆等省市全力开展防汛抗洪与救灾工作。
articles.summary_en: In response to recent heavy rains, the National Flood Control Headquarters and the Ministry of Water Resources have coordinated efforts as provinces like Hunan, Hubei, and Chongqing implement flood control and disaster relief.

articles.title_zh: 张工会见乌兹别克斯坦塔什干市市长乌穆尔扎科夫
articles.title_en: Zhang Gong Meets Mayor of Tashkent Umurzakov
articles.summary_zh: 5月24日，天津市市长张工在津会见乌兹别克斯坦塔什干市市长乌穆尔扎科夫，双方探讨加强经贸投资、基础设施及高等教育等领域合作。
articles.summary_en: On May 24, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong met with Tashkent Mayor Umurzakov in Tianjin to discuss strengthening cooperation in trade, investment, infrastructure, and higher education.

articles.title_zh: 第二届中国新疆民间艺术季在乌鲁木齐启动

articles.title_zh: 深圳常住人口首破1800万，去年增量居全国城市首位

articles.title_zh: 安徽省委书记、省长赴中科大调研

articles.title_zh: 习近平同俄罗斯总统普京共同会见记者
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin Jointly Meet the Press
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月20日，国家主席习近平在北京同俄罗斯总统普京会谈后共同会见记者，双方签署联合声明并就深化全面战略协作、推动全球治理达成共识。
articles.summary_en: On May 20, 2026, President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin jointly met the press in Beijing after talks, signing joint statements to deepen strategic coordination and global governance.

articles.title_zh: 中俄关于倡导世界多极化和新型国际关系的联合声明
articles.title_en: Joint Statement of the People's Republic of China and the Russian Federation on Advocating for World Multipolarity and a New Type of International Relations
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月20日，中国和俄罗斯在北京发表联合声明，倡导平等有序的世界多极化，构建公正合理的全球治理体系和新型国际关系。
articles.summary_en: On May 20, 2026, China and Russia issued a joint statement in Beijing advocating for an equal and orderly multipolar world and the construction of a fair global governance system and new international relations.

articles.title_zh: 俄罗斯总统普京访华期间两国元首会晤成果文件清单
articles.title_en: List of Outcome Documents from the Meeting Between the Two Heads of State During Russian President Putin's Visit to China
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月20日，俄罗斯总统普京访华期间，中俄两国元首会晤并签署了一系列涵盖战略协作、贸易、科技、教育等领域的成果文件。
articles.summary_en: On May 20, 2026, during Russian President Putin's visit to China, the two heads of state met and signed a series of outcome documents covering strategic coordination, trade, science, technology, and education.

articles.title_zh: 李强签署国务院令公布《中华人民共和国矿产资源法实施条例》
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Decree to Publish Implementing Regulations of the Mineral Resources Law
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强日前签署国务院令，公布《中华人民共和国矿产资源法实施条例》，旨在保障矿产资源合理开发利用及安全，自2026年6月15日起施行。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council decree to publish the Implementing Regulations of the Mineral Resources Law, aimed at ensuring the rational development and security of mineral resources, effective June 15, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 山东日照探索推进全域美丽海湾建设
articles.title_en: Rizhao, Shandong Explores the Promotion of All-Region Beautiful Bay Construction
articles.summary_zh: 山东日照市通过实施“湾长制”和生态修复，推进全域美丽海湾建设，实现了生态保护与经济发展的共赢。
articles.summary_en: Rizhao, Shandong is promoting the construction of "Beautiful Bays" through the "Bay Chief System" and ecological restoration, achieving a win-win for environmental protection and economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 三部门开展2026年“数贸汇英才”面向高校毕业生招聘活动
articles.title_en: Three Departments Launch 2026 'Digital Trade Talent Gathering' Recruitment for College Graduates
articles.summary_zh: 商务部、教育部、人力资源社会保障部于2026年5月20日发布通知，将于5月至12月联合举办面向高校毕业生的数字贸易和服务外包企业招聘活动。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Education, and Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security announced a joint recruitment campaign for college graduates in digital trade and service outsourcing from May to December 2026.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security

tags_en: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security

articles.title_zh: 两部门发文推动多用户绿电直连发展
articles.title_en: Two Departments Issue Document to Promote Multi-user Green Power Direct Connection
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局发布通知，有序推动多用户绿电直连发展，旨在实现更高水平、更大范围的新能源就近消纳利用。
articles.summary_en: The NDRC and National Energy Administration issued a notice to promote multi-user green power direct connection to enhance the local consumption of renewable energy.

articles.title_zh: 工业和信息化部开展年度监督检查工作 促车企提升质量安全水平
articles.title_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Launches Annual Supervision Inspections to Improve Vehicle Quality and Safety
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部于2026年5月20日在北京宣布开展年度道路机动车辆生产一致性监督检查，旨在提升车企质量安全水平并维护市场秩序。
articles.summary_en: On May 20, 2026, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology announced annual supervision inspections for road motor vehicle production consistency to enhance quality safety and market order.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 青海“十五五”时期以生态优先引领高质量发展
articles.title_en: Qinghai to Lead High-Quality Development with Ecological Priority During the 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 5月20日，青海省长罗东川在新闻发布会上介绍，青海将在“十五五”时期以更高标准打造生态文明高地，推动生态优势转化为发展胜势。
articles.summary_en: On May 20, Qinghai Governor Luo Dongchuan announced that the province will prioritize ecological civilization and high-quality development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 鲁信创投通过“耐心资本”助力山东科创高质量发展
articles.title_en: Luxin Venture Capital Boosts High-Quality Sci-Tech Development in Shandong via "Patient Capital"
articles.summary_zh: 山东省国有创投机构鲁信创投通过“投早、投小、投长期、投硬科技”的策略，支持硅基仿生、艾恩半导体等企业，助力新质生产力发展。
articles.summary_en: Luxin Venture Capital, a state-owned firm in Shandong, supports "hard tech" and "new quality productive forces" by investing in early-stage companies such as Silicon Bio and Aien Semiconductor.

articles.title_zh: 民建中央开展2026年度重点考察调研推动未来产业突破
articles.title_en: CNDCA Conducts 2026 Key Research to Promote Breakthroughs in Future Industries
articles.summary_zh: 民建中央受中共中央委托，在上海、陕西开展关于强化源头创新与制度供给、推动未来产业实现新突破的重点考察调研。
articles.summary_en: Commissioned by the CPC Central Committee, the CNDCA conducted key research in Shanghai and Shaanxi to strengthen source innovation and institutional supply for future industries.

articles.title_zh: 全国首个澳洲坚果全产业链标准发布实施
articles.title_en: China's First Full-Industry Chain Standard for Macadamia Nuts Released and Implemented
articles.summary_zh: 云南省林业和草原局近日宣布，我国首个澳洲坚果全产业链标准《澳洲坚果栽培技术和质量要求》正式实施。
articles.summary_en: The Yunnan Provincial Forestry and Grassland Bureau announced the official implementation of China's first full-industry chain standard for Macadamia nuts, focusing on cultivation and quality.

articles.title_zh: 浙江省电力碳计量测试中心成立
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Provincial Electric Power Carbon Measurement and Testing Center Established
articles.summary_zh: 5月20日，经浙江省市场监督管理局批复，浙江省首个电力碳计量测试中心正式成立，旨在提供电力碳排放精准计量与溯源技术支撑。
articles.summary_en: On May 20, the Zhejiang Provincial Electric Power Carbon Measurement and Testing Center was officially established with approval from the provincial market regulation authority to provide technical support for precise carbon emission measurement.

articles.title_zh: 2026年全国夏收夏种气象服务启动
articles.title_en: 2026 National Summer Harvest and Planting Meteorological Services Launched
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月19日，中央气象台发布首份专报，正式启动全国夏收夏种气象服务，旨在保障夏季农业生产。
articles.summary_en: On May 19, 2026, the Central Meteorological Observatory released its first report, officially launching national meteorological services for summer harvest and planting to support agricultural production.
